description.zh-cn: 文化大革命（简称文革），是1966年5月16日至1976年10月6日发生在中国大陆，由毛泽东发动的一场重大政治运动。期间，中央书记处及总书记职务被撤销，大量领导人（如吴克华、钦本立、李富春等）受迫害，其中李富春因“二月逆流”事件受到严重迫害。地方机构瘫痪，高考中断，教育体系遭受严重破坏。重庆等地发生了大规模武斗。故宫作为“四旧”的象征面临被毁威胁，后在周恩来干预下得以保全。文革对中国社会影响深远，被后世负面评价为“十年内乱”、“十年浩劫”，并受邓小平等人全面否定。该运动结束后提出了“两个凡是”方针。
description.en: The Cultural Revolution (referred to as the Cultural Revolution), initiated by Mao Zedong, was a major political movement that occurred in mainland China from May 16, 1966, to October 6, 1976. During this period, the Central Secretariat and the General Secretary's positions were abolished, many leaders (such as Wu Kehua, Qin Benli, and Li Fuchun) were persecuted; among them, Li Fuchun was severely persecuted for his involvement in the 'February Countercurrent' incident. Local institutions were paralyzed, the Gaokao was suspended, and the education system was severely damaged. Large-scale armed conflicts occurred in Chongqing and other areas. The Forbidden City, as a symbol of the 'Four Olds', faced the threat of destruction but was preserved through the intervention of Zhou Enlai. The Cultural Revolution had a profound and lasting impact on Chinese society, being negatively evaluated by later generations as 'ten years of civil strife' or 'ten years of catastrophe', and was completely rejected by Deng Xiaoping and others. The 'Two Whatevers' policy was proposed after this movement ended.

description.zh-cn: 中国革命家、政治家、理论家，中国共产党、中国人民解放军和中华人民共和国的主要缔造者和第一代最高领导人，亦是中华人民共和国的开国领袖。他在遵义会议后恢复对红军的领导权，并在长征中逐步确立其核心领导地位。曾任中共中央委员会主席，是李富春担任中共中央政治局常委期间的直接上级。他领导了井冈山革命根据地建设和土地改革。执政期间，推行“一边倒”外交政策，促成《中苏友好同盟互助条约》签订，并领导了反右运动、大跃进和文化大革命。1972年，他还会见日方代表团，推动中日建交。其父毛贻昌与毛宁之父毛贻发同属贻字辈，为堂兄弟关系。
description.en: A Chinese revolutionary, politician, and theorist, and the main founder and first-generation paramount leader of the Communist Party of China, the People's Liberation Army, and the People's Republic of China, also the founding father of the People's Republic of China. He regained leadership over the Red Army after the Zunyi Conference and gradually established his core leadership position during the Long March. He served as Chairman of the Central Committee of the CPC, and was the direct superior of Li Fuchun during the latter's tenure as a member of the Politburo Standing Committee. He led the establishment of the Jinggang Mountains revolutionary base and the Land Reform Movement. During his rule, he pursued the 'Lean to One Side' foreign policy, facilitated the signing of the Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship, Alliance and Mutual Assistance, and led political movements such as the Anti-Rightist Movement, the Great Leap Forward, and the Cultural Revolution. In 1972, he also met the Japanese delegation to promote the establishment of diplomatic relations between China and Japan. His father, Mao Yichang, and Mao Ning's father, Mao Yifa, belonged to the same 'Yi' generation, indicating they were paternal cousins.

birth_place.zh-cn: 长沙府宁乡县花明楼镇炭子冲村

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国前主要领导人之一。早期曾在湖北省总工会担任向忠发的副手。后曾任中华人民共和国第二任主席、中共中央委员会副主席。他曾支持通过群众斗争进行土地改革，并推动了中国人民大学的建立。在七千人大会上，他批评大跃进，并将大饥荒成因归结为“三分天灾，七分人祸”，与毛泽东产生分歧。他曾率中共代表团出席苏共十九大，最终在文化大革命中被迫害致死。
description.en: A former major leader of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China. Early in his career, he served as Xiang Zhongfa's deputy at the Hubei Provincial General Labor Union. He later served as the second Chairman of the PRC and Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee. He supported carrying out land reform through mass struggles and promoted the establishment of Renmin University of China. At the Seven Thousand Cadres Conference, he criticized the Great Leap Forward, attributing the Great Famine to 'three parts natural disaster, seven parts man-made disaster', leading to disagreements with Mao Zedong. He led a CPC delegation to attend the 19th Congress of the CPSU and was ultimately persecuted to death during the Cultural Revolution.

birth_place.zh-cn: 四川省广安市广安区协兴镇牌坊村

death_place.zh-cn: 北京市海淀区中国人民解放军总医院

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国的主要领导人之一，第二代中央领导集体的核心人物，改革开放的总设计师。曾任晋冀鲁豫及第二野战军政治委员、中共中央书记处总书记。1977年复出后，他领导拨乱反正、平反冤假错案、恢复高考，并推动十一届三中全会确立改革开放路线。他提倡党政分开，提出“一国两制”，主导废除干部终身制，支持浦东开发，并推动中顾委撤销。他曾是李富春与蔡畅婚礼的证婚人，并在李富春追悼会上致悼词。晚年对八六学潮立场强硬，是六四戒严及清场的主要决策者。
description.en: A paramount leader of the Chinese Communist Party and the People's Republic of China, a core figure of the second generation of central leadership, and the chief architect of Reform and Opening-up. He served as Political Commissar of the Shanxi-Hebei-Shandong-Henan Field Army and the Second Field Army, and as General Secretary of the Central Secretariat of the CPC. After his rehabilitation in 1977, he led the rectification of errors, rehabilitated unjust cases, restored the Gaokao, and promoted the establishment of the reform and opening-up policy at the 3rd Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee. He advocated for the separation of party and government, proposed 'One Country, Two Systems,' abolished lifelong tenure for cadres, supported Pudong's development, and pushed for the abolition of the Central Advisory Commission. He was a witness at the wedding of Li Fuchun and Cai Chang, and delivered the eulogy at Li Fuchun's memorial service. In his later years, he took a hardline stance on the 1986 student demonstrations and was a key decision-maker for the June Fourth crackdown and clearance.

birth_place.zh-cn: 湖北省黄州府黄冈县回龙山镇林家大湾村

death_place.zh-cn: 蒙古人民共和国肯特省巴特瑙劳布县苏布拉嘎盆地

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国的现代政治人物、军事家，中华人民共和国元帅。曾任国防部部长、中共中央副主席、国务院副总理。他曾是原中国共产党和中华人民共和国主要领导人之一。在七千人大会上公开支持毛泽东路线，但私下对大跃进不满。毛泽东曾在中共九大上确立他为接班人，但庐山会议后分歧加剧。文革期间，他曾迫害贺龙，支持韦国清镇压造反派。最终在九一三事件中坠机身亡。
description.en: A modern Chinese politician and military strategist, Marshal of the People's Republic of China. He served as Minister of National Defense, Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee, and Vice Premier of the State Council. He was one of the former main leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China. At the Seven Thousand Cadres Conference, he publicly supported Mao Zedong's line but privately expressed dissatisfaction with the Great Leap Forward. Mao Zedong had designated him as his successor at the Ninth National Congress of the CPC, but disagreements intensified after the Lushan Conference. During the Cultural Revolution, he persecuted He Long and supported Wei Guoqing in suppressing rebels. He eventually died in a plane crash during the September 13th Incident.

birth_place.zh-cn: 清朝江苏省淮安府山阳县驸马巷

description.zh-cn: 中国政治家、革命家、军事家、外交家，中共、新中国及解放军创建者和领导人之一。向忠发任中共名义领袖期间，系实际负责人之一。长征初期作为“三人团”成员，遵义会议后与毛泽东、王稼祥组成新“三人团”，成为主要军事指挥者。曾任中华人民共和国首任国务院总理兼外交部长、全国政协主席；总理任上，系副总理李富春直接上级，文革期间李富春协助其主管经济。他领导南昌起义，促成《中苏友好同盟互助条约》、《中日联合声明》与《上海公报》签署。文革中，他努力维持国家运转并保护故宫，组建523项目，报告“六十一人案”中央知晓，并估计土改死亡83万人。
description.en: A Chinese politician, revolutionary, military leader, and diplomat, and one of the founders and leaders of the CCP, the People's Republic of China, and the PLA. During Xiang Zhongfa's nominal leadership of the CCP, he was one of the actual leaders. In the early Long March, he was a member of the 'Trio', and after the Zunyi Conference, formed a new 'Trio' with Mao Zedong and Wang Jiaxiang, becoming a key military commander. He served as the first Premier of the State Council and Minister of Foreign Affairs of the PRC, and Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee. As Premier, he was the direct superior of Vice Premier Li Fuchun, who also assisted him in managing economic work during the Cultural Revolution. He led the Nanchang Uprising and facilitated the signing of the Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship, Alliance and Mutual Assistance, the Sino-Japanese Joint Communiqué, and the Shanghai Communiqué. During the Cultural Revolution, he strove to maintain normal state operations and protected the Forbidden City, established Project 523, reported the Central Committee's awareness of the 'Case of the 61', and estimated 830,000 deaths during land reform.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东第四任妻子，毛岸青继母，中国政治人物、演员、文艺理论家，原国家级副职领导人，曾任中央文化革命小组副组长。她是文化大革命期间中国共产党的主要领导人之一，“四人帮”之首，魏京生在文革期间曾对其产生怀疑。
description.en: Mao Zedong's fourth wife and a prominent member of the Gang of Four, of whom Wei Jingsheng became suspicious during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命时期中华人民共和国的重要政治人物，中国共产党高级领导人。作为“四人帮”核心成员，曾任上海市革委会主任、中央文革小组副组长、中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理。被《“571工程”纪要》视为林彪的主要政治对手。在“林彪、江青反革命集团案”中被判处死刑，缓期两年执行。
description.en: An important political figure and a high-ranking leader of the Communist Party of China during the Cultural Revolution. As a core member of the 'Gang of Four', he served as Director of the Shanghai Revolutionary Committee, Deputy Head of the Central Cultural Revolution Group, Standing Committee Member of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau, and Vice Premier of the State Council. He was also considered by the 'Project 571 Outline' as Lin Biao's main political rival. He was sentenced to death with a two-year reprieve in the 'Case of the Lin Biao and Jiang Qing Counter-revolutionary Cliques'.

birth_place.zh-cn: 浙江省诸暨县直埠镇姚公埠村

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，“四人帮”成员之一。他曾任中央文革小组成员，是文革的理论旗手，并发表《评新编历史剧〈海瑞罢官〉》。与张春桥等人一同被《“571工程”纪要》称为“文人力量”。作为中国文化大革命时期的重要政治人物，原国家级副职领导人，他在“林彪、江青反革命集团案”中被判处有期徒刑。
description.en: A Chinese politician and a member of the 'Gang of Four'. He served as a member of the Central Cultural Revolution Group, was a theoretical standard-bearer of the Cultural Revolution, and published 'Critique of the New Historical Drama 'Hai Rui Dismissed from Office''. Along with Zhang Chunqiao and others, he was referred to as the 'literati force' in the 'Project 571 Outline'. As an important political figure during China's Cultural Revolution and a former national deputy leader, he was sentenced to imprisonment in the 'Case of the Lin Biao and Jiang Qing Counter-revolutionary Cliques'.

birth_place.zh-cn: 吉林省长春市绿园区西新镇开源村

death_place.zh-cn: 北京市首都医科大学附属复兴医院

description.zh-cn: “四人帮”成员之一，中国政治人物。曾任中共中央副主席、中共中央政治局常委等正国级领导职务。在“林彪、江青反革命集团案”中被判处无期徒刑。
description.en: A Chinese politician and a member of the 'Gang of Four'. He served as a national-level leader, including Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee and Standing Committee member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee. He was sentenced to life imprisonment in the 'Lin Biao, Jiang Qing Counter-revolutionary Cliques case'.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东指定的接班人。在他逝世后，他领导粉碎“四人帮”，成为中国最高领导人。作为中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，他在文化大革命结束后，曾兼任中共中央主席、国务院总理和中央军委主席，是至今唯一一位同时出任党政军三大最高领导职务的领导人。他提出了“两个凡是”的执政原则。
description.en: Mao Zedong's designated successor, who led the smashing of the 'Gang of Four' after Mao's death, becoming China's paramount leader. A Chinese politician, he served as Chairman of the CCP Central Committee, Premier of the State Council, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission after the Cultural Revolution. He is the only leader to have simultaneously held these three highest party, government, and military positions. He is known for proposing the 'Two Whatevers' governing principle.

birth_place.zh-cn: 广东省嘉应直隶州雁洋

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，中华人民共和国开国元帅，中共元老之一，中国共产党和中华人民共和国的创建者和缔造者之一。长征期间曾任红军前敌指挥部参谋长，在张国焘与毛泽东分裂时起关键作用。他曾任全国人大常委会委员长、中共中央副主席、国防部部长等职。领导广东土改时因政策温和受毛泽东批评。在“二月逆流”中对文化大革命进行抗争。在粉碎“四人帮”中起决定性作用，并提出设立台湾特别行政区的构想。他支持关于真理标准问题的讨论。他也是凌孜的父亲。
description.en: A Chinese politician, one of the founding marshals of the People's Republic of China, and a veteran of the Communist Party of China. During the Long March, he served as the Chief of Staff of the Red Army's Frontline Command and played a crucial role during the split between Zhang Guotao and Mao Zedong. He served as Chairman of the NPC Standing Committee, Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee, and Minister of National Defense. He was criticized by Mao Zedong for his moderate land reform policies in Guangdong. He, along with Li Fuchun and others, resisted the Cultural Revolution during the 'February Countercurrent'. He played a decisive role in the smashing of the Gang of Four, proposed establishing a special administrative region for Taiwan, and supported the discussion on the criterion of truth. He was also Ling Zi's father.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物、原正国级领导人，文化大革命时期重要人物。他曾任中共中央办公厅主任、中央警卫部队领导，直接参与并负责粉碎“四人帮”事件的具体执行，深度参与了怀仁堂事变。阎明复任中央办公厅翻译组组长后期，汪东兴是其直接上级。他也是“凡是派”的主要成员之一，支持“两个凡是”原则，并曾阻挠为六十一人叛徒集团案平反。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, a former state-level leader, and an important figure during the Cultural Revolution. He served as Director of the General Office of the CCP Central Committee and led the Central Security Forces, directly participating in and responsible for the specific execution of smashing the 'Gang of Four' incident, including deep involvement in the Huairentang Incident. During the latter part of Yan Mingfu's tenure as head of the translation group of the General Office, Wang Dongxing was his direct superior. He was also one of the main members of the 'Whatever Faction', supporting the 'Two Whatevers' principle, and once obstructed the rehabilitation of the Case of the 61 Renegades.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国前主要领导人之一。曾任中国共产党安全和情报部长、中共中央副主席、中央文革小组顾问。他是文化大革命的主要人物和关键支持者之一，四人帮集团主犯，并因文革罪行受到批判。他也是“六十一人叛徒集团案”的主要制造者之一。在“反党小说《刘志丹》案”中起主要作用。死后被认定为林彪、江青反革命集团主犯之一，同时也是一位书法家。
description.en: A former major leader of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China. He served as Minister of Public Security, Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee, and advisor to the Central Cultural Revolution Group. As a key figure and supporter of the Cultural Revolution, he was a principal culprit of the 'Gang of Four' and was criticized for his crimes during the Cultural Revolution. He was also one of the main fabricators of the 'Case of the 61 Renegades' and played a key role in the 'Liu Zhidan Anti-Party Novel Case'. After his death, he was identified as one of the principal culprits of the Lin Biao and Jiang Qing counter-revolutionary cliques. He was also a calligrapher.

birth_place.zh-cn: 福建省泉州市惠安县洛阳镇梅岭村
birth_place.en: Meiling Village, Luoyang Town, Hui'an County, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国前政治人物及理论家，原国家级正职领导人。曾长期担任毛泽东的政治秘书，在文化大革命期间担任中共中央政治局常委、中央文革小组组长。九届二中全会后被隔离审查，后被划入林彪反革命集团，也是四人帮集团主犯之一。
description.en: A former political figure and theorist of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and a former national-level principal leader. He served as Mao Zedong's political secretary for a long time. During the Cultural Revolution, he served as a Standing Committee Member of the CPC Politburo and Head of the Central Cultural Revolution Group. He was placed under isolation review after the Second Plenary Session of the Ninth Central Committee, and later classified as a member of the Lin Biao Counter-revolutionary Group and a principal offender of the Gang of Four.

death_place.zh-cn: 北京市东城区北京医院

description.zh-cn: 彭真，伟大的无产阶级革命家、政治家、杰出的国务活动家、坚定的马克思主义者，我国社会主义法制的主要奠基人，党和国家的卓越领导人之一，中共八大元老之一。曾任北京市委第一书记、文化革命五人小组组长。文化大革命初期被打倒，并在“彭、罗、陆、杨反党集团案”中首当其冲。复出后，曾任全国人民代表大会常务委员会委员长、宪法修改委员会副主任委员。阎明复任全国人大常委会副秘书长期间，彭真是其直接上级。
description.en: Peng Zhen was a great proletarian revolutionary, politician, outstanding statesman, staunch Marxist, and a principal founder of China's socialist legal system. He was one of the eminent leaders of the Party and state, and one of the Eight Elders of the CCP. He served as the First Secretary of the Beijing Municipal Party Committee and head of the Five-Man Group for the Cultural Revolution. He was purged during the early stages of the Cultural Revolution, being the primary target in the 'Peng, Luo, Lu, Yang Anti-Party Clique' case. After his rehabilitation, he served as Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress and Deputy Chairman of the Constitution Revision Committee. When Yan Mingfu served as Deputy Secretary-General of the NPC Standing Committee, Peng Zhen was his direct superior.

birth_place.zh-cn: 大清四川省顺庆府南充县
birth_place.en: Nanchong County, Shunqing Prefecture, Sichuan Province, Great Qing

death_place.zh-cn: 西德巴登-符腾堡州海德堡

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国副国级领导人之一，无产阶级革命家、军事家、开国大将。曾任中共中央书记处书记、国务院副总理、中华人民共和国公安部首任部长、国防部副部长、解放军总参谋长等职。在文革初期被打倒，是“彭、罗、陆、杨反党集团案”成员之一，被授予中国人民解放军大将军衔。
description.en: One of the sub-national leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, a proletarian revolutionary, military strategist, and a founding General. He served as Secretary of the CPC Central Secretariat, Vice Premier of the State Council, the first Minister of Public Security of the PRC, Deputy Minister of National Defense, and Chief of the PLA General Staff. He was purged during the Cultural Revolution as a member of the 'Peng, Luo, Lu, Yang Anti-Party Clique' and was awarded the rank of PLA General.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国的领导人之一，曾任中宣部部长、国务院副总理。在文革初期被指控为“彭、罗、陆、杨反党集团案”成员之一而被打倒。
description.en: One of the leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, former head of the Propaganda Department of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council. He was denounced as a member of the 'Peng, Luo, Lu, Yang Anti-Party Clique' case during the early stages of the Cultural Revolution.

birth_place.zh-cn: 清四川省潼川府遂宁县双江镇
birth_place.en: Shuangjiang Town, Suining County, Tongchuan Prefecture, Sichuan Province, Qing Dynasty

death_place.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国北京市中国人民解放军总医院
death_place.en: General Hospital of the People's Liberation Army, Beijing, People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物、主要领导人之一、原国家级正职领导人、中国人民解放军高级将领。他曾于1938年在延安与李富春等人合影，后接替其担任中共中央书记处办公厅主任，也曾任中共中央办公厅主任。文革初期被打倒。历任中华人民共和国主席、中共中央政治局委员、中共中央军委副主席兼秘书长，是中共八大元老之一。他曾负责部署军队执行戒严；并以实际行动支持废除领导职务终身制。
description.en: A Chinese politician, one of the paramount leaders, former national-level state leader, and high-ranking general of the People's Liberation Army. In 1938, he was photographed with Li Fuchun and others in Yan'an and later succeeded Li Fuchun as Director of the General Office of the Central Secretariat. He also served as Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and was purged during the early stages of the Cultural Revolution. His career also included serving as President of the People's Republic of China, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, and Vice Chairman and Secretary-General of the Central Military Commission. He was one of the Eight Elders of the CPC. He was responsible for deploying troops for martial law and demonstrated support for abolishing the lifelong tenure system for leading positions through his own retirement.

birth_place.zh-cn: 清朝湖南省湘潭县石潭镇

death_place.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国北京市海淀区中国人民解放军总医院

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国的杰出领导人之一，中华人民共和国元帅，中国人民解放军的创建者与领导者之一，军事家、政治家。曾任原红三军团军团长，八路军副总指挥、第一野战军司令员，在朝鲜战争期间担任中国人民志愿军首任司令员兼政治委员，是《朝鲜停战协定》的签署人之一，并在粟裕任总参谋长时任国防部长。他参与创建了井冈山革命根据地，后于1930年因杀害袁文才、王佐而被迫率部撤离。1938年曾在延安与李富春等人合影。1958年曾批判粟裕，后在庐山会议上因批评大跃进而被打倒，最终在文化大革命中被迫害致死。
description.en: One of the prominent leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, a Marshal of the PRC, and one of the founders and leaders of the People's Liberation Army. He was a military strategist and politician. He served as former commander of the 3rd Army Group of the Red Army, Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Eighth Route Army, Commander of the First Field Army, and the first Commander and Political Commissar of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army during the Korean War, and was one of the signatories of the Korean Armistice Agreement. He later served as Minister of National Defense when Su Yu was Chief of the General Staff. He participated in establishing the Jinggangshan Revolutionary Base, but was later forced to withdraw his troops in 1930 after the killing of Yuan Wencai and Wang Zuo. In 1938, he was photographed with Li Fuchun and others in Yan'an. In 1958, he criticized Su Yu. He was purged during the Lushan Conference for criticizing the Great Leap Forward and subsequently persecuted to death during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国元帅，中国工农红军与中国人民解放军的主要创始人之一，南昌起义领导人之一。他曾任红二方面军总指挥，是长征期间重要的军事领导人。曾任中华人民共和国国务院副总理、中央军事委员会副主席，并主持修建了大田湾体育场。在文化大革命中被迫害致死。
description.en: A Marshal of the People's Republic of China, one of the principal founders of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army and the People's Liberation Army, and a leader of the Nanchang Uprising. He served as Commander-in-Chief of the Second Front Army and was an important military leader during the Long March. He also served as Vice Premier of the State Council and Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission, and presided over the construction of Datianwan Stadium. He was persecuted to death during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国的领导人之一，原中共中央政治局常委。他曾被毛泽东派往广东以激进方式推进土地改革，并在当地担任主要领导职务。后曾任中央文革小组顾问。在文化大革命中被打倒并迫害致死。
description.en: One of the leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and a former member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee. He was sent by Mao Zedong to Guangdong to advance land reform in a radical manner, and held major leadership positions there. Later, he served as an advisor to the Central Cultural Revolution Group. He was overthrown and persecuted to death during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 明史学家、中国历史学家，因其剧作《海瑞罢官》在文革初期受到批判，被迫害致死。北京市副市长。
中国近现代小说家、散文家、剧作家，被广泛认为是中国近现代文学的代表人物。在文革初期因不堪迫害而投湖自尽。
中国著名翻译家，在文革初期与夫人一同自尽。

中国共产党和中华人民共和国第二代主要领导人之一，著名的中国政治家，曾任中共中央主席、总书记，被认为是团派的创始人，也是“求是派”的重要成员。文革后，他审定了《实践是检验真理的唯一标准》一文，与邓小平共同主导“拨乱反正”，主持平反冤假错案，推动改革开放并支持废除干部终身制，是改革开放早期的主要领导人之一，被视为改革派代表人物。1986年因处理八六学潮被批评并辞职。其逝世是六四事件的导火索，为纪念他，《世界经济导报》刊文引发政治事件并被停刊。
description.en: One of the second generation of principal leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, a prominent Chinese politician. He served as Chairman and General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee, considered the founder of the Tuanpai (Youth League Faction) and a key member of the "Pragmatist Faction." After the Cultural Revolution, he reviewed and approved the article "Practice is the Sole Criterion for Testing Truth," co-led the "Boluan Fanzheng" (rectifying past errors) with Deng Xiaoping, presided over the redress of unjust, false, and wrong cases, and promoted reform and opening up, supporting the abolition of lifelong tenure for cadres. He was one of the main leaders in the early stages of Reform and Opening-up and was regarded as a representative of reformists. In 1986, he was criticized and resigned due to his handling of the 1986 student demonstrations. His death was a catalyst for the Tiananmen Square protests of 1989, and a political incident, leading to the shutdown of the 'World Economic Herald', was sparked by its commemorative article.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国前主要领导人、政治人物，中国改革派领导人。曾任国务院总理（于1980年9月接替华国锋）和中共中央总书记。早期被毛泽东派往广东参与并推进激进的土地改革工作，被视为中共党内改革派领袖。在胡耀邦辞职后代理中共中央总书记，他通过讲话限制了“反对资产阶级自由化”运动的扩大化，使其在1987年夏天基本结束。文革后支持改革开放，但在六四事件中，因同情学生运动、反对戒严而被免去中共中央总书记职务并被长期软禁。在阎明复任中共中央书记处书记期间，赵紫阳是其直接上级。
description.en: A prominent political figure, former major leader of the Chinese Communist Party and the People's Republic of China, and a Chinese reformist leader. He served as Premier of the State Council (succeeding Hua Guofeng in September 1980) and General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee. In his early career, he was sent by Mao Zedong to Guangdong to participate in and promote radical land reform, where he was regarded as a reformist leader. After Hu Yaobang's resignation, he became the acting General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee, curbing the 'Anti-Bourgeois Liberalization Campaign' in 1987. Supporting reform and opening up after the Cultural Revolution, he was dismissed from his post as General Secretary and placed under long-term house arrest for sympathizing with student movements and opposing martial law during the Tiananmen Square incident. He was also Yan Mingfu's direct superior when Yan served as a secretary of the CPC Central Secretariat.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治家，齐桥桥的弟弟，中国共产党第五代中央领导集体的核心人物。自2012年起担任中华人民共和国最高领导人，现任中国共产党中央委员会总书记、中华人民共和国主席、中央军事委员会主席。他被官方认定为习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想的主要创立者，并于任内通过宪法修正案取消了国家主席的任期限制。其间，他提出“一带一路”倡议，签署并公布了《香港国安法》，并通过反腐运动等措施削弱并边缘化了团派的政治影响力。一些政策被部分学者视为可能导致“文革2.0”。
description.en: Younger brother of Qi Qiaoqiao, he is a Chinese politician and core figure of the fifth generation of central leadership of the Communist Party of China. He has served as the supreme leader of the People's Republic of China since 2012, currently holding the titles of General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President of the PRC, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission. He is officially recognized as the main founder of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, and during his tenure, a constitutional amendment was passed to remove the term limit for the presidency. During this period, he proposed the 'Belt and Road' initiative, signed and promulgated the Hong Kong National Security Law, and weakened and marginalized the political influence of the Tuanpai (Youth League Faction) through measures such as the anti-corruption campaign. Some of his policies are considered by certain scholars to potentially lead to a 'Cultural Revolution 2.0'.

en: Member of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党是中华人民共和国的执政党，也是土地改革运动的发起者和领导者。该党根据列宁主义，领导无产阶级专政。它在第二次国共内战中取得胜利并建立了中华人民共和国。历史上，曾于井冈山建立革命根据地，领导抗日武装力量并进行长征。曾是四一二事件主要被清剿对象，后中原大战使其得以发展。因法轮功的迅速发展和意识形态差异，发起了镇压运动。李达、艾跃进、李富春等多人曾是其党员，其中李富春曾长期担任重要领导职务。
description.en: The Chinese Communist Party is the ruling party of the People's Republic of China and the initiator and leader of the Land Reform Movement. Following Leninism, it leads the dictatorship of the proletariat. It triumphed in the Chinese Civil War and established the People's Republic of China. Historically, it established revolutionary bases in Jinggangshan, led anti-Japanese armed forces, and conducted the Long March. It was a primary target during the April 12th Incident but later developed during the Central Plains War. Due to the rapid growth of Falun Gong and ideological differences, it initiated a suppression campaign. Many, including Li Da, Ai Yuejin, and Li Fuchun, were its members, with Li Fuchun holding important leadership positions for a long time.

description.zh-cn: 红卫兵是文化大革命时期中国大陆对大、中学生自发成立的群众组织的统称。他们以青年学生为主体，是文革初期冲击社会秩序的主要力量，进行了破四旧、大串联等活动，是“破四旧”运动的主要执行者。
description.en: Red Guards were a general term for mass organizations spontaneously formed by high school and university students in mainland China during the Cultural Revolution. Composed mainly of young students, they were the primary force impacting social order in the early stages of the Cultural Revolution, carrying out activities such as 'Destroy the Four Olds' and 'Great Link-ups', and were the main executors of the 'Destroy the Four Olds' movement.

location.zh-cn: 北京市海淀区钓鱼台国宾馆

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间中国共产党的最高领导机构之一，也是文化大革命的实际指挥机构。它实际取代了中央政治局和中央书记处的职能。
description.en: One of the highest leading bodies of the Chinese Communist Party during the Cultural Revolution and its actual command institution. It effectively replaced the functions of the Politburo and the Secretariat.

description.zh-cn: 由王洪文、张春桥、江青、姚文元四人组成的中共党内政治集团，在文化大革命期间形成并掌握重要权力。
description.en: A political faction composed of Wang Hongwen, Zhang Chunqiao, Jiang Qing, and Yao Wenyuan during the Cultural Revolution.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院
en: State Council of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国最高国家行政机关，是最高国家权力机关的执行机关，也是《中华人民共和国治安管理处罚法》的提案方。其前身是1949年设立的中央人民政府政务院。作为中央人民政府行政机构，国务院本身亦是中央人民政府。李富春曾任其副总理。1961年，国务院将故宫列为第一批全国重点文物保护单位。
description.en: The highest state administrative organ of the People's Republic of China, serving as the executive body of the supreme organ of state power, and the proposer of the 'Public Security Administration Punishments Law of the People's Republic of China'. Its predecessor was the Government Administration Council of the Central People's Government, established in 1949. As an administrative organ of the Central People's Government, the State Council itself is also the Central People's Government. Li Fuchun served as its Vice Premier. In 1961, the State Council listed the Forbidden City as one of the first National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units.

description.zh-cn: 文革前夕负责文化工作的领导小组，由彭真领导，后被撤销。中央文化革命小组的前身，由彭真担任组长。
文化大革命期间中国各级政权的临时领导机构，通常是在夺权后成立。地区的革命委员会取代了专区行政公署。
description.en: Provisional organs of power at all levels in China during the Cultural Revolution. The prefectural revolutionary committees replaced the special administrative offices.

description.zh-cn: 指1950年代末期中国共产党在中国大陆推行的“社会主义建设总路线、大跃进、人民公社”三项政策和运动。这是文化大革命前的政治运动，其挫败也是文化大革命的背景之一，并被普遍认为是导致三年困难时期的直接原因。
description.en: Refers to the three policies and movements promoted by the Communist Party of China in mainland China in the late 1950s: the General Line for Socialist Construction, the Great Leap Forward, and the People's Communes. This political movement preceded the Cultural Revolution, and its failures were a contributing factor to the Cultural Revolution, also widely considered the direct cause of the Three Years of Great Famine.

description.zh-cn: 指中华人民共和国于1959年至1961年间因三面红旗运动而发生全国性饥荒的一段时期，部分学者也将1958年、1962年划入饥荒时期。此次大饥荒共造成中国大陆1500万至5500万人的非正常死亡，被广泛视为人类历史上规模最大的饥荒之一，并导致毛泽东退居二线。此后，李富春提出了“八字方针”以调整国民经济。
description.en: Refers to a period of nationwide famine in the People's Republic of China from 1959 to 1961, caused by the Three Red Banners movement. Some scholars also include the years 1958 and 1962 in this famine period. The Great Famine caused 15 to 55 million excess deaths in mainland China and is widely regarded as one of the largest famines in human history. This famine also led to Mao Zedong's semi-retirement. Afterwards, Li Fuchun proposed the 'Eight-Character Policy' to adjust the national economy.

description.zh-cn: 1962年初，中共中央召开扩大的中央工作会议，旨在总结大跃进的经验教训，统一认识，加强团结。会上，刘少奇提出“三分天灾，七分人祸”的观点，加剧了与毛泽东的矛盾。毛泽东作了自我批评，并退居二线。
description.en: In early 1962, the CPC Central Committee held an enlarged Central Work Conference to summarize the experiences and lessons of the 'Great Leap Forward,' unify understanding, and strengthen unity. At the conference, Liu Shaoqi proposed the view of 'three parts natural disaster, seven parts man-made disaster,' which exacerbated the conflict with Mao Zedong. Mao Zedong made a self-criticism and retreated to the second line of leadership.

description.zh-cn: 大跃进失败后，毛泽东为解决干部作风和经济管理等问题，于1963年起在中国城乡开展了社会主义教育运动，即“四清”运动（清政治、清经济、清组织、清思想）。该运动加剧了毛泽东与刘少奇之间的矛盾，被视为文化大革命的预演或前奏。
description.en: After the failure of the Great Leap Forward, Mao Zedong launched the Socialist Education Movement (also known as the 'Four Clean-ups' campaign – cleaning up politics, economy, organization, and ideology) in urban and rural China starting in 1963 to address issues such as cadre conduct and economic management. This movement exacerbated the conflict between Mao Zedong and Liu Shaoqi and is widely regarded as a prelude or rehearsal for the Cultural Revolution.

zh-cn: 破除旧思想、旧文化、旧风俗、旧习惯

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国文化大革命初期，以大、中学生红卫兵为主力发起的社会运动，旨在破除旧思想、旧文化、旧风俗、旧习惯。这场运动对文物古迹和传统文化造成了巨大破坏。
description.en: A social movement during the early stages of the Cultural Revolution in the People's Republic of China, primarily carried out by Red Guards from high schools and universities, aimed at destroying the 'Four Olds': Old Ideas, Old Culture, Old Customs, and Old Habits. This movement caused immense damage to cultural relics and traditional culture.

description.zh-cn: 文革初期全国范围的红卫兵流动交流活动。
1966年8月，文化大革命初期，红卫兵运动在北京进入最为暴力的阶段，发生大规模的批斗、抄家、暴力事件和屠杀，同时“破四旧”运动也在此期间逐渐升级。
description.en: In August 1966, during the early stage of the Cultural Revolution, the Red Guard movement in Beijing entered its most violent phase, marked by widespread struggle sessions, home raids, violence, and mass killings, while the 'Destroy the Four Olds' campaign also gradually escalated during this period.

description.zh-cn: 上海工人造反派于1967年1月在上海夺取党政大权的事件，开启了全国范围的夺权运动，并加剧了全国范围内的派系斗争。
description.en: The January 1967 power seizure by Shanghai worker rebel factions, which initiated a nationwide power seizure movement and intensified factional struggles across the country.

description.zh-cn: 全国范围的造反派夺取各级党政机关权力的运动。
文化大革命期间各派群众组织之间发生的大规模武装暴力冲突事件，导致全面内战状态。其中，重庆的武斗尤为激烈。
description.en: Large-scale violent conflicts that occurred during the Cultural Revolution. The struggles in Chongqing were particularly intense.

description.zh-cn: 文革用语之一。文攻指口诛笔伐，武卫指用武力捍卫。

en: Up to the Mountains and Down to the Countryside Movement

description.zh-cn: 文革期间，中华人民共和国在1960年代末至1970年代末组织了数千万知识青年被派往农村地区进行劳动，接受再教育的政治运动。这场运动导致了红卫兵运动的停止，习近平也曾参与其中。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, the People's Republic of China organized a political movement from the late 1960s to the late 1970s, sending tens of millions of educated urban youth to rural areas for labor and re-education. This movement led to the cessation of the Red Guard movement, and Xi Jinping also participated.

description.zh-cn: 文革中期全国范围的政治清洗运动，造成大量冤假错案。

zh-cn: 中国共产党第九次全国代表大会
en: 9th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party

description.zh-cn: 在文革高潮中召开的中共全国代表大会，将林彪确立为毛泽东的接班人并写入党章。

location.zh-cn: 蒙古人民共和国温都尔汗

description.zh-cn: 1971年9月13日，中共中央副主席林彪及其家人乘机叛逃苏联途中，飞机在蒙古温都尔汗坠毁，机上人员全部遇难，标志着林彪集团的覆灭。此次政治事件对中国政局产生深远影响，梁兴初等人因此受到牵连。
description.en: On September 13, 1971, Lin Biao, Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee, along with his family, attempted to defect to the Soviet Union by plane, which subsequently crashed in Öndörkhaan, Mongolia, killing everyone on board. This political event marked the demise of the Lin Biao group, had a profound impact on Chinese politics, and implicated figures such as Liang Xingchu.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命后期，由毛泽东发动、江青等人积极推行的政治运动。名义上批判林彪和孔子，实则针对周恩来等人。

en: Criticize Deng and Counter-attack the Right-Deviationist Verdict-Reversal Trend

description.zh-cn: 中国文化大革命末期由毛泽东发起的最后一次大规模政治运动，旨在批判邓小平在1975年推行的整顿政策，导致其第三次被打倒。
description.en: The last large-scale political movement of the Cultural Revolution in China, initiated by Mao Zedong to criticize the rectification policies implemented by Deng Xiaoping in 1975, which led to his third political downfall.

description.zh-cn: 1976年4月在天安门广场发生的，以悼念周恩来、抗议“四人帮”为主题的群众自发抗议运动，后被定性为反革命事件。
description.en: A spontaneous mass protest movement that took place in Tiananmen Square in April 1976, centered on mourning Zhou Enlai and protesting the 'Gang of Four', which was later characterized as a counter-revolutionary incident.

description.zh-cn: 1976年10月6日，由时任中共中央第一副主席华国锋、中共中央副主席叶剑英、中共中央办公厅主任汪东兴等人策划发动，在北京市中南海怀仁堂拘捕“四人帮”及其在北京的骨干成员的政治事件，标志着文化大革命的结束。
description.en: A political event planned by Hua Guofeng, then First Vice Chairman of the CCP Central Committee, Ye Jianying, Vice Chairman of the CCP Central Committee, and Wang Dongxing, Director of the CCP General Office, to arrest the Gang of Four and their associates.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命结束后，由邓小平等人领导的，旨在纠正文革期间及以前“左倾”错误的思想、政治、组织、政策等一系列举措的统称。真理标准大讨论是其重要组成部分，该运动也为改革开放奠定了基础。
description.en: Led by Deng Xiaoping and others after the Cultural Revolution, this movement was a comprehensive term for a series of measures aimed at correcting the 'leftist' errors in ideology, politics, organization, and policy during and before the Cultural Revolution. The discussion on the criterion for truth was a crucial part of it, and the movement also laid the foundation for reform and opening up.

description.zh-cn: 文革结束后，由邓小平等人启动，中华人民共和国于1978年12月起推行的一项以经济建设为中心，对内改革、对外开放为核心的社会经济政策与运动，始于中共十一届三中全会。真理标准大讨论为其奠定了思想基础。这项政策带来的思想解放氛围，也为后来的八六学潮提供了宏观背景。
description.en: Initiated by Deng Xiaoping and others after the Cultural Revolution, this socio-economic policy and movement, centered on economic development, internal reform, and external opening, was implemented by the People's Republic of China starting in December 1978, officially commencing at the Third Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee of the CCP. The 'Discussion on the Criterion for Truth' laid its ideological groundwork. The atmosphere of intellectual liberation fostered by this policy also provided the macro context for the later 1986 student demonstrations.

zh-cn: 林彪、江青反革命集团案
最高人民法院特别法庭
en: Case of the Lin Biao and Jiang Qing Counter-revolutionary Cliques
Lin Biao and Jiang Qing Counter-revolutionary Cliques
Special Court of the Supreme People's Court
Trial of the Gang of Four and the Lin Biao Counter-Revolutionary Clique
Trial of the Lin Biao and Jiang Qing Counter-revolutionary Cliques

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国最高人民法院专门设立特别法庭，对林彪、江青两个反革命集团案的10名主犯进行公开审判。林彪集团和四人帮是文化大革命后，中华人民共和国政府对该反革命集团的官方称谓。
description.en: The Special Tribunal of the Supreme People's Court of the People's Republic of China was specifically established for the public trial of the ten principal offenders from the Lin Biao and Jiang Qing counter-revolutionary cliques. The Lin Biao clique and the Gang of Four was the official designation by the PRC government for this counter-revolutionary group after the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 民主柬埔寨（红色高棉）时期，由柬埔寨红色高棉政权进行的大规模屠杀事件，受中国文革影响。
法国发生的学生和工人抗议运动，受到中国文革的影响。
文化大革命发生的主要地点。指中华人民共和国实际管辖的领土，不包括香港、澳门和台湾。
description.en: Refers to the territory under the actual jurisdiction of the People's Republic of China, excluding Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 全称《中国共产党中央委员会通知》，是指导“文化大革命”的纲领性文件，标志着文革的全面发动。

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会关于无产阶级文化大革命的决定
en: Decision of the Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party on the Great Proletarian Cultural Revolution

description.zh-cn: 简称“十六条”，是中共中央于1966年8月8日中共八届十一中全会通过的关于“文化大革命”的纲领性文件。它肯定了“破四旧”的目标，并赋予中央文革小组极大的权力。
description.en: Known as the 'Sixteen Articles', it is a programmatic document on the 'Cultural Revolution' passed by the Eleventh Plenary Session of the 8th Central Committee of the CCP on August 8, 1966. It affirmed the goal of 'Destroying the Four Olds' and granted immense power to the Central Cultural Revolution Group.

zh-cn: 评新编历史剧《海瑞罢官》
评新编历史剧〈海瑞罢官〉
en: Commentary on the New Historical Drama 'Hai Rui Dismissed from Office'
On the New Historical Drama 'Hai Rui Dismissed from Office'

description.zh-cn: 由姚文元撰写的批判文章，被认为是文化大革命的导火索之一。
全称《关于当前学术讨论的汇报提纲》，由彭真等人草拟，试图将对《海瑞罢官》的批判局限于学术范围，后被撤销。由彭真主持的文化革命五人小组起草的报告提纲，试图将学术批判限制在学术范围内，后遭毛泽东严厉批评。

zh-cn: 炮打司令部——我的一张大字报

description.zh-cn: 由毛泽东撰写，矛头直指刘少奇和邓小平。

zh-cn: 关于建国以来党的若干历史问题的决议
en: Resolution on Certain Questions in the History of Our Party since the Founding of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 由中国共产党第十一届中央委员会第六次全体会议通过的历史决议，是中共中央对建国以来若干重大历史问题作出的官方定论文件。该决议全面否定文化大革命，并对毛泽东的功过进行了评价，其中认定他在文革中犯有严重错误。
description.en: A historical resolution passed by the Sixth Plenary Session of the 11th CPC Central Committee, it is an official conclusion document by the CPC Central Committee on several major historical issues since the founding of the PRC. This resolution fully repudiated the Cultural Revolution and evaluated Mao Zedong's merits and demerits, concluding that he made serious mistakes during the Cultural Revolution.

zh-cn: 约瑟夫·维萨里奥诺维奇·斯大林

description.zh-cn: 苏联政治家、最高领导人，曾任苏共中央委员会总书记、部长会议主席。二战期间同盟国“三巨头”之一，在雅尔塔会议承诺对日作战，苏联出兵对日本投降影响重大。为扩大东亚影响力，他与毛泽东领导的中国签订新同盟条约，并帮助建立人民大学。他曾接见并重视向忠发，推动其党内晋升。赫鲁晓夫对其的全盘否定是中苏论战和文革的重要背景。
description.en: Soviet politician and supreme leader, who served as General Secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union and Chairman of the Council of Ministers. As one of the 'Big Three' Allied leaders during World War II, he promised at the Yalta Conference to enter the war against Japan, and the subsequent Soviet invasion significantly impacted Japan's decision to surrender. For strategic considerations of expanding Soviet influence in East Asia, he agreed to sign a new alliance treaty with Mao Zedong's China and decided to assist China in establishing Renmin University. He also met with and showed appreciation for Xiang Zhongfa, promoting his advancement within the party. Khrushchev's complete repudiation of him served as an important background for the Sino-Soviet split and the Cultural Revolution.

zh-cn: 关于个人崇拜及其后果
en: On the Cult of Personality and Its Consequences

description.zh-cn: 赫鲁晓夫在苏共二十大上发表的秘密报告，全盘否定斯大林，深刻影响了毛泽东。
文化大革命前夕对彭真、罗瑞卿、陆定一、杨尚昆等人的政治清洗运动，他们被打成“反党集团”。
description.en: A political purge against Peng Zhen, Luo Ruiqing, Lu Dingyi, and Yang Shangkun on the eve of the Cultural Revolution, in which they were labeled an 'anti-Party clique'.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会
en: Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 1927年由中国共产党中央执行委员会改组而来，是中国共产党的最高领导机构和中央权力机关。它由中国共产党全国代表大会选举产生中央政治局、中央政治局常务委员会和中央委员会总书记。时任主席毛泽东曾参与中日建交的决策过程。该机构在1947年批准并公布了《中国土地法大纲》，1979年正式为《刘志丹》案平反（1986年停止发行），并于2002年10月批准了神舟五号的飞行方案。
description.en: Restructured in 1927 from the Central Executive Committee, it is the highest leading body and central authority of the Communist Party of China. It elects the Political Bureau, its Standing Committee, and the General Secretary of the Central Committee through the National Congress. Its then-Chairman, Mao Zedong, was involved in the decision-making process for the normalization of Japan-China relations. The body approved and promulgated the 'Outline Land Law of China' in 1947, officially rehabilitated the 'Liu Zhidan' case in 1979 (though distribution was halted in 1986), and approved the flight plan for Shenzhou 5 in October 2002.

description.zh-cn: 由毛泽东领导的中国共产党在中华人民共和国发动的政治、经济及社会运动，旨在利用国家行政力量，通过农业和工业的平行增长，快速实现工业化和集体化，将国家从以农业为主的经济体转型成为一个现代化的共产主义社会，并试图实现超英赶美的目标。运动包括大炼钢铁、人民公社化等。然而，这场脱离现实的“跃进”最终导致了严重的经济困难、环境破坏和大饥荒，是三年困难时期的主要原因之一。
description.en: A political, economic, and social movement initiated by Mao Zedong and the Chinese Communist Party in the People's Republic of China. It aimed to rapidly industrialize and collectivize the country, transforming it from an agrarian economy into a modern communist society by utilizing state administrative power and achieving parallel growth in agriculture and industry, with the goal of surpassing the UK and US. Key components included the Great Steel Smelting and the People's Communes. However, this unrealistic 'Great Leap Forward' ultimately led to severe economic difficulties, environmental damage, and a great famine, being one of the main causes of the Three Years of Great Famine.

description.zh-cn: 1957年在中国大陆由毛泽东发起的政治运动，旨在针对知识分子、党内不同意见者和民主党派，反对资产阶级右派。该运动对知识分子造成极大打击，破坏了民主制度，并为之后的大跃进埋下祸根。
description.en: A political movement launched by Mao Zedong in mainland China in 1957, targeting intellectuals, dissidents within the party, and democratic parties, aimed at opposing bourgeois rightists. This campaign dealt a severe blow to intellectuals, undermined the democratic system, and sowed the seeds for the subsequent Great Leap Forward.

description.zh-cn: 阶级斗争是马克思主义的核心概念之一，认为人类社会的历史是通过阶级之间的对立和斗争实现的。在中国文化大革命时期，阶级斗争被视为其核心理论和实践之一。
description.en: Class struggle is one of the core concepts of Marxism, positing that the history of human society is realized through the opposition and struggle between classes. During China's Cultural Revolution, class struggle was regarded as one of its core theories and practices.

description.zh-cn: 中共八大元老之一，中国政治家、经济管理家，中国共产党和中华人民共和国第一、二代中央领导集体重要成员及主要领导人之一。曾任重工业部部长、国务院副总理、中纪委第一书记，后接替邓小平担任中共中央顾问委员会第二任主任，并主张在中共十四大后废除中顾委。他支持关于真理标准问题的讨论。大饥荒后，他支持“三自一包”等经济调整政策，并以实际退休支持废除领导职务终身制。文革中被下放。六四事件中，他是保守派代表，支持对学生运动采取强硬措施，并曾推荐和保护李锐。
description.en: One of the Eight Elders of the CPC, a Chinese politician and economic administrator, and an important and main member of the first and second generation central leadership collectives of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China. He served as Minister of Heavy Industry, Vice Premier of the State Council, and First Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection. He supported the discussion on the criterion of truth. He later succeeded Deng Xiaoping as the second Director of the Central Advisory Commission and advocated for its abolition after the 14th National Congress of the CPC. After the Great Famine, he supported economic adjustment policies such as 'Sanzi Yibao' and supported the abolition of lifelong tenure for leading positions through his own retirement. He was sent down during the Cultural Revolution. During the June Fourth Incident, he was a conservative representative, supporting strong measures against student movements, and also recommended and protected Li Rui.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东发动文革时提出的需要防止的政治趋向。
“走资本主义道路的当权派”的简称，是文革中用于攻击党政领导干部的罪名。
指在中国共产党第一代领导集体退下后，于1980年代至1990年代间，在中华人民共和国政治决策中拥有实际最高决策权的八位或更多位中国共产党、中华人民共和国、中国人民解放军元老。
description.en: Refers to the eight veteran members of the Communist Party of China who held actual decision-making power in the People's Republic of China during the 1980s and 1990s.

description.zh-cn: 文革期间摧毁公安、检察、法院体系的口号和行动。
文革期间对毛泽东的个人崇拜达到顶峰。

zh-cn: 首都工人毛泽东思想宣传队

description.zh-cn: 由工农兵组成的宣传队伍，进驻各单位领导斗批改。

zh-cn: 第四届全国人民代表大会
第四届全国人民代表大会第一次会议

description.zh-cn: 文革后期召开的全国人民代表大会，通过了《七五宪法》。

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国宪法 (1975年)
en: 1975 Constitution of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 简称“七五宪法”，将文革的理论和实践写入宪法。

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国宪法 (1978年)

description.zh-cn: 简称“七八宪法”。
毛泽东思想理论体系，是中国共产党的指导思想之一，以毛泽东的名字命名。它以毛泽东为主要代表的中国共产党人，根据马克思列宁主义的基本原理，将中国长期革命和建设实践中的经验作了理论概括而形成的。
description.en: One of the guiding ideologies of the Communist Party of China, named after Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 指“大鸣、大放、大字报、大辩论”，文革中主要的群众斗争形式。
文化大革命期间在广西壮族自治区发生的一系列系统性大屠杀，并伴有食人事件。
description.en: A series of systematic massacres that occurred in the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region during the Cultural Revolution, accompanied by incidents of cannibalism.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间在内蒙古自治区发生的大规模冤假错案，具体指对内蒙古人民革命党进行的大规模政治清洗和屠杀。
description.en: A large-scale case of wrongful convictions that occurred in the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 文革期间在广东发生的系统性大屠杀。
文革期间在云南发生的系统性大屠杀。
以道县大屠杀为代表的文革期间湖南发生的大屠杀。
吴晗创作的历史剧，对该剧的批判成为文革的导火索。
文化大革命初期，中共元老们在北京怀仁堂对中央文革小组的错误做法和混乱局势进行了抵制和抗争。此事件是一场重要的政治斗争，后被称为“二月逆流”，李富春是主要参与者之一。
description.en: In the early stage of the Cultural Revolution, veteran CCP leaders resisted and protested against the erroneous practices and chaotic situation of the Central Cultural Revolution Group at Huairentang. This significant political struggle was later known as the 'February Countercurrent', with Li Fuchun being one of the main participants.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国的领导人之一，中国革命家、军事家、外交家，中华人民共和国十大元帅之一。他曾任国务院副总理、外交部部长、上海市市长。他参与创建了井冈山革命根据地。在“二月逆流”中反对文革。长期担任粟裕的直接领导和政治搭档。
description.en: One of the leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, a revolutionary, military commander, and diplomat, and one of the Ten Marshals of the PRC. He participated in the establishment of the Jinggangshan Revolutionary Base.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党革命家、中国人民解放军高级将领、中华人民共和国政治人物。曾任国务院副总理，为原国家级副职领导人。他在“二月逆流”中反对文化大革命。
description.en: Chinese Communist revolutionary, a high-ranking general of the People's Liberation Army, and a politician of the People's Republic of China. He served as a Vice Premier of the State Council, holding a former national-level deputy position. He opposed the Cultural Revolution during the 'February Countercurrent'.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国于1955年授予建国元勋的最高军衔。
因毛泽东将芒果转赠给工宣队而引发的对芒果的崇拜现象。
习仲勋是中国共产党、中华人民共和国政治人物，陕甘边区革命根据地的主要创建者和领导者之一。“五马进京”事件核心人物之一，中共八大元老之一，并以实际退休行动支持废除领导职务终身制。曾任西北野战军副政委、国务院副总理、中共中央书记处书记、全国人大常委会副委员长。1962年因审阅小说《刘志丹》手稿遭受长期迫害。后任中共广东省委第一书记，建议在深圳等地建立“贸易合作区”。他是习近平之父。
description.en: Xi Zhongxun was a prominent political figure in the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and one of the main founders and leaders of the Shaan-Gan Border Revolutionary Base Area. A core figure in the 'Five Horses Enter Beijing' incident and one of the Eight Elders of the CPC, he notably supported the abolition of lifelong tenure for leading positions through his own retirement. He served as Deputy Political Commissar of the Northwest Field Army, Vice Premier of the State Council, Secretary of the CCP Central Secretariat, and Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress. In 1962, he was persecuted for reviewing the novel 'Liu Zhidan.' Later, as First Secretary of the CPC Guangdong Provincial Committee, he proposed 'trade cooperation zones' in Shenzhen. He is the father of current Chinese leader Xi Jinping.

birth_place.zh-cn: 山西省忻州直隶州定襄县蒋村
birth_place.en: Jiang Village, Dingxiang County, Xinzhou Prefecture, Shanxi Province

death_place.en: Peking Union Medical College Hospital, Beijing

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，开国元勋，原副国级领导人，邓小平主政时期的中共八大元老之一。他曾任国务院副总理、中共中央顾问委员会副主任并长期主持日常工作。作为中国共产党和中华人民共和国的第一、二、三代主要领导人之一，他也是“六十一人叛徒集团案”的主要受害者，在文化大革命中被打倒监禁。他以实际退休行动支持废除领导职务终身制，是薄熙来和薄小莹的父亲。
description.en: A Chinese Communist Party and People's Republic of China political figure, a founding father of the PRC, and a former deputy national leader. He was one of the Eight Elders of the CCP during Deng Xiaoping's administration. He served as Vice Premier of the State Council and Deputy Director of the Central Advisory Commission, presiding over its daily work for a long time. As one of the main leaders of the first, second, and third generations of the CCP and PRC, he was also a principal victim of the 'Case of the 61 Renegades' and was imprisoned during the Cultural Revolution. He supported the abolition of lifelong tenure for leading positions through his own retirement, and was the father of Bo Xilai and Bo Xiaoying.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国是自1949年起统治中国大陆的政权，位于亚洲东部的社会主义国家，由中国共产党执政。建国初期推行土地改革并寻求苏联援助。曾参与朝鲜战争，完成载人航天。1972年与日本建交，1997年恢复对香港主权。作为金砖国家创始成员，与多国建交，但因网络审查致Google撤离，并曾与越南发生战争。被指控支持俄罗斯并压制国内批评者。此外，中国还将突厥斯坦伊斯兰党视为主要的恐怖主义威胁之一。
description.en: The People's Republic of China is the regime that has ruled mainland China since 1949. It is a socialist country in East Asia, governed by the Chinese Communist Party. In its early years, it implemented land reform and sought Soviet aid. It participated in the Korean War and completed human spaceflight missions. It established diplomatic relations with Japan in 1972, and resumed sovereignty over Hong Kong in 1997. As a founding member of BRICS, it established diplomatic relations with many countries, but Google withdrew due to internet censorship, and it engaged in war with Vietnam. It is accused of supporting Russia and suppressing domestic critics. Additionally, it considers the Turkistan Islamic Party as one of its primary terrorist threats.

location.zh-cn: 中国大陆及台湾海峡沿岸岛屿

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党与中国共产党之间为争夺中国执政权而爆发的内战，亦称第二次国共内战，是国共内战的第二个阶段。该内战始于1945年抗日战争结束，至1949年12月以中国共产党取得决定性胜利、中华人民共和国成立告终。在此期间，中国共产党在其控制的“解放区”内已开始推行土地改革。石双琪曾率民兵团支援前线参与此战争。
description.en: The Chinese Civil War, also known as the Second Chinese Civil War, was a conflict fought between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party of China for control of China. It was the second phase of the war, commencing in 1945 after the end of the Second Sino-Japanese War and concluding around December 1949 with the decisive victory of the Chinese Communist Party and the establishment of the People's Republic of China. During this period, the CCP had already begun implementing land reform in the 'liberated areas' under its control. Shi Shuangqi participated in this war by leading a militia regiment to support the front lines.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国中央人民政府成立典礼
en: Proclamation of the People's Republic of China
The Proclamation of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 标志中华人民共和国中央人民政府正式成立的典礼。
1989年4月中旬，由高校学生发起的民主示威运动持续近两个月。广义上指波及中华人民共和国全境的示威，狭义上特指发生在北京天安门广场的示威及随后于6月4日凌晨的武力清场。这场政治风波导致时任中共中央总书记赵紫阳被撤职，第一代团派势力遭到清洗，阎明复亦因此被免去中共中央书记处书记等职务。八六学潮被认为是其前奏。
description.en: Beginning in mid-April 1989, student-led pro-democracy demonstrations lasted nearly two months. Broadly, it refers to protests across the People's Republic of China; more specifically, it denotes the student demonstrations in Beijing's Tiananmen Square and the subsequent crackdown, which concluded with military action on the morning of June 4. This political turmoil led to the dismissal of then CPC General Secretary Zhao Ziyang and the purge of the first-generation Tuanpai (Youth League Faction). Yan Mingfu was also dismissed from his post as secretary of the CPC Central Secretariat and other positions due to his actions during this event. The 1986 student demonstrations are considered its precursor.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，78级大学生，现任中华人民共和国国务院总理。在中共二十届一中全会后成为排名第二的中共中央政治局常委，曾任中共上海市委书记、浙江省省长。
description.en: Chinese politician and a member of the Class of 1978, currently serving as the Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China. He became the second-ranked member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the CPC Central Committee after the First Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee, and previously served as Secretary of the CPC Shanghai Municipal Committee and Governor of Zhejiang Province.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任全国人民代表大会常务委员会委员长、中共中央政治局常委，曾任中共中央纪委书记、中共中央组织部部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, current Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国主要领导人之一，中国共产党中央政治局常委。现任中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会主席（接替汪洋），曾任中央书记处第一书记（蔡奇的前任），并担任中共二十大秘书长。他也是一名78级研究生。
description.en: Chinese politician, one of the principal leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China. He is currently a member of the Standing Committee of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee and Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (succeeding Wang Yang). He previously served as First Secretary of the Central Secretariat (predecessor to Cai Qi) and Secretary-General of the 20th CPC National Congress. He was also a postgraduate student of the Class of 1978.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国首都，亦是明清两朝的都城。1644年曾被李自成攻陷，后为清军占领。这里是叶剑英（曾任市长）、华国锋、周恩来、毛泽东、董必武、陈云、李富春等众多历史人物的逝世地。屠呦呦曾在此主要居住和工作，艾未未、魏京生、闫仲秋在此出生。此外，它也是六四戒严及清场事件的主要发生地，以及中国科学技术大学的创校地点。
description.en: The capital of the People's Republic of China, historically also the capital of the Ming and Qing dynasties. It was captured by Li Zicheng in 1644 and subsequently occupied by Qing forces. It is the place of death for Ye Jianying (who served as mayor), Hua Guofeng, Zhou Enlai, Mao Zedong, Dong Bibu, Chen Yun, Li Fuchun, and many other historical figures. Tu Youyou primarily resided and worked here, while Ai Weiwei, Wei Jingsheng, and Yan Zhongqiu were born here. Additionally, it was the main site of the June Fourth crackdown and clearing events, and the founding location of the University of Science and Technology of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国直辖市，是中国人口最多的城市，也是国家的经济、金融、贸易、航运、商业、上游制造和对外开放中心。此处亦是李克强的逝世地和向忠发被处决的地点。
description.en: A direct-administered municipality of the People's Republic of China, and the country's most populous city. It is also the nation's center for economy, finance, trade, shipping, commerce, upstream manufacturing, and opening up. This is also the place where Li Keqiang passed away and where Xiang Zhongfa was executed.

location.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国北京市西城区人民大会堂

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的最高国家权力机关和国家立法机关，负责选举和罢免最高人民法院院长。
中华人民共和国的省级特别行政区，实行一国两制和高度自治。它与深圳相邻，是全球重要的国际金融、贸易和航运中心。这里是著名作家古龙的出生地，仓颉输入法在此地非常普及，也是四朵金花组合的出身地和主要活跃地区，且邓亮洪曾在此流亡。同时，它也是潘晓颖与陈同佳的居住地，潘晓颖命案曾在此引发政治争议。
description.en: A provincial special administrative region of the People's Republic of China, practicing 'one country, two systems' and a high degree of autonomy. Bordering Shenzhen, it is a vital international financial, trade, and shipping center. It is the birthplace of renowned writer Gu Long, where the Cangjie input method is very popular, the origin and main area of activity for the Four Golden Flowers, and where Tang Liang Hong once lived in exile. It is also the place of residence for Poon Hiu-wing and Chan Tong-kai, where the Poon Hiu-wing murder case sparked political controversy.

description.zh-cn: 1919年5月4日发生于中国北京的爱国运动，以青年学生为主体，广泛参与者包括公民、市民和工商人士。这场反帝反封建运动，形式涵盖示威、请愿、罢课、罢工及暴力对抗政府。其爆发源于巴黎和会山东问题及北洋政府外交失败。运动最终迫使北洋政府拒签《凡尔赛条约》并罢免亲日官员，对中国近代史影响深远，推动了新文化运动，使西学思想深入。此运动亦影响了如柯仲平等人的早期思想。
description.en: A patriotic, anti-imperialist and anti-feudal movement that took place in Beijing, China, on May 4, 1919. It was primarily led by young students, with broad participation from citizens, merchants, and other social strata. The movement involved demonstrations, petitions, student and worker strikes, and violent confrontations with the government. It erupted due to the Shandong question at the Paris Peace Conference and the Beiyang government's diplomatic failure. It ultimately compelled the Beiyang government to refuse to sign the Treaty of Versailles and dismiss pro-Japanese officials, profoundly impacting modern Chinese history, advancing the New Culture Movement, deepening the reception of Western thought, and influencing the early ideas of figures like Ke Zhongping.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党领导的国民政府与中国共产党领导的政权之间的第一次内战，是国共内战的第一个阶段，始于国共分裂，终于西安事变后的第二次国共合作。
description.en: The first phase of the Chinese Civil War, beginning with the KMT-CCP split and ending with the Second United Front after the Xi'an Incident.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在第一次国共内战期间，于其革命根据地建立的政权。向忠发曾提名毛泽东担任其临时中央政府主席。
description.en: A state established by the Chinese Communist Party in its revolutionary base areas during the First KMT-CCP Civil War. Xiang Zhongfa once nominated Mao Zedong to serve as the chairman of its provisional central government.

description.zh-cn: 第一次国共内战期间，中国共产党领导的中国工农红军主力被迫退出中央苏区，从长江以南各革命根据地向陕甘革命根据地进行的一次重要大规模战略转移。毛泽民在此期间负责后勤供给工作，李富春也参与了此次行动。
description.en: During the First KMT-CPC Civil War, the main force of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, led by the Communist Party of China, was forced to withdraw from the Central Soviet Area, undertaking a massive strategic transfer from revolutionary bases south of the Yangtze River to the Shaan-Gan Revolutionary Base. Mao Zemin was responsible for logistical supplies, and Li Fuchun also participated in this movement.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争时期中国国民党与中国共产党的第二次合作，是为共同抗日而结成的统一战线。
中国共产党在第二次国共内战时期的主要武装力量，由中国工农红军、八路军和新四军改编而来。后成为中华人民共和国的主要武装力量。曾计划进攻台湾，后因朝鲜战争放弃；也曾执行六四戒严和清场任务。倪匡年轻时曾加入其华东公安部队。
description.en: The main armed force of the Chinese Communist Party during the Second Chinese Civil War, reorganized from the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, Eighth Route Army, and New Fourth Army. It later became the primary armed force of the People's Republic of China. It had planned to attack Taiwan but was forced to abandon the plan due to the Korean War; it also carried out martial law and clearing operations on June Fourth. Ni Kuang joined its East China Public Security Force in his youth.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国土地改革法
en: Land Reform Law of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在解放区及中华人民共和国建国初期（1946-1953年），由毛泽东等高层主导，在中国大陆进行的土地所有制改革运动。1950年6月，颁布法律为全国范围的土地改革提供了法律依据，旨在废除地主阶级的土地所有制，实行农民的土地所有制，解放农村生产力，发展农业，为工业化开辟道路。该运动也导致了大量暴力事件和人口死亡，并彻底改变了中国农村的社会结构。
description.en: A land ownership reform movement conducted by the Communist Party of China in the liberated areas and in the early days of the People's Republic of China (1946-1953), led by Mao Zedong and other high-ranking officials in mainland China. In June 1950, a law was promulgated, providing the legal basis for implementing land reform nationwide. The movement aimed to abolish the landlord class's land ownership, implement peasant land ownership, liberate rural productive forces, develop agricultural production, and pave the way for industrialization. It also led to extensive violence and numerous deaths, fundamentally changing the social structure of rural China.

description.zh-cn: 1950年至1953年间在朝鲜半岛爆发的一场战争。它是朝鲜民主主义人民共和国（朝鲜）与大韩民国（韩国）之间的军事冲突，一方为朝鲜、中国人民志愿军，另一方为韩国、美国领导的联合国军（其中美国第七舰队参与）。作为冷战时期的一场区域性冲突，它导致美国介入台湾海峡，阻止了解放军攻台计划，并在战后持续影响该地区局势。战争最终以《朝鲜停战协定》的签署而告终，未签订和平条约。毛泽东认为，中国在朝鲜战争中的表现赢得了苏联的信任，从而获得了更多的援助与合作。
description.en: A war fought on the Korean Peninsula from 1950 to 1953. It was a military conflict between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (North Korea) and the Republic of Korea (South Korea). On one side were North Korea and the Chinese People's Volunteer Army, and on the other were South Korea and a United Nations force led by the United States (with the U.S. Seventh Fleet participating). As a regional conflict during the Cold War, it led to U.S. intervention in the Taiwan Strait, preventing the PLA's plan to invade Taiwan, and continued to influence the region's situation after the war. The war ended with the signing of the Korean Armistice Agreement, but no peace treaty was signed. Mao Zedong believed that China's performance in the Korean War won the trust of the Soviet Union, leading to more aid and cooperation.

description.zh-cn: 一个由主权国家组成的全球性国际组织，二战后成立，加拿大是其创始国之一。它旨在促进国际合作、防止未来冲突，罗斯福是其关键推动者。其大会多次通过决议谴责俄罗斯的入侵行为。
description.en: A global international organization of sovereign states, founded after World War II, with Canada as a founding member. It aims to promote international cooperation and prevent future conflicts, with Roosevelt as a key driving force. Its General Assembly has passed multiple resolutions condemning Russia's invasion.

description.zh-cn: 江泽民是中国共产党和中华人民共和国前主要领导人，1989年至2002年中国的实际最高领导人，中共第三代中央领导集体核心。曾任上海市委书记。六四后接任中共中央总书记、国家主席和中央军委主席。主政期间，延续废除干部终身制，提出985工程。作为时任总书记，他将法轮功视为威胁，并于1999年发起全面镇压。卸任总书记和国家主席后，仍任中央军委主席。
description.en: Jiang Zemin was a former major leader of the Chinese Communist Party and the People's Republic of China, and the paramount leader of China from 1989 to 2002, as well as the core figure of the third generation of central leadership of the CCP. He served as Shanghai Party Secretary. After the June Fourth incident, he succeeded as General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, and subsequently served as President of the PRC and Chairman of the Central Military Commission. During his leadership, he continued the abolition of lifelong tenure for cadres and proposed the '985 Project'. As the then-General Secretary, he viewed Falun Gong as a threat to the Communist Party and launched a full-scale suppression in 1999. After stepping down as General Secretary and President of the PRC, he continued to serve as Chairman of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 1992年1月至2月，邓小平巡视中国南方城市（包括武昌、深圳、珠海、上海等地），并发表了一系列重要讲话，即著名的“南方谈话”。这些讲话对推动中国改革开放具有深远意义，不仅重新启动了因六四事件而停滞的改革进程，也深化了改革开放，对中国经济改革与发展产生了重要影响。
description.en: From January to February 1992, Deng Xiaoping toured Southern Chinese cities (including Wuchang, Shenzhen, Zhuhai, and Shanghai), delivering a series of vital speeches, famously known as the 'Southern Tour speeches'. These remarks held profound significance for China's reform and opening-up, effectively restarting the stalled reform process after the Tiananmen Square incident and deepening it, thus profoundly impacting China's economic reform and development.

description.zh-cn: 负责监管国家之间贸易规则，并监督成员经济体之间执行各项贸易协定的国际组织。
description.en: An intergovernmental organization that regulates and facilitates international trade.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛，中华人民共和国第四代主要领导人，中国共产党第四代中央领导集体的核心人物，同时被认为是第二代团派的核心人物。他曾于2002年至2012年担任中国共产党中央委员会总书记、中华人民共和国主席、中央军委主席，是习近平的前任。在任期间，他亲临神舟五号发射现场，并于2005年签署主席令公布《治安管理处罚法》，还主持决定对陈良宇进行立案调查。他被认为是李克强的政治导师，于1983年将李克强引荐到共青团中央委员会。2012年，他卸任所有党政军职务实现“裸退”，完善了废除干部领导职务终身制的表现。
description.en: Hu Jintao, the paramount leader of the People's Republic of China and the core figure of the fourth generation of central leadership of the Communist Party of China, is also considered the core figure of the second-generation Tuanpai (Youth League Faction). He served as General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee, President of the People's Republic of China, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission from 2002 to 2012, preceding Xi Jinping. During his tenure, he personally observed the launch of Shenzhou 5, signed a presidential decree to promulgate the 'Public Security Administration Punishments Law' in 2005, and presided over the decision to investigate Chen Liangyu. He is considered Li Keqiang's political mentor, having brought him into the Central Committee of the Communist Youth League in 1983. In 2012, he relinquished all party, government, and military positions in a 'naked retirement,' a move that perfected the abolition of lifelong tenure for cadres.

birth_place.zh-cn: 天津市北辰区宜兴埠镇

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。他曾任中华人民共和国国务院总理，在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命，并曾签署任命梁振英为香港第四任行政长官的国务院令。他还曾担任抗震救灾总指挥。在总理任内，他曾与杨利伟成功返回后与其通话表示祝贺。此外，他曾任中共中央办公厅主任、中共第十六、十七届中央政治局常委。他是温云松的父亲。据报道，他曾反对薄熙来晋升，并在薄熙来事件中公开要求重庆反思。他曾于2018年探望阎明复。据称曾被陈良宇顶撞。
description.en: A Chinese politician. He was appointed as Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China during the 11th National People's Congress, and signed the State Council order appointing Leung Chun-ying as the fourth Chief Executive of Hong Kong. He also served as the commander-in-chief for earthquake relief. During his tenure as Premier, he spoke with Yang Liwei after his successful return to congratulate him. He also served as Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and a member of the Standing Committee of the 16th and 17th Politburo of the CPC Central Committee. He is the father of Wen Yunsong. He reportedly opposed Bo Xilai's promotion and publicly called for Chongqing to reflect on the incident during Bo's downfall. He visited Yan Mingfu in 2018. Reportedly confronted by Chen Liangyu.

description.zh-cn: 在北京举办的第29届夏季奥林匹克运动会。
description.en: The 29th Summer Olympic Games.

birth_place.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国安徽省合肥市
birth_place.en: Hefei, Anhui, People's Republic of China

death_place.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国上海市浦东新区
death_place.en: Pudong, Shanghai, People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 李克强是中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，团派主要成员，曾任中共中央政治局常委、国务院总理，原正国级领导人。他被视为改革派学者型官员，其经济思想被称为“李克强经济学”。作为1977级大学生，他曾任国务院副总理，并在任总理期间推广“一带一路”倡议。他曾是薄熙来在中共十八大前的政治竞争对手，并主持二十大开幕会。由于习近平的集权，他被国际媒体评价为中国近代最弱势的总理之一。
description.en: Li Keqiang was a political figure of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, a key member of the Tuanpai (Youth League Faction), who served as a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Premier of the State Council, a former national-level leader. He was regarded as a reform-minded, scholar-type official, and his economic philosophy was known as 'Likonomics'. A Class of 1977 university student, he was appointed Vice Premier and promoted the 'Belt and Road' initiative during his premiership. He was a political rival of Bo Xilai before the 18th CPC National Congress and presided over the opening ceremony of the 20th. Due to Xi Jinping's consolidation of power, he was evaluated by international media as one of the weakest premiers in modern Chinese history.

description.zh-cn: 由中华人民共和国政府于2013年倡议并主导的国际经济合作倡议（由习近平提出），旨在加强区域互联互通，并形成跨国经济带。

zh-cn: 亚洲基础设施投资银行

description.zh-cn: 一个由中国倡议设立的多边开发银行，为“一带一路”等亚洲基建项目提供资金。

zh-cn: 反对逃犯条例修订草案运动

description.zh-cn: 2019年在香港爆发的大规模社会运动，旨在反对《逃犯条例》修订草案。该运动被认为是促使中央政府订立《港区国安法》的关键背景事件。
description.en: A large-scale social movement that erupted in Hong Kong in 2019, primarily against the proposed amendments to the Fugitive Offenders Ordinance. This movement is also considered a key background event that prompted the central government to enact the Hong Kong National Security Law.

description.zh-cn: 由严重急性呼吸系统综合征冠状病毒2（SARS-CoV-2）导致的2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）所引发的全球大流行疫情，被定性为全球性重大突发公共卫生事件。在此期间，中国地方政府曾引用《治安管理处罚法》中关于“紧急状态”的条款实施疫情防控措施，故宫也于2020年初一度关闭。此外，李洪志对此发表言论，称病毒是针对中共而来，并宣称中国已有数亿人因此死亡。
description.en: A global pandemic of Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) caused by Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), designated as a major global public health emergency. During this period, local governments in China cited the 'state of emergency' clause in the 'Public Security Administration Punishments Law' to implement pandemic control measures, and the Forbidden City was temporarily closed in early 2020. Additionally, Li Hongzhi commented on the pandemic, stating the virus targeted the CCP and claiming that hundreds of millions of people had died from it in China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国为应对2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）大流行而采取的严格公共卫生防控政策。
description.en: A public health policy adopted by the Chinese government in response to the COVID-19 pandemic.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院发布的优化新冠疫情防控的十条措施，标志着清零政策的结束。
一个横跨东欧和北亚的联邦共和国，与中国接壤，是苏联的主要继承国，继承了其航天能力。作为金砖国家创始成员国，该国与北约东扩存在持续紧张关系，并于2022年2月24日全面入侵乌克兰。此外，它在叙利亚内战中支持阿萨德政府，并在其政权垮台后为其提供庇护。
description.en: A federal republic spanning Eastern Europe and Northern Asia, bordering China. It is the main successor of the Soviet Union, having inherited its space capabilities. A founding member of BRICS, the country experiences persistent tensions with NATO expansion and launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022. Additionally, it supported the Assad government during the Syrian Civil War and provided asylum to Assad after his regime's collapse.

description.zh-cn: 美利坚合众国是北美洲的联邦共和国，实行总统制。1943年组建第七舰队，与加拿大共享最长不设防边界。二战后主导对日占领，冷战中是苏联主要对手并领导朝鲜战争联合国军。苏联解体后成为唯一超级大国，实现载人航天。1970年代对华战略转变促进中日建交，也曾批评“一带一路”。作为乌克兰主要军援国，曾参与利比亚军事干预，军队在越南战争使用橙剂。孟山都公司总部设于此。该国曾谴责伊朗镇压示威，李洪志自1998年起定居。曾将“东伊运”列为恐怖组织，后于2020年将其除名。
description.en: The United States of America is a federal republic in North America with a presidential system. It formed the Seventh Fleet in 1943 and shares the world's longest undefended border with Canada. After WWII, it led Japan's post-war occupation; during the Cold War, it was the Soviet Union's main rival and led the UN Command in the Korean War. Following the Soviet collapse, it became the sole superpower and achieved human spaceflight. Its strategic shift towards China in the 1970s created conditions for Sino-Japanese diplomatic relations, and it has also criticized the 'Belt and Road' initiative. A major military aid provider to Ukraine, it participated in military intervention in Libya, and its military used Agent Orange during the Vietnam War. Monsanto's headquarters are located here. The country has condemned Iran's crackdown on protests, and Li Hongzhi has resided here since 1998. It formerly designated ETIM as a terrorist organization, but removed it from the list in 2020.

description.zh-cn: 由中国、俄罗斯等国发起的欧亚政治、经济和安全组织。
由巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国、南非等新兴市场国家组成的合作机制，是世界经济增长的主要动力之一。

en: Government Administration Council of the Central People's Government
State Administration Council of the Central People's Government

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期的中央人民政府，是最高国家行政机关，职权相当于后来的国务院，也是中央人民政府重工业部等机构的上级机关。该政府由周恩来担任总理。
description.en: The Central People's Government, established in the early years of the People's Republic of China, served as the highest state administrative organ, with functions equivalent to the later State Council. It was also the superior body to institutions like the Central People's Government Ministry of Heavy Industry. Zhou Enlai served as its Premier.

en: Constitution of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的根本大法，历经多次修改。其中1982年版本明确将知识分子列为社会主义建设的依靠力量之一，同时也是设立浙江省人民代表大会的法源。
description.en: The fundamental law of the People's Republic of China, which has undergone multiple revisions. The 1982 version explicitly lists intellectuals as one of the forces to rely on for socialist construction, and it is also the legal source for the establishment of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国宪法 (1982年)
中华人民共和国宪法（八二宪法）
en: 1982 Constitution of the People's Republic of China
Constitution of the People's Republic of China (1982)

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的第四部宪法，也被称为“八二宪法”，是现行宪法。该宪法的颁行加强了民族区域自治制度的建设，其第三十一条规定了设立特别行政区的法律依据。它还规定了国家主席等领导职务的任期制，正式从法律上废除了领导干部职务终身制，并规定实行初等义务教育。
description.en: The fourth constitution of the People's Republic of China, also known as the '82 Constitution', is the current constitution. It stipulated term limits for leading positions such as the President, formally abolishing the lifelong tenure system for leading cadres in law, and also stipulates the implementation of compulsory primary education.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国宪法 (1954年)
en: 1954 Constitution of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的第一部宪法，该法案的通过使国务院取代了原政务院的行政职能。
中华人民共和国地方各级国家行政机关。

en: Constituent departments of the State Council
Constituent Department of the State Council
Constituent Departments of the State Council

description.zh-cn: 国务院组成部门是中华人民共和国国务院的组成机构类别，属于职能机构分类，承担国务院的基本行政管理职能。
description.en: The constituent departments of the State Council are a category of constituent bodies of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, belonging to a classification of functional bodies, and undertaking the basic administrative functions of the State Council.

en: Directly Subordinate Institution of the State Council

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院的组成部门之一，主管国务院某项专门业务。
description.en: A constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for a specific specialized business.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物、前领导人，曾任国务院副总理，也是一位农业政策专家。他支持“三自一包”等农业改革政策，在1962年北戴河会议上受到毛泽东批判并被降职。他也是“五马进京”事件核心人物之一。
description.en: A former leader of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, who served as Vice Premier of the State Council and was an agricultural policy expert. He supported agricultural reform policies such as 'Sanzi Yibao', which led to criticism and demotion by Mao Zedong at the 1962 Beidaihe Conference. He was also one of the core figures in the 'Five Horses Enter Beijing' incident.

birth_place.zh-cn: 山西省归化城土默特塔布村

description.zh-cn: 乌兰夫，蒙古族，是中国共产党和中华人民共和国的高级领导人、政治人物，原正国级领导人，有“蒙古王”之称。他曾任中国人民解放军开国上将、中华人民共和国副主席、全国人大常委会副委员长、国务院副总理、中共中央统战部部长等职，是中华人民共和国历史上官阶最高的少数民族人士。他曾在文革中被打倒，并领导并完成了《民族区域自治法》的制定。
description.en: An ethnic Mongol, a senior leader of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, known as the 'Mongol King'. He was an opening general of the People's Liberation Army and served as Vice President of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物、原正国级领导人。曾任国务院副总理、重工业部部长、中共中央办公厅主任、国家计划委员会主任、中共中央政治局常委。是中国社会主义经济建设的奠基人之一，在文化大革命期间因二月逆流事件受到迫害。
description.en: A politician of the Chinese Communist Party and the People's Republic of China, and a former national-level leader. He served as Vice Premier of the State Council, Minister of Heavy Industry, Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, Director of the State Planning Commission, and a member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the CCP Central Committee. He was one of the founders of China's socialist economic construction and was persecuted during the Cultural Revolution for his involvement in the February Countercurrent.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物、原正国级领导人、中国人民解放军高级将领。曾任中华人民共和国主席、全国政协主席，是中共八大元老之一。他在文化大革命中受到冲击，曾与李富春等人一同在“二月逆流”事件中抗争。后参与策划粉碎四人帮事件，并支持关于真理标准问题的讨论。阎明复任全国政协副主席期间，他曾是阎明复的直接上级。
description.en: A Chinese Communist Party and People's Republic of China politician, former national-level leader, and senior general of the People's Liberation Army. He served as President of the People's Republic of China and Chairman of the National People's Political Consultative Conference, and was one of the Eight Elders of the CCP. He was purged during the Cultural Revolution and, along with Li Fuchun and others, resisted it in the 'February Countercurrent' incident. He later participated in the planning to crush the Gang of Four and supported the discussion on the criterion of truth. He was Yan Mingfu's direct superior when Yan served as Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee.

birth_place.zh-cn: 四川省江津县吴滩乡石院子

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国元帅，中国共产党和中华人民共和国的军事家、革命家和政治家，中华人民共和国十大元帅之一。曾任北京市市长、国务院副总理，并担任粟裕的前任代总参谋长。在政治运动中批判粟裕，并与李富春等人一同在“二月逆流”事件中对文化大革命进行抗争。
description.en: Marshal of the People's Republic of China, a military strategist, revolutionary, and politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and one of the Ten Marshals of the PRC. He served as Mayor of Beijing and Vice Premier of the State Council, and as the predecessor of Su Yu as Acting Chief of the General Staff. He criticized Su Yu during political movements, and along with Li Fuchun and others, resisted the Cultural Revolution in the 'February Countercurrent' incident.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党政治人物，曾任中共上海市委第一书记、上海市市长、国务院副总理。他曾向刘少奇建议将在押干部保释出狱。
description.en: A politician of the Communist Party of China, he served as the First Secretary of the Shanghai Municipal Committee of the CPC, Mayor of Shanghai, and Vice Premier of the State Council. He once suggested to Liu Shaoqi to bail out imprisoned cadres.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国高级领导人，中华人民共和国开国上将。文化大革命期间的重要人物，曾任北京市革委会主任、公安部部长。
description.en: A General of the People's Liberation Army, former Minister of Public Security of the PRC.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国务院副总理。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as a Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党及中华人民共和国政治人物，原副国级党和国家领导人。活跃于“文化大革命”中后期及“后毛泽东时代”。曾任国务院副总理、中央政法小组组长等职。他因深受毛泽东赏识和培养，在文革中后期进入中央核心。曾阻挠为六十一人叛徒集团案平反。中共十一届三中全会后在政治上受到排挤，于1980年2月辞去所有职务。
description.en: A politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and a former Vice-national level leader. He was active in the late stage of the Cultural Revolution and the post-Mao era. He served as Vice Premier of the State Council, head of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Group, and other positions. Highly appreciated and cultivated by Mao Zedong, he entered the central core leadership in the late Cultural Revolution. He once obstructed the rehabilitation of the Case of the 61 Renegades. After the Third Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee of the CPC, he was politically marginalized and resigned from all his positions in February 1980.

birth_place.zh-cn: 中华民国山西省武乡县
birth_place.en: Wuxiang County, Shanxi Province, Republic of China

death_place.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国北京市

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国务院副总理。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as a Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国务院副总理。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as a Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，中国人民解放军开国上将，中共八大元老之一。曾担任中华人民共和国副主席，接替乌兰夫。
description.en: One of the leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, who succeeded Ulanhu as Vice President of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国务院副总理，并接替李富春担任中华人民共和国国家计划委员会主任。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as a Vice Premier of the State Council and succeeded Li Fuchun as the Director of the State Planning Commission of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国务院副总理、中国人口福利基金会会长。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as a Vice Premier of the State Council and president of the China Population Welfare Foundation.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国务院副总理。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as a Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国元帅，中国共产党和中华人民共和国的军事家、革命家、政治家。曾任红四方面军总指挥，是长征期间重要的军事领导人。历任国防部部长、国务院副总理等职，并与李富春等人在“二月逆流”事件中对文化大革命进行抗争。
description.en: A Marshal of the People's Republic of China, a military strategist, revolutionary, and politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China. He served as Commander-in-Chief of the Fourth Front Army and was an important military leader during the Long March. He also held positions such as Minister of National Defense and Vice Premier of the State Council. Along with Li Fuchun and others, he resisted the Cultural Revolution during the 'February Countercurrent' incident.

description.zh-cn: 中共元老，中华人民共和国政治家、外交家、军事家。曾任国务院副总理、国防部部长、中共中央军委秘书长，是习近平早期的上司。
description.en: CCP veteran, politician, diplomat, and military strategist of the People's Republic of China. He served as Vice Premier, Minister of Defense, and Secretary-General of the CPC Central Military Commission, and was Xi Jinping's early superior.

description.zh-cn: 曾任国务院副总理、全国政协副主席。
