description.en: Served as a Vice Premier of the State Council and Vice Chairman of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国务院副总理。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as a Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国务院副总理。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as a Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党高级领导人，曾任中央文革小组副组长、国务院副总理、全国政协副主席。
description.en: A senior leader of the Communist Party of China, he served as Deputy Head of the Central Cultural Revolution Group, Vice Premier of the State Council, and Vice Chairman of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 姚依林是中国共产党和中华人民共和国的早期领导人、杰出的无产阶级革命家。他曾任中共中央政治局常委（包括第十三届）、国务院副总理、中共中央办公厅主任，长期担任党和国家财经工作领导职务。作为原正国级党和国家领导人，他被认为是保守派人物。
description.en: Yao Yilin was an early leader of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and an outstanding proletarian revolutionary. He served as a member of the Political Bureau Standing Committee (including the 13th), Vice Premier of the State Council, and Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee. He held leading positions in the Party and state's economic and financial work for a long time. As a former national-level leader, he was considered a conservative figure.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物、外交官，时任中华人民共和国外交部部长，代表中方签署了《中日联合声明》。
description.en: Chinese politician and diplomat, then Minister of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China, who signed the Sino-Japanese Joint Communiqué on behalf of the Chinese side.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国原正国级领导人，中共八大元老之一，中共党内改革派代表人物。他在改革开放初期在安徽推行农村改革，曾任国务院副总理、第七届全国人民代表大会常务委员会委员长，并以实际退休行动支持废除领导职务终身制。
description.en: A former top-level leader of the CPC and PRC, one of the Eight Elders, and a key reformist. He initiated rural reforms in Anhui during the early reform era, served as Vice Premier of the State Council and Chairman of the Standing Committee of the 7th National People's Congress, and supported the abolition of lifelong tenure through his own retirement.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国上将、政治人物。曾任国防部部长、国务院副总理，并指挥一江山岛战役。他也是联名签署反对武力镇压学生示威抗议信的七名退役将军之一。
description.en: A senior general of the People's Republic of China and a politician. He served as Minister of National Defense and Vice Premier of the State Council, and commanded the Yijiangshan Islands Campaign. He was also one of the seven retired generals who jointly signed a letter opposing the use of force against student demonstrations.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国务院副总理。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as a Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任国务院秘书长。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as Secretary-General of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任国务院秘书长、中共四川省委书记等职。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as Secretary-General of the State Council and Secretary of the Sichuan Provincial Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院的组成人员之一，是国家级副职领导人。
description.en: A member of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, holding a rank equivalent to a vice-premier.

description.zh-cn: 前中华人民共和国电力工业部部长
中国政治人物，现任中华人民共和国国务院总理。
description.en: Chinese politician, current Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，周恩来义子。曾任国务院总理、全国人大常委会委员长、中共中央政治局常委。他曾于任总理期间宣布开发浦东的决策，并于六四事件期间宣布戒严令，被认为是中共党内保守派的代表人物。他也是育才学校校友。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, foster son of Zhou Enlai. He served as Premier and Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress. During his tenure as Premier, he announced the decision to develop Pudong and declared martial law during the Tiananmen Square protests of 1989, being considered a representative figure of the conservative faction within the CCP. He was also an alumnus of Yucai School.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任国务院副总理。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，原正国级党和国家领导人，曾任中共中央政治局常委、全国人大常委会委员长、国务院副总理。
description.en: Chinese politician, a former national leader at the top rank (Zhengguojie), served as a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, and Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国务院副总理。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as a Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治家，原正国级领导人。他曾任中共中央政治局常委、中共中央组织部部长，作为中共元老，其对胡锦涛的赏识是胡后来得以执掌大权的重要因素。
description.en: A politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and a former national-level leader. He served as a member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of the CPC Central Organization Department. As a CPC elder, his appreciation for Hu Jintao was a significant factor in Hu's later rise to supreme power.

zh-cn: 陈俊生 (全国政协副主席)

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中华人民共和国国务院副总理。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as a Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物。曾任中华人民共和国国务院总理、中共中央政治局常委。在担任上海市市长、中共上海市委书记期间，提出了“开发浦东，振兴上海，服务全国，面向世界”的方针。在425上访事件中，他采取了较为温和的和解立场，但其立场最终被江泽民拒绝。
description.en: A politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China. He served as Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China and a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee. During his tenure as Mayor of Shanghai and Secretary of the CPC Shanghai Municipal Committee, he put forward the policy of 'developing Pudong, revitalizing Shanghai, serving the whole country, and facing the world'. During the April 25 Appeal, he adopted a more moderate and conciliatory stance, but his position was ultimately rejected by Jiang Zemin.

description.zh-cn: 李维汉与金维映之子，曾任全国人大常委会副委员长。
中国共产党和中华人民共和国的政治人物、军事领导人，中国人民解放军上将（1988年授予），曾任中华人民共和国国防部部长。秦天与秦卫江之父。
description.en: A political figure and military leader of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, a General of the People's Liberation Army (awarded in 1988), former Minister of National Defense of the PRC. Father of Qin Tian and Qin Weijiang.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中国人民银行行长。
description.en: Chinese politician who served as the Governor of the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 原中共北京市委书记，后因贪腐案下台。
中国政治人物，曾任中华人民共和国国务院副总理。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as a Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国前主要领导人之一，曾任中共中央政治局常委、中央政法委书记。
中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，原国家级正职领导人，曾任中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理、对外贸易经济合作部部长、天津市副市长。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, a former national-level principal leader, who served as a member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the CPC Central Committee, Vice Premier of the State Council, Minister of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation, and Vice Mayor of Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，原正国级领导人。曾任中共中央政治局常委、上海市委书记，并在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间担任全国人大常委会委员长。据报道，在2013年一次会议上，他曾推醒在主席台上睡着的贾庆林。
description.en: Politician of the People's Republic of China and a former national-level leader. He served as a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Secretary of the Shanghai Municipal Party Committee, and Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress during the 11th National People's Congress. According to reports, he once woke up Jia Qinglin, who had fallen asleep on the rostrum during a meeting in 2013.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中华人民共和国国务院副总理。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as a Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国上将，曾任国防部部长，时任解放军总参谋长，参与指挥戒严部队。
中国维吾尔族政治人物。
description.en: Chinese politician of Uyghur ethnicity.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，原副国级领导人，有“中国铁娘子”之称。曾接替李岚清任对外经济贸易部部长，并担任过国务院副总理、国务委员、卫生部部长等职。据报道，她与薄熙来交恶，并阻止其接任副总理职位。
description.en: A politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, a former Deputy State Leader, known as the "Iron Lady of China." She succeeded Li Lanqing as Minister of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation, and also served as Vice Premier of the State Council, State Councilor, and Minister of Health. She reportedly had a poor relationship with Bo Xilai and blocked his succession to the Vice Premier position.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中国人口福利基金会会长。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as the president of the China Population Welfare Foundation.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共上海市委书记、国务院副总理、中共中央政治局常委。其患病离职为中纪委调查上海社保案提供了契机。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as Secretary of the Shanghai Municipal Party Committee, Vice Premier of the State Council, and a member of the Standing Committee of the Politburo. His illness and departure from office provided an opportunity for the CCDI to investigate the Shanghai social security case.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国务院副总理。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as a Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 回族，中华人民共和国政治人物。曾任中共安徽省委书记。在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为中华人民共和国国务院副总理。
description.en: A Chinese politician of Hui ethnicity, appointed as a Vice Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China during the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共中央政治局常委、中央政法委书记。他因腐败问题在反腐运动中落马，被判无期徒刑。在中央政法委任职期间，周本顺是其直接下属。本案中，他曾作出批示要求正确引导舆论，被指意图掩盖政府干预司法的事实。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, former member of the Politburo Standing Committee and Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission. He fell during the anti-corruption campaign due to corruption and was sentenced to life imprisonment. During his tenure at the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, Zhou Benshun was his direct subordinate. In this case, he issued an instruction to 'correctly guide public opinion,' which was seen as an attempt to cover up government interference in the judiciary.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国上将。曾任国防部部长、中央军委副主席，在神舟五号飞行期间与航天员杨利伟进行了“天地对话”。
description.en: Then Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission and Minister of National Defense, who conducted a 'space-to-ground call' with astronaut Yang Liwei during the Shenzhou 5 mission.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间担任全国人大常委会副委员长。
description.en: Chinese politician who served as a Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国女性政治人物，在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间担任全国人大常委会副委员长。
description.en: A female Chinese politician who served as a Vice Chairwoman of the Standing Committee of the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中共中央政治局常委、中华人民共和国国务院副总理。在薄熙来被免职后接任中共重庆市委书记，并公开否定“重庆模式”的存在。其后担任全国人大常委会委员长，并在中共十九届二中全会上就修宪建议草案作了说明。
description.en: Chinese politician, who served as a member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council. Following Bo Xilai's dismissal, he took over as Secretary of the CPC Chongqing Municipal Committee and publicly denied the existence of the 'Chongqing Model'. Subsequently, he served as Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress and explained the draft proposal for constitutional amendments at the Second Plenary Session of the 19th CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，原正国级领导人，曾任中华人民共和国副主席、北京市市长、中共中央纪律检查委员会书记，并在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为中华人民共和国国务院副总理。
description.en: Chinese politician, formerly a national-level leader, who served as Vice President of the People's Republic of China, Mayor of Beijing, and Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the CPC. He was also appointed as a Vice Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China during the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国女性政治人物，团派主要成员。曾任中共中央政治局委员、中华人民共和国国务院副总理，并在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为国务委员。
description.en: A female Chinese politician and a key member of the Tuanpai (Youth League Faction). She served as a member of the Politburo of the CPC and Vice Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, and was appointed as a State Councilor during the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国上将，曾任国防部部长。在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为国务委员和中央军事委员会委员。
description.en: A general in the People's Liberation Army, appointed as a State Councilor and a member of the Central Military Commission during the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国务院副总理，并在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为国务委员。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as a Vice Premier of the State Council and was appointed as a State Councilor during the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物。曾任中共上海市委副书记，并在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为国务委员。此后，他接替周永康担任中共中央政法委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician. He formerly served as Deputy Secretary of the Shanghai Municipal Committee of the CPC and was appointed as a State Councilor during the 11th National People's Congress. Subsequently, he succeeded Zhou Yongkang as Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国土家族政治人物、高级外交官。在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为国务委员，并曾担任中央外事工作领导小组办公室主任。
description.en: A Chinese politician and senior diplomat of Tujia ethnicity. He was appointed as a State Councilor during the 11th National People's Congress and served as Director of the Office of the Central Foreign Affairs Leading Group.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国前正国级领导人，曾任中共第十八届中央政治局常委、国务院副总理（并担任推进“一带一路”建设工作领导小组首任组长），以及中共天津市委书记。
description.en: Former member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the CCP and Vice Premier of the State Council of the PRC.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党、中华人民共和国政治人物，原正国级领导人，团派主要成员。曾任中共中央政治局常委、第十三届全国政协主席、国务院副总理、中共广东省委书记、中共重庆市委书记。他是薄熙来在重庆市委书记职务上的前任及政治竞争对手。
description.en: Chinese politician, a key member of the Tuanpai (Youth League Faction), and a former top national leader. He served as a member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the CPC, Chairman of the 13th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC), Vice Premier of the State Council, Secretary of the CPC Guangdong Provincial Committee, and Secretary of the CPC Chongqing Municipal Committee. He was Bo Xilai's predecessor and political rival as Chongqing Municipal Party Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 蒙古族，原中共中央书记处书记，陈希的前任国家行政学院院长。
中国人民解放军上将，曾任国防部部长，并在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为中央军事委员会委员。
description.en: A general in the People's Liberation Army, appointed as a member of the Central Military Commission during the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国外交官及政治人物，曾任中共中央政治局委员、中央外事工作委员会办公室主任、国务委员、中华人民共和国外交部部长等职务。
description.en: A Chinese diplomat and politician of the Communist Party of China, who has served as a member of the Politburo, Director of the Office of the Central Foreign Affairs Commission, State Councilor, and Minister of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物。曾任中共中央政法委书记、中共十九届中央政治局委员、中央书记处书记。他也是傅政华担任公安部副部长时的上级。
description.en: Chinese politician. He served as Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, a member of the Political Bureau, and a secretary of the Secretariat of the 19th CPC Central Committee. He was also Fu Zhenghua's superior when Fu was Vice Minister of Public Security.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任上海市市长、代理市委书记（接替陈良宇），后任中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理（接替张高丽），现任中华人民共和国副主席。
description.en: Chinese politician, current Vice President of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国务院副总理，中共十九届中央政治局委员。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as a Vice Premier of the State Council and a member of the Political Bureau of the 19th CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物、副国级领导人。他曾是团派主要成员，一度被视为胡锦涛的隔代接班人，但在中共二十大上失势。现任第十四届全国政协副主席、党组副书记。
description.en: A political figure of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, holding a sub-national leadership position. He was a key member of the Tuanpai (Youth League Faction), once seen as Hu Jintao's designated successor, but lost power at the 20th CPC National Congress. He currently serves as the Vice Chairman and Deputy Party Secretary of the 14th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物、经济学者，曾任中共十九届中央政治局委员、国务院副总理。他是习近平的童年朋友和亲密顾问，原国家级副职领导人。
description.en: Chinese politician and economist. He served as a member of the Political Bureau of the 19th CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of China. He is a childhood friend and close advisor to Xi Jinping, and a former national-level deputy leader.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军火箭军上将，曾任第二炮兵部队司令员、火箭军首任司令员、国防部部长。
中国政治人物、高级外交官，副国级领导人，77级大学生。现任中共第二十届中央政治局委员、中共中央外事工作委员会办公室主任，曾任外交部长、国务委员。
description.en: Chinese politician and senior diplomat, a member of the Class of 1977 and a sub-national leader. He is currently a member of the Politburo of the CCP and Director of the Office of the Central Foreign Affairs Commission, having previously served as Minister of Foreign Affairs and State Councilor.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，全国人大常委会副委员长
中国政治家，曾任中华人民共和国公安部部长，国务委员，傅政华担任公安部副部长时的上级。
description.en: Chinese politician, Fu Zhenghua's superior when he was Vice Minister of Public Security.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，正国级领导人，现任中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理（排名第一）、中央港澳工作领导小组组长。曾任中共中央办公厅主任（蔡奇的前任）。他也是一名78级大学生。
description.en: A politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, a national-level leader. He is currently a member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the CPC Central Committee, the First-ranked Vice Premier of the State Council, and leader of the Central Leading Group on Hong Kong and Macau Affairs. He previously served as Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee (predecessor to Cai Qi). He is also a member of the Class of 1978.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，副国级领导人，现任中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理、中央财经委员会办公室主任、中央金融委员会办公室主任、中央金融工作委员会书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, current Vice Premier of the State Council.

birth_place.zh-cn: 河南省信阳专区罗山县
birth_place.en: Luoshan County, Xinyang Prefecture, Henan Province

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，副国级党和国家领导人。现任中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理、国务院安全生产委员会主任。曾任重庆市市长，是唐良智的前任。
description.en: A politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, a sub-national level party and state leader. He is currently a member of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee, Vice Premier of the State Council, and Director of the Work Safety Committee of the State Council. He previously served as Mayor of Chongqing, being Tang Liangzhi's predecessor.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，中共第二十届中央政治局委员，中华人民共和国国务院副总理。
description.en: Chinese politician, a member of the 20th Politburo of the Chinese Communist Party Central Committee, and a Vice Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国陆军上将，曾任中华人民共和国第十三任国防部部长。
中国政治人物，中共中央书记处书记，副国级领导人。曾任傅政华的继任公安部常务副部长、北京市公安局局长。
description.en: Chinese politician, Fu Zhenghua's successor as Executive Vice Minister of Public Security and Director of the Beijing Municipal Public Security Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 白族
中国共产党、中华人民共和国外交官及政治人物。曾任外交部部长、国务委员，原副国级领导人。
description.en: A Chinese diplomat who served as the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 负责对组织进行日常管理并施行法律政策等相关活动的政府机构，是三权分立中的一部分，负责执行国家政策。
description.en: The branch of government responsible for the day-to-day management of the state and the implementation of laws and policies, one of the three branches in the separation of powers.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国防部
en: Ministry of National Defense of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院负责履行国防职能的组成部门。中华人民共和国中央军事委员会的军事工作机关之一。
中国人民解放军海军上将，现任国防部部长
中华人民共和国国防部发言人，陆军大校
中华人民共和国国防部发言人，陆军大校
中华人民共和国国防部发言人，陆军大校

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国防部部长

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国防部的首长职位
中国军方举办军事外交活动和礼仪活动的场所
北京市下辖的市辖区
北京市的一条主要道路

zh-cn: 中国人民革命军事博物馆
en: Military Museum of the Chinese People's Revolution

description.zh-cn: 中国唯一的国家级大型综合性军事博物馆
位于北京市的纪念性建筑
北京市的一条街道

zh-cn: 中央人民政府人民革命军事委员会
en: People's Revolutionary Military Commission of the Central People's Government

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期的国家最高军事领导机关。在1949年至1954年间，它是中华人民共和国的最高军事领导机构。
description.en: The supreme military leading body of the People's Republic of China from 1949 to 1954.

zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议共同纲领
en: Common Program of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期的临时宪法，在1954年《中华人民共和国宪法》颁布前，实际上起着临时宪法的作用。
description.en: It effectively served as the interim constitution of the People's Republic of China before the promulgation of the 1954 Constitution.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会主席
en: Chairman of the Chinese Communist Party
Chairman of the Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
Chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在1945年至1982年间设立的最高领导人职务，后被中央委员会总书记取代。
description.en: The highest leadership position in the Communist Party of China from 1945 to 1982, later replaced by the General Secretary of the Central Committee.

birth_place.zh-cn: 四川省顺庆府仪陇县马鞍镇

death_place.zh-cn: 北京市东城区北京医院

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党的优秀党员、伟大的无产阶级革命家，党、国家和军队的卓越领导人之一，中国共产党、中华人民共和国及中国人民解放军的主要缔造者和创始人之一。他曾任中国工农红军总司令，是长征期间重要的军事领导人，也是中华人民共和国十大元帅之首。他参与创建了井冈山革命根据地。
description.en: An outstanding member of the Communist Party of China, a great proletarian revolutionary, and one of the eminent leaders of the Party, state, and military. He was one of the main founders and creators of the Communist Party of China, the People's Republic of China, and the People's Liberation Army. He served as Commander-in-Chief of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, was an important military leader during the Long March, and the foremost of the Ten Marshals of the People's Republic of China. He also participated in the establishment of the Jinggangshan Revolutionary Base.

zh-cn: 第一届全国人民代表大会
第一届全国人民代表大会第一次会议
en: First Session of the 1st National People's Congress
First Session of the First National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的第一届最高国家权力机关。其第一次会议于1954年9月在北京市召开，通过了《中华人民共和国宪法》和《中华人民共和国国务院组织法》，标志着人民代表大会制度的确立，选举产生了新的国家领导机构，并成立了中华人民共和国国务院。许涤新、曾泽生等曾当选为代表。此次会议也导致了中央人民政府重工业部的结束。
description.en: The first highest state authority of the People's Republic of China. Its first session, held in Beijing in September 1954, passed the 'Constitution of the People's Republic of China' and the 'Organic Law of the State Council', marking the establishment of the system of people's congresses. It elected new state leadership bodies and established the State Council of the People's Republic of China. Xu Dixin and Zeng Zesheng were among its delegates. This session also led to the dissolution of the Central People's Government Ministry of Heavy Industry.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国防委员会
en: National Defence Commission of the People's Republic of China
National Defense Commission of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 1954年至1975年间中华人民共和国的最高军事领导机构，同时也是国家军事咨询议事机构。
description.en: The supreme military leading body of the People's Republic of China from 1954 to 1975.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国中央军事委员会
中国人民革命军事委员会
中国共产党中央军事委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国中央军事委员会，通称中央军事委员会，简称中央军委、军委，是中国共产党和中华人民共和国武装力量最高军事领导机构的总称，包括中国共产党中央军事委员会、中华人民共和国中央军事委员会两个机构。受中国共产党中央委员会和全国人民代表大会领导。在土地革命战争后期、抗日战争和第二次国共内战时期，它是中国共产党的最高军事领导机构。——机构沿革：1926年11月上旬，为准备上海工人武装起义，中共中央决定将中央军事部改为中央军事委员会兼上海区军事委员会，周恩来任书记。1927年5月25日召开的中共中央政治局常委会将中央军事委员会改称中央军人部（仍习惯性称中央军事部）。1930年2月，军事部与军委合二为一。1931年11月25日，设中华苏维埃共和国中央革命军事委员会、负责红军作战和建设。仍设中央军事委员会。1937年7月，中革军委与中央军委改组中共中央革命军事委员会。1945年8月，新成立中央军事委员会。1949年，改称中国人民革命军事委员会，作为中华人民共和国成立初期的最高军事领导机构。1954年9月28日，通过首部宪法，设中共中央军事委员会。1982年12月4日，通过八二宪法，成立中华人民共和国中央军事委员会。此后，中共中央军委和国家中央军委的组成人员基本相同，实际上是“一个机构两块牌子”。
description.en: The supreme military leading body in the early days of the People's Republic of China.

He served as Vice President of the Republic of China and later as acting President after Chiang Kai-shek's resignation, notably commanding the Battle of Taierzhuang. He was impeached by the Control Yuan. Liu Zhendong was among his subordinates.

description.en: The Third Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China marked the beginning of China's reform and opening-up. This important meeting established Deng Xiaoping's core leadership position, signaling China's entry into a new era, and created the political conditions for rehabilitating unjust, false, and and wrongful cases.

description.zh-cn: 2018年3月11日，第十三届全国人民代表大会第一次会议以2958票赞成、2票反对、3票弃权表决通过《宪法修正案》。该修正案取消了《中华人民共和国宪法》中关于国家主席和副主席“连续任职不得超过两届”的规定，并将习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想写入《中华人民共和国宪法》。
description.en: This constitutional amendment removed the provision from the Constitution of the People's Republic of China that the President and Vice President 'shall serve no more than two consecutive terms', and also wrote Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era into the Constitution of the People's Republic of China.

description.en: The Communist Youth League of China is the youth organization of the Communist Party of China, with its history traceable to its predecessor. It is a mass organization for advanced youth led by the CPC, considered its assistant and reserve force, and a primary source of officials for the Youth League Faction. Li Keqiang served as its top leader (First Secretary of the Central Secretariat) from 1993 to 1998. Li Fuchun also served as chairman of its European Executive Committee.

description.en: The China Association for Science and Technology (CAST) is a mass organization for scientific and technological workers in China, a national people's organization in the field of science and technology in the People's Republic of China, and one of the most important non-governmental organizations for scientific and technological work in mainland China. It was formed in September 1958 through the merger of its predecessor organizations with the All-China Association for Science and Technology Popularization. CAST is directly led by the Secretariat of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

越南战争，发生在1955年至1975年间，是越南民主共和国（北越）与越南共和国（南越）及其盟友之间的一场长期战争。这场战争也波及到老挝和柬埔寨，美国第七舰队参与其中。期间，北越军队曾因疟疾问题向中国求助，促成了523项目的启动。美国军方在此次战争中大量使用了由孟山都等公司生产的落叶剂橙剂，并引发了伯克利学生的大规模反战运动。
description.en: The Vietnam War, occurring between 1955 and 1975, was a prolonged conflict between the Democratic Republic of Vietnam (North Vietnam) and the Republic of Vietnam (South Vietnam) and their allies. This war also extended to Laos and Cambodia, with the U.S. Seventh Fleet participating. During this period, North Vietnamese forces sought Chinese assistance for malaria issues, leading to the initiation of Project 523. The U.S. military extensively used the defoliant Agent Orange, produced by companies including Monsanto, which also triggered large-scale anti-war movements by Berkeley students.

en: Second Taiwan Strait Crisis artillery duel

description.zh-cn: 1958年发生在台湾海峡的军事冲突，也是第二次台湾海峡危机的主要军事行动。期间，解放军对金门进行了大规模炮击，同时美国第七舰队为中华民国海军的补给船队提供护航。
description.en: A military conflict in the Taiwan Strait in 1958, and the main military action of the Second Taiwan Strait Crisis. During this period, the PLA conducted a massive artillery bombardment of Kinmen, while the U.S. Seventh Fleet provided escorts for the supply convoys of the Republic of China Navy.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党对军队绝对领导的原则
抗日战争和第二次国共内战时期由中国共产党领导的武装力量之一，由南方八省红军和游击队改编而成。
description.en: One of the armed forces led by the Communist Party of China during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在中国东北地区创建的抗日武装
1936年12月12日，张学良、杨虎城在西安发动“兵谏”（亦称军事政变），扣留了时任国民政府军事委员会委员长的蒋中正，要求停止内战、一致抗日。此次事件促成了第二次国共合作，并结束了第一次国共内战。
description.en: On December 12, 1936, Zhang Xueliang and Yang Hucheng launched a 'remonstrance by military force' (also known as a military coup) in Xi'an, detaining Chiang Kai-shek, the head of the Nationalist government's Military Affairs Commission. They demanded an end to the civil war and a united front against Japan. This event led to the Second United Front and ended the First Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 指1960年至1989年间，中华人民共和国与苏联之间发生的一系列政治、意识形态和军事上的疏远与对峙冲突。分歧同时覆盖国家利益和意识形态层面。大跃进是导致关系恶化的重要因素之一。期间，苏联政府撕毁合同、撤走专家，加剧了中国三年困难时期。这一状况最终导致两国关系破裂，且《中苏友好同盟互助条约》在1980年期满后未再续约。此紧张关系也是促使中国寻求与日本建交的背景之一。
description.en: Refers to a series of political, ideological, and military estrangement and confrontation conflicts between the People's Republic of China and the Soviet Union from 1960 to 1989. Differences covered both national interests and ideological levels. The Great Leap Forward was one of the important factors leading to the deterioration of relations. During this period, the Soviet government's tearing up of contracts and withdrawal of experts exacerbated China's Three Years of Difficult Period. This situation ultimately led to the breakdown of relations between the two countries, and the Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship, Alliance and Mutual Assistance was not renewed after its expiration in 1980. This tense relationship also served as one of the background factors that prompted China to seek the establishment of diplomatic relations with Japan.

description.zh-cn: 20世纪80年代，中华人民共和国政府对其武装力量——中国人民解放军进行的精简整编工作，裁减员额100万。
description.en: A reduction of military personnel by one million in the People's Liberation Army of the People's Republic of China during the 1980s.

description.zh-cn: 马克思列宁主义是对马克思主义和列宁主义的统称，是由列宁和斯大林发展的马克思主义理论。它是中国共产党的第一个官方意识形态和指导思想之一，也是20世纪多数社会主义国家的官方意识形态。
description.en: Marxism-Leninism is a general term for the theories of Marxism and Leninism, and a Marxist theory developed by Vladimir Lenin and Joseph Stalin. It served as the Chinese Communist Party's first official ideology and a guiding thought, and was also the official ideology of most socialist states in the 20th century.

description.zh-cn: 以邓小平的名字命名，是中国共产党列为指导思想的理论体系之一，也是中国特色社会主义理论体系的开篇之作。
description.en: One of the guiding ideologies of the Communist Party of China, named after Deng Xiaoping.

description.zh-cn: 由江泽民提出的执政理念，后被确立为中国共产党指导思想之一。它要求中国共产党始终代表中国先进社会生产力的发展要求，代表中国先进文化的前进方向，代表中国最广大人民的根本利益，被认为是继承和发展了马克思列宁主义、毛泽东思想、邓小平理论。
description.en: A guiding ideology of the Chinese Communist Party proposed by Jiang Zemin, requiring the CCP to always represent the development trends of China's advanced social productive forces, the orientations of an advanced culture, and the fundamental interests of the overwhelming majority of the Chinese people.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党的指导思想之一，由胡锦涛提出。

zh-cn: 习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想
新时代中国特色社会主义思想
en: Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era

description.zh-cn: 由时任中共中央总书记习近平提出并创立的中国特色社会主义理论，是中国共产党的指导思想。其核心内容被概括为“十个明确”、“十四个坚持”和“十三个方面成就”。该理论于2017年中共十九大写入党章，并于2018年写入中华人民共和国宪法。
description.en: The theory of socialism with Chinese characteristics, primarily founded by Xi Jinping (then General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee), serves as the guiding ideology of the Communist Party of China. Its core content is summarized as 'Ten Clarifications,' 'Fourteen Adherences,' and 'Thirteen Aspects of Achievements'. description.en: Located on Xichang'an Street, Xicheng District, Beijing, China, within Zhongnanhai, it serves as the headquarters for the Communist Party of China and the State Council of the People's Republic of China, and one of the offices for the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee. It is the office location for important organs such as the State Council, the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee, and the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, and also the residence for some party and state leaders. Furthermore, it is the place where Emperor Guangxu was long-term confined and eventually passed away.

description.en: A Chinese revolutionary and statesman, one of the founders and early leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and a founding father of the PRC. He served as a judge and political figure for the CPC and PRC, and also as acting chairman of the PRC, sharing the vice-chairmanship with Song Qingling, and served as Vice Premier of the Government Administration Council of the Central People's Government. He was known as one of the 'Five Elders of Yan'an'. Father of Dong Lianghui, Xu Dixin once assisted him.
