description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国的最高领导机构，也是中国共产党的最高权力常设机关。它作为中央委员会的核心领导层、中央政治局的常设机构，实际是中国共产党和中华人民共和国的最高领导及决策机构。其通常由7名成员组成。李克强（2007-2022）、贾庆林（第十六届、第十七届）、李富春等曾担任该机构成员。
description.en: The highest leadership body of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and the permanent body of the CPC's highest authority. As the core leadership of the Central Committee and the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau, it de facto serves as the top leadership and decision-making body for both the CPC and the PRC. It typically consists of 7 members. Li Keqiang (2007-2022), Jia Qinglin (16th and 17th committees), Li Fuchun, and others have served as members of this body.

description.zh-cn: 任弼时的妻子，因向忠发叛变供出其住址而被捕。
description.en: Wife of Ren Bishi, who was arrested after Xiang Zhongfa betrayed her location upon his capture.

description.zh-cn: 任弼时的女儿。
任弼时的堂妹。
中国近现代思想家、政治家、革命家，新文化运动的主要开创者、倡导者和领袖之一，并担任《新青年》杂志主编。他是中国共产党的主要创始人、早期领导人，也是中国共产党首任总书记，是向忠发的前任。民国初年，他反对将孔教立为国教。五四运动后，他积极投身政治活动，思想转向马克思主义。在其任期内，于四一二事件中被南京国民政府列为首要通缉犯。
description.en: A modern Chinese thinker, politician, and revolutionary, he was a key initiator, advocate, and leader of the New Culture Movement, and served as editor-in-chief of 'New Youth' magazine. He was a main founder and early leader of the Communist Party of China, and its first General Secretary, serving as predecessor to Xiang Zhongfa. In the early Republic of China, he opposed establishing Confucianism as the state religion. After the May Fourth Movement, he actively engaged in political activities, and his ideology shifted towards Marxism. During his tenure, he was listed as a primary wanted criminal by the Nanjing Nationalist Government following the April 12th Incident.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党、中国人民解放军创始人之一，中国共产党早期主要领导人。他曾反对共产国际任命其担任苏区中央局书记。作为红四方面军主要领导人，在与红一方面军会师后，因路线分歧另立中央，后被迫取消。在长征期间，其南下路线遭到李富春的反对。最终，他脱党并因与中央分裂而被开除党籍。
description.en: One of the founders of the Chinese Communist Party and the People's Liberation Army, and an early leader of the CCP. He opposed the Comintern's appointment of him as the secretary of the Soviet Area Central Bureau. As a key leader of the Fourth Front Army, after joining forces with the First Front Army, he established a separate party central committee due to strategic disagreements, which was later forced to be dissolved. During the Long March, his proposed southern route was opposed by Li Fuchun. Ultimately, he left the party and was expelled due to a split with the central committee.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央书记处
en: Secretariat of the Chinese Communist Party
Secretariat of the Central Committee of the CCP
Secretariat of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央政治局及其常务委员会的办事机构，同时也是中国共产党的中央机构之一。李富春曾任其书记，该机构还直接领导中国科学技术协会。
description.en: The administrative body of the Politburo and its Standing Committee of the Communist Party of China, and one of its central bodies. Li Fuchun served as a secretary, and the body directly leads the China Association for Science and Technology.

description.zh-cn: 第一次国共内战时期中共在中央苏区的最高领导机关。中国共产党在中央苏区的最高领导机构。
于右任等人于1922年创办的上海一所大学，于右任为首任校长。康生曾就读于此大学，王稼祥曾就读其大学附中。
description.en: A university founded in Shanghai in 1922 by Yu Youren and others, with Yu serving as its first president. Kang Sheng was a student here, and Wang Jiaxiang attended its affiliated middle school.

zh-cn: 中共陕甘宁特区委员会
中共陕甘宁边区中央局
en: Northwest Bureau of the CPC Central Committee

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会在西北地区设立的派出机构，作为其代表机关。
中国共产党早期主要领导人之一，曾两度担任中国共产党实际最高领导人，并在向忠发之前担任中共最高领导人，后被派回国纠正李立三路线。他是一位社会主义革命家、作家、诗人、翻译家、文学评论家。1935年被国民党逮捕，后在福建长汀被宋希濂奉命枪决。
description.en: An early principal leader of the Chinese Communist Party, who served as the actual highest leader twice, including before Xiang Zhongfa, and was later sent back to China to correct the Lisan Line. He was a socialist revolutionary, writer, poet, translator, and literary critic. He was arrested by the KMT in 1935 and later executed by order in Changting, Fujian, by Song Xilian's troops.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国的早期领导人、政治人物。他曾任国家级副职领导人，是对外工作的开拓者之一。在遵义会议上，他支持毛泽东，并与毛泽东、周恩来组成了新的“三人团”。
description.en: An early leader and political figure of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China. He served as a former state-level deputy leader and was one of the pioneers in foreign affairs. He supported Mao Zedong at the Zunyi Conference and later formed the new 'Trio' with Mao Zedong and Zhou Enlai.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期革命家。
中国共产党早期军事领导人之一。

death_place.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国北京市

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国的伟大无产阶级革命家、军事家、政治家，中华人民共和国十大元帅之一，中国人民解放军的创始人和缔造者之一，南昌起义领导人之一。曾任中国工农红军总参谋长。长征期间，他与彝族首领小叶丹结盟，确保红军顺利通过彝族区。在战争时期，他长期与邓小平搭档，并曾任中央军委战略小组组长。
description.en: A great proletarian revolutionary, military strategist, and politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, one of the Ten Marshals of the PRC, and one of the founders and creators of the People's Liberation Army, as well as one of the leaders of the Nanchang Uprising. He served as Chief of the General Staff of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army. During the Long March, he formed an alliance with the Yi leader Xiao Yedan, ensuring the Red Army's safe passage through the Yi region. He was a long-term partner of Deng Xiaoping during wartime and once served as the head of the Central Military Commission's strategic group.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事将领，西北军将领，与张学良共同发动西安事变。
description.en: Leader of the Northwestern Army and one of the instigators of the Xi'an Incident.

description.zh-cn: 东北军将领。

en: Criticize Chen and Rectify Work Style Campaign

description.zh-cn: 中共在九届二中全会后，自上而下开展的旨在批判陈伯达的政治运动，同时也是一场整风运动。该运动需区别于延安整风。
description.en: A political campaign launched by the CPC from top to bottom after the Second Plenary Session of the 9th Central Committee, aimed at criticizing Chen Boda. It was also a rectification movement and should be distinguished from the Yan'an Rectification Movement.

zh-cn: 关于若干历史问题的决议
en: Resolution on Certain Questions in the History of Our Party

description.zh-cn: 中共七大前夕通过的重要历史决议，总结了中国共产党建党以来的历史问题。
第二次国共内战“三大战役”之一，由林彪指挥的东北人民解放军对东北的国民革命军发起的决战。
description.en: One of the 'Three Great Campaigns' of the Chinese Civil War, a decisive battle launched by the Northeast People's Liberation Army under Lin Biao's command against the National Revolutionary Army in Northeast China.

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战时期“三大战役”之一，由中国人民解放军华东野战军、中原野战军在以徐州为中心，东起海州，西至商丘，北起临城，南达淮河的广大地区，对中华民国国军发动的战略性进攻战役。
description.en: One of the 'Three Great Campaigns' of the second Chinese Civil War, a strategic offensive launched by the People's Liberation Army's East China Field Army and Central Plains Field Army against the Republic of China Army.

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战“三大战役”之一。
description.en: One of the 'Three Great Campaigns' during the Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 苏联军事学院，是苏联武装力量培养诸兵种合成军队军官的最高军事学府。刘伯承曾在此学习。
description.en: A high-level military educational institution of the Soviet Armed Forces, where Liu Bocheng once studied.

description.zh-cn: 刘伯承的第三任妻子。
description.en: The third wife of Liu Bocheng.

description.zh-cn: 刘伯承与汪荣华之子，曾任装甲兵部队作战部副部长，少将。
description.en: Son of Liu Bocheng and Wang Ronghua, former deputy director of the Operations Department of the Armored Forces, Major General.

description.zh-cn: 刘伯承三子
刘伯承四子
刘伯承三女

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央政治局
中国共产党第十九届中央政治局
en: Politburo of the Chinese Communist Party
Politburo of the Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
Politburo of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China
Politburo of the Communist Party of China
Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China
Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China Central Committee

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党的中央领导机构之一，是其中央委员会的常设机构。在中央委员会全体会议闭会期间，行使中央委员会的职权。其组成人员是中国共产党和中华人民共和国的党和国家领导人。向忠发曾任主席，李富春曾任委员。该机构曾作出对陈良宇立案调查的决定。
description.en: One of the central leadership bodies and a standing institution of the Chinese Communist Party's Central Committee. It exercises the functions and powers of the Central Committee when its plenary session is not in session. Its members are party and state leaders of the CCP and the People's Republic of China. Xiang Zhongfa once served as its chairman, and Li Fuchun as a member. This body also made the decision to investigate Chen Liangyu.

description.zh-cn: 为增援西路军而组织的部队

en: West Route Army of the Red Army

description.zh-cn: 1936年10月，中国工农红军红四方面军主力约2.18万人，在甘肃靖远西渡黄河后，改称西路军（初称河西部队）。该部队奉命执行宁夏战役计划，但在河西走廊几乎全军覆没。
description.en: Formed in October 1936, the Western Route Army (initially known as the Hexi Force) consisted of the main force of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army's Fourth Front Army (approximately 21,800 troops) after crossing the Yellow River in Jingyuan, Gansu. Tasked with executing the Ningxia Campaign Plan and establishing a base in Hexi to open a route to the Soviet Union, the force was nearly annihilated in the Hexi Corridor.

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战时期中国共产党在中国中原地区设立的军区。
description.en: A military region established by the Communist Party of China in the Central Plains region of China during the Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在西南地区设立的中央局。
description.en: A Central Bureau established by the Communist Party of China in the Southwest region.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期在西南地区的政权机关

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军军事学院

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军的第一所最高军事学府，创办于中华人民共和国成立初期，旨在培养、提高解放军高级指挥员的军政素质。1986年，该学府与后勤学院、政治学院合并，共同组建了中国人民解放军国防大学。
description.en: The first highest military academy of the Chinese People's Liberation Army, established in the early days of the People's Republic of China, aimed at training and improving the military and political qualities of senior PLA commanders. In 1986, it merged with the Logistics Academy and the Political Academy to jointly form the PLA National Defense University.

description.zh-cn: 民国时期四川地方军队的称谓，朱德曾在此进行动员工作
川军将领，刘伯承早期上级

birth_place.zh-cn: 清朝河南省陈州府项城县袁张营
birth_place.en: Yuanzhangying, Xiangcheng, Chenzhou, Henan, Qing dynasty

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯是清末民初的军事家、政治家，北洋军的创始者与领导者，也是北洋军阀的奠基人。他曾任山东巡抚，参与东南互保，并上奏创办山东大学堂。他曾逼迫清帝溥仪退位，后任中华民国临时大总统及第一任正式大总统。他意图建立中华帝国，期间曾将紫禁城三大殿等建筑改名，但未能正式登基。他被广泛认为是刺杀宋教仁的幕后主使。赵秉钧是其重要亲信。
description.en: Yuan Shikai was a military and politician during the late Qing dynasty and early Republic of China. He founded and led the Beiyang Army, laying the groundwork for the Beiyang warlords. He served as Governor of Shandong, participated in the Mutual Protection of Southeast China, and proposed the establishment of Shandong University. He forced Emperor Puyi's abdication, then served as the Provisional and first Formal President of the Republic of China. He attempted to establish the Empire of China, renaming buildings like the Forbidden City's three great halls, though he was never formally enthroned. He was widely considered the mastermind behind Song Jiaoren's assassination. Zhao Bingjun was one of his key confidants.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事人物，北洋军阀直系首领之一，也是直系的代表人物，以其军事才能闻名，是直系军阀的实际军事领导者，为北伐战争的讨伐对象。
description.en: A military figure of the Republic of China, one of the leaders and a representative figure of the Zhili clique of the Beiyang Warlords, known for his military skills and as the de facto military leader of the clique, who was an object of the Northern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党革命家、民主革命家、教育家、政治人物。同盟会会员。1911年9月25日，他与王天杰共同领导了荣县独立，建立了辛亥革命时期第一个县级革命政权。曾任中国史学会副主席，刘伯承入党介绍人之一，中共五老之一，中国人民大学首任校长，并曾支持陶行知创办育才学校。
description.en: Chinese Communist revolutionary, democratic revolutionary, educator, and politician. A member of the Tongmenghui. On September 25, 1911, he, along with Wang Tianjie, led the independence of Rong County, establishing the first county-level revolutionary government during the Xinhai Revolution. He served as the vice-chairman of the Chinese Historical Association, was one of Liu Bocheng's introducers to the Communist Party, one of the 'Five Elders' of the Chinese Communist Party, the first president of Renmin University of China, and also supported Tao Xingzhi in founding Yucai School.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军一级上将和政治人物，奉系军阀领袖张作霖长子，东北军将领，西安事变发动者之一。他继承父业统治东北，并宣布东北易帜归顺国民政府。在中原大战后期，他于1930年9月18日发出电报，呼吁蒋、联双方停止内战，通电拥蒋，率军入关，影响了战局。他曾指挥东北军在中东路事件中与苏联作战。与堂兄张学成一同就读奉天讲武堂，后因张学成投靠日本而下令将其剿杀。
description.en: A prominent military and political figure of the Republic of China, the first son of warlord Zhang Zuolin. He was a leader of the Northeastern Army and one of the instigators of the Xi'an Incident. He inherited his father's rule over Northeast China and declared allegiance to the Nationalist Government. In the later stages of the Central Plains War, on September 18, 1930, he sent a telegram calling for an end to the civil war between Chiang's forces and the coalition, which constituted his decisive intervention in support of Chiang Kai-shek and influenced the outcome. He commanded the Northeastern Army against the Soviet Union during the Sino-Soviet conflict of 1929. He attended the Fengtian Military Academy with his cousin Zhang Xuecheng, whom he later ordered killed for collaborating with the Japanese.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期主要领导人之一，二十八个半布尔什维克成员。他曾任张闻天的前任（中共中央总书记），并在向忠发死后接任中共中央总负责人。在第五次反围剿战争中，他与李德共同担任实际领导者，并为战争的失败负主要责任，最终在遵义会议上被剥夺最高军事指挥权。他最终在黑茶山空难中遇难。
description.en: One of the early key leaders of the Communist Party of China and a member of the '28 Bolsheviks'. He served as Zhang Wentian's predecessor (General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee), and took over as the head of the CCP after Xiang Zhongfa's death. During the Fifth Anti-Encirclement Campaign, he, along with Li De, served as one of the actual leaders and was held primarily responsible for its failure, ultimately being stripped of supreme military command at the Zunyi Conference. He later died in the Heichashan air crash.

description.zh-cn: 共产国际派往中国的苏联军事顾问。曾在中国工农红军中担任指挥职务，但因不了解中国战场特点，其军事指挥导致第五次反围剿战争失败，后在遵义会议上被剥夺军事指挥权。
description.en: A Soviet military advisor sent by the Comintern to China. He held command positions in the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, but due to his lack of understanding of the Chinese battlefield, his military command led to the failure of the Fifth Anti-Encirclement Campaign, and he was later stripped of military command at the Zunyi Conference.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军高级将领，1937年1月战斗牺牲
彝族沽基族首领，与刘伯承在彝海结盟，帮助红军顺利通过彝族聚居区。
description.en: Leader of the Guji clan of the Yi people, who formed a sworn brotherhood with Liu Bocheng at Yihai, helping the Red Army to pass smoothly through the Yi residential area.

description.zh-cn: 国民革命军将领
中国共产党和中华人民共和国的领导人之一，中国人民解放军高级将领。他曾任铁道部部长，参与创建了井冈山革命根据地，并于1938年在延安与李富春等人合影。
description.en: One of the leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and a senior general of the People's Liberation Army. He served as Minister of Railways, participated in the establishment of the Jinggangshan Revolutionary Base, and was photographed with Li Fuchun and others in Yan'an in 1938.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事家、政治家，晋系军阀的创始人和最高领导人，亦是反蒋联军的“中华民国陆海空军总司令”。他长期统治山西，被称为“山西王”。美国《时代杂志》在1930年称其为“模范督军”，并认为他为山西带来了繁荣。
description.en: A military strategist and politician of the Republic of China, founder and supreme leader of the Jin clique, and also the commander-in-chief of the anti-Chiang coalition forces. He ruled Shanxi for a long period and was known as the "King of Shanxi". In 1930, Time Magazine called him a "model governor" who brought prosperity to Shanxi.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军一级上将，新桂系核心代表人物，中华民国首任国防部部长，华中剿匪总司令。他曾任淞沪戒严司令部司令，是四一二事件的主要执行者之一。他曾与杨宇霆在冀东会晤，并于事件后奉命来台宣慰。他是白先勇之父。
description.en: A first-class general of the Republic of China Army, a representative figure of the New Guangxi clique, and a prominent KMT general. He served as the commander of the Shanghai Martial Law Command and was one of the main executors of the April 12th Incident. He also met with Yang Yuting in eastern Hebei.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期军事领导人、中国人民解放军高级将领。曾在129师任职，与李达、邓小平、刘伯承共事并合影。
description.en: An early military leader of the CPC, who served with Li Da, Deng Xiaoping, and Liu Bocheng in the 129th Division and was photographed with them.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争中八路军发动的一次大规模战役

zh-cn: 冀南、太行、太岳行政联合办事处

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在抗日战争时期于中国华北敌后设立了行政机构。中国华北作为根据地，不仅是中共在抗日战争时期的主要活动区域，也是第二次国共内战期间中共设立的军事区域。
description.en: This administrative body was established by the Communist Party of China behind enemy lines in North China during the Second Sino-Japanese War. North China served as a base area established by the CCP during the Anti-Japanese War, and also as a military region established by the CCP during the second phase of the Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 解放战争时期的一次重要战役

zh-cn: 中国共产党第六次全国代表大会
en: 6th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party

description.zh-cn: 1928年中国共产党在莫斯科召开全国代表大会，会上提出“马克思主义中国化”，并推动了民族政策从民族自决向民族区域自治的转变。会议后，向忠发当选为中共中央总书记。
description.en: The National Congress of the Communist Party of China was held in Moscow in 1928. During the congress, the concept of 'Sinicization of Marxism' was proposed, and national policies shifted from national self-determination to regional ethnic autonomy. After the congress, Xiang Zhongfa was elected General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1929年中东路事件期间，共产国际在苏联伯力附近组建了一个主要由中国矿工组成的军事单位，该单位旨在支持苏联。同时，中国共产党也发起了一场旨在支持苏联的政治运动，两者处于同一历史背景。
description.en: During the 1929 Sino-Soviet conflict, the Comintern formed a military unit near Khabarovsk, Soviet Union, mainly composed of Chinese miners. This unit aimed to support the Soviet Union. Concurrently, the Chinese Communist Party also initiated a political movement with the same objective, both existing within the same historical context.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央在长征途中召开的一次重要的政治局扩大会议，确立了毛泽东在党和红军中的领导地位。
description.en: An enlarged meeting of the Politburo of the Communist Party of China held during the Long March, which established Mao Zedong's leadership position within the party and the Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 1962年10月至11月发生在中华人民共和国和印度共和国之间的一场边境战争。
中国共产党、中华人民共和国政治人物，正国级领导人。曾任中央人民政府副主席、国家计划委员会主席。作为中华人民共和国早期主要领导人之一，他是“五马进京”事件核心人物之一，后因“高岗饶漱石事件”被打为反党集团首领并倒台，最终自杀。小说《刘志丹》被指控为高岗翻案，是其主要罪名之一。
description.en: A politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, a state-level leader. He served as Vice Chairman of the Central People's Government and Chairman of the State Planning Commission. As one of the early main leaders of the PRC, he was one of the core figures in the 'Five Horses Enter Beijing' incident, later labeled the leader of an anti-Party clique due to the 'Gao Gang-Rao Shushi Incident', eventually falling from power and committing suicide. One of the main accusations against the novel 'Liu Zhidan' was that it was an attempt to reverse the verdict on Gao Gang.

description.zh-cn: 刘少奇的第六任妻子，曾任中华人民共和国第一夫人、物理学家、全国政协常委。
中国共产党领导的早期工人运动之一。
中国反帝国主义的群众运动。

en: Northern Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在华北地区的领导机关，为中国共产党中央委员会的派出机构。
description.en: A dispatched agency of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, leading the Communist Party in North China.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在中原地区的领导机关。中国共产党在长江以北地区的领导机关。
抗日战争期间，国民革命军与新四军之间发生的军事冲突，属于国共摩擦范畴。此次事件中，国民党军队袭击新四军，其军部遭到围攻。
中国共产党在华北地区的中央派出机构，同时也是该地区的领导机关。
description.en: The dispatched agency of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China in North China.

description.zh-cn: 原中国共产党、中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任副国级领导人及中共华东局第一书记（康生曾为其副手）。他是“五马进京”事件的核心人物之一，后因“高饶反党联盟”事件倒台并被打倒。
description.en: A former political figure of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China. He served as a vice-national level leader and the First Secretary of the CPC East China Bureau (with Kang Sheng as his deputy). He was one of the core figures in the 'Five Horses Enter Beijing' incident and was later purged due to the 'Gao-Rao Anti-Party Alliance' incident.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期领导人之一.
中国共产党领导工人运动的第一个公开机构。

zh-cn: 中国共产党第六届中央委员会第四次全体会议

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党第六届中央委员会第四次全体会议。
是一位杰出的无产阶级革命家和理论家、忠诚的马克思主义者，也是中国共产党早期及长征时期的重要领导人之一。遵义会议后，他接替博古负总责并任中共中央总书记。他还曾任中华人民共和国外交部副部长。他曾批准刘少奇保释干部的决定，后因在庐山会议支持彭德怀而被定为反党集团成员。
description.en: He was an outstanding proletarian revolutionary and theorist, a loyal Marxist, and one of the important leaders of the Chinese Communist Party during its early period and the Long March. After the Zunyi Conference, he succeeded Bo Gu as the General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, taking overall responsibility for the party. He also served as Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China. He approved Liu Shaoqi's decision to bail out cadres and was later labeled a member of an anti-Party group for supporting Peng Dehuai at the Lushan Conference.

description.zh-cn: 刘少奇于1939年7月在延安马列学院的演讲，后整理成书。这是其著名的理论著作，强调党员的意识形态修养。

zh-cn: 中国共产党第七次全国代表大会
en: 7th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party
7th National Congress of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党第七次全国代表大会在延安举行，会议确立了毛泽东思想为党的指导思想。
description.en: The 7th National Congress of the Communist Party of China was held in Yan'an, establishing Mao Zedong Thought as the party's guiding ideology.

description.zh-cn: 刘少奇的第三任妻子。
刘少奇与何宝珍的长子。
刘少奇与何宝珍的女儿。
刘少奇与王前的儿子。
刘少奇与王前的女儿。
刘少奇与王光美的长女。
刘少奇与王光美的二女儿。
刘少奇与王光美的小女儿。
中国劳动模范，北京市清洁工人。
华国锋的妻子。
华国锋长女
华国锋次女
中国杂交水稻育种专家，中国工程院院士，美国国家科学院外籍院士。因其在20世纪60-70年代对杂交水稻品种的研究，显著提高了中国及世界各地的粮食产量，被誉为“杂交水稻之父”。
description.en: A Chinese agronomist, member of the Chinese Academy of Engineering, and foreign associate of the U.S. National Academy of Sciences. He is renowned as the "Father of Hybrid Rice" for his research on hybrid rice varieties in the 1960s and 1970s, which significantly increased food production in China and around the world.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军将领。
中国政治人物、中国共产党领导人之一，曾任中共中央政治局委员、北京市委第一书记、北京市市长，以及中共北京市委第二书记。他参与策划了粉碎四人帮事件，但曾阻挠为六十一人叛徒集团案平反。
description.en: A Chinese politician and one of the leaders of the Communist Party of China. He served as a member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, First Secretary of the Beijing Municipal Committee, Mayor of Beijing, and Second Secretary of the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee. He participated in planning the smashing of the Gang of Four but also obstructed the rehabilitation of the Case of the 61 Renegades.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗巴列维王朝的末代国王，在1979年伊朗伊斯兰革命中被推翻。
description.en: The last Shah of the Pahlavi dynasty in Iran, overthrown in the 1979 Iranian Revolution.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国公安部
en: Ministry of Public Security of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院主管全国公安工作的组成部门，中国的国家警察机关，负责起草《中华人民共和国治安管理处罚法》。该机构在镇压前曾与李洪志保持正面关系，并于1999年7月29日对其发布全国通缉令。2003年，该机构还公布了首批“东突”恐怖组织名单，其中包括“东伊运”。
description.en: The national police agency of China and a component department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for drafting the 'Public Security Administration Punishments Law of the People's Republic of China'. It maintained positive relations with Li Hongzhi before the suppression, issuing a nationwide wanted notice for him on July 29, 1999. In 2003, the agency also announced the first list of 'East Turkestan' terrorist organizations, including ETIM.

zh-cn: 中国共产党湖南省委员会
en: Hunan Provincial Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
Hunan Provincial Committee of the CCP
Hunan Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间湖南省的权力机构。
文化大革命期间国务院的办事机构。
"凡是派"是中华人民共和国在文化大革命结束后，由时任中共中央主席华国锋等人提出的政治原则和执政指导思想。它主张绝对遵循毛泽东的一切决策和指示，即“凡是毛主席作出的决策，我们都坚决维护；凡是毛主席的指示，我们都始终不渝地遵循”。该方针旨在维持毛泽东时代的政策和思想路线，并因此成为真理标准大讨论中被批判的核心观点。
description.en: "Whateverism" (Two Whatevers) was a political principle and governing guiding ideology proposed by Hua Guofeng and others, then Chairman of the CCP Central Committee, after the Cultural Revolution in the People's Republic of China. It advocated for absolute adherence to Mao Zedong's decisions and instructions, stating: 'We will resolutely uphold whatever policy decisions Chairman Mao made, and unswervingly follow whatever instructions Chairman Mao gave.' This principle aimed to maintain the policies and ideological line of the Mao Zedong era and became the central point of criticism in the Truth Criterion Discussion.

en: The great discussion on the criterion of truth

description.zh-cn: 1978年在中国思想理论界展开的一场关于实践是检验真理的唯一标准（即真理标准问题）的大讨论。此次讨论旨在批判“两个凡是”，确立实践是检验真理的唯一标准。这是一次重要的思想解放运动，为中共十一届三中全会召开作了思想准备。
description.en: A major debate on practice being the sole criterion for testing truth (the criterion for testing truth issue) unfolded in China's ideological and theoretical circles in 1978. This debate aimed to criticize the 'Two Whatevers' and establish practice as the sole criterion for testing truth. It was an important ideological emancipation movement that laid the ideological groundwork for the 3rd Plenary Session of the 11th CCP Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 20世纪中国死亡人数最多的一次地震。
叶剑英的配偶。
叶剑英的配偶。
叶剑英的配偶。
中国政治人物，叶剑英长子，曾任全国政协常务副主席。
叶剑英次子。
叶剑英三子。
叶剑英骨灰安葬地。
由中国共产党领导的针对中国国民党的武装起义。
中华民国时期军事及政治人物，粤系军阀的代表人物。他曾炮轰总统府，也曾与孙中山合作但之后反目。
description.en: A military and political figure in the Republic of China era, representative of the Yue clique. He once cooperated with Sun Yat-sen but later became his opponent.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党左派领袖、革命家，曾任黄埔军校党代表。
description.en: A revolutionary of the Kuomintang, served as the Party Representative of the Whampoa Military Academy.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党早期领导人之一，中华民国大陆时期政要、诗人。他曾是一位早期的革命者，策划暗杀时任摄政王的载沣。后任武汉国民政府主席，与蒋介石在分共方式上存在分歧，导致宁汉分裂。最终成为汪精卫政权的首脑。
description.en: One of the early leaders of the Kuomintang and a prominent politician and poet during the Republic of China era on the mainland. He was an early revolutionary who plotted the assassination of the then Prince-Regent Zaifeng. He later served as chairman of the Wuhan Nationalist Government, where his disagreements with Chiang Kai-shek over the method of purging communists led to the Nanjing-Wuhan split. Eventually, he became the head of the Wang Jingwei regime.

description.zh-cn: 中国军事家，北伐名将，中国人民解放军创建者之一，曾任新四军军长。
description.en: One of the founders of the People's Liberation Army, a key leader of the New Fourth Army, and a Chinese military strategist.

description.zh-cn: 日本政治人物、建筑师，曾任第64、65任内阁总理大臣。因平民出身被称为“庶民宰相”，但也因洛克希德事件等丑闻备受争议。他曾代表日方签署《中日联合声明》。
description.en: Japanese politician and architect who served as the 64th and 65th Prime Minister of Japan. Known as the 'commoner prime minister' for his humble origins, he was also controversial due to scandals like the Lockheed affair. He signed the Sino-Japanese Joint Communiqué on behalf of Japan.

birth_place.en: Futada Village, Kariwa District, Niigata Prefecture

description.zh-cn: 《中华人民共和国全国人大常委会告台湾同胞书》是由全国人民代表大会常务委员会发表的文件，标志着中华人民共和国对台政策的转变，并宣告停止对金门等岛屿的炮击。
description.en: A document issued by the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, marking a shift in the PRC's policy towards Taiwan and announcing the cessation of shelling of islands like Kinmen.

description.zh-cn: 叶剑英的养女。
叶剑英的弟弟。
国民革命军的部队之一，因在北伐战争中战功卓著而被称为“铁军”。

zh-cn: 中华苏维埃共和国中央革命军事委员会

description.zh-cn: 中华苏维埃共和国和土地革命战争时期中国工农红军的最高军事领导和指挥机构，负责领导全国红军的作战和建设。同时期，上海有中央军事委员会，负责后勤等。

en: Southern Bureau of the CPC Central Committee

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在抗日战争时期设于重庆的派出机构，是其在国民党统治区的领导机关。该机构曾重视并支持育才学校，许涤新也曾在此宣传部工作。
description.en: An agency of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China established in Chongqing during the Second Sino-Japanese War, serving as its leading body in Kuomintang-controlled areas. It valued and supported Yucai School, and Xu Dixin once worked in its Propaganda Department.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军的院校。
中国第二次国共内战中，北平以和平方式易手。
中华民国陆军二级上将，晋系重要将领。曾任国民党华北剿匪总司令，在平津战役中率部和平改编，促成北平解放，并于第二次国共内战末期投向中国共产党。他是一位中国军事家、政治家，曾任中华人民共和国水利部、水利电力部部长。
description.en: General (Second Class) of the Republic of China Army and an important general of the Jin clique. He was the former Commander-in-Chief of the Kuomintang's North China Bandit Suppression Headquarters and led his troops to accept peaceful reorganization during the Pingjin Campaign, facilitating the peaceful liberation of Beiping, and later defected with his troops to the Chinese Communist Party at the end of the Chinese Civil War. A Chinese military strategist and politician, he later served as Minister of Water Resources and Minister of Water Resources and Electric Power of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央在华南地区的派出机构。
中华人民共和国广东省的省级行政机关。
description.en: The provincial-level administrative organ of Guangdong Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国广东省的省会、副省级市和首批沿海开放城市。这里也是吴克华的逝世地。
description.en: The capital of Guangdong Province, a sub-provincial city, and one of the first coastal open cities in the People's Republic of China. It is also the place of death of Wu Kehua.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军军事科学院
en: People's Liberation Army Academy of Military Sciences

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军全军性的军事科学研究机关。
郭兴福教学法的创立者。
中国人民解放军与越南共和国军在西沙群岛发生的海战。
周恩来的出生地，位于清朝江苏省淮安府，今江苏省淮安市淮安区。
周恩来妻子，中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，原正国级领导人，中共八大元老之一，曾任全国政协主席。
description.en: A former major leader of the Chinese Communist Party and the People's Republic of China, who served as Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 周恩来胞弟
周恩来留法期间的女友，中国第一位留法女博士，与邓颖超共同组织天津女界爱国同志会。
位于中国天津市的一所著名综合性研究型大学，由教育家严修、张伯苓创办。周恩来、姚依林、孟凡利等曾就读于此。艾跃进亦是其校友，并曾在此长期任教。
description.en: A famous comprehensive research university located in Tianjin, China, founded by educators Yan Xiu and Zhang Boling. Notable alumni include Zhou Enlai, Yao Yilin, Meng Fanli, and Ai Yuejin, who also served as a long-term faculty member.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党旅欧支部的早期组织，李富春曾参与建立并担任地方支部书记。
description.en: An early organization of the European branch of the Chinese Communist Party, which Li Fuchun helped establish and served as a local branch secretary.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期组织之一。
五四运动时期在天津成立的青年学生社团。

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国外交部
en: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China

location.zh-cn: 北京市朝阳区朝阳门南大街2号

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院主管外交事务的组成部门，曾就此事件作出回应。
description.en: The department of the People's Republic of China government responsible for foreign affairs, which responded to this incident.

description.zh-cn: 林彪的妻子，林立果、林立衡之母，曾任中共第九届中央政治局委员，林彪反革命集团案主犯之一，在九一三事件中坠机身亡。
description.en: Wife of Lin Biao, mother of Lin Liheng.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上将，林彪反革命集团案主犯之一，曾任总参谋长。时任广州军区司令，支持韦国清镇压“4·22”派。
中国人民解放军空军上将，曾任空军司令员。林彪反革命集团主犯之一。
description.en: An Air Force General of the People's Liberation Army, once served as Commander of the Air Force. One of the main culprits of the Lin Biao counter-revolutionary clique.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海军中将，林彪反革命集团主要成员之一，曾任海军政治委员。
description.en: A Navy Vice Admiral of the People's Liberation Army, one of the main culprits of the Lin Biao counter-revolutionary clique.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将，林彪集团主要成员，曾任总后勤部部长。林彪反革命集团主犯之一。
关于工业、农业、交通运输业和国防现代化的国家战略目标。
旨在解决朝鲜半岛和印度支那问题的国际会议，会议决定以北纬17度线为界暂时分割越南。
description.en: An international conference to resolve issues in the Korean Peninsula and Indochina, which decided to temporarily partition Vietnam at the 17th parallel.

description.zh-cn: 中国妇女运动的先驱，觉悟社成员。
中国共产党创始人之一，哲学家、政治活动家，介绍朱德入党。
description.en: One of the founders of the Communist Party of China, a philosopher and political activist.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期领导人之一，革命烈士，在四一二事件后的搜捕中被杀害。
description.en: One of the early leaders of the Communist Party of China, who was killed in the roundups following the April 12th Incident.

description.zh-cn: 中共早期领导人之一，曾负责情报保卫工作，并担任中共中央特科负责人。1931年被捕后叛变，投靠国民党，导致包括向忠发在内的大量中共地下党员被捕。
description.en: One of the early leaders of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP), who was responsible for intelligence and security work and served as the head of the CCP's special service (Teke). After being arrested in 1931, he defected to the Kuomintang, leading to the arrest of many underground CCP members, including Xiang Zhongfa.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期领导人，曾任中共中央政治局主席、中共中央总书记。因出身工人阶级而被共产国际提拔，但实际领导权多由周恩来、李立三等人掌握。1931年在上海被国民政府逮捕后迅速叛变并被处决。
description.en: An early leader of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP), serving as Chairman of the CCP Central Politburo and General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee. He was promoted by the Comintern due to his working-class background, but actual leadership was often held by others like Zhou Enlai and Li Lisan. After his arrest by the Nationalist government in Shanghai in 1931, he quickly defected and was executed.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期领导人，中共驻共产国际代表团团长。共产国际派遣回国后，他逐渐取代向忠发成为中共实际领导人，并在向忠发死后代理总书记。他被认为是“左”倾教条主义的代表，国际派人物，二十八个半布尔什维克之一，也是瞿秋白的政治对手。
description.en: An early leader of the Communist Party of China (CCP), he served as the head of the CCP delegation to the Comintern. After being sent back to China by the Comintern, he gradually replaced Xiang Zhongfa as the de facto leader of the CCP, and later served as acting General Secretary after Xiang's death. He was considered a representative of 'left' dogmatism, a figure of the International Faction, one of the '28 and a half Bolsheviks', and a political opponent of Qu Qiubai.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治家，曾任美国副总统，并在1960年总统选举中作为共和党候选人与肯尼迪竞争。后成为美国第37任总统。其于1972年访华，推动了中美关系正常化，并为中日建交创造了条件。1973年，他在白宫会见了田中角荣。
description.en: American politician, served as Vice President, and competed with Kennedy as a Republican candidate in the 1960 presidential election. He later became the 37th President of the United States. His 1972 visit to China promoted the normalization of Sino-US relations and created conditions for the establishment of Sino-Japanese diplomatic relations. In 1973, he met with Kakuei Tanaka at the White House.

description.zh-cn: 美国外交家、政治家及国际关系专家，曾任美国国家安全顾问和国务卿。他亦曾对薄熙来主政时期的重庆发展持正面评价。
description.en: An American diplomat, political scientist, and international relations expert, who served as United States National Security Advisor and Secretary of State. He also once held a positive view of Chongqing's development during Bo Xilai's era.

zh-cn: 第二届全国人民代表大会
第三届全国人民代表大会

description.zh-cn: 中国人民志愿军是中华人民共和国在朝鲜战争期间派遣并支援朝鲜的武装力量。以“志愿”军队名义参战，并是《朝鲜停战协定》的签署方之一。
description.en: The Chinese People's Volunteer Army was the armed force dispatched by the People's Republic of China during the Korean War to aid North Korea. It participated under the guise of a 'volunteer' army and was a signatory to the Korean Armistice Agreement.

description.zh-cn: 彭德怀的出生地。
彭德怀的第二任妻子。
彭德怀的侄女。
晚清时期由曾国藩组建的湖南地方武装，其活动延续至民国初年，是清朝镇压太平天国的主要军事力量。
description.en: A regional army from Hunan organized by Zeng Guofan during the late Qing Dynasty. Its operations extended into the early Republic of China period, and it served as the primary military force for the Qing dynasty in suppressing the Taiping Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 1931年9月战斗牺牲
湖南督军。中华民国军事将领。
中国共产党党员，对彭德怀早期思想有影响。
彭德怀在湘军时的师长。
由彭德怀等人领导的武装起义。

zh-cn: 中国工农红军第四军 (红一方面军)
en: Fourth Red Army of the First Front Army

description.zh-cn: 由朱德和毛泽东的部队在井冈山会师后组成的红军主力部队之一。
description.en: A Red Army unit formed after the rendezvous of Zhu De's and Mao Zedong's forces at Jinggangshan.

description.zh-cn: 井冈山地方武装首领，后加入红军。1930年被彭德怀杀害。
description.en: A local armed leader in the Jinggang Mountains who later joined the Red Army. He was killed by Peng Dehuai in 1930.

description.zh-cn: 井冈山地方武装首领，后加入红军。1930年被彭德怀杀害。
description.en: A local armed leader in the Jinggang Mountains who later joined the Red Army. He was killed by Peng Dehuai in 1930.

description.zh-cn: 长江局代表。
国民革命军第18师师长。
国民革命军将领。
中国人民解放军大将。
中国人民解放军上将，长期负责中共情报保卫和特务工作，曾任中共中央社会部部长。
description.en: A senior general of the Chinese Communist Party, long responsible for intelligence and secret service work, who served as the head of the Central Social Affairs Department of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国将领。
中国工农红军和八路军高级指挥员，曾任八路军副参谋长。
中华民国陆军一级上将、国民革命军将领，黄埔军校第一期毕业，是蒋介石最信任的将领之一。曾参与东征、北伐、长征期间对红军的围堵、抗日战争和国共内战，号称“西北王”。
description.en: A first-class general of the Republic of China Army and National Revolutionary Army, a graduate of the first class of the Whampoa Military Academy, and one of Chiang Kai-shek's most trusted generals. He participated in the Eastern Expedition, Northern Expedition, the encirclement and blocking of the Red Army during the Long March, the Second Sino-Japanese War, and the Chinese Civil War, known as the 'King of the Northwest'.

birth_place.zh-cn: 大清浙江省宁波府镇海县
birth_place.en: Zhenhai County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang, Qing dynasty

death_place.zh-cn: 中华民国台湾省台北市
death_place.en: Taipei, Taiwan Province, Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华民国将领，国军整编第29军军长，在宜川战役中阵亡。
description.en: A general of the Republic of China who was killed in action during the Yichuan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国将领，青海王。
原新疆警备总司令。
中华人民共和国成立初期的大行政区军政领导机构。

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军新疆军区

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军曾设的六大军区之一。
朝鲜外务相。
美国陆军五星上将、菲律宾陆军元帅，曾任美国陆军参谋长、联合国军总司令、驻日盟军总司令，代表同盟国接受日本投降并主导了战后对日本的占领。在莱特湾海战期间，第七舰队归其指挥的西南太平洋方面军管辖。
description.en: An American five-star general and Field Marshal of the Philippine Army, who was Chief of Staff of the United States Army, Commander-in-Chief of the United Nations Command, and Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers. He accepted Japan's surrender on behalf of the Allies and led the post-war occupation of Japan. During the Battle of Leyte Gulf, the Seventh Fleet was under the command of his Southwest Pacific Area.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东与杨开慧的长子，毛岸青之兄，任彭德怀秘书，在朝鲜战争中阵亡。
朝鲜民主主义人民共和国的创建者和首任最高领导人，被尊为“共和国永远的主席”，曾任朝鲜总理。在朝鲜战争期间担任朝鲜人民军最高司令官，是《朝鲜停战协定》的签署人之一。
description.en: Founder and first supreme leader of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Served as the Supreme Commander of the Korean People's Army during the Korean War and was one of the signatories of the Korean Armistice Agreement.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民志愿军代司令员。
中国人民解放军元帅、中华人民共和国元帅，中国人民解放军和中华人民共和国的创建者与领导人之一。他曾任中国人民解放军总政治部主任、中央人民政府最高人民检察署检察长。
description.en: A Marshal of the People's Liberation Army and the People's Republic of China, and one of the founders and leaders of the People's Liberation Army and the People's Republic of China. He also served as Director of the General Political Department of the People's Liberation Army and Procurator-General of the Supreme People's Procuratorate of the Central People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党党员，曾任中共湖南省委第一书记。因在庐山会议上支持彭德怀，被错误地打成反党集团成员。他还是姚依林的入党介绍人。
description.en: A member of the Communist Party of China and former First Secretary of the Hunan Provincial Committee of the CPC. He was wrongly branded a member of an anti-Party group for supporting Peng Dehuai at the Lushan Conference. He also introduced Yao Yilin to the party.

description.zh-cn: 北京地质学院红卫兵造反派。
红卫兵头目。

zh-cn: 弗拉基米尔·拉祖瓦耶夫
弗拉基米尔·尼古拉耶维奇·拉祖瓦耶夫

birth_place.zh-cn: 俄罗斯帝国库尔斯克省阿列克谢耶夫卡村

description.zh-cn: 苏联军事将领、外交官，陆军中将军衔。曾参与俄国内战、苏芬战争、第二次世界大战和朝鲜战争。苏德战争期间历任多个方面军及集团军要职，朝鲜战争期间任苏联驻朝鲜特命全权大使兼朝鲜人民军总顾问。
description.en: Soviet military leader and diplomat with the rank of Lieutenant General. Participated in the Russian Civil War, Winter War, World War II, and the Korean War. Held key positions in various fronts and armies during the Soviet-German War, and served as the Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the USSR to North Korea and Chief Military Advisor to the Korean People's Army during the Korean War.

description.zh-cn: 徐向前的儿子。
中国政治人物，山西省立国民师范学校校友，中国人民解放军高级将领，曾指高岗在热河土改中推行极左路线。
中华民国军事将领及政治人物，西北军领袖，民国军阀，因其部队被称为“基督将军”。曾发动北京政变将溥仪逐出紫禁城，并创办了西北军第二军官学校。他也是反蒋联军的副总司令之一，曾应邀到育才学校演讲。
description.en: A warlord and political figure in the Republic of China, leader of the Guominjun (Northwest Army), known as the 'Christian General'. He founded the Northwest Army Second Military Officers' School and expelled Puyi from the Forbidden City during the Beijing Coup. He was also one of the deputy commanders-in-chief of the anti-Chiang coalition and was invited to give a speech at Yucai School.

description.zh-cn: 红四方面军早期领导人，后被张国焘杀害。
红四方面军政治委员，西路军政委，同时也是长征期间重要的政治领导人之一。
description.en: Political Commissar of the Fourth Front Army and the Western Route Army, and an important political leader during the Long March.

zh-cn: 山西省立国民师范学校

description.zh-cn: 徐向前、薄一波早年就读的师范学校。
description.en: The normal school that Xu Xiangqian and Bo Yibo attended in their early years.

zh-cn: 中国工农红军第四方面军
en: Fourth Front Army of the Red Army
Fourth Front Army of the Chinese Red Army

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军主力部队之一。由张国焘、徐向前、陈昌浩领导，其中徐向前是主要军事领导人，长征时期由张国焘领导。
description.en: One of the main forces of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army. It was led by Zhang Guotao, Xu Xiangqian, and Chen Changhao. Xu Xiangqian was one of its main military leaders, and it was led by Zhang Guotao during the Long March.

en: Alumni Association of Huangpu Military Academy

description.zh-cn: 由黄埔军校校友组成的联谊组织，宋希濂曾任副会长。
description.en: An organization composed of alumni of the Whampoa Military Academy, where Song Xilian served as vice president.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代一所著名的军事院校，朱德曾就读于此。
description.en: A famous modern military academy in China, where Zhu De once studied.

description.zh-cn: 位于德国哥廷根的公立研究型大学，朱德曾在此留学。
description.en: A public research university in Göttingen, Germany.

description.zh-cn: 朱德的原配夫人
朱德的第三位妻子
朱德的第五位妻子
朱德的第六任妻子，曾任全国妇联主席，中国妇女解放运动的领导人。
description.en: The sixth wife of Zhu De and a leader of the women's liberation movement in China.

description.zh-cn: 朱德的女儿，曾任北京师范大学俄语系教授。
description.en: The daughter of Zhu De, a former professor in the Russian Department at Beijing Normal University.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央纪律检查委员会
中共中央纪律检查委员会
十三届中央纪律检查委员会
en: Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Chinese Communist Party
Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党的最高纪律检查机关。该机构负责对薄熙来、陈良宇、周本顺等事件立案调查，并据报道是推动香港修订《逃犯条例》的真正倡议者。
description.en: The highest internal disciplinary body of the Communist Party of China. It is responsible for investigating incidents involving figures like Bo Xilai, Chen Liangyu, and Zhou Benshun, and was reportedly the true initiator behind Hong Kong's push to amend the extradition law.

description.zh-cn: 辛亥革命是一场推翻清朝统治、建立中华民国的全国性资产阶级民主革命。革命始于1911年武昌起义，共和派促使清宣统帝退位。北洋军阀袁世凯利用军事实力逼迫清帝退位并攫取了革命果实。摄政王载沣顺应潮流辞职。此次革命曾获邵玉轩斥巨资资助。
description.en: The Xinhai Revolution was a nationwide bourgeois democratic revolution that overthrew the Qing dynasty and established the Republic of China. It began with the Wuchang Uprising in 1911, leading to the abdication of Emperor Xuantong. Warlord Yuan Shikai exploited his military power to force the emperor's resignation and seize the revolution's fruits. Prince-Regent Zaifeng resigned in response to the changing times. This revolution received significant funding from Shao Yuxuan.

description.zh-cn: 滇军将领，曾提拔朱德，曾为范石生的上级，后被唐继尧击败身亡。
description.en: A general of the Yunnan Army, formerly Fan Shisheng's superior, who was later defeated and killed by Tang Jiyao.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党左派领导人
川军将领
国民革命军高级将领，朱德的老同学
中华民国军事将领，滇军著名将领，朱德的故旧。
description.en: A military general of the Republic of China and a notable commander in the Yunnan Army.

description.zh-cn: 朱德、陈毅领导的武装起义
朱德和毛泽东在红四军建军原则和领导方式上的分歧
中华民国军事人物、军阀，曾为冯玉祥部下，国民革命军将领。张作霖死后，张学成曾投靠于他。中原大战时，他加入反蒋联军并任第四方面军指挥官，后在该战役中失败。
description.en: A military figure and warlord of the Republic of China, formerly a subordinate of Feng Yuxiang and a general of the National Revolutionary Army. After Zhang Zuolin's death, Zhang Xuecheng once defected to him. During the Central Plains War, he joined the anti-Chiang coalition as the commander of the 4th Front Army and was later defeated in the war.

description.zh-cn: 国民革命军陆军二级上将
抗日战争时期，中国共产党在根据地内展开的生产自救运动，李富春是组织者之一。
description.en: A self-help production campaign launched by the Chinese Communist Party in its base areas during the Second Sino-Japanese War, which Li Fuchun helped organize.

description.zh-cn: 建国初期中国共产党在党政机关和工商界开展的政治运动
澳大利亚联邦总理
清末民初著名军事家、政治家，梁启超在时务学堂的学生。他是护国运动的主要组织者和领导者，曾遭遇袁世凯派遣的刺客暗杀但幸免于难。
description.en: A famous military strategist and politician of the late Qing and early Republic of China periods. He was a student of Liang Qichao at the Academy of Current Affairs, a key organizer and leader of the National Protection War, and survived an assassination attempt by assassins sent by Yuan Shikai.

description.zh-cn: 林彪与叶群之子，中华人民共和国文化大革命时期政治人物。曾任解放军空军司令部办公室副主任兼作战部副部长，是《“571工程”纪要》的主要策划者。
description.en: Son of Lin Biao and Ye Qun, a political figure during China's Cultural Revolution. He served as Deputy Director of the Air Force Command Headquarters Office and Deputy Minister of the Combat Department, and was the main planner of the "Project 571 Outline".

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，林彪与叶群之女，林立果的姐姐，《空军报》副总编。
description.en: Chinese political figure, daughter of Lin Biao and Ye Qun.

description.zh-cn: 林彪的女儿。
林彪的前妻。
林彪的堂兄，中共早期领导人。
林彪的堂兄，中共早期领导人。
中国清朝武官，本籍福建厦门。曾任台湾镇总兵，在1862年的戴潮春事件中的斗六门战役殉职。
description.en: A military official of the Qing Dynasty from Xiamen, Fujian. He served as the Taiwan Town General and was killed in the Battle of Douliumen during the Dai Chaochun Incident in 1862.

description.zh-cn: 越南民主共和国总理。
越南民主共和国国防部长。

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军第四野战军
国民革命军第十八集团军第115师

description.zh-cn: 八路军的三个主力师之一。

zh-cn: 中国人民抗日军事政治大学
中国人民抗日军政大学
中国人民抗日红军大学

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军国防大学的前身之一。该机构源于中国工农红军大学，于1936年6月更名，后于1937年初由中国人民抗日红军大学更名为抗日军政大学。作为中国共产党在抗日战争时期创办的学校，其主要任务是培养军事和政治干部。
description.en: One of the predecessors of the PLA National Defense University. This institution originated from the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army University, which was renamed in June 1936. In early 1937, it was further renamed from the Chinese People's Anti-Japanese Red Army University to the Anti-Japanese Military and Political University. Established by the Communist Party of China during the Second Sino-Japanese War, its primary mission was to train military and political cadres.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第九届中央委员会第二次全体会议
en: Second Plenary Session of the 9th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 在庐山召开的中共中央全会，林彪、陈伯达等人与毛泽东在设立国家主席等问题上发生严重分歧。此次会议标志着毛泽东和林彪关系公开破裂并迅速恶化，也成为陈伯达政治生涯的转折点。
description.en: A plenary session of the CPC Central Committee held in Lushan, where Lin Biao, Chen Boda, and others had serious disagreements with Mao Zedong on issues such as the establishment of the state chairmanship. This meeting marked the public breakdown and rapid deterioration of relations between Mao Zedong and Lin Biao, and also became a turning point in Chen Boda's political career.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争期间八路军首次集中较大兵力对日军的一次成功伏击战。
特指文革期间对毛泽东的个人崇拜。

en: Constitution of the Chinese Communist Party
Constitution of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党的根本法规，规定其组织架构和行为准则。1982年修订的章程还明确了中央顾问委员会的设立、地位和职能。
description.en: The fundamental regulations of the Communist Party of China, which stipulates its organizational structure and code of conduct. The constitution revised in 1982 also clarified the establishment, status, and functions of the Central Advisory Commission.

zh-cn: 苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟

description.zh-cn: 苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟（苏联），是由列宁和布尔什维克党建立的欧亚大陆北部的社会主义联邦制国家。作为共产国际总部，它在20世纪是社会主义阵营的领导者，冷战时期与美国对峙，成为两大超级大国。二战期间，苏联是同盟国主要成员，对中国提供援助并对日宣战，入侵满洲等。国共内战期间支援中国共产党，后与中华人民共和国结盟。1950年代末中苏交恶后，苏联撤走专家，对中国经济造成负面影响；1960年代后，苏联对中国构成安全威胁，促使中国寻求与西方国家缓和关系。它也是世界上第一个实现载人航天的国家。
description.en: The Union of Soviet Socialist Republics (USSR) was a socialist federal state in Northern Eurasia, founded by Lenin and the Bolshevik Party. As the headquarters of the Communist International, it was the leader of the socialist bloc in the 20th century, opposing the United States during the Cold War and becoming one of the two superpowers. During World War II, the USSR was a principal member of the Allied powers, providing aid to China and declaring war on Japan, invading Manchuria, etc. During the Chinese Civil War, it supported the Communist Party of China, and later allied with the People's Republic of China. After the Sino-Soviet split in the late 1950s, the Soviet Union withdrew experts, negatively impacting China's economy; after the 1960s, the USSR posed a security threat to China, prompting China to seek détente with Western countries. It was also the first country to achieve human spaceflight.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东的第一任妻子。
毛泽东的第二任妻子，毛岸英之母，毛新宇的祖母。
毛泽东的第三任妻子，曾任第五届全国政协委员。
毛泽东和毛泽民的父亲，与毛宁之父毛贻发同属贻字辈。
description.en: Father of Mao Zedong and Mao Zemin, and belongs to the same 'Yi' generation as Mao Ning's father, Mao Yifa.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东和毛泽民的母亲。
description.en: Mother of Mao Zedong and Mao Zemin.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东与杨开慧的次子，中国共产党党员，翻译家，毛新宇之父。
description.en: Second son of Mao Zedong, member of the Chinese Communist Party, and translator.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东与杨开慧三子，毛岸青之弟。
毛泽东与贺子珍的女儿，江青继女，李讷的姐姐。
中国文化大革命时期政治人物，毛泽东与江青的女儿，毛岸青的异母姊妹。

Later, he served as commander of the Kuomintang's Reorganized 96th Army, and during the Jinan Campaign, he led his troops in an uprising and defected to the Communist Party of China.

Furthermore, it took a leading role in the military intervention in Libya, and both France and Canada are now members of the Organisation internationale de la Francophonie. The French government also awarded Gong Li the rank of Commander of the Ordre des Arts et des Lettres.

He was one of the Eight Elders of the CCP, serving as Head of the Organization Department of the CCP Central Committee and Vice Director of the Central Advisory Commission. He also led troops into Yunnan.

description.zh-cn: 中国空气动力学家和系统科学家，工程控制论创始人之一，中国载人航天奠基人，“两弹一星”功勋奖章获得者，被誉为“中国航天之父”、“中国导弹之父”。他还是中国科学院及中国工程院院士，曾任中国科学技术协会第三届主席。张纯如曾为其撰写传记《中国导弹之父——钱学森之谜》。
description.en: Chinese aerodynamicist and systems scientist, one of the founders of engineering cybernetics, and a founding figure of China's manned space program. He was awarded the 'Two Bombs, One Satellite' Meritorious Award and is known as the 'Father of Chinese Aerospace' and 'Father of Chinese Missiles'. He was also an academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and Chinese Academy of Engineering, and served as the third chairman of the China Association for Science and Technology. Iris Chang wrote his biography 'Thread of the Silkworm'.

description.en: A revolutionary party founded by Sun Yat-sen in Tokyo, Japan, in the late Qing dynasty. It was formed by the merger of several revolutionary groups, including the Huaxinghui, and was the first national revolutionary party in modern China. Shao Yuxuan was one of its members. During the Railway Protection Movement, the Tongmenghui adopted a strategy of 'using the cause of railway protection to advance the reality of revolution,' secretly pushing the movement towards armed uprising.
