description.en: A political system reform initiated by the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China in the 1980s. It aimed to end the lifelong tenure system for leading cadres and establish term limits and a retirement system. To achieve this goal, the Central Advisory Commission was also established as a transitional body to replace de facto lifelong tenure.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国计划生育

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的人口控制政策。

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国义务教育
中华人民共和国义务教育法
en: Compulsory Education Law of the People's Republic of China
Compulsory education in the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 根据宪法制定的法律，旨在保障适龄儿童、少年接受义务教育的权利，保证义务教育的实施，提高全民族素质。该法规定所有适龄儿童、青少年必须接受九年教育，是中华人民共和国的一项重要教育政策。
description.en: A law formulated in accordance with the Constitution to protect the right of school-age children and adolescents to receive compulsory education, ensure its implementation, and improve the quality of the entire nation. This law requires all school-age children and adolescents to receive nine years of education and is a significant educational policy in the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平为解决香港、澳门及台湾问题提出的构想，后成为中华人民共和国处理香港和澳门问题的基本国策。倪匡曾表示从不相信此政策。
description.en: A concept proposed by Deng Xiaoping to resolve the issues of Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan, which later became the basic state policy of the People's Republic of China for Hong Kong and Macau. Ni Kuang once stated that he never believed in this policy.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的高技术研究发展计划。
中华人民共和国广东省的计划单列市，中国四大一线城市之一、粤港澳大湾区的中心城市之一、中国超大城市之一。它也是中国的第一个经济特区，改革开放的窗口。深圳是中国全国性经济中心、国际科技创新中心和对外开放门户，也是华商银行的注册地。
description.en: A sub-provincial city in Guangdong Province, People's Republic of China. It is one of the four first-tier cities in China, a central city in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, and one of China's megacities. It is also China's first special economic zone and a window for reform and opening up. Shenzhen serves as a national economic center, an international technology and innovation hub, a gateway for foreign relations, and the place of registration for Hua Shang Bank.

location.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国广东省
location.en: Guangdong Province, People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 美国政治家，第39任美国总统。在其任内，发生了伊朗人质危机。
description.en: American politician, the 39th President of the United States. The Iran hostage crisis occurred during his term.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治家，曾任美国总统。
新加坡建国总理、政治家。他曾建议中共停止对外输出革命，并在新加坡与马来西亚合并及分离时期担任关键政治角色。在1997年大选后，他控告邓亮洪诽谤。他是李显龙的父亲。
description.en: Founding Prime Minister and politician of Singapore. He advised the CCP to stop exporting revolution and played a key political role during Singapore's merger with and separation from Malaysia. After the 1997 general election, he sued Tang Liang Hong for defamation. He is also known as the father of Lee Hsien Loong.

description.zh-cn: 由邓小平提出的经济体制模式，旨在在社会主义制度下发展市场经济。
description.en: An economic system model proposed by Deng Xiaoping, aiming to develop a market economy under the socialist system.

description.zh-cn: 法国汽车制造商，邓小平早年曾在此做工。

en: Secretary-General of the Chinese Communist Party

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会总书记（中央书记处负责人）职务的前身之一。邓小平曾担任此职，负责处理中共中央日常事务。
description.en: One of the predecessors to the position of General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee (head of the Central Secretariat). This position was held by Deng Xiaoping and was responsible for handling the daily affairs of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 陈云的妻子
陈云长子，中国政治人物，原副国级领导人。曾任国家开发银行董事长、第十二届全国政协副主席。
description.en: Chinese politician, former national-deputy level leader, and the eldest son of Chen Yun. He has served as the Chairman of the China Development Bank and a Vice Chairman of the 12th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 陈云三女
中华民国陆军中将，曾任国民革命军第五军军长、陆军第二兵团司令、徐州剿匪总司令部副总司令。在淮海战役中被俘。
description.en: A Lieutenant General of the Republic of China Army, who served as the commander of the 5th Corps, the 2nd Army Group, and the deputy commander of the Xuzhou Bandit Suppression General Headquarters. He was captured during the Huaihai Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代著名作家、思想家、设计师、新文化运动领袖之一。他曾任职于教育部，并提议将《永乐大典》残本交由京师图书馆收藏以加强保护。他也是瞿秋白在左翼文化运动中的战友。
description.en: A modern Chinese writer, thinker, designer, and one of the leaders of the New Culture Movement. While working for the Ministry of Education, he proposed transferring the remaining volumes of the Yongle Encyclopedia to the Capital Library for better preservation. He was also a comrade-in-arms of Qu Qiubai in the left-wing cultural movement.

description.zh-cn: 中国的一家出版机构。
中华人民共和国成立初期在上海为稳定金融市场而采取的经济斗争。
中华人民共和国成立后，中国共产党内发生的第一次高层政治斗争，导致高岗、饶漱石等高级官员被清洗。
description.en: The first high-level political struggle within the Communist Party of China after the founding of the PRC, which led to the purge of high-ranking officials including Gao Gang and Rao Shushi.

description.zh-cn: 中国在计划经济时期对粮食等主要农产品实行的统一收购和销售政策。在大跃进期间，基于虚报的产量进行高额征购，导致农民口粮、种子粮被收缴，是饥荒的重要制度性原因。
description.en: A policy of unified purchase and sale of major agricultural products such as grain during China's planned economy era. During the Great Leap Forward, high procurement quotas based on inflated production figures led to the confiscation of farmers' food rations and seeds, which was a significant institutional cause of the famine.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国时期上海市的行政管理机构。
description.en: The administrative body of Shanghai Municipality during the Republic of China era.

description.zh-cn: 陈毅元帅之子。
description.en: Son of Marshal Chen Yi.

description.zh-cn: 民国时期在北京和里昂设立的一所大学。
description.en: A university established in Beijing and Lyon during the Republican era.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国民革命军将领
壮族政治人物，曾任广西自治区主席、广西壮族自治区革命委员会主任，被认为是广西大屠杀的主要组织者。
description.en: A Zhuang ethnic politician, he served as Chairman of the Guangxi Autonomous Region and Director of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Revolutionary Committee, and was considered a primary organizer of the Guangxi Massacre.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期为稳定物价而采取的经济斗争。
中国共产党高级理论家，曾任中央文革小组成员。
中国外交官，曾任国务院港澳事务办公室主任。
description.en: Chinese diplomat who served as the Director of the Hong Kong and Macau Affairs Office of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国现代女作家、革命活动家
中华人民共和国外交部直属的唯一一所培养外交外事、国际问题研究和涉外经济、法律复合型人才的文科外语类高等学校，被誉为“中国外交官的摇篮”。
description.en: The only institution of higher learning under the direct administration of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China, which specializes in cultivating versatile talents for diplomatic and foreign affairs, international studies, and foreign-related economics and law. It is known as the 'cradle of Chinese diplomats'.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军高级将领，曾任中央文革小组副组长。
中国人民解放军高级将领，曾任中央文革小组成员。
中国共产党高级理论家，曾任中央文革小组成员。
中国共产党高级理论家，曾任中央文革小组成员。
中国历史学家、考古学家，曾任中央文革小组成员。
曾任《光明日报》总编辑，中央文革小组成员。
曾任北京市委文教书记，中央文革小组成员。中国人民大学前党委书记，为学校复校奔走。
曾任吉林省委文教书记，中央文革小组成员。
曾任西南局宣传部长，中央文革小组成员。
中国国家领导人进行外事活动的重要场所，也是中央文革小组的办公地点。
文化大革命期间负责组织和宣传工作的机构，部分取代了中央文革小组的功能。
中华人民共和国公安部管理的，主要关押最高级别政治犯的监狱。
description.en: A maximum-security prison in the People's Republic of China, primarily used for detaining high-ranking political prisoners.

zh-cn: 首都中学红卫兵联合行动委员会

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命初期北京的一个红卫兵组织，主要由高干子弟组成，后因反对中央文革小组被打压。魏京生是其成员之一。
description.en: A Red Guard organization in Beijing during the early stages of the Cultural Revolution, of which Wei Jingsheng was a member.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间发布的一份文件，规定了对“反革命”行为的镇压措施。
中国人民解放军高级将领，曾任北京卫戍区司令员。

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十一届中央委员会
en: 11th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
Fifth Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
Sixth Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee of the CCP

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在1977年至1982年间的中央领导机构。其第五次全体会议于1980年2月决定重新设立中央书记处。在此期间，第十一届中央委员会第六次全体会议通过了《关于建国以来党的若干历史问题的决议》，华国锋在本次会议上辞去了中共中央主席和军委主席职务。
description.en: The central leading body of the Communist Party of China from 1977 to 1982. Its Fifth Plenary Session in February 1980 decided to re-establish the Central Secretariat. During this period, the Sixth Plenary Session of its 11th Central Committee adopted the 'Resolution on Certain Questions in the History of Our Party Since the Founding of the People's Republic of China', and Hua Guofeng resigned as Chairman of the CCP Central Committee and Chairman of the Central Military Commission at this session.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军高级将领，文革期间任副总参谋长。
民国时期军事将领，刘少奇母亲的侄子。
民国时期政治人物，刘少奇母亲的侄子。
民国时期湖南省省长。
中国文化大革命期间的一起重大政治案件，旨在打击以刘少奇为首的中共领导人，亦是一起重大冤假错案。
description.en: A major political case during the Cultural Revolution in China, aimed at targeting CPC leaders headed by Liu Shaoqi, which was also a significant case of injustice, falsehood, and error.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央政治局常委扩大会议，讨论经济调整问题。
文化大革命时期北京红卫兵“五大领袖”之一。
康生第二任妻子，曾任康生办公室主任，第四、五届全国人大常委会委员，中共九、十、十一届中央委员。
康生与陈宜之子，曾任中共杭州市委书记。

en: East China Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党台湾省工作委员会的上级机构。
description.en: The superior body of the Taiwan Provincial Work Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 一所以人文社会科学为主的综合性研究型全国重点大学，直属于中华人民共和国教育部。

en: Nine Commentaries on the Communist Party of the Soviet Union

description.zh-cn: 1963年至1964年间，中国共产党为回应苏联共产党的《公开信》而发表的九篇评论文章，标志着中苏论战的顶峰。
description.en: A series of nine articles published by the CCP between 1963 and 1964 in response to the CPSU's "Open Letter", marking the peak of the Sino-Soviet polemics.

description.zh-cn: 1962年在中国共产党内部发生的一场政治迫害事件，小说《刘志丹》被定性为反党小说，导致包括习仲勋在内的大量干部被迫害，被认为是“文化大革命”的先声。
description.en: A political persecution incident within the Communist Party of China in 1962, where the novel 'Liu Zhidan' was labeled an anti-Party novel, leading to the persecution of numerous officials including Xi Zhongxun. It is considered a precursor to the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期领导人。后叛变，曾指控康生叛变，最终被康生下令枪决。
中国左翼作家、政治人物，长期负责中共情报工作，中华人民共和国成立后曾任上海市副市长。1955年因内奸罪被捕，1982年获得平反。
description.en: Chinese left-wing writer and politician who was in charge of the CCP's intelligence work for a long time. He served as the deputy mayor of Shanghai after the founding of the People's Republic of China. He was arrested in 1955 on charges of being a traitor and was rehabilitated in 1982.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期领导人之一，曾领导情报保卫工作，在黑茶山空难中遇难。
中国作家，小说《刘志丹》的作者，刘景范的妻子。因创作该小说而在“反党小说《刘志丹》案”中受到长期迫害。
description.en: Chinese writer, author of the novel 'Liu Zhidan', and wife of Liu Jingfan. She was persecuted for a long time during the 'Anti-Party Novel Liu Zhidan Case' for writing the novel.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，原云南省委书记，曾任西南军政委员会交通部部长、铁道部副部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as Minister of Transport of the Southwest Military and Administrative Committee and Vice Minister of Railways.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中华人民共和国外交部副部长。
毛泽东晚年英文翻译。
教育家，曾任南京大学校长。
中国文艺理论家、文学翻译家、文艺活动家。
中国共产党中央委员会的机关刊物。
中华人民共和国国家科学技术方面的最高学术机构，同时是全国自然科学与高新技术综合研究发展中心，以及中国科学技术大学的创办及主管单位。该院原有的地震研究部门在国家地震局组建时曾进行调整。
description.en: The highest academic institution in science and technology of the People's Republic of China, serving as the national comprehensive research and development center for natural sciences and high technology, and also the founder and governing body of the University of Science and Technology of China. When the National Earthquake Administration was formed, earthquake research departments formerly under this academy were reorganized.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国家计划委员会
en: State Planning Commission of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院曾经存在的宏观经济调控和计划部门，负责制定和管理国民经济计划。该机构存在于1952年至1998年间，自1954年起作为国务院组成部门。李富春曾长期担任其主任。
description.en: A former department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for macroeconomic regulation and national economic planning. It existed from 1952 to 1998, serving as a component department of the State Council since 1954. Li Fuchun served as its director for a long time.

description.zh-cn: 曾是中山大学的前身，现为位于中国广州市的一所综合性研究型大学。
description.en: Formerly the predecessor of Sun Yat-sen University, it is now a major research university in Guangzhou, China.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党创办的第一所具有社会教育性质的大学，同时也是一所干部学校，中国人民大学的前身之一。
description.en: The first social education-oriented university established by the Communist Party of China, also a cadre school, and one of the predecessors of Renmin University of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会直属事业单位，是《人民日报》的出版单位。
description.en: A public institution directly under the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, and the publisher of the People's Daily.

description.zh-cn: 一种在文化大革命初期流行的思想，强调家庭出身对个人政治地位的决定性作用。

zh-cn: 中央人民政府最高人民法院

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期的最高审判机关。

zh-cn: 中央人民政府国家计划委员会
en: State Planning Commission of the Central People's Government

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期，是负责全国经济计划工作的中央人民政府部门，与政务院平级。该机构后来改为中华人民共和国国家计划委员会。
description.en: In the early days of the People's Republic of China, it was a central government department responsible for national economic planning, on the same level as the Government Administration Council. This institution was later reorganized as the State Planning Commission of the People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国主席令
en: Order of the President of China

description.zh-cn: 由中华人民共和国主席发布的法令。
中华民国大陆时期滇系军阀领导人、滇军将领，长期主政云南，曾任云南省政府主席，有“云南王”之称。汪精卫曾试图寻求其支持但未获成功。
description.en: A leader of the Yunnan clique and a military general during the mainland period of the Republic of China, he governed Yunnan for a long time, served as its provincial government chairman, and was known as the 'King of Yunnan'. Wang Jingwei unsuccessfully sought his support.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将，曾任铁道部副部长。
description.en: A lieutenant general in the People's Liberation Army, formerly served as Vice Minister of Railways.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上将，曾任铁道部副部长。
description.en: An admiral in the People's Liberation Army of China, formerly served as Vice Minister of Railways.

description.zh-cn: 藏族政治人物，领导并完成了《民族区域自治法》的制定。
description.en: A Tibetan politician who led and completed the formulation of the Law on Regional Ethnic Autonomy.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军开国上将，张又侠之父。
时任西藏军区司令员，战争期间任西藏军区前线指挥所司令员。
原国民党第一兵团司令，1949年与程潜共同起义。
中国军事人物，最高军衔为中国人民解放军中将。曾于长春围困战中率部起义，后参与抗美援朝战争。是解放军开国将领中少数未加入中国共产党党籍者之一。
description.en: A Chinese military figure with the highest rank of Lieutenant General in the People's Liberation Army. He led his troops to defect during the Siege of Changchun and later participated in the Korean War. He was one of the few founding generals of the PLA who never joined the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军开国上将，时任第五兵团司令员，其部队在西南战役中俘虏了宋希濂。他是胡耀邦的表哥。
description.en: A general of the People's Liberation Army, then commander of the 5th Army Group, whose troops captured Song Xilian during the Southwest Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 民国时期川军将领。
时任中共云南省委第一书记。他因不同意小说《刘志丹》出版，并向康生报告，成为引发此案的关键人物之一。
description.en: Then First Secretary of the CCP Yunnan Provincial Committee. He became one of the key figures in triggering the case by disagreeing with the publication of the novel 'Liu Zhidan' and reporting it to Kang Sheng.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海军上将，曾任中共上海市委第一书记
中国人民解放军上将。
曾任中华人民共和国地质矿产部部长
中国人民解放军中将。1929年参加中国工农红军，曾参与长征、抗日战争、辽沈战役等。中华人民共和国成立后，历任多地军区司令员。文化大革命期间曾遭迫害。逝世后，其骨灰遵遗愿撒在辽宁塔山战场。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the Chinese People's Liberation Army. He joined the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army in 1929 and participated in the Long March, the Second Sino-Japanese War, and the Liaoshen Campaign. After the founding of the People's Republic of China, he served as commander of several military regions. He was persecuted during the Cultural Revolution. After his death, his ashes were scattered on the Tashan battlefield in Liaoning in accordance with his last wishes.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期领导人、工人运动领袖。
description.en: An early leader of the Communist Party of China and a leader of the labor movement.

description.zh-cn: 新四军政治部主任，在皖南事变突围时阵亡。

zh-cn: 中国工农红军第二方面军
en: Second Front Army of the Chinese Red Army

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军主力部队之一，由红二军团和红六军团会合后组成，由贺龙、任弼时领导。
description.en: One of the main forces of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, formed by the merger of the Second and Sixth Army Corps, led by He Long and Ren Bishi.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党高级干部。因对小说《刘志丹》提出修改意见，被打成“习贾刘反党集团”成员，后被迫害致死。
description.en: A senior cadre of the Communist Party of China. He was labeled a member of the 'Xi-Jia-Liu Anti-Party Clique' for offering suggestions on the novel 'Liu Zhidan' and was later persecuted to death.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在抗日战争和国共内战时期建立的政府。
中国共产党和中华人民共和国正国级领导人，现任中共中央政治局常委、中央书记处排名第一的书记、中共中央办公厅主任。曾任中共三明市委副书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, currently a member of the Standing Committee of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee, a secretary of the CPC Central Secretariat, and Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee. Former Deputy Secretary of the CPC Sanming Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。现任中共中央政治局常委、中央纪委书记。曾任中共广东省委书记、中共十九届中央政治局委员。
description.en: Chinese politician. Currently a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection. He previously served as Secretary of the CPC Guangdong Provincial Committee and a member of the Political Bureau of the 19th CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1921年中共一大前在中国各地及海外成立的共产主义小组
中国第一个共产主义小组，在各地建党活动中起联络中心作用，是中国共产党的前身组织之一。
由列宁领导的布尔什维克发动的革命，推翻了俄国临时政府。
description.en: A revolution led by Lenin's Bolsheviks that overthrew the Russian Provisional Government.

zh-cn: 有中国特色的社会主义

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党根据本国国情，将马克思主义基本原理与中国具体实际相结合而形成的政治经济理论，也是中国共产党和中华人民共和国的官方意识形态及国策。
description.en: A political and economic theory formulated by the Communist Party of China by adapting the basic principles of Marxism to the specific conditions of China.

en: Communist Party of the Soviet Union

description.zh-cn: 苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟的执政党，将列宁主义纳入其官方学说。
description.en: The ruling political party of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会的机关报。该报在大跃进期间进行了大量宣传报道，并于1977年10月22日发表文章，正式向全国宣布恢复高考的消息。钦本立曾于1951年至1956年在此任职。
description.en: The official newspaper of the Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party. It extensively reported during the Great Leap Forward and published an article on October 22, 1977, formally announcing the restoration of the Gaokao to the nation. Qin Benli worked at this newspaper from 1951 to 1956.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，中共第二十届中央政治局委员。
中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，副国级领导人。现任中共中央政治局委员、中央书记处书记、中共中央宣传部部长。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China and a national-level leader. He is currently a member of the Politburo of the CCP Central Committee, a secretary of the Central Secretariat, and the head of the CCP Central Propaganda Department.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，中共第二十届中央政治局委员，时任中共中央政法委书记
中国政治人物，中共中央书记处书记，中华人民共和国国家监察委员会主任，中华人民共和国总监察官。

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会办公厅
en: General Office of the Chinese Communist Party
General Office of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会的综合办事机构，负责日常文书、会务、安保、机要、通讯等工作，并为中共中央和中央直属机关提供服务。李富春曾任其主任。
description.en: The working body of the CPC Central Committee, responsible for daily clerical work, meeting arrangements, security, confidential matters, communications, etc. Li Fuchun once served as its director.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会组织部
en: Organization Department of the Chinese Communist Party
Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee
Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China
Organization Department of the Communist Party of China Central Committee

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会的职能部门，负责党组织建设、干部队伍建设和人才工作。在抗日战争时期，李富春曾任其副部长。该部门于1979年递交报告，为小说《刘志丹》案平反。自2018年起，统一管理中央机构编制委员会办公室。
description.en: A functional department of the CPC Central Committee, responsible for party organization building, cadre team development, and talent work. Li Fuchun served as its deputy head during the Second Sino-Japanese War. In 1979, the department submitted a report to rehabilitate the 'Liu Zhidan' novel case. Since 2018, it has centrally managed the Office of the Central Institutional Organization Commission.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会宣传部
中国共产党中央宣传部
en: Publicity Department of the Chinese Communist Party
Propaganda Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China
Publicity Department of the Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
Publicity Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会主管意识形态方面工作的综合职能部门，也是中国共产党的宣传与意识形态管理机构。该部门加挂国务院新闻办公室牌子。它曾指示工人出版社创作一部关于刘志丹的小说，并据报道在《穹顶之下》发布数日后下令全面封杀该片。
description.en: The comprehensive functional department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China in charge of ideological and propaganda work, which also carries the nameplate of the State Council Information Office. It instructed the Workers' Publishing House to create a novel about Liu Zhidan, and reportedly ordered a complete ban on 'Under the Dome' several days after its release.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会统一战线工作部
中共中央统一战线工作部
en: United Front Work Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会主管统一战线工作的职能部门。
description.en: A functional department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China responsible for united front work.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会政法委员会
中国共产党中央政法委员会
en: Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission
Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会的直属机构，负责领导和管理全国政法工作。该机构曾牵头成立联合调查组，对陕西千亿矿权案卷宗丢失等问题进行调查；佘孟孝曾在此任副秘书长。
description.en: An agency directly under the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, responsible for leading and managing political and legal affairs nationwide. It once led a joint investigation team to investigate issues like the missing case files in the 'Shaanxi Hundred-Billion-Yuan Mining Rights Case'; She Mengxiao also served as its Deputy Secretary-General.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会政策研究室
国务院农村发展研究中心
en: Policy Research Office of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

zh-cn: 中国共产党第六届中央委员会
en: 6th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party

description.zh-cn: 中共七届一中全会选出的五位中央书记处书记，即毛泽东、朱德、刘少奇、周恩来、任弼时的合称。他们是中国共产党第一代领导集体的核心，地位等同于后来的政治局常委。
description.en: The five secretaries of the Central Secretariat elected at the first plenary session of the 7th Central Committee of the CPC, namely Mao Zedong, Zhu De, Liu Shaoqi, Zhou Enlai, and Ren Bishi. They were the core of the first generation of collective leadership of the Communist Party of China, and their status was equivalent to that of later Politburo Standing Committee members.

description.zh-cn: 中国革命家、政治家、外交家，中国工人运动领导人，曾任中联部部长，中国共产党、中华人民共和国政治人物，原国家级副职领导人。
description.en: A Chinese revolutionary, politician, diplomat, leader of the Chinese workers' movement, former head of the International Liaison Department of the CPC Central Committee, and a political figure of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and a former national-level deputy leader.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中共上海市委第一书记
中国共产党和中华人民共和国的早期领导人之一，曾任中共上海市委第一书记。他曾向薄一波和宋任穷转达陈云关于在中共十四大后不再设立中顾委的意见。
description.en: One of the early leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, he served as the First Secretary of the CPC Shanghai Municipal Committee. He once relayed Chen Yun's opinion to Bo Yibo and Song Renqiong about not establishing the Central Advisory Commission after the 14th National Congress of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治家，原正国级领导人。曾任中共中央政治局常委、中央书记处书记、天津市市长。在六四事件中，他因反对实施戒严并支持赵紫阳而被免职。复出后曾任电子工业部部长、全国政协副主席等职务。他曾赏识李瑞环。
description.en: Politician of the People's Republic of China, former national-level leader. He served as a member of the Politburo Standing Committee and a secretary of the Central Secretariat of the CPC. He was dismissed from his party leadership positions for sympathizing with the student movement and supporting Zhao Ziyang during the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests. After his political comeback, he served as Minister of Electronics Industry and Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间担任全国人大常委会副委员长和会议秘书长。
description.en: Chinese politician who served as a Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee and Secretary-General of the sessions of the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共上海市委书记、中共中央书记处书记。在六四事件中与阎明复一同被免职。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, former secretary of the CPC Central Secretariat. He was dismissed along with Yan Mingfu during the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，原国家级副职领导人。曾任中共中央书记处书记、中共中央统战部部长、全国政协副主席等职。因在六四事件中的表现被撤职，后复出任民政部副部长，并长期从事慈善事业。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China and a former deputy state leader. He served as a secretary of the Central Secretariat of the CPC and head of the United Front Work Department. He was dismissed for his actions during the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests, later returned to politics as Vice Minister of Civil Affairs, and was long involved in philanthropy.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党、中华人民共和国政治人物，原正国级党和国家领导人，曾任中共中央政治局常委、全国政协主席、天津市市长。
description.en: A former major leader of the Chinese Communist Party and the People's Republic of China, who served as Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 杨尚昆的胞弟，解放军上将。曾任中共中央军委秘书长兼总政治部主任。在任总政治部主任期间，他参与指挥了戒严部队。
description.en: Younger brother of Yang Shangkun and a PLA general. He served as Secretary-General of the CPC Central Military Commission and Director of the General Political Department. During his tenure as Director of the General Political Department, he participated in commanding the martial law troops.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，原国家级正职领导人，曾任中共中央政治局常委、中央纪律检查委员会书记、中组部副部长。
description.en: Former Politburo Standing Committee member, once served as deputy head of the CCP Central Organization Department.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中共中央政治局常委、中华人民共和国副主席。
description.en: Chinese politician, former member of the Politburo Standing Committee and Vice President of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党、中华人民共和国政治人物，原正国级党和国家领导人。曾任中央书记处书记、陈希的前任中共中央党校校长。
中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，原正国级领导人，第十七届中共中央政治局常委，曾任中央纪委书记。

zh-cn: 王刚 (中国全国政协原副主席)

death_place.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军总医院

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军前主要领导人之一，原副国级领导人，上将军衔（2014年被开除军籍），在反腐运动中落马。他曾在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为中央军事委员会副主席。
description.en: A general in the People's Liberation Army. He was appointed as a Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission during the 11th National People's Congress, and later fell during the anti-corruption campaign.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，团派主要成员。曾任中华人民共和国副主席、中共中央政治局委员，为原副国级领导人。
description.en: A political figure of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and a key member of the Tuanpai (Youth League Faction). He served as Vice President of the People's Republic of China and a member of the Politburo of the CPC, holding a former vice-national level leadership position.

description.zh-cn: 原中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共中央办公厅主任、中共中央书记处书记、全国政协副主席、中央统战部部长，是胡锦涛的首席助理。作为令狐路线的弟弟，他在反腐运动中落马，并被指是操盘整倒陈良宇的人之一。
description.en: Former Chinese political figure, who served as Director of the CCP General Office and a chief aide to Hu Jintao. As the younger brother of Linghu Luxian, he fell during the anti-corruption campaign and was also implicated in the downfall of Chen Liangyu.

description.zh-cn: 原中央宣传部部长
中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共十九届中央政治局常委、全国人大常委会委员长。涉及胡锦涛二十大离场事件。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the 19th CPC Central Committee and Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress. Involved in the incident where Hu Jintao was escorted out of the 20th National Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中共浙江省委书记（夏宝龙担任该职务时的前任），并曾担任浙江省人大常委会主任。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee (predecessor to Xia Baolong) and former Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第二十届中央委员会
en: 20th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

location.zh-cn: 北京市西城区府右街12号
location.en: No. 12 Fuyou Street, Xicheng District, Beijing

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党第二十次全国代表大会选举产生的中央委员会，是中国共产党在2022年至2027年的最高领导机关，王抗平为候补委员。
description.en: The central leadership body elected by the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, serving as the highest leading body from 2022 to 2027. Wang Kangping serves as an alternate member of this committee.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物、力学工程师及航天领域专家，中共第二十届中央政治局委员、中共新疆维吾尔自治区党委书记。曾任中国航天科技集团公司总经理，出身航天科技集团的省委书记之一
中国政治人物及环境科学家。曾任中华人民共和国环境保护部部长（在《穹顶之下》发布后曾对其公开表示赞赏）、北京市市长。现任中共第二十届中央政治局委员、中共上海市委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician and environmental scientist. He served as Minister of Environmental Protection (publicly praising 'Under the Dome' upon its release) and Mayor of Beijing. He is currently a member of the 20th CPC Central Committee Politburo and Secretary of the CPC Shanghai Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物。曾任中共第十九届中央政治局委员、重庆市委书记，在唐良智担任重庆市市长期间，其为袁家军的前任。现任中共第二十届中央政治局委员、天津市委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician. He served as a member of the Political Bureau of the 19th CPC Central Committee and as Secretary of the CPC Chongqing Municipal Committee. During Tang Liangzhi's tenure as Mayor of Chongqing, Chen Min'er was the predecessor of Yuan Jiajun. He is currently a member of the Political Bureau of the 20th CPC Central Committee and the Party Secretary of Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党、中华人民共和国政治人物及空间技术专家，副国级领导人。现任中共中央政治局委员、中共重庆市委书记，曾任浙江省人大常委会主任，并曾担任神舟五号任务载人飞船系统总指挥。
description.en: Chinese politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and a space technology expert, holding a vice-national level leadership position. Currently a member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Party Secretary of Chongqing Municipality, and formerly Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress. He also served as Commander-in-Chief of the manned spacecraft system for the Shenzhou 5 mission.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任中共中央政治局委员、中国共产党广东省委员会书记。曾任中共十九届中央政治局委员、中央书记处书记，以及中共杭州市委书记、中共中央宣传部部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, currently serving as a member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Party Secretary of Guangdong Province. He previously served as a member of the Political Bureau and a secretary of the Secretariat of the 19th CPC Central Committee, Party Secretary of Hangzhou, and Minister of the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee.

zh-cn: 中国共产党全国代表大会
en: National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party
National Congress of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党的最高领导机关，每五年举行一次，负责选举中央委员会等机构。
description.en: The highest leading body of the Communist Party of China, held every five years, responsible for electing bodies such as the Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党第一次全国代表大会后设立的中央领导机构，是中国共产党中央委员会的前身机构之一。

zh-cn: 中国共产党第五次全国代表大会
中国共产党第五届中央委员会
en: 5th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party
5th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party

description.zh-cn: 1927年中国共产党在武汉召开的全国代表大会，决定设立中国共产党中央委员会，并在会后设立了中共中央政治局。向忠发在此次会议上当选为中共中央委员，进入中央领导层。
description.en: The National Congress of the CCP held in Wuhan in 1927, which decided to establish the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and subsequently established the Political Bureau of the Central Committee. Xiang Zhongfa was elected to the CCP Central Committee at this meeting, entering the central leadership.

description.zh-cn: 在政党内部实行民主原则和制度，是现代政党制度的重要组成部分。此原则由列宁提出，后被斯大林进一步发展，并成为中国共产党的根本组织原则。
description.en: Refers to the implementation of democratic principles and systems within a political party, an important component of modern political party systems. This principle was proposed by Lenin, later further developed by Stalin, and became the fundamental organizational principle of the Communist Party of China.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会总书记
en: General Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party
General Secretary of the Central Committee of the CCP
General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在1956年至1967年间以及1980年至1982年间设立于中央书记处的领导职务，负责处理中央书记处运作。此职务并非中共中央的主要负责人，与1982年起设立的党内最高领导人职务不同。
description.en: A leading position established within the Central Secretariat of the Communist Party of China between 1956-1967 and 1980-1982, responsible for managing the operations of the Central Secretariat. This position was not the main leader of the CPC Central Committee and is distinct from the supreme leader role established since 1982.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十九届中央委员会第一次全体会议
en: First Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 审议通过了《中共中央政治局关于加强和维护党中央集中统一领导的若干规定》，并选举产生了中共第十九届中央领导机构及其负责人。
description.en: Deliberated and adopted the 'Regulations of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee on Strengthening and Upholding the Centralized and Unified Leadership of the CPC Central Committee', and elected the central leading bodies and their leaders of the 19th CPC Central Committee.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十七次全国代表大会
en: 17th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party
17th National Congress of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党于2007年10月在北京召开的全国代表大会。自此次会议起，中央政治局不再设置候补委员职位。
description.en: The national congress of the Communist Party of China held in Beijing in October 2007.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第二十届中央委员会第一次全体会议
en: First plenary session of the 20th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party

description.zh-cn: 选举产生了中共第二十届中央领导机构（包括中央政治局及其常务委员会）及其负责人。
description.en: Elected the 20th central leading bodies of the CPC and their leaders.

description.zh-cn: 中共第二十届中央政治局委员，北京市委书记。

description.zh-cn: 指在2006年上海市部分政府官员被中央指控违规动用社会保障基金进行投资活动而遭中央惩处的事件。该事件牵扯出大量政治、经济和法律问题，涉及贪污腐败案件，导致时任上海市委书记陈良宇被停止政治局委员职务。
description.en: Refers to the 2006 incident where some Shanghai government officials were accused by the central government of illegally using social security funds for investment activities and were subsequently punished. This event triggered numerous political, economic, and legal issues, involving corruption cases and leading to the suspension of Chen Liangyu, then-Shanghai Party Secretary, from his Politburo membership.

description.zh-cn: 薄一波的二子。中华人民共和国政治人物，77级大学生。曾任大连市市长、辽宁省省长、中华人民共和国商务部部长、中共重庆市委书记、中共中央政治局委员。2013年因受贿、贪污、滥用职权罪被判处无期徒刑。他被指是操盘整倒陈良宇的人之一，亦是习近平的政治对手。他曾是谷开来之夫，其前妻为李雪峰之女。
description.en: Bo Yibo's second son. A former Chinese politician, a member of the Class of 1977. He served as a member of the Politburo of the Chinese Communist Party, Party Secretary of Chongqing, Minister of Commerce, Governor of Liaoning, and Mayor of Dalian. In 2013, he was sentenced to life imprisonment for bribery, corruption, and abuse of power. He is considered a political rival of Xi Jinping. He was the husband of Gu Kailai, and his ex-wife is the daughter of Li Xuefeng.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党于2017年10月召开的全国代表大会，选举产生了第十九届中央委员会。此次大会将习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想写入《中国共产党章程》。会后，习近平人马在中央政治局处于主导地位，团派势力大为削弱。
description.en: The National Congress of the Communist Party of China held in October 2017. It elected the 19th Central Committee and wrote Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era into the Constitution of the Communist Party of China. Following the event, Xi Jinping's allies gained a dominant position in the Politburo, while the Tuanpai (Youth League Faction) saw its influence significantly weakened.

description.en: The National Congress of the Communist Party of China was held in October 2022. It elected the 20th Central Committee and the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection. Following the congress, several high-level Tuanpai leaders did not enter the new Central Committee, marking a sharp decline in the faction's political influence.

He was long responsible for the CPC's external liaison, united front work, overseas Chinese affairs, and Hong Kong and Macao affairs, and was a prominent leader in foreign affairs. He died suddenly after being nominated as a candidate for Vice President.

description.zh-cn: 中央研究院副院长兼总干事，中国民权保障同盟执行委员兼秘书长，被军统特务刺杀。
中国近代革命家、政治家、教育家、翻译家。曾任中华民国首任教育总长、北京大学校长、中央研究院首任院长等职。他革新北大，倡导“思想自由，兼容并包”的办学方针，开“学术”与“自由”之风，为五四运动培养了思想动力，期间私下支持学生并以辞职抗议政府镇压。他被毛泽东誉为“学界泰斗、人世楷模”，并曾提议将国立山东大学设于青岛。
description.en: A modern Chinese revolutionary, politician, educator, and translator. He served as the first Minister of Education of the Republic of China, President of Peking University, and the first President of Academia Sinica. He reformed Peking University, advocating for 'freedom of thought and inclusiveness,' fostering a spirit of 'academics' and 'freedom,' which cultivated intellectual momentum for the May Fourth Movement. During the movement, he privately supported students and resigned in protest against government suppression. He was praised by Mao Zedong as a 'titan of the academic world and a model for all,' and also proposed the establishment of National Shandong University in Qingdao.

description.zh-cn: 康生出生地
中华民国的创建政党，曾在中国大陆执政，于1929年成为执政党并参与国共内战。战败后迁台，至今仍是台湾（中华民国）主要政党之一。该党由蒋介石领导，刘伯承、朱德（后脱离）、邓小平（国共合作时期）、李富春（第一次国共合作时期任旅欧支部职务）等曾加入。汪精卫叛逃后被开除党籍。在台执政期间，曾瓦解中共台湾省工委。公职人员在大罢免运动中受挑战，该党亦采取反制策略。
description.en: The founding political party of the Republic of China, which once governed mainland China, becoming the ruling party in 1929 and participating in the Chinese Civil War. After its defeat, it relocated to Taiwan, remaining one of the main political parties in Taiwan (Republic of China) to this day. The party was led by Chiang Kai-shek; Liu Bocheng, Zhu De (later defected), Deng Xiaoping (during the KMT-CPC cooperation period), Li Fuchun (serving in its European branch during the First United Front), and others were once members. Wang Jingwei was expelled after his defection. During its rule in Taiwan, it dismantled the Taiwan Provincial Work Committee of the CPC. Its public officials faced challenges in the Great Recall movement, and the party adopted counter-strategies.

description.zh-cn: 由中国国民党在广州组建的武装力量，中华民国国民政府的军队，于1948年后改组为中华民国国军。在蒋介石领导下发动北伐，推翻北洋政府，统一中国。长征期间，负责围剿和追击红军，在1936年的一次战斗中，刘志丹被其部队阻击身亡。
description.en: The military arm of the Kuomintang (KMT), founded in Guangzhou, and the national army of the Nationalist Government of the Republic of China. It was reorganized into the Republic of China Armed Forces after 1948. Under the leadership of Chiang Kai-shek, it launched the Northern Expedition, which overthrew the Beiyang Government and unified China. During the Long March, it was responsible for encircling and pursuing the Red Army. In a battle in 1936, Liu Zhidan was killed by its troops.

description.zh-cn: 它是中国国民革命军第八路军的简称，是抗日战争时期中国共产党领导的主要武装力量之一，由中国工农红军主力改编而成。
description.en: A unit of the National Revolutionary Army formed from the main forces of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 一场由蔡锷、唐继尧等人在云南发起的军事运动，旨在反对袁世凯称帝。梁启超是主要策划者之一。这场内战最终迫使袁世凯取消帝制，主要力量来自蔡锷等人组织的军队。
description.en: A military movement and civil war initiated in Yunnan by Cai E, Tang Jiyao, and others, aimed at opposing Yuan Shikai's attempt to declare himself emperor. Liang Qichao was one of its main planners. This movement ultimately forced Yuan Shikai to abolish the monarchy, with its primary forces organized by Cai E.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党为反击国民党清党而发动的武装起义。此事件被认为是中共独立领导武装斗争和创建军队的开始，标志着中共武装力量的初步建立，同时也是第一次国共内战的导火索之一。
description.en: An armed rebellion launched by the Communist Party of China in response to the Kuomintang's purge. It is regarded as the beginning of the CPC's independent leadership of armed struggle and army building, and also served as a catalyst for the First Chinese Civil War.

zh-cn: 国民革命军第十八集团军第129师
en: 129th Division of the Eighteenth Army Group of the National Revolutionary Army
129th Division of the Eighteenth Group Army of the National Revolutionary Army

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争时期八路军的主力师之一，由刘伯承任师长，邓小平任政委，李达任参谋长。
description.en: One of the main divisions of the Eighth Route Army during the Second Sino-Japanese War, with Liu Bocheng as commander, Deng Xiaoping as political commissar, and Li Da as chief of staff.

description.zh-cn: 由孙中山等人发动的反对袁世凯的武装斗争，因宋教仁遇刺案而爆发。
description.en: An armed struggle led by Sun Yat-sen against Yuan Shikai, which broke out following the assassination of Song Jiaoren.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代民主革命的伟大先行者、中华民国国父、中华民国和中国国民党的缔造者，以及中国同盟会创建者。他领导了反清运动，并曾被李鸿章幕僚联络商讨广东独立。其五权宪法理论是监察院创设学理根据。他曾与流亡日本的梁启超会面商讨合作未果。他还对五四运动表示肯定和支持，认为学生运动是伟大的爱国运动。
description.en: A great pioneer of the modern democratic revolution, the Founding Father of the Republic of China, and the founder of the Republic of China, the Kuomintang, and the Tongmenghui. He led the anti-Qing movement and was once contacted by Li Hongzhang's aides to discuss Guangdong's independence. His Five-Power Constitution theory served as the theoretical basis for the establishment of the Control Yuan. He also met with Liang Qichao during his exile in Japan to discuss cooperation, but it did not materialize. Furthermore, he affirmed and supported the May Fourth Movement, viewing the student movement as a great patriotic movement.

description.zh-cn: 由孙中山在日本成立的革命政党，是中国国民党的前身之一，反对袁世凯的统治。
description.en: A revolutionary political party founded by Sun Yat-sen in Japan, a predecessor of the Kuomintang, which opposed the rule of Yuan Shikai.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期成员、活动家，刘伯承的入党介绍人之一，杨尚昆的四哥，著名烈士。
description.en: An early member and activist of the Communist Party of China, one of Liu Bocheng's introducers to the Party, the fourth older brother of Yang Shangkun, and a renowned martyr.

description.zh-cn: 川军将领
1929年，中华民国与苏联因中东铁路问题爆发军事冲突，源于中华民国东北当局试图收回中东铁路。
description.en: A military conflict in 1929 between the Republic of China and the Soviet Union over the Chinese Eastern Railway.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争胜利后，中国国民党与中国共产党在重庆进行的一次重要和平谈判。
中华人民共和国江苏省省会。
description.en: The capital of Jiangsu Province, People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军总医院

description.zh-cn: 杨尚昆、彭德怀逝世的地点。

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十次全国代表大会
en: 10th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在文化大革命期间召开的全国代表大会。
中国人民解放军上将。他曾任中央军事委员会副主席、中国人民解放军国防大学校长、政治委员。他是张海阳的父亲。
description.en: A general (shangjiang) of the People's Liberation Army (PLA) of China. He served as Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission, and President and Political Commissar of the PLA National Defense University. He is the father of Zhang Haiyang.

description.zh-cn: 中国话剧导演、演员，周恩来和邓颖超的养女。
中国在20世纪60-70年代进行的核弹、导弹和人造卫星项目的统称，旨在指导原子弹、氢弹、人造地球卫星的研制工作。
第一届亚非会议。
中美两国乒乓球队互访，开启两国关系正常化进程。

en: 1972 visit by Richard Nixon to China

description.zh-cn: 1972年2月，时任美国总统理查德·尼克松对中华人民共和国进行国事访问。此次历史性访问标志着中美关系破冰，是两国关系正常化的重要一步，也是中美关系史上的一个转折点。它也为中日关系正常化创造了条件。访问期间，双方签署了《上海公报》。
description.en: In February 1972, then-U.S. President Richard Nixon made a historic state visit to the People's Republic of China. This visit marked a breakthrough in Sino-U.S. relations, an important step towards the normalization of relations, and a turning point in the history of Sino-U.S. relations. It also created conditions for the normalization of Sino-Japanese relations. During the visit, the Shanghai Communiqué was signed.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会副主席
en: Vice Chairman of the Chinese Communist Party

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会设立的副职领导人职位，存在于1956年至1982年间，仅次于中共中央主席。此处的节点代表该职位群体。
description.en: A deputy leadership position of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, established from 1956 to 1982, and second only to the Chairman of the CPC Central Committee. This node represents the group of individuals holding this position.

zh-cn: 首都医科大学附属复兴医院

description.zh-cn: 王洪文去世的医院。
文化大革命期间上海的政治事件。
毛泽东在长沙批评“四人帮”的一系列谈话。
曾任中共云南省委书记。
中国抗日战争是20世纪30至40年代，中华民国抵抗大日本帝国全面侵略的战争。九一八事变被视为其开端，全面爆发始于1937年，并持续至1945年。战争期间，国民政府迁都重庆，使重庆成为中国的战时首都。石双琪曾参加抗日自卫队。
description.en: The Sino-Japanese War was a full-scale conflict in the 1930s and 1940s, where the Republic of China resisted an invasion by the Empire of Japan. The Mukden Incident is considered its beginning, with the war fully erupting in 1937 and lasting until 1945. During the war, the Nationalist Government moved its capital to Chongqing, making it China's wartime capital. Shi Shuangqi also joined the anti-Japanese self-defense force.

description.zh-cn: 侵华日军少佐。
中华民国军事将领。

zh-cn: 第三次讨伐吴化文部战役

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治家、军事家，中国国民党总裁，二战盟国领袖之一。曾任黄埔军校校长、国民政府主席、军事委员会委员长、中华民国总统、中国战区最高统帅。作为九一八事变时国民政府的实际掌权者，他主张“攘外应先安内”政策，并领导国民革命军对红军进行“围剿”和“追剿”。他领导国民党清共派，在四一二事件中下令清党，并镇压二二八事件。曾下令“就地枪决”向忠发，长期囚禁张学良。其政府曾批准对毛泽民等人处以极刑，并签署1945年《中苏友好同盟条约》。
description.en: A Chinese politician, military strategist, and leader of the Kuomintang, also one of the Allied leaders in World War II. He served as Commandant of the Whampoa Military Academy, Chairman of the Nationalist Government, Chairman of the Military Affairs Commission, President of the Republic of China, and Supreme Commander of the China Theater. As the de facto leader of the Nationalist Government during the Mukden Incident, he advocated the policy of 'first internal pacification, then external resistance', and led the National Revolutionary Army in 'encirclement' and 'pursuit' campaigns against the Red Army. He led the KMT's pro-purge faction, ordering the purge during the April 12th Incident, and suppressed the February 28 Incident. He ordered the immediate execution of Xiang Zhongfa on the spot, and long-term imprisoned Zhang Xueliang. His government approved death sentences for Mao Zemin and others, and signed the 1945 Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship and Alliance.

description.zh-cn: 东亚共和制国家，1912年在中国大陆建立，1912年至1949年间曾是中国执政政权。1949年后退守台湾，治权范围主要为台湾、澎湖、金门、马祖。该政权曾被艾森豪威尔政府承认为代表全中国的唯一合法政府。曾于虹桥机场事件及淞沪会战中与日本发生冲突。1972年，日本与中华人民共和国建交后，与其断交。曾泽生在1948年前效忠于该政权。还曾于1936-1940年及1992-1994年与拉脱维亚建立外交关系。
description.en: A republic in East Asia, established on the Chinese mainland in 1912, serving as the ruling regime in China from 1912 to 1949. After 1949, it retreated to Taiwan, with its current jurisdiction primarily covering Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen, and Matsu. It was once recognized by the Eisenhower administration as the sole legitimate government of all China. It clashed with Japan in the Hongqiao Airport Incident and the Battle of Shanghai. In 1972, after Japan established diplomatic relations with the People's Republic of China, it severed ties with this regime. Zeng Zesheng was loyal to this regime before 1948. It also established diplomatic relations with Latvia during 1936-1940 and 1992-1994.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的省级特别行政区，实行一国两制和高度自治。仓颉输入法在此地非常普及。
description.en: A special administrative region of the People's Republic of China where the Cangjie input method is very popular.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党与中国共产党之间的第一次合作。
2022年在中国大陆多地发生的、反对动态清零政策的全国性抗议活动。
description.en: Protests against the Chinese government's zero-COVID policy.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国务院副总理。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as a Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 与战争、军队等相关的事务
中国政治家和军事家，曾任国民党长沙绥靖公署主任兼湖南省政府主席，1949年率部起义。
由中华民国实际控制的岛屿群，位于台湾海峡西侧，靠近中国大陆。
description.en: An island group controlled by the Republic of China, located on the west side of the Taiwan Strait, close to mainland China.

description.zh-cn: 金门群岛中的一个岛屿
中国共产党领导下的广泛政治联盟，联合各民主党派、人民团体、各族各界人士的政治联盟。

en: Nationalist Government of the Republic of China
Nationalist government of the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 由中国国民党建立的中华民国政府，是中华民国训政时期的中央政府与最高行政机关。最初成立于广州，在北伐成功后取代北洋政府，成为中国的执政当局，并于1928年至1948年间代表中国政权。在此期间，它也是中原大战中由蒋中正领导的中央政府一方。同年（1928年）将绥远特别区改制为绥远省，其间于1931年成立监察院，并于同年逮捕并处决了向忠发。由蒋介石等人在四一二事件后于南京成立的国民政府，曾与由汪精卫等人领导的武汉国民政府对立。在抗日战争期间，国民政府迁都重庆。
description.en: The government of the Republic of China, established by the Kuomintang, served as the central government and supreme administrative organ during the period of political tutelage. Initially established in Guangzhou, it replaced the Beiyang government as the ruling authority in China after the success of the Northern Expedition, representing China from 1928 to 1948. During this period, it also constituted the central government side led by Chiang Kai-shek in the Central Plains War. In the same year (1928), it reorganized the Suiyuan Special Administrative Region into Suiyuan Province. In 1931, it established the Control Yuan and also arrested and executed Xiang Zhongfa. The Nationalist Government, established in Nanjing by Chiang Kai-shek and others after the April 12th Incident, stood in opposition to the Wuhan Nationalist Government led by Wang Jingwei. During the Second Sino-Japanese War, the Nationalist Government relocated its capital to Chongqing.

description.zh-cn: 中国军事家、政治家，国民党高级将领。他曾任新疆省主席，并释放了被盛世才关押的部分中共党员。后任京沪警备司令，在虹桥机场事件中下令格杀闯入机场的日军。
description.en: A Chinese military strategist and politician, a high-ranking general of the Kuomintang. He served as the Chairman of Xinjiang Province and released some of the CCP members imprisoned by Sheng Shicai. Later, as the commander of the Jinghu Garrison, he ordered the killing of Japanese soldiers who broke into the airport during the Hongqiao Airport Incident.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国的政党之一。

en: Constitution of the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华民国的根本大法。
中华人民共和国的国家权力机关。
中国共产党领导下的、中华人民共和国的群众性社会组织。
description.en: Mass organizations under the leadership of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国军事家、政治家、国民党将领。中国国民党革命委员会的主要创始人和领导人。他曾在广州主持会议决定“清共”，引发广州四一五事件。
description.en: A Chinese military strategist, politician, and KMT general. He was a principal founder and leader of the Revolutionary Committee of the Chinese Kuomintang. He also presided over a meeting in Guangzhou that decided to "purge the communists," leading to the Guangzhou April 15th Incident.

description.zh-cn: 东亚的一个岛屿，现由中华民国有效管辖，亦是潘晓颖命案的司法管辖区之一。它也是新加坡“星光部队”的训练地点、神舟五号飞船部分植物种子的来源地、仓颉输入法的发源地。在1996年总统选举期间，中国大陆对其外海发射导弹，曾引发台海危机。
description.en: An island in East Asia, currently under the effective jurisdiction of the Republic of China, and one of the jurisdictions involved in the Poon Hiu-wing murder case. It also serves as the training location for Singapore's 'Starlight' military units, is the origin of some plant seeds carried aboard the Shenzhou 5 spacecraft, and is the birthplace of the Cangjie input method. During its 1996 presidential election, mainland China's missile launches off its coast triggered the Taiwan Strait Crisis.

description.zh-cn: 香港主权由英国移交给中华人民共和国，中华人民共和国恢复行使主权的历史事件。
description.en: The historical event marking the transfer of sovereignty over Hong Kong from the United Kingdom to the People's Republic of China and the resumption of China's exercise of sovereignty.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国恢复对澳门行使主权的事件。

中共在延安时期进行的思想和政治运动，后期由康生发动了抓“特务”的政治运动。
description.en: A thought and political movement conducted by the CCP during the Yan'an period. In its later stages, a political campaign to identify and arrest 'spies' was initiated by Kang Sheng.

description.zh-cn: 由中国国民党领导、国民政府（国民革命军）发起，旨在推翻北洋军阀（北洋政府）统治、统一中国的军事行动。李富春曾参与其中。
description.en: A military campaign led by the Kuomintang and launched by the Nationalist Government (National Revolutionary Army), aimed at overthrowing the Beiyang government and other regional warlords, thereby unifying China. Li Fuchun participated in this campaign.

description.zh-cn: 叶剑英的配偶。
叶剑英提出的关于台湾回归、实现和平统一的九条方针政策。

zh-cn: 中国工农红军第一方面军
en: First Front Army of the Red Army
First Front Army of the Chinese Red Army

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军主力部队之一，由中共中央直接领导，并进行了长征。
description.en: One of the main forces of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, directly led by the Central Committee of the CCP, and which undertook the Long March.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治家、军事家，曾任中华民国副总统及行政院院长。他组织的“九人小组”调查报告导致孙立人被软禁，并曾于1943年参观育才学校并给予正面评价。
description.en: A politician and military leader of the Republic of China, he served as Vice President and Premier. The investigation report from his 'nine-person group' notably led to Sun Li-jen's house arrest. He also visited Yucai School in 1943 and gave a positive evaluation.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国将领。
中华民国将领。
中华民国将领，宁夏军阀。
中华民国军事将领，冯玉祥麾下“五虎将”之一，曾任河北省政府主席。
description.en: A general in the Republic of China, one of the 'Five Tiger Generals' under Feng Yuxiang, and former chairman of Hebei Provincial Government.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事人物，国民革命军将领。曾任第四军军长，是叶挺的上级。
革命家，朱德的挚友
滇系军阀首领，曾长期统治云南，并创办了建国军军士队。
description.en: The leader of the Yunnan clique of warlords, who ruled Yunnan for an extended period and founded the National Construction Army's NCO team.

description.zh-cn: 国民革命军将领
北伐战争中由叶挺领导的、以共产党员为骨干的国民革命军部队。
中国政治人物。

birth_place.zh-cn: 俄罗斯帝国库尔斯克省

description.zh-cn: 苏联政治家，斯大林逝世后的主要领导人。他曾任苏联共产党中央委员会第一书记和苏联部长会议主席。作为苏联部长会议主席，他成为冷战时期肯尼迪的主要对手，尤其在古巴导弹危机期间。他曾与毛泽东会谈，其对斯大林的批判影响了毛泽东发动文革的决策。在他领导下，中苏关系恶化，导致中苏交恶。
description.en: A Soviet statesman and the primary leader of the Soviet Union after Stalin's death. He served as the First Secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union and Chairman of the Council of Ministers. As Chairman of the Council of Ministers, he was Kennedy's main adversary during the Cold War, especially during the Cuban Missile Crisis. He met with Mao Zedong, and his criticism of Stalin influenced Mao Zedong's decision to launch the Cultural Revolution. Under his leadership, relations between the Soviet Union and China deteriorated, leading to the Sino-Soviet split.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国的中央行政机构，由中国国民党领导。在1949年前曾统治中国大陆，早期（1913年10月10日至1928年12月29日）主要由北洋军阀掌控，为建国初期中央政府。蒋介石领导时期，曾与苏联签署《中苏友好同盟条约》。1948年行宪后，因国共内战战败迁往台湾。1949年后，作为退守台湾的执政当局，负责侦破并瓦解了中共台湾省工委组织。在《中日联合声明》中，日本承认中华人民共和国政府为中国唯一合法政府，间接否定了其合法性。
description.en: The central administrative organ of the Republic of China, led by the Kuomintang. It governed mainland China until 1949. Its early central government (Oct 10, 1913 – Dec 29, 1928) was primarily controlled by Beiyang warlords. Under Chiang Kai-shek, it signed the Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship and Alliance. After its 1948 constitutional rule and defeat in the Chinese Civil War, it relocated to Taiwan. There, post-1949, it dismantled the CPC Taiwan Provincial Work Committee. The Sino-Japanese Joint Communiqué later implicitly denied its legitimacy by recognizing the PRC as China's sole legal government.

中华民国第6、7任总统，蒋中正长子，毛福梅之子，蒋纬国之兄，蒋孝武之父。他作为中华民国政治人物，在台湾时期逐步掌控情治系统，并曾任命郝柏村为参谋总长，此外，他还曾批评孔祥熙为“大资产阶级”，并多次到狱中探望并劝降张志忠。

During his time in Taiwan, he gradually gained control over the intelligence system, appointed Hau Pei-tsun as Chief of the General Staff, criticized H. H. 人民公社是大跃进时期（1958-1983年）在中国农村推行的一种政社合一的社会基层组织形式。它是1958年将农业生产合作社合并而成的运动，作为农业集体化的高级阶段和社会改造运动，是“三面红旗”之一。其建立进一步剥夺了农民对土地的权利；同时，公共食堂制度的推行导致粮食浪费，平均主义的分配方式打击了农民的生产积极性，成为三年困难时期的重要成因。
description.en: The People's Commune was a grassroots social organization that integrated government administration and economic management, implemented in rural China during the Great Leap Forward (1958-1983). It was a movement initiated in 1958 to merge agricultural producers' cooperatives, serving as an advanced stage of agricultural collectivization and a social transformation movement, identified as one of the 'Three Red Flags'. Its establishment further deprived peasants of their rights to the land; meanwhile, the implementation of the public canteen system led to food waste, and the egalitarian distribution method dampened farmers' production enthusiasm, becoming a significant cause of the Three Years of Great Famine.

description.en: The Ministry of Heavy Industry of the Central People's Government was an industrial administration department in the early days of the People's Republic of China and a component department of the Government Administration Council, established in accordance with the 1949 Organic Law of the Central People's Government of the People's Republic of China. Li Fuchun served as its minister. It was responsible for industries such as steel, non-ferrous metals, machinery, shipbuilding, ordnance, aviation, chemicals, and building materials. The department was dissolved in September 1954, as the predecessor to the Ministry of Heavy Industry of the People's Republic of China, and was succeeded by the Ministry of Heavy Industry.

中国共产党中央委员会直属的文献编译研究机构，负责编译马克思主义经典著作和党的重要文献。其牌子由中共中央党史和文献研究院加挂。
description.en: A document translation and research institution directly under the Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party, responsible for compiling and translating classic works of Marxism and important party documents. Its sign is held by the Institute of Party History and Literature of the CPC Central Committee.

中共中央工业交通工作部
中国共产党第三次全国代表大会

zh-cn: 中国共产党第四次全国代表大会
en: 4th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party

description.zh-cn: 李维汉与吴景之之子，中国政治人物，曾任中央机构编制委员会办公室主任。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Director of the Office of the Central Institutional Organization Commission.

description.zh-cn: 由毛泽东、蔡和森等人发起组织的、对中国革命进程有重要影响的青年进步团体。
西藏地方政府。

en: Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会领导财经工作的决策议事协调机构，是中华人民共和国经济的核心领导和决策部门。2018年由中央财经领导小组改组而成。
description.en: The decision-making, deliberative, and coordinating body of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China that leads financial and economic work. It is the core leadership and decision-making department for the economy of the People's Republic of China. It was reorganized from the Central Leading Group for Financial and Economic Affairs in 2018.

description.zh-cn: 1927年8月7日，中国共产党在汉口召开紧急会议，纠正了陈独秀的右倾机会主义，确立了土地革命和武装反抗国民党反动派的总方针。会议上，向忠发被选为临时中央政治局委员。
description.en: On August 7, 1927, the Communist Party of China held an emergency meeting in Hankou. It corrected Chen Duxiu's right-leaning opportunism and established the general policy of land revolution and armed resistance against the Kuomintang reactionaries. During the meeting, Xiang Zhongfa was elected a member of the temporary Politburo.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国湖南省长沙市下辖的县，李维汉的出生地。
苏联及现今俄罗斯的首都。《中苏友好同盟互助条约》在此地的克里姆林宫签署。
description.en: The capital of the Soviet Union and present-day Russia. The Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship, Alliance and Mutual Assistance was signed here at the Kremlin.

description.zh-cn: 晚清时期，由光绪帝领导，康有为、梁启超等维新派人士推动的政治改革运动（史称戊戌变法），旨在学习西方，推动清朝政治、经济、军事的现代化改革。此运动于1898年9月21日被慈禧太后发动的戊戌政变终止，光绪帝亦因此被软禁。
description.en: A political reform movement initiated in the late Qing dynasty by the Guangxu Emperor and reform-minded figures like Kang Youwei and Liang Qichao. It aimed to modernize China by learning from the West and reforming its political, economic, and military systems. The movement was terminated on September 21, 1898, by the Wuxu Coup launched by Empress Dowager Cixi, leading to the emperor's house arrest.

description.zh-cn: 日本是历史悠久的东亚岛国，明治维新后快速现代化，文化受《论语》和白居易诗歌影响。大日本帝国时期，甲午战争后至一战前是中国学习西方文化的重要中介；北洋政府时期支持皖系和奉系军阀。在虹桥机场事件、淞沪会战及二战期间与中国发生冲突，并对重庆进行了战略轰炸。1972年与中华人民共和国建交。作为美国第七舰队主要驻扎地，其民众普遍反对核武器影响了美国核动力航母部署。20世纪末曾发生药害爱滋事件。
description.en: Japan is a historically rich East Asian island country that rapidly modernized after the Meiji Restoration, with its culture influenced by The Analects and Bai Juyi's poetry. During the Empire of Japan period, from after the First Sino-Japanese War to before World War I, it was an important intermediary for China to learn Western culture; during the Beiyang government, it supported the Anhui and Fengtian cliques. It clashed with China during the Hongqiao Airport Incident, the Battle of Shanghai, and World War II, strategically bombing Chongqing. In 1972, it established diplomatic relations with the People's Republic of China. As the main basing location for the U.S. Seventh Fleet, public opposition to nuclear weapons in the country has influenced the deployment of U.S. nuclear-powered aircraft carriers. In the late 20th century, it experienced the HIV-tainted blood scandal.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代民主革命家，华兴会会长，宋教仁的挚友。曾任军政府战时总司令、陆军总长。
description.en: A Chinese modern democratic revolutionary, president of the Huaxinghui, and a close friend of Song Jiaoren. He served as wartime commander-in-chief and Minister of War for the military government.

birth_place.zh-cn: 湖南省常德府桃源县仙瑞乡上坊村湘冲
birth_place.en: Xiangchong, Shangfang Village, Xianrui Township, Taoyuan County, Changde Prefecture, Hunan Province

death_place.zh-cn: 江苏省沪海道上海县闸北区沪宁铁路医院
death_place.en: Huning Railway Hospital, Zhabei District, Shanghai County, Huhai Dao, Jiangsu Province

description.zh-cn: 中国近代民主革命家，中华民国初期第一位倡导责任内阁制的政治家，华兴会和同盟会的主要领导人，国民党的主要筹建人及代理理事长。他于1913年3月20日在上海北站遇刺，并于22日不治身亡。此事件是二次革命的直接导火索。
description.en: A Chinese modern democratic revolutionary, the first politician to advocate for a cabinet responsibility system in the early Republic of China, a key leader of the Huaxinghui and the Tongmenghui, and a principal founder and acting chairman of the Kuomintang. On March 20, 1913, he was assassinated at Shanghai North Railway Station and died on the 22nd. This event was the direct trigger for the Second Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 吉林省巡抚。
林伯渠堂兄。

zh-cn: 中华民国临时政府 (1912年－1913年)

description.zh-cn: 中华民国建国初期，以京兆地方（北京）为首都的中央政府。始于1912年袁世凯就任临时大总统。在袁世凯去世后，该政府实际由北洋军阀各派系所控制，因大总统和国务总理主要由北洋军阀出身而得名。其于1914年设立了绥远特别区。五四运动期间，其在巴黎和会上的外交失败和对内镇压学生的做法引发了全国性的抗议。
description.en: The central government of the Republic of China in its early days, with its capital in Jingzhao (Beijing). It began with Yuan Shikai's inauguration as Provisional President in 1912. After Yuan Shikai's death, it was effectively controlled by various factions of the Beiyang Warlords, who predominantly held the positions of President and Premier. It established the Suiyuan Special Administrative Region in 1914. During the May Fourth Movement, its diplomatic failure at the Paris Peace Conference and its suppression of students sparked nationwide protests.

zh-cn: 中国国民党中央执行委员会农民运动讲习所

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期培养农民运动干部的机构。
description.en: An early institution of the Communist Party of China for training cadres for the peasant movement.

description.zh-cn: 一套中文的拉丁字母拼音方案。
中华民国抗日战争时期至行宪前夕，国民政府的最高民意咨询机关，同时也是一个准议会机关。徐旭生曾任第二至四届参政员。
description.en: The highest advisory body on public opinion and a quasi-parliamentary institution of the Nationalist Government of the Republic of China during the Anti-Japanese War period until the eve of constitutional implementation. Xu Xusheng served as a member from the second to the fourth sessions.

description.zh-cn: 林伯渠之子。

zh-cn: 中国共产党第七届中央政治局

description.zh-cn: 1931年发生于江西宁都县的国民革命军第26路军起义事件，李达参与此次起义后加入中国工农红军。
description.en: An uprising of the 26th Route Army of the National Revolutionary Army in Ningdu, Jiangxi in 1931. Li Da participated in this uprising and subsequently joined the Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 苏区中央局召开的会议，撤销了毛泽东的军权。
抗日战争时期八路军的军事院校。

中华人民共和国苏维埃社会主义共和国联邦友好同盟互助条约
en: Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship, Alliance and Mutual Assistance

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国和苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟于1950年缔结的双边条约，旨在提供同盟、集体安全、援助与合作。该条约取代了1945年的《中苏友好同盟条约》，是毛泽东“一边倒”外交政策的体现。
description.en: A bilateral treaty concluded in 1950 between the People's Republic of China and the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics, providing for alliance, collective security, assistance, and cooperation. It replaced the 1945 Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship and Alliance and was a manifestation of Mao Zedong's "Lean to One Side" foreign policy.

description.zh-cn: 对1962年王稼祥等人对外政策建议的概括，后遭到批判。

第二次国共内战期间在河南东部地区进行的一场大规模战役。
description.en: A large-scale campaign fought in eastern Henan during the Second Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战末期的一场战役，中国人民解放军攻占上海，并控制上海全境。
description.en: A campaign in the late stage of the Chinese Civil War, which resulted in the Chinese People's Liberation Army taking control of the entire Shanghai area.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中华人民共和国最高人民检察院检察长。
中国政治人物，曾任中央人民政府内政部部长。

中华民国陆军中将，其兵团在豫东战役中被围歼。

description.en: A General of the Republic of China Army and commander of the 7th Army Group, who was defeated and committed suicide in the Nianzhuang battle of the Huaihai Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国军高级将领，济南战役中被俘。

death_place.zh-cn: 河南省永城市陈官庄乡

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军二级上将，抗战期间曾任新编第二十二师师长与第五军军长，参与昆仑关战役与滇西缅北战役。国共内战期间任第二兵团司令，在徐蚌会战中阵亡。
description.en: A Lieutenant General of the Republic of China Army, posthumously promoted to General. He served as the commander of the New 22nd Division and the 5th Corps during the Second Sino-Japanese War, participating in the Battle of Kunlun Pass and the Battle of Northern Burma and Western Yunnan. During the Chinese Civil War, he commanded the 2nd Army Group and was killed in action during the Huaihai Campaign.

en: Party and State Leaders of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治术语，指在中国共产党、中华人民共和国、中国人民解放军以及中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会担任特定领导职务及级别的高级领导人的统称。这些职务通常分为国家级正职和国家级副职。
description.en: A political term in the People's Republic of China, referring to high-level leaders holding specific leadership positions and ranks within the Communist Party of China, the People's Republic of China, the People's Liberation Army, and the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference. These positions are usually divided into national-level full and deputy ranks.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党的组织原则和领导制度，旨在防止个人专断。
description.en: An organizational and leadership principle of the CPC aimed at preventing personal autocracy.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国中央人民政府下属的财政主管机构。
description.en: The financial authority under the Central People's Government of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 薄一波的长女。
description.en: Bo Yibo's eldest daughter.

description.zh-cn: 薄一波的长子。
description.en: Bo Yibo's eldest son.

description.zh-cn: 中国历史学者，薄一波与胡明的三女。曾任北京大学历史系副教授，研究方向为隋唐考古、石窟艺术等。
description.en: A Chinese historian, the third daughter of Bo Yibo and Hu Ming. She was an associate professor in the History Department of Peking University, specializing in Sui and Tang archaeology, grotto art, etc.

description.zh-cn: 全称山西牺牲救国同盟会，是抗日战争时期在山西成立的，由薄一波创建的群众抗日团体，也是一个抗日民族统一战线组织。
description.en: The full name is the Shanxi Sacrifice for National Salvation Alliance. It was an anti-Japanese national united front organization established in Shanxi during the Second Sino-Japanese War, founded by Bo Yibo.

zh-cn: 山西国民兵军官教导团

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争期间由薄一波组建的山西新军部队。

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争时期在晋东南地区建立的抗日根据地军事组织。
description.en: A military organization of the anti-Japanese base area established in the southeastern Shanxi area during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，中国共产党和中华人民共和国的领导人之一，曾任中共中央组织部部长，是“六十一人叛徒集团案”的主要受害者。
description.en: Chinese politician, one of the leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, former Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, and a main victim of the 'Case of the 61 Renegades'.

description.zh-cn: 1947年由中共中央批准公布的土地改革纲领性文件，规定废除封建剥削的土地制度，实行耕者有其田。
description.en: A programmatic document on land reform approved and promulgated by the CPC Central Committee in 1947, which stipulated the abolition of the feudal exploitative land system and the implementation of 'land to the tiller'.

description.zh-cn: 一份旨在纠正“大跃进”中工业领域“左”倾错误的政策文件。
description.en: A policy document aimed at correcting the 'leftist' errors in the industrial sector during the Great Leap Forward.

zh-cn: 国务院财政经济委员会

description.zh-cn: 1979年至1980年间存在的国务院下属机构，后被中央财政经济领导小组取代。
description.en: A subordinate body of the State Council that existed from 1979 to 1980, later replaced by the Central Leading Group for Financial and Economic Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 1986年底由中国大陆各地高校学生发起的一场大规模学生示威游行，旨在争取民主选举、新闻自由等权利。该运动是中华人民共和国民主运动的一部分，对后续的政治事件产生了深远影响，并成为导致胡耀邦下台的导火索。
description.en: A large-scale student movement initiated by university students across mainland China at the end of 1986, aiming to demand rights such as democratic elections and freedom of the press. It was part of the Chinese democracy movement, had a profound impact on subsequent political events, and became the catalyst for Hu Yaobang's removal from office.

birth_place.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国山西省临猗县
birth_place.en: Linyi County, Shanxi Province, People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中国律师，前中共中央政治局委员薄熙来之妻。因谋杀尼尔·海伍德犯故意杀人罪被判处死刑，缓期二年执行，后减为无期徒刑，目前在燕城监狱服刑。
description.en: A Chinese lawyer and the wife of former Politburo member Bo Xilai. She was convicted of intentional homicide and received a suspended death sentence, which was later commuted to life imprisonment. She is currently serving her sentence at Yancheng Prison.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军少将，一二·九运动的领导者和发动人之一，谷开来之父。
description.en: A major general of the Chinese People's Liberation Army, one of the initiators of the December 9th Movement, and the father of Gu Kailai.

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来与第一任妻子李丹宇之子，商人。
description.en: Son of Bo Xilai and Li Danyu, a businessman.

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来与薄谷开来之子，薄一波之孙，投资人、律师。他曾与陈晓丹交往。
description.en: Son of Bo Xilai and Bo Gu Kailai, grandson of Bo Yibo. He is an investor and lawyer, and once dated Chen Xiaodan.

description.en: The leading organ of the Communist Party of China in Zhejiang Province.

description.en: A mountain range in southwestern Jiangxi Province, China, in the middle section of the Luoxiao Mountains on the border of Hunan and Jiangxi. It was the site of the first rural revolutionary base established by the Communist Party of China, thus known as the 'cradle of the revolution'.

中国共产党中央委员会曾设立的负责农村工作的部门，后在党政分开的背景下被撤销。
description.en: A department formerly established by the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, responsible for rural work, which was later abolished in the context of the separation of party and government.

zh-cn: 生产资料所有制的社会主义改造

description.zh-cn: 在土地改革运动后，中国共产党在中国大陆推行的将农民土地所有权转变为集体所有制的政治运动。
description.en: A political movement launched by the CCP in mainland China after the Land Reform Movement to transform peasant land ownership into collective ownership.

description.zh-cn: 1952年9月，中共中央将五个大行政区的地方局书记调入北京，以削弱地方权力，加强中央集权的重大政治事件。
description.en: A major political event in September 1952, where the Central Committee of the CCP transferred the secretaries of the five great administrative regions to Beijing to weaken local power and strengthen central authority.

description.zh-cn: 邓颖超的父亲，清朝武官。
中国妇女运动的先驱，与邓颖超共同组织天津女界爱国同志会。

中国共产党早期女领导人之一。

description.en: A public non-profit social organization in the People's Republic of China engaged in population and family planning as well as population welfare, supervised by the National Health Commission.

description.en: A theoretical physicist, academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, and the second chairman of the China Association for Science and Technology.
