description.en: A people's organization composed of national associations of writers and artists, federations of literary and art circles of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, and national industrial federations of literary and art workers.

en: University of Science and Technology of China

description.zh-cn: 位于中国安徽省合肥市，隶属于中国科学院，是中华人民共和国理工科排名前列的公立研究型大学。该校是八六学潮的策源地，其学生曾率先发起游行抗议地方人大代表选举问题。此外，科大讯飞由该校背景的“讯飞信息科技有限公司”整体变更设立。
description.en: Located in Hefei, Anhui Province, China, and affiliated with the Chinese Academy of Sciences, this is a top-tier public research university in science and engineering. It was the origin of the 1986 student demonstrations, where its students first marched to protest local People's Congress deputy elections. Additionally, iFlytek was established through the overall transformation of 'Xunfei Information Technology Co., Ltd.', a company with ties to the university.

description.zh-cn: 中国现代文学史上一个重要的文学团体。
description.en: An important literary group in the history of modern Chinese literature.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国全国性的史学学术团体，徐旭生曾任常务理事。
description.en: A national historical academic society in the People's Republic of China, where Xu Xusheng served as a standing council member.

description.zh-cn: 教育家，大连大学创始人之一，大连大学首任校长。
唐朝诗人、官员，号称“诗仙”，与杜甫并称“李杜”。
唐代伟大的现实主义诗人，世称“诗圣”、“诗史”，与李白齐名，并称为“李杜”。其作品对白居易的讽谕诗创作有重要影响。
description.en: A great realist poet of the Tang dynasty, known as the 'Poet-Sage' and 'Poet-Historian', whose works significantly influenced Bai Juyi's satirical poetry.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国初年，由陈独秀、胡适、鲁迅、钱玄同、蔡元培等受西方教育者发起，是一场反对旧传统、提倡“民主”与“科学”的思想启蒙、文化革新与文学革命运动。它旨在“反传统、反孔教、反文言”，并为五四运动准备了思想基础，在运动后得到推广但也有分化。
description.en: Initiated by Western-educated figures such as Chen Duxiu, Hu Shi, Lu Xun, Qian Xuantong, and Cai Yuanpei in the early Republic of China, this movement was an intellectual enlightenment, cultural renewal, and literary revolution against old traditions, promoting 'democracy' and 'science'. It aimed to 'oppose tradition, Confucianism, and classical Chinese', laid the ideological foundation for the May Fourth Movement, and was further popularized but also saw divisions afterwards.

description.zh-cn: 饶漱石之父，曾任江西省人民委员会副省长。
中共早期党员，后叛变，在汪精卫政权特务总部工作，是潘汉年会见汪精卫的唯一见证人。
description.en: An early member of the CPC who later defected and worked for the secret service headquarters of the Wang Jingwei regime. He was the sole witness to the meeting between Pan Hannian and Wang Jingwei.

description.zh-cn: 高岗的前妻。
高岗的第二任妻子。
位于陕西省榆林市的一所中学。
中国工农红军高级将领，陕甘边革命根据地创建者之一。
抗日战争时期八路军留守陕甘宁边区的部队。
中国政治人物，被认为是高岗的“五虎上将”之一。
中国大型钢铁企业集团，是位于辽宁鞍山的特大型钢铁联合企业，也是“156项重点工程”之一。
description.en: A large Chinese steel enterprise group, it is a super-large iron and steel complex located in Anshan, Liaoning, and also one of the '156 Key Projects'.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，被认为是高岗的“五虎上将”之一。
中国政治人物，被认为是高岗的“五虎上将”之一。
中国经济学家，被认为是高岗的“五虎上将”之一，也曾是陈元的导师。
description.en: Chinese economist, considered one of Gao Gang's "Five Tiger Generals", and also a mentor to Chen Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 曾任陕甘宁边区政府民政厅厅长，建议杨芝芳与高岗离婚。
中国政治人物，曾任全国人大常委会副委员长。因受贿罪被判处并执行死刑。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as a Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress. He was sentenced to death and executed for bribery.

description.zh-cn: 前中共中央委员，曾任赵紫阳的政治秘书（兼中共中央政治体制改革研究室主任）。六四事件后被判刑，是中国异见人士，《零八宪章》的首批签署者之一。
description.en: Former member of the CPC Central Committee, political secretary to Zhao Ziyang (also serving as Director of the CPC Central Research Office for Political System Reform). Sentenced after the Tiananmen Square incident, he was a Chinese dissident and one of the first signatories of Charter 08.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政府和日本国政府联合声明
en: Joint Communiqué of the Government of Japan and the Government of the People's Republic of China
Normalization of relations between Japan and China

description.zh-cn: 指1972年日本与中华人民共和国建立正式外交关系的历史进程，期间两国政府于1972年9月29日签署了恢复邦交的联合声明，由田中角荣首相任内实现。
description.en: Refers to the historical process of establishing formal diplomatic relations between Japan and the People's Republic of China in 1972. During this process, the governments of both countries signed a joint statement on September 29, 1972, to restore diplomatic ties, achieved during Prime Minister Kakuei Tanaka's term.

zh-cn: 中华民国陆军军官学校
中国国民党陆军军官学校
国民革命军黄埔军官学校

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军军官学校，由中国国民党创办，是培养陆军军官的军事院校，也是中华民国创建的第一所现代军事学校。
description.en: The first modern military academy established in the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 赫鲁晓夫之后的苏联最高领导人，曾任苏共中央总书记。其执政后期苏联经济陷入停滞。
description.en: The paramount leader of the Soviet Union after Khrushchev, serving as General Secretary of the CPSU.

description.zh-cn: 苏联元帅，曾任苏联国防部长。
description.en: A Marshal of the Soviet Union who served as Minister of Defence of the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 周恩来外祖父。
中国共产党早期领导人，在四一二事件后的搜捕中被杀害。
description.en: An early leader of the Chinese Communist Party, who was killed in the roundups following the April 12th Incident.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代史上的政治活动家、学者，曾任北洋政府教育总长，亦是华兴会共同创始人之一。
description.en: One of the co-founders of the Huaxinghui.

description.zh-cn: 中国历史上最后一个帝制王朝，由满族建立。初期沿用锦衣卫制度，后改为銮仪卫。它是太平天国运动的主要镇压者和第二次鸦片战争的主要参战方。其行政区划初称布政使司，后“省”获官方认可。甲午战争后编练新军，包括北洋军前身。日俄战争在其领土进行，战后影响立宪运动。其在1911年推行的铁路国有政策直接导致了保路运动的爆发。载沣是其最后的实际统治者之一，并被福泽谕吉《脱亚论》视为应“绝交”的“恶友”。
description.en: The last imperial dynasty in Chinese history, established by the Manchu people. It initially adopted the Jinyiwei system, later changing to the Luan Yi Wei (Imperial Guard of Honor). It was the primary suppressor of the Taiping Rebellion and a major combatant in the Second Opium War. Its administrative divisions were initially called 'Buzheng Shisi,' with 'province' later gaining official recognition. After the First Sino-Japanese War, it began training the New Army, including the predecessor of the Beiyang Army. The Russo-Japanese War was fought on its territory, influencing the Constitutional Movement afterward. Its policy of railway nationalization in 1911 directly led to the outbreak of the Railway Protection Movement. Zaifeng was one of its last de facto rulers, and it was considered a 'bad friend' by Fukuzawa Yukichi in 'Datsu-A Ron,' with whom Japan should break ties.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代的一个府。
description.en: An ancient prefecture in China.

description.zh-cn: 赵紫阳的妻子。
赵紫阳次子。
description.en: Second son of Zhao Ziyang.

description.zh-cn: 赵紫阳之女，中国嘉德国际拍卖有限公司总经理。
description.en: Daughter of Zhao Ziyang, General Manager of China Guardian Auctions.

description.zh-cn: 赵紫阳曾就读的中学。

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院总理
en: Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国中央人民政府（国务院）的首长，是中国的政府首脑。它负责领导中华人民共和国国务院，作为中央人民政府的最高领导人。李克强曾于2013年至2023年担任此职务。
description.en: The head of the Central People's Government (State Council) of the People's Republic of China, serving as China's head of government. It is responsible for leading the State Council and acts as the highest leader of the Central People's Government. Li Keqiang held this position from 2013 to 2023.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央军事委员会副主席

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央军事委员会的副职领导人。

zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会副主席
en: Vice Chairperson of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference
Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference
Vice Chairperson of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会副主席，属国家级副职党和国家领导人。
description.en: Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, a state-level deputy leader position.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院副总理
en: Vice Premier of the State Council
Vice Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院的副总理，是国务院的副首长、副职负责人之一，也是国务院常务会议的重要组成人员。其职责是协助总理工作，位列党和国家领导人，职务为国家级副职公务员，亦是中华人民共和国的最高行政首长之一。例如，李克强曾于2008年至2013年担任排名第一的副总理。
description.en: The Vice Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China is one of the deputy heads and deputy chief officials of the State Council, and an important member of its executive meetings. Their responsibilities include assisting the Premier. They are ranked among the Party and state leaders, hold the position of a national deputy-level civil servant, and are also among the highest administrative leaders of the People's Republic of China. For example, Li Keqiang served as the first-ranking Vice Premier from 2008 to 2013.

en: History of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 政治体制改革，1980年代由邓小平、胡耀邦、赵紫阳等人推动的政治改革尝试。
1987年初在中国大陆开展的一场政治运动，由中共党内保守派在八六学潮后发起。该运动旨在批判和反对被认为是资产阶级自由化的思想、言论和行为、西方的政治和思想影响，以及崇拜西方资本主义国家“民主”、“自由”、否定社会主义的政治思潮。运动导致多名知识分子和官员受到处分。
description.en: A political campaign initiated by CCP conservatives in early 1987 in mainland China, following the 1986 student demonstrations. It aimed at criticizing and opposing ideas, speeches, and behaviors deemed 'bourgeois liberalization', specifically targeting Western political and ideological influences, and tendencies to worship Western capitalist 'democracy' and 'freedom' while negating socialism. The campaign resulted in the punishment of several intellectuals and officials.

description.zh-cn: 美国第40任总统。其政府发布了《八一七公报》和《六项保证》。他在就职典礼后几分钟，伊朗人质被释放。
description.en: The 40th President of the United States. His administration issued the August 17th Communiqué and the Six Assurances. His inauguration coincided with the release of the Iran hostages.

description.zh-cn: 苏联最后一任最高领导人，曾任苏联共产党中央委员会总书记。六四事件期间曾访华。
description.en: The last leader of the Soviet Union, serving as General Secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十三届中央委员会第四次全体会议
en: Fourth Plenary Session of the 13th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
Fourth Plenary Session of the 13th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 此次中国共产党的重要会议，审议并通过了关于赵紫阳等人在“六四事件”中所犯错误的报告，并因此免去其党内一切领导职务；同时，江泽民被选举为新任中共中央总书记。此外，阎明复、胡启立、芮杏文也在此次会议上被免去中央书记处书记职务。
description.en: This important meeting of the Chinese Communist Party reviewed and approved the report on the errors committed by Zhao Ziyang and others in the 'Tiananmen Square Incident', consequently removing him from all leadership positions within the Party; concurrently, Jiang Zemin was elected as the new General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee. Additionally, Yan Mingfu, Hu Qili, and Rui Xingwen were also dismissed from their posts as secretaries of the Central Secretariat at this meeting.

description.zh-cn: 杨尚昆出生地
杨尚昆的妻子，参加了二万五千里长征的女红军，曾任中央戏剧学院党委书记、副院长。
description.en: Wife of Yang Shangkun, a female Red Army soldier who participated in the Long March. She served as Party Secretary and Vice President of the Central Academy of Drama.

description.zh-cn: 杨尚昆次子，著名摄影家，现任中国宋庆龄基金会副主席。
description.en: Second son of Yang Shangkun, a renowned photographer, currently serving as Vice Chairman of the China Soong Ching Ling Foundation.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国南部沿海的省级行政区。它是徐发淦的籍贯地，河源市位于其境内；同时，也是杨竞衡的出生地。
description.en: A provincial-level administrative division located on the southern coast of the People's Republic of China. It is Xu Fagan's ancestral home, with Heyuan City situated within its borders; it is also the birthplace of Yang Jingheng.

description.zh-cn: 韩国前总统，全斗焕的继任者。他曾与金泳三、金钟泌三党合并，后在金泳三执政期间因腐败被起诉定罪，并最终获得赦免。
description.en: Former President of South Korea and successor to Chun Doo-hwan. He merged his party with those of Kim Young-sam and Kim Jong-pil. He was later prosecuted and convicted for corruption during Kim Young-sam's presidency and eventually pardoned.

description.zh-cn: 日本第125代天皇。
指中共十四大前，杨尚昆、杨白冰兄弟被指意图夺取军权，最终被邓小平解除军权的政治事件。
description.en: Refers to the political incident before the 14th National Congress of the CPC, where brothers Yang Shangkun and Yang Baibing were accused of attempting to seize military power, ultimately leading to their removal from military authority by Deng Xiaoping.

description.zh-cn: 杨尚昆二妹。
胡耀邦长子，曾任中共中央统战部副部长。
胡耀邦次子，曾任香港华润集团常务董事。

en: Rehabilitation of unjust, false, and wrongful cases

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命结束后，中国共产党对在历次政治运动中受迫害的干部和群众进行平反昭雪的政治行动。
description.en: After the end of the Cultural Revolution, a political action by the Communist Party of China to rehabilitate cadres and masses who were persecuted in previous political movements.

description.zh-cn: 指胡耀邦在1987年1月16日中共中央政治局扩大会议上辞去中共中央总书记职务的事件。该事件是八六学潮最直接的政治后果。
description.en: Refers to the event on January 16, 1987, when Hu Yaobang resigned from his position as General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee at an enlarged Politburo meeting. This event was the most direct political consequence of the 1986 student demonstrations.

description.zh-cn: 前中共中央总书记胡耀邦因心脏病逝世，引发了大规模的悼念活动，成为六四事件的导火索。
中国教育家，曾任北京大学校长。他开除了指出农村饿死人情况的学生黄立众。
description.en: Chinese educator who served as the President of Peking University. He expelled the student Huang Lizhong for pointing out the starvation deaths in rural areas.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物。
description.en: Chinese politician.

zh-cn: 中国共产党陕西省委员会
en: Shaanxi Provincial Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
Shaanxi Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物

zh-cn: 实践是检验真理的唯一标准
en: Practice is the Sole Criterion for Testing Truth

description.zh-cn: 1978年5月11日，由胡福明撰写并发表于《光明日报》的评论文章，在中国思想解放运动中，引发了全国范围关于真理标准问题的大讨论。
description.en: On May 11, 1978, a commentary article written by Hu Fuming and published in Guangming Daily, during China's ideological emancipation movement, triggered a nationwide discussion on the criterion of truth.

description.zh-cn: 中国学者，南京大学教授，《实践是检验真理的唯一标准》一文的主要作者。
description.en: A Chinese scholar and professor at Nanjing University, the main author of the article "Practice is the Sole Criterion for Testing Truth".

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任东北人民政府工业部部长。1952年8月起，出任中央人民政府重工业部部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, who previously served as Minister of Industry of the Northeast People's Government. In August 1952, he was appointed Minister of the Central People's Government Ministry of Heavy Industry.

description.zh-cn: 中国上海历史上曾有的一个县，也是乔石和向忠发的出生地。其部分区域于1992年被划入新成立的浦东新区。
description.en: A former county in the history of Shanghai, China, and also the birthplace of Qiao Shi and Xiang Zhongfa. Part of its area was merged into the newly established Pudong New Area in 1992.

description.zh-cn: 湖北省的工人组织，向忠发曾任委员长。
description.en: A workers' organization in Hubei Province, where Xiang Zhongfa once served as chairman.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期工人运动领袖，向忠发的入党介绍人，一位革命活动家。
description.en: An early labor movement leader and revolutionary activist of the Chinese Communist Party, who introduced Xiang Zhongfa to the party.

zh-cn: 中共湖北区执行委员会

description.zh-cn: 国民党重要政治人物，CC系领导人之一，曾与顾顺章一同策划并逮捕了向忠发。
description.en: An important political figure in the Kuomintang and one of the leaders of the CC Clique, who, along with Gu Shunzhang, planned and arrested Xiang Zhongfa.

description.zh-cn: 时任淞沪警备司令，在接到蒋介石命令后下令处决向忠发。
description.en: Then commander of the Shanghai Garrison, who ordered the execution of Xiang Zhongfa upon receiving orders from Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: 瞿秋白之母
瞿秋白的第二任妻子，上海大学学生。
杨之华与沈剑龙的女儿，瞿秋白的继女。
瞿秋白的二弟
瞿秋白的四弟
瞿秋白的六弟
瞿秋白就读的中学
瞿秋白学习英文的学校
中华苏维埃共和国的最高学府
中国共产党早期领导人
中华民国陆军中将，蒋介石嫡系重要将领，抗日名将，黄埔军校第一期毕业。曾任第十一集团军总司令等职。他曾是瞿秋白在上海大学的学生，后负责羁押并执行对瞿秋白的枪决。1949年在国共内战中被俘，1959年获特赦。晚年移居美国，致力于中国和平统一。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the Republic of China Army, a key general loyal to Chiang Kai-shek, a famous anti-Japanese war hero, and a graduate of the first class of the Whampoa Military Academy. He served as the commander of the 11th Army Group. He was a student of Qu Qiubai at Shanghai University and later responsible for detaining and executing Qu Qiubai. He was captured in the Chinese Civil War in 1949 and was granted amnesty in 1959. In his later years, he moved to the United States and dedicated himself to the peaceful reunification of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党高级将领，曾任驻闽绥署主任
陈独秀的第二任妻子
浙江大学的前身。
位于日本东京的著名私立大学，宋教仁曾在此留学。
description.en: A famous private university in Tokyo, Japan, where Song Jiaoren studied.

description.zh-cn: 中国顶尖的综合性高等学府，位于北京市，是新文化运动和五四运动的中心。1917年，根据国民政府教育部的统一调整，接收了北洋大学法科。李克强（法学学士、经济学硕士及博士）、林立果、徐旭生（曾任教授、教务长及哲学系主任）、罗豪才（曾长期任教，任副校长）、黄立众（后因言获罪被开除）和张文勋等诸多知名人士曾在此就读、进修或任职。
description.en: A top comprehensive institution of higher learning in Beijing, China, and the center of the New Culture Movement and the May Fourth Movement. In 1917, following a unified restructuring by the Ministry of Education of the Nationalist Government, it absorbed the law department of Peiyang University. Many notable figures have studied, pursued advanced studies, or worked here, including Li Keqiang (Bachelor of Laws, Master of Economics, and Doctor of Economics), Lin Liguo, Xu Xusheng (who served as professor, dean of studies, and head of the philosophy department), Luo Haocai (who taught for many years and served as Vice President), Huang Lizhong (later expelled for his speech), and Zhang Wenxun.

en: Left Opposition of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 20世纪初期中国的一份革命杂志，也是新文化运动中的重要刊物之一，曾刊登毛泽东的《体育之研究》。
description.en: A revolutionary Chinese magazine in the early 20th century, which was also an important publication during the New Culture Movement, and published Mao Zedong's 'A Study of Physical Education'.

description.zh-cn: 由托洛茨基发展的马克思主义理论，与斯大林主义对立。

description.zh-cn: 1911年（清宣统三年），清政府宣布“铁路干线国有政策”，引发一场大规模群众运动，尤以四川民众反对最为激烈，史称四川保路运动。运动期间，四川总督赵尔丰下令枪杀请愿群众，造成三十二人死亡的惨案，成为运动由和平请愿转向武装斗争的转折点，为武昌起义创造了条件，加速了清朝灭亡。
description.en: In 1911 (the third year of the Xuantong reign of the Qing dynasty), the Qing government's announcement of the 'Policy of Nationalizing Trunk Railways' triggered a large-scale mass movement, with the most intense opposition coming from the people of Sichuan, known as the Sichuan Railway Protection Movement. During the movement, Sichuan Viceroy Zhao Erfeng ordered Qing soldiers to shoot at the protesting crowd, causing a tragedy with thirty-two deaths. This became a turning point, shifting the movement from peaceful petition to armed struggle, creating conditions for the Wuchang Uprising and accelerating the downfall of the Qing dynasty.

description.en: The founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, known as the Hongwu Emperor. He was an ancestor of Zhu Rongji, the great-grandfather of Emperor Xuande, and the grandfather of Zhu Gaoxu; Li Jinglong was the son of his nephew Li Wenzhong. He was the husband of Empress Ma, whom he compared to Empress Zhangsun of the Tang dynasty, and after her death, he vowed not to install another empress. He was also the founder of the Jinyiwei. During his reign, he initiated several major political purges, including the Empty Seal Case, the Hu Weiyong case, the Lan Yu case, and the Guo Huan case. Notably, through the Hu Weiyong case, he abolished the chancellery system in China and greatly consolidated imperial power.

description.zh-cn: 中国前驻英国大使

英国是位于西欧的岛屿主权国家，由英格兰、威尔士、苏格兰及北爱尔兰组成。在近代，与清朝签订《南京条约》并在上海设立租界；鸦片战争后取得香港岛主权并发展为殖民地，政府于1841年至1997年间管治香港。其在新加坡的殖民当局曾因罗豪才参与反对殖民统治的斗争而将其逮捕并驱逐。作为加拿大的前宗主国，两国至今在英联邦框架下保持密切关系。在军阀割据时期，曾与美国一同支持直系军阀，并通过《日英同盟》成为日本的盟友。第二次世界大战期间，是同盟国主要成员及苏联盟国，与美国和中国共同发表了《波茨坦宣言》，并参与了对利比亚的军事干预行动。
description.en: The United Kingdom is a sovereign island state located in Western Europe, comprising England, Wales, Scotland, and Northern Ireland. In modern times, it signed the Treaty of Nanking with the Qing dynasty and established a concession in Shanghai; after the Opium War, it gained sovereignty over Hong Kong Island and developed it as a colony, with its government administering Hong Kong from 1841 to 1997. Its colonial authorities in Singapore arrested and deported Luo Haocai for his participation in the struggle against colonial rule. As Canada's former colonial power, the two nations maintain close relations within the Commonwealth framework to this day. During the Warlord Era, it supported the Zhili clique alongside the United States to protect its interests in China, and became an ally of Japan through the Anglo-Japanese Alliance. During World War II, it was a principal member of the Allied powers and an ally of the Soviet Union, co-issuing the Potsdam Declaration with the United States and China, and participated in the military intervention in Libya.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事及政治人物，北洋军阀奉系首领。曾任中华民国陆海军大元帅、北洋政府末任国家元首。他与蒋介石协议共同驱逐共产国际势力，并搜查苏联使馆，处决了李大钊等共产党人。他是张学良之父、张作孚之兄，曾抚养并提拔侄子张学成。后在皇姑屯事件中被日军刺杀身亡。
description.en: A prominent military and political figure of the Republic of China and a leader of the Fengtian clique of the Beiyang Warlords. He served as Grand Marshal of the Army and Navy of the Republic of China and was the last head of state of the Beiyang Government. He notably agreed with Chiang Kai-shek to jointly expel Comintern influence, raided the Soviet embassy in Beijing, and executed Li Dazhao and other communists. He was the father of Zhang Xueliang and the elder brother of Zhang Zuofu, also raising and promoting his nephew Zhang Xuecheng in his army. He was later assassinated by the Japanese army in the Huanggutun Incident.

description.zh-cn: 中国富商于文斗之女，张学良的原配妻子。在张学良的人生中扮演了重要角色。
description.en: Daughter of Chinese businessman Yu Wendou and the original wife of Zhang Xueliang. She played a significant role in Zhang Xueliang's life.

description.zh-cn: 张学良的夫人之一。
张学良的秘书和情妇，后成为其第二任妻子，长期陪伴其幽禁生活。
description.en: Zhang Xueliang's secretary and mistress, later his second wife, accompanying him throughout his long period of house arrest.

description.zh-cn: 张作霖原配妻子，张学良之母。

中国军事人物，张作孚之子，张作霖之侄，张学良的堂弟。曾于奉天讲武堂和日本陆军大学学习。初在奉系军队任职，后投靠石友三，中原大战失败后又在九一八事变后投靠日军，被任命为东北自卫军总司令，最终因其投靠日本的国仇家恨而被张学良下令剿杀。
description.en: A Chinese military figure, son of Zhang Zuofu, nephew of Zhang Zuolin, and cousin of Zhang Xueliang. He studied at the Fengtian Military Academy and the Imperial Japanese Army Academy. He initially served in the Fengtian clique army, later defected to Shi Yousan, and after the defeat in the Central Plains War, he defected to the Japanese army after the Mukden Incident. He was appointed Commander-in-Chief of the Northeast Self-Defense Army and was eventually killed on Zhang Xueliang's orders due to his collaboration with the Japanese, which was seen as a national betrayal.

description.en: The eldest daughter of Zhang Xueliang and Yu Fengzhi.

description.en: A military academy from the Republic of China era on the mainland, located in Fengtian (modern-day Shenyang), where Zhang Xuecheng and Zhang Xueliang were classmates in 1919.

description.zh-cn: 奉系将领，张学良的恩师与挚友。因遭杨宇霆排挤等原因起兵反奉，兵败后被处死。
description.en: A general of the Fengtian clique and a mentor to Zhang Xueliang. He rebelled against the Fengtian clique due to being sidelined by Yang Yuting and other reasons, and was executed after his defeat.

description.zh-cn: 北洋军阀执政时期奉系军阀重要将领，有“智囊”、“小诸葛”之称，后被张学良处决。
description.en: An important general of the Fengtian clique during the Beiyang government era, known as the 'mastermind' and 'little Zhuge', later executed by Zhang Xueliang.

description.zh-cn: 奉系军阀高级官员，中华民国政治人物，曾任黑龙江省政府主席，后与杨宇霆一同被张学良处决。
description.en: A high-ranking official of the Fengtian clique and a political figure of the Republic of China. He served as the chairman of the Heilongjiang provincial government and was later executed along with Yang Yuting by Zhang Xueliang.

description.zh-cn: 1928年6月4日，日本关东军在沈阳皇姑屯策划并实施了一起针对奉系军阀首领张作霖的暗杀爆炸事件，导致其死亡。此事件是九一八事变的重要背景。
description.en: On June 4, 1928, the Japanese Kwantung Army orchestrated and carried out an assassination bombing in Huanggutun, Shenyang, targeting Fengtian clique warlord leader Zhang Zuolin, which resulted in his death. This incident was a significant precursor to the Mukden Incident.

description.zh-cn: 该部队作为大日本帝国陆军的组成部分，于1919年至1945年驻扎在中国东北地区。期间，它策划并执行了皇姑屯事件、九一八事变，扶植满洲国，最终在苏联发动的“八月风暴”攻势下投降。
description.en: A general army of the Imperial Japanese Army from 1919 to 1945, stationed in the northeastern region of China. It planned the Huanggutun Incident and the Mukden Incident, established the puppet state of Manchukuo, and ultimately surrendered following the Soviet 'August Storm' offensive.

description.zh-cn: 指张学良宣布东北地区服从国民政府，并将北洋政府的五色旗更换为国民政府的青天白日满地红旗的事件。此举标志着北伐战争的结束、北洋政府的终结和中国在名义上的统一，但同时也引起了日本的不满。
description.en: Refers to Zhang Xueliang's announcement of the Northeast's allegiance to the Nationalist Government, replacing the Beiyang government's Five-Colored Flag with the Nationalist Government's Blue Sky, White Sun, and Wholly Red Earth flag. This marked the end of the Beiyang government and the nominal unification of China under the Nationalist Government, but also caused dissatisfaction in Japan.

description.zh-cn: 1931年9月18日，日本关东军在中国东北蓄意制造并发动侵华战争，进攻沈阳并侵占中国东北，最终导致东北全境被日军占领。此事件是日本帝国主义侵华的开端，被视为十四年抗战的开始。中原大战后东北军入关，关外防务空虚，是此次军事入侵事件发生的间接原因之一。
description.en: On September 18, 1931, the Japanese Kwantung Army deliberately created and launched an invasion in Northeast China, attacking Shenyang and occupying the region, which ultimately led to the occupation of the entire Northeast by Japanese forces. This incident marked the beginning of Japanese imperialist aggression in China and is considered the start of the Fourteen-Year War of Resistance Against Japan. The Northeast Army's entry into the region south of the Great Wall after the Central Plains War left Manchuria defensively vulnerable, serving as an indirect cause of this military invasion.

description.zh-cn: 北洋军阀的主要派系之一，由张作霖领导，根据地在东北，并受日本支持。

description.en: A Taiwanese politician and former President of the Republic of China, serving as the eighth and ninth President. In 1991, he announced the end of the Temporary Provisions Effective During the Period of Communist Rebellion. He had a relationship of both cooperation and struggle with Hau Pei-tsun in politics. In his youth, he was recruited into the New Democratic Comrades Association and was sworn into the Chinese Communist Party by Xu Maode.

description.en: A political figure in the late Qing dynasty, half-brother of the Guangxu Emperor, and father of the Xuantong Emperor (Puyi). During the Xuantong era, he served as the Prince-Regent, a position established in the late Qing dynasty to assist the young Xuantong Emperor. He was also one of the last de facto rulers of the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 这是中国抗日战争时期由汪精卫在日本扶植下成立的亲日傀儡政权，首都设于南京。它被普遍认为是与大日本帝国合作的伪政府，曾力邀梅兰芳演出但遭拒绝。
description.en: Established by Wang Jingwei and fostered by Japan during the Second Sino-Japanese War, this pro-Japanese puppet government had its capital in Nanjing. It was widely regarded as a collaborationist regime that cooperated with the Empire of Japan, and famously invited Mei Lanfang to perform, which he refused.

description.zh-cn: 指1868年至1947年间的日本，推行帝国主义扩张政策。作为二战轴心国，它侵略中国，是中日战争主要参战方，关东军曾部署东北，并扶植汪精卫国民政府等傀儡政权，也是满洲国宗主国。其军队侵占香港，开启日占时期，并占领新加坡，对罗豪才童年造成创伤。它还赢得了日俄战争，对毛福梅死亡负直接责任。为防日本帝国主义复兴，《中苏友好同盟互助条约》曾明确以此为目标。
description.en: Refers to Japan from 1868 to 1947, which pursued an imperialist expansionist policy. As an Axis power in WWII, it invaded China, was a major combatant in the Sino-Japanese War, deployed the Kwantung Army in Northeast China, and established puppet regimes like the Wang Jingwei government, also acting as the suzerain of Manchukuo. Its military invaded Hong Kong, initiating the period of Japanese occupation, and occupied Singapore, causing trauma to Luo Haocai's childhood. It also won the Russo-Japanese War and was directly responsible for Mao Fumei's death. To prevent the resurgence of Japanese imperialism, the Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship, Alliance and Mutual Assistance explicitly aimed at this goal.

It is the initiator and leader of the 'Belt and Road' initiative and a signatory to the Sino-Japanese Joint Communiqué. As the ruling authority of China, it has defined Falun Gong as a threat and carried out a comprehensive suppression against it since 1999.

description.zh-cn: 日本第124代天皇。他是大日本帝国在二战期间的国家元首与军队最高统帅，并在战争末期做出接受《波茨坦宣言》、结束战争的最终决定，通过“玉音放送”向全国宣布投降。他也是田中角荣担任首相时的在位天皇。
description.en: The 124th Emperor of Japan. He reigned as the head of state and supreme commander of the military of the Empire of Japan during World War II, making the final decision to accept the Potsdam Declaration and end the war, and announcing the surrender to the nation via the Gyokuon-hōsō. He also reigned during Kakuei Tanaka's tenure as Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 此事件标志着中国全面抗日战争的开始。事变后，许涤新得以获释，同时上海的事态日益紧张。
description.en: This event marked the beginning of the Second Sino-Japanese War. After the incident, Xu Dixin was released, and tensions in Shanghai escalated.

description.zh-cn: 九一八事变后，1932年由大日本帝国关东军在中国东北地区扶植建立的傀儡政权。
description.en: A puppet state established by the Kwantung Army of the Empire of Japan in Northeast China in 1932, following the Mukden Incident.

description.zh-cn: 爱新觉罗·溥仪，清朝末代皇帝，也是中国历史上最后一位皇帝。由慈禧太后临终前指定继位，1924年被冯玉祥逐出紫禁城。后被关东军扶植为满洲国执政与皇帝，成为满洲国唯一一位君主。
description.en: Aisin-Gioro Puyi, the last emperor of the Qing dynasty and the last emperor of China. He was designated by Empress Dowager Cixi on her deathbed, expelled from the Forbidden City by Feng Yuxiang in 1924, and later installed by the Kwantung Army as the emperor of Manchukuo, becoming its sole monarch.

description.zh-cn: 一场1939年至1945年爆发的全球性军事冲突，主要由轴心国与同盟国之间进行。美国在罗斯福领导下加入同盟国，艾森豪威尔担任盟军在欧洲的最高指挥官。伯克利实验室和麻省理工学院在军事科研中发挥重要作用，其中伯克利实验室承包了原子弹研发计划，麻省理工的军事科研活动愈发频密。加拿大对德宣战并参战。在此期间，拉脱维亚先后被苏联和纳粹德国占领。日本的投降标志着其亚洲战场的结束。战后，香港岛人口剧增，发展加速。
description.en: A global military conflict that broke out between 1939 and 1945, primarily involving the Axis and Allied powers. The United States, under Roosevelt's leadership, joined the Allied powers, and Eisenhower served as the Supreme Commander of the Allied forces in Europe. Berkeley Lab and MIT played significant roles in military scientific research; Berkeley Lab undertook the atomic bomb development project, while MIT's military research activities became increasingly frequent. Canada declared war on Germany and participated. During this period, Latvia was successively occupied by the Soviet Union and Nazi Germany. Japan's surrender marked the end of its Asian theatre. Post-war, the population of Hong Kong Island surged, and its development accelerated.

description.zh-cn: 中国抗日战争中首场大型会战，也是规模最大、战斗最激烈的战役之一，发生于上海。虹桥机场事件是其导火线之一。战后上海沦陷。
description.en: The first major battle of the Second Sino-Japanese War, and one of its largest and most intense, which took place in Shanghai. It was triggered in part by the Hongqiao Airport Incident. After the battle, Shanghai fell to Japanese forces.

description.zh-cn: 侵华日军于1937年12月13日攻占中国南京后制造的大规模屠杀、强奸以及纵火、抢劫等战争罪行与反人类罪行。张纯如的著作使其在西方世界广为人知。
description.en: A mass murder and war rape committed by Japanese troops against the residents of Nanjing, then the capital of China, during the Second Sino-Japanese War. Iris Chang's book brought widespread awareness of it to the Western world.

description.zh-cn: 日本中国派遣军总司令官，代表日本在中国战区投降。
标志着第二次世界大战和中国抗日战争的结束。此次事件直接导致了汪精卫国民政府的终结，并使梅兰芳得以重返舞台。
description.en: The event marking the end of World War II and the Second Sino-Japanese War. It directly led to the collapse of the Wang Jingwei regime and enabled Mei Lanfang to return to the stage.

zh-cn: 广岛与长崎原子弹爆炸
en: Atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki

description.zh-cn: 美国对日本广岛和长崎投下原子弹，加速了日本的投降。
苏联对日宣战并进攻中国东北的军事行动。
徐州会战中的重要战役，是抗战初期中国军队取得的一次重大胜利。
中华民国军事将领，国民革命军陆军二级上将。在枣宜会战中阵亡，是二战中同盟国牺牲的最高级别将领之一。
武汉会战后，日军为控制长江交通线、打击国军战力而发动的战役。

zh-cn: 第二次世界大战中国战区受降仪式
en: Surrender ceremony of the Second Sino-Japanese War

description.zh-cn: 中国战区接受日本投降的正式仪式。
中国国民党部分中央执行委员、中央监察委员和候补中央执行委员在北京西山碧云寺召开的会议，旨在反对容共政策。
中国国民党内主张清党、反共的政治派别，是四一二事件的发动方。
description.en: The political faction within the Kuomintang that advocated for purging communists and opposed communism, which initiated the April 12th Incident.

description.zh-cn: 苏联及共产国际派驻中国的顾问，时任国民党中央执行委员会最高顾问。被国民党右派视为赤化中国的阴谋策划者，在四一二事件后被驱逐。
description.en: An advisor sent by the Soviet Union and the Comintern to China, who was serving as the supreme advisor to the Kuomintang Central Executive Committee. He was seen by the KMT right-wing as a conspirator for the communization of China and was expelled after the April 12th Incident.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代政治家、教育家、书法家。曾任国民党中央监察委员，提出发动“护党救国”运动，并强烈谴责汪精卫的容共态度。
description.en: A modern Chinese politician, educator, and calligrapher. He was also a member of the KMT Central Supervisory Committee, proposing the "Protect the Party, Save the Nation" movement and strongly condemning Wang Jingwei's accommodating stance towards communists.

description.zh-cn: 黄埔军校内由反共派组成的组织。

zh-cn: 谷歌退出中国大陆事件

description.zh-cn: 指2010年Google公司因网络攻击（黑客攻击）和内容审查问题与中国政府出现分歧，最终决定关闭中国大陆的网页搜索服务（google.cn），并将其转至香港的google.com.hk的事件。
description.en: Refers to the event where Google redirected its search services for mainland China from Beijing to Hong Kong due to censorship and hacking concerns.

location.zh-cn: 美国加利福尼亚州山景城

description.zh-cn: 总部位于美国加利福尼亚州山景城的跨国科技公司，为Alphabet的子公司，专注于互联网相关服务和产品，业务范围涵盖互联网广告、互联网搜索、云计算等领域。
description.en: An American multinational technology company, a subsidiary of Alphabet Inc., specializing in Internet-related services and products, which include online advertising technologies, a search engine, cloud computing, software, and hardware.

description.zh-cn: Google公司在中华人民共和国的运营实体，曾运营google.cn。其搜索服务于2010年停止运营并转至香港。
description.en: The operating entity of Google in the People's Republic of China. Its search services ceased operations and were redirected to Hong Kong in 2010.

description.zh-cn: Google公司在香港的运营实体，自2010年谷歌退出中国大陆后，承接其简体中文搜索业务，并为中国大陆用户提供未经审查的搜索服务。
description.en: The operating entity of Google in Hong Kong, which has provided uncensored search services to mainland China users since 2010.

description.zh-cn: 一次针对Google及其他二十余家美国公司的网络攻击，是谷歌退出中国事件的直接导火索之一。
曾任Google首席执行官及执行董事长。作为Google首席执行官时，他对退出中国市场持不赞同态度。
description.en: Former CEO and Executive Chairman of Google. As Google CEO, he disapproved of the company's withdrawal from the Chinese market.

description.zh-cn: Google联合创始人，曾在斯坦福大学攻读博士学位。他坚决反对内容审查，支持退出中国市场。
description.en: Co-founder of Google, who was a Ph.D. student at Stanford University. He firmly opposed content censorship and supported withdrawing from the Chinese market.

description.zh-cn: 一家总部位于北京的中国跨国科技公司，专注于互联网相关服务、产品及人工智能。作为中国主要的搜索引擎公司和科技巨头，它曾是Google在中国的主要竞争对手。其搜索引擎曾将特定词语（如“温云松”）设为敏感词并限制搜索结果。此外，该公司还与奇虎360在不正当竞争、商标侵权、违反Robots协议等领域发生过多次法律诉讼。
description.en: A Chinese multinational technology company headquartered in Beijing, specializing in Internet-related services and products, and artificial intelligence. As a major search engine and technology giant in China, it was once Google's main competitor. Its search engine once designated specific terms (such as 'Wen Yunsong') as sensitive and restricted search results. Additionally, the company has been involved in multiple legal disputes with Qihoo 360 regarding unfair competition, trademark infringement, and violation of the Robots Exclusion Standard.

en: Federal government of the United States
Government of the United States of America

description.zh-cn: 美国的国家政府，由美国宪法建立，负责管辖美国。
description.en: The national government of the United States, established by the U.S. Constitution, which governs the country.

description.zh-cn: 时任美国国务卿，就谷歌事件要求中国政府作出解释。
Google为重返中国市场而秘密研发的自我审查版搜寻App项目。
中国政府指控谷歌中国传播淫秽色情信息并对其进行处罚的事件。
雅虎公司是美国的一家互联网服务公司，曾是Google的竞争对手，也与其有过合作关系。其在中国的业务分支，曾于2004年由周鸿祎担任总裁。
description.en: Yahoo! Inc. is an American internet service company, a former competitor and partner of Google. Its Chinese business arm was led by Zhou Hongyi as president in 2004.

description.zh-cn: 中国跨国科技公司，同时也是一家大型电子商务公司。该公司是无界传媒的投资方之一，并在事件后提出将无界传媒清盘。此外，它于2013年入股新浪微博，并与新浪有战略合作关系。
description.en: A Chinese multinational technology company and a major e-commerce company. It was one of the investors in Wujie Media and proposed to liquidate the company after the incident. In addition, it invested in Sina Weibo in 2013 and has a strategic partnership with Sina.

description.zh-cn: 美国的跨国科技公司，曾与朱邦复合作开发中文视窗系统，后合作关系破裂。
description.en: An American multinational technology company that once collaborated with Chu Bong-Foo on developing a Chinese Windows system, but the partnership later fell apart.

zh-cn: 中央苏区第四次反围剿战争
en: Fourth encirclement campaign against the Jiangxi Soviet

description.zh-cn: 国共内战期间在江西省中南部发生的一次战役。

location.zh-cn: 中国大陆、台湾海峡、中缅边境
location.en: Mainland China, Taiwan Strait, China–Burma border

description.zh-cn: 20世纪中国爆发的规模最大、影响最深远的内战，分为两个阶段，是中国现代史的重大转折点。
description.en: The largest and most influential civil war in 20th century China, divided into two stages, marking a major turning point in modern Chinese history.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军红三师师长，在南丰战斗中阵亡。
国民革命军第59师师长，被俘。

zh-cn: 中央苏区第五次反围剿战争
en: Fifth encirclement campaign against the Jiangxi Soviet

description.zh-cn: 国民政府对中共中央苏区发动的第五次军事围剿，其失利是红军开始长征的直接原因。
description.en: The fifth encirclement campaign launched by the Nationalist Government against the Central Soviet Area of the CCP, the failure of which was the direct cause for the start of the Long March.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国与大日本帝国签订的停战协定。
美国政治人物，第50任美国副总统。
description.en: American politician, Vice President of the United States.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治人物、律师。
美国法学家、律师。
美国国会的两院之一。

en: Supreme Court of the United States

description.zh-cn: 美国联邦司法机构的最高级别法院。
美国两大主要政党之一，通常被认为是保守派政党。
description.en: One of the two major political parties in the United States, generally considered the conservative party.

description.zh-cn: 美国两大主要政党之一，罗斯福和约翰·F·肯尼迪都曾是其党员。
description.en: One of the two major contemporary political parties in the United States, to which both Roosevelt and John F. Kennedy belonged.

description.zh-cn: 由英国统治的全球帝国，在1921年达到巅峰。它在鸦片战争中作为主要西方列强，与清朝进行了两次战争，其中是发动第二次鸦片战争的主要国家之一。此外，它也是新加坡在1824年至1963年间的宗主国。作为第二次世界大战的同盟国之一，汪精卫国民政府于1943年对其宣战。
description.en: A global empire ruled by the United Kingdom, which reached its peak in 1921. It was the main Western power in the Opium Wars, fighting against the Qing dynasty in both conflicts, and was one of the main countries that initiated the Second Opium War. It also served as the sovereign state of Singapore from 1824 to 1963. As one of the Allied powers in World War II, the Wang Jingwei regime declared war against it in 1943.

description.zh-cn: 北美十三殖民地反抗英国统治、争取民族独立的革命战争。法国介入此战争增加了巨大的财政压力，成为大革命的诱因之一。
第二次世界大战后，以美国为首的西方阵营与以苏联为首的东方阵营（及其各自盟友）之间，围绕地缘政治展开的紧张对峙和政治对抗。美国总统艾森豪威尔的任期是冷战的关键时期。
description.en: A period of geopolitical tension and political confrontation after World War II, primarily between the Western Bloc, led by the United States, and the Eastern Bloc, led by the Soviet Union and their respective allies. Eisenhower's presidency was a key period of the Cold War.

description.zh-cn: 2001年9月11日发生在美国本土的一系列自杀式恐怖袭击事件，由基地组织策划。
description.en: A series of four coordinated suicide terrorist attacks by the Islamic terrorist group al-Qaeda against the United States on September 11, 2001.

description.zh-cn: 位于美国纽约曼哈顿下城的建筑群，在九一一袭击事件中倒塌。
美国第16任总统，在美国内战期间领导联邦取得胜利，并颁布《解放黑人奴隶宣言》。
description.en: The 16th President of the United States, who led the Union to victory in the American Civil War and issued the Emancipation Proclamation.

description.zh-cn: 由美国南部11个蓄奴州为维护奴隶制度而脱离联邦后建立的国家。
description.en: A nation established by 11 southern slave states that seceded from the Union to preserve the institution of slavery.

description.zh-cn: 美国于1861年至1865年发生的内战，是美国历史上规模最大、最惨烈的内战。交战双方为北方的联邦阵营与南方的邦联阵营，最终以联邦获胜、奴隶制度被废除告终。
description.en: The American Civil War, fought from 1861 to 1865, was the largest and most devastating civil war in U.S. history. It pitted the northern Union against the southern Confederacy, ultimately resulting in a Union victory and the abolition of slavery.

description.zh-cn: 美国牧师、社会运动家、民权运动领袖。
一场旨在为非裔美国人争取平等权利、结束美国种族隔离和歧视的社会运动。肯尼迪总统在其任内对该运动表示支持，并采取了若干干预措施。
description.en: A social movement aimed at securing equal rights for African Americans and ending racial segregation and discrimination in the United States. President Kennedy supported the movement and intervened with several measures during his presidency.

description.zh-cn: 苏联政治家，苏联首任名义上的国家元首。
俄罗斯共产主义革命家、政治家、政治理论家和思想家，苏维埃俄国和苏联的主要缔造者和首任政府首脑，也是共产国际的创始人。其思想影响了中国共产党早期的民族政策。娜杰日达·阿利卢耶娃曾担任其办公室机要秘书。
description.en: Russian communist revolutionary, politician, political theorist, and thinker. He was the main founder and first head of government of Soviet Russia and the Soviet Union, and the founder of the Communist International. His thought influenced the early ethnic policy of the Chinese Communist Party, and Nadezhda Alliluyeva served as a confidential secretary in his office.

description.zh-cn: 苏联末任政府首脑。

zh-cn: 俄罗斯苏维埃联邦社会主义共和国

description.zh-cn: 苏联的创始成员国和最大加盟共和国。

zh-cn: 白俄罗斯苏维埃社会主义共和国

description.zh-cn: 苏联的创始成员国。

zh-cn: 乌克兰苏维埃社会主义共和国

description.zh-cn: 苏联的创始成员国。

zh-cn: 外高加索社会主义联邦苏维埃共和国
外高加索苏维埃社会主义联邦共和国

description.zh-cn: 苏联的创始成员国。

en: Treaty on the Creation of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics
Declaration of the Creation of the USSR

description.zh-cn: 苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟解体，指苏联于20世纪90年代初停止存在并分裂为多个主权国家的过程。此后列宁主义在一些国家影响力下降，也为瓦哈比派分子进入俄罗斯车臣地区扩张势力提供了契机。
description.en: The dissolution of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics refers to the process in the early 1990s when the Soviet Union ceased to exist and split into multiple sovereign states. Subsequently, the influence of Leninism declined in some countries, and it also provided an opportunity for Wahhabi elements to expand their influence into the Chechnya region of Russia.

description.zh-cn: 1933年至1945年，由阿道夫·希特勒和纳粹党统治的德国，是第二次世界大战的欧洲轴心国，法西斯意大利的主要盟友，也是加拿大的敌对国。该政权在战争初期曾与中国有军事合作，但于1941年承认汪精卫国民政府。在第二次世界大战期间，它占领了比利时和拉脱维亚。
description.en: Germany between 1933 and 1945, governed by Adolf Hitler and the Nazi Party. As a European Axis power in World War II, it was the primary ally of Fascist Italy and also an adversary of Canada. The regime had military cooperation with China in the early stage of the war but recognized the Wang Jingwei regime in 1941. During World War II, it occupied Belgium and Latvia.

description.zh-cn: 苏联政治家，勃列日涅夫之后的苏联最高领导人。
苏联政治家，安德罗波夫之后的苏联最高领导人。
苏共党内保守派为防止戈尔巴乔夫下放权力导致国家解体而发动的未遂政变。

en: State Committee on the State of Emergency

description.zh-cn: 由苏共党内保守派组成，为发动八一九事件而成立。
由俄罗斯、白俄罗斯、乌克兰三国领导人签署，宣布苏联停止存在并成立独立国家联合体的协议。

zh-cn: 斯坦尼斯拉夫·舒什克维奇

description.zh-cn: 白俄罗斯政治家，签署《别洛韦日协议》者之一。
乌克兰政治人物。曾于1990年至1991年出任末任乌克兰最高苏维埃主席，1991年至1994年担任首任乌克兰总统，也是《别洛韦日协议》签署者之一。
description.en: Ukrainian politician. He served as the last Chairman of the Supreme Soviet of Ukraine from 1990 to 1991 and as the first President of Ukraine from 1991 to 1994, and was one of the signatories of the Belovezha Accords.

description.zh-cn: 联合国大会于1971年通过的决议，关于“恢复中华人民共和国在联合国组织中的合法权利问题”，承认中华人民共和国政府是中国的唯一合法代表。此事件也是中日建交的背景之一。
description.en: A resolution passed by the United Nations General Assembly in 1971, concerning the 'Restoration of the People's Republic of China's lawful rights in the United Nations Organization', which recognized the Government of the People's Republic of China as the sole legitimate representative of China. This event also served as part of the background for the establishment of Sino-Japanese diplomatic relations.

en: University of Science and Technology Beijing

nodes.id: BAIDU:中央西藏工作协调小组

zh-cn: 中央西藏工作协调小组

description.zh-cn: 邓小平的父亲。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping's father.

description.zh-cn: 英国政治家，曾任英国首相。她曾与邓小平就香港前途问题进行谈判；马尔康·芮夫金曾在其内阁中担任苏格兰事务大臣。
description.en: British stateswoman who served as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom. She negotiated with Deng Xiaoping on the future of Hong Kong; Malcolm Rifkind served as Secretary of State for Scotland in her cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 英国商人尼尔·海伍德于2011年11月13日在重庆南山丽景度假酒店被杀害。尸体于11月14日被发现。后经调查，此为他杀刑事案件，嫌疑人为薄谷开来及薄熙来家庭佣工张晓军（男性）。张晓军系薄家勤务人员，且是谷开来谋杀尼尔·海伍德的同案犯。此案随后进行了对谷开来、张晓军故意杀害尼尔·伍德的司法审判。
description.en: An orderly of the Bo family and an accomplice in Gu Kailai's murder of Neil Heywood.

zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国

description.zh-cn: 位于东亚朝鲜半岛北部的社会主义国家，由朝鲜劳动党实行一党专政。该国是朝鲜战争的主要参战方，其军队是《朝鲜停战协定》的签署方之一。1953年，该国授予曾泽生一级国旗勋章。近期，该国被指控向俄罗斯提供武器及派遣士兵参与战争。
description.en: A socialist state located in the northern part of the Korean Peninsula in East Asia, where the Workers' Party of Korea exercises one-party rule. It was a main belligerent in the Korean War, and its army was one of the signatories of the Korean Armistice Agreement. In 1953, it awarded Zeng Zesheng the First Class Order of the National Flag. Recently, it has been accused of supplying weapons and sending soldiers to participate in the war on Russia's side.

description.zh-cn: 位于东亚朝鲜半岛南部的共和制国家。朝鲜战争的主要参战方之一。由于时任总统李承晚的反对，大韩民国并未签署《朝鲜停战协定》。
description.en: A main belligerent in the Korean War. Due to the opposition of then-President Syngman Rhee, the Republic of Korea did not sign the Korean Armistice Agreement.

description.zh-cn: 根据联合国安理会决议成立，由美国领导的多国部队，在朝鲜战争中支援大韩民国并与中国人民志愿军作战。该司令部是《朝鲜停战协定》的签署方之一。
description.en: A multinational military force established under a UN Security Council resolution and led by the United States to support South Korea and fight against the Chinese People's Volunteer Army during the Korean War. The command is a signatory to the Korean Armistice Agreement.

description.zh-cn: 韩国独立运动家、政治家，大韩民国首任总统、首任国会议长。他曾因反对以三八线为界停战而拒绝在《朝鲜停战协定》上签字。
description.en: A Korean independence activist and politician, the first President of the Republic of Korea and the first Speaker of the National Assembly. He refused to sign the Korean Armistice Agreement due to his opposition to a ceasefire along the 38th parallel.

description.zh-cn: 美国第33任总统。曾任罗斯福的最后一任副总统，在其逝世后接任总统。他批准对日本使用原子弹并接受其投降。朝鲜战争爆发后，他下令第七舰队进入台湾海峡，实行台湾海峡中立化政策。
description.en: 33rd President of the United States. He served as Roosevelt's final Vice President and succeeded him as President upon Roosevelt's death. He authorized the use of atomic bombs against Japan and accepted its surrender. After the outbreak of the Korean War, he ordered the Seventh Fleet into the Taiwan Strait to implement the Taiwan Strait Neutralization policy.

description.zh-cn: 美国陆军五星上将，军事家、政治家，曾任第34任美国总统。第二次世界大战期间，他担任盟军在欧洲的最高指挥官。
description.en: An American military officer and statesman who served as the 34th president of the United States. He was a five-star general in the United States Army and served as Supreme Commander of the Allied Expeditionary Force in Europe during World War II.

description.zh-cn: 接替沃尔顿·沃克任美国第八集团军司令，后接替道格拉斯·麦克阿瑟任联合国军总司令。
朝鲜民主主义人民共和国的武装力量，是朝鲜战争的主要参战方和《朝鲜停战协定》的签署方之一。
description.en: The armed forces of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, a main belligerent in the Korean War and a signatory to the Korean Armistice Agreement.

description.zh-cn: 大韩民国的武装力量，是朝鲜战争的主要参战方，但未在《朝鲜停战协定》上签字。在2024年戒严期间，其部分单位被动员部署至国会及其他关键地点。
description.en: The armed forces of the Republic of Korea, a main belligerent in the Korean War, but not a signatory to the Korean Armistice Agreement. During the 2024 martial law, some of its units were mobilized and deployed to the National Assembly and other key locations.

zh-cn: 朝鲜人民军最高司令官及中国人民志愿军司令员一方与联合国军总司令另一方关于朝鲜军事停战的协定
en: Agreement Between the Commander-in-Chief, United Nations Command, on the One Hand, and the Supreme Commander of the Korean People’s Army and the Commander of the Chinese People’s Volunteers, on the Other Hand, Concerning a Military Armistice in Korea

description.zh-cn: 一份旨在停止朝鲜战争交战双方敌对军事行为的军事文件，于1953年7月27日在板门店签署。该协定建立了朝韩非军事区，并至今仍是维持朝鲜半岛停火状态的唯一法律依据。
description.en: A military document signed on July 27, 1953, in Panmunjom, aimed at ceasing hostile military actions between the belligerents of the Korean War. The agreement established the Korean Demilitarized Zone and remains the sole legal basis for maintaining the ceasefire on the Korean Peninsula.

description.zh-cn: 位于朝韩非军事区内的共同警备区，是《朝鲜停战协定》的签署地点。
description.en: The Joint Security Area within the Korean Demilitarized Zone, and the location where the Korean Armistice Agreement was signed.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜战争前朝鲜半岛南北方事实上的分界线。
美国海军旗下的远洋舰队之一，隶属于美国太平洋舰队。司令部设在日本横须贺港，是目前美国最大的海外前线投送部队，曾在朝鲜战争、越南战争和台湾海峡危机中扮演关键角色。
description.en: One of the forward-deployed naval forces of the United States Navy, subordinate to the United States Pacific Fleet. Headquartered at Yokosuka, Japan, it is the largest of the U.S. Navy's forward-deployed fleets and has played a key role in the Korean War, Vietnam War, and Taiwan Strait crises.

description.zh-cn: 美国国会通过的法案，以回应中国实施《香港国安法》。
第二次世界大战的战区之一，以日本为首的轴心国和以美国为首的同盟国之间在太平洋及其周边地区进行的战争。其地理范围包括东亚、东南亚、太平洋、印度洋和大洋洲，是二战地理上规模最大的战场。第七舰队在此期间成立。
description.en: One of the theaters of World War II, fought in the Pacific and its surrounding areas between the Japan-led Axis powers and the US-led Allied powers. Its geographical scope included East Asia, Southeast Asia, the Pacific Ocean, the Indian Ocean, and Oceania, making it the largest theater of war geographically in WWII. The Seventh Fleet was established during this period.

description.en: Refers to the political assassination of Taiwanese writer Henry Liu in the United States. The case implicated Taiwan's intelligence agencies and severely damaged the reputation of the Chiang family.

description.zh-cn: 美籍华裔作家，笔名“江南”，因撰写《蒋经国传》而在美国遭台湾情报人员买凶杀害。
description.en: A Chinese-American writer, pen name 'Chiang Nan', who was assassinated in the U.S. by killers hired by Taiwanese intelligence personnel for writing a biography of Chiang Ching-kuo.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国海军二级上将，曾任国防部情报局局长，因江南案下台并被捕入狱。
description.en: An admiral in the Republic of China Navy, former director of the Military Intelligence Bureau, who was arrested and imprisoned, and subsequently stepped down due to the Henry Liu case.

中国共产党的领导制度。
新民主主义革命是中国共产党领导的资产阶级民主革命。毛泽东认为其在半殖民地半封建国家分为新民主主义和社会主义两个阶段，并将五四运动定性为开端。井冈山革命根据地的建立，开辟了“农村包围城市，武装夺取政权”的道路。
description.en: The New Democratic Revolution was a bourgeois-democratic revolution led by the Communist Party of China. Mao Zedong's theory posited that in semi-colonial, semi-feudal countries, it was divided into New Democratic and Socialist stages, characterizing the May Fourth Movement as its beginning. The establishment of the Jinggangshan Revolutionary Base opened the path of 'encircling the cities from the countryside and seizing power by armed force'.

His birth date is disputed: the Chinese government claims he was born on July 7, 1952, while Li Hongzhi himself states his actual birthday is May 13, 1951, due to a registration error during the Cultural Revolution. He began publicly teaching Falun Gong in China in 1992, and after suppression by the Chinese government in 1999, he now resides in the United States.

description.en: The event where U.S. Navy Commodore Matthew C. Perry compelled Japan to open its ports, widely considered one of the starting points of the Meiji Restoration.

description.zh-cn: 指日本在19世纪后期、幕末至明治时代初期间推行的一系列政治、经济和社会近代化改革运动。旨在使日本现代化，摆脱并终结封建制度，建立现代国家。福泽谕吉是该运动重要的思想推动者之一。维新后武士的失业问题亦成为征韩论的背景之一。
description.en: A series of political, economic, and social modernization reforms implemented in Japan in the late 19th century, from the end of the Edo period to the beginning of the Meiji period. These reforms aimed at modernizing the country, abolishing its feudal system, and establishing a modern state. Fukuzawa Yukichi was a key intellectual promoter of this movement, and the resulting unemployment of the samurai class was one of the background factors for the Seikanron.

location.zh-cn: 朝鲜半岛、辽东半岛、山东、威海、黄海、澎湖

description.zh-cn: 1894年至1895年间清朝与大日本帝国之间因朝鲜问题爆发的一场大规模战争，以清朝惨败告终。中国的惨败极大地刺激了中国的知识分子，促使他们更积极、全面地向西方学习。福泽谕吉曾将其描述为“文野之战”并支持日本开战。战争赔款被用作建立京都帝国大学（京都大学前身）的资金来源之一。
description.en: A major war between the Qing dynasty of China and the Empire of Japan, primarily over the issue of Korea, which ended in a decisive defeat for the Qing. China's defeat was a major catalyst for Chinese intellectuals to more actively and comprehensively learn from the West. Fukuzawa Yukichi described it as a 'war between civilization and barbarism' and supported Japan's engagement in it. The war indemnity was used as one of the funding sources for the establishment of Kyoto Imperial University (the predecessor of Kyoto University).

The invasion is one of the largest-scale wars on the European continent since World War II. Wei Jingsheng expressed his views on it, agreeing with some of Russia's justifications.

description.en: A historical state that existed from 1721 to 1917. During his exile in Xinjiang, Lin Zexu became wary of its growing threat and considered it a long-term danger to China. During the Second Opium War, it acted as a mediator and took the opportunity to force the Qing government to sign unequal treaties, thereby acquiring Outer Manchuria and other large territories in northern China through the Convention of Peking. It was also one of the combatants in the Russo-Japanese War, but was ultimately defeated.

description.en: A Japanese statesman who proposed using the indemnity from the First Sino-Japanese War to upgrade the Third Higher School to an Imperial University, leading to the establishment of Kyoto University.

description.zh-cn: 1933年发生在京都大学的一起有关学术思想自由的事件。因法学部教授泷川幸辰的学说受到政府压制而引发，导致多名教授辞职，并引发社会对大学自治和思想自由的深刻反思。
description.en: An incident concerning academic freedom of thought that occurred at Kyoto University in 1933. It was triggered by government suppression of the theories of Faculty of Law professor Yukitoki Takikawa, leading to the resignation of several professors and prompting profound societal reflection on university autonomy and freedom of thought.

description.zh-cn: 日本刑法学家，京都大学法学部教授。因其刑法学说被指为“共产主义”，遭到政府弹压，引发了著名的“泷川事件”。战后曾任京都大学校长。
description.en: A Japanese criminal law scholar and professor at the Faculty of Law, Kyoto University. His criminal law theories were labeled as 'communist' and suppressed by the government, sparking the famous 'Takigawa incident'. He served as president of Kyoto University after the war.

description.zh-cn: 日本政治家，在泷川事件期间担任文部大臣，向京都大学施压要求罢免泷川幸辰教授。
description.en: A Japanese politician who, as Minister of Education during the Takigawa incident, pressured Kyoto University to dismiss Professor Yukitoki Takikawa.

description.zh-cn: 日本哲学家，京都大学哲学系教授，京都学派的开创者之一。
description.en: A Japanese philosopher, professor of philosophy at Kyoto University, and one of the founders of the Kyoto School.

description.zh-cn: 日本理论物理学家，理学博士，曾任京都大学、大阪大学名誉教授。因提出介子理论，成为首位获得诺贝尔奖的日本人。
description.en: A Japanese theoretical physicist, Doctor of Science, and emeritus professor at Kyoto University and Osaka University. He was the first Japanese Nobel laureate for his prediction of the meson.

description.zh-cn: 日本物理学家，1965年诺贝尔物理学奖得主，与汤川秀树是中学至大学的同期生。
description.en: A Japanese physicist and Nobel laureate in Physics in 1965, who was a contemporary of Hideki Yukawa from middle school to university.

日本化学家，2001年诺贝尔化学奖得主。

description.en: Japanese politician, the 58th-60th Prime Prime Minister of Japan (1960-1964). Kakuei Tanaka served as Minister of Finance in his cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 国家主席的日常办事机构。

description.zh-cn: 指与广东省有任职背景或与习仲勋主政广东有关联的官员群体。亦可指民国时期的军阀派系，主要势力范围在广东地区，受苏联支持。
description.en: Refers to a group of officials with a background in Guangdong or connected to Xi Zhongxun's governance in Guangdong. It can also refer to a warlord clique during the Republican era, with its main sphere of influence in the Guangdong region, supported by the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国最高人民检察院检察长。曾任中共上海市委副书记。
中国人民解放军陆军中将，曾任中国人民解放军国防大学政治委员、中央军事委员会办公厅原主任。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the PLA Ground Force, who served as Political Commissar of the PLA National Defense University and former Director of the General Office of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治家，曾任司法部部长（傅政华的继任），后任江西省政协主席。2024年因严重违纪违法被查处。
description.en: Chinese politician, who served as Minister of Justice (succeeding Fu Zhenghua) and later as Chairman of the Jiangxi Provincial CPPCC. He was investigated in 2024 for severe disciplinary violations.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯的叔父及嗣父。
袁世凯的长子，曾积极推动其父称帝。
description.en: Yuan Shikai's eldest son, who actively encouraged his father to become emperor.

description.zh-cn: 清末淮军将领，袁世凯早期的提携者。
description.en: A Huai Army general in the late Qing dynasty and an early patron of Yuan Shikai.

description.zh-cn: 清末民初政治家，袁世凯的盟友。
晚清重臣、政治家和军事家，满洲正白旗人，慈禧太后的心腹。他是载沣的岳父，也是溥仪的外祖父。
description.en: A prominent minister, statesman, and military leader in the late Qing dynasty, a confidant of Empress Dowager Cixi, and the father-in-law of Zaifeng.

description.zh-cn: 晚清维新派领袖、政治家和思想家，梁启超的老师。他是戊戌变法的主要策划者和领导者之一。变法失败后流亡海外，组织保皇会，主张君主立宪。他还曾试图将儒家改造为国教（孔教）。
description.en: Leader of the late Qing reformists, a politician and thinker, and Liang Qichao's teacher. He was a key planner and leader of the Hundred Days' Reform. After the reform failed, he lived in exile, organized the Baohuang Hui (Protect the Emperor Society), and advocated for a constitutional monarchy. He also attempted to establish Confucianism as the state religion (the Confucian Church).

description.zh-cn: 清末维新派政治家、思想家，戊戌六君子之一。他曾于屠城三十余年后到访南京，记述了当地父老对湘军暴行“犹深愤恨”的情形。
description.en: A reformist politician and thinker of the late Qing Dynasty, and one of the 'Six Gentlemen of the Wuxu Reform'. He recorded local elders' 'deep hatred' for Xiang Army atrocities during a visit to Nanjing over thirty years after the massacre.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治家。曾任军政府鄂军都督、大元帅，以及中华民国临时副总统、第一任副总统；后继任第二、三任大总统。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as the first Vice President and the second and third President of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治家、军事人物，北洋军阀皖系首领。曾是袁世凯手下重要将领。历任参谋总长、国务总理、临时执政等职，并在赵秉钧辞职后代理国务总理。他在北洋政府时期发挥重要作用，因在清帝退位、抵制洪宪帝制和讨伐张勋复辟中的贡献，被誉为“三造共和”。
description.en: A Chinese politician and military figure, leader of the Anhui clique. He was an important general under Yuan Shikai. He served as Chief of the General Staff, Premier, and Provisional Chief Executive, and also as acting Premier after Zhao Bingjun's resignation. He played a significant role during the Beiyang Government period, and is known for his contributions in forcing the Qing emperor's abdication, resisting the Hongxian Monarchy, and suppressing the Manchu Restoration, earning him the moniker 'the three-time creator of the Republic'.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事将领，袁世凯手下重要将领，“北洋三杰”之一，北洋军阀直系首领，曾任中华民国代总统。
description.en: A Chinese general, one of the 'Three Distinguished of Beiyang', leader of the Zhili clique, and acting President of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代政治活动家，筹安会发起人，积极推动袁世凯称帝。
description.en: A Chinese politician active in the late Qing and early Republican periods, founder of the Chou'anhui, who actively promoted Yuan Shikai's monarchical ambitions.

description.zh-cn: 光绪帝的皇后，宣统帝（溥仪）的嗣母。她是清朝最后一位实际掌权者，宣统年间与载沣共同作为最高统治者，拥有重大事件的最终决定权。在宣统帝逊位时垂帘听政，并代表其颁布退位诏书。
description.en: The empress consort of the Guangxu Emperor and adoptive mother of the Xuantong Emperor. She was the last de facto ruler of the Qing dynasty. During the Xuantong era, she served as co-supreme ruler with Zaifeng, holding the final decision-making power on major events. She also issued the abdication edict on behalf of the emperor.

description.zh-cn: 清朝末年由袁世凯在小站编练的现代化新式陆军。该军原名定武军，由袁世凯在小站练兵时对其改编而成，后改称新建陆军，是北洋军的直接前身。
description.en: A modernized army established by Yuan Shikai at Xiaozhan in the late Qing Dynasty. Originally known as the Dingwu Army, it was reorganized by Yuan Shikai during the Xiaozhan training period, and later renamed the Newly Created Army. It served as the direct predecessor of the Beiyang Army.

en: Society for the Study of Self-Strengthening

description.zh-cn: 清末维新派在北京成立的政治团体，旨在推动变法维新。
description.en: A political group founded by reformists in Beijing during the late Qing dynasty to promote political reform and modernization.

description.zh-cn: 由宋教仁主导，将中国同盟会改组并联合其他党派而成的政党，在1913年国会选举中获胜，成为第一大党。
description.en: A political party led by Song Jiaoren, formed by reorganizing the Tongmenghui and uniting with other parties, which won the 1913 parliamentary election.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯发起复辟帝制，建立中华帝国的政治运动。这是一个由袁世凯筹备建立的君主立宪制国家，年号洪宪，旨在取代中华民国。此举引发护国运动，最终被迫取消并以失败告终。
description.en: A political movement initiated by Yuan Shikai to restore the monarchy and establish the Empire of China. This constitutional monarchy, with the era name Hongxian, was intended to replace the Republic of China. The short-lived endeavor triggered the National Protection War, leading to its forced abolition and ultimate failure.

description.zh-cn: 由杨度等人发起，旨在为袁世凯称帝制造舆论和理论支持的政治团体。
description.en: A political group initiated by Yang Du and others, aimed at creating public opinion and theoretical support for Yuan Shikai's enthronement.

description.zh-cn: 清末八国联军侵华（义和团运动）期间，中国东南各省督抚违抗清廷命令，与列强私下达成和平协议，旨在避免与列强开战并维护辖区和平稳定。这是一场重要的政治运动。
description.en: During the late Qing Dynasty's Boxer Rebellion, which involved the Eight-Nation Alliance invasion, governors of southeastern Chinese provinces defied imperial orders to declare war on foreign powers. They instead privately negotiated agreements to avoid conflict and maintain peace and stability within their jurisdictions. This was a significant political movement.

description.zh-cn: 四通利方公司（SRSNet）是一家位于北京中关村的中文软件公司，由四通集团公司、王志东和严援朝于1993年共同创办。1998年，该公司与华渊资讯合并，共同组建新浪（Sina）。新浪是一家服务中国大陆及全球华人社群的中文网络内容服务提供商，与腾讯、搜狐和网易并称中国四大门户网站之一。
description.en: SRSNet (formerly Shidonglifang), a Chinese software company based in Zhongguancun, Beijing, was co-founded in 1993 by Stone Group, Wang Zhidong, and Yan Yuanchao. In 1998, it merged with Sinanet (formerly Huayuan Information) to form Sina. Sina is a Chinese online media company serving China and the global Chinese communities, known as one of the four major portal websites in China, along with Tencent, Sohu, and NetEase.

description.zh-cn: 中共二十大闭幕会上，前中共中央总书记胡锦涛被工作人员从主席台带离会场。此事件被外界广泛解读为团派失势的象征性时刻。
description.en: The incident where former CPC General Secretary Hu Jintao was escorted off the rostrum by staff during the closing session of the 20th CPC National Congress. It was widely interpreted as a symbolic moment of the Tuanpai's loss of power.

description.zh-cn: 明朝是中国历史上继元朝之后的大一统王朝，也是最后一个由汉族统治的帝制王朝。由朱元璋建立，马皇后为其首位皇后。其间改行中书省为承宣布政使司，俗称“行省”。明成祖时期，北京故宫开始建造并作为其后的主要皇宫。
description.en: The Ming Dynasty was a unified imperial dynasty in Chinese history, following the Yuan Dynasty, and the last imperial dynasty ruled by Han Chinese. Founded by Zhu Yuanzhang, with Empress Ma as its first empress, it reformed the Central Secretariat into the Provincial Administration Commission, known as 'Xingsheng'. During the reign of the Yongle Emperor, the Forbidden City in Beijing was built and became the main imperial palace.

description.zh-cn: 由忽必烈建立的中国历史上由蒙古族建立的大一统王朝，追尊蒙哥为宪宗桓肃皇帝。其设立行中书省作为一级地方行政区划，官场上使用空印文书的习惯做法被明朝沿用，并最终引发了空印案。
description.en: A Chinese dynasty founded by Kublai Khan, and established by the Mongols, which posthumously honored Möngke as Emperor Xianzong Huansu. The bureaucratic practice of using empty-sealed documents, inherited from the Yuan, led to the Empty Seal Case in the Ming dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 元末红巾军领袖之一，朱元璋早期的上司，马皇后的养父。
description.en: A leader of the Red Turban Rebellion during the late Yuan dynasty, Zhu Yuanzhang's early superior, and the adoptive father of Empress Ma.

description.zh-cn: 明太祖朱元璋的皇后，郭子兴的养女，朱高煦之祖母。她以贤惠、仁慈、节俭著称，常劝谏朱元璋，挽救大臣性命。同时，她不干预朝政，限制外戚势力，深受后人敬仰。
description.en: The empress consort of the Hongwu Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang, adoptive daughter of Guo Zixing, and grandmother of Zhu Gaoxu. She was renowned for her kindness, wisdom, and frugality, often advising the emperor and saving the lives of officials. She also refrained from interfering in court politics and limiting the power of imperial relatives, earning her deep respect from later generations.

description.zh-cn: 元末明初的群雄之一，汉政权建立者
元末明初的群雄之一，吴政权建立者
明朝开国军事统帅，位列开国“六王”之首，封中山武宁王，曾封魏国公。他率军攻陷元大都，是朱高煦之外祖父。他对胡惟庸极为厌恶，并向朱元璋密报其奸行。
description.en: A founding military marshal of the Ming Dynasty, ranked first among the six founding 'kings', enfeoffed as Prince of Zhongshan and once as Duke of Wei. He led his army to capture Yuan Dadu and was the maternal grandfather of Zhu Gaoxu. He deeply disliked Hu Weiyong and secretly reported his misconduct to the Hongwu Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 明朝开国名将。体貌奇伟，勇力绝伦，猿臂善射，统军有方。官至中书平章军国重事，兼太子少保。曾封郑国公、鄂国公。北伐中原时暴卒军中，追封开平王，谥号忠武。
description.en: Founding general of the Ming Dynasty. Known for his exceptional bravery and military skill. He held high positions such as Grand Marshal and Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince, and was enfeoffed as the Duke of E. He died suddenly during the northern expedition against the Yuan and was posthumously created Prince of Kaiping with the posthumous name Zhongwu.

birth_place.zh-cn: 河南江北等处行中书省安丰路濠州怀远县
birth_place.en: Huaiyuan County, Haozhou, Anfeng Circuit, Henan Jiangbei Xingsheng

description.zh-cn: 明朝开国功臣，韩国公，曾任左丞相。后在胡惟庸案中受牵连被杀。
description.en: A founding father of the Ming dynasty, Duke of Han, and former Left Chancellor. He was later implicated and executed in the Hu Weiyong case.

description.zh-cn: 明朝开国功臣、政治家、文学家。据《明史》记载，他被胡惟庸下毒害死。
description.en: A founding father, statesman, and literary figure of the Ming dynasty. According to the History of Ming, he was poisoned to death by Hu Weiyong.

description.zh-cn: 胡惟庸，明朝初年的宰相，同时也是明朝最后一任中书省丞相。他是胡惟庸案的核心人物，最终被朱元璋以谋反罪名诛杀。
description.en: Hu Weiyong was a chancellor in the early Ming dynasty and the last Chancellor of the Central Secretariat. He was the central figure in the Case of Hu Weiyong and was eventually executed by the Hongwu Emperor on charges of treason.

description.zh-cn: 明朝开国将领、凉国公。后被指控谋反，引发蓝玉案，成为该案核心人物。此谋反案由锦衣卫办理，是著名的诏狱之一。
description.en: A founding general of the Ming Dynasty and Duke of Liang. He was later accused of treason, sparking the Lan Yu case and becoming its central figure. This treason case was one of the famous imperial prison cases handled by the Jinyiwei.

description.zh-cn: 明太祖朱元璋嫡长子，洪武元年被立为皇太子，是明朝开国皇太子。他也是建文帝朱允炆之父。正史记载其为马皇后所生，但亦有异说。
description.en: The eldest son and heir apparent of Emperor Taizu, Zhu Yuanzhang, and the first crown prince of the Ming dynasty, designated in the first year of the Hongwu era. He was also the father of Emperor Jianwen, Zhu Yunwen. Official histories record him as the son of Empress Ma, though conflicting accounts exist.

description.zh-cn: 明朝第二位皇帝明惠宗朱允炆，朱元璋之孙，年号“建文”。在位期间，于洪武三十一年（1398年）追尊祖母马皇后。后在靖难之役中被其叔朱棣击败。
description.en: The second emperor of the Ming dynasty, Ming Huizong Zhu Yunwen, a grandson of Zhu Yuanzhang, reigned under the era name 'Jianwen'. During his reign, he honored his grandmother Empress Ma with a posthumous title in the 31st year of the Hongwu era (1398). He was later defeated by his uncle Zhu Di in the Jingnan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 朱元璋之父，追尊为仁祖淳皇帝
朱元璋之母，追尊为淳皇后
明朝设立的军政特务机构，直接向皇帝负责，掌管侍卫、巡查、缉捕、刑狱等事宜。其前身为亲军都尉府及仪鸾司，于洪武十五年（1382年）改制而成。清初被改为銮仪卫，南明政权的锦衣卫则延续至1661年咒水之难后才正式终结。
description.en: A military and secret police organization of the Ming Dynasty, directly responsible to the emperor, in charge of bodyguards, patrols, arrests, and prisons. It was reorganized from the Imperial Guard's Commander's Office and the Imperial Standard Guard in 1382. It was renamed the Imperial Guard of Honor (Luan Yi Wei) in the early Qing Dynasty, while the Southern Ming regime's Jinyiwei officially ended after the Cursed Water Incident in 1661.

description.zh-cn: 明朝初年的中央最高行政机构，由丞相领导。胡惟庸案后被废除。
description.en: The central highest administrative body in the early Ming dynasty, led by the chancellors. It was abolished after the Hu Weiyong case.

description.zh-cn: 朱元璋在位期间社会生产逐渐恢复和发展的时期

en: Four Major Cases of the early Ming dynasty

description.zh-cn: 明朝洪武年间，明太祖朱元璋为整顿吏治、清除功臣、加强中央集权而策划的四起重大政治案件，包括空印案、郭桓案、胡惟庸案和蓝玉案。
description.en: Four major political cases during the Hongwu era of the Ming Dynasty, initiated by Emperor Hongwu (Zhu Yuanzhang) to consolidate power, purge officials and meritorious subjects, and centralize authority. They include the Empty Seal Case, the Case of Guo Huan, the Case of Hu Weiyong, and the Case of Lan Yu.

description.zh-cn: 明太祖朱元璋第四子，明朝第三位皇帝，明成祖。原为燕王，通过靖难之役从其侄建文帝手中夺取皇位，年号永乐。他下令编纂《永乐大典》，并恢复加强了锦衣卫的权力。关于其生母，正史记载为马皇后，但有史料称其生母为䂵妃。他是朱高煦之父。
description.en: The fourth son of the Hongwu Emperor and the third Emperor of the Ming Dynasty, known as the Yongle Emperor. He seized the throne from his nephew, the Jianwen Emperor, through the Jingnan Campaign. He commissioned the compilation of the Yongle Encyclopedia and restored and strengthened the power of the Jinyiwei. His parentage is disputed; while official histories record Empress Ma as his mother, some historical sources claim he was born to Consort Gong. He was the father of Zhu Gaoxu.

description.zh-cn: 明朝开国将领，德庆侯
明朝开国将领，颖国公
明朝开国将领，宋国公
元末红巾军领袖，小明王

en: Office of the Central Foreign Affairs Commission

description.en: The administrative office of the Central Foreign Affairs Commission of the Communist Party of China.

国务院台湾事务办公室
en: Taiwan Affairs Office of the State Council

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国负责处理台湾事务的机构，与中共中央台湾工作办公室为“一个机构两块牌子”。
description.en: An administrative agency under the State Council of the People's Republic of China responsible for Taiwan-related affairs. It shares the same office with the Taiwan Work Office of the CCP Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中共中央台湾工作办公室主任。

description.en: Chinese diplomat who served as the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

en: Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications of the People's Republic of China

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国外交部亚洲司
en: Department of Asian Affairs of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国外交部内设机构，负责处理亚洲地区相关外交事务。
description.en: An internal department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China, responsible for handling diplomatic affairs related to the Asian region.

zh-cn: 海峡两岸经济合作架构协议

description.zh-cn: 伊朗与P5+1国家就伊朗核问题达成的协议。

zh-cn: 2023年沙特阿拉伯和伊朗北京会谈

description.zh-cn: 该国位于西亚阿拉伯半岛，是一个君主专制国家，政教合一，以石油经济为支柱。其建立由瓦哈比派与绍德家族的联盟促成，并定瓦哈比派为国教。该国曾被邀请加入金砖国家，后暂缓申请。在阿拉伯之春后的地区冲突中扮演重要角色，如军事干预也门，并曾被指控支持阿米尼示威。
description.en: This monarchical absolute state, located on the Arabian Peninsula in Western Asia, integrates religion and politics and relies on an oil-based economy. Its establishment was facilitated by the alliance between the Wahhabi movement and the House of Saud, which it adopted as its state religion. The country was invited to join BRICS but later postponed its application. It has played a significant role in regional conflicts following the Arab Spring, such as its military intervention in Yemen, and was previously accused of supporting the Mahsa Amini protests.

description.zh-cn: 位于西亚的政教合一伊斯兰共和国，2024年加入金砖国家。该国被指控向俄罗斯提供无人机和弹道导弹，同时也是马赫萨·阿米尼示威的发生地。
description.en: A theocratic Islamic republic in Western Asia that joined BRICS in 2024. The country is accused of supplying drones and ballistic missiles to Russia and was also the site of the Mahsa Amini protests.

description.zh-cn: 美国总统拜登任期内，中美两国高层首次举行的面对面会谈。
description.en: The first face-to-face meeting between high-level officials from China and the United States during President Joe Biden's term.

description.zh-cn: 美国政府官员，现任美国国家安全事务助理。
description.en: American government official serving as the current United States National Security Advisor.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯外交部长

zh-cn: 穆罕默德·贾瓦德·扎里夫

description.zh-cn: 伊朗政治人物，曾任伊朗外交部长。
中国外交官，曾任外交部亚洲司副司长。
欧盟外交与安全政策高级代表。
毛泽民的第三任妻子。
description.en: Third wife of Mao Zemin.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国时期新疆省的统治者，下令处决了毛泽民、陈潭秋、林基路等人。
description.en: Ruler of Xinjiang Province during the Republic of China era, who ordered the execution of Mao Zemin, Chen Tanqiu, Lin Jilu, and others.

description.zh-cn: 令计划的妻子。
中国政治人物，令狐路线的兄长。
description.en: Chinese politician, elder brother of Linghu Luxian.

description.zh-cn: 令狐路线的弟弟，曾将其在汇金立方的股份转给外甥女（令狐路线之女）王玲。
description.en: Younger brother of Linghu Luxian, who transferred his shares in Huijin Lifang to his niece Wang Ling (daughter of Linghu Luxian).

description.zh-cn: 中国医生，令计划的三姐，令狐野的女儿。高中毕业后曾作为知识青年下乡。她是五兄弟姊妹中唯一保留令狐姓者。
description.en: Chinese doctor, the third elder sister of Ling Jihua and daughter of Linghu Ye. She was a sent-down youth after high school graduation. She is the only one of the five siblings to retain the original surname Linghu.

description.zh-cn: 令狐路线的兄长。
description.en: Elder brother of Linghu Luxian.

description.zh-cn: 令狐路线、令方针、令政策、令计划、令完成的父亲。
description.en: Father of Linghu Luxian, Ling Fangzhen, Ling Zhengce, Ling Jihua, and Ling Wancheng.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国教育部直属的综合性全国重点大学，双一流、985工程重点建设大学。周本顺的母校之一，在此获得工学硕士和管理学博士学位。
description.en: A comprehensive national key university directly under the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China, part of the Double First-Class and Project 985 initiatives. It is also one of Zhou Benshun's alma maters, where he obtained a Master of Engineering and a Ph.D. in Management.

description.zh-cn: 神秘政商联盟组织
前中国中央电视台记者、主播，后因涉郭振玺案被判刑六年，现为投资人。
description.en: Former China Central Television reporter and anchor, later sentenced to six years in prison for his involvement in the Guo Zhenxi case, now an investor.

description.zh-cn: 中共四川省委原副书记
中共中央办公厅秘书局原局长
令狐路线的丈夫，原山西省运城市副市长，后被免职。
description.en: Husband of Linghu Luxian, former deputy mayor of Yuncheng, Shanxi, who was later dismissed from his post.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中国科学技术协会党组书记。
description.en: Formerly served as the Party Group Secretary of the China Association for Science and Technology.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中国共产党长治市委员会书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, former secretary of the CPC Changzhi Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中国共产党朔州市委员会书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, former secretary of the CPC Shuozhou Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝第9任皇帝，亦是在位时间最长的皇帝。在位前期开创开元盛世，后期因怠政导致安史之乱爆发。他曾征召李白入京任翰林供奉，并追封庄周为南华真人。其与杨贵妃的爱情故事是《长恨歌》的主题。
description.en: The 9th and longest-reigning emperor of the Tang Dynasty. He posthumously honored Zhuang Zhou as Nanhua Zhenren, and his love story with Yang Guifei is the subject of the 'Song of Everlasting Regret'.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝诗人，李白的好友与敬慕对象。
唐朝诗人、官员，曾与李白、杜甫交游。
唐玄宗之子，永王。安史之乱时起兵，招揽李白入幕，后兵败。
唐朝著名宦官，本名冯元一。他深得唐玄宗宠信，官至骠骑大将军，封齐国公。一生对玄宗忠心耿耿，但据说也曾因被李白冒犯而排挤他。
唐玄宗的贵妃，也是备受宠爱的宠妃，中国古代四大美女之一，文学作品《长恨歌》的主角。她在马嵬驿兵变中被赐死。有传闻称她曾因高力士中伤而排斥李白。
description.en: A beloved consort of Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and one of the Four Beauties of ancient China, she is also a central figure in the literary work 'Song of Everlasting Regret'. She was forced to commit suicide during the Mawei Mutiny. Rumors suggest she rejected Li Bai due to the slanders of Gao Lishi.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝诗人、官员，对李白极为赏识，称其为“谪仙人”。
唐朝道士，据说曾向唐玄宗推荐李白。
唐玄宗的妹妹，据说曾推荐李白。
李白的第一任妻子，前宰相许圉师的孙女。
李白的最后一任妻子，前宰相宗楚客的后人。
李白之子。
唐朝宰相，李白妻子宗氏的先人。
李白的族叔，唐朝官员，在李白晚年照顾他并整理其诗稿。
唐朝名将，在平定安史之乱中起到关键作用。传说他曾受李白救助，后为获罪的李白求情。
description.en: A famous general of the Tang Dynasty who played a crucial role in suppressing the An Lushan Rebellion. It is said that he was once rescued by Li Bai and later interceded for the disgraced poet.

description.zh-cn: 南朝诗人，李白最敬慕的诗人之一。
唐代道教一代宗师，曾称赞李白有“仙风道骨”。
东晋政治家，李白终身仰慕的历史人物之一。
安史之乱是唐朝于755年至763年由安禄山与史思明发动的一场大规模政治叛乱，被视为唐朝由盛转衰的关键事件，深刻影响了当时的社会与文化，包括诗人李白的晚年生活。
description.en: The An Lushan Rebellion was a large-scale political rebellion launched by An Lushan and Shi Siming in the Tang Dynasty from 755 to 763. It is considered a key event marking the dynasty's decline from its peak, profoundly impacting the society and culture of the time, including the later life of the poet Li Bai.

description.zh-cn: 翰林院是中国古代的学术与官僚储备机构。其历史悠久，在唐朝时期曾作为宫廷机构，著名诗人李白在此担任翰林供奉。至清朝，它发展为重要的学术和秘书机构，如年羹尧在康熙三十九年考中进士后曾在此任职。该机构也曾长期收藏《永乐大典》副本。
description.en: The Hanlin Academy was an academic and administrative institution in imperial China with a long history. During the Tang Dynasty, it served as a court institution, where the renowned poet Li Bai held the position of Hanlin Academician. In the Qing Dynasty, it evolved into an important academic and secretariat body, with figures like Nian Gengyao serving there after becoming a Jinshi in 1700. The institution also long housed the duplicate manuscript of the Yongle Encyclopedia.

description.zh-cn: 起源于中国的本土民族宗教，以“道”为最高信仰，深受道家思想影响，后将庄周尊为南华真人。李白笃信道教，热切向往神仙不死。
description.en: An indigenous Chinese religion, deeply influenced by Taoist philosophy, which later revered Zhuang Zhou as Nanhua Zhenren.

description.zh-cn: 陈良宇的儿子。
陈良宇的三弟。

zh-cn: 天津市第二中级人民法院

description.zh-cn: 负责审理陈良宇案的法院。
description.en: The court responsible for trying the Chen Liangyu case.

zh-cn: 上海大学市北附属中学
中国人民解放军联勤保障部队工程大学

description.zh-cn: 中国官员，曾任上海市劳动和社会保障局局长，因陈良宇事件被判刑。
description.en: Chinese official, former Director of the Shanghai Municipal Bureau of Labor and Social Security, who was sentenced in the Chen Liangyu incident.

description.zh-cn: 中国商人，上海社保案的核心人物，通过违规借贷上海社保基金迅速积累财富。
description.en: Chinese businessman and central figure in the Shanghai social security fund case, who rapidly accumulated wealth through illegal loans from the fund.

description.zh-cn: 中国商人。

en: Retreat of the government of the Republic of China to Taiwan

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战末期，中华民国政府将中央政府机构迁往台湾台北市的历史事件。
description.en: The historical event at the end of the Second Chinese Civil War where the government of the Republic of China relocated its central government agencies to Taipei City, Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 美国军事家、政治家、外交家，曾任美国陆军参谋长，并曾作为美国特使调停国共冲突。
description.en: An American soldier, statesman, and diplomat, who served as Chief of Staff of the United States Army, and also as an American envoy who mediated the KMT-CCP conflict.

en: Three Great Campaigns of the Wanli Emperor

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战期间，中国人民解放军与中华民国国军之间的三次决定性战役，即辽沈、淮海、平津三大战役，是国共内战的战略决战。
description.en: Three decisive campaigns between the People's Liberation Army and the Republic of China Armed Forces during the Second Chinese Civil War, consisting of the Liaoshen, Huaihai, and Pingjin Campaigns.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国的国家武装力量，在1947年行宪后由国民革命军改组而来。在1955年的大陈岛撤退行动中与第七舰队合作，并在1958年的八二三炮战中得到第七舰队的护航补给。
description.en: The national armed forces of the Republic of China, reorganized from the National Revolutionary Army after the 1947 constitution was enacted. It cooperated with the Seventh Fleet during the 1955 Dachen Islands evacuation and received escort for supplies from the Seventh Fleet during the 1958 Second Taiwan Strait Crisis.

description.zh-cn: 由首批入选985工程的九所高校组成的高校联盟。
