description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海军上将，曾任海军司令员，在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为中央军事委员会委员。
description.en: An admiral in the People's Liberation Army Navy, formerly served as Navy Commander, and was appointed as a member of the Central Military Commission during the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国军事人物
中国人民解放军高级将领，曾任中国人民解放军总政治部主任，后在接受组织谈话期间自杀身亡。
description.en: A high-ranking general in the People's Liberation Army, former Director of the PLA General Political Department, who committed suicide during an investigation.

description.zh-cn: 中国军事人物
中国人民解放军空军上将，曾任中国人民解放军国防大学校长。
description.en: A general of the PLAAF, who served as President of the PLA National Defense University.

description.zh-cn: 清朝奠基者，后金开国皇帝，后被追尊为清太祖。他是塔克世与宣皇后的长子。他统一女真各部，并在与明朝的战争中屡获胜利。但在宁远之战中被袁崇焕击败并负伤，不久后去世。
description.en: The founder of the Qing dynasty and the Later Jin dynasty, posthumously honored as Emperor Taizu of Qing. He was the eldest son of Taksi and Empress Xuan. He unified the Jurchen tribes and achieved numerous victories in wars against the Ming Dynasty. However, he was defeated and wounded by Yuan Chonghuan at the Battle of Ningyuan, dying shortly thereafter.

description.zh-cn: 由女真族首领努尔哈赤于1616年建立的政权，是清朝的前身。在其存续期间，与明朝在辽东地区展开了长期的军事对抗。
description.en: A khanate established by the Jurchen leader Nurhaci in 1616, the predecessor to the Qing dynasty. During its existence, it engaged in long-term military conflict with the Ming Dynasty in the Liaodong region.

description.zh-cn: 努尔哈赤第八子，后金第二位大汗，清朝的开国皇帝。他继续对明朝的战争，并于1629年发动己巳之变，绕道蒙古攻入明朝内地。
description.en: Son of Nurhaci, the second khan of the Later Jin and the founding emperor of the Qing Dynasty. He continued the war against the Ming and launched the Jisi Incident in 1629, bypassing the Ming defenses via Mongolia to attack the Ming heartland.

description.zh-cn: 明末农民起义军领袖，大顺政权的建立者与大顺皇帝。他率军攻入北京导致明朝灭亡，并曾将锦衣卫改名为龙衣卫。但随后在一片石之战中被清吴联军击败。其军队被认为是焚毁《永乐大典》正本的可能原因之一。
description.en: Leader of the peasant rebellion in the late Ming dynasty, founder and emperor of the Dashun regime. He led his army to capture Beijing, causing the fall of the Ming dynasty, and once renamed the Jinyiwei to Longyiwei (Dragon-Clad Guard). However, he was later defeated by the Qing-Wu allied forces at the Battle of Shanhai Pass. His army is also considered a possible cause for the destruction of the original manuscript of the Yongle Encyclopedia.

description.zh-cn: 由李自成在明末民变中建立的农民政权。
description.en: A peasant regime established by Li Zicheng during the late Ming peasant rebellions.

description.zh-cn: 明末清初军事家、政治家。曾任辽东总兵，手握关宁铁骑，于一片石之战中投降多尔衮，引清兵入关，被封为平西王。晚年发动三藩之乱，建立吴周政权，自称皇帝。
description.en: A military general and politician in the late Ming and early Qing dynasties. He served as a late Ming general, commanding the Guan-Ning Army in the Liaodong region. During the Battle of Shanhai Pass, he surrendered to Dorgon, allowing Qing forces to enter the pass, and was subsequently enfeoffed as the Prince of Pacifying the West. In his later years, he initiated the Revolt of the Three Feudatories and established the Wu Zhou dynasty, declaring himself emperor.

description.zh-cn: 清朝初年杰出的政治家和军事家，努尔哈赤第十四子，清太宗皇太极之弟，顺治帝时期摄政王。他曾在一片石之战中率领清军主力入关，是清朝入关初期的实际统治者。
description.en: An outstanding statesman and military strategist in the early Qing dynasty. The 14th son of Nurhaci and brother of Hong Taiji, he served as regent during the Shunzhi Emperor's reign. He led the main Qing forces into the pass during the Battle of Shanhai Pass, becoming the de facto ruler during the early Qing entry period.

description.zh-cn: 清朝第四位皇帝，清朝入关后的第二位皇帝，年号康熙，庙号清圣祖。孝庄太皇太后之孙。他是在位61年的中国历史上在位时间最长的皇帝。雍正帝之父，隆科多的表兄。
description.en: The fourth emperor of the Qing dynasty, posthumously known as Emperor Shengzu and grandson of Empress Dowager Xiaozhuang. His 61-year reign makes him the longest-reigning emperor in Chinese history. He was also the cousin of Longkodo and father of the Yongzheng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 清朝康熙年间，由吴三桂、耿精忠、尚之信发动的大规模反清叛乱。
description.en: A large-scale rebellion against the Qing dynasty during the reign of the Kangxi Emperor, launched by Wu Sangui, Geng Jingzhong, and Shang Zhixin.

description.zh-cn: 中国清朝第五位皇帝，清世宗，年号雍正。他是康熙帝第四子，乾隆帝之父，孝圣宪皇后的丈夫。因中国礼仪之争引发的矛盾，他在位期间实行禁教政策，中断了明末清初的西学东渐进程。
description.en: The fifth emperor of the Qing dynasty and the fourth son of the Kangxi Emperor. During his reign, he implemented a policy of prohibiting Christianity due to the Chinese Rites controversy, which interrupted the process of West-to-East knowledge transfer in the late Ming and early Qing.

description.zh-cn: 由雍正帝设立的清朝中枢权力机构，主要在清朝中后期发挥作用。
中国清朝第六位皇帝，年号乾隆，清高宗，雍正帝第四子，孝圣宪皇后之子。他实际掌握中国最高权力长达六十三年零四个月，是中国历史上实际执掌国家最高权力时间最长的皇帝。在位期间，他下令开四库馆并从《永乐大典》中辑佚，同时对紫禁城进行了大规模的增建和改建，奠定了其现今的大部分格局。
description.en: The sixth emperor of the Qing dynasty, known by his reign name Qianlong, was Emperor Gaozong of Qing, the fourth son of Emperor Yongzheng, and son of Empress Xiaoshengxian. He de facto held supreme power in China for 63 years and four months, making him the longest-reigning ruler in Chinese history. During his reign, he ordered the establishment of the Siku Quanshu project and the recovery of lost texts from the Yongle Encyclopedia, while also undertaking large-scale additions and renovations to the Forbidden City, laying the foundation for much of its current layout.

description.zh-cn: 清朝乾隆年间编修的中国历史上规模最大的丛书，其编纂过程中从《永乐大典》中辑佚了大量古籍。
description.en: The largest collection of books in Chinese history, compiled during the Qianlong era of the Qing dynasty. A significant number of lost ancient books were recovered from the Yongle Encyclopedia for its compilation.

description.zh-cn: 1840年至1842年清朝与大英帝国之间的一场侵略战争，战争的导火线是清政府的禁烟运动，其中著名的事件是虎门销烟。战争以中国失败并赔款割地告终，签订了中国近代史上第一个不平等条约《南京条约》。
description.en: A war fought between the Qing dynasty and the British Empire from 1840 to 1842. The conflict was triggered by the Qing government's campaign against the British opium trade, which culminated in the destruction of opium at Humen. The war concluded with a Chinese defeat and the signing of the Treaty of Nanking.

description.zh-cn: 第一次鸦片战争后清政府与英国签订的条约，是中国近代史上第一个不平等条约。条约内容包括割让香港岛、开放五个通商口岸及赔款。
description.en: The treaty signed between the Qing government and Great Britain after the First Opium War, and the first of the unequal treaties in modern Chinese history. Its terms included the cession of Hong Kong Island, the opening of five treaty ports, and payment of reparations.

description.zh-cn: 清末拜上帝会创始人，太平天国运动的领袖及太平天国的建立者和天王。其子为洪天贵福。
description.en: Founder of the God Worshipping Society in the late Qing Dynasty, leader of the Taiping Rebellion, founder and Heavenly King of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom. His son was Hong Tianguifu.

description.zh-cn: 太平天国是由洪秀全在清朝后期建立的农民起义政权，与清朝对峙并进行了长达14年的战争。其军事力量在天京城破时，城中守军约有万余人。
description.en: The Taiping Heavenly Kingdom was a rebel state established by Hong Xiuquan during the late Qing Dynasty, which engaged in a 14-year war with the Qing government. Its military force numbered around 10,000 defenders when Tianjing fell.

description.zh-cn: 晚清时期政治家、战略家、理学家、文学家，中兴四大名臣之一，湘军的创立者和统帅。他曾向清廷奏报攻克金陵战果时，称杀敌十万余，有学者认为此为夸大战功。
description.en: A Chinese statesman, military general, Confucian scholar, and writer of the late Qing dynasty, and one of the Four Great Ministers of the Restoration. He was the founder and commander of the Xiang Army. In his report to the Qing court on the capture of Jinling, he claimed to have killed over 100,000 enemies, a figure some scholars believe to be an exaggeration.

description.zh-cn: 中国清朝晚期女性皇室成员、政治人物，同治、光绪年间的实际最高统治者，亦是光绪帝名义上的母亲。她在执政期间指定溥仪继位并任命载沣为摄政王。曾于义和团运动期间向多国宣战，引发八国联军之役，其权威在东南互保事件中受到严重挑战。
description.en: A female royal member and political figure in the late Qing dynasty, she was the de facto supreme ruler during the Tongzhi and Guangxu reigns, and the nominal mother of Emperor Guangxu. During her rule, she appointed Puyi as the successor and Zaifeng as the Prince-Regent. She declared war on multiple foreign powers during the Boxer Rebellion, leading to the invasion by the Eight-Nation Alliance, and her authority was severely challenged by the Mutual Protection of Southeast China.

description.zh-cn: 为镇压义和团运动而侵华的八国军事联盟。

description.zh-cn: 中央机构编制委员会办公室，是中国共产党中央机构编制委员会的常设办事机构，正部级中共中央办事机构。负责全国行政管理体制和机构改革以及机构编制的日常管理工作。其历史可追溯至1988年组建，当时与国务院机构改革办公室一个机构两块牌子；自1991年起，正式成为既是中共中央的机构，又是国务院的机构。该机构还曾对“一个机构两块牌子”的含义做出过政策解释。
description.en: The Office of the Central Institutional Organization Commission is the permanent working body of the Central Institutional Organization Commission of the Communist Party of China, functioning as a ministerial-level working body of the CPC Central Committee. It is responsible for the daily management of the national administrative system and institutional reform, as well as institutional organization. Its history can be traced back to its establishment in 1988, when it operated under the arrangement of 'one institution, two names' with the State Council Office for Institutional Reform. Since 1991, it has officially served as an institution of both the CPC Central Committee and the State Council. It has also provided policy explanations for the meaning of 'one institution with two names'.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代思想家、政治家、教育家、史学家、文学家。作为戊戌变法领袖之一，他也是清末民初中国知识界及政治界的领军人物。他曾倡导君主立宪，后反对袁世凯称帝及张勋复辟。作为巴黎和会中国代表团顾问，他从巴黎致电通报外交困境，是五四运动爆发的信息源头。他还是清华国学研究院四大导师之一，梁思成之父，晚年专注于文化教育与学术研究，对西学东渐贡献巨大。
description.en: A prominent Chinese thinker, politician, educator, historian, and writer. As one of the leaders of the Hundred Days' Reform, he was also a leading figure in China's intellectual and political circles during the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic. He advocated for constitutional monarchy, later opposing Yuan Shikai's imperial ambitions and Zhang Xun's restoration attempt. As an advisor to the Chinese delegation at the Paris Peace Conference, his telegram from Paris reporting on the diplomatic crisis was the source of information that led to the outbreak of the May Fourth Movement. He was also one of the four great tutors at the Tsinghua Institute of Chinese Studies and the father of Liang Sicheng. In his later years, he focused on cultural education and academic research, making significant contributions to the dissemination of Western knowledge.

description.zh-cn: 晚清重臣，洋务派和清流派的主要代表人物。他历任山西巡抚、两广总督、湖广总督、军机大臣等职，官至体仁阁大学士。倡导“中学为体，西学为用”，创办了汉阳铁厂等一系列近代工业和教育机构。他曾镇压自立军起义，并是东南互保的核心人物之一。他与曾国藩、李鸿章、左宗棠并称“晚清四大名臣”，曾建议慈禧太后给予载沣“摄政王”的封号。
description.en: A prominent official of the late Qing dynasty, a key representative of the Westernization Movement and the Qingliu school. He held various high-ranking positions including Governor of Shanxi, Viceroy of Liangguang, Viceroy of Huguang, and Grand Councilor, eventually rising to the rank of Grand Secretary of the Tiren Cabinet. Advocating 'Chinese learning as the essence, Western learning for practical use', he founded a series of modern industrial and educational institutions such as the Hanyang Iron Works. He suppressed the Self-Strengthening Army Uprising and was one of the key figures in the Mutual Protection of Southeast China. Known as one of the 'Four Great Officials of the Late Qing' alongside Zeng Guofan, Li Hongzhang, and Zuo Zongtang, he once suggested to Empress Dowager Cixi that Zaifeng be given the title of 'Prince-Regent'.

description.en: The eleventh emperor of the Qing dynasty, and the ninth after its entry into Shanhai Pass. He was the second son of Yixuan, designated by Empress Dowager Cixi to succeed Emperor Xianfeng, and ascended the throne in 1875. At the time of his ascension, more than a decade had passed since the Nanjing Massacre by the Xiang Army, and the city of Nanjing had still not recovered from the destruction. During his reign, he implemented New Policies, led the Hundred Days' Reform, and approved the establishment of Shandong University and Peiyang University, the first modern university in China. After the failure of the Hundred Days' Reform, he was placed under house arrest.

中华人民共和国直辖市、国家中心城市、超大城市。位于中国西南部、长江上游地区，是西部大开发的重要战略支点。有文字记载的历史达3000多年，是巴蜀文化的发祥地。抗日战争时期曾为中华民国战时首都。1997年因三峡工程的需要再次成为直辖市。在特定时期，作为“重庆模式”的实施地引起广泛关注，此外也是艾跃进的祖籍所在地。陈元执掌的国家开发银行曾向其批准大量贷款。
description.en: A direct-administered municipality, national central city, and megacity of the People's Republic of China. Located in southwestern China and the upper reaches of the Yangtze River, it is a crucial strategic point for the Western Development. With a recorded history of over 3000 years, it is the birthplace of Bashu culture. It served as the wartime capital of the Republic of China during the Second Sino-Japanese War. In 1997, it was re-established as a direct-administered municipality due to the needs of the Three Gorges Project. It gained widespread attention as the place where the 'Chongqing Model' was implemented, and is also the ancestral home of Ai Yuejin. Additionally, the China Development Bank, led by Chen Yuan, approved substantial loans to the city.

description.zh-cn: 法兰西第二共和国的唯一一位总统和法兰西第二帝国的唯一一位皇帝。他曾以“教会的保护者”名义派兵保护罗马，阻止意大利王国占领（即教宗国）。
description.en: The only president of the French Second Republic and the only emperor of the Second French Empire. He protected Rome with French troops in his capacity as 'protector of the Church', preventing its capture by the Kingdom of Italy (i.e., the Papal States).

description.zh-cn: 由拿破仑三世统治的法国政权。该政权曾出兵保护教宗国免受意大利王国吞并，并与大英帝国结盟，联合发动第二次鸦片战争以对抗清朝。
description.en: The French regime ruled by Napoleon III. It allied with the British Empire and jointly launched the Second Opium War against the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 普鲁士王国与法兰西第二帝国之间的战争，是德国统一战争的最后一场，其结果是德意志帝国的建立。这场战争也导致法国从罗马撤军，为意大利王国吞并罗马创造了条件。
description.en: The final of the German unification wars, fought between the Kingdom of Prussia and the Second French Empire, which resulted in the creation of the German Empire. It also led to the French withdrawal from Rome, creating conditions for the Kingdom of Italy to annex Rome.

description.zh-cn: 1870年至1940年间的法国共和政府。在第二次世界大战中被纳粹德国击败后解体。
description.en: The republican government of France from 1870 to 1940. It collapsed after the defeat by Nazi Germany in World War II.

location.zh-cn: 欧洲、亚洲、非洲、大西洋、太平洋

description.zh-cn: 一场1914年至1918年发生的全球性军事冲突，始于欧洲，萨拉热窝事件是其直接导火索。美国在伍德罗·威尔逊总统的领导下于1917年参战。中国作为战胜国参与战后巴黎和会，但山东问题未能得到公平处理，成为五四运动的国际背景。
description.en: A global military conflict (1914-1918) originating in Europe, directly triggered by the Sarajevo incident. Woodrow Wilson led the United States to enter the war in 1917. China participated as a victorious nation in the post-war Paris Peace Conference, but the unfair handling of the Shandong Problem became the international backdrop for the May Fourth Movement.

description.zh-cn: 在第一次世界大战期间占领比利时。
法国军事家、政治家，第二次世界大战期间领导自由法国运动，战后成为法兰西第五共和国的创建者和首任总统。
description.en: French general and statesman who led the Free French Forces during World War II. He later founded the French Fifth Republic in 1958 and served as its first president.

description.zh-cn: 1949年5月23日在美、英、法三国占领区成立。作为欧盟创始成员国之一，其国家主导的工业发展模式和强权政策曾成为明治日本效仿的对象。近期，德国政府批评伊朗政权镇压示威，并呼吁欧盟对伊朗实施进一步制裁。
description.en: Established on 23 May 1949 in the zones occupied by the United States, the United Kingdom, and France. As one of the founding members of the EU, its state-led industrial development model and strong-arm policies became a model for Meiji Japan. Recently, the German government criticized the Iranian regime for suppressing protests and called on the EU to impose further sanctions on Iran.

description.zh-cn: 法国军事将领、政治家及法国元帅。第一次世界大战中因凡尔登战役的胜利而成为民族英雄，但在第二次世界大战期间领导与纳粹德国合作的维希法国政府，战后被判叛国罪。
description.en: A French general, politician, and Marshal of France. He became a national hero for his victory at the Battle of Verdun in World War I, but led the collaborationist Vichy France regime with Nazi Germany during World War II, for which he was convicted of treason.

location.zh-cn: 维希 (事实), 巴黎 (法定), 西格马林根 (流亡)
location.en: Vichy (de facto), Paris (de jure), Sigmaringen (in exile)

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战期间，由菲利普·贝当领导的法国国家政权。它最初在法国未被德军占领的南部地区成立，名义上中立，但与纳粹德国合作，并于1942年后被德国完全控制。
description.en: During World War II, this French state was led by Philippe Pétain. Initially established in the southern, unoccupied zone of France, it was officially neutral but collaborated with Nazi Germany and became fully controlled by Germany after 1942.

description.zh-cn: 由夏尔·戴高乐在伦敦建立的流亡政府，致力于抵抗德国占领和维希政权，并在解放法国中发挥了关键作用。
description.en: A government-in-exile established in London by Charles de Gaulle, dedicated to resisting the German occupation and the Vichy regime, and playing a key role in the liberation of France.

description.zh-cn: 一个由欧洲和北美国家组成的国际军事联盟，旨在实现集体防御和防务合作。它包括2个北美国家和30个欧洲国家，加拿大是其创始国之一，拉脱维亚于2004年加入。俄罗斯对其东扩的担忧是发动战争的宣称理由之一。
description.en: An international military alliance formed by European and North American countries, aiming for collective defense and cooperation. It comprises 2 North American and 30 European states, with Canada as one of its founding members and Latvia joining in 2004. Russia's concerns about its eastward expansion were one of the stated reasons for the war.

description.zh-cn: 法国前总统，任内推动法国重返北约军事指挥结构。
美国及其盟友以伊拉克拥有大规模杀伤性武器为由发动的军事行动，推翻了萨达姆政权。这场始于2003年的军事冲突中，加拿大拒绝了美国提出的加入邀请。
description.en: A military operation launched by the United States and its allies, citing Iraq's possession of weapons of mass destruction, which overthrew the regime of Saddam Hussein. In this military conflict, which began in 2003, Canada declined the United States' invitation to join.

en: French aircraft carrier Charles de Gaulle

description.zh-cn: 位于法国巴黎战神广场的铁制镂空塔，为巴黎城市地标及法国文化象征之一，曾为世界最高人造建筑。
description.en: A wrought-iron lattice tower on the Champ de Mars in Paris, France. It is a cultural icon of France and one of the most recognizable structures in the world. It was the world's tallest man-made structure upon its completion.

description.zh-cn: 中山大学的源流学校之一。

description.en: An institution of higher agricultural education located in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China, one of the predecessors of South China Agricultural University.

中国诗人
中国工程教育家，曾任国立北洋工学院院长。
动力机械工程专家，中国工程院院士，接替钟登华担任天津大学校长。
description.en: Expert in power machinery engineering, academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering, and president of Tianjin University, succeeding Zhong Denghua.

description.zh-cn: 清末官员，曾任陕西巡抚、两江总督。后在保路运动激化后，被清廷任命为署理四川总督，率湖北新军入川镇压。他曾是东南互保的支持者，并创办了暨南学堂。1911年11月27日，他在资中县被哗变的部下所杀。
description.en: A late Qing official, who served as Governor of Shaanxi and Governor-General of Liangjiang. Later, after the escalation of the Railway Protection Movement, he was appointed acting Governor-General of Sichuan by the Qing court and led the Hubei New Army into Sichuan for suppression. He was a supporter of the Mutual Protection of Southeast China and founded Jinan School. On November 27, 1911, he was killed by his mutinous subordinates in Zizhong County.

en: Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上海市军事管制委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国儒家经典之一。

description.en: A compilation of speeches, sayings, and deeds of Confucius and his disciples from the Spring and Autumn period of China, and one of the most important classics of Confucianism.

description.zh-cn: 中国男子短跑运动员，暨南大学体育学院院长。

中国教育家，华东师范大学首任校长。
中国教育家、哲学家，文化大革命后华东师范大学首位校长。
中国工程院院士，华东师范大学现任校长。
美国圣公会主教，圣约翰大学创办人。
中国田径运动员，奥运会冠军，华东师范大学校友。

location.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国上海市

华东师范大学原校长，上海纽约大学首任校长。
桥梁工程与结构力学专家，同济大学前校长、名誉校长。
中国共产党党员，中华人民共和国水利和水电专家及政治人物，原国家级副职领导人。曾任中共第十至第十四届中央委员，第七、八、九届全国政协副主席，中华人民共和国水利部及水利电力部部长，第六届中国红十字会会长。
description.en: A member of the Communist Party of China, an expert in water conservancy and hydropower, and a political figure in the People's Republic of China. She was a former national-level deputy leader, having served as a member of the 10th to 14th Central Committees of the CCP, Vice Chairperson of the 7th, 8th, and 9th National Committees of the CPPCC, Minister of Water Resources and Minister of Water Resources and Electric Power, and the 6th President of the Red Cross Society of China.

description.zh-cn: 前身为重庆土木建筑学院，原建筑老八校之一，2000年并入重庆大学。
数学家。
中华人民共和国教育官员、理学博士、教授兼博士生导师。曾任重庆大学校长、浙江大学校长及北京大学校长。此外，他还曾担任中国社会科学院马克思主义研究院副院长。
description.en: An education official of the People's Republic of China, holding a Doctor of Science degree, a professor, and a doctoral advisor. He formerly served as the President of Chongqing University, Zhejiang University, and Peking University. Additionally, he also served as the Deputy Director of the Academy of Marxism, Chinese Academy of Social Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 中国企业家，华为技术有限公司创始人、集团总裁。
画家、艺术家。
重庆大学研究生院副院长、化学化工学院教授、博士生导师。
重庆大学化学化工学院本科生。
原由重庆大学管理的独立学院。
清朝官员，首任管理大学堂事务大臣。
美国传教士，京师大学堂首任西学总教习。
中国清朝末年设立的第一所新式学校，1902年并入京师大学堂。
中国近代启蒙思想家、翻译家，曾任京师大学堂译书局总办、北京大学校署理校长。他翻译了《天演论》等西方学术名著，系统地将进化论、自由主义等西方思想引入中国。
description.en: A Chinese scholar and translator of the late Qing period, most famous for introducing Western ideas, including Darwin's 'survival of the fittest', to China in the late 19th century.

zh-cn: 国立北京大学 (汪精卫国民政府)

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争时期，日伪政府在北京大学原址上成立的大学。
原北京大学哲学系党总支书记，因贴出“全国第一张马列主义的大字报”而成为文革时期的风云人物。
中国药物化学家，中国中医科学院终身研究员兼首席研究员，青蒿素和双氢青蒿素的发现者，北京大学医学院校友。因其在抗疟药方面的贡献，于2015年获得诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。
description.en: A Chinese pharmaceutical chemist, lifetime researcher and chief researcher at the China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences, and the discoverer of artemisinin and dihydroartemisinin. An alumna of Peking University Medical School. She was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine in 2015 for her contributions to antimalarial drugs.

description.zh-cn: 华裔物理学家，1957年诺贝尔物理学奖得主，国立西南联合大学校友，中国科学院院士。
新东方教育集团创始人，北京大学校友。
中国企业家，百度公司创始人、董事长兼首席执行官，北京大学校友。
description.en: Chinese entrepreneur, co-founder, chairman, and CEO of Baidu.

description.zh-cn: 由北京大学于1986年投资创办的大型控股集团公司，周鸿祎在创立奇虎360之前曾在此就职。
description.en: A large holding group company founded by Peking University in 1986. Zhou Hongyi worked here before founding Qihoo 360.

由国立中央大学和金陵大学学生发起的学生运动。

description.en: A private research university in Baltimore, Maryland, where Woodrow Wilson earned his Ph.D., Iris Chang obtained her Master of Arts degree, and Zhang Xiaoqian once conducted research.

description.zh-cn: 由北京大学农学院、清华大学农学院和华北大学农学院合并而成，为中国农业大学的前身之一。
中国农业大学的前身之一。1952年成立时名为北京机械化农业学院，1953年更名为北京农业机械化学院，1985年更名为北京农业工程大学。
中国农业大学的历史源头，中国现代农业高等教育的起源地。

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议在上海市的委员会。
根据《南京条约》，上海于1843年正式对外开放，成为通商口岸，开启了其近代化进程。
description.en: According to the Treaty of Nanking, Shanghai was officially opened to foreign trade in 1843, becoming a treaty port and beginning its process of modernization.

description.zh-cn: 近代外国在上海设立的拥有独立司法、行政权力的地区。
清朝与英国签订的关于上海租界的章程。
天主教会的主要男修会之一。在明末清初的西学东渐中扮演关键角色，派遣利玛窦等传教士来华，并于17世纪开始将《易经》引介至欧洲。
description.en: One of the main male religious orders of the Catholic Church. Its members, called Jesuits, played a key role in the first phase of West-to-East knowledge transfer by sending missionaries like Matteo Ricci to China, and began introducing the I Ching to Europe in the 17th century.

description.zh-cn: 晚清重臣，洋务运动的领袖之一。他创建并统帅淮军和北洋水师，与曾国藩、张之洞、左宗棠并称“晚清四大名臣”。赵秉钧曾在他手下任职。
description.en: A prominent official in the late Qing dynasty and a leader of the Westernization Movement. He founded and commanded the Huai Army and the Beiyang Fleet, and was known as one of the 'Four Great Officials of the Late Qing' along with Zeng Guofan, Zhang Zhidong, and Zuo Zongtang. Zhao Bingjun once served under him.

description.zh-cn: 上海首家华人新式学堂。
旨在解决城市粮农副食品供应问题的工程。
战国四公子之一。

清朝于雍正七年（1729年）设立的县，位于今湖南省，治所在裴家河。1914年1月因与江西省安福县同名而改名为临澧县。

中华人民共和国的省份，井冈山位于其西南部。
description.en: A province of the People's Republic of China, where the Jinggang Mountains are located in the southwest.

description.zh-cn: 中国设立的第一个经济特区，作为改革开放的试验田，为深圳的早期高速发展提供了政策支持。
description.en: The first Special Economic Zone established in China, serving as a pilot area for reform and opening-up, providing policy support for Shenzhen's early rapid development.

description.zh-cn: 这是一个中国古代行政区划，深圳市的前身。它于东晋咸和六年（331年）始设，历史上长期存在，并曾长期管辖香港岛。
description.en: This ancient administrative division in China, the predecessor of Shenzhen, was first established in 331 AD during the Eastern Jin Dynasty. It existed for a long period and had long-term jurisdiction over Hong Kong Island.

en: Refugee wave from the People's Republic of China to British Hong Kong

description.zh-cn: 指在1950年代至1970年代末，大批中国大陆居民因政治、经济等原因，经由深圳等地非法越境进入英属香港的群众性偷渡事件。该事件是冷战时期历时最长、人数最多的群体性逃亡事件，被认为是促成深圳经济特区建立的原因之一。
description.en: Refers to the mass illegal border crossings of mainland Chinese residents, primarily through Shenzhen, into British Hong Kong from the 1950s to the late 1970s due to political and economic reasons. This event was the longest and largest group escape during the Cold War, and is considered one of the reasons for the establishment of the Shenzhen Special Economic Zone.

description.zh-cn: 招商局集团原常务副董事长，蛇口工业区和招商银行、平安保险等企业的创办者，是深圳经济特区早期的重要开拓者。
description.en: Former executive vice chairman of China Merchants Group, founder of Shekou Industrial Zone and enterprises like China Merchants Bank and Ping An Insurance, and a key pioneer in the early days of the Shenzhen Special Economic Zone.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国第一家完全由企业法人持股的股份制商业银行。
description.en: The first joint-stock commercial bank in the People's Republic of China wholly owned by corporate legal entities.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国第一家由企业创办的商业保险机构，也是中国第一家股份制保险企业，同时也是一个中国综合金融服务集团。郑建源曾通过其控股公司持有该公司大量股份。
description.en: The first commercial insurance institution in the People's Republic of China established by an enterprise, and also the first joint-stock insurance company in China. It is an integrated financial services group, in which Zheng Jianyuan once held a large number of shares through his holding companies.

zh-cn: 中国特色社会主义先行示范区
en: Pilot Demonstration Area of Socialism with Chinese Characteristics

description.zh-cn: 中共中央、国务院支持深圳建设的示范区，承担在制度创新、扩大开放等方面先行先试的重要使命。
description.en: A demonstration area supported by the CPC Central Committee and the State Council for Shenzhen to build, undertaking the important mission of piloting institutional innovation and expanding opening-up.

description.zh-cn: 深圳光明新区红坳村发生的大规模土石崩塌事故，造成73人死亡，是重大的生产安全事故，导致巨大人员伤亡和财产损失。
description.en: A large-scale landslide and debris flow accident occurred in Hong'ao Village, Guangming New District, Shenzhen, resulting in 73 deaths. It was a major industrial safety accident, causing significant casualties and property damage.

zh-cn: 深圳经济特区建立40周年庆祝大会
en: 40th Anniversary of the Shenzhen Special Economic Zone

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。现任中共广东省委副书记，广东省人民政府省长、中共深圳市委书记。中共第二十届中央委员。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China. He is currently the Deputy Secretary of the Guangdong Provincial Committee of the CCP, Governor of Guangdong Province, and Secretary of the Shenzhen Municipal Committee of the CCP. He is a member of the 20th Central Committee of the CCP.

description.en: A Chinese politician, currently serving as the Director of the Standing Committee of the Shenzhen Municipal People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任中共深圳市委副书记、深圳市人民政府市长。

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议在深圳市的地方组织。
description.en: The local organization of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference in Shenzhen.

description.zh-cn: 由杨坚建立的中国朝代，历史上承南北朝、下启唐朝，结束了长期的分裂局面，重新统一了中国。该朝代开始将“省”用于中央政府的一级行政机关。
description.en: A Chinese dynasty founded by Yang Jian, succeeding the Northern and Southern dynasties and preceding the Tang dynasty. It ended a long period of division, reunifying China, and notably began using 'province' as a first-level administrative division of the central government.

description.zh-cn: 隋朝中央政府的一级行政机关之一。
元朝设立的一级地方行政区划，省制的前身。
明朝的一级行政区单位，俗称“行省”。
清朝第六位皇帝清高宗弘历。其在位期间，“省”作为行政区划名称获得官方认可，年号是清朝使用时间最长的年号，并曾下诏为袁崇焕平反，肯定其作为明朝忠臣的功绩。
description.en: The Qianlong Emperor, the sixth emperor of the Qing dynasty. During his reign, 'province' was officially recognized as an administrative division, his era name was the longest-used in the Qing dynasty, and an imperial edict was issued to posthumously rehabilitate Yuan Chonghuan, affirming his merits as a loyal official of the Ming Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 清朝官修典籍，其《舆地考》中使用“省”作为各地区名称。
中华民国的一级行政区单位。
中华民国北洋政府时期的行政区划，位于省与县之间，后被国民政府废除。
抗战胜利后国民政府将中国东北地区重新划分省区的方案。
在美国海军协助下，中华民国将大陈岛军民撤至台湾的行动。
description.en: The operation by the Republic of China, with the assistance of the U.S. Navy, to evacuate military personnel and civilians from the Dachen Islands to Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，现任中华民国总统及民主进步党主席。他曾任中华民国行政院院长（曾在陈明通担任陆委会主委期间任职，并宣布省级机关“去任务化”），也曾任台南市市长（后被监察院弹劾）。他曾在大罢免运动期间表态支持，呼吁民进党与公民同行。
description.en: A politician in the Republic of China, he is the incumbent President and Chairman of the Democratic Progressive Party. He previously served as Premier of the Executive Yuan (during part of Chen Ming-tong's tenure as Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council) and as the Mayor of Tainan (and was later impeached by the Control Yuan). He expressed support for the Great Recall movement, calling on the DPP to stand with the citizens.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国台湾省的议会机关，2018年起去任务化，实质解散。
中华民国福建省的行政机关，2018年起去任务化，实质解散。
法国大革命前的行政区划。
法国大革命后设立的行政单位，取代了旧的行省。

中国古代北方的游牧民族政权，与新朝关系恶化。
中国历史上的一个重要朝代，承五代十国、下启元朝，分为北宋与南宋。971年，宋朝军队攻灭南汉。
description.en: An important era in Chinese history, following the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period and preceding the Yuan dynasty, it was divided into Northern Song and Southern Song. In 971, the Song army conquered the Southern Han.

description.zh-cn: 与北宋同时期由党项族建立的政权，是宋神宗时期北宋在西部的主要军事对手。该政权后被蒙古所灭。
description.en: A state established by the Tangut people, coexisting with the Northern Song dynasty. It was the primary military adversary of the Northern Song in the west during Emperor Shenzong's reign.

宋代名臣

description.zh-cn: 香港特别行政区的宪制性文件。
1860年，清政府与英、法、俄签订了一系列条约。其中，与英法签订的条约结束了第二次鸦片战争，确认了《天津条约》的效力并增加了割让九龙半岛等条款。此后，俄国又以“调停有功”为由，迫使清政府签订条约，承认《瑷珲条约》并将乌苏里江以东约40万平方公里的土地划归俄国。
description.en: In 1860, the Qing government signed a series of treaties. Those with Britain and France concluded the Second Opium War, ratifying the Treaty of Tientsin and adding new clauses, including the cession of the Kowloon Peninsula. Subsequently, Russia, under the pretext of 'meritorious mediation,' compelled the Qing government to sign a treaty that confirmed the Treaty of Aigun and ceded approximately 400,000 square kilometers of territory east of the Ussuri River to Russia.

en: Convention for the Extension of Hong Kong Territory

description.zh-cn: 香港岛是香港三大地域之一，根据《南京条约》被割让给英国。它是香港开埠时最早发展的地区，现为香港的政治、经济、金融和商业中心。岛上最高峰为太平山。
description.en: Hong Kong Island is one of the three main regions of Hong Kong. It was ceded to the United Kingdom under the Treaty of Nanking. As the earliest developed area during Hong Kong's founding, it now serves as the city's political, economic, financial, and commercial center. Its highest point is Victoria Peak.

description.zh-cn: 香港政治人物，现任第六届香港特别行政区行政长官，曾任保安局副局长、保安局局长及政务司司长。
description.en: Hong Kong politician, current Sixth-term Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (HKSAR), and former Under Secretary for Security, Secretary for Security, and Chief Secretary for Administration.

zh-cn: 香港特别行政区基本法第二十三条
en: Article 23 of the Hong Kong Basic Law

description.zh-cn: 《香港特别行政区基本法》中关于国家安全的条文，规定香港特别行政区应自行立法禁止七种危害国家安全行为。其立法工作曾在香港引发巨大争议。
description.en: A provision in the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region concerning national security, which requires the region to enact its own laws to prohibit seven types of acts that endanger national security. Its legislative process caused significant controversy in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 香港特别行政区为履行《基本法》第二十三条规定的宪制责任，就危害国家安全的行为所制定的法律条文。
description.en: A piece of legislation enacted by the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to fulfill its constitutional duty under Article 23 of the Basic Law, targeting acts that endanger national security.

description.zh-cn: 香港特别行政区第七届立法机关。
description.en: The 7th term of the legislature of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

description.zh-cn: 位于香港的公立研究型大学。
description.en: A public research university located in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 最后一任香港总督。
一项由习近平提出的香港管治原则。
中葡两国为解决澳门前途问题而签署的联合声明。

zh-cn: 大不列颠及爱尔兰联合王国
en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

description.zh-cn: 前香港的宗主国。
曾占领澳门的欧洲国家。
英国的中央行政机关。
中华人民共和国为解决台湾问题而提出的统一后政治构想，尚未设立。
指自第二次国共内战后，中国大陆与台湾分治的政治局面及其衍生问题，涉及与台湾政治地位相关的复杂地缘政治议题。
description.en: Refers to the political situation of divided rule between mainland China and Taiwan since the Chinese Civil War, and the complex geopolitical issues concerning Taiwan's political status.

description.zh-cn: 荷兰华裔商人，曾向朝鲜政府建议设立新义州特别行政区并被任命为首任行政长官。
朝鲜设立的特别行政区，旨在模仿“一国两制”模式，但改革未能如期完成。
中华民国大陆时期设立并已撤销的特别行政区，后改为察哈尔省。该区接收了原归绥道下辖的兴和道。
description.en: A former special region during the mainland period of the Republic of China, which took over the Xinghe Circuit formerly under the Guisui Circuit.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国大陆时期已撤销的特别行政区。于1914年由北洋政府设立，1928年被国民政府改制为绥远省。
description.en: A former special administrative region during the period of the Republic of China on the mainland. It was established by the Beiyang government in 1914 and reorganized into Suiyuan Province by the Nationalist government in 1928.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国大陆时期设立的特别行政区，后改为热河省。
中华民国大陆时期设立的特别行政区，后改为西康省。
八国联军总司令。
美国政治人物，曾任美国国务卿，并在2004年美国总统选举中作为民主党候选人与乔治·沃克·布什竞争。
description.en: American politician, former Secretary of State, who ran as the Democratic candidate against George W. Bush in the 2004 presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的一种省级行政区，直接由中央政府管辖，其下级行政区划单位为县级行政区。
description.en: A type of provincial-level administrative division in the People's Republic of China, directly administered by the central government, with county-level divisions as its subordinate units.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国时期的直辖市，现为武汉市的一部分。
description.en: A former municipality during the Republic of China era, now part of the city of Wuhan.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的省级行政区。李克强曾担任该省省委书记，杨彬也曾作为全国人大代表代表该地区。
description.en: A province-level administrative division of the People's Republic of China. Li Keqiang once served as its Provincial Party Secretary, and Yang Bin represented this region as a deputy to the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国东北部的一个省级行政区。
description.en: A provincial-level administrative region in Northeast China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的省级行政区，李国璋的籍贯所在省份。
description.en: A province-level administrative division of the People's Republic of China, and the native province of Li Guozhang.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国省级行政区，由旧直隶省改称而来。
description.en: A province-level administrative division of the People's Republic of China, formerly known as Zhili Province.

description.en: Famous modern Chinese female writer and artist who worked as a researcher at Berkeley.

清朝第九位皇帝，道光帝之子，孝钦显皇后之夫，光绪帝的伯父及嗣父，奕䜣的异母兄。他即位后，面对太平天国起事，曾一度想重用林则徐，并罢免了阻挠此事的穆彰阿。作为第二次鸦片战争期间的中国君主，他在英法联军攻入北京后逃往承德避暑山庄，并于次年病逝。他是中国历史上最后一位掌握实际统治权的皇帝。
description.en: The ninth emperor of the Qing dynasty, son of the Daoguang Emperor, husband of Empress Xiaocingxian, uncle and adoptive father of the Guangxu Emperor, and Yixin's elder half-brother. After ascending the throne, he faced the Taiping Rebellion and once intended to reinstate Lin Zexu, dismissing Mujaangga who obstructed this decision. As the Chinese monarch during the Second Opium War, he fled to the Chengde Mountain Resort after Anglo-French forces entered Beijing and died there the following year. He was the last emperor in Chinese history to hold actual ruling power.

description.zh-cn: 国立清华大学首任校长
清华大学于1925年成立的研究机构，聘请梁启超、王国维、陈寅恪、赵元任为四大导师，旨在研究中国传统文化。
description.en: A research institution established by Tsinghua University in 1925, which appointed Liang Qichao, Wang Guowei, Chen Yinke, and Zhao Yuanren as the 'Four Great Tutors' to study traditional Chinese culture.

description.zh-cn: 华人计算机科学家，2000年图灵奖得主，现任清华大学人工智能学院院长、交叉信息研究院院长。
description.en: A Chinese computer scientist, winner of the 2000 Turing Award, and the current Dean of the Institute for Artificial Intelligence and Dean of the Institute for Interdisciplinary Information Sciences at Tsinghua University.

description.zh-cn: 位于四川省成都市的省级一级示范性普通高中，宣称历史可追溯至西汉的文翁石室。
西汉蜀郡太守，创办了中国最早的地方官办学堂“文翁石室”。
中国汉朝第六位皇帝，汉武帝之父。
西汉第七位皇帝，庙号“世宗”，谥号“孝武皇帝”。他推行“罢黜百家，独尊儒术”，使儒家思想成为官方意识形态，并正式尊《周易》为儒家“五经”之一。在其统治下，征服多个百越王国。晚年多病猜忌，引发巫蛊之祸，错杀太子刘据，逼死皇后卫子夫，后深感后悔。
description.en: The seventh emperor of the Western Han dynasty, with the temple name 'Shizong' and posthumous name 'Xiaowu Emperor'. He implemented the policy of 'dismissing the hundred schools of thought and exclusively revering Confucianism', making it the state ideology, and officially revered the I Ching as one of the Confucian 'Five Classics'. Under his reign, he conquered several Baiyue kingdoms. In his later years, due to illness and paranoia, he instigated the Witchcraft Delusion, wrongly executing Crown Prince Liu Ju and forcing Empress Wei Zifu to commit suicide, an act he later deeply regretted.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代的地理划分，汉代十三州之一，也是汉代至唐代的一个行政区划。此处置为其政府机构。
description.en: A geographical division in ancient China, one of the thirteen provinces of the Han dynasty. It was also an administrative division from the Han to Tang dynasties, and this refers to its government agency.

description.zh-cn: 明末农民起义领袖之一，大西政权的建立者，自称大西皇帝。
description.en: A leader of the peasant rebellions in the late Ming Dynasty and the founder of the Daxi regime.

description.zh-cn: 清朝康熙年间四川按察使。
清末四川总督。
中国近代第一家官办钢铁企业，也是当时亚洲最大的钢铁厂。
description.en: China's first government-run iron and steel enterprise and the largest in Asia at the time.

description.en: A CCP member who was arrested after Xiang Zhongfa betrayed the location of the secretarial office where he was.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国录用公务员的全国性统一考试。
隋朝创立的中国古代通过考试选拔官员的制度，由隋文帝开创先河，打破了世族对官职的垄断，对后世选官制度影响深远。
description.en: A system for selecting officials through examinations, pioneered by Emperor Wen of Sui in the Sui dynasty, which broke the aristocratic monopoly on official positions and had a profound impact on later official selection systems.

description.en: The permanent body of the 10th National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China, which passed the 'Public Security Administration Punishments Law of the People's Republic of China' on August 28, 2005.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院曾经的组成部门，负责国家人事行政管理工作。1988年版的人事部承担了国家机构编制委员会办公室的工作。后与劳动和社会保障部合并为人力资源和社会保障部。
description.en: Formerly a constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for national personnel administration. The 1988 version of the Ministry of Personnel undertook the work of the Office of the National Commission for Institutional Organization. Later, it merged with the Ministry of Labor and Social Security to form the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝之母。
汉武帝嫡长子，卫子夫所生，皇位法定继承人。在巫蛊之祸中，因被江充等人诬陷，无法自辩而被迫起兵，兵败后自缢而死。
description.en: The legitimate eldest son of Emperor Wu of Han and Empress Wei Zifu, and the legal heir to the throne. During the Witchcraft Disaster, he was framed by Jiang Chong and others. Unable to defend himself, he was forced to rebel. After the rebellion failed, he committed suicide by hanging.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝的第二任皇后，太子刘据之母。在巫蛊之祸中支持儿子起兵，兵败后交出皇后玉玺自缢身亡。
description.en: The second empress of Emperor Wu of Han and the mother of Crown Prince Liu Ju. She supported her son's rebellion during the Witchcraft Delusion and committed suicide after its failure.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝的第一任皇后，后因巫蛊被废。
汉武帝宠妃，汉昭帝刘弗陵之母。汉武帝为防止“子幼母壮”外戚专权，在立刘弗陵为太子后将其赐死。
description.en: A favored consort of Emperor Wu and mother of Liu Fuling. To prevent a powerful maternal clan from dominating a young emperor, Emperor Wu had her executed after making Liu Fuling the crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝幼子，巫蛊之祸后，因其他年长皇子或死或不堪，最终被立为太子并继位为汉昭帝，是西汉第八位皇帝。
description.en: The youngest son of Emperor Wu. After the Witchcraft Delusion, with other elder princes either dead or deemed unworthy, he was made Crown Prince and eventually ascended the throne as Emperor Zhao, becoming the eighth emperor of the Western Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 西汉权臣，霍去病异母弟。在巫蛊之祸中未受牵连，后成为汉武帝的托孤之臣，辅佐汉昭帝，并在昭帝死后拥立汉宣帝，掌握朝政大权。
description.en: A powerful statesman of the Western Han and half-brother of Huo Qubing. He remained unscathed by the Witchcraft Delusion and became one of the regents appointed by Emperor Wu. He assisted Emperor Zhao and later enthroned Emperor Xuan, holding significant power.

description.zh-cn: 西汉儒家学者，建议“罢黜百家，表彰六经”。
西汉大臣，建议推行推恩令。
汉武帝宠臣，因得罪太子刘据，担心其继位后对自己不利，遂制造巫蛊之祸，诬陷太子。后被太子起兵所杀。
description.en: A favored official of Emperor Wu of Han. Fearing retaliation after Crown Prince Liu Ju's ascension, he fabricated the witchcraft accusations, instigating the disaster. He was killed by the prince's forces during the uprising.

description.zh-cn: 西汉史学家，因李陵案受宫刑。他在《史记》中高度评价晏婴，并表达了对他的仰慕。
description.en: A historian of the Western Han dynasty who suffered castration due to the Li Ling case. In his work 'Records of the Grand Historian', he highly praised Yan Ying and expressed his admiration for him.

description.zh-cn: 西汉将领，兵败投降匈奴。
西汉音乐家，汉武帝宠臣。
汉朝是中国历史上继秦朝之后的大一统王朝，分为西汉和东汉。王莽曾在此担任要职并篡位。此期间，汉朝官员收集、总结法家学说，使其成为治国基础，同时《周易》也被尊为“五经”之一。
description.en: The Han dynasty, a major unified dynasty in Chinese history, succeeded the Qin dynasty and was divided into Western Han and Eastern Han. Wang Mang held important positions and usurped the throne during this period. Han officials collected and summarized Legalist doctrines, making them the foundation for governance, and the I Ching was also revered as one of the 'Five Classics'.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝设立的宫中决策中枢，用以削弱相权。
中国古代的国立最高学府。
西汉征和二年（前91年）发生在汉武帝晚年的一场政治动乱，被称为巫蛊之祸。因太子刘据被江充等人诬陷以巫蛊诅咒汉武帝，被迫起兵诛杀江充，反被汉武帝认为是谋反，派兵镇压。最终太子兵败自杀，皇后卫子夫自尽，前后罹难者达数万人，对汉朝政治影响深远。
description.en: The Witchcraft Incident (巫蛊之祸), a major political turmoil, occurred in 91 BC during the late reign of Emperor Wu of Han in the Western Han Dynasty. It was triggered by accusations from Jiang Chong and others that Crown Prince Liu Ju was using witchcraft to curse the emperor. Liu Ju was forced to raise an army to execute Jiang Chong but was subsequently deemed a rebel by Emperor Wu, who sent troops to suppress him. This ultimately led to the Crown Prince's defeat and suicide, Empress Wei Zifu's suicide, and the deaths of tens of thousands of people, with profound and far-reaching political consequences for the Han Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝采纳董仲舒建议实行的文化政策，确立了儒家思想在中国的主导地位，从而提升了《论语》等儒家经典的地位。
description.en: A cultural policy implemented during the reign of Emperor Wu of Han that established the dominance of Confucianism in China, thereby elevating the status of Confucian classics like the Analects.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝为削弱诸侯王势力而颁布的法令。
汉武帝晚年颁布的一份重要诏书，反思其过去穷兵黩武的政策，宣布停止对外征伐，转向休养生息，富国安民。
description.en: An important edict issued by Emperor Wu in his later years, reflecting on his past militaristic policies. He announced a shift from foreign conquests to policies focused on recuperation and enriching the populace.

description.zh-cn: 中国清朝第三位皇帝，也是清朝入关后的第一位皇帝。他是康熙帝之父，孝庄太皇太后之子。他在位期间，对李自成焚毁的紫禁城进行了重建。
description.en: The third emperor of the Qing dynasty and the first to rule after entering the Central Plains via Shanhai Pass. He was the father of Emperor Kangxi and son of Empress Dowager Xiaozhuang. During his reign, he initiated the reconstruction of the Forbidden City which had been burned by Li Zicheng.

description.zh-cn: 顺治帝妃，康熙帝生母。
清朝初年权臣，康熙帝早期的辅政大臣之一。
description.en: A powerful minister in the early Qing dynasty, one of the four regents during the early reign of the Kangxi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 17世纪于台湾的政权
准噶尔汗国首领
德国耶稣会传教士，与顺治帝建立了私人友谊。
蒙古科尔沁部人，清朝初期的女政治家。清太宗皇太极之妃，顺治帝生母，康熙帝之祖母。她先后辅佐皇太极、顺治帝、康熙帝，对清朝初年的政治稳定和发展有重要影响，是清朝入关后的政权奠基人之一。
description.en: A female politician in the early Qing dynasty from the Khorchin Mongol tribe. She successively assisted Hong Taiji, the Shunzhi Emperor, and the Kangxi Emperor, playing a significant role in the political stability and development of the early Qing dynasty and was one of the key founders of the Qing regime after entering the Shanhai Pass.

description.zh-cn: 清朝将领
明郑末代君主
耶稣会传教士
清朝火器专家
17世纪至18世纪天主教会关于中国传统礼仪问题的争论
罗马教廷是天主教会的最高权力机构，对梵蒂冈城邦拥有直接统治权，在国际法上是主权实体。
description.en: The supreme body of government of the Catholic Church, which is a sovereign entity under international law.

description.zh-cn: 源于孔子思想，由其创立的学术派别，是一个包含哲学、伦理、政治的中国思想体系。它以《论语》为核心经典之一，庄子曾对其部分主张持批评态度。
description.en: Originating from Confucius's thought, and founded by him as an academic school, it is a Chinese system of philosophical, ethical, and political thought. The Analects is one of its core classic texts, and some of its tenets were criticized by Zhuangzi.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝的嫡次子，曾两度被立为皇太子，后被废黜。
description.en: The second son of the Kangxi Emperor, he was twice appointed as Crown Prince and later deposed.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝第一任皇后
康熙帝皇贵妃，雍正帝生母。
description.en: An Imperial Noble Consort of the Kangxi Emperor and the birth mother of the Yongzheng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 徐才厚的妻子
徐才厚的女儿

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军国防大学
中国人民解放军军事政治大学
en: People's Liberation Army National Defense University
National Defense University of PLA China

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军的最高军事学府，是中央军委副战区级直属单位。该校于1986年1月15日由军事学院、后勤学院、政治学院合并成立，并于2017年进行了新调整组建。历史上，中国人民解放军曾于1969年由高等军事学院、军事学院、政治学院、后勤学院四校合并组建类似机构，但于1977年撤销。王抗平为该校校友。
description.en: The highest military academy of the People's Liberation Army, it is a deputy theater-grade unit directly under the Central Military Commission. The academy was established on January 15, 1986, by merging the Military Academy, the Logistics Academy, and the Political Academy, and underwent a new restructuring and reorganization in 2017. Historically, a similar institution was formed in 1969 by the merger of the PLA Higher Military Academy, Military Academy, Political Academy, and Logistics Academy, but it was disbanded in 1977. Wang Kangping is an alumnus of the academy.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军济南军区

description.zh-cn: 曾为中国人民解放军七大军区之一

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军第七十八集团军
中国人民解放军陆军第十六集团军

description.zh-cn: 曾任总政治部副主任、中央军委纪委书记
原中国人民解放军总后勤部副部长。
原济南军区政治部主任
美国政治人物，在乔治·沃克·布什总统任内接替拉姆斯菲尔德担任国防部长。
description.en: American politician who succeeded Donald Rumsfeld as Secretary of Defense during the presidency of George W. Bush.

description.zh-cn: 网刊
一份由中国知识分子、维权人士、异见人士等各界人士于2008年发起的宣言，旨在促进中国民主化、改善人权状况，并提出建立中华联邦共和国的构想。
description.en: A declaration initiated in 2008 by Chinese intellectuals, rights activists, dissidents, and others from various sectors, aiming to promote democratization and improve human rights in China, and proposing the establishment of a Federal Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国民主运动

description.zh-cn: 一系列在中华人民共和国境内发生的，旨在推动政治民主化、保障公民权利的社会政治运动。八六学潮是其重要组成部分，魏京生是其中的代表人物之一。
description.en: A series of socio-political movements within the People's Republic of China, aimed at promoting political democratization and the protection of civil rights. The 1986 student demonstrations are an important part of this movement, and Wei Jingsheng is one of its representative figures.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国北京市人民政府下属的公安机关。该机构曾负责调查和拘押艾未未，其人员曾在成都殴打艾未未，并主导了2011年将其秘密关押81天的行动。

description.en: Empress of the Yongle Emperor Zhu Di, mother of the Hongxi Emperor and Zhu Gaoxu, and daughter of the Ming Dynasty founding general Xu Da.

description.zh-cn: 明朝初年燕王朱棣与建文帝之间的一场因削藩引发的内战，最终燕王朱棣获胜并即位为明成祖。
description.en: A civil war in the early years of the Ming dynasty, resulting in the victory of Zhu Di, the Prince of Yan, who became the Yongle Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 明朝学者、官员、内阁首辅。曾任《永乐大典》首任主编（总裁官），并与李景隆等人一同重修《明太祖实录》。后被锦衣卫指挥使纪纲害死。
description.en: A Ming dynasty scholar, official, and Grand Secretary. He served as the first chief editor of the Yongle Encyclopedia and was involved in revising the Veritable Records of Emperor Taizu of Ming with Li Jinglong. He was later killed by Ji Gang, the commander of the Jinyiwei.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代最大的类书，由明成祖朱棣下令编纂，收录了明初之前各种学科的文献资料。
description.en: The largest leishu (a type of reference book) in ancient China, commissioned by the Yongle Emperor of the Ming dynasty. It collected a vast amount of literature and knowledge from before the early Ming dynasty.

description.en: A series of maritime expeditions during the Yongle and Xuande reigns of the Ming dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 明朝的特务与秘密警察机构，由宦官掌管。魏忠贤在天启年间总督东厂，大肆缉捕迫害异己。
description.en: A spy agency of the Ming dynasty, controlled by eunuchs. Wei Zhongxian commanded the Eastern Depot during the Tianqi era, using it to arrest and persecute his opponents.

description.zh-cn: 明朝政治家、高僧，明成祖靖难之役的主要策划者，在《永乐大典》重修时担任监修。
description.en: A Ming dynasty politician and Buddhist monk who served as a supervisor for the revision of the Yongle Encyclopedia.

description.zh-cn: 明代学者、官员、文学家、儒学大师，建文帝时期翰林院侍讲、大臣。在其著作《叶郑传》和《先府君行状》中记载了空印案的相关情况。曾请求诛杀李景隆。靖难之变后因拒绝为朱棣草拟即位诏书而被杀。
description.en: A Ming dynasty scholar, official, literary figure, and renowned Confucian master, who served as a Hanlin Academy lecturer and minister during the Jianwen Emperor's reign. He recorded details about the Empty Seal Case in his works 'Biography of Ye and Zheng' and 'Conduct of My Late Father'. He also requested the execution of Li Jinglong. After the Jingnan Campaign, he was executed for refusing to draft the enthronement edict for Zhu Di.

description.zh-cn: 建文帝时期兵部尚书，曾极力反对任命李景隆为大将军。靖难之变后被朱棣所杀。
description.en: During the reign of the Jianwen Emperor, he served as Minister of War and strongly opposed the appointment of Li Jinglong as Grand General. He was killed by Zhu Di after the Jingnan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 他曾是建文帝时期的太常寺卿，主张削藩。他推荐李景隆为大将军，但在靖难之变后被朱棣所杀。
description.en: He served as Grand Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices during the Jianwen Emperor's reign, advocating for reducing the power of the princes. He recommended Li Jinglong as Grand General and was subsequently killed by Zhu Di after the Jingnan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 李景隆，明朝开国功臣李文忠之子，袭封曹国公。作为明朝初期将领，在靖难之役中初期任建文帝方主帅，屡败于燕王朱棣，后于南京开金川门投降。永乐年间被削爵圈禁，并于永乐末年去世。
description.en: Li Jinglong, son of Li Wenzhong, a founding duke of the Ming Dynasty, inherited the title Duke of Cao. As an early Ming general, he served as the chief commander of the Jianwen Emperor's forces during the early stages of the Jingnan campaign, suffering repeated defeats against Zhu Di, the Prince of Yan. He later surrendered by opening the Jinchuan Gate in Nanjing. He was stripped of his title and placed under house arrest during the Yongle era, and passed away towards the end of the Yongle reign.

description.zh-cn: 中国1989年六四事件学生运动领袖之一。事件后遭通缉并流亡海外，先后在法国、美国求学和居住。现为网络“六四档案”、“孙文学校”创办人，柴玲前夫。
description.en: One of the student leaders of the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests in China. He became a wanted fugitive after the event and went into exile, studying and residing in France and the United States. He is the founder of the 'June 4th Archive' website and the 'Sun Yat-sen School' online, and the ex-husband of Chai Ling.

description.zh-cn: 位于吉林省长春市，是以培养飞行人才为主的综合性高等军事院校，隶属中国人民解放军空军。其历史可追溯至由东北人民解放军航空学校于1949年5月更名而来的机构。学校于2004年6月9日由多所院校合并组建。其前身院校包括：1993年由空军第一飞行基础学校（该校前身为1986年由空军第一航空预备学校更名而来的机构，后于1993年升格为空军长春飞行学院）升格而来的机构；1992年10月由空军第二航空技术专科学校（该校前身为1986年由空军第二航空机务学校升格而来，并于1992年升格为空军第二航空学院）升格而成的机构；以及1986年6月更名并持续至2004年合并组建的空军第七航空学校（该校源于1949年由牡丹江航校定名，并于1952年1月更名为空军第七航空学校，活跃于1949年12月20日-1952年1月）。此外，由空军第十三航空学校于1986年7月升格而来的某机构，也于2012年4月并入空军航空大学。2017年在深化国防和军队改革中，学校进行了调整重组。
description.en: Located in Changchun, Jilin Province, it is a comprehensive higher military institution mainly for training flight personnel, affiliated with the PLA Air Force. Its history can be traced back to an institution renamed from the Northeast People's Liberation Army Aviation School in May 1949. The university itself was initially formed on June 9, 2004, by the merger of several institutions. Its predecessor institutions include: an institution upgraded in 1993 from the Air Force First Flight Basic School (which originated from the Air Force First Aviation Preparatory School, renamed in 1986, and later upgraded to Air Force Changchun Flight College in 1993); an institution upgraded from the Air Force Second Aeronautical Technical College in October 1992 (this college was upgraded from the Air Force Second Aeronautical and Mechanical School in 1986 and further upgraded to the Air Force Second Aviation College in 1992); and the Air Force Seventh Aviation School (which originated from the Mudanjiang Aviation School in 1949, was renamed the Air Force Seventh Aviation School in January 1952, active from December 20, 1949, to January 1952, and was later renamed in June 1986 and continued until the 2004 merger). Additionally, an institution upgraded from the Air Force Thirteenth Aviation School in July 1986 was merged into the Air Force Aviation University in April 2012. It was further reorganized in 2017 during the reform of national defense and the military.

孝钦显皇后之母。
清朝第十位皇帝，孝钦显皇后与咸丰帝的独子，光绪帝的堂兄。
咸丰帝的皇后，同治年间的两宫皇太后之一。她与慈禧太后一同垂帘听政，是奕䜣的重要政治盟友。
description.en: Empress consort of the Xianfeng Emperor and one of the two empress dowagers during the Tongzhi era. She co-reigned with Empress Dowager Cixi and was an important political ally of Yixin.

description.zh-cn: 清朝晚期皇室宗室，著名的改革家、政治家、军事家、外交家和洋务派领袖。道光帝第六子，咸丰帝异母弟。他曾任总理衙门首席大臣、领班军机大臣等要职，是同治朝及光绪朝前期朝廷的最高掌权者之一，也是洋务运动的主要发起者和领导者。此外，他曾被任命为全权钦差大臣，负责与英法联军进行谈判并签订《北京条约》，并在辛酉政变中与慈禧合作，但后来被罢免。
description.en: A prince of the Manchu Aisin Gioro clan, an important statesman, reformer, military strategist, diplomat, and a key leader of the Self-Strengthening Movement during the late Qing dynasty. He was the sixth son of the Daoguang Emperor and the younger half-brother of the Xianfeng Emperor. He served as the head of the Zongli Yamen and Grand Councilor, making him one of the most powerful figures during the Tongzhi and early Guangxu eras. He was also appointed as imperial commissioner with plenipotentiary powers to negotiate with the Anglo-French forces and sign the Convention of Peking. Furthermore, he collaborated with Empress Dowager Cixi during the Xinyou Coup but was later dismissed.

description.zh-cn: 咸丰帝临终前任命的辅佐同治帝的八位大臣，以载垣、端华、肃顺为首。他们在辛酉政变中被推翻。
description.en: A group of eight officials appointed by the Xianfeng Emperor on his deathbed to assist the young Tongzhi Emperor, led by Zaiyuan, Duanhua, and Sushun. They were overthrown in the Xinyou Coup.

description.zh-cn: 慈禧太后联合恭亲王奕䜣发动的宫廷政变，夺取了实际统治权。
中华民国时期军阀，原国民革命军将领。他因盗掘清东陵而臭名昭著。1943年4月被俘后，他投靠了汪精卫国民政府。
description.en: A warlord during the Republic of China era and a former general of the National Revolutionary Army. He was notorious for looting the Eastern Tombs of the Qing Dynasty. After being captured in April 1943, he defected to the Wang Jingwei regime.

description.zh-cn: 庚子国变后，清政府推行的一系列改革措施。
清末，由清政府主导的君主立宪准备活动，同时也是一场政治改革运动，其发生受到了日本以君主立宪政体战胜专制俄国的鼓舞。在此期间，也涌现出主张君主立宪的政治派别，他们在四川发动和领导了保路运动，并力图将其控制在和平抗议的范围内。
description.en: In the late Qing Dynasty, China saw a government-led preparatory movement for a constitutional monarchy, a political reform greatly encouraged by Japan's victory as a constitutional monarchy over the autocratic Russian Empire. Concurrently, political factions advocating constitutional monarchy emerged, notably initiating and leading the Railway Protection Movement in Sichuan, striving to keep it within peaceful protest bounds.

description.zh-cn: 顾命八大臣之首，在辛酉政变中被奕䜣等人定罪处死。
description.en: Leader of the Eight Regent Ministers, who was convicted and executed by Yixin and his allies during the Xinyou Coup.

description.zh-cn: 清朝雍正帝的嫡妻，正宫皇后，出身于满洲正黄旗乌拉那拉氏，是内大臣费扬古之女。
description.en: Empress Xiaojingxian was the empress consort of the Yongzheng Emperor of the Qing dynasty. She was from the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner Ulanara clan and the daughter of Fiyanggū, an Inner Court Minister.

description.zh-cn: 清朝皇太后，雍正帝之贵妃，乾隆帝之生母。
清朝宗室，康熙帝第八子，雍正帝异母弟，也是其政治对手。因参与九子夺嫡，被雍正帝圈禁，改名阿其那，后在禁所病故。人称“八贤王”。他曾获清朝亲王爵位。
description.en: An imperial prince of the Qing dynasty, the eighth son of the Kangxi Emperor and a half-brother of the Yongzheng Emperor. Due to his involvement in the nine sons' succession struggle, he was imprisoned by the Yongzheng Emperor, forced to change his name to Akina, and later died in confinement. He was known as the 'Eighth Virtuous Prince'. He once held a princely title of the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝第九子，雍正帝的政治对手。
description.en: The ninth son of the Kangxi Emperor and a political rival of the Yongzheng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝第十四子，雍正帝同母弟。
description.en: The fourteenth son of the Kangxi Emperor, a full brother of the Yongzheng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，康熙帝第十三子，雍正帝异母弟、得力助手。清朝有史以来第九位铁帽子王，也是第一位因功受封的铁帽子王。雍正帝即位后，改名允祥，逝世后获准改回原名。谥号“贤”。
description.en: An imperial prince of the Qing dynasty, the 13th son of the Kangxi Emperor and a half-brother of the Yongzheng Emperor, and a key assistant to him. He was the 9th iron-cap prince in Qing history and the first to be granted the title for merit. He changed his name to Yunxiang after the Yongzheng Emperor's accession, and was allowed to revert to his original name posthumously. His posthumous name was 'Xian'.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝第三子。
康熙帝第十子。
雍正帝第三子，后被过继给允禩。
description.en: The third son of the Yongzheng Emperor, later adopted into Yinsi's lineage.

description.zh-cn: 清朝将领，雍正时期重臣，后被雍正帝赐死。
description.en: An important official during the Yongzheng era of the Qing Dynasty, later forced to commit suicide by the Yongzheng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 清朝康熙、雍正两朝重臣，佟国维之子，康熙帝表弟，孝懿仁皇后之弟，雍正帝舅舅。
description.en: An important official during the Kangxi and Yongzheng eras of the Qing Dynasty, son of Tung-gowei, cousin of the Kangxi Emperor, younger brother of Empress Xiaoyiren, and uncle of the Yongzheng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 雍正时期首席军机大臣，大学士，雍正帝遗命的辅政大臣之一。
清初学者，其著作在雍正年间引发文字狱。
清朝一种官员向皇帝直接汇报的制度，由雍正帝完善并强化。
清朝的一项重要税制改革。
清朝的一项财政改革措施。
清朝在西南少数民族地区推行的政治改革。

en: List of Qing ambans in Tibet

description.zh-cn: 清朝中央政府派驻西藏的代表官员职位。
清朝康熙末年，九位皇子争夺皇位的历史事件。
description.en: A historical event during the late Kangxi era of the Qing dynasty where nine of his sons vied for the throne.

location.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国北京市东城区
location.en: Dongcheng District, Beijing, People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 位于北京中轴线中心的宫殿建筑群，是中国明清两代二十四位皇帝的皇家宫殿。始建于1406年，1420年落成，是世界上现存规模最大、最完整的宫殿型建筑。孝庄太皇太后曾在此长期居住并逝世。现为故宫博物院所在地。
description.en: The palace complex at the center of Beijing's central axis served as the imperial palace for 24 emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties. Construction started in 1406 and was completed in 1420, making it the world's largest and most complete preserved palace complex. Empress Dowager Xiaozhuang resided here for a long time and passed away. It now houses the Palace Museum.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝皇帝，唐高宗李治与武则天之幼子，唐玄宗李隆基之父，李显和安定公主之弟。他曾两次登基、两次禅位，是唐朝第五位和第九位皇帝。
description.en: An emperor of the Tang dynasty, the youngest son of Emperor Gaozong Li Zhi and Empress Wu Zetian, father of Emperor Xuanzong Li Longji, and younger brother of Li Xian and Princess Anding. He ascended the throne twice and abdicated twice, serving as the fifth and ninth emperor of the Tang dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 唐睿宗妃，唐玄宗李隆基生母。
中国历史上唯一获正史承认的女性皇帝，武周皇帝，唐玄宗的祖母。她也是安定公主的母亲，在公主出生时为唐高宗的昭仪。
description.en: The only female emperor in Chinese history recognized by official history, Empress of the Wu Zhou dynasty, and grandmother of Emperor Xuanzong of Tang. She was also the mother of Princess Anding and Emperor Gaozong's Zhaoyi when the princess was born.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝宰相，杨贵妃的堂兄。与安禄山不和，是安史之乱的导火索之一，后在马嵬驿兵变中被杀。
description.en: Chancellor of the Tang Dynasty and cousin of Imperial Consort Yang. His conflict with An Lushan was a major catalyst for the rebellion, and he was killed during the Mawei Mutiny.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝三镇节度使，安史之乱的发动者，建立大燕政权。
description.en: A military governor of three regions in the Tang Dynasty, initiator of the An Lushan Rebellion, and founder of the Yan state.

description.zh-cn: 安史之乱期间，唐玄宗出逃途中，禁军将领陈玄礼率兵发动兵变，杀死了杨国忠，并处死了杨贵妃。
description.en: During the An Lushan Rebellion, a mutiny launched by imperial guard general Chen Xuanli during Emperor Xuanzong's flight, resulting in the executions of Yang Guozhong and Imperial Consort Yang.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝第七位皇帝，李亨，唐玄宗第三子。
唐玄宗统治前期出现的治世，是唐朝的极盛时期，最终因安史之乱而终结。
description.en: The golden age of the Tang Dynasty during the early reign of Emperor Xuanzong, which came to an end with the An Lushan Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 唐玄宗第十八子，杨贵妃前夫。
唐朝公主，唐高宗李治与武则天的小女儿，唐玄宗的姑姑，安定公主的同胞妹妹。她曾与李隆基发生政治斗争。
description.en: A princess of the Tang dynasty, the youngest daughter of Emperor Gaozong Li Zhi and Empress Wu Zetian, an aunt of Emperor Xuanzong, and a full sister of Princess Anding. She was involved in a political struggle with Li Longji.

description.zh-cn: 唐中宗李显的第二任皇后，曾临朝称制，后在唐隆政变中被杀。
由李隆基与太平公主发动的宫廷政变，诛杀韦皇后及其党羽，拥立唐睿宗复辟。
唐玄宗宠妃，谗害太子李瑛等人。
唐玄宗第二子，曾为太子，后被武惠妃谗言所害。
唐玄宗时期宰相，因其“口蜜腹剑”的权术而著称。他为巩固自身权位，建议重用胡人将领，间接导致安禄山势力坐大，为安史之乱埋下隐患。
description.en: A chancellor during Emperor Xuanzong's reign, known for his 'sweet words and treacherous heart' (口蜜腹剑). To consolidate his own power, he advocated for the heavy use of non-Han generals, which indirectly led to An Lushan's growing influence and laid the groundwork for the An Lushan Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝是由李渊建立的中国历史上的一个重要朝代，被认为是中国的黄金时代之一，也是安定公主生活的时代背景。其国力因安史之乱由盛转衰。著名诗人白居易在此期间生活并担任官职。唐昭宗是其晚期的皇帝。
description.en: The Tang Dynasty, founded by Li Yuan, was an important period in Chinese history and is considered one of China's golden ages, and also the historical context for Princess Anding's life. Its national power declined from its peak due to the An Lushan Rebellion. The renowned poet Bai Juyi lived and served as an official during this era. Emperor Zhaozong was one of its late rulers.

description.zh-cn: 唐玄宗嫔妃，唐肃宗生母。
唐朝、西汉以及东汉末年的首都。作为西汉首都，它曾是巫蛊之祸中太子与丞相军队激战的主要地点。在唐朝，唐昭宗曾多次被迫离开此地。在东汉末年，它曾被李傕、郭汜等人攻占。
description.en: The capital of the Tang, Western Han, and late Eastern Han dynasties. As the Western Han capital, it was the main site of fierce battles between the Crown Prince's and the Chancellor's forces during the Witchcraft Delusion. During the Tang dynasty, Emperor Zhaozong was forced to leave the city multiple times. In the late Eastern Han dynasty, it was captured by Li Jue, Guo Si, and others.

description.zh-cn: 卡尔·马克思的妻子，出身于普鲁士贵族家庭。
description.en: The wife of Karl Marx, from a Prussian aristocratic family.

description.zh-cn: 卡尔·马克思的母亲，出身于荷兰一个富裕的商人家庭。
description.en: Karl Marx's mother, from a wealthy Dutch merchant family.

description.zh-cn: 卡尔·马克思的长女。
卡尔·马克思的次女。
卡尔·马克思的幼女。

zh-cn: 路德维希·冯·威斯特华伦

description.zh-cn: 燕妮·马克思的父亲，卡尔·马克思的岳父。
卡尔·马克思的政治经济学批判著作。
description.en: A foundational theoretical text in materialist philosophy, economics and politics by Karl Marx.

description.zh-cn: 位于普鲁士王国的城市，卡尔·马克思的出生地。
description.en: A city in the Kingdom of Prussia, the birthplace of Karl Marx.

description.zh-cn: 英国首都及最大都市，英格兰首府。由罗马人于公元43年建立，现为世界领先的全球城市之一，在艺术、商业、教育、金融、媒体、旅游和交通方面具有显著地位。这里也是马克思长期流亡、进行研究和最终逝世的地方。
description.en: The capital and largest city of the United Kingdom and England. Founded by the Romans in 43 AD, it is now one of the world's leading global cities, with significant influence in arts, commerce, education, finance, media, tourism, and transport. It is also the place where Marx lived in exile for a long time, conducted his research, and eventually died.

description.zh-cn: 马克思于1835年至1836年就读的大学。
description.en: The university Marx attended from 1835 to 1836.

description.zh-cn: 位于德国柏林的公立研究型大学。马克思曾于1836年至1841年在此就读，并深受黑格尔哲学的影响。
description.en: A public research university in Berlin, Germany. Karl Marx attended this university from 1836 to 1841, during which he was deeply influenced by Hegelian philosophy.

description.zh-cn: 1841年授予马克思哲学博士学位的大学。
description.en: The university that awarded Marx his PhD in Philosophy in 1841.

description.zh-cn: 一个激进的思想家团体，从左翼视角批判当时的社会、政治与宗教体制，马克思曾是其中一员。
description.en: A group of radical thinkers who criticized the social, political, and religious institutions of their time from a left-wing perspective, of which Marx was a member.

zh-cn: 格奥尔格·威廉·弗里德里希·黑格尔

description.zh-cn: 德国哲学家，德国古典哲学的集大成者。其辩证法思想对马克思产生了深远影响。他曾批评《论语》为常识道德，并无出色之处。
description.en: A German philosopher and a major figure in German idealism. His dialectical method profoundly influenced Marx. He was also critical of the Analects, considering its content to be common-sense morality with nothing outstanding.

description.zh-cn: 由正义者同盟改组而成的国际无产阶级政党，委托马克思和恩格斯起草了《共产党宣言》。
description.en: An international proletarian political party reorganized from the League of the Just, which commissioned Marx and Engels to write The Communist Manifesto.

description.zh-cn: 一个旨在联合各国工人阶级进行斗争的国际组织，马克思是其创始人和核心领导人之一。
description.en: An international organization aiming to unite the working classes of different countries for struggle, of which Marx was a founder and one of its key leaders.

description.zh-cn: 俄国革命家和无政府主义理论家，在第一国际中与马克思展开了激烈的斗争。
description.en: A Russian revolutionary and anarchist theorist who engaged in a fierce struggle with Marx within the First International.

description.zh-cn: 德国哲学家，青年黑格尔派的领导人物之一，马克思早期的朋友，后成为其批判对象。
description.en: German philosopher and one of the leaders of the Young Hegelians. He was an early friend of Marx who later became a target of his criticism.

description.zh-cn: 科隆的激进派报刊，马克思曾于1842年担任其主编，后被普鲁士政府查禁。
description.en: A radical newspaper in Cologne, where Marx served as editor in 1842 before it was banned by the Prussian government.

description.zh-cn: 18世纪在神圣罗马帝国内崛起的强权，与奥地利争夺德意志地区领导权。19世纪时作为德意志邦国，是马克思的出生地。
description.en: A major power that emerged in the Holy Roman Empire in the 18th century, contending with Austria for leadership in the German region. In the 19th century, it was a German kingdom and Marx's birthplace.

description.zh-cn: 激进左翼报刊。
德国社会活动家。
共产主义者同盟的前身。
马克思与恩格斯合作撰写的第一部著作，批判了青年黑格尔派的代表人物布鲁诺·鲍威尔。
description.en: The first collaborative work by Marx and Engels, criticizing Bruno Bauer, a leading figure of the Young Hegelians.

description.zh-cn: 法国内政部长。
德国哲学家和人类学家，其唯物主义思想对青年马克思产生了重要影响，但马克思后来在《关于费尔巴哈的提纲》中对其进行了批判。
description.en: A German philosopher and anthropologist whose materialist ideas significantly influenced the young Marx, though Marx later criticized him in 'Theses on Feuerbach'.

description.zh-cn: 马克思于1847年出版的著作，旨在回应和批判皮埃尔-约瑟夫·蒲鲁东的《贫困的哲学》。
description.en: A book published by Marx in 1847, intended as a response and critique to Pierre-Joseph Proudhon's 'The Philosophy of Poverty'.

description.zh-cn: 法国无政府社会主义者，其思想在《哲学的贫困》中受到马克思的批判。
description.en: A French anarcho-socialist whose ideas were criticized by Marx in 'The Poverty of Philosophy'.

zh-cn: 新莱茵报：民主派机关报

description.zh-cn: 美国报纸，马克思在1852年至1862年间担任其欧洲通讯员。
description.en: An American newspaper for which Marx served as a European correspondent from 1852 to 1862.

description.zh-cn: 1871年巴黎市民发动的起义，建立了短暂的工人阶级政权，马克思在《法兰西内战》中为其正名。
description.en: An uprising by the citizens of Paris in 1871 that established a short-lived working-class government, which Marx defended in 'The Civil War in France'.

description.zh-cn: 马克思为第一国际撰写的小册子，分析并支持了1871年的巴黎公社运动。
description.en: A pamphlet written by Marx for the First International, analyzing and supporting the Paris Commune of 1871.

description.zh-cn: 德国社会民主党创始人。
德国社会民主党领袖。
德国工人运动活动家。
苏格兰古典政治经济学家和哲学家，被誉为“经济学之父”，其自由市场经济理论影响了福泽谕吉。
description.en: A Scottish classical political economist and philosopher, known as 'The Father of Economics', whose theories on free-market economy influenced Fukuzawa Yukichi.

description.zh-cn: 古典政治经济学家。
张献忠建立的政权，定都成都。
明朝大臣。
张献忠养子。
张献忠养子。
张献忠养子。
张献忠养子。
明朝末年爆发的大规模农民起义，李自成是其中的主要领袖之一。
description.en: Large-scale peasant uprisings that broke out in the late Ming dynasty, with Li Zicheng being one of the main leaders.

description.zh-cn: 明末民变首领。
明末民变首领。
明末民变领袖，闯王，李自成舅父。
明末清初政治人物，曾任将领，后降清。
明末将领。
明朝兵部尚书。
明末大臣，曾任东阁大学士、督师，负责围剿农民起义军。
description.en: A minister of the late Ming Dynasty who served as Grand Secretary of the East Cabinet and Supreme Commander, responsible for suppressing peasant rebellions.

description.zh-cn: 明朝襄王。
明朝监军兵备副使。
明朝楚定王。
明朝瑞王。
明朝四川巡抚。
明朝四川巡抚。
明朝蜀王。
清朝肃亲王，皇太极长子，曾与多尔衮争夺皇位。
description.en: The eldest son of Hong Taiji, who contended with Dorgon for the throne.

description.zh-cn: 明末清初将领。
明朝灭亡后，由明朝宗室在南方建立的政权。
西方传教士。
西方传教士。

en: An Account of the Entry of the Catholic Religion into Sichuan

description.zh-cn: 记录张献忠屠杀事迹的书籍。
南明军官。

zh-cn: 香港特别行政区行政长官

description.zh-cn: 香港特别行政区及香港特别行政区政府的首长职位。
description.en: The position of the head of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

description.zh-cn: 香港政治人物，曾任香港特别行政区行政长官。
description.en: A Hong Kong politician who served as the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

description.zh-cn: 曾任香港特别行政区行政长官。

zh-cn: 香港特别行政区行政会议

description.zh-cn: 梁振英之父，香港警员。
梁振英之母。
梁振英之妻，律师。
description.en: Spouse of Leung Chun-ying

description.zh-cn: 梁振英长子。
description.en: Son of Leung Chun-ying

description.zh-cn: 香港前行政长官梁振英次女

zh-cn: 荷李活道已婚警察宿舍
en: Former Hollywood Road Police Married Quarters
University of the West of England

zh-cn: 2012年香港特别行政区行政长官选举
第4届香港特别行政区行政长官选举

location.en: Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre

description.zh-cn: 香港特别行政区第四届行政长官选举，由1200人组成的选举委员会选出行政长官，最终梁振英以689票当选。
description.en: The 4th Chief Executive election of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, where the Chief Executive was elected by a 1,200-member Election Committee. Leung Chun-ying was ultimately elected with 689 votes.

en: Occupy Central with Love and Peace

zh-cn: 梁振英涉嫌收取澳洲企业款项事件

description.zh-cn: 大律师。
曾任全国政协副主席。
香港政治人物，2012年香港特别行政区行政长官选举候选人。曾任香港特别行政区政务司司长、财政司司长。
description.en: Hong Kong politician, candidate in the 2012 Hong Kong Chief Executive election. He previously served as Chief Secretary for Administration and Financial Secretary of Hong Kong.

zh-cn: 2012年香港特别行政区行政长官选举电视辩论

description.zh-cn: 曾任全国政协委员，梁振英竞选办成员。
香港传媒人
被指为香港江湖人物，曾与梁振英竞选团队成员在流浮山小桃园饭局会面。
description.en: Alleged Hong Kong triad figure who met with members of Leung Chun-ying's campaign team at the Lau Fau Shan "Little Peach Garden" dinner.

description.zh-cn: 香港政治人物，梁振英竞选办公室主要成员。
description.en: Hong Kong politician, a key member of Leung Chun-ying's campaign office.

description.zh-cn: 溥仪生母，载沣的元配嫡福晋，大学士荣禄之女。
description.en: The primary consort of Zaifeng and the daughter of the Grand Secretary Ronglu.

description.zh-cn: 清末民初军阀，曾于1917年率兵进入北京，拥立清废帝溥仪复辟，但迅速失败。
description.en: A warlord in the late Qing and early Republic, who led troops into Beijing in 1917 to restore the deposed emperor Puyi, but failed quickly.

description.zh-cn: 由冯玉祥发动的军事政变，推翻了直系军阀控制的时任大总统曹锟政府，并导致溥仪被逐出紫禁城。
description.en: A military coup launched by Feng Yuxiang that overthrew the Zhili clique-controlled government of then-President Cao Kun, and led to Puyi's expulsion from the Forbidden City.

description.zh-cn: 苏联在二战末期对日本展开的军事行动，在满洲国发起并迅速击溃关东军，直接导致了满洲国的覆灭，并与原子弹轰炸共同成为促使日本投降的“双重震撼”。
description.en: A military operation launched by the Soviet Union against Japan at the end of World War II, initiated in Manchukuo and swiftly defeating the Kwantung Army, which directly led to Manchukuo's collapse and, along with the atomic bombings, created a 'double shock' that led to Japan's surrender.
