description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中共重庆市委副书记、重庆市市长。在薄熙来主政重庆期间，他长期担任市长一职，是重庆经济发展的重要人物。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as Deputy Secretary of the Chongqing Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China and Mayor of Chongqing. During Bo Xilai's tenure in Chongqing, he served as Mayor for a long time and was a key figure in the city's economic development.

description.zh-cn: 时任中共重庆市委常委兼政法委书记
时任重庆市公安局副局长。
1929年10月29日发生在美国的股票市场崩溃事件，被认为是引发大萧条的开端和标志。
美国推行的贸易保护主义法案，提高了关税，被认为加剧了全球贸易崩溃和大萧条。
美国总统富兰克林·德拉诺·罗斯福为应对大萧条而实施的一系列经济政策。
description.en: A series of economic programs enacted by Roosevelt in response to the Great Depression.

description.zh-cn: 一种货币制度，其僵化被认为是导致大萧条蔓延的原因之一。
由约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯提出的经济理论，主张政府干预以刺激经济。
一种经济理论，认为货币供给是影响经济活动的最主要因素。
一种经济学派，对大萧条的成因有其独特的解释。
在德国兴起的一种极权主义意识形态，具体表现为与纳粹党相关的意识形态和实践。
description.en: A totalitarian ideology that emerged in Germany, specifically manifested as the ideology and practices associated with the Nazi Party.

description.zh-cn: 加拿大是一个位于北美洲北部的联邦制、君主立宪制及议会制国家，亦是英联邦和法语国家及地区国际组织的成员。其政府近期谴责伊朗镇压示威，并对伊朗道德警察及其他官员实施了制裁。
description.en: Canada is a federal, constitutional monarchy and parliamentary country located in northern North America, and is a member of the Commonwealth of Nations and the Organisation internationale de la Francophonie. Its government recently condemned Iran's crackdown on protests and imposed sanctions on Iran's morality police and other officials.

description.zh-cn: 大洋洲国家。其联邦政府于2021年废除了维多利亚州与中国签订的“一带一路”协议。邓亮洪曾在此寻求政治庇护。
description.en: An Oceanian country. Its federal government abolished the "Belt and Road" agreement signed by Victoria with China in 2021. Tang Liang Hong once sought political asylum here.

description.zh-cn: 美国的中央银行系统，在威尔逊总统任内通过《联邦储备法案》而建立。
description.en: The central banking system of the United States, created during the presidency of Woodrow Wilson with the enactment of the Federal Reserve Act.

description.zh-cn: 美国第31任总统，在大萧条开始时就任，并在1932年选举中被罗斯福击败。
description.en: 31st President of the United States, defeated by Roosevelt in the 1932 election.

description.zh-cn: 英国经济学家，凯恩斯主义的创始人。
美国经济学家、统计学家，货币主义的代表人物，芝加哥经济学派的领军人物，1976年诺贝尔经济学奖得主。
description.en: An American economist and statistician, a leading figure of monetarism, a leader of the Chicago school of economics, and the 1976 Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences laureate.

description.zh-cn: 日本大藏大臣，采取凯恩斯主义政策使日本较早摆脱萧条。
奥地利裔德国政治人物，纳粹党领袖，1933年至1945年间担任德国总理和元首。作为第二次世界大战的发动者和墨索里尼在二战中的主要盟友，其崛起与大萧条密切相关。1944年盟军接近巴黎时，他曾下令摧毁埃菲尔铁塔及城市。
description.en: Austrian-born German politician and leader of the Nazi Party, who served as Chancellor and Führer of Germany from 1933 to 1945. As the initiator of World War II and Mussolini's main ally, his rise was closely linked to the Great Depression. In 1944, as the Allies approached Paris, he ordered the destruction of the Eiffel Tower and the city.

description.zh-cn: 美国经济学家，提出了债务紧缩理论。
奥地利经济学派代表人物，著有《美国大萧条》。
18世纪欧洲的思想解放运动，其思想助长了法国大革命的阶级意识。
法国大革命在此会议中爆发。
在拿破仑战争之前的一系列欧洲冲突，神圣罗马帝国卷入其中，开始了其最终的衰落。
description.en: A series of European conflicts preceding the Napoleonic Wars, in which the Holy Roman Empire became involved, beginning its final decline.

description.zh-cn: 由罗伯斯庇尔领导的雅各宾派专制独裁统治时期。
由拿破仑统治下的法国及其盟国与其他欧洲国家之间的一系列战争，最终导致了神圣罗马帝国的崩溃。
description.en: A series of wars between France under Napoleon and its allies against other European nations, which ultimately led to the collapse of the Holy Roman Empire.

description.zh-cn: 旧制度下法国社会中除教士和贵族外的其他所有人，主要是平民和资产阶级。
第三等级代表在网球场宣誓，国民议会将续存至法国宪法建立为止。
由第三等级自行成立的议会，后改称国民制宪议会。
法国大革命的标志性事件。
指法国大革命前的社会和政治制度，以君主专制和封建等级为特征。
路易十六时期的法国财政总监。

zh-cn: 马克西米连·罗伯斯比尔
马克西米连·罗伯斯庇尔

description.zh-cn: 雅各宾派领袖，恐怖统治时期的实际独裁者。
反对罗伯斯庇尔独裁的国民公会成员组成的政治派别。
路易十六的王后，奥地利皇帝的妹妹。
统治法国的君主王朝，在法国大革命中被推翻。
由普选产生的法国立法机构，取代了国民立法议会。
法国大革命期间的政治派别，代表工商业资产阶级利益。
法国大革命时期政治家，雅各宾派成员，后被罗伯斯庇尔处决。
法国大革命时期政治家，埃贝尔派领袖，后被罗伯斯庇尔处决。
推翻罗伯斯庇尔和雅各宾专政的政变。
拿破仑·波拿巴发动的政变，结束了督政府的统治，标志着法国大革命的结束。
欧洲君主制国家为对抗法国大革命及拿破仑而组成的军事同盟。
由梁启超提出的政治概念，指有虚位君主的共和政体，类似于君主立宪制。
description.en: A political concept proposed by Liang Qichao, referring to a republican form of government with a nominal monarch, similar to a constitutional monarchy.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党内部对改革开放持保留或反对态度的政治派别。在八六学潮后，该派系将学潮归咎于胡耀邦的纵容，并成功施压使其下台。
description.en: A political faction within the Communist Party of China. After the 1986 student demonstrations, this faction blamed the protests on Hu Yaobang's leniency and successfully pressured him into resigning.

description.zh-cn: 由萨丁尼亚王国主导成立，完成了意大利统一，并于1870年攻占罗马，终结了教宗国。该国在墨索里尼统治时期（1922-1943）成为第二次世界大战的欧洲轴心国，并于1941年承认汪精卫国民政府。
description.en: The state founded under the leadership of the Kingdom of Sardinia that completed the unification of Italy and ended the Papal States by capturing Rome in 1870. Under Mussolini's rule (1922-1943), it became a European Axis power in World War II and recognized the Wang Jingwei regime in 1941.

description.zh-cn: 意大利政治家、记者，国家法西斯党领袖，法西斯主义创始人。他于1922年至1943年担任意大利王国首相，期间代表意大利王国签署了《拉特兰条约》，并于1943年至1945年担任意大利社会共和国的国家元首。
description.en: Italian politician and journalist who founded and led the National Fascist Party. He was Prime Minister of Italy from 1922 to 1943, during which he signed the Lateran Treaty on behalf of Italy, and Duce of the Italian Social Republic from 1943 to 1945.

description.zh-cn: 德国与苏联签署的互不侵犯条约，秘密划分了在东欧的势力范围。
轴心国入侵苏联的军事行动代号。
第二次世界大战期间苏联与纳粹德国及其盟国之间的战争。
由协约国与德国签订，正式结束第一次世界大战的和平条约。条约内容不仅包含建立国际联盟和对德国施加的严厉条款，其中关于山东问题的条款也引发了中国的五四运动。
description.en: The most important peace treaty signed between the Allied Powers and Germany that officially brought World War I to an end. It included the covenant for the League of Nations, and its clauses concerning the Shandong Problem also triggered the May Fourth Movement in China.

description.zh-cn: 德国、意大利和日本签署的军事同盟条约。
西班牙国民军领袖，后成为西班牙独裁者。
德国并吞奥地利的事件。
1918年至1992年间存在的中欧国家。
description.en: A Central European country that existed from 1918 to 1992.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国及其合作者针对约六百万欧洲犹太人的种族灭绝。
由中国政府出资成立，为“一带一路”相关项目提供融资支持的基金。

zh-cn: 推进“一带一路”建设工作领导小组
en: Belt and Road Construction Leadership Group

description.zh-cn: 为推进“一带一路”建设而成立的中国国家级议事协调机构。
“一带一路”的枢纽和旗舰项目，涉及中国与巴基斯坦之间的一系列大型工程计划。
一种对“一带一路”倡议的批评性观点，认为中国通过提供巨额贷款使受援国陷入债务危机，以获取其战略资产或政治影响力。
因中巴经济走廊穿越其主权争议地区而多次反对“一带一路”倡议，并且是金砖国家创始成员国。
欧洲国家，欧盟创始成员国之一，梵蒂冈城邦位于其首都罗马市内。曾是七国集团中首个加入“一带一路”倡议的国家，但于2023年宣布退出。
description.en: A European country and an EU founding member, within whose capital, Rome, Vatican City is located. It was the first G7 country to join the 'Belt and Road Initiative', but announced its withdrawal in 2023.

description.zh-cn: 于2023年10月宣布退出“一带一路”倡议。
由中国公司承建的马来西亚铁路项目，是“一带一路”倡议的一部分，曾被马哈迪政府要求重新谈判。

zh-cn: 吉隆坡—新加坡高速铁路

description.zh-cn: 连接马来西亚吉隆坡和新加坡的高速铁路项目，曾被马哈迪政府宣布取消后又推迟。
微软公司创始人，曾任董事长，“一带一路”计划的明确支持者，并将屠呦呦获得诺贝尔奖列为2015年的好消息之一。
description.en: Founder and former chairman of Microsoft Corporation, a clear supporter of the 'Belt and Road' initiative, who listed Tu Youyou's Nobel Prize win as one of the good news stories of 2015.

description.zh-cn: 连接中国、吉尔吉斯斯坦和乌兹别克斯坦的铁路项目，被视为共建“一带一路”的旗舰工程。

en: Imperial Edict of the Abdication of the Qing Emperor
Imperial Edict of the Abdication of the Xuantong Emperor

zh-cn: 中华民国军政府鄂军都督府

description.zh-cn: 清末大臣，时任四川总督。他对保路运动采取强硬镇压手段，于1911年9月7日诱捕保路运动领袖并下令开枪，制造了“成都血案”，激化了矛盾。
description.en: A late Qing official, serving as the Viceroy of Sichuan. He adopted harsh repressive measures against the Railway Protection Movement, arresting its leaders and ordering troops to fire on protesters on September 7, 1911, creating the 'Chengdu Massacre' and escalating the conflict.

description.zh-cn: 清朝末年由满清宗室贵族组成的政治团体，反对共和。
清末宗社党首领，被革命党人彭家珍刺杀，有观点认为袁世凯是幕后策划者。
description.en: Leader of the Royalist Party in the late Qing Dynasty, assassinated by the revolutionary Peng Jiazhen, with some believing Yuan Shikai was the mastermind.

en: Provisional Constitution of the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 第一次世界大战中的军事同盟，主要由法国、英国、俄罗斯帝国、美国等国组成。

zh-cn: 同盟国 (第一次世界大战)

description.zh-cn: 第一次世界大战中的军事同盟，主要由德意志帝国、奥匈帝国、奥斯曼帝国等国组成。
奥匈帝国是一个存在于1867年至1918年间的中欧二元君主国，由奥地利帝国和匈牙利王国组成。弗朗茨·斐迪南是其皇储，梅耶林惨案发生于该国。
description.en: Austria-Hungary was a dual monarchy in Central Europe from 1867 to 1918, consisting of the Austrian Empire and the Kingdom of Hungary. Franz Ferdinand was its heir presumptive, and the Mayerling incident took place there.

description.zh-cn: 指奥匈帝国皇储弗朗茨·斐迪南大公夫妇在萨拉热窝被刺杀的事件，此事件成为第一次世界大战的导火线。
description.en: The assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand, heir to the Austro-Hungarian throne, and his wife in Sarajevo. This event was the immediate cause of World War I.

description.zh-cn: 卡尔·路德维希大公的长子，在其父放弃继承权后成为奥匈帝国推定继承人，后于萨拉热窝被刺杀，引发第一次世界大战。
description.en: The eldest son of Archduke Karl Ludwig. He became the heir presumptive to the Austro-Hungarian throne after his father renounced his rights. His assassination in Sarajevo triggered World War I.

description.zh-cn: 青年波斯尼亚成员、塞尔维亚民族主义者，于1914年6月28日在萨拉热窝刺杀了弗朗茨·斐迪南大公及其妻子苏菲，引发了萨拉热窝事件。
description.en: A member of Young Bosnia and a Serbian nationalist, who assassinated Archduke Franz Ferdinand and his wife Sophie on June 28, 1914, in Sarajevo, triggering the Sarajevo incident.

description.zh-cn: 德国在第一次世界大战期间采取的军事策略，即潜艇可以攻击任何驶往敌国的商船、油轮或客轮。这是促使美国参战的关键因素之一。
description.en: A type of naval warfare in which submarines sink vessels such as freighters and tankers without warning, as opposed to attacks per prize rules. This was a key factor in the United States' decision to enter World War I.

description.zh-cn: 第一次世界大战结束后，战胜国为解决战争遗留问题及奠定战后和平而召开的会议。会上制定了《凡尔赛条约》并筹建了国际联盟，其关于山东问题的决议直接引发了中国的五四运动。
description.en: A conference convened by the victorious Allied Powers after World War I to address issues arising from the war and establish post-war peace. It resulted in the Treaty of Versailles and the creation of the League of Nations, and its resolution on the Shandong Problem directly triggered the May Fourth Movement in China.

description.zh-cn: 第一次世界大战后成立的国际组织，旨在维护世界和平，不承认满洲国的合法性。由伍德罗·威尔逊大力倡导，但美国最终未能加入。中国曾就九一八事变向其提出申诉，但该组织未能有效制止日本的侵略。
description.en: An intergovernmental organization founded as a result of the Paris Peace Conference after World War I, aiming to maintain world peace and not recognize the legitimacy of Manchukuo. It was strongly advocated for by Woodrow Wilson, though the United States never joined. China appealed to it regarding the Mukden Incident, but it failed to effectively stop Japanese aggression.

zh-cn: 兹比格涅夫·布热津斯基

description.zh-cn: 美国战略家，认为美国在苏联解体中发挥了核心作用。
冷战期间美苏两国在军事力量上的竞赛。
苏联于1979年入侵阿富汗引发的战争。
description.en: The war triggered by the Soviet Union's invasion of Afghanistan in 1979.

description.zh-cn: 前苏联加盟共和国，于1990年3月11日率先宣布独立。
时任苏联副总统，八一九事件的主要领导者。
由部分前苏联加盟共和国组成的区域性组织，旨在取代旧苏联的架构。
俄罗斯总理，与叶利钦共同推行“休克疗法”。
苏联解体后俄罗斯实行的一种激进经济改革政策。
时任南疆军区司令员，战争期间任康西瓦前线指挥所司令员。
时任印度国防部长。

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军南疆军区
中国人民解放军陆军第八十三集团军

description.zh-cn: 1962年冷战时期在美国、苏联与古巴之间爆发的一场极其严重的政治、军事危机。肯尼迪总统曾就此咨询艾森豪威尔。
description.en: A major confrontation in 1962 that brought the United States and the Soviet Union close to war over the presence of Soviet nuclear-armed missiles in Cuba. President Kennedy consulted Eisenhower during the crisis.

zh-cn: 约翰·菲茨杰拉德·肯尼迪

description.zh-cn: 第35任美国总统，1961年至1963年任职，任内处理了古巴导弹危机等重大事件，1963年11月22日在达拉斯遇刺身亡。
description.en: The 35th President of the United States, serving from 1961 until his assassination in 1963. His presidency included handling major events like the Cuban Missile Crisis. He was assassinated on November 22, 1963, in Dallas.

birth_place.zh-cn: 布鲁克莱恩 (马萨诸塞州)

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国家安全部

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院主管国家安全的组成部门。
时任中华人民共和国国家安全部副部长。
时任重庆市公安局技术侦察总队总队长、渝北区公安分局局长。
对王立军徇私枉法、叛逃、滥用职权、受贿案的司法审判。

zh-cn: 郭维国、李阳、王鹏飞、王智徇私枉法案

description.zh-cn: 对郭维国等四名重庆警官在海伍德死亡案中徇私枉法的司法审判。
中国人民解放军上将，曾任火箭军司令员。

zh-cn: 美国空军中国航空航天研究所
中国人民解放军军事检察院

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军的最高检察机关。
description.en: The highest procuratorial organ of the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军火箭军少将，曾任火箭军装备部部长。
中国人民解放军海军中将，曾任南部战区副司令员兼南部战区海军司令员。
中国人民解放军中将，曾任中央军委装备发展部副部长。
中国人民解放军中将，曾任中央军委装备发展部副部长。
中国人民解放军空军上将，曾任空军司令员。
中国人民解放军火箭军中将，曾任火箭军副司令员。
中国人民解放军陆军上将，曾任火箭军政治委员。
曾任中国航天科技集团董事长。
曾任中国兵器工业集团董事长。
曾任中国运载火箭技术研究院院长、长征七号运载火箭总指挥。
中国人民解放军火箭军中将。

zh-cn: 中国运载火箭技术研究院
en: China Academy of Launch Vehicle Technology

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国提出的关于通过军事手段统一台湾的政治概念。
description.en: A political concept proposed by the People's Republic of China regarding the unification of Taiwan by military means.

zh-cn: 中共十八大后的反腐败
中共十八大以来的反腐败工作

description.zh-cn: 自2012年中共十八大以来，由习近平领导的中国共产党发起的一系列反腐败行动。该运动导致多位团派高级官员被查处。
description.en: A series of anti-corruption campaigns initiated by the Communist Party of China under the leadership of Xi Jinping since the 18th National Congress in 2012. This movement led to the investigation and removal of several high-ranking officials from the Tuanpai (Youth League Faction).

description.zh-cn: 位于青藏高原与四川盆地之间的地震断裂带，是汶川大地震的主要成因。
地球主要构造板块之一，其向欧亚板块的持续推挤是龙门山断层活动和汶川地震的根本原因。
地球主要构造板块之一。

zh-cn: 卧龙国家级自然保护区
中国大熊猫保护研究中心

description.zh-cn: 位于都江堰玉垒山麓，是为纪念李冰父子而修建的祀庙。在汶川大地震中全部垮塌后重建。
description.en: Located at the foot of Mount Yulei in Dujiangyan, it is a temple built to commemorate Li Bing and his son. It was rebuilt after completely collapsing in the Wenchuan earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国四川省的省级国家行政机关。
description.en: The provincial-level state administrative organ of Sichuan Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国大陆艺术家、社会活动家及异见人士，诗人艾青之子，活跃于建筑、艺术、影像和社会文化评论领域。他曾因调查川震遇难学生名单，其志愿者屡受地方政府扣留。
description.en: A Chinese contemporary artist, activist, and dissident. He is the son of poet Ai Qing and is active in the fields of architecture, art, film, and social and cultural criticism. He is notable for his investigation into the student casualties of the Sichuan earthquake, a process during which his volunteers were repeatedly detained by local authorities.

description.zh-cn: 中国异见人士，因帮助四川大地震死难者家长调查被判刑。
四川作家、维权人士，因致力于调查灾区学校豆腐渣工程并搜集川震遇难学生名单而被判刑。艾未未曾为其出庭作证。
description.en: Sichuanese writer and human rights activist, who was sentenced to prison for his dedication to investigating shoddy school construction in disaster areas and collecting lists of student victims of the Sichuan earthquake. Ai Weiwei testified in court for him.

description.zh-cn: 为悼念汶川大地震遇难者，中国首次为普通民众死难者设立的全国性哀悼活动。
汶川地震形成的最危险的堰塞湖。
时任四川省省长，于2012年宣布灾后重建完成。
1894年朝鲜爆发的农民起义，成为甲午战争的直接导火索。
朝鲜半岛历史上的一个王朝，统治时间为1392年至1897年。它最初亲明，后在丁卯战争中被迫与后金结盟。当时是朝鲜半岛的统治政权，名义上为清朝的藩属国，是战争爆发的核心争端地区，并在征韩论时期采取锁国政策。在福泽谕吉的《脱亚论》中被视为应与之“绝交”的“恶友”。
description.en: A Korean dynastic kingdom that ruled the Korean Peninsula from 1392 to 1897. It was initially pro-Ming but was forced into an alliance with the Later Jin after the First Manchu invasion of Korea. It was the ruling power on the Korean peninsula at that time, nominally a vassal state of the Qing dynasty, and a core disputed area for the outbreak of war. During the Seikanron debate, it adopted a policy of isolationism. It was also regarded by Fukuzawa Yukichi in 'Datsu-A Ron' as a 'bad friend' with whom Japan should break ties.

description.zh-cn: 清朝与日本在甲午战争后签订的不平等条约。该条约导致中国割地赔款并丧失多项主权，同时规定重庆成为向日本开放的内陆通商口岸之一。
description.en: An unequal treaty signed between the Qing dynasty and Japan after the First Sino-Japanese War. It resulted in China ceding territory, paying indemnities, losing sovereignty, and stipulated that Chongqing would become one of the inland treaty ports opened to Japan.

description.zh-cn: 清朝建立的近代化海军舰队，在甲午战争中全军覆没。
俄国、德国、法国联合干涉，迫使日本将《马关条约》中割占的辽东半岛归还给中国的事件。
日军在占领旅顺后对城内军民进行的大规模屠杀。
北洋水师提督，在威海卫之战后自杀殉国。
日本第122代天皇，大日本帝国第一代大元帅。作为国家元首，他在甲午战争和日俄战争期间积极推动军事扩张，并见证了日本从孤立的封建国家向工业化世界强国的转变。
description.en: The 122nd Emperor of Japan and the first Grand Marshal of the Empire of Japan. As head of state, he actively promoted military expansion during the First Sino-Japanese War and the Russo-Japanese War, and witnessed Japan's transformation from an isolated feudal state into an industrialized world power.

description.zh-cn: 日本近代政治家，明治维新元老，曾四次担任日本内阁总理大臣（亦是首任）。他曾于甲午战争期间担任日本首相，并任首任统监府统监。戊戌政变后，他帮助梁启超成功逃亡至日本。
description.en: Japanese modern politician and Meiji Restoration elder, who served four terms as Prime Minister of Japan (also the first). He served as Prime Minister during the First Sino-Japanese War and was the first Resident-General of Korea. After the Wuxu Coup, he helped Liang Qichao successfully escape to Japan.

description.zh-cn: 日本陆军大将，指挥第二军攻陷旅顺并发动旅顺大屠杀。
清朝醇亲王，道光帝第七子，载沣与光绪帝之父。曾负责海军事务，为迎合慈禧太后而挪用海军军费。
description.en: Prince Chun of the Qing Dynasty, the seventh son of the Daoguang Emperor, and the father of Zaifeng and the Guangxu Emperor. He was in charge of naval affairs and misappropriated naval funds to please Empress Dowager Cixi.

description.zh-cn: 晚清重臣，光绪帝的老师。曾任清朝户部尚书，奏准暂停海军购买外洋枪炮船只。他曾与奕䜣一同在甲申易枢中被贬，但因反对洋务运动而与奕䜣政见不合。
description.en: A prominent official in the late Qing dynasty and tutor to the Guangxu Emperor. He served as Minister of Revenue and approved the suspension of navy purchases of foreign cannons and ships. He was demoted along with Yixin in the Jiashen Purge, but his opposition to the Self-Strengthening Movement put him at odds with Yixin.

description.zh-cn: 东学党首领，领导了东学党起义。
甲午战争中双方海军主力进行的一场决定性海战。

zh-cn: 海峡两岸服务贸易协议

description.zh-cn: 由海峡两岸关系协会与海峡交流基金会签署的服务贸易协定，旨在开放两岸服务业市场。该协议在立法院的审查争议是太阳花学运的直接导火索。
description.en: A service trade agreement signed by ARATS and SEF, aimed at opening up the service industry markets across the Taiwan Strait. Its controversial review in the Legislative Yuan was the direct trigger of the Sunflower Student Movement.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，中国国民党籍立法委员，曾在国民党立委初选中击败李庆华。在立法院联席会议上宣布《海峡两岸服务贸易协议》视为已审查，直接引发了占领行动。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China who defeated Lee Ching-hua in a KMT legislative primary.

description.zh-cn: 2014年在台湾发生的一场学生与公民运动，是太阳花学运的开端与核心事件，期间示威者占领了立法院议场。
description.en: A student and civic movement in Taiwan in 2014, during which protesters occupied the legislative chamber.

description.zh-cn: 时任行政院院长，下令强制驱离占领行政院的群众。
太阳花学运期间，部分抗议群众转而占领行政院，后遭警方强制驱离。
负责执行驱离占领行政院群众任务的警察机关。
太阳花学运期间发起的大规模集会游行，主办单位宣称有数十万人参与。

zh-cn: 两岸协议监督条例草案

description.zh-cn: 为规范未来两岸协议的签订与审查程序、建立监督两岸协议的法律机制而提出的法律草案，是太阳花学运的核心诉求之一。
description.en: A proposed bill to regulate the signing and review process of future cross-strait agreements, one of the core demands of the Sunflower Student Movement.

zh-cn: 2014年中华民国地方公职人员选举

description.zh-cn: 俗称“九合一选举”，中国国民党在此次选举中遭遇重大挫败，被认为与太阳花学运有关。

zh-cn: 2016年中华民国总统副总统及立法委员选举

description.zh-cn: 此次选举中，民主进步党获得胜利，实现首次完全执政，其结果被认为受到太阳花学运影响。
中华民国政党，受太阳花学运影响而出现的“第三势力”政党。
description.en: A political party in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，太阳花学运主要的学生领袖之一。
太阳花学运主要的学生领袖之一。
中华民国政治人物、律师、法律学者。太阳花学运的主要人物与决策核心成员之一。曾为时代力量党员，在2016年立法委员选举中击败李庆华。现任台湾民众党主席、立法委员，并担任立法院党团总召。他曾发动“扫除绿卫兵”行动，参与罢免民进党籍民意代表，并在蔡正元的罢免答辩书中被点名批评，后对《公职人员选举罢免法》修正案表示支持。他曾提出修宪废除监察院案。
description.en: A politician, lawyer, and legal scholar of the Republic of China. One of the key figures and core decision-makers of the Sunflower Student Movement. He was formerly a member of the New Power Party and defeated Lee Ching-hua in the 2016 legislative election. He is currently serving as Chairman of the Taiwan People's Party, a Legislative Yuan member, and the caucus convener of the Legislative Yuan party group. He initiated the 'Sweep the Green Guards' campaign, participating in the recall of DPP representatives. He was also singled out for criticism in Tsai Cheng-yuan's defense statement for the recall and later supported the amendment to the 'Public Officials Election and Recall Act'. He has proposed a constitutional amendment to abolish the Control Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 由多个公民团体组成的联盟，是发起太阳花学运的主要组织之一。
由各校学运社团组成的学生团体，是发起太阳花学运的主要组织之一。
太阳花学运核心人物之一，因被控在占领行政院事件中煽惑他人犯罪而受审。
负责审理太阳花学运相关案件的法院。
蔡英文政府首任行政院院长，其内阁上任后撤回对126名占领行政院行动者的刑事告诉。
太平天国创始人之一，早期核心人物，与洪秀全一同传教，被封为南王。
太平天国早期核心领袖、东王，掌握军政实权，后在天京事变中被杀。
太平天国早期核心领袖，被封为西王。
太平天国早期核心领袖，被封为北王，发动天京事变。
太平天国早期核心领袖，被封为翼王。因天京事变及洪秀全猜忌而出走。
洪秀全长子，太平天国第二代领袖、末代君主，称幼天王。天京城破时由李秀成带其突围。
description.en: Hong Xiuquan's eldest son, the second-generation leader and last monarch of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom, known as the Young Heavenly King. He was led by Li Xiucheng to break out of the siege when Tianjing fell.

description.zh-cn: 由洪秀全、冯云山创立的宗教组织，是太平天国的前身。
太平天国运动的开端。
太平天国领导集团的内部冲突，即1856年发生在其首都天京的事件。此次冲突导致大量人员被杀，是太平天国由盛转衰的转折点。
description.en: An internal conflict among the leadership of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom that occurred in its capital, Tianjing, in 1856. The event resulted in a large number of deaths and marked the turning point from the zenith to the decline of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 清朝军队围攻太平天国首都天京（南京）的战役，是太平天国战争的最后一战。此战以湘军攻破天京告终，标志着太平天国运动的失败。
description.en: The siege of Tianjing (Nanjing), the capital of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom, by Qing forces, was the last major battle of the Taiping Rebellion. It concluded with the Xiang Army breaking through and capturing Tianjing, marking the failure of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom movement.

description.zh-cn: 由李鸿章建立的晚清地方武装，曾参与镇压太平天国，其旧部也成为北洋新军军官的来源之一。
description.en: A regional army in the late Qing Dynasty, established by Li Hongzhang, which participated in suppressing the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom. Its former members were also one of the sources of officers for the Beiyang New Army.

description.zh-cn: 由梁发编写的基督教布道书，对洪秀全创立拜上帝会产生重要影响。
基督徒，《劝世良言》的作者。
晚清时期活跃于华北的农民起义军，后期与太平军残部合并。
洪秀全族弟，太平天国后期重要领导人，被封为干王、军师。
石达开余部将领，被认为是最后一支覆灭的太平军。

en: Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea

description.zh-cn: 1919年至1948年间在朝鲜日治时期于中国上海成立的流亡政府。
description.en: An exile government established in Shanghai, China during the Japanese colonial period, active from 1919 to 1948.

description.zh-cn: 韩国军事将领、政治家，前总统和军事独裁者。他通过五一六军事政变上台，并且在金泳三的政治生涯早期是其主要政治对手。
description.en: Former South Korean president, military general, politician, and dictator. He came to power through the May 16 coup and was a major political opponent of Kim Young-sam during the early part of Kim's career.

description.zh-cn: 韩国前总统和军事独裁者，大韩民国第五共和国总统。他通过双十二政变上台，又发动5·17政变扩大权力。其宣布的戒严是2024年戒严事件的重要历史参照。金泳三执政期间，他因腐败和镇压光州民主化运动被起诉并定罪，后被金泳三赦免。
description.en: Former South Korean president and military dictator, and the fifth President of the Republic of Korea. He seized power in the Coup d'état of December Twelfth and further solidified his power through the May 17 coup. His declaration of martial law serves as a key historical precedent for the 2024 martial law event. During Kim Young-sam's presidency, he was prosecuted and convicted for corruption and for suppressing the Gwangju Uprising, and was later pardoned by Kim.

description.zh-cn: 大韩民国前总统，韩国民主运动领袖，金泳三的继任总统。他曾推行“阳光政策”，并与金泳三、金钟泌并称为“三金”，在韩国政坛上既是竞争对手也是合作伙伴。其三个儿子也曾担任国会议员。
description.en: A leader of the South Korean democracy movement and Kim Young-sam's successor as president of the Republic of Korea. He implemented the 'Sunshine Policy'. Along with Kim Young-sam and Kim Jong-pil, he was one of the 'Three Kims,' who were both rivals and partners in South Korean politics. His three sons also served as members of the National Assembly.

description.zh-cn: 大韩民国第16任总统。他曾延续对朝友好政策，并在公开演讲中提及黎明在韩国的知名度。
description.en: The 16th President of the Republic of Korea, who mentioned Leon Lai's fame in Korea during a public speech.

description.zh-cn: 韩国史上首位女性总统，后遭弹劾下台。
韩国共同民主党党代表，强烈反对2024年戒严令，并呼吁民众保护国会。他本人也在尹锡悦的计划逮捕名单上。
description.en: Leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, who strongly opposed the 2024 martial law, called on citizens to protect the National Assembly, and was on Yoon Suk Yeol's planned arrest list.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国的第三代最高领导人，金正日之子。现任朝鲜劳动党总书记和国务委员会委员长，并于2018年与文在寅共同签署了《板门店宣言》。
description.en: The third supreme leader of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, son of Kim Jong-il. He is currently serving as the General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and Chairman of the State Affairs Commission, and co-signed the Panmunjom Declaration with Moon Jae-in in 2018.

description.zh-cn: 由朴正熙等人发动的军事政变，导致国会被解散，第三共和国建立。
description.en: A military coup led by Park Chung-hee and others, which resulted in the dissolution of the National Assembly and the establishment of the Third Republic.

description.zh-cn: 1987年6月在韩国爆发的全国性民主运动，迫使全斗焕政府接受了总统直选制等民主化要求。
description.en: A nationwide pro-democracy movement in South Korea in June 1987, which forced the Chun Doo-hwan government to accept democratic reforms, including direct presidential elections.

description.zh-cn: 李承晚独裁统治时期。
四一九革命后建立的民主政府。
韩国现行的宪政体制，始于1987年的民主化改宪，该改宪是六月民主运动的成果。自此建立的民主政府延续至今。
description.en: The current constitutional system of South Korea began with the democratic constitutional reforms of 1987, which were the outcome of the June Democratic Movement. The democratic government established since then continues to this day.

description.zh-cn: 大韩民国的立法机关，是韩国三权分立宪政体制中的重要组成部分。在2024年戒严期间，国会议员集会并通过决议，成功废除了戒严令。
description.en: The legislative body of the Republic of Korea, an important component of the country's constitutional system of separation of powers. During the 2024 martial law, its members convened and passed a resolution to successfully nullify the martial law decree.

description.zh-cn: 大韩民国宪法裁判机构。
指韩国经济高速发展的时期。
2024年12月3日由时任韩国总统尹锡悦宣布的紧急戒严，在约6小时后被国会决议废除，该事件引发了严重的政治危机。
description.en: An emergency martial law declared by then-South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol on December 3, 2024, which was nullified by a National Assembly resolution about 6 hours later, sparking a severe political crisis.

description.zh-cn: 大韩民国国务总理。
韩国政治人物，现任韩国国会议长。2024年戒严期间，他召集国会会议，并宣布废除戒严令的决议获通过。
description.en: South Korean politician and current Speaker of the National Assembly. During the 2024 martial law, he convened a session of the National Assembly and announced the passage of the resolution to nullify it.

description.zh-cn: 大韩民国大法院院长。
大韩民国宪法法院院长。
大韩民国最高司法机构。

zh-cn: 弗兰克-瓦尔特·施泰因迈尔

description.zh-cn: 德国政治人物，现任德国联邦总统。
德国政治人物，德国候任总理。
冷战期间位于中欧的国家，由苏联占领区成立。
德意志民主共和国（东德）并入德意志联邦共和国（西德）的政治事件。
德国政治家、外交家，首任德意志帝国首相。因其“铁血政策”而被称为“铁血宰相”，通过一系列战争主导了德意志的统一。
description.en: A German statesman and diplomat, and the first Chancellor of the German Empire. Known as the 'Iron Chancellor' for his 'iron and blood' policy, he orchestrated the unification of Germany through a series of wars.

description.zh-cn: 普鲁士国王及首任德意志皇帝。
description.en: King of Prussia and the first German Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 16世纪欧洲的基督教改革运动，始于德意志地区，导致神圣罗马帝国在宗教上分裂。
德国神学家，宗教改革的发起者。
罗马公教会。

zh-cn: 奥托一世 (神圣罗马帝国)

description.zh-cn: 德意志国王，首位神圣罗马帝国皇帝。
西德首任联邦总理。
德国主要政党之一。
德国主要政党之一。
中国政治人物，在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间担任全国人大常委会副委员长兼秘书长。
description.en: Chinese politician who served as a Vice Chairman and concurrently Secretary-General of the Standing Committee of the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 张高丽的妻子。
description.en: Wife of Zhang Gaoli.

zh-cn: 彭帅指控张高丽性丑闻事件

description.zh-cn: 彭帅在微博发文指控前中国国务院副总理张高丽性侵的事件。
description.en: The event where Peng Shuai accused former Chinese Vice Premier Zhang Gaoli of sexual assault in a Weibo post.

nodes.id: BAIDU:第24届冬奥会工作领导小组

zh-cn: 第24届冬奥会工作领导小组

description.zh-cn: 李富春和蔡畅的独生女。
description.en: The only daughter of Li Fuchun and Cai Chang.

description.zh-cn: 位于湖南长沙的一所中学，是张孝骞和李富春的母校。
description.en: A secondary school located in Changsha, Hunan, which is the alma mater of Zhang Xiaoqian and Li Fuchun.

en: Primary Consort of Prince Chun the Virtuous

description.zh-cn: 慈禧太后之妹，光绪帝生母。
光绪帝的妃嫔。
光绪帝的妃嫔，珍妃之姐。
由光绪帝于1898年颁布，标志戊戌变法开始的诏书。
清朝第八位皇帝，光绪帝和载沣的祖父，咸丰帝之父。其在位期间爆发了第一次鸦片战争。在鸦片问题上，他最初支持林则徐的严禁政策并下令终止鸦片贸易，但在战争爆发后态度转变，将林则徐革职。
description.en: The eighth emperor of the Qing dynasty, grandfather of Guangxu and Zaifeng, and father of Xianfeng. During his reign, the First Opium War broke out. On the opium issue, he initially supported Lin Zexu's strict prohibition policy and ordered him to end the opium trade, but changed his stance after the war's outbreak, leading to Lin's dismissal.

description.zh-cn: 王洪文的妻子，上海棉纺织十七厂工人。
赵乐际之父，曾任《青海日报》副总编、陕西人民教育出版社社长。
中国共产党成都市委员会书记
成都市人民代表大会常务委员会主任
中国人民政治协商会议成都市委员会主席

zh-cn: 中国共产党成都市委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在成都市的领导机关。
description.en: The leading body of the Communist Party of China in Chengdu.

description.zh-cn: 中国成都市的行政管理机关。
description.en: The administrative body of Chengdu, China.

nodes.id: BAIDU:成都市人民代表大会常务委员会

zh-cn: 成都市人民代表大会常务委员会

nodes.id: BAIDU:中国人民政治协商会议成都市委员会

zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议成都市委员会

description.zh-cn: 战国时期秦国蜀郡郡守，主持修建了都江堰。
description.en: The governor of Shu Commandery in the State of Qin during the Warring States period, who presided over the construction of Dujiangyan.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代建设并使用至今的大型水利工程，位于四川省都江堰市城西。由鱼嘴、飞沙堰、宝瓶口等主体工程构成，主要作用是引水灌溉和防洪。
description.en: A large-scale hydraulic engineering project built in ancient China and still in use today, located west of Dujiangyan City, Sichuan Province. It consists of main structures such as the Yuzui, Feishayan, and Baopingkou, with its primary functions being water diversion for irrigation and flood control.

description.zh-cn: 三国时期蜀汉开国皇帝，刘禅之父。他被张松视为可以取代刘璋的明主，并在张松的协助下进入益州，最终夺取了该地。
description.en: Founding emperor of Shu Han, father of Liu Shan. He was seen by Zhang Song as a worthy ruler to replace Liu Zhang, and with Zhang Song's assistance, he entered Yi Province and eventually seized control of it.

description.zh-cn: 蜀汉是中国历史上三国时期西南方的国家之一，由刘备建立，国号为“汉”。在《三国演义》中，作者以蜀汉为中心，体现了“尊刘反曹”的倾向。
description.en: Shu Han was one of the three major states that competed for supremacy over China in the Three Kingdoms period, located in southwestern China, founded by Liu Bei with the official state name of 'Han'. In 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', the narrative centers on Shu Han, reflecting a pro-Liu, anti-Cao bias.

description.zh-cn: 曹魏将领，率军灭亡蜀汉。
description.en: A general of Cao Wei who led the conquest of Shu Han.

description.zh-cn: 清朝时期的大规模移民运动。
民国时期川军将领，四川省主席。

zh-cn: 联合国教育、科学及文化组织

description.zh-cn: 联合国的专门机构之一，旨在通过教育、科学和文化促进国际合作。巩俐于2000年被任命为该组织的“促进和平艺术家”。
description.en: A specialized agency of the United Nations aimed at promoting international cooperation through education, science, and culture. Gong Li was appointed as a UNESCO Artist for Peace in 2000.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任重庆市副书记，现任重庆市市长。
description.en: Chinese politician, formerly Deputy Secretary of Chongqing, currently the Mayor of Chongqing.

zh-cn: 重庆市人民代表大会常务委员会
中国人民政治协商会议重庆市委员会
en: Chongqing Municipal Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference

description.zh-cn: 南宋第三位皇帝。因即位前藩封于恭州（重庆古称），即位后认为这是“双重喜庆”，遂将恭州升格并赐名“重庆”。
description.en: The third emperor of the Southern Song dynasty. Before his accession, he was enfeoffed in Gongzhou (the ancient name of Chongqing). After ascending the throne, he considered this a 'double celebration' and thus elevated Gongzhou's status and renamed it 'Chongqing'.

description.zh-cn: 南宋第二位皇帝，宋高宗养子及继承人，宋太祖后裔。他为岳飞平反，是宋光宗赵惇之父。
description.en: The second emperor of the Southern Song dynasty, adopted son and successor of Emperor Gaozong, and a descendant of Emperor Taizu. He rehabilitated Yue Fei and was the father of Emperor Guangzong (Zhao Dun).

description.zh-cn: 战国时期秦国政治家。灭巴国后屯兵江州，修筑江州城，为史载重庆建城之始。
description.en: A politician of the Qin state during the Warring States period. After conquering the state of Ba, he stationed troops in Jiangzhou and built the city wall, marking the recorded beginning of Chongqing's city construction.

description.zh-cn: 在抗日战争期间，由日本对作为中国战时首都的重庆进行的长期战略轰炸。
description.en: The long-term strategic bombing of Chongqing, China's wartime capital, by Japan during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间在重庆发生的保皇派与造反派之间的大规模武装冲突，对城市造成了严重破坏。
description.en: Large-scale armed conflicts between the Royalist and Rebel factions in Chongqing during the Cultural Revolution, causing severe damage to the city.

description.zh-cn: 位于重庆市渝中区，是1949年后重庆修建的第一个大型体育场馆，也是中国第一座现代意义上的综合体育场。
description.en: Located in Yuzhong District, Chongqing, it was the first large-scale stadium built in Chongqing after 1949 and the first modern comprehensive stadium in China.

zh-cn: 广东省人民代表大会常务委员会
中国人民政治协商会议广东省委员会
en: Guangdong Provincial Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议在广东省的地方组织。
description.en: The Guangdong provincial-level organization of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期秦国君主，秦朝开国皇帝，中国历史上首位完成华夏大一统的政治人物，也是中国首位称皇帝的君主。他统一六国，建立了秦朝，并曾极为赞赏韩非的著作。他下令实施“焚书坑儒”，导致《论语》等经典几近失传。
description.en: The first political figure to complete the unification of China and the first monarch to be titled 'Emperor'. He unified the six states, established the Qin Dynasty, and greatly admired the writings of Han Fei. He also ordered the 'Burning of books and burying of scholars', which nearly led to the loss of classics like the Analects.

description.zh-cn: 南越国创建者，原为秦朝将领。
description.en: Founder of the Nanyue kingdom, originally a general of the Qin dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 由秦朝将领赵佗在岭南地区建立的政权，领有今日广东、广西、海南及越南北部。
description.en: A kingdom founded by the Qin general Zhao Tuo in the Lingnan region, covering present-day Guangdong, Guangxi, Hainan, and northern Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 19世纪中叶，清朝与英国及法国等西方列强之间发生两场冲突，即第一次鸦片战争（1840-1842年）和第二次鸦片战争。其中，第一次鸦片战争是大清帝国与英国之间的战争，直接导致香港岛被割让。清政府战败后，刺激其推行洋务运动，并开启了第二阶段的西学东渐。
description.en: A series of two conflicts occurred between the Qing dynasty and Western powers (primarily Britain and France) in the mid-19th century: the First Opium War (1840-1842) and the Second Opium War. The First Opium War, a conflict between the Qing Empire and the United Kingdom, directly led to the cession of Hong Kong Island. The Qing government's defeat stimulated the launch of the Self-Strengthening Movement, initiating the second phase of the West-to-East knowledge transfer.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党广州市委员会书记。
广州市人民代表大会常务委员会主任。
广州市人民政府市长。
中国人民政治协商会议广州市委员会主席。

zh-cn: 中国共产党广州市委员会
广州市人民代表大会常务委员会

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国广东省广州市的地方国家行政机关。
description.en: The local state administrative organ of Guangzhou City, Guangdong Province, People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议广州市委员会

description.zh-cn: 唐末民变领袖，大齐政权皇帝。
description.en: Leader of a major rebellion in the late Tang dynasty and emperor of the Qi dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 南汉开国皇帝，史称南汉高祖。于917年在番禺称帝，建立“大越”，次年改国号为“大汉”。
description.en: The founding emperor of Southern Han, known posthumously as Emperor Gaozu of Southern Han. He proclaimed himself emperor in Panyu in 917, establishing the state of 'Great Yue', which he renamed 'Great Han' the following year.

description.zh-cn: 五代十国时期的政权之一，位于现广东、广西、海南、香港、澳门以及越南北部，后于971年被北宋所灭。
description.en: One of the states during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, located in modern-day Guangdong, Guangxi, Hainan, Hong Kong, Macau, and northern Vietnam. It was conquered by the Northern Song dynasty in 971.

description.zh-cn: 越南政治家，现任越南共产党中央委员会总书记、越南共产党中央军事委员会书记。
description.en: Vietnamese politician, currently serving as the General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam and Secretary of the Central Military Commission of the Communist Party of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 越南政治家，现任越南社会主义共和国主席。
description.en: Vietnamese politician, currently serving as the President of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 越南政治家，现任越南政府总理。
description.en: Vietnamese politician, currently serving as the Prime Minister of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 越南政治家，现任越南国会主席。
description.en: Vietnamese politician, currently serving as the Chairman of the National Assembly of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 越南政治家，现任越共中央书记处常务书记。
description.en: Vietnamese politician, currently serving as the Permanent Member of the Secretariat of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 法兰西殖民帝国在东南亚的殖民地，1897年后将越南尊人府纳入其直接管理。
description.en: A colony of the French colonial empire in Southeast Asia. After 1897, it brought the Vietnamese Tôn Nhơn Phủ under its direct administration.

description.zh-cn: 由胡志明等人创办的越南革命组织，旨在反对法国和日本的殖民统治。
description.en: A Vietnamese revolutionary organization founded by Hồ Chí Minh and others to oppose French and Japanese colonial rule.

description.zh-cn: 由越南独立同盟会发动的起义，旨在夺取越南政权并宣布独立。
description.en: An uprising launched by the Viet Minh to seize power in Vietnam and declare independence.

description.zh-cn: 1945年由胡志明宣布成立，通常被称为北越。该国是越南战争中的一方，曾向中国请求抗疟药物援助。
description.en: A state proclaimed by Hồ Chí Minh in 1945, commonly known as North Vietnam. It was a party in the Vietnam War that requested antimalarial drug assistance from China.

description.zh-cn: 第一次印度支那战争中的决定性战役，越南民主共和国军队在此击败法军。
description.en: The decisive battle of the First Indochina War, where the forces of the Democratic Republic of Vietnam defeated the French.

description.zh-cn: 1955年由吴廷琰建立的国家，通常被称为南越，在越南战争中与北越对峙。
description.en: A state established by Ngô Đình Diệm in 1955, commonly known as South Vietnam, which opposed North Vietnam during the Vietnam War.

description.zh-cn: 越南共和国（南越）首任总统。于1963年死于一场军事政变，该政变得到了肯尼迪政府的默许。
description.en: The first president of the Republic of Vietnam (South Vietnam), who was assassinated in a 1963 military coup tacitly approved by the Kennedy administration.

description.zh-cn: 指标志着越南战争结束的北越军队攻陷南越首都西贡事件，该事件直接促成了越南的统一。
description.en: Refers to the event where North Vietnamese forces captured Saigon, the capital of South Vietnam, marking the end of the Vietnam War and leading directly to the reunification of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 越南共产党于1986年开始推行的经济改革政策，旨在建立社会主义市场经济。
description.en: An economic reform policy initiated by the Communist Party of Vietnam in 1986, aimed at establishing a socialist-oriented market economy.

en: Territorial disputes in the South China Sea

zh-cn: 越南共产党中央书记处
en: Central Secretariat of the Communist Party of Vietnam

description.zh-cn: 越南共产党的中央机构之一，负责处理日常党务。
description.en: One of the central bodies of the Communist Party of Vietnam, responsible for handling daily party affairs.

description.zh-cn: 前越南共产党中央委员会总书记、越南社会主义共和国主席。
越南国防部长。
前越南共产党中央委员会总书记。
前越南社会主义共和国主席。
前越南政府总理。
阮朝末代君主，越南帝国及越南国君主/国家元首。
阮朝建立者，安南国王，国号被嘉庆帝改为“越南”。
越南历史上最后一个君主制王朝。
description.en: The last imperial dynasty of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 蒙古帝国的创建者及首任皇帝（大汗），后被元朝追尊为元太祖，是蒙哥的祖父。
description.en: The founder and first Great Khan of the Mongol Empire, and the grandfather of Möngke Khan.

description.zh-cn: 元朝初年重要谋臣，金莲川幕府核心人物，曾劝说忽必烈定国号为“大元”。
中国古典文献之一，古代中国用于推演未来吉凶祸福的卜筮书。自汉代开始被尊奉为“五经”之一，其中心思想是用阴阳符号构成的六十四卦象代表世间万物的运行状态。同时，它也是元朝国号“大元”的出处。
description.en: One of the Chinese classic texts, an ancient Chinese divination text used to predict future fortunes. It has been revered as one of the 'Five Classics' since the Han Dynasty. Its central idea is to use the 64 hexagrams, composed of yin and yang symbols, to represent the state of all things in the world. Additionally, it is the source of the Yuan dynasty's name 'Dayuan'.

description.zh-cn: 忽必烈汗颁布的确立“大元”国号的诏书。
宋朝的南迁政权，是中国南方的汉人政权，是宋朝的后半期，由宋高宗赵构建立。蒙哥在位期间曾对其发动大规模进攻，最终被元朝所灭。
description.en: A Han Chinese dynasty in southern China, which was subjected to a large-scale invasion during Möngke's reign.

description.zh-cn: 元朝皇室退居漠北后的政权。
由女真族建立的统治中国北方和东北地区的封建王朝，后被蒙古帝国所灭。
description.en: A feudal dynasty established by the Jurchen people that ruled northern and northeastern China.

description.zh-cn: 成吉思汗的第四子，蒙哥、元世祖忽必烈、旭烈兀、阿里不哥的父亲。
description.en: The fourth son of Genghis Khan, and the father of Möngke, Kublai, Hulagu, and Ariq Böke.

description.zh-cn: 蒙古帝国第四任大汗，拖雷长子，元朝追尊为宪宗桓肃皇帝。其在位期间发动了对南宋、大理、西亚等地的征服战争，但在征伐南宋的钓鱼城之战中去世，他的死引发了帝国分裂。
description.en: The fourth Great Khan of the Mongol Empire and the eldest son of Tolui, posthumously honored as Emperor Xianzong Huansu by the Yuan Dynasty. During his reign, he launched wars of conquest against the Southern Song, Dali, and West Asia. He died during the Battle of Diaoyu Fortress while invading the Southern Song, and his death triggered the division of the empire.

description.zh-cn: 拖雷第七子，忽必烈与蒙哥之弟，在蒙哥去世后、拖雷家族内战中与忽必烈争夺汗位。
description.en: Möngke's younger brother, who contended with Kublai for the khanship after Möngke's death.

description.zh-cn: 蒙哥去世后，其弟忽必烈与阿里不哥为争夺蒙古帝国汗位而爆发的内战，导致蒙古帝国分裂。
description.en: A civil war that broke out after Möngke's death between his brothers Kublai and Ariq Böke for the succession to the khanship, leading to the division of the Mongol Empire.

description.zh-cn: 元朝末年爆发的大规模民变，直接导致元朝覆灭。
元军与南宋军队的最后决战，元朝在此战中彻底消灭南宋流亡政权，标志着南宋的灭亡。
明朝将领徐达领导的旨在推翻元朝统治的军事行动。
蒙古帝国第二任大汗，成吉思汗第三子和继承人，蒙哥的养父。
description.en: The second Great Khan of the Mongol Empire, third son and successor of Genghis Khan, and the adoptive father of Möngke Khan.

description.zh-cn: 蒙古帝国时期大臣，元朝初年的重要政治家。曾劝谏窝阔台汗在汉地实行汉法，并奉成吉思汗之命记录其与丘处机的对话。
description.en: A minister during the Mongol Empire and an important statesman in the early Yuan dynasty. He advised Ogedei Khan to implement Han laws in Han territories and was ordered by Genghis Khan to record his conversations with Qiu Chuji.

description.zh-cn: 元朝最后一位皇帝，后退居漠北，成为北元开国皇帝。
description.en: The last emperor of the Yuan dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 中国春秋战国时期的哲学思想流派，以老子和庄周为主要代表人物，为道教的思想渊源之一。
description.en: A school of thought in the Spring and Autumn and Warring States periods of China, with Laozi and Zhuangzi as its main representatives.

description.zh-cn: 太平道的开创者之一。
东汉末年的道教派别，由张角、于吉等人创立。
五斗米道的创立者，被尊为天师。

en: Way of the Five Pecks of Rice

description.zh-cn: 早期道教组织，由张道陵创立。
太平道的创立者，黄巾之乱的领导者。
一种世界性宗教和哲学体系，也是世界主要宗教之一。它对中国古代思想家，如皇侃，产生了影响，并与道教在中国历史上长期互动与论争。
description.en: A world religion and philosophical system that influenced ancient Chinese thinkers like Huang Kan.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年的一次大规模民变，刘备在此期间起兵。
中国历史上的一个朝代，是三国的前身。其末期许贡与孙策等人物活跃，周瑜名义上为其臣子，曹昂在此期间生活并被举为孝廉。
description.en: A Chinese dynasty, the predecessor of the Three Kingdoms. During its late period, figures like Xu Gong and Sun Ce were active. Zhou Yu was nominally its subject, and Cao Ang lived during this period and was nominated as Xiaolian.

description.zh-cn: 北魏道士，吸收佛教思想改革道教。
中国南北朝时期的北方王朝
唐朝第二位皇帝，开创“贞观之治”，被尊为“天可汗”，推崇道教，也是李泰之父。
description.en: The second emperor of the Tang dynasty, who initiated the 'Reign of Zhenguan' and was honored as the 'Tian Kehan', and was also the father of Li Tai.

description.zh-cn: 全真道掌教，改革道教戒律，曾与成吉思汗会面。
金元时期兴起的道教宗派，由王重阳创立。
全真道的创始人。
记述老子到西域、天竺教化胡人的道教经典，在佛道之争中被判为伪经并遭焚毁。
description.en: A Taoist scripture that promotes the 'Laozi huahu' theory.

description.zh-cn: 道教经籍的总集。
中国历史上三次由帝王发动的的灭佛事件。
北宋第八位皇帝，宋高宗之父。艺术家，自创“瘦金书”字体。笃信道教，自称“教主道君皇帝”，并追封庄周为微妙元通真君。因靖康之变被俘，客死异乡。
description.en: The eighth emperor of the Northern Song dynasty, an artist known for creating the "Slender Gold" style of calligraphy. A devout Daoist, he called himself "Jiaozhu Daojun Emperor" and posthumously honored Zhuang Zhou as Weimiao Yuantong Zhenjun. He was captured during the Jingkang incident and died in captivity.

description.zh-cn: 全真道掌教，丘处机弟子。他曾随丘处机西行，撰写《长春真人西游记》，并与佛教发生激烈冲突。
description.en: As a leader of Quanzhen Dao and a disciple of Qiu Chuji, he accompanied Qiu Chuji on his journey to the west, wrote 'Travels of the Perfect Man Changchun to the West', and had intense conflicts with Buddhism.

description.zh-cn: 元代曹洞宗高僧，少林寺住持。
西晋天师道祭酒，撰写《老子化胡经》。
description.en: A Celestial Master libationer of the Western Jin dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 西晋大乘佛教高僧。
一种认为老子西出函谷关后，到天竺教化胡人、成为佛陀的观点，是佛道之争的核心议题之一。
description.en: A doctrine claiming that Laozi went to India after passing through Hangu Pass and converted the 'barbarians', becoming the Buddha.

description.zh-cn: 中国春秋时期思想家，道家学派和道教的创始人。
description.en: A Chinese philosopher of the Spring and Autumn period, founder of philosophical Taoism and religious Taoism.

description.zh-cn: 中国战国中期思想家、哲学家、文学家，道家学派的代表人物，被道教奉为祖师，其著作《南华经》为重要经典。
description.en: A representative figure of Taoism during the Warring States period in China.

description.zh-cn: 指儒教、道教、佛教三家思想的融合与调和。
三国时期曹魏的著名诗人和文学家，曹操与卞氏嫡出之第三子。在其作品《辩道论》中批驳道教神仙说。
description.en: A famous poet and writer of Cao Wei during the Three Kingdoms period, the third son of Cao Cao and Lady Bian.

en: Jim O'Neill, Baron O'Neill of Gatley

description.zh-cn: 高盛公司首席经济师，于2001年首次提出“金砖四国”概念。
金砖国家创始成员国。
于2011年加入金砖国家的成员国。
本次峰会后宣布扩充成员国。

于2024年加入金砖国家的成员国，并于2014年将“东伊运”列入恐怖主义组织名单。
description.en: Joined BRICS in 2024 and listed ETIM as a terrorist organization in 2014.

description.zh-cn: 曾被邀请加入金砖国家，后撤回申请。
阿根廷总统，上台后撤回了阿根廷加入金砖国家的申请。
于2025年成为金砖国家的正式成员。
新加坡于1963年至1965年间曾加入其联邦，成为新加坡州，并预计于2025年成为金砖伙伴国。
description.en: Singapore was a state within its federation from 1963 to 1965.

description.zh-cn: 于2025年成为金砖伙伴国。
东欧国家，允许俄罗斯利用其领土对乌克兰发动攻击，被视为俄罗斯的盟友。于2025年成为金砖伙伴国。
description.en: An Eastern European country that has allowed Russia to use its territory to launch attacks on Ukraine, considered an ally of Russia.

description.zh-cn: 于2025年成为金砖伙伴国。
于2025年成为金砖伙伴国。
于2025年成为金砖伙伴国。
于2025年成为金砖伙伴国。

由金砖国家成立的国际开发银行。
印度现任总理。
南非现任总统。
埃及现任总统。
埃塞俄比亚现任总理。
伊朗现任总统。

zh-cn: 穆罕默德·本·扎耶德·阿勒纳哈扬

description.zh-cn: 阿联酋现任总统。
印度尼西亚现任总统。
梵蒂冈城邦的前身，是在756年由“丕平献土”事件后成立的政教合一主权国家，其领土曾广及意大利半岛中部。
description.en: The predecessor to the Vatican City State, a sovereign theocratic state established in 756 after the 'Donation of Pepin', which once controlled large territories in central Italy.

description.zh-cn: 由意大利王国与圣座为解决“罗马问题”而签订的条约，正式确立并承认梵蒂冈城邦为主权国家。
description.en: A treaty signed between the Kingdom of Italy and the Holy See to resolve the 'Roman Question', which recognized Vatican City as a sovereign state.

description.zh-cn: 天主教会第259任教宗，代表圣座签署了《拉特兰条约》。
description.en: The 259th Pope of the Catholic Church, who signed the Lateran Treaty on behalf of the Holy See.

description.zh-cn: 法兰克国王丕平将意大利中部的大片领土（包括罗马城及其周围区域）赠予教宗的历史事件，奠定了教宗国的基础。
description.en: A historical event in which Pepin, King of the Franks, granted the Pope large territories in central Italy.

description.zh-cn: 法兰克王国国王，将罗马城及其周围区域赠予教宗，史称“丕平献土”，奠定了教宗国的基础。
description.en: King of the Franks, who donated the city of Rome and its surrounding areas to the Pope, known as the 'Donation of Pepin', laying the foundation for the Papal States.

description.zh-cn: 19世纪在意大利半岛发生的政治及社会运动，旨在结束各国林立及外国势力干预，将意大利半岛的各个国家统一为一个国家，最终导致了教宗国的终结。
description.en: The 19th-century political and social movement that resulted in the consolidation of different states of the Italian Peninsula into a single state, the Kingdom of Italy.

description.zh-cn: 意大利统一运动的领导者。
梵蒂冈城国国家元首（教宗）。
梵蒂冈城国政府主席。
第二次世界大战期间的教宗。
圣座的行政机构，同时也是天主教会的中央政府，它协助教宗处理整个天主教会的事务。其对来华传教政策的改变（中国礼仪之争）导致清朝禁教，中断了第一阶段的西学东渐。
description.en: The administrative apparatus of the Holy See, also serving as the central government of the Catholic Church, it assists the Pope in governing its affairs. Its change in policy regarding Chinese rites led to the Qing dynasty's prohibition of Christianity, interrupting the first phase of the West-to-East knowledge transfer.

description.zh-cn: 罗马教廷中综理圣座行政并掌理教宗枢密事务的机构。
圣座国务枢机卿。
比利时第七任国王。
比利时政治人物，比利时首相。
19世纪的欧洲国家，由今荷兰、比利时、卢森堡组成。
导致南尼德兰（主要是现代比利时）从荷兰联合王国独立的革命。
欧洲联盟的前身之一。
比利时第二任国王，刚果自由邦的私人所有者，同时也是斯蒂芬妮公主的父亲。
description.en: Second King of the Belgians, private owner of the Congo Free State, and father of Princess Stéphanie.

description.zh-cn: 利奥波德二世的私人领地，位于中非。
比利时在非洲的殖民地。
比利时在非洲的殖民地。
比利时第六任国王，于2013年退位。
比利时政治人物，曾任比利时首相。
比利时首位女首相。

en: Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant

description.zh-cn: 趁阿拉伯之春造成的地区动荡而崛起的极端恐怖组织，曾控制叙利亚和伊拉克的大片区域。
description.en: An extremist terrorist organization that rose to prominence amid the regional instability caused by the Arab Spring, once controlling large areas of Syria and Iraq.

description.zh-cn: 比利时首都。
比利时第一任国王。
比利时漫画家，《丁丁历险记》的作者。
比利时漫画家埃尔热创作的系列漫画作品。
欧盟的行政及执行机构。
欧盟的司法机构。
欧洲理事会主席
欧盟委员会主席
欧洲议会议长
欧洲联盟的前身之一。
法律上独立于欧盟的国际组织，但在欧洲共同体的管辖范围内。
由欧洲煤钢共同体、欧洲经济共同体和欧洲原子能共同体合并而成，是欧盟的前身。
时任法国外交部长

en: 2016 United Kingdom European Union membership referendum

description.zh-cn: 位于欧洲西北部的构成国，是荷兰王国的主要组成部分，也是欧盟创始成员国之一。
description.en: A constituent country located in Northwestern Europe, the main component of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, and a founding member of the EU.

description.zh-cn: 欧盟创始成员国之一
乌克兰总统，在俄罗斯全面入侵后领导乌克兰进行抵抗。
description.en: President of Ukraine, who has led the country's resistance following the full-scale Russian invasion.

description.zh-cn: 欧盟成员国
现任英国首相，工党领袖。
英国的最高立法机关。
英国的中右翼政党，马尔康·芮夫金是其成员。
description.en: A centre-right political party in the United Kingdom, of which Malcolm Rifkind is a member.

description.zh-cn: 英国哲学家，被广泛誉为自由主义之父和早期启蒙运动思想家。
一种哲学理论，认为知识仅来自或主要来自感官经验。
英国博物学家、地质学家和生物学家，以其对进化科学的贡献而闻名。
研究生命的自然科学。
英国摇滚乐队，被广泛认为是有史以来最有影响力的乐队。
乌克兰现任总理
乌克兰最高拉达主席
乌克兰的立法机关

zh-cn: 克里米亚转交苏维埃乌克兰

description.zh-cn: 2014年2月爆发的革命，最终推翻了亚努科维奇政府。
description.en: A revolution that broke out in February 2014, ultimately overthrowing the Yanukovych government.

zh-cn: 维克多·费奥多罗维奇·亚努科维奇

description.zh-cn: 乌克兰前总统，因在2013年拒绝与欧盟签订联合协议而引发迈丹革命，最终被罢免并逃离乌克兰。
description.en: Former President of Ukraine, whose refusal to sign an association agreement with the EU in 2013 triggered the Euromaidan Revolution, leading to his ousting and flight from Ukraine.

description.zh-cn: 成吉思汗长子术赤之子，金帐汗国的建立者，是推举蒙哥称汗的关键人物。
description.en: Son of Jochi, the eldest son of Genghis Khan, founder of the Golden Horde, and a key figure in the election of Möngke Khan.

description.zh-cn: 2014年4月在乌克兰顿巴斯地区爆发的武装冲突，由俄罗斯支持的分裂分子与乌克兰政府军交战。
description.en: An armed conflict that began in April 2014 in the Donbas region of Ukraine, fought between Russia-backed separatists and Ukrainian government forces.

description.zh-cn: 指中华民国北洋政府时期，大总统府与国务院之间的权力斗争。黎元洪与段祺瑞是早期核心人物，后期主要发生在冯国璋与段祺瑞之间。
description.en: Refers to the power struggle between the Presidential Palace and the State Council during the Beiyang government period of the Republic of China. Li Yuanhong and Duan Qirui were key figures in the early phase, with the struggle later primarily involving Feng Guozhang and Duan Qirui.

description.zh-cn: 由前清遗臣张勋发动的、旨在恢复清朝统治的未遂政变，张勋率军进入北京，拥立清朝末代皇帝溥仪复辟。该事件仅持续12天便以失败告终，并被段祺瑞组织的讨逆军迅速平定。
description.en: An unsuccessful coup launched by former Qing loyalist Zhang Xun, aimed at restoring Qing rule, in which Zhang Xun led troops into Beijing to enthrone the last Qing emperor Puyi. The event lasted only 12 days, ending in failure and quickly suppressed by the punitive army organized by Duan Qirui.

en: Republic of China declaration of war on Germany

description.zh-cn: 1917年中华民国国会讨论的是否对德意志帝国宣战的议案。
中华民国军事将领，直系军阀首领，曾任中华民国第五任大总统。
description.en: A Chinese warlord, leader of the Zhili clique, and President of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国早期最重要的军阀势力之一，由袁世凯培植的北洋新军主要将领组成。该军事政治集团在民国初年控制北洋政府。袁世凯死后于1916年分裂为多个派系，形成军阀割据局面。
description.en: A military-political group that controlled the Beiyang government in the early Republic of China. It was one of the most important warlord factions, composed of the main generals of the Beiyang New Army cultivated by Yuan Shikai. After Yuan's death in 1916, it split into several cliques, leading to a period of warlordism.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国北洋政府时期，由段祺瑞领导的北洋军阀主要派系之一，受日本支持。
description.en: One of the main warlord factions during the Beiyang government era of the Republic of China, led by Duan Qirui and supported by Japan.

description.zh-cn: 北洋军阀的主要派系之一，由冯国璋领导，以冯国璋、曹锟、吴佩孚为主要代表，并受英美两国支持。
description.en: One of the main factions of the Beiyang Warlords, led by Feng Guozhang and primarily represented by Feng Guozhang, Cao Kun, and Wu Peifu, supported by the United Kingdom and the United States.

description.zh-cn: 明初国都，今江苏省南京市。
明初四大案之一，明太祖朱元璋诛杀宰相胡惟庸，并株连众多功臣宿将的重大政治事件。胡惟庸被指控谋反，导致数万人被处死。此案后，朱元璋废除了丞相制度。
description.en: One of the Four Major Cases of the early Ming dynasty. It refers to the major political event where the Hongwu Emperor (Zhu Yuanzhang) executed Chancellor Hu Weiyong and implicated numerous meritorious officials. Hu Weiyong was accused of treason, leading to the execution of tens of thousands of people. Following this case, Zhu Yuanzhang abolished the chancellorship.

description.zh-cn: 明初四大案之一，大将军蓝玉被指控谋反，超过一万五千人被株连。
description.en: One of the Four Major Cases of the Early Ming Dynasty. General Lan Yu was accused of treason, resulting in the implication and execution of over 15,000 people.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代官职
明朝与瓦剌在土木堡发生的一场战役。此战中明英宗被俘，直接导致朱祁钰被拥立为帝，并成为明朝由盛转衰的转折点之一。
description.en: A military conflict between the Ming Dynasty and the Oirats at Tumu Fortress. Emperor Yingzong was captured in this battle, directly leading to Zhu Qiyu being enthroned, and it is considered a turning point from prosperity to decline for the Ming Dynasty.

birth_place.zh-cn: 大明北直隶顺天府紫禁城
birth_place.en: Forbidden City, Shuntian Prefecture, North Zhili, Ming Dynasty

death_place.zh-cn: 大明北直隶顺天府紫禁城
death_place.en: Forbidden City, Shuntian Prefecture, North Zhili, Ming Dynasty

description.zh-cn: 明朝第六位和第八位皇帝，明宣宗长子，景泰帝的异母兄长，年号正统和天顺。其在位期间，经历土木堡之变被俘，后发动“夺门之变”复辟，并最终废除了宫妃殉葬制度。
description.en: The Zhengtong and Tianshun Emperor (personal name Zhu Qizhen) was the sixth and eighth emperor of the Ming dynasty, and the elder half-brother of the Jingtai Emperor. During his reign, he was captured in the Tumu Crisis, later restored to the throne through the Duomen Coup, and eventually abolished the system of concubine burial.

description.zh-cn: 明朝宦官，在英宗首次在位期间专权，怂恿英宗亲征导致土木堡之变，并在此役中被杀。
description.en: A Ming Dynasty eunuch who monopolized power during Emperor Yingzong's first reign. He instigated the emperor to personally lead the expedition that resulted in the Tumu Crisis, where he was killed.

description.zh-cn: 蒙古族的一支，在土木堡之变中俘虏了明英宗。
description.en: A group of Mongol tribes that captured Emperor Yingzong during the Tumu Crisis.

description.zh-cn: 瓦剌太师，在土木堡之变中俘虏明英宗，后率军围攻北京并将其送还明朝。
description.en: The Taishi of the Oirats who captured Emperor Yingzong during the Tumu Crisis, later besieged Beijing, and eventually returned him to the Ming Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 明朝名臣，官至兵部尚书、太子太傅。在土木堡之变后拥立朱祁钰（景泰帝）为帝，并领导北京保卫战取得胜利。后在夺门之变后被明英宗以谋逆罪杀害。
description.en: A famous official of the Ming dynasty, serving as Minister of War and Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince. He supported Zhu Qiyu (the Jingtai Emperor)'s ascension to the throne after the Tumu Crisis and led the Defense of Beijing to victory. He was later executed for treason by Emperor Yingzong after the Duomen Coup.

description.zh-cn: 明朝第七位皇帝（1449年-1457年在位），明宣宗朱瞻基次子，明英宗朱祁镇异母弟。因土木堡之变中兄长被俘而即位，后在夺门之变中被复辟的兄长废黜。
description.en: The Jingtai Emperor (personal name Zhu Qiyu) was the seventh emperor of the Ming dynasty, reigning from 1449 to 1457. He was the second son of the Xuande Emperor and the younger half-brother of the Zhengtong Emperor. He ascended the throne after his brother was captured in the Tumu Crisis, and was later deposed by his brother in the Duomen Coup.

description.zh-cn: 土木堡之变后，于谦领导明军成功抗击并抵御了瓦剌对北京的入侵。
description.en: Following the Tumu Crisis, the Ming army, led by Yu Qian, successfully defended Beijing against the Oirat invasion.

description.zh-cn: 明代宗景泰八年（1457年），由曹吉祥、石亨、徐有贞等人趁景泰帝病重发动，拥立被软禁的太上皇明英宗复辟的宫廷军事政变，导致景泰帝被废。
description.en: A military and palace coup launched by Cao Jixiang, Shi Heng, Xu Youzhen, and others, who took advantage of the Jingtai Emperor's illness to restore the imprisoned Emperor Emeritus Yingzong to the throne, leading to the deposition of the Jingtai Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 明朝内阁首辅，万历初年改革的推行者，明神宗的帝师，明穆宗顾命大臣。
明神宗在位前十年，在张居正的辅佐下，明朝出现的短暂中兴局面。
明穆宗第三子，明朝第十三位皇帝，明代在位时间最长的皇帝，明光宗之父。其遗骸于1966年8月被红卫兵焚毁。
description.en: The third son of Emperor Muzong of Ming, the 13th and longest-reigning emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and father of Emperor Guangzong of Ming. His remains were burned by Red Guards in August 1966.

description.zh-cn: 明神宗在位中后期，长期不理朝政的现象。
后金与明朝的战略决战，以后金大胜告终。
中国明朝末期宦官，天启年间权倾朝野，人称“九千岁”。他掌控朝政，与客氏结盟，拉拢齐楚浙党组成阉党，残酷打击东林党人。其党羽曾与袁崇焕在辽东事务上产生摩擦。崇祯帝即位后，他被清算，最终畏罪自杀，尸身被凌迟。
description.en: A Chinese eunuch who lived in the late Ming dynasty. Known as the 'Nine Thousand Years', he held immense power during the Tianqi era and controlled the court. He formed a political alliance with Madam Ke and created the 'Eunuch Party' by aligning with officials from the Qi, Chu, and Zhe factions, brutally persecuting the Donglin Party. His associates clashed with Yuan Chonghuan over Liaodong affairs. He was purged after the Chongzhen Emperor ascended the throne, eventually committing suicide to avoid capture, and his corpse was subjected to lingchi.

description.zh-cn: 天启年间以宦官魏忠贤为首的政治集团，与东林党进行了激烈的党争。
description.en: A political faction headed by the eunuch Wei Zhongxian during the Tianqi era, which engaged in a fierce power struggle with the Donglin Party.

description.zh-cn: 明朝末年的一个士大夫政治集团，主张开放言路、澄清吏治，在天启年间遭到阉党的残酷打击。
description.en: A political faction of scholar-officials in the late Ming dynasty who advocated for open criticism and clean governance. They were brutally suppressed by the Eunuch Party during the Tianqi era.

description.zh-cn: 儒家哲学流派
罗马教宗
根据《凡尔登条约》从法兰克王国分裂出的国家，为神圣罗马帝国的前身。
中世纪欧洲神圣罗马帝国皇帝与罗马教廷之间关于主教叙任权的斗争。

zh-cn: 亨利四世 (神圣罗马帝国)

description.zh-cn: 神圣罗马帝国皇帝，叙任权斗争中的关键人物。
罗马教宗，推动克吕尼改革，与亨利四世发生冲突。
神圣罗马帝国皇帝亨利五世与教宗和主教们达成的协议，结束了叙任权斗争。

zh-cn: 腓特烈二世 (神圣罗马帝国)

description.zh-cn: 霍亨斯陶芬王朝的神圣罗马帝国皇帝。
神圣罗马帝国史上没有一位国王能得到普遍认可的时期，导致诸侯权力扩大。
欧洲历史上一次大规模的国际战争，主要在德意志地区进行，对当地经济和人口造成了巨大破坏。它削弱了哈布斯堡家族的实力，并标志着神圣罗马帝国衰落的开端。
description.en: A large-scale international war in European history, primarily fought in the German lands, which caused immense economic and demographic devastation. It weakened the power of the House of Habsburg and marked the beginning of the decline of the Holy Roman Empire.

description.zh-cn: 结束三十年战争的一系列和约，确立了神圣罗马帝国内诸侯的主权。
哈布斯堡王朝的核心领地，神圣罗马帝国内的主要邦国。
由拿破仑一世在德意志地区组建的亲法邦联，是法兰西第一帝国的卫星国。其成员脱离了神圣罗马帝国，也是神圣罗马帝国解体的直接原因之一。
description.en: A pro-French confederation established by Napoleon I in the German region, serving as a satellite state of the First French Empire. Its members seceded from the Holy Roman Empire, and its formation was also one of the direct causes of the Holy Roman Empire's dissolution.

zh-cn: 弗朗茨二世 (神圣罗马帝国)

description.zh-cn: 哈布斯堡-洛林王朝成员，神圣罗马帝国末任皇帝。为应对拿破仑称帝，他创立奥地利皇位并成为首任奥地利皇帝（弗朗茨一世）。1806年奥斯特里茨战役战败后，他于8月6日宣布解散神圣罗马帝国。
description.en: A member of the House of Habsburg-Lorraine and the last Holy Roman Emperor. In response to Napoleon crowning himself emperor, he founded the Austrian imperial title and became the first Emperor of Austria (as Francis I). After the defeat at the Battle of Austerlitz, he announced the dissolution of the Holy Roman Empire on August 6, 1806.

en: Dissolution of the Holy Roman Empire

description.zh-cn: 神圣罗马帝国正式灭亡的事件。
法兰克王国国王，800年被加冕为“罗马人的皇帝”。
为查理曼加冕的罗马教宗。
由神圣罗马皇帝弗朗茨二世建立的国家。

zh-cn: 查理五世 (神圣罗马帝国)

description.zh-cn: 哈布斯堡王朝的君主，同时统治神圣罗马帝国和西班牙帝国。
伊朗第二任最高领袖。他将阿米尼示威定性为“暴乱”，并指责其由美国及以色列策划。
description.en: The second Supreme Leader of Iran, who characterized the Mahsa Amini protests as 'riots' and accused the United States and Israel of planning them.

description.zh-cn: 现任伊朗第一副总统。

zh-cn: 穆罕默德-巴盖尔·加利巴夫

description.zh-cn: 现任伊斯兰议会议长。
伊朗伊斯兰共和国的最高立法机构。
导致巴列维王朝覆亡、伊朗伊斯兰共和国成立的革命。
统治伊朗的最后一个王朝。
伊朗伊斯兰革命的政治和精神领袖，伊朗伊斯兰共和国的创始人和第一任最高领袖。
description.en: The political and spiritual leader of the Iranian Revolution, the founder and first Supreme Leader of the Islamic Republic of Iran.

location.en: Embassy of the United States, Tehran

description.zh-cn: 1979年伊朗革命后，伊朗穆斯林群众占领美国驻伊朗大使馆，扣留66名美国外交官和平民长达444天，引发一场危机。
description.en: A crisis following the 1979 Iranian Revolution where 66 American diplomats and civilians were held hostage for 444 days after the U.S. Embassy in Tehran was seized.

description.zh-cn: 巴列维王朝的创始人。
1951年当选的伊朗改革派首相，后于1953年在美国和英国支持的政变中被推翻。
description.en: The reformist Prime Minister of Iran elected in 1951, who was overthrown in a 1953 coup backed by the United States and the United Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 由美国中央情报局策划的推翻伊朗首相摩萨台的政变。
巴列维国王推行的一系列农业与工业改革。
伊朗与伊拉克之间长达8年的边境战争。
伊拉克共和国。
前伊拉克总统，曾发动两伊战争，其政权在美国发动的伊拉克战争中被推翻。
description.en: Former President of Iraq, whose regime was overthrown in the U.S.-led Iraq War.

birth_place.zh-cn: 美国康涅狄格州纽黑文市

description.zh-cn: 美国政治人物，曾担任美国第43任总统。2008年，他曾在白宫会见魏京生等五名中国异议人士。
description.en: American politician who served as the 43rd President of the United States. In 2008, he met with Wei Jingsheng and four other Chinese dissidents at the White House.

description.zh-cn: 指参与伊朗核问题谈判的六个世界大国，包括联合国安理会五个常任理事国（中国、法国、俄罗斯、英国、美国）以及德国。
曾任伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队圣城旅指挥官。
22岁的伊朗库尔德族女子玛莎·阿米尼因“违反着装规范”被指导巡逻队逮捕后于医院死亡。她的死是引发全国性阿米尼示威的直接导火索。
description.en: Mahsa Amini, a 22-year-old Iranian Kurdish woman, died in a hospital after being arrested by the Guidance Patrol for an 'improper hijab.' Her death was the direct trigger for the nationwide Mahsa Amini protests.

description.zh-cn: 自2022年9月16日以来在伊朗爆发的大规模示威运动，由玛莎·阿米尼之死引发，抗议强制佩戴头巾及伊朗伊斯兰共和国政府的统治。
description.en: A series of large-scale protests that began in Iran on September 16, 2022, sparked by the death of Mahsa Amini, protesting against the compulsory hijab and the rule of the Islamic Republic of Iran.

description.zh-cn: 以色列国。在军事上与新加坡关系紧密，曾派遣军官指导新加坡军队的建立。同时，伊朗最高领袖哈梅内伊曾指责以色列与美国共同策划阿米尼示威，而以色列总理则批评伊朗政权为“杀人政府”。
description.en: Israel. It has close military ties with Singapore, having dispatched officers to guide the establishment of the Singaporean army. Concurrently, Iran's Supreme Leader Khamenei accused Israel of co-planning the Amini protests with the United States, while the Israeli Prime Minister criticized the Iranian regime as a 'murderous regime'.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗伊斯兰共和国的武装部队之一，负责维护伊斯兰教义和国内秩序。其总司令侯赛因·萨拉米曾警告示威者，并指控沙特阿拉伯支持示威。
description.en: One of the armed forces of the Islamic Republic of Iran, responsible for maintaining Islamic doctrines and domestic order. Its commander, Hossein Salami, has warned protesters and accused Saudi Arabia of supporting the demonstrations.

description.zh-cn: 负责选举、监督、罢免伊朗最高领袖的机构。

en: Armed Forces of the Soviet Union

description.zh-cn: 国际联盟李顿调查团就九一八事变发表的调查报告。报告谴责了日本的行为，并指出满洲国并非独立运动产物，但主张承认日本在东北的特殊地位。
description.en: The investigation report on the Mukden Incident published by the League of Nations' Lytton Commission. It condemned Japan's actions, concluded that Manchukuo was not a product of an independence movement, but advocated for recognizing Japan's special status in Northeast China.

description.zh-cn: 满洲国首任国务总理大臣。
日本陆军中将，时任关东军作战主任参谋，是九一八事变的主要策划者之一。
description.en: A lieutenant general in the Imperial Japanese Army who was the Operations Staff Officer of the Kwantung Army and one of the chief masterminds of the Mukden Incident.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，吉林省代理长官，向日本投降并推动建立满洲国。
满洲国成立前的过渡政权机构。
日本与满洲国签订的条约，规定日本承认满洲国并拥有驻军权，确立了日本对满洲国的控制。
溥仪于1945年8月18日宣读的诏书，宣告满洲国终结。

zh-cn: 阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹·本·阿卜杜拉赫曼·本·费萨尔·阿勒沙特

description.zh-cn: 现代沙乌地阿拉伯王国的开国君主。

zh-cn: 萨勒曼·本·阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹·阿勒沙特

description.zh-cn: 沙乌地阿拉伯第七任国王。
沙乌地阿拉伯王储兼首相。
世界性宗教，也是沙烏地阿拉伯的國教。
description.en: A major world religion.

description.zh-cn: 逊尼派伊斯兰教内的伊斯兰复兴主义和原教旨主义运动，由穆罕默德·伊本·阿卜杜勒·瓦哈卜发起。其信徒自称“一神论者”，教义极端保守。该运动是沙特阿拉伯奉行的官方意识形态和国教，属逊尼派一支。
description.en: An Islamic revivalist and fundamentalist movement within Sunni Islam, founded by Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab. Its followers refer to themselves as 'Muwahhidun' (Unitarians) and hold ultraconservative doctrines. It is the official state ideology and state religion adopted by Saudi Arabia, belonging to a branch of Sunni Islam.

description.zh-cn: 沙乌地新闻工作者及异议人士。
沙乌地阿拉伯前王储。

zh-cn: 沙特·本·阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹·阿勒沙特

description.zh-cn: 沙乌地阿拉伯第二任国王。

zh-cn: 费萨尔·本·阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹·阿勒沙特

description.zh-cn: 沙乌地阿拉伯第三任国王。
伊斯兰教的第二大教派，被瓦哈比派视为异端，在沙乌地阿拉伯是少数派并受到压制。
description.en: The second-largest branch of Islam, considered heretical by Wahhabism, it is a minority in Saudi Arabia and suppressed.

description.zh-cn: 突厥斯坦伊斯兰党的创始地之一，同时也是该组织的反对者，曾参与对其的打击行动。
description.en: One of the founding locations of the Turkistan Islamic Party, and also an opponent of the group, having participated in operations against it.

description.zh-cn: 伊斯兰教的核心宗教文本，被视为沙乌地阿拉伯的最高宪法。
沙乌地阿拉伯国家行事的法律依据。

zh-cn: 穆罕默德·伊本·阿卜杜勒·瓦哈卜
穆罕默德·伊本·阿布杜勒·瓦哈比

description.zh-cn: 阿拉伯伊斯兰教学者，瓦哈比派运动的创始人。
description.en: An Arab Islamic scholar and the founder of the Wahhabi movement.

description.zh-cn: 德拉伊耶的部落酋长，绍德家族的领袖，与穆罕默德·伊本·阿卜杜勒·瓦哈卜合作建立了第一个沙特国家。
description.en: The tribal chief of Diriyah and leader of the House of Saud, who collaborated with Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab to establish the first Saudi state.

description.zh-cn: 原中共中央军委办公室主任。
原上海申能集团副总经理。曾任黄菊秘书，因涉嫌向陈良宇通风报信及受贿而在陈良宇事件中被捕。
description.en: Former Deputy General Manager of Shanghai Shenneng Group and former secretary to Huang Ju. He was arrested during the Chen Liangyu incident for allegedly tipping off Chen Liangyu and accepting bribes.

description.zh-cn: 原中共中央警卫局局长。
原中共中央警卫局局长。
原上海光明食品集团公司董事长。

en: Death and state funeral of Jiang Zemin

description.zh-cn: 中国历史上继五代十国之后的朝代，与南宋合称宋朝。其为宋朝的前半期，首都为东京开封府。
description.en: A dynasty in Chinese history following the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period. Together with the Southern Song, it forms the Song dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 北宋开国皇帝，史称宋太祖。他是一位政治家和军事家，曾任后周殿前都点检，是宋太宗的胞兄。他下令征讨南汉。
description.en: Founding emperor of the Northern Song dynasty, known as Emperor Taizu of Song. He was a politician and military general, formerly Supreme Commander of the Palace Guard of Later Zhou, and elder brother of Emperor Taizong of Song. He ordered the conquest of Southern Han.

description.zh-cn: 赵匡胤部下在陈桥驿发动兵变，拥立其为皇帝，建立宋朝。
description.en: A mutiny launched by Zhao Kuangyin's subordinates at Chen Bridge Post, which led to his enthronement and the founding of the Song dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 五代十国时期最后一个朝代。
后周最后一位皇帝，被迫禅位予赵匡胤。
宋太祖为加强中央集权，解除禁军将领及地方藩镇兵权的政治事件。
description.en: A political event where Emperor Taizu of Song relieved his generals of their commands to consolidate central authority.

description.zh-cn: 北宋初年重要将领，在“杯酒释兵权”中被解除兵权。
北宋第二位皇帝，宋太祖赵匡胤之弟。
description.en: The second emperor of the Northern Song dynasty, younger brother of Zhao Kuangyin.

description.zh-cn: 一份据称由杜太后（昭宪太后）口授、赵普记录的誓书，内容为兄终弟及，规定了宋朝初期的皇位继承顺序。宋太宗以此作为其继位合法性的依据。
description.en: A purported pledge dictated by Empress Dowager Du and recorded by Zhao Pu, which stipulated the imperial succession order in the early Song dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 金朝攻破北宋首都东京开封府，俘虏宋徽宗、宋钦宗二帝，导致北宋灭亡的历史事件。
description.en: A historical event in which the Jin dynasty conquered the Northern Song capital, Tokyo, and captured Emperors Huizong and Qinzong, leading to the fall of the Northern Song dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 北宋末代皇帝，宋徽宗长子，宋高宗之兄。与宋徽宗一同于靖康之变被俘。
description.en: The last emperor of the Northern Song dynasty, the eldest son of Emperor Huizong. Captured along with his father during the Jingkang Incident.

description.zh-cn: 南宋开国皇帝，宋徽宗第九子，宋钦宗之弟。
南宋抗金名将、民族英雄，中兴四将之一。
南宋宰相，主和派代表人物，被认为是害死岳飞的主谋。
南宋与金朝签订的和平协议，确立了两国以淮水-大散关为界的局面。
南宋末年丞相，在厓山海战后背负幼主宋帝昺投海殉国。
南宋最后一位皇帝。
北宋政治家、改革家，在宋神宗支持下推行新法，主导熙宁变法。
description.en: A politician and reformer of the Northern Song dynasty who, with the support of Emperor Shenzong, implemented the New Policies, leading the Xining Reforms.

description.zh-cn: 由宋神宗任用王安石主持的，旨在富国强兵的一系列社会经济改革运动。该变法引发了朝廷内部守旧派与改革派长期的政治斗争。
description.en: A series of socio-economic reforms aimed at enriching the state and strengthening the military, initiated by Emperor Shenzong and led by Wang Anshi. The reforms led to long-term political struggles between conservative and reformist factions at court.

description.zh-cn: 北宋政治家、史学家，作为守旧派领袖，激烈反对王安石变法。
description.en: A politician and historian of the Northern Song dynasty. As the leader of the conservative faction, he vehemently opposed the Wang Anshi Reforms.

description.zh-cn: 北宋第六位皇帝，宋徽宗之父。在位期间，因对北宋积贫积弱的状况深感忧心，启用王安石推行熙宁变法，并对外发动熙河开边，意图富国强兵，但变法引发了剧烈的新旧党争，对外军事行动也遭遇永乐城之战的惨败。
description.en: The sixth emperor of the Northern Song dynasty, father of Emperor Huizong. During his reign, concerned about the state's poverty and weakness, he appointed Wang Anshi to implement the Xining Reforms and launched the Xihe Expansion campaign, aiming to enrich the state and strengthen its military. However, the reforms triggered intense factional struggles, and his foreign military campaigns suffered a disastrous defeat at the Battle of Yongle City.

description.zh-cn: 荷兰政治人物，现任北大西洋公约组织秘书长。
挪威政治人物，曾任北大西洋公约组织秘书长。
建立北大西洋公约组织的条约。
为对抗北约而成立的军事集团。
北约军事总部。
北约领导的驻阿富汗维和部队。
于2017年将“东伊运”列入恐怖主义名单。
description.en: Listed ETIM as a terrorist organization in 2017.

description.zh-cn: 位于波罗的海东岸的欧洲东北部国家，是波罗的海国家之一。现为欧盟和北约成员国。
description.en: A country in Northeastern Europe on the eastern shore of the Baltic Sea, one of the Baltic states. Currently a member of the EU and NATO.

description.zh-cn: 欧洲国家。在1960年代初中苏交恶期间，接受了中国大量的粮食和经济援助。
description.en: A European country. During the Sino-Soviet split in the early 1960s, it received substantial food and economic aid from China.

description.zh-cn: 联合国的主要机构之一，负责维护国际和平与安全。曾通过决议授权北约采取军事行动，并通过第84号决议授权组建了联合国军。于2002年将“东伊运”列入恐怖组织名单。
description.en: One of the principal organs of the United Nations, responsible for maintaining international peace and security. It has authorized NATO military actions through resolutions, authorized the formation of the United Nations Command through Resolution 84, and listed ETIM as a terrorist organization in 2002.

description.zh-cn: 利比亚前领导人。2011年北约军事干预导致其政权在第一次利比亚内战中被推翻并被杀，结束了长达42年的统治。
description.en: Former leader of Libya. His regime was overthrown and he was killed during the First Libyan Civil War in 2011, following NATO military intervention, which ended his 42-year rule.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国的执政党。
description.en: The ruling party of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 二战后苏联在朝鲜半岛北部设立的军事管理机构。

zh-cn: 北朝鲜临时人民委员会
en: Provisional People's Committee of North Korea

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国成立前的临时最高行政机关。
朝鲜劳动党内曾存在的亲华派系，后被金日成清洗。
朝鲜劳动党内的亲苏联派系。
前韩国情报部长。
根据《朝鲜停战协定》设立的缓冲区，横贯朝鲜半岛，将朝鲜民主主义人民共和国与大韩民国隔开。
description.en: A buffer zone established by the Korean Armistice Agreement that runs across the Korean Peninsula, separating the Democratic People's Republic of Korea from the Republic of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国政治及军事人物，前朝鲜党和国家领导干部，曾一度被视为朝鲜实际上的“二号人物”。他曾任国家体育指导委员会首任委员长，是金正恩的姑父。
description.en: A political and military figure in the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, a former high-ranking official of the Workers' Party and the state, once considered the de facto 'second-in-command' of North Korea. He served as the first Chairman of the State Physical Culture and Sports Guidance Commission and was Kim Jong Un's uncle by marriage.

birth_place.zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国江原道川内郡

death_place.zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国平壤市

zh-cn: 俄朝全面战略伙伴关系条约
en: North Korean–Russian Treaty on Comprehensive Strategic Partnership

description.zh-cn: 1990年代朝鲜发生的大规模饥荒。

zh-cn: 朝鲜劳动党中央军事委员会
en: Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜劳动党的最高军事决策机构。
Google联合创始人，曾在斯坦福大学攻读博士学位。2011年至2015年担任Google首席执行官。
description.en: Co-founder of Google, who was a Ph.D. student at Stanford University. He served as the CEO of Google from 2011 to 2015.

description.zh-cn: Google于2015年重组后成立的控股母公司，总部位于美国。
description.en: The holding parent company established after Google's restructuring in 2015, headquartered in the United States.

description.zh-cn: 自2015年起担任Google的首席执行官。
description.en: CEO of Google since 2015.

description.zh-cn: 一款由Google主导开发并持续更新的移动设备操作系统，于2005年被Google公司收购。
description.en: A mobile operating system primarily developed and continuously updated by Google, acquired by Google in 2005.

description.zh-cn: 网络出版与广告商，为Google子公司。
一家电信设备制造商，曾于2011年被Google收购。
description.en: A telecommunications equipment manufacturer that was acquired by Google in 2011.

description.zh-cn: 美国消费电子产品和健身公司，为Alphabet子公司。
Sun Microsystems的联合创始人，Google项目最早的投资者之一。
description.en: Co-founder of Sun Microsystems and one of the earliest investors in the Google project.

description.zh-cn: 美国风险投资公司，Google的早期投资者。
美国风险投资公司，Google的早期投资者。
中国政府在其管辖互联网内部建立的互联网审查系统，常被称为“互联网边界审查系统”，导致“温云松”等词成为网络搜索的敏感词。
description.en: The common term for the Internet censorship system of the Chinese government, which has made terms like 'Wen Yunsong' sensitive for web searches.

description.zh-cn: Google公司的首位雇员。
由孙正义领导的日本跨国企业集团，是新天域资本公司的长期投资者。

description.en: A Chinese input method created by Chu Bong-Foo in 1976, originally named 'Glyph-meaning Indexing Method'. It is one of the most common input methods in Hong Kong and Macau. Commercial derivatives of Cangjie have simplified decomposition rules to increase input speed, with one such variant being used by the current record holder for the fastest Chinese computer typing.

He authored many popular wuxia novels such as the 'Chu Liuxiang Series' and 'Juedai Shuangjiao', which have been frequently adapted into films and television series.
