description.en: The outbreak of COVID-19 in mainland China.

description.zh-cn: 由柯文哲于2019年创立的台湾政党之一。在大罢免运动中，与中国国民党合作，发起“扫除绿卫兵”行动参与罢免民进党籍民意代表。
description.en: A political party in Taiwan, founded by Ko Wen-je in 2019. During the Great Recall movement, it collaborated with the Kuomintang and launched the 'Sweep the Green Guards' campaign to participate in the recall of DPP representatives.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物、医师，台湾民众党创党主席，曾任台北市市长，柯美兰的胞兄。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician and physician, founding chairman of the Taiwan People's Party, former Mayor of Taipei, and the elder brother of Ko Mei-lan.

description.zh-cn: 指台北市京华城购物中心原址改建案，因容积率变更引发的图利争议及司法调查案件。
description.en: Refers to the redevelopment case of the former Core Pacific City shopping center site in Taipei, which sparked controversy and judicial investigation over changes in the floor area ratio, leading to allegations of illicit gains.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物、护理师，台湾民众党籍。
台湾网络名人、企业家，与黄国昌共同举办多场社会运动。

zh-cn: 「拒绝红色媒体、守护台湾民主」游行

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾为罢免运动目标。
台湾政治团体，曾发动对黄国昌的罢免案。
中华民国政治人物，曾连任七届立法委员。他曾是黄国昌2016年立委选举的竞争对手。因在立委任内诈领助理费而被以贪污罪起诉，后潜逃并被通缉。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China, and Huang Kuo-chang's opponent in the 2016 legislative election. He served seven consecutive terms as a legislator, but was later indicted for corruption for fraudulently claiming assistant fees during his tenure and subsequently became a fugitive.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，中国国民党籍，傅兆林之子。现任立法委员、中国国民党立法院党团总召集人，并担任中国国民党中央委员会政策委员会执行长。曾任花莲县县长。他是大罢免运动中罢免泛蓝阵营的指标性人物之一，也是徐榛蔚的丈夫。
description.en: Taiwanese politician, son of Fu Zhaolin. He is a KMT legislator and currently serves as the caucus convener for the KMT in the Legislative Yuan, and also as the Executive Director of the KMT Policy Committee. He previously served as Hualien County Magistrate. He was one of the iconic targets of the recall effort against the Pan-Blue camp during the Great Recall movement, and is the husband of Hsu Chen-wei.

zh-cn: 中国国民党立法院党团

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党在立法院的议会党团。
中华民国政治人物，时代力量籍，时任时代力量党主席。
台湾政治人物。
台湾政治人物。
台湾政治人物、律师，党外运动重要人物，美丽岛事件受刑人之一。曾任第八届民主进步党主席。因其在反核运动中的形象，也被称为“斗笠人”。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician and lawyer, a prominent figure in the Tangwai movement, and one of the defendants in the Kaohsiung Incident. He served as the 8th Chairman of the Democratic Progressive Party. Due to his image in the anti-nuclear movement, he is also known as the 'Douli Man'.

description.zh-cn: 台湾人权工作者，时任民间司法改革基金会执行长。
明仁宗朱高炽的皇后，明宣宗朱瞻基之母。
description.en: Empress of the Hongxi Emperor, mother of the Xuande Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 明朝第五位皇帝，明仁宗朱高炽长子，明英宗和景泰帝的父亲，朱高煦之侄。他平定了叔父朱高煦的叛乱，并非常器重于谦。
description.en: The fifth emperor of the Ming Dynasty, eldest son of the Hongxi Emperor Zhu Gaochi, father of Emperor Yingzong and the Jingtai Emperor, and nephew of Zhu Gaoxu. He suppressed the rebellion of his uncle Zhu Gaoxu.

description.zh-cn: 明仁宗和明宣宗统治时期，政治清明、经济发展的盛世。
description.en: A period of stability and prosperity during the reigns of the Hongxi and Xuande emperors.

description.zh-cn: 明朝重臣，历仕建文、永乐、洪熙、宣德四朝。
description.en: An important official of the Ming dynasty, serving four emperors.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，因劝谏触怒明仁宗而下狱。
description.en: A Ming dynasty official who was imprisoned for admonishing the Hongxi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，因劝谏触怒明仁宗而下狱。
description.en: A Ming dynasty official who was imprisoned for admonishing the Hongxi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 明朝内阁首辅大臣，辅佐明宣宗。
description.en: Grand Secretary of the Ming dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 宋神宗的妃嫔，宋徽宗的生母，被追尊为皇后。
description.en: A consort of Emperor Shenzong and the biological mother of Emperor Huizong, posthumously honored as an empress.

description.zh-cn: 北宋第七位皇帝，宋神宗的第六子和继任者，宋徽宗之兄。
description.en: The seventh emperor of the Northern Song dynasty, the sixth son and successor of Emperor Shenzong, and elder brother of Emperor Huizong.

description.zh-cn: 宋神宗的皇后，在宋哲宗去世后，支持宋徽宗继位。
description.en: Empress of Emperor Shenzong who supported Emperor Huizong's succession after Emperor Zhezong's death.

description.zh-cn: 北宋宰相，曾反对宋徽宗继位。
description.en: A chancellor of the Northern Song dynasty who opposed Emperor Huizong's succession.

description.zh-cn: 北宋宰相，宋徽宗时期“六贼”之一，被认为是导致北宋灭亡的奸臣。
description.en: A chancellor of the Northern Song dynasty, one of the "Six Traitors" during Emperor Huizong's reign, considered a corrupt official who contributed to the fall of the dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 北宋宦官、将领，宋徽宗时期“六贼”之一。
description.en: A eunuch and general of the Northern Song dynasty, one of the "Six Traitors" during Emperor Huizong's reign.

description.zh-cn: 金朝第二位皇帝，发动靖康之变，俘虏了宋徽宗和宋钦宗。
description.en: The second emperor of the Jin dynasty, who launched the Jingkang Incident and captured Emperor Huizong and Emperor Qinzong.

description.zh-cn: 北宋末年宋江领导的农民起义。
description.en: A peasant rebellion led by Song Jiang at the end of the Northern Song dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 北宋末年方腊领导的农民起义。
description.en: A peasant rebellion led by Fang La at the end of the Northern Song dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 北宋与金朝为联合夹击辽朝而订立的盟约。
description.en: An alliance formed between the Northern Song and Jin dynasties to jointly attack the Liao dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 由契丹族建立的统治中国北方的封建王朝，与北宋长期对峙。
description.en: A feudal dynasty established by the Khitan people that ruled northern China and was a long-term rival of the Northern Song.

description.zh-cn: 北宋末年东京的著名艺伎，与宋徽宗有交往。
description.en: A famous courtesan in Tokyo during the late Northern Song dynasty, who had a relationship with Emperor Huizong.

description.zh-cn: 北宋著名词人，传说与宋徽宗为李师师争风吃醋。
description.en: A famous poet of the Northern Song dynasty, rumored to have been a rival of Emperor Huizong for the affection of Li Shishi.

description.zh-cn: 宋徽宗的原配皇后，宋钦宗的生母。
description.en: Emperor Huizong's first empress consort and the biological mother of Emperor Qinzong.

description.zh-cn: 宋徽宗的继室皇后，靖康之变被俘。
description.en: Emperor Huizong's second empress consort, captured during the Jingkang Incident.

description.zh-cn: 宋徽宗的妃嫔，宋高宗的生母。
description.en: A consort of Emperor Huizong and the biological mother of Emperor Gaozong.

description.zh-cn: 金朝第三位皇帝，为改善与南宋关系，追封宋徽宗为天水郡王。
description.en: The third emperor of the Jin dynasty who posthumously honored Emperor Huizong as Prince of Tianshui Commandery to improve relations with the Southern Song.

description.zh-cn: 刘备之父
蜀汉第二位、也是最后一位皇帝，刘备之子。
description.en: The second and last emperor of Shu Han, son of Liu Bei.

description.zh-cn: 刘备三子，封为梁王、安平王
中国东汉末年至三国时代蜀汉的将领，刘备的养子。
description.en: A general of Shu Han during the late Eastern Han dynasty and Three Kingdoms period of China, the adopted son of Liu Bei.

description.zh-cn: 刘备的正室夫人，麋竺之妹
孙权的妹妹，刘备的继室夫人，曾试图将刘禅带往东吴。
description.en: Sister of Sun Quan and wife of Liu Bei, who attempted to take Liu Shan to Eastern Wu.

description.zh-cn: 刘备的继室夫人，吴懿之妹
刘备的妾室，刘禅的生母。
description.en: A concubine of Liu Bei and the biological mother of Liu Shan.

birth_place.en: Yangdu County, Langya Commandery, Eastern Han

description.zh-cn: 三国时期蜀汉丞相，刘备的主要辅佐大臣，受刘备托孤辅佐刘禅。他也是诸葛瑾之弟，诸葛乔的养父。他是一位杰出的政治家、军事家、发明家及散文家，曾于228年征集兵丁守护都江堰，并设立专职堰官进行管理。
description.en: Chancellor of Shu Han during the Three Kingdoms period, he served as regent for Liu Shan on Liu Bei's request. He was the younger brother of Zhuge Jin and the adoptive father of Zhuge Qiao. An outstanding statesman, military strategist, inventor, and writer, he also conscripted soldiers in 228 to guard Dujiangyan and established specialized weir officials for its management.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年至三国时期蜀汉名将，刘备的义弟兼主要部将之一。他曾与鲁肃就荆州问题进行谈判。在《三国演义》中，他被塑造为威猛刚毅、义重如山的形象。
description.en: A famous general of Shu Han from the late Eastern Han to the Three Kingdoms period, Liu Bei's sworn brother and one of his key commanders. He once negotiated with Lu Su regarding the Jing Province issue. In 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', he is depicted as a figure of might, resolution, and unwavering loyalty.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年至三国时期蜀汉名将，刘备的义弟，刘禅的岳父，五虎上将之一。
description.en: A military general serving under the warlord Liu Bei in the late Eastern Han dynasty and the state of Shu Han during the Three Kingdoms period of China, and the father-in-law of Liu Shan.

description.zh-cn: 三国时期蜀汉的著名将领，官至征南将军。他曾在长坂坡保护刘禅。
description.en: A renowned military general of the state of Shu Han during the Three Kingdoms period, who held the rank of General Who Conquers the South. He famously protected Liu Shan at Changban.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年权臣，曹魏的奠基者。在汉献帝东归后将其迎至许都，消灭了李傕势力。他是孙刘联盟的主要对抗目标，曹昂、曹丕之父，曹叡的祖父。曾因态度傲慢未能招揽张松，也曾被许贡提及孙策对他构成威胁。在《三国演义》中，他被塑造成一位“宁教我负天下人，休教天下人负我”的奸雄。
description.en: A powerful minister of the late Eastern Han dynasty and the founder of the state of Cao Wei. He welcomed Emperor Xian to Xudu after his return to the east and eliminated Li Jue's faction. He was the primary adversary of the Sun-Liu alliance, father of Cao Ang and Cao Pi, and grandfather of Cao Rui. His arrogant attitude prevented him from recruiting Zhang Song, and Sun Ce viewed him as a threat, as mentioned in Xu Gong's memorial. In 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', he is portrayed as a cunning and ambitious tyrant who famously declared, 'I would rather betray the world than let the world betray me.'

description.zh-cn: 孙策之弟，三国时期孙吴开国皇帝，六朝开拓者之首。
description.en: Younger brother of Sun Ce, and founder of the state of Eastern Wu during the Three Kingdoms period.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年名将，与王允合谋刺杀董卓，后被李傕、郭汜联军击败，逃离长安。
description.en: A famous general of the late Eastern Han dynasty. He conspired with Wang Yun to assassinate Dong Zhuo, but was later defeated by the allied forces of Li Jue and Guo Si and fled Chang'an.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年军阀，袁熙之父。
东汉末年军阀，势力曾进入扬州，击败割据江东的周氏兄弟。孙策、鲁肃与周瑜都曾短暂效力于其麾下。
description.en: A warlord in the late Eastern Han dynasty. His forces once entered Yang Province, defeating the Zhou brothers who controlled Jiangdong. Sun Ce, Lu Su, and Zhou Yu all briefly served under him.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年荆州牧，其去世引发了曹操南下及赤壁之战。
description.en: The governor of Jing Province in the late Eastern Han dynasty, whose death triggered Cao Cao's southern campaign and the Battle of Red Cliffs.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年益州牧。为抵御张鲁和曹操，听从张松建议迎刘备入蜀，后因发现张松密谋而将其处死，并与刘备交战。
description.en: Warlord and governor of Yi Province during the late Eastern Han dynasty. He invited Liu Bei into his territory on Zhang Song's advice to counter threats, but later executed Zhang Song upon discovering his conspiracy and went to war with Liu Bei.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年军阀
东汉末年徐州牧
东汉最后一位皇帝，先后被董卓、李傕、郭汜、曹操等人挟持控制。许贡曾上表于他，意图调走孙策。
description.en: The last emperor of the Eastern Han dynasty, who was held hostage and controlled successively by warlords such as Dong Zhuo, Li Jue, Guo Si, and Cao Cao. Xu Gong once submitted a memorial to him, proposing to transfer Sun Ce away.

description.zh-cn: 孙权、刘备联军在长江赤壁一带大破曹操大军的战役，是三国时期著名的以少胜多的战役，奠定了三国鼎立的基础。
description.en: A decisive naval battle in the winter of 208 at the end of the Han dynasty, where the allied forces of Sun Quan and Liu Bei decisively defeated the numerically superior forces of Cao Cao.

en: Liu Bei's takeover of Yi Province

description.zh-cn: 刘备夺取益州的战役
刘备从曹操手中夺取汉中的战役
关羽北伐曹操的战役，期间孙权偷袭荆州，导致关羽败亡。
刘备为关羽报仇并意图夺回荆州而讨伐东吴的战役。此战以蜀汉惨败告终。
description.en: A campaign launched by Liu Bei against Eastern Wu to avenge Guan Yu and reclaim Jingzhou. The battle resulted in a disastrous defeat for Shu Han.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮向刘备陈述的“三分天下”的战略规划。
蜀汉重臣，与诸葛亮同为刘备的托孤之臣。
description.en: A key official of Shu Han, co-regent with Zhuge Liang for Liu Shan.

description.zh-cn: 原为刘璋的部下，与张松关系良好。后与张松一同策划并协助刘备夺取益州，成为刘备的谋士。在取益州和汉中时多有贡献。
description.en: Originally a subordinate of Liu Zhang and an associate of Zhang Song. He later conspired with Zhang Song to assist Liu Bei in taking control of Yi Province, after which he became Liu Bei's strategist. He made significant contributions during the campaigns to take Yi Province and Hanzhong.

description.zh-cn: 刘璋的属下，后献图于刘备，促成刘备入蜀。
东汉末年大儒，刘备的老师。
汉献帝的岳父，衣带诏事件的主谋。
唐太宗李世民的第九子，嫡三子，李泰的胞弟。李承干被废后，被立为皇太子，后继位为唐高宗，成为唐朝第三位皇帝，也是安定公主的父亲。
description.en: The ninth son of Emperor Taizong Li Shimin and his third legitimate son, full brother of Li Tai. After Li Chengqian's deposition, he was made crown prince and later succeeded the throne as Emperor Gaozong, becoming the third emperor of the Tang dynasty and the father of Princess Anding.

description.zh-cn: 唐高宗李治第五子，武则天长子。
唐高宗第六子，章怀太子，李显之兄。
唐中宗，唐朝皇子，曾两次在位，是唐朝第四位和第六位皇帝，也是安定公主的同胞弟弟。
description.en: Emperor Zhongzong of Tang, a prince of the Tang dynasty, who reigned twice as the fourth and sixth emperor. He was also a full brother of Princess Anding.

description.zh-cn: 唐高宗的原配皇后，在安定公主死后被诬陷并废黜。
description.en: The first empress consort of Emperor Gaozong, who was framed and deposed after the death of Princess Anding.

description.zh-cn: 武则天建立的朝代。
description.en: A dynasty established by Wu Zetian.

description.zh-cn: 导致武则天退位，唐中宗复辟的政变。
唐朝、武周时期宰相，神龙政变策划者之一。
description.en: A chancellor of the Tang and Wu Zhou dynasties.

description.zh-cn: 武则天的男宠。
武则天的男宠。
唐中宗嫡长子，懿德太子。
唐中宗第七女。
唐朝、武周时期的著名宰相。
description.en: A famous chancellor of the Tang and Wu Zhou dynasties.

description.zh-cn: 武则天之侄。
description.en: Nephew of Wu Zetian.

description.zh-cn: 武则天之侄。
道光帝皇后，咸丰帝生母。
清朝道光年间的军机大臣，被认为是鸦片战争期间主和派的代表人物之一，与林则徐政见相左，并对其进行排挤。
description.en: A Grand Councilor during the Daoguang era of the Qing dynasty, considered a leading figure of the peace faction during the Opium War. He opposed Lin Zexu's policies and worked to undermine him.

description.zh-cn: 清朝大臣。
清朝后期政治家、思想家、文学家和学者，以在广东发起的禁烟运动及虎门销烟而闻名，是第一次鸦片战争中的关键人物。他主张了解和学习西方技术，被认为是中国近代“开眼看世界的第一人”。
description.en: A prominent Chinese scholar and official of the late Qing dynasty, best known for his role in the First Opium War and the destruction of opium at Humen. He was a proponent of learning from Western technology and is considered the 'first person to open his eyes to the world' in modern China.

description.zh-cn: 咸丰帝次子，早夭。
唐朝开国皇帝，唐太宗李世民之父。隋末时于晋阳起兵，攻入长安，废隋恭帝杨侑后称帝。
description.en: The founding emperor of the Tang dynasty and the father of Emperor Taizong, Li Shimin. He rebelled in Jinyang during the late Sui, captured Chang'an, and proclaimed himself emperor after deposing Emperor Gong Yang You.

description.zh-cn: 唐高祖李渊的皇后，唐太宗李世民之母。
description.en: Empress of Emperor Gaozu of Tang and mother of Emperor Taizong, Li Shimin.

description.zh-cn: 唐高祖李渊四子，与李建成结盟，在玄武门之变中被李世民所杀。
description.en: The fourth son of Emperor Gaozu of Tang, allied with Li Jiancheng, and was killed by Li Shimin's forces during the Xuanwu Gate Incident.

description.zh-cn: 由李世民发动的宫廷政变，通过杀死兄长李建成和四弟李元吉，确立了其皇位继承权。
description.en: A palace coup launched by Li Shimin, securing his succession to the throne by killing his elder brother Li Jiancheng and younger brother Li Yuanji.

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗李世民的皇后，李泰的母亲，以贤德著称。
description.en: Empress of Emperor Taizong of Tang, mother of Li Tai, known for her virtue and wisdom.

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗在位期间出现的政治清明、经济复苏、文化繁荣的治世局面。
description.en: A period of political stability, economic recovery, and cultural prosperity during Emperor Taizong's reign.

description.zh-cn: 李渊、李世民父子在晋阳发动的反隋起义，为唐朝的建立奠定了基础。
description.en: An anti-Sui uprising launched by Li Yuan and his son Li Shimin in Jinyang, which laid the foundation for the establishment of the Tang dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 隋末群雄之一，建立夏国，后在虎牢之战中被李世民击败并俘虏。
description.en: A warlord during the late Sui dynasty who established the state of Xia, later defeated and captured by Li Shimin at the Battle of Hulao.

description.zh-cn: 隋末唐初的群雄之一。他在洛阳废隋恭帝杨侗自立，建立郑国。虎牢之战后投降唐朝。
description.en: One of the warlords during the late Sui and early Tang dynasties. He deposed Emperor Gong Yang Tong in Luoyang, established himself as emperor, and founded the state of Zheng. After the Battle of Hulao, he surrendered to the Tang.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝统一战争中的决定性战役，李世民在此一举击败窦建德与王世充两大势力。
description.en: A decisive battle in the Tang unification wars, where Li Shimin defeated the forces of Dou Jiande and Wang Shichong.

description.zh-cn: 位于蒙古高原的游牧汗国，是突厥汗国分裂后形成的主要部分之一。其与隋朝时而战争时而臣服，隋末时曾支持地方割据势力，是唐朝初年的主要外部威胁，后被唐太宗所灭。
description.en: A nomadic khaganate on the Mongolian Plateau, and one of the main parts formed after the split of the Turkic Khaganate. It engaged in both conflict and vassalage with the Sui dynasty, and supported local warlords at the end of the Sui dynasty. It became a major external threat to the early Tang dynasty, later conquered by Emperor Taizong.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝皇帝作为中亚和北亚各民族的国际同盟之主的称号，始于唐太宗。
description.en: A title for the Tang emperor as the head of an international alliance of various peoples in Central and North Asia, starting with Emperor Taizong.

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗时期的著名谏臣和宰相，以直言敢谏著称。
description.en: A renowned chancellor and advisor during Emperor Taizong's reign, famous for his forthright remonstrance.

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗时期的主要谋士和宰相，与杜如晦并称“房谋杜断”。
description.en: A key advisor and chancellor to Emperor Taizong, known for his strategic planning.

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗时期的主要谋士和宰相，与房玄龄并称“房谋杜断”。
description.en: A key advisor and chancellor to Emperor Taizong, known for his decisive judgment.

description.zh-cn: 高句丽末期军事独裁者，其政变及对外扩张行为引发了唐朝的军事干预。
description.en: A military dictator of late Goguryeo whose coup and expansionist policies led to military intervention by the Tang dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 位于朝鲜半岛北部的古代王国，曾与隋朝和唐朝发生多次大规模战争，亦与新朝关系恶化。
description.en: An ancient kingdom on the Korean Peninsula that engaged in prolonged warfare with the Tang and Sui dynasties, and also had deteriorating relations with the Xin Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗嫡长子，原为皇太子，后因与李泰争储并图谋不轨而被废。
description.en: The eldest son of Emperor Taizong and original crown prince, who was deposed after plotting rebellion due to his rivalry with Li Tai.

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗第四子，深得宠爱，与太子李承干争夺储位，后被贬。
description.en: The fourth son of Emperor Taizong, highly favored by his father, who vied for the crown prince position with Li Chengqian and was later demoted.

description.zh-cn: 吐蕃赞普，统一青藏高原，并与唐朝和亲。
description.en: Emperor of the Tibetan Empire who unified the Tibetan Plateau and established a marriage alliance with the Tang dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝宗室女，嫁予吐蕃赞普松赞干布，是唐蕃和亲的重要人物。
description.en: A Tang imperial clanswoman who married Tibetan Emperor Songtsen Gampo, a key figure in the Tang-Tibetan marriage alliance.

description.zh-cn: 青藏高原上的一个帝国，与唐朝同期，双方既有战事（如趁安史之乱占领了唐朝的西域和河西走廊），也有和亲关系。
description.en: An empire on the Tibetan Plateau, contemporary with the Tang Dynasty. It engaged in both conflicts (such as taking advantage of the An Lushan Rebellion to occupy Tang's Western Regions and Hexi Corridor) and marriage alliances with Tang.

description.zh-cn: 嘉庆帝的原配妻子和第一任皇后。
嘉庆帝的第二任皇后。
嘉庆帝皇长子，早夭。
乾隆朝权臣，嘉庆帝亲政后被赐死。
嘉庆年间爆发的大规模白莲教起义。
川楚教乱首领之一。
天理教徒攻入紫禁城事件。
清代中期由白莲教演化出的一个民间宗教。1813年，其教徒在林清的带领下发动起义并攻打了紫禁城。
description.en: A folk religious sect in the mid-Qing dynasty that evolved from the White Lotus. In 1813, its followers, led by Lin Qing, launched an uprising and attacked the Forbidden City.

description.zh-cn: 天理教首领，癸酉之变的发动者。
时任两广总督，因处理英国入侵澳门事件不力被免职。
指清朝嘉庆、道光年间的社会矛盾激化、国势由盛转衰的时期。
毛岸青之妻，毛新宇之母，中国军事科学院军事百科研究部副部长。
毛泽东嫡孙，毛岸青与邵华之子。中国军事研究员，中国人民解放军少将。
毛泽东与贺子珍的长女，毛岸青异母姊妹。失散后于1973年被找到。
毛岸英之妻刘思齐和毛岸青之妻邵华的母亲，毛新宇的外祖母。
曾任毛泽东、周恩来、朱德等领导人的俄文翻译。
中共地下党在上海创办的幼稚园，用于收养中共烈士和领导人的子女。

zh-cn: 金山安全软件有限公司

description.zh-cn: 中国软件公司，与奇虎360及其董事长周鸿祎在商业诋毁和不正当竞争方面有过多次激烈的法律纠纷。
description.en: A Chinese software company that has had numerous intense legal conflicts with Qihoo 360 and its chairman Zhou Hongyi over commercial defamation and unfair competition.

description.zh-cn: 金山软件创始人之一，雷军在金山软件的同事。
description.en: One of the founders of Kingsoft, colleague of Lei Jun at Kingsoft.

description.zh-cn: 美国跨国科技公司。
description.en: American multinational technology company.

zh-cn: 北京小米支付技术有限公司

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任吉林省省长。

zh-cn: 天津市第一中级人民法院

description.zh-cn: 北京市下的一个行政区，此处指其政府机构。
曾任重庆市公安局局长。
曾任重庆市副市长。
中国政治人物，曾任中国证券监督管理委员会主席。在中共十九届四中全会上被追认留党察看二年的处分。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Chairman of the China Securities Regulatory Commission. His punishment of being placed on probation within the Party for two years was confirmed at the Fourth Plenary Session of the 19th CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: “牵手”果蔬汁品牌创办人。

location.zh-cn: 美国密苏里州克雷夫科尔

description.zh-cn: 一家美国农业生物技术公司，曾是全球转基因种子的领先生产商。2018年被拜耳公司收购。
description.en: An American agricultural biotechnology corporation that was a leading producer of genetically engineered seeds. It was acquired by Bayer in 2018.

description.zh-cn: 林彪父亲
钦差大臣林则徐在广东虎门集中销毁了收缴的鸦片。此事激化了中英矛盾，成为第一次鸦片战争的导火索。
description.en: Imperial Commissioner Lin Zexu publicly destroyed confiscated opium in Humen, Guangdong. This historic event intensified Sino-British tensions and served as the direct trigger for the First Opium War.

description.zh-cn: 发生于新疆地区由张格尔领导的叛乱。
道光帝的皇贵妃，奕䜣的生母，咸丰帝的养母。
description.en: An Imperial Noble Consort of the Daoguang Emperor, the birth mother of Yixin, and the adoptive mother of the Xianfeng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 清朝末期满洲贵族、大臣。在鸦片战争期间持主和态度，与林则徐政见不合，后接替林则徐任两广总督，与英方签订《穿鼻草约》。
description.en: A Manchu nobleman and minister of the late Qing dynasty. He held a pro-peace stance during the Opium War, clashing with Lin Zexu. He later succeeded Lin as the Governor-General of Liangguang and signed the Convention of Chuanbi with the British.

description.zh-cn: 明宣宗第二任皇后、明英宗的生母。在土木堡之变后，任命当时为郕王的朱祁钰为监国。
description.en: Second Empress of the Xuande Emperor and mother of Emperor Yingzong. After the Tumu Crisis, she appointed Zhu Qiyu, then Prince of Cheng, as regent.

description.zh-cn: 明朝第九位皇帝，明英宗长子。他原为太子，曾被景泰帝废黜，后复位并即位为帝。即位后，他恢复了叔叔景泰帝的帝号，并为于谦平反。他是明世宗之祖父。
description.en: The ninth emperor of the Ming dynasty. He was the eldest son of Emperor Yingzong, originally the crown prince, but was deposed by the Jingtai Emperor. He was later reinstated as crown prince and ascended the throne. Upon his ascension, he restored his uncle's imperial title. He was also the grandfather of the Jiajing Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 明英宗的护卫将军，在土木堡之变中杀死王振后战死。
description.en: Emperor Yingzong's guard general, who killed Wang Zhen during the Tumu Crisis and died in battle.

description.zh-cn: 明朝将领，夺门之变主谋之一。复辟后把持朝政，后因图谋叛乱被清算。
description.en: A Ming Dynasty general and one of the masterminds of the Duomen Coup. After the restoration, he controlled the court but was later purged for plotting a rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，夺门之变主谋之一。力主杀害于谦，后被清算流放。
description.en: A Ming Dynasty official and one of the masterminds of the Duomen Coup. He strongly advocated for the execution of Yu Qian and was later purged and exiled.

description.zh-cn: 明朝宦官，夺门之变主谋之一。复辟后与石亨把持朝政，后因发动曹石之变被凌迟处死。
description.en: A Ming Dynasty eunuch and one of the masterminds of the Duomen Coup. He controlled the court with Shi Heng after the restoration and was later executed by slow slicing for launching the Cao-Shi Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 明英宗的皇后。
description.en: The empress of Emperor Yingzong.

description.zh-cn: 明英宗的贵妃，明宪宗生母。
description.en: A noble consort of Emperor Yingzong and the birth mother of Emperor Xianzong.

description.zh-cn: 明英宗天顺朝内阁首辅。成功劝谏明英宗赦免汪皇后的殉葬。
description.en: Grand Secretary during the Tianshun era of Emperor Yingzong's reign, who successfully persuaded Emperor Yingzong to spare Empress Wang from being sacrificed.

description.zh-cn: 由曹吉祥和石亨策划的旨在反对明英宗的未遂叛乱。
description.en: An unsuccessful rebellion planned by Cao Jixiang and Shi Heng against Emperor Yingzong.

description.zh-cn: 秦国国君，秦始皇的父亲。原在赵国作为人质，后在吕不韦的帮助下返回秦国并最终继位。
description.en: King of the state of Qin and the father of Qin Shi Huang. He was originally a hostage in the state of Zhao and later returned to Qin and ascended the throne with the help of Lü Buwei.

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇的母亲，秦庄襄王之妻。原为吕不韦的姬妾。
description.en: The wife of King Zhuangxiang of Qin and the mother of Qin Shi Huang. She was originally a concubine of Lü Buwei.

description.zh-cn: 中国战国末期卫国商人，后成为秦国相国（丞相）及政治家，对秦始皇亲政前有重要影响，并被秦始皇尊为“仲父”。传说他可能为秦始皇生父，并曾将嫪毐引荐给赵太后。他广招门客编撰《吕氏春秋》，是先秦杂家的代表人物之一，对秦王政统一六国的事业有重大贡献。
description.en: A merchant from the state of Wei during the late Warring States period, who later became the Chancellor and a politician of the state of Qin. He was influential during Qin Shi Huang's early reign and honored as 'Second Father' by him. He is also rumored to be Qin Shi Huang's biological father. He gathered scholars to compile the 'Lüshi Chunqiu' and is a representative figure of the Miscellaneous School of thought, making significant contributions to Qin's unification of the six states.

description.zh-cn: 战国末年秦国人物，秦始皇之母赵姬的面首。后因发动叛乱失败被车裂处死。
description.en: Lover of Queen Dowager Zhao, later executed for rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇长子，原定的皇位继承人。
description.en: The eldest son and original heir of Qin Shi Huang.

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇幼子，秦朝第二位皇帝。
description.en: The youngest son of Qin Shi Huang and the second emperor of the Qin dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇的异母弟，后叛秦降赵。
description.en: Half-brother of Qin Shi Huang, who later defected to Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 秦朝丞相、文学家、书法家，法家代表人物，韩非的同学。在秦始皇焚书坑儒时，他将《周易》列为医术占卜之书，使其免于被毁。
description.en: Chancellor of the Qin dynasty, a key Legalist figure, a writer, calligrapher, and a fellow student of Han Fei. During Emperor Qin Shi Huang's 'burning of books and burying of scholars', he classified the I Ching as a book of medicine and divination, thus sparing it from destruction.

description.zh-cn: 秦朝宦官，中车府令，与李斯合谋发动沙丘之变，后陷害李斯。
description.en: A powerful eunuch of the Qin dynasty and a key conspirator in the Sand Dune Coup.

description.zh-cn: 秦国将领，秦灭六国战争中的主要将领之一。
description.en: A leading general of the state of Qin during the wars of unification.

description.zh-cn: 战国末期韩国法家思想家，法家思想的代表人物与集大成者。他曾多次上书韩桓惠王，要求推行法治以图富强。后为李斯的同学，但最终被李斯所害。
description.en: A Legalist philosopher from the State of Han during the late Warring States period, he was a representative and synthesizer of the Legalist school. He repeatedly submitted memorials to King Huanhui of Han, advocating for the implementation of the rule of law to strengthen the state. He was a fellow student of Li Si and was later executed by him.

description.zh-cn: 楚考烈王之子，曾任秦国丞相，并以秦国公子身份奉命平定嫪毐之乱，后叛秦归楚。
description.en: Son of King Kaolie of Chu, who served as Chancellor of Qin, was honored as a Prince of Qin, and was ordered to suppress the Lao Ai rebellion, before rebelling and returning to Chu.

description.zh-cn: 战国末期刺客，受燕太子丹之托刺杀秦王失败。
description.en: An assassin of the late Warring States period, known for his failed attempt to assassinate Qin Shi Huang.

description.zh-cn: 汉朝开国功臣，出身于韩国贵族，其祖父与父亲曾五代相韩。曾策划博浪沙行刺秦始皇，后为汉初三杰之一。汉初，曾作为大臣为吕后出谋划策，保住太子刘盈的地位。
description.en: A founding father of the Han Dynasty, who came from the nobility of the State of Han, and whose grandfather and father served as chancellors to five generations of Han rulers. He plotted an assassination attempt on Qin Shi Huang at Bolangsha and later became a key strategist for the Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 燕王喜的太子，派遣荆轲刺杀秦王。
description.en: Crown Prince of Yan who dispatched Jing Ke to assassinate the King of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 中国周朝的诸侯国，战国七雄之一。后通过商鞅变法富国强兵，最终统一六国建立秦朝。在战国时期，李冰曾担任蜀郡郡守。
description.en: A vassal state of the Zhou Dynasty in China, and one of the Seven Warring States. It became wealthy and powerful through Shang Yang's reforms, eventually unifying the other six states and establishing the Qin Dynasty. During the Warring States period, Li Bing served as the governor of Shu Commandery.

description.zh-cn: 中国历史上第一个大一统的中央集权制王朝，始置丞相一职。
description.en: The first unified, centralized imperial dynasty in Chinese history, which established the position of Chancellor.

description.zh-cn: 中国战国时代的诸侯国，姬姓韩氏，由三家分晋而来。作为战国七雄之一，它是第一个被秦国所灭的国家，也是著名思想家韩非的母国。
description.en: A vassal state during the Warring States period in China, of the Ji family name and Han clan. It originated from the Partition of Jin. As one of the Seven Warring States, it was the first to be conquered by the State of Qin and was the home state of the famous philosopher Han Fei.

description.zh-cn: 战国七雄之一。
description.en: One of the seven major states of the Warring States period.

description.zh-cn: 周朝时期位于长江中游地区的诸侯国，也是战国七雄之一。
description.en: A state in the middle Yangtze River region during the Zhou dynasty, and also one of the seven major states of the Warring States period.

description.zh-cn: 中国周朝的诸侯国，战国七雄之一。
description.en: A vassal state of the Zhou Dynasty in China, one of the Seven Warring States.

description.zh-cn: 古代中国南方和越南北部的各部落的统称。
description.en: A collective term for various tribes inhabiting Southern China and Northern Vietnam in ancient times.

en: Burning of books and burying of scholars

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇于公元前213年至212年推行的极端政治行动，旨在统一思想、压制异见与摧残文化。此举导致焚毁大量书籍，特别是儒家经典，并坑杀“犯禁者四百六十余人”。《周易》因被视为占卜书籍而幸免。
description.en: An extreme political action implemented by Qin Shi Huang from 213 to 212 BC, aimed at unifying thought, suppressing dissent, and destroying culture. It led to the burning of numerous books, especially Confucian classics, and the burying alive of over 460 'violators'. The I Ching was spared because it was considered a divination book.

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇死后，赵高、李斯等人伪造遗诏，拥立胡亥即位的政治事件。
description.en: A political conspiracy after Qin Shi Huang's death where Zhao Gao and Li Si forged the imperial will to enthrone Huhai.

description.zh-cn: 为抵御北方游牧民族而修筑的军事防御工程。
description.en: A series of fortifications built for military defense against northern nomadic peoples.

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇的陵墓，位于今陕西省西安市临潼区。
description.en: The mausoleum of Qin Shi Huang, located in Lintong District, Xi'an, Shaanxi province.

description.zh-cn: 山西省晋中市下辖的县
位于荷兰首都阿姆斯特丹的综合性研究型大学。
中国法学家，北京大学法学院教授。

en: Ningxia Hui Autonomous Regional Committee of the Chinese Communist Party

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在宁夏回族自治区的领导机关。
description.en: The leading organ of the Communist Party of China in the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，团派官员，曾任中共江苏省委书记。其后未达退休年龄即被调离实权岗位。
description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China and an official from the Tuanpai (Youth League Faction). He served as Secretary of the CPC Jiangsu Provincial Committee and was later transferred from his position of power before reaching the standard retirement age.

zh-cn: 香港特别行政区第五届政府

description.zh-cn: 由行政长官林郑月娥领导的香港政府，因潘晓颖命案提出《逃犯条例》修订草案。
description.en: The Hong Kong government led by Chief Executive Carrie Lam, which proposed the extradition bill amendment in response to the Poon Hiu-wing murder case.

description.en: An international non-governmental organization that advocates for freedom of the press.

description.en: Former Hong Kong Secretary for Home Affairs

郭伯雄之女。

中华人民共和国计算机信息网络国际联网管理暂行规定

description.zh-cn: 中国工程院院士，被认为是防火长城的首要设计师。
description.en: An academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering, considered to be the principal designer of the Great Firewall.

description.en: An American technology company that was a partner of Unihub.

description.en: A Chinese human rights activist, who was met by U.S. President George W. Bush along with Wei Jingsheng.

location.en: Building 2, No. 6 Jiuxianqiao Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing, People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中国大陆的一家主营安全相关的互联网公司，由周鸿祎和齐向东于2005年9月成立。旗下产品有360安全卫士、360杀毒、360搜索等。该公司曾与多家中国互联网公司发生商业纠纷和诉讼。
description.en: A mainland Chinese internet company focusing on security-related products, founded by Zhou Hongyi and Qi Xiangdong in September 2005. Its products include 360 Safeguard, 360 Total Security, 360 Search, and more. The company has been involved in business disputes and lawsuits with several other Chinese internet companies.

description.zh-cn: 三六零安全科技股份有限公司的联合创始人，曾任公司总裁。毕业于长春邮电学院。
description.en: Co-founder of Qihoo 360, formerly served as the company's President. Graduated from Changchun University of Posts and Telecommunications.

en: Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences
zh-cn: 中国科学院信息工程研究所

description.zh-cn: 由中国共产党中央委员会机关报《人民日报》社主办与出版的国际新闻报刊。该报在艾未未被捕后发表多篇社评对其进行批评，并对《零八宪章》持负面评价。
description.en: An international news tabloid published by the People's Daily, the official newspaper of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China. It published multiple editorials criticizing Ai Weiwei after his arrest and holds a negative view of Charter 08.

description.zh-cn: 中国异议人士，“拆墙运动”发起者。
description.en: Chinese dissident, founder of the 'Tear Down the Wall Movement'.

description.zh-cn: Google提供的电子邮件服务。
description.en: Email service provided by Google.

description.zh-cn: 一种用于匿名通信的自由及开放源代码软件。
description.en: Free and open-source software for enabling anonymous communication.

description.zh-cn: 监测中国互联网审查的组织。
description.en: An organization that monitors internet censorship in China.

description.zh-cn: 台湾白色恐怖时期的主要情治单位之一，负责执行戒严、镇压异议人士。
description.en: One of the main intelligence agencies during the White Terror period, responsible for enforcing martial law and suppressing dissidents.

description.zh-cn: 由时任台湾省政府主席陈诚颁布，宣告在台湾全境实施戒严，是白色恐怖时期的开端。
description.en: Proclaimed by then-Taiwan Provincial Governor Chen Cheng, it declared martial law throughout Taiwan, marking the beginning of the White Terror period.

en: Act for the Punishment of Rebellion

description.zh-cn: 白色恐怖时期的“特别刑法”，扩张了犯罪构成要件，成为政府整肃异己的法律工具。
description.en: A "special criminal law" during the White Terror period that expanded the elements of crime, becoming a legal tool for the government to purge dissidents.

en: Statute for the Purge of Spies during the Period of National Mobilization for the Suppression of Communist Rebellion
zh-cn: 戡乱时期检肃匪谍条例

description.zh-cn: 白色恐怖时期的法律之一，废止时间被视为白色恐怖时期的结束点之一。
description.en: One of the laws during the White Terror period; its abolition is considered one of the end points of the period.

description.zh-cn: 发生于台东泰源监狱的政治犯武装起义事件，参与者多为台湾独立运动人士。
description.en: An armed uprising of political prisoners at Taiyuan Prison in Taitung, primarily involving Taiwan independence movement activists.

description.zh-cn: 泰源事件的参与者之一，后被枪决。
description.en: One of the participants in the Taiyuan Incident, later executed.

description.zh-cn: 泰源事件的参与者之一，后被枪决。
description.en: One of the participants in the Taiyuan Incident, later executed.

description.zh-cn: 美国的“红色恐慌”浪潮，又称麦卡锡主义，是20世纪50年代初在美国出现的指控他人不忠、颠覆或叛国，但没有适当证据的政治迫害行为。这种反共意识形态与台湾的白色恐怖相呼应。艾森豪威尔曾暗中反对麦卡锡主义。
description.en: The "Red Scare" wave in the United States, often referred to as McCarthyism, was a period of political persecution during the early 1950s, characterized by making accusations of disloyalty, subversion, or treason without proper regard for evidence. Its anti-communist stance ideologically aligned with Taiwan's White Terror. Eisenhower covertly opposed McCarthyism.

en: Taiwan Provincial Work Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
Taiwan Provincial Work Committee of the Communist Party of China
zh-cn: 中国共产党台湾省工作委员会
中共台湾省工作委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党于1946年至1952年在台湾成立的省级地下组织。在白色恐怖时期，它作为主要镇压目标之一，领导了学生工作委员会等下属机构。该组织最终于1950年代被国民党政府破获。
description.en: A provincial-level underground organization established by the Communist Party of China in Taiwan from 1946 to 1952. During the White Terror, it was a primary target of suppression and led subordinate bodies such as the Student Work Committee. The organization was eventually dismantled by the Kuomintang government in the 1950s.

description.zh-cn: 时任基隆中学校长，因《光明报》事件被捕并枪决。
description.en: Then-principal of Keelung High School, arrested and executed in connection with the Guangming Daily Incident.

description.zh-cn: 国立清华大学历史研究所硕士生，在“独立台湾会事件”中被调查局拘提，引发社会抗议。
description.en: A master's student at National Tsing Hua University's Institute of History, whose arrest by the Investigation Bureau in the "Independent Taiwan Association Incident" triggered social protests.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国的司法调查机关，在白色恐怖后期依然扮演执行政治侦防的角色。
description.en: The judicial investigation agency of the Republic of China, which continued to play a role in political investigation and prevention in the later stages of the White Terror.

zh-cn: 中华民国促进转型正义委员会

description.zh-cn: 依据《促进转型正义条例》成立的独立机关，负责推动转型正义，包括对白色恐怖时期的不法判决进行平反。
description.en: An independent commission established under the Act on Promoting Transitional Justice, responsible for advancing transitional justice, including overturning unjust verdicts from the White Terror period.

description.zh-cn: 时任美国国务卿。
description.en: U.S. Secretary of State at the time.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国军将领，金门防卫司令部副司令官，在金门炮战中阵亡。
description.en: A general of the Republic of China Armed Forces and Deputy Commander of the Kinmen Defense Command, killed in action during the Kinmen Artillery Duel.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国军将领，金门防卫司令部副司令官，在金门炮战中阵亡。
description.en: A general of the Republic of China Armed Forces and Deputy Commander of the Kinmen Defense Command, killed in action during the Kinmen Artillery Duel.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国军将领，金门防卫司令部副司令官，在金门炮战中阵亡。
description.en: A general of the Republic of China Armed Forces and Deputy Commander of the Kinmen Defense Command, killed in action during the Kinmen Artillery Duel.

description.zh-cn: 中东地区的一场政治危机，被认为是毛泽东决定炮击金门以牵制美军的原因之一。

en: Mutual Defense Treaty between the United States and the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 1954年，美国与中华民国在华盛顿签署的军事防御同盟条约，由艾森豪威尔政府推动签订。该条约签订于冷战时期，并促成了美军协防台湾司令部的成立。
description.en: A mutual defense alliance treaty signed in Washington in 1954 between the United States and the Republic of China, promoted by the Eisenhower administration. Signed during the Cold War, this treaty led to the establishment of the U.S. Taiwan Defense Command.

nodes.id: BAIDU:中华人民共和国国防部告台湾同胞书

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国防部告台湾同胞书

description.zh-cn: 美国提供给中华民国国军的203毫米自走炮，在炮战中发挥重要作用。
美国提供给中华民国空军的空对空导弹，在台海空战中首次使用。
世界女子职业网球的管理组织。在此事件中，该组织公开声援彭帅，并暂停了在中国的赛事。
description.en: The governing body of women's professional tennis. In this incident, the organization publicly supported Peng Shuai and suspended its tournaments in China.

description.zh-cn: 国际女子网球协会（WTA）主席，代表WTA就彭帅事件多次发表声明，表达关切并要求调查。
description.en: Chairman of the Women's Tennis Association (WTA), who issued multiple statements on behalf of the WTA regarding the Peng Shuai incident, expressing concern and demanding an investigation.

description.zh-cn: 该组织在此事件中与彭帅进行视频通话，并称其安全无虞，但其做法被外界批评为帮助中国政府掩盖真相。
description.en: In this incident, the organization held video calls with Peng Shuai and claimed she was safe, but its actions were criticized by outsiders for helping the Chinese government cover up the truth.

description.zh-cn: 第一次世界大战后，关于原德国在山东半岛的权益归属问题引发的外交争议。巴黎和会决定将此权益转让给日本，而非归还中国，是五四运动的直接导火索。
description.en: A diplomatic dispute after World War I concerning the disposition of former German concessions in the Shandong Peninsula. The Paris Peace Conference's decision to transfer these rights to Japan instead of returning them to China was the direct trigger for the May Fourth Movement.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，时任北洋政府交通总长。因被指为亲日派卖国贼，在五四运动中成为学生的主要攻击目标之一，其住宅赵家楼被烧，后被免职。
description.en: Chinese politician, serving as the Minister of Communications in the Beiyang government at the time. Accused of being a pro-Japanese traitor, he became a primary target for students during the May Fourth Movement, his residence at Zhaojialou was burned, and he was subsequently dismissed from office.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任驻日公使。在五四运动中，因被学生指为亲日派卖国贼，于曹汝霖住宅内被学生痛打，后被免职。
description.en: Chinese politician, formerly served as the Minister to Japan. During the May Fourth Movement, he was accused by students of being a pro-Japanese traitor, beaten at Cao Rulin's residence, and subsequently dismissed from office.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，时任货币局总裁。因被指为亲日派卖国贼，与曹汝霖、章宗祥一同成为五四运动的主要攻击目标，后被免职。
description.en: Chinese politician, serving as the President of the Currency Bureau at the time. Accused of being a pro-Japanese traitor, along with Cao Rulin and Zhang Zongxiang, he became a primary target of the May Fourth Movement and was subsequently dismissed from office.

description.zh-cn: 五四运动期间由钱能训担任代理国务总理的北洋政府内阁。因运动引发的全国性压力而被迫解散。
description.en: The Beiyang government cabinet with Qian Nengxun as acting Premier during the May Fourth Movement. It was forced to dissolve due to nationwide pressure sparked by the movement.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，国民外交协会理事。他在《晨报》上发表文章《外交警报敬告国民》，披露巴黎和会外交失败的消息，对点燃五四运动起了关键作用。学者，林徽因之父。
description.en: Chinese politician, scholar, and a director of the National Diplomatic Association. He was the father of Lin Huiyin. His article 'Diplomatic Warning to Our Countrymen' published in the 'Morning Post' revealed the news of the diplomatic failure at the Paris Peace Conference, playing a key role in igniting the May Fourth Movement.

description.zh-cn: 五四运动的扩大阶段，因6月3日北京学生遭大规模逮捕而引发。以上海工商界的罢市和工人的罢工为标志，运动中心从北京转移到上海，参与阶层从学生扩大到工商界和工人阶级。
description.en: An expanded phase of the May Fourth Movement, triggered by the mass arrest of Beijing students on June 3. Marked by strikes by Shanghai's business community and workers, the movement's center shifted from Beijing to Shanghai, and participation expanded from students to the business and working classes.

description.zh-cn: 由九个一战战胜国召开的国际会议。在美国调停下，会议促成中日签订《解决山东悬案条约》，使山东问题得到比较圆满的解决。
description.en: An international conference convened by nine victorious nations of World War I. Under US mediation, the conference facilitated the signing of the 'Sino-Japanese Treaty for the Settlement of the Shandong Question', leading to a relatively satisfactory resolution of the Shandong Problem.

description.zh-cn: 五四运动时期的代理国务总理。
淞沪会战的直接导火索，两名日本军人在上海虹桥机场被中国守卫击毙。
淞沪会战末期的一场著名战斗，以八百壮士的英勇抵抗而闻名。
为淞沪会战编组的日军主要作战部队之一。
为增援淞沪战场而在杭州湾登陆的日军部队。
淞沪会战日军上海派遣军司令官，后任中支那方面军司令。

en: Alexander Ernst Alfred Hermann Freiherr von Falkenhausen
zh-cn: 亚历山大·恩斯特·阿尔弗雷德·赫尔曼·冯·法肯豪森

birth_place.zh-cn: 德意志帝国西里西亚省布卢门塔尔

death_place.zh-cn: 德意志联邦共和国莱茵兰-普法尔茨拿骚

description.zh-cn: 德国陆军将领，最高军阶为步兵上将。他曾担任德国驻中华民国军事顾问团团长，为国军提供作战指导。二战期间，他还曾是德国占领下比利时和法国北部的军政府司令官。
description.en: A German army general, reaching the rank of General of the Infantry. He served as the head of the German military mission to the Republic of China, providing operational guidance to the National Revolutionary Army. During World War II, he also served as the military governor of German-occupied Belgium and Northern France.

description.zh-cn: 日军第10军司令官。
国军团附，率领八百壮士坚守四行仓库。
国军第583团第3营营长，率全营官兵坚守宝山，壮烈殉国。
国军第88师第264旅少将旅长，淞沪会战国军牺牲的第一位高级将领。
国军第67军军长，在掩护上海守军撤退时牺牲。
上海租界青帮大老、商人、政治人物，与黄金荣、张啸林并称“上海滩三大亨”。作为青帮头目及上海地方领袖，他在四一二事件中组织力量协助国民党清党，并利用其关系配合国军作战计划，在闸北秘密修建掩体。
description.en: Du Yuesheng was a prominent Green Gang boss, businessman, and political figure in the Shanghai International Settlement, known as one of "Shanghai's Big Three" alongside Huang Jinrong and Zhang Xiaolin. As a Green Gang leader and local Shanghai figure, he organized forces to assist the Kuomintang (KMT) in the party purge during the April 12th Incident, and also utilized his connections to cooperate with KMT military plans, secretly constructing bunkers in Zhabei.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国时期存在多支武装力量。其中一支由杨虎城领导，主体为国民革命军第十七路军；另有由冯玉祥领导的军阀派系，受苏联支持。
description.en: During the Republican era, there were multiple armed forces. One was led by Yang Hucheng, primarily the 17th Route Army of the National Revolutionary Army; another was a warlord clique led by Feng Yuxiang, supported by the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国时期的西安市，西安事变的发生地。
国民党中央委员，在西安事变中遇难。
中国政治人物，现任福建省委书记、福建省人大常委会主任，曾任中央机构编制委员会办公室主任。
description.en: Chinese politician, current Party Secretary and Chairman of the Standing Committee of the People's Congress of Fujian, and former Director of the Office of the Central Institutional Organization Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任福建省省长
description.en: Chinese politician, current Governor of Fujian

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任福建省政协主席
description.en: Chinese politician, current Chairman of the Fujian Provincial Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference

description.zh-cn: 战国时期越国君主
description.en: Monarch of the state of Yue during the Warring States period

description.zh-cn: 闽越国第一任君主，闽越王，在福州冶山一带的冶城建都。
description.en: The first king of Minyue Kingdom, who established his capital at Yecheng in the area of Yeshan, Fuzhou.

description.zh-cn: 闽越国宗室、繇王
description.en: A member of the Minyue royal family, King Yao

description.zh-cn: 闽越国末代君主，自称武帝
description.en: The last ruler of Minyue Kingdom, self-proclaimed Emperor Wu

description.zh-cn: 唐朝设立的军区长官职称，其设立始出现“福建”之名
五代十国时期闽国建立者。
description.en: Founder of the Min Kingdom during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period.

description.zh-cn: 五代十国时期的十国之一，定都福州。
description.en: One of the Ten Kingdoms during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, with its capital in Fuzhou.

description.zh-cn: 宋朝的行政区划
description.en: An administrative division of the Song dynasty

description.zh-cn: 晚清洋务运动时期创办的近代军事工业，主要从事现代舰船的建造。
description.en: A modern military industry founded during the Self-Strengthening Movement in the late Qing dynasty, primarily engaged in building modern warships.

zh-cn: 国民革命军第十九路军

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国民革命军的一支部队
description.en: A military formation of the Republic of China's National Revolutionary Army

description.zh-cn: 由国民革命军第十九路军于1933年在福建发动“闽变”（反蒋事变）期间建立的政权，定都福州，后被中央军镇压。
description.en: A regime established by the 19th Route Army of the National Revolutionary Army during the Fujian Rebellion (an anti-Chiang incident) in Fujian in 1933. It had its capital in Fuzhou and was later suppressed by the Central Army.

description.zh-cn: 连接江西鹰潭和福建厦门的铁路线
description.en: A railway line connecting Yingtan in Jiangxi and Xiamen in Fujian

description.zh-cn: 悉达多·乔达摩的出生地。
古印度的一种血统论社会等级制度。
古印度反对婆罗门教的各种新思潮的总称。
古印度王朝，其君主阿育王大力推广佛教。
佛教教团的第一次分裂，导致上座部与大众部的形成。
佛教两大现存分支之一，主要流传于南亚和东南亚。
佛教两大现存分支之一，主要流传于东亚和西藏地区。
南梁王朝的建立者，大力扶持佛教发展，并推动汉传佛教素食传统。
大乘佛教核心经典之一，影响了梁武帝推行僧侣素食。
印度僧人，被尊为中国禅宗的初祖。
汉传佛教的一个主要宗派，由菩提达摩传入中国。
唐代文学家、思想家、政治家，因上《谏迎佛骨表》而著名，持反对佛教立场。
东晋时期的高僧，被认为是净土宗的初祖。
汉朝开国皇帝，史称汉高祖。他击败项羽，统一中国，奠定西汉王朝。他也是刘盈（汉惠帝）与鲁元公主的父亲。
description.en: The founder and first emperor of the Han dynasty, known as Emperor Gaozu of Han. He defeated Xiang Yu in the Chu–Han Contention, unifying China and establishing the Western Han dynasty. He was the father of Liu Ying (Emperor Hui) and Princess Yuan of Lu.

description.zh-cn: 王莽是西汉末年的政治人物、外戚及权臣。他曾任大司马，在汉哀帝时期一度失势，后哀帝死后重掌大权。最终，他篡夺西汉政权，建立新朝，成为新朝的开国皇帝，也是唯一一位皇帝。
description.en: Wang Mang was a political figure, consort kin, and powerful minister in the late Western Han dynasty. He served as Grand Marshal and briefly lost power during Emperor Ai's reign. After Emperor Ai's death, he regained control. Ultimately, he usurped the Western Han regime, established the Xin dynasty, and became its founding and sole emperor.

description.zh-cn: 王莽建立的中国朝代，介于西汉与东汉之间。
曹魏的开国皇帝。他是曹操与卞氏的嫡长子，也是曹昂的异母弟。他接受汉献帝禅让，结束东汉，并在称帝后追尊曹昂为王。
description.en: The founding emperor of the state of Cao Wei. He was the eldest son of Cao Cao and Lady Bian, and also the half-brother of Cao Ang. After ascending to the throne, he posthumously honored Cao Ang as a king.

description.zh-cn: 秦末义军领袖之一，西楚霸王，后在楚汉战争中败给刘邦。许贡在给汉献帝的上表中曾将孙策与他相提并论。
description.en: Leader of the anti-Qin rebellion, Hegemon-King of Western Chu. He was later defeated by Liu Bang in the Chu-Han Contention. Xu Gong once compared Sun Ce to him in his memorial to Emperor Xian.

description.zh-cn: 秦朝灭亡后，项羽与刘邦之间为争夺统治权而进行的战争。
description.en: A war for supremacy over China between Xiang Yu and Liu Bang following the collapse of the Qin dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 楚汉战争的决定性战役，刘邦击败项羽。
汉高祖刘邦的皇后，汉惠帝刘盈和鲁元公主的母亲。刘邦死后，她临朝称制，掌握汉朝实权。
description.en: The empress consort of Emperor Gaozu of Han (Liu Bang), and the mother of Emperor Hui (Liu Ying) and Princess Yuan of Lu. After Liu Bang's death, she ruled as empress dowager and regent, holding de facto power over the Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 汉朝第二位皇帝，汉高祖刘邦与皇后吕雉之子，鲁元公主的弟弟。他在位期间，推行黄老学说，注重国家的休养生息和无为而治。
description.en: The second emperor of the Han Dynasty, son of Emperor Gaozu Liu Bang and Empress Lü Zhi, and younger brother of Princess Yuan of Lu. During his reign, he promoted Huang-Lao philosophy, focusing on national recuperation and governance through inaction.

description.zh-cn: 西汉开国功臣，与张良、萧何并称“汉初三杰”，与彭越、英布并称“汉初三大名将”，被后人誉为“兵仙”、“国士无双”。军事才能卓著，后被刘邦用陈平之计擒获。
description.en: A founding general of the Western Han dynasty, one of the 'Three Heroes of the early Han dynasty'. He was an outstanding military commander who was later captured by Liu Bang using Chen Ping's strategy.

description.zh-cn: 西汉第五位皇帝，汉高祖刘邦第四子，鲁元公主异母弟。在诸吕之乱平定后，由陈平、周勃等大臣拥立为帝。他与其子汉景帝共同开创了“文景之治”的盛世。
description.en: The fifth emperor of the Western Han dynasty, fourth son of Emperor Gaozu Liu Bang and half-brother of Princess Yuan of Lu. He was enthroned by ministers including Chen Ping and Zhou Bo after the Lü Clan Disturbance was quashed. Along with his son Emperor Jing, he initiated the prosperous 'Rule of Wen and Jing'.

en: Rebellions at the end of the Sui dynasty

description.zh-cn: 隋朝末年由于隋炀帝的暴政，特别是东征高句丽的巨大消耗，引发的全国性大规模民变和割据，最终导致隋朝灭亡。
description.en: Widespread rebellions and warlordism across China in the late Sui dynasty, caused by the tyranny of Emperor Yang, especially the immense costs of the Goguryeo campaigns, which ultimately led to the collapse of the Sui dynasty.

birth_place.en: Dangshan County, Song Prefecture, Tang Dynasty

description.zh-cn: 五代十国时期后梁的开国皇帝。原为唐末参与黄巢起事的将领，后归降唐朝，官至宣武军节度使，逐渐控制朝政。907年篡唐自立，建立后梁。后为其子朱友珪所弑。
description.en: The founding emperor of the Later Liang dynasty during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period. He was originally a general in the Huang Chao Rebellion in the late Tang dynasty, later surrendering to the Tang and rising to the position of military governor (jiedushi) of the Xuanwu Army, gradually seizing control of the imperial court. In 907, he usurped the Tang throne and established the Later Liang. He was later assassinated by his son, Zhu Yougui.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝末代皇帝，唐昭宗第九子。在昭宗被杀后，被朱温拥立为傀儡皇帝，后被禅位并遭杀害。
description.en: The last emperor of the Tang dynasty, the ninth son of Emperor Zhaozong. He was installed as a puppet emperor by Zhu Wen after his father's assassination, and was later forced to abdicate and subsequently murdered.

description.zh-cn: 五代十国中的第一个朝代，由朱温建立。
description.en: The first of the Five Dynasties during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, founded by Zhu Wen.

en: Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period

description.zh-cn: 唐朝灭亡后中国历史上的一个时期。
唐朝末年由黄巢领导的一场大规模民变，严重动摇了唐朝的统治基础。
description.en: A major rebellion during the late Tang dynasty led by Huang Chao, which severely weakened the Tang regime.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝倒数第二位皇帝，唐懿宗第七子，唐僖宗的弟弟。在位期间，他试图削除藩镇与宦官势力，但后期反被军阀挟制，最终被朱温所杀。
description.en: The second to last emperor of the Tang dynasty, the seventh son of Emperor Yizong and younger brother of Emperor Xizong. During his reign, he attempted to eliminate the power of military governors (fanzhen) and eunuchs, but was later controlled by warlords and ultimately killed by Zhu Wen.

description.zh-cn: 莫斯科大公和首位俄罗斯沙皇。
description.en: Grand Prince of Moscow and the first Tsar of Russia.

description.en: Organizations sent by Liu Shaoqi and Deng Xiaoping to guide the movement in various units during the early stage of the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 对文化大革命时期五类“阶级敌人”（地主、富农、反革命分子、坏分子、右派分子）的统称。
在文化大革命中被视为“资产阶级”并受到打击的社会群体。
description.en: A social group that was regarded as 'bourgeoisie' and subjected to persecution during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 北京师范大学女子附属中学党总支书记兼副校长。在北京“红八月”期间被该校红卫兵批斗致死，是北京市首位在文革中被打死的教育工作者。
description.en: Party Branch Secretary and Vice Principal of the Beijing Normal University Affiliated Girls' Middle School. She was beaten to death by Red Guards during the 'Red August,' becoming the first educator killed in Beijing during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 日本江户时代的一个藩，位于本州岛最西部。在幕末时期，它与萨摩藩结成萨长同盟，是倒幕运动的核心力量之一。
description.en: A feudal domain of Japan during the Edo period, located at the westernmost tip of Honshu. During the Bakumatsu period, it formed the Satcho Alliance with the Satsuma Domain and was one of the core forces in the movement to overthrow the Tokugawa shogunate.

description.zh-cn: 大日本帝国正式吞并大韩帝国的事件。
朝鲜王朝的延续，1910年被日本吞并。
大日本帝国陆军和海军的统称，自1930年代起逐渐控制国家政治，推行军国主义。
1947年颁布的宪法，取代了《大日本帝国宪法》，正式结束了大日本帝国时期。
朝鲜独立运动家，因暗杀伊藤博文而闻名。

description.en: A rebellion launched in 1426 by Zhu Gaoxu, Prince of Han (uncle of Emperor Xuande), in his fief of Le'an Prefecture, taking advantage of an earthquake in Beijing. It was quickly suppressed by the Xuande Emperor who personally led the campaign.

description.zh-cn: 明朝内阁大学士，辅佐明宣宗。在平定高煦之乱时，力劝明宣宗御驾亲征。

description.en: Queen of the United Kingdom, who ascended to the throne during Churchill's second term as Prime Minister. She was also the former Queen of Canada and gave Royal Assent to the Canada Act 1982.

description.zh-cn: 三国时期蜀汉官员，字伯松，原字仲慎。原为诸葛瑾的次子，后被诸葛亮收为养子。
description.en: An official of Shu Han during the Three Kingdoms period. His courtesy name was Bosong, originally Zhongshen. He was originally the second son of Zhuge Jin and was later adopted by Zhuge Liang.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮叔父，曾在袁术和刘表麾下。
description.en: Uncle of Zhuge Liang, served under Yuan Shu and Liu Biao.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮好友，曾向刘备举荐诸葛亮。
description.en: Friend of Zhuge Liang, recommended Zhuge Liang to Liu Bei.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮好友。

description.zh-cn: 刘备重要谋士，与诸葛亮齐名，号称“凤雏”。
description.en: An important advisor to Liu Bei, as famous as Zhuge Liang, known as the 'Fledgling Phoenix'.

description.zh-cn: 刘备在夷陵之战失败后，于永安病危时将儿子刘禅托付给诸葛亮、李严等人的事件。
description.en: After his defeat at the Battle of Yiling, the dying Liu Bei entrusted his son Liu Shan to the care of Zhuge Liang and Li Yan.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮为平定南中地区的叛乱而发动的军事行动。
description.en: A military campaign launched by Zhuge Liang to pacify the rebellions in the Nanzhong region.

description.zh-cn: 三国时期南中地区的首领。
description.en: A local leader in the Nanzhong region during the Three Kingdoms period.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮为实现“兴复汉室，还于旧都”的目标而对曹魏发动的五次军事行动。
description.en: A series of five military campaigns launched by Zhuge Liang against the state of Cao Wei in order to restore the Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮在第一次北伐前写给后主刘禅的奏章，表达了其忠诚和北伐的决心。
description.en: A memorial written by Zhuge Liang to Emperor Liu Shan before his first Northern Expedition, expressing his loyalty and determination.

description.zh-cn: 蜀汉参军。因在街亭之战中失利，被诸葛亮处斩。
description.en: An army advisor of Shu Han, executed by Zhuge Liang after his defeat at the Battle of Jieting.

description.zh-cn: 三国时期曹魏的太傅、政治家、军事家、权臣，西晋的奠基人。诸葛亮北伐时的主要对手，高平陵之变后掌控曹魏大权。
description.en: A strategist, politician, and regent of the state of Cao Wei during the Three Kingdoms period of China, and the founder of the Jin dynasty. He was also the primary adversary of Zhuge Liang during the Northern Expeditions.

description.zh-cn: 他原为袁绍部将，官渡之战后投降曹操，成为曹魏五子良将之一。作为曹魏名将，在街亭之战中大破马谡，但在追击蜀军时中埋伏身亡。
description.en: Originally a general under Yuan Shao, he surrendered to Cao Cao after the Battle of Guandu and became one of the Five Elite Generals of Cao Wei. As a renowned general of Cao Wei, he decisively defeated Ma Su at the Battle of Jieting, but was later ambushed and killed while pursuing Shu forces.

description.zh-cn: 蜀汉重臣，诸葛亮指定的继承人之一。

description.zh-cn: 蜀汉重臣，诸葛亮指定的继承人之一。

description.en: Wife of Franklin D. Roosevelt and First Lady of the United States.

description.zh-cn: 美国第28任总统，进步主义时代的领袖人物，其政治理念被称为“威尔逊主义”。他曾是学者、普林斯顿大学校长和新泽西州州长，并任命罗斯福为海军助理部长。他领导美国参加第一次世界大战，并倡导建立国际联盟。
description.en: The 28th President of the United States, a leader of the Progressive Era, whose political philosophy is known as 'Wilsonianism'. He was an academic, President of Princeton University, and Governor of New Jersey, and he appointed Roosevelt as Assistant Secretary of the Navy. He led the United States into World War I and advocated for the formation of the League of Nations.

description.zh-cn: 罗斯福前两任的副总统。

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战末期，美、英、苏三国（罗斯福、丘吉尔、斯大林）首脑举行会议，商讨战后世界秩序。会议中，苏联秘密承诺在德国投降后对日作战，同时达成的协议规定了苏联在远东的利益，为1945年《中苏友好同盟条约》的签订奠定了基础。
description.en: A conference held by the heads of government of the US, UK, and Soviet Union (Roosevelt, Churchill, and Stalin) near the end of World War II to discuss the post-war reorganization of the world. During the conference, the USSR secretly committed to entering the war against Japan after Germany's surrender. The agreements also defined Soviet interests in the Far East, laying the groundwork for the 1945 Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship and Alliance.

description.zh-cn: 位于美国马萨诸塞州剑桥市的私立研究型大学，约翰·F·肯尼迪于1940年毕业于此。

description.en: The nineteenth son of Emperor Taizu Zhu Yuanzhang, he was enfeoffed as the Prince of Gu. During the Jingnan Campaign, he and Li Jinglong together opened the Jinchuan Gate to surrender to Prince Yan Zhu Di.

description.zh-cn: 明太祖朱元璋第五子，被封为周定王，并担任明朝宗人府左宗人。正史记载为马皇后所生。他后在建文帝时期被废为庶人，期间被李景隆逮捕，后于永乐年间揭发李景隆。
description.en: The fifth son of Emperor Hongwu (Zhu Yuanzhang), he was created Prince Ding of Zhou and served as Left Zongren of the Zongrenfu during the Ming Dynasty. Official histories record him as the son of Empress Ma. He was later deposed as a commoner during Emperor Jianwen's reign; during this period, he was arrested by Li Jinglong, and later accused Li Jinglong during the Yongle era.

description.zh-cn: 明太祖朱元璋第十二子，在建文帝削藩时自焚而死。

description.en: Taiwanese businessman and former civil servant. He served as an engineer in the Department of Construction and a director of the Housing and Urban Development Bureau of the Taiwan Provincial Government. He later entered business as the chairman of Kai Chu Group and Mao Kai Company, and also served as chairman of the De Fa Charitable Foundation. His son is the politician Fu Kun-chi. He received a suspended sentence in 2010 for violating company law during the 1997 Asian financial crisis.

description.zh-cn: 2025年间在中华民国发生的一场大规模政治及社会运动，旨在罢免各地民选公职人员，主要对象涵盖中国国民党与民主进步党的立法委员及地方首长（例如针对傅崐萁的罢免运动）。最终，所有进入投票阶段的罢免案均以不通过告终。
description.en: A large-scale political and social movement in the Republic of China (Taiwan) during 2025, aiming to recall elected public officials across the country, primarily targeting legislators and local government heads from both the Kuomintang (KMT) and the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP), such as the recall movement against Fu Kun-chi. Ultimately, all recall proposals that proceeded to a vote failed.

description.en: The highest supervisory agency of the Republic of China, is one of the highest state organs defined by the Constitution of the Republic of China under its Five-Power Constitution. Its powers include monitoring, auditing, impeaching, and censuring government officials.

description.zh-cn: 陕西千亿矿权案，指2006年至2019年间，凯奇莱能源投资有限公司与西安地质矿产勘查开发院之间因一份价值千亿的煤炭资源合作勘查合同而产生的长期诉讼。该案因涉及最高人民法院案卷丢失、多位高官干预司法而引发广泛社会关注。凯奇莱能源投资有限公司的法定代表人作为本案主要当事人，对此案进行了长达十余年的诉讼和举报。
description.en: The 'Shaanxi Hundred-Billion-Yuan Mining Rights Case' refers to the long-term litigation from 2006 to 2019 between Kailai Energy Investment Co., Ltd. and the Xi'an Institute of Geology and Mineral Exploration over a cooperative exploration contract for coal resources worth hundreds of billions of yuan. The case garnered widespread public attention due to the disappearance of case files at the Supreme People's Court and judicial interference by multiple high-ranking officials. The legal representative of Kailai Energy Investment Co., Ltd., a key party in this case, engaged in over a decade of litigation and whistleblowing concerning it.

description.en: A Tang dynasty writer and poet, and one of the most representative poets of the mid-Tang period. He was known for his incisive prose and exceptional skill in poetry, with 'Song of Everlasting Sorrow' being a representative work. He advocated the New Yuefu movement, and his poetry is known for its accessibility and widespread popularity.

东汉末年权臣、军阀，官至太师，李傕、郭汜等人的原主帅。其乱政导致许靖等人逃离京城，后被吕布、王允所杀。
description.en: A powerful minister and warlord in the late Eastern Han dynasty, who served as Grand Tutor and was the original commander of Li Jue, Guo Si, and others. His tyrannical rule caused figures like Xu Jing to flee the capital, and he was later assassinated by Lü Bu and Wang Yun.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年官员，官至司徒。他与吕布合谋诛杀董卓，后被攻入长安的李傕所杀。
description.en: An official of the late Eastern Han dynasty, he served as Situ (Minister of Works). He conspired with Lu Bu to assassinate Dong Zhuo and was later killed by Li Jue after the latter captured Chang'an.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年军阀，曾收留吕布。

东汉末年的群雄之一，出自凉州军阀，是继董卓之后的权臣。他原为董卓旧部，在董卓死后击败吕布并占据长安。其人性格勇猛诡谲，善于用兵，有辩才。官至大司马、车骑将军、司隶校尉，爵位为池阳侯。
description.en: A warlord during the late Eastern Han dynasty from Liang Province, and a powerful minister who succeeded Dong Zhuo. Originally a subordinate of Dong Dong, he defeated Lu Bu and occupied Chang'an after Dong Zhuo's death. He was known for his ferocity, cunning, and military skill, as well as his eloquence. He held high offices including Grand Marshal, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and Colonel-Director of Retainers, and was enfeoffed as the Marquis of Chiyang.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年董卓的部将，与李傕一同攻入长安，挟持汉献帝。后与李傕反目，最终被部将伍习所杀。
description.en: A general under the warlord Dong Zhuo during the late Eastern Han dynasty. He, along with Li Jue, captured Chang'an and held Emperor Xian hostage. He later had a falling out with Li Jue and was eventually killed by his subordinate Wu Xi.

description.en: The formal wife of Cao Cao and mother of Cao Pi, Cao Zhang, Cao Zhi, and Cao Xiong.

description.zh-cn: 曹操的长子，生母为刘夫人，由嫡母丁夫人抚养成人。二十岁时举为孝廉。后在曹操征伐张绣的宛城之战中，为救父亲而阵亡。他是曹丕与曹植的异母兄。
description.en: The eldest son of Cao Cao. His birth mother was Lady Liu, and he was raised by his adoptive mother, Lady Ding. At the age of twenty, he was nominated as Xiaolian. He was killed in the Battle of Wancheng while saving his father during the campaign against Zhang Xiu. He was the half-brother of Cao Pi and Cao Zhi.

description.zh-cn: 三国时期曹魏的第二位皇帝，曹丕与文昭甄皇后之子，亦是曹昂的侄子。在位期间成功防御吴、蜀的多次攻伐，平定公孙渊叛乱。他继位后改谥曹昂为丰愍王。
description.en: The son of Cao Pi and the second emperor of Cao Wei, and the nephew of Cao Ang. After ascending the throne, he changed Cao Ang's posthumous title to King Min of Feng.

description.zh-cn: 曹魏文帝曹丕的妻妾，魏明帝曹叡的生母，原为袁熙之妻。
曹魏时期创立的，并成为魏晋南北朝时期主要的官员选拔制度，后被隋文帝废除。
description.en: An official selection system established during the Cao Wei period, which became the primary system for selecting officials during the Wei, Jin, Northern and Southern dynasties, and was later abolished by Emperor Wen of Sui.

description.zh-cn: 曹魏宗室名将，受曹丕遗诏辅佐曹叡。
曹魏宗室名将，托孤大臣之一。
东汉末年至三国时期曹魏重要将领，曹操的堂弟。因其吝啬曾得罪曹丕，一度被下狱免官，后得卞太后求情赦免。官至骠骑将军，死后谥为恭侯。
description.en: An important general of Cao Wei during the late Eastern Han Dynasty and the Three Kingdoms period, and a cousin of Cao Cao. Due to his stinginess, he offended Cao Pi and was once imprisoned and dismissed from office, but was later pardoned after Empress Dowager Bian interceded. He reached the rank of General of Chariots and Cavalry and was posthumously honored as Marquis Gong.

In 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', he is depicted as devising the plan to seize Jing Province, ultimately leading to Guan Yu's defeat and death.

description.en: A favored consort of Emperor Gaozu of Han, Liu Bang, and the mother of Liu Ruyi, the Prince of Zhao. After Liu Bang's death, she was brutally mutilated by Empress Lü Zhi and turned into a 'human swine'.

description.zh-cn: 汉高祖刘邦第三子，其母为戚夫人。他被封为赵王，是鲁元公主和刘盈的异母弟。因刘邦宠爱，曾差点取代太子位，后被吕后毒杀。
description.en: The third son of Emperor Gaozu Liu Bang and Concubine Qi. He was enfeoffed as the King of Zhao and was the half-brother of Princess Yuan of Lu and Liu Ying. Due to Liu Bang's favor, he nearly replaced the crown prince, but was later poisoned to death by Empress Lü Zhi.

description.zh-cn: 刘邦的妃嫔，汉文帝刘恒之母。
汉朝公主，汉高祖刘邦与皇后吕雉的长女，刘盈的同母姐姐。
description.en: A princess of the Han Dynasty, the eldest daughter of Emperor Gaozu Liu Bang and Empress Lü Zhi, and the full sister of Liu Ying.

description.zh-cn: 刘邦的同乡，早期曾背叛刘邦投靠魏国。
西汉开国功臣，刘邦的连襟，娶吕后之妹吕媭为妻。他曾主张发兵攻打匈奴。晚年因被人诬陷，刘邦曾命陈平将其处死，但陈平将其生擒带回，使其幸免于难。
description.en: A founding general of the Western Han dynasty, Liu Bang's brother-in-law, and husband to Lü Xu, the younger sister of Empress Lü. He advocated for sending troops to attack the Xiongnu. In his later years, falsely accused, Liu Bang ordered Chen Ping to execute him; however, Chen Ping captured him alive and brought him back, thus saving his life.

description.en: A historical policy of political marriage alliance practiced between ancient Chinese rulers and neighboring peoples or states, particularly prevalent during the Han Dynasty with the Xiongnu and other surrounding ethnic groups.

description.en: An event in 200 BC where Emperor Gaozu of Han (Liu Bang) was besieged by the Xiongnu at Baideng, near Pingcheng. Liu Bang later escaped by using a strategy devised by Chen Ping.

description.en: Father of Nurhaci, a Jurchen leader of the Jianzhou Left Guard during the late Ming Dynasty in China, and the founder of the Qing Dynasty. He was once a subordinate of Wang Gao, the commander of the Jianzhou Right Guard, but later submitted to the Ming Dynasty and was promoted to Commander of the Jianzhou Left Guard. He was killed along with his father Giocangga during an attack by Ming forces in 1583. In 1636, he was posthumously honored as Prince Fu by Hong Taiji, and in 1648, he was posthumously honored as Emperor Xuan with the temple name Xianzhu by the Shunzhi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 塔克世的嫡夫人，喜塔腊氏。努尔哈赤、舒尔哈齐、雅尔哈齐、沾河姑的生母。后被追尊为宣皇后。
description.en: Taksi's primary consort, of the Hitara clan. She was the birth mother of Nurhaci, Šurhaci, Yarhaci, and Zhanhegu. She was posthumously honored as Empress Xuan.

description.zh-cn: 努尔哈赤的祖父，塔克世之父。在明军的一次攻击中与儿子塔克世一同被杀，后被追尊为清景祖。
description.en: Grandfather of Nurhaci and father of Taksi. He was killed along with his son Taksi during an attack by Ming forces and was later posthumously honored as Qing Jingzu.

description.zh-cn: 明朝辽东总兵，早期对努尔哈赤有重要影响。
description.en: A general of Liaodong in the late Ming Dynasty, who had a significant influence on Nurhaci in his early days.

description.zh-cn: 该人物被描述为建州女真苏克苏浒部图伦城主，努尔哈赤早期主要仇敌。同时，也有记载称其为明朝将领，在攻破古埒城后杀害了塔克世和觉昌安。
description.en: This figure is described as the lord of Tulun city of the Suksuhu tribe of Jianzhou Jurchen, a major early enemy of Nurhaci. Additionally, they are recorded as a Ming Dynasty general who killed Taksi and Giocangga after conquering Gure city.

description.zh-cn: 塔克世的第三子，努尔哈赤同母弟，被封为和硕庄亲王。他后来与其兄长决裂，并被囚禁。
description.en: The third son of Taksi and a full brother of Nurhaci, he was granted the title of Prince Zhuang of the First Rank. He later broke with his elder brother and was imprisoned.

description.zh-cn: 努尔哈赤长子，曾被立为继承人，后被处死。
努尔哈赤于1618年发布的讨明檄文，标志着对明朝的公开反叛。
description.en: A manifesto issued by Nurhaci in 1618, declaring war against the Ming dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 明朝与后金在宁远城下的一次重要战役。袁崇焕率领明军使用红衣大炮成功击退努尔哈赤的进攻，是明军对后金的首次重大胜利，也是努尔哈赤亲征的唯一败绩，未能攻克由袁崇焕镇守的宁远城。努尔哈赤在此战后不久去世。
description.en: A major battle between Ming and Later Jin forces at Ningyuan. The Ming army, led by Yuan Chonghuan, successfully repelled Nurhaci's attack using Hongyipao cannons, marking the first significant Ming victory against the Later Jin, and Nurhaci's only defeat in person, failing to capture Ningyuan defended by Yuan Chonghuan. Nurhaci died shortly after this battle.

description.zh-cn: 明朝末年著名政治及军事人物，官至兵部尚书兼蓟辽督师。他构筑了“关宁锦防线”，在宁远之战、宁锦之战中多次击败后金军队。为自保曾上疏颂扬魏忠贤，但最终仍被其排挤去职。后因己巳之变中护卫不力及擅杀毛文龙等罪名，被崇祯帝以反间计为由判处凌迟，后于清乾隆年间获得平反。
description.en: A renowned political and military figure in the late Ming Dynasty, who served as Minister of War and Viceroy of Jiliao. He constructed the 'Guan-Ning-Jin Defense Line' and repeatedly defeated the Later Jin forces in the battles of Ningyuan and Ningjin. He once praised Wei Zhongxian to protect himself but was eventually dismissed by him. He was later executed by lingchi by the Chongzhen Emperor, who fell for a deception stratagem, on charges including failing to protect the capital during the Jisi Incident and unlawfully executing Mao Wenlong. He was posthumously rehabilitated during the Qianlong era of the Qing Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 努尔哈赤创建的军政合一、兵民合一的社会组织形式。
description.en: A system of military and social organization created by Nurhaci, integrating civil and military functions, and unifying soldiers and civilians.

Although he issued orders prohibiting the killing of civilians and abduction of women, he bears direct responsibility for the large-scale massacre and looting by his troops after the city fell. Rumors that he amassed a fortune of 'tens of millions' from this campaign are widespread, though some scholars argue this is untrue.

description.en: A large-scale massacre, looting, and arson committed by the Xiang Army led by Zeng Guoquan against the soldiers and civilians in Tianjing (Nanjing) after capturing the capital of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom in July 1864. The event lasted for three days and nights, causing a massive number of deaths, with estimates ranging from about 25,000 to 200,000-300,000.

Later, he became devoted to Daoist activities like the Feng and Shan sacrifices and the 'Heavenly Books', and also granted Zi Lu the title 'Duke of Henei'.

description.en: A late Ming general, a key figure in the Guanning Army, and uncle of Wu Sangui. He defended Liaodong alongside Yuan Chonghuan for many years. After Yuan's arrest, he led a mutiny but was later persuaded to return. He surrendered to the Qing after the fall of the Ming.

description.zh-cn: 日本幕末至明治初期的武士、政治家，位阶勋等为赠从一位勋一等。他是尊王攘夷派中心人物，与西乡隆盛、大久保利通并称为“维新三杰”，在明治政府中扮演了关键角色。曾作为岩仓使节团成员，归国后反对征韩论。
description.en: A Japanese samurai and statesman active from the late Bakumatsu period to the early Meiji era, posthumously awarded the rank of Senior First Rank and Grand Cordon of the Order of the Rising Sun. A central figure in the Sonnō jōi movement, he is known as one of the 'Three Great Nobles of the Restoration' along with Saigō Takamori and Ōkubo Toshimichi, playing a key role in the Meiji government. He was also a member of the Iwakura Mission, and upon his return, he opposed the Seikanron.

birth_place.zh-cn: 日本萨摩藩鹿儿岛城下

description.zh-cn: 日本武士、明治维新时期的政治家，与西乡隆盛及木户孝允并称维新三杰，也是明治政府的核心领导人。他曾是岩仓使节团成员，归国后反对征韩论。
description.en: A Japanese samurai and statesman of the Meiji Restoration period, one of the Three Great Nobles of the Restoration, and a core leader of the Meiji government. He was also a member of the Iwakura Mission and opposed the Seikanron upon his return.

zh-cn: 弗拉基米尔·科科夫佐夫

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯帝国财政大臣。
description.en: Finance Minister of the Russian Empire.

description.zh-cn: 李斯的出生地，位于今河南省。
秦朝首都，李斯的逝世地点。
战国时期儒家代表人物、大师，韩非与李斯的老师。他提倡性恶论，其学生韩非和李斯后来成为法家重要人物。
description.en: A Confucian master and representative during the Warring States period, and the teacher of Han Fei and Li Si. He advocated the theory of evil human nature, with his students Han Fei and Li Si later becoming important figures in Legalism.

description.zh-cn: 战国末期秦国东方的六个主要诸侯国。
李斯为劝谏秦王政取消驱逐客卿的命令而作。
秦朝官职，掌管司法。
秦国统一中国的战争。
秦朝丞相，主张实行分封制。
中央集权的行政区划制度。
封建制度是一种将土地和人民分封给王室成员和功臣的政治制度。在日本江户时代，亦存在等级森严的社会制度，福泽谕吉对此持批判和反对态度。
description.en: Feudalism is a political system where land and people are granted to royal family members and meritorious officials. In Japan's Edo period, a rigid hierarchical social system also existed, which was criticized and opposed by Fukuzawa Yukichi.

description.zh-cn: 齐人，秦朝博士，主张实行分封制。
李斯长子，三川郡守。
秦朝时期的郡，李由曾任该郡郡守。
台湾艺人
中华民国政治人物

zh-cn: 健康幼稚园火烧车事件

description.zh-cn: 前促进转型正义委员会副主委

zh-cn: 内政部警政署刑事警察局

description.zh-cn: 现任新北市副市长

zh-cn: 2022年中华民国直辖市长及县市长选举

description.zh-cn: 韩国宰相，历相韩釐王与韩桓惠王两代，为张开地之子、张良之父。
description.en: Chancellor of the State of Han, serving two generations of monarchs: King Xi and King Huanhui. He was the son of Zhang Kaidi and the father of Zhang Liang.

description.zh-cn: 韩国宰相，历相韩昭侯、韩宣惠王与韩襄王三代，为张良的祖父。
description.en: Chancellor of the State of Han, serving three generations of monarchs: Marquis Zhao, King Xuanhui, and King Xiang. He was the grandfather of Zhang Liang.

description.zh-cn: 张良长子。
西汉，作为汉朝的前半期，是中国历史上继秦朝之后的大一统王朝。巫蛊之祸是其由盛转衰的转折点之一。
description.en: The Western Han Dynasty, as the earlier part of the Han Dynasty, was a unified dynasty in Chinese history following the Qin Dynasty. The Witchcraft Delusion is considered one of its turning points from prosperity to decline.

description.zh-cn: 秦末汉初的隐士，传说曾授予张良兵书。
古代兵书，相传为黄石公授予张良。
战国时期韩国公子，后被项梁立为韩王。
刘邦的谋士。
秦末汉初的四位著名隐士：东园公、甪里先生、绮里季、夏黄公。应太子刘盈之请，出山辅佐，帮助其稳固了太子地位。
description.en: Four famous hermits of the late Qin and early Han dynasties: Dongyuan Gong, Luli Xiansheng, Qili Ji, and Xia Huang Gong. At the request of Crown Prince Liu Ying, they came out of seclusion to support him, helping to solidify his status.

description.zh-cn: 东汉第十二位皇帝。
东汉末年外戚，官至大将军，为铲除宦官势力召董卓进京。
东汉末年操纵朝政的十二位宦官。
东汉第十三位皇帝，后被董卓废为弘农王并毒杀。
董卓的谋士。
董卓部将。董卓死后受王允派遣迎击李傕，兵败战死。他曾于荥阳击败曹操。
description.en: A general under Dong Zhuo. After Dong Zhuo's death, he was dispatched by Wang Yun to intercept Li Jue but was defeated and killed in battle. He once defeated Cao Cao at Xingyang.

description.zh-cn: 董卓之弟。
董卓的女婿，曾是李傕的上级。
description.en: Dong Zhuo's son-in-law and a superior of Li Jue.

description.zh-cn: 董卓的部将，为孙坚所杀。
唐高祖李渊长子，原皇太子
隋朝第二位皇帝，隋文帝杨坚次子。他在废黜兄长杨勇后成为太子，并继承皇位。在位期间兴建大运河、东征高句丽，最终引发隋末民变。
description.en: The second emperor of the Sui dynasty, second son of Emperor Wen Yang Jian. He became the crown prince after deposing his elder brother Yang Yong and succeeded to the throne. During his reign, he constructed the Grand Canal and launched eastern expeditions against Goguryeo, which ultimately led to the rebellions at the end of the Sui dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 隋文帝杨坚的皇后，北周八大柱国之一独孤信之女，也是李渊的姨母。她深度参与政治决策。
description.en: Empress of Emperor Wen of Sui (Yang Jian), daughter of Dugu Xin, one of the Eight Pillar Generals of Northern Zhou, and aunt of Li Yuan. She was deeply involved in political decision-making.

description.zh-cn: 隋朝的开国皇帝，统一了分裂长达近三百年的中国，开创了开皇之治。他在位期间进行了一系列改革，包括创立五省六部制和科举制度。
description.en: The founding emperor of the Sui dynasty, who reunified China after nearly three centuries of division and initiated the Kaihuang Era of prosperity. During his reign, he implemented a series of reforms, including the establishment of the Five Departments and Six Ministries system and the imperial examination system.

description.zh-cn: 唐高祖李渊之母
唐高祖李渊之父
隋朝太原郡丞
隋朝武牙郎将
突厥可汗
位于蒙古高原的古代游牧帝国
隋朝将领，在江都发动兵变，弑杀隋炀帝，后自立为帝，国号许。
description.en: A Sui dynasty general who launched a coup in Jiangdu, assassinated Emperor Yang, and later declared himself emperor of the state of Xu.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝为消灭隋末割据势力、统一全国而进行的一系列战争
西魏八大柱国之一
中国政治人物，曾任中华人民共和国国家安全部部长。
中国政治人物，现任中华人民共和国国家安全部部长。
中共中央纪委和中华人民共和国国家监察委员会的直属事业单位。
description.en: An institution directly under the CCDI and the National Supervisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国法学界、法律界的全国性群众性学术团体，是中国共产党领导下的人民团体。佘孟孝曾任常务副会长、党组书记，罗豪才也曾任副会长。
description.en: A national mass and academic organization for China's legal and academic circles, it is a people's organization under the leadership of the Communist Party of China. She Mengxiao served as its executive vice president and party group secretary, and Luo Haocai also served as vice president.

description.zh-cn: 由菩提达摩传入中国的大乘佛教宗派。
菩提达摩的弟子，中国禅宗二祖。
description.en: A disciple of Bodhidharma and the second patriarch of Chan Buddhism in China.

description.zh-cn: 菩提达摩的弟子，据传记录了达摩的言行。
description.en: A disciple of Bodhidharma, said to have recorded his teachings.

zh-cn: 菩提达磨大师略辨大乘入道四行观

description.zh-cn: 相传为达摩口述，昙林记录的禅宗理论著作。
菩提达摩的逝世地。
菩提达摩的出生地之一。
根据《洛阳伽蓝记》记载，菩提达摩来自波斯。
中国南北朝时期的南朝第三个王朝。
大乘佛教经典，早期禅宗（楞伽宗）所依持的重要经典。
早期禅宗的一个流派，因重视《楞伽经》而得名。
唐朝禅宗高僧，被后世尊为北宗禅的创始人。
位于广州的千年古刹，相传为达摩所建。
广州的古寺，内有达摩“洗钵泉”遗迹。
中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任武汉市市长、成都市市长、中共成都市委书记、中共重庆市委副书记、重庆市人民政府市长。现任安徽省政协主席、党组书记。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, he has served as Mayor of Wuhan, Mayor of Chengdu, Secretary of the CPC Chengdu Municipal Committee, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Chongqing Municipal Committee, and Mayor of the Chongqing Municipal People's Government. He is currently the Chairman and Party Group Secretary of the Anhui Provincial Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，夏宝龙担任浙江省省长时的前任。
description.en: Chinese politician, predecessor to Xia Baolong as Governor of Zhejiang.

zh-cn: 贵州省人民代表大会常务委员会
第十三届全国人民代表大会代表名单
第十三届全国人大代表
en: List of deputies to the 13th National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国第十三届全国人民代表大会的代表，是最高国家权力机关的组成人员。
description.en: Deputies to the 13th National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China, who are members of the highest organ of state power.

en: Office of the Chairman of the Central Military Commission

description.zh-cn: 为中央军事委员会主席服务的办事机构。

zh-cn: 中共中央办公厅调研室
en: Research Department of the General Office of the Chinese Communist Party

zh-cn: 中央军事委员会改革和编制办公室
en: Office for Reform and Organizational Structure

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将，现任中央军委办公厅主任。
中国人民解放军中将，曾任中央警卫局局长、中央军委主席办公室主任。

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军空军中将
en: People's Liberation Army Air Force Lieutenant General

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军现行军衔制度中的主要军衔之一，适用于副大军区职（副战区级）、正军职、副军职军官，包括空军在内的各军兵种均设此衔。
description.en: One of the primary military ranks in the current rank system of the People's Liberation Army, applicable to officers at the deputy theater command level, corps leader level, and deputy corps leader level. This rank is established in all services and branches, including the Air Force.

description.zh-cn: 曾任山西省革命委员会主任，与陈永贵存在政治斗争。
大寨大队原党支部书记，陈永贵的前任。
柬埔寨共产党总书记、红色高棉最高领导人，曾与陈永贵互访。
文化大革命期间山西省的权力机构。
抗日战争期间，日本当局在占领区建立的组织，旨在促进亚洲团结和发展。
description.en: A Japanese organization established by authorities in occupied territories during the Anti-Japanese War, aimed at promoting Asian unity and development.

description.zh-cn: 位于山西省昔阳县的村庄，在毛泽东时代作为“农业学大寨”运动的全国典型。
毛泽东发起的全国性农业运动，以大寨为榜样。
文革时期的一项极左政策，旨在取消农民的自留地和家庭副业。
段祺瑞和范瑾的母亲。
description.en: Mother of Duan Qirui and Fan Jin.

description.zh-cn: 段祺瑞的原配妻子。
description.en: Duan Qirui's first wife.

description.zh-cn: 清末由李鸿章在天津创办的军事院校，是中国近代第一所陆军军官学校。
description.en: A military academy founded in Tianjin by Li Hongzhang during the late Qing dynasty, it was the first modern army officer school in China.

description.zh-cn: 普鲁士王国及后来的德意志帝国的总参谋部军事学院，是19世纪末德国重要的军事教育机构。
description.en: The military staff college of the Prussian Army and later the German Imperial Army, a significant military educational institution in Germany during the late 19th century.

description.zh-cn: 直系军阀与皖系军阀之间为争夺北京政府统治权而爆发的战争。
description.en: A war fought between the Zhili and Anhui cliques for control of the Beiyang government.

zh-cn: 中华民国临时政府 (段祺瑞)

description.zh-cn: 1924年甲子政变后，由段祺瑞在北京成立的政府，段祺瑞任“临时执政”。
description.en: The government established in Beijing by Duan Qirui after the 1924 Beijing Coup, in which he served as the 'Provisional Chief Executive'.

description.zh-cn: 段祺瑞执政府卫队开枪镇压北京学生和市民的请愿游行，造成大量伤亡。
description.en: An incident where guards of Duan Qirui's government fired on protesters in Beijing, resulting in numerous casualties.

description.zh-cn: 由段祺瑞等四十六名北洋军将领联名发出，要求清帝退位、实行共和的电报。
description.en: A telegram jointly issued by 46 Beiyang Army generals led by Duan Qirui, demanding the abdication of the Qing emperor and the establishment of a republic.

description.zh-cn: 皖系军阀的重要人物，段祺瑞的得力干将和主要谋士，曾任奉军副司令，与张作霖不和。
description.en: A key figure in the Anhui clique, Duan Qirui's chief subordinate and strategist. He also served as deputy commander of the Fengtian army and was at odds with Zhang Zuolin.

description.zh-cn: 皖系军阀为操控国会选举而成立的政治团体，因在北京安福胡同开会而得名。
description.en: A political organization formed by the Anhui clique to manipulate parliamentary elections, named after its meeting place on Anfu Hutong in Beijing.

en: Premier of the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华民国北洋政府时期的政府首脑。
description.en: The head of government during the Beiyang era of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 2013年9月发生在中华民国的政治事件，涉及总统马英九与立法院长王金平之间的权力斗争。
