description.en: A political incident in Taiwan in September 2013, involving a power struggle between President Ma Ying-jeou and Legislative Yuan President Wang Jin-pyng.

en: Special Investigation Division of the Supreme Prosecutors Office
zh-cn: 最高法院检察署特别侦查组

description.zh-cn: 中华民国最高法院检察署内设立的特别检察官机构，负责侦办总统、副总统及五院院长等层级的贪渎与重大经济犯罪。
description.en: A special prosecutor's office established within the Supreme Prosecutors Office of the Republic of China, responsible for investigating corruption and major economic crimes involving high-level officials such as the President, Vice President, and heads of the five Yuans.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，民主进步党籍，现任立法委员，并担任民主进步党立法院党团总召集人。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician, a member of the Democratic Progressive Party, a current member of the Legislative Yuan, and convener of the Democratic Progressive Party caucus in the Legislative Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任法务部部长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who served as the Minister of Justice.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国检察官，曾任台湾高等法院检察署检察长。
description.en: A prosecutor in the Republic of China who served as the Head Prosecutor of the Taiwan High Prosecutors Office.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任立法院秘书长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who served as the Secretary-General of the Legislative Yuan.

en: National Tainan First Senior High School
zh-cn: 国立台南第一高级中学

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾台南市的著名高级中学。
description.en: A renowned senior high school located in Tainan, Taiwan.

location.zh-cn: 日治台湾高雄州冈山郡
location.en: Okayama District, Takao Prefecture, Japanese Taiwan

description.zh-cn: 日治时期台湾高雄州冈山郡的一个行政区，今高雄市路竹区。
description.en: An administrative division of Okayama District, Takao Prefecture during the Japanese rule of Taiwan, now Luzhu District, Kaohsiung City.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝诗人，白居易的挚友，二人并称“元白”，共同倡导新乐府运动。
description.en: A Tang dynasty poet and a close friend of Bai Juyi. They were collectively known as 'Yuan Bai' and jointly advocated for the New Yuefu Movement.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝文学家、哲学家、诗人，白居易晚年在洛阳的挚友。二人唱和甚多，被时人并称为“刘白”。
description.en: A Tang dynasty writer, philosopher, and poet, and a close friend of Bai Juyi in his later years in Luoyang. They often exchanged poems and were known as 'Liu Bai'.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝第十一位皇帝。白居易因直言进谏曾令其不快，后将白居易贬为江州司马。
description.en: The 11th emperor of the Tang dynasty. He was displeased by Bai Juyi's direct remonstrations and later demoted him to the position of Sima of Jiangzhou.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝第十六位皇帝，曾褒奖白居易为“诗仙”。
description.en: The 16th emperor of the Tang dynasty, who praised Bai Juyi as the 'Poet Immortal'.

description.zh-cn: 唐代诗人、名士。在白居易初到长安时，他因欣赏其诗才而大加赞赏，并为之延誉，使其声名大振。
description.en: A Tang dynasty poet and famous scholar. Upon Bai Juyi's initial arrival in Chang'an, he greatly admired his poetic talent and helped promote his reputation, making him widely known.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝宰相，曾在唐宪宗面前为白居易的直言敢谏辩护。
description.en: A chancellor of the Tang dynasty who defended Bai Juyi's outspokenness to Emperor Xianzong.

description.zh-cn: 唐代文学家，白居易的弟弟。
description.en: A Tang dynasty writer, and the younger brother of Bai Juyi.

description.zh-cn: 由白居易、元稹等人倡导的唐代诗歌革新运动，主张“文章合为时而著，歌诗合为事而作”，强调诗歌的社会功能、现实意义和讽谕作用。
description.en: A poetic reform movement in the Tang dynasty advocated by Bai Juyi, Yuan Zhen, and others. It promoted the idea that 'prose should be written for the times, and poetry for current events,' emphasizing the social function, realistic significance, and satirical function of poetry.

description.zh-cn: 位于今河南省，是白居易的出生地。
description.en: Located in modern-day Henan Province, it is the birthplace of Bai Juyi.

description.zh-cn: 白居易创作的著名长篇叙事诗，记叙了作者在被贬谪江州途中与一位琵琶女的相遇。
description.en: A famous long narrative poem by Bai Juyi, recounting his encounter with a pipa player while he was demoted and on his way to Jiangzhou.

description.zh-cn: 白居易的个人诗文集，由其本人编辑，好友元稹作序。元稹亦在其离任杭州时协助收集编纂而成。
description.en: Bai Juyi's personal collection of poems and writings, edited by himself, with a preface by his friend Yuan Zhen. Yuan Zhen also assisted in collecting and compiling it when Bai Juyi left his post in Hangzhou.

description.zh-cn: 古龙与郑月霞的长子。
description.en: The eldest son of Gu Long and Zheng Yuexia.

description.zh-cn: 台湾演员。1980年在北投吟松阁因敬酒风波，其友人刺伤古龙，导致古龙健康状况急剧恶化。
description.en: A Taiwanese actor. In 1980, at the Yinsong Pavilion in Beitou, a dispute over a toast led to his associates stabbing Gu Long, causing a severe decline in Gu Long's health.

description.zh-cn: 台湾知名黑社会组织，传闻古龙在离家出走后曾短暂加入。
description.en: A well-known triad in Taiwan, which Gu Long was rumored to have briefly joined after running away from home.

description.zh-cn: 台湾的一家主要报纸，曾连载古龙的小说《天涯‧明月‧刀》，但因理念前卫而中途停止刊载。
description.en: A major newspaper in Taiwan that serialized Gu Long's novel 'Tianya, Mingyue, Dao' but prematurely ended its publication due to its avant-garde concepts.

description.zh-cn: 古龙的武侠小说，因理念较为前卫，在《中国时报》连载时被腰斩。
description.en: A wuxia novel by Gu Long. Its serialization in the China Times was prematurely ended due to its avant-garde concepts.

description.zh-cn: 古龙的武侠小说，创作上向日本时代小说《宫本武藏》取经，探索武道。
description.en: A wuxia novel by Gu Long, which drew inspiration from the Japanese historical novel 'Miyamoto Musashi' to explore the way of martial arts.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军成员，曾参加长征，是王健林的父亲，也是王思聪的祖父。
description.en: A member of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army who participated in the Long March, and is the father of Wang Jianlin and the paternal grandfather of Wang Sicong.

description.zh-cn: 中国商人和社交媒体名人，王健林之子。
description.en: Chinese businessman and social media personality, son of Wang Jianlin.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国四川省已撤销的专区。
description.en: A former administrative division in Sichuan Province, People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军第七综合训练基地

description.zh-cn: 曾位于中国辽宁省大连市的一所军事院校。
description.en: A former military academy located in Dalian, Liaoning, China.

description.zh-cn: 一家美国的连锁电影院，曾为全球最大的连锁影院。
description.en: An American movie theater chain, formerly the largest in the world.

description.zh-cn: 大连万达集团旗下的文化产业公司。
description.en: The cultural industry subsidiary of Dalian Wanda Group.

description.zh-cn: 中国的一家房地产开发公司。
description.en: A real estate developer in China.

description.zh-cn: 中国的一家房地产开发公司。
description.en: A real estate developer in China.

description.zh-cn: 由王健林成立的足球俱乐部，后被实德集团收购。
description.en: A football club founded by Wang Jianlin, later acquired by Shide Group.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的足球运动管理机构。
description.en: The governing body for football in the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝妃嫔，允禩的生母。
description.en: A consort of the Kangxi Emperor and the biological mother of Yinsi.

description.zh-cn: 允禩的嫡福晋，安亲王岳乐的外孙女。
description.en: The primary consort of Yinsi, granddaughter of Prince An Yue Le.

description.zh-cn: 允禩之子，曾被雍正帝改名为菩萨保。
description.en: Son of Yinsi, his name was once changed to Pusabao by the Yongzheng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室爵位，低于亲王、郡王，高于贝子。
description.en: A noble title for imperial clansmen in the Qing dynasty, ranking below a Prince and a Junwang, but above a Beizi.

description.zh-cn: 清朝康熙、雍正、乾隆三朝重臣。
description.en: An influential minister during the Kangxi, Yongzheng, and Qianlong reigns of the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 清朝掌管蒙古、西藏等少数民族事务的中央机构。
description.en: The central government agency of the Qing Dynasty responsible for the affairs of ethnic minorities such as the Mongols and Tibetans.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代官署，六部之一，掌管全国屯田、水利、土木、工程、交通、官办工业等。
description.en: One of the six ministries in ancient Chinese government, in charge of public works, water conservancy, construction, transportation, and state-run industries.

description.zh-cn: 宗人府是中国明清时期管理皇家宗室事务的机构，负责宗族名册、记录宗室成员信息并处理其请求、奖惩事宜。在越南阮朝，亦设有类似的宗室管理机构，其职能与中国宗人府相近，曾为避绍治帝名讳而改名。
description.en: Zongrenfu was an institution in Ming and Qing dynasty China that managed imperial clan affairs, responsible for genealogical records, recording clan members' information, and handling their requests and punishments. A similar imperial clan affairs agency also existed in the Nguyễn dynasty in Vietnam, with functions akin to its Chinese counterpart, and was renamed to avoid Emperor Thiệu Trị's naming taboo.

description.zh-cn: 清代八旗之一，下五旗之一。
description.en: One of the Eight Banners of the Qing Dynasty, one of the Lower Five Banners.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，安亲王，努尔哈赤之孙。
description.en: An imperial clansman of the Qing dynasty, Prince An, and a grandson of Nurhaci.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝第九女。
description.en: The ninth daughter of the Kangxi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝妃嫔，皇长子胤禔的生母，曾抚养允禩。
description.en: A consort of the Kangxi Emperor, biological mother of the first prince Yinzhi, and she raised Yinsi in his childhood.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝皇长子。
description.en: The first son of the Kangxi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 清代学者、书法家，曾任允禩的侍读。
description.en: A scholar and calligrapher of the Qing dynasty, who once served as an attendant-reader to Yinsi.

en: Changchun University of Science and Technology

zh-cn: 辽宁省人民代表大会常务委员会
en: Standing Committee of the Liaoning Provincial People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 辽宁省人民代表大会的常设机关。
description.en: The permanent body of the Liaoning Provincial People's Congress.

en: Work Safety Committee of the State Council
zh-cn: 国务院安全生产委员会
国务院三峡工程建设委员会
广东梅大高速路面塌方灾害

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来担任中共重庆市委书记期间，在重庆推行的一系列政治、经济和社会政策的总称。其特点是强调国家干预、社会公平和宣扬红色文化。
description.en: A term for the series of political, economic, and social policies implemented by Bo Xilai in Chongqing during his tenure as the secretary of the CPC Chongqing Municipal Committee, characterized by an emphasis on state intervention, social equity, and the promotion of 'red culture'.

description.zh-cn: 一家位于辽宁的保健品公司，曾在薄熙来担任商务部长期间获得直销牌照，后因欺诈问题引发蚁力神事件。
description.en: A health products company in Liaoning that obtained a direct selling license while Bo Xilai was Minister of Commerce, and was later involved in the Yilishen incident due to fraud.

description.zh-cn: 醇贤亲王奕𫍽的侧福晋，载沣的生母。
description.en: A secondary consort of Yixuan, Prince Chun, and the biological mother of Zaifeng.

description.zh-cn: 武昌起义标志着辛亥革命的开端。保路运动爆发后，清廷调派湖北新军入川镇压，致使武昌防务空虚，为起义成功创造了决定性条件。此次起义直接导致清朝覆灭和载沣摄政体制瓦解。
description.en: The Wuchang Uprising marked the beginning of the Xinhai Revolution. Following the outbreak of the Railway Protection Movement, the Qing court dispatched the Hubei New Army to Sichuan for suppression, leaving Wuchang's defenses vulnerable and creating a decisive condition for the success of the uprising. This uprising directly led to the fall of the Qing dynasty and the collapse of Zaifeng's regency.

description.zh-cn: 载沣第四子。
description.en: The fourth son of Zaifeng.

description.zh-cn: 清朝末年的国家银行，其发行的兑换券上印有摄政王载沣的肖像。
description.en: The state bank of the late Qing dynasty, which issued banknotes featuring the portrait of Prince-Regent Zaifeng.

zh-cn: 上海市第一中级人民法院

description.zh-cn: 位于中国上海市的司法机关。
description.en: A judicial body located in Shanghai, China.

description.zh-cn: 一家美国报纸。其在2017年的一篇报道中对科大讯飞的技术提出了潜在的伦理担忧。
description.en: An American newspaper. In a 2017 report, it raised potential ethical concerns about iFlytek's technology.

description.zh-cn: 中国前国家副主席曾庆红之子。
description.en: Son of former Chinese Vice President Zeng Qinghong.

zh-cn: 华夏人寿保险股份有限公司

description.zh-cn: 加拿大多伦多的一个地区。
description.en: A district in Toronto, Canada.

description.zh-cn: 秦国国君，秦庄襄王之父，在位时间极短。
description.en: King of the state of Qin, father of King Zhuangxiang of Qin. His reign was extremely short.

description.zh-cn: 秦孝文王的正夫人，无子，后收养异人（秦庄襄王）为义子。
description.en: The primary consort of King Xiaowen of Qin. Being childless, she adopted Yiren (King Zhuangxiang of Qin) as her son.

description.zh-cn: 秦国国君，秦孝文王之父，在位时间长达五十六年。
description.en: King of the state of Qin, father of King Xiaowen of Qin. His reign lasted for fifty-six years.

description.zh-cn: 东周国末代君主，后被吕不韦所杀。
description.en: The last ruler of the state of Eastern Zhou, who was killed by Lü Buwei.

description.zh-cn: 中国历史上周朝的一个姬姓诸侯国。它是吕不韦的出生地，也是子路曾在此地为官并最终殉职的地方。
description.en: A Ji family name vassal state during the Zhou dynasty in Chinese history. It was the birthplace of Lü Buwei, and also where Zi Lu once served as an official and ultimately died.

description.zh-cn: 中国战国时期从周王室分裂出的一个小国，后被秦国所灭。
description.en: A small state that split from the Zhou royal house during the Warring States period, later conquered by the state of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代思想流派，以“兼儒墨，合名法”为特点，吕不韦是其代表人物。
description.en: An ancient Chinese school of thought characterized by 'combining Confucianism and Mohism, integrating the School of Names and Legalism'. Lü Buwei is its representative figure.

description.zh-cn: 中国春秋战国时期各种学术流派的总称。
description.en: A collective term for the various academic schools of thought during the Spring and Autumn and Warring States periods in China.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代官职，为百官之长。
description.en: An official position in ancient China, the head of all civil officials.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代在今陕西省修建的一项大型水利工程。该工程由秦国兴建，最初由韩国提出，意图消耗秦国国力，但建成后反而极大地增强了秦国的农业生产和经济实力。
description.en: An ancient, large-scale hydraulic engineering project built in present-day Shaanxi province by the State of Qin. Initially proposed by the State of Han with the aim of draining Qin's resources, its completion instead greatly enhanced Qin's agricultural production and economic strength.

description.zh-cn: 由秦国相邦吕不韦主持，集合其门客共同编撰的一部古代类百科全书式的著作，是杂家思想的代表作。
description.en: An ancient Chinese encyclopedic text compiled under the patronage of Lü Buwei, Chancellor of Qin, by his scholarly retainers. It is a representative work of the Miscellaneous School of thought.

description.zh-cn: 秦国设立的一个郡，位于今四川省境内。
description.en: A commandery established by the State of Qin, located in present-day Sichuan Province.

en: China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国家中医药管理局直属的集科研、医疗、教学为一体的综合性中医药研究机构。屠呦呦于此工作。
description.en: A comprehensive research institution for Chinese medicine directly under the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine of the People's Republic of China, integrating scientific research, medical care, and teaching. Tu Youyou works here.

description.zh-cn: 位于浙江省宁波市的中学，屠呦呦曾于此就读。
description.en: A high school located in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, where Tu Youyou once studied.

description.zh-cn: 位于浙江省宁波市的中学，屠呦呦于1951年于此毕业。
description.en: A high school located in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, from which Tu Youyou graduated in 1951.

description.zh-cn: 一种从黄花蒿中提取的倍半萜内酯化合物，由屠呦呦及其团队发现。它具有高效的抗疟作用，是现代抗疟药物的基础，主要用于治疗疟疾。
description.en: A sesquiterpene lactone isolated from Artemisia annua, discovered by Tu Youyou and her team. It possesses potent antimalarial properties, forms the basis for modern antimalarial drugs, and is primarily used to treat malaria.

description.zh-cn: 作为一种由屠呦呦及其团队发现的抗疟药（青蒿素）的还原产物，它是青蒿素在体内的活性代谢物，也是合成其他高效衍生物（如蒿甲醚和青蒿琥酯）的重要中间体。
description.en: It is a reduction product of artemisinin, an antimalarial drug discovered by Tu Youyou and her team. It serves as artemisinin's active metabolite in vivo and is a key intermediate for synthesizing other potent derivatives like artemether and artesunate.

description.zh-cn: 一个中华人民共和国国家秘密军事医学研究项目，旨在研发治疗抗氯喹疟疾的药物。屠呦呦是该项目研究组的组长，并在此期间最终成功发现了青蒿素。
description.en: A top-secret military medical research project of the People's Republic of China, aimed at developing a treatment for chloroquine-resistant malaria. Tu Youyou was the head of the project's research group and ultimately discovered artemisinin during this period.

description.zh-cn: 中国东晋时期的医学家、炼丹家，著有《肘后备急方》，其著作启发了屠呦呦发现青蒿素的方法。
description.en: A medical scholar and alchemist of the Eastern Jin dynasty in China, author of 'The Handbook of Prescriptions for Emergencies', whose work inspired Tu Youyou's method for discovering artemisinin.

en: A Handbook of Prescriptions for Emergencies

description.zh-cn: 中国东晋时期葛洪编撰的古代中医典籍，其中关于青蒿治疟的记载启发了屠呦呦的低温提取方法。
description.en: An ancient Chinese medical text compiled by Ge Hong during the Eastern Jin dynasty. Its description of using sweet wormwood to treat malaria inspired Tu Youyou's low-temperature extraction method.

description.zh-cn: 中药学家，曾是屠呦呦在中医研究院的老师和同事。
description.en: A pharmacognosist who was Tu Youyou's teacher and colleague at the China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 美国最高学术荣誉团体之一。
description.en: One of the highest academic honorary societies in the United States.

description.zh-cn: 中国财政金融家，屠呦呦的舅舅。
description.en: A Chinese financier and banker, and Tu Youyou's maternal uncle.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国财政部国库司首任司长，屠呦呦的外祖父。
description.en: The first Director of the National Treasury Department of the Ministry of Finance of the Republic of China, and Tu Youyou's maternal grandfather.

description.zh-cn: 清朝武官，湄云舰管带，屠呦呦的曾祖父。
description.en: A military officer of the Qing Dynasty, commander of the warship Meiyun, and Tu Youyou's great-grandfather.

description.zh-cn: 清朝第七位皇帝嘉庆帝的年号。
description.en: The era name of the Jiaqing Emperor, the seventh emperor of the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 意大利籍耶稣会传教士、画家，曾为清朝宫廷画师。
description.en: An Italian Jesuit brother and missionary in China, where he served as an artist at the imperial court of three emperors.

description.zh-cn: 清朝军机大臣，是林则徐的坚定支持者。在林则徐被革职后，他力荐复用林则徐未果，最终以尸谏方式自缢身亡。
description.en: A Grand Councilor of the Qing dynasty and a staunch supporter of Lin Zexu. After Lin's dismissal, he strongly recommended his reinstatement but failed, ultimately committing suicide as a form of remonstrance.

description.zh-cn: 清代思想家、史学家。他是林则徐的好友，并受其委托，将《四洲志》等资料编成《海国图志》。该书详细介绍了西方各国的历史地理和科技，主张“师夷长技以制夷”，对晚清思想界影响深远。
description.en: A Chinese scholar, historian, and thinker of the Qing dynasty. He was a friend of Lin Zexu and was commissioned by him to compile the 'Illustrated Treatise on the Maritime Kingdoms' (Haiguo Tuzhi) from materials like the 'Gazetteer of the Four Continents.' This work introduced the history, geography, and technology of Western nations and advocated for 'learning from the barbarians' advanced technology to counter them,' profoundly influencing late Qing thought.

description.zh-cn: 第一次鸦片战争期间的英国驻华商务总监，同时也是英国皇家海军军官。他在禁烟运动中与林则徐直接对抗，代表英方参与战争初期的军事行动和谈判，并于1841年率军占领香港岛。
description.en: The British Chief Superintendent of Trade in China and a Royal Navy officer during the First Opium War. He directly confronted Lin Zexu during the anti-opium campaign, represented the British side in early military actions and negotiations, and led the occupation of Hong Kong Island in 1841.

description.zh-cn: 英国怡和洋行的创始人之一，是当时中国最大的鸦片商人之一。在林则徐禁烟期间，他是主要的对抗者，并返回英国游说政府对华出兵。
description.en: Co-founder of the British trading firm Jardine, Matheson & Co., and one of the largest opium traders in China at the time. He was a primary opponent during Lin Zexu's anti-opium campaign and returned to Britain to lobby the government for military action against China.

description.zh-cn: 英国宝顺洋行的鸦片商人，与威廉·渣甸同为林则徐禁烟运动的主要抵制者。
description.en: An opium trader from the British firm Dent & Co., who, along with William Jardine, was a major opponent of Lin Zexu's anti-opium campaign.

description.zh-cn: 清朝广东水师提督，积极配合林则徐的禁烟和海防工作。在第一次鸦片战争的虎门之战中，他率军奋力抵抗，最终壮烈殉国。
description.en: The admiral of the Guangdong Fleet of the Qing dynasty, who actively cooperated with Lin Zexu in opium prohibition and coastal defense. He valiantly led his troops in the Battle of Humen during the First Opium War and died in action.

en: Illustrated Treatise on the Maritime Kingdoms

description.zh-cn: 由魏源在林则徐《四洲志》的基础上编撰而成的一部介绍世界地理、历史和西方科技的著作，对晚清的洋务运动和日本的明治维新产生了重要影响。
description.en: A treatise compiled by Wei Yuan based on Lin Zexu's 'Gazetteer of the Four Continents,' introducing world geography, history, and Western technology. It had a significant influence on the Self-Strengthening Movement in the late Qing and the Meiji Restoration in Japan.

description.zh-cn: 林则徐在广州禁烟期间，组织人员翻译英国人休·慕瑞的《地理百科全书》而成的书籍，是中国近代第一部相对完整、系统的世界地理志。后成为魏源编撰《海国图志》的基础。
description.en: A book compiled under Lin Zexu's direction in Guangzhou, consisting of translations from Hugh Murray's 'Cyclopaedia of Geography'. It was the first systematic world geography gazetteer in modern China and later became the basis for Wei Yuan's 'Illustrated Treatise on the Maritime Kingdoms'.

description.zh-cn: 清朝由皇帝亲自派遣，代表皇帝行使权力、处理特定事务的临时性高级官员。
description.en: A temporary high-ranking official in the Qing dynasty, dispatched by the emperor to handle specific matters with imperial authority.

description.zh-cn: 清朝地方最高级官吏之一，总管广东和广西两省的军民政务。
description.en: One of the highest-ranking local officials in the Qing dynasty, responsible for the military and civil affairs of Guangdong and Guangxi provinces.

description.zh-cn: 孔祥熙与宋霭龄的次女，是“飞狗事件”的核心人物。
description.en: The second daughter of H. H. Kung and Soong Ai-ling, and the central figure in the 'Flying Dog Incident'.

description.zh-cn: 中国电视制片人，宋祖英的丈夫。
description.en: Chinese television producer, husband of Song Zuying.

description.zh-cn: 中国女演员，宋祖英的妹妹。
description.en: Chinese actress, younger sister of Song Zuying.

location.zh-cn: 湖南省湘西土家族苗族自治州

description.zh-cn: 宋祖英的出生地。
description.en: The birthplace of Song Zuying.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海军政治工作部文工团

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海军的文艺团体。
description.en: The cultural troupe of the People's Liberation Army Navy of China.

zh-cn: 第九届全国人民代表大会代表名单

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国第九届全国人民代表大会的代表身份。
description.en: The status of a deputy to the 9th National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 西班牙男高音歌唱家。
description.en: Spanish operatic tenor.

description.zh-cn: 台湾男歌手、音乐人、演员。
description.en: Taiwanese male singer, musician, and actor.

description.zh-cn: 台湾流行歌手、音乐人、演员、导演。在2024年花莲地震后，与妻子昆凌共同捐款支持国立东华大学重建。
description.en: A Taiwanese pop singer, musician, actor, and director. After the 2024 Hualien earthquake, he and his wife Hannah Quinlivan jointly donated money to support the reconstruction of National Dong Hwa University.

description.zh-cn: 中国电视节目主持人、媒体人、企业家。
description.en: Chinese television host, media personality, and entrepreneur.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国银行家，曾任中国银行总经理，反对孔祥熙的财政政策。
description.en: Chinese banker who served as the general manager of the Bank of China and opposed H. H. Kung's financial policies.

description.zh-cn: 中国女记者，曾任《新民报》采访部主任，报道了引发争议的“飞狗事件”。
description.en: Chinese female journalist, served as the director of the interview department of 'Xin Min Bao', and reported on the controversial 'Flying Dog Incident'.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国掌管财政、税收、关务、国有财产等事务的最高机构，其政府部长负责监督国库、确定财政政策和管理政府预算。
description.en: The ministry of the Republic of China that governs revenue, taxation, customs, and national property. Its government minister is responsible for supervising the treasury, determining fiscal policy, and managing the government budget.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国的中央银行。
description.en: The central bank of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 民国时期的主要商业银行之一，后被国民政府增资控股。
description.en: One of the major commercial banks during the Republic of China period, later controlled by the Nationalist Government through increased capital.

zh-cn: 北京市通州区潞河中学

description.zh-cn: 位于北京通州的学校，前身为美国华北公理会开设的书院，孔祥熙曾在此就读。
description.en: A school in Tongzhou, Beijing, formerly an academy established by the American Board of Commissioners for Foreign Missions, where H. H. Kung studied.

description.zh-cn: 美国俄亥俄州的一所私立文理学院，孔祥熙的母校。
description.en: A private liberal arts college in Ohio, USA, and the alma mater of H. H. Kung.

description.zh-cn: 由孔祥熙在家乡太谷县创办的学校。
description.en: A school founded by H. H. Kung in his hometown of Taigu County.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国民政府于1935年起发行的法定货币，由孔祥熙主导推行。
description.en: The legal tender of the Republic of China issued by the Nationalist Government starting in 1935, implemented under the leadership of H. H. Kung.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国山西省，是孔祥熙的出生地。
description.en: A county in Shanxi Province, China, and the birthplace of H. H. Kung.

description.zh-cn: 美国城市，孔祥熙和宋彬彬的逝世地。
description.en: A city in the United States where H. H. Kung and Song Binbin passed away.

description.zh-cn: 明宣宗的贤妃，景泰帝的生母。
description.en: A consort of the Xuande Emperor and the biological mother of the Jingtai Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 景泰帝的原配皇后，因反对废黜太子朱见深而被废。
description.en: The first empress consort of the Jingtai Emperor, who was deposed for opposing the removal of Crown Prince Zhu Jianshen.

description.zh-cn: 景泰帝的第二位皇后，太子朱见济的生母。
description.en: The second empress consort of the Jingtai Emperor and the biological mother of Crown Prince Zhu Jianji.

description.zh-cn: 景泰帝与汪皇后所生的女儿。
description.en: Daughter of the Jingtai Emperor and Empress Wang.

description.zh-cn: 景泰帝的皇贵妃，在景泰帝死后被明英宗下令殉葬。
description.en: Imperial Noble Consort of the Jingtai Emperor, who was ordered by Emperor Yingzong to be buried alive as a human sacrifice after the Jingtai Emperor's death.

description.zh-cn: 明朝孝慈高皇后马氏的父亲，后被朱元璋追封为徐王。
description.en: The father of Empress Ma of the Ming dynasty, posthumously created Prince of Xu by Zhu Yuanzhang.

description.zh-cn: 元末明初的富商。
description.en: A wealthy businessman in the late Yuan and early Ming dynasties.

description.zh-cn: 明太祖朱元璋的妃子，部分史料记载其为明成祖朱棣的生母，但其真实身份存在争议。
description.en: A consort of the Hongwu Emperor (Zhu Yuanzhang). While some historical sources identify her as the birth mother of the Yongle Emperor (Zhu Di), her true identity remains disputed.

description.zh-cn: 元惠宗的第三任皇后，元朝最后一位皇后。
description.en: The third empress of Emperor Huizong of Yuan and the last empress of the Yuan dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 清朝晚期负责外交、通商、海关、海防、邮政及各项洋务事宜的中央机构，由奕䜣建议设立并长期领导。
description.en: The central institution in late Qing dynasty China responsible for foreign affairs, commerce, customs, coastal defense, postal services, and various other foreign matters, established and led by Yixin for a long period.

description.zh-cn: 慈禧太后心腹太监，因违背祖制出京被处死。
description.en: A favored court eunuch of Empress Dowager Cixi, executed for leaving the capital in violation of palace rules.

description.zh-cn: 清朝官员，曾任山东巡抚，奉奕䜣之命处死了安德海；后任四川总督，并于1877年参考明代方法，以铁石结构改造了都江堰的堰体和堤坝。
description.en: A Qing official. He served as Governor of Shandong, executing the eunuch An Dehai on Yixin's orders. Later, as Governor-General of Sichuan, he renovated the weirs and dams of Dujiangyan in 1877 with an iron-and-stone structure, referencing Ming dynasty methods.

description.zh-cn: 奕䜣长孙，第二代恭亲王。
description.en: Grandson of Yixin and the second Prince Gong.

description.zh-cn: 奕䜣次子，溥伟的生父。
description.en: Second son of Yixin and biological father of Puwei.

description.zh-cn: 奕䜣的嫡福晋，大学士桂良之女；也是胤祥侧福晋之一。
description.en: The primary consort of Yixin, and a daughter of the grand secretary Guiliang; also one of Yinxiang's secondary consorts.

description.zh-cn: 清朝末年重臣，奕䜣的岳父。
description.en: An important minister in the late Qing dynasty and the father-in-law of Yixin.

description.zh-cn: 由美国基督教教会开办的女子中学。
description.en: A girls' middle school founded by an American Christian church.

description.zh-cn: 杨开慧的故乡，原名板仓乡，后为纪念她于1949年后改名。
description.en: The hometown of Yang Kaihui, originally named Bancang Township, it was renamed after 1949 in her memory.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将，曾任兰州军区副政治委员、政治部主任。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the People's Liberation Army who served as Deputy Political Commissar and Director of the Political Department of the Lanzhou Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将，曾任兰州军区副政治委员。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the People's Liberation Army who served as Deputy Political Commissar of the Lanzhou Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将，曾任中国人民解放军陆军第十二集团军政治委员。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the People's Liberation Army who served as Political Commissar of the 12th Group Army of the People's Liberation Army Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军中将，曾任中国人民解放军陆军第十二集团军政治委员。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the People's Liberation Army Ground Force who served as Political Commissar of the 12th Group Army of the People's Liberation Army.

zh-cn: 陕西省人民代表大会常务委员会

description.zh-cn: 曾任法制日报社副社长、副总编辑。
description.en: Former deputy director and deputy editor-in-chief of the Legal Daily.

description.zh-cn: 王光美的父亲，曾担任中国中央政府经济专门委员。
description.en: Father of Wang Guangmei, served as an economic expert commissioner for the central government of China.

description.zh-cn: 中共辅仁大学工委领导人。
description.en: Leader of the CCP working committee at Fu Jen University.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国第一配偶

description.zh-cn: 作为国家主席刘少奇的配偶，王光美承担了第一夫人的角色。
description.en: As the spouse of President Liu Shaoqi, Wang Guangmei assumed the role of the First Lady.

description.zh-cn: 王光美在四清运动中总结出的工作方法，后在文革中成为她受批判的罪状之一。
description.en: A work methodology summarized by Wang Guangmei during the Four Cleanups Movement, which later became one of the charges against her during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 王光美的四哥，曾任第四机械工业部副部长、电子工业部总工程师。
description.en: Fourth older brother of Wang Guangmei, former Vice Minister of the Fourth Ministry of Machine Building and Chief Engineer of the Ministry of Electronics Industry.

description.zh-cn: 王光美的五哥，抗日时期中华民国空军王牌飞行员。
description.en: Fifth older brother of Wang Guangmei, an ace pilot of the Republic of China Air Force during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 张自忠的女儿。
description.en: Daughter of Zhang Zizhong.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事将领，国民革命军第二十九军军长，张自忠的上级，曾接任于右任为陕西省政府主席。
description.en: A military general of the Republic of China, commander of the 29th Army of the National Revolutionary Army, Zhang Zizhong's superior, and who succeeded Yu Youren as the Chairman of the Shaanxi Provincial Government.

description.zh-cn: 枣宜会战中的一部分，张自忠在此战斗中被日军包围并最终殉国。
description.en: Part of the Battle of Zaoyang-Yichang, where Zhang Zizhong was surrounded by Japanese forces and ultimately died.

zh-cn: 国民革命军第二十九军

description.zh-cn: 由原西北军一部改编而成的国民革命军部队，军长为宋哲元。
description.en: A National Revolutionary Army unit reorganized from a part of the former Northwestern Army, commanded by Song Zheyuan.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国的一个地方政权，管辖河北、察哈尔两省及北平、天津两市。
description.en: A local government of the Republic of China, governing Hebei and Chahar provinces, as well as the cities of Beiping and Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国天津市的最高行政职务。
description.en: The highest administrative position in Tianjin City of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国北平市的最高行政职务。
description.en: The highest administrative position in Beiping City of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 大正天皇的皇后。
description.en: The Empress consort of Emperor Taishō.

description.zh-cn: 大正天皇的次子。
description.en: The second son of Emperor Taishō.

description.zh-cn: 大正天皇的三子。
description.en: The third son of Emperor Taishō.

description.zh-cn: 大正天皇的幼子。
description.en: The fourth and youngest son of Emperor Taishō.

description.zh-cn: 大韩帝国末代皇帝。
description.en: The last emperor of the Korean Empire.

description.zh-cn: 日本首相，军阀巨头。其内阁因第一次护宪运动而下台，史称“大正政变”。
description.en: A Prime Minister of Japan and a military oligarch. His cabinet was forced to resign due to the first Movement to Protect the Constitution, an event known as the Taishō Political Crisis.

description.zh-cn: 因君主年幼、患病或出国等原因，代行君主权力的职务。
description.en: An office held by a person appointed to administer the state because the monarch is a minor, is absent, or is incapacitated.

description.zh-cn: 大日本帝国宪法下授予天皇的最高军事头衔。
description.en: The highest military rank under the Constitution of the Empire of Japan, held by the Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 大正初期，由于民众抗议和民主运动，迫使桂太郎军阀内阁下台的政治事件。
description.en: A political event in the early Taishō period where popular protest and a pro-democracy movement forced the oligarchic cabinet of Katsura Tarō to resign.

description.zh-cn: 大正天皇在位期间，日本出现的民主主义与自由主义思潮和政治运动。
description.en: A period of liberal and democratic thought and political movements in Japan during the reign of Emperor Taishō.

description.zh-cn: 1915年日本帝国向中华民国袁世凯政府提出的一系列不平等要求，旨在扩大其在华利益。
description.en: A set of unequal demands made in 1915 by the Empire of Japan to the government of the Republic of China under Yuan Shikai, aimed at expanding its interests in China.

en: Petition Movement for the Establishment of a Taiwanese Parliament
zh-cn: 台湾议会设置请愿运动

description.zh-cn: 日治时期台湾人争取政治参与权的运动。
description.en: A movement by the Taiwanese people during the Japanese colonial period to demand political participation rights.

description.zh-cn: 1923年发生在日本关东地区的大地震，对东京、横滨等地造成毁灭性的破坏。
description.en: A major earthquake in the Kantō region of Japan in 1923, which caused devastating damage to Tokyo, Yokohama, and surrounding areas.

description.zh-cn: 清朝外戚，一等公，孝诚仁皇后之父。
description.en: A maternal relative of the Qing imperial family, a Duke of the first rank, and the father of Empress Xiaochengren.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝嫡长子，孝诚仁皇后所生，允礽的同母兄。
description.en: The eldest legitimate son of the Kangxi Emperor, born to Empress Xiaochengren, and the full brother of Yunreng.

description.zh-cn: 允礽的第二子，曾被封为理郡王、理亲王。
description.en: The second son of Yunreng, who was created Prince of the Second Rank Li and later Prince of the First Rank Li.

description.zh-cn: 允礽的嫡福晋。
description.en: The primary consort of Yunreng.

description.zh-cn: 允礽的侧福晋。
description.en: A secondary consort of Yunreng.

description.zh-cn: 清朝名儒，皇太子允礽的老师。
description.en: A renowned Confucian scholar of the Qing dynasty and a tutor to Crown Prince Yunreng.

description.zh-cn: 清朝名儒，皇太子允礽的老师。
description.en: A renowned Confucian scholar of the Qing dynasty and a tutor to Crown Prince Yunreng.

description.zh-cn: 清朝大臣及理学家，曾教授皇太子允礽理学。
description.en: A minister and Neo-Confucian scholar of the Qing dynasty who taught Neo-Confucianism to Crown Prince Yunreng.

description.zh-cn: 清朝大臣及理学家，皇太子允礽的老师。
description.en: A minister and Neo-Confucian scholar of the Qing dynasty and a tutor to Crown Prince Yunreng.

description.zh-cn: 清朝官员，曾任少詹事，负责教导皇太子允礽。
description.en: A Qing dynasty official who served as Junior Supervisor of the Household and was responsible for tutoring Crown Prince Yunreng.

description.zh-cn: 允礽被废后遭幽禁并最终去世的地点。
description.en: The location where Yunreng was imprisoned after his deposition and eventually died.

description.zh-cn: 清朝皇室爵位的第一等。
description.en: The first rank of the Qing imperial nobility.

description.zh-cn: 康有为在戊戌变法失败后于加拿大成立的政治组织，旨在支持光绪帝，推行君主立宪，反对革命。
description.en: A political organization founded by Kang Youwei in Canada after the failure of the Hundred Days' Reform, aimed at supporting the Guangxu Emperor, promoting constitutional monarchy, and opposing revolution.

description.zh-cn: 英国传教士。他曾向康有为建议聘请伊藤博文为顾问，并在戊戌政变后协助康有为逃亡。
description.en: A British missionary. He suggested to Kang Youwei to hire Itō Hirobumi as an adviser and assisted Kang in his escape after the Wuxu Coup.

description.zh-cn: 清末保守派官员。他向慈禧太后密奏，警告重用伊藤博文的危险，促使慈禧太后发动政变。
description.en: A conservative official in the late Qing dynasty. He secretly reported to Empress Dowager Cixi, warning of the danger of appointing Itō Hirobumi, which contributed to Cixi launching the coup.

description.zh-cn: 共和制是一种国体，其下国家的最高执政者依据法律选出，而非君主世袭，与君主制相对。施行共和制的国家通常称作“共和国”。在民国成立后，康有为曾持续反对共和制。
description.en: Republicanism is a form of state in which the head of state is elected according to law rather than being hereditary, in contrast to a monarchy. States with this form of government are typically called 'republics'. For instance, Kang Youwei continuously opposed republicanism after the founding of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 康有为长女。
description.en: Kang Youwei's eldest daughter.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国时期的山东省行政区划。
description.en: The administrative division of Shandong Province during the Republic of China era.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国重庆市的著名中学。
description.en: A renowned secondary school located in Chongqing, China.

description.zh-cn: 中国新闻工作者，曾任光明日报总编辑，刘永清的舅舅。
description.en: Chinese journalist, former editor-in-chief of Guangming Daily, and Liu Yongqing's maternal uncle.

description.zh-cn: 刘永清的姐姐，曾任中国社会科学院副院长、党总支副书记。
description.en: Liu Yongqing's elder sister, who served as Vice President and Deputy Secretary of the Party General Branch of the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 美国前第一夫人，乔治·W·布什的妻子。
description.en: Former First Lady of the United States, wife of George W. Bush.

description.zh-cn: 一家以旅游为主业的中国公司，由中国共产主义青年团中央委员会控股。
description.en: A Chinese company primarily engaged in tourism, controlled by the Central Committee of the Communist Youth League of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任山东省省长（龚正的前任），也曾任中国证券监督管理委员会主席。
description.en: A Chinese political figure, who served as Governor of Shandong Province (Gong Zheng's predecessor) and also as Chairman of the China Securities Regulatory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾在龚正担任杭州市委书记期间任副书记兼市长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, who served as Deputy Secretary and Mayor of Hangzhou while Gong Zheng was the Party Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，龚正的继任杭州市委书记。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, Gong Zheng's successor as Party Secretary of Hangzhou.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国江苏省的地级市，也是龚正和佘孟孝的出生地。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Jiangsu Province, China, and the birthplace of Gong Zheng and She Mengxiao.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任海关总署署长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, who served as the Director of the General Administration of Customs.

description.zh-cn: 由台北市与上海市轮流举办的年度城市交流论坛。
description.en: An annual city exchange forum held alternately by Taipei and Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国设在深圳市的海关机构。
description.en: The customs authority of the People's Republic of China located in Shenzhen.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国外交家、政治人物，曾任监察院院长。他曾推荐马英九担任蒋经国的英文翻译。
description.en: A diplomat and politician of the Republic of China, he served as President of the Control Yuan. He once recommended Ma Ying-jeou to be Chiang Ching-kuo's English translator.

description.zh-cn: 时任中华民国总统马英九与中华人民共和国最高领导人习近平在新加坡举行的会面，是1949年后两岸最高领导人的首次会晤。
description.en: A meeting between then-President of the Republic of China Ma Ying-jeou and paramount leader of the People's Republic of China Xi Jinping in Singapore, marking the first meeting between the top leaders of both sides of the Taiwan Strait since 1949.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国前总统马英九与中华人民共和国最高领导人习近平在北京举行的第二次会面。
description.en: The second meeting between former President of the Republic of China Ma Ying-jeou and paramount leader of the People's Republic of China Xi Jinping, held in Beijing.

zh-cn: 台北市长马英九特别费案

description.zh-cn: 马英九在台北市长任内因特别费使用问题被起诉的案件，此事导致他辞去国民党主席职务。
description.en: A case in which Ma Ying-jeou was indicted for issues related to the use of special allowance funds during his tenure as Mayor of Taipei, which led to his resignation as Chairman of the Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 指2024年中华民国总统选举前，中国国民党与台湾民众党之间的政党协商与合作尝试，马英九参与协调。
description.en: Refers to the political negotiations and cooperation attempts between the Kuomintang and the Taiwan People's Party before the 2024 Republic of China presidential election, in which Ma Ying-jeou participated in coordination.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国卸任总统马英九首次访问中国大陆，进行祭祖和交流活动。
description.en: The first visit to mainland China by former President of the Republic of China Ma Ying-jeou for ancestral worship and exchange activities.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国卸任总统马英九第二次访问中国大陆，访问了广东、陕西和北京，并与习近平举行了第二次会面。
description.en: The second visit to mainland China by former President of the Republic of China Ma Ying-jeou, visiting Guangdong, Shaanxi, and Beijing, and holding a second meeting with Xi Jinping.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上将，曾任沈阳军区司令员、南部战区司令员。
description.en: A general of the People's Liberation Army, former commander of the Shenyang Military Region and the Southern Theater Command.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军将领，曾任陆军第十三集团军军长。
description.en: A general of the People's Liberation Army, former commander of the 13th Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将，曾任陆军第十三集团军军长。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the People's Liberation Army, former commander of the 13th Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 历史学家，根据李宗仁口述执笔撰写了《李宗仁回忆录》。
description.en: Historian who wrote "The Memoirs of Li Tsung-jen" based on Li's oral accounts.

description.zh-cn: 李宗仁的口述自传，由历史学家唐德刚执笔记录整理而成。
description.en: The oral autobiography of Li Zongren, recorded and compiled by historian T. K. Tong.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物
description.en: Chinese politician

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物
description.en: Chinese politician

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物
description.en: Chinese politician

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物
description.en: Chinese politician

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十八届中央委员会候补委员列表

description.zh-cn: 一个指代特定职位的泛称，代表在中国共产党第十八届中央委员会中担任候补委员的群体。
description.en: A generic term for a specific position, representing the group of alternate members of the 18th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 《南华早报》原主编
description.en: Former editor-in-chief of the South China Morning Post

zh-cn: 中国共产主义青年团福建省委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任黑龙江省省长、中华人民共和国国土资源部部长。后因腐败问题被查处。
description.en: Chinese politician who served as Governor of Heilongjiang and Minister of Land and Resources of the People's Republic of China. He was later investigated for corruption.

description.zh-cn: 由中国政府与欧洲联盟合作创办，位于中国上海的世界顶尖商学院。
description.en: A world-class business school co-founded by the Chinese government and the European Union, located in Shanghai, China.

description.zh-cn: 一家由清华大学控股的高科技公司。
description.en: A high-tech company controlled by Tsinghua University.

en: Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection
zh-cn: 中国共产党中央纪律检查委员会书记

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央纪律检查委员会的主要负责人。
description.en: The principal responsible person of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 梁思成的第二任妻子。
description.en: The second wife of Liang Sicheng.

en: Society for Research in Chinese Architecture

description.zh-cn: 北洋政府陆军部次长。
description.en: Deputy Minister of the Army of the Beiyang Government.

description.zh-cn: 北宋时期由李诫编著的一部关于建筑设计、构造与施工的官方典籍。
description.en: An official treatise on architectural design, structure, and construction compiled by Li Jie during the Northern Song Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 傅作义长女，中国共产党地下党员，在北平和平解放过程中起了重要作用。
description.en: Eldest daughter of Fu Zuoyi, an underground member of the Communist Party of China who played an important role in the peaceful liberation of Beiping.

description.zh-cn: 傅作义的秘书，真实身份是中国共产党安插在傅作义身边的地下党员。
description.en: Fu Zuoyi's secretary, who was actually an underground member of the Communist Party of China placed by his side.

description.zh-cn: 傅作义的堂弟，1957年被打成右派，在劳动教养期间死于三年大饥荒。
description.en: Fu Zuoyi's cousin, labeled a rightist in 1957 and died during the Great Famine while undergoing re-education through labor.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国时期以山西为根据地的军阀派系，由阎锡山于1911年创立，统治山西长达38年。其军队于1927年易帜后，曾采用特定番号，后改编为国民革命军第三集团军。该派系受日本支持，直至1949年因傅作义投共而消亡。
description.en: A warlord clique based in Shanxi during the Republic of China era, founded by Yan Xishan in 1911. It ruled Shanxi for 38 years. Its army adopted a specific designation after switching allegiance in 1927, later reorganized into the Third Group Army of the National Revolutionary Army. This clique was supported by Japan until its demise in 1949 following Fu Zuoyi's defection to the Communists.

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战期间，由国民政府在华北设立的军事指挥机构。
description.en: A military command established by the Nationalist Government in North China during the Second Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 1936年傅作义部在绥远省抵抗伪蒙军进攻的战役。
description.en: A campaign in 1936 where Fu Zuoyi's forces resisted the invasion of the puppet Mongol army in Suiyuan province.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国掌管外交事务的部门。
description.en: The ministry of the Republic of China that manages foreign affairs.

en: Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship and Alliance

description.zh-cn: 1945年，中华民国政府与苏联签署的条约，由宋子文代表中方签订。中华人民共和国成立后，毛泽东致力于废除此条约，并最终由1950年的《中苏友好同盟互助条约》所取代。
description.en: A treaty signed in 1945 between the Government of the Republic of China and the Soviet Union, with T. V. Soong signing on behalf of China. After the founding of the People's Republic of China, Mao Zedong sought to abolish this treaty, which was eventually replaced by the 1950 Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship, Alliance and Mutual Assistance.

description.zh-cn: 位于上海市的医院，是宋子文的出生地。
description.en: A hospital in Shanghai, the birthplace of T. V. Soong.

description.zh-cn: 太平公主的第一任丈夫，城阳公主之子。因受兄长薛𫖮谋反牵连，被武则天杖责饿死狱中。
description.en: Princess Taiping's first husband, son of Princess Chengyang. He was implicated in his brother Xue Yi's rebellion and was caned and starved to death in prison by order of Wu Zetian.

description.zh-cn: 太平公主的第二任丈夫，武则天的堂侄。
description.en: Princess Taiping's second husband, a paternal cousin of Wu Zetian.

description.zh-cn: 太平公主与薛绍之子。
description.en: Son of Princess Taiping and Xue Shao.

description.zh-cn: 唐代女官、诗人、皇妃。武则天时期的重要政治人物，在唐隆政变中被李隆基所杀。
description.en: A female official, poet, and imperial consort during the Tang dynasty. A key political figure during Wu Zetian's reign, she was killed by Li Longji in the Tanglong Coup.

description.zh-cn: 武则天的外甥，因行为不检，逼奸太平公主的随行宫女，后被流放并于途中处死。
description.en: Wu Zetian's nephew. Due to his misconduct, including assaulting a lady-in-waiting accompanying Princess Taiping, he was exiled and subsequently executed.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝官员，与太平公主有私交。
description.en: An official of the Tang dynasty who had an intimate relationship with Princess Taiping.

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗李世民与长孙皇后之女，唐高宗的同母妹妹，薛绍的母亲。
description.en: Daughter of Emperor Taizong and Empress Zhangsun, full sister of Emperor Gaozong, and mother of Xue Shao.

description.zh-cn: 汉文帝的皇后，汉景帝刘启之母。
description.en: Empress of Emperor Wen and mother of Emperor Jing (Liu Qi).

description.zh-cn: 西汉吴王，七国之乱的主要发起者。
description.en: King of Wu during the Western Han dynasty and the main instigator of the Rebellion of the Seven States.

description.zh-cn: 西汉吴王刘濞的太子，因与当时的皇太子刘启（后来的汉景帝）下棋发生争执而被其打死。
description.en: Crown Prince of Liu Pi, the King of Wu. He was killed by the then Crown Prince Liu Qi (later Emperor Jing) during a dispute over a board game.

description.zh-cn: 西汉时期的军事家、将领，曾任太尉、丞相。成功平定七国之乱，后遭景帝猜忌下狱绝食而死。
description.en: A military strategist and general of the Western Han dynasty, who served as Grand Marshal and Chancellor. He successfully suppressed the Rebellion of the Seven States but was later imprisoned due to Emperor Jing's suspicion and died on a hunger strike.

description.zh-cn: 西汉外戚，窦太后侄，曾参与平定七国之乱。
description.en: A relative of the imperial family by marriage in the Western Han dynasty, nephew of Empress Dowager Dou. He participated in suppressing the Rebellion of the Seven States.

description.zh-cn: 汉景帝长子，母栗姬。初为太子，后被废为临江王，最终被迫自杀。
description.en: The eldest son of Emperor Jing, his mother was Consort Li. Initially the crown prince, he was later demoted to King of Linjiang and ultimately forced to commit suicide.

description.zh-cn: 汉景帝的妃嫔，皇长子刘荣的生母。
description.en: A consort of Emperor Jing and the mother of his eldest son, Liu Rong.

description.zh-cn: 西汉楚王，与吴王刘濞一同发起七国之乱。
description.en: King of Chu during the Western Han dynasty, who, along with Liu Pi, King of Wu, initiated the Rebellion of the Seven States.

description.zh-cn: 西汉大臣，晁错的政敌，曾建议汉景帝诛杀晁错以平息七国之乱。
description.en: A minister of the Western Han dynasty and a political rival of Chao Cuo. He advised Emperor Jing to execute Chao Cuo to quell the Rebellion of the Seven States.

description.zh-cn: 东汉开国皇帝，汉景帝之子长沙定王刘发的后裔。
description.en: The founding emperor of the Eastern Han dynasty, a descendant of Liu Fa, King Ding of Changsha, who was a son of Emperor Jing.

description.zh-cn: 汉景帝之子，母唐姬，为东汉光武帝刘秀的祖先。
description.en: Son of Emperor Jing and Consort Tang, and an ancestor of Emperor Guangwu (Liu Xiu) of the Eastern Han.

description.zh-cn: 汉景帝之子，母贾夫人，为三国时期蜀汉皇帝刘备的祖先。
description.en: Son of Emperor Jing and Lady Jia, and an ancestor of Liu Bei, emperor of Shu Han during the Three Kingdoms period.

description.zh-cn: 汉景帝的妃嫔，长沙定王刘发的生母。
description.en: A consort of Emperor Jing and the mother of Liu Fa, King Ding of Changsha.

description.zh-cn: 汉景帝的妃嫔，赵敬肃王刘彭祖与中山靖王刘胜的生母。
description.en: A consort of Emperor Jing and the mother of Liu Pengzu, King Jingsu of Zhao, and Liu Sheng, King Jing of Zhongshan.

description.zh-cn: 汉景帝的第一位皇后，后被废黜。
description.en: The first empress of Emperor Jing, who was later deposed.

description.zh-cn: 林义雄的妻子，曾当选立法委员。
description.en: Wife of Lin Yi-hsiung, formerly served as a member of the Legislative Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 林义雄的长女，林宅血案的唯一幸存者。
description.en: The eldest daughter of Lin Yi-hsiung and the sole survivor of the Lin family massacre.

description.zh-cn: 发生于1980年2月28日的灭门血案，受害者为时任台湾省议员林义雄的母亲与双胞胎女儿，长女亦受重伤。当时林义雄因美丽岛事件而被羁押。
description.en: A familicide that occurred on February 28, 1980. The victims were the mother and twin daughters of then-Taiwan Provincial Assembly member Lin Yi-hsiung; his eldest daughter was also severely injured. Lin was in custody for the Kaohsiung Incident at the time.

description.zh-cn: 台湾党外运动重要人士，曾任台湾省议会议员。
description.en: An important figure in Taiwan's Tangwai movement, who served as a member of the Taiwan Provincial Assembly.

description.zh-cn: 指2000年陈水扁当选中华民国总统，实现台湾历史上首次和平的政党轮替。
description.en: Refers to the election of Chen Shui-bian as President of the Republic of China in 2000, marking the first peaceful transfer of power between political parties in Taiwan's history.

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾新北市贡寮区的核能发电厂，其兴建与否在台湾社会引发长期争议。
description.en: A nuclear power plant located in Gongliao District, New Taipei City, Taiwan, whose construction has been a subject of long-term controversy in Taiwanese society.

description.zh-cn: 陈水扁担任中华民国总统期间的行政团队。
description.en: The executive team during Chen Shui-bian's presidency of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 一项旨在将中华民国立法委员席次减半的政治改革运动。
description.en: A political reform movement aimed at halving the number of seats in the Legislative Yuan of the Republic of China.

zh-cn: 林义雄反核四禁食行动

description.zh-cn: 林义雄为呼吁政府停止兴建龙门核能发电厂而发起的无限期绝食抗议行动。
description.en: An indefinite hunger strike initiated by Lin Yi-hsiung to urge the government to halt the construction of the Lungmen Nuclear Power Plant.

description.zh-cn: 马英九担任中华民国总统期间的行政团队。
description.en: The executive team during Ma Ying-jeou's presidency of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 艾未未的母亲。
description.en: The mother of Ai Weiwei.

description.zh-cn: 艺术家，艾未未的配偶，北京发课文化发展有限公司的法人代表。
description.en: Artist, spouse of Ai Weiwei, and the legal representative of Beijing Fake Cultural Development Ltd.

description.zh-cn: 艾未未曾在美国就读的设计学院。
description.en: A design school in the United States that Ai Weiwei attended.

zh-cn: 汶川大地震死难学生调查活动

description.zh-cn: 由艾未未发起的，旨在调查2008年汶川大地震中遇难学生名单的社会活动。
description.en: A social activity initiated by Ai Weiwei to investigate the list of student victims in the 2008 Wenchuan earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 中国人权律师，曾作为艾未未方法人公司的代理律师处理“发课税案”。
description.en: A Chinese human rights lawyer who represented Ai Weiwei's legal entity company in the 'Fake Tax Case'.

description.zh-cn: 香港亲北京报纸，曾发文称艾未未“五毒俱全”。
description.en: A pro-Beijing newspaper in Hong Kong that published articles accusing Ai Weiwei of being thoroughly corrupt.

description.zh-cn: 香港立法会议员，曾指控艾未未的作品《透视研究：天安门》违反国安法、侮辱国家尊严。
description.en: A member of the Hong Kong Legislative Council who accused Ai Weiwei's work 'Study of Perspective: Tiananmen' of violating the National Security Law and insulting national dignity.

description.zh-cn: 香港西九文化区的视觉文化博物馆，因收藏并计划展出艾未未的争议性作品而引发政治风波，后决定不在开馆时展出相关作品。
description.en: A museum of visual culture in Hong Kong's West Kowloon Cultural District. Its collection and planned exhibition of Ai Weiwei's controversial works sparked political controversy, leading to the decision not to display them at the museum's opening.

description.zh-cn: 瑞士建筑事务所，与艾未未合作设计了北京国家体育场“鸟巢”。
description.en: A Swiss architectural firm that collaborated with Ai Weiwei on the design of the Beijing National Stadium, also known as the 'Bird's Nest'.

description.zh-cn: 2008年北京奥运会主场馆，艾未未作为艺术顾问参与了其设计过程。
description.en: The main stadium for the 2008 Beijing Olympics, for which Ai Weiwei served as the artistic consultant during its design.

description.zh-cn: 杨佳持刀进入上海闸北公安分局，造成6名警员死亡的事件。艾未未质疑该案司法程序不公并制作了相关纪录片。
description.en: An incident where Yang Jia entered the Zhabei Public Security Bureau in Shanghai with a knife, resulting in the deaths of six police officers. Ai Weiwei questioned the fairness of the judicial process and produced a documentary on the case.

description.zh-cn: 上海维权人士，艾未未曾声援其返回上海的行动并制作纪录片。
description.en: A Shanghai-based human rights activist whose efforts to return to Shanghai were supported by Ai Weiwei, who also made a documentary about his case.

description.zh-cn: 丹麦玩具公司，曾因拒绝向艾未未出售积木用于政治作品而引发争议，后改变其销售政策。
description.en: A Danish toy company that sparked controversy by refusing to sell bricks to Ai Weiwei for a political artwork, later reversing its sales policy.

description.zh-cn: 维基解密创始人，艾未未曾公开抗议将其引渡至美国的司法程序。
description.en: Founder of WikiLeaks. Ai Weiwei publicly protested the legal proceedings to extradite him to the United States.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝妃嫔，皇十三子胤祥、皇十三女和硕温恪公主、皇十五女和硕敦恪公主的生母。
description.en: A consort of the Kangxi Emperor, and the birth mother of the 13th prince Yinxiang, the 13th princess Heshuo Wenke, and the 15th princess Heshuo Dunke.

description.zh-cn: 胤祥第七子，第二代怡亲王。
description.en: The seventh son of Yinxiang and the second Prince Yi.

description.zh-cn: 胤祥嫡福晋，吏部尚书玛尔汉之女。
description.en: The primary consort of Yinxiang, daughter of Marhan, the Minister of Personnel.

description.zh-cn: 正白旗满洲，官至吏部尚书，胤祥岳父。
description.en: A Manchu of the Plain White Banner who served as the Minister of Personnel. He was Yinxiang's father-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 胤祥第四女，母嫡福晋兆佳氏。雍正初年被抚养于宫中，后下嫁喀尔喀博尔济锦氏多尔济塞布腾。
description.en: The fourth daughter of Yinxiang with his primary consort Lady Zhaojia. She was raised in the palace during the early Yongzheng era and later married Dorjisebten of the Khalkha Borjigin clan.

description.zh-cn: 喀尔喀博尔济锦氏，和硕和惠公主的丈夫。
description.en: Of the Khalkha Borjigin clan, husband of Princess Heshuo Hehui.

description.zh-cn: 和硕和惠公主与多尔济塞布腾之子，胤祥外孙。
description.en: Son of Princess Heshuo Hehui and Dorjisebten, grandson of Yinxiang.

description.zh-cn: 清朝世袭亲王爵位，始封者为康熙帝第十三子胤祥。
description.en: A hereditary princely peerage of the Qing dynasty. Its first holder was Yinxiang, the 13th son of the Kangxi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 清朝特有的世袭罔替的王爵。胤祥是清朝第九位铁帽子王，也是首位因功绩获此恩封的亲王。
description.en: A special hereditary princely rank in the Qing dynasty that could be passed down without demotion. Yinxiang was the 9th iron-cap prince and the first to receive this honor for his merits.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝第十三女，胤祥同胞妹。
description.en: The 13th daughter of the Kangxi Emperor and a full sister of Yinxiang.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝第十五女，胤祥同胞妹。
description.en: The 15th daughter of the Kangxi Emperor and a full sister of Yinxiang.

description.zh-cn: 胤祥第四子，封宁良郡王，母为嫡福晋兆佳氏。
description.en: The fourth son of Yinxiang, granted the title Prince Ning of the Second Rank, his mother was Primary Consort Lady Zhaojia.

description.zh-cn: 胤祥庶福晋之一。
description.en: One of Yinxiang's concubines.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年名士，孙策的谋士，为孙策规划了平定江东的战略。
description.en: A famous scholar in the late Eastern Han dynasty and an advisor to Sun Ce, who devised the strategy for conquering Jiangdong.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年武将，初为刘繇部下，后归顺孙策。
description.en: A military general in the late Eastern Han dynasty, initially served under Liu Yao before surrendering to Sun Ce.

description.zh-cn: 东吴重臣，曾受孙策临终托孤辅佐孙权。他因鲁肃不够谦逊而加以非议，不建议孙权启用。
description.en: A key minister of Eastern Wu, entrusted by Sun Ce on his deathbed to assist Sun Quan. He criticized Lu Su for not being humble enough and advised Sun Quan against appointing him.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年官员，曾任吴郡都尉、太守。因上表意图对付孙策，被孙策发现后处死。其门客后刺杀了孙策。
description.en: An official in the late Eastern Han dynasty, who served as the Commandant and Grand Administrator of Wu Commandery. He was executed by Sun Ce after Sun Ce discovered his plot against him. His retainers later assassinated Sun Ce.

description.zh-cn: 桥公长女，孙策之妻。
description.en: Elder daughter of Qiao Gong, wife of Sun Ce.

description.zh-cn: 孙策为奠定孙吴基业而在江东地区进行的一系列军事行动。
description.en: A series of military campaigns conducted by Sun Ce in the Jiangdong region to establish the foundation of Eastern Wu.

description.zh-cn: 泾县山贼总帅，曾袭击孙策，后被孙策收降。
description.en: A bandit leader from Jing County who once attacked Sun Ce but was later pacified and recruited by him.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年人物，大乔和小乔的父亲。
description.en: A figure in the late Eastern Han dynasty, father of Da Qiao and Xiao Qiao.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国台北县（今新北市）的立法机关台北县议会的成员。
description.en: Members of the Taipei County Council, the legislative body of Taipei County (now New Taipei City), Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾任台北市民政局长，现任中国国民党台北市党部主委。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician, former Director of the Taipei City Department of Civil Affairs, and current Chairperson of the Kuomintang's Taipei City chapter.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾任立法委员。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician and former member of the Legislative Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党于2021年发起的一项旨在团结党员、吸引失联党员回归的计划。
description.en: A program launched by the Kuomintang in 2021 aimed at uniting party members and encouraging the return of disconnected members.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，民主进步党籍，现任立法委员。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician, a member of the Democratic Progressive Party, and a current member of the Legislative Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾任台北市副市长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician and former Deputy Mayor of Taipei.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物、学者，曾任立法委员。曾与李庆华一同退出亲民党。
description.en: A politician and scholar of the Republic of China, and a former member of the Legislative Yuan. He left the People First Party along with Lee Ching-hua.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，民主进步党籍。现任监察院院长兼国家人权委员会主任委员，曾任高雄市市长、中华民国总统府秘书长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician of the Democratic Progressive Party, currently serving as the President of the Control Yuan and the Chairperson of the National Human Rights Commission, and formerly Mayor of Kaohsiung and Secretary-General to the President of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物、摇滚歌手，曾任立法委员。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician and rock singer, and a former member of the Legislative Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 针对时任立法委员林昶佐的罢免投票案，最终因投票率未达门槛而宣告失败。
description.en: A recall election held against then-Legislator Freddy Lim, which ultimately failed to pass due to insufficient voter turnout.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，民主进步党籍。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician and a member of the Democratic Progressive Party.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治人物，第41任美国总统，乔治·沃克·布什的父亲。
description.en: American politician, 41st President of the United States, and father of George W. Bush.

description.zh-cn: 中国历史学家，南京大学历史学系教授，曾担任杨洁篪的博士导师。
description.en: Chinese historian, professor at the Department of History of Nanjing University, and was Yang Jiechi's doctoral supervisor.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国外交部部长

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国外交部的负责人职位。
description.en: The head position of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

en: List of ambassadors of China to the United States

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国派驻美利坚合众国的最高级别外交使节。
description.en: The highest-ranking diplomatic representative of the People's Republic of China to the United States of America.

zh-cn: 上海外国语大学附属外国语学校

description.zh-cn: 清末民初政治家，袁世凯的亲信，中国现代警察制度的创始人。曾任中华民国国务总理，被认为是宋教仁遇刺案的直接布置者，并因此嫌疑辞职。
description.en: A politician in the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China, a confidant of Yuan Shikai, and the founder of China's modern police system. He served as Premier of the Republic of China, was considered the direct organizer of Song Jiaoren's assassination, and resigned due to suspicion in the case.

description.zh-cn: 赵秉钧的秘书，通过电报“毁宋酬勋”直接安排了刺杀行动。
description.en: Secretary to Zhao Bingjun, who directly arranged the assassination through the telegram 'destroy Song for a reward'.

description.zh-cn: 中华国民共进会会长，负责雇佣凶手武士英执行对宋教仁的暗杀。
description.en: President of the China National Progressive Association, responsible for hiring the assassin Wu Shiying to carry out the assassination of Song Jiaoren.

description.zh-cn: 刺杀宋教仁的直接凶手。
description.en: The direct assassin of Song Jiaoren.

description.zh-cn: 同盟会女会员及女权运动领袖，因国民党党纲中无“男女平权”而与宋教仁发生冲突。
description.en: A female member of the Tongmenghui and a leader of the women's rights movement, who clashed with Song Jiaoren over the absence of 'gender equality' in the Kuomintang's platform.

description.zh-cn: 由黄兴、宋教仁等人在长沙成立的革命团体，后并入中国同盟会。
description.en: A revolutionary group founded in Changsha by Huang Xing, Song Jiaoren, and others, which later merged into the Tongmenghui.

description.zh-cn: 一种政治制度，主张内阁由国会多数党领袖组成并对国会负责。宋教仁是其在民国初期的主要倡导者。
description.en: A political system where the cabinet is formed by the leader of the majority party in parliament and is responsible to the parliament. Song Jiaoren was its main advocate in the early Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国第一届内阁，由唐绍仪组阁。宋教仁在其中担任农林总长，赵秉钧担任内务总长。
description.en: The first cabinet of the Republic of China, formed by Tang Shaoyi. Song Jiaoren served as the Minister of Agriculture and Forestry, and Zhao Bingjun served as Minister of the Interior.

description.zh-cn: 位于武昌的由美国圣公会创办的学校，宋教仁曾在此就读。
description.en: A school in Wuchang founded by the American Episcopal Church, where Song Jiaoren studied.

description.zh-cn: 宋教仁遇刺的地点。
description.en: The location where Song Jiaoren was assassinated.

description.zh-cn: 华兴会共同创始人之一。
description.en: One of the co-founders of the Huaxinghui.

description.zh-cn: 华兴会共同创始人之一，革命宣传家。
description.en: One of the co-founders of the Huaxinghui and a revolutionary propagandist.

description.zh-cn: 清末新军第六镇统制，革命党人，后被袁世凯派人刺杀。
description.en: Commander of the 6th Division of the New Army in the late Qing Dynasty, a revolutionary, who was later assassinated by order of Yuan Shikai.

description.zh-cn: 民主革命家，公开斥责袁世凯刺杀宋教仁后，被毒杀于宴席上。
description.en: A democratic revolutionary who was poisoned at a banquet after publicly denouncing Yuan Shikai for assassinating Song Jiaoren.

description.zh-cn: 北洋政府时期的军事执法机构，其侦探刺杀了应桂馨。
description.en: A military law enforcement agency during the Beiyang Government period, whose detectives assassinated Ying Guixin.

description.zh-cn: 香港的一所女子中学。
description.en: A girls' secondary school in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 一份在香港出版的中文报纸。
description.en: A Chinese newspaper published in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 香港的图书出版公司。
description.en: A book publishing company in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 由蔡边村自编自导的纪录片，记录了他寻找20多年未见的生母亦舒的经历。
description.en: A documentary written and directed by Tsai Bian-cun, documenting his search for his birth mother, Yi Shu, whom he had not seen for over 20 years.

zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议湖南省委员会
en: Hunan Provincial Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference

description.zh-cn: 在孟加拉管辖区扩大鸦片种植，并通过私人商人向中国走私鸦片，是鸦片贸易的主要推动者之一。
description.en: Expanded opium cultivation in the Bengal Presidency and smuggled it into China via private merchants, being one of the main drivers of the opium trade.

description.zh-cn: 第二次鸦片战争期间，1858年清政府与英、法、美、俄等国在天津签订了一系列不平等条约。这些条约内容包括增开通商口岸、鸦片贸易合法化及战争赔款。其中《天津条约》的换约问题，成为战争扩大的直接原因。
description.en: During the Second Opium War, a series of unequal treaties were signed by the Qing government, notably in Tianjin in 1858 with countries including Britain, France, the US, and Russia. Their terms included opening more treaty ports, legalizing the opium trade, and paying war indemnities. The issue of the ratification of the Treaty of Tianjin specifically became a direct cause for the escalation of the war.

description.zh-cn: 位于香港的半岛。根据《北京条约》，界限街以南的部分被割让给英国。
description.en: A peninsula in Hong Kong. The portion south of Boundary Street was ceded to the United Kingdom under the Convention of Peking.

description.zh-cn: 根据《北京条约》等条约割让给俄国的地区。
description.en: A region ceded to Russia under treaties including the Convention of Peking.

description.zh-cn: 指在19世纪至20世纪初，中国（以及日本、朝鲜等）与西方列强签订的一系列权利不对等的条约。鸦片战争后签订的《南京条约》、《天津条约》和《北京条约》均属此类。
description.en: Refers to a series of treaties signed in the 19th and early 20th centuries between China (as well as Japan, Korea, etc.) and Western powers, in which rights were not reciprocal. The treaties of Nanking, Tientsin, and Peking after the Opium Wars are examples.

description.zh-cn: 一个历史名词，指中国从第一次鸦片战争到中华人民共和国成立期间，遭受西方列强、俄国和日本侵略、干涉、瓜分的历史时期。鸦片战争及其后签订的不平等条约被视为这一时期的开端。
description.en: A historical term referring to the period of intervention and subjugation of the Chinese nation by Western powers, Russia and Japan from the First Opium War to the establishment of the People's Republic of China. The Opium Wars and the subsequent unequal treaties are considered the beginning of this period.

description.zh-cn: 清朝官员，时任两广总督。其处理“亚罗号事件”的方式成为第二次鸦片战争的导火索。在战争初期，因对英法态度强硬，广州城破后被俘，最终绝食死于印度加尔各答。
description.en: A Qing official serving as the Viceroy of Liangguang. His handling of the Arrow Incident became the trigger for the Second Opium War. Due to his hardline stance against Britain and France in the early stages of the war, he was captured after the fall of Guangzhou and died on a hunger strike in Calcutta, India.

description.zh-cn: 1856年10月8日，广东水师登上在香港注册的亚罗号船搜捕海盗，成为英国发动战争的导火索。
description.en: On October 8, 1856, the Guangdong navy boarded the Hong Kong-registered ship Arrow to search for pirates, which became the casus belli for Britain to start the war.

description.zh-cn: 1856年2月，法国籍神父马赖因违禁深入中国内地传教，被广西西林代理知县张鸣凤所捕杀，成为法国发动战争的导火索。
description.en: In February 1856, French priest Auguste Chapdelaine was arrested and executed by the acting magistrate of Xilin, Guangxi, for illegally entering inland China to preach, becoming the casus belli for France to join the war.

description.zh-cn: 清朝末年蒙古族将领，在第二次鸦片战争中负责京津地区的防务，指挥了大沽口和八里桥等重要战役。
description.en: A Mongol general of the late Qing dynasty who was responsible for the defense of the Beijing-Tianjin area during the Second Opium War, commanding key battles such as Taku Forts and Baliqiao.

zh-cn: 第八代额尔金伯爵詹姆斯·布鲁斯
詹姆斯·布鲁斯，第八代额尔金伯爵

description.zh-cn: 英国全权专使，第二次鸦片战争期间的英方主要代表。为报复清军虐待俘虏，下令焚毁圆明园。
description.en: British High Commissioner and Plenipotentiary, the main British representative during the Second Opium War. He ordered the burning of the Old Summer Palace in retaliation for the torture and death of captives by Qing forces.

description.zh-cn: 法国特命全权专使，第二次鸦片战争期间的法方主要代表。
description.en: French special envoy and plenipotentiary, the main French representative during the Second Opium War.

description.zh-cn: 英国外交官，时任英国驻广州领事，处理亚罗号事件。在通州谈判期间被僧格林沁俘虏并遭受虐待。
description.en: A British diplomat, then British consul in Guangzhou, who handled the Arrow Incident. He was captured and tortured by Sengge Rinchen's forces during the Tongzhou negotiations.

description.zh-cn: 1860年10月，英法联军在北京郊区对圆明园进行抢劫后，英国专使额尔金下令将其焚毁，以报复清军虐待战俘的行为。
description.en: In October 1860, after looting the Old Summer Palace in the suburbs of Beijing, British High Commissioner Lord Elgin ordered it to be burned down as retaliation for the torture of prisoners of war by Qing forces.

description.zh-cn: 1860年9月21日英法联军与清军主力在北京通州八里桥进行的决战。清军惨败，京师门户洞开。
description.en: The decisive battle between the Anglo-French forces and the main Qing army at Baliqiao, Tongzhou, Beijing, on September 21, 1860. The Qing army was disastrously defeated, leaving the capital exposed.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯帝国东西伯利亚总督穆拉维约夫以武力胁迫清朝黑龙江将军奕山签订的不平等条约，割让黑龙江以北、外兴安岭以南约60万平方公里领土给俄国。
description.en: An unequal treaty signed under military duress by Nikolay Muravyov, Governor-General of Eastern Siberia, and Yishan, the Qing General of Heilongjiang, ceding about 600,000 square kilometers of territory north of the Amur River and south of the Stanovoy Range to Russia.

zh-cn: 动员戡乱时期临时条款
en: Temporary Provisions against the Communist Rebellion

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政府为应对国共内战而制定的宪法附加条款，赋予总统紧急权力。
description.en: Additional constitutional articles enacted by the ROC government in response to the Chinese Civil War, granting emergency powers to the president.

description.zh-cn: 第一次国共内战期间，国民政府对中共在南方的根据地发动的五次大规模军事围剿。
description.en: Five large-scale military encirclement campaigns launched by the Nationalist Government against the CCP's southern base areas during the First Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 指2024年台湾第十一届立法院中，由在野的中国国民党与台湾民众党联合提出的国会职权修法所引发的一系列政治争议。
description.en: Refers to a series of political controversies in Taiwan in 2024 surrounding amendments to the powers of the Legislative Yuan, jointly proposed by the opposition parties Kuomintang (KMT) and Taiwan People's Party (TPP) in the 11th Legislative Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 台湾企业家，联华电子创办人。他成立了“反共护台志工联盟”，是推动罢免泛蓝阵营公职人员的主要人物之一。
description.en: Taiwanese entrepreneur and founder of UMC. He established the 'Anti-Communist and Defend Taiwan Volunteer Alliance' and was a key figure in promoting the recall of Pan-Blue camp public officials.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，原为台湾民众党籍，后退党。曾任新竹市市长，因贪污案一审有罪而被停职，并在大罢免运动中成为罢免对象。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician, formerly a member of the Taiwan People's Party before withdrawing. She served as the mayor of Hsinchu City, was suspended from office after being convicted of corruption in the first instance, and became a target of recall during the Great Recall movement.

description.zh-cn: 民主进步党籍南投县议员，为大罢免运动中少数被推进入投票阶段的泛绿阵营公职人员。
description.en: A DPP member of the Nantou County Council, she was one of the few Pan-Green camp public officials whose recall case proceeded to the voting stage during the Great Recall movement.

description.zh-cn: 指赖清德担任中华民国总统期间的行政团队。大罢免的失败被视为对其执政的不信任投票。
description.en: Refers to the executive team during Lai Ching-te's presidency of the Republic of China. The failure of the Great Recall was seen as a vote of no confidence in his administration.

description.zh-cn: 指萨摩、长州、土佐、肥前四个在倒幕运动和明治维新中起主导作用的强藩。
description.en: Refers to the four powerful domains of Satsuma, Chōshū, Tosa, and Hizen, which played a leading role in the anti-shogunate movement and the Meiji Restoration.

description.zh-cn: 日本幕末至明治初期的萨摩藩武士、政治家，与木户孝允、大久保利通并称为“维新三杰”。他曾是明治新政府的核心人物，后因征韩论争议下野，并因不满改革而领导西南战争。
description.en: A samurai and statesman from the Satsuma Domain during the late Edo and early Meiji periods. He was one of the 'Three Great Nobles of the Restoration', alongside Kido Takayoshi and Ōkubo Toshimichi, and a central figure in the early Meiji government. He resigned due to the Seikanron debate and later, out of dissatisfaction with the reforms, led the Satsuma Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 日本最后一场、也是规模最大的一场内战，由前参议西乡隆盛领导的萨摩藩士族对抗明治政府。战争期间，木户孝允病危，并在忧虑中去世。
description.en: The last and largest civil war in Japan, and the last and most serious of the shizoku rebellions, fought by disenfranchised samurai of the Satsuma Domain led by former Sangi Saigō Takamori against the Meiji government. During the war, Kido Takayoshi fell critically ill and died while worrying about the conflict.

description.zh-cn: 明治政府用县取代旧有的藩，是中央集权化的关键一步。
description.en: The Meiji government's policy of replacing the feudal domains (han) with prefectures, a key step in centralization.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉发表于《时事新报》的著名社论，主张日本应脱离亚洲邻国，与西方文明国家共进退。这一思想对明治政府的外交政策产生了深远影响。
description.en: A famous editorial by Fukuzawa Yukichi, published in 'Jiji Shinpō', advocated that Japan should break from its Asian neighbors and align with Western civilized nations. This idea had a profound impact on the Meiji government's foreign policy.

birth_place.zh-cn: 日本摄津国大坂堂岛新地五丁目中津藩藏屋敷
birth_place.en: Nakatsu Domain Kurayashiki, Dōjima-shinchi 5-chome, Ōsaka, Settsu Province, Japan

death_place.zh-cn: 日本东京府东京市芝区三田二丁目
death_place.en: 2-chōme, Mita, Shiba-ku, Tokyo City, Tokyo Prefecture, Japan

description.zh-cn: 日本明治时期重要的启蒙思想家、教育家，庆应义塾大学创立者，对明治维新运动影响深远。他提出了著名的《脱亚论》，并被誉为“日本近代教育之父”。
description.en: A prominent Japanese enlightenment thinker and educator of the Meiji era, as well as an author, writer, teacher, translator, entrepreneur, and journalist. He founded Keio University, was an early advocate for reform in Japan, and proposed the famous 'Datsu-A Ron' (Leaving Asia). He is regarded as one of the founders of modern Japan and is often called 'the father of modern Japanese education'.

description.zh-cn: 日本幕末的政治家与军事家，曾担任咸临丸的指挥官，并在江户无血开城中扮演了关键角色。
description.en: A Japanese statesman and naval engineer during the late Edo period. He served as the commander of the Kanrin Maru and played a key role in the bloodless surrender of Edo.

description.zh-cn: 日本明治政府于1871年至1873年间派遣至欧美各国的大型外交使团，旨在修改不平等条约、考察西方制度与技术，并为日本的现代化建设提供蓝图。大久保利通是其主要成员之一，木户孝允则担任使节团的全权副使。其归国成员尤其反对立即征韩。
description.en: A large Japanese diplomatic mission sent by the Meiji government to the United States and Europe between 1871 and 1873, aimed at renegotiating unequal treaties, studying Western institutions and technology, and providing a blueprint for Japan's modernization. Ōkubo Toshimichi was one of its key members, while Kido Takayoshi served as one of the Vice-Ambassadors. Its returning members notably opposed an immediate invasion of Korea.

zh-cn: 苏联共产党第二十次代表大会
en: 20th Congress of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union

description.zh-cn: 苏联共产党的一次重要代表大会，赫鲁晓夫在此次会议上发表了批判斯大林的“秘密报告”。
description.en: A significant congress of the CPSU where Khrushchev delivered his "Secret Speech" criticizing Stalin.

description.zh-cn: 赫鲁晓夫提出的苏联外交政策，主张与资本主义国家“和平共处、和平竞赛、和平过渡”。
description.en: A Soviet foreign policy proposed by Khrushchev, advocating for "peaceful coexistence, peaceful competition, and peaceful transition" with capitalist countries.

zh-cn: 苏联共产党第二十二次代表大会
en: 22nd Congress of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union

description.zh-cn: 苏联共产党的一次代表大会，会上苏共公开批判阿尔巴尼亚劳动党，并决定将斯大林遗体移出列宁墓。
description.en: A congress of the CPSU where the party openly criticized the Party of Labour of Albania and decided to remove Stalin's body from Lenin's Mausoleum.

description.zh-cn: 中苏交恶期间，中华人民共和国与苏联在两国边境发生了一系列军事对峙和武装冲突。其中，1969年的武装冲突尤为突出，加剧了中国面临的安全威胁，并促使其调整外交战略。
description.en: During the Sino-Soviet split, a series of military standoffs and armed clashes occurred between the People's Republic of China and the Soviet Union along their shared border. Notably, the armed clashes in 1969 intensified the security threat faced by China, prompting it to adjust its foreign policy strategy.

description.zh-cn: 1969年3月发生于乌苏里江珍宝岛的中苏大规模武装冲突，是中苏边界冲突中最著名的事件。
description.en: A large-scale armed conflict between China and the Soviet Union on Zhenbao Island in the Ussuri River in March 1969, the most famous incident in the Sino-Soviet border conflict.

description.zh-cn: 1971年7月，时任美国国家安全顾问基辛格秘密访问中国，为尼克松访华铺平了道路。
description.en: In July 1971, then-U.S. National Security Advisor Henry Kissinger secretly visited China, paving the way for Nixon's visit.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东于1970年代提出的外交战略构想，主张联合美国、日本、西欧等国家，形成一条线，共同对付苏联的扩张。
description.en: A foreign policy strategy conceived by Mao Zedong in the 1970s, advocating for a united front including the United States, Japan, and Western Europe to form a line against Soviet expansionism.

description.zh-cn: 中国第一个核武器研制计划的代号。
description.en: The codename for China's first nuclear weapons development program.

description.zh-cn: 与赫鲁晓夫相关的去斯大林化政策以及和平共处理论。
description.en: The policies of de-Stalinization and the theory of peaceful coexistence associated with Khrushchev.

description.zh-cn: 1969年8月13日中苏在新疆铁列克提地区发生的边境武装冲突。
description.en: A border armed conflict between China and the Soviet Union in the Tieleketi region of Xinjiang on August 13, 1969.

description.zh-cn: 1989年5月，时任苏共中央总书记戈尔ба乔夫访问中国，标志着中苏关系正常化。
description.en: In May 1989, then-General Secretary of the CPSU Gorbachev visited China, marking the normalization of Sino-Soviet relations.

description.zh-cn: 中国作家、记者，时任中国作家协会副主席。他因其支持民主改革的言论对学生产生影响，并在“反对资产阶级自由化”运动中被开除党籍。
description.en: A Chinese writer and journalist, then-Vice Chairman of the Chinese Writers Association. He influenced students with his pro-democratic reform views and was expelled from the party during the 'Anti-Bourgeois Liberalization Campaign'.

description.zh-cn: 对公职人员的任职期限进行限制的制度。
description.en: A system that limits the term of office for public officials.

description.zh-cn: 关于公职人员达到一定年龄或服务年限后退出工作岗位的制度安排。
description.en: Institutional arrangements for public officials to withdraw from their work positions after reaching a certain age or length of service.

description.zh-cn: 始于1980年代中国的旨在改革政治结构和制度的运动。
description.en: A movement that began in the 1980s in China aimed at reforming the political structure and system.

description.zh-cn: 结束日俄战争的和平条约，在美国总统西奥多·罗斯福的斡旋下签订。
description.en: The peace treaty that formally ended the Russo-Japanese War, signed under the mediation of U.S. President Theodore Roosevelt.

description.zh-cn: 美国第26任总统。他曾在日俄战争末期斡旋双方签订《朴茨茅斯条约》。在1912年总统选举中作为进步党候选人参选，导致共和党选票分裂。他强烈批评威尔逊的战时政策。
description.en: The 26th President of the United States. He mediated the signing of the Treaty of Portsmouth at the end of the Russo-Japanese War. He ran as a Progressive Party candidate in the 1912 presidential election, splitting the Republican vote. He was a strong critic of Wilson's wartime policies.

description.zh-cn: 日俄战争的失败直接引发了俄国国内的政治动荡和革命。
description.en: The defeat in the Russo-Japanese War was a direct catalyst for political unrest and revolution within Russia.

description.zh-cn: 日俄战争期间俄罗斯帝国的沙皇。
description.en: The Tsar of the Russian Empire during the Russo-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 日俄战争中的决定性海战，日本联合舰队在此役中几乎全歼俄国第二太平洋舰队。
description.en: The decisive naval battle of the Russo-Japanese War, in which the Japanese Combined Fleet almost completely annihilated the Russian Second Pacific Squadron.

description.zh-cn: 日本在日俄战争胜利后与大韩帝国签订的条约，使韩国成为日本的保护国。
description.en: A treaty signed between Japan and the Korean Empire after Japan's victory in the Russo-Japanese War, making Korea a protectorate of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 作为俄罗斯的盟友，在日俄战争爆发时向日本宣战。
description.en: As an ally of Russia, it declared war on Japan at the outbreak of the Russo-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 日本与英国于1902年结成的军事同盟，为日本挑战俄国提供了外交支持。
description.en: A military alliance formed between Japan and Great Britain in 1902, which provided diplomatic support for Japan to challenge Russia.

description.zh-cn: 日俄战争中规模最大的一场陆战，日军占领奉天，俄军战败撤退。
description.en: The largest land battle of the Russo-Japanese War, resulting in the Japanese capture of Mukden and the retreat of Russian forces.

zh-cn: 2022年贵州省三都县客车侧翻事故

description.zh-cn: 2022年9月18日，一辆载有隔离转运人员的客车在中国贵州省发生侧翻，造成27人死亡的重大事故。
description.en: On September 18, 2022, a bus carrying individuals for quarantine transfer overturned in Guizhou Province, China, causing a major accident with 27 fatalities.

description.zh-cn: 一种应对2019冠状病毒病疫情的公共卫生策略，旨在将病毒视为地方性流行病，并逐步恢复社会正常活动，而不是试图完全消灭病毒。
description.en: A public health strategy for managing the COVID-19 pandemic that aims to treat the virus as an endemic disease and gradually resume normal societal activities rather than attempting to completely eliminate the virus.

description.zh-cn: 中国外交官，曾任中华人民共和国外交部发言人。
description.en: Chinese diplomat who served as a spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 由中共中央派出，对地方和中央单位进行巡视监督的临时性机构。
description.en: Temporary bodies dispatched by the CCP Central Committee to conduct inspection and supervision of local and central units.

description.zh-cn: 义和团运动后，清政府与十一国签订的不平等条约，内容包括巨额赔款（庚子赔款）、允许外国驻军等。
description.en: An unequal treaty signed between the Qing government and eleven nations after the Boxer Rebellion, which included massive indemnities (the Boxer Indemnity) and the stationing of foreign troops.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，端郡王。因其子溥儁被立为大阿哥（己亥建储）遭外国公使反对而极度仇外，是操纵义和团运动的清廷主战派首脑之一。
