description.en: Grandson of Emperor Yang of Sui. After the fall of the Sui dynasty, he was installed as the King of Sui by the Eastern Turks.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国受政府委托处理海峡两岸事务的半官方机构。
description.en: A semi-official organization in the Republic of China (Taiwan) authorized by the government to handle cross-strait affairs.

zh-cn: 光复大陆设计研究委员会

description.zh-cn: 中华民国一个已裁撤的政府机构，其业务后移交给大陆委员会等单位。
description.en: A defunct government agency of the Republic of China whose duties were later transferred to the Mainland Affairs Council and other units.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国一个已裁撤的政府机构，其部分业务后由大陆委员会承接。
description.en: A defunct government agency of the Republic of China, some of whose duties were later taken over by the Mainland Affairs Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，现任大陆委员会主任委员。
description.en: A politician in the Republic of China (Taiwan), currently serving as the Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，现任大陆委员会政务副主任委员。
description.en: A politician in the Republic of China (Taiwan), currently serving as a Deputy Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任行政院大陆委员会主任委员。
description.en: A politician in the Republic of China (Taiwan), former Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾代理行政院大陆委员会主任委员。
description.en: A politician in the Republic of China (Taiwan), former acting Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任行政院大陆委员会主任委员。
description.en: A politician in the Republic of China (Taiwan), former Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任行政院大陆委员会主任委员。
description.en: A politician in the Republic of China (Taiwan), former Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任行政院大陆委员会主任委员，其职位后由陈明通接任。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician, who served as Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council. He was succeeded by Chen Ming-tong.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任行政院大陆委员会主任委员。
description.en: A politician in the Republic of China (Taiwan), former Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任行政院大陆委员会主任委员。
description.en: A politician in the Republic of China (Taiwan), former Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物、外交官，曾任大陆委员会主任委员，其职位后由陈明通接任。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician and diplomat who served as Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council. She was succeeded by Chen Ming-tong.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾接任陈明通担任大陆委员会主任委员。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who formerly served as Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council, succeeding Chen Ming-tong.

description.zh-cn: 一种菊科蒿属植物，是提取青蒿素的天然来源。
description.en: A plant species in the family Asteraceae, the natural source from which artemisinin is extracted.

description.zh-cn: 一种由疟原虫引起的威胁生命的寄生虫病，通过受感染的蚊子叮咬传播给人类。
description.en: A life-threatening parasitic disease caused by Plasmodium parasites, transmitted to humans through the bites of infected mosquitoes.

zh-cn: 拉斯克临床医学研究奖

description.zh-cn: 一项著名的美国生物医学奖项，被誉为“美国的诺贝尔奖”。
description.en: A prestigious American award for biomedical research, often called 'America's Nobel'.

zh-cn: 诺贝尔生理学或医学奖
en: Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine

description.zh-cn: 诺贝尔奖之一，旨在表彰在生理学或医学领域作出最重要发现的个人。
description.en: One of the Nobel Prizes, awarded for outstanding discoveries in the fields of physiology or medicine.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国。在毛泽东和周恩来指示下，启动了523项目以研发抗疟新药。
description.en: The People's Republic of China. Under the direction of Mao Zedong and Zhou Enlai, it initiated Project 523 to develop new antimalarial drugs.

zh-cn: 中国科学院上海有机化学研究所
en: Shanghai Institute of Organic Chemistry, Chinese Academy of Sciences

description.zh-cn: 523项目的主要协作单位，在确定青蒿素的化学结构方面发挥了关键作用，其研究员周维善也完成了青蒿素的全合成。
description.en: A key collaborating unit of Project 523 that played a crucial role in determining the chemical structure of artemisinin. Its researcher, Zhou Weishan, also completed the total synthesis of artemisinin.

zh-cn: 中国科学院生物物理研究所
en: Institute of Biophysics, Chinese Academy of Sciences

description.zh-cn: 523项目的主要协作单位，通过单晶X射线衍射技术最终确定了青蒿素的相对构型和绝对构型。
description.en: A key collaborating unit of Project 523 that ultimately determined the relative and absolute configuration of artemisinin using single-crystal X-ray diffraction.

description.zh-cn: 中国科学院上海有机化学研究所的研究员，完成了青蒿素的全合成。
description.en: A researcher at the Shanghai Institute of Organic Chemistry, who completed the total synthesis of artemisinin.

description.zh-cn: 瑞士跨国医疗保健公司。其研究员于1982年首次完成了青蒿素的全合成。
description.en: A Swiss multinational healthcare company. Its researchers completed the first total synthesis of artemisinin in 1982.

description.zh-cn: 时任韩国国防部长，被指建议尹锡悦实施戒严，并在事后辞职。
description.en: Then-South Korean Minister of National Defense, who allegedly advised President Yoon Suk Yeol to implement martial law and subsequently resigned.

description.zh-cn: 时任韩国陆军参谋总长，在2024年戒严期间被任命为戒严司令官。
description.en: Then-Chief of Staff of the Republic of Korea Army, appointed as the Martial Law Commander during the 2024 martial law.

description.zh-cn: 由2024年韩国戒严引发的一系列政治动荡，包括大规模抗议、总统弹劾及逮捕等事件。
description.en: A series of political upheavals triggered by the 2024 South Korean martial law, including mass protests, the impeachment and arrest of the president.

description.zh-cn: 时任韩国执政党国民力量党代表，公开反对总统尹锡悦宣布的戒严令。他本人也在尹锡悦的计划逮捕名单上。
description.en: Then-leader of the ruling People Power Party, who publicly opposed the martial law declared by President Yoon Suk Yeol and was also on Yoon's planned arrest list.

description.zh-cn: 指国家元首利用职权推翻现有政权或民主制度的政变形式。2024年韩国戒严被广泛认为是尹锡悦发动的一场未遂的自我政变。
description.en: A form of coup in which a nation's head of state uses their power to overthrow the existing government or democratic system. The 2024 South Korean martial law is widely considered an attempted self-coup by Yoon Suk Yeol.

description.zh-cn: 韩国国会的所在地，是2024年戒严事件中军民对峙的核心地点。
description.en: The seat of the National Assembly of South Korea and the central location of the confrontation between the military and civilians during the 2024 martial law event.

description.zh-cn: 韩国陆军特战司令部下属的精锐反恐特种部队，在2024年戒严期间被派往国会议事堂执行任务。
description.en: An elite counter-terrorism special forces unit of the ROK Army Special Warfare Command, deployed to the National Assembly Building during the 2024 martial law.

description.zh-cn: 因发动2024年韩国戒严，韩国国会对总统尹锡悦提出的弹劾案，并于12月14日通过。
description.en: The impeachment motion against President Yoon Suk Yeol initiated by the South Korean National Assembly for declaring the 2024 martial law, which was passed on December 14.

zh-cn: 高级公职人员犯罪调查处
en: Corruption Investigation Office for High-ranking Officials

description.zh-cn: 韩国独立的腐败调查机构，于2025年1月15日正式逮捕了前总统尹锡悦。
description.en: An independent anti-corruption investigation agency in South Korea, which officially arrested former President Yoon Suk Yeol on January 15, 2025.

description.zh-cn: 韩国的主要情报机构。据其第一次长洪壮源作证，该机构拒绝执行尹锡悦在戒严期间下达的逮捕政治人物的命令。
description.en: The main intelligence agency of South Korea. According to testimony from its First Deputy Director Hong Jang-won, the agency refused to carry out President Yoon Suk Yeol's order to arrest political figures during the martial law.

description.zh-cn: 时任韩国国家情报院长，曾在2024年3月反对尹锡悦的戒严计划，并在戒严当晚搁置了尹锡悦撤换其副手的命令。
description.en: Then-Director of the National Intelligence Service of South Korea. He opposed Yoon Suk Yeol's martial law plan in March 2024 and shelved Yoon's order to dismiss his deputy on the night of the martial law declaration.

description.zh-cn: 韩国政治人物，曾任国防部长，在2024年3月明确反对尹锡悦提出的戒严计划。
description.en: A South Korean politician and former Minister of National Defense who explicitly opposed Yoon Suk Yeol's proposed martial law plan in March 2024.

zh-cn: 2024年10月北韩指控南韩无人机侵入领空事件

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜指控韩国无人机侵入平壤领空并投放传单一事。该事件后被指是时任国防部长金龙显为激化南北紧张局势、为宣布戒严制造借口而策划的。
description.en: An incident where North Korea accused South Korean drones of intruding into Pyongyang's airspace to drop leaflets. It was later alleged to have been orchestrated by then-Defense Minister Kim Yong-hyun to escalate inter-Korean tensions and create a pretext for declaring martial law.

description.zh-cn: 由全斗焕发动的军事政变，建立了第五共和国军事独裁。这是2024年戒严之前韩国最后一次宣布全国戒严。
description.en: A military coup led by Chun Doo-hwan, which established the military dictatorship of the Fifth Republic. It was the last time a nationwide martial law was declared in South Korea before the 2024 event.

description.zh-cn: 韩国负责管理选举的独立国家机构。在2024年戒严宣布后的数分钟内，其总部即被戒严部队占领。
description.en: The independent national agency of South Korea responsible for managing elections. Its headquarters were occupied by martial law troops within minutes of the 2024 declaration.

description.zh-cn: 中国田径教练，曾聘请谷开来担任其代理律师。
description.en: A Chinese athletics coach who once hired Gu Kailai as his legal representative.

description.zh-cn: 《马家军调查》一书的作者，曾被谷开来代表马俊仁起诉。
description.en: The author of the book 'An Investigation into Ma's Army', who was sued by Gu Kailai on behalf of Ma Junren.

zh-cn: 安徽省合肥市中级人民法院

description.zh-cn: 审理谷开来故意杀人案的法院。
description.en: The court that tried the Gu Kailai intentional homicide case.

description.zh-cn: 关押谷开来的监狱。
description.en: The prison where Gu Kailai is incarcerated.

description.zh-cn: 中国山西省下辖的一个县，是谷开来的出生地。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Shanxi Province, China, and the birthplace of Gu Kailai.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽民与王淑兰之女。
description.en: Daughter of Mao Zemin and Wang Shulan.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党党员，与毛泽民一同在新疆被杀害。
description.en: A member of the Communist Party of China who was killed in Xinjiang along with Mao Zemin.

description.zh-cn: 中共党员，在新疆被捕后叛变。
description.en: A CCP member who defected after being arrested in Xinjiang.

description.zh-cn: 由毛泽东创办的学校，毛泽民曾在此学习。
description.en: A school founded by Mao Zedong where Mao Zemin once studied.

zh-cn: 中华苏维埃共和国国家银行
en: National Bank of the Chinese Soviet Republic

description.zh-cn: 中华苏维埃共和国的中央银行，由毛泽民负责筹建并担任首任行长。
description.en: The central bank of the Chinese Soviet Republic, established under the responsibility of Mao Zemin who served as its first governor.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国时期新疆省的行政管理机构。
description.en: The administrative body of Xinjiang Province during the Republic of China era.

zh-cn: 中国国民党中央执行委员会调查统计局
en: Central Bureau of Investigation and Statistics

description.zh-cn: 国民党的情报机构之一，参与了对新疆中共党员的审讯。
description.en: One of the intelligence agencies of the Kuomintang, which participated in the interrogation of CCP members in Xinjiang.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国湖南省湘潭市，是毛泽民的出生地。
description.en: Located in Xiangtan, Hunan Province, China, it is the birthplace of Mao Zemin.

description.zh-cn: 新疆维吾尔自治区首府，毛泽民在此地工作并被杀害。
description.en: The capital of the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, where Mao Zemin worked and was killed.

description.zh-cn: 国立东华大学创校校长，留美经济学家，美国加州大学戴维斯分校经济学博士。
description.en: Founding president of National Dong Hwa University, an economist who studied in the United States, with a Ph.D. in Economics from the University of California, Davis.

zh-cn: 加利福尼亚州立大学洛杉矶分校

description.zh-cn: 位于美国加利福尼亚州洛杉矶的公立大学。
description.en: A public university in Los Angeles, California, USA.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任教育部长，负责国立东华大学的设校案。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China, who served as Minister of Education and was responsible for the establishment of National Dong Hwa University.

description.zh-cn: 前身为台湾省立花莲师范学校，于2008年与国立东华大学合并。
description.en: Formerly known as Taiwan Provincial Hualien Normal School, it merged with National Dong Hwa University in 2008.

description.zh-cn: 美国建筑师，后现代主义建筑之父，耶鲁大学建筑学院院长。其设计蓝图被选为国立东华大学主校区的设计方案。
description.en: An American architect, a father of postmodern architecture, and dean of the Yale School of Architecture. His design blueprint was selected for the main campus of National Dong Hwa University.

description.zh-cn: 国立东华大学第二任校长，留美化学家。
description.en: The second president of National Dong Hwa University, a chemist who studied in the United States.

description.zh-cn: 国立东华大学第三任校长，留美超导物理学家。
description.en: The third president of National Dong Hwa University, a superconductivity physicist who studied in the United States.

description.zh-cn: 2024年4月3日发生在台湾花莲县附近海域的强烈地震，对国立东华大学造成了严重的财产损失。
description.en: A strong earthquake that occurred off the coast of Hualien County, Taiwan on April 3, 2024, causing severe property damage to National Dong Hwa University.

description.zh-cn: 国立东华大学校友、立法委员。在2024年花莲地震后，呼吁教育部支持母校重建。
description.en: An alumna of National Dong Hwa University and a legislator. After the 2024 Hualien earthquake, she called on the Ministry of Education to support the reconstruction of her alma mater.

description.zh-cn: 台湾漫画家，在2024年花莲地震后义卖作品，将所得捐赠给国立东华大学用于重建。
description.en: A Taiwanese cartoonist who, after the 2024 Hualien earthquake, sold his artworks for charity and donated the proceeds to National Dong Hwa University for reconstruction.

description.zh-cn: 台湾女艺人，周杰伦的妻子。在2024年花莲地震后，与丈夫周杰伦共同捐款支持国立东华大学重建。
description.en: A Taiwanese actress and the wife of Jay Chou. After the 2024 Hualien earthquake, she and her husband Jay Chou jointly donated money to support the reconstruction of National Dong Hwa University.

en: National Museum of Marine Biology and Aquarium

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾屏东县车城乡的海洋生物学博物馆，与国立东华大学合作成立海洋科学学院。
description.en: A marine biology museum located in Checheng, Pingtung County, Taiwan, which collaborated with National Dong Hwa University to establish the College of Marine Sciences.

zh-cn: 国立东华大学海洋生物研究所
en: National Dong Hwa University Graduate Institute of Marine Biology

description.zh-cn: 由国立东华大学与国立海洋生物博物馆共同创立的学院，于2022年与环境学院整合为环境暨海洋学院。
description.en: A college jointly founded by National Dong Hwa University and the National Museum of Marine Biology and Aquarium. It was merged with the College of Environmental Studies to form the College of Environmental and Ocean Sciences in 2022.

zh-cn: 国立东华大学环境暨海洋学院
en: NDHU College of Environmental Studies and Oceanography

description.zh-cn: 国立东华大学的学院之一。该学院于2022年由原环境学院和海洋科学学院整合而成。原环境学院此前独立存在，直至同年合并。
description.en: A college of National Dong Hwa University. This college was formed in 2022 by the merger of the former College of Environmental Studies and College of Marine Sciences. The former College of Environmental Studies existed independently until its merger in the same year.

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾新竹市的国立研究型大学。
description.en: A national research university in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国首位奥运跆拳道金牌得主，曾任国立东华大学跆拳道指导教练。
description.en: The first Olympic taekwondo gold medalist from the Republic of China, formerly served as the taekwondo coach at National Dong Hwa University.

description.zh-cn: 一项基本人权，指个人持有或思考独立于他人观点的思想、观点或信仰的自由。在泷川事件中，京都大学的学术思想自由受到严重挑战。
description.en: A fundamental human right referring to the freedom of an individual to hold or consider a fact, viewpoint, or thought, independent of others' viewpoints. The academic freedom of thought at Kyoto University was severely challenged during the Takigawa incident.

description.zh-cn: 由导演黑泽明执导的一部电影，以1933年的泷川事件为背景。
description.en: A film directed by Akira Kurosawa, set against the backdrop of the 1933 Takigawa incident.

description.zh-cn: 日本著名电影导演，执导了以泷川事件为背景的电影《我于青春无悔》。
description.en: A famous Japanese film director who directed the film 'No Regrets for Our Youth,' which was based on the Takigawa incident.

description.zh-cn: 法国思想家，西方国家学说以及法学理论的奠基人。
description.en: A French philosopher and a founder of Western theories of the state and law.

description.zh-cn: 一种由少数贵族阶级掌握政权的政体。
description.en: A form of government in which power is held by the nobility.

description.zh-cn: 一种由全体人民掌握政权的政体。
description.en: A form of government in which power is held by all the people.

description.zh-cn: 中国西周时期，周厉王出奔后，由诸侯代行王政的时期。中文“共和”一词即来源于此。
description.en: An interregnum period in the Western Zhou dynasty of China after King Li fled, during which feudal lords governed. The Chinese term 'gonghe' (republic) originates from this period.

description.zh-cn: 公元前842年西周发生的一场暴动，导致周厉王被推翻。
description.en: A rebellion in 842 BC during the Western Zhou dynasty that resulted in the overthrow of King Li of Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 西周第十位君主，因国人暴动而出逃。
description.en: The tenth king of the Western Zhou dynasty, who fled after the Compatriots' Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 共国的伯君，在周召共和时期代行王政。
description.en: The Count of Gong who acted as regent during the Gonghe Regency.

description.zh-cn: 一种基于马克思列宁主义国家理论的共和制变体。
description.en: A variant of a republic based on the state theory of Marxism–Leninism.

description.zh-cn: 自1948年以来通过世袭统治朝鲜民主主义人民共和国的家族。
description.en: The ruling family of North Korea, which has ruled through hereditary succession since 1948.

description.zh-cn: 一种神权政体，所有法律都必须与伊斯兰教教谕保持一致。
description.en: A form of theocratic government where all laws must be consistent with Islamic teachings.

description.zh-cn: 记录伊斯兰教先知穆罕默德言行的文献。
description.en: Records of the traditions or sayings of the Prophet Muhammad.

description.zh-cn: 是一种共和政体，起源于威玛共和国。这种政府体制中，总统与总理和内阁共同分享行政权。
description.en: A type of republic, originating from the Weimar Republic. It is a system of government in which a president exists alongside a prime minister and a cabinet, with the latter two being responsible to the legislature of a state.

description.zh-cn: 一种政府体制，行政机构的权力来源于立法机构（议会）。
description.en: A system of government in which the executive branch derives its democratic legitimacy from its ability to command the confidence of the legislative branch (parliament).

description.zh-cn: 是共和制的一种，它的政府型态属于议会制。
description.en: A type of republic that operates under a parliamentary system of government.

description.zh-cn: 俞正声的妻子，张震寰之女。
description.en: Wife of Yu Zhengsheng, daughter of Zhang Zhenhuan.

zh-cn: 越南南方民族解放阵线

description.zh-cn: 在南越进行游击战的武装组织，与北越结盟。
description.en: An armed organization that conducted guerrilla warfare in South Vietnam, allied with North Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治家，曾任肯尼迪政府副总统，在肯尼迪遇刺后继任为美国第36任总统。其任内越南战争全面升级。
description.en: American politician who served as Vice President in the Kennedy administration and succeeded him as the 36th President of the United States after Kennedy's assassination. During his tenure, the Vietnam War fully escalated.

description.zh-cn: 1964年至1968年间担任驻越美军最高司令官。
description.en: Commander of U.S. forces in Vietnam from 1964 to 1968.

description.zh-cn: 由美国、北越、南越和越南南方共和国临时革命政府签署的和平协议，标志着美军正式撤出越南。
description.en: A peace treaty signed by the United States, North Vietnam, South Vietnam, and the Provisional Revolutionary Government of the Republic of South Vietnam, marking the official withdrawal of U.S. troops from Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 美国声称其驱逐舰在东京湾（北部湾）遭到北越攻击，成为美国国会通过《东京湾决议案》，授权总统升级战争的直接原因。
description.en: The United States claimed its destroyers were attacked by North Vietnam in the Gulf of Tonkin, which became the direct cause for the U.S. Congress to pass the Gulf of Tonkin Resolution, authorizing the president to escalate the war.

description.zh-cn: 美国国会通过的一项联合决议，授权总统林登·约翰逊采取一切必要措施，包括使用武装部队，以应对东南亚的“侵略”。
description.en: A joint resolution passed by the U.S. Congress, authorizing President Lyndon B. Johnson to take all necessary measures, including the use of armed force, to repel aggression in Southeast Asia.

description.zh-cn: 美国对北越进行的大规模持续性战略轰炸行动。
description.en: A large-scale, sustained strategic bombing campaign conducted by the United States against North Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 北越和越共发动的一次大规模军事攻势，虽然在军事上失败，但在政治和宣传上取得巨大成功，成为战争的转折点。
description.en: A massive military offensive launched by North Vietnam and the Viet Cong. Although a military failure, it was a major political and propaganda victory, becoming a turning point in the war.

description.zh-cn: 北越军队攻占南越首都西贡，标志着越南战争的结束和南越政权的覆灭。
description.en: The capture of Saigon, the capital of South Vietnam, by the People's Army of Vietnam, marking the end of the Vietnam War and the collapse of the South Vietnamese government.

description.zh-cn: 由越南共和国军队将领发动，推翻并杀害了总统吴廷琰的军事政变。此行动得到了肯尼迪政府的同意。
description.en: A military coup launched by generals of the Army of the Republic of Vietnam that overthrew and assassinated President Ngô Đình Diệm. The Kennedy administration consented to this action.

description.zh-cn: 南越将军，曾发动政变推翻吴廷琰。在1975年西贡沦陷时担任南越末代总统，并向北越投降。
description.en: A South Vietnamese general who led a coup against Ngô Đình Diệm. He served as the last president of South Vietnam and surrendered to North Vietnam during the Fall of Saigon in 1975.

description.zh-cn: 日本陆军大将，在武汉会战期间担任华中方面军司令官，为日军方面主要指挥官。
description.en: A general in the Imperial Japanese Army who served as the commander of the Central China Area Army during the Battle of Wuhan, acting as a main commander for the Japanese forces.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军一级上将，曾任国民革命军追剿军总司令，在长征期间对红军进行追击。在武汉会战期间，指挥了著名的万家岭战役。
description.en: A General of the Republic of China's army, he also served as Commander-in-Chief of the Pursuit Army, pursuing the Red Army during the Long March. During the Battle of Wuhan, he commanded the famous Battle of Wanjialing.

description.zh-cn: 日本皇族、陆军大将，在武汉会战期间指挥日军第2军助攻武汉。
description.en: A Japanese imperial prince and general of the Imperial Japanese Army who commanded the Japanese 2nd Army in a supporting attack on Wuhan during the Battle of Wuhan.

description.zh-cn: 大日本帝国陆军的一个方面军，是进攻武汉的日军主力部队。
description.en: An army group of the Imperial Japanese Army, which was the main Japanese force in the attack on Wuhan.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争期间，中国国民革命军的一个战区，负责武汉会战的江南防务。
description.en: A war zone of the National Revolutionary Army during the Second Sino-Japanese War, responsible for the defense south of the Yangtze River during the Battle of Wuhan.

description.zh-cn: 武汉会战中的一场重要战役，中国军队在此重创日军第106师团等部。
description.en: A significant battle within the larger Battle of Wuhan, where Chinese forces inflicted heavy casualties on the Japanese 106th Division and other units.

description.zh-cn: 大日本帝国陆军的一个师团，在万家岭战役中遭到中国军队重创。
description.en: A division of the Imperial Japanese Army that suffered heavy losses against Chinese forces in the Battle of Wanjialing.

description.zh-cn: 武汉会战期间日军对广东发动的战役，其迅速胜利导致国民政府决定放弃武汉。
description.en: A campaign launched by the Japanese army in Guangdong during the Battle of Wuhan. Its swift success led to the Nationalist Government's decision to abandon Wuhan.

description.zh-cn: 日本皇族、陆军元帅，在武汉会战期间传达天皇命令，批准使用化学武器。
description.en: A member of the Japanese Imperial Family and Field Marshal in the Imperial Japanese Army, who conveyed the Emperor's order authorizing the use of chemical weapons during the Battle of Wuhan.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军二级上将，时任第32军军长，在万家岭战役中成功阻击了日军第27师团的增援。
description.en: A general of the Republic of China's army, then commander of the 32nd Army, who successfully blocked Japanese 27th Division reinforcements during the Battle of Wanjialing.

description.zh-cn: 大日本帝国陆军的一个师团，在万家岭战役期间试图增援第106师团但被阻击。
description.en: A division of the Imperial Japanese Army that attempted to reinforce the 106th Division during the Battle of Wanjialing but was intercepted.

description.zh-cn: 日本国会在1938年通过的法律，授权政府为战争无限投入资源，使日本进入战时经济体制。
description.en: A law passed by the Diet of Japan in 1938, authorizing the government to commit unlimited resources to the war effort, transitioning Japan to a wartime economy.

description.zh-cn: 中国企业家，在武汉会战期间组织将武汉地区大量工业装备和人员转移到四川。
description.en: A Chinese entrepreneur who organized the relocation of a large amount of industrial equipment and personnel from the Wuhan area to Sichuan during the Battle of Wuhan.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国与苏联签订的条约，为苏联向中国提供军事及技术援助（如苏联航空志愿队）提供了基础。
description.en: A treaty signed between the Republic of China and the Soviet Union, which provided the basis for Soviet military and technical assistance to China (such as the Soviet Volunteer Group).

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国铁道部前部长，是刘志军的前任。他曾推行“网运分离”的铁路改革，但该方向在刘志军上任后被逆转。他曾联名举报刘志军。
description.en: Former Minister of Railways of the People's Republic of China and Liu Zhijun's predecessor. He promoted the "separation of network and operation" railway reform, a policy that was reversed after Liu took office. He co-signed a letter to report Liu Zhijun's misconduct.

description.zh-cn: 刘志军的出生地，位于湖北省，现为鄂州市华容区的一部分。
description.en: Liu Zhijun's birthplace, located in Hubei Province, now part of Huairong District, Ezhou City.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国高速铁路

description.zh-cn: 中国的全国性高速铁路网络建设计划。刘志军是这一计划的主要推动者，在其任内，中国高速铁路建设进入高速发展期。
description.en: China's national high-speed railway network construction project. Liu Zhijun was the main promoter of this project, and during his tenure, China's high-speed rail construction entered a period of rapid development.

zh-cn: 北京市第二中级人民法院

description.zh-cn: 位于中国北京市的司法机构。该法院于2013年一审判处刘志军死刑，缓期二年执行。
description.en: A judicial body in Beijing, China. In 2013, this court sentenced Liu Zhijun to death with a two-year reprieve in the first-instance trial.

description.zh-cn: 中国工程院院士，“中华之星”动车组总设计师。他曾联名举报刘志军在高铁技术引进中排挤国产技术的行为。
description.en: An academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering and the chief designer of the "China Star" EMU. He co-signed a letter to report Liu Zhijun for sidelining domestically developed technology in favor of foreign high-speed rail technology.

description.zh-cn: 2008年发生在中国山东省胶济铁路的特大交通安全事故，造成72人死亡。时任铁道部部长刘志军因此次事故被记过处分。
description.en: A major railway accident that occurred in 2008 on the Jiaoji Railway in Shandong Province, China, resulting in 72 deaths. Then-Minister of Railways Liu Zhijun received a demerit as a result of the accident.

zh-cn: 甬台温铁路列车追尾事故

description.zh-cn: 发生在中国浙江省温州市附近甬台温铁路上的特大铁路交通事故。事故调查报告认定，已被免职的刘志军对此事故负有主要领导责任。
description.en: A major railway accident that occurred on the Yongtaiwen Railway near Wenzhou, Zhejiang Province, China. The accident investigation report concluded that Liu Zhijun, who had already been dismissed, bore primary leadership responsibility for the accident.

description.zh-cn: 中国著名律师，在刘志军案中担任其辩护人，为其作罪轻辩护。
description.en: A famous Chinese lawyer who acted as Liu Zhijun's defense counsel, arguing for a lighter sentence.

description.zh-cn: 研究苏联和东欧历史的学者，秦晖的妻子。
description.en: A scholar of Soviet and Eastern European history, wife of Qin Hui.

description.zh-cn: 中国农民战争史与土地制度史学科的开拓者，秦晖的硕士导师。
description.en: A pioneer in the history of Chinese peasant wars and land systems, and Qin Hui's master's thesis advisor.

description.zh-cn: 秦晖于1997年总结的历史现象，指“农民负担简而复繁，出现反弹，反而越改越重”。
description.en: A historical phenomenon summarized by Qin Hui in 1997, which refers to the cycle where the burden on peasants, after being simplified, rebounds and becomes even heavier.

description.zh-cn: 中国历史上对农业收成征收的税种，于2006年被废除。
description.en: A tax levied on agricultural production throughout Chinese history, which was abolished in 2006.

description.zh-cn: 耶稣基督的十二宗徒之一，被天主教会认为是罗马教会的第一位主教。
description.en: One of the Twelve Apostles of Jesus Christ, considered by the Catholic Church to be the first bishop of Rome.

description.zh-cn: 天主教会中最大的个别教会，唯一的西方传统教会。
description.en: The largest particular church within the Catholic Church and the only Western traditional church.

description.zh-cn: 与教宗完全共融的23个自治的东方基督教会。
description.en: The 23 autonomous Eastern Christian particular churches in full communion with the Pope.

description.zh-cn: 天主教会的发源地。
description.en: The founding place of the Catholic Church.

description.zh-cn: 明末官员、学者，天主教徒。他与利玛窦等人合作翻译了《几何原本》等西方科学著作，是中西文化交流和天主教在中国传播的先驱之一。
description.en: A Chinese scholar-official, agronomist, astronomer, mathematician, and writer during the Ming dynasty. He was a colleague and collaborator of the Italian Jesuits Matteo Ricci and Sabatino de Ursis, assisting their translation of several classic Western texts into Chinese, including part of Euclid's Elements. As a prominent Catholic convert, he was also instrumental in the early spread of Catholicism in China.

description.zh-cn: 天主教枢机主教，首任宗座驻华代表，创立了主徒会。
description.en: A Catholic Cardinal, the first Apostolic Delegate to China, and the founder of the Congregation of the Disciples of the Lord.

description.zh-cn: 由刚恒毅枢机主教在中国创立的天主教修会。
description.en: A Catholic religious congregation founded in China by Cardinal Celso Costantini.

description.zh-cn: 比利时籍天主教神父，后加入中国籍，在中国创立了耀汉小兄弟会和德来小姊妹会。
description.en: A Belgian Catholic priest who later became a Chinese citizen and founded the Congregation of the Little Brothers of St. John the Baptist and the Congregation of the Little Sisters of Saint Thérèse of the Child Jesus in China.

en: Congregation of the Little Brothers of St. John the Baptist

description.zh-cn: 由雷鸣远神父在中国创立的天主教男修会。
description.en: A Catholic male religious congregation founded in China by Father Vincent Lebbe.

description.zh-cn: 天主教大公会议，在此会议上宣布了圣母为“天主之母”的信理。
description.en: An ecumenical council of the Catholic Church at which the doctrine of Mary as the 'Mother of God' (Theotokos) was proclaimed.

description.zh-cn: 天主教关于圣母玛利亚的信理之一，承认她是天主耶稣基督的母亲。
description.en: One of the Catholic dogmas concerning the Virgin Mary, acknowledging her as the mother of Jesus Christ, who is God.

description.zh-cn: 由中华人民共和国政府建立和控制的官方天主教管理机构，不被圣座承认。
description.en: The official Catholic governing body established and controlled by the government of the People's Republic of China, not recognized by the Holy See.

description.zh-cn: 拒绝加入中国天主教爱国会、继续忠于罗马教宗的中国天主教会团体。
description.en: The community of the Catholic Church in China that refuses to join the Chinese Patriotic Catholic Association and remains loyal to the Pope of Rome.

description.zh-cn: 天主教会第265任教宗，曾于2007年向中国天主教徒发出牧函，寻求与中国政府对话。
description.en: The 265th Pope of the Catholic Church, who issued a pastoral letter to Chinese Catholics in 2007, seeking dialogue with the Chinese government.

description.zh-cn: 天主教会现任教宗。曾与中国国家主席习近平互通信件，并在其任内达成了中梵关于主教任命的临时性协议。
description.en: The current Pope of the Catholic Church. He has exchanged correspondence with Chinese President Xi Jinping, and during his pontificate, a provisional agreement between China and the Vatican on the appointment of bishops was reached.

description.zh-cn: 天主教会第264任教宗，于2000年册封了120位中华殉道圣人。
description.en: The 264th Pope of the Catholic Church, who canonized 120 Chinese Martyr Saints in 2000.

description.zh-cn: 在1648年至1930年间在中国殉教并于2000年被教宗若望保禄二世封圣的120位天主教徒。
description.en: A group of 120 Catholics who were martyred in China between 1648 and 1930 and were canonized by Pope John Paul II in 2000.

description.zh-cn: 古代西域国家，以喀什（疏勒）为国都。
由东汉将领班超拥立的疏勒国王。
曾统治中亚和南亚的古代帝国，对丝绸之路贸易和佛教传播有重要影响。
中亚的突厥王朝，是首个信奉伊斯兰教的突厥系国家。
乃蛮王子，后篡夺西辽帝位，统治西域。
由阿古柏在新疆建立的伊斯兰教国家。
中华民国时期回族将领，曾据守喀什。
叙利亚阿拉伯人，曾率领维吾尔与吉尔吉斯联军攻打喀什。

zh-cn: 东突厥斯坦伊斯兰共和国
沙比提大毛拉·阿不都尔巴克

description.zh-cn: 东突厥斯坦伊斯兰共和国的建立者之一。
东突厥斯坦伊斯兰共和国的建立者之一。
中华民国时期回族军阀，马家军首脑之一。
艾提尕尔清真寺的大毛拉，于2014年遇刺身亡。
新加坡的主要华文日报之一。该报曾对神舟五号的成功发射给予高度评价。此外，该报还对彭帅进行了采访，彭帅在采访中否认曾指控他人对其性侵，但这次采访被外界批评为中国的大外宣。
description.en: One of Singapore's main Chinese-language daily newspapers. It highly praised the successful launch of Shenzhou 5. Additionally, it conducted an interview with Peng Shuai, in which she denied ever accusing anyone of sexual assault. This interview was criticized by outsiders as Chinese propaganda.

description.zh-cn: 法国体育报纸。该报对彭帅进行了采访，在采访中彭帅再次否认曾提出性侵指控，并宣布退役。
description.en: A French sports newspaper. It conducted an interview with Peng Shuai, in which she again denied making sexual assault allegations and announced her retirement.

description.zh-cn: 美国职业网球运动员，对彭帅的遭遇表示痛心和震惊，并呼吁进行调查。
description.en: American professional tennis player who expressed being heartbroken and shocked by Peng Shuai's situation and called for an investigation.

description.zh-cn: 塞尔维亚职业网球运动员，对彭帅的失踪表示震惊。
description.en: Serbian professional tennis player who expressed shock over Peng Shuai's disappearance.

description.zh-cn: 日本职业网球运动员，对彭帅的处境表示担忧，并表示任何情况都不应审查。
description.en: Japanese professional tennis player who expressed concern for Peng Shuai's situation and stated that censorship is never okay under any circumstances.

description.zh-cn: 胡德平的前妻，原中组部部长安子文之女。
description.en: Former wife of Hu Deping and daughter of An Ziwen, former head of the CPC Organization Department.

description.zh-cn: 日本政治家，与胡德平会面时任内阁官房长官。
description.en: A Japanese politician who was the Chief Cabinet Secretary at the time of his meeting with Hu Deping.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国文化和旅游部管理的国家局，负责文物和博物馆事业。
description.en: A state administration under the Ministry of Culture and Tourism of the People's Republic of China, responsible for cultural heritage and museums.

description.zh-cn: 由中华炎黄文化研究会主办的综合性纪实月刊。
description.en: A comprehensive documentary monthly magazine sponsored by the Chinese Yan Huang Culture Research Association.

zh-cn: 中国生物多样性保护与绿色发展基金会
en: China Biodiversity Conservation and Green Development Foundation

description.zh-cn: 中国一家致力于生物多样性保护和绿色发展的非营利组织。
description.en: A non-profit organization in China dedicated to biodiversity conservation and green development.

description.zh-cn: 一家总部位于瑞士的跨国投资银行和金融服务公司。
description.en: A multinational investment bank and financial services company headquartered in Switzerland.

description.zh-cn: 中国的全国性慈善组织。
description.en: A national charitable organization in China.

description.zh-cn: 一种政治理论，指社会主义国家在资本主义国家的政治、经济、文化影响下，逐渐演变为资本主义国家。四清运动的一个目标是防止和平演变。
description.en: A political theory suggesting that socialist states gradually evolve into capitalist states under the political, economic, and cultural influence of capitalist countries. One of the goals of the Four Cleanups Movement was to prevent peaceful evolution.

description.zh-cn: 指在司法或政治运动中，对无辜者所作的错误判决和迫害事件。例如，四清运动产生了大量的冤假错案；有媒体称陈良宇事件是由令计划等人炮制的一起冤案。
description.en: Refers to wrongful verdicts and persecution incidents in judicial or political movements, particularly a miscarriage of justice where an innocent person is wrongly convicted. For instance, the Four Cleanups Movement produced a large number of such cases, and some media outlets claim the Chen Liangyu incident was a wrongful conviction orchestrated by Ling Jihua and others.

description.zh-cn: 1962年前后，中国农村为恢复大饥荒后的农业生产，推行了“自由市场、自留地、自负盈亏、包产到户”的经济调整政策。该政策受到刘少奇、邓小平等人的支持，但遭到毛泽东的反对，并被批评为搞资本主义。
description.en: Around 1962, to restore agricultural production after the Great Famine, China's rural areas implemented economic adjustment policies of 'free markets, private plots, self-responsibility for profits and losses, and fixing output quotas on a household basis'. This policy was supported by figures like Liu Shaoqi and Deng Xiaoping but was opposed by Mao Zedong, who criticized it as capitalist.

description.zh-cn: 一种体罚和羞辱方式，在批斗会上强迫受害者弯腰并将双臂向后抬起。这种方式在“桃园经验”中出现，并在文化大革命中流行。
description.en: A form of corporal punishment and humiliation where victims were forced to bend over with their arms raised behind their backs during struggle sessions. This method appeared in the 'Taoyuan Experience' and became prevalent during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 香港模特、演员，黄晓明的前妻。
description.en: Hong Kong model and actress, ex-wife of Huang Xiaoming.

description.zh-cn: 中国乒乓球运动员，黄晓明的表妹。
description.en: Chinese table tennis player, cousin of Huang Xiaoming.

description.zh-cn: 中国演员，黄晓明的初恋女友。
description.en: Chinese actress, Huang Xiaoming's first love girlfriend.

description.zh-cn: 中国演员，黄晓明的前女友。
description.en: Chinese actress, former girlfriend of Huang Xiaoming.

description.zh-cn: 中国女演员，黄晓明的前女友。
description.en: Chinese actress, former girlfriend of Huang Xiaoming.

description.zh-cn: 中国女演员，黄晓明的前女友。
description.en: Chinese actress, former girlfriend of Huang Xiaoming.

description.zh-cn: 中国演员、导演、制片人。
description.en: Chinese actor, director, and producer.

description.zh-cn: 香港的一家唱片公司及娱乐集团。
description.en: A record company and entertainment group in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 由列夫·托洛茨基及其支持者于1938年成立的国际托洛茨基主义组织。
description.en: An international Trotskyist organization founded in 1938 by Leon Trotsky and his supporters.

description.zh-cn: 列夫·托洛茨基在1936年撰写的著作，分析和批判了苏联在斯大林统治下的官僚化堕落。
description.en: A book written by Leon Trotsky in 1936 that analyzes and criticizes the bureaucratic degeneration of the Soviet Union under Stalin's rule.

description.zh-cn: 一名苏联内务人民委员部的特工，于1940年在墨西哥奉斯大林之命刺杀了列夫·托洛茨基。
description.en: A Soviet NKVD agent who, on Stalin's orders, assassinated Leon Trotsky in Mexico in 1940.

description.zh-cn: 托洛茨基主义理论中的一个概念，用以形容苏联虽然保留了国有化的生产资料，但政治权力被一个官僚阶层所篡夺，不再是真正的无产阶级专政国家。
description.en: A concept in Trotskyist theory used to describe the Soviet Union, where although nationalized means of production were preserved, political power was usurped by a bureaucratic caste, and it was no longer a true proletarian dictatorship.

en: Great Purge of Trotskyists in China

description.zh-cn: 1952年12月22日，中华人民共和国政府在全国范围内对托洛茨基主义者进行的大规模逮捕和镇压行动。
description.en: A large-scale arrest and suppression campaign against Trotskyists throughout the People's Republic of China on December 22, 1952.

zh-cn: 中国布尔什维克列宁主义反对派

description.zh-cn: 中国第一个托洛茨基主义组织，成立于1928年12月。
description.en: The first Trotskyist organization in China, established in December 1928.

description.zh-cn: 由刘仁静等人于1930年1月1日成立的中国托洛茨基主义组织。
description.en: A Chinese Trotskyist organization founded on January 1, 1930 by Liu Renjing and others.

description.zh-cn: 由赵济等人于1930年夏成立的中国托洛茨基主义组织。
description.en: A Chinese Trotskyist organization founded in the summer of 1930 by Zhao Ji and others.

description.zh-cn: 明智光秀的叔父，在光秀父亲早逝后照顾他。
description.en: Akechi Mitsuhide's uncle who took care of him after his father's early death.

description.zh-cn: 明智光秀的正室。
description.en: The official wife of Akechi Mitsuhide.

description.zh-cn: 明智光秀的三女，细川忠兴的正室。
description.en: The third daughter of Akechi Mitsuhide and the wife of Hosokawa Tadaoki.

description.zh-cn: 日本战国时代的武将，细川玉子的丈夫。
description.en: A Japanese samurai warrior of the Sengoku period, husband of Hosokawa Tama.

description.zh-cn: 日本战国时代美浓国的大名，明智光秀早年侍奉的主君。
description.en: A daimyō of Mino Province during the Sengoku period, and an early lord of Akechi Mitsuhide.

description.zh-cn: 斋藤道三之子，与父亲内乱，明智光秀支持道三与其为敌。
description.en: Son of Saitō Dōsan. He had an internal conflict with his father, during which Akechi Mitsuhide supported Dōsan against him.

description.zh-cn: 日本战国时代越前国的大名，明智光秀曾在他麾下效力。
description.en: A daimyō of Echizen Province during the Sengoku period, whom Akechi Mitsuhide served for a time.

description.zh-cn: 日本战国时代的武将，明智光秀曾侍奉他。在本能寺之变后，他拒绝了光秀的拉拢。
description.en: A Japanese samurai daimyō of the Sengoku period whom Akechi Mitsuhide once served. He refused to ally with Mitsuhide after the Honnō-ji Incident.

description.zh-cn: 室町幕府的末代将军，明智光秀曾侍奉他。有说法称光秀发动本能寺之变是为了复兴幕府。
description.en: The 15th and final shōgun of the Ashikaga shogunate, whom Akechi Mitsuhide served. It is theorized that Mitsuhide launched the Honnō-ji Incident to restore the shogunate.

description.zh-cn: 丹波国的大名，被明智光秀击败。
description.en: A daimyō of Tanba Province, defeated by Akechi Mitsuhide.

description.zh-cn: 大和国的战国大名，在本能寺之变后拒绝加入明智光秀一方。
description.en: A daimyō of Yamato Province. After the Honnō-ji Incident, he refused to join Akechi Mitsuhide's side.

description.zh-cn: 江户时代初期的天台宗僧侣。传说其真实身份为明智光秀。
description.en: A Tendai Buddhist monk of the early Edo period. Legend suggests that his true identity was Akechi Mitsuhide.

description.zh-cn: 日本古代的令制国之一，位于今岐阜县南部，是明智光秀的出生地。
description.en: One of the old provinces of Japan, located in the southern part of modern-day Gifu Prefecture. It is the birthplace of Akechi Mitsuhide.

description.zh-cn: 新北市市长的前身职务。
description.en: The predecessor position to the Mayor of New Taipei City.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国的直辖市之一，由原台北县升格而来。
description.en: A special municipality in the Republic of China, upgraded from the former Taipei County.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国台湾省曾经的县份，于2010年12月25日升格为新北市。
description.en: A former county of Taiwan Province, Republic of China, which was upgraded to New Taipei City on December 25, 2010.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，现任中国共产党烟台市委员会书记。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, currently serving as the Secretary of the Yantai Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 英国外交家、汉学家，曾任驻华公使。
description.en: A British diplomat, sinologist, and former minister to China.

description.zh-cn: 英国驻华使馆翻译马嘉理在云南被杀的事件，成为英国进一步侵华的借口。
description.en: The murder of Augustus Margary, a British consular officer, in Yunnan, which became a pretext for further British aggression in China.

description.zh-cn: 清政府与英国在烟台签订的不平等条约，作为马嘉理事件的解决方案。
description.en: An unequal treaty signed between the Qing government and the United Kingdom in Yantai as a resolution to the Margary Affair.

description.zh-cn: 辛亥革命时期在烟台成立的革命政权。
description.en: A revolutionary government established in Yantai during the Xinhai Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 清末民初的著名华侨实业家，张裕酿酒公司的创办人。
description.en: A prominent overseas Chinese industrialist in the late Qing and early Republican periods, and the founder of the Changyu Pioneer Wine Company.

description.zh-cn: 美国出版商，创办了《时代》、《生活》和《财富》等著名杂志。
description.en: An American publisher who founded famous magazines such as Time, Life, and Fortune.

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇统一六国后为宣扬国威、求仙访药而进行的一系列巡游活动。
description.en: A series of tours conducted by Qin Shi Huang after unifying the Six States to display national prestige and seek immortality.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝将领，原为安禄山部将，与安禄山共同发动安史之乱，是主要领导人之一。其后称大燕皇帝。
description.en: A Tang Dynasty general, originally a subordinate of An Lushan, he co-initiated the An-Shi Rebellion and was one of its key leaders. He later proclaimed himself emperor of Yan.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝名将，潼关守将。在安史之乱中，因杨国忠逼迫其出战，导致兵败被俘。
description.en: A famous Tang Dynasty general and the commander of the Tongguan Pass. During the An-Shi Rebellion, he was forced into battle by Yang Guozhong, leading to his defeat and capture.

description.zh-cn: 杨国忠的妻子，在马嵬驿兵变后试图逃跑时被杀。
description.en: Wife of Yang Guozhong, killed while trying to escape after the Mawei Inn Mutiny.

description.zh-cn: 安禄山之子。杨国忠怂恿唐玄宗将其斩杀，此事导致安禄山决定提前叛变。
description.en: Son of An Lushan. Yang Guozhong persuaded Emperor Xuanzong to execute him, an act that prompted An Lushan to advance his rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝官职，中书省的长官，为宰相之首。杨国忠在李林甫死后担任此职。
description.en: An official position in the Tang Dynasty, head of the Central Secretariat and chief chancellor. Yang Guozhong held this post after Li Linfu's death.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡的国家管理机构。
新加坡政府负责管理国家财政的部门。
新加坡政治人物，淡马锡控股董事长。
新加坡政治人物，淡马锡控股候任董事长。
公司董事会的领导职位。
企业中的最高行政负责人。
胡善祥之母。
description.en: Mother of Hu Shanxiang.

description.zh-cn: 明宣宗与胡善祥所生长女。
description.en: The eldest daughter of the Xuande Emperor and Hu Shanxiang.

description.zh-cn: 明宣宗与胡善祥所生次女。
description.en: The second daughter of the Xuande Emperor and Hu Shanxiang.

description.zh-cn: 胡善祥之姊，明太祖时的尚宫。
description.en: Sister of Hu Shanxiang, served as a Shang Gong (Lady of the Palace) during the reign of Emperor Taizu of Ming.

description.zh-cn: 胡善祥之兄。
description.en: Brother of Hu Shanxiang.

description.zh-cn: 胡善祥之弟。
description.en: Brother of Hu Shanxiang.

description.zh-cn: 顺德公主的丈夫。
description.en: Husband of Princess Shunde.

description.zh-cn: 胡善祥的出身地。
description.en: The birthplace of Hu Shanxiang.

description.zh-cn: 明宣宗以胡善祥“无子多病”为由废黜其皇后之位的事件。
description.en: The event in which the Xuande Emperor deposed Empress Hu Shanxiang on the grounds that she was 'childless and sickly'.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代皇太子正配的称号。
description.en: The title for the primary consort of a Crown Prince in ancient China.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代宫廷女官职位。
description.en: A position for a female official in the imperial court of ancient China.

description.zh-cn: 香港律师及政治人物，白韵琹的丈夫。1989年起与白韵琹同居，1997年结婚。
description.en: A Hong Kong lawyer and politician, and the husband of Pamela Peck Wan-kam. He has been living with Peck since 1989 and they married in 1997.

description.zh-cn: 位于美国加利福尼亚州旧金山的一所公立大学。
description.en: A public university in San Francisco, California, USA.

description.zh-cn: 香港十八个区议会之一，负责处理湾仔区的地区事务。
description.en: One of the 18 district councils in Hong Kong, responsible for handling district affairs in Wan Chai.

description.zh-cn: 香港政治人物，社民连成员，曾任湾仔区议会议员。
description.en: A Hong Kong politician, member of the League of Social Democrats, and former Wan Chai District Councillor.

description.zh-cn: 香港资深传媒工作者、剧作家。
description.en: A veteran Hong Kong media professional and playwright.

zh-cn: 新马师曾家族争产事件

description.zh-cn: 香港艺人新马师曾（邓永祥）去世后，其家人之间爆发的遗产纠纷。
description.en: The inheritance dispute that erupted among the family members of Hong Kong artist Sun Ma Sze Tsang (Tang Wing-cheung) after his death.

description.zh-cn: 香港艺人新马师曾的第四任妻子。
description.en: The fourth wife of Hong Kong artist Sun Ma Sze Tsang.

description.zh-cn: 香港粤剧演员，有“慈善伶王”之称。
description.en: A Hong Kong Cantonese opera actor, known as the 'King of Charity Opera'.

description.zh-cn: 香港主持人、演员。
description.en: A Hong Kong host and actor.

description.zh-cn: 香港政治人物。
description.en: A Hong Kong political figure.

description.zh-cn: 香港政治人物，民建联成员。
description.en: A Hong Kong politician and member of the DAB.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期人物，纵横家鼻祖，苏秦和张仪的老师。
description.en: A figure from the Warring States period, considered the founder of the School of Diplomacy and the teacher of Su Qin and Zhang Yi.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期纵横家，与张仪同为鬼谷子门下。
description.en: A strategist of the Warring States period, and a fellow student of Zhang Yi under Guiguzi.

description.zh-cn: 秦国君主，秦惠王之子。因与张仪有隙，张仪在其即位后离开秦国。
description.en: Ruler of the State of Qin, son of King Huiwen. Due to his animosity towards Zhang Yi, Zhang Yi left Qin after he ascended the throne.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期楚国相国。
description.en: Chancellor of the State of Chu during the Warring States period.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期楚国君主，曾被张仪以割让土地为名欺骗，导致齐楚联盟破裂。
description.en: Ruler of the State of Chu during the Warring States period. He was deceived by Zhang Yi with a promise of land, which led to the rupture of the alliance between Qi and Chu.

description.zh-cn: 孟子的弟子，曾称赞公孙衍、张仪为大丈夫。
description.en: A disciple of Mencius who once praised Gongsun Yan and Zhang Yi as great men.

description.zh-cn: 由魏国相邦公孙衍发起的五国合纵攻秦的战役。
description.en: A battle initiated by Gongsun Yan, the chancellor of Wei, leading a coalition of five states against Qin.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期魏国都城，位于今山西夏县，是张仪的出生地。
description.en: The capital of the State of Wei during the Warring States period, located in modern-day Xia County, Shanxi. It is the birthplace of Zhang Yi.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期由张仪等人倡导的外交策略，主张事奉一个强国以攻击其他弱国，破坏了六国合纵。
description.en: A diplomatic strategy advocated by Zhang Yi during the Warring States period, which proposed allying with a strong state to attack weaker ones, thereby undermining the 'Hezong' (Vertical Alliance) of the six other major states.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期由公孙衍、苏秦等人倡导的外交策略，主张联合多个弱国抵抗一个强国。
description.en: A diplomatic strategy advocated by Gongsun Yan and Su Qin during the Warring States period, which proposed forming a 'vertical alliance' of weaker states to resist a single powerful state.

description.zh-cn: 一个美国非裔民权组织，旨在利用黑人教会的道德权威和组织能力来指导非暴力抵抗活动以促进民权改革。
description.en: An African-American civil rights organization which aimed to harness the moral authority and organizing power of black churches to conduct nonviolent protests in the service of civil rights reform.

description.zh-cn: 美国作家、活动家、民权领袖，也是马丁·路德·金的妻子。
description.en: American author, activist, civil rights leader, and the wife of Martin Luther King Jr.

description.zh-cn: 美国民权活动家和基督教牧师，是马丁·路德·金的亲密朋友和导师，也是南方基督教领袖会议的联合创始人。
description.en: American civil rights activist and Christian minister, who was a close friend and mentor to Martin Luther King Jr. and a co-founder of the Southern Christian Leadership Conference.

zh-cn: 联合抵制蒙哥马利公车运动

description.zh-cn: 一场反对阿拉巴马州蒙哥马利市公共汽车上种族隔离政策的政治和社会抗议活动。
description.en: A political and social protest campaign against the policy of racial segregation on the public transit system of Montgomery, Alabama.

description.zh-cn: 美国民权活动家，因在蒙哥马利公车上拒绝给白人让座而闻名，此举引发了联合抵制蒙哥马利公车运动。
description.en: American activist in the civil rights movement best known for her pivotal role in the Montgomery bus boycott.

description.zh-cn: 美国联邦调查局首任局长。
description.en: The first Director of the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) of the United States.

zh-cn: 罗伯特·弗朗西斯·甘迺迪

description.zh-cn: 美国政治家，约翰·F·肯尼迪的弟弟，在其总统任内被任命为美国司法部长。
description.en: American politician, brother of John F. Kennedy, who appointed him as Attorney General during his presidency.

description.zh-cn: 马丁·路德·金在1963年向华盛顿进军行动中发表的著名演讲，呼吁结束美国的种族主义。
description.en: A public speech delivered by American civil rights activist Martin Luther King Jr. during the March on Washington for Jobs and Freedom on August 28, 1963, in which he called for an end to racism in the United States.

description.zh-cn: 1963年举行的大规模人权政治集会，旨在为非裔美国人争取公民和经济权利。
description.en: A major political rally for human rights, calling for civil and economic rights for African Americans, held in 1963.

en: Assassination of Martin Luther King Jr.

description.zh-cn: 1968年4月4日，马丁·路德·金在田纳西州孟菲斯的洛林汽车旅馆被暗杀。
description.en: The assassination of Martin Luther King Jr. occurred on April 4, 1968, at the Lorraine Motel in Memphis, Tennessee.

description.zh-cn: 被判谋杀马丁·路德·金的罪犯。
description.en: The convicted assassin of Martin Luther King Jr.

description.zh-cn: 印度律师、反殖民民族主义者和政治伦理学家，他采用非暴力抵抗来领导印度成功地从英国的统治中独立出来。
description.en: Indian lawyer, anti-colonial nationalist, and political ethicist, who employed nonviolent resistance to lead the successful campaign for India's independence from British rule.

description.zh-cn: 由南方基督教领袖会议领导的一场旨在引起人们对阿拉巴马州伯明翰黑人社区融合努力的关注的运动。
description.en: A movement organized by the Southern Christian Leadership Conference (SCLC) to bring attention to the integration efforts of African American citizens in Birmingham, Alabama.

description.zh-cn: 马丁·路德·金在阿拉巴马州伯明翰监狱中写的一封公开信。信中为非暴力抵抗种族主义的策略辩护。
description.en: An open letter written on April 16, 1963, by Martin Luther King Jr. from the city jail in Birmingham, Alabama. The letter defends the strategy of nonviolent resistance to racism.

description.zh-cn: 美国一项具有里程碑意义的民权和劳动法，禁止基于种族、肤色、宗教、性别或国籍的歧视。
description.en: A landmark civil rights and labor law in the United States that outlaws discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, or national origin.

description.zh-cn: 一种为实现社会或政治目标而不对自身、他人或环境造成伤害的个人实践。它源于“不伤害”的信念，是“和平”哲学的替代词。
description.en: The personal practice of being harmless to self and others under every condition. It comes from the belief that hurting people, animals or the environment is unnecessary to achieve an outcome and refers to a general philosophy of abstention from violence.

description.zh-cn: 刘备在夺取汉中后自立的王号，是其称帝前的重要阶段。
description.en: The royal title Liu Bei claimed after conquering Hanzhong, an important step before he declared himself emperor.

en: Three visits to the thatched cottage

description.zh-cn: 刘备三次亲自到访诸葛亮的住处，最终说服其出山辅佐自己的事件。
description.en: The event where Liu Bei personally visited Zhuge Liang's residence three times, ultimately persuading him to emerge from seclusion and serve as his advisor.

description.zh-cn: 一种经济体系，其中生产和价格由供求关系决定，与改革派的经济主张相关联。
description.en: An economic system in which production and prices are determined by supply and demand, associated with the economic proposals of the reformist faction.

description.zh-cn: 指放松政府对社会和经济活动的管制，通常与改革派的政治和经济主张相关。
description.en: Refers to the loosening of government control over social and economic activities, generally associated with the political and economic proposals of the reformist faction.

description.zh-cn: 1980年代早期由保守派发起的一场政治运动，旨在清除被认为是来自西方的资产阶级思想影响。
description.en: A political campaign initiated by conservatives in the early 1980s, aimed at eliminating what was considered bourgeois ideological influence from the West.

description.zh-cn: 六四事件后由保守派发起的一场运动，旨在抵御西方国家通过非暴力方式改变中国社会主义制度的企图。
description.en: A campaign initiated by conservatives after the Tiananmen Square protests, aimed at resisting attempts by Western countries to change China's socialist system through non-violent means.

description.zh-cn: 一份由保守派人士创办的中国政论杂志，因刊文批评江泽民“七一讲话”而在2001年被停刊。
description.en: A Chinese political commentary magazine founded by conservatives, which was shut down in 2001 after publishing an article criticizing Jiang Zemin's "July 1" speech.

description.zh-cn: 一个支持左派政治思想、毛泽东思想及保守派理念的中国网站。该网站曾开设专题赞扬重庆模式，并在薄熙来事件后一度被关闭。
description.en: A Chinese website supporting left-wing political thought, Maoist ideology, and conservative ideas. It once featured a special section praising the Chongqing Model and was temporarily shut down after the Bo Xilai incident.

zh-cn: 关于当前意识形态领域情况的通报

description.zh-cn: 一份中共中央办公厅印发的内部文件，要求抵制普世价值、新闻自由等西方思想，显示了习近平执政初期的保守政治路线。
description.en: An internal document issued by the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, calling for resistance against Western ideas such as universal values and press freedom, indicating Xi Jinping's conservative political line in his early tenure.

description.zh-cn: 中国企业家，原北京市华远集团党委副书记，因批评习近平而被开除党籍并判处有期徒刑。
description.en: A Chinese entrepreneur and former deputy party secretary of Huayuan Group, who was expelled from the party and sentenced to prison for criticizing Xi Jinping.

description.zh-cn: 韩国政治家，曾在李承晚辞职后代理总统职务。
description.en: A South Korean politician who served as acting president after Syngman Rhee's resignation.

description.zh-cn: 韩国政治家，李承晚之后的第四任韩国总统。
description.en: A South Korean politician who served as the fourth President of South Korea, succeeding Syngman Rhee.

description.zh-cn: 韩国政治家，曾任国会议长，是李承晚的主要政治对手。
description.en: A South Korean politician who served as the Speaker of the National Assembly and was a major political rival of Syngman Rhee.

description.zh-cn: 韩国独立运动家和历史学家，曾任大韩民国临时政府第二任总统。
description.en: A Korean independence activist and historian who served as the second president of the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 1952年李承晚政府单方面设定的海上防卫界线，用于规范渔业活动，引发与日本的长期争端。
description.en: A maritime defense boundary unilaterally established by the Syngman Rhee government in 1952 to regulate fishing activities, which sparked a long-term dispute with Japan.

description.zh-cn: 韩国的一所私立大学。
description.en: A private university in South Korea.

description.zh-cn: 文在寅的妻子，韩国前第一夫人。
description.en: Wife of Moon Jae-in, former First Lady of South Korea.

description.zh-cn: 大韩民国国军的陆上武装部队。
description.en: The army of South Korea, responsible for ground-based warfare.

zh-cn: 大韩民国第1空降特战旅

description.zh-cn: 韩国陆军特战司令部下属的特种部队。
description.en: A special forces unit of the Republic of Korea Army Special Warfare Command.

description.zh-cn: 韩国政治人物，曾任国家安全企划部部长，是文在寅服役时的营长。
description.en: South Korean politician, former head of the Agency for National Security Planning, who was Moon Jae-in's battalion commander during his military service.

description.zh-cn: 1976年在板门店共同警备区发生的军事冲突事件。
description.en: A military conflict that occurred in the Joint Security Area at Panmunjom in 1976.

description.zh-cn: 1981年全斗焕军事独裁政府镇压釜山地区的社会科学读书聚会，并将其定义为“共产主义运动”的事件。
description.en: An incident in 1981 where the Chun Doo-hwan military government suppressed social science reading groups in Busan, labeling them as communist movements.

description.zh-cn: 1996年发生在韩国远洋渔船佩斯卡玛号上的一起海上仇杀事件。
description.en: A murder incident that occurred aboard the South Korean fishing vessel Pescamar No. 15 in 1996.

description.zh-cn: 韩国的一个保守派政党，是国民力量的前身。
description.en: A conservative political party in South Korea, a predecessor to the People Power Party.

description.zh-cn: 文在寅与金正恩在板门店举行的首脑会晤。
description.en: A summit meeting between Moon Jae-in and Kim Jong Un held at Panmunjom.

description.zh-cn: 文在寅担任韩国总统期间的韩国政府。
description.en: The government of South Korea during the presidency of Moon Jae-in.

description.zh-cn: 韩国政治人物，曾任文在寅政府时期的国务总理。
description.en: South Korean politician who served as Prime Minister during the Moon Jae-in government.

description.zh-cn: 韩国政治人物，曾任文在寅政府时期的国务总理。
description.en: South Korean politician who served as Prime Minister during the Moon Jae-in government.

description.zh-cn: 韩国政治人物，曾任文在寅政府时期的国务总理。
description.en: South Korean politician who served as Prime Minister during the Moon Jae-in government.

description.zh-cn: 韩国保守派政治人物，曾在2017年总统选举电视辩论中与文在寅交锋。
description.en: A conservative South Korean politician who confronted Moon Jae-in in a televised debate during the 2017 presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 共同民主党的前身之一。
description.en: A predecessor to the Democratic Party of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 薄一波的父亲。
description.en: Father of Bo Yibo.

description.zh-cn: 指一名男子在同一时间只与一名女子保持夫妻关系的婚姻制度，其教义成为张学良与于凤至离婚的借口。
description.en: A marital system where a man is married to only one woman at a time; its doctrine was used as a pretext for Zhang Xueliang's divorce from Yu Fengzhi.

description.zh-cn: 中国旧县名，位于今吉林省公主岭市境内，为于凤至的出生地。
description.en: A former county in China, located in present-day Gongzhuling, Jilin Province, and the birthplace of Yu Fengzhi.

description.zh-cn: 始于2014年2月的俄罗斯与乌克兰之间的长期武装冲突。2022年的全面入侵是该战争的重大升级。
description.en: A long-term armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine that began in February 2014. The 2022 full-scale invasion represents a major escalation of this war.

en: Prelude to the Russian invasion of Ukraine

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯在乌克兰边境大规模集结军队引发的国际危机，最终升级为全面入侵。
description.en: An international crisis sparked by a massive Russian military buildup on the Ukrainian border, which ultimately escalated into a full-scale invasion.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯政府对其2022年全面入侵乌克兰的官方代号。
description.en: The official codename used by the Russian government for its 2022 full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

description.zh-cn: 位于乌克兰东部的亲俄分离主义政权，于2022年2月21日获俄罗斯承认独立。
description.en: A pro-Russian separatist entity in eastern Ukraine, recognized as independent by Russia on February 21, 2022.

description.zh-cn: 位于乌克兰东部的亲俄分离主义政权，于2022年2月21日获俄罗斯承认独立。
description.en: A pro-Russian separatist entity in eastern Ukraine, recognized as independent by Russia on February 21, 2022.

en: United Nations General Assembly Resolution ES-11/1

description.zh-cn: 联合国大会通过的决议，谴责俄罗斯入侵乌克兰并要求其全面撤军。
description.en: A resolution passed by the UN General Assembly condemning Russia's invasion of Ukraine and demanding a full withdrawal of its forces.

description.zh-cn: 联合国的主要司法机关，裁定俄罗斯必须立即停止在乌克兰的军事行动。
description.en: The principal judicial organ of the United Nations, which ruled that Russia must immediately suspend its military operations in Ukraine.

description.zh-cn: 调查和起诉犯有灭绝种族罪、危害人类罪、战争罪和侵略罪的个人的国际法庭。该法院已对普京等人发出逮捕令。
description.en: An international tribunal that investigates and prosecutes individuals for genocide, crimes against humanity, war crimes, and the crime of aggression. It has issued an arrest warrant for Vladimir Putin and others.

description.zh-cn: 由俄罗斯在乌克兰四个占领区举行的公投，旨在将其并入俄罗斯联邦，但此举遭到国际社会广泛谴责。
description.en: Referendums held by Russia in four occupied regions of Ukraine with the aim of annexing them into the Russian Federation, a move widely condemned by the international community.

description.zh-cn: 北大西洋公约组织接纳新成员国，特别是向东欧扩张的过程，被俄罗斯视为对其安全利益的威胁。
description.en: The process of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization admitting new member states, particularly its expansion into Eastern Europe, which Russia views as a threat to its security interests.

description.zh-cn: 2022年9月乌克兰发起的一次成功的军事反攻行动，夺回了哈尔科夫州的大片领土。
description.en: A successful military counteroffensive launched by Ukraine in September 2022, which recaptured large territories in Kharkiv Oblast.

description.zh-cn: 乌克兰于2022年下半年发起的反攻，最终解放了赫尔松市及第聂伯河西岸地区。
description.en: A counteroffensive launched by Ukraine in the latter half of 2022, which culminated in the liberation of Kherson city and the west bank of the Dnipro River.

description.zh-cn: 乌克兰于2023年6月再次发起的大规模反攻，但收效甚微。
description.en: A large-scale counteroffensive launched again by Ukraine in June 2023, which had limited success.

description.zh-cn: 2013年底至2014年初在乌克兰发生的一系列亲欧盟抗议活动，最终导致亲俄总统亚努科维奇下台。
description.en: A series of pro-EU protests in Ukraine from late 2013 to early 2014, which ultimately led to the ousting of pro-Russian President Yanukovych.

description.zh-cn: 因俄罗斯入侵乌克兰而导致的难民潮，是自二战以来欧洲最大的难民危机。
description.en: The refugee outflow caused by the Russian invasion of Ukraine, representing the largest refugee crisis in Europe since World War II.

zh-cn: 俄罗斯入侵乌克兰的战争罪行
en: War crimes in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯军队在入侵乌克兰期间被指控犯下的一系列战争罪行，包括屠杀、酷刑、绑架儿童和使用违禁武器等。
description.en: A series of war crimes allegedly committed by Russian forces during the invasion of Ukraine, including massacres, torture, child abductions, and the use of prohibited weapons.

zh-cn: 阿夫迪伊夫卡战役 (2022年—2024年)

description.zh-cn: 围绕顿涅茨克州阿夫迪伊夫卡市的长期战役，最终以俄罗斯占领该市告终。
description.en: A prolonged battle for the city of Avdiivka in Donetsk Oblast, which concluded with its capture by Russian forces.

zh-cn: 北哈尔科夫州战役 (2024年至今)
en: Northern Kharkiv front of the Russo-Ukrainian war
Northern Kharkiv front of the Russo-Ukrainian War

description.zh-cn: 2024年5月，俄罗斯在哈尔科夫州发动的新一轮攻势。
description.en: A new offensive launched by Russia in Kharkiv Oblast in May 2024.

description.zh-cn: 2024年8月，乌克兰军队对俄罗斯境内的库尔斯克州发动的攻势。
description.en: An offensive launched by Ukrainian forces into Russia's Kursk Oblast in August 2024.

description.zh-cn: 美国的公立大学系统，伯克利分校是其创始大学。
description.en: A public university system in the United States, of which UC Berkeley is the founding campus.

description.zh-cn: 由美国和加拿大顶尖研究型大学组成的协会。
description.en: An association of leading research universities in the United States and Canada.

zh-cn: 劳伦斯伯克利国家实验室

description.zh-cn: 隶属于美国能源部的国家实验室，由加州大学伯克利分校管理。
description.en: A U.S. national laboratory that conducts scientific research on behalf of the Department of Energy, managed by the University of California, Berkeley.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战期间，由美国陆军领导的研发第一颗原子弹的计划，伯克利的科学家和实验室深度参与其中。
description.en: A research and development project during World War II that produced the first nuclear weapons, led by the United States Army and with deep involvement from Berkeley scientists and laboratories.

description.zh-cn: 1964年由伯克利学生发起的学生抗议运动，在美国社会产生了深远影响。
description.en: A student protest movement initiated by Berkeley students in 1964 that had a profound impact on American society.

description.zh-cn: 美国物理学家，在伯克利发明了回旋加速器，并以此为基础发现了多种化学元素。
description.en: American physicist who invented the cyclotron at Berkeley, leading to the discovery of numerous chemical elements.

description.zh-cn: 一种粒子加速器，由欧内斯特·劳伦斯在伯克利发明。
description.en: A type of particle accelerator invented by Ernest Lawrence at Berkeley.

description.zh-cn: 第97号化学元素，以伯克利来命名。
description.en: The chemical element with atomic number 97, named after Berkeley.

zh-cn: 戴维斯加利福尼亚大学

description.zh-cn: 加州大学系统中的一所分校，起源于伯克利设立的“大学农场”。
description.en: A campus in the University of California system that originated as the 'University Farm' established by Berkeley.

description.zh-cn: 加州大学伯克利分校的第一任校长。
description.en: The first Chancellor of the University of California, Berkeley.

zh-cn: 美国国家数学科学研究所

description.zh-cn: 在伯克利校园内建立的数学研究机构，陈省身为首任主任。
description.en: A mathematical research institute established on the Berkeley campus, with Shiing-Shen Chern as its first director.

description.zh-cn: 华裔诺贝尔物理学奖得主，毕业于伯克利。
description.en: Chinese-American Nobel laureate in Physics, an alumnus of Berkeley.

description.zh-cn: 华裔菲尔兹奖得主，毕业于伯克利。
description.en: Chinese-American Fields Medalist, an alumnus of Berkeley.

description.zh-cn: 华裔美国教育家，曾任加州大学伯克利分校校长。
description.en: Chinese-American educator who served as Chancellor of the University of California, Berkeley.

description.zh-cn: 被指为蒲城县职业教育中心副校长，在抗议活动中遭到示威者围殴。
description.en: Alleged to be the vice principal of Pucheng County Vocational Education Center, who was beaten by protesters during the demonstrations.

description.zh-cn: 在蒲城县的抗议活动中维持秩序并与示威者发生冲突的执法力量。
description.en: Law enforcement forces that maintained order and clashed with protesters during the protests in Pucheng County.

description.zh-cn: 报道了蒲城县抗议事件平息后情况的广播电台。
description.en: A radio station that reported on the situation in Pucheng County after the protests subsided.

zh-cn: 上海特别市临时市政府

description.zh-cn: 1927年上海工人第三次武装起义后成立的临时政权，在四一二事件中被蒋介石下令解散。
description.en: A provisional government established after the third armed workers' uprising in Shanghai in 1927, which was ordered to be dissolved by Chiang Kai-shek during the April 12th Incident.

description.zh-cn: 由中国共产党领导的上海工人组织，在四一二事件中被解散。
description.en: A Shanghai workers' organization led by the Chinese Communist Party, which was dissolved during the April 12th Incident.

description.zh-cn: 青帮领袖，策划并执行清党的主要人物之一，负责联络杜月笙。
description.en: A leader of the Green Gang and a key figure in planning and executing the party purge, responsible for liaising with Du Yuesheng.

description.zh-cn: 国民党党代表，于1927年3月6日枪杀陈赞贤。
description.en: A KMT party representative who shot and killed Chen Zanxian on March 6, 1927.

description.zh-cn: 江西省总工会副委员长、赣州总工会委员长，于1927年3月6日被倪弼枪杀。
description.en: Vice-chairman of the Jiangxi Provincial General Labor Union and chairman of the Ganzhou General Labor Union, who was shot and killed by Ni Bi on March 6, 1927.

description.zh-cn: 继四一二事件后，在广州发生的大规模搜捕和处决共产党员及支持者的事件。
description.en: An event of mass arrests and executions of communists and their supporters in Guangzhou, following the April 12th Incident.

description.zh-cn: 美利坚合众国开国元勋之一，宾夕法尼亚大学的创建者。
description.en: One of the Founding Fathers of the United States and the founder of the University of Pennsylvania.

description.zh-cn: 世界上第一台全数字电子计算机，由宾夕法尼亚大学工程学院于1946年设计完成。
description.en: The first fully digital electronic computer in the world, designed by the School of Engineering at the University of Pennsylvania and completed in 1946.

description.zh-cn: 由美国东北部地区的八所私立大学组成的体育赛事联盟，现已引申为美国顶尖学府的代名词。
description.en: An athletic conference composed of eight private universities in the Northeastern United States, now also commonly refers to these universities as a group of elite colleges.

description.zh-cn: 18世纪至19世纪初苏格兰的一段思想、科学与文化成就迸发的时期。
description.en: The period in 18th- and early 19th-century Scotland characterized by an outpouring of intellectual and scientific accomplishments.

zh-cn: 宾夕法尼亚大学沃顿商学院
en: Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania

description.zh-cn: 宾夕法尼亚大学下属的商学院。
description.en: The business school of the University of Pennsylvania.

description.zh-cn: 投资家、慈善家，宾夕法尼亚大学校友。
description.en: Investor and philanthropist, an alumnus of the University of Pennsylvania.

description.zh-cn: 律师、台湾立法委员，宾夕法尼亚大学校友。
description.en: Lawyer and legislator in Taiwan; an alumna of the University of Pennsylvania.

description.zh-cn: 前任美国驻华大使、前犹他州州长，宾夕法尼亚大学校友。
description.en: Former U.S. Ambassador to China and former Governor of Utah; an alumnus of the University of Pennsylvania.

description.zh-cn: 美国语言学家、哲学家、认知科学家、历史学家、社会评论家和政治活动家，宾夕法尼亚大学校友。
description.en: An American linguist, philosopher, cognitive scientist, historian, social critic, and political activist; an alumnus of the University of Pennsylvania.

description.zh-cn: 美籍华裔建筑师，宾夕法尼亚大学校友。
description.en: Chinese-American architect, an alumnus of the University of Pennsylvania.

description.zh-cn: 台裔经济学家、香港中文大学教授，宾夕法尼亚大学校友。他曾试图在电视节目中揭发张荣坤的资金问题并遭到封杀；亦曾批评孟山都控制中国大豆市场，并指控其贿赂官员。
description.en: Taiwanese-born economist and professor at the Chinese University of Hong Kong; an alumnus of the University of Pennsylvania. He attempted to expose Zhang Rongkun's financial issues on a TV program but was censored, and also criticized Monsanto for controlling China's soybean market, accusing it of bribing officials.

description.zh-cn: 中国著名物理学家，宾大历史上第一位中国女博士，中国半导体科学事业开拓者之一。
description.en: Renowned Chinese physicist, the first Chinese female Ph.D. in the history of the University of Pennsylvania, and one of the pioneers of China's semiconductor science.

description.zh-cn: 1978年至1979年间，在北京西单墙上张贴大字报，宣传不同政见，支持“求是派”，要求民主和自由的民主运动。魏京生是其中的重要成员。
description.en: A democratic movement that took place from 1978 to 1979, where big-character posters advocating different political views, democracy, and freedom were posted on the Xidan Wall in Beijing, supporting the "Pragmatist Faction." Wei Jingsheng was a key member of this movement.

zh-cn: 第五个现代化：民主及其他

description.zh-cn: 魏京生于1978年12月5日在西单民主墙张贴的大字报，宣扬民主主义，认为政治民主化是中国现代化的前提。
description.en: A big-character poster written by Wei Jingsheng and posted on the Xidan Democracy Wall on December 5, 1978, advocating for democracy and arguing that political democratization is a prerequisite for China's modernization.

description.zh-cn: 由欧洲议会颁发的人权奖项，以苏联科学家和持不同政见者安德烈·萨哈罗夫的名字命名。2023年，该奖项被追授给玛莎·阿米尼及“女性、生命、自由”运动。
description.en: A human rights prize awarded by the European Parliament, named after Soviet scientist and dissident Andrei Sakharov. In 2023, it was posthumously awarded to Mahsa Amini and the 'Woman, Life, Freedom' movement.

description.zh-cn: 美国的一个非营利组织，旨在促进全球民主。
description.en: A U.S. non-profit organization aimed at promoting democracy worldwide.

zh-cn: 中国人民大学附属中学
en: High School Affiliated to Renmin University of China

description.zh-cn: 位于北京的一所中学，魏京生曾在此就读。
description.en: A middle school in Beijing where Wei Jingsheng studied.

description.zh-cn: 魏京生在1973年退伍后被分配工作的单位，担任电工。
description.en: The workplace where Wei Jingsheng was assigned to work as an electrician after being discharged from the army in 1973.

description.zh-cn: 由魏京生等人创办的民运杂志。
description.en: A pro-democracy magazine founded by Wei Jingsheng and others.

description.zh-cn: 关于西藏政治地位的争议，魏京生曾于1992年致信邓小平阐述自己对此问题的看法。
description.en: The political dispute over the status of Tibet. Wei Jingsheng wrote a letter to Deng Xiaoping in 1992 explaining his views on the issue.

description.zh-cn: 美国国务院官员，曾任主管民主、人权和劳工事务的助理国务卿，于1994年2月在北京与魏京生会面。
description.en: A U.S. State Department official who served as Assistant Secretary of State for Democracy, Human Rights, and Labor, and met with Wei Jingsheng in Beijing in February 1994.

zh-cn: 北京市第一中级人民法院

description.zh-cn: 审理魏京生案并于1995年以“阴谋颠覆政府罪”判处其有期徒刑14年的法院。
description.en: The court that tried Wei Jingsheng's case and sentenced him to 14 years in prison for 'conspiring to subvert the government' in 1995.

description.zh-cn: 维吾尔族人权活动家，世界维吾尔代表大会前主席。她曾与魏京生一同被美国总统乔治·沃克·布什会见，并否认新疆存在东突厥斯坦伊斯兰运动组织。
description.en: A Uyghur human rights activist and former president of the World Uyghur Congress. She was met by U.S. President George W. Bush along with Wei Jingsheng, and has denied the existence of the ETIM organization in Xinjiang.

description.zh-cn: 中国学者和活动家，曾与魏京生一同被美国总统乔治·沃克·布什会见。
description.en: A Chinese scholar and activist, who was met by U.S. President George W. Bush along with Wei Jingsheng.

description.zh-cn: 美籍华人牧师，曾与魏京生一同被美国总统乔治·沃克·布什会见。
description.en: A Chinese American pastor, who was met by U.S. President George W. Bush along with Wei Jingsheng.

zh-cn: 共产中国与自由世界的未来
en: Communist China and the Free World's Future

description.zh-cn: 美国国务卿迈克·蓬佩奥于2020年7月23日发表的演讲，其中提及了魏京生和王丹。
description.en: A speech delivered by U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo on July 23, 2020, in which he mentioned Wei Jingsheng and Wang Dan.

description.zh-cn: 英国不列颠东印度公司雇员，在新加坡建立交易站和殖民地，被视为现代新加坡的开埠者。
description.en: An employee of the British East India Company who established a trading post and colony in Singapore, considered the founder of modern Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚的立法机构，通过修宪将新加坡驱逐出联邦。
description.en: The legislative body of Malaysia, which expelled Singapore from the federation through a constitutional amendment.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡现任总统。
description.en: The current President of Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡现任国会议长。
description.en: The current Speaker of the Parliament of Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡现任首席大法官。
description.en: The current Chief Justice of Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡游泳运动员，为新加坡赢得史上首枚奥运金牌。
description.en: A Singaporean swimmer who won Singapore's first-ever Olympic gold medal.

description.zh-cn: 美国游泳运动员，在2016年奥运会男子100米蝶泳决赛中与另外两位选手并列第二，负于约瑟·斯库林。
description.en: An American swimmer who tied for second place with two other competitors in the men's 100m butterfly final at the 2016 Olympics, losing to Joseph Schooling.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡羽毛球运动员，为新加坡获得首枚羽毛球世锦赛金牌。
description.en: A Singaporean badminton player who won Singapore's first-ever badminton world championship gold medal.

description.zh-cn: 古蜀国君主。有说法认为他“决玉垒山以除水害”，开凿了宝瓶口，是都江堰的早期建设者。
description.en: A king of the ancient Shu kingdom. According to some accounts, he 'cut through Mount Yulei to eliminate water hazards' by excavating the Baopingkou, making him an early builder of Dujiangyan.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代官职，为一个郡的最高行政长官。
description.en: An official title in ancient China, the highest administrative officer of a commandery.

description.zh-cn: 位于四川盆地西部，是都江堰工程的主要灌溉区域，被称为“天府之国”。
description.en: Located in the western part of the Sichuan Basin, it is the main irrigation area of the Dujiangyan project, known as the 'Land of Abundance'.

description.zh-cn: 元朝四川肃政谦访使，于1335年主持大修，首次引入铁石结构改造都江堰。
description.en: A Surveillance Commissioner of Sichuan during the Yuan dynasty who, in 1335, presided over a major overhaul and first introduced an iron-and-stone structure to renovate Dujiangyan.

description.zh-cn: 民国时期四川省水利局长，于1936年主持都江堰大修，采用近代设计施工方法和水泥等新材料，奠定了现代鱼嘴的基础。
description.en: Director of the Sichuan Provincial Water Conservancy Bureau during the Republic of China era who, in 1936, presided over a major overhaul of Dujiangyan using modern design, construction methods, and new materials like cement, laying the foundation for the modern Yuzui.

description.zh-cn: 1933年发生于岷江上游的地震，导致的山体滑坡形成堰塞湖，其后溃坝形成的洪水将都江堰堰首建筑全部冲毁。
description.en: An earthquake that occurred in the upper reaches of the Min River in 1933, causing landslides that formed a barrier lake. The subsequent dam failure unleashed a flood that completely destroyed the headworks of Dujiangyan.

description.zh-cn: 1981年四川发生的特大洪水，导致都江堰灌区的水利设施受到不同程度的破坏。
description.en: A major flood in Sichuan in 1981 that caused varying degrees of damage to the water conservancy facilities in the Dujiangyan irrigation area.

description.zh-cn: 经济学家，在1979至1980年间参观都江堰后深受震撼，立志要像李冰父子那样，为后世子孙的幸福贡献力量。
description.en: An economist who, after visiting Dujiangyan between 1979 and 1980, was profoundly moved and vowed to contribute to the happiness of future generations, just like Li Bing and his son.

description.zh-cn: 清朝大臣，隆科多之父，康熙帝舅父。
description.en: A minister of the Qing Dynasty, father of Longkodo, and maternal uncle of the Kangxi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 清朝官员，佟国维之父，隆科多之祖父。
description.en: An official of the Qing Dynasty, father of Tung-gowei, and grandfather of Longkodo.

description.zh-cn: 清朝官员，隆科多伯父。
description.en: An official of the Qing Dynasty, paternal uncle of Longkodo.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝第三任皇后，佟国维之女，隆科多之姊。
description.en: The third empress of the Kangxi Emperor, daughter of Tung-gowei, and elder sister of Longkodo.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝皇贵妃，隆科多之姊。
description.en: Imperial Noble Consort of the Kangxi Emperor, elder sister of Longkodo.

description.zh-cn: 满洲八大姓之一。
description.en: One of the eight great Manchu clans.

description.zh-cn: 清朝负责京师卫戍、警备和治安的官职，俗称九门提督。
description.en: An official position in the Qing Dynasty responsible for the garrison, security, and public order of the capital, commonly known as the Commander of the Nine Gates.

description.zh-cn: 清朝负责皇室仪仗、车驾等事务的机构。其前身是锦衣卫，专责此类皇室事宜。
description.en: An institution in the Qing Dynasty responsible for imperial ceremonies, carriages, and related affairs. It was renamed from the Jinyiwei and was exclusively in charge of such imperial matters.

description.zh-cn: 清朝官员，隆科多堂兄弟。
description.en: An official of the Qing Dynasty, cousin of Longkodo.

description.zh-cn: 计算机科学家，姚期智的妻子。
description.en: Computer scientist, spouse of Andrew Yao.

zh-cn: 清华大学交叉信息研究院
en: Institute for Interdisciplinary Information Sciences, Tsinghua University
American Academy of Arts and Sciences

description.zh-cn: 东亚的一个民族，中国的主体民族，也是世界上人口最多的民族。
description.en: An ethnic group in East Asia, the dominant ethnic group in China, and the largest ethnic group in the world.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国行政院副院长。
description.en: Vice Premier of the Executive Yuan of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 卓荣泰内阁的前任内阁。
description.en: The predecessor cabinet to the Cho Jung-tai cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 卓荣泰内阁首任交通部部长，后因婚外情丑闻辞职。
description.en: The first Minister of Transportation in the Cho Jung-tai cabinet, who later resigned due to an extramarital affair scandal.

description.zh-cn: 卓荣泰内阁首任教育部政务次长，后因性平案泄密辞职。
description.en: The first Political Deputy Minister of Education in the Cho Jung-tai cabinet, who resigned due to leaking information in a gender equity case.

description.zh-cn: 卓荣泰内阁经济部部长。
description.en: Minister of Economic Affairs in the Cho Jung-tai cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 卓荣泰内阁卫生福利部部长。
description.en: Minister of Health and Welfare in the Cho Jung-tai cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 卓荣泰内阁交通部部长。
description.en: Minister of Transportation and Communications in the Cho Jung-tai cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 张学良时期的警务处长，奉命处决了杨宇霆和常荫槐。
description.en: Chief of Police Affairs under Zhang Xueliang, who was ordered to execute Yang Yuting and Chang Yinhuai.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事将领，曾在江苏与孙传芳联合袭击奉军。
description.en: A military general of the Republic of China who, along with Sun Chuanfang, attacked the Fengtian army in Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 直系将领，于1918年被徐树铮枪杀。
description.en: A general of the Zhili clique who was shot dead by Xu Shuzheng in 1918.

description.zh-cn: 杨宇霆长子。
description.en: Eldest son of Yang Yuting.

description.zh-cn: 美国人类学家，其理论认为宗教相当于人文社科中的一门包罗万象的“生存之道”。
description.en: American anthropologist who theorized that religion is an all-encompassing 'way of life' within the humanities and social sciences.

description.zh-cn: 一个通常带有贬义的词汇，用于指代某些被认为是偏离主流、具有潜在危害性的新兴宗教或信仰团体。现代宗教学术界倾向于使用中性的“新兴宗教”一词。
description.en: A pejorative term for what is perceived as a deviant or dangerous new religious movement. Modern religious studies scholarship prefers the neutral term 'new religious movement'.

description.zh-cn: 古罗马哲学家，其对拉丁语“religio”的词源学解释影响了后世对宗教概念的理解。
description.en: Ancient Roman philosopher whose etymological explanation of the Latin word 'religio' influenced later understanding of the concept of religion.

description.zh-cn: 中国哲学家，指出翻译词“宗教”在中文中有其特定意义，不能与所有带“教”字的词汇混淆。
description.en: Chinese philosopher who pointed out that the translated term 'religion' has a specific meaning in Chinese and should not be confused with all words containing the character '教'.

description.zh-cn: 现代知名僧人，将“宗教”定义为“尊崇的教化”。
description.en: Well-known modern monk who defined 'religion' as 'revered teachings'.

description.zh-cn: 台湾僧人，法鼓山创办人，认为“有所宗而以为教者，即为宗教”。
description.en: Taiwanese monk, founder of Dharma Drum Mountain, who defined religion as 'that which has a principle and is taken as a teaching'.

description.zh-cn: 由释圣严法师创立的台湾佛教组织。
description.en: A Taiwanese Buddhist organization founded by Master Sheng-yen.

description.zh-cn: 英国考古学家、人类学家，提出万物有灵论作为宗教起源的理论。
description.en: British archaeologist and anthropologist who proposed animism as a theory for the origin of religion.

description.zh-cn: 一种宗教起源理论，认为原始人基于对梦境、呼吸等现象的观察，产生了万物皆有灵魂（Anima）的概念。
description.en: A theory of the origin of religion suggesting that primitive humans, based on observations of phenomena like dreams and breath, developed the concept that all things possess a soul (Anima).

description.zh-cn: 苏格兰社会人类学家，提出巫术论，认为人类精神发展经历了从巫术到宗教再到科学的阶段。
description.en: Scottish social anthropologist who proposed the magic theory, arguing that human intellectual development progresses from magic through religion to science.

description.zh-cn: 一种准宗教现象，认为通过特定行为（如接触律或相似律）可以控制自然。在弗雷泽的理论中，巫术是宗教的前身。
description.en: A quasi-religious phenomenon based on the belief that nature can be controlled through specific actions (e.g., law of contact or similarity). In Frazer's theory, magic is the precursor to religion.
