description.zh-cn: 一种系统性的知识体系，通过可检验的解释和对宇宙的预测来建立和组织知识。在弗雷泽的理论中，科学是继宗教之后的人类精神发展阶段。
description.en: A systematic enterprise that builds and organizes knowledge in the form of testable explanations and predictions about the universe. In Frazer's theory, science is the stage of human intellectual development that follows religion.

description.zh-cn: 德国哲学家、东方学家，提出“语言疾病学说”来解释神话和宗教的起源。
description.en: German philologist and Orientalist who proposed the 'disease of language' theory to explain the origin of myth and religion.

description.zh-cn: 英国人类学家，功能论的提出者之一，认为宗教旨在满足个体的心理需求。
description.en: British anthropologist, a proponent of functionalism, who argued that religion serves to satisfy individual psychological needs.

description.zh-cn: 一种社会学和人类学理论，认为宗教等社会制度的存在是为了满足个体或社会的特定需求（如心理慰藉、社会团结）。
description.en: A sociological and anthropological theory which holds that social institutions like religion exist to fulfill specific needs of individuals or society (e.g., psychological comfort, social cohesion).

description.zh-cn: 法国人类学家，提出神话结构学说，认为神话反映了人类心灵的共同结构。
description.en: French anthropologist who developed structural anthropology, arguing that myths reflect the common structures of the human mind.

description.zh-cn: 英国哲学家、逻辑学家，对宗教持批判态度，从逻辑和科学角度对有神论提出质疑。
description.en: British philosopher and logician who was a prominent critic of religion, questioning theism from logical and scientific perspectives.

description.zh-cn: 在一神论宗教中被认为是至高无上的、宇宙的创造者和统治者的存在。
description.en: The supreme being, creator, and principal object of faith in monotheistic religions.

description.zh-cn: 英国哲学家，著名的理性有神论者，认为宇宙的高度秩序性为一神论提供了证据。
description.en: British philosopher and a leading proponent of theistic arguments, who argues that the high degree of order in the universe provides evidence for theism.

description.zh-cn: 相信只存在一个神或至高无上存在的宗教或哲学信仰。
description.en: The belief in one god or in the oneness of God.

description.zh-cn: 德裔美国神学家、哲学家，主张宗教与科学有本质区别，寻求的真理在不同意域（分离论）。
description.en: German-American theologian and philosopher who argued that religion and science are fundamentally different, seeking truth in different domains (separation theory).

zh-cn: 弗里德里希·施莱尔马赫

description.zh-cn: 德国神学家、哲学家，宗教情感论的代表人物，认为宗教的本质是“对无限者的情感”和“绝对的依存感”。
description.en: German theologian and philosopher, a key figure in religious emotionalism, who defined the essence of religion as a 'feeling for the infinite' and a 'feeling of absolute dependence'.

description.zh-cn: 德国神学家，认为宗教的核心是对“神圣者”（the Numinous）的体验，这种体验包含敬畏与向往的交织情感。
description.en: German theologian who argued that the core of religion is the experience of 'the Numinous', an experience characterized by a mixture of awe (mysterium tremendum) and fascination (fascinans).

description.zh-cn: 法国数学家、物理学家、哲学家，提出了著名的“帕斯卡的赌注”，是宗教意志论的先驱。
description.en: French mathematician, physicist, and philosopher who formulated the famous 'Pascal's Wager', a precursor to religious voluntarism.

description.zh-cn: 美国哲学家、心理学家，宗教意志论的重要发展者，认为在证据不足的情况下，人有权基于实践和意志的理由去选择信仰。
description.en: American philosopher and psychologist, a key developer of religious voluntarism, who argued that one has the right to believe based on practical and volitional grounds when evidence is insufficient.

description.zh-cn: 将儒家思想体系视为一种宗教信仰的观点或运动，强调其祭祀、礼仪和教义等宗教性元素。
description.en: The view or movement that treats the Confucian system of thought as a religion, emphasizing its religious elements such as rituals, ceremonies, and doctrines.

description.zh-cn: 梅兰芳的幼子，梅派艺术的传人。
description.en: The youngest son of Mei Lanfang and an heir to the Mei School of Peking Opera.

description.zh-cn: 中国画家，曾教梅兰芳画工虫。
description.en: A Chinese painter who taught Mei Lanfang how to paint insects.

description.zh-cn: 戏曲理论家，梅兰芳的良师益友，介绍梅兰芳与齐白石相识。
description.en: An opera theorist, a good teacher and helpful friend to Mei Lanfang, who introduced Mei to Qi Baishi.

description.zh-cn: 民国时期京剧四个旦角行当的代表演员的合称，包括梅兰芳、程砚秋、尚小云、荀慧生。
description.en: A collective name for four representative Dan role actors of Peking Opera during the Republican era, including Mei Lanfang, Cheng Yanqiu, Shang Xiaoyun, and Xun Huisheng.

description.zh-cn: 京剧“四大名旦”之一，梅兰芳的学生。
description.en: One of the "Four Great Dan" of Peking Opera and a student of Mei Lanfang.

description.zh-cn: 京剧“四大名旦”之一。
description.en: One of the "Four Great Dan" of Peking Opera.

description.zh-cn: 京剧“四大名旦”之一。
description.en: One of the "Four Great Dan" of Peking Opera.

description.zh-cn: 窝阔台的皇后，负责抚育蒙哥长大。
description.en: A queen of Ögedei Khan, responsible for raising Möngke Khan.

description.zh-cn: 拔都的弟弟，率军护送并支持蒙哥召开忽里台登基。
description.en: Younger brother of Batu Khan, who led an army to escort and support Möngke's enthronement at the Kurultai.

description.zh-cn: 贵由的皇后，在贵由死后临朝称制，反对蒙哥继位，后被处死。
description.en: Wife of Güyük Khan, who acted as regent after his death, opposed Möngke's succession, and was later executed.

description.zh-cn: 蒙古帝国第二次向西方的远征，蒙哥参与其中并建立了战功。
description.en: The second Mongol invasion of the West, in which Möngke participated and achieved military merit.

description.zh-cn: 钦察部落首领，在第二次蒙古西征中被蒙哥活捉。
description.en: A leader of the Kipchaks, captured alive by Möngke during the second Mongol invasion of the West.

description.zh-cn: 位于今中国云南地区的政权，被忽必烈奉蒙哥之命所灭。
description.en: A kingdom located in modern-day Yunnan, China, which was conquered by Kublai under Möngke's orders.

description.zh-cn: 大理国末代国王，投降蒙古后被任命为大理总管。
description.en: The last king of the Dali Kingdom, who surrendered to the Mongols and was appointed as the General Administrator of Dali.

description.zh-cn: 由旭烈兀领导的蒙古帝国第三次西征，征服了西亚大片地区，建立了伊儿汗国。
description.en: The third Mongol invasion of the West, led by Hulagu, which conquered large parts of West Asia and established the Ilkhanate.

description.zh-cn: 位于西亚的伊斯兰教派国家，于1256年被旭烈兀西征军所灭。
description.en: An Islamic sectarian state in West Asia, destroyed by Hulagu's army in 1256.

description.zh-cn: 位于叙利亚地区的王朝，于1260年被旭烈兀西征军所灭。
description.en: A dynasty in the region of Syria, destroyed by Hulagu's army in 1260.

description.zh-cn: 南宋与蒙古在钓鱼城的一场关键战役，蒙古大汗蒙哥在此战中身亡。
description.en: A key battle between the Southern Song and the Mongols at Diaoyu Fortress, where the Great Khan Möngke died in action.

description.zh-cn: 法国传教士，受路易九世派遣出使蒙古，并觐见了蒙哥汗。
description.en: A French missionary sent by Louis IX on a mission to the Mongol Empire, where he had an audience with Möngke Khan.

description.zh-cn: 法国国王，派遣传教士卢布鲁克出使蒙古。
description.en: King of France who dispatched the missionary William of Rubruck on a mission to the Mongols.

description.zh-cn: 小亚美尼亚国王，归附蒙古帝国，曾亲自前往哈拉和林觐见蒙哥。
description.en: King of Armenian Cilicia, who submitted to the Mongol Empire and personally traveled to Karakorum for an audience with Möngke.

description.zh-cn: 蒙哥的大皇后，弘吉剌部人。
description.en: The chief empress of Möngke Khan, from the Onggirat tribe.

description.zh-cn: 蒙哥的长子，由忽都台皇后所生。
description.en: The eldest son of Möngke Khan, born to Empress Qutuqtai.

description.zh-cn: 蒙哥的次子。
description.en: The second son of Möngke Khan.

description.zh-cn: 蒙哥的三子，由忽都台皇后所生。
description.en: The third son of Möngke Khan, born to Empress Qutuqtai.

description.zh-cn: 蒙哥的四子。
description.en: The fourth son of Möngke Khan.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军少将，2022年4月起担任第七十三集团军军长。
description.en: A major general in the PLA Ground Force, serving as the commander of the 73rd Group Army since April 2022.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军将领，曾任华东野战军第13纵队司令员和改编后的第三十一军首任军长。
description.en: PLA general who served as the commander of the 13th Column of the East China Field Army and the first commander of the reorganized 31st Corps.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军将领，曾任华东野战军第13纵队政治委员。
description.en: PLA general who served as the political commissar of the 13th Column of the East China Field Army.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军第三野战军

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在第二次国共内战时期的主力部队之一，由华东野战军改编而成。第三十一军曾隶属于其第十兵团。
description.en: One of the main forces of the PLA during the Second Chinese Civil War, reorganized from the East China Field Army. The 31st Corps was subordinate to its 10th Army Group.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军攻占漳州和厦门地区的战役，第三十一军是主力之一。
description.en: The campaign for the PLA to capture the Zhangzhou and Xiamen areas, where the 31st Corps was one of the main forces.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军将领，曾任第三十一军政治委员。
description.en: PLA general who served as the political commissar of the 31st Corps.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军少将，担任新组建的第七十三集团军首任军长。
description.en: A major general in the PLA Ground Force, serving as the first commander of the newly formed 73rd Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军少将，担任新组建的第七十三集团军首任政治委员。
description.en: A major general in the PLA Ground Force, serving as the first political commissar of the newly formed 73rd Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军将领，曾任陆军第三十一集团军军长。
description.en: PLA general who served as the commander of the 31st Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 由朱利安·阿桑奇于2006年创立的揭密网站，专门发布匿名来源和网络泄露的文档。
description.en: A whistle-blowing website founded by Julian Assange in 2006, which publishes news leaks and classified media provided by anonymous sources.

description.zh-cn: 美国活动家和告密者，前美国陆军士兵，因向维基解密泄露机密文件而被定罪。
description.en: American activist and whistleblower. She is a former United States Army soldier who was convicted for disclosing to WikiLeaks classified documents.

description.zh-cn: 曾向朱利安·阿桑奇提供政治庇护，允许其在其驻英国大使馆居住了近七年。
description.en: Granted political asylum to Julian Assange, allowing him to reside in its embassy in the UK for nearly seven years.

description.zh-cn: 厄瓜多尔政治家，曾任厄瓜多尔总统。在其任内，厄瓜多尔撤销了对朱利安·阿桑奇的政治庇护。
description.en: Ecuadorian politician who served as the President of Ecuador. During his term, Ecuador revoked Julian Assange's political asylum.

description.zh-cn: 负责大伦敦地区（除伦敦城外）执法的英国警察机构，由伦敦市长通过市长警务和犯罪问题办公室进行监督。该机构曾负责执行逮捕朱利安·阿桑奇的行动。
description.en: The UK police force responsible for law enforcement in Greater London, excluding the City of London. It is overseen by the Mayor of London through the Mayor's Office for Policing and Crime. This agency was notably responsible for arresting Julian Assange.

description.zh-cn: 美国联邦法律，美国政府据此对朱利安·阿桑奇提出多项指控。
description.en: A United States federal law under which the U.S. government brought multiple charges against Julian Assange.

description.zh-cn: 律师，朱利安·阿桑奇的妻子。
description.en: A lawyer and the wife of Julian Assange.

description.zh-cn: 澳大利亚的一所公立研究型大学，朱利安·阿桑奇曾在此学习物理与数学。
description.en: A public research university in Australia where Julian Assange studied physics and mathematics.

description.zh-cn: 一个中国高空气球飞越北美上空，被美国击落。此事件导致美国国务卿布林肯取消访华行程，进一步加剧了双边关系的紧张。
description.en: A Chinese high-altitude balloon flew over North America and was shot down by the United States. The incident led to U.S. Secretary of State Antony Blinken's cancellation of his trip to China, further escalating bilateral tensions.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国和美利坚合众国关于建立外交关系的联合公报
en: Joint Communiqué on the Establishment of Diplomatic Relations

description.zh-cn: 中美三个联合公报中的第二个，宣布两国自1979年1月1日起正式建立大使级外交关系。
description.en: The second of the three US-China Joint Communiqués, announcing the formal establishment of ambassadorial-level diplomatic relations between the two countries as of January 1, 1979.

zh-cn: 巴拉克·奥巴马政府的东亚外交政策
en: East Asian foreign policy of the Obama administration
East Asian foreign policy of the Barack Obama administration

description.zh-cn: 美国奥巴马政府提出的外交战略，旨在将美国的战略重心转向亚太地区，以应对中国经济和军事力量的持续增加。
description.en: A foreign policy strategy proposed by the Obama administration to shift America's strategic focus to the Asia-Pacific region in response to the continued growth of China's economic and military power.

description.zh-cn: 韩国独立运动家，金九的前任大韩民国临时政府主席。
description.en: Korean independence activist, predecessor of Kim Gu as the President of the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 韩国独立运动家，曾担任大韩民国临时政府主席，并劝说金九出任国务领。
description.en: Korean independence activist who served as President of the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea and persuaded Kim Gu to take the position of State Councillor.

description.zh-cn: 金九的出生地。
description.en: The birthplace of Kim Gu.

description.zh-cn: 金九逝世的城市。
description.en: The city where Kim Gu died.

description.zh-cn: 金九等人于1928年成立的韩国独立运动政党，后于1940年与其他党派合并重组。
description.en: A Korean independence movement political party founded by Kim Gu and others in 1928, which later merged and reorganized with other parties in 1940.

zh-cn: 驻朝鲜美国陆军司令部军政厅
en: United States Army Military Government in Korea

description.zh-cn: 二战后在朝鲜半岛南部实行军事统治的美国机构，不支持大韩民国临时政府，并扶持李承晚政权。
description.en: The American agency that exercised military rule in the southern Korean Peninsula after World War II, did not support the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea, and backed the Syngman Rhee regime.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜半岛19世纪的宗教运动组织，金九于1893年加入。
description.en: A 19th-century religious movement organization on the Korean Peninsula, which Kim Gu joined in 1893.

description.zh-cn: 由金九在九一八事变后成立的敢死队，旨在通过暗杀等手段打击日本侵略者。
description.en: A secret organization founded by Kim Gu after the Mukden Incident, aimed at fighting against Japanese invaders through methods such as assassination.

description.zh-cn: 韩人爱国团成员，在上海虹口公园成功炸死多名日军高级将领。
description.en: A member of the Korean Patriotic Corps who successfully bombed and killed several high-ranking Japanese military officials in Shanghai's Hongkou Park.

description.zh-cn: 韩国独立运动家，其遗骸与李奉昌、尹奉吉一同被金九运回国安葬。
description.en: A Korean independence activist whose remains were returned to Korea for burial by Kim Gu, along with those of Lee Bong-chang and Yun Bong-gil.

description.zh-cn: 香港电影公司，施南生在80年代在此工作，并创造了港产片的黄金时代。
description.en: A Hong Kong film company where Nansun Shi worked in the 1980s, contributing to the golden age of Hong Kong cinema.

description.zh-cn: 香港一家收费电视台，施南生曾协助其开创。
description.en: A pay television station in Hong Kong which Nansun Shi helped to establish.

description.zh-cn: 一家收费电视公司，施南生曾协助其开创业务。
description.en: A pay television company whose business Nansun Shi helped to establish.

description.zh-cn: 位于香港的学校，施南生的小学及中学母校。
description.en: A school in Hong Kong, which is the primary and secondary school alma mater of Nansun Shi.

description.zh-cn: 在该届颁奖典礼上，施南生获颁终身成就奖。
description.en: At this awards ceremony, Nansun Shi was awarded the Lifetime Achievement Award.

description.zh-cn: 台湾电影女演员，为施南生颁发第43届香港电影金像奖终身成就奖。
description.en: A Taiwanese actress who presented the Lifetime Achievement Award to Nansun Shi at the 43rd Hong Kong Film Awards.

description.zh-cn: 在该届影展上，施南生获得金摄影奖。
description.en: At this film festival, Nansun Shi received the Berlinale Camera award.

description.zh-cn: 台湾新竹市的最高行政首长职位。
description.en: The chief executive position of Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 台湾新竹市议会的民意代表职位。
description.en: The position of a representative in the Hsinchu City Council, Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 指控时任新竹市市长林智坚在国立台湾大学和中华大学的硕士论文涉嫌抄袭，并最终被认定为抄袭的学术争议事件。此事件导致林智坚的双硕士学位皆被撤销，引发其退出2022年桃园市长选举，并使其指导教授陈明通受到调查。
description.en: Refers to an academic controversy and political incident where then-Hsinchu Mayor Lin Chih-chien's master's theses from National Taiwan University and Chung Hua University were accused and subsequently confirmed to be plagiarized. This led to the revocation of both his master's degrees, his withdrawal from the 2022 Taoyuan mayoral election, and an investigation into his advisor, Chen Ming-tong.

description.zh-cn: 台湾新竹市的一所私立大学，林智坚在此获得学士学位，但其硕士学位后因抄袭被撤销。
description.en: A private university in Hsinchu City, Taiwan, where Lin Chih-chien obtained his bachelor's degree. His master's degree from the university was later revoked due to plagiarism.

description.zh-cn: 台湾棒球选手，在新竹棒球场开幕赛中因场地问题严重受伤，导致其赛季报销。
description.en: A Taiwanese baseball player who suffered a severe, season-ending injury during the inaugural game at the Hsinchu Baseball Stadium due to poor field conditions.

description.zh-cn: 三立电视董事长，于2024年延揽林智坚至旗下永兴资本公司担任总经理。
description.en: Chairman of Sanlih E-Television. In 2024, he recruited Lin Chih-chien to serve as the general manager of its subsidiary, Yong-Xing Capital.

description.zh-cn: 台湾的一家主要电视台，其董事长为张荣华。
description.en: A major television station in Taiwan, chaired by Chang Jung-hua.

zh-cn: 台湾省立竹东高级中学

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾新竹县竹东镇的一所高级中学，为林智坚的母校。
description.en: A senior high school located in Zhudong Township, Hsinchu County, Taiwan. It is Lin Chih-chien's alma mater.

zh-cn: 新竹市立培英国民中学
en: Hsinchu Pei Ying Junior High School

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾新竹市的一所国民中学，为林智坚的母校。
description.en: A junior high school in Hsinchu City, Taiwan, and Lin Chih-chien's alma mater.

zh-cn: 新竹市东区东园国民小学

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾新竹市东区的一所国民小学，为林智坚的母校之一。
description.en: An elementary school in East District, Hsinchu City, Taiwan, one of Lin Chih-chien's alma maters.

zh-cn: 新竹市北区民富国民小学
新竹县新竹市民富国民小学

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾新竹市北区的一所国民小学，为林智坚的母校之一。
description.en: An elementary school in North District, Hsinchu City, Taiwan, one of Lin Chih-chien's alma maters.

description.zh-cn: 台湾北部的一个直辖市，林智坚曾被提名为该市市长候选人。
description.en: A special municipality in northern Taiwan for which Lin Chih-chien was nominated as a mayoral candidate.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东的理论著作，在延安整风运动中被指定为学习文件，并被认为是毛泽东主义（毛泽东思想）最重要的基础理论著作。
description.en: A theoretical work by Mao Zedong, designated as a study document during the Yan'an Rectification Movement and considered the most important foundational theoretical work of Maoism (Mao Zedong Thought).

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，现任中国人民银行行长、党委书记。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, currently serving as the Governor and Party Committee Secretary of the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，现任中国人民银行副行长、国家外汇管理局局长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, currently serving as a Deputy Governor of the People's Bank of China and Administrator of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，现任中国人民银行副行长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, currently serving as a Deputy Governor of the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，现任中国人民银行副行长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, currently serving as a Deputy Governor of the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，现任中国人民银行副行长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, currently serving as a Deputy Governor of the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，现任中国人民银行副行长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, currently serving as a Deputy Governor of the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，现任中央纪委国家监委驻中国人民银行纪检监察组组长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, currently serving as the head of the Discipline Inspection and Supervision Group of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the National Supervisory Commission stationed at the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民银行的前身之一，1948年与华北银行、西北农民银行合并组建中国人民银行。
description.en: One of the predecessors of the People's Bank of China, which merged with Huabei Bank and Northwest Farmers Bank in 1948 to form the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国河北省的省会，中国人民银行的成立地。
description.en: The capital city of Hebei Province, China, and the place where the People's Bank of China was founded.

zh-cn: 中国银行业监督管理委员会

description.zh-cn: 原中华人民共和国国务院直属正部级事业单位，负责监管银行业金融机构。其职能由中国人民银行分离而出。
description.en: Formerly a ministerial-level public institution directly under the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for regulating banking financial institutions. Its functions were separated from the People's Bank of China.

zh-cn: 国务院金融稳定发展委员会

description.zh-cn: 原国务院统筹协调金融稳定和改革发展重大问题的议事协调机构，其办公室曾设在中国人民银行。
description.en: The former deliberative and coordinating body of the State Council for coordinating major issues of financial stability, reform, and development, whose office was once located in the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中国人民银行行长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, former Governor of the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中国人民银行行长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, former Governor of the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中国人民银行行长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, former Governor of the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中国人民银行行长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, former Governor of the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中国人民银行行长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, former Governor of the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 首任民选花莲县县长。
description.en: The first democratically elected Magistrate of Hualien County.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，首位中国国民党籍花莲县县长。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China, the first Kuomintang Magistrate of Hualien County.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，首位外省籍及军职出身的花莲县县长。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China, the first Magistrate of Hualien County from mainland China and with a military background.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾两度担任花莲县县长并担任台湾省政府委员。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who served twice as the Magistrate of Hualien County and as a member of the Taiwan Provincial Government council.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾任花莲县县长及台湾肥料董事长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who served as the Magistrate of Hualien County and Chairman of Taiwan Fertilizer.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任花莲县县长。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China, served as the Magistrate of Hualien County.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，任内因病逝世的花莲县县长。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China, served as the Magistrate of Hualien County and passed away in office.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾以台湾省政府主席身份兼任代理花莲县县长。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China, served as the acting Magistrate of Hualien County concurrently while being the Chairman of the Taiwan Provincial Government.

description.zh-cn: 唐代的一种官职，多为有才艺者担任，侍奉于皇帝左右。
description.en: An official title in the Tang dynasty, often held by talented individuals who served the emperor.

description.zh-cn: 李白创作的一首五言绝句，是其代表作之一。
description.en: A five-character quatrain written by Li Bai, one of his most representative works.

description.zh-cn: 李白创作的一首乐府诗，是其代表作之一。
description.en: A yuefu poem written by Li Bai, one of his most representative works.

description.zh-cn: 李白创作的一首乐府诗，是其代表作之一。
description.en: A yuefu poem written by Li Bai, one of his most representative works.

en: Leaving Baidi Town Early in the Morning

description.zh-cn: 李白创作的一首七言绝句，是其代表作之一。
description.en: A seven-character quatrain written by Li Bai, one of his most representative works.

description.zh-cn: 唐代的一个州，位于今四川省境内，是李白的成长地。
description.en: A prefecture in the Tang dynasty, located in modern-day Sichuan province, where Li Bai grew up.

description.zh-cn: 唐代绵州下辖的一个县，被认为是李白的出生地之一。
description.en: A county under Mian Prefecture in the Tang dynasty, considered one of Li Bai's possible birthplaces.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国西南的古代国家，后被汉朝所灭。
description.en: An ancient state in southwestern China, which was later extinguished by the Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 唐代益州长史，曾称赞年轻的李白“天才英丽，下笔不休”。
description.en: The governor of Yizhou in the Tang dynasty, who praised the young Li Bai for his 'brilliant talent and ceaseless writing'.

description.zh-cn: 唐代名士，与李白等人隐居于徂徕山，并称为“竹溪六逸”。
description.en: A renowned scholar of the Tang dynasty who, along with Li Bai and others, lived in seclusion on Mount Culai. They were known as the 'Six Idlers of the Bamboo Brook'.

description.zh-cn: 李白诗文集，其早期版本由李阳冰编订。
description.en: The collection of Li Bai's poems and writings, with an early version compiled by Li Yangbing.

description.zh-cn: 海外华侨社团，中国致公党的前身。
description.en: An overseas Chinese society, the predecessor of the China Zhi Gong Party.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中国致公党第4至6届中央委员会主席。在反右运动中被划为右派，后在文革期间被迫害致死。
description.en: Served as the Chairman of the 4th to 6th Central Committees of the China Zhi Gong Party. He was labeled a rightist during the Anti-Rightist Campaign and was persecuted to death during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中国致公党第7、8届中央委员会主席。
description.en: Served as the Chairman of the 7th and 8th Central Committees of the China Zhi Gong Party.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中国致公党第9、10届中央委员会主席，是罗豪才的前任。他也是一位印尼华侨。
description.en: A Chinese politician, he served as the Chairman of the 9th and 10th Central Committees of the China Zhi Gong Party, and was a predecessor to Luo Haocai. He was also an Indonesian overseas Chinese.

description.zh-cn: 祖籍福建安溪的新加坡归国华侨，中国共产党党员，中华人民共和国法学家、教育家、社会活动家及政治人物。曾任国家级副职领导人，是中国现代行政法学的开拓者与奠基人。他还担任过中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会副主席、中国致公党中央委员会主席、中华人民共和国最高人民法院副院长等职务。
description.en: Luo Haocai was a returned overseas Chinese from Singapore with ancestral roots in Anxi, Fujian. He was a member of the Communist Party of China, a jurist, educator, social activist, and political figure of the People's Republic of China. He served as a deputy national leader and is recognized as a pioneer and founder of modern administrative law in China. His prominent roles included Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, Chairman of the Central Committee of the China Zhi Gong Party, and Vice President of the Supreme People's Court of the PRC.

description.zh-cn: 一场军事行动，期间陈炯明的军队被击败，导致中国致公党总部迁至香港。
description.en: A military campaign during which Chen Jiongming's army was defeated, leading to the relocation of the China Zhi Gong Party headquarters to Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 一个历史悠久的民间社团，与中国致公党的源流有关。
description.en: A historical fraternal organization with ties to the origins of the China Zhi Gong Party.

description.zh-cn: 中国清代的民间秘密社团。
description.en: A secret society in China during the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 中国致公党中央副主席，四川省副省长。
description.en: Vice Chairman of the Central Committee of the China Zhi Gong Party and Vice Governor of Sichuan Province.

description.zh-cn: 曾任天津市副市长，致公党党员。
description.en: Former Vice Mayor of Tianjin and a member of the China Zhi Gong Party.

zh-cn: 中国致公党中央委员会
en: Central Committee of the China Zhi Gong Party

description.zh-cn: 中国致公党的最高执行机关。
description.en: The highest executive body of the China Zhi Gong Party.

description.zh-cn: 中国致公党代表，参加了中国人民政治协商会议第一届全体会议。
description.en: A representative of the China Zhi Gong Party who attended the first plenary session of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 中国致公党代表，参加了中国人民政治协商会议第一届全体会议。
description.en: A representative of the China Zhi Gong Party who attended the first plenary session of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 中国致公党代表，参加了中国人民政治协商会议第一届全体会议。
description.en: A representative of the China Zhi Gong Party who attended the first plenary session of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 中国致公党代表，参加了中国人民政治协商会议第一届全体会议。
description.en: A representative of the China Zhi Gong Party who attended the first plenary session of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 中国致公党的成立地点。
description.en: The founding location of the China Zhi Gong Party.

description.zh-cn: 反右运动期间被划定的政治标签，指代被认为是反对共产党和中国社会主义制度的个人或群体。
description.en: A political label designated during the Anti-Rightist Campaign, referring to individuals or groups considered to be opposing the Communist Party and the socialist system in China.

description.zh-cn: 中国经济学家，在反右运动中被划为右派。
description.en: A Chinese economist who was labeled a rightist during the Anti-Rightist Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 一种政党制度，指国内只存在唯一一个执政党。反右运动后，中国共产党实质性一党专政的局面得到巩固。
description.en: A type of party system in which a single political party forms the government. After the Anti-Rightist Campaign, the de facto one-party dictatorship of the CPC was consolidated.

description.zh-cn: 指国家权力集中于一人之手的政治局面。反右运动后，毛泽东的个人权威达到顶峰，形成一人独裁的局面。
description.en: A political situation where state power is concentrated in the hands of one person. After the Anti-Rightist Campaign, Mao Zedong's personal authority reached its peak, leading to a one-man dictatorship.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党提出的促进艺术发展和科学进步的方针，鼓励知识分子发表意见，后被认为是引诱批评者暴露以便打击的“阳谋”。
description.en: A policy promoted by the CPC to encourage the development of arts and sciences by allowing free expression of different views, later considered a stratagem to entice critics to reveal themselves for subsequent persecution.

description.zh-cn: 1956年在匈牙利发生的全国性民众反抗运动，该事件的发生使毛泽东对政权稳固感到担忧，影响了他对“鸣放”的态度。
description.en: A nationwide popular uprising in Hungary in 1956, which caused Mao Zedong to worry about the stability of his regime and influenced his attitude towards the "Blooming and Contending" period.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东撰写的党内指示，分析了当时“鸣放”中的政治动向，为即将开始的反右运动提供了理论准备。
description.en: An internal party directive written by Mao Zedong, analyzing the political trends during the "Blooming and Contending" period and providing theoretical preparation for the impending Anti-Rightist Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 1930年下半年起，中国共产党在中央苏区内部发动的肃清所谓“AB团”的政治运动，造成大量党员和干部被错杀。
description.en: A political purge launched by the Chinese Communist Party within the Central Soviet Area starting in the second half of 1930 to eliminate the so-called "AB League", resulting in the wrongful execution of numerous party members and cadres.

zh-cn: 中国工农红军第二十军

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军的一支部队，因发动富田事变，最终被缴械整肃，番号被取消。
description.en: A unit of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, which was disarmed and purged, and its designation cancelled, after launching the Futian Incident.

description.zh-cn: 指对错案进行纠正，恢复受害者名誉的政治行为。此处特指为富田事变相关人员恢复名誉的努力。
description.en: Refers to the political act of correcting a wrongful case and rehabilitating the reputation of the victims. Specifically refers to the efforts to rehabilitate those involved in the Futian Incident.

description.zh-cn: 红二十军政委，在部队被缴械后遭处决。
description.en: Political Commissar of the Red 20th Army, executed after the unit was disarmed.

zh-cn: 历史与阶级意识：关于马克思主义辩证法的研究
黑格尔主义的马克思主义
en: Geschichte und Klassenbewußtsein. Studien über marxistische Dialektik
History and Class Consciousness: Studies in Marxist Dialectics

description.zh-cn: 匈牙利马克思主义哲学家卢卡奇·格奥尔格的主要著作，收录了他在1919年至1922年间撰写的8篇论文，被认为是西方马克思主义的奠基之作之一。
description.en: A major work by the Hungarian Marxist philosopher György Lukács, compiling eight essays written between 1919 and 1922, and is considered one of the foundational texts of Western Marxism.

description.zh-cn: 匈牙利马克思主义哲学家，《历史与阶级意识》的作者，被认为是西方马克思主义的创始人之一。
description.en: Hungarian Marxist philosopher, author of 'History and Class Consciousness', and considered one of the founders of Western Marxism.

description.zh-cn: 弗里德里希·恩格斯提出的一套理论，试图将马克思主义的辩证法应用于自然科学。
description.en: A theory proposed by Friedrich Engels attempting to apply Marxist dialectics to natural science.

description.zh-cn: 一个社会学概念，指在资本主义社会中，人与人之间的社会关系被转化为物与物之间的关系，从而掩盖了社会关系的本质。
description.en: A sociological concept where social relations between people in a capitalist society are transformed into relations between things, thereby obscuring the true nature of these social relations.

description.zh-cn: 20世纪20年代以来在西欧和中欧发展起来的一种马克思主义思潮，强调马克思主义的哲学和文化层面。
description.en: A current of Marxist theory that arose from Western and Central Europe in the aftermath of the 1917 October Revolution, emphasizing the philosophical and cultural dimensions of Marxism.

description.zh-cn: 马克思主义理论中的一个社会阶级，指在资本主义社会中不占有生产资料，靠出卖劳动力为生的雇佣工人阶级。
description.en: A social class in Marxist theory, referring to the wage-earning workers in a capitalist society who do not own the means of production and live by selling their labor power.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任中国共产党佛山市委员会书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, currently serving as the Secretary of the Foshan Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任佛山市人民代表大会常务委员会主任。
description.en: Chinese politician, currently serving as the Director of the Standing Committee of the Foshan Municipal People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，蒙古族，现任佛山市人民政府市长。
description.en: Chinese politician of Mongol ethnicity, currently serving as the Mayor of the Foshan Municipal People's Government.

zh-cn: 中国共产党佛山市委员会
en: Foshan Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在佛山市的地方组织。
description.en: The local organization of the Communist Party of China in Foshan.

zh-cn: 佛山市人民代表大会常务委员会
en: Standing Committee of Foshan Municipal People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 佛山市人民代表大会的常设机关。
description.en: The standing body of the Foshan Municipal People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 佛山市的国家行政机关。
description.en: The state administrative organ of Foshan City.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中国共产党佛山市委员会书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Secretary of the Foshan Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 明朝佛山乡绅，曾组织地方武装镇压农民起义。
description.en: A local gentleman of Foshan during the Ming dynasty, who organized local armed forces to suppress a peasant uprising.

description.zh-cn: 清朝咸丰年间太平军将领，曾在佛山建立根据地。
description.en: A general of the Taiping Army during the Xianfeng era of the Qing dynasty, who established a base in Foshan.

description.zh-cn: 总部位于佛山顺德的中国跨国科技集团和家电制造商。
description.en: A Chinese multinational technology group and home appliance manufacturer headquartered in Shunde, Foshan.

description.zh-cn: 总部位于佛山顺德的中国房地产开发公司。
description.en: A Chinese real estate development company headquartered in Shunde, Foshan.

description.zh-cn: 总部位于佛山的中国调味品生产和销售公司。
description.en: A Chinese condiment production and sales company headquartered in Foshan.

description.zh-cn: 美国企业家，与比尔·盖茨共同创办了微软公司。
description.en: American business magnate who co-founded Microsoft Corporation with Bill Gates.

description.zh-cn: 美国慈善家，比尔·盖茨的前妻，比尔及梅琳达·盖茨基金会的联合创始人。
description.en: American philanthropist, former wife of Bill Gates, and co-founder of the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation.

description.zh-cn: 美国律师，比尔·盖茨的父亲。
description.en: American attorney and father of Bill Gates.

description.zh-cn: 美国商界女性，曾任银行董事，是比尔·盖茨的母亲。
description.en: American businesswoman who served on a bank's board of directors, and was the mother of Bill Gates.

description.zh-cn: 位于西雅图的一所私立学校，比尔·盖茨和保罗·艾伦曾在此就读。
description.en: A private school in Seattle, attended by Bill Gates and Paul Allen.

zh-cn: 比尔及梅琳达·盖茨基金会

description.zh-cn: 由比尔·盖茨和梅琳达·盖茨夫妇创办的美国私人基金会，是全球最大的私人基金会之一。
description.en: An American private foundation founded by Bill and Melinda Gates, one of the largest private foundations in the world.

description.zh-cn: 印度裔美国商业高管，自2014年起担任微软首席执行官。
description.en: Indian-American business executive who has been the chief executive officer of Microsoft since 2014.

description.zh-cn: 一家美国跨国集团控股公司。
description.en: An American multinational conglomerate holding company.

description.zh-cn: 美国华盛顿州的一座城市，是比尔·盖茨的出生地。
description.en: A city in the U.S. state of Washington, the birthplace of Bill Gates.

description.zh-cn: 国际商业机器公司，是一家美国跨国科技和咨询公司。
description.en: International Business Machines Corporation, an American multinational technology and consulting company.

description.zh-cn: 微软公司为个人电脑开发的磁盘操作系统，是公司早期成功的关键。
description.en: A disk operating system for personal computers developed by Microsoft, which was key to the company's early success.

description.zh-cn: 美国跨国科技公司，与微软在操作系统图形用户界面上存在竞争和法律纠纷。
description.en: An American multinational technology company that had competition and legal disputes with Microsoft over graphical user interfaces for its operating systems.

description.zh-cn: 香港商人、投资者和慈善家，长实集团创办人。他与比尔·盖茨共同投资了一家食品科技公司，并在2012年香港行政长官选举中提名唐英年。
description.en: Hong Kong business magnate, investor, philanthropist, and founder of Cheung Kong Group. He co-invested in a food technology company with Bill Gates and nominated Henry Tang in the 2012 Hong Kong Chief Executive election.

description.zh-cn: 一家由比尔·盖茨资助的核能公司，致力于开发行波反应堆。
description.en: A nuclear energy company funded by Bill Gates, focused on developing traveling wave reactors.

description.zh-cn: 斯洛文尼亚学者，评价中国特色社会主义是资本主义和威权主义的结合。
description.en: A Slovenian scholar who described socialism with Chinese characteristics as a combination of capitalism and authoritarianism.

zh-cn: 为人民服务—共产主义联盟

description.zh-cn: 马列毛主义组织，认为中国是社会帝国主义国家。
description.en: A Marxist-Leninist-Maoist organization that considers China a social-imperialist country.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，受汪东兴指示组织撰写了提出“两个凡是”的社论《学好文件抓住纲》。
description.en: A Chinese political figure who, under the instruction of Wang Dongxing, organized the writing of the editorial 'Study the Documents Well and Grasp the Key Link', which proposed the 'Two Whatevers'.

description.zh-cn: 清朝管园大臣，在英法联军劫掠圆明园时投福海自尽。
法国传教士，曾为清朝宫廷服务，参与设计圆明园西洋楼。
法国传教士、画家，曾为清朝宫廷服务，参与设计圆明园西洋楼。
位于英国伦敦的皇家植物园，其建造曾参考中国造园理论。

zh-cn: 威尔士亲王弗雷德里克
弗雷德里克 (威尔士亲王)

description.en: English architect, landscape architect, painter and furniture designer.

zh-cn: 圆明园十二生肖兽首铜像

description.zh-cn: 圆明园海晏堂前“水力钟”喷泉的十二生肖人身兽首铜像，在第二次鸦片战争中被掠夺后流失海外。
香港的免费无线电视台。著名艺人沈殿霞曾长期在此工作，该台也是“四朵金花”组合的经纪公司。
description.en: A free-to-air television broadcaster in Hong Kong. Famous artist Lydia Shum worked here for a long time, and it also served as the management agency for the 'Four Golden Flowers' group.

description.zh-cn: 加拿大城市，沈殿霞安葬于此，该市设立“肥肥日”以纪念她。
description.en: A city in Canada where Lydia Shum is buried. The city established "Fei Fei Day" in her memory.

description.zh-cn: 张春桥的妻子，毕业于燕京大学新闻系。1973年与张春桥离婚，但1998年后继续共同生活。
description.en: Zhang Chunqiao's wife, a graduate of the Journalism Department of Yenching University. She divorced Zhang in 1973 but resumed living with him after 1998.

zh-cn: 内蒙古自治区人民政府
en: People's Government of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region
People's Government of Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国省级行政区内蒙古自治区的最高国家行政机关。
description.en: The highest state administrative organ of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, a provincial-level administrative region of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，蒙古族，接替布小林出任内蒙古自治区人民政府主席。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, of Mongol ethnicity, who succeeded Bu Xiaolin as Chairwoman of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，在布小林担任内蒙古自治区主席初期任中国共产党内蒙古自治区委员会书记。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as the Secretary of the CCP Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Committee during the early part of Bu Xiaolin's tenure as Chairwoman of Inner Mongolia.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，在布小林担任内蒙古自治区主席期间任中国共产党内蒙古自治区委员会书记。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as the Secretary of the CCP Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Committee during Bu Xiaolin's tenure as Chairwoman of Inner Mongolia.

description.zh-cn: 中国内蒙古自治区呼和浩特市下辖的一个旗，是布小林的出生地。
description.en: A banner under the administration of Hohhot, Inner Mongolia, China. It is the birthplace of Bu Xiaolin.

en: President of the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华民国（1912年—1949年）的国家元首职位。
description.en: The head of state position of the Republic of China (1912–1949).

description.zh-cn: 清末由李鸿章创办的近代海军学校，旨在为北洋水师培养海军人才。

description.en: A renowned scholar in the late Eastern Han dynasty and a friend of Xu Gong, whom he sought refuge with to escape the turmoil caused by Dong Zhuo.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年吴郡太守，曾是许贡的上司。后遭许贡迫害。
description.en: Grand Administrator of Wu Commandery in the late Eastern Han dynasty and Xu Gong's former superior. He was later persecuted by Xu Gong.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年人物，与兄弟割据江东，被袁术击败后，在逃亡途中为许贡所杀。
description.en: A figure in the late Eastern Han dynasty who, along with his brothers, controlled Jiangdong. After being defeated by Yuan Shu, he was killed by Xu Gong while fleeing.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年将领，孙坚旧部，曾任吴郡都尉，是许贡的下属。
description.en: A general in the late Eastern Han dynasty, formerly a subordinate of Sun Jian. He served as the Commandant of Wu Commandery under Xu Gong.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年吴郡名士，曾帮助盛宪躲避许贡的迫害。
description.en: A renowned scholar of Wu Commandery in the late Eastern Han dynasty who helped Sheng Xian hide from Xu Gong's persecution.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年人物，许贡的部下，曾收留遭迫害的盛宪和被击败的严白虎。
description.en: A figure in the late Eastern Han dynasty and a subordinate of Xu Gong, who gave shelter to the persecuted Sheng Xian and the defeated Yan Baihu.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年官员，在197年被朝廷任命为吴郡太守。
description.en: An official in the late Eastern Han dynasty who was appointed by the imperial court as the Grand Administrator of Wu Commandery in 197.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年人物，与兄弟割据江东，后被袁术击败。
description.en: A figure in the late Eastern Han dynasty who, along with his brothers, controlled Jiangdong and was later defeated by Yuan Shu.

description.en: The former name of Shunping County, Wan County, located in Hebei Province, China, where Shi Shuangqi once served as the County Party Secretary.

description.en: A county in Hebei Province, China, where Shi Shuangqi served as the First County Party Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国河北省，石双琪曾在此地担任市长并最终逝世。
description.en: A city in Hebei Province, China, where Shi Shuangqi served as mayor and eventually passed away.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，接替石双琪担任保定市人民政府市长。
description.en: A Chinese political figure who succeeded Shi Shuangqi as Mayor of the Baoding Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物、医生。曾任第十二届全国人民代表大会解放军代表、空军总医院院长。
description.en: A politician and doctor of the People's Republic of China. He has served as a PLA deputy to the 12th National People's Congress and president of the PLA Air Force General Hospital.

description.zh-cn: 日本江户时代末期的大名，长州藩第13代藩主。他对木户孝允有深厚的信赖，并赐予其“木户”姓氏。
description.en: A daimyō of the late Edo period, the 13th lord of the Chōshū Domain. He had deep trust in Kido Takayoshi and granted him the surname 'Kido'.

description.zh-cn: 原为京都艺妓，名为几松。在幕末动乱时期多次帮助木户孝允，后成为其妻子。
description.en: Originally a geisha in Kyoto named Ikumatsu. She helped Kido Takayoshi multiple times during the turbulent Bakumatsu period and later became his wife.

description.zh-cn: 指德川幕府，日本江户时代的统治机构。在幕末时期与尊王攘夷派对立。
description.en: Refers to the Tokugawa shogunate, the ruling body of Japan during the Edo period. It was opposed by the Sonnō jōi faction during the Bakumatsu period.

description.zh-cn: 日本幕末时期的土佐藩乡士，在促成萨长同盟中扮演了关键角色。
description.en: A low-ranking samurai from the Tosa Domain during the Bakumatsu period who played a crucial role in brokering the Satchō Alliance.

description.zh-cn: 日本幕末时期，萨摩藩和长州藩为了共同对抗德川幕府而结成的军事政治同盟。木户孝允是长州藩的代表。
description.en: A military and political alliance formed between the Satsuma and Chōshū domains during the Bakumatsu period to combine their efforts against the Tokugawa shogunate. Kido Takayoshi was the representative for the Chōshū Domain.

description.zh-cn: 明治天皇在1868年发布的明治维新基本方针。木户孝允对其草案进行了重要修改，并促成了宣誓仪式的举行。
description.en: A statement of the basic policies of the Meiji Restoration, promulgated by Emperor Meiji in 1868. Kido Takayoshi made significant revisions to its draft and promoted the idea of a formal oath-taking ceremony.

description.zh-cn: 日本明治时期的政治家，征韩论的支持者，明治六年政变后下野，成为自由民权运动的领袖。
description.en: A Japanese politician of the Meiji period, a supporter of Seikanron, who resigned after the Meiji Six Year Coup and became a leader of the Freedom and People's Rights Movement.

description.zh-cn: 日本明治时期的政治家，征韩论的支持者之一。
description.en: A Japanese statesman of the Meiji period and a supporter of the Seikanron.

description.zh-cn: 日本明治时期的政治家，征韩论的支持者之一。
description.en: A Japanese statesman of the Meiji period and a supporter of the Seikanron.

description.zh-cn: 日本明治时期的政治家，征韩论的支持者之一。
description.en: A Japanese statesman of the Meiji period and a supporter of the Seikanron.

description.zh-cn: 由不满明治政府的士族发动的叛乱，其起因与明治六年政变有关。
description.en: A rebellion by discontented samurai against the Meiji government, linked to the aftermath of the Meiji Six Year Coup.

description.zh-cn: 日本明治时期的政治和社会运动，其起点与明治六年政变中下野的官员有关。
description.en: A political and social movement in Meiji Japan, whose origins are connected to the officials who resigned during the Meiji Six Year Coup.

description.zh-cn: 日本神话中神功皇后征服朝鲜半岛的传说，为“征韩论”一词的来源。
description.en: A legendary conquest of the Korean peninsula by Empress Jingū in Japanese mythology, which is the origin of the term 'Seikanron'.

description.zh-cn: 日本幕末时期的政治口号和运动，其关于日本对朝鲜半岛支配权的主张为征韩论提供了思想背景。
description.en: A political slogan and movement in late-Edo period Japan whose claims of Japanese sovereignty over the Korean peninsula provided an ideological background for the Seikanron.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任上海市宝山区区长、陈良宇秘书，因陈良宇事件被判刑。
description.en: Chinese politician, former District Mayor of Baoshan, Shanghai, and secretary to Chen Liangyu, who was sentenced in the Chen Liangyu incident.

description.zh-cn: 南宋理学家，他将《论语》与《大学》、《孟子》、《中庸》合为“四书”，并撰写《论语集注》，极大地提升了《论语》的地位。其著作《周易本义》是后世研究《周易》的重要版本。
description.en: A Neo-Confucian scholar of the Southern Song dynasty. He grouped the Analects with the Great Learning, Mencius, and the Doctrine of the Mean to form the 'Four Books', and wrote the 'Collected Commentaries on the Analects', greatly elevating its status. His work 'Zhouyi benyi' (Original Meaning of the Zhou Changes) is also an important version for later studies of the I Ching.

description.zh-cn: 三国时期曹魏的官员和学者，主持编纂了《论语集解》。
description.en: An official and scholar of Cao Wei during the Three Kingdoms period, who led the compilation of the 'Collected Explanations of the Analects'.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年的经学大师，他以张侯论为底本，参考《齐论》、《古论》，作《论语注》，定下了《论语》的今本。
description.en: A great master of classics in the late Eastern Han dynasty. He used Zhang's Analects as a basis, referencing the Qi Analects and Gu Analects, to create his 'Commentary on the Analects', which established the modern text of the Analects.

description.zh-cn: 南北朝时期的学者，受佛教影响编成了《论语义疏》。
description.en: A scholar during the Southern and Northern Dynasties who, influenced by Buddhism, compiled the 'Subcommentary on the Analects'.

description.zh-cn: 北宋理学家，义理派易学代表人物。他高度评价《论语》，认为其意味深长，并著有《伊川易传》。
description.en: A Neo-Confucian philosopher of the Northern Song dynasty and a representative of the Yili school. He highly praised the Analects, believing it to be profoundly meaningful, and authored the 'Yichuan Yizhuan'.

description.zh-cn: 日本天皇，王仁将《论语》献给了他。

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中华人民共和国公安部副部长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, who served as Vice Minister of the Ministry of Public Security of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 管理中国武术运动的全国性社会团体。
description.en: A national social organization that manages Wushu sports in China.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平的连襟，在三反运动中被错误批判后自杀。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping's brother-in-law, who committed suicide after being wrongly criticized during the Three-anti campaign.

description.zh-cn: 冠生园创始人，在五反运动中被迫害跳楼自杀。
description.en: Founder of Guan Sheng Yuan, who was persecuted and committed suicide by jumping from a building during the Five-anti campaign.

description.zh-cn: 由冼冠生创办的著名食品企业。
description.en: A famous food company founded by Xian Guansheng.

description.zh-cn: 原中共天津地委书记，因在三反运动中被揭发严重贪污，与张子善一同被处决。
description.en: Former secretary of the Tianjin Prefectural Committee of the CPC, who was executed along with Zhang Zishan for serious corruption exposed during the Three-anti campaign.

description.zh-cn: 三反运动期间揭露的中共高级干部刘青山、张子善的重大贪污案件。
description.en: A major corruption case involving senior CPC cadres Liu Qingshan and Zhang Zishan, exposed during the Three-anti campaign.

description.zh-cn: 上海商业储蓄银行的创办者，在三反五反运动后拒绝返回大陆，定居台湾。
description.en: Founder of the Shanghai Commercial and Savings Bank, who refused to return to the mainland after the Three-anti and Five-anti campaigns and settled in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，汉族，中国共产党党员。曾任第十三届全国人民代表大会河北地区代表，现任河北建设集团董事长。
description.en: A Chinese politician, of Han ethnicity, and a member of the Communist Party of China. He served as a deputy from the Hebei region to the 13th National People's Congress and is the chairman of Hebei Construction Group.

description.zh-cn: 香港政治人物，香港励进会的创办人及主席。
description.en: A Hong Kong politician, founder and chairperson of the Progressive Hong Kong Society.

description.zh-cn: 香港商人，香港励进会的共同创办人及副主席。
description.en: A Hong Kong businessman, co-founder and vice-chairman of the Progressive Hong Kong Society.

en: Liberal Democratic Federation of Hong Kong

description.zh-cn: 香港一个已解散的亲建制派政党，由香港励进会等团体于1990年合并而成。
description.en: A disbanded pro-establishment political party in Hong Kong, formed in 1990 by the merger of the Progressive Hong Kong Society and other groups.

description.zh-cn: 香港工商派政治人物，曾为香港励进会成员。
description.en: A Hong Kong politician from the business sector, formerly a member of the Progressive Hong Kong Society.

description.en: The 1988 Hong Kong Legislative Council election, after which the Progressive Hong Kong Society became the largest party in the Legislative Council.

description.en: A renowned drama theatre in China.

description.en: A county-level city under the jurisdiction of Hengshui City, Hebei Province, China.

description.en: A mass organization composed of Chinese filmmakers, and a group member of the China Federation of Literary and Art Circles.

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命时期国民公会中的一个激进政治派别，罗伯斯庇尔是其主要成员之一。在热月政变中失败。
description.en: A radical political faction in the National Convention during the French Revolution, of which Robespierre was a leading member. They were defeated in the Thermidorian Reaction.

description.zh-cn: 热月党人的主要成员，在国民公会中率先攻击罗伯斯庇尔，引发了热月政变。
description.en: A leading member of the Thermidorians who initiated the attack on Robespierre in the National Convention, sparking the Thermidorian Reaction.

description.zh-cn: 热月党人的主要成员，在热月政变期间被国民公会任命为部队指挥官，负责逮捕罗伯斯庇尔及其支持者。
description.en: A leading member of the Thermidorians, appointed as commander of troops by the National Convention during the Thermidorian Reaction, responsible for arresting Robespierre and his supporters.

description.zh-cn: 热月党人的主要成员，在策划推翻罗伯斯庇尔的阴谋中扮演了重要角色。
description.en: A leading member of the Thermidorians who played a significant role in plotting the overthrow of Robespierre.

zh-cn: 路易·安托万·德·圣茹斯特
安东万·路易·德·圣茹斯特

description.zh-cn: 罗伯斯庇尔的亲密盟友，山岳党成员，在热月政变后与罗伯斯庇尔一同被处决。
description.en: A close ally of Robespierre and a member of the Mountain, executed alongside Robespierre after the Thermidorian Reaction.

description.zh-cn: 巴黎国民卫队指挥官，罗伯斯庇尔的支持者，在热月政变中试图抵抗但失败，后被处决。
description.en: Commander of the Parisian National Guard and a supporter of Robespierre. He attempted to resist during the Thermidorian Reaction but failed and was subsequently executed.

description.zh-cn: 马克西米连·罗伯斯庇尔的弟弟，在热月政变后一同被捕并被处决。
description.en: The younger brother of Maximilien Robespierre, arrested and executed with him after the Thermidorian Reaction.

description.zh-cn: 罗伯斯庇尔的盟友，在热月政变后被处决。
description.en: An ally of Robespierre who was executed after the Thermidorian Reaction.

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命时期巴黎的市政府，在热月政变中支持罗伯斯庇尔但失败，大量成员被处决。
description.en: The municipal government of Paris during the French Revolution, which supported Robespierre during the Thermidorian Reaction but was defeated, with many of its members executed.

description.zh-cn: 国民公会主席之一，在热月政变中攻击罗伯斯庇尔，但后来也被流放。
description.en: One of the presidents of the National Convention, who attacked Robespierre during the Thermidorian Reaction but was later exiled.

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命时期最著名和最有影响力的政治派别，以其激进主义和推动恐怖统治而闻名。
description.en: The most famous and influential political faction during the French Revolution, known for its radicalism and for instigating the Reign of Terror.

description.zh-cn: 由欧洲多个君主制国家组成的反对法兰西第一共和国的军事同盟，在雅各宾专政时期被法军击败并逐出法国。
description.en: A military alliance of several European monarchies against the French First Republic, which was defeated and driven out of France by French forces during the Jacobin Dictatorship.

description.zh-cn: 热月政变后发生的一段时期，期间雅各宾派和激进分子遭到热月党人及其支持者的报复性屠杀和镇压。
description.en: A period following the Thermidorian Reaction, during which Jacobins and radicals were subjected to retaliatory massacres and suppression by the Thermidorians and their supporters.

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命期间巴黎的激进下层民众，最初是雅各宾派的有力支持者，但在第一次白色恐怖期间遭到镇压。
description.en: The radical lower-class populace of Paris during the French Revolution, who were initially strong supporters of the Jacobins but were suppressed during the First White Terror.

description.zh-cn: 雅各宾派在恐怖统治时期颁布的一项控制商品价格和工资的法令，在热月政变后被废除。
description.en: A law enacted by the Jacobins during the Reign of Terror to control commodity prices and wages, which was abolished after the Thermidorian Reaction.

description.zh-cn: 一场由保皇党人领导的反对国民公会的叛乱，被拿破仑·波拿巴镇压。
description.en: A revolt led by royalists against the National Convention, which was suppressed by Napoleon Bonaparte.

description.zh-cn: 法国国王路易十六之子，在法国大革命期间被囚禁，其狱卒安托万·西蒙是罗伯斯庇尔的支持者。
description.en: Son of King Louis XVI of France, imprisoned during the French Revolution. His jailer, Antoine Simon, was a supporter of Robespierre.

description.zh-cn: 谢文华的出生地，位于安徽省。
description.en: Xie Wenhua's birthplace, located in Anhui Province.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军军衔，介于少将和上校之间。
description.en: A military rank in the People's Liberation Army, between Major General and Colonel.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在福州市的军事单位。
description.en: A military unit of the People's Liberation Army in Fuzhou.

description.zh-cn: 福建省的地方国家权力机关。

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议在山西省的地方组织。成立于1955年2月，其前身是山西省各界人民代表会议协商委员会。

description.zh-cn: 在中国大陆，该词指与物质文明并列的一种文明理论及政策，旨在培养有理想、有道德、有文化、有纪律的社会主义公民，提高整个中华民族的思想道德素质和科学文化素质。
description.en: In mainland China, this term refers to a theory and policy of civilization that is juxtaposed with material civilization. It aims to cultivate socialist citizens with ideals, morality, culture, and discipline, and to improve the ideological, moral, scientific, and cultural qualities of the entire Chinese nation.

description.zh-cn: 一种以提高受教育者诸方面素质为目标的教育理论、政策和教育模式，强调人的思想道德素质、能力培养、个性发展、身体健康和心理健康教育，是精神文明建设的组成部分。
description.en: An educational theory, policy, and model aimed at improving all aspects of the educated, emphasizing moral qualities, ability cultivation, personal development, and physical and mental health, and is a component of spiritual civilization construction.

description.zh-cn: 一种旨在培养公民爱国情感的教育活动，是精神文明建设的组成部分。
description.en: An educational activity aimed at cultivating citizens' patriotic feelings, which is a component of spiritual civilization construction.

zh-cn: 中央精神文明建设办公室
中央精神文明建设指导委员会办公室

description.zh-cn: 中央精神文明建设指导委员会的办事机构。
description.en: The administrative office of the Central Guidance Commission on Building Spiritual Civilization.

description.zh-cn: 中国上古传说中黄帝的史官，被认为是汉字的发明者。
description.en: A legendary historian of the Yellow Emperor in ancient China, regarded as the inventor of Chinese characters.

description.zh-cn: 清朝康熙年间编纂的汉字字典，朱邦复曾参考此字典改良仓颉输入法。
description.en: A Chinese character dictionary compiled during the Kangxi era of the Qing Dynasty, which Chu Bong-Foo referenced to improve the Cangjie input method.

description.zh-cn: 指将电脑软硬件及相关技术进行中文语言本地化的过程。
description.en: The process of localizing computer hardware, software, and related technologies for the Chinese language.

description.zh-cn: 由朱邦复构思的一套用以统一处理汉字形、音、义、码、序、辨等问题的综合系统，仓颉输入法是其中的一部分。
description.en: A comprehensive system conceived by Chu Bong-Foo to uniformly handle issues related to the form, sound, meaning, code, order, and distinction of Chinese characters, of which the Cangjie input method is a part.

description.zh-cn: 由微软公司开发的操作系统系列，其内置的仓颉输入法成为主流版本之一。
description.en: An operating system series developed by Microsoft, whose built-in Cangjie input method has become one of the mainstream versions.

description.zh-cn: 台湾的财团法人机构，1990年与朱邦复合作开发微软中文视窗系统3.0。
description.en: A Taiwanese foundation that collaborated with Chu Bong-Foo in 1990 to develop Microsoft Chinese Windows 3.0.

description.zh-cn: 由沈红莲设计的汉字检字法，常被称为“第六代”仓颉，但与第三、五代差异较大，更像一款衍生输入法。
description.en: A character indexing method designed by Shen Honglian, often referred to as the 'sixth generation' Cangjie, but it differs significantly from the third and fifth generations, resembling more of a derivative input method.

description.zh-cn: 由麦志洪自1987年起开发的仓颉输入法衍生版本，旨在提高输入速度。
description.en: A derivative of the Cangjie input method developed by Mak Chi-hung since 1987, aimed at increasing input speed.

description.zh-cn: 一套中文处理系统，快速仓颉输入法最初是在此系统中开发的。
description.en: A Chinese processing system where the Quick Cangjie input method was originally developed.

description.zh-cn: 杜星垣曾就读的中学，现名为霞浦一中。

description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, former Vice Chairman of the All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese, and a member of the 7th and 8th National Committees of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 印度城市，徐发淦的出生地。
description.en: A city in India, birthplace of Xu Fagan.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期韩国君主，韩桓惠王之父。
description.en: King of the State of Han during the Warring States period, father of King Huanhui of Han.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期韩国上党郡太守，因不愿执行将上党割让给秦国的命令而被韩桓惠王罢免。
description.en: The governor of Shangdang Commandery in the State of Han during the Warring States period. He was dismissed by King Huanhui of Han for refusing to carry out the order to cede Shangdang to the State of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期秦国相国，获封应侯。韩桓惠王曾向其许诺割让上党以求和。
description.en: The prime minister of the State of Qin during the Warring States period, enfeoffed as Marquis of Ying. King Huanhui of Han promised to cede Shangdang to him in exchange for peace.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期韩国上党郡太守，接替靳黈后，不愿降秦而率领当地军民归顺赵国，直接引发了长平之战。
description.en: The governor of Shangdang Commandery in the State of Han during the Warring States period. After succeeding Jin Tou, he refused to surrender to Qin and led the local army and people to align with the State of Zhao, directly triggering the Battle of Changping.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期赵国名将，在长平之战初期率领赵军抵抗秦军。
description.en: A renowned general of the State of Zhao during the Warring States period, who led the Zhao army against the Qin forces in the early stages of the Battle of Changping.

description.zh-cn: 南京市的最高国家行政机关。

description.en: One of the research institutes established by the Chinese Academy of Sciences, it is a comprehensive, base-type research institute focusing on the theory and application of computer science, and led by the research, development, and industrial construction of computer software and high-tech.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党员，原名戴云龙。1949年受中共华东军区派遣赴台进行策反及情报搜集工作，失败后被捕，于1951年1月18日在马场町被枪决，后于1964年被中华人民共和国追认为烈士。
时任江阴要塞少将司令，在江阴要塞起义中被戴龙说服调整炮台角度。
与戴龙一同被中共华东军区派遣赴台，后一同被捕并于1951年被判处死刑。
明朝礼部尚书，在《永乐大典》重修时担任监修。
description.en: Minister of Rites of the Ming dynasty who served as a supervisor for the revision of the Yongle Encyclopedia.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，被任命为《永乐大典》重录工作的总校官。
description.en: A Ming dynasty official appointed as the general proofreader for the project to create a duplicate copy of the Yongle Encyclopedia.

description.zh-cn: 清末官员，曾从翰林院盗走百余册《永乐大典》。
description.en: An official in the late Qing dynasty who stole over a hundred volumes of the Yongle Encyclopedia from the Hanlin Academy.

description.zh-cn: 清末的一支军队，在1900年焚烧翰林院，导致《永乐大典》部分被毁或散佚。
description.en: An army unit in the late Qing dynasty that burned down the Hanlin Academy in 1900, causing parts of the Yongle Encyclopedia to be destroyed or scattered.

description.zh-cn: 清朝安徽学政，上书提议从《永乐大典》中辑佚以编纂《四库全书》。
description.en: The Education Commissioner of Anhui during the Qing dynasty, who proposed recovering lost texts from the Yongle Encyclopedia for the compilation of the Siku Quanshu.

en: Old History of the Five Dynasties

description.zh-cn: 一部关于五代十国历史的史书，原书已佚，后由清代学者从《永乐大典》中辑出。
description.en: A historical text about the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period. The original was lost and later reconstructed by Qing scholars from the Yongle Encyclopedia.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官方颁布的韵书，《永乐大典》以此书作为编排韵目。
description.en: The official rime dictionary of the Ming dynasty, which the Yongle Encyclopedia used as the basis for its organizational structure.

description.zh-cn: 清末大臣，在1909年清点翰林院藏书后，将仅存的64册《永乐大典》运回家中私藏。
description.en: A late Qing minister who, after an inventory in 1909, moved the last 64 volumes of the Yongle Encyclopedia from the Hanlin Academy to his private residence.

description.zh-cn: 中国国家图书馆的前身。现今收藏《永乐大典》副本最多的机构。
description.en: The predecessor of the National Library of China. It currently holds the largest collection of the Yongle Encyclopedia's duplicate manuscript.

Academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering

description.zh-cn: 中国工程科学技术方面的最高学术称号。
description.en: The highest academic title in engineering science and technology in China.

description.zh-cn: 集医疗、教学、科研和预防保健为一体的现代化综合性三级甲等医院。
description.en: A modern, comprehensive Grade A tertiary hospital that integrates medical care, teaching, research, and preventive healthcare.

description.zh-cn: 中国医学家，中国工程院院士，曾任北京大学常务副校长、医学部主任。
description.en: Chinese medical scientist, academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering, former Executive Vice President of Peking University and Director of the Peking University Health Science Center.

description.zh-cn: 中国遗传学领域的全国性学术团体。
description.en: A national academic society in the field of genetics in China.

description.zh-cn: “长江学者奖励计划”是中国教育部设立的一项高层次人才计划，旨在吸引和培养具有国际影响力的学科带头人。该计划由中国教育部与香港李嘉诚基金会共同实施。
description.en: The 'Chang Jiang Scholars Program' is a high-level talent program established by the Ministry of Education of China, aiming to attract and cultivate academic leaders with international influence. This program is jointly implemented with the Li Ka Shing Foundation in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 中国生物化学家，现任武汉大学副校长，中国生物物理学会常务理事，2021年当选中国科学院院士。
description.en: Chinese biochemist, current Vice President of Wuhan University, standing council member of the Biophysical Society of China, and elected as an academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences in 2021.

description.zh-cn: 越剧表演艺术家，谢群英的老师。
description.en: A Yue opera performing artist and the mentor of Xie Qunying.

description.zh-cn: 中国戏剧表演艺术的最高奖项。
description.en: The highest award for theatrical performance art in China.

description.zh-cn: 一种政治制度设计原则，主张将国家权力分散到行政、立法、司法三个独立的分支机构以防止权力集中。
description.en: A political principle of constitutional law under which the powers of government are divided among separate branches, typically executive, legislative, and judicial, to prevent the concentration of power.

description.zh-cn: 由政府高级官员（通常是部长）组成的行政决策机构。
description.en: An executive decision-making body composed of senior government officials, typically ministers.

description.zh-cn: 负责制定法律的国家机关，如议会或国会，拥有制定、修改和废除法律的权力或过程。
description.en: The state body responsible for making laws, such as a parliament or congress, which possesses the power or process of making, amending, and repealing laws.

description.zh-cn: 解释和应用法律的权力或过程。
description.en: The power or process of interpreting and applying law.

description.zh-cn: 由行政机关颁布的具有法律效力的命令。
description.en: An order having the force of law issued by an executive authority.

description.zh-cn: 由行政首长发布的具有法律约束力的指令。
description.en: A legally binding directive issued by the head of the executive branch.

description.zh-cn: 负责国家政策执行的机构，通常指行政机关。
description.en: The body responsible for implementing state policy, often referring to the executive branch.

description.zh-cn: 议会制下的一个政治安排，指在野党同意在信任投票和预算案中支持执政党，以换取政策让步。
description.en: A political arrangement in a parliamentary system where an opposition party agrees to support the governing party in motions of confidence and appropriation bills, in exchange for policy concessions.

description.zh-cn: 在特定领土内拥有主权的政治实体。
description.en: A political entity with sovereignty over a specific territory.

description.zh-cn: 国家的世袭元首。
description.en: The hereditary head of a state.

description.zh-cn: 负责解释和适用法律的政府分支，包括法院系统。

description.zh-cn: 隶属于监察院的部会单位，负责调查侵害人权或歧视事件。
description.en: A commission under the Control Yuan responsible for investigating human rights violations and discrimination cases.

description.zh-cn: 监察委员，曾自行发动调查孙立人案，报告结果与总统府方面极为不同。
description.en: A Control Yuan member who independently initiated an investigation into the Sun Li-jen case, with findings significantly different from the presidential office's.

description.en: A politician of the Republic of China who served as Premier, later impeached for refusing a summons from the Control Yuan and subsequently resigned. He also served as Mayor of Shanghai and participated in diplomatic negotiations after the Hongqiao Airport Incident.

description.zh-cn: 隶属于监察院的部会单位，负责审核全国各机关之财务与总决算。
description.en: A ministerial-level agency under the Control Yuan responsible for auditing the finances and final accounts of all government agencies.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间的一个政治身份划分，指革命干部、革命军人、革命烈士、工人、贫下中农。
description.en: A political classification during the Cultural Revolution, referring to revolutionary cadres, revolutionary soldiers, revolutionary martyrs, workers, and poor and lower-middle peasants.

description.zh-cn: 指高级干部的子女。
description.en: Refers to the children of high-ranking officials.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命初期，由中共中央派往各地指导运动的组织。
description.en: Organizations dispatched by the CPC Central Committee to guide the movement in various places during the early stages of the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间在武汉发生的保皇派与造反派之间的大规模武装冲突。
description.en: A large-scale armed conflict between the Royalist and Rebel factions in Wuhan during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 一种威权主义的政治体制。
description.en: An authoritarian political system.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物、企业家。汉族，安徽宁国人，中国共产党党员。曾历任贵州电子信息职业技术学院院长、中国振华电子集团有限公司董事长等职。是第十一届、第十二届全国人大代表。
description.en: Chinese politician and entrepreneur. Of Han ethnicity, native of Ningguo, Anhui, and a member of the Communist Party of China. He has served as the president of Guizhou Electronic Information Vocational and Technical College and chairman of China Zhenhua Electronics Group Co., Ltd. He was a deputy to the 11th and 12th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国安徽省辖县级市，为陈中的出生地。

description.en: A Chinese political figure, of Han ethnicity, a member of the Communist Party of China, holding the police rank of Deputy Commissioner General. He is a former general of the People's Armed Police, served for a long term in the Public Security Border Troops, and currently serves as the Party Secretary of the China People's Police University.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党党员，战后赴台协助建立中共台湾省工委学工委并担任书记，因光明报案爆发后返回中国大陆，在天津大学任教直至退休。
description.en: A member of the Chinese Communist Party who went to Taiwan after the war to help establish the Student Work Committee of the CPC Taiwan Provincial Working Committee and served as its secretary. He returned to mainland China after the outbreak of the Guangming Daily incident and taught at Tianjin University until his retirement.

description.zh-cn: 江苏省苏州市下辖的县，为徐懋德的出生地。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, and the birthplace of Xu Maode.

description.zh-cn: 徐懋德的师长，对其思想左倾产生重要影响，并介绍其加入新四军。
description.en: Xu Maode's teacher who had a significant leftist influence on him and introduced him to the New Fourth Army.

description.zh-cn: 中共地下党员，受徐懋德派遣成立外围组织“新民主同志会”。
description.en: An underground member of the CCP, dispatched by Xu Maode to establish the peripheral organization 'New Democratic Comrades Association'.

description.zh-cn: 由陈炳基在徐懋德指示下成立的中共外围组织，用于吸收台湾青年。
description.en: A peripheral organization of the CCP established by Chen Bingji under Xu Maode's instructions to recruit Taiwanese youth.

description.zh-cn: 被吸收加入新民主同志会的人员之一。
description.en: One of the individuals recruited into the New Democratic Comrades Association.

description.zh-cn: 被吸收加入新民主同志会的人员之一。
description.en: One of the individuals recruited into the New Democratic Comrades Association.

description.en: An underground member of the CCP who took over the leadership of the Student Work Committee after Xu Maode fled to the mainland, and was later arrested in the Guangming Daily incident.

description.zh-cn: 中共党员，在师范大学发展组织。徐懋德在潜返大陆前曾告知其危险。
description.en: A CCP member who developed the organization at National Taiwan Normal University. Xu Maode warned him of the danger before fleeing to the mainland.

description.zh-cn: 中共地下党员，在光明报案中与李水井一同被捕。
description.en: An underground member of the CCP, arrested along with Li Shuijing in the Guangming Daily incident.

description.zh-cn: 日本设于关东州的军政机构，其陆军部于1919年独立为关东军。
description.en: A military and administrative body established by Japan in the Kwantung Leased Territory. Its army department became the independent Kwantung Army in 1919.

description.zh-cn: 日本关东军与苏联红军在满蒙边界诺门罕地区发生的大规模军事冲突，关东军在此战中惨败。
description.en: A large-scale military conflict between the Japanese Kwantung Army and the Soviet Red Army in the Nomonhan region on the Manchu-Mongolian border, resulting in a decisive defeat for the Kwantung Army.

zh-cn: 格奥尔基·康斯坦丁诺维奇·朱可夫

description.zh-cn: 苏联军事将领，在诺门罕战役中指挥苏联远东军击败了关东军。
description.en: A Soviet military general who commanded the Soviet Far East Army to defeat the Kwantung Army in the Battles of Nomonhan.

description.zh-cn: 日本陆军大将，因诺门罕战役的失败被撤去关东军司令官职务。
description.en: A general in the Imperial Japanese Army who was dismissed as commander of the Kwantung Army following the defeat in the Battles of Nomonhan.

description.zh-cn: 日本陆军大将，关东军最后一任总司令，于1945年8月19日向苏军投降。
description.en: A general in the Imperial Japanese Army and the last commander of the Kwantung Army, who surrendered to the Soviet forces on August 19, 1945.

description.zh-cn: 1946年2月，由原关东军125师团残部联合国民党发起的武装暴动，被东北民主联军镇压。
description.en: An armed rebellion launched in February 1946 by remnants of the former Kwantung Army's 125th Division in alliance with the Kuomintang, which was suppressed by the Northeast Democratic United Army.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯去世后，中国陷入的分裂时期，期间国家由各地北洋军将领分裂成的军阀势力所控制。
description.en: A period of division in China following the death of Yuan Shikai, during which the country was controlled by warlord factions that emerged from the fragmentation of the Beiyang Army.

description.en: Chinese politician who succeeded Jiang Zhiying as head of the United Front Work Department of the Jilin Provincial Party Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，接替姜治莹担任中共白城市委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician who succeeded Jiang Zhiying as Party Secretary of Baicheng.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任长春市人民政府市长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Mayor of Changchun.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，中国共产党党员。曾任长春市人民政府市长，接替姜治莹。因2018年长春长生疫苗事件被要求引咎辞职。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China and a member of the Communist Party of China. He served as Mayor of Changchun Municipal People's Government, succeeding Jiang Zhiying. He was asked to resign in 2018 due to the Changsheng vaccine scandal.

description.zh-cn: 中国人口、资源与环境经济学家，吉林大学教授、博士生导师、校友及前副校长。他也是中国共产党党员，并曾担任国务院学位委员会学科评议组成员、中国人口学会副会长、中国高等教育学会常务理事。
description.en: A Chinese economist specializing in population, resources, and environmental economics. He is a professor, doctoral supervisor, alumnus, and former vice president of Jilin University. He is also a member of the Communist Party of China and has served as a member of the Academic Degrees Committee of the State Council's disciplinary review group, vice president of the China Population Association, and an executive council member of the China Association of Higher Education.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共嘉峪关市委书记，甘肃省人大常委会秘书长、副主任，第十届全国人大代表。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, who served as Secretary of the CPC Jiayuguan Municipal Committee, Secretary-General and Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Gansu Provincial People's Congress, and a deputy to the 10th National People's Congress.

description.en: A law enacted to protect the physical and mental health of minors, safeguard their legitimate rights and interests, and promote their all-round development in morality, intelligence, and physique.

en: Labour Law of the People's Republic of China
zh-cn: 中华人民共和国劳动法

description.zh-cn: 为保护劳动者的合法权益，调整劳动关系，建立和维护适应社会主义市场经济的劳动制度，促进经济发展和社会进步而制定的法律。
description.en: A law enacted to protect the legitimate rights and interests of laborers, adjust labor relations, establish and maintain a labor system adapted to the socialist market economy, and promote economic development and social progress.

description.zh-cn: 中国政府对农村义务教育阶段贫困家庭学生免除学杂费、书本费，并补助寄宿生生活费的一项政策。
description.en: A policy of the Chinese government to exempt students from poor rural families in the compulsory education stage from tuition and textbook fees, and to provide subsidies for boarding students' living expenses.

en: Literacy education in the People's Republic of China
zh-cn: 中华人民共和国扫盲教育

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立后在全国范围内开展的旨在消除文盲的群众性运动。
description.en: A mass movement launched nationwide after the founding of the People's Republic of China aimed at eliminating illiteracy.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代史上第一个以大总统令公布、实施、并影响全国的学制，又称“1922年学制”或“新学制”。
description.en: The first educational system in modern Chinese history to be promulgated by presidential decree, implemented, and influential nationwide, also known as the '1922 system' or the 'New School System'.

description.zh-cn: 一种教育阶段的划分方式，指小学六年、初中三年的学制。
description.en: A way of dividing educational stages, referring to a system of six years of primary school and three years of junior high school.

description.zh-cn: 一种以应付考试为主要目的的教育方式，教学内容和进度紧密围绕考试大纲，忽视学生的全面发展。
description.en: An educational approach primarily aimed at preparing for exams, where teaching content and pace closely follow the exam syllabus, often neglecting the all-round development of students.

location.zh-cn: 河南省洛阳市洛阳新区

description.en: The local organization of the Communist Party of China in Luoyang City.

description.en: Courts established in prefectures, prefecture-level cities, autonomous prefectures, leagues, and municipalities directly under the Central Government in the People's Republic of China. They are the second level of people's courts in the four-level court system, serving as a crucial link connecting higher and lower local judicial organs.

description.zh-cn: 河南省洛阳市中级人民法院法官，因审理“河南种子案”而知名。
description.en: A judge of the Luoyang Intermediate People's Court of Henan Province, known for presiding over the 'Henan Seed Case'.

description.en: The local organ of state power in Henan Province.

description.zh-cn: 2003年5月，洛阳市中级人民法院审理的一起民事案件。审判长李慧娟因认定《河南省农作物种子管理条例》的部分条款抵触《中华人民共和国种子法》而无效，引发了司法与立法的冲突。
description.en: A civil case tried by the Luoyang Intermediate People's Court in May 2003. The presiding judge, Li Huijuan, ruled that some provisions of the 'Henan Provincial Regulations on the Administration of Crop Seeds' were invalid because they conflicted with the 'Seed Law of the People's Republic of China', which triggered a conflict between the judiciary and the legislature.

zh-cn: 栾川男子扇打老师事件

description.zh-cn: 一起因学生殴打20年前的班主任而引发的寻衅滋事案。
description.en: A case of 'picking quarrels and provoking trouble' arising from a student beating his class teacher from 20 years ago.

description.zh-cn: 位于湖北省武汉市的一所中学。
description.en: A secondary school located in Wuhan, Hubei.

description.en: A mathematical treatise by the ancient Greek mathematician Euclid. Its first six books were translated into Chinese by Matteo Ricci and Xu Guangqi in 1607, marking a significant introduction of systematic Western mathematics to China.

description.zh-cn: 严复翻译英国生物学家赫胥黎的《进化论与伦理学》而成的著作。其“物竞天择，适者生存”的思想在晚清思想界产生了巨大冲击。
description.en: Yan Fu's translation of Thomas Huxley's 'Evolution and Ethics'. Its ideas of 'natural selection and survival of the fittest' had a tremendous impact on the intellectual world of the late Qing.

description.zh-cn: 英国传教士，于1843年在上海创办墨海书馆，该馆是晚清译介西学最重要的出版机构之一。
description.en: An English Congregationalist missionary to China. In 1843, he founded the Mohai Shu Guan (London Missionary Society Press) in Shanghai, one of the most important publishers for translating Western knowledge in the late Qing.

description.zh-cn: 由英国传教士麦都思在上海创办的出版社，出版了大量关于西方政治、科学、宗教的书籍，是晚清传播西学的重要机构。
description.en: A press founded in Shanghai by the English missionary Walter Henry Medhurst, it published numerous books on Western politics, science, and religion, and was a key institution for disseminating Western knowledge in the late Qing.

en: Society for the Diffusion of Christian and General Knowledge Among the Chinese

description.zh-cn: 由西方传教士和外商组成的出版机构，翻译出版了大量西方书籍，其书刊是康有为、梁启超等维新派人士了解西学的重要来源。
description.en: A publishing house formed by Western missionaries and foreign businessmen. It translated and published a large number of Western books, which became an important source of Western knowledge for reformers like Kang Youwei and Liang Qichao.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代史上首位留学美国的学生。他积极推动并最终促成了清政府派遣幼童赴美留学计划。
description.en: The first Chinese student to graduate from a US university (Yale College). He actively promoted and was instrumental in the establishment of the Chinese Educational Mission.

description.zh-cn: 清政府在1872年至1875年间先后派遣的四批共一百二十名赴美国留学的幼童。这是中国最早的官派留学活动。
description.en: A group of 120 Chinese boys sent by the Qing government to study in the United States between 1872 and 1881. It was China's first government-sponsored study abroad program.

en: Chinese Learning as Substance, Western Learning for Application
Chinese learning as substance, Western learning for application

description.zh-cn: 由张之洞提出的处理中西学关系的指导原则，主张在维护中国传统纲常伦理的前提下，学习西方的先进科技。这一思想成为晚清洋务运动的理论基础。
description.en: A guiding principle proposed by Zhang Zhidong for handling the relationship between Chinese and Western learning. It advocated for learning advanced Western technology while upholding traditional Chinese ethical principles, becoming the theoretical basis for the Self-Strengthening Movement.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，第一任中华人民共和国国防科学技术工业委员会主任，中国人民解放军少将。

description.en: Abbreviated as COSTIND, it was formerly a constituent department under the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for national defense science, technology, and industry.

description.zh-cn: 春秋时期位于中国东南部的诸侯国，曾一度称霸。据传为夏朝王室后裔所建。
description.en: A state in southeastern China during the Spring and Autumn period, which once became a hegemon. It was traditionally believed to have been founded by descendants of the Xia dynasty's royal house.

description.zh-cn: 由蜀泮在前257年建立的政权，后被赵佗所灭。

description.zh-cn: 古代百越族群的一支，主要分布于今广西地区。

description.en: A branch of the ancient Baiyue peoples, mainly distributed in present-day northern Vietnam and southern Guangxi, China.

description.zh-cn: 汉初由古闽人（越国后裔）在今福建一带建立的王国，都城为冶。
description.en: A kingdom established in the early Han dynasty by the ancient Min people (descendants of the Yue state) in the area of modern Fujian, with its capital at Ye.
