description.zh-cn: 由陈胜、吴广领导的中国历史上第一次大规模的农民起义，揭开了秦末民变的序幕。其在秦朝末年建立了农民起义政权，意为“张大楚国”，并以陈县为首都。
description.en: The first large-scale peasant uprising in Chinese history, led by Chen Sheng and Wu Guang, which marked the beginning of the rebellions at the end of the Qin dynasty. This uprising established a rebel state, meaning 'Great Chu', with Chen County as its capital.

description.zh-cn: 秦朝末年农民起义的领袖之一，与吴广一同发动大泽乡起义，后建立张楚政权并自立为王。
description.en: One of the leaders of the peasant uprising at the end of the Qin Dynasty, who launched the Dazexiang Uprising with Wu Guang and later established the Zhangchu regime, declaring himself king.

description.zh-cn: 秦朝末年农民起义的领袖之一，与陈胜一同发动大泽乡起义。
description.en: One of the leaders of the peasant uprising at the end of the Qin Dynasty, who launched the Dazexiang Uprising with Chen Sheng.

description.zh-cn: 陈胜麾下的将军，曾率军西击秦朝，一度逼近咸阳。
description.en: A general under Chen Sheng who led an army to attack the Qin dynasty from the west, once approaching the capital Xianyang.

description.zh-cn: 吴广的部将，后杀害吴广。

description.en: A subordinate of Chen Sheng who, after Chen's death, organized the 'Cangtou Army' to recapture Chen County and avenge Chen Sheng.

description.zh-cn: 原楚国贵族，被吕臣拥立为王，重建张楚政权。
description.en: A former noble of the State of Chu, who was installed as king by Lü Chen to re-establish the Zhangchu regime.

description.zh-cn: 西汉开国功臣，官至太尉、丞相。曾与周勃一同诋毁陈平。
description.en: A founding general of the Western Han dynasty who served as Grand Marshal and Chancellor. He once slandered Chen Ping along with Zhou Bo.

description.zh-cn: 明末政治人物。崇祯四年进士，曾任辉县知县、兵部主事、湖广佥事等职。后擢为河南巡抚，未及上任，因张献忠攻破襄阳而不屈殉国。
description.en: A political figure of the late Ming Dynasty. After passing the imperial examination in 1631, he served in various roles including Magistrate of Huixian, Secretary in the Ministry of War, and Surveillance Commissioner in Huguang. He was later promoted to Governor of Henan, but was killed by Zhang Xianzhong's forces in Xiangyang before he could assume office.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，任推官，在张献忠攻破襄阳时殉职。
description.en: An official of the Ming Dynasty with the rank of Tuiguan (Judge), who died in the line of duty when Xiangyang fell to Zhang Xianzhong.

description.zh-cn: 明末时期由农民组成的起义武装力量的泛称。

description.zh-cn: 明朝山西潞安府下辖的一个县，是张克俭的籍贯所在地。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Lu'an Prefecture, Shanxi, during the Ming Dynasty, and the ancestral home of Zhang Kejian.

description.zh-cn: 明朝湖广地区的军事重镇，张克俭等人在此地被张献忠杀害。
description.en: A key military stronghold in the Huguang region during the Ming Dynasty, where Zhang Kejian and others were killed by Zhang Xianzhong.

description.zh-cn: 明朝河南省下辖的一个县，张克俭曾在此地任知县。
description.en: A county in Henan Province during the Ming Dynasty, where Zhang Kejian once served as magistrate.

description.zh-cn: 明朝时期的一个县，农民军曾在此地与明军交战。
description.en: A county during the Ming Dynasty where peasant rebels clashed with Ming forces.

description.en: An administrative division in the People's Republic of China; the cities referred to here are county-level cities administered by the special administrative office.

description.en: The successor type of agency to the special administrative office, which replaced the prefectural revolutionary committees after the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。曾任国家安全生产监督管理局首任局长、中共中央纪律检查委员会委员。

description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China, of Han ethnicity, a member of the Communist Party of China, and a deputy representing the Jiangsu region to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 西汉初年政治家、谋略家。早年家贫，后先后追随魏咎、项羽，最终归附刘邦。在楚汉相争中，他献出反间计等六条奇计，为刘邦夺取天下立下大功。汉朝建立后，历任丞相，与周勃共同平定诸吕之乱，拥立汉文帝，安定了汉初的政治局势。
description.en: A politician and strategist in the early Western Han dynasty. After an impoverished early life, he successively followed Wei Jiu and Xiang Yu before finally joining Liu Bang. During the Chu-Han Contention, he proposed six brilliant strategies, including sowing discord, which were instrumental in Liu Bang's victory. After the founding of the Han dynasty, he served as Chancellor and, together with Zhou Bo, quashed the Lü Clan Disturbance and enthroned Emperor Wen, stabilizing the political situation of the early Han.

description.zh-cn: 秦末魏国宗室，被陈胜部将周巿立为魏王。
description.en: A member of the royal family of the Wei state during the late Qin dynasty, installed as the King of Wei by Zhou Shi, a general under Chen Sheng.

description.zh-cn: 项羽麾下重要将领之一，后因陈平的反间计而被项羽猜忌。
description.en: One of Xiang Yu's key generals, who later fell under Xiang Yu's suspicion due to Chen Ping's plot to sow discord.

description.zh-cn: 吕后之妹，樊哙之妻。因陈平曾奉命捉拿樊哙而记恨陈平，并向吕后进谗言。
description.en: The younger sister of Empress Lü and wife of Fan Kuai. She held a grudge against Chen Ping for his role in arresting Fan Kuai and slandered him to Empress Lü.

description.zh-cn: 西汉初年大臣，官至右丞相。曾因反对吕后封诸吕为王而被罢免。
description.en: A minister in the early Western Han dynasty who served as Chancellor of the Right. He was dismissed for opposing Empress Lü's decision to ennoble members of the Lü clan as kings.

description.zh-cn: 陈平的哥哥。在陈平年少时耕田供养其读书。
description.en: Chen Ping's elder brother. He farmed to support Chen Ping's studies during their youth.

zh-cn: 新疆维吾尔自治区地震局

description.zh-cn: 中国地震局和新疆维吾尔自治区人民政府双重领导的事业单位，承担新疆维吾尔自治区行政区域内防震减灾工作的政府行政管理职能。
description.en: A public institution under the dual leadership of the China Earthquake Administration and the People's Government of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, responsible for the administrative management of earthquake prevention and disaster reduction within the administrative area of Xinjiang.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院直属事业单位，原名国家地震局，主管全国防震减灾工作。
description.en: A public institution directly under the State Council of the People's Republic of China, formerly known as the State Seismological Bureau, in charge of nationwide earthquake prevention and disaster reduction.

description.en: The first president and long-term Party Committee Secretary of Beijing Sport University (including its predecessors).

description.en: Director of the Preparatory Office of the Central Institute of Physical Culture, later served as Vice President and temporary Party Branch Secretary.

description.en: A sports university located in Cologne, Germany, and an international exchange partner of Beijing Sport University.

description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, who served as Deputy Mayor of Shenzhen, Deputy Mayor of Xiamen, and Deputy Director of the Standing Committee of the Shenzhen Municipal People's Congress. He committed suicide in 2014 due to depression.

description.zh-cn: 深圳市人民代表大会的常设机关。

description.zh-cn: 范石生的世交，曾介绍范石生加入蔡锷部。
description.en: A family friend of Fan Shisheng who introduced him to join Cai E's forces.

description.zh-cn: 滇军将领，与范石生、朱德等人为云南陆军讲武堂同学并结为兄弟。
description.en: A general of the Yunnan Army, a classmate and sworn brother of Fan Shisheng, Zhu De, and others at the Yunnan Military Academy.

description.zh-cn: 滇军将领，与范石生、朱德等人结为兄弟。后在范石生军内任前敌总指挥时被刺杀。
description.en: A general of the Yunnan Army and a sworn brother of Fan Shisheng, Zhu De, and others. He was later assassinated while serving as the frontline commander in Fan Shisheng's army.

description.zh-cn: 1911年在昆明爆发的旨在响应武昌起义的武装起义。
description.en: An armed uprising in Kunming in 1911 in response to the Wuchang Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 民国时期以云南籍军人为主组成的地方军队。
description.en: A regional army in the Republic of China era, primarily composed of soldiers from Yunnan.

description.zh-cn: 滇军将领，曾维护与顾品珍发生矛盾的范石生。
description.en: A general of the Yunnan Army who defended Fan Shisheng during his conflict with Gu Pinzhen.

description.zh-cn: 滇军将领，顾品珍死后任副总司令，曾与范石生一同主张讨伐陈炯明。
description.en: A general of the Yunnan Army. After Gu Pinzhen's death, he served as deputy commander-in-chief and, along with Fan Shisheng, advocated for a punitive expedition against Chen Jiongming.

en: 16th Army of the National Revolutionary Army

description.zh-cn: 由范石生部改编而成的国民革命军部队。
description.en: A unit of the National Revolutionary Army formed by reorganizing Fan Shisheng's troops.

description.zh-cn: 1928年4月，朱德、陈毅率领的南昌起义余部及湘南农军与毛泽东率领的秋收起义部队在井冈山的会合。
description.en: The meeting of the remaining forces of the Nanchang Uprising led by Zhu De and Chen Yi and the Hunan peasants' army with the Autumn Harvest Uprising troops led by Mao Zedong in the Jinggang Mountains in April 1928.

en: National Security Bureau of the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华民国最重要的情报机关，隶属于国家安全会议，负责国家安全及情报、特种勤务等工作。
description.en: The principal intelligence agency of the Republic of China (Taiwan), responsible for national security, intelligence gathering, and special services.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物、外交官，接任陈明通担任国家安全局局长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician and diplomat who succeeded Chen Ming-tong as Director-General of the National Security Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国官员，曾任中共中央台湾工作办公室副主任，曾与陈明通在台北会谈中就两岸认同问题进行辩论。
description.en: An official of the People's Republic of China who served as Deputy Director of the Taiwan Affairs Office of the State Council. He debated with Chen Ming-tong on cross-strait identity issues during the Taipei talks.

description.zh-cn: 指梁振英竞选团队成员与乡绅及江湖人物郭永鸿（上海仔）的会面，引发“黑金政治”的疑虑。
description.en: Refers to a meeting between members of Leung Chun-ying's campaign team, rural leaders, and triad figure Kwok Wing-hung ("Shanghai Tsai"), which raised concerns about "black-gold politics".

description.zh-cn: 指2012年香港行政长官选举期间，候选人唐英年位于九龙塘的大宅被揭发有大型僭建地库，引发诚信争议。
description.en: Refers to the controversy during the 2012 Hong Kong Chief Executive election where candidate Henry Tang's mansion in Kowloon Tong was discovered to have a large illegal basement, sparking a debate over his integrity.

description.zh-cn: 香港政治人物，曾任保安局局长，因基本法23条立法争议而辞职。现任新民党主席，曾考虑并短暂宣布参选2012年香港行政长官选举，但未能取得足够提名。
description.en: Hong Kong politician, former Secretary for Security who resigned due to controversy over the Basic Law Article 23 legislation. She is also the chairwoman of the New People's Party and had considered and briefly announced her candidacy for the 2012 Hong Kong Chief Executive election but failed to secure enough nominations.

description.zh-cn: 香港亲建制派政党，主要代表工商界利益。
description.en: A pro-establishment political party in Hong Kong, primarily representing business and professional interests.

description.zh-cn: 一项政治诉求，旨在争取在2012年实现香港行政长官和立法会全体议员由普选产生。该建议未被中央政府接纳。
description.en: A political demand aimed at achieving universal suffrage for both the Hong Kong Chief Executive and all members of the Legislative Council in 2012. The proposal was not accepted by the Central Government.

description.zh-cn: 香港民间人权阵线自1997年起每年7月1日（香港特别行政区成立纪念日）举办游行活动。其中，2003年的游行主要为反对基本法23条立法。2012年7月1日，民间人权阵线再次主办游行，主要诉求之一是要求新上任的行政长官梁振英下台。
description.en: The Civil Human Rights Front has organized marches annually in Hong Kong on July 1st (HKSAR Establishment Day) since 1997. The 2003 march primarily protested against the Basic Law Article 23 legislation. On July 1, 2012, the Front again organized a protest, with one of its main demands being the resignation of the newly inaugurated Chief Executive, Leung Chun-ying.

description.zh-cn: 负责选举香港特别行政区行政长官的选举团体。

description.zh-cn: 2012年香港特首选举之后的下一届选举。

description.zh-cn: 汤川秀树成长、长期工作和逝世的城市。
description.en: The city where Hideki Yukawa grew up, worked for a long time, and passed away.

description.zh-cn: 位于日本大阪府的国立大学。汤川秀树曾在此任教并获得博士学位。
description.en: A national university in Osaka Prefecture, Japan. Hideki Yukawa taught and received his doctorate here.

description.zh-cn: 日本物理学家和电气工程学家，曾任大阪帝国大学理学部主任教授，帮助汤川秀树获得在该校的教职。
description.en: A Japanese physicist and electrical engineer, who was the head professor of the Faculty of Science at Osaka Imperial University and helped Hideki Yukawa get a teaching position there.

description.zh-cn: 一种强相互作用的基本粒子，其存在由汤川秀树的理论所预言。
description.en: A type of subatomic particle that participates in the strong interaction, whose existence was predicted by Hideki Yukawa's theory.

description.zh-cn: 英国物理学家，因在宇宙线中发现π介子而获得1950年诺贝尔物理学奖，他的发现证实了汤川秀树的理论。
description.en: A British physicist who was awarded the 1950 Nobel Prize in Physics for his discovery of the pion (pi-meson) in cosmic rays, a discovery that confirmed Hideki Yukawa's theory.

description.zh-cn: 一种介子，由塞西尔·鲍威尔于1947年发现，证实了汤川秀树的理论。
description.en: A type of meson discovered by Cecil Powell in 1947, confirming Hideki Yukawa's theory.

description.zh-cn: 诺贝尔奖的奖项之一，旨在奖励在物理学领域做出最重要发现或发明的个人。汤川秀树于1949年获得该奖项。
description.en: One of the Nobel Prizes, awarded to those who have made the most important discoveries or inventions in the field of physics. Hideki Yukawa received this award in 1949.

zh-cn: 京都大学基础物理学研究所

description.zh-cn: 隶属于京都大学的理论物理学研究机构，汤川秀树是其首任所长。
description.en: A research institute for theoretical physics affiliated with Kyoto University, of which Hideki Yukawa was the first director.

description.zh-cn: 一份由罗素和爱因斯坦起草，呼吁世界各国领导人通过和平方式解决国际冲突的反核战争宣言，汤川秀树是签署人之一。
description.en: A manifesto drafted by Bertrand Russell and Albert Einstein calling on world leaders to resolve international conflicts peacefully, which warned of the dangers of nuclear weapons. Hideki Yukawa was one of its signatories.

description.zh-cn: 日本物理学家，被称为“日本近代物理学之父”，是汤川秀树的博士导师。
description.en: A Japanese physicist known as the 'father of modern physics in Japan', and was Hideki Yukawa's doctoral advisor.

description.zh-cn: 日本天体物理学家，汤川秀树的博士生。
description.en: A Japanese astrophysicist and a doctoral student of Hideki Yukawa.

description.zh-cn: 日本理论物理学家，汤川秀树的博士生。
description.en: A Japanese theoretical physicist and a doctoral student of Hideki Yukawa.

description.zh-cn: 日本中国文学研究者，是汤川秀树的弟弟。
description.en: A Japanese researcher of Chinese literature and the younger brother of Hideki Yukawa.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，汉族，曾任安徽省残疾人联合会理事长、安徽省人大常委会社会建设工作委员会副主任等职务。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, of Han ethnicity, who has served as Chairwoman of the Anhui Provincial Disabled Persons' Federation and Deputy Director of the Social Construction Work Committee of the Standing Committee of the Anhui Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国仪器仪表与传感专家，回族，南京大学党委常委、副校长，中国科学院院士。

description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as the Party Secretary and Vice President of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region High People's Court, and a Grand Justice of the second rank.

description.zh-cn: 曾纪鸿与郭筠的长子。
description.en: The eldest son of Zeng Jihong and Guo Yun.

description.en: A general and regent of Eastern Wu during the Three Kingdoms period, the eldest son of Zhuge Jin, and the elder brother of Zhuge Qiao.

description.en: The third son of Zhuge Jin and the younger brother of Zhuge Qiao.

description.zh-cn: 三国时期蜀汉将领。
description.en: A general of Shu Han during the Three Kingdoms period.

description.zh-cn: 三国时期蜀汉官员，诸葛乔之子。后因诸葛恪一脉被诛杀，回归其亲生祖父诸葛瑾一脉以延续其后嗣。
description.en: An official of Shu Han during the Three Kingdoms period and the son of Zhuge Qiao. He later returned to the lineage of his biological grandfather Zhuge Jin to continue the family line after Zhuge Ke's branch was executed.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代县名，隶属于琅邪郡，今山东省临沂市沂南县。

description.en: Vice Dean of the Law School at China University of Political Science and Law, and a legal scholar. He has criticized the budget allocation of the China Earthquake Administration and was critical of the Chongqing Model, arguing that its 'strike black' campaign was an illegal crackdown that undermined the rule of law.

description.zh-cn: 全国人大代表，曾建议裁撤中国地震局。

description.en: A scholar and political figure of the People's Republic of China, with his ancestral home in Cixi, Zhejiang. He has served as a professor and Deputy Party Secretary at Tongji University, and was the Party Secretary of Tongji University from July 2017 to April 2025.

description.zh-cn: 指1978年至1988年间由蒋经国担任总统的中华民国政府。
description.en: Refers to the government of the Republic of China under President Chiang Ching-kuo from 1978 to 1988.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾与江鹏坚竞争民主进步党首届党主席职位。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who competed with Chiang Peng-chien for the first chairmanship of the Democratic Progressive Party.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，于江鹏坚担任民进党主席期间任秘书长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who served as Secretary-General of the Democratic Progressive Party during Chiang Peng-chien's chairmanship.

description.zh-cn: 由江鹏坚创立的台湾人权组织。

description.en: A Taiwanese politician and former DPP legislator who claimed to have seen intelligence documents held by Chiang Peng-chien.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾任监察院院长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who served as President of the Control Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国军事人物，中国人民解放军中将。曾任国防科技大学校长，2008年当选第十一届全国政协常务委员。
description.en: A military figure of the People's Republic of China and a lieutenant general in the People's Liberation Army. He formerly served as the President of the National University of Defense Technology and was elected as a Standing Committee member of the 11th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference in 2008.

description.zh-cn: 中国江苏省苏州市下辖的县级市。
description.en: A county-level city under the administration of Suzhou, Jiangsu province, China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国宇航科学技术工作者的学术性群众团体。
description.en: An academic and public organization for astronautical science and technology professionals in the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 汉朝初年赵王，张耳之子，鲁元公主的丈夫。
description.en: King of Zhao in the early Han Dynasty, son of Zhang Er, and husband of Princess Yuan of Lu.

description.zh-cn: 鲁元公主与张敖之子。
description.en: Son of Princess Yuan of Lu and Zhang Ao.

description.zh-cn: 汉惠帝刘盈的皇后，鲁元公主与宣平侯张敖之女，即刘盈的外甥女。
description.en: Empress of Emperor Hui of Han, Liu Ying. She was the daughter of Princess Yuan of Lu and Zhang Ao, Marquess of Xuanping, making her Liu Ying's niece.

description.zh-cn: 汉朝初年赵王，张敖的父亲。
description.en: King of Zhao in the early Han Dynasty and father of Zhang Ao.

description.zh-cn: 西汉官员，曾建议与匈奴和亲。
description.en: An official of the Western Han Dynasty who suggested the Heqin marriage alliance with the Xiongnu.

description.zh-cn: 匈奴帝国的建立者和第一位单于。曾在刘邦死后，写信对吕后言语轻慢。
description.en: Founder and first Chanyu of the Xiongnu Empire. After the death of Liu Bang, he wrote a letter to Empress Lü with disrespectful language.

description.zh-cn: 吕雉的父亲，鲁元公主的外祖父。
description.en: Father of Lü Zhi and maternal grandfather of Princess Yuan of Lu.

description.zh-cn: 刘邦第六子，鲁元公主的异母弟。
description.en: The sixth son of Liu Bang and half-brother of Princess Yuan of Lu.

description.zh-cn: 刘邦第八子，鲁元公主的异母弟。
description.en: The eighth son of Liu Bang and half-brother of Princess Yuan of Lu.

description.en: The seat of the Lianshui County People's Government.

description.en: An ancient commandery in China.

description.en: An ancient commandery in China.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝初期在今涟水县境内设置的州。
description.en: A prefecture established in present-day Lianshui County during the early Tang Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代的一个州，唐朝时下邳隶属该州。
description.en: An ancient Chinese prefecture (zhou), to which Xiapī belonged during the Tang Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政府于2020年进行的全国性人口普查。
description.en: A nationwide census conducted by the government of the People's Republic of China in 2020.

description.zh-cn: 连接江苏省连云港市和镇江市的高速铁路。
description.en: A high-speed railway connecting Lianyungang and Zhenjiang in Jiangsu Province.

description.zh-cn: 位于涟水县的连镇铁路上的一个车站。
description.en: A station on the Lianyungang-Zhenjiang High-Speed Railway located in Lianshui County.

description.en: A town under the jurisdiction of Lianshui County.

description.en: A publicly listed brewing company located in Gaogou Town, Lianshui County, Jiangsu Province.

description.zh-cn: 位于涟水县的全日制民办高等院校。
description.en: A full-time private higher vocational college located in Lianshui County.

description.zh-cn: 位于涟水县的寺庙，始建于唐初。
description.en: A temple in Lianshui County, first built in the early Tang Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝末年封州刺史，为南汉的建立奠定了基础。其子刘隐、刘䶮相继继承其势力。
description.en: The prefect of Feng Prefecture in the late Tang dynasty who laid the foundation for the Southern Han state. His sons Liu Yin and Liu Yan succeeded his power.

description.zh-cn: 唐末五代十国时期清海军节度使，南汉建立者刘䶮之兄，为南汉的建立奠定基础。
description.en: Military governor (Jiedushi) of the Qinghaijun Circuit during the late Tang and Five Dynasties period. He was the elder brother of Liu Yan, the founder of Southern Han, and laid the groundwork for the state's establishment.

description.zh-cn: 南汉第二位皇帝，史称殇帝，继承其父刘䶮的皇位，后被其弟刘晟所杀。
description.en: The second emperor of Southern Han, known posthumously as Emperor Shang. He succeeded his father Liu Yan and was later killed by his younger brother Liu Sheng.

description.zh-cn: 南汉末代皇帝，史称后主。
description.en: The last emperor of Southern Han, known as the 'Last Ruler' (Houzhu).

description.zh-cn: 越南吴朝的开创者。他于937年击败南汉军队，在交州建立吴朝。
description.en: Founder of the Ngô dynasty in Vietnam. He defeated the Southern Han army in 937 and established his dynasty in Jiaozhou.

description.zh-cn: 由吴权在击败南汉军队后建立的越南王朝。
description.en: A Vietnamese dynasty established by Ngô Quyền after defeating the Southern Han army.

description.zh-cn: 南汉高祖刘䶮之子，被封为交王，在领兵进攻吴权时兵败阵亡。
description.en: Son of Emperor Gaozu of Southern Han, Liu Yan. He was titled Prince of Jiao and was killed in battle while leading an army against Ngô Quyền.

description.zh-cn: 南汉交州属将，在杀死主管官员后向南汉求救以对抗吴权。
description.en: A general in Jiaozhou under Southern Han. After killing the chief official, he requested aid from Southern Han to fight against Ngô Quyền.

description.zh-cn: 北宋开国名将，被赵匡胤任命为都总管，率军攻灭南汉。
description.en: A founding general of the Northern Song dynasty. He was appointed by Zhao Kuangyin as the commander-in-chief to lead the army that conquered Southern Han.

description.zh-cn: 南汉将领。成功抵御宋军后，遭诬陷谋反并被后主刘𬬮赐死。
description.en: A general of Southern Han. After successfully repelling the Song army, he was falsely accused of treason and put to death by the Last Ruler Liu Chang.

description.zh-cn: 南汉将领，在宋军进攻时见南汉大势已去，遂投降宋朝。
description.en: A general of Southern Han who surrendered to the Song army during their invasion, seeing that the Southern Han was doomed.

description.zh-cn: 汉朝开国功臣，继萧何后为相国，全面继承萧何的政策，世称“萧规曹随”。
description.en: A founding minister of the Han Dynasty. He succeeded Xiao He as chancellor and continued all of Xiao He's policies, an approach known as 'Cao following Xiao's rules'.

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇时期制定的禁止民间私藏儒家典籍及诸子百家著作的法令。
description.en: A law enacted during the reign of Qin Shi Huang that prohibited private ownership of Confucian classics and the writings of the Hundred Schools of Thought.

description.zh-cn: 汉惠帝刘盈之子，汉朝第三位皇帝。因其母被吕后所杀，长大后出怨言，被吕后废黜并杀害。
description.en: Son of Emperor Hui of Han, Liu Ying, and the third emperor of the Han Dynasty. After his mother was killed by Empress Lü Zhi, he expressed resentment upon growing up and was subsequently deposed and killed by her.

description.zh-cn: 汉朝将领，以信守承诺闻名。曾反对樊哙攻打匈奴的提议。
description.en: A general of the Han Dynasty, famous for keeping his promises. He opposed Fan Kuai's proposal to attack the Xiongnu.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国重工业部

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院曾设置的一个组成部门，负责管理重工业。该部门于1954年9月根据《国务院组织法》成立，接替原中央人民政府重工业部的相关工作。
description.en: A former constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for managing heavy industry. description.en: A type of administrative division in ancient China.

description.zh-cn: 元代的一个军事或行政单位，后被改置为广安府。
description.en: A military or administrative unit in the Yuan dynasty, which was later reorganized into Guang'an Fu.

description.zh-cn: 元代设立的一个行政区划，隶属于四川省顺庆路，后在明代被降格为广安州。
description.en: An administrative division established in the Yuan dynasty, subordinate to Shunqing Lu of Sichuan Province, and later downgraded to Guang'an Zhou in the Ming dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 元代四川省的一个路级行政区划。
description.en: A lu-level administrative division in Sichuan Province during the Yuan dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 元代广安府的治所。明洪武十年（1377年）被并入广安州。
description.en: The seat of government for Guang'an Fu during the Yuan dynasty. It was merged into Guang'an Zhou in the tenth year of the Hongwu reign (1377).

description.zh-cn: 明、清时期的一个府级行政区划，广安州为其下辖州。
description.en: A fu-level administrative division during the Ming and Qing dynasties, which administered Guang'an Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 明、清时期隶属于广安州的县。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Guang'an Zhou during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

description.zh-cn: 明、清时期隶属于广安州的县。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Guang'an Zhou during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

description.zh-cn: 明、清时期隶属于广安州的县。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Guang'an Zhou during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

description.zh-cn: 明、清时期隶属于广安州的县。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Guang'an Zhou during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

zh-cn: 中华民国大陆时期行政区划沿革
en: Administrative divisions of the Republic of China (1912–1949)

description.zh-cn: 民国初年推行的一项行政区划改革政策，旨在简化地方行政层级。该政策导致广安州被废除，改设为广安县。
description.en: An administrative reform policy implemented in the early years of the Republic of China aimed at simplifying local administrative levels. This policy led to the abolition of Guang'an Zhou and its replacement with Guang'an County.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国初年由广安州改制而成的县。
description.en: A county established in the early years of the Republic of China through the reorganization of Guang'an Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 美国哈佛大学经济学教授，将相关经济方案改称为“休克疗法”，并在多个国家推广。
description.en: An American economics professor at Harvard University who renamed the economic program 'shock therapy' and promoted it in several countries.

description.zh-cn: 将公有资产所有权移转给私人部门的经济过程。
description.en: The economic process of transferring ownership of state-owned assets to the private sector.

description.zh-cn: 减少或消除国家之间商品和服务贸易壁垒的政策。
description.en: The policy of reducing or eliminating barriers to trade in goods and services between countries.

description.zh-cn: 加拿大作家、社会活动家，在其著作《休克主义》中推广了“休克疗法”这一术语。
description.en: Canadian author and social activist who popularized the term 'shock therapy' in her book 'The Shock Doctrine'.

zh-cn: 贡萨洛·桑切斯·德洛萨达

description.zh-cn: 玻利维亚政治家，在担任财政计划部长期间，制定政策采纳了休克疗法。
description.en: A Bolivian politician who, as Minister of Planning, formulated policies adopting shock therapy.

description.zh-cn: 指1975年智利在采纳休克疗法后经济恢复正常的事件，被认为是休克疗法首次成功的案例。
description.en: Refers to the economic recovery of Chile in 1975 after adopting shock therapy, considered its first successful case.

description.zh-cn: 一群曾在芝加哥大学留学的智利财经官员，他们根据密尔顿·弗里德曼的理念在智利推行了经济改革。
description.en: A group of Chilean finance officials who studied at the University of Chicago and implemented economic reforms in Chile based on Milton Friedman's ideas.

description.zh-cn: 南美洲国家，是首个成功实施休克疗法的国家。
description.en: A country in South America, the first to successfully implement shock therapy.

description.zh-cn: 一种经济和政治哲学，休克疗法是其重要的经济政策方向之一。
description.en: An economic and political philosophy for which shock therapy is one of its key economic policy directions.

description.zh-cn: 美国经济学家，对休克疗法的有效性提出质疑，认为其可能加剧经济危机。
description.en: An American economist who questioned the effectiveness of shock therapy, arguing it could exacerbate economic crises.

birth_place.zh-cn: 积石山保安族东乡族撒拉族自治县
birth_place.en: Jishishan Bonan, Dongxiang and Salar Autonomous County

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，保安族，中国共产党党员。曾任第十三届全国人民代表大会甘肃省代表。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, of Bonan ethnicity, and a member of the Communist Party of China. She served as a delegate from Gansu Province to the 13th National People's Congress.

en: Jishishan Bonan, Dongxiang and Salar Autonomous County
zh-cn: 积石山保安族东乡族撒拉族自治县

description.zh-cn: 位于中国甘肃省的一个自治县，是董彩云的家乡。
description.en: An autonomous county in Gansu Province, China, and the hometown of Dong Caiyun.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国陕西省下辖的县级市，王友三的出生地。
description.en: A county-level city in Shaanxi Province, People's Republic of China, and the birthplace of Wang Yousan.

zh-cn: 湖南省公立第二师范学校
湖南省常德市第一中学
湖南省西路公立师范学堂

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国湖南省著名重点中学、湖南省重点学校、全国现代教育技术实验学校。
description.en: A famous key middle school, provincial key school, and national modern educational technology experimental school in Hunan Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治家、教育家。曾任中华民国国务总理，其内阁被称为“进步党内阁”。他创办了西路师范讲习所（常德市第一中学前身）。
description.en: A Chinese politician and educator. He served as Premier of the Republic of China, and his cabinet was known as the 'Progressive Party Cabinet'. He also founded the West Route Normal School (the predecessor of Changde No. 1 Middle School).

description.zh-cn: 中国大陆对在教学质量、学校管理、师资、教学设施等多方面都比较出色的中学的非官方称呼。
description.en: An unofficial designation for middle schools in mainland China that excel in teaching quality, school management, faculty, and facilities.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代革命家，常德市第一中学校友。
description.en: A modern Chinese revolutionary and alumnus of Changde No. 1 Middle School.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期党员，常德市第一中学校友。
description.en: An early member of the Communist Party of China and an alumnus of Changde No. 1 Middle School.

description.zh-cn: 中国历史学家，常德市第一中学校友。
description.en: A Chinese historian and alumnus of Changde No. 1 Middle School.

description.zh-cn: 中国经济学家，常德市第一中学校友。
description.en: A Chinese economist and alumnus of Changde No. 1 Middle School.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中纪委副书记，常德市第一中学校友。
description.en: A Chinese political figure, former Deputy Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, and alumnus of Changde No. 1 Middle School.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，汪精卫政权特务头子，常德市第一中学校友。
description.en: A Chinese political figure, head of the secret service of the Wang Jingwei regime, and alumnus of Changde No. 1 Middle School.

description.zh-cn: 苏格兰的一所公立研究型大学，亚当·斯密曾在此求学并担任教授。
description.en: A public research university in Scotland where Adam Smith studied and later became a professor.

description.zh-cn: 苏格兰启蒙运动时期的哲学家、经济学家和历史学家，亚当·斯密的挚友。
description.en: A Scottish Enlightenment philosopher, economist, and historian, and a close friend of Adam Smith.

description.zh-cn: 苏格兰哲学家，亚当·斯密在格拉斯哥大学的老师，对斯密影响深远。
description.en: A Scottish philosopher who was Adam Smith's professor at the University of Glasgow and had a profound influence on him.

en: An Inquiry into the Nature and Causes of the Wealth of Nations
zh-cn: 国民财富的性质和原因的研究

description.zh-cn: 亚当·斯密的代表作，系统性地阐述了古典经济学理论，奠定了现代经济学的基础。书中提出了劳动分工、自由市场和“看不见的手”等核心概念。
description.en: Adam Smith's magnum opus, which systematically expounds classical economic theory and lays the foundation for modern economics. It introduces core concepts such as the division of labour, the free market, and the 'invisible hand'.

description.zh-cn: 亚当·斯密的第一本主要著作，阐述了他的道德哲学，核心是基于“同情心”的理论。
description.en: Adam Smith's first major work, which lays out his moral philosophy based on the principle of 'sympathy'.

description.zh-cn: 一种经济理论和政策体系，主张通过贸易保护主义（如减少进口、增加出口）来积累国家财富。亚当·斯密的《国富论》对其进行了经典的批驳。
description.en: An economic theory and policy system that advocates for accumulating national wealth through protectionist trade policies (such as reducing imports and increasing exports). It was classically refuted by Adam Smith in 'The Wealth of Nations'.

description.zh-cn: 18世纪法国的经济学派，认为国家财富的唯一来源是农业。其领导人物是弗朗索瓦·魁奈。
description.en: An 18th-century French school of economics that held that the wealth of nations was derived solely from the value of agriculture. Its leader was François Quesnay.

description.zh-cn: 以亚当·斯密的《国富论》为起点的经济学派，主要关注经济增长和财富分配。
description.en: The school of economic thought that began with Adam Smith's 'The Wealth of Nations', focusing primarily on economic growth and wealth distribution.

description.zh-cn: 英国政治家，聘请亚当·斯密担任其继子亨利·斯科特的私人家教。
description.en: A British politician who hired Adam Smith as a private tutor for his stepson, Henry Scott.

zh-cn: 第三代巴克卢公爵亨利·斯科特

description.zh-cn: 苏格兰贵族，亚当·斯密在1764年至1766年间担任其私人家教。
description.en: A Scottish nobleman for whom Adam Smith served as a private tutor from 1764 to 1766.

description.zh-cn: 法国经济学家，重农主义学派的领导人，亚当·斯密在巴黎与其结识并极为尊重其理论。
description.en: A French economist and leader of the Physiocratic school, whom Adam Smith met in Paris and whose theories he greatly respected.

description.zh-cn: 苏格兰法夫郡的一个城镇，是亚当·斯密的出生地。
description.en: A town in Fife, Scotland, which is the birthplace of Adam Smith.

description.zh-cn: 苏格兰医生和化学家，亚当·斯密在格拉斯哥大学的同事和好友，也是斯密的遗嘱执行人之一。
description.en: A Scottish physician and chemist, a colleague and friend of Adam Smith at the University of Glasgow, and one of the executors of Smith's will.

description.zh-cn: 苏格兰地质学家，亚当·斯密的好友，也是斯密的遗嘱执行人之一。
description.en: A Scottish geologist, a friend of Adam Smith, and one of the executors of Smith's will.

description.zh-cn: 1950年3月由中国人民解放军发起的战役，导致了西南军政长官公署的最终溃散。
description.en: A military campaign launched by the People's Liberation Army in March 1950, which led to the final collapse of the Southwest Military and Political Administrator's Office.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事将领，在西南军政长官公署及其前身机构中长期担任参谋长职务。
description.en: A military general of the Republic of China who served for a long time as Chief of Staff in the Southwest Military and Political Administrator's Office and its predecessor organizations.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事将领，曾任西南军政长官公署副长官及西昌警备总司令部总司令。
description.en: A military general of the Republic of China who served as Deputy Administrator of the Southwest Military and Political Administrator's Office and Commander-in-Chief of the Xichang Garrison Command.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事将领，曾任西南军政长官公署副长官及西南第二路游击总司令。
description.en: A military general of the Republic of China who served as Deputy Administrator of the Southwest Military and Political Administrator's Office and Commander-in-Chief of the Southwest Second Route Guerrilla.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治及军事人物，曾任贵州绥靖公署主任。
description.en: A political and military figure of the Republic of China who served as Director of the Guizhou Pacification Command.

description.zh-cn: 位于四川省的城市，西南军政长官公署后期所在地，于1950年3月27日被解放军攻占。
description.en: A city in Sichuan Province, the later location of the Southwest Military and Political Administrator's Office, captured by the PLA on March 27, 1950.

description.zh-cn: 山西省人民政府的组成部门，主管全省教育事业。
description.en: A constituent department of the Shanxi Provincial People's Government, responsible for education affairs in the province.

description.zh-cn: 曾任太原市第五中学校校长。
description.en: Former principal of Taiyuan No. 5 Middle School.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期领导人，太原市第五中学校杰出校友。
description.en: An early leader of the Communist Party of China and a distinguished alumnus of Taiyuan No. 5 Middle School.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，中国共产党党员，第十三届全国人民代表大会河南省代表。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, a member of the Communist Party of China, and a deputy from Henan Province to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 河南省洛阳市下辖区，宁建华的家乡。
description.en: A district under the jurisdiction of Luoyang City, Henan Province, hometown of Ning Jianhua.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国黑龙江省绥化市下辖的县，王悦华的出生地。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Suihua City, Heilongjiang Province, People's Republic of China, and the birthplace of Wang Yuehua.

zh-cn: 中国共产主义青年团黑龙江省委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国共产主义青年团在黑龙江省的省级组织。
description.en: The provincial-level organization of the Communist Youth League of China in Heilongjiang Province.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国黑龙江省鸡西市的地方国家行政机关。
description.en: The local state administrative organ of Jixi City, Heilongjiang Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华全国总工会在黑龙江省的地方组织。
description.en: The local organization of the All-China Federation of Trade Unions in Heilongjiang Province.

description.zh-cn: 满洲国及中华民国大陆时期的一个省份。
description.en: A province during the Manchukuo and Republic of China mainland periods.

description.zh-cn: 中国土壤微生物学家，中国科学院院士，祖籍江苏昆山。主要研究土壤微生物区系、营养物质的生物循环、紫云英根瘤菌共生固氮等。
description.en: Chinese soil microbiologist and academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, with ancestral roots in Kunshan, Jiangsu. His main research areas include soil microbial flora, biological cycling of nutrients, and symbiotic nitrogen fixation by Chinese milk vetch rhizobia.

description.zh-cn: 中国植物学家。
description.en: Chinese botanist.

en: China Association of Agricultural Science Societies

description.zh-cn: 伦敦大学博士，武汉大学物理学教授。
description.en: Ph.D. from the University of London, professor of physics at Wuhan University.

zh-cn: 河南省文学艺术界联合会

description.zh-cn: 日本的军事院校，张学成和张学文曾在此留学深造。
description.en: A military academy in Japan where Zhang Xuecheng and Zhang Xuewen studied.

description.zh-cn: 大日本帝国的武装力量。在皇姑屯事件中刺杀了张作霖，并发动了九一八事变侵略奉天。张学成在事变后投靠该军队。
description.en: The armed forces of the Empire of Japan. They assassinated Zhang Zuolin in the Huanggutun Incident and launched the Mukden Incident to invade Fengtian. Zhang Xuecheng defected to this army after the incident.

description.zh-cn: 中国辽宁省的城市，张学成在此地附近被击毙。
description.en: A city in Liaoning Province, China, near where Zhang Xuecheng was killed.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共吉林省委宣传部部长，吉林省文学艺术界联合会主席，吉林省政协副主席。
description.en: Politician of the People's Republic of China, former Minister of the Propaganda Department of the CPC Jilin Provincial Committee, Chairman of the Jilin Federation of Literary and Art Circles, and Vice Chairman of the Jilin Provincial CPPCC.

zh-cn: 吉林省文学艺术界联合会

description.zh-cn: 由吉林省文学艺术界联合会和各艺术家协会组成的专业性人民团体。
description.en: A professional people's organization composed of the Jilin Provincial Federation of Literary and Art Circles and various artists' associations.

zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议吉林省委员会
en: Jilin Provincial Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议吉林省委员会，是中国人民政治协商会议在吉林省的地方组织。
description.en: The Jilin Provincial Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference is the local organization of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference in Jilin Province.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央政治局于2012年12月4日提出的关于改进工作作风、密切联系群众的八项规定，对领导干部的公务活动作出了严格限制。据报道，周本顺曾对此表达不满。
description.en: The eight-point regulation on improving work style and maintaining close ties with the masses, introduced by the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee on December 4, 2012, places strict limits on the official activities of leading cadres. Zhou Benshun reportedly expressed dissatisfaction with these regulations.

description.zh-cn: 德国军事家，曾任德国军事顾问团领导人。
description.en: German military officer who previously led the German military mission in China.

description.zh-cn: 在1928年至1938年间，由德国派遣至中华民国，协助国民革命军进行军事改革与训练的顾问团体。
description.en: A group of German military advisors sent to the Republic of China between 1928 and 1938 to assist in the reform and training of the National Revolutionary Army.

en: Military Administration in Belgium and Northern France
zh-cn: 比利时及北法兰西军事行政区
比利时和法国北部军事行政区

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战期间，纳粹德国在占领的比利时和法国北部地区设立的临时军事占领机构。
description.en: An interim occupation authority established by Nazi Germany during World War II in occupied Belgium and northern France.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国的精锐准军事组织。
description.en: A major paramilitary organization under Adolf Hitler and the Nazi Party in Nazi Germany.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国的国家秘密警察。
description.en: The official secret police of Nazi Germany.

description.zh-cn: 一个族教群体，起源于中东的以色列人或希伯来人。在维希法国时期，他们成为系统性迫害和围捕的对象，导致至少72,500人被杀害。
description.en: An ethnoreligious group originating from the Israelites or Hebrews of the ancient Near East. During the Vichy France period, they were subject to systematic persecution and roundups, resulting in the murder of at least 72,500 people.

description.zh-cn: 华裔比利时化学家，在二战期间从纳粹枪口下拯救了近百名比利时人，并为法肯豪森辩护作证。
description.en: A Chinese-Belgian chemist who rescued nearly 100 Belgians from the Nazis during World War II and later testified in defense of Falkenhausen.

description.zh-cn: 德国政治家，德国抵抗运动的重要成员。
description.en: A German politician and a key figure in the German resistance to Nazism.

description.zh-cn: 德国陆军元帅，德国抵抗运动成员，7月20日密谋案的主要人物之一。
description.en: A German field marshal and a member of the German Resistance, and a key figure in the 20 July plot.

description.zh-cn: 1944年7月20日，德国抵抗运动成员在“狼穴”总部刺杀阿道夫·希特勒并夺取政权的未遂事件。
description.en: A failed attempt by members of the German Resistance to assassinate Adolf Hitler and seize control of the government at the Wolf's Lair headquarters on 20 July 1944.

description.zh-cn: 位于陕西、甘肃边界地区的革命根据地，是红军长征的最终目的地。
description.en: A revolutionary base area located on the border of Shaanxi and Gansu provinces, which was the final destination of the Long March.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中央人民政府重工业部有色金属工业局局长。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as the Director of the Non-ferrous Metals Industry Bureau of the Central People's Government Ministry of Heavy Industry.

description.zh-cn: 原为中央人民政府重工业部下设的职能局，1952年8月划归第一机械工业部。
description.en: Originally a functional bureau under the Central People's Government Ministry of Heavy Industry, it was transferred to the First Ministry of Machine Building Industry in August 1952.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中央人民政府重工业部兵工总局副局长。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as Deputy Director of the Ordnance Administration of the Central People's Government Ministry of Heavy Industry.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中南兵工局第二副局长。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as the Second Deputy Director of the Central South Ordnance Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，1954年6月起任中央人民政府重工业部副部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, appointed Vice Minister of the Central People's Government Ministry of Heavy Industry in June 1954.

description.zh-cn: 晏婴的父亲，因宋国内乱而到齐国担任上大夫。
description.en: Father of Yan Ying, who served as a senior official (Shang Dafu) in the State of Qi after fleeing civil unrest in the State of Song.

description.zh-cn: 晏婴的儿子。
description.en: Son of Yan Ying.

description.zh-cn: 春秋时期宋国君主，晏弱的曾祖父。
description.en: Duke Mu of Song, a ruler of the State of Song during the Spring and Autumn period and the great-grandfather of Yan Ruo.

description.zh-cn: 春秋时期齐国君主，晏婴曾为其臣。
description.en: Duke Ling of Qi, a ruler of the State of Qi during the Spring and Autumn period, served by Yan Ying.

description.zh-cn: 春秋时期齐国君主，晏婴曾为其臣，后被大夫崔杼所杀。
description.en: Duke Zhuang II of Qi, a ruler of the State of Qi during the Spring and Autumn period, served by Yan Ying and later assassinated by the official Cui Zhu.

description.zh-cn: 春秋时期齐国大夫，因其妻与齐后庄公通奸而谋杀了庄公。
description.en: An official of the State of Qi during the Spring and Autumn period who assassinated Duke Zhuang II for having an affair with his wife.

description.zh-cn: 春秋时期楚国君主，晏婴出使楚国时曾与其会面。
description.en: King Ling of Chu, a ruler of the State of Chu during the Spring and Autumn period, whom Yan Ying met during a diplomatic mission.

description.zh-cn: 一位贤人，曾被囚禁，后被晏婴赎出并待为上宾。
description.en: A worthy man who was imprisoned and later ransomed and treated as an honored guest by Yan Ying.

description.zh-cn: 齐景公时期的大将之一，在“二桃杀三士”事件中自刎身亡。
description.en: One of the generals under Duke Jing of Qi, who committed suicide in the incident of 'Two Peaches Kill Three Warriors'.

description.zh-cn: 齐景公时期的大将之一，在“二桃杀三士”事件中自刎身亡。“二桃杀三士”是一则历史典故，讲述晏婴利用计谋，通过两个桃子使三位恃功而骄的勇士自杀。
description.en: One of the generals under Duke Jing of Qi, who committed suicide in the incident of 'Two Peaches Kill Three Warriors'. The 'Two Peaches Kill Three Warriors' incident is a historical anecdote about how Yan Ying used a stratagem with two peaches to cause three arrogant but accomplished warriors to kill themselves.

description.zh-cn: 春秋时期的一种高级官职。
description.en: A high-ranking official position during the Spring and Autumn period.

description.zh-cn: 中国历史上的一个时期，始于平王东迁，终于三家分晋。晏婴是此一时期的重要人物。
description.en: A period in Chinese history from approximately 770 to 476 BC. Yan Ying was an important figure during this time.

birth_place.en: Lunbei Village, Torao District, Tainan Prefecture

death_place.zh-cn: 中华民国台湾省台北市古亭区马场町
death_place.en: Machangding, Guting District, Taipei City, Taiwan Province, Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 台湾教师、社会活动家，云林仑背人。曾任猫儿干国民学校校长，并在南投竹山国民学校、台北龙山国民学校、云林莿桐国民学校任教。因在台湾白色恐怖时期参与中国共产党台湾省工作委员会的地下活动，于1951年被国民党政府逮捕，1952年被枪决。2018年促进转型正义委员会撤销其有罪判决。
description.en: A Taiwanese teacher and social activist from Lunbei, Yunlin. He served as the principal of Ma'o-kan Elementary School and also taught at Zhushan Elementary School in Nantou, Longshan Elementary School in Taipei, and Citong Elementary School in Yunlin. During the White Terror period in Taiwan, he was arrested by the Kuomintang government in 1951 for his involvement in the underground activities of the Taiwan Provincial Work Committee of the Communist Party of China, and was executed by firing squad in 1952. In 2018, the Transitional Justice Commission posthumously exonerated him by revoking his conviction.

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾台南市的国立大学，郭庆曾在此就读。
description.en: A national university located in Tainan, Taiwan, where Guo Qing studied.

zh-cn: 台北市私立延平高级中学

description.zh-cn: 台湾一所已于二二八事件后停办的学院，郭庆曾在此夜间部进修。
description.en: A college in Taiwan that ceased operations after the February 28 incident, where Guo Qing attended night classes.

description.zh-cn: 二仑乡公所总干事，中共地下党员，介绍郭庆加入组织。
description.en: Chief executive of Erlun Township Office, an underground member of the Communist Party of China, who introduced Guo Qing to the organization.

description.zh-cn: 位于台北市的墓地，埋葬了许多台湾白色恐怖时期的政治受难者，郭庆的墓地在此被发现。
description.en: A cemetery in Taipei where many political victims of the White Terror period were buried; Guo Qing's grave was discovered here.

description.zh-cn: 1949年中华民国政府在台湾实施的土地改革政策。
description.en: A land reform policy implemented by the government of the Republic of China in Taiwan in 1949.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，中国共产党党员，第十三届全国人民代表大会解放军和武警部队代表。
description.en: A Chinese politician, member of the Communist Party of China, and a delegate of the People's Liberation Army and Armed Police Force to the 13th National People's Congress.

en: People's Liberation Army and People's Armed Police Force
zh-cn: 全国人民代表大会解放军和武警部队代表团

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军和中国人民武装警察部队在全国人民代表大会的联合代表团。
description.en: The joint delegation of the People's Liberation Army and the People's Armed Police Force to the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国飞行员、政治人物，曾任中国人民解放军空军指挥学院副院长、中华全国妇女联合会副主席，拥有中国人民解放军空军少将军衔。
description.en: A Chinese pilot and politician, she formerly served as the Deputy Dean of the PLA Air Force Command College and Vice Chairperson of the All-China Women's Federation, holding the rank of Major General in the PLA Air Force.

description.zh-cn: 由OpenAI开发的人工智能聊天机器人。
description.en: An artificial intelligence chatbot developed by OpenAI.

description.zh-cn: 由OpenAI开发的多模态大型语言模型。
description.en: A multimodal large language model developed by OpenAI.

description.zh-cn: 一家美国跨国科技公司，设计、开发和销售消费电子产品、计算机软件和在线服务。
description.en: An American multinational technology company that designs, develops, and sells consumer electronics, computer software, and online services.

description.zh-cn: 由苹果公司为其iOS和iPadOS操作系统创建的移动应用程序数字发行平台。
description.en: A mobile app digital distribution platform created by Apple Inc. for its iOS and iPadOS operating systems.

description.zh-cn: 国际新闻通讯社。
description.en: An international news agency.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国官方倡导的一套价值观。
description.en: A set of values promoted by the government of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 一个文本到图像的深度学习模型。
description.en: A deep learning, text-to-image model.

description.zh-cn: 由微软公司推出的网络搜索引擎，后集成人工智能聊天功能。
description.en: A web search engine owned and operated by Microsoft, later integrated with AI chat features.

description.zh-cn: 指中国在文化大革命结束后，通过1977年和1978年恢复的高考所招收的两个年级的大学生。这一群体因其独特的时代背景、刻苦的学习精神以及在改革开放后社会各领域发挥的重要作用而备受关注。
description.en: Refers to the two cohorts of university students enrolled through the restored National College Entrance Examination (Gaokao) in 1977 and 1978, following the end of the Cultural Revolution in China. This group is notable for its unique historical context, diligent study habits, and the significant roles its members played in various sectors during the Reform and Opening-up era.

zh-cn: 普通高等学校招生全国统一考试

description.zh-cn: 中国的大学入学考试。该考试自1965年起中断，于1977年恢复，对中国社会产生了深远影响，并直接促成了“77-78级”大学生的产生。
description.en: The university entrance examination in China. It was suspended from 1965 and reinstated in 1977, an event that had a profound impact on Chinese society and directly led to the creation of the 'Class of 77-78'.

description.zh-cn: “知识青年”的简称，指在文化大革命期间从城市被派往农村地区接受“贫下中农再教育”的青年。恢复高考对他们而言是改变命运的重大机遇。
description.en: An abbreviation for 'intellectual youth', referring to the young people sent from cities to rural areas for 're-education from poor and lower-middle peasants' during the Cultural Revolution. The restoration of Gaokao was a life-changing opportunity for them.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在土地改革和文革时期划分的阶级成分，在“上山下乡”运动中负责对知青进行“再教育”。
description.en: A class designation defined by the Chinese Communist Party during the land reform and Cultural Revolution eras. They were tasked with the 're-education' of the sent-down youth during the 'Up to the Mountains and Down to the Countryside Movement'.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命时期盛行的一种观念，认为读书学习没有价值。77-78级大学生在当时坚持读书，克服了这一观念的影响。
description.en: A prevalent concept during the Cultural Revolution that held that studying and learning were useless. Students of the Class of 77-78 persisted in their studies, overcoming the influence of this idea.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间通过单位推荐而非入学考试方式进入大学的学生群体。
description.en: A group of students who entered universities during the Cultural Revolution through recommendation from their work units rather than by entrance examination.

en: Koo Foundation Sun Yat-Sen Cancer Center
zh-cn: 医疗财团法人辜公亮基金会和信治癌中心医院

description.zh-cn: 医疗财团法人辜公亮基金会的所属医疗机构。
description.en: The affiliated medical institution of the Koo Foundation.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国辽宁省沈阳市下辖的市辖区。
description.en: A municipal district of Shenyang, Liaoning province, China.

description.zh-cn: 加拿大政治人物，现任多伦多市长。
description.en: Canadian politician, current Mayor of Toronto.

description.zh-cn: 上加拿大总督，于1793年建立了约克镇（现多伦多）。
description.en: Governor of Upper Canada who founded the Town of York (now Toronto) in 1793.

description.zh-cn: 多伦多首位市长，1837年上加拿大起义的领导者。
description.en: The first mayor of Toronto and a leader of the Upper Canada Rebellion of 1837.

description.zh-cn: 一场反对英国殖民政府精英小圈子的武装冲突。
description.en: An armed conflict against the elite circle of the British colonial government.

description.zh-cn: 为管理多伦多市及其周边城镇而成立的省级行政区划，于1998年被新的多伦多市取代。
description.en: A regional level of government established to manage the City of Toronto and its surrounding municipalities, replaced by the new City of Toronto in 1998.

description.zh-cn: 加拿大一级行政区，该国人口最多的省份。于1867年加入联邦，是加拿大联邦的创始成员之一。
description.en: A Canadian first-level administrative division and the most populous province in the country. It joined the Confederation in 1867 as one of its founding members.

description.zh-cn: 1841年至1867年期间大英帝国在北美洲的殖民地。
description.en: A British colony in North America from 1841 to 1867.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国军事人物，中国人民解放军少将，曾任陕西省军区顾问。
description.en: A military figure of the People's Republic of China, a major general in the People's Liberation Army, and a former consultant to the Shaanxi Military Region.

location.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国陕西省

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陕西省军区

description.zh-cn: 中国塑性成形领域学者、清华大学机械工程系教授，中华人民共和国教育部第二批“长江学者”特聘教授。
description.en: A scholar in the field of plastic forming, a professor in the Department of Mechanical Engineering at Tsinghua University, and a distinguished professor of the second batch of the 'Chang Jiang Scholars Program' of the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 位于德国斯图加特的一所领先的研究型大学，尤其在工程和技术领域。
description.en: A leading research university in Stuttgart, Germany, especially in the fields of engineering and technology.

description.zh-cn: 突尼斯前总统，在茉莉花革命中被推翻，结束长达23年的执政。
description.en: Former President of Tunisia, ousted during the Jasmine Revolution, ending his 23-year rule.

zh-cn: 穆罕默德·胡斯尼·穆巴拉克

description.zh-cn: 埃及前总统，在2011年埃及革命中被推翻，结束长达30年的统治。
description.en: Former President of Egypt, ousted during the 2011 Egyptian revolution, ending his 30-year rule.

zh-cn: 阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹·布特弗利卡

description.zh-cn: 阿尔及利亚前总统，在2019年全国游行示威后提前下台，结束近20年的总统生涯。
description.en: Former President of Algeria, resigned after nationwide protests in 2019, ending his nearly 20-year presidency.

description.zh-cn: 也门前总统，执政33年后在2011年反政府示威中移交权力，后在也门内战中被杀。
description.en: Former President of Yemen, who transferred power after 33 years of rule during the 2011 anti-government protests and was later killed in the Yemeni Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 因阿拉伯之春导致的北非和中东地区动荡，大量难民和移民涌入欧洲引发的危机。
description.en: A crisis caused by the large influx of refugees and migrants into Europe due to instability in North Africa and the Middle East following the Arab Spring.

description.zh-cn: 发生在突尼斯的民众反政府运动，导致本·阿里政权倒台，并引发了阿拉伯之春。
description.en: A popular anti-government movement in Tunisia that led to the fall of Ben Ali's regime and triggered the Arab Spring.

description.zh-cn: 突尼斯年轻小贩，其自焚事件成为茉莉花革命乃至整个阿拉伯之春的导火索。
description.en: A young Tunisian street vendor whose self-immolation was the catalyst for the Jasmine Revolution and the entire Arab Spring.

description.zh-cn: 导致埃及总统穆巴拉克下台的民众反政府运动。
description.en: A popular anti-government movement that led to the resignation of Egyptian President Mubarak.

description.zh-cn: 卡扎菲政权倒台后，利比亚各派系之间爆发的武装冲突。
description.en: An armed conflict between various factions in Libya following the overthrow of the Gaddafi regime.

description.zh-cn: 也门哈迪政府被推翻后，由胡塞武装与沙特领导的联军等多方参与的持续内战。
description.en: An ongoing civil war involving multiple parties, including the Houthi movement and the Saudi-led coalition, following the overthrow of the Hadi government.

description.zh-cn: 埃及首位民选总统，后在2013年埃及政变中被军方推翻，最终在法庭上身亡。
description.en: The first democratically elected president of Egypt, who was overthrown by the military in the 2013 Egyptian coup d'état and later died in court.

description.zh-cn: 埃及军方推翻民选总统穆尔西的政变。
description.en: The military coup in Egypt that overthrew the democratically elected President Morsi.

description.zh-cn: 导致苏丹总统巴希尔被推翻的军事政变。
description.en: The military coup that led to the overthrow of Sudanese President Omar al-Bashir.

description.zh-cn: 苏丹武装部队与快速支援部队之间爆发的全国性武装冲突。
description.en: A nationwide armed conflict that broke out between the Sudanese Armed Forces and the Rapid Support Forces.

zh-cn: 阿卜杜拉布·曼苏尔·哈迪
阿卜杜·拉布·曼苏尔·哈迪

description.zh-cn: 也门前总统，在萨利赫下台后接任，后被胡塞武装推翻。
description.en: Former President of Yemen, who took office after Saleh stepped down and was later overthrown by Houthi forces.

description.zh-cn: 也门的什叶派政治和武装组织，在也门内战中扮演关键角色。
description.en: A Shia political and armed organization in Yemen that plays a key role in the Yemeni Civil War.

en: Saudi-led intervention in the Yemeni civil war
zh-cn: 沙特领导的干预也门行动

description.zh-cn: 沙特阿拉伯领导的多个逊尼派国家联军对也门胡塞武装展开的军事干预行动。
description.en: A military intervention in Yemen by a coalition of several Sunni Muslim countries led by Saudi Arabia against the Houthi movement.

description.zh-cn: 利比亚反对派在第一次利比亚内战期间成立的临时政府机构，成功推翻了卡扎菲政权。
description.en: The interim governing body established by opposition forces during the First Libyan Civil War, which successfully overthrew the Gaddafi regime.

zh-cn: 联合国安全理事会第1973号决议

description.zh-cn: 联合国安理会通过的决议，授权在利比亚设立禁飞区并采取“一切必要措施”保护平民，为多国军事干预提供了法律依据。
description.en: A resolution passed by the UN Security Council authorizing a no-fly zone over Libya and taking "all necessary measures" to protect civilians, providing a legal basis for multinational military intervention.

zh-cn: 海湾阿拉伯国家合作委员会

description.zh-cn: 由海湾六国组成的区域性组织，在阿拉伯之春期间介入了巴林和也门的局势。
description.en: A regional organization comprising six Gulf states that intervened in the situations in Bahrain and Yemen during the Arab Spring.

description.zh-cn: 西亚岛国，在阿拉伯之春期间爆发了大规模反政府示威，后在海合会干预下平息。
description.en: An island country in Western Asia that experienced large-scale anti-government protests during the Arab Spring, which were suppressed with the intervention of the GCC.

description.zh-cn: 2011年在美国纽约爆发的抗议运动，受阿拉伯之春影响，抗议社会不公和经济不平等。
description.en: A protest movement that began in New York City in 2011, influenced by the Arab Spring, protesting social and economic inequality.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，中国共产党党员，曾任中央政府驻澳门联络办公室协调部部长，第十一、十二届全国政协委员。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China and a member of the Communist Party of China. He served as the Minister of the Coordination Department of the Liaison Office of the Central People's Government in Macao and was a member of the 11th and 12th National Committees of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 由中国共产党领导的全国性社会团体，旨在加强海内外中华儿女的联系与团结。
description.en: A national social organization led by the Communist Party of China, aiming to strengthen connections and unity among Chinese people at home and abroad.

zh-cn: 唱红歌、读经典、讲故事、传箴言
宣扬中国共产党传统革命思想

description.zh-cn: 重庆模式期间推广的一项意识形态宣传活动，要求市民歌唱红色歌曲、阅读经典、讲述故事、传播箴言。
description.en: An ideological propaganda campaign promoted during the Chongqing Model period, requiring citizens to sing red songs, read classics, tell stories, and spread maxims.

description.zh-cn: 一个政治意识形态派别，在中国语境下通常指支持更多国家干预和强调意识形态纯洁性的人士。
description.en: A political ideological faction, which in the Chinese context usually refers to those who support more state intervention and emphasize ideological purity.

description.zh-cn: 中国法学家，对重庆模式持批评态度，认为其“打黑”是“黑打”，破坏法治。
description.en: A Chinese legal scholar who was critical of the Chongqing Model, arguing that its 'strike black' campaign was an illegal crackdown that undermined the rule of law.

description.zh-cn: 指律师李庄在为重庆涉黑案嫌疑人辩护期间，被控伪证罪并被判刑的事件，是重庆打黑运动中标志性的争议案件。
description.en: Refers to the incident where lawyer Li Zhuang was charged with perjury and sentenced while defending a suspect in a Chongqing organized crime case. It is a landmark controversial case in the Chongqing 'strike black' campaign.

zh-cn: 中国致公党广西壮族自治区委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国致公党在广西壮族自治区的地方组织。
description.en: The local organization of the China Zhi Gong Party in the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 中国致公党广西壮族自治区第十四届委员会主任委员。
description.en: Chairman of the 14th Committee of the China Zhi Gong Party in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 中国历史学家、研究馆员，现任故宫博物院副院长、中国史学会清宫史研究会秘书长，是享受国务院政府特殊津贴的专家。主要从事清代政治制度与礼俗研究。
description.en: Chinese historian and research fellow, currently serving as the Deputy Director of the Palace Museum and Secretary-General of the Qing Palace History Research Association of the Chinese Historical Association. She is an expert who receives the special government allowance from the State Council. Her research primarily focuses on the political system, rites, and customs of the Qing Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国黑龙江省的城市，是任万平的出生地。
description.en: A city in Heilongjiang Province, China, and the birthplace of Ren Wanping.

en: History of Qing (People's Republic of China)

description.zh-cn: 由中华人民共和国组织纂修的清朝历史著作。
description.en: A historical work on the Qing Dynasty compiled under the organization of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国中央电视台推出的一档文博探索类节目。
description.en: A cultural and museum exploration program produced by China Central Television.

description.zh-cn: 中国中央电视台文博探索类节目《国家宝藏》的第二季。
description.en: The second season of the CCTV cultural and museum exploration program 'National Treasure'.

description.zh-cn: 中国法学家，清华大学法学院教授。她对《治安管理处罚法》2023年修订草案中关于“伤害中华民族感情”的条款提出了公开批评。
description.en: Chinese legal scholar and professor at Tsinghua University School of Law. She publicly criticized the clauses regarding 'hurting the feelings of the Chinese nation' in the 2023 draft amendment to the 'Public Security Administration Punishments Law'.

description.zh-cn: 清华大学下属的法学院，劳东燕在此任教。
description.en: The law school of Tsinghua University, where Lao Dongyan is a professor.

description.zh-cn: 中国法学家，华东政法大学宪法学教授。他对《治安管理处罚法》2023年修订草案提出了批评。
description.en: Chinese legal scholar and professor of constitutional law at East China University of Political Science and Law. He criticized the 2023 draft amendment to the 'Public Security Administration Punishments Law'.

description.zh-cn: 中国政法大学教授，她对《治安管理处罚法》2023年修订草案提出了批评。
description.en: Professor at China University of Political Science and Law, who criticized the 2023 draft amendment to the 'Public Security Administration Punishments Law'.

description.zh-cn: 中国政法大学教授，她对《治安管理处罚法》2023年修订草案中将“侮辱”、“谩骂”视为阻碍执行职务的行为表示担忧。
description.en: Professor at China University of Political Science and Law, who expressed concern about classifying 'insult' and 'verbal abuse' as obstruction of duty in the 2023 draft amendment to the 'Public Security Administration Punishments Law'.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，时任司法部部长，在第十四届全国人大常委会第五次会议上就《中华人民共和国治安管理处罚法（修订草案）》作了说明。
description.en: Chinese politician, then Minister of Justice, who explained the 'Public Security Administration Punishments Law (Revised Draft)' at the fifth session of the Standing Committee of the 14th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 一种法律概念，指国家面临或发生重大威胁时，政府可采取特殊措施的状态。《治安管理处罚法》第五十条规定了拒不执行紧急状态下命令的处罚，但在实践中其适用引发了争议。
description.en: A legal concept where a government can take special measures when the state faces a major threat. Article 50 of the 'Public Security Administration Punishments Law' stipulates penalties for refusing to comply with orders under a state of emergency, but its application has been controversial in practice.

description.zh-cn: 中国电气自动化专家，曾任中共天津市委常委、第八届全国人大代表、常委会委员。
description.en: A Chinese expert in electrical automation, who served as a member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Tianjin Municipal Committee, a delegate to the 8th National People's Congress, and a member of its Standing Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国最高层级的地方行政区划，包括省、自治区、直辖市等。

description.zh-cn: 县人民政府的常设组成部门，负责教育事务。
description.en: A permanent component department of the County People's Government, responsible for educational affairs.

description.zh-cn: 中国国际问题研究专家，现任外交学院院长。
description.en: An expert on international studies in China, currently serving as the President of China Foreign Affairs University.

description.zh-cn: 中国外交官，曾任中国驻瑞士大使，现任外交学院党委书记。
description.en: A Chinese diplomat, former Chinese Ambassador to Switzerland, and current Party Secretary of China Foreign Affairs University.

description.zh-cn: 承担全国外交外事人员、国际职员后备人员的培训，以及相关国际交流合作等工作的机构，与外交学院一个机构两块牌子。
description.en: An institution responsible for the training of national diplomatic and foreign affairs personnel, reserve personnel for international organizations, and related international exchange and cooperation. It operates under the 'one institution, two names' model with China Foreign Affairs University.

description.zh-cn: 一种学术性活动，学生在其中扮演不同国家的外交官，模拟联合国会议的议事规则，讨论国际热点问题。
description.en: An academic activity in which students role-play as diplomats from different countries, simulating UN conferences to discuss pressing international issues according to the rules of procedure.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，中国共产党党员。曾任第十三届全国人民代表大会甘肃省代表。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China and a member of the Communist Party of China. He served as a delegate from Gansu Province to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 无线电视翡翠台的晚间综艺节目，四朵金花在此节目中组成并演出。

description.en: A Hong Kong artist and host of 'Enjoy Yourself Tonight' at the time, who named the group 'Four Golden Flowers'.

description.en: A Hong Kong songwriter and lyricist who composed and wrote the lyrics for the Four Golden Flowers' signature song of the same name.

description.zh-cn: 香港的唱片公司，四朵金花的唱片由其副牌丽歌唱片发行。
description.en: A record company in Hong Kong, whose sub-label Regal Records released the albums of the Four Golden Flowers.

description.en: A sworn sisterhood group formed by seven famous actresses from the Hong Kong Cantonese cinema era, of which Wong Oi-ming was a member.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物与商界高管，中国共产党党员。历任习酒董事长、习酒集团董事长，后于2024年出任贵州茅台集团党委书记、董事长。同时也是第十三届全国人民代表大会代表。
description.en: A Chinese politician and business executive, and a member of the Communist Party of China. He has served as Chairman of Xijiu and Chairman of Xijiu Group, and in 2024 became the Party Secretary and Chairman of Kweichow Moutai Group. He is also a delegate to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国主张的政治原则，认为世界上只有一个中国，中华人民共和国政府是全中国的唯一合法政府，台湾是中国的一部分。
description.en: A political principle asserted by the People's Republic of China, which holds that there is only one China in the world, the government of the PRC is the sole legal government of all China, and Taiwan is a part of China.

description.zh-cn: 一种主张中华人民共和国和中华民国（台湾）是两个独立主权国家的政治观点。
description.en: A political viewpoint advocating that the People's Republic of China and the Republic of China (Taiwan) are two separate sovereign states.

description.en: A political viewpoint that posits the concurrent existence of two independent sovereign states, the People's Republic of China and the Republic of China.

en: Theory of the Undetermined Status of Taiwan

description.zh-cn: 一种认为台湾的主权归属在法律上尚未确定的理论。
description.en: A theory holding that the sovereignty of Taiwan has not yet been legally determined.

description.zh-cn: 一个政治原则，其核心思想是世界上只有一个代表中国的国家。各方对其具体含义有不同解释。

description.en: A Chinese politician of Han ethnicity and a member of the Communist Party of China. She served as a researcher for PLA Air Force Unit 95851 and was a deputy of the People's Liberation Army and People's Armed Police Force delegation to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.en: The fifth emperor of the Qing dynasty, and the third Qing emperor to rule over China proper.

description.en: An ancient Chinese official title. In the second year of the Yongzheng reign of the Qing dynasty, the Yuanwailang of the Zongrenfu was renamed Fulisiguan (Deputy Director).

description.zh-cn: 由越南宗正府改名而来，后在后黎朝时期改名为宗人府。
description.en: Renamed from the Vietnamese Zongzhengfu, it was later renamed Zongrenfu during the Later Lê dynasty.

description.en: The third emperor of the Nguyễn dynasty of Vietnam. Due to the taboo on his personal name, the Vietnamese Zongrenfu was renamed Tôn Nhơn Phủ.

He has served as a Standing Committee member of the Guangdong Provincial Political Consultative Conference, a delegate to the 19th National Congress of the CPC, Commander of the Guangdong Provincial Corps of the People's Armed Police Force, and Division Commander of the PAPF 8630 Unit.

description.zh-cn: 清末官员，东南互保的参与者之一。时任安徽巡抚。
description.en: A late Qing official who participated in the Mutual Protection of Southeast China. He was the Governor of Anhui at the time.

description.zh-cn: 清末官员，东南互保的参与者之一。在李鸿章北上议和时代理两广总督。
description.en: A late Qing official who participated in the Mutual Protection of Southeast China. He served as the acting Viceroy of Liangguang when Li Hongzhang went north for peace negotiations.

description.zh-cn: 清末官员，东南互保的支持者。时任四川总督。
description.en: A late Qing official who supported the Mutual Protection of Southeast China. He was the Viceroy of Sichuan at the time.

description.zh-cn: 清末状元、实业家、教育家，曾劝告刘坤一、张之洞等人实行东南互保。
description.en: A scholar, industrialist, and educator of the late Qing Dynasty who advised Liu Kunyi and Zhang Zhidong to initiate the Mutual Protection of Southeast China.

description.zh-cn: 清末民初著名谋士，曾劝告刘坤一、张之洞等人实行东南互保。
description.en: A famous strategist in the late Qing and early Republican era who advised Liu Kunyi and Zhang Zhidong to initiate the Mutual Protection of Southeast China.

description.zh-cn: 李鸿章幕僚，曾奉李鸿章之命联络孙中山，寻求其在广东独立计划中的协助。
description.en: An aide to Li Hongzhang who, on Li's behalf, contacted Sun Yat-sen to seek his assistance in a plan for Guangdong's independence.

description.zh-cn: 清末大臣，在东南互保后奉命到南方各省收缴财权和兵权，以加强中央集权。
description.en: A minister of the late Qing Dynasty who was sent to the southern provinces after the Mutual Protection of Southeast China to reclaim financial and military power for the central government.

description.zh-cn: 1950年中国国民党迁台后推行的一系列组织改革方案。
description.en: A series of organizational reform plans implemented by the Kuomintang after relocating to Taiwan in 1950.

description.zh-cn: 隶属于中国国民党中央委员会文化传播委员会，负责党史史料文物之征集、典藏、编纂与运用等事宜。
description.en: Subordinate to the KMT Central Committee's Cultural and Communications Committee, responsible for the collection, preservation, compilation, and utilization of party history materials and artifacts.

en: The more knowledge one has, the more reactionary one becomes

description.zh-cn: 美国哲学家，以其著作《无政府、国家与乌托邦》而闻名，是自由意志主义的重要代表人物。
