description.zh-cn: 明太祖朱元璋的妃子，有史料记载其为懿文太子朱标、秦愍王朱樉、晋恭王朱㭎的生母。
description.en: A consort of the Hongwu Emperor. Some historical sources identify her as the birth mother of Crown Prince Yiwen (Zhu Biao), Prince Min of Qin (Zhu Shuang), and Prince Gong of Jin (Zhu Gang).

description.zh-cn: 明朝参军，其子被诬告欲杀父，朱元璋欲诛之，因马皇后劝谏而查明真相，使其免罪。
description.en: A military adjutant in the Ming dynasty. When his son was falsely accused of patricide, the Hongwu Emperor intended to execute him, but Empress Ma's counsel led to an investigation that cleared his name.

description.zh-cn: 明朝将领，镇守严州时被人诬告，朱元璋欲将其召回，因马皇后劝谏而作罢。
description.en: A Ming dynasty general who was falsely accused while defending Yanzhou. The Hongwu Emperor intended to recall him, but desisted after Empress Ma's advice.

description.zh-cn: 位于今中国安徽省，是马皇后的出生地。
description.en: Located in modern-day Anhui Province, China, it is the birthplace of Empress Ma.

description.zh-cn: 明朝初年的首都，即今南京。是马皇后的逝世地点。
description.en: The capital of the early Ming dynasty, now modern Nanjing. It is the place where Empress Ma died.

description.zh-cn: 中国历史名城，在太平天国时期作为其首都，名为天京。战前人口约90万，至1864年湘军破城时锐减至约3万人。城破后遭到湘军严重破坏，人口进一步减少，直至光绪帝登基时（1875年）仍未恢复。
description.en: A historic Chinese city, which served as the capital of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom under the name Tianjing. Its population plummeted from about 900,000 before the war to about 30,000 when the Xiang Army captured it in 1864. The city was severely damaged by the Xiang Army, and its population further declined, remaining desolate even by the time Emperor Guangxu ascended the throne in 1875.

description.zh-cn: 太平天国后期重要军事将领，封忠王。在天京被围期间，曾因城内饥荒而释放十余万民众出城。城破后，他带幼主洪天贵福突围，并下令焚烧天王府。
description.en: An important military general in the late Taiping Heavenly Kingdom, titled the Loyal King (Zhong Wang). During the siege of Tianjing, he released over 100,000 civilians from the city due to famine. After the city fell, he led the young monarch Hong Tianguifu in an attempt to break out and ordered the burning of the Heavenly King's Mansion.

description.zh-cn: 太平天国天王洪秀全的宫殿，在天京城破时被李秀成下令焚烧。
description.en: The palace of the Heavenly King Hong Xiuquan in the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom, which was ordered to be burned down by Li Xiucheng when Tianjing fell.

description.zh-cn: 曾国藩、曾国荃的幕僚，其日记《能静居日记》记录了亲眼目睹的湘军入城后的屠杀和抢掠情景，是研究该事件的重要史料。他曾劝说曾国荃制止杀戮并办理善后事宜。
description.en: A staff advisor (Muyou) to Zeng Guofan and Zeng Guoquan. His diary, 'Diary of Nengjing Study,' contains eyewitness accounts of the massacre and looting by the Xiang Army after entering the city, making it a crucial historical source for the event. He advised Zeng Guoquan to stop the killing and manage the aftermath.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代史权威学者，其著作《近代中国史纲》引用赵烈文的《能静居日记》来记述湘军南京屠城。
description.en: An authoritative historian of modern Chinese history. His work 'A Modern History of China' cites Zhao Liewen's 'Diary of Nengjing Study' to describe the Nanjing Massacre by the Xiang Army.

description.zh-cn: 由历史学家郭廷以所著的关于中国近代史的著作，其中引用了《能静居日记》描述湘军南京屠城。
description.en: A work on modern Chinese history by historian Kuo Ting-yee, which quotes the 'Diary of Nengjing Study' to describe the Nanjing Massacre by the Xiang Army.

description.zh-cn: 湘军将领，在攻克天京时与曾国荃一同在现场指挥。
description.en: A Xiang Army general who commanded the assault on Tianjing on-site alongside Zeng Guoquan.

description.zh-cn: 湘军将领，曾国荃麾下统领。在天京城破后，其部队不奉禁令，大肆掠夺。
description.en: A general in the Xiang Army and a commander under Zeng Guoquan. After the fall of Tianjing, his troops disobeyed orders and engaged in widespread looting.

description.zh-cn: 湘军将领，曾国荃麾下统领。在天京城破后，其部队不奉禁令，大肆掠夺。
description.en: A general in the Xiang Army and a commander under Zeng Guoquan. After the fall of Tianjing, his troops disobeyed orders and engaged in widespread looting.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军高级将领，曾任中国人民解放军总装备部政治委员。
description.en: A high-ranking general in the People's Liberation Army, former Political Commissar of the PLA General Armaments Department.

description.zh-cn: 一种政治主张，认为军队应效忠于国家而非特定政党。
description.en: A political principle asserting that the military should be loyal to the state rather than a specific political party.

description.zh-cn: 李继耐之子，中国科学院软件研究所研究员，曾任云南省德宏傣族景颇族自治州州委书记。
description.en: Son of Li Jinai, a researcher at the Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences, and former Party Secretary of Dehong Dai and Jingpo Autonomous Prefecture in Yunnan Province.

en: General of the People's Liberation Army

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军现行军衔制中的最高军衔。
description.en: The highest rank in the current military rank system of the People's Liberation Army.

location.zh-cn: 天津市河西区西园道6号

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国天津市的省级国家监察机关，与中国共产党天津市纪律检查委员会合署办公。
description.en: The provincial-level state supervisory organ of Tianjin, People's Republic of China, which works jointly with the Tianjin Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，时任天津市监察委员会主任。
description.en: Chinese politician, serving as the Director of the Tianjin Municipal Supervisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国天津市的地方国家权力机关。
description.en: The local state power organ of Tianjin, People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中国共产党天津市纪律检查委员会
en: Tianjin Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党天津市委员会的纪律检查机关。
description.en: The discipline inspection body of the Tianjin Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国监察法
en: Supervision Law of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国关于国家监察工作的基本法律。
description.en: The basic law of the People's Republic of China concerning state supervision work.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，现任中共福州市委书记。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, currently serving as the Party Secretary of Fuzhou.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，现任福州市人民政府市长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, currently serving as the Mayor of the Fuzhou Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 福州市的国家行政机关。
description.en: The state administrative organ of Fuzhou City.

zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议福州市委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议在福州市的地方组织。
description.en: The local organization of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference in Fuzhou.

description.zh-cn: 闽越国的都城，福州历史上最早的城市。
description.en: The capital of the Minyue Kingdom, the earliest city in the history of Fuzhou.

description.zh-cn: 西晋时期晋安郡首位太守。
description.en: The first prefect of Jin'an Commandery during the Western Jin dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 北宋时期福州知州，倡导种植榕树。
description.en: Prefect of Fuzhou during the Northern Song dynasty, who advocated for the planting of banyan trees.

description.zh-cn: 北宋时期福州知州，组织“编户植榕”。
description.en: Prefect of Fuzhou during the Northern Song dynasty, who organized households to plant banyan trees.

description.zh-cn: 福州市的市树，福州因此得名“榕城”。
description.en: The city tree of Fuzhou, which is why Fuzhou is nicknamed 'Banyan City'.

description.zh-cn: 南宋皇帝，曾在福州即位。
description.en: An emperor of the Southern Song dynasty who was enthroned in Fuzhou.

description.zh-cn: 意大利耶稣会传教士，将天主教传入福州。
description.en: An Italian Jesuit missionary who introduced Catholicism to Fuzhou.

description.zh-cn: 南明皇帝，在福州即位。
description.en: An emperor of the Southern Ming dynasty who was enthroned in Fuzhou.

description.zh-cn: 时任福州市委书记习近平谋划的一项使福州成为国际化大都市的战略工程。
description.en: A strategic project planned by then Fuzhou Party Secretary Xi Jinping to make Fuzhou an international metropolis.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，汉族，中国共产党党员。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, of Han ethnicity, and a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国广东省下辖的地级市。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Guangdong province, China.

description.zh-cn: 马克思主义哲学的核心组成部分，认为社会发展的基础是物质生产方式。
description.en: A core component of Marxist philosophy, which holds that the basis of social development is the material mode of production.

description.zh-cn: 1848年在欧洲爆发的一系列革命浪潮，马克思积极支持并参与了相关活动。
description.en: A series of revolutionary waves that broke out in Europe in 1848, which Marx actively supported and participated in.

description.zh-cn: 马克思于1845年写下的11条简短笔记，标志着他与费尔巴哈哲学的决裂和历史唯物主义的形成，其中第十一条尤为著名。
description.en: A set of eleven brief notes written by Marx in 1845, marking his break with Feuerbach's philosophy and the formation of historical materialism, with the eleventh thesis being particularly famous.

zh-cn: 尼泊尔共产党（毛主义中心）

description.zh-cn: 尼泊尔共产党（毛主义中心）的指导思想，被认为是马列毛主义在尼泊尔的发展。
description.en: The guiding ideology of the Communist Party of Nepal (Maoist Centre), considered a development of Marxism-Leninism-Maoism in Nepal.

description.zh-cn: 秘鲁共产党（光辉道路）的意识形态，被其追随者认为是马列毛主义的普遍适用性贡献。
description.en: The ideology of the Shining Path, considered by its followers to be a universally applicable contribution to Marxism-Leninism-Maoism.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和毛主义政党的政治、组织和领导方法，核心思想是“从群众中来，到群众中去”。
description.en: The political, organizational and leadership method developed by the Chinese Communist Party and Maoist political parties, summarized as 'from the masses, to the masses'.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东提出的一种军事战略，强调维持人民群众支持、采取游击战术，并以农村包围城市。
description.en: A military strategy developed by Mao Zedong that emphasizes maintaining the support of the populace, employing guerrilla warfare tactics, and encircling cities from the countryside.

description.zh-cn: 于2022年成立的毛派国际组织。
description.en: An international Maoist organization founded in 2022.

zh-cn: 厄瓜多尔共产党—红太阳
en: Communist Party of Ecuador – Red Sun

description.zh-cn: 上海市曾下辖的县，1992年撤销，其行政区域成为浦东新区的主体部分。
上海市曾下辖的市辖区，2009年整体并入浦东新区。

zh-cn: 上海市浦东新区人民政府
中国（上海）自由贸易试验区管理委员会

description.zh-cn: 上海市浦东新区的最高地方行政机构，同时也负责中国（上海）自由贸易试验区的行政管理事务。
上海市下辖的市辖区，其部分区域于1992年被划入新成立的浦东新区。
上海市下辖的市辖区，其部分区域于1992年被划入新成立的浦东新区。

zh-cn: 杰奎琳·肯尼迪·奥纳西斯

description.zh-cn: 约翰·F·肯尼迪的妻子，在他担任总统期间为美国第一夫人。
description.en: Wife of John F. Kennedy and the First Lady of the United States during his presidency.

description.zh-cn: 美国商人和政治家，约翰·F·肯尼迪的父亲。
description.en: American businessman and politician, father of John F. Kennedy.

description.zh-cn: 美国慈善家和社会名流，约翰·F·肯尼迪的母亲。
description.en: American philanthropist and socialite, mother of John F. Kennedy.

description.zh-cn: 1963年11月22日，美国总统约翰·F·肯尼迪在德克萨斯州达拉斯市被枪杀的事件。
description.en: The assassination of U.S. President John F. Kennedy on November 22, 1963, in Dallas, Texas.

description.zh-cn: 被认定为刺杀约翰·F·肯尼迪总统的嫌犯。
description.en: Identified as the suspect in the assassination of President John F. Kennedy.

description.zh-cn: 1961年，在中央情报局的协助下，逃亡美国的古巴人对古巴进行的一次失败的入侵。该行动在肯尼迪任内被批准执行。
description.en: A failed military invasion of Cuba undertaken by the CIA-sponsored paramilitary group Brigade 2506 in 1961. The operation was authorized by President Kennedy.

description.zh-cn: 由肯尼迪总统请求国会建立的美国政府机构，派遣美国志愿者到世界各地提供发展援助。
description.en: A U.S. government agency established by President Kennedy's request to Congress, which sends American volunteers to provide development assistance around the world.

description.zh-cn: 美国国家航空航天局执行的载人航天任务，旨在将人类送上月球。肯尼迪总统于1961年宣布了这一目标，极大地推动了该计划。
description.en: A human spaceflight program by NASA with the goal of landing humans on the Moon. President Kennedy announced this goal in 1961, giving the program a major push.

description.zh-cn: 美国亚拉巴马州州长，以其种族隔离主义立场而闻名。1963年，他试图阻止黑人学生入学，但被肯尼迪政府干预。
description.en: Governor of Alabama known for his segregationist views. He attempted to block black students from enrolling in 1963 but was met with intervention from the Kennedy administration.

description.zh-cn: 禁止在大气层、外层空间和水下进行核武器试验的条约。肯尼迪推动了该条约的签订。
description.en: A treaty prohibiting all test detonations of nuclear weapons except for those conducted underground. Kennedy pushed for this treaty.

description.zh-cn: 美国女演员，据报道与约翰·F·肯尼迪有婚外情。
description.en: American actress who reportedly had an extramarital affair with John F. Kennedy.

description.zh-cn: 苏联外交部长。作为苏方代表，签署了《中苏友好同盟互助条约》。
description.en: Soviet Minister of Foreign Affairs. As the Soviet representative, he signed the Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship, Alliance and Mutual Assistance.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东在1949年提出的中华人民共和国建国初期的外交政策，主张在国际上坚定地站在以苏联为首的社会主义阵营一边。这一政策直接促成了《中苏友好同盟互助条约》的签订。
description.en: A foreign policy directive for the early People's Republic of China proposed by Mao Zedong in 1949, advocating for firmly siding with the socialist camp led by the Soviet Union. This policy directly led to the signing of the Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship, Alliance and Mutual Assistance.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任台湾民主自治同盟总部秘书长、全国政协委员。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as the Secretary-General of the headquarters of the Taiwan Democratic Self-Government League and a member of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 加拿大总督，代表加拿大君主行使权力。
description.en: The Governor General of Canada, who exercises the powers of the Canadian monarch.

description.zh-cn: 根据资料文本，其为加拿大总理。
description.en: According to the source text, the Prime Minister of Canada.

description.zh-cn: 加拿大首席大法官。
description.en: The Chief Justice of Canada.

description.zh-cn: 加拿大的联邦立法机构，由加拿大君主、上议院和下议院组成。
description.en: The federal legislature of Canada, consisting of the Canadian Monarch, the Senate, and the House of Commons.

description.zh-cn: 加拿大国会的上议院。
description.en: The upper house of the Parliament of Canada.

description.zh-cn: 加拿大国会的下议院。
description.en: The lower house of the Parliament of Canada.

description.zh-cn: 指加拿大省、新不伦瑞克省和新斯科舍省组成加拿大联邦的历史事件。
description.en: The historical event in which the Province of Canada, New Brunswick, and Nova Scotia united to form the Dominion of Canada.

description.zh-cn: 一项英国国会法令，通过该法令成立了加拿大联邦。
description.en: An act of the Parliament of the United Kingdom which established the Dominion of Canada.

description.zh-cn: 一项英国国会法令，肯定了加拿大的独立性，使其成为独立国家。
description.en: An Act of the Parliament of the United Kingdom that affirmed Canada's independence, establishing it as an independent nation.

description.zh-cn: 英国国会通过的法律，将加拿大宪法修宪权移交加拿大国会。
description.en: An act passed by the UK Parliament that transferred the power to amend the Canadian Constitution to the Parliament of Canada.

description.zh-cn: 加拿大省份，1867年加入联邦，是加拿大联邦的创始成员之一。
description.en: A Canadian province that joined the Confederation in 1867 as one of its founding members.

description.zh-cn: 加拿大省份，1867年加入联邦，是加拿大联邦的创始成员之一。
description.en: A Canadian province that joined the Confederation in 1867 as one of its founding members.

description.zh-cn: 加拿大省份，1867年加入联邦，是加拿大联邦的创始成员之一。
description.en: A Canadian province that joined the Confederation in 1867 as one of its founding members.

description.zh-cn: 法国在北美洲的殖民地，在七年战争后被割让给英国。
description.en: A French colony in North America, ceded to Great Britain after the Seven Years' War.

description.zh-cn: 由56个主权国家组成的国际组织，成员多为前英国殖民地，加拿大是其成员国。
description.en: An international organization of 56 sovereign states, most of which are former British colonies. Canada is a member state.

zh-cn: 法语国家及地区国际组织

description.zh-cn: 以法语为第一或第二语言的国家和地区组成的国际组织，加拿大是其成员国。
description.en: An international organization of countries and regions where French is the first or second language. Canada is a member state.

description.zh-cn: 加拿大、美国和墨西哥于1994年签署的自由贸易协定，旨在消除三国之间的贸易壁垒。
description.en: A free trade agreement signed by Canada, the United States, and Mexico in 1994, aimed at eliminating trade barriers among the three countries.

description.zh-cn: 北美洲国家，与加拿大和美国共同签署了《北美自由贸易协议》。
description.en: A North American country that, along with Canada and the United States, signed the North American Free Trade Agreement.

description.zh-cn: 中国机械制造专家，曾任南京航空学院副院长、院长、教授、博士生导师。
description.en: A Chinese expert in mechanical manufacturing, he served as vice president, president, professor, and doctoral supervisor at Nanjing Aeronautical Institute.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国浙江省下辖的地级市。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Zhejiang Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 一门应用工程、物理与材料科学的原理，来设计、分析、制造及维护机械系统的学科。
description.en: A discipline that applies the principles of engineering, physics, and materials science for the design, analysis, manufacturing, and maintenance of mechanical systems.

description.zh-cn: 总部位于瑞士日内瓦的联合国组织。
description.en: A United Nations organization headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland.

zh-cn: 国际植物新品种保护联盟
en: International Union for the Protection of New Varieties of Plants

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。
description.en: Politician of the People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议黑龙江省委员会

description.zh-cn: 唐朝的盟友，曾出兵协助唐朝平定安史之乱。
description.en: An ally of the Tang Dynasty that dispatched troops to help quell the An Lushan Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 安禄山之子，弑父称帝，后被史思明所杀。
description.en: Son of An Lushan, who assassinated his father to usurp the throne and was later killed by Shi Siming.

description.zh-cn: 史思明之子，弑父称帝，后兵败自尽，安史之乱结束。
description.en: Son of Shi Siming, who assassinated his father to usurp the throne. His defeat and suicide marked the end of the An Lushan Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝宦官，曾谗毁郭子仪，导致其被解除兵权。
description.en: A Tang Dynasty eunuch who slandered Guo Ziyi, leading to the general being stripped of his military command.

description.zh-cn: 中国历史地理名词，指玉门关、阳关以西的地区。安史之乱后，唐朝失去对此地的控制。
description.en: A historical-geographical term in China referring to the areas west of Yumen Pass and Yang Pass. The Tang Dynasty lost control over this region after the An Lushan Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国甘肃省西北部的狭长走廊地带。安史之乱后，唐朝失去对此地的控制。
description.en: A narrow corridor in the northwestern part of China's Gansu Province. The Tang Dynasty lost control over this region after the An Lushan Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 山西省运城市下辖县，令狐路线的出生地。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Yuncheng City, Shanxi Province, and the birthplace of Linghu Luxian.

description.zh-cn: 位于山西省的一所医科大学，令狐路线曾在此就读。
description.en: A medical university located in Shanxi Province, where Linghu Luxian studied.

description.zh-cn: 一家公司，令完成曾是其合伙人，后将其股份转给王玲。
description.en: A company where Ling Wancheng was a partner before transferring his shares to Wang Ling.

description.zh-cn: 令狐路线与王健康的女儿。
description.en: Daughter of Linghu Luxian and Wang Jiankang.

description.zh-cn: 上海市的市辖区，徐景贤的出生地。
description.en: A municipal district of Shanghai, birthplace of Xu Jingxian.

description.zh-cn: 徐景贤的回忆录，于2003年在香港出版。

description.en: Grandson of Song Lian, who was implicated and executed in the Hu Weiyong case.

description.zh-cn: 明朝靖宁侯，蓝玉的姻亲。因“交通胡惟庸”被杀，其案揭开了蓝玉案的序幕。
description.en: Marquis of Jingning of the Ming dynasty and a relative of Lan Yu by marriage. He was executed for 'communicating with Hu Weiyong', and his case served as a prelude to the Lan Yu case.

description.zh-cn: 明朝太监。野史记载他在胡惟庸图谋不轨时，拼死拦住朱元璋的座驾，从而揭发了阴谋，但自己也被卫兵打死。
description.en: A eunuch of the Ming dynasty. Unofficial histories record that when Hu Weiyong was plotting treason, he desperately stopped the Hongwu Emperor's carriage, thereby exposing the conspiracy, but was beaten to death by the guards himself.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代中央行政机构中吏、户、礼、兵、刑、工六个部门的总称。在丞相被废后，六部直接对皇帝负责。
description.en: The collective term for the six central government departments in ancient China: Personnel, Revenue, Rites, War, Justice, and Works. After the abolition of the chancellery, the Six Ministries became directly responsible to the emperor.

description.zh-cn: 位于香港的一所小学。
description.en: A primary school located in Hong Kong.

en: King George V School, Hong Kong

description.zh-cn: 位于香港的一所中学。
description.en: A secondary school located in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 一家艺人经纪公司。
description.en: An artist management company.

description.zh-cn: 2010年香港电影，李治廷在其中担任主演。
description.en: A 2010 Hong Kong film starring Aarif Rahman.

description.zh-cn: 2014年中国大陆电视剧，李治廷在其中饰演唐高宗李治。
description.en: A 2014 mainland Chinese television series in which Aarif Rahman played Emperor Gaozong of Tang (Li Zhi).

description.zh-cn: 2013年中国大陆浪漫喜剧电影，由李治廷和范冰冰主演。
description.en: A 2013 mainland Chinese romantic comedy film starring Aarif Rahman and Fan Bingbing.

description.zh-cn: 2017年动作喜剧电影，由李治廷和成龙主演。
description.en: A 2017 action-comedy film starring Aarif Rahman and Jackie Chan.

description.zh-cn: 香港女歌手。
description.en: A Hong Kong female singer.

description.zh-cn: 香港男歌手，亚洲星光大道3班殿军。
description.en: A Hong Kong male singer, third runner-up of Asian Millionstar 3.

description.zh-cn: 香港电影导演、编剧及监制。
description.en: A Hong Kong film director, screenwriter, and producer.

description.zh-cn: 香港歌手卫兰的英文专辑。
description.en: An English album by Hong Kong singer Janice Vidal.

description.zh-cn: 白居易写给元稹的一封长信，系统地阐述了他的文学主张，是中国文学批评史上的重要文献。
description.en: A long letter from Bai Juyi to Yuan Zhen, systematically explaining his literary views. It is an important document in the history of Chinese literary criticism.

description.zh-cn: 位于杭州的著名湖泊。白居易任杭州刺史时，曾修筑堤防以利灌溉。
description.en: A famous lake in Hangzhou. When Bai Juyi was the prefect of Hangzhou, he had an embankment built to facilitate irrigation.

description.zh-cn: 东晋末至南朝宋初的诗人，以田园诗著称。白居易对其人品和诗风十分仰慕。
description.en: A poet from the late Eastern Jin to the early Southern Song dynasties, known for his pastoral poetry. Bai Juyi greatly admired his character and poetic style.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝皇帝，唐昭宗的父亲。
description.en: An emperor of the Tang dynasty, father of Emperor Zhaozong.

description.zh-cn: 唐懿宗的妃嫔，唐昭宗的生母，被追尊为皇后。
description.en: A consort of Emperor Yizong and the birth mother of Emperor Zhaozong, posthumously honored as Empress.

description.zh-cn: 唐末掌权的宦官，拥立唐昭宗即位，后与昭宗决裂并被其讨伐。
description.en: A powerful eunuch in the late Tang dynasty who enthroned Emperor Zhaozong, but later broke with him and was campaigned against.

description.zh-cn: 唐末凤翔节度使，曾与朝廷发生冲突，兵临长安，后又与昭宗和解。
description.en: The jiedushi of Fengxiang circuit during the late Tang dynasty. He clashed with the imperial court, marched on Chang'an, and later reconciled with Emperor Zhaozong.

description.zh-cn: 唐末镇国节度使，曾在唐昭宗出逃时将其控制于华州，并杀害了多名宗室诸王。
description.en: The jiedushi of Zhenguo circuit during the late Tang dynasty. He held Emperor Zhaozong under his control in Huazhou when the emperor fled the capital and executed several imperial princes.

description.zh-cn: 唐末神策军左中尉，宦官。他发动政变废黜并软禁了唐昭宗，后在反政变中被杀。
description.en: A eunuch and Left Commander of the Shence Army in the late Tang dynasty. He launched a coup to depose and place Emperor Zhaozong under house arrest, but was later killed in a counter-coup.

description.zh-cn: 唐昭宗的皇后，唐哀帝李柷和德王李𥙿的母亲。在昭宗被弑时幸免于难。
description.en: Empress consort of Emperor Zhaozong, and the mother of Emperor Ai and Prince of De, Li Yu. She survived the assassination of Emperor Zhaozong.

description.zh-cn: 唐昭宗长子。曾被宦官刘季述拥立为帝，后被朱温所杀。
description.en: The eldest son of Emperor Zhaozong. He was briefly enthroned by the eunuch Liu Jishu and was later executed by Zhu Wen.

description.zh-cn: 忠于唐昭宗的神策军军官，在宰相崔胤指使下发动反政变，诛杀刘季述，使昭宗复辟。
description.en: An officer of the Shence Army loyal to Emperor Zhaozong. At the instigation of Chancellor Cui Yin, he launched a counter-coup, killed Liu Jishu, and restored Emperor Zhaozong to the throne.

description.zh-cn: 朱温的部将，左龙武统军。受朱温指派，率兵执行了弑杀唐昭宗的行动。
description.en: A general under Zhu Wen, Left Longwu Army Commander. He was dispatched by Zhu Wen to lead the troops that assassinated Emperor Zhaozong.

description.zh-cn: 朱温的部将，右龙武统军。受朱温指派，参与了弑杀唐昭宗的行动。
description.en: A general under Zhu Wen, Right Longwu Army Commander. He was dispatched by Zhu Wen and participated in the assassination of Emperor Zhaozong.

description.zh-cn: 朱温的心腹，被任为枢密使以监视唐昭宗，并参与了弑君行动。
description.en: A confidant of Zhu Wen, appointed as Commissioner of Palace Affairs to monitor Emperor Zhaozong, and participated in his assassination.

description.zh-cn: 龙武衙官，在弑君行动中追上并直接杀害了唐昭宗。
description.en: An officer of the Longwu Guard who, during the assassination, pursued and directly killed Emperor Zhaozong.

description.zh-cn: 唐昭宗的昭仪，在弑君行动中试图以身体保护昭宗，一同被杀害。
description.en: A Zhaoyi (a high-ranking consort) of Emperor Zhaozong. She attempted to shield the emperor with her body during the assassination and was killed alongside him.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝中晚期的地方军事割据势力，拥有独立的军事、财政和行政权力，是导致唐朝衰亡的主要原因之一。
description.en: Regional military governorships in mid to late Tang China which possessed significant autonomy in military, financial, and administrative affairs, and were a primary cause of the dynasty's decline.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝晚期控制中央禁军、掌握朝政的重要政治势力。
description.en: A powerful political faction in the late Tang dynasty that controlled the imperial guards and held significant influence over the court.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国山东省，据传是子路的出生地。
description.en: A county in Shandong Province, China, believed to be the birthplace of Zi Lu.

description.zh-cn: 卫国大夫，子路的主君。在蒯聩发动的兵变中被劫持。
description.en: A grand master of the state of Wei and the lord of Zi Lu. He was hijacked during the coup initiated by Kuai Kui.

description.zh-cn: 卫灵公的太子，后为卫后庄公。因权力斗争发动兵变，导致子路死亡。
description.en: The crown prince of Duke Ling of Wei, later known as Duke Zhuang II of Wei. He initiated a coup due to power struggles, which led to the death of Zi Lu.

description.zh-cn: 蒯聩手下的勇士，参与杀害子路。
description.en: A warrior under Kuai Kui who participated in the killing of Zi Lu.

description.zh-cn: 宋朝皇帝，追尊子路为“卫公”。
description.en: An emperor of the Song dynasty who posthumously honored Zi Lu as 'Duke of Wei'.

description.zh-cn: 孔子弟子，被子路委派为费邑宰。在蒯聩兵变时从卫国逃出。
description.en: A disciple of Confucius, appointed by Zi Lu as the governor of Fei. He escaped from the State of Wei during Kuai Kui's coup.

description.zh-cn: 春秋时期的一个邑，子羔曾在此地担任邑宰。
description.en: A city during the Spring and Autumn period, where Zi Gao once served as governor.

description.zh-cn: 卫国君主，蒯聩之子。其父蒯聩发动兵变意图废黜他。
description.en: The ruler of the State of Wei, son of Kuai Kui. His father launched a coup in an attempt to depose him.

description.zh-cn: 晋国大夫，曾为出逃的蒯聩提供庇护。
description.en: A grand master of the State of Jin who provided refuge to the fugitive Kuai Kui.

description.zh-cn: 蒯聩的妹妹，孔悝的母亲。她参与了劫持自己儿子孔悝以协助其兄夺权的计划。
description.en: The younger sister of Kuai Kui and the mother of Kong Kui. She participated in the plan to abduct her own son to help her brother seize power.

description.zh-cn: 伯姬的情夫，协助蒯聩和伯姬劫持孔悝。
description.en: The lover of Bo Ji, who assisted Kuai Kui and Bo Ji in abducting Kong Kui.

description.zh-cn: 孔悝的家臣，在蒯聩兵变时将卫出公护送至鲁国。
description.en: A retainer of Kong Kui who escorted Duke Chu of Wei to the State of Lu during Kuai Kui's coup.

description.zh-cn: 卫国兵变时的守城将领，曾试图阻止子路进城。
description.en: A defending general during the coup in Wei who tried to stop Zi Lu from entering the city.

description.zh-cn: 居住在中国东北地区的民族，后被皇太极改名为满洲。
description.en: An ethnic group residing in Northeast China, later renamed Manchu by Hong Taiji.

description.zh-cn: 由女真族发展而来的民族，名称由皇太极确定。
description.en: An ethnic group that evolved from the Jurchens, with its name finalized by Hong Taiji.

description.zh-cn: 后金的第一个都城，位于今辽宁省新宾满族自治县。
description.en: The first capital of the Later Jin, located in modern-day Xinbin Manchu Autonomous County, Liaoning.

description.zh-cn: 位于蒙古高原南部的蒙古部落群体，后被皇太极征服。
description.en: A group of Mongol tribes in the southern part of the Mongolian Plateau, later conquered by Hong Taiji.

death_place.zh-cn: 甘肃省天祝藏族自治县

description.zh-cn: 蒙古察哈尔部大汗，在与后金的战争中失败，最终病逝。
description.en: The Great Khan of the Chahar Mongols, who was defeated in the war against the Later Jin and eventually died of illness.

en: Later Jin conquest of the Chahar

description.zh-cn: 皇太极领导的一系列军事行动，最终征服了林丹汗的察哈尔部，统一了漠南蒙古。
description.en: A series of military campaigns led by Hong Taiji that resulted in the conquest of Ligdan Khan's Chahar tribe and the unification of Southern Mongolia.

description.zh-cn: 皇太极发动的对朝鲜的第一次入侵，迫使朝鲜断绝与明朝的关系并与后金结为兄弟之盟。
description.en: The first invasion of Korea launched by Hong Taiji, which forced Korea to sever ties with the Ming and enter into a fraternal alliance with the Later Jin.

description.zh-cn: 林丹汗之子，于1635年向后金投降。
description.en: Son of Ligdan Khan, who surrendered to the Later Jin in 1635.

description.zh-cn: 后金学者，奉努尔哈赤之命创制满文。
description.en: A Later Jin scholar who was ordered by Nurhaci to create the Manchu script.

description.zh-cn: 后金学者，奉努尔哈赤之命创制满文。
description.en: A Later Jin scholar who was ordered by Nurhaci to create the Manchu script.

description.zh-cn: 原明朝将领，于1633年率部投降后金，为后金带来了先进的火炮技术。
description.en: A former Ming general who defected to the Later Jin in 1633, bringing advanced artillery technology with him.

description.zh-cn: 1950年中华民国空军对上海进行的一次大规模空袭，造成严重人员伤亡和财产损失。
description.en: A large-scale air raid on Shanghai conducted by the Republic of China Air Force in 1950, causing severe casualties and property damage.

zh-cn: 2022年3月上海市2019冠状病毒病聚集性疫情

description.zh-cn: 2022年春季在上海爆发的大规模新冠病毒感染事件，导致了长达两个月的封城措施。
description.en: A large-scale COVID-19 outbreak in Shanghai in the spring of 2022, which led to a two-month-long citywide lockdown.

description.zh-cn: 中国历史最长、规模最大的美术电影制片基地之一，创作了《大闹天宫》等大量经典动画作品。
description.en: One of China's oldest and largest animation film studios, known for producing numerous classic animated works such as 'Havoc in Heaven'.

description.zh-cn: 上海美术电影制片厂制作的彩色动画长片，是中国动画史上的里程碑式作品。
description.en: A color animated feature film produced by the Shanghai Animation Film Studio, a milestone work in the history of Chinese animation.

description.zh-cn: 形成于20世纪上海的一种文化现象和风格，特点是融合了江南传统文化和西方近代文化。
description.en: A cultural phenomenon and style that formed in 20th-century Shanghai, characterized by the fusion of traditional Jiangnan culture and modern Western culture.

description.zh-cn: 指代中国长江三角洲地区具有鲜明特征的地域文化，是海派文化的重要根基。
description.en: Refers to the distinctive regional culture of the Yangtze River Delta region in China, serving as a significant foundation for the Shanghai School culture.

description.zh-cn: 中国通信与信息处理专家，曾任江苏师范大学教授和九州职业技术学院院长。
description.en: A Chinese expert in communication and information processing, who served as a professor at Jiangsu Normal University and president of Jiuzhou Vocational and Technical College.

description.zh-cn: 高等教育体系中的一种职称。
description.en: An academic rank in the higher education system.

en: Four Great Talents of Hong Kong

description.zh-cn: 对香港四位著名作家的并称，包括金庸、倪匡、黄沾、蔡澜。
description.en: A collective title for four renowned Hong Kong writers: Jin Yong, Ni Kuang, Wong Jim, and Chua Lam.

description.zh-cn: 由倪匡、黄沾、蔡澜共同主持的亚洲电视经典成人清谈节目。
description.en: A classic adult talk show on Asia Television hosted by Ni Kuang, Wong Jim, and Chua Lam.

description.zh-cn: 倪匡创作的著名科幻小说系列。
description.en: A famous science fiction novel series written by Ni Kuang.

description.zh-cn: 位于香港南区，是倪匡的逝世地点。
description.en: Located in the Southern District of Hong Kong, it is the place where Ni Kuang passed away.

description.zh-cn: 笔名还珠楼主，中国武侠小说作家，对倪匡的写作影响深远。
description.en: A Chinese wuxia novelist under the pen name Huanzhu Louzhu, who had a profound influence on Ni Kuang's writing.

description.zh-cn: 由倪匡创作的著名虚构武术家角色，最初在电影中由李小龙扮演而广为人知。
description.en: A famous fictional martial artist character created by Ni Kuang, first popularized by Bruce Lee's portrayal in film.

description.zh-cn: 金庸小说《天龙八部》中的角色。因倪匡代笔时不喜欢此角色，便将其眼睛写瞎。
description.en: A character in Jin Yong's novel 'Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils'. Ni Kuang, who disliked the character while ghostwriting, wrote her to be blinded.

description.zh-cn: 香港电影界的年度颁奖典礼。2012年授予倪匡终身成就奖。
description.en: An annual awards ceremony for Hong Kong cinema. It presented the Lifetime Achievement Award to Ni Kuang in 2012.

description.zh-cn: 纪登奎的妻子。
description.en: Spouse of Ji Dengkui.

description.zh-cn: 纪登奎的儿子。
description.en: Son of Ji Dengkui.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国山西省，是纪登奎的出生地。
description.en: A county in Shanxi Province, China, and the birthplace of Ji Dengkui.

description.zh-cn: 汉高祖刘邦第七子，封淮南王。因谋反被汉文帝流放蜀郡，在途中绝食自杀。
description.en: The seventh son of Emperor Gaozu of Han (Liu Bang), enfeoffed as the King of Huainan. He was exiled to Shu Commandery by Emperor Wen for treason and committed suicide by starvation on the way.

description.zh-cn: 原为赵王张敖的姬妾，后为刘邦侍寝并生下刘长。
description.en: Originally a concubine of Zhang Ao, King of Zhao. She was presented to Liu Bang and gave birth to Liu Chang.

description.zh-cn: 刘长长子，继承淮南王爵位，主编了《淮南子》。
description.en: The eldest son of Liu Chang, who inherited the title of King of Huainan and was the patron for the compilation of the Huainanzi.

description.zh-cn: 西汉皇族淮南王刘安及其门客集体编写的一部道家著作。
description.en: A Daoist classic compiled under the patronage of Liu An, King of Huainan, during the Western Han Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 汉初赵国国相，曾策划暗杀刘邦。
description.en: Chancellor of the Kingdom of Zhao in the early Han Dynasty, who plotted to assassinate Liu Bang.

description.zh-cn: 汉初大臣，因未尽力营救刘长之母赵姬而被刘长刺杀。
description.en: An official in the early Han Dynasty who was assassinated by Liu Chang for failing to rescue his mother, Consort Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 刘邦的长孙，齐王。在“夷灭诸吕”后曾试图争夺皇位。
description.en: The eldest grandson of Liu Bang, the King of Qi. He attempted to contend for the imperial throne after the Lü Clan Disturbance.

description.zh-cn: 西汉丞相，在刘长谋反事败后，主张将其处死。
description.en: Chancellor of the Western Han Dynasty who advocated for the execution of Liu Chang after his rebellion plot was exposed.

description.zh-cn: 刘长之子，曾为衡山王、济北王。
description.en: Son of Liu Chang, who served as the King of Hengshan and later the King of Jibei.

description.zh-cn: 刘长之子，曾为庐江王、衡山王，后因谋反国除。
description.en: Son of Liu Chang, who served as the King of Lujiang and later the King of Hengshan; his kingdom was abolished after a rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 刘长之子，封东城侯，早逝无后。
description.en: Son of Liu Chang, enfeoffed as the Marquis of Dongcheng, who died young without an heir.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国四川省乐山市下辖的市辖区。
description.en: A municipal district under the jurisdiction of Leshan City, Sichuan Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 曾是中华人民共和国四川省乐山市沙湾区下辖的一个乡，于2019年12月被撤销。
description.en: A former township under the jurisdiction of Shawan District, Leshan City, Sichuan Province, People's Republic of China, which was abolished in December 2019.

description.zh-cn: 曾是中华人民共和国四川省乐山市沙湾区下辖的一个镇，于2019年12月被撤销。
description.en: A former town under the jurisdiction of Shawan District, Leshan City, Sichuan Province, People's Republic of China, which was abolished in December 2019.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国四川省乐山市沙湾区下辖的一个街道。
description.en: A sub-district under the jurisdiction of Shawan District, Leshan City, Sichuan Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国经济学家，中国共产党党员。曾任《新华日报》编委、中共中央统战部副部长、中国社会科学院副院长、汕头大学校长等职务。
description.en: Chinese economist and a member of the Communist Party of China. He held various positions including member of the editorial board of Xinhua Daily, Deputy Head of the United Front Work Department of the CCP Central Committee, Vice President of the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, and President of Shantou University.

description.zh-cn: 位于广东省揭西县，是许涤新的出生地。
description.en: Located in Jiexi County, Guangdong Province, it is the birthplace of Xu Dixin.

description.zh-cn: 介绍许涤新加入中国共产党的人物。
description.en: The person who introduced Xu Dixin to join the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党的理论刊物，许涤新曾担任其责任编辑和编委。
description.en: A theoretical journal of the Communist Party of China, for which Xu Dixin served as a managing editor and editorial board member.

description.zh-cn: 一份在香港发行的报纸，许涤新曾是其编委。
description.en: A newspaper published in Hong Kong, where Xu Dixin was a member of the editorial board.

description.zh-cn: 一份在香港发行的报纸，许涤新曾任其副刊主编。
description.en: A newspaper published in Hong Kong, where Xu Dixin served as the chief editor of its supplement.

zh-cn: 中国社会科学院经济研究所
en: Institute of Economics, Chinese Academy of Social Sciences

description.zh-cn: 中国社会科学院下属的经济学研究机构，许涤新曾任所长。
description.en: An economics research institute under the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, where Xu Dixin served as director.

description.zh-cn: 位于广东省汕头市的综合性大学，许涤新曾任校长。
description.en: A comprehensive university in Shantou, Guangdong, where Xu Dixin served as president.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，中国共产党党员。曾任赣州市人民政府市长、赣州市人大常委会主任及党组书记，并担任第九届与第十届全国人大代表。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China and a member of the Communist Party of China. He served as the Mayor of the Ganzhou Municipal People's Government, Director and Party Group Secretary of the Standing Committee of the Ganzhou Municipal People's Congress, and was a deputy to the 9th and 10th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国江西省下辖的地级市，是王昭悠的出生地。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Jiangxi Province, People's Republic of China, and the birthplace of Wang Zhaoyou.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物、植物学家。
description.en: A political figure and botanist of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 日本四大财阀之一。井上馨与其关系密切，晚年担任其最高顾问。
description.en: One of the four major zaibatsu of Japan. Inoue Kaoru had close ties with it and served as its supreme advisor in his later years.

description.zh-cn: 日本的大型综合商社。其前身先收公司由井上馨与益田孝等人创立。
description.en: A major Japanese general trading company. Its predecessor, Senshu Kaisha, was founded by Inoue Kaoru, Masuda Takashi, and others.

description.zh-cn: 1864年长州藩与英、法、荷、美四国联合舰队之间的战争。此事件使留学英国的井上馨认识到国力差距，思想从攘夷转向开国。
description.en: A war in 1864 between the Chōshū Domain and the combined fleets of Great Britain, France, the Netherlands, and the United States. This event made Inoue Kaoru, who was studying in Britain, realize the disparity in national power, shifting his ideology from 'expel the barbarians' to 'open the country'.

description.zh-cn: 东亚国家。井上馨曾担任日本驻朝鲜公使，并推动其现代化运动。
description.en: An East Asian country. Inoue Kaoru served as the Japanese minister to Korea and promoted its modernization movement.

description.zh-cn: 茅以升于1921年在此获得博士学位，是该校的第一位博士。后为卡内基美隆大学的一部分。
description.en: Mao Yisheng received his PhD here in 1921, becoming the school's first-ever doctoral graduate. It later became part of Carnegie Mellon University.

description.zh-cn: 位于江苏省的一个县，是茅以升的出生地。
description.en: A county in Jiangsu province, the birthplace of Mao Yisheng.

description.zh-cn: 时任中国人民解放军空军副参谋长。
description.en: Then Deputy Chief of Staff of the PLA Air Force.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军将领，在批判罗瑞卿的会议上联名发言。
description.en: A general of the People's Liberation Army who co-authored a speech at the meeting to criticize Luo Ruiqing.

en: Security Council of the Russian Federation

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯总统主持的，商讨和决定国家安全战略的机构。
description.en: A consultative body of the Russian president that works out the president's decisions on national security affairs.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯政治家，谢尔盖·绍伊古的前任俄罗斯联邦安全会议秘书长。
description.en: Russian politician, predecessor of Sergey Shoigu as Secretary of the Security Council of Russia.

en: Ministry of Defence of the Russian Federation

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯联邦的政府部门，负责国防事务。
description.en: The ministry of the Russian government responsible for defence affairs.

zh-cn: 阿纳托利·爱德华多维奇·谢尔久科夫

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯政治家，谢尔盖·绍伊古的前任俄罗斯国防部长。
description.en: Russian politician, predecessor of Sergey Shoigu as Minister of Defence of Russia.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯莫斯科州的最高行政长官职位。
description.en: The highest executive office in Moscow Oblast, Russia.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯政治家，谢尔盖·绍伊古的前任莫斯科州州长。
description.en: Russian politician, predecessor of Sergey Shoigu as Governor of Moscow Oblast.

zh-cn: 安德烈·尤里耶维奇·沃罗比约夫

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯政治家，谢尔盖·绍伊古的继任莫斯科州州长。
description.en: Russian politician, successor of Sergey Shoigu as Governor of Moscow Oblast.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯的执政党。
description.en: The ruling political party of Russia.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯政治家，接替谢尔盖·绍伊古成为统一俄罗斯党领导人。
description.en: Russian politician, who succeeded Sergey Shoigu as the leader of the United Russia party.

zh-cn: 俄罗斯联邦紧急情况部

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯联邦的政府部门，负责处理紧急情况和救灾。
description.en: The ministry of the Russian government responsible for emergency situations and disaster relief.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯图瓦共和国的城镇，谢尔盖·绍伊古的出生地。
description.en: A town in the Tuva Republic, Russia, and the birthplace of Sergey Shoigu.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯陆军大将，现任俄罗斯武装力量总参谋长。
description.en: Russian army general, current Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Russia.

zh-cn: 本·华莱士 (英国政治人物)

description.zh-cn: 英国政治家，曾任国防大臣。在2022年俄罗斯入侵乌克兰前与绍伊古会面。
description.en: British politician, former Secretary of State for Defence. Met with Shoigu before the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

zh-cn: 瓦格纳集团—俄罗斯国防部冲突

description.zh-cn: 瓦格纳集团领导人叶夫根尼·普里戈任与俄罗斯国防部长谢尔盖·绍伊古之间的公开权力斗争，最终导致瓦格纳集团叛乱。
description.en: A public power struggle between Wagner Group leader Yevgeny Prigozhin and Russian Minister of Defence Sergey Shoigu, which culminated in the Wagner Group rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯寡头，瓦格纳集团的领导人，曾发动针对俄罗斯国防部的叛乱。
description.en: Russian oligarch, leader of the Wagner Group, who launched a rebellion against the Russian Ministry of Defence.

description.zh-cn: 一家俄罗斯准军事组织，由叶夫根尼·普里戈任领导。
description.en: A Russian paramilitary organization led by Yevgeny Prigozhin.

description.zh-cn: 2023年6月，瓦格纳集团领导人普里戈任发动的针对俄罗斯国防部的武装叛乱。
description.en: In June 2023, an armed rebellion launched by Wagner Group leader Prigozhin against the Russian Ministry of Defence.

description.zh-cn: 现任摩纳哥亲王，曾与绍伊古和普京一同在图瓦钓鱼。
description.en: The reigning Prince of Monaco, who once went fishing in Tuva with Shoigu and Putin.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯联邦的国歌。
description.en: The national anthem of the Russian Federation.

description.zh-cn: 元末民变领袖，白莲教教主，韩林儿之父。他自称宋徽宗八世孙，利用弥勒佛下凡的号召组织起义，事败被杀。
description.en: A leader of the Red Turban Rebellion at the end of the Yuan dynasty, leader of the White Lotus society, and the father of Han Lin'er. He claimed to be a descendant of Emperor Huizong of Song and organized an uprising under the banner of Maitreya's descent, but was killed after the plot was discovered.

description.zh-cn: 元末红巾军主要领袖。在韩山童死后，他重新集结部众，拥立韩林儿为帝，建立“宋”政权。后在安丰保卫战中被张士诚部将吕珍所杀。
description.en: A major leader of the Red Turban Army during the late Yuan dynasty. After Han Shantong's death, he regrouped the forces and enthroned Han Lin'er as emperor, establishing the 'Song' regime. He was later killed by Lü Zhen, a general under Zhang Shicheng, during the defense of Anfeng.

description.zh-cn: 张士诚麾下将领。奉命围攻安丰，并在此战中杀死了刘福通。
description.en: A general under Zhang Shicheng. He was ordered to besiege Anfeng and killed Liu Futong in the battle.

description.zh-cn: 元朝末年重要将领，曾率军反攻红巾军，于1359年攻破汴梁，迫使韩林儿逃亡。
description.en: An important general of the late Yuan dynasty. He led counter-offensives against the Red Turban Army, captured Bianliang in 1359, forcing Han Lin'er to flee.

description.zh-cn: 韩山童之妻，韩林儿之母。韩林儿称帝后，被尊为皇太后。
description.en: The wife of Han Shantong and mother of Han Lin'er. After Han Lin'er became emperor, she was honored as the Empress Dowager.

description.zh-cn: 元末民变期间，由刘福通等人拥立韩林儿建立的政权，国号宋，年号龙凤，又称“韩宋”。
description.en: A regime established by Liu Futong and others during the Red Turban Rebellion, with Han Lin'er as its emperor. Its state name was Song and its era name was Longfeng; it is also known as 'Han Song'.

description.zh-cn: 导致韩林儿在瓜步渡长江时溺亡的事件。
description.en: The incident that caused Han Lin'er to drown while crossing the Yangtze River at Guabu.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国的中央二级行政机关，负责劳动政策、劳工关系及就业服务等事务。
description.en: A cabinet-level ministry of the Republic of China that oversees labor affairs, including labor policy, industrial relations, and employment services.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，林美珠的前任劳动部部长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician and Lin Mei-chu's predecessor as Minister of Labor.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，林美珠的继任劳动部部长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician and Lin Mei-chu's successor as Minister of Labor.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，林美珠的前任蒙藏委员会委员长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician and Lin Mei-chu's predecessor as Chairperson of the Mongolian and Tibetan Affairs Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，林美珠的继任蒙藏委员会委员长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician and Lin Mei-chu's successor as Chairperson of the Mongolian and Tibetan Affairs Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国行政院会议的成员，为不管部会之部长。
description.en: A member of the Executive Yuan Council in the Republic of China, serving as a minister without portfolio.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国嘉义县的最高行政机关。
description.en: The highest administrative body of Chiayi County, Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，在林美珠担任嘉义县副县长期间任县长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who served as the Magistrate of Chiayi County while Lin Mei-chu was the Deputy Magistrate.

description.zh-cn: 政府部门中部长或大臣的副手，是一个官职级别。
description.en: A rank for a deputy to a minister in a government department.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，在林美珠担任内政部政务次长期间任内政部部长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who served as the Minister of the Interior while Lin Mei-chu was the Political Deputy Minister.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，在林美珠担任中央选举委员会秘书长期间任主任委员。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who served as the Chairperson of the Central Election Commission while Lin Mei-chu was the Secretary-General.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国内政部的内部单位，负责民政事务。
description.en: An internal unit of the Ministry of the Interior of the Republic of China, responsible for civil affairs.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，在林美珠担任内政部民政司司长期间任内政部部长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who served as the Minister of the Interior while Lin Mei-chu was the Director-General of the Department of Civil Affairs.

zh-cn: 台湾金联资产管理公司

description.zh-cn: 台湾一家处理不良金融资产的资产管理公司。
description.en: A Taiwanese asset management corporation that deals with non-performing financial assets.

description.zh-cn: 由林全担任行政院院长所组成的中华民国内阁。
description.en: The cabinet of the Republic of China formed by Premier Lin Chuan.

description.zh-cn: 由赖清德担任行政院院长所组成的中华民国内阁。
description.en: The cabinet of the Republic of China formed by Premier Lai Ching-te.

zh-cn: 最高行政法院 (中华民国)

description.zh-cn: 中华民国的终审行政法院。
description.en: The final instance administrative court of the Republic of China (Taiwan).

description.zh-cn: 台湾原住民青年，因1986年的一起刑事案件而闻名。
description.en: A Taiwanese indigenous youth known for a criminal case in 1986.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，中国国民党籍立法委员，曾批评时任劳动部部长的林美珠为“神隐部长”。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician and Kuomintang legislator who criticized then-Minister of Labor Lin Mei-chu as the 'invisible minister'.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国的三所高等行政法院之一，位于台北市。
description.en: One of the three High Administrative Courts in the Republic of China, located in Taipei.

description.zh-cn: 美国经济学家、法学学者、物理学家及作家，圣塔克拉拉大学法学院教授，无政府资本主义理论的重要学者，米尔顿·佛利民的儿子。
description.en: American economist, legal scholar, physicist, and author, a professor of law at Santa Clara University. He is a major figure in the theory of anarcho-capitalism and the son of Milton Friedman.

description.zh-cn: 位于美国新泽西州的公立研究型大学。
description.en: A public research university in New Jersey.

description.zh-cn: 俄裔美国经济学家、统计学家，1971年诺贝尔经济学奖得主。
description.en: A Russian-American economist, statistician, and Nobel laureate in Economic Sciences in 1971.

description.zh-cn: 美国经济学家，1992年诺贝尔经济学奖得主，芝加哥经济学派的代表人物之一。
description.en: American economist who received the 1992 Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences. He was a leader of the Chicago School of economics.

description.zh-cn: 智利将军和独裁者，于1973年发动军事政变推翻阿连德政府后，统治智利至1990年。
description.en: A Chilean general and dictator who ruled Chile from 1973 to 1990, after leading a military coup to overthrow the government of Salvador Allende.

description.zh-cn: 一个经济学学派，强调自由市场和货币主义的重要性，与芝加哥大学经济系密切相关。
description.en: A school of economic thought that emphasizes the importance of free markets and monetarism, closely associated with the Department of Economics at the University of Chicago.

description.zh-cn: 美国的中央银行系统。
description.en: The central banking system of the United States.

description.zh-cn: 爱沙尼亚政治家，曾两次担任爱沙尼亚总理。
description.en: An Estonian politician who served as the Prime Minister of Estonia twice.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国云南省德宏傣族景颇族自治州陇川县的最高行政机关。
description.en: The highest administrative organ of Longchuan County, Dehong Dai and Jingpo Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 德宏傣族景颇族自治州人民政府

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国云南省德宏傣族景颇族自治州的最高行政机关。
description.en: The highest administrative organ of Dehong Dai and Jingpo Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国云南省德宏傣族景颇族自治州下辖的县。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Dehong Dai and Jingpo Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 宗教人士，曾任陇川各民族联合政府行政委员会副主任。
description.en: A religious figure who served as the Vice Chairman of the Administrative Committee of the Longchuan United Government of All Nationalities.

description.zh-cn: 明朝实行的锁国性质国策，严格禁止人民对外通商贸易。郑和下西洋是这一政策下的重大例外。
description.en: An isolationist national policy implemented by the Ming Dynasty, strictly prohibiting private maritime trade. Zheng He's voyages were a major exception to this policy.

description.zh-cn: 盘踞在旧港（今巨港）的海盗头目，在郑和第一次下西洋时被剿灭并生擒。
description.en: A pirate leader based in Old Port (modern Palembang), who was defeated and captured by Zheng He during the first voyage.

description.zh-cn: 锡兰山国王。因在郑和第三次下西洋时图谋加害船队，被郑和率兵突袭王城后生擒。
description.en: The king of Ceylon. He plotted to harm the fleet during Zheng He's third voyage and was captured after Zheng He led a surprise attack on his royal city.

description.zh-cn: 明代太监，作为郑和的副手，多次共同率领船队下西洋。在郑和于第七次航行途中去世后，他率领船队返回中国。
description.en: A Ming Dynasty eunuch who served as Zheng He's deputy, co-leading the treasure fleet on multiple voyages. After Zheng He's death during the seventh expedition, he led the fleet back to China.

description.zh-cn: 由帖木儿建立的帝国，其势力范围曾与明朝西部接壤。有学者认为郑和下西洋的目的之一是联合印度洋沿岸国家以制衡帖木儿帝国。
description.en: An empire founded by Timur, whose territory bordered the western frontier of the Ming Dynasty. Some scholars suggest that one of the purposes of Zheng He's voyages was to form alliances with countries along the Indian Ocean to counterbalance the Timurid Empire.

description.zh-cn: 台湾资深艺人及作家，作为郭台铭的副手搭档参与总统选举连署，后于登记前共同退选。
description.en: A veteran Taiwanese artist and author who was Terry Gou's running mate for the presidential election petition, later withdrawing together before the official registration.

description.zh-cn: 2024年总统选举前，由郭台铭于台北君悦酒店邀请侯友宜、柯文哲进行的最后一次公开在野整合协商。国民党主席朱立伦与前总统马英九亦到场，但会谈最终不欢而散，标志着“蓝白合作”彻底破局。
description.en: The final public opposition integration negotiation before the 2024 presidential election, hosted by Terry Gou at the Grand Hyatt Taipei for Hou Yu-ih and Ko Wen-je. KMT Chairman Eric Chu and former President Ma Ying-jeou also attended. The talks ended acrimoniously, marking the definitive collapse of the 'Blue-White Cooperation'.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡政治人物。
description.en: Singaporean politician.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡政治人物，现任新加坡副总理。
description.en: Singaporean politician, current Deputy Prime Minister of Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡政治人物。
description.en: Singaporean politician.

description.zh-cn: 美国外交官，时任美国副国务卿。
description.en: American diplomat, then U.S. Deputy Secretary of State.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡的主权财富基金。
description.en: Singapore's sovereign wealth fund.

zh-cn: 新加坡能源市场管理局

description.zh-cn: 新加坡贸易和工业部下属的法定委员会，负责监管国家的能源市场。
description.en: A statutory board under the Ministry of Trade and Industry of Singapore that regulates the country's energy market.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡政府管理教育事务的部门。
description.en: The ministry of the Singaporean government responsible for education affairs.

en: Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth
zh-cn: 新加坡文化、社区及青年部

description.zh-cn: 新加坡政府管理文化、社区和青年事务的部门。
description.en: The ministry of the Singaporean government responsible for culture, community, and youth affairs.

zh-cn: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校
密歇根大学安娜堡分校

description.zh-cn: 新加坡的一个反对党。
description.en: An opposition political party in Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 新文化运动的重要组成部分，旨在以贴近口语的白话文取代传统的文言文作为书面语，并对文学的内容、形式和评价标准进行全面革新。
description.en: An important component of the New Culture Movement, aiming to replace classical literary Chinese with vernacular Chinese as the written language, and to comprehensively innovate the content, form, and evaluation criteria of literature.

description.zh-cn: 中国学者，新文化运动中激进反孔的代表人物之一。他在《新青年》上发表多篇文章猛烈攻击儒家学说，被胡适称为“四川省只手打孔家店的老英雄”。
description.en: Chinese scholar, one of the radical anti-Confucian figures in the New Culture Movement. He published numerous articles in 'New Youth' fiercely attacking Confucianism and was dubbed by Hu Shih as 'the old hero from Sichuan who single-handedly smashed the Confucian establishment'.

description.zh-cn: 民国时期以《学衡》杂志为中心形成的学术文化流派。该派成员多有留学背景，他们反对新文化运动对中国传统文化的激烈批判和全盘否定，主张“昌明国粹，融化新知”。
description.en: An academic and cultural school formed around the 'Xueheng' (Critical Review) magazine during the Republican era. Many of its members had studied abroad. They opposed the New Culture Movement's fierce criticism and wholesale rejection of traditional Chinese culture, advocating for 'illuminating the national quintessence and assimilating new knowledge'.

description.zh-cn: 中国现代著名学者、教育家，学衡派的代表人物。他通过创办《学衡》杂志，撰写文章系统地批评新文化运动，认为其对中西文化的理解均存在谬误。
description.en: A renowned modern Chinese scholar and educator, and a representative figure of the Xueheng School. Through founding the 'Xueheng' magazine, he wrote articles systematically criticizing the New Culture Movement, arguing that its understanding of both Chinese and Western cultures was flawed.

description.zh-cn: 共产国际代表。1920年，他受命来到中国，先后与李大钊、陈独秀等人会面，直接推动了中国各地共产主义小组的建立和中国共产党的成立。
description.en: A representative of the Communist International. In 1920, he was sent to China where he met with Li Dazhao, Chen Duxiu, and others, directly facilitating the establishment of communist groups across China and the founding of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 美国著名哲学家、教育家，实用主义（实验主义）的创始人。他于1919至1921年在中国讲学，其思想对胡适等人及整个新文化运动产生了重要影响。
description.en: A prominent American philosopher and educator, and the founder of pragmatism. He lectured in China from 1919 to 1921, and his ideas had a significant impact on figures like Hu Shih and the New Culture Movement as a whole.

description.zh-cn: 一种由父母或家族长辈决定子女婚姻的传统制度。它是新文化运动所批判的封建礼教之一，运动倡导者提倡自由恋爱和婚姻自主。
description.en: A traditional system where marriages are decided by parents or family elders. It was one of the feudal rituals criticized by the New Culture Movement, whose proponents advocated for free love and marital autonomy.

description.zh-cn: 新文化运动中出现的一种激进思想口号，最初由胡适于1929年提出，主张中国应全面学习和采纳西方文化以实现现代化。此观点引发巨大争议，后被胡适修正为“充分世界化”。
description.en: A radical slogan that emerged during the New Culture Movement, first proposed by Hu Shih in 1929, advocating for China to comprehensively learn from and adopt Western culture to achieve modernization. This viewpoint sparked immense controversy and was later revised by Hu Shih to 'full-scale world-ification'.

description.zh-cn: 大日本帝国于台湾日治时期建立的九所帝国大学之一，也是当时台湾的最高学府。作为国立台湾大学的前身，其附属农林专门部曾是国立中兴大学的前身。
description.en: One of the nine Imperial Universities established by the Empire of Japan in Taiwan under Japanese rule, it was also the highest institution of learning in Taiwan during that period. It is the predecessor of National Taiwan University, and its affiliated Agriculture and Forestry Department was once the predecessor of National Chung Hsing University.

description.zh-cn: 国立台湾大学是一所台湾的国立大学，其前身为国立中兴大学法商学院。该校曾在1945年11月至12月15日期间使用过一个临时校名。
description.en: National Taiwan University is a national university in Taiwan, its predecessor was the College of Law and Business of National Chung Hsing University. The university used a temporary school name during the period of November 1945 to December 15, 1945.

description.zh-cn: 日本历史学家，台北帝国大学首任总长。
description.en: Japanese historian and the first president of Taihoku Imperial University.

description.zh-cn: 植物学家，中华民国接收台湾后国立台湾大学首任代理校长。
description.en: Botanist and the first acting president of National Taiwan University after the Republic of China took over Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 经济学家、中央研究院院士，曾任国立台湾大学校长。其上任过程因“2018年国立台湾大学校长遴选事件”而备受争议。
description.en: Economist, academician of Academia Sinica, and former president of National Taiwan University. His appointment was controversial due to the '2018 National Taiwan University presidential election controversy'.

description.zh-cn: 化工学家，国立台湾大学第13任校长。
description.en: Chemical engineer and the 13th president of National Taiwan University.

description.zh-cn: 台湾日治时期的一所医学专门学校，是国立台湾大学医学院最早的前身之一。

zh-cn: 台湾总督府高等商业学校

description.zh-cn: 台湾日治时期的一所商业学校，其校地与部分学系后来并入国立台湾大学法学院。
该组织前身为台北高等商业学校。在不同历史阶段，它曾并入国立台湾大学法学院，也是国立台北大学的前身之一。此外，它还于1961年与台湾省立农学院合并组成台湾省立中兴大学。
description.en: This organization originated from the transformation of Taipei Higher Commercial School. At different historical stages, it was merged into the National Taiwan University College of Law, and was also one of the predecessors of National Taipei University. Furthermore, in 1961, it merged with the Taiwan Provincial College of Agriculture to form the Taiwan Provincial Chung Hsing University.

en: National Taiwan University of Science and Technology

description.zh-cn: 台湾数学家、政治活动家，在台湾白色恐怖时期遭警备总部约谈后，陈尸于台湾大学校园内。
description.en: Taiwanese mathematician and political activist who was found dead on the National Taiwan University campus after being interrogated by the Taiwan Garrison Command during the White Terror period.

en: Repatriation of Bunun remains at National Taiwan University

description.zh-cn: 工学家，曾任国立台湾大学第2任校长。
化学家，中央研究院院士，曾任国立台湾大学第3任校长。
台湾首位医学博士，曾任国立台湾大学代理校长。
化学家，中央研究院院士，曾任国立台湾大学第5任校长。
水利学家，曾任国立台湾大学第6任校长。
土木工程学家，曾任国立台湾大学第7任校长。
经济学家，曾任国立台湾大学第8任校长。
医学家，曾任国立台湾大学第9任校长。
电机学家，曾任国立台湾大学第10任校长。
医学家，中央研究院院士，曾任国立台湾大学第11任校长。
中国音乐家，刘半农之弟。
description.en: A Chinese musician, younger brother of Liu Bannong.

description.zh-cn: 曾与刘半农共同编辑《江阴杂志》。
description.en: Co-edited the 'Jiangyin Magazine' with Liu Bannong.

description.zh-cn: 由刘半农与李家瑞合著的关于俗字研究的著作。
description.en: A work on the study of popular characters co-authored by Liu Bannong and Li Jiarui.

description.zh-cn: 与刘半农合著《宋元以来俗字谱》的学者。
description.en: A scholar who co-authored 'A譜 of Popular Characters since the Song and Yuan Dynasties' with Liu Bannong.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党党员，中华人民共和国政治人物。因在脱贫攻坚战中作出突出贡献，被授予“全国脱贫攻坚先进个人”荣誉称号。
description.en: A member of the Communist Party of China and a political figure in the People's Republic of China. He was awarded the honorary title of 'National Advanced Individual in Poverty Alleviation' for his outstanding contributions to the poverty alleviation campaign.

description.zh-cn: 江西省赣州市赣县区下辖的乡镇级行政单位。
description.en: A township-level administrative unit under Ganxian District, Ganzhou, Jiangxi.

description.zh-cn: 江西省赣州市赣县区下辖的乡镇级行政单位。
description.en: A township-level administrative unit under Ganxian District, Ganzhou, Jiangxi.

description.zh-cn: 江西省赣州市赣县区下辖的乡镇级行政单位。
description.en: A township-level administrative unit under Ganxian District, Ganzhou, Jiangxi.

description.zh-cn: 西汉时期吴王刘濞的太子，在与皇太子刘启（后来的汉景帝）下棋时，因争执被后者用棋盘砸死。
description.en: The crown prince of Liu Pi, King of Wu, during the Western Han dynasty. He was killed with a chessboard by Crown Prince Liu Qi (later Emperor Jing of Han) during a dispute while playing a game.

description.zh-cn: 苏格兰诗人，伦敦大学学院的创办人之一。
description.en: Scottish poet and a co-founder of University College London.

en: Henry Brougham, 1st Baron Brougham and Vaux
zh-cn: 第一代布鲁厄姆和沃克斯男爵亨利·布鲁厄姆

description.zh-cn: 苏格兰律师，伦敦大学学院的创办人之一。
description.en: Scottish lawyer and a co-founder of University College London.

description.zh-cn: 英国哲学家，其教育理念深刻影响了伦敦大学学院的创办者，被誉为“伦大教父”。
description.en: English philosopher whose educational ideas deeply influenced the founders of University College London, earning him the title of its 'spiritual father'.

description.zh-cn: 位于英国伦敦的研究型大学，与伦敦大学学院同为伦敦大学的始创成员学院，两校间存在历史悠久的竞争关系。
description.en: A research university in London, England. It is a founding constituent college of the University of London along with UCL, and has a long-standing rivalry with it.

description.zh-cn: 奥地利外交官，曾对伦敦大学学院的建立表示反对。
description.en: Austrian diplomat who expressed opposition to the establishment of University College London.

description.zh-cn: 耶鲁大学的医学院，与伦敦大学学院签订了两校史上最具规模的合作项目。
description.en: The medical school of Yale University, which has signed the largest collaborative project in the history of both universities with University College London.

description.zh-cn: 一家总部位于荷兰阿姆斯特丹的全球性信息分析公司，与伦敦大学学院合作开办了大数据研究中心。
description.en: A global information analytics business headquartered in Amsterdam, which co-founded the Big Data Institute with University College London.

zh-cn: 亚历山大·格雷厄姆·贝尔
亚历山大·格拉汉姆·贝尔

description.zh-cn: 首个电话专利持有者，伦敦大学学院校友。
description.en: Holder of the first patent for the telephone and an alumnus of University College London.

description.zh-cn: 去氧核糖核酸发现者及诺贝尔生理学或医学奖得主之一，伦敦大学学院校友。
description.en: Co-discoverer of the structure of the DNA molecule and Nobel laureate in Physiology or Medicine, and an alumnus of University College London.

description.zh-cn: “光纤之父”及诺贝尔物理学奖得主，伦敦大学学院校友。
description.en: 'Father of Fiber Optics' and Nobel laureate in Physics, and an alumnus of University College London.

description.zh-cn: 英国摇滚乐队，所有成员均为伦敦大学学院校友。
description.en: British rock band, all members of which are alumni of University College London.

description.zh-cn: 电影导演，伦敦大学学院校友。
description.en: Film director and an alumnus of University College London.

description.zh-cn: 英国皇室成员，担任伦敦大学学院校监。
description.en: Member of the British royal family, serving as the Chancellor of University College London.

description.zh-cn: 总部位于伦敦的生物医学研究慈善基金会，弗朗西斯·克里克研究院的共同创办者之一。
description.en: A London-based charitable foundation focused on biomedical research, and a co-founder of the Francis Crick Institute.

description.zh-cn: 澳大利亚南澳大利亚州的首府，伦敦大学学院在此设有能源学院。
description.en: The capital city of South Australia, Australia, where UCL has a campus for its School of Energy and Resources.

description.zh-cn: 卡塔尔的首都，伦敦大学学院在此设有考古与博物馆学院。
description.en: The capital city of Qatar, where UCL has a campus for archaeology and museum studies.

description.zh-cn: 苏维埃军事家和革命家，《苏联成立条约》的签署人之一。
description.en: Soviet military commander and revolutionary, one of the signatories of the Treaty on the Creation of the USSR.

zh-cn: 格里戈里·彼得罗夫斯基

description.zh-cn: 乌克兰苏维埃政治家，《苏联成立条约》的签署人之一。
description.en: Ukrainian Soviet politician, one of the signatories of the Treaty on the Creation of the USSR.

zh-cn: 亚历山大·切尔维亚科夫

description.zh-cn: 白俄罗斯苏维埃政治家，《苏联成立条约》的签署人之一。
description.en: Byelorussian Soviet politician, one of the signatories of the Treaty on the Creation of the USSR.

description.zh-cn: 格鲁吉亚革命家和苏维埃政治家，《苏联成立条约》的签署人之一。
description.en: Georgian revolutionary and Soviet politician, one of the signatories of the Treaty on the Creation of the USSR.

zh-cn: 第一次全联盟苏维埃代表大会

description.zh-cn: 1922年12月30日通过《苏联成立条约》和《苏联成立宣言》的会议。
description.en: The congress that approved the Treaty on the Creation of the USSR and the Declaration of the Creation of the USSR on December 30, 1922.

description.zh-cn: 靖难之役中的一场关键战役，李景隆率领的南军在此被朱棣的燕军击溃。
description.en: A key battle in the Jingnan Campaign where the southern army led by Li Jinglong was routed by Zhu Di's Yan army.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任内蒙古自治区政协副主席。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, former Vice Chairman of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 内蒙古自治区下辖的一个旗，是邬宝恒的出生地。
description.en: A banner under the jurisdiction of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, and the birthplace of Wu Baoheng.

zh-cn: 伊朗伊斯兰共和国政府
en: Government of the Islamic Republic of Iran

description.zh-cn: 伊朗的执政当局，是阿米尼示威的主要抗议对象。
description.en: The ruling authority of Iran, the main target of the Mahsa Amini protests.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗的道德警察，负责监督公众执行头巾令等伊斯兰教着装规范。因逮捕并导致玛莎·阿米尼死亡而受到广泛谴责。
description.en: The morality police of Iran, responsible for enforcing Islamic dress codes such as the hijab. Widely condemned for arresting Mahsa Amini, which led to her death.

description.zh-cn: 始于2017年的伊朗女性抗议运动，反对强制佩戴头巾，被视为阿米尼示威的前身和组成部分。
description.en: A protest movement by women in Iran against the compulsory hijab, which started in 2017. It is considered a precursor and a component of the Mahsa Amini protests.

description.zh-cn: 阿米尼示威中最为流传的口号，代表了示威的核心诉求。该运动与玛莎·阿米尼被追授2023年萨哈罗夫奖。
description.en: The most popular slogan in the Mahsa Amini protests, representing the core demands of the movement. The movement, along with Mahsa Amini, was posthumously awarded the 2023 Sakharov Prize.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗律师、前法官、人权活动家，2003年诺贝尔和平奖得主。她表示阿米尼示威的目标是推翻政权。
description.en: An Iranian lawyer, former judge, and human rights activist, who won the Nobel Peace Prize in 2003. She stated that the goal of the Amini protests is to overthrow the regime.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗的国家足球队。在2022年世界杯期间，球员通过不唱国歌等方式表达对阿米尼示威的支持。
description.en: The national football team of Iran. During the 2022 World Cup, players expressed their support for the Mahsa Amini protests by not singing the national anthem.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗前国脚，因在社交媒体上声援阿米尼示威而被捕。
description.en: A former player of the Iran national football team who was arrested for supporting the Mahsa Amini protests on social media.

zh-cn: 联合国经济及社会理事会
en: United Nations Economic and Social Council

description.zh-cn: 联合国主要机构之一，于2022年12月14日投票决定将伊朗从联合国妇女地位委员会中除名，以回应伊朗政府对示威的镇压。
description.en: One of the principal organs of the United Nations, which voted on December 14, 2022, to remove Iran from the Commission on the Status of Women in response to the government's crackdown on protests.

zh-cn: 联合国妇女地位委员会
en: UN Commission on the Status of Women

description.zh-cn: 联合国经社理事会下的一个职司委员会，伊朗因镇压阿米尼示威于2022年被取消其成员资格。
description.en: A functional commission of the UN Economic and Social Council. Iran's membership was revoked in 2022 due to its suppression of the Mahsa Amini protests.

zh-cn: 伊朗情报与国家安全部

description.zh-cn: 伊朗的情报机构，指控并逮捕了报道玛莎·阿米尼之死的两名女记者，称她们是外国间谍。
description.en: The intelligence agency of Iran, which accused and arrested two female journalists who reported on the death of Mahsa Amini, branding them as foreign agents.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗女记者，因报道玛莎·阿米尼之死而被伊朗情报部逮捕，并被指控为外国间谍。
description.en: An Iranian female journalist who was arrested by the Ministry of Intelligence and accused of being a foreign agent for her reporting on the death of Mahsa Amini.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗女记者，因报道玛莎·阿米尼之死而被伊朗情报部逮捕，并被指控为外国间碟。
description.en: An Iranian female journalist who was arrested by the Ministry of Intelligence and accused of being a foreign agent for her reporting on the death of Mahsa Amini.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队总司令，认为示威背后有来自沙特阿拉伯的支持。
description.en: Commander-in-Chief of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, who believed that Saudi Arabia was behind the protests.

description.zh-cn: 联合国下属机构，于2022年11月通过决议，谴责伊朗镇压示威者，并成立调查团调查伊朗当局的行为。
description.en: A United Nations body that passed a resolution in November 2022 condemning Iran's crackdown on protesters and establishing a fact-finding mission to investigate the authorities' actions.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗人权活动家，因“为伊朗受压迫的女性而战、为促进所有人的人权及自由而战”而获得2023年诺贝尔和平奖。
description.en: An Iranian human rights activist who was awarded the 2023 Nobel Peace Prize 'for her fight against the oppression of women in Iran and her fight to promote human rights and freedom for all'.

description.zh-cn: 此次选举中，强硬保守派候选人易卜拉欣·莱希当选伊朗总统。
description.en: In this election, the hardline conservative candidate Ebrahim Raisi was elected President of Iran.

description.zh-cn: 德国足球俱乐部，其球迷在比赛中展示横幅，声援阿米尼示威并悼念遇难者萨丽娜·伊斯梅尔扎德。
description.en: A German football club whose fans displayed a banner during a match to show solidarity with the Mahsa Amini protests and to mourn the victim Sarina Esmailzadeh.

description.zh-cn: 美国足球的管理机构。在2022年世界杯期间，该协会为支持伊朗示威者，在社交媒体上发布了不含伊朗国徽的伊朗国旗图片。
description.en: The governing body of soccer in the United States. During the 2022 World Cup, it posted an image of the Iranian flag without the national emblem on social media to support protesters in Iran.

description.zh-cn: 为纪念法国大革命100周年而举办的世界博览会，埃菲尔铁塔是为此而建的主要建筑。
description.en: A world's fair held in Paris to celebrate the 100th anniversary of the French Revolution, for which the Eiffel Tower was built as the main attraction.

description.zh-cn: 1853年纽约万国工业博览会上的木结构观景塔，是埃菲尔铁塔的灵感来源之一。
description.en: A wooden observation tower at the 1853 New York World's Fair, which served as an inspiration for the Eiffel Tower.

description.zh-cn: 巴黎的市政府，埃菲尔铁塔的所有者。
description.en: The municipal government of Paris, which owns the Eiffel Tower.

description.zh-cn: 法国作家，是反对建造埃菲尔铁塔的艺术家之一，据说他每天在塔的餐厅用餐，因为那是巴黎唯一看不到塔的地方。
description.en: A French writer who was among the artists protesting the Eiffel Tower. He is said to have eaten lunch in the tower's restaurant every day because it was the only place in Paris where he could not see it.

description.zh-cn: 第一次世界大战中的一场关键战役，埃菲尔铁塔的无线电发射机通过干扰德军通讯，为盟军胜利作出了贡献。
description.en: A pivotal battle of World War I in which the radio transmitter in the Eiffel Tower contributed to the Allied victory by jamming German communications.

description.zh-cn: 奥地利裁缝，在测试自制降落伞时从埃菲尔铁塔第一层跳下身亡。
description.en: An Austrian tailor who died after jumping from the first level of the Eiffel Tower to test his homemade parachute design.

description.zh-cn: 二战期间巴黎的德国军事总督，他违抗了希特勒摧毁巴黎的命令，从而保全了埃菲尔铁塔。
description.en: The German military governor of Paris during World War II, who disobeyed Hitler's order to destroy the city, thereby saving the Eiffel Tower.

description.zh-cn: 美国电梯公司，为埃菲尔铁塔安装了通往第二层的具有挑战性的电梯。
description.en: An American elevator company that installed the challenging elevators to the second floor of the Eiffel Tower.

description.zh-cn: 由联合国教科文组织世界遗产委员会评选出的对全人类具有突出普遍价值的地点。
description.en: A landmark or area selected by the UNESCO World Heritage Committee as having cultural, historical, scientific or other form of significance, which is legally protected by international treaties.

description.zh-cn: 位于英国黑潭的观光塔，其设计灵感来源于埃菲尔铁塔。
description.en: A tourist attraction in Blackpool, England, inspired by the Eiffel Tower.

description.zh-cn: 一座未完工的铁塔，旨在超越埃菲尔铁塔，后被拆除。
description.en: An unfinished iron tower designed to surpass the Eiffel Tower, which was later demolished.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第一代领导集体

description.zh-cn: 对中国共产党第八届中央委员会七名政治局常委毛泽东、刘少奇、周恩来、朱德、陈云、林彪和邓小平的合称，被视为中国共产党第一代领导集体。
description.en: A collective term for the seven members of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the 8th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China: Mao Zedong, Liu Shaoqi, Zhou Enlai, Zhu De, Chen Yun, Lin Biao, and Deng Xiaoping, regarded as the first generation of collective leadership of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会的办事机构。
description.en: The working body of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党的中央权力机关。
description.en: The central authority of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 1954年至1975年间中华人民共和国的最高军事领导机构。
description.en: The supreme military leading body of the People's Republic of China from 1954 to 1975.

description.zh-cn: 指20世纪80年代中国由邓小平和陈云共同主导的政治格局。
description.en: Refers to the political landscape in China during the 1980s, co-dominated by Deng Xiaoping and Chen Yun.

description.zh-cn: 中国学者，《零八宪章》的主要起草人之一。
description.en: A Chinese scholar and one of the main drafters of Charter 08.

description.zh-cn: 捷克斯洛伐克反体制运动的象征性文件。
description.en: A symbolic document of the anti-regime movement in Czechoslovakia.

description.zh-cn: 《零八宪章》中提出的用于解决两岸及民族问题的政治构想。
description.en: A political concept proposed in Charter 08 to resolve cross-strait and ethnic issues.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国刑法中的一项罪名，常用于惩处异见人士。刘晓波因《零八宪章》被以此罪名判刑。
description.en: A crime under the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, often used to punish dissidents. Liu Xiaobo was sentenced on this charge for his involvement with Charter 08.

description.zh-cn: 1979年台湾民主运动中的重要政治性刊物，一些评论员认为其对《零八宪章》有影响。
description.en: An important political magazine in Taiwan's democracy movement in 1979, which some commentators believe influenced Charter 08.

en: University of Shanghai for Science and Technology

description.zh-cn: 位于中国上海的高等学府，前身为上海机械学院。
description.en: An institution of higher education in Shanghai, China, formerly known as Shanghai Institute of Mechanical Engineering.

description.zh-cn: 位于北京市西城区的金融中心区，其规划蓝图由陈元主持制定。
description.en: A financial center in Xicheng District, Beijing, whose planning blueprint was developed under the leadership of Chen Yuan.

zh-cn: 国立中兴大学附属高级中学
en: The Affiliated Senior High School of National Chung Hsing University

description.zh-cn: 原为国立大里高级中学，于2014年2月1日改隶国立中兴大学。
description.en: Formerly National Dali Senior High School, it became affiliated with National Chung Hsing University on February 1, 2014.

zh-cn: 国立中兴大学附属台中高级农业职业学校
en: The Affiliated Taichung Agricultural Senior High School of National Chung Hsing University

description.zh-cn: 原为国立台中高级农业职业学校，于2014年2月1日改隶国立中兴大学。
description.en: Formerly National Taichung Agricultural Senior High School, it became affiliated with National Chung Hsing University on February 1, 2014.

description.zh-cn: 台湾省立中兴大学首任校长，中央研究院院士。
description.en: The first president of Taiwan Provincial Chung Hsing University and an academician of Academia Sinica.

description.zh-cn: 省立中兴大学第二任校长。
description.en: The second president of Provincial Chung Hsing University.

description.zh-cn: 台湾的一个大学联盟系统，旨在整合国立大学资源，国立中兴大学为其成员之一。
description.en: A university alliance system in Taiwan aimed at integrating resources of national universities. National Chung Hsing University is one of its members.

description.zh-cn: 台湾的一个大学联盟系统，国立中兴大学为其成员之一。
description.en: A university alliance system in Taiwan, of which National Chung Hsing University is a member.

zh-cn: 发展国际一流大学及顶尖研究中心计划

description.zh-cn: 台湾教育部于2005年启动的一项高等教育计划，旨在提升顶尖大学的国际竞争力。
description.en: A higher education project launched by the Ministry of Education of Taiwan in 2005, aimed at enhancing the international competitiveness of top universities.

description.zh-cn: 台湾的国立大学，与国立中兴大学等校共同参与“正兴城湾杯”校际竞赛。
description.en: A national university in Taiwan that participates in the 'Jheng-Sing-Cheng-Wan Cup' intercollegiate competition with National Chung Hsing University and other institutions.

description.zh-cn: 研究行政法律规范及其发展规律的法律科学，罗豪才是中国现代该领域的开拓者与奠基人。
description.en: The legal science that studies administrative legal norms and their developmental patterns. Luo Haocai is a pioneer and founder of this field in modern China.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国广东省广州市的一所中学，罗豪才曾在此就读。
description.en: A middle school in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China, where Luo Haocai once studied.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国江苏省无锡市的一所中学，罗豪才曾在此就读。
description.en: A middle school in Wuxi, Jiangsu, China, where Luo Haocai once studied.

description.zh-cn: 中国法学家，与罗豪才等人于1990年代初率先提出“现代行政法的平衡理论”。
description.en: Chinese jurist who, along with Luo Haocai and others, pioneered the 'balance theory of modern administrative law' in the early 1990s.

description.zh-cn: 古代不列颠爱西尼部落的女王，曾率领部落反抗罗马帝国的统治，并在公元61年攻陷并焚毁了伦蒂尼恩（伦敦）。
description.en: Queen of the ancient British Iceni tribe, who led an uprising against the occupying forces of the Roman Empire and sacked and burned Londinium (London) in 61 AD.

description.zh-cn: 西撒克逊国王，于886年从维京人手中夺回伦敦并进行了重建。
description.en: King of the West Saxons, who recaptured and rebuilt London from the Vikings in 886 AD.

description.zh-cn: 诺曼底公爵，在1066年征服英格兰后成为英格兰国王。他在伦敦建造了伦敦塔以震慑当地居民。
description.en: Duke of Normandy who became King of England after conquering it in 1066. He built the Tower of London to intimidate the local inhabitants.

description.zh-cn: 位于伦敦市中心泰晤士河北岸的历史城堡，由威廉一世在1066年诺曼征服后开始兴建，是伦敦的世界遗产之一。
description.en: A historic castle located on the north bank of the River Thames in central London. Its construction was initiated by William the Conqueror after the Norman Conquest of 1066. It is one of London's World Heritage Sites.

description.zh-cn: 英格兰国王，于1097年开始兴建威斯敏斯特厅，该建筑后来成为威斯敏斯特宫的基础。
description.en: King of England who began the construction of Westminster Hall in 1097, which became the basis of the Palace of Westminster.

description.zh-cn: 位于伦敦泰晤士河畔，是英国国会的所在地。其基础建筑威斯敏斯特厅由威廉二世于1097年开始兴建。
description.en: Located on the banks of the River Thames in London, it is the meeting place of the Parliament of the United Kingdom. Its foundational structure, Westminster Hall, was initiated by William II in 1097.

description.zh-cn: 1666年发生在伦敦的一场大火灾，摧毁了城内大量的木质建筑，之后由罗伯特·胡克等人主导了重建工作。
description.en: A major conflagration that swept through London in 1666, destroying a large number of the city's wooden buildings. Reconstruction was later led by individuals such as Robert Hooke.

description.zh-cn: 1665年至1666年间在英国发生的大规模腺鼠疫疫情，导致近10万伦敦人死亡，占当时人口的五分之一。
description.en: A massive outbreak of bubonic plague in England from 1665 to 1666, which killed nearly 100,000 Londoners, a fifth of the city's population at the time.

description.zh-cn: 英国科学家，在1666年伦敦大火后主导了城市的重建工作。
description.en: An English scientist who played a leading role in the reconstruction of London after the Great Fire of 1666.

description.zh-cn: 1952年发生在伦敦的一场严重空气污染事件，最终促使英国议会通过了《1956年空气清净法案》。
description.en: A severe air pollution event that occurred in London in 1952, which ultimately led to the passage of the Clean Air Act 1956.

description.zh-cn: 英国国会为应对1952年伦敦烟雾事件而通过的一项法案，旨在解决空气污染问题。
description.en: An Act of the Parliament of the United Kingdom passed in response to the Great Smog of London in 1952, aimed at tackling air pollution.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战期间纳粹德国空军对伦敦进行的一系列大规模轰炸，导致超过3万名伦敦人死亡，并摧毁了大量建筑。
description.en: A sustained strategic bombing campaign against London by Nazi Germany's air force during World War II, resulting in over 30,000 civilian deaths and the destruction of numerous buildings.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国的空军，在第二次世界大战期间对伦敦实施了大规模的轰炸，即“伦敦大轰炸”。
description.en: The aerial warfare branch of Nazi Germany, which carried out a massive bombing campaign against London during World War II, known as 'The Blitz'.

description.zh-cn: 英格兰的一个行政区和大区，由32个伦敦自治市镇和伦敦城组成。其行政管理由大伦敦政府负责。
description.en: An administrative area and region of England, consisting of 32 London boroughs and the City of London. Its administration is handled by the Greater London Authority.

description.zh-cn: 负责大伦敦地区战略性管理的最高层级地方政府，由选举产生的伦敦市长和伦敦议会组成。
description.en: The top-tier local government responsible for the strategic administration of Greater London, composed of the elected Mayor of London and the London Assembly.

description.zh-cn: 英国政治家，现任伦敦市长。
description.en: A British politician serving as the current Mayor of London.

description.zh-cn: 大伦敦政府的行政首长，负责大伦敦地区的战略管理。现任市长是萨迪克·汗。
description.en: The executive head of the Greater London Authority, responsible for the strategic governance of Greater London. The current mayor is Sadiq Khan.

description.zh-cn: 大伦敦政府的一部分，负责监督伦敦市长的决策，并有权批准或否决市长的年度预算提案。
description.en: Part of the Greater London Authority that scrutinises the activities of the Mayor of London and has the power to approve or reject the mayor's annual budget proposals.

description.zh-cn: 维多利亚时代的英国作家，其作品深刻描绘了当时的伦敦社会，塑造了维多利亚时代早期伦敦的经典形象。
description.en: A Victorian-era English writer whose works vividly depicted London society, shaping the classic image of early Victorian London.

description.zh-cn: 英国剧作家、诗人和演员，被广泛认为是英语世界最伟大的作家和世界上最杰出的戏剧家。他曾在伦敦生活和工作了很长时间。
description.en: An English playwright, poet, and actor, widely regarded as the greatest writer in the English language and the world's pre-eminent dramatist. He lived and worked in London for a significant period.

description.zh-cn: 文绣的祖父，官至吏部尚书。
description.en: Grandfather of Wenxiu, who served as the Minister of Personnel.

description.zh-cn: 文绣的母亲，端恭的继配。
description.en: Mother of Wenxiu and the second wife of Duangong.

description.zh-cn: 位于北京的著名中学。文绣离婚后曾在此化名傅玉芳担任国文与国画教师。
