description.en: A well-known middle school in Beijing. After her divorce, Wenxiu taught Chinese literature and painting here under the alias Fu Yufang.

description.zh-cn: 文绣于1947年曾在此报社担任校对。
description.en: A newspaper where Wenxiu worked as a proofreader in 1947.

description.zh-cn: 律师，在文绣与溥仪的离婚案中担任溥仪的代理律师之一。
description.en: A lawyer who represented Puyi during his divorce case with Wenxiu.

description.zh-cn: 律师，在文绣与溥仪的离婚案中担任溥仪的代理律师之一。
description.en: A lawyer who represented Puyi during his divorce case with Wenxiu.

description.zh-cn: 律师，在文绣与溥仪的离婚案中担任文绣的代理律师之一。
description.en: A lawyer who represented Wenxiu during her divorce case with Puyi.

description.zh-cn: 律师，在文绣与溥仪的离婚案中担任文绣的代理律师之一。
description.en: A lawyer who represented Wenxiu during her divorce case with Puyi.

description.zh-cn: 律师，在文绣与溥仪的离婚案中担任文绣的代理律师之一。
description.en: A lawyer who represented Wenxiu during her divorce case with Puyi.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国辽宁省下辖的地级市，是盛斌的出生地。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Liaoning Province, People's Republic of China, and the birthplace of Sheng Bin.

zh-cn: 俄罗斯联邦军队综合军事学院
en: Combined Arms Academy of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯联邦的一所军事学院。
description.en: A military academy in the Russian Federation.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军第二十三集团军
中国人民解放军黑龙江省军区

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将，曾任沈阳军区副司令员，后由盛斌接任。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the People's Liberation Army, former Deputy Commander of the Shenyang Military Region, succeeded by Sheng Bin.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军少将，曾任黑龙江省军区司令员，后由盛斌接任。
description.en: A major general of the People's Liberation Army, former Commander of the Heilongjiang Military District, succeeded by Sheng Bin.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军少将，接替盛斌担任黑龙江省军区司令员。
description.en: A major general of the People's Liberation Army who succeeded Sheng Bin as the Commander of the Heilongjiang Military District.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上将，曾任国家国防动员委员会秘书长，后由盛斌接任。
description.en: A general of the People's Liberation Army, former Secretary-General of the National Defense Mobilization Committee, succeeded by Sheng Bin.

description.zh-cn: 明朝将领，封泰宁侯，曾主持营建北京紫禁城。
description.en: A general of the Ming dynasty, enfeoffed as Marquis of Taining, who oversaw the construction of the Forbidden City in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，官至工部侍郎，曾主持营建北京紫禁城。
description.en: An official of the Ming dynasty who served as Vice Minister of Works and oversaw the construction of the Forbidden City in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，官至刑部侍郎，曾主持营建北京紫禁城。
description.en: An official of the Ming dynasty who served as Vice Minister of Justice and oversaw the construction of the Forbidden City in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 原成立于北京，后因国共内战，部分文物随国民政府迁至台湾。现为台湾最具规模的博物馆。
description.en: Originally established in Beijing, a portion of its collection was moved to Taiwan with the Nationalist government due to the Chinese Civil War. It is now the largest museum in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 拉脱维亚政治人物，现任拉脱维亚总统。
description.en: Latvian politician, the current President of Latvia.

description.zh-cn: 拉脱维亚共和国的国家元首职位。
description.en: The position of the head of state of the Republic of Latvia.

description.zh-cn: 拉脱维亚政治人物，现任拉脱维亚总理。
description.en: Latvian politician, the current Prime Minister of Latvia.

description.zh-cn: 拉脱维亚共和国的政府首脑职位。
description.en: The position of the head of government of the Republic of Latvia.

zh-cn: 1991年拉脱维亚独立和民主化公投

description.zh-cn: 导致拉脱维亚于1991年8月21日正式恢复独立的公民投票事件。
description.en: A referendum event that led to the formal restoration of Latvia's independence on August 21, 1991.

description.zh-cn: 13世纪初通过武力征服拉脱维亚地区并强迫当地居民改信基督教的德意志十字军组织。
description.en: A German crusading order that conquered the territory of Latvia in the early 13th century and forced the local population to convert to Christianity.

zh-cn: 拉脱维亚苏维埃社会主义共和国

description.zh-cn: 拉脱维亚被苏联吞并后成立的加盟共和国。
description.en: The constituent republic established after Latvia was annexed by the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国在波罗的海国家和白俄罗斯部分地区建立的占领区行政单位。
description.en: The civilian occupation regime established by Nazi Germany in the Baltic states and parts of Belarus.

description.zh-cn: 促进波罗的海国家（包括拉脱维亚）从苏联独立的非暴力运动。
description.en: A non-violent movement that led to the restoration of independence for the Baltic states, including Latvia, from the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 拉脱维亚共和国的立法机构。
description.en: The legislative body of the Republic of Latvia.

description.zh-cn: 拉脱维亚政治人物，曾任拉脱维亚总统。
description.en: Latvian politician who served as the President of Latvia.

description.zh-cn: 拉脱维亚独立后产生的一种特殊的法律地位，主要适用于苏联时期移居的非拉脱维亚族人及其后代。
description.en: A unique legal status in Latvia that emerged after its independence, primarily applying to non-ethnic Latvians who migrated during the Soviet era and their descendants.

description.zh-cn: 拉脱维亚政治人物，曾任拉脱维亚总统，签署法令停止给予新生儿非公民身份。
description.en: Latvian politician who served as President of Latvia and signed a law to stop granting non-citizen status to newborns.

zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议德宏傣族景颇族自治州委员会

location.zh-cn: 德宏傣族景颇族自治州芒市斑色路3号
location.en: No. 3 Banse Road, Mangshi, Dehong Dai and Jingpo Autonomous Prefecture

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国云南省德宏傣族景颇族自治州的政治协商会议组织。
description.en: The political consultative conference organization of Dehong Dai and Jingpo Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中国共产党德宏傣族景颇族自治州委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在德宏傣族景颇族自治州的地方组织。
description.en: The local organization of the Chinese Communist Party in Dehong Dai and Jingpo Autonomous Prefecture.

description.zh-cn: 云南省德宏傣族景颇族自治州下辖的县级市，是该州州府所在地。
description.en: A county-level city under the jurisdiction of Dehong Dai and Jingpo Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, and the seat of the prefecture's government.

description.zh-cn: 白族，曾任保山专区各族各界人民代表会议协商委员会副主席。
description.en: Of Bai ethnicity, served as a vice-chairman of the Consultative Committee of the People's Representative Conference of all Ethnic Groups and Circles in Baoshan Prefecture.

description.zh-cn: 傣族，曾任保山专区各族各界人民代表会议协商委员会副主席。
description.en: Of Dai ethnicity, served as a vice-chairman of the Consultative Committee of the People's Representative Conference of all Ethnic Groups and Circles in Baoshan Prefecture.

description.zh-cn: 吴克华的妻子。
description.en: Spouse of Wu Kehua.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海南省军区

description.zh-cn: 辽沈战役中的一场关键性阻击战，由吴克华指挥的第四纵队负责执行。
description.en: A crucial blocking action during the Liaoshen Campaign, executed by the 4th Column commanded by Wu Kehua.

en: Sweep Away All Cow Demons and Snake Spirits

description.zh-cn: 1966年6月1日《人民日报》发表的社论，首次明确提出“破四旧”的概念。
description.en: An editorial published in the People's Daily on June 1, 1966, which first explicitly proposed the concept of 'Destroying the Four Olds'.

en: Temple and Cemetery of Confucius and the Kong Family Mansion in Qufu

description.zh-cn: 位于山东曲阜的孔子及其家族的纪念性建筑群，在“破四旧”运动中遭到严重损毁。
description.en: A complex of commemorative buildings for Confucius and his family in Qufu, Shandong, which was severely damaged during the 'Destroy the Four Olds' movement.

description.zh-cn: 位于山东省曲阜市的一所师范大学，其红卫兵参与了对“三孔”的破坏。
description.en: A normal university in Qufu, Shandong Province, whose Red Guards participated in the destruction of the 'Three Confucian sites'.

zh-cn: 关于无产阶级文化大革命中保护文物图书的几点意见

description.zh-cn: 1967年5月14日由中共中央下发的文件，要求各地国家权力机关保护文物。
description.en: A document issued by the Central Committee of the CCP on May 14, 1967, requiring local state power organs to protect cultural relics.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝时期的宦官，与江充勾结陷害太子刘据。在江充死后向汉武帝谎报太子谋反，事后被汉武帝下令烧死。
description.en: A eunuch serving Emperor Wu of Han who colluded with Jiang Chong to frame Crown Prince Liu Ju. After Jiang Chong's death, he falsely reported to the emperor that the prince was committing treason. He was later burned to death by the emperor's order.

description.zh-cn: 西汉丞相，卫子夫姐夫。其子公孙敬声被捕后，为赎子罪抓获朱安世，反被朱安世诬告以巫蛊诅咒武帝，导致父子均死于狱中，家族被牵连。
description.en: Chancellor of the Western Han and brother-in-law of Empress Wei Zifu. He was falsely accused of witchcraft by Zhu Anshi, leading to his death in prison and the implication of his family.

description.zh-cn: 公孙贺之子，因贪污被捕，后被朱安世诬告与阳石公主私通并以巫蛊诅咒武帝，死于狱中。
description.en: Son of Gongsun He. He was arrested for corruption and later accused by Zhu Anshi of having an affair with Princess Yangshi and using witchcraft, leading to his death in prison.

description.zh-cn: 汉阳陵游侠，被公孙贺抓捕后，出于报复上书诬告公孙父子，是巫蛊之祸的导火索之一。
description.en: A vigilante from Yangling. After being captured by Gongsun He, he retaliated by falsely accusing Gongsun and his son, becoming one of the triggers for the Witchcraft Delusion.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝之女，在巫蛊之祸中被指控与公孙敬声私通，后被处死。
description.en: Daughter of Emperor Wu of Han. She was accused of having an affair with Gongsun Jingsheng during the Witchcraft Delusion and was executed.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝与卫子夫之女，在巫蛊之祸中受公孙贺案牵连被处死。
description.en: Daughter of Emperor Wu of Han and Empress Wei Zifu. She was implicated in the Gongsun He case during the Witchcraft Delusion and was executed.

description.zh-cn: 西汉大司马大将军，卫子夫之弟。他在巫蛊之祸前去世，他的死使太子刘据失去了重要的政治支持。
description.en: Grand Marshal of the Western Han, and brother of Empress Wei Zifu. His death before the Witchcraft Delusion deprived Crown Prince Liu Ju of crucial political support.

description.zh-cn: 卫青长子，长平侯。在巫蛊之祸中受公孙贺案牵连被处死。
description.en: Eldest son of Wei Qing. He was implicated in the Gongsun He case during the Witchcraft Delusion and was executed.

description.zh-cn: 太子少傅。在刘据无法自辩时，劝说其起兵诛杀奸臣。
description.en: Junior Tutor to the Crown Prince. He advised Liu Ju to take up arms against the treacherous officials when the prince had no other way to defend himself.

description.zh-cn: 护北军使者。在巫蛊之祸中，他接到太子的调兵符节但选择闭门不出，持观望态度，后被汉武帝以“坐观成败，有二心”为由腰斩。
description.en: Supervisor of the Northern Army. During the Witchcraft Delusion, he received the Crown Prince's orders to mobilize troops but refused, adopting a wait-and-see attitude. He was later executed by Emperor Wu for his inaction and perceived disloyalty.

description.zh-cn: 司直。在太子兵败后，放其从城门逃走，后被汉武帝以“坐观成败，有贰心”为由腰斩。
description.en: Director of Justice. After the Crown Prince's defeat, he allowed him to escape through the city gates. He was later executed by Emperor Wu for perceived disloyalty.

description.zh-cn: 西汉贰师将军，其亲家刘屈牦因巫蛊案被杀后，他在前线仓促出击匈奴，兵败投降，后被匈奴所杀。
description.en: A general of the Western Han. After his relative by marriage, Liu Qumao, was executed in a witchcraft case, he hastily attacked the Xiongnu, was defeated, surrendered, and was later killed by the Xiongnu.

description.zh-cn: 太子刘据之孙，刘进之子。巫蛊之祸中唯一的幸存者，尚在襁褓中即下狱，后被霍光等人拥立为帝，是为汉宣帝。
description.en: Grandson of Crown Prince Liu Ju and son of Liu Jin. He was the sole survivor of his family in the Witchcraft Delusion, imprisoned as an infant. He was later enthroned as Emperor Xuan by Huo Guang and others.

description.zh-cn: 皇太子刘据的妾室，在巫蛊之祸中被处死。
description.en: A consort of Crown Prince Liu Ju, executed during the Witchcraft Delusion.

description.zh-cn: 皇太孙刘进之妻，汉宣帝刘病已之母，在巫蛊之祸中被处死。
description.en: Wife of Imperial Grandson Liu Jin and mother of Emperor Xuan (Liu Bingyi). She was executed during the Witchcraft Delusion.

description.zh-cn: 西汉官员。巫蛊之祸时任狱吏，暗中保护抚养了尚在襁褓中的刘病已。后向霍光提议立刘病已为帝。
description.en: A Western Han official. As a prison official during the Witchcraft Delusion, he secretly protected and raised the infant Liu Bingyi. He later proposed to Huo Guang that Liu Bingyi should be made emperor.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国现任国务院总理，李克强的继任者。
description.en: The current Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, Li Keqiang's successor.

zh-cn: 中央应对新型冠状病毒感染疫情工作领导小组
中央应对新型冠状病毒感染肺炎疫情工作领导小组
en: Central Leading Group for Novel Coronavirus Prevention and Control

description.zh-cn: 为应对2019冠状病毒病疫情而设立的中央领导机构，由李克强担任组长。
description.en: A central leading group established to respond to the COVID-19 pandemic, headed by Li Keqiang.

description.zh-cn: 三六零安全科技股份有限公司联合创始人兼董事长。毕业于西安交通大学，曾就职于方正集团，并于2004年任雅虎中国总裁。
description.en: Co-founder and Chairman of Qihoo 360. A graduate of Xi'an Jiaotong University, he previously worked at Founder Group and served as the President of Yahoo! China in 2004.

description.zh-cn: 微软公司在中国的分支机构。曾与奇虎360合作，为中国Windows用户提供安全及升级服务。
description.en: The Chinese branch of Microsoft Corporation. It partnered with Qihoo 360 to provide security and upgrade services for Windows users in China.

description.zh-cn: 一套由美国商务部管理的法规，用于控制特定商品和技术的出口。奇虎360于2020年被列入该条例的实体清单。
description.en: A set of regulations administered by the U.S. Department of Commerce to control the export of certain goods and technologies. Qihoo 360 was added to its Entity List in 2020.

zh-cn: 艺进娱辉科技投资公司

description.zh-cn: 中国信息安全公司，曾与奇虎360因不正当竞争问题发生法律诉讼。
description.en: A Chinese information security company that was involved in a lawsuit with Qihoo 360 over unfair competition.

description.zh-cn: 因奇虎360官网发表的文章对其构成侵权而起诉该公司，并获胜诉。
description.en: Sued Qihoo 360 for infringement due to articles published on its official website and won the case.

description.zh-cn: 金山网络CEO。因其在社交媒体上对奇虎360的抨击言论，被奇虎360以商业信誉诋毁为由起诉。
description.en: CEO of Kingsoft Network. He was sued by Qihoo 360 for commercial defamation over his critical remarks about the company on social media.

description.zh-cn: 三六零安全科技股份有限公司高管，曾任副总裁。
description.en: An executive at Qihoo 360, previously served as Vice President.

description.zh-cn: 丘处机的弟子，随其西行，后成为全真教第六任掌教。
description.en: A disciple of Qiu Chuji who accompanied him on his journey to the west and later became the sixth leader of the Quanzhen School.

en: Seven True Disciples of the North

description.zh-cn: 全真教创始人王重阳的七位主要弟子。
description.en: The seven primary disciples of Wang Chongyang, founder of the Quanzhen School.

description.zh-cn: 全真教的主要支派之一，尊丘处机为祖师。
description.en: One of the main branches of the Quanzhen School, which reveres Qiu Chuji as its patriarch.

description.zh-cn: 金朝第五位皇帝，曾召见丘处机。
description.en: The fifth emperor of the Jin dynasty, who once summoned Qiu Chuji for an audience.

description.zh-cn: 金朝第六位皇帝，曾对丘处机及其道观予以支持。
description.en: The sixth emperor of the Jin dynasty, who supported Qiu Chuji and his Taoist temple.

description.zh-cn: 金朝第七位皇帝，曾召见丘处机。
description.en: The seventh emperor of the Jin dynasty, who once summoned Qiu Chuji for an audience.

description.zh-cn: 金朝第八位皇帝，曾因丘处机协助安抚民众而赐予封号。
description.en: The eighth emperor of the Jin dynasty, who bestowed a title upon Qiu Chuji for his assistance in pacifying the populace.

description.zh-cn: 南宋第四位皇帝，曾派人邀请丘处机但被拒绝。
description.en: The fourth emperor of the Southern Song dynasty, who sent envoys to invite Qiu Chuji but was declined.

description.zh-cn: 成吉思汗派遣的使者，负责邀请并护送丘处机西行。
description.en: An envoy sent by Genghis Khan, responsible for inviting and escorting Qiu Chuji on his journey west.

en: The Travels of the Perfect Man Changchun to the West

description.zh-cn: 由丘处机弟子李志常根据西行见闻所撰写的记述。
description.en: A record written by Qiu Chuji's disciple Li Zhichang based on his experiences during the journey to the west.

description.zh-cn: 元朝第三位皇帝，曾加封丘处机封号。
description.en: The third emperor of the Yuan dynasty, who granted an additional title to Qiu Chuji.

description.zh-cn: 全真教第四任掌教，丘处机的前任。
description.en: The fourth leader of the Quanzhen School, and Qiu Chuji's predecessor.

description.zh-cn: 金朝将领，曾请求丘处机协助安抚民众。
description.en: A general of the Jin dynasty who requested Qiu Chuji's assistance in pacifying the populace.

description.zh-cn: 位于北京的著名道观，原名天长观。1227年成吉思汗赐名长春宫，并由丘处机掌管。丘处机在此羽化。
description.en: A famous Taoist temple in Beijing, originally named Tianchang Guan. In 1227, Genghis Khan renamed it Changchun Palace and placed it under the authority of Qiu Chuji, who passed away there.

description.zh-cn: 音乐制作人，《雪狼湖》的音乐总监和监制。
description.en: A music producer who served as the music director and producer for 'Snow.Wolf.Lake'.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡音乐人，《雪狼湖》的音乐总监和谱曲人。
description.en: A Singaporean musician who served as the music director and composer for 'Snow.Wolf.Lake'.

description.zh-cn: 香港音乐人，《雪狼湖》的音乐总监和指挥。
description.en: A Hong Kong musician who served as the music director and conductor for 'Snow.Wolf.Lake'.

description.zh-cn: 音乐制作人，《雪狼湖》的监制、音乐总监和指挥。
description.en: A music producer who served as the producer, music director, and conductor for 'Snow.Wolf.Lake'.

description.zh-cn: 香港作家，《雪狼湖》音乐剧的原著小说作者。
description.en: A Hong Kong writer, author of the original novel on which the musical 'Snow.Wolf.Lake' is based.

description.zh-cn: 张学友于1997年发行的粤语专辑，收录了音乐剧《雪狼湖》的主要歌曲，在音乐剧公演前推出。
description.en: A Cantonese album by Jacky Cheung released in 1997, featuring the main songs from the musical 'Snow.Wolf.Lake', released before the musical's premiere.

description.zh-cn: 《雪狼湖》音乐剧的主要赞助商。
description.en: The main sponsor of the musical 'Snow.Wolf.Lake'.

description.zh-cn: 香港歌手、演员，在《雪狼湖》香港首演版本中饰演女主角宁静雪。
description.en: A Hong Kong singer and actress, who played the female lead Ning Jingxue in the Hong Kong premiere version of 'Snow.Wolf.Lake'.

description.zh-cn: 香港演员、歌手，在《雪狼湖》新加坡版饰演宁静雪，国语版饰演宁玉凤。
description.en: A Hong Kong actress and singer, who played Ning Jingxue in the Singapore version of 'Snow.Wolf.Lake' and Ning Yufeng in the Mandarin version.

description.zh-cn: 张学友于1996年与香港管弦乐团合作举办的系列音乐会。
description.en: A series of concerts held in 1996 by Jacky Cheung in collaboration with the Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra.

description.zh-cn: 香港的管弦乐团，曾于1996年与张学友合作演出。
description.en: An orchestra in Hong Kong that collaborated with Jacky Cheung for a performance in 1996.

description.zh-cn: 香港电影美术指导及服装设计师，《雪狼湖》的美术总监和导演。
description.en: A Hong Kong film art director and costume designer who served as the art director and director for 'Snow.Wolf.Lake'.

description.zh-cn: 香港音乐人，《雪狼湖》的谱曲人、填词人及改编者。
description.en: A Hong Kong musician who was a composer, lyricist, and adapter for 'Snow.Wolf.Lake'.

description.zh-cn: 香港电影编剧及导演，《雪狼湖》的改编者。
description.en: A Hong Kong film screenwriter and director who was an adapter for 'Snow.Wolf.Lake'.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡歌手、演员，在《雪狼湖》中饰演宁玉凤。
description.en: A Singaporean singer and actress who played Ning Yufeng in 'Snow.Wolf.Lake'.

description.zh-cn: 美国籍台湾歌手、演员，在《雪狼湖》国语版中饰演宁静雪。
description.en: An American-Taiwanese singer and actress who played Ning Jingxue in the Mandarin version of 'Snow.Wolf.Lake'.

description.zh-cn: 中国歌手，在《雪狼湖》国语版中饰演宁静雪。
description.en: A Chinese singer who played Ning Jingxue in the Mandarin version of 'Snow.Wolf.Lake'.

zh-cn: 北京普思投资有限公司

description.zh-cn: 由王思聪创立的私募股权投资公司。
description.en: A private equity investment company founded by Wang Sicong.

description.zh-cn: 由王思聪创办的视频直播网站，已于2019年倒闭。
description.en: A video live streaming website founded by Wang Sicong, which went bankrupt in 2019.

zh-cn: 上海香蕉计划文化发展有限公司
en: Shanghai Banana Plan Cultural Development Co., Ltd.

description.zh-cn: 由王思聪成立的经纪公司。
description.en: A talent agency founded by Wang Sicong.

description.zh-cn: 由王思聪收购并重组的电子竞技俱乐部。
description.en: An e-sports club acquired and restructured by Wang Sicong.

description.zh-cn: 韩国女子音乐组合。
description.en: A South Korean girl group.

description.zh-cn: 中国演员。
description.en: Chinese actor.

description.zh-cn: 中国企业家。
description.en: Chinese entrepreneur.

description.zh-cn: 中国演员。
description.en: Chinese actress.

description.zh-cn: 《青春有你2》练习生。
description.en: A trainee from 'Youth With You 2'.

description.zh-cn: 中国模特、网红、演员。
description.en: Chinese model, internet celebrity, and actress.

description.zh-cn: 中国淘宝店主、网红主播。
description.en: Chinese Taobao store owner and internet celebrity streamer.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国初期对东北地区辽宁、吉林、黑龙江三个省级行政区的合称。
description.en: A collective term for the three provincial-level administrative regions of Liaoning, Jilin, and Heilongjiang in Northeast China during the early Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任立法院院长，其选区为辽北省。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China who served as the President of the Legislative Yuan. His constituency was Liaobei Province.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国东北九省之一。
description.en: One of the Nine Northeastern Provinces of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代提出的“国之四维”，即礼、义、廉、耻四种道德准则，是新生活运动的核心思想。
description.en: The 'Four Cardinal Principles of the State' from ancient China, namely propriety, justice, honesty, and honor. These four moral principles were the core ideology of the New Life Movement.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党官员，曾任新生活运动总会干事。他认为新生活运动旨在将五四新文化运动的“破坏运动”转变为“建设运动”。
description.en: A Kuomintang official who served as a secretary for the New Life Movement General Association. He believed the movement aimed to transform the 'destructive movement' of the May Fourth New Culture Movement into a 'constructive movement'.

description.zh-cn: 日本前首相。他曾在战前表示，新生活运动是中国不可轻视的三件大事之一，反映了该运动在国际上的影响。
description.en: Former Prime Minister of Japan. He stated before the war that the New Life Movement was one of three major affairs in China that should not be underestimated, reflecting the movement's international impact.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国官员，自1936年起担任新生活运动促进总会总干事，负责实际工作，并最终执行了蒋中正暂停该运动的指令。
description.en: An official of the Republic of China who served as the Director-General of the New Life Movement Promotion General Association from 1936, responsible for its practical work. He ultimately carried out Chiang Kai-shek's directive to suspend the movement.

description.zh-cn: 明代御用建筑匠师，天安门的设计者。
description.en: An imperial architect of the Ming dynasty who designed Tiananmen.

description.zh-cn: 明清两代的皇家城池，位于紫禁城之外、内城之内。
description.en: The royal city of the Ming and Qing dynasties, located outside the Forbidden City and inside the Inner City.

description.zh-cn: 明朝第三位皇帝，在其统治期间下令始建天安门（时称承天门）。
description.en: The third emperor of the Ming dynasty, during whose reign the construction of Tiananmen (then known as Chengtianmen) was ordered.

description.zh-cn: 清朝入关后的第一位皇帝，其统治期间下令重建承天门并更名为天安门。
description.en: The first emperor of the Qing dynasty after entering the Shanhai Pass, who ordered the reconstruction of Chengtianmen and its renaming to Tiananmen during his reign.

description.zh-cn: 1966年发生于中国河北省邢台地区的一系列强烈地震，对天安门的建筑结构造成了影响，是其1970年重建的原因之一。
description.en: A series of strong earthquakes that occurred in the Xingtai area of Hebei Province, China, in 1966. They affected the structure of Tiananmen and were one of the reasons for its reconstruction in 1970.

description.zh-cn: 1989年5月23日向天安门毛泽东像泼洒颜料的三名青年之一。
description.en: One of the three young men who threw paint at the portrait of Mao Zedong on Tiananmen on May 23, 1989.

description.zh-cn: 1989年5月23日向天安门毛泽东像泼洒颜料的三名青年之一。
description.en: One of the three young men who threw paint at the portrait of Mao Zedong on Tiananmen on May 23, 1989.

description.zh-cn: 1989年5月23日向天安门毛泽东像泼洒颜料的三名青年之一。
description.en: One of the three young men who threw paint at the portrait of Mao Zedong on Tiananmen on May 23, 1989.

description.zh-cn: 2014年3月6日向天安门毛泽东像投掷墨水瓶的男子。
description.en: A man who threw an ink bottle at the portrait of Mao Zedong on Tiananmen on March 6, 2014.

zh-cn: 天安门金水桥恐怖袭击案

description.zh-cn: 2013年10月28日，恐怖分子驾车冲撞天安门金水桥护栏并起火的事件。
description.en: An incident on October 28, 2013, where terrorists drove a vehicle into the guardrails of the Jinshui Bridge at Tiananmen, causing it to catch fire.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国发行的第二套人民币，其一元券的背面图案为天安门。
description.en: The second series of currency issued by the People's Republic of China. The reverse of its one-yuan note features Tiananmen.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任河南省省长、中华人民共和国邮电部部长。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as the Governor of Henan Province and the Minister of Posts and Telecommunications of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国山西省运城市下辖的一个县。
description.en: A county under the administration of Yuncheng, Shanxi, China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国河南省在1968年之前的省级人民政府。
description.en: The provincial people's government of Henan Province, People's Republic of China, before January 1968.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在江汉地区设立的军区。
description.en: A military region established by the People's Liberation Army in the Jianghan area.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 汉光武帝刘秀统治时期，东汉政治改革、经济发展、社会平稳的局面。
description.en: A period during the reign of Emperor Guangwu (Liu Xiu) characterized by political reforms, economic development, and social stability in the Eastern Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 新朝末年的一支农民起义军，在刘秀推翻新莽政权的过程中提供了协助。
description.en: A peasant rebel army during the late Xin dynasty that assisted Liu Xiu in overthrowing the Xin regime.

description.zh-cn: 汉明帝和汉章帝统治时期的盛世，东汉国力强盛，社会稳定，人口滋殖。
description.en: A golden age during the reigns of Emperor Ming and Emperor Zhang, characterized by national strength, social stability, and population growth in the Eastern Han.

description.zh-cn: 东汉第三位皇帝，汉明帝之子。他开创了东汉大力任用外戚的先河。
description.en: The third emperor of the Eastern Han dynasty, son of Emperor Ming. He set the precedent for the significant employment of consort kin in the Eastern Han government.

description.zh-cn: 东汉中后期与宦官轮流掌权的政治势力，通常指皇帝的母族或妻族。
description.en: A political faction that took turns holding power with the eunuchs during the middle and late Eastern Han dynasty, typically referring to the emperor's maternal or marital relatives.

description.zh-cn: 东汉第四位皇帝，在位期间东汉国力达到极盛，史称“永元之隆”。他重用宦官以制衡外戚势力。
description.en: The fourth emperor of the Eastern Han dynasty. During his reign, the dynasty's power reached its zenith, a period known as the 'Reign of Yongyuan'. He heavily relied on eunuchs to counterbalance the power of the consort clans.

description.zh-cn: 东汉外戚，章德窦皇后的兄长。在窦太后执政期间，窦氏戚族曾一度掌权。
description.en: A member of an Eastern Han consort clan, the elder brother of Empress Dowager Dou. During the regency of Empress Dowager Dou, the Dou clan briefly held power.

description.zh-cn: 汉灵帝的皇后，汉少帝刘辩的生母，大将军何进的妹妹。后被董卓所杀。
description.en: The empress of Emperor Ling, mother of Emperor Shao (Liu Bian), and sister of Grand Marshal He Jin. She was later killed by Dong Zhuo.

description.zh-cn: 东汉外戚，顺烈皇后梁妠的兄弟。在汉顺帝死后，他掌控朝政近二十年，期间肆意废立皇帝，后被汉桓帝联合宦官诛灭。
description.en: A member of an Eastern Han consort clan, brother of Empress Liang Na. After the death of Emperor Shun, he controlled the court for nearly twenty years, deposing and installing emperors at will, before being eliminated by Emperor Huan in collusion with eunuchs.

description.zh-cn: 东汉皇帝，由外戚梁冀拥立，因表露出对梁冀的不满而被其毒死。
description.en: An Eastern Han emperor installed by the consort clan relative Liang Ji. He was poisoned by Liang Ji after expressing dissatisfaction with him.

description.zh-cn: 东汉皇帝，由梁冀拥立。后联合宦官诛灭梁氏外戚势力，但也导致了宦官权力的扩张。
description.en: An Eastern Han emperor installed by Liang Ji. He later allied with eunuchs to eliminate the Liang consort clan, but this also led to the expansion of eunuch power.

description.zh-cn: 由匈奴分裂出的一支部落，后归附东汉，长期与汉族杂居。
description.en: A tribal confederation that split from the Xiongnu. They later submitted to the Eastern Han and lived alongside the Han people for a long period.

description.zh-cn: 由匈奴分裂出的一支部落，与东汉为敌，后被东汉击败，向西迁移。
description.en: A tribal confederation that split from the Xiongnu. They were hostile to the Eastern Han, were eventually defeated, and migrated westward.

description.zh-cn: 东汉第二位皇帝，光武帝刘秀之子。他统治时期与汉章帝时期合称为“明章之治”，并派人去西域求取佛法。
description.en: The second emperor of the Eastern Han dynasty, son of Emperor Guangwu (Liu Xiu). His reign, together with that of Emperor Zhang, is known as the 'Rule of Ming and Zhang'. He also dispatched envoys to the Western Regions to seek Buddhist teachings.

description.zh-cn: 中国第一座官办佛教寺院，由汉明帝下令修建，被认为是中国佛教的发源地。
description.en: The first official Buddhist temple in China, built by order of Emperor Ming. It is considered the cradle of Chinese Buddhism.

description.zh-cn: 原臣属于匈奴的东胡部落，东汉末年曾割据辽东、辽西等地，后被曹操击败。
description.en: An Eastern Hu tribe originally subordinate to the Xiongnu. They established a regional power base in Liaodong and Liaoxi during the late Eastern Han but were later defeated by Cao Cao.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年乌桓首领，曾收留袁绍之子袁尚，后在白狼山之战中被曹操击败并斩杀。
description.en: A Wuhuan chieftain in the late Eastern Han dynasty. He gave refuge to Yuan Shao's son Yuan Shang, but was later defeated and executed by Cao Cao at the Battle of White Wolf Mountain.

description.zh-cn: 东汉时期的宦官，改进了造纸术，对中国乃至世界文化的传播做出了巨大贡献。
description.en: A eunuch in the Eastern Han dynasty who improved the papermaking process, making a huge contribution to the dissemination of culture in China and the world.

description.zh-cn: 高嘉瑜前男友，因对高嘉瑜施暴而引发社会关注。
description.en: Kao Chia-yu's ex-boyfriend, who gained public attention for assaulting her.

description.zh-cn: 台湾基隆市的一个市辖区，是高嘉瑜的出生地。
description.en: A district of Keelung City, Taiwan, and the birthplace of Kao Chia-yu.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。曾任中共中央宣传部副部长、国家互联网信息办公室主任、国务院新闻办公室主任、国家广播电视总局局长，现任中共贵州省委书记、贵州省人大常委会主任。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China. He has served as Deputy Head of the Publicity Department of the CCP Central Committee, Director of the Cyberspace Administration of China, Director of the State Council Information Office, and Director of the National Radio and Television Administration. He is the current CCP Committee Secretary of Guizhou and Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Guizhou Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，徐麟的继任国家广播电视总局局长。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, successor of Xu Lin as Director of the National Radio and Television Administration.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，时任中共贵州省委副书记、省长。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, serving as Deputy Secretary of the CCP Guizhou Provincial Committee and Governor of Guizhou.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年官员，官至太尉，是崔州平和崔钧的父亲。
description.en: An official in the late Eastern Han dynasty who served as Grand Commandant. He was the father of Cui Zhouping and Cui Jun.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年官员，曾任西河郡太守，是崔州平的哥哥。
description.en: An official in the late Eastern Han dynasty who served as the Grand Administrator of Xihe Commandery. He was the older brother of Cui Zhouping.

description.zh-cn: 中国中古时代的著名士族，以博陵郡为郡望。
description.en: A prominent aristocratic clan in medieval China, originating from Boling Commandery.

description.zh-cn: 东汉时期的一个行政区划。
description.en: An administrative division during the Eastern Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 崔州平的籍贯所在地，位于博陵郡，今属河北省。
description.en: Cui Zhouping's ancestral home, located in Boling Commandery, now part of Hebei Province.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代的郡名，崔钧曾在此担任太守。
description.en: A commandery in ancient China where Cui Jun once served as Grand Administrator.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任常州市市长、中共铜陵市委书记，现任中共黄山市委书记。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who has served as Mayor of Changzhou, Secretary of the CPC Tongling Municipal Committee, and is currently the Secretary of the CPC Huangshan Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年至三国时期谋士。曾为李傕的谋士，献策攻取长安。
description.en: An advisor from the late Eastern Han dynasty to the Three Kingdoms period. He served as an advisor to Li Jue and devised the strategy to capture Chang'an.

description.zh-cn: 董卓死后，其部将李傕、郭汜等人反攻长安，掌控朝廷并造成关中地区动乱的时期。
description.en: The period of turmoil in the Guanzhong region after Dong Zhuo's death, when his generals Li Jue and Guo Si counter-attacked Chang'an, seized control of the imperial court.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年董卓的部将，与李傕、郭汜一同攻占长安，后在攻打穰城时战死。
description.en: A general under the warlord Dong Zhuo during the late Eastern Han dynasty. He participated in the capture of Chang'an with Li Jue and Guo Si. He was later killed in action while attacking Rangcheng.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年董卓的部将，与李傕等人一同专政，后因李傕猜忌而被其设计杀害。
description.en: A general under the warlord Dong Zhuo during the late Eastern Han dynasty. He ruled jointly with Li Jue and others, but was later killed in a plot by Li Jue due to suspicion.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年名将，曾与李傕交战并被其击败。
description.en: A famous general of the late Eastern Han dynasty who fought against and was defeated by Li Jue.

description.zh-cn: 董卓旧部，董卓死后受王允派遣与徐荣一同迎击李傕，后率部投降。
description.en: A former subordinate of Dong Zhuo. After Dong Zhuo's death, he was dispatched by Wang Yun along with Xu Rong to intercept Li Jue, but later surrendered with his troops.

description.zh-cn: 董卓旧部，与李傕等人会合围攻长安，后与樊稠一同被李傕杀害。
description.en: A former subordinate of Dong Zhuo. He joined Li Jue and others in besieging Chang'an and was later killed by Li Jue along with Fan Chou.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年西凉军阀，曾联合韩遂攻打李傕，但被击败。
description.en: A warlord from Xiliang during the late Eastern Han dynasty. He once allied with Han Sui to attack Li Jue, but was defeated.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年西凉军阀，曾联合马腾攻打李傕，但被击败。
description.en: A warlord from Xiliang during the late Eastern Han dynasty. He once allied with Ma Teng to attack Li Jue, but was defeated.

description.zh-cn: 曹操麾下官员，任谒者仆射，曾奉命率领关中诸将讨伐李傕。
description.en: An official under Cao Cao, serving as Ye Zhe Pu She. He was ordered to lead the generals of Guanzhong to campaign against Li Jue.

description.zh-cn: 关中将领，参与讨伐李傕，并最终将其击败斩杀。
description.en: A general from the Guanzhong region who participated in the campaign against Li Jue and ultimately defeated and killed him.

description.zh-cn: 关中将领，参与讨伐李傕，并最终将其击败斩杀。
description.en: A general from the Guanzhong region who participated in the campaign against Li Jue and ultimately defeated and killed him.

description.zh-cn: 关中将领，参与讨伐李傕。贾诩曾短暂投奔于他。
description.en: A general from the Guanzhong region who participated in the campaign against Li Jue. Jia Xu briefly took refuge with him.

description.zh-cn: 郭汜的部将，后将其杀害。
description.en: A subordinate general of Guo Si, whom he later assassinated.

description.zh-cn: 东汉时期的一个郡，是李傕的出生地。
description.en: A commandery during the Eastern Han dynasty, and the birthplace of Li Jue.

description.zh-cn: 李傕的儿子。
description.en: Son of Li Jue.

description.zh-cn: 李傕的侄子。
description.en: Nephew of Li Jue.

description.zh-cn: 李傕的侄子，曾劫持汉献帝至李傕营中。
description.en: Nephew of Li Jue, who once abducted Emperor Xian to Li Jue's camp.

description.zh-cn: 元末明初小说家，传说为罗贯中的老师，有说法认为他与罗贯中合著了《三国演义》。
description.en: A novelist from the late Yuan and early Ming dynasties, believed to be Luo Guanzhong's teacher. Some theories suggest he co-authored 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' with Luo.

description.zh-cn: 由西晋陈寿所著的纪传体国别史，是记载中国三国时期历史的官修正史，也是《三国演义》的主要史料来源之一。
description.en: An official historical text on the Three Kingdoms period of China, written by Chen Shou of the Western Jin dynasty. It is one of the primary sources for 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms'.

description.zh-cn: 元代至治年间刊行的民间话本，是《三国演义》的重要创作来源之一。
description.en: A folk storyteller's script published during the Zhizhi era of the Yuan dynasty, serving as an important source for 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms'.

description.zh-cn: 清朝学者，与其父毛纶一同评改《三国演义》，形成今日通行的120回“毛本”。
description.en: A Qing dynasty scholar who, along with his father Mao Lun, edited and revised 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', creating the popular 120-chapter version known as the 'Mao edition'.

description.zh-cn: 清朝学者，与其子毛宗岗一同评改《三国演义》。
description.en: A Qing dynasty scholar who, along with his son Mao Zonggang, edited and revised 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms'.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，第十三届全国人民代表大会陕西省代表。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China and a deputy from Shaanxi Province to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 非洲国家。在1960年接受了中国的粮食援助。
description.en: An African country. It received food aid from China in 1960.

description.zh-cn: 古巴革命领导人之一。1960年访华期间，中国向古巴提供了6000万美元贷款。
description.en: One of the leaders of the Cuban Revolution. During his visit to China in 1960, China provided Cuba with a 60 million USD loan.

description.zh-cn: 黄立众，原北京大学学生，因指出农村饿死人情况被开除。在大饥荒期间，他于1960年在安徽无为县组织了“中国劳动党”。该党旨在反抗造成大饥荒的政策，并计划发动暴动，后于1961年被镇压。
description.en: Huang Lizhong, a former student of Peking University, was expelled for pointing out starvation deaths in rural areas. During the Great Famine, he organized the 'China Labor Party' in his hometown of Wuwei County, Anhui in 1960. The party aimed to resist the policies causing the famine and planned an uprising, which was later suppressed in 1961.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，刘长龙的继任长春市市长。
description.en: Chinese politician, Liu Changlong's successor as Mayor of Changchun.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会机关委员会

location.zh-cn: 北京市西城区太平桥大街23号
location.en: No. 23, Taipingqiao Street, Xicheng District, Beijing

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会机关的中国共产党基层组织，行政级别为正司局级。
description.en: The primary-level organization of the Communist Party of China within the organs of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, with a departmental level administrative ranking.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物。
description.en: Chinese politician.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会机关党组

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会机关中设立的领导核心。
description.en: The leading core group of the Communist Party of China established within the organs of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物。
description.en: Chinese politician.

zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会办公厅秘书局
中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会经济委员会办公室

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会的机关报。
description.en: The official newspaper of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物。
description.en: Chinese politician.

zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会办公厅研究室
全国政协办公厅研究室

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物。
description.en: Chinese politician.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物。
description.en: Chinese politician.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海军军医大学第一附属医院（上海长海医院）现任政治委员。
description.en: Current Political Commissar of the First Affiliated Hospital of the Naval Medical University (Shanghai Changhai Hospital).

description.zh-cn: 中国内地对医院实行“三级六等”的划分等级中的最高等级。
description.en: The highest level in the 'three levels and six grades' classification system for hospitals in mainland China.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军曾在中国东部地区设立的大军区。
description.en: A former military region of the People's Liberation Army located in eastern China.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中国人民解放军第二军医大学第一附属医院（上海长海医院）院长。
description.en: Former Dean of the First Affiliated Hospital of the Second Military Medical University (Shanghai Changhai Hospital).

description.zh-cn: 曾任中国人民解放军第二军医大学第一附属医院（上海长海医院）院长。
description.en: Former Dean of the First Affiliated Hospital of the Second Military Medical University (Shanghai Changhai Hospital).

description.zh-cn: 大上海计划中的一部分，其旧址现为上海长海医院的影像楼。
description.en: Part of the Greater Shanghai Plan, its former site is now the imaging building of Shanghai Changhai Hospital.

description.zh-cn: 1930年代中华民国上海市政府实施的一项大型城市规划。
description.en: A large-scale urban plan implemented by the Shanghai Municipal Government of the Republic of China in the 1930s.

description.zh-cn: 大上海计划中的一部分，其旧址现为上海长海医院内的中国人民解放军第二军医大学校史陈列馆。
description.en: Part of the Greater Shanghai Plan, its former site is now the historical exhibition hall of the Second Military Medical University within Shanghai Changhai Hospital.

en: Embassy of the United States, Tehran

description.zh-cn: 美国在伊朗的代表机构，在1979年的人质危机中被占领。
description.en: The diplomatic mission of the United States in Iran, which was seized during the 1979 hostage crisis.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗政治家，伊朗人质危机爆发时任伊朗总理。
description.en: Iranian politician who was the Prime Minister of Iran at the time of the hostage crisis.

description.zh-cn: 由迈赫迪·巴扎尔甘领导的伊朗革命后首个政府，因人质危机而集体辞职。
description.en: The first government of Iran after the revolution, led by Mehdi Bazargan, which resigned en masse due to the hostage crisis.

description.zh-cn: 美国军方为营救在伊朗被扣押的人质而发起的一次失败的军事行动。
description.en: A failed United States Armed Forces operation to rescue the hostages held in Iran.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治家，在卡特政府担任国务卿，因反对鹰爪行动而辞职。
description.en: American politician who served as Secretary of State in the Carter administration and resigned in protest of Operation Eagle Claw.

description.zh-cn: 一部2012年的美国电影，改编自伊朗人质危机期间六名美国外交官在加拿大的帮助下逃离德黑兰的真实事件。
description.en: A 2012 American film based on the true story of six American diplomats who escaped from Tehran with Canadian help during the Iran hostage crisis.

zh-cn: 马哈茂德·艾哈迈迪-内贾德
马哈茂德·艾哈迈迪内贾德

description.zh-cn: 伊朗第六任总统，曾被部分人质指认参与了1979年的人质劫持行动。
description.en: The sixth president of Iran, who was accused by some former hostages of being involved in the 1979 hostage-taking.

description.zh-cn: 中国历史上继商朝之后的朝代，《周易》据信成书于此期间。
description.en: The dynasty in Chinese history that followed the Shang dynasty, during which the Book of Changes is believed to have been written.

description.zh-cn: 传说中的“三易”之一，以艮卦为首，现已失传。
description.en: One of the legendary 'Three Changes' (San Yi), which started with the Gen hexagram and is now lost.

description.zh-cn: 传说中的“三易”之一，以坤卦为首，长期失传，但出土的王家台秦简可能与其有关。
description.en: One of the legendary 'Three Changes' (San Yi), which started with the Kun hexagram. It was long lost, but the excavated Qin slips from Wangjiatai may be related to it.

description.zh-cn: 《连山》、《归藏》和《周易》的合称。
description.en: The collective name for Lianshan, Guicang, and Zhouyi (I Ching).

description.zh-cn: 西周的奠基者，传统上认为他将八卦推演为六十四卦，并为《周易》作卦辞。
description.en: The founder of the Western Zhou dynasty, traditionally credited with expanding the eight trigrams to sixty-four hexagrams and writing the hexagram judgments for the I Ching.

description.zh-cn: 对《周易》的解释性著作，共有十篇，传统上认为由孔子及其后学所作，旨在从哲学和道德层面解读《周易》。
description.en: An interpretive work on the I Ching, consisting of ten sections. It is traditionally attributed to Confucius and his followers and aims to interpret the I Ching from philosophical and moral perspectives.

description.zh-cn: 三国时期曹魏的玄学家，为《周易》作注，是义理派易学的代表人物。
description.en: A metaphysician of the Cao Wei state during the Three Kingdoms period who wrote a commentary on the I Ching and is a representative figure of the Yili (Meaning and Principle) school of I Ching studies.

description.zh-cn: 东晋学者，与王弼共同为《周易》作注。
description.en: A scholar of the Eastern Jin dynasty who, along with Wang Bi, wrote commentaries on the I Ching.

description.zh-cn: 中国上古神话中的人类始祖，传说中他创造了八卦。
description.en: A legendary ancestor of humanity in ancient Chinese mythology, credited with the creation of the eight trigrams.

description.zh-cn: 由三个爻组成的八种符号，是《易经》的基本单位，传说由伏羲所创。
description.en: Eight symbols composed of three yao (lines), which are the basic units of the I Ching, traditionally created by Fu Xi.

description.zh-cn: 中国传说中夏朝的建立者，传说他将八卦扩充为六十四卦。
description.en: The legendary founder of the Xia dynasty in China, who is said to have expanded the eight trigrams into sixty-four hexagrams.

description.zh-cn: 由两个八卦重叠而成的六十四种符号组合，构成了《周易》的主体内容。
description.en: The sixty-four symbolic combinations formed by stacking two eight trigrams, which constitute the main content of the I Ching.

description.zh-cn: 西周初年的政治家，周文王之子，传统上认为他为《周易》的每一爻撰写了解释，即“爻辞”。
description.en: A statesman in the early Western Zhou dynasty, son of King Wen of Zhou. He is traditionally credited with writing the explanations for each line of the I Ching, known as the 'line statements' (yaoci).

description.zh-cn: 北宋时期的哲学家、易学家，象数派代表人物，其伏羲先天六十四卦图对后世及西方影响深远。
description.en: A philosopher and I Ching scholar of the Northern Song dynasty, a representative figure of the Xiangshu (Image-Number) school. His 'Fuxi's Former Heaven Sixty-Four Hexagrams Chart' had a profound influence on later generations and the West.

zh-cn: 戈特弗里德·威廉·莱布尼茨

description.zh-cn: 德国哲学家、数学家，二进制的发明者。他从传教士白晋处了解到《易经》的六十四卦，并认为其与二进制相符。
description.en: A German philosopher and mathematician, and the inventor of the binary system. He learned about the sixty-four hexagrams of the I Ching from the missionary Joachim Bouvet and believed they corresponded to his binary system.

description.zh-cn: 法国耶稣会传教士，曾向德国哲学家莱布尼茨介绍《易经》及邵雍的卦图。
description.en: A French Jesuit missionary who introduced the I Ching and Shao Yong's hexagram charts to the German philosopher Leibniz.

description.zh-cn: 由德国数学家莱布尼茨发明的记数系统，仅使用0和1两个符号。莱布尼茨发现其与《易经》的阴阳爻有对应关系。
description.en: A number system invented by the German mathematician Leibniz that uses only two symbols, 0 and 1. Leibniz discovered its correspondence with the yin and yang lines of the I Ching.

description.zh-cn: 瑞士心理学家，认为《易经》作为一种预测未来的方法是极其有效的。
description.en: A Swiss psychologist who considered the I Ching to be an extremely effective method for predicting the future.

description.zh-cn: 西汉易学家，象数派代表人物，著有《京氏易传》。
description.en: An I Ching scholar of the Western Han dynasty and a representative of the Xiangshu school, author of the 'Jing shi Yizhuan'.

description.zh-cn: 中国哲学中的概念，指宇宙最原始的秩序状态，是阴阳两仪的来源。
description.en: A concept in Chinese philosophy referring to the primordial state of the universe, the source of the two polarities (yin and yang).

description.zh-cn: 指阴和阳两种对立的势力或状态，由太极产生。
description.en: Refers to the two opposing forces or states of yin and yang, which are generated from Taiji.

description.zh-cn: 由两仪衍生出的四种现象或图像，分别是太阳、少阳、少阴、太阴。
description.en: The four phenomena or images derived from the Liangyi, namely Greater Yang, Lesser Yang, Lesser Yin, and Greater Yin.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军空军中将。曾任空军航空兵第42师师长、成都军区空军副参谋长、空军武器试验基地司令员、东部战区副司令员，现任联勤保障部队司令员。他也是中国共产党第二十届中央委员会候补委员。
description.en: A lieutenant general in the People's Liberation Army Air Force. He has served as commander of the 42nd Air Division, deputy chief of staff of the Chengdu Military Region Air Force, commander of the PLA Air Force Weapon Test Base, deputy commander of the Eastern Theater Command, and is currently the commander of the Joint Logistics Support Force. He is also an alternate member of the 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 湖南省下辖的地级市，王抗平的出生地。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Hunan Province, the birthplace of Wang Kangping.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军成都军区空军

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军曾设的大军区空军之一，王抗平曾在此担任副参谋长。
description.en: One of the former military region air forces of the People's Liberation Army, where Wang Kangping served as deputy chief of staff.

description.zh-cn: 日本政治家，时任日本外务大臣，代表日方签署了《中日联合声明》。
description.en: Japanese politician, then Minister for Foreign Affairs of Japan, who signed the Sino-Japanese Joint Communiqué on behalf of the Japanese side.

description.zh-cn: 日本政治家，时任内阁官房长官，陪同田中角荣访华。
description.en: Japanese politician, then Chief Cabinet Secretary, who accompanied Kakuei Tanaka on his visit to China.

description.zh-cn: 日本政治家，在1972年自民党总裁选举中支持田中角荣实现中日邦交正常化的承诺。
description.en: Japanese politician who supported Kakuei Tanaka's commitment to normalize Japan-China diplomatic relations in the 1972 LDP presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国与日本在1952年签订的和平条约，在《中日联合声明》签署后，被日本方面宣布失效。
description.en: A peace treaty signed between the Republic of China and Japan in 1952, which was declared null and void by the Japanese side after the signing of the Sino-Japanese Joint Communiqué.

en: Treaty of Peace and Friendship between Japan and China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国与日本于1978年签订的条约，从法律上确认了《中日联合声明》的各项原则。
description.en: A treaty signed between the People's Republic of China and Japan in 1978, which legally confirmed the principles of the Sino-Japanese Joint Communiqué.

description.zh-cn: 中原大战期间，由阎锡山、冯玉祥、李宗仁等反蒋势力在北平成立的政府。
description.en: A government established in Beiping by anti-Chiang forces such as Yan Xishan, Feng Yuxiang, and Li Zongren during the Central Plains War.

description.zh-cn: 反蒋联军将领，任第八方面军指挥官，在许昌前线被国民政府飞机炸死。
description.en: An anti-Chiang coalition general, commander of the 8th Front Army, who was killed by Nationalist government aircraft on the Xuchang front.

description.zh-cn: 西北军第二方面军骑兵集团司令，曾率部奇袭中央军后方的归德机场，险些俘获蒋中正。
description.en: Commander of the Cavalry Group of the Northwest Army's 2nd Front Army, who led a surprise raid on the Guider airfield behind the Central Army's lines and nearly captured Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: 五四运动当天，部分激进学生在北京游行示威期间，放火焚烧了亲日派官员曹汝霖的住宅。这是五四运动中的标志性暴力事件。
description.en: On the day of the May Fourth Movement, some radical students, during a demonstration in Beijing, set fire to the residence of pro-Japanese official Cao Rulin. This was a landmark violent event within the May Fourth Movement.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任江苏省人民政府副省长，现任中共江苏省委常委、省委政法委书记。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, former Vice Governor of Jiangsu Province, currently a member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Jiangsu Provincial Committee and Secretary of the Provincial Political and Legal Affairs Commission.

en: Tongzhou Branch of Beijing Municipal Public Security Bureau
zh-cn: 北京市公安局通州分局

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 该事件导致南明锦衣卫指挥使马吉翔等人被杀，标志着锦衣卫历史的正式结束。
description.en: This event led to the killing of Ma Jixiang, the commander of the Southern Ming Jinyiwei, and others, marking the official end of the Jinyiwei's history.

description.zh-cn: 明朝初期的军事机构，是锦衣卫的前身之一。
description.en: A military institution in the early Ming Dynasty, one of the predecessors of the Jinyiwei.

description.zh-cn: 明朝历代皇帝的统称，是锦衣卫的直接领导者。
description.en: A collective term for the emperors of the Ming Dynasty, who were the direct leaders of the Jinyiwei.

description.zh-cn: 锦衣卫首任指挥使。
description.en: The first commander of the Jinyiwei.

description.zh-cn: 明朝末任锦衣卫掌卫事。
description.en: The last commander in charge of the Jinyiwei in the Ming Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 指由皇帝直接掌管、不经正常司法程序的特殊监狱及相关案件，常由锦衣卫北镇抚司执行。
description.en: Refers to special prisons and related cases directly managed by the emperor, bypassing normal judicial procedures, often handled by the Jinyiwei's Northern Pacification Office.

description.zh-cn: 明朝的刑部、都察院与大理寺合称，是国家的最高司法机关。
description.en: The collective name for the Ministry of Justice, the Censorate, and the Grand Court of Revision in the Ming Dynasty, which were the highest judicial bodies of the state.

description.zh-cn: 明成祖时期的锦衣卫掌卫事。
description.en: Commander in charge of the Jinyiwei during the reign of the Yongle Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 南明永历帝时期的锦衣卫指挥使，在咒水之难中被杀。
description.en: The commander of the Jinyiwei during the reign of the Yongli Emperor of the Southern Ming, killed in the Cursed Water Incident.

description.zh-cn: 明末首辅，其案件为锦衣卫办理的著名诏狱之一。
description.en: The Grand Secretary at the end of the Ming Dynasty, whose case was one of the famous imperial prison cases handled by the Jinyiwei.

description.zh-cn: 明朝内廷管理宦官与宫内事务的“十二监”中，首席衙门。
description.en: The chief agency among the 'Twelve Directorates' that managed eunuchs and palace affairs in the inner court of the Ming Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡的主要反对党之一。
description.en: One of the main opposition parties in Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚的一个州，邓亮洪曾短暂逗留于此。
description.en: A state in Malaysia where Tang Liang Hong briefly stayed.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚柔佛州的首府。
description.en: The capital of the Malaysian state of Johor.

description.zh-cn: 奥匈帝国皇太子鲁道夫的情妇，在梅耶林惨案中与鲁道夫一同自杀。
description.en: The mistress of Crown Prince Rudolf of Austria-Hungary, who died with him in a suicide pact during the Mayerling incident.

description.zh-cn: 奥地利皇后，鲁道夫皇太子的母亲。
description.en: Empress of Austria and mother of Crown Prince Rudolf.

zh-cn: 比利时的史蒂芬妮公主

description.zh-cn: 比利时国王利奥波德二世的女儿，鲁道夫皇太子的妻子。
description.en: Daughter of King Leopold II of Belgium and wife of Crown Prince Rudolf.

description.zh-cn: 罗马天主教会教宗，鲁道夫曾向其请求解除婚姻关系，但他将此事告知了皇帝弗朗茨·约瑟夫一世。
description.en: Head of the Catholic Church to whom Rudolf appealed for an annulment of his marriage, but who instead informed Emperor Franz Joseph I.

description.zh-cn: 奥地利阿兰市的一个村庄，梅耶林惨案的发生地。
description.en: A village in the municipality of Alland, Austria, and the site of the Mayerling incident.

en: National People's Congress decision on Hong Kong national security legislation
Decision of the National People's Congress on Establishing and Improving the Legal System and Enforcement Mechanisms for the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to Safeguard National Security
zh-cn: 全国人民代表大会关于建立健全香港特别行政区维护国家安全的法律制度和执行机制的决定

description.zh-cn: 由第十三届全国人民代表大会第三次会议通过的决定，授权全国人大常委会制定《香港国安法》。
description.en: A decision passed by the Third Session of the 13th National People's Congress, authorizing the NPCSC to formulate the Hong Kong National Security Law.

description.zh-cn: 香港一份已停刊的报纸，其多名高层因《港区国安法》被捕、资产被冻结后，于2021年6月24日停止运作。
description.en: A defunct Hong Kong newspaper that ceased operations on June 24, 2021, after several of its senior executives were arrested and its assets were frozen under the National Security Law.

description.zh-cn: 香港一个已停止运作的民主派网络媒体。在多名高层被警方国安处以“串谋发布煽动刊物罪”拘捕后，于2021年12月29日停止运作。
description.en: A defunct pro-democracy online media outlet in Hong Kong. It ceased operations on December 29, 2021, after several of its senior executives were arrested by the National Security Department for 'conspiracy to publish seditious materials'.

en: Robert Reed, Baron Reed of Allermuir

description.zh-cn: 英国最高法院院长，因《港区国安法》的实施而辞任香港终审法院非常任法官。
description.en: President of the Supreme Court of the United Kingdom who resigned as a non-permanent judge of the Hong Kong Court of Final Appeal due to the implementation of the National Security Law.

en: Hong Kong Court of Final Appeal

description.zh-cn: 香港特别行政区的最终上诉法院。
description.en: The final appellate court of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

description.zh-cn: 英国最高法院副院长，因《港区国安法》的实施而辞任香港终审法院非常任法官。
description.en: Deputy President of the Supreme Court of the United Kingdom who resigned as a non-permanent judge of the Hong Kong Court of Final Appeal due to the implementation of the National Security Law.

description.zh-cn: 前英国最高法院法官，于2024年6月辞任香港终审法院非常任法官，并公开批评《港区国安法》对香港法治构成威胁。
description.en: A former Justice of the Supreme Court of the United Kingdom who resigned as a non-permanent judge of the Hong Kong Court of Final Appeal in June 2024 and publicly criticized the National Security Law for posing a threat to the rule of law in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 香港特别行政区政府的法律政策及检控部门，曾接收台方的司法互助请求。
description.en: The legal policy and prosecution department of the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, which has received judicial assistance requests from Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 一首在2019年反对逃犯条例修订草案运动中被广泛传唱的歌曲，后被香港政府申请禁制令。
description.en: A song widely sung during the 2019 anti-extradition bill movement, which later became the subject of an injunction application by the Hong Kong government.

description.zh-cn: 首位被控违反《港区国安法》并被定罪的人士。
description.en: The first person to be charged and convicted under the Hong Kong National Security Law.

description.zh-cn: 姚依林与周彬的二女儿，王岐山之妻。
description.en: The second daughter of Yao Yilin and Zhou Bin, wife of Wang Qishan.

description.zh-cn: 姚依林与周彬的三女儿。
description.en: The third daughter of Yao Yilin and Zhou Bin.

description.zh-cn: 姚依林的三女婿，姚明端之夫。
description.en: Yao Yilin's third son-in-law, husband of Yao Mingduan.

description.zh-cn: 民主进步党内的派系之一，段宜康曾任总召。
description.en: A faction within the Democratic Progressive Party; Duan Yi-kang formerly served as its convener.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾任《民进报》总编辑，段宜康曾为其助理。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician and former editor-in-chief of the DPP News, for whom Duan Yi-kang served as an assistant.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，段宜康曾担任其助理。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician for whom Duan Yi-kang served as an assistant.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾任澎湖县长，段宜康曾担任其特别助理。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician and former Magistrate of Penghu County, for whom Duan Yi-kang served as a special assistant.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，因被段宜康指控涉及中华民国曲棍球协会弊案而引发“吞曲棍球”争议，并对段宜康提起诉讼。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who was accused by Duan Yi-kang of being involved in a corruption case related to the Chinese Taipei Hockey Association, leading to the "swallowing hockey pucks" controversy and a lawsuit against Duan.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，因段宜康指控其与林沧敏共用金主而对其提起诉讼，该案最终段宜康被判无罪。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who sued Duan Yi-kang after he accused her and Lin Tsang-min of sharing the same financial backer. Duan was ultimately acquitted in the case.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，在2014年彰化县长选举期间，被段宜康指控为林沧敏与黄文玲的共同金主。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who was accused by Duan Yi-kang of being the common financial backer for both Lin Tsang-min and Huang Wen-ling during the 2014 Changhua County magistrate election.

description.zh-cn: 2016年举行的台湾地方公职人员补选。其中花莲市长补选后，段宜康因发表针对选举结果和选民的争议言论而引发风波。
description.en: Local public official by-elections held in Taiwan in 2016. After the Hualien mayoral by-election, Duan Yi-kang caused a stir with controversial remarks about the election results and voters.

description.zh-cn: 都统，孝定景皇后的父亲，慈禧太后的弟弟。
description.en: A military commander (Dutong), father of Empress Xiaodingjing and younger brother of Empress Dowager Cixi.

description.zh-cn: 公共卫生学家，受隆裕太后任命领导了1910-1911年东北鼠疫的防疫工作。
description.en: A public health physician who, appointed by Empress Dowager Longyu, led the efforts to combat the 1910–1911 Manchurian plague.

description.zh-cn: 在清朝末年于中国东北地区爆发的一场严重肺鼠疫。
description.en: A severe pneumonic plague that erupted in Northeast China during the final years of the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 一种政体，君主拥有绝对、不受限制的权力。中国的君主专制政体随《宣统帝退位诏书》的颁布而结束。
description.en: A form of government in which the monarch holds supreme, unrestricted authority. The absolute monarchy in China ended with the promulgation of the Imperial Edict of the Abdication of the Qing Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 清朝江西巡抚。光绪帝曾意图选择其女为皇后但被慈禧太后阻止。
description.en: Governor of Jiangxi Province in the Qing dynasty. The Guangxu Emperor had intended to choose his daughter as Empress but was stopped by Empress Dowager Cixi.

description.zh-cn: 中国历史上继春秋时期之后的一段时期。
description.en: A period in ancient Chinese history following the Spring and Autumn period.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期田齐的第三位君主，他将邹忌封于下邳。
description.en: The third monarch of the state of Tian Qi during the Warring States period, who enfeoffed Zou Ji at Xiapī.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期齐国政治家，被齐威王封为下邳成侯。
description.en: A politician of the State of Qi during the Warring States period, who was made Marquis Cheng of Xiapī by King Wei of Qi.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代的一种爵位，邹忌被封于下邳为此爵。
description.en: An ancient Chinese noble title. Zou Ji was granted this title with a fief at Xiapī.

description.zh-cn: 西汉时期的一个郡，是韩信所封楚国的主要区域。
description.en: A commandery during the Western Han Dynasty, which was the main territory of the Kingdom of Chu enfeoffed to Han Xin.

description.zh-cn: 东汉时期由汉明帝设立的侯国，治所位于下邳。
description.en: A kingdom established by Emperor Ming of Han during the Eastern Han Dynasty, with its capital at Xiapī.

description.zh-cn: 汉明帝之子，被封为第一任下邳王。
description.en: Son of Emperor Ming of Han, who was enfeoffed as the first King of Xiapī.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代的九州之一，三国时期治所设在下邳。
description.en: One of the Nine Provinces of ancient China. During the Three Kingdoms period, its administrative center was at Xiapī.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代的一个郡，曾在不同朝代设立。
description.en: An ancient Chinese commandery established in various dynasties.

description.zh-cn: 地名，位于今江苏省宿迁市。在隋朝是下邳郡的治所。
description.en: A place name, located in modern-day Suqian, Jiangsu. It was the administrative center of Xiapī Commandery during the Sui Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代的军事藩镇，后周时期下邳属其管辖。
description.en: A military governorship in ancient China. Xiapī was under its jurisdiction during the Later Zhou period.

description.zh-cn: 宋、金时期的一个军事建制州，下邳隶属该州。
description.en: A military prefecture (jun) during the Song and Jin dynasties, to which Xiapī belonged.

description.zh-cn: 元朝的一个府，下邳隶属该府。
description.en: A prefecture (fu) during the Yuan Dynasty, to which Xiapī belonged.

description.zh-cn: 明朝的行政区划，下邳隶属该区。
description.en: An administrative division of the Ming Dynasty, to which Xiapī belonged.

description.zh-cn: 清朝康熙年间发生于山东郯城的一场大地震，导致下邳治所迁移。
description.en: A major earthquake that occurred in Tancheng, Shandong during the reign of the Kangxi Emperor of the Qing Dynasty, which caused the relocation of the administrative center of Xiapī.

description.zh-cn: 位于江苏省的县级市，是清朝郯城大地震后下邳的新治所所在地。
description.en: A county-level city in Jiangsu Province, which became the new administrative seat of Xiapī after the Tancheng earthquake in the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 一家与法轮功相关的多语种电视台，曾采访李洪志并报导其关于疫情的争议性言论。
description.en: A multilingual television station associated with Falun Gong, which interviewed Li Hongzhi and reported his controversial statements on the pandemic.

description.zh-cn: 美籍华人作家，曾是曹长青主持的文学社团“大路社”的成员。
description.en: A Chinese-American writer, formerly a member of the literary society 'Dalu She' led by Cao Changqing.

description.zh-cn: 台湾民视新闻台的政论节目。
description.en: A political talk show on Taiwan's FTV News.

description.zh-cn: 台湾壹电视新闻台的政论节目。
description.en: A political talk show on Taiwan's Next TV News.

description.zh-cn: 美国佐治亚州首府及最大城市，佐治亚理工学院主校区所在地，也是1996年夏季奥林匹克运动会的举办地。
description.en: The capital and most populous city of the U.S. state of Georgia. It is the location of Georgia Institute of Technology's main campus and was the host city for the 1996 Summer Olympics.

description.zh-cn: 美国佐治亚州的公立大学系统，佐治亚理工学院是其成员之一。
description.en: The public university system of the U.S. state of Georgia, of which Georgia Institute of Technology is a member.

description.zh-cn: 美国大学体育竞技联盟，佐治亚理工学院是其成员学校之一。
description.en: An American collegiate athletic conference, of which Georgia Institute of Technology is a member school.

description.zh-cn: 1996年在亚特兰大举办的夏季奥林匹克运动会。佐治亚理工学院为其建造了奥运村等设施，对赛事顺利召开起到重要作用。
description.en: The Summer Olympic Games held in Atlanta in 1996. Georgia Institute of Technology played a significant role in the successful hosting of the event by constructing facilities such as the Olympic Village.

description.zh-cn: 位于美国华盛顿特区的一组博物馆和研究中心，由美国政府资助、管理。
description.en: A group of museums and research centers administered by the government of the United States, located in Washington, D.C.

description.zh-cn: 佐治亚理工学院校友，因发明聚合酶链式反应（PCR）而获得1993年诺贝尔化学奖。
description.en: An alumnus of Georgia Institute of Technology who received the 1993 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for his invention of the polymerase chain reaction (PCR).

description.zh-cn: 一种分子生物学技术，用于放大特定的DNA片段。由佐治亚理工学院校友凯利·穆利斯发明。
description.en: A molecular biology technique used to amplify specific segments of DNA. It was invented by Georgia Tech alumnus Kary Mullis.

description.zh-cn: 佐治亚理工学院校友，曾任巴拿马副总统、第50任巴拿马总统。
description.en: An alumnus of Georgia Institute of Technology, who served as Vice President and the 50th President of Panama.

description.zh-cn: 佐治亚理工学院电子计算机工程硕士，米哈游公司创始人之一，现任董事长及总裁。
description.en: Holder of a Master's degree in Electrical and Computer Engineering from Georgia Institute of Technology, co-founder of miHoYo, and its current chairman and president.

description.zh-cn: 中国视频游戏开发与动画公司，由佐治亚理工学院校友刘伟等人共同创立。
description.en: A Chinese video game development and animation company, co-founded by Georgia Tech alumnus Liu Wei.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将，曾任中国人民解放军火箭军副司令员。
description.en: A lieutenant general in the People's Liberation Army (PLA), former Deputy Commander of the PLA Rocket Force.

description.zh-cn: 位于俄罗斯莫斯科的语言学院，吴国华在此获得俄罗斯联邦语文学博士学位。
description.en: A language institute in Moscow, Russia, where Wu Guohua obtained a Ph.D. in Philology from the Russian Federation.

description.zh-cn: 江苏省扬州市下辖区，是吴国华的出生地。
description.en: A district of Yangzhou City, Jiangsu Province, and the birthplace of Wu Guohua.

description.zh-cn: 明朝重臣，“三杨”之一。在仁宣时期担任内阁大学士，是“仁宣之治”的重要辅臣。
description.en: An influential minister of the Ming dynasty, one of the 'Three Yangs'. During the Ren-Xuan period, he served as a Grand Secretary in the Inner Cabinet and was an important supporting minister of the 'Reign of Ren and Xuan'.

description.zh-cn: 明仁宗、宣宗、英宗三朝的内阁辅臣杨士奇、杨荣、杨溥的合称。他们是仁宣之治的核心决策人物。
description.en: A collective term for the cabinet ministers Yang Shiqi, Yang Rong, and Yang Pu, who served during the reigns of Emperors Renzong, Xuanzong, and Yingzong. They were the core decision-makers of the Reign of Ren and Xuan.

description.zh-cn: 明朝重臣，长期担任户部尚书。在仁宣时期是重要的辅政大臣，对息兵养民政策的实施有重要贡献。
description.en: An influential minister of the Ming dynasty who served as Minister of Revenue for a long period. He was a key regent minister during the Ren-Xuan period and made significant contributions to the implementation of policies for recuperation.

description.zh-cn: 明成祖朱棣统治时期，国家强盛、社会繁荣的时期。为仁宣之治奠定了基础。
description.en: The period of national strength and social prosperity during the reign of the Yongle Emperor (Zhu Di). It laid the foundation for the Reign of Ren and Xuan.

description.zh-cn: 明英宗时期，太监王振凭借皇帝的信任而独揽大权，导致政治腐败，最终引发土木堡之变。其擅政标志着仁宣之治的结束。
description.en: During the reign of Emperor Yingzong, the eunuch Wang Zhen monopolized power with the emperor's trust, leading to political corruption and eventually the Tumu Crisis. His rise to power marked the end of the Reign of Ren and Xuan.

description.zh-cn: 中国作家，山药蛋派成员。曾任山西省文学艺术界联合会副主席、山西省作家协会副主席，为中国作家协会名誉委员。
description.en: Chinese writer and a member of the Shanyaodan School. He formerly served as the vice chairman of the Shanxi Federation of Literary and Art Circles, the vice chairman of the Shanxi Writers Association, and was an honorary member of the China Writers Association.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国山西省晋中市下辖的县，胡正的出生地。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Jinzhong City, Shanxi Province, People's Republic of China, and the birthplace of Hu Zheng.

description.zh-cn: 中国当代文学的一个重要流派，以山西作家群为主体。
description.en: An important school of modern Chinese literature, mainly composed of writers from Shanxi.

en: Shanxi Federation of Literary and Art Circles
zh-cn: 山西省文学艺术界联合会

description.zh-cn: 1937年淞沪战役后，由蒋中正下令在上海成立的组织，是忠义救国军的前身组织。
description.en: An organization established in Shanghai by order of Chiang Kai-shek after the 1937 Battle of Shanghai, serving as the predecessor to the Loyal and Righteous Army.

description.zh-cn: 忠义救国军于1946年1月21日改编后的部队番号。
description.en: The military designation of the Loyal and Righteous Army after its reorganization on January 21, 1946.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党领导的新四军下属部队，曾与忠义救国军发生摩擦。
description.en: A unit under the command of the New Fourth Army, led by the Communist Party of China, which had frictions with the Loyal and Righteous Army.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事将领，时任保密局（军统局的后续机构）局长，在二二八事件期间派遣刘戈青赴台。
description.en: A military general of the Republic of China and the director of the Secrecy Bureau (successor to Juntong) at the time. He dispatched Liu Geqing to Taiwan during the February 28 Incident.

description.zh-cn: 保密局人员，在二二八事件期间被郑介民派遣至台湾，负责组织忠义救国军别动队进行清乡行动。
description.en: An agent of the Secrecy Bureau dispatched to Taiwan by Zheng Jiemin during the February 28 Incident, responsible for organizing commando units of the Loyal and Righteous Army to carry out rural pacification campaigns.

zh-cn: 湖北省汉江中级人民法院

location.zh-cn: 湖北省仙桃市黄金大道西段9号

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国湖北省的一所中级人民法院，直接隶属于湖北省高级人民法院管理，辖区范围为天门、潜江、仙桃三个省直管市。
description.en: An intermediate people's court in Hubei Province, People's Republic of China, directly subordinate to the Hubei Provincial High People's Court. Its jurisdiction covers the three provincially administered cities of Tianmen, Qianjiang, and Xiantao.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国湖北省的高级人民法院。
description.en: The High People's Court of Hubei Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 湖北省的地方国家权力机关。
description.en: The local state power organ of Hubei Province.

description.zh-cn: 湖北省人民代表大会的常设机关。
description.en: The standing committee of the Hubei Provincial People's Congress.

birth_place.zh-cn: 宁夏回族自治区海原县
birth_place.en: Haiyuan County, Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region

description.en: Chinese politician, current CPC Secretary of Jinan.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任济南市市长。
description.en: Chinese politician, current Mayor of Jinan.

description.zh-cn: 济南市地方国家权力机关的执行机关和国家行政机关。
description.en: The executive organ of the local state power and the state administrative organ of Jinan City.

description.en: Chinese politician, current Director of the Standing Committee of the Jinan Municipal People's Congress.

zh-cn: 济南市人民代表大会常务委员会

description.en: The standing body of the Jinan Municipal People's Congress.

description.en: The local organization of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference in Jinan.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代的郡，汉代设立，隋代改为齐州。
description.en: An ancient commandery in China, established during the Han dynasty and changed to Qizhou during the Sui dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 国民政府外交部特派山东交涉员，在五三惨案中被日军杀害。
description.en: A special commissioner of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Nationalist Government for negotiations in Shandong, who was killed by the Japanese army during the Jinan Incident.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国山东省旧地级市，2019年1月9日撤销，其所辖区域划归济南市管辖。
description.en: A former prefecture-level city in Shandong Province, People's Republic of China, which was abolished on January 9, 2019, with its jurisdiction transferred to Jinan.

description.zh-cn: 中国新石器时代晚期的一种文化，因首次发现于济南市章丘区龙山街道的城子崖遗址而得名。
description.en: A late Neolithic culture in China, named after its first discovery at the Chengziya site in Longshan Sub-district, Zhangqiu District, Jinan.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代的一条重要河流，济南因地处其南而得名。
description.en: An important ancient river in China, from which Jinan derives its name for being located to its south.

description.zh-cn: 连接中国山东省青岛和济南的铁路，其建成促进了济南的繁荣。
description.en: A railway connecting Qingdao and Jinan in Shandong Province, China, the construction of which promoted the prosperity of Jinan.

description.zh-cn: 连接中国天津与南京浦口的铁路，与胶济铁路在济南交汇，促进了济南的繁荣。
description.en: A railway connecting Tianjin and Pukou, Nanjing in China, which intersects with the Jiaoji Railway in Jinan, promoting the city's prosperity.

description.zh-cn: 阿拉伯联合酋长国中面积最大的酋长国，其首府阿布扎比亦为国家首都。
description.en: The largest emirate in the United Arab Emirates, whose capital, Abu Dhabi, is also the national capital.

description.zh-cn: 阿拉伯联合酋长国的成员国之一，其首府迪拜是阿联酋最大的城市。
description.en: One of the constituent emirates of the United Arab Emirates; its capital, Dubai, is the largest city in the UAE.

description.en: One of the constituent emirates of the United Arab Emirates.

description.en: One of the constituent emirates of the United Arab Emirates, which joined the federation in 1972.

description.zh-cn: 阿拉伯联合酋长国现任副总统兼总理、迪拜酋长国酋长。
description.en: The current Vice President and Prime Minister of the United Arab Emirates, and Ruler of Dubai.

zh-cn: 扎耶德·本·苏丹·阿勒纳哈扬
扎耶德·本·苏尔坦·阿勒纳哈扬

description.zh-cn: 阿布扎比酋长国前酋长，在推动阿拉伯联合酋长国成立过程中发挥了核心作用，被认为是阿联酋国父。
description.en: Former ruler of Abu Dhabi who played a central role in the formation of the United Arab Emirates and is considered the Father of the Nation.

zh-cn: 拉希德·本·赛义德·阿勒马克图姆

description.zh-cn: 迪拜酋长国前酋长，利用石油收入推动迪拜经济多元化，为迪拜成为现代化城市奠定基础。
description.en: Former ruler of Dubai who used oil revenues to drive the emirate's economic diversification, laying the foundation for Dubai to become a modern city.

description.zh-cn: 位于波斯湾南岸的酋长国联盟，是阿拉伯联合酋长国的前身。自1892年起成为英国的保护国，直至1971年独立并组建阿联酋。
description.en: A confederation of sheikhdoms on the southern coast of the Persian Gulf, the predecessor to the United Arab Emirates. It was a British protectorate from 1892 until it gained independence and formed the UAE in 1971.

description.zh-cn: 英国前首相。其政府于1968年1月宣布决定终止与停战诸酋长国的条约关系，启动了英国从该地区撤军的进程。
description.en: Former Prime Minister of the United Kingdom. His government announced in January 1968 the decision to terminate the treaty relationship with the Trucial States, initiating the process of British military withdrawal from the region.

description.zh-cn: 英国前首相。其政府于1971年3月再次确认了终止与停战诸酋长国条约关系的决定。
description.en: Former Prime Minister of the United Kingdom. His government reconfirmed the decision to terminate the treaty relationship with the Trucial States in March 1971.

description.zh-cn: 位于波斯湾的岛屿，沙迦酋长哈立德曾与伊朗达成协议，将其租予伊朗。
description.en: An island in the Persian Gulf, which Sheikh Khalid of Sharjah agreed to lease to Iran.

description.zh-cn: 由阿拉伯世界国家组成的区域性组织。
description.en: A regional organization of Arab states in and around North Africa, the Horn of Africa and Arabia.

zh-cn: 李真 (河北省国税局局长)

description.zh-cn: 时任河北省委书记程维高的秘书。栗战书与其产生矛盾后被调离权力中心。
description.en: Secretary to Cheng Weigao, then Party Secretary of Hebei. Li Zhanshu was transferred away from the center of power after a conflict with him.

description.zh-cn: 中国国共内战期间的一场战役，栗战书的叔叔栗政通在此战役中阵亡。
description.en: A campaign during the Chinese Civil War in which Li Zhanshu's uncle, Li Zhengtong, was killed.

description.zh-cn: 一项已废止的中华人民共和国法律制度，由栗战书执掌下的十三届全国人大常委会于2019年12月28日废除。
description.en: A defunct legal system in the People's Republic of China, which was abolished on December 28, 2019, by the 13th NPCSC under the leadership of Li Zhanshu.

description.zh-cn: 河北省石家庄市下辖县。习近平曾在此担任县委书记，当时栗战书在邻近的无极县任职。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Shijiazhuang, Hebei province. Xi Jinping served as its Party Secretary while Li Zhanshu was serving in the neighboring Wuji County.

description.zh-cn: 一首中华人民共和国的政治歌曲。1982年，栗战书致信胡耀邦建议高唱此歌，并提议修改歌词。
description.en: A political song from the People's Republic of China. In 1982, Li Zhanshu wrote to Hu Yaobang suggesting this song be promoted and proposed a lyric change.

en: Surpass the UK and catch up with the US

description.zh-cn: 大跃进时期的主要口号和目标，旨在短期内使中国的主要工业产品产量超过英国，赶上美国。
description.en: A major slogan and goal of the Great Leap Forward, aiming to make China's output of major industrial products surpass that of the UK and catch up with the US in a short period.

zh-cn: 鼓足干劲、力争上游、多快好省地建设社会主义

description.zh-cn: 中共八大二次会议通过的指导方针，是“三面红旗”之一，为大跃进运动提供了理论依据。
description.en: The guiding principle adopted at the Second Session of the Eighth CPC National Congress, one of the 'Three Red Banners', which provided the theoretical basis for the Great Leap Forward.

description.zh-cn: 美国风险投资家，红杉资本的创始人。
description.en: American venture capitalist, founder of Sequoia Capital.

zh-cn: 门洛帕克 (加利福尼亚州)

description.zh-cn: 位于美国加利福尼亚州圣马特奥县的一座城市，是红杉资本的创立地。
description.en: A city in San Mateo County, California, United States, and the founding location of Sequoia Capital.

description.zh-cn: 红杉资本的合伙人之一，在1990年代中期与迈克尔·莫里茨一起从创始人唐·瓦伦丁手中接管了公司。
description.en: A partner at Sequoia Capital who, along with Michael Moritz, took over the firm from founder Don Valentine in the mid-1990s.

description.zh-cn: 红杉资本的合伙人之一，在1990年代中期与道格·莱昂内一起从创始人唐·瓦伦丁手中接管了公司。
description.en: A partner at Sequoia Capital who, along with Doug Leone, took over the firm from founder Don Valentine in the mid-1990s.

description.zh-cn: 红杉中国的创始合伙人之一，曾任德丰杰全球基金董事。被中国媒体描述为中国最著名的风险投资家之一。
description.en: One of the founding partners of Sequoia China, former director of Draper Fisher Jurvetson's global fund. Described by Chinese media as one of the country's most famous venture capitalists.

description.zh-cn: 一家美国风险投资公司。张帆在创立红杉中国前曾是其全球基金的董事。
description.en: An American venture capital firm. Zhang Fan was a director of its global fund before co-founding Sequoia China.

description.zh-cn: 中国在线旅游服务公司。沈南鹏在创立红杉中国前曾是其总裁兼CFO。
description.en: A Chinese online travel services company. Neil Shen was its President and CFO before co-founding Sequoia China.

description.zh-cn: 一家美国公司，在全球范围内运营在线支付系统，是红杉资本投资的知名企业之一。
description.en: An American company operating a worldwide online payments system, one of the notable companies invested in by Sequoia Capital.

description.zh-cn: 一家美国跨国计算机技术公司，是红杉资本投资的知名企业之一。
description.en: An American multinational computer technology corporation, one of the notable companies invested in by Sequoia Capital.

description.zh-cn: 一家在线快时尚零售商，是红杉资本投资的知名企业之一。
description.en: An online fast fashion retailer, one of the notable companies invested in by Sequoia Capital.

description.zh-cn: 一家美国视频游戏公司，是红杉资本投资的知名企业之一。
description.en: An American video game company, one of the notable companies invested in by Sequoia Capital.

description.zh-cn: 一家美国视频游戏和家用电脑公司，是红杉资本投资的知名企业之一。
description.en: An American video game and home computer company, one of the notable companies invested in by Sequoia Capital.

description.zh-cn: 一款美国的免费即时通讯应用程序，是红杉资本投资的知名企业之一。
description.en: An American freeware, cross-platform messaging and Voice over IP service, one of the notable companies invested in by Sequoia Capital.

description.zh-cn: 一个面向商业和就业的在线服务网站，是红杉资本投资的知名企业之一。
description.en: An American business and employment-oriented online service, one of the notable companies invested in by Sequoia Capital.

description.zh-cn: 国立西南联合大学解散后，由其师范学院留昆独立办学而成立的学院，后更名为云南师范大学。
description.en: After the dissolution of the National Southwestern Associated University, this college was established independently from its Normal College which remained in Kunming. It was later renamed Yunnan Normal University.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军中将，在国立长沙临时大学迁往昆明期间，担任步行穿越湘西、贵州、滇东的学生旅行团团长。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the National Revolutionary Army who served as the leader of the student trekking group that walked through western Hunan, Guizhou, and eastern Yunnan during the relocation of the National Temporary University of Changsha to Kunming.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治学家，抗日战争时期曾在国立西南联合大学与云南大学两校兼职。
description.en: A Chinese political scientist who held concurrent positions at both the National Southwestern Associated University and Yunnan University during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 中国文学家，国立西南联合大学教授，与冯友兰共同为联大校歌作词。
description.en: A Chinese literary scholar and professor at the National Southwestern Associated University who co-authored the lyrics for the university anthem with Feng Youlan.

description.zh-cn: 中国语言学家，为国立西南联合大学校歌作曲。
description.en: A Chinese linguist who composed the music for the National Southwestern Associated University anthem.

description.en: The school anthem of the National Southwestern Associated University, set to the tune of 'Man Jiang Hong', with lyrics by Luo Yong and Feng Youlan, and music by Zhang Qingchang.

description.zh-cn: 中国物理学家，曾任国立西南联合大学理学院院长。
description.en: A Chinese physicist, who served as the Dean of the College of Science at the National Southwestern Associated University.

description.zh-cn: 中国物理学家，曾任国立西南联合大学理学院院长。
description.en: A Chinese physicist, who served as the Dean of the College of Science at the National Southwestern Associated University.

description.zh-cn: 中国现代历史学家，曾任国立西南联合大学教授。他认为法家是儒家的正宗。
description.en: A modern Chinese historian and former professor at the National Southwestern Associated University. He believed that Legalism was the true heir to Confucianism.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国江苏省下辖的县级市，是黄铭的出生地。
description.en: A county-level city in Jiangsu Province, People's Republic of China, and the birthplace of Huang Ming.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军的最高参谋机关。
description.en: The highest staff body of the PLA Ground Force.
