description.zh-cn: 在法国解放后由夏尔·戴高乐建立的临时政府，取代了维希政权，并负责战后重建和对合作者进行审判。
description.en: An interim government established by Charles de Gaulle after the liberation of France, which replaced the Vichy regime and was responsible for post-war reconstruction and the trials of collaborators.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战期间纳粹德国入侵法国及低地国家的军事行动，导致法兰西第三共和国的迅速溃败和维希政权的建立。
description.en: The military campaign during World War II in which Nazi Germany invaded France and the Low Countries, leading to the swift collapse of the French Third Republic and the establishment of the Vichy regime.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战期间盟军在法属北非的登陆行动，该行动直接促使德国和意大利执行“安东行动”。
description.en: The Allied landings in French North Africa during World War II, which directly prompted Germany and Italy to execute Operation Anton.

description.zh-cn: 德国和意大利为应对“火炬行动”而发起的军事行动，旨在占领维希法国控制的法国南部地区，导致维希政权名存实亡。
description.en: The military operation launched by Germany and Italy in response to Operation Torch to occupy the southern French territory controlled by Vichy France, which rendered the Vichy regime defunct in all but name.

description.zh-cn: 盟军在法国诺曼底地区进行的大规模登陆行动，是解放法国的开端，直接导致了维希政权的崩溃。
description.en: The large-scale Allied landing operation in the Normandy region of France, which marked the beginning of the liberation of France and directly led to the collapse of the Vichy regime.

description.zh-cn: 隶属于自由法国的军队，在1945年4月攻下西格马林根，俘虏了最后一批维希法国的流亡者。
description.en: An army affiliated with the Free French Forces, which captured Sigmaringen in April 1945 and took the last Vichy France exiles prisoner.

description.zh-cn: 维希法国在法国本土被解放后，于德国西格马林根成立的流亡政府。
description.en: The government-in-exile of Vichy France, established in Sigmaringen, Germany, after the liberation of mainland France.

description.zh-cn: 与犹太人一样，在维希法国时期被视为“不良分子”并遭到抓捕。
description.en: Like the Jewish people, they were considered 'undesirables' and were arrested during the Vichy France period.

description.en: A crucial blocking action during the Liaoshen Campaign, where the 10th Column led by Liang Xingchu tenaciously held back the KMT's Liao Yaoxiang Army Group in the Heishan and Dahushan areas.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军中将，在辽沈战役中任第九兵团司令官，被俘。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the Republic of China Army, served as the commander of the 9th Army Group during the Liaoshen Campaign and was captured.

description.zh-cn: 一家美国公司，与科大讯飞建立了合作伙伴关系。
description.en: An American company that has established a partnership with iFlytek.

description.en: A lieutenant general of the People's Liberation Army (PLA) and a Grand Justice of the first rank. He formerly served as the President of the PLA Military Court and a member of the Standing Committee of the 13th National People's Congress.

description.en: The northern faction in the American Civil War, composed of states that remained loyal to the federal union.

description.zh-cn: 美利坚联盟国唯一一任总统。
description.en: The only President of the Confederate States of America.

description.zh-cn: 美利坚联盟国军队总司令，被认为是美国历史上最杰出的将领之一。
description.en: Commander of the Confederate States Army, considered one of the most brilliant generals in American history.

description.zh-cn: 美国内战后期联邦军总司令，领导联邦取得最终胜利，后成为美国第18任总统。
description.en: Commanding General of the Union Army during the later part of the American Civil War, leading the Union to ultimate victory, and later became the 18th President of the United States.

description.zh-cn: 邦联军队炮击南卡罗来纳州查尔斯顿港的萨姆特堡，迫使其投降，此事件标志着美国内战的爆发。
description.en: The bombardment of Fort Sumter in Charleston, South Carolina, by Confederate forces, which forced its surrender and marked the beginning of the American Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 美利坚联盟国陆军将军，指挥了萨姆特堡战役，打响了内战第一枪。
description.en: A general in the Confederate States Army who commanded the attack on Fort Sumter, firing the first shots of the Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 美国东南部的一个州，是第一个宣布脱离联邦的州。
description.en: A state in the southeastern United States, it was the first state to secede from the Union.

description.zh-cn: 由美国总统林肯颁布的行政命令，宣布解放邦联控制下的所有奴隶。
description.en: An executive order issued by President Abraham Lincoln that proclaimed the freedom of all slaves in Confederate-held territory.

description.zh-cn: 美国内战期间联邦军的主要将领之一，曾任波托马克军团司令。
description.en: A major general for the Union during the American Civil War and served as commander of the Army of the Potomac.

description.zh-cn: 被认为是美国内战的转折点，联邦军在此次战役中击败了李将军的北侵部队，造成邦联军重大伤亡。
description.en: Considered the turning point of the American Civil War, the Union army defeated General Lee's invading forces in this battle, inflicting heavy casualties on the Confederacy.

description.zh-cn: 美国内战期间的联邦军将领，在盖茨堡战役中指挥波托马克军团取得决定性胜利。
description.en: A Union general during the American Civil War, best known for commanding the Army of the Potomac to a decisive victory at the Battle of Gettysburg.

description.zh-cn: 美国内战期间的联邦军将领，以实施“全面战争”战略和“向大海进军”而闻名。
description.en: A Union general during the American Civil War, known for implementing the strategy of 'total war' and for his 'March to the Sea'.

description.zh-cn: 在美国内战结束五天后，总统亚伯拉罕·林肯被同情邦联的演员约翰·威尔克斯·布斯刺杀。
description.en: Five days after the end of the American Civil War, President Abraham Lincoln was assassinated by John Wilkes Booth, a Confederate sympathizer.

description.zh-cn: 美国内战结束后，解决南方各州重返联邦、前邦联领导人的地位以及非裔美国人自由民的法律地位等问题的时期。
description.en: The period after the American Civil War that addressed the reintegration of Southern states into the Union, the status of former Confederate leaders, and the legal status of African American freedmen.

description.zh-cn: 美国陆军将领，在内战初期担任联邦军总司令，并制定了“蟒蛇计划”。
description.en: A United States Army general who served as Commanding General of the Union Army at the start of the Civil War and devised the Anaconda Plan.

description.zh-cn: 由温菲尔德·史考特将军制定的联邦军战略计划，通称“蟒蛇计划”。旨在通过对南方港口实施封锁（切断邦联国际贸易）和控制密西西比河，来削弱邦联经济，以最小的流血代价赢得战争。该封锁由联邦海军执行，是“蟒蛇计划”的重要组成部分。
description.en: A strategic plan for the Union Army, known as the "Anaconda Plan," devised by General Winfield Scott. It aimed to weaken the Confederacy's economy and win the war with minimal bloodshed by blockading Southern ports (to cut off international trade) and controlling the Mississippi River. The naval blockade, implemented by the Union Navy, was a key component of this plan.

description.en: Chinese politician, current Party Secretary of Xiamen University.

description.en: An autonomous county under the administration of Qinhuangdao, Hebei province, People's Republic of China, where Li Shulei once held a temporary post.

description.zh-cn: 蔡京之弟，王安石的女婿，官至枢密使、尚书左丞。
description.en: Younger brother of Cai Jing, son-in-law of Wang Anshi, who served as Commissioner of Military Affairs and Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 蔡京长子，深得宋徽宗恩宠，官至领枢密院事。后与父蔡京不睦，形同仇敌。
description.en: Eldest son of Cai Jing, highly favored by Emperor Huizong of Song, and served as the head of the Bureau of Military Affairs. He later had a hostile relationship with his father, becoming like an enemy.

description.zh-cn: 蔡京第四子，官至徽猷阁待制，后遭兄蔡攸告发，贬死于白州。
description.en: Fourth son of Cai Jing, who served as an attendant in the Huiyou Pavilion. He was later denounced by his elder brother Cai You and exiled to Baizhou, where he died.

description.en: Third son of Cai Jing, who served as Minister of Rites and Grand Academician of the Baohe Hall. He was ordered to commit suicide in the first year of the Jingkang era.

It was later purged by Kim Il-sung for opposing issues such as the hereditary succession of Kim Jong-il.

description.en: A political faction within the Workers' Party of Korea in the 1960s, composed of military cadres who followed Kim Il-sung in the anti-Japanese armed struggle. It was later held responsible and purged for failures such as the 'Blue House Raid'.

description.en: A Korean communist party founded in 1925. It was later ordered to dissolve by the Comintern due to internal strife, but its members and organizations continued to operate in various places as party cells, becoming the main source for both the North and South Korean Workers' Parties.

description.zh-cn: 因西班牙哈布斯堡王朝绝嗣而引发的欧洲主要大国间的战争。大不列颠王国作为主要参战方，通过战后的《乌德勒支和约》获得了领土和贸易优势。
description.en: A major European conflict triggered by the death of the last Habsburg King of Spain. The Kingdom of Great Britain was a major participant and gained territory and trade advantages through the subsequent Treaty of Utrecht.

description.zh-cn: 18世纪的欧洲主要势力之一，在西班牙王位继承战争中与法国结盟对抗大不列颠及其盟友。
description.en: A major European power in the 18th century, allied with France against Great Britain and its allies in the War of the Spanish Succession.

description.zh-cn: 结束西班牙王位继承战争的一系列和约。根据条约，英国从法国和西班牙获得了纽芬兰、阿卡迪亚、直布罗陀和梅诺卡岛。
description.en: A series of peace treaties that ended the War of the Spanish Succession. Under the treaty, Great Britain gained Newfoundland, Acadia, Gibraltar, and Menorca from France and Spain.

description.zh-cn: 结束七年战争的和约。该条约标志着英国成为世界头号殖民大国，从法国获得新法兰西，从西班牙获得佛罗里达。
description.en: The peace treaty that ended the Seven Years' War. It marked Great Britain's emergence as the world's foremost colonial power, gaining New France from France and Florida from Spain.

zh-cn: 第一代克莱武男爵罗伯特·克莱武

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党党员，曾在中国抗日战争时期担任八路军排长，中华人民共和国时期担任四川省凉山州雷波县城区粮站站长。
description.en: A member of the Communist Party of China, who served as a platoon leader in the Eighth Route Army during the Second Sino-Japanese War and as the head of the urban grain station in Leibo County, Liangshan Prefecture, Sichuan Province during the People's Republic of China era.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国河北省的城市，是肖万世的出生地。
description.en: A city in Hebei Province, China, and the birthplace of Xiao Wanshi.

description.zh-cn: 清朝安徽省下辖的一个府，与安庆府同为“安徽”省名的来源。
description.en: A prefecture in Anhui Province during the Qing Dynasty, which, along with Anqing Fu, is the origin of the name 'Anhui'.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝至南宋的行政区划，安庆府的前身，在升为府前被称为安庆军。
description.en: An administrative division from the Tang to the Southern Song dynasty, the predecessor of Anqing Fu. It was known as Anqing Jun before being promoted to a Fu (prefecture).

description.zh-cn: 安徽省下辖的地级市，安庆府于1260年将治所迁至此地。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Anhui Province, where Anqing Fu moved its seat of government in 1260.

description.zh-cn: 元朝的行政区划，由安庆府改制而来，后被朱元璋改为宁江府。
description.en: An administrative division of the Yuan Dynasty, converted from Anqing Fu, and later changed to Ningjiang Fu by Zhu Yuanzhang.

description.zh-cn: 明清时期安庆府的下辖县之一。
description.en: One of the counties under the jurisdiction of Anqing Fu during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

description.zh-cn: 明清时期安庆府的下辖县之一。
description.en: One of the counties under the jurisdiction of Anqing Fu during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

description.zh-cn: 明清时期安庆府的下辖县之一。
description.en: One of the counties under the jurisdiction of Anqing Fu during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

description.zh-cn: 明清时期安庆府的下辖县之一。
description.en: One of the counties under the jurisdiction of Anqing Fu during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

description.zh-cn: 清朝初年设立的省份，安庆府曾为其下辖府之一。后分为安徽、江苏两省。
description.en: A province established in the early Qing Dynasty, of which Anqing Fu was one of its subordinate prefectures. It was later divided into Anhui and Jiangsu provinces.

description.zh-cn: 清朝时期的安徽省，由江南省分设而来，以安庆府为省会。
description.en: Anhui Province during the Qing Dynasty, established from the division of Jiangnan Province, with Anqing Fu as its capital.

description.zh-cn: 常陸宮正仁亲王的妻子。
description.en: The wife of Masahito, Prince Hitachi.

description.zh-cn: 正仁親王妃华子的父亲。
description.en: The father of Hanako, Princess Hitachi.

description.zh-cn: 昭和天皇与香淳皇后的长女，常陸宮正仁亲王的姐姐。
description.en: The eldest daughter of Emperor Shōwa and Empress Kōjun, and the elder sister of Masahito, Prince Hitachi.

description.zh-cn: 昭和天皇与香淳皇后的次女，常陸宮正仁亲王的姐姐。
description.en: The second daughter of Emperor Shōwa and Empress Kōjun, and the elder sister of Masahito, Prince Hitachi.

description.zh-cn: 昭和天皇与香淳皇后的三女，常陸宮正仁亲王的姐姐。
description.en: The third daughter of Emperor Shōwa and Empress Kōjun, and the elder sister of Masahito, Prince Hitachi.

description.zh-cn: 昭和天皇与香淳皇后的四女，常陸宮正仁亲王的姐姐。
description.en: The fourth daughter of Emperor Shōwa and Empress Kōjun, and the elder sister of Masahito, Prince Hitachi.

description.zh-cn: 昭和天皇与香淳皇后的五女，常陸宮正仁亲王的妹妹。
description.en: The fifth daughter of Emperor Shōwa and Empress Kōjun, and the younger sister of Masahito, Prince Hitachi.

description.zh-cn: 日本皇室的宫家之一，由正仁亲王于1964年创立。
description.en: One of the princely houses of the Japanese Imperial Family, founded by Prince Masahito in 1964.

description.zh-cn: 位于美国明尼苏达州的一所公立研究型大学系统。
description.en: A public research university system in the U.S. state of Minnesota.

zh-cn: 陆军军官学校台湾训练班
陆军军官学校第四军官训练班

description.zh-cn: 由孙立人于1947年在台湾创办的军官训练机构，为陆军官校在台复校的基础，其人员与设施于1951年并入陆官。
description.en: An officer training institution founded by Sun Li-jen in Taiwan in 1947, which formed the basis for the re-establishment of the R.O.C. Military Academy in Taiwan. Its personnel and facilities were merged into the academy in 1951.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军二级上将，黄埔七期毕业生，1950年担任陆军官校在台复校后首任校长。
description.en: A general of the Republic of China Army, a graduate of the seventh class of Whampoa, who became the first Commandant after the R.O.C. Military Academy was re-established in Taiwan in 1950.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军二级上将，陆军官校专科班第1期毕业，是陆官专科班出身的最高阶将领。
description.en: A general of the Republic of China Army, a graduate of the 1st class of the junior college program at the R.O.C. Military Academy, and the highest-ranking general from the program.

description.zh-cn: 《开罗宣言》中规定日本应归还给中华民国的领土之一。
description.en: One of the territories that Japan was required to return to the Republic of China according to the Cairo Declaration.

description.zh-cn: 同盟国与日本在1951年签订的和平条约，其中日本放弃了对台湾、澎湖等领土的主权。其法律地位高于《开罗宣言》等战时文件。
description.en: A peace treaty signed between the Allied Powers and Japan in 1951, in which Japan renounced sovereignty over territories including Taiwan and the Pescadores. Its legal status is considered higher than wartime documents like the Cairo Declaration.

description.zh-cn: 台湾历史学家及政治人物，认为《开罗宣言》只是一项新闻公报，并非正式宣言。
description.en: A Taiwanese historian and politician who argues that the Cairo Declaration was merely a press communiqué, not a formal declaration.

description.zh-cn: 香港女演员，与胡枫为情同兄妹的挚友。
description.en: Hong Kong actress, a close friend of Bowie Woo.

description.zh-cn: 香港男演员，与胡枫、谢贤、Joe Junior共同主持旅游节目《4个小生去旅行》。
description.en: Hong Kong actor, co-hosted the travel show '4 Amigos Bon Voyage' with Bowie Woo, Patrick Tse, and Joe Junior.

description.zh-cn: 香港歌手及演员，与胡枫、谢贤、曾江共同主持旅游节目。
description.en: Hong Kong singer and actor, co-hosted a travel show with Bowie Woo, Patrick Tse, and Kenneth Tsang.

description.zh-cn: 香港政治人物及前演员，胡枫的契女。
description.en: Hong Kong politician and former actress, goddaughter of Bowie Woo.

description.zh-cn: 香港女演员，在1960年代后期与胡枫合作过多部歌舞片。
description.en: Hong Kong actress who co-starred with Bowie Woo in numerous song-and-dance films in the late 1960s.

description.zh-cn: 香港粤剧演员和电影演员，与胡枫合作其出道作《男人心》。
description.en: Hong Kong Cantonese opera and film actress who co-starred with Bowie Woo in his debut film 'A Man's Heart'.

description.zh-cn: 香港电影界的年度颁奖典礼，该届向胡枫颁发了终身成就奖。
description.en: The annual awards ceremony for the Hong Kong film industry, where Bowie Woo was presented with the Lifetime Achievement Award.

description.zh-cn: 香港女演员、歌手及主持人。
description.en: Hong Kong actress, singer, and host.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任中国共产党西宁市委员会书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, current Secretary of the Xining Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

birth_place.zh-cn: 青海省化隆回族自治县

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任西宁市人民政府市长。
description.en: Chinese politician, current Mayor of the Xining Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国十六国时期的政权之一。
description.en: One of the states during the Sixteen Kingdoms period of China.

description.zh-cn: 11世纪初期青海河湟地区吐蕃部落集团首领之一。
description.en: One of the leaders of a Tibetan tribal confederation in the Huangshui River Valley region of Qinghai in the early 11th century.

description.zh-cn: 吐蕃赞普的后代，曾被李立遵劫持为名义上的领袖。
description.en: A descendant of the Tibetan emperor (Tsenpo), who was once held by Li Lizun as a nominal leader.

description.zh-cn: 明朝及清初在西宁地区设立的军事及行政机构。
description.en: A military and administrative institution established in the Xining area during the Ming and early Qing dynasties.

description.zh-cn: 明朝设立的军事指挥机构，管辖范围包括今陕西、甘肃、宁夏、青海部分地区。
description.en: A military command institution established during the Ming dynasty, with jurisdiction over parts of modern-day Shaanxi, Gansu, Ningxia, and Qinghai.

description.zh-cn: 清代青海和硕特蒙古首领，曾于雍正元年发动反清叛乱，后被年羹尧率领的清军镇压。
description.en: A leader of the Khoshut Mongols in Qinghai during the Qing dynasty. He launched a rebellion against the Qing in the first year of the Yongzheng reign, which was later suppressed by Qing forces led by Nian Gengyao.

description.zh-cn: 清朝在西宁设立的行政机构。
description.en: An administrative institution established in Xining during the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 清朝时期的甘肃省行政建制。
description.en: The administrative division of Gansu Province during the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国时期设立的省级行政区。
description.en: A provincial-level administrative region established during the Republic of China era.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中华人民共和国教育部部长。
description.en: Chinese politician who served as the Minister of Education of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国教育家，曾任天津大学校长，是钟登华的前任。
description.en: Chinese educator who served as the President of Tianjin University and was Zhong Denghua's predecessor.

description.zh-cn: 位于江西省赣州市赣县区的镇，是钟登华的出生地。
description.en: A town in Ganxian District, Ganzhou City, Jiangxi Province, and the birthplace of Zhong Denghua.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中国农业大学党委书记，是钟登华的前任。
description.en: Chinese politician who served as the Party Secretary of China Agricultural University and was Zhong Denghua's predecessor.

zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会农业和农村委员会
全国政协农业和农村委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会的专门委员会之一。
description.en: One of the special committees of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，副总警监警衔。曾任中共吉林省委常委、政法委书记，吉林省公安厅厅长、党委书记，吉林省政协副主席等职。
description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China with the police rank of Deputy Commissioner General. He has served as a member of the Standing Committee of the CCP Jilin Provincial Committee and Secretary of the Political and Legal Affairs Commission, Director and Party Secretary of the Jilin Provincial Public Security Department, and Vice Chairman of the Jilin Provincial CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 李申学的出生地，是中华人民共和国河北省唐山市下辖的县。
description.en: Li Shenxue's birthplace, a county under the jurisdiction of Tangshan City, Hebei Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国材料力学家、光弹性学家，曾任天津大学教授、博士生导师。
description.en: Chinese material mechanician and photoelasticity expert, formerly a professor and doctoral supervisor at Tianjin University.

description.zh-cn: 中国辽宁省铁岭市下辖的一个县。
description.en: A county under the administration of Tieling City, in Liaoning province, China.

en: Chinese Society of Theoretical and Applied Mechanics

description.zh-cn: 中国的力学领域的学术组织。
description.en: An academic organization in the field of mechanics in China.

description.zh-cn: 德国制药及化工跨国集团，于2018年收购了孟山都公司。
description.en: A German multinational pharmaceutical and chemical corporation that acquired Monsanto in 2018.

description.zh-cn: 1947年发生于美国德克萨斯城的工业事故，导致孟山都公司一家分厂被完全摧毁。
description.en: An industrial accident that occurred in Texas City, USA in 1947, which resulted in the complete destruction of a Monsanto plant.

description.zh-cn: 一种曾被广泛使用的合成杀虫剂，后因其对环境的长期影响而被禁用。
description.en: A synthetic insecticide that was once widely used but later banned due to its long-term environmental impacts.

description.zh-cn: 一种高效落叶剂，因含有剧毒的戴奥辛，对生态环境和人类健康造成严重损害。孟山都曾是其主要生产商之一。
description.en: A powerful defoliant containing highly toxic dioxin, which caused severe damage to the ecosystem and human health. Monsanto was one of its main producers.

description.zh-cn: 一种广谱除草剂，由孟山都公司商品化并以“Roundup”品牌销售。
description.en: A broad-spectrum herbicide, commercialized by Monsanto under the brand name Roundup.

description.zh-cn: 一家制药公司，于1985年被孟山都公司收购。
description.en: A pharmaceutical company that was acquired by Monsanto in 1985.

description.zh-cn: 在孟山都收购G.D.希尔勒公司后，由其阿斯巴甜业务部门成立的独立子公司。
description.en: An independent subsidiary formed from the aspartame business of G. D. Searle & Company after its acquisition by Monsanto.

description.zh-cn: 由孟山都与Pharmacia & Upjohn于1999年合并而成的制药巨头。后于2002年被辉瑞制药收购。
description.en: A pharmaceutical giant formed by the merger of Monsanto and Pharmacia & Upjohn in 1999. It was later acquired by Pfizer in 2002.

description.zh-cn: 一种基因改造的牛科生长激素，注射后可增加乳牛的泌乳量。由孟山都研发，商品名为Posilac。
description.en: A genetically engineered bovine growth hormone that increases milk production in dairy cows. Developed by Monsanto under the brand name Posilac.

description.zh-cn: 美国制药公司，于2008年从孟山都手中收购了重组牛生长激素业务。
description.en: An American pharmaceutical company that acquired the recombinant bovine growth hormone business from Monsanto in 2008.

description.zh-cn: 国际非政府环保组织，曾反驳孟山都公司申请猪只育种技术的专利。
description.en: An international non-governmental environmental organization that opposed Monsanto's patent application for pig breeding technology.

description.zh-cn: 曾任香港浸会大学校长，早年曾在孟山都公司担任高级化学研究师。
description.en: Former president of Hong Kong Baptist University, who previously worked at Monsanto as a Senior Research Chemist.

description.zh-cn: 一家生物技术公司，其开发的技术被孟山都公司用于农业应用生物技术的产业化经营模式。
description.en: A biotechnology company whose developed technologies were used by Monsanto in its industrialized business model for agricultural biotechnology applications.

description.zh-cn: 一家制药公司，于1999年与孟山都公司合并，组建了新的Pharmacia公司。
description.en: A pharmaceutical company that merged with Monsanto in 1999 to form the new Pharmacia corporation.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国福建省宁德市的地方国家行政机关。
description.en: The local state administrative organ of Ningde City, Fujian Province, People's Republic of China.

en: Fujian Radio Film and TV Group

description.zh-cn: 中国福建省的省级电视台。
description.en: The provincial television station of Fujian Province, China.

description.zh-cn: 由中央人民广播电台制作播出的全国性新闻广播节目。
description.en: A national news radio program produced and broadcast by China National Radio.

description.zh-cn: 由中国中央电视台制作播出的全国性新闻电视节目。
description.en: A national news television program produced and broadcast by China Central Television.

description.zh-cn: 美国海军在太平洋地区的主要作战力量，是第七舰队的上级指挥单位。
description.en: The main combat force of the United States Navy in the Pacific region, and the superior command unit of the Seventh Fleet.

zh-cn: 美国印度洋-太平洋司令部

description.zh-cn: 美国的联合作战司令部之一，负责印太地区的军事行动，美国太平洋舰队隶属于该司令部。
description.en: One of the unified combatant commands of the United States, responsible for military operations in the Indo-Pacific region. The U.S. Pacific Fleet is subordinate to this command.

description.zh-cn: 位于日本横须贺市的美国海军基地，是第七舰队的司令部所在地。
description.en: A United States Navy base located in Yokosuka, Japan, which serves as the headquarters of the Seventh Fleet.

description.zh-cn: 美国海军上将，曾在第二次世界大战期间指挥第七舰队。
description.en: An admiral in the United States Navy who commanded the Seventh Fleet during World War II.

zh-cn: 亚佛雷德·梅尔维勒·普莱德

description.zh-cn: 美国海军中将，曾任第七舰队司令，并兼任首任美军协防台湾司令部司令。
description.en: A Vice Admiral in the U.S. Navy who served as commander of the Seventh Fleet and concurrently as the first commander of the U.S. Taiwan Defense Command.

description.zh-cn: 美国海军的一艘常规动力航空母舰，曾长期作为第七舰队的核心力量驻扎在日本。于2008年结束前沿部署任务，后由乔治·华盛顿号接替。
description.en: A conventionally powered aircraft carrier of the U.S. Navy that was long stationed in Japan as the core of the Seventh Fleet. It ended its forward-deployment mission in 2008 and was subsequently replaced by the USS George Washington.

zh-cn: 乔治·华盛顿号航空母舰

description.zh-cn: 美国海军的核动力航空母舰。2008年接替小鹰号成为首艘驻扎在日本的核动力航母。2015年由罗纳德·里根号接替，2024年完成大修后重返第七舰队。
description.en: A nuclear-powered aircraft carrier of the U.S. Navy. In 2008, it replaced the USS Kitty Hawk, becoming the first nuclear-powered carrier to be stationed in Japan. It was replaced by the USS Ronald Reagan in 2015 and returned to the Seventh Fleet in 2024 after completing its overhaul.

description.zh-cn: 美国海军的核动力航空母舰。于2015年接替返回美国进行大修的乔治·华盛顿号，成为第七舰队的旗舰。
description.en: A nuclear-powered aircraft carrier of the U.S. Navy. In 2015, it replaced the USS George Washington, which returned to the U.S. for an overhaul, becoming the flagship of the Seventh Fleet.

description.zh-cn: 清末立宪派人士，四川省咨议局议长。被推举为四川保路同志会会长，是保路运动的主要领导人之一。后被赵尔丰诱捕，成都独立后被推举为大汉四川军政府首任都督。
description.en: A Constitutionalist figure in the late Qing dynasty and the speaker of the Sichuan Provincial Consultative Assembly. He was elected as the president of the Sichuan Railway Protection League and was one of the main leaders of the movement. He was later arrested by Zhao Erfeng and, after Chengdu's independence, was elected the first governor-general of the Dahan Sichuan Military Government.

description.zh-cn: 清末立宪派人士，四川省咨议局副议长。被推举为四川保路同志会副会长，后与蒲殿俊等人一同被赵尔丰诱捕。
description.en: A Constitutionalist figure in the late Qing dynasty and the deputy speaker of the Sichuan Provincial Consultative Assembly. He was elected as the vice-president of the Sichuan Railway Protection League and was later arrested by Zhao Erfeng along with Pu Dianjun and others.

description.zh-cn: 保路同志会和股东会的主要人物之一，于1911年9月7日被四川总督赵尔丰诱捕。
description.en: One of the key figures of the Railway Protection League and the shareholders' meeting, who was arrested by Viceroy of Sichuan Zhao Erfeng on September 7, 1911.

description.zh-cn: 保路同志会和股东会的主要人物之一，于1911年9月7日被四川总督赵尔丰诱捕。
description.en: One of the key figures of the Railway Protection League and the shareholders' meeting, who was arrested by Viceroy of Sichuan Zhao Erfeng on September 7, 1911.

description.zh-cn: 1911年11月27日成都宣布独立后成立的军政府，由蒲殿俊担任首任都督。它的成立标志着清朝在四川的统治彻底覆灭。
description.en: The military government established after Chengdu declared independence on November 27, 1911, with Pu Dianjun as its first governor-general. Its establishment marked the complete collapse of Qing rule in Sichuan.

description.zh-cn: 清朝巡防军统领，在成都血案中力主武力镇压，并率先下令对民众开枪。
description.en: Commander of the Qing Patrol and Defense Army, who strongly advocated for armed suppression during the Chengdu Massacre and was the first to order troops to fire on the populace.

description.zh-cn: 清朝在四川省的最高军政长官职位。保路运动期间，该职位先后由王人文（护理）、赵尔丰、端方（署理）担任。
description.en: The highest military and administrative official position of the Qing Dynasty in Sichuan Province. During the Railway Protection Movement, this post was held successively by Wang Renwen (acting), Zhao Erfeng, and Duanfang (acting).

description.zh-cn: 清末负责邮政、通信和交通事务的中央机构。时任大臣盛宣怀是铁路国有政策的主要推行者。
description.en: The central government agency responsible for postal services, communications, and transportation in the late Qing dynasty. The minister at the time, Sheng Xuanhuai, was the main implementer of the railway nationalization policy.

description.zh-cn: 计划连接四川与湖北的铁路。其资金主要来自四川民众的强制性集资，清廷将其强行收归国有的决定是保路运动的直接导火索。
description.en: A planned railway connecting Sichuan and Hubei. Its funding primarily came from mandatory contributions from the people of Sichuan. The Qing court's decision to forcibly nationalize it was the direct trigger of the Railway Protection Movement.

description.zh-cn: 计划连接广东与湖北的铁路。与川汉铁路一同被清廷强行收归国有，引发了包括广东在内的多省反对。
description.en: A planned railway connecting Guangdong and Hubei. Along with the Chuanhan Railway, it was forcibly nationalized by the Qing court, sparking opposition in multiple provinces, including Guangdong.

description.zh-cn: 李洪志的妻子。
description.en: The wife of Li Hongzhi.

description.zh-cn: 法轮功的主要指导书籍，由李洪志撰写，于1994年首次出版。
description.en: The main instructional book of Falun Gong, written by Li Hongzhi and first published in 1994.

description.zh-cn: 日本关东军炸毁南满铁路柳条湖段路轨并诬陷为中国军队所为的事件，是九一八事变的直接导火索。
description.en: The event where the Japanese Kwantung Army blew up a section of the South Manchuria Railway at Liutiaohu and framed the Chinese army for it, serving as the direct trigger for the Mukden Incident.

description.zh-cn: 日本在中国东北经营的铁路，关东军以其被破坏为借口发动了九一八事变。
description.en: A railway operated by Japan in Northeast China. The Kwantung Army used its alleged destruction as a pretext to launch the Mukden Incident.

description.zh-cn: 日本陆军大将，九一八事变时任关东军司令官，下令进攻中国军队。
description.en: A general in the Imperial Japanese Army who was the commander of the Kwantung Army during the Mukden Incident and ordered the attack on Chinese forces.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国将领，时任黑龙江省政府代理主席，在九一八事变后组织了江桥抗战。
description.en: A general of the Republic of China, acting chairman of Heilongjiang Province, who organized the Jiangqiao Resistance after the Mukden Incident.

description.zh-cn: 九一八事变后，由马占山领导的中国军队在黑龙江嫩江桥地区抵抗日军进攻的战斗。
description.en: A battle after the Mukden Incident where Chinese forces led by Ma Zhanshan resisted the Japanese attack in the Nen River Bridge area of Heilongjiang.

description.zh-cn: 日本首相，在九一八事变后试图通过和平手段解决争端，但于五一五事件中被暗杀。
description.en: Prime Minister of Japan who attempted to resolve the dispute peacefully after the Mukden Incident but was assassinated in the May 15 Incident.

description.zh-cn: 1932年日本海军少壮派军官发动的政变，导致首相犬养毅被暗杀。
description.en: A coup d'état in Japan in 1932 launched by young naval officers, which resulted in the assassination of Prime Minister Inukai Tsuyoshi.

description.zh-cn: 一种将军事力量置于国家首要地位的意识形态。九一八事变加剧了日本的军国主义倾向。
description.en: An ideology that places military power at the forefront of the state. The Mukden Incident intensified militaristic tendencies in Japan.

description.zh-cn: 中国毛泽东思想研究者、军事学家、演讲家，南开大学教授、博士生导师，中国非军事院校首个军事学硕士点的创始人。
description.en: A Chinese researcher of Mao Zedong Thought, military scientist, and public speaker. He was a professor and doctoral supervisor at Nankai University and the founder of the first military science master's program in a non-military university in China.

description.zh-cn: 隶属于重庆市的县，是艾跃进的祖籍地。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Chongqing, it is the ancestral home of Ai Yuejin.

description.zh-cn: 一种源自胃黏膜上皮细胞的恶性肿瘤，是导致艾跃进逝世的病因。
description.en: A malignant tumor originating from the epithelial cells of the gastric mucosa, which was the cause of Ai Yuejin's death.

description.zh-cn: 浙江省湖州市下辖县，钦本立的出生地。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, and the birthplace of Qin Benli.

description.zh-cn: 浙江省的一所中学，钦本立曾在此就读，后因参与学潮被开除。
description.en: A high school in Zhejiang Province where Qin Benli studied before being expelled for participating in student activism.

description.zh-cn: 上海市的社会科学研究机构。钦本立在文革后获得平反，并调入该院任职。
description.en: A social science research institution in Shanghai. Qin Benli was politically rehabilitated after the Cultural Revolution and transferred to work at this academy.

description.zh-cn: 中国经济学家，倡导创办了《世界经济导报》。
description.en: A Chinese economist who advocated for the founding of the 'World Economic Herald'.

location.zh-cn: 香港金钟添马添美道2号政府总部东翼8至10楼
location.en: 8-10/F, East Wing, Central Government Offices, 2 Tim Mei Avenue, Tamar, Admiralty, Hong Kong

description.zh-cn: 香港特别行政区政府的决策局之一，主管香港公共秩序，并统管多个纪律部队。
description.en: One of the policy bureaus of the Government of Hong Kong, responsible for public order and overseeing various disciplinary services.

description.zh-cn: 香港政治人物，现任保安局副局长。
description.en: Hong Kong politician, current Under Secretary for Security.

description.zh-cn: 香港公务员，现任保安局常任秘书长。
description.en: Hong Kong civil servant, current Permanent Secretary for Security.

description.zh-cn: 香港政治人物，现任保安局局长政治助理。
description.en: Hong Kong politician, current Political Assistant to the Secretary for Security.

zh-cn: 香港特别行政区政务司司长
en: Chief Secretary for Administration of Hong Kong

description.zh-cn: 香港特别行政区政府中地位仅次于行政长官的政府官员。
description.en: The government official with the second highest position in the Government of Hong Kong, after the Chief Executive.

description.zh-cn: 负责香港关税及管制的纪律部队。
description.en: The disciplinary service responsible for customs and excise control in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 负责管理香港监狱、惩教院所的纪律部队。
description.en: The disciplinary service responsible for managing prisons and correctional institutions in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 负责香港消防与救护服务的纪律部队。
description.en: The disciplinary service responsible for fire and ambulance services in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 香港的纪律部队之一，提供飞行支援服务。
description.en: One of the disciplinary services in Hong Kong, providing flying support services.

description.zh-cn: 香港保安局辖下负责协调禁毒政策和措施的部门。
description.en: A division under the Security Bureau of Hong Kong responsible for coordinating anti-drug policies and measures.

description.zh-cn: 首任防卫司，在香港保卫战后被俘，因协助盟军收集情报而被日军处决。
description.en: The first Defence Secretary, captured after the Battle of Hong Kong and executed by the Japanese military for assisting Allied forces in intelligence gathering.

zh-cn: 香港特别行政区政府总部

description.zh-cn: 港英政府时期负责辅佐香港总督的最高级行政机关。
description.en: The highest administrative body assisting the Governor of Hong Kong during the British Hong Kong period.

description.zh-cn: 首位华人保安司，并在香港主权移交后成为首任保安局局长。
description.en: The first ethnic Chinese Secretary for Security, who became the first Secretary for Security after the handover of Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 香港前保安司，于1995年2月退休。
description.en: Former Secretary for Security of Hong Kong, retired in February 1995.

zh-cn: 独立监察警方处理投诉委员会

description.zh-cn: 指香港主权移交前，港英政府在公务员体系中提升本地华人地位的政策。
description.en: Refers to the policy of the British Hong Kong government to promote local Chinese within the civil service before the handover of Hong Kong.

zh-cn: 党的群众路线教育实践活动
en: Party's Mass Line Education and Practice Activities

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党自2013年起在全党范围内开展的一项政治运动。在此活动期间，时任河北省委书记周本顺在一次专题民主生活会上进行了自我批评。
description.en: A political campaign launched by the Communist Party of China across the entire party starting in 2013. During this campaign, then-Hebei Party Secretary Zhou Benshun conducted self-criticism at a special democratic life meeting.

zh-cn: 福建省厦门市中级人民法院

description.zh-cn: 位于福建省厦门市的中华人民共和国中级人民法院，负责一审判决周本顺受贿案。
description.en: An Intermediate People's Court of the People's Republic of China located in Xiamen, Fujian, which tried and sentenced Zhou Benshun in the first instance for bribery.

description.zh-cn: 湖南省人民政府主管全省公安工作的职能部门。
description.en: The functional department of the Hunan Provincial People's Government in charge of public security work throughout the province.

zh-cn: 中国共产党邵阳市委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在邵阳市的领导机关。
description.en: The leading organ of the Communist Party of China in Shaoyang City.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国湖南省怀化市下辖的县，是周本顺的出生地。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Huaihua City, Hunan Province, People's Republic of China, and the birthplace of Zhou Benshun.

zh-cn: 中国地震局离退休干部办公室

location.zh-cn: 北京市海淀区复兴路63号
location.en: No. 63 Fuxing Road, Haidian District, Beijing

description.zh-cn: 中国地震局直属的内设职能机构，负责地震系统离退休干部管理工作。
description.en: An internal functional agency directly under the China Earthquake Administration, responsible for the management of retired cadres in the earthquake system.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国对外文化联络委员会
国务院对外文化联络委员会
en: Commission for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries of the People's Republic of China

zh-cn: 江苏公安管理干部学院
江苏省公安交巡警队长学校
江苏省公安刑警队长学校
江苏省公安派出所长学校
en: Jiangsu Public Security Management Cadre College

description.zh-cn: 江苏警官学院是一所位于中国江苏省南京市的公安政法类本科院校。其历史可追溯至1949年6月成立的南京市公安学校。学校历经多次更名与合并，其中包含全国第一所公安专科学校，并有学校分别于1998年9月和2000年6月合并入江苏公安专科学校。学院最终于2002年正式成立为江苏警官学院，自2004年3月起增挂牌子，作为同一机构运营。
description.en: Jiangsu Police Institute is a public security and political science undergraduate institution located in Nanjing, Jiangsu, China. Its history can be traced back to the Nanjing Public Security School, established in June 1949. The school underwent multiple name changes and mergers, including the first public security junior college in China, and other schools that merged into Jiangsu Public Security College in September 1998 and June 2000, respectively. It was officially established as the Jiangsu Police Institute in 2002, and has operated as the same institution with an additional nameplate since March 2004.

zh-cn: 东突厥斯坦伊斯兰运动
东突厥斯坦民族革命阵线
叙利亚突厥斯坦伊斯兰党

location.zh-cn: 巴基斯坦北瓦济里斯坦、叙利亚伊德利卜、中国新疆、阿富汗
location.en: North Waziristan, Pakistan; Idlib, Syria; Xinjiang, China; Afghanistan

description.zh-cn: 突厥斯坦伊斯兰党是一个活跃于中亚和叙利亚的维吾尔族伊斯兰主义武装极端组织，其头目被认为是瓦哈比派信徒。该组织的目标是在整个突厥斯坦（包括中国新疆和中亚各国）建立独立的伊斯兰国家，并被联合国、中国等认定为恐怖组织。其叙利亚分支活跃于叙利亚内战，并于2025年1月宣布解散并并入叙利亚国防部。
description.en: The Turkistan Islamic Party is a Uyghur Islamist armed extremist group active in Central Asia and Syria, whose leader is considered a follower of Wahhabism. Its goal is to establish an independent Islamic state in the entire Turkestan region (including Xinjiang, China and Central Asian countries). It is designated as a terrorist organization by the United Nations, China, and others. Its Syrian branch was active in the Syrian Civil War and announced its dissolution and merger into the Syrian Ministry of Defense in January 2025.

description.zh-cn: 突厥斯坦伊斯兰党的重建者和前领导人，2003年被巴基斯坦军队击毙。
description.en: Re-founder and former leader of the Turkistan Islamic Party, killed by the Pakistani military in 2003.

description.zh-cn: 突厥斯坦伊斯兰党的重建者之一。
description.en: One of the re-founders of the Turkistan Islamic Party.

zh-cn: 阿卜杜勒·哈克·突厥斯坦尼

description.zh-cn: 突厥斯坦伊斯兰党的现任领导人，曾于2010年被美军导弹击伤。
description.en: The current leader of the Turkistan Islamic Party, who was reportedly wounded in a US missile strike in 2010.

zh-cn: 1997年乌鲁木齐“2.25”公共汽车爆炸案
乌鲁木齐公共汽车爆炸案

description.zh-cn: 1997年发生在乌鲁木齐的一系列公共汽车爆炸案，由“东伊运”策划。
description.en: A series of bus bombings in Ürümqi in 1997, planned by ETIM.

description.zh-cn: 负责英国移民、安全和法律与秩序的政府部门。于2016年7月将突厥斯坦伊斯兰党列入被禁恐怖组织名单。
description.en: The UK government department responsible for immigration, security, and law and order. It added the Turkistan Islamic Party to its list of proscribed terrorist organisations in July 2016.

description.zh-cn: 代表海外维吾尔族世俗东突独立势力的主要组织。与以“东伊运”为代表的伊斯兰化势力争夺话语权。
description.en: The main organization representing secular East Turkestan independence forces among Uyghurs abroad. It competes with Islamist forces like ETIM for narrative control.

description.zh-cn: 叙利亚过渡政府成立后组建的国防机构，吸收了包括叙利亚突厥斯坦伊斯兰党在内的多个前反对派武装派别。
description.en: The defense body formed after the establishment of the Syrian transitional government, which absorbed several former opposition armed factions, including the Turkistan Islamic Party in Syria.

description.zh-cn: 叙利亚内战期间由多个伊斯兰主义反政府武装组成的联盟，突厥斯坦伊斯兰党曾是其成员。
description.en: An alliance of several Islamist anti-government armed groups during the Syrian Civil War, of which the Turkistan Islamic Party was a member.

description.zh-cn: 逊尼派伊斯兰教法学的四大主流学派之一，穆罕默德·伊本·阿卜杜勒·瓦哈卜的思想渊源于此。
description.en: One of the four major schools of Islamic jurisprudence within Sunni Islam, from which the thoughts of Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab were derived.

description.zh-cn: 伊斯兰学者，其复古主义思想对穆罕默德·伊本·阿卜杜勒·瓦哈卜有重要影响。
description.en: An Islamic scholar whose revivalist thought significantly influenced Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab.

description.zh-cn: 沙特阿拉伯的王室家族，其领袖穆罕默德·本·沙特与瓦哈比派合作，促成了沙特国家的建立。
description.en: The royal family of Saudi Arabia. Its leader, Muhammad bin Saud, cooperated with the Wahhabi movement, which led to the establishment of the Saudi state.

description.zh-cn: 伊斯兰教的主要教派之一，瓦哈比派是其内部的一个运动。
description.en: One of the main branches of Islam, within which Wahhabism is a movement.

description.zh-cn: 伊斯兰教的神秘主义派别，被瓦哈比派视为异端。
description.en: The mystical branch of Islam, considered heretical by Wahhabism.

description.zh-cn: 社会从宗教价值观向非宗教价值观转变的过程，受到瓦哈比派的反对。
description.en: The process of a society's transformation from religious values to non-religious values, which is opposed by Wahhabism.

description.zh-cn: 一个伊斯兰术语，指穆斯林维护和传播宗教的责任。瓦哈比派主张对所谓的异端和异教徒进行圣战。
description.en: An Islamic term referring to the religious duty of Muslims to maintain and spread the religion. Wahhabism advocates for jihad against so-called heretics and infidels.

zh-cn: 伊奇克里亚车臣共和国

description.zh-cn: 车臣的分离主义政府，曾为争取外部援助而与瓦哈比派分子合作。
description.en: A secessionist government of Chechnya that once cooperated with Wahhabi elements to gain external support.

description.zh-cn: 东突厥斯坦伊斯兰党头目，与瓦哈比派有关系。
description.en: Leader of the Turkistan Islamic Party, who has ties to Wahhabism.

zh-cn: 2014年昆明火车站暴力恐怖袭击事件

description.zh-cn: 制造2014年3月1日昆明火车站暴恐事件的恐怖组织头目。该事件发生在中国昆明，其实施者被认为与瓦哈比派思想有关。
description.en: The leader of the terrorist group that carried out the March 1, 2014 Kunming Railway Station terrorist attack. This incident occurred in Kunming, China, and its perpetrators are believed to be linked to Wahhabi ideology.

description.zh-cn: 在法国巴黎发生的一系列恐怖袭击事件，该事件促使德国副总理要求沙特停止资助极端主义。
description.en: A series of terrorist attacks in Paris, France, which prompted the German Vice Chancellor to call for Saudi Arabia to stop funding extremism.

description.zh-cn: 德国政治家，曾任副总理。在2015年巴黎袭击事件后，他要求沙特阿拉伯停止资助宣扬极端宗教思想的清真寺。
description.en: A German politician and former Vice Chancellor. After the 2015 Paris attacks, he demanded that Saudi Arabia stop funding mosques that promote extremist religious ideology.

description.zh-cn: 中国企业家，新浪网创始人之一，曾任新浪总裁兼CEO。他也是四通利方的创始人之一。
description.en: Chinese entrepreneur, a co-founder of Sina.com, and served as its President and CEO. He was also a co-founder of SRSNet.

description.zh-cn: 中国企业家，新浪网创始人之一，曾先后担任新浪总裁、CEO、副董事长及代理董事长等职务。
description.en: Chinese entrepreneur, a co-founder of Sina.com, and has served in various roles including President, CEO, Vice Chairman, and Acting Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 台湾企业家，华渊资讯公司创始人，新浪网创始人之一，曾任新浪副董事长。
description.en: Taiwanese entrepreneur, founder of Sinanet, and a co-founder of Sina.com, where he served as Vice Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 中国企业家，现任新浪董事长兼CEO。他于2009年领导了新浪的管理层收购（MBO）。
description.en: Chinese business executive, currently the Chairman and CEO of Sina. He led Sina's management buyout (MBO) in 2009.

description.zh-cn: 新浪公司党委书记。
description.en: Party Secretary of Sina Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 中国互联网公司，与新浪、腾讯和网易并称为中国四大门户网站。
description.en: A Chinese internet company, known as one of the four major portal websites in China along with Sina, Tencent, and NetEase.

description.zh-cn: 中国民营高科技企业，是四通利方的创办者之一。
description.en: A Chinese private high-tech enterprise and one of the founders of SRSNet.

description.zh-cn: 中国计算机科学家，CCDOS发明人，四通利方的创始人之一。
description.en: Chinese computer scientist, inventor of CCDOS, and a co-founder of SRSNet.

description.zh-cn: 中国网络游戏公司，曾在2005年意图收购新浪但未成功。
description.en: A Chinese online gaming company that attempted an unsuccessful takeover of Sina in 2005.

description.zh-cn: 中国企业家，曾任新浪董事，于2008年退出董事会。
description.en: Chinese entrepreneur who served as a director on Sina's board until his departure in 2008.

description.zh-cn: 中国视频分享网站，新浪曾于2011年对其进行投资。
description.en: A Chinese video-sharing website in which Sina invested in 2011.

description.zh-cn: 新浪高管，曾任首席技术官兼联席总裁。
description.en: Sina executive who served as CTO and Co-President.

description.zh-cn: 由新浪于2005年上线的网络日志频道，曾是中国主流的博客平台之一，于2022年4月关闭。
description.en: An online blog channel launched by Sina in 2005. It was one of the mainstream blog platforms in China and was shut down in April 2022.

description.zh-cn: 由微软公司推出的门户网站和相关互联网服务，曾于2010年与新浪签署合作协议。
description.en: A web portal and related collection of Internet services offered by Microsoft, which signed a cooperation agreement with Sina in 2010.

description.zh-cn: 美国职业篮球联赛，于2013年与新浪建立战略合作伙伴关系。
description.en: A professional basketball league in the United States that established a strategic partnership with Sina in 2013.

description.zh-cn: 浙江省的广播电视机构，于2017年与新浪签署战略合作协议。
description.en: The broadcasting and television organization of Zhejiang Province, which signed a strategic cooperation agreement with Sina in 2017.

zh-cn: 全国“扫黄打非”工作小组办公室

description.zh-cn: 中国负责打击淫秽色情和非法出版物的政府机构，曾在2014年因传播淫秽色情信息问题处罚新浪。
description.en: A Chinese government agency responsible for combating pornography and illegal publications, which penalized Sina in 2014 for disseminating obscene and pornographic content.

description.zh-cn: 新浪首席财务官。
description.en: Chief Financial Officer of Sina.

description.zh-cn: 英国自由党政治家，曾任英国首相。
description.en: British Liberal politician who served as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 1946年温斯顿·丘吉尔在美国发表的著名演说，常被视为冷战开始的标志。
description.en: A famous speech delivered by Winston Churchill in the United States in 1946, often considered the starting signal of the Cold War.

description.zh-cn: 年羹尧之妹，雍正帝的妃嫔，初为侧福晋，后晋封为皇贵妃。
description.en: The younger sister of Nian Gengyao and a consort of the Yongzheng Emperor. She was initially a side consort and was later elevated to the rank of Imperial Noble Consort.

description.zh-cn: 清朝官员，曾任湖广巡抚，是年羹尧的父亲。
description.en: A Qing dynasty official who served as the Governor of Huguang. He was the father of Nian Gengyao.

description.zh-cn: 清朝将领，曾在年羹尧麾下参与平定青海罗卜藏丹津叛乱，后接任年羹尧的川陕总督之职。
description.en: A Qing dynasty general who served under Nian Gengyao in suppressing the rebellion of Lobsang Tendzin in Qinghai. He later succeeded Nian as the Viceroy of Sichuan and Shaanxi.

description.zh-cn: 年羹尧的幕客与亲信，在年羹尧死后因其著作《西征随笔》被雍正帝下令斩首。
description.en: An advisor and confidant of Nian Gengyao. After Nian's death, he was beheaded by order of the Yongzheng Emperor due to his book 'Notes on the Western Expedition'.

description.zh-cn: 清朝翰林院侍讲，因作诗谄媚颂扬年羹尧，在年羹尧案后被雍正帝斥为“名教罪人”并革职。
description.en: A Hanlin Academy Expositor-in-waiting of the Qing dynasty. He was denounced by the Yongzheng Emperor as a 'sinner against Confucian morality' and dismissed from office for writing poems that flattered and praised Nian Gengyao.

description.zh-cn: 清朝官员，曾任巡抚。在年羹尧权势鼎盛时，曾被迫在路边跪迎年羹尧。
description.en: A Qing dynasty official who served as a provincial governor. At the height of Nian Gengyao's power, he was forced to kneel on the roadside to greet Nian.

description.zh-cn: 年羹尧之兄，曾任工部侍郎、内务府总管大臣。
description.en: The elder brother of Nian Gengyao, who served as Vice Minister of Works and Minister of the Imperial Household Department.

description.zh-cn: 年羹尧的籍贯所在地，位于辽东。
description.en: Nian Gengyao's ancestral home, located in Liaodong.

description.zh-cn: 年羹尧之子。年羹尧被赐死后，年富被处斩。
description.en: Son of Nian Gengyao. After Nian Gengyao was ordered to commit suicide, Nian Fu was executed.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗前总统，政治立场为温和派。在2017年总统选举中击败易卜拉欣·莱希，并在2021年任期届满后由莱希接替。
description.en: Former President of Iran with a moderate political stance. He defeated Ebrahim Raisi in the 2017 presidential election and was succeeded by Raisi after his term ended in 2021.

zh-cn: 2024年瓦尔扎甘直升机坠毁事故

description.zh-cn: 导致时任伊朗总统易卜拉欣·莱希和外交部长侯赛因·阿米尔-阿卜杜拉希扬等人遇难的直升机坠毁事件。
description.en: A helicopter crash that resulted in the deaths of then-Iranian President Ebrahim Raisi, Foreign Minister Hossein Amir-Abdollahian, and others.

zh-cn: 侯赛因·阿米尔-阿卜杜拉希扬

description.zh-cn: 伊朗外交部长，在易卜拉欣·莱希总统任内任职，并与莱希在2024年瓦尔扎甘直升机坠毁事故中一同遇难。
description.en: Foreign Minister of Iran who served during the presidency of Ebrahim Raisi and died alongside him in the 2024 Varzaqan helicopter crash.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗政治人物。在易卜拉欣·莱希担任总统期间任副总统，并在莱希逝世后代理总统职务。
description.en: Iranian politician. He served as Vice President during Ebrahim Raisi's presidency and became acting president after Raisi's death.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗第二大城市和什叶派圣地，是易卜拉欣·莱希的出生地和安葬地。
description.en: The second-largest city in Iran and a holy city for Shia Muslims, it is the birthplace and burial place of Ebrahim Raisi.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗库姆市的什叶派神学院，易卜拉欣·莱希曾在此学习。
description.en: A Shia seminary in the city of Qom, Iran, where Ebrahim Raisi studied.

description.zh-cn: 1988年，伊朗政府对数千名政治犯执行死刑的事件。易卜拉欣·莱希被指控是负责此次处决的“死亡委员会”成员之一。
description.en: An event in 1988 where the Iranian government executed thousands of political prisoners. Ebrahim Raisi is accused of being a member of the 'death committee' responsible for these executions.

description.zh-cn: 阿里·哈梅内伊的儿子。在易卜拉欣·莱希去世后，被外界认为是伊朗最高领袖的热门继承人选之一。
description.en: Son of Ali Khamenei. After the death of Ebrahim Raisi, he is considered by outsiders to be one of the leading candidates to succeed the Supreme Leader of Iran.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗阿亚图拉，曾为霍梅尼指定的继承人。他公开反对1988年对政治犯的处决，称其为“伊斯兰共和国历史上最大的罪行”，随后失势。
description.en: An Iranian Ayatollah, once the designated successor to Khomeini. He publicly opposed the 1988 executions of political prisoners, calling them 'the greatest crime in the history of the Islamic Republic,' and subsequently fell from favor.

description.zh-cn: 清末太监，据传奉慈禧太后之命将珍妃投入井中。
description.en: A court eunuch in the late Qing dynasty, who allegedly threw Consort Zhen into a well under the order of Empress Dowager Cixi.

description.zh-cn: 珍妃的兄长，礼部侍郎。因珍妃案被贬谪至乌里雅苏台。
description.en: The elder brother of Consort Zhen and a Vice Minister of Rites. He was demoted and exiled to Uliastai due to his sister's case.

description.zh-cn: 清代八旗之一，珍妃所属的旗籍。
description.en: One of the Eight Banners of the Qing dynasty, to which Consort Zhen's clan belonged.

description.zh-cn: 中国内地广播、电视双栖主持人，供职于上海广播电视台东方广播中心，主任播音员职称，中国共产党党员。
description.en: A mainland Chinese radio and television host, working at the Oriental Radio Center of Shanghai Media Group, holding the title of Chief Announcer, and a member of the Communist Party of China.

zh-cn: 华东师范大学第二附属中学
en: No. 2 High School of East China Normal University

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年官员，徐州富商，麋夫人的兄长。
description.en: An official and wealthy merchant from Xuzhou during the late Eastern Han dynasty, and the elder brother of Lady Mi.

description.zh-cn: 东汉时期东海郡下辖的一个县，为麋夫人的出生地。
description.en: A county under Donghai Commandery during the Eastern Han dynasty, the birthplace of Lady Mi.

description.zh-cn: 李井泉的第一任妻子，在文化大革命中被迫害致死。
description.en: Li Jingquan's first wife, who was persecuted to death during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 八路军的主力师之一。
description.en: One of the main divisions of the Eighth Route Army.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中共山东省委第一书记，是三年困难时期山东省饥荒的主要责任人之一。
description.en: Former First Secretary of the Shandong Provincial Committee of the CPC, one of the main figures responsible for the famine in Shandong Province during the Three Years of Great Famine.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中共甘肃省委第一书记，是三年困难时期甘肃省饥荒的主要责任人之一。
description.en: Former First Secretary of the Gansu Provincial Committee of the CPC, one of the main figures responsible for the famine in Gansu Province during the Three Years of Great Famine.

description.zh-cn: 1953年发生在香港石硖尾寮屋区的一场严重火灾。
description.en: A major fire in 1953 in the Shek Kip Mei squatter area in Hong Kong.

zh-cn: 中华基督教会协和小学

description.zh-cn: 吴宇森曾就读的小学。
description.en: The primary school John Woo attended.

zh-cn: 地利亚修女纪念学校（协和二中）
地利亚修女纪念学校（利玛窦）

description.zh-cn: 吴宇森曾就读的中学之一。
description.en: One of the secondary schools John Woo attended.

description.zh-cn: 吴宇森毕业的中学。
description.en: The secondary school from which John Woo graduated.

description.zh-cn: 香港电影公司，吴宇森早期在此执导了多部喜剧片。
description.en: A Hong Kong film company where John Woo directed several comedies early in his career.

description.zh-cn: 吴宇森执导的香港动作电影，奠定其暴力美学风格，并获得商业和评论上的巨大成功。
description.en: A Hong Kong action film directed by John Woo, which established his style of violent aesthetics and achieved huge commercial and critical success.

description.zh-cn: 香港著名演员，与吴宇森多次合作，主演了《英雄本色》等多部经典影片。
description.en: A famous Hong Kong actor who frequently collaborated with John Woo, starring in classics like 'A Better Tomorrow'.

description.zh-cn: 吴宇森执导的动作电影，为其在国际上赢得了广泛赞誉。
description.en: An action film directed by John Woo that earned him widespread international acclaim.

description.zh-cn: 吴宇森在好莱坞执导的动作惊悚片，由约翰·特拉沃尔塔和尼古拉斯·凯奇主演，取得了巨大的商业成功。
description.en: An action thriller directed by John Woo in Hollywood, starring John Travolta and Nicolas Cage, which was a major commercial success.

description.zh-cn: 美国演员，主演了吴宇森执导的《断箭》和《夺面双雄》。
description.en: An American actor who starred in John Woo's films 'Broken Arrow' and 'Face/Off'.

description.zh-cn: 台湾导演，其作品《赛德克·巴莱》由吴宇森监制。
description.en: A Taiwanese director whose film 'Seediq Bale' was produced by John Woo.

description.zh-cn: 由魏德圣执导、吴宇森监制的台湾史诗电影。
description.en: A Taiwanese epic film directed by Wei Te-sheng and produced by John Woo.

description.zh-cn: 中国抗日战争时期的最高决策机关。
description.en: The supreme decision-making body during the Second Sino-Japanese War in China.

zh-cn: 中国国民党临时全国代表大会

description.zh-cn: 1938年由中国国民党临时全国代表大会通过的纲领性文件，规定组织国民参政机关。
description.en: A programmatic document passed by the Kuomintang's Provisional National Congress in 1938, which stipulated the organization of a national political participation body.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治活动家，国民参政会驻会委员，是“六参政员访问延安”的发起人之一。
description.en: A Chinese political activist, resident committee member of the People's Political Council, and one of the initiators of the 'Six Councillors' Visit to Yan'an'.

description.zh-cn: 由国民参政会宪政期成会通过的宪法草案。
description.en: A draft constitution passed by the Constitutionalism Promotion Committee of the People's Political Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国国家社会党领袖，曾任国防参议会参议员及国民参政会驻会委员。
description.en: Leader of the China National Socialist Party, who served as a member of the National Defense Council and a resident committee member of the People's Political Council.

description.zh-cn: 红一、二、四方面军在甘肃会宁地区会师，标志着长征的结束。
description.en: The rendezvous of the First, Second, and Fourth Front Armies of the Red Army in the Huining area of Gansu, marking the end of the Long March.

description.zh-cn: 中央红军在长征途中突破国民革命军第四道封锁线的战役，也是长征中最惨烈的一战。
description.en: A battle in which the Central Red Army broke through the fourth blockade line of the National Revolutionary Army during the Long March, and it was the most tragic battle of the Long March.

description.zh-cn: 遵义会议后，中央红军在贵州、四川、云南三省交界地区四次渡过赤水河的军事行动，是长征中以少胜多、变被动为主动的光辉战例。
description.en: After the Zunyi Conference, the Central Red Army crossed the Chishui River four times in the border area of Guizhou, Sichuan, and Yunnan provinces. It is a brilliant example of defeating a superior enemy and turning a passive situation into an active one during the Long March.

zh-cn: 地方各级人民代表大会

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国地方各级国家权力机关的总称。
description.en: The general term for local organs of state power at various levels in the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 由国家林业和草原局加挂的牌子。
description.en: A nameplate added to the National Forestry and Grassland Administration.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将，曾任中国人民解放军战略支援部队政治工作部主任、火箭军副政委。中共第二十届中央候补委员。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the People's Liberation Army (PLA), he has served as Director of the Political Work Department of the PLA Strategic Support Force and Deputy Political Commissar of the PLA Rocket Force. He is an alternate member of the 20th Central Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 中国江苏省盐城市下辖的县，丁兴农的出生地。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Yancheng City, Jiangsu Province, China, and the birthplace of Ding Xingnong.

description.zh-cn: 中国负责航天测控的部门。
description.en: The Chinese department responsible for aerospace tracking and control.

zh-cn: 中央军委装备发展部政治工作局

description.zh-cn: 中央军委装备发展部下属的政治工作部门，其前身为总装备部政治部。
description.en: The political work department of the Equipment Development Department of the Central Military Commission, formerly the Political Department of the General Armament Department.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军国防大学联合勤务学院
中国人民解放军后勤学院
中国人民解放军后方勤务学院

description.zh-cn: 1952年成立，原名中国人民解放军后方勤务学院，1960年更名。1986年与军事学院、政治学院合并成立国防大学。
description.en: Established in July 1952, originally named PLA Rear Services Academy and renamed in 1960. It merged with the Military Academy and the Political Academy in 1986 to form the National Defense University.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军国防大学政治学院西安校区
中国人民解放军军事航天部队航天工程大学
中国人民解放军战略支援部队航天工程大学

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上将，曾任中国人民解放军国防大学校长。
description.en: A general of the PLA, who served as President of the PLA National Defense University.

description.en: A general of the PLA, who served as President of the PLA National Defense University.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上将，曾任中国人民解放军国防大学校长。
description.en: A general of the PLA, who served as President of the PLA National Defense University.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上将，曾任中国人民解放军国防大学校长、政治委员。
description.en: A general of the PLA, who served as President and Political Commissar of the PLA National Defense University.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军空军上将，曾任中国人民解放军国防大学校长。
description.en: A general of the PLAAF, who served as President of the PLA National Defense University.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军上将，现任中国人民解放军国防大学校长。
description.en: A general of the PLA Ground Force, currently serving as the President of the PLA National Defense University.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上将，曾任中国人民解放军国防大学政治委员。
description.en: A general of the PLA, who served as Political Commissar of the PLA National Defense University.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上将，曾任中国人民解放军国防大学政治委员。
description.en: A general of the PLA, who served as Political Commissar of the PLA National Defense University.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将，曾任中国人民解放军国防大学政治委员。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the PLA, who served as Political Commissar of the PLA National Defense University.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，籍贯山东掖县。担任辽宁五一八内燃机配件有限公司董事长兼总经理，并当选为第十三届全国人民代表大会代表。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China with an ancestral home in Yexian, Shandong. He serves as the Chairman and General Manager of Liaoning 518 Internal Combustion Engine Parts Co., Ltd., and was elected as a deputy to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 杨彬的籍贯地，位于山东省。
description.en: Yang Bin's ancestral home, located in Shandong Province.

description.zh-cn: 日本在上海的军事单位，参与了虹桥机场事件及淞沪会战。
description.en: A Japanese military unit in Shanghai involved in the Hongqiao Airport Incident and the Battle of Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国上海的军用机场，是虹桥机场事件的发生地。
description.en: A military airport in Shanghai, China, and the site of the Hongqiao Airport Incident.

description.zh-cn: 1932年发生于上海的中日军事冲突，其后签订了《淞沪停战协定》。
description.en: A military conflict between China and Japan in Shanghai in 1932, which led to the signing of the Shanghai Ceasefire Agreement.

description.zh-cn: 一·二八事变后中日签订的停战协定，划定上海为非武装区，限制了中国军队的活动。
description.en: A ceasefire agreement signed by China and Japan after the January 28 Incident, which designated Shanghai as a demilitarized zone and restricted Chinese military activities.

description.zh-cn: 中国军官，时任保安团总团长，在虹桥机场事件中向张治中报告情况。
description.en: A Chinese military officer, then commander-in-chief of the Security Regiment, who reported the situation to Zhang Zhizhong during the Hongqiao Airport Incident.

description.zh-cn: 日本在上海的外交代表机构，参与了虹桥机场事件的交涉。
description.en: The diplomatic representative body of Japan in Shanghai, involved in the negotiations of the Hongqiao Airport Incident.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命后，以邓小平为代表的政治派别，主张实事求是、解放思想，推动拨乱反正和改革开放。
description.en: A political faction represented by Deng Xiaoping after the Cultural Revolution, advocating for seeking truth from facts, emancipating the mind, and promoting Boluan Fanzheng and Reform and Opening-up.

description.zh-cn: 指始于1970年代末，贯穿整个1980年代的中国大陆思想解放运动，被视为继五四运动后的第二次启蒙，以真理标准大讨论为起点。
description.en: Refers to the ideological emancipation movement in mainland China that began in the late 1970s and lasted through the 1980s. It is considered the second enlightenment after the May Fourth Movement and started with the Truth Criterion Discussion.

description.zh-cn: 美国地质学家、物理学家和教育家，麻省理工学院的创始人。
description.en: American geologist, physicist, and educator, the founder of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology.

description.zh-cn: 美国教育家，曾任哈佛大学校长，在任期间曾六次建议将麻省理工学院并入哈佛大学。
description.en: American academic who served as president of Harvard University and, during his tenure, proposed merging MIT with Harvard six times.

description.zh-cn: 美国发明家和企业家，伊士曼柯达公司的创始人，曾向麻省理工学院提供巨额匿名捐款。
description.en: American inventor and entrepreneur who founded the Eastman Kodak Company and provided large anonymous donations to MIT.

description.zh-cn: 美国物理学家，1930年至1948年担任麻省理工学院校长，期间推动了课程改革。
description.en: American physicist who served as President of MIT from 1930 to 1948, during which he pushed for curriculum reform.

description.zh-cn: 一种利用无线电波探测目标的遥感技术，麻省理工学院放射实验室在二战期间对其发展做出了关键贡献。
description.en: A remote sensing technology that uses radio waves to detect objects, whose development was critically advanced by the MIT Radiation Laboratory during World War II.

description.zh-cn: 英国计算机科学家，万维网的发明者，在麻省理工学院建立了万维网联盟。
description.en: British computer scientist, inventor of the World Wide Web, who founded the World Wide Web Consortium at MIT.

description.zh-cn: 负责制定万维网主要标准的国际标准组织，由蒂姆·伯纳斯-李在麻省理工学院创立。
description.en: The main international standards organization for the World Wide Web, founded at MIT by Tim Berners-Lee.

description.zh-cn: 2013年4月发生于美国波士顿的恐怖袭击事件，其嫌犯在事发三天后射杀了麻省理工学院警卫肖恩·科利尔。
description.en: A terrorist attack in Boston, USA, in April 2013. Three days later, the suspects shot and killed MIT police officer Sean Collier.

description.zh-cn: 加纳外交家，曾任第七任联合国秘书长，麻省理工学院校友。
description.en: A Ghanaian diplomat who served as the seventh Secretary-General of the United Nations, and an alumnus of MIT.

description.zh-cn: 美国前宇航员、工程师，曾参与阿波罗11号任务，是第二位踏上月球的人。他拥有麻省理工学院的博士学位。
description.en: American former astronaut and engineer. He was part of the Apollo 11 mission and the second person to walk on the Moon. He holds a doctorate from MIT.

description.zh-cn: 美国物理学家和企业家，因共同发明集成电路而被誉为“硅谷市长”，英特尔公司的联合创始人，麻省理工学院校友。
description.en: American physicist and entrepreneur nicknamed 'the Mayor of Silicon Valley' for co-inventing the integrated circuit. He was a co-founder of Intel Corporation and an alumnus of MIT.

description.zh-cn: 一家以生产高端音响设备闻名的美国制造公司，由麻省理工学院校友及教授Amar Bose创办。
description.en: An American manufacturing company known for high-end audio equipment, founded by MIT alumnus and professor Amar Bose.

description.zh-cn: 美国神经科学家，曾担任麻省理工学院第16任校长，是该校第一位女校长。
description.en: American neuroscientist who served as the 16th president of MIT, becoming the first woman to hold the position.

location.zh-cn: 中国广东省潮州市湘桥区西荣路48号

description.zh-cn: 潮州广播电视台，是中华人民共和国广东省潮州市的市级广播电视媒体。它于2004年由潮州人民广播电台及潮州电视台合并成立。潮州电视台作为其前身之一，主要在1987年至2004年间提供电视服务。
description.en: Chaozhou Broadcast Television Station is a municipal-level radio and television media outlet in Chaozhou, Guangdong Province, People's Republic of China. It was formed in 2004 by the merger of Chaozhou People's Radio Station and Chaozhou Television Station. Chaozhou Television Station, as one of its predecessors, primarily provided television services from 1987 to 2004.

zh-cn: 南方广播影视传媒集团

description.zh-cn: 潮州广播电视台的上级单位。
description.en: The parent organization of Chaozhou Broadcast Television Station.

description.zh-cn: 中国的国家网络电视播出机构。
description.en: China's national web-based television broadcaster.

description.zh-cn: 中国广东省下辖的地级市。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Guangdong Province, China.

description.zh-cn: 中国广东省下辖的地级市。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Guangdong Province, China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国广东省潮州市的地方国家行政机关。
description.en: The local state administrative organ of Chaozhou City, Guangdong Province, People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十九届中央委员会第二次全体会议
en: Second Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 讨论研究修改宪法部分内容的建议。
description.en: Discussed and studied proposals for amending parts of the Constitution.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十九届中央委员会第三次全体会议
en: Third Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 审议通过了关于深化党和国家机构改革的决定和方案。
description.en: Reviewed and adopted the decision and plan on deepening the reform of Party and state institutions.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十九届中央委员会第四次全体会议
en: Fourth Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 审议通过了关于坚持和完善中国特色社会主义制度、推进国家治理体系和治理能力现代化若干重大问题的决定。
description.en: Reviewed and adopted the Decision on Some Major Issues Concerning How to Uphold and Improve the System of Socialism with Chinese Characteristics and Advance the Modernization of China's System and Capacity for Governance.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，在中共十九届四中全会上被递补为中央委员。
description.en: A Chinese politician who was made a full member of the Central Committee at the Fourth Plenary Session of the 19th CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国工程技术专家，在中共十九届四中全会上被递补为中央委员。
description.en: A Chinese engineering expert who was made a full member of the Central Committee at the Fourth Plenary Session of the 19th CPC Central Committee.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十九届中央委员会第五次全体会议
en: Fifth Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 审议通过了《中共中央关于制定国民经济和社会发展第十四个五年规划和2035年远景目标的建议》。
description.en: Reviewed and adopted the 'Proposals of the CPC Central Committee for Formulating the 14th Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035'.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十九届中央委员会第六次全体会议
en: Sixth Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 审议通过了《中共中央关于党的百年奋斗重大成就和历史经验的决议》和《关于召开党的第二十次全国代表大会的决议》。
description.en: Reviewed and adopted the 'Resolution of the CPC Central Committee on the Major Achievements and Historical Experience of the Party over the Past Century' and the 'Resolution on the Convening of the 20th National Congress of the Party'.

zh-cn: 关于党的百年奋斗重大成就和历史经验的决议
中共中央关于党的百年奋斗重大成就和历史经验的决议
en: Resolution of the CPC Central Committee on the Major Achievements and Historical Experience of the Party over the Past Century

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党通过的第三个历史决议，总结了党的百年历史。
description.en: The third historical resolution passed by the Communist Party of China, summarizing the party's century-long history.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十九届中央委员会第七次全体会议
en: Seventh Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 决定中国共产党第二十次全国代表大会于2022年10月16日在北京召开。
description.en: Decided that the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China would be convened in Beijing on October 16, 2022.

description.zh-cn: 中国白族作家、文艺理论家，曾任云南大学中文系系主任。
description.en: A Chinese writer and literary theorist of Bai ethnicity, formerly the head of the Department of Chinese at Yunnan University.

description.zh-cn: 由商鞅在秦国推行的政治和经济改革，是秦国能统一六国的重要原因。
description.en: Political and economic reforms implemented by Shang Yang in the State of Qin, a key reason for Qin's ability to unify the six states.

description.zh-cn: 西汉时期的史学家和思想家，首次将法家思想的流派命名为“法家”。
description.en: A historian and thinker of the Western Han Dynasty who first named the school of Legalist thought as 'Legalism'.

description.zh-cn: 春秋时期齐国政治家，辅佐齐桓公，其改革被一些学者认为是法家的起源。
description.en: A statesman of the State of Qi during the Spring and Autumn period who assisted Duke Huan of Qi. His reforms are considered by some scholars to be the origin of Legalism.

description.zh-cn: 春秋时期齐国国君，春秋五霸之首，在管仲辅佐下称霸。
description.en: The ruler of the State of Qi during the Spring and Autumn period, the first of the Five Hegemons, who achieved hegemony with the assistance of Guan Zhong.

description.zh-cn: 南开大学历史系教授，认为法家思想与法西斯主义有相通之处。
description.en: A professor of history at Nankai University who believed there were parallels between Legalist thought and fascism.

properties.period: 春秋末期 - 战国初期

description.zh-cn: 孔子弟子，孔门十哲之一，在晋国西河办学，培养出李悝、吴起等法家代表人物。
description.en: A disciple of Confucius and one of the Ten Wise Ones of the Confucian School. He established a school in Xihe of the Jin state, where he educated future Legalist representatives like Li Kui and Wu Qi.

description.zh-cn: 战国初期军事家、政治家，法家代表人物，曾师从子夏和曾申。
description.en: A military strategist and statesman of the early Warring States period, a representative of Legalism, who studied under Zixia and Zeng Shen.

description.zh-cn: 中国诗人，曾任中国作家协会副主席、西北艺术学院院长等职务。
description.en: Chinese poet, who served as vice chairman of the China Writers Association and president of the Northwest Art College.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国云南省，是柯仲平的出生地。
description.en: A county in Yunnan Province, China, and the birthplace of Ke Zhongping.

description.zh-cn: 清朝时期的云南省，是曾泽生的出生地所在省份。
description.en: Yunnan Province during the Qing Dynasty, the province where Zeng Zesheng was born.

description.zh-cn: 位于云南省的县，是曾泽生的出生地。
description.en: A county in Yunnan Province, the birthplace of Zeng Zesheng.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军第五十军
中国人民解放军第五十军
en: 60th Corps of the National Revolutionary Army
50th Corps of the People's Liberation Army

description.zh-cn: 原为龙云的滇系部队，后在长春围困战中由军长曾泽生率领起义，并被改编为中国人民解放军第五十军。
description.en: Originally a unit of Long Yun's Yunnan clique, it defected under the leadership of its commander Zeng Zesheng during the Siege of Changchun and was reorganized into the 50th Corps of the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军第五十军首任政治部主任。
description.en: The first Director of the Political Department of the 50th Corps of the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 抗美援朝战争期间的一次战役，在此次战役中，曾泽生麾下的陈屏率部率先攻入汉城。
description.en: A campaign during the Korean War, in which Chen Ping, under Zeng Zesheng's command, led his troops to be the first to enter Seoul.

description.zh-cn: 授予在解放战争时期参加革命战争有功而无重大过失的人员的勋章。曾泽生于1955年荣获一级解放勋章。
description.en: A medal awarded to personnel who participated in the War of Liberation with meritorious service and without major faults. Zeng Zesheng was awarded the First Class Order of Liberation in 1955.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国的勋章。曾泽生于1953年获朝鲜授予一级国旗勋章。
description.en: An order of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Zeng Zesheng was awarded the First Class Order of the National Flag by North Korea in 1953.

description.zh-cn: 中央军委政治工作部宣传局与国防部国际传播局一个机构两块牌子
由时任中共中央主席毛泽东发动和领导了无产阶级文化大革命。
description.en: The Cultural Revolution was initiated and led by then-CCP Chairman Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 该通知的通过标志着文化大革命的全面发动。
该文的发表被视为文革的导火索。
发表《评新编历史剧〈海瑞罢官〉》一文，该文被认为是文革的导火索。
在七千人大会上（1962年），刘少奇对大跃进的批评引起毛泽东的不满，成为两人后续政治斗争的伏笔。此后，刘少奇与毛泽东在国家治理和阶级斗争等问题上分歧日益严重。在四清运动问题上（1965年），双方分歧加剧，毛泽东下决心在政治上打倒刘少奇。在文化大革命期间，刘少奇被毛泽东作为“党内头号走资派”和“资产阶级司令部”的主要代表进行批判和打倒，并最终被迫害致死。
在文化大革命中，刘少奇被错误地打成“叛徒、内奸、工贼”和“党内头号走资本主义道路的当权派”，其政治局常委排名下降，后被撤销一切职务并开除党籍，遭到残酷迫害，最终含冤去世。文革期间，数十万红卫兵曾包围中南海，试图抓出时任国家主席刘少奇。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Liu Shaoqi was wrongly branded as a 'traitor, renegade, and scab' and 'the top capitalist roader in the Party'. His ranking in the Politburo Standing Committee declined, he was subsequently stripped of all his posts, expelled from the Party, subjected to brutal persecution, and ultimately died with an unredressed grievance. During the Cultural Revolution, hundreds of thousands of Red Guards once surrounded Zhongnanhai, attempting to seize the then-State Chairman Liu Shaoqi.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，邓小平作为“党内第二号走资派”被打倒，被撤销一切职务。他的“猫论”被列为罪状之一，并被下放至江西劳动。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Deng Xiaoping was overthrown as the 'No. 2 capitalist roader in the Party' and stripped of all his posts. His 'cat theory' was listed as one of his 'crimes', and he was sent to Jiangxi for manual labor.

description.zh-cn: 协助毛泽东发动文革
文革结束后领导“拨乱反正”，并通过《关于建国以来党的若干历史问题的决议》全面否定文化大革命。
该决议公开全盘否定文革，称其为“给党、国家和各族人民带来严重灾难的内乱”。
怀仁堂政变（粉碎“四人帮”）标志着文化大革命的正式结束。
description.en: The Huairentang Coup (the smashing of the 'Gang of Four') marked the official end of the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 作为主要领导者，与叶剑英、汪东兴等人策划并实施了逮捕“四人帮”的行动，即“粉碎四人帮”政变。
作为主要领导者之一，与华国锋、汪东兴等人达成一致，支持并参与决策，并策划实施了逮捕“四人帮”的行动，即史称的“粉碎四人帮”政变。
与华国锋、叶剑英等人发动政变“粉碎四人帮”，作为决策人之一，并以中央警卫部队（8341部队）领导身份，支持并执行了逮捕行动。
文革催生了红卫兵运动。
红卫兵是“破四旧”运动的主要执行力量，破坏了大量文物古迹。
description.en: The Red Guards were the main force executing the 'Destroy the Four Olds' movement, destroying a large number of cultural relics and historical sites.

description.zh-cn: 上海“一月风暴”成为全国“夺权运动”的开始。
与姚文元赴上海支持王洪文夺权。
王洪文作为上海工人造反派领袖，领导“工总司”等造反派组织夺取了中共上海市委的权力。
江青提出“文攻武卫”口号，激化了武斗。
提出“文攻武卫”口号。
毛泽东发出指示“知识青年到农村去，接受贫下中农的再教育，很有必要”，开启了大规模的上山下乡运动。
description.en: Mao Zedong issued the directive 'It is highly necessary for educated youth to go to the countryside to be re-educated by the poor and lower-middle peasants,' initiating the large-scale Down to the Countryside Movement.

description.zh-cn: 该运动旨在打倒邓小平，并导致其第三次下台。
邓小平在中共十一届三中全会后成为实际最高领导人，开启并主导了改革开放政策，并被官方评价为“改革开放的总设计师”。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping is officially acclaimed as the 'Chief Architect of Reform and Opening-up'.

description.zh-cn: 提出并领导了“拨乱反正”，平反冤假错案。
文化大革命影响了法国五月革命等政治事件。
被迫害致死
被迫害致死
撰写大字报，矛头直指刘少奇和邓小平
赫鲁晓夫的秘密报告使毛泽东开始关注“防修反修”并恐惧自己死后被否定。
江青位居政治团体“四人帮”之首。
林彪在文化大革命期间制造的第一起内部陷害案件。
事件后，华国锋在中共中央政治局紧急会议上被推举为中共中央主席、中央军委主席，成为最高领导人。
导致毛泽东自我检讨后退居二线
作为发动文革的目的之一
与《五一六通知》同为文革的纲领性文件
在中国大陆进行全方位的阶级斗争
夺权运动导致公检法体系被摧毁
各派间的夺权运动引发了武斗
各派间的武斗导致了全面内战，是文化大革命的重要组成部分。
是文革中期重要的政治清洗运动。
文革后期四人帮势力逐渐上升
将毛泽东思想写入宪法
将文革“四大”写入宪法
在文化大革命期间受到迫害和下放
该会议的召开标志着改革开放的正式开始。
会议通过了《关于建国以来党的若干历史问题的决议》。
在文化大革命初期，倡导对毛泽东的个人崇拜，称“毛主席的话句句是真理”
指示江青等人策划发表该文
指使姚文元编写该文，并策划发表。
主持起草《二月提纲》，试图将学术讨论与政治问题分离。
试图将对《海瑞罢官》的批判局限于纯学术范围
指示彻底批判并撤销《二月提纲》
毛泽东在天安门多次接见红卫兵，回信支持清华附中红卫兵的造反运动，并对红卫兵运动和“破四旧”表示支持和鼓励，从而推动了红卫兵运动。
description.en: Mao Zedong met with Red Guards multiple times at Tiananmen, replying to support the rebellion movement of Tsinghua Affiliated High School Red Guards, and expressing support and encouragement for the Red Guard movement and 'Destroy the Four Olds', thereby promoting the Red Guard movement.

description.zh-cn: 支持谢富治“砸烂公检法”的主张
在党章中被确立为毛泽东的接班人
受毛泽东青睐和提拔，一度被认为是其接班人，后被冷落
决定恢复邓小平的职务，使其第二次复出
运动中有针对四人帮的抗议
毛泽东提议华国锋任中共中央第一副主席、国务院总理，并多次提名和提拔华国锋，视其为接班人。
作为文化大革命的急先锋和主要参与者，进行了阶级斗争、破四旧和大串联等活动。
毛泽东崇拜推动了文化大革命。
是文革期间个人崇拜的极端表现之一。
拨乱反正运动旨在纠正和否定文化大革命的错误。
是文革期间的重要口号和行动，导致公检法体系被摧毁。

position.zh-cn: 接班人，中国共产党中央军事委员会副主席

description.zh-cn: 在中共九大上，林彪被确立为毛泽东的“亲密战友和接班人”，其地位被写入党章，同时他也是毛泽东的副手。
在会上接替华国锋出任中共中央主席。
四人帮在文化大革命期间（1966-1976）是批斗邓小平的主要政治力量。邓小平在1975年复出后曾进行全面整顿，与四人帮发生激烈权力斗争，因“评《水浒》运动”等事件被打击。1976年，四人帮发动“批邓、反击右倾翻案风”运动，最终导致邓小平第三次下台。
description.en: The Gang of Four was the main political force criticizing Deng Xiaoping during the Cultural Revolution and launched the 'Criticize Deng, Counterattack the Right-Deviationist Verdict-Reversal Trend' campaign in 1976, leading to Deng's third downfall.

description.zh-cn: 群众运动中包含支持邓小平的声音。
中国共产党在第二次国共内战胜利后建立了中华人民共和国。
五四运动促进了马克思主义在中国的传播，为中国共产党的成立创造了条件。毛泽东曾指出，这场运动在思想和干部方面为1921年中国共产党的成立奠定了基础。
description.en: The May Fourth Movement promoted the spread of Marxism in China and created conditions for the establishment of the Communist Party of China. Mao Zedong once pointed out that this movement laid the foundation for the establishment of the Communist Party of China in 1921 in terms of ideology and cadres.

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战以中国共产党的胜利告终，直接导致了中华人民共和国的成立。
description.en: The victory of the Chinese Communist Party in the Second Chinese Civil War directly led to the establishment of the People's Republic of China.

position.zh-cn: 中央政治局主席; 中央委员会主席

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东是中国共产党的创始成员之一和长期领导人。
毛泽东在开国大典上宣告中华人民共和国中央人民政府成立。

In 1992, Song Ping again recognized and recommended Hu Jintao for the Politburo Standing Committee of the CPC Central Committee. The sustained appreciation and recommendation from party elders like Song Ping were significant factors in Hu Jintao's ultimate rise to the paramount leadership.

该事件被官方媒体广泛宣传，是中国民众舆论对法轮功态度转变的关键点，之后当局的镇压手段更为严厉和暴力。

此次会议通过报告，撤销了赵紫阳担任的中共中央总书记、中央政治局常委、中央政治局委员、中央军委第一副主席等所有职务。
description.en: The plenum passed a report that removed Zhao Ziyang from his posts as General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee, Politburo Standing Committee member, Politburo member, and First Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 该社论将学生运动定性为“动乱”，代表了政府的强硬立场，旨在制止抗议。

position.en: Chief of the French State, Prime Minister

description.zh-cn: 1940年7月10日，法国国会决定将权力移交给元帅菲利普·贝当，建立维希政权。贝当当日被授予全权，并于7月11日成为维希法国的国家元首（任期至1944年8月20日）。他同时兼任总理（任期至1942年4月18日），掌握全部行政与立法权力。
description.en: On July 10, 1940, the French Parliament decided to transfer power to Marshal Philippe Pétain, establishing the Vichy regime. Pétain was granted full powers on that day and became the Chief of the French State (serving until August 20, 1944) on July 11. He also served as Prime Minister (serving until April 18, 1942), holding all executive and legislative powers.

三十年战争对德意志地区经济和人口造成严重摧残，导致帝国体制形骸化，皇权被严重削弱，并使帝国割裂，标志着帝国衰落的开始。
description.en: The Thirty Years' War severely devastated the economy and population of the German lands, leading to the ossification of the imperial system, severely weakening imperial power, fracturing the empire, and marking the beginning of its decline.

description.zh-cn: 和约规定神圣罗马帝国内的诸侯可享有自主权，进一步削弱了皇权。

莱茵邦联的成立及其成员的脱离严重削弱了奥地利在德意志地区的领主地位，是帝国解体的直接原因之一。
拿破仑通过军事胜利、政治操作（如建立莱茵邦联）以及向奥皇弗朗茨二世发出最后通牒，直接导致其解散神圣罗马帝国并使其灭亡。
description.en: Napoleon's military victories, political maneuvers (such as establishing the Confederation of the Rhine), and an ultimatum to Emperor Francis II directly led to his dissolution of the Holy Roman Empire and its demise.

description.zh-cn: 弗朗茨二世公开宣布放弃神圣罗马皇帝的帝号并解散帝国，直接导致了神圣罗马帝国的正式解体。

description.zh-cn: 在1980年代共同作为改革派核心人物，合作推进中国的改革开放和一系列政治改革。

description.zh-cn: 代表中国政府与英国首相撒切尔夫人在北京签署《中英联合声明》。
description.en: Representing the Chinese government, signed the Sino-British Joint Declaration with British Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间被清洗并入狱，并遭受批斗。
description.en: Was purged from the CCP in 1963, later imprisoned and subjected to struggle sessions during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 因文化大革命对家庭带来的冲击而被迫中止学业，并作为“知识青年”下放到陕西延川县。
description.en: His secondary education was interrupted due to the impact of the Cultural Revolution on his family, and he was exiled to Yanchuan County, Shaanxi as an educated youth.

description.zh-cn: 向胡耀邦称赞习近平为“栋梁之才”。
description.en: Communicated findings to Hu Yaobang, describing Xi as a 'pillar of talent'.

description.zh-cn: 向胡耀邦称赞习近平为“栋梁之才”。
description.en: Communicated findings to Hu Yaobang, describing Xi as a 'pillar of talent'.

description.zh-cn: 在陈良宇被免职后，习近平被调往上海接任市委书记。
description.en: Following the dismissal of Chen Liangyu, Xi was transferred to replace him as party secretary.

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来的倒台为习近平在十八大上台扫清了障碍。
description.en: The downfall of Bo Xilai opened the door for Xi to come to power without challengers at the 18th Party Congress.

description.zh-cn: 蔡英文当选后两岸关系恶化。
description.en: Relations deteriorated after Tsai Ing-wen won the presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 习近平政府签署第四十九号《中华人民共和国主席令》，公布《中华人民共和国香港特别行政区维护国家安全法》，旨在加强对香港的控制。
description.en: Xi's government signed Presidential Order No. 49, promulgating the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to expand control over the city.

description.en: Yi Shu is Ni Kuang's younger sister, and Ni Kuang is her elder brother.
