position.zh-cn: 华东公安部队基层军官
position.en: Junior officer in the East China Public Security Force

description.zh-cn: 参与过土地改革和治理淮河工程。
description.en: Participated in land reform and Huai River governance projects.

description.zh-cn: 倪匡与黄沾是好友，并列为“香港四大才子”，并共同主持电视节目《今夜不设防》。
description.en: Ni Kuang and Wong Jim were close friends, both part of the 'Four Great Talents of Hong Kong', and co-hosted the TV show 'Celebrity Talk Show'.

description.zh-cn: 倪匡与蔡澜是好友，并列为“香港四大才子”，并共同主持电视节目《今夜不设防》。
description.en: Ni Kuang and Chua Lam were close friends, both part of the 'Four Great Talents of Hong Kong', and co-hosted the TV show 'Celebrity Talk Show'.

description.zh-cn: 自1966年倪匡为《明报》向古龙邀稿《绝代双骄》后，二人结为莫逆之交，相交甚笃，感情深厚。
description.en: After Ni Kuang invited Gu Long to write 'Juedai Shuangjiao' for Ming Pao in 1966, the two became very close friends with a deep bond.

description.zh-cn: 两人在电影剧本创作上合作无间。
description.en: They collaborated closely on film screenplays.

description.zh-cn: 曾为金庸代笔《天龙八部》的部分章节，因不喜欢角色阿紫而将她写瞎。
description.en: Ghostwrote parts of 'Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils' for Jin Yong, and made the character Ah Zi blind because he disliked her.

description.zh-cn: 公开持反共立场，认为“爱国必须反共，反共才是爱国”，并因在军队中的经历及被指为“反革命”而逃离中国大陆。
description.en: Held a public anti-communist stance, believing that 'to be patriotic, one must be anti-communist', and fled mainland China after his experiences in the army and being accused of being a 'counter-revolutionary'.

description.zh-cn: 六四事件后，倪匡对香港的未来感到担忧，并因此在1992年移居美国。
description.en: After the Tiananmen Square incident, Ni Kuang became concerned about Hong Kong's future, which contributed to his decision to emigrate to the United States in 1992.

description.zh-cn: 因害怕中共收回香港而在1992年移居美国。
description.en: Emigrated to the United States in 1992 out of fear of the CCP taking over Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 倪匡坦言，《追龙》中因其优点尽失而灭亡的东方城市，就是指失去自由的香港。
description.en: Ni Kuang admitted that the eastern city in his novel 'Chasing the Dragon', which perishes after losing all its merits, is an allegory for a Hong Kong that has lost its freedom.

description.zh-cn: “烛影斧声”事件暗示宋太宗谋杀了赵匡胤以夺取皇位。
description.en: The 'shadow of candles and sound of an axe' incident implies that Emperor Taizong murdered Zhao Kuangyin to seize the throne.

description.zh-cn: 投奔后汉枢密使郭威帐下。
向赵匡胤提出“先南后北”的统一全国策略。
description.en: Proposed the 'south first, then north' strategy to Zhao Kuangyin for unifying the country.

description.zh-cn: 赵匡胤派兵灭亡荆南割据政权。
description.en: Zhao Kuangyin sent troops to conquer the Jingnan regime.

description.zh-cn: 赵匡胤派兵灭亡后蜀。
description.en: Zhao Kuangyin sent troops to conquer Later Shu.

description.zh-cn: 赵匡胤派兵灭亡南汉。
description.en: Zhao Kuangyin sent troops to conquer Southern Han.

description.zh-cn: 赵匡胤派兵灭亡南唐。
description.en: Zhao Kuangyin sent troops to conquer Southern Tang.

description.zh-cn: 烛影斧声疑案后，宋太宗得以继承帝位。
description.en: The suspicious 'shadow of candlelight and sound of an axe' incident led to Emperor Taizong's accession to the throne.

description.zh-cn: 赵匡胤亲征平定李筠叛乱，李筠自焚而死。
description.en: Zhao Kuangyin personally led the campaign to suppress Li Yun's rebellion; Li Yun committed suicide by self-immolation.

description.zh-cn: 赵匡胤亲征平定李重进叛乱，李重进自焚而死。
description.en: Zhao Kuangyin personally led the campaign to suppress Li Chongjin's rebellion; Li Chongjin committed suicide by self-immolation.

description.zh-cn: 病危时口授遗命，其中告诫太祖兄终弟及，此乃金匮之盟的来源；并通过遗命正式订立了金匮之盟。
description.en: On her deathbed, she dictated the posthumous edict, which included an admonition to Emperor Taizu that the throne should pass from brother to brother. This admonition became the origin of the Covenant of the Golden Casket, which was formally established through her edict.

description.zh-cn: 会议通过决议，为刘少奇彻底平反，并恢复其作为党和国家领导人之一的名誉。

description.en: Li Hongzhi married Li Rui in the 1980s.

description.zh-cn: 1999年，由中共执政的中国政府将法轮功取缔，并开始了对其的镇压。
description.en: In 1999, the Chinese government, led by the CCP, banned Falun Gong and initiated its suppression.

description.zh-cn: 江泽民发动了对法轮功的镇压，并将李洪志列为通缉对象。
description.en: Jiang Zemin initiated the suppression of Falun Gong and placed Li Hongzhi on a wanted list.

description.zh-cn: 作为镇压的一部分，中国公安部对李洪志下达了全国通缉令。
description.en: As part of the suppression, the Chinese Ministry of Public Security issued a nationwide arrest warrant for Li Hongzhi.

description.zh-cn: 1999年7月29日，中国公安部向全国下达了对李洪志的通缉令。
description.en: On July 29, 1999, China's Ministry of Public Security issued a nationwide wanted notice for Li Hongzhi.

description.zh-cn: 在处理425上访事件上，朱镕基主张和解，而江泽民拒绝其立场并主张镇压，两人意见相左。
description.en: Regarding the handling of the April 25 Appeal, Zhu Rongji advocated for a peaceful resolution, while Jiang Zemin rejected his stance and insisted on suppression, indicating a disagreement.

description.zh-cn: 拒绝了中国公安部就通缉李洪志提出的合作请求。
description.en: Rejected the cooperation request from the Chinese Ministry of Public Security regarding the arrest warrant for Li Hongzhi.

description.zh-cn: 在气功热的社会背景下，李洪志开始准备创立和教授法轮功。
description.en: Amidst the Qigong fever, Li Hongzhi began preparing to establish and teach Falun Gong.

description.zh-cn: 发表言论，称中国的疫情已经造成4亿人死亡。
description.en: Made a statement claiming that the COVID-19 pandemic in China had already caused 400 million deaths.

description.zh-cn: 因参选立委辞去中研院职务。
于2015年7月2日至2019年3月1日担任时代力量党主席。
自2025年2月19日起担任党主席，此前曾于2025年1月1日至2月19日任代理主席。
担任第9届与第11届立法委员。
柯文哲因京华城案请辞台湾民众党主席。
柯文哲因案请辞，黄国昌随后代理并当选为新任党主席。
在2025年台湾民众党主席补选中击败蔡壁如。
发动罢免黄国昌的行动，但罢免案最终未通过。
作为两党党团总召，在立法院议事上进行合作。傅崐萁称黄国昌为“好兄弟”，黄国昌则称赞傅崐萁“劳苦功高”，表示将继续合作。
批评黄国昌在国会改革议题上昨是今非、双重标准。
批评黄国昌是“伪君子的代名词”。
共同发起并举办“拒绝红色媒体、守护台湾民主”游行和“716公平正义救台湾”游行等社会运动。
与林义雄、林峰正等人共同筹组“公民组合”。
与黄国昌、林峰正等人共同筹组“公民组合”。
与黄国昌、林义雄等人共同筹组“公民组合”。
1395年，朱高炽娶兵马指挥张麒女为燕王世子妃。
明仁宗朱高炽是明成祖长子，朱高煦是次子。
朱高煦因屡有战功，且其父明成祖曾许诺立其为太子，故在兄长朱高炽被立为太子后心有不甘，不断出言诋毁和攻击太子，以图夺取太子之位。
description.en: Zhu Gaoxu was resentful after his elder brother Zhu Gaochi was made crown prince, as their father, the Yongle Emperor, had once promised the position to him. He continuously sought opportunities to attack the crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 与朱高煦结党，离间明成祖与太子朱高炽的关系。
明宣宗是明仁宗的嫡长子。
明仁宗在位期间采取一系列改革，开启了仁宣之治。
明宣宗延续其父的政策，共同缔造了仁宣之治。
在靖难之役中，以万余兵力镇守北平，成功抵御李景隆率领的五十万中央军围攻。
登基后下令中止郑和下西洋的活动。
登基后即将夏原吉释放出狱并恢复其官职。
因上疏劝谏激怒仁宗，被下令捶打并关入诏狱。
因劝谏触怒仁宗而下狱。
宋徽宗为宋神宗第十一子。
description.en: Emperor Huizong was the eleventh son of Emperor Shenzong.

description.zh-cn: 宋徽宗是宋哲宗之弟，并继承其皇位。
description.en: Emperor Huizong was the younger brother of Emperor Zhezong and succeeded him to the throne.

description.zh-cn: 宋钦宗是宋徽宗长子。
description.en: Emperor Qinzong was the eldest son of Emperor Huizong.

description.zh-cn: 显恭皇后为宋徽宗元配皇后。
description.en: Empress Wang (Xiangong) was Emperor Huizong's first empress consort.

description.zh-cn: 显肃皇后为宋徽宗继室皇后。
description.en: Empress Zheng (Xiansu) was Emperor Huizong's second empress consort.

description.zh-cn: 在宋哲宗无子去世后，向太后支持当时为端王的赵佶继位。
description.en: After Emperor Zhezong died without an heir, Empress Dowager Xiang supported Zhao Ji, then Prince Duan, to succeed the throne.

description.zh-cn: 反对当时为端王的赵佶继位，称其“轻佻，不可以君天下”。
description.en: Opposed the succession of Zhao Ji, then Prince Duan, stating he was "frivolous and cannot rule the empire."

description.zh-cn: 宋徽宗任用蔡京为相，导致政治腐败。
description.en: Emperor Huizong appointed Cai Jing as chancellor, leading to political corruption.

description.zh-cn: 宋徽宗任用宦官童贯为将军，引发严重问题。
description.en: Emperor Huizong's appointment of the eunuch Tong Guan as a general caused serious problems.

description.zh-cn: 宋徽宗时期的政治腐败和横征暴敛激起了宋江起义。
description.en: The political corruption and heavy taxation during Emperor Huizong's reign triggered the Song Jiang rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 宋徽宗时期的政治腐败和横征暴敛激起了方腊起义。
description.en: The political corruption and heavy taxation during Emperor Huizong's reign triggered the Fang La rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 宋徽宗与金国结成海上之盟以联合灭辽。
description.en: Emperor Huizong formed the Alliance on the Sea with the Jin dynasty to jointly destroy the Liao dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 海上之盟的建立导致了辽朝的灭亡。
description.en: The formation of the Alliance on the Sea led to the fall of the Liao dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 金太宗下诏废黜宋徽宗，并将其俘虏北上。
description.en: Emperor Taizong of Jin issued an edict to depose Emperor Huizong and took him captive to the north.

description.zh-cn: 金太宗下诏废黜宋钦宗，并将其俘虏北上。
description.en: Emperor Taizong of Jin issued an edict to depose Emperor Qinzong and took him captive to the north.

description.zh-cn: 宋徽宗禅位后，被其子宋钦宗软禁于龙德宫。
description.en: After abdicating, Emperor Huizong was placed under house arrest in Longde Palace by his son, Emperor Qinzong.

description.zh-cn: 民间流传宋徽宗喜爱青楼女子李师师，并多次私下会面。
description.en: It is widely rumored that Emperor Huizong was fond of the courtesan Li Shishi and met with her privately on multiple occasions.

description.zh-cn: 传说宋徽宗与词人周邦彦为李师师争风吃醋。
description.en: According to legend, Emperor Huizong and the poet Zhou Bangyan were rivals for the affection of Li Shishi.

description.zh-cn: 刘禅是刘备之子。
description.en: Liu Shan is the son of Liu Bei.

description.zh-cn: 刘备的养子
为与孙权建立更巩固的关系而结成的政治婚姻。
在被吕布击败后，归顺曹操，被任命为豫州牧、左将军。
刘备三顾茅庐请诸葛亮出山辅佐，成为其核心幕僚，并为蜀汉“鞠躬尽瘁，死而后已”。
description.en: After Liu Bei's three visits to his thatched cottage, Zhuge Liang left his seclusion to serve Liu Bei as his chief advisor, dedicating himself to Shu Han with utmost devotion until his death.

description.zh-cn: 张飞自184年起跟随刘备，为其效力直至去世。
刘备三顾茅庐请出诸葛亮，与其情好日密，自称“犹鱼之有水也”。
刘备与关羽、张飞在桃园结为异姓兄弟，情同手足。此即著名的“桃园结义”事件，主要记载于《三国演义》中。
description.en: Liu Bei, Guan Yu, and Zhang Fei became sworn brothers in the Peach Garden, forming a deep, fraternal bond. This famous event is known as the 'Oath of the Peach Garden' and is primarily recorded in 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms'.

description.zh-cn: 在《三国演义》中，刘备、张飞与关羽在桃园结为异姓兄弟，史称“桃园结义”。
description.en: In 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Liu Bei, Zhang Fei, and Guan Yu became sworn brothers in the Peach Garden, an event known as the 'Oath of the Peach Garden'.

description.zh-cn: 衣带诏事件败露后，刘备杀死曹操任命的徐州刺史车胄，公开与曹操对立，是为曹操水火不容的死敌（张松语）。建安二十四年（219年），刘备与曹操又为争夺汉中展开战斗。
description.en: After the failed Girdle Edict plot, Liu Bei killed Cao Cao's appointed Xu Province governor Che Zhou, openly opposing Cao Cao, solidifying his position as Cao Cao's irreconcilable arch-enemy (as described by Zhang Song). Additionally, in the year 219, Liu Bei and Cao Cao also fought for control over Hanzhong.

description.zh-cn: 为共同抵抗曹操，孙权和刘备结成联盟，并在赤壁之战中联手获胜。联盟最终因荆州争端和关羽之死而破裂。
description.en: To jointly resist Cao Cao, Sun Quan and Liu Bei formed an alliance and achieved victory together at the Battle of Red Cliffs. The alliance eventually broke down due to the dispute over Jing Province and the death of Guan Yu.

description.zh-cn: 215年，刘备占领益州后，孙权索要荆州部分郡县未果，双方关系开始破裂并爆发军事对峙。219年，孙权趁关羽北伐之际偷袭荆州并杀害关羽，使得孙刘联盟彻底瓦解。此后，刘备为义弟复仇，于221年发兵攻打孙权，引发了夷陵之战，持续至223年。
description.en: In 215, after Liu Bei conquered Yi Province, Sun Quan's demand for the return of several commanderies in Jing Province was rejected, leading to a breakdown in their relations and military confrontation. In 219, Sun Quan launched a surprise attack on Jing Province during Guan Yu's northern campaign, killing Guan Yu and completely severing the Sun-Liu alliance. Subsequently, to avenge his sworn brother, Liu Bei launched a campaign against Sun Quan in 221, leading to the Battle of Yiling, which lasted until 223.

description.zh-cn: 吕布趁刘备与袁术作战时偷袭下邳，夺取徐州，后多次与刘备作战。
刘备曾与袁术大军相持，互有胜负。
刘备入蜀后与刘璋决裂，张松被杀成为此次决裂并开战的导火线之一，刘备最终夺取益州。
description.en: After Liu Bei entered Shu, he broke with Liu Zhang. The execution of Zhang Song became one of the catalysts for this conflict and the subsequent war, eventually leading to Liu Bei's conquest of Yizhou.

description.zh-cn: 刘备三顾茅庐，与诸葛亮会面并商讨天下大势。
刘备率众跟随邹靖讨伐黄巾军，立下战功，开始其军事生涯。
孙刘联军在赤壁之战中大败曹操，为刘备占据荆州，建立基业提供了决定性机会。
刘备在夷陵之战中率领的蜀汉军队被陆逊指挥的吴军击败，蜀汉元气大伤。刘备退守白帝城，并于次年病逝。
description.en: In the Battle of Yiling, the Shu Han army led by Liu Bei was defeated by the Wu army commanded by Lu Xun, suffering a major blow. Liu Bei retreated to Baidi Cheng and died of illness the following year.

description.zh-cn: 此战中，孙权袭取荆州，诛杀关羽，使刘备集团丧失荆州根据地并损失大将。
张松说服刘璋邀请刘备入蜀，并为刘备提供益州内部情报和地图，促成刘备夺取益州。
法正作为刘璋的使者邀请刘备入蜀，并向刘备献策夺取益州。
陶谦病重时，表示“非刘备不能安此州也”，将徐州让给刘备。
于白帝城向诸葛亮托孤，将后主刘禅及国家大事托付于他，并允许其在刘禅无才时“君可自取”。
于白帝城托孤，以尚书令李严为副手，辅助诸葛亮。
刘备加入董承奉汉献帝衣带诏诛杀曹操的密谋。
李显为武则天第三子。
唐睿宗是唐高宗李治和武则天的幼子。
为打击萧淑妃，主动向高宗请求将武氏纳入宫中。
为争夺后位，武则天将女儿安定公主之死嫁祸于王皇后，成为政治斗争的对手。后谋废王皇后，得立为后，最终将王皇后废为庶人并囚禁。
description.en: To seize the position of empress, Wu Zetian framed Empress Wang for the death of her daughter, Princess Anding, making them political rivals. Later, she plotted to depose Empress Wang, successfully became empress, and ultimately deposed Empress Wang as a commoner and imprisoned her.

description.zh-cn: 与萧淑妃争宠，后将其废为庶人并囚禁。
自660年起，因高宗患病，开始代理朝政，并称“二圣”。
与宰相上官仪商议，打算废掉武氏皇后之位，但事情败露未果。
因上官仪草拟废后诏书，将其下狱并灭族。
武则天以“朕即使把天下都给韦玄贞，又有何不可”为由，废黜其兄唐中宗（李显）帝位，贬为庐陵王，并迁于房州。
武则天废中宗后，立李旦为帝，但临朝称制，使其成为傀儡皇帝。
以支持庐陵王为号召，在扬州举兵反对武则天，兵败被杀。
于博州举兵反对武则天，七日后败死。
于豫州起兵呼应李冲，兵败自杀。
改唐为周，在神都洛阳登基即位。
武则天改唐为周，中断了唐朝的统治。
听从狄仁杰建议，召还庐陵王并复立为皇太子。
武则天晚年的男宠。
武则天晚年的男宠。
因其窃议张易之兄弟，敕令赐死。
因其窃议张易之兄弟，敕令赐死。
因其窃议张易之兄弟，敕令赐死。
作为宰相，张柬之联合其他大臣与禁军统领发动神龙政变，是此次政变的主要策划和发动者之一。
神龙政变中，武则天被军队包围，被迫下诏禅位，将帝位禅让予唐中宗。
神龙政变后，武周王朝灭亡。
神龙政变后，唐中宗李显复位。
咸丰帝是道光帝第四子。
孝全成皇后是咸丰帝的生母。
奕䜣是咸丰帝的同父异母弟。
description.en: Yixin was the younger half-brother of the Xianfeng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 因恭亲王奕䜣要求册封自己的生母为皇太后之事，咸丰帝与曾情同手足的奕䜣嫌隙渐生。
咸丰帝即位后，为扫除朝中主和派的阻力并准备重用林则徐，将穆彰阿革职，永不录用。
description.en: After ascending the throne, the Xianfeng Emperor dismissed Mujaangga from office permanently to remove obstacles from the court's peace faction and to prepare for the reinstatement of Lin Zexu.

description.zh-cn: 即位之初将其革职。
即位之初启用林则徐等能臣。
重用汉族大臣曾国藩等人组织团练来对付太平天国。
提拔行事果断的肃顺，并支持其推行的改革。
太平天国运动几乎困扰了咸丰帝在位的全部时限。
英法联军攻入北京，咸丰帝仓皇北逃，最终导致身心崩溃。战争的失败、首都的陷落和圆明园的焚毁对他造成了巨大打击，促使其于次年病逝。
description.en: The Anglo-French allied forces invaded Beijing, leading to the Xianfeng Emperor's hasty flight north and eventual physical and mental collapse. The defeat in the war, the fall of the capital, and the burning of the Old Summer Palace dealt a huge blow to him, contributing to his death from illness the following year.

description.zh-cn: 咸丰帝临终前下达遗诏，任命八位大臣辅佐年幼的同治帝。
政变推翻了咸丰帝遗命的辅政大臣，将其核心成员载垣、端华、肃顺等人捉拿定罪，彻底打破了咸丰帝设计的辅政权力结构。
description.en: The coup overthrew the regents appointed by the Xianfeng Emperor's will, leading to the arrest and conviction of key members such as Zaiyuan, Duanhua, and Sushun, and completely dismantling the regency power structure designed by the Xianfeng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 根据《北京条约》，清政府被迫割让九龙半岛给英国，赔偿巨额军费，并给予列强更多特权，严重损害了其主权和利益。
description.en: According to the Convention of Peking, the Qing government was forced to cede the Kowloon Peninsula to Britain, pay huge military indemnities, and grant more privileges to foreign powers, severely damaging its sovereignty and interests.

description.zh-cn: 李世民是李渊的次子。
description.en: Li Shimin is the second son of Li Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 李世民是太穆皇后窦氏的嫡次子。
description.en: Li Shimin is the second legitimate son of Empress Taimu (née Dou).

description.zh-cn: 李建成是李世民的兄长。
description.en: Li Jiancheng is Li Shimin's elder brother.

description.zh-cn: 李元吉是李世民的四弟。
description.en: Li Yuanji is Li Shimin's fourth younger brother.

description.zh-cn: 长孙皇后是李世民的妻子和皇后。
description.en: Empress Zhangsun was Li Shimin's wife and empress.

description.zh-cn: 李治（唐高宗）是李世民的第九子和皇位继承人。
description.en: Li Zhi (Emperor Gaozong) is Li Shimin's ninth son and successor.

description.zh-cn: 李泰是李世民的嫡次子。
description.en: Li Tai is Li Shimin's second legitimate son.

description.zh-cn: 因皇位继承问题，李世民与太子李建成发生激烈冲突，最终发动玄武门之变将之杀害。
description.en: Due to the issue of succession, Li Shimin had a fierce conflict with Crown Prince Li Jiancheng, eventually launching the Xuanwu Gate Incident and killing him.

description.zh-cn: 李元吉与李建成结盟对抗李世民，在玄武门之变中一同被杀。
description.en: Li Yuanji allied with Li Jiancheng against Li Shimin and was killed alongside him in the Xuanwu Gate Incident.

description.zh-cn: 李世民策划并领导了玄武门之变，以夺取皇位继承权。
description.en: Li Shimin planned and led the Xuanwu Gate Incident to seize the right of succession.

description.zh-cn: 玄武门之变的成功使李世民被立为太子，并很快继承皇位。
description.en: The success of the Xuanwu Gate Incident led to Li Shimin being appointed as crown prince and soon succeeding to the throne.

description.zh-cn: 李世民积极谋划并劝说其父李渊在晋阳起兵反隋。
description.en: Li Shimin actively planned and persuaded his father Li Yuan to rise against the Sui in Jinyang.

description.zh-cn: 晋阳起兵是唐朝建立的开端。
description.en: The Jinyang Uprising marked the beginning of the establishment of the Tang dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 李世民通过一系列政治、经济措施，开创了贞观之治。
description.en: Through a series of political and economic measures, Li Shimin created the Reign of Zhenguan.

description.zh-cn: 在虎牢之战中击败并俘虏了窦建德，消灭了其割据势力。
description.en: Defeated and captured Dou Jiande in the Battle of Hulao, eliminating his separatist regime.

description.zh-cn: 在虎牢之战后，迫使王世充投降，消灭了其割据势力。
description.en: After the Battle of Hulao, forced Wang Shichong to surrender, eliminating his separatist regime.

description.zh-cn: 派遣李靖等人率军出征，最终灭亡东突厥汗国。
description.en: Dispatched generals like Li Jing to lead an expedition, ultimately conquering the Eastern Turkic Khaganate.

description.zh-cn: 因渊盖苏文弑君专权并入侵新罗，李世民发动了对高句丽的战争。
description.en: Due to Yeon Gaesomun's regicide, usurpation of power, and invasion of Silla, Li Shimin launched a war against Goguryeo.

description.zh-cn: 李承干因嫉妒李泰受宠，两人为争夺储位而互相倾轧。
description.en: Li Chengqian became jealous of the favor shown to Li Tai, leading to a fierce rivalry between them for the position of crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 643年，太子李承干因失宠且忌惮魏王李泰，担心被废，与侯君集等人密谋刺杀唐太宗发动政变。事败后，李承干被废为庶人。
description.en: In 643, Crown Prince Li Chengqian, having fallen out of favor and fearing Prince of Wei Li Tai, also worried about being deposed, conspired with Hou Junji and others to assassinate Emperor Taizong and launch a coup. The plot failed, and he was demoted to a commoner.

description.zh-cn: 魏征是唐太宗最重要的辅臣之一，以向皇帝直言进谏而闻名。
description.en: Wei Zheng was one of Emperor Taizong's most important ministers, famous for offering frank advice to the emperor.

description.zh-cn: 房玄龄是唐太宗的主要谋士和长期担任宰相。
description.en: Fang Xuanling was a key advisor to Emperor Taizong and served as chancellor for a long period.

description.zh-cn: 杜如晦是唐太宗的重要谋士和宰相。
description.en: Du Ruhui was an important advisor and chancellor to Emperor Taizong.

description.zh-cn: 吐蕃赞普松赞干布迎娶唐朝文成公主，建立唐蕃和亲关系。
description.en: Tibetan Emperor Songtsen Gampo married Princess Wencheng of the Tang dynasty, establishing a marriage alliance.

description.zh-cn: 通过将文成公主嫁给松赞干布，与吐蕃建立了和亲关系，促进了文化交流。
description.en: By marrying Princess Wencheng to Songtsen Gampo, he established a marriage alliance with the Tibetan Empire, promoting cultural exchange.

description.zh-cn: 亲政后立即逮捕和珅并将其赐死。
嘉庆元年爆发的白莲教起义，是嘉庆朝面临的重大内乱。
川楚教乱是白莲教发动的大规模农民起义。
川楚教乱的白莲教首领之一。
天理教徒攻入紫禁城，是清朝历史上一次严重的宫禁事件。
率领天理教徒攻入紫禁城。
针对英国派兵入侵澳门，下令封锁水路并最终迫使其撤离。
禁止西洋人在内地居住，禁止人民接触天主教。
因礼仪问题取消觐见，驱逐使团，并拒绝英国提出的外交及通商要求。
其统治时期未能解决社会矛盾，使清朝由盛转衰，进入“嘉道中衰”。
毛岸龙是毛岸青的同胞弟弟。
杨月花是毛岸青的异母姊妹。

李讷是毛岸青的异母姊妹。

description.en: He Jian, then Chairman of the Hunan Provincial Government, ordered the arrest and execution of Yang Kaihui.

description.zh-cn: 在毛岸青兄弟于上海期间，曾安排寄养和照料他们。
1967年在北京大学公开控诉邵华。
由李富春、蔡畅介绍入党。
入园学习生活。
在马列著作编译室工作。
毛岸英在参与朝鲜战争期间阵亡。
介绍毛岸青加入中国共产党。
介绍毛岸青加入中国共产党。
传达中共中央指示，安排毛岸青兄弟赴苏联。
带领毛岸青兄弟前往法国，准备赴苏联。
在巴黎迎接毛岸青兄弟前往苏联。
与张文秋一同撮合毛岸青与邵华的婚事。
与毛泽东一同撮合毛岸青与邵华的婚事。
担任火炬手。
description.en: Served as a torchbearer.

description.zh-cn: 2017年9月29日被开除党籍。
在习近平担任中共中央总书记期间，孙政才任中央政治局委员。
在温家宝担任国务院总理期间，孙政才任农业部部长。
提名孙政才出任农业部部长，并对其大力提拔。
对孙政才以涉嫌受贿罪立案侦查并采取强制措施，后提起公诉。
一审以受贿罪判处孙政才无期徒刑。
在2002年中共北京市第九次党代会上，作为差额人选的孙政才意外当选市委常委，顶掉了时任市委常委蒋效愚。
在刘淇担任北京市委书记期间任市委秘书长。
在贾庆林担任北京市委书记期间任市委常委。
在北京市委工作期间，与时任市委书记刘淇合流，共同对付时任市长王岐山。
刘淇担任北京市委书记，王岐山担任市长期间，两人不睦。
孙政才落马被认为受时任重庆市公安局局长何挺遭查的影响。
为何挺安排情妇。
孙政才落马被认为受时任重庆市副市长沐华平遭查的影响。
在中共十九大期间，公开指责孙政才等人“阴谋篡党夺权”。
被中国证监会主席刘士余公开指责为“阴谋篡党夺权”的政治团伙成员之一。
在孙政才任农业部长访问美国期间，为其提供专机。
林立果在九一三事件中坠机身亡。
description.en: Lin Liguo died in a plane crash during the September 13th Incident.

description.zh-cn: 在1970年九届二中全会后，林彪与毛泽东关系破裂，分歧公开化。最终林彪策划“571工程”政变失败，并在九一三事件中死亡。
description.en: Following the Second Plenary Session of the 9th CCP Central Committee in 1970, the relationship between Lin Biao and Mao Zedong fractured, and their disagreements became public. This ultimately led to Lin Biao's failed "Project 571" coup plot and his death in the September 13th Incident.

description.zh-cn: 在大会上一片检讨声中，林彪发言维护毛泽东，称困难是由于没有听从毛的指示造成的。
毛泽东通过南巡与地方负责人谈话，公开与林彪的矛盾，为斗倒林彪做准备。
依照秘密建储制，立绵宁（后改名旻宁，即道光帝）为太子。
因在事件中表现英勇，被嘉庆帝封为“智亲王”。
平定了在新疆地区持续八年的张格尔之乱。
被道光帝任命为钦差大臣，赴广东查禁鸦片。
作为钦差大臣，林则徐在广东主持了禁烟运动，最终将收缴的鸦片在虎门海滩公开销毁。
description.en: As Imperial Commissioner, Lin Zexu led the anti-opium campaign in Guangdong, culminating in the public destruction of confiscated opium at Humen beach.

description.zh-cn: 在第一次鸦片战争中是清朝的敌对方。
战争的失败导致清朝签订不平等条约，损害了其统治。
第一次鸦片战争爆发后，道光帝将战事失利归咎于林则徐，对其严厉申斥，最终将其革职并遣戍新疆。
description.en: After the outbreak of the First Opium War, the Daoguang Emperor blamed Lin Zexu for the military setbacks, severely reprimanded him, and ultimately dismissed him from his post and exiled him to Xinjiang.

description.zh-cn: 明宣宗朱瞻基是明英宗的父亲，明英宗是明宣宗朱瞻基的长子。
description.en: The Xuande Emperor, Zhu Zhanji, was the father of Emperor Yingzong, who was his eldest son.

description.zh-cn: 明英宗的母亲是孝恭章皇后孙氏。
description.en: Emperor Yingzong's mother was Empress Xiaogongzhang, née Sun.

description.zh-cn: 景泰帝朱祁钰是明英宗朱祁镇的同父异母弟。
description.en: The Jingtai Emperor Zhu Qiyu was the younger half-brother of the Emperor Yingzong Zhu Qizhen.

description.zh-cn: 明英宗是明宪宗朱见深（其长子）的父亲。
description.en: Emperor Yingzong was the father of Emperor Xianzong (Zhu Jianshen), his eldest son.

description.zh-cn: 孝肃皇后周氏是明宪宗朱见深的生母。
description.en: Empress Xiaosu, née Zhou, was the birth mother of Emperor Xianzong (Zhu Jianshen).

description.zh-cn: 明英宗在土木堡之变中被瓦剌俘虏，中断了其第一次统治。
description.en: Emperor Yingzong was captured by the Oirats during the Tumu Crisis, interrupting his first reign.

description.zh-cn: 在土木堡之变中，樊忠指责王振为国贼并用棰将其击杀。
description.en: During the Tumu Crisis, Fan Zhong denounced Wang Zhen as a traitor and killed him with a mace.

description.zh-cn: 朱祁钰（景泰帝）将从瓦剌归来的兄长明英宗软禁于南宫，并废黜其子朱见深的太子之位，不欲其复位，双方关系敌对。明英宗复辟后将朱祁钰废为郕王并上恶谥“戾”。
description.en: Zhu Qiyu (Jingtai Emperor) placed his elder brother Emperor Yingzong under house arrest in the Southern Palace upon his return from Oirat captivity, and deposed Yingzong's son Zhu Jianshen as crown prince, not wishing for his restoration, thus creating a hostile relationship. After Emperor Yingzong was restored, he deposed Zhu Qiyu to Prince of Cheng and gave him the malicious posthumous name 'Li' (Adverse).

description.zh-cn: 于谦作为兵部尚书，全面负责并领导了北京保卫战的防御工作，成功抵御了瓦剌的进攻，最终取得胜利。
description.en: Yu Qian led the Defense of Beijing and successfully repelled the Oirat invasion.

description.zh-cn: 石亨是夺门之变的主要策划和领导者之一。
description.en: Shi Heng was one of the main planners and leaders of the Duomen Coup.

description.zh-cn: 徐有贞是夺门之变的主要策划和领导者之一。
description.en: Xu Youzhen was one of the main planners and leaders of the Duomen Coup.

description.zh-cn: 曹吉祥是夺门之变的主要策划和领导者之一。
description.en: Cao Jixiang was one of the main planners and leaders of the Duomen Coup.

description.zh-cn: 明英宗复辟后，以谋逆罪名将北京保卫战功臣于谦杀害。
description.en: After his restoration, Emperor Yingzong executed Yu Qian, the hero of the Defense of Beijing, on charges of treason.

description.zh-cn: 以“不杀于谦，今日之事无名”为由，说服明英宗处死于谦。
description.en: Persuaded Emperor Yingzong to execute Yu Qian by arguing 'Without killing Yu Qian, this affair (the coup) has no legitimacy'.

description.zh-cn: 曹吉祥与石亨图谋发动叛乱（曹石之变），以反对明英宗。
description.en: Cao Jixiang and Shi Heng plotted to launch a rebellion (the Cao-Shi Rebellion) against Emperor Yingzong.

description.zh-cn: 作为天顺朝的贤臣，李贤辅佐明英宗勤于理政，并劝止其更换太子。
description.en: As a virtuous minister of the Tianshun era, Li Xian assisted Emperor Yingzong in governance and advised him against replacing the crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇是秦庄襄王之子。
秦始皇是赵姬之子。
扶苏是秦始皇长子。
胡亥（秦二世）是秦始皇幼子。
成𫊸是秦始皇的异母弟。
在秦王政即位初期担任相国，尊为“仲父”主持国政。
因嫪毐之乱的牵连，秦始皇于秦王政十年（前237年）罢免吕不韦的相邦职务，后将其流放至蜀地，最终导致吕不韦饮鸩自杀。
description.en: Due to his involvement in the Lao Ai rebellion, Qin Shi Huang dismissed Lü Buwei from his post as Chancellor in the tenth year of his reign (-237), later exiling him to Shu, which ultimately led Lü Buwei to commit suicide by drinking poison.

description.zh-cn: 嫪毐发动兵变，意图杀害秦王政取而代之，最终被平定，嫪毐被车裂并夷三族。
嫪毐被吕不韦送入宫后，作为太后赵姬的男宠，深得专宠，两人私通并生下二子。
description.en: After being sent into the palace by Lü Buwei, Lao Ai became the exclusive favorite of Queen Dowager Zhao and had two sons with her.

description.zh-cn: 李斯在秦始皇手下历任长史、客卿、廷尉、丞相等职，是秦始皇统一六国和建立帝制过程中的关键大臣。
听信李斯、姚贾谗言，将韩非下狱，导致其最终死亡。
description.en: Heeding the slander of Li Si and Yao Jia, King Zheng of Qin had Han Fei imprisoned, which ultimately led to his death.

description.zh-cn: 灭亡六国后，建立秦朝，自称始皇帝。
派内史腾攻灭韩国。
派王翦攻灭赵国。
派王贲攻灭魏国。
派王翦、蒙武攻灭楚国。
派王贲、蒙恬攻灭齐国。
在咸阳宫试图刺杀秦王政，失败被杀。
为报复秦王政，派遣荆轲前往秦国行刺。
为报灭韩之仇，在博浪沙策划行刺秦始皇，失败。
赵高、李斯伪造遗诏，拥立胡亥（秦二世）为帝。
伪造的遗诏赐死扶苏，使其失去了皇位继承权。
与李斯、胡亥共同策划了沙丘之变。
与赵高、胡亥共同策划了沙丘之变。
采纳李斯建议，下令焚书，后坑杀术士（儒生）。
description.en: Qin Shi Huang ordered the implementation of the 'book burning' policy.

description.zh-cn: 派蒙恬率军北击匈奴，收复河南地（河套地区）。
派兵南征百越，设立桂林、南海、象郡进行统治。
在法学院进修。
在北京大学法律系为本科同学。
2010年9月起任省委常委、组织部部长。
2015年11月30日至2016年1月28日任代理省长。
在中国社会科学院任职期间，李克强为中华人民共和国国务院总理。
石泰峰任江苏省省长期间，罗志军为中共江苏省委书记。
石泰峰任江苏省省长期间，李强为中共江苏省委书记。
于1984年12月19日结婚
description.en: Married on December 19, 1984

description.zh-cn: 小一至中七就读于该校。
description.en: Studied from Primary 1 to Form 7 at the college.

description.zh-cn: 在曾荫权担任行政长官期间，林郑月娥出任发展局局长。
description.en: Carrie Lam served as the Secretary for Development during Donald Tsang's tenure as Chief Executive.

description.zh-cn: 在梁振英担任行政长官期间，林郑月娥出任政务司司长。
description.en: Carrie Lam served as the Chief Secretary for Administration during Leung Chun-ying's tenure as Chief Executive.

position.zh-cn: 香港特别行政区行政长官
position.en: Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

description.zh-cn: 在李克强担任国务院总理期间，林郑月娥出任香港特首并向其述职。
description.en: During Li Keqiang's tenure as Premier of the State Council, Carrie Lam served as the Chief Executive of Hong Kong and reported to him.

description.zh-cn: 林郑月娥支持全国人大常委会在香港推行《港区国安法》。2020年6月30日，她作为时任香港特别行政区行政长官，签署法律公告，使《中华人民共和国香港特别行政区维护国家安全法》在香港刊宪并即时生效。
description.en: Carrie Lam supported the implementation of the National Security Law in Hong Kong by the NPCSC. On June 30, 2020, as the then Chief Executive of the HKSAR, she signed the legal notice to gazette the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, bringing it into immediate effect.

description.zh-cn: 美国政府发布此行政命令，对香港官员实施制裁。
description.en: The U.S. government issued this executive order to impose sanctions on Hong Kong officials.

description.zh-cn: 习近平在会面中对林郑月娥的工作给予积极评价和坚定支持，并请她转达对被制裁官员的慰问。
description.en: During meetings, Xi Jinping gave positive evaluations and firm support to Carrie Lam's work, and asked her to convey his regards to sanctioned officials.

description.zh-cn: 无国界记者组织将林郑月娥列入“新闻自由掠夺者”名单。
description.en: Reporters Without Borders listed Carrie Lam as a "predator of press freedom".

description.zh-cn: 徐英伟在林郑月娥政府中担任民政事务局局长，后因洪为民生日派对事件辞职。
description.en: Caspar Tsui served as Secretary for Home Affairs in Carrie Lam's government and later resigned due to the Witman Hung birthday party incident.

description.zh-cn: 2015年7月30日被开除党籍。
description.en: Expelled from the party on July 30, 2015.

description.zh-cn: 2016年7月被开除军籍，剥夺上将军衔。
description.en: Expelled from the military and stripped of the rank of general in July 2016.

description.zh-cn: 江泽民是郭伯雄的主要提拔者，郭是江在军中的重要亲信。
description.en: Jiang Zemin was the main promoter of Guo Boxiong, who was a key confidant of Jiang in the military.

description.zh-cn: 习近平主导的反腐运动导致郭伯雄被调查并最终被判刑。
description.en: The anti-corruption campaign led by Xi Jinping resulted in the investigation and eventual sentencing of Guo Boxiong.

description.zh-cn: 傅全有调任兰州军区司令员后，重用郭伯雄，任命其为第47集团军军长。
description.en: After being appointed commander of the Lanzhou Military Region, Fu Quanyou heavily promoted Guo Boxiong, appointing him as commander of the 47th Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 对郭伯雄进行组织调查，并宣布将其开除党籍，移交司法机关。
description.en: Conducted an organizational investigation into Guo Boxiong and announced his expulsion from the party and transfer to judicial authorities.

description.zh-cn: 对郭伯雄涉嫌违法犯罪进行立案侦查，并移送审查起诉。
description.en: Filed a case to investigate Guo Boxiong for suspected illegal crimes and transferred the case for review and prosecution.

description.zh-cn: 政治盟友。
description.en: Political ally.

description.zh-cn: 政治盟友。
description.en: Political ally.

description.zh-cn: 政治盟友。
description.en: Political ally.

description.zh-cn: 房峰辉曾称郭伯雄为“姐夫”，暗示两人关系密切。
description.en: Fang Fenghui once called Guo Boxiong 'brother-in-law', implying a close relationship.

description.zh-cn: 防火长城是中华人民共和国政府用以过滤国际互联网出口内容的软硬件系统集合。
description.en: The Great Firewall is a combination of hardware and software systems used by the government of the People's Republic of China to filter its international internet gateways.

description.zh-cn: 自本世纪初以来，由国家计算机网络与信息安全管理中心（CNCERT）运营和维护防火长城。
description.en: Since the beginning of the 21st century, the GFW has been operated and maintained by the National Computer Network Emergency Response Technical Team/Coordination Center of China (CNCERT/CC).

description.zh-cn: 作为时任总理签署国务院令发布施行该规定。
description.en: As the then-Premier, signed the State Council decree to issue and implement this regulation.

description.zh-cn: 被认为是防火长城关键部分的首要设计师，被称为“中国国家防火墙之父”。
description.en: Considered to be the principal designer of key parts of the Great Firewall, known as the 'Father of the GFW'.

description.zh-cn: 向中华人民共和国政府提供了具有流量监控和过滤功能的互联网设备，用于构建防火长城。
description.en: Provided the Chinese government with internet equipment featuring traffic monitoring and filtering capabilities, which were used to build the Great Firewall.

description.zh-cn: 因其向中国提供审查技术而召开听证会进行质询。
description.en: Held a hearing to question the company for providing censorship technology to China.

description.zh-cn: 因其向中国提供审查技术而召开听证会进行质询。
description.en: Held a hearing to question the company for providing censorship technology to China.

description.zh-cn: 因其向中国提供审查技术而召开听证会进行质询。
description.en: Held a hearing to question the company for providing censorship technology to China.

description.zh-cn: 曾经加入中国GFW防火长城计划，并派高管加入研究搜索引擎安全管理系统。
description.en: Once joined the GFW project and dispatched executives to participate in researching a search engine security management system.

description.zh-cn: 据透露，方滨兴卸任后，防火长城项目交由启明星辰公司负责。
description.en: It was revealed that after Fang Binxing stepped down, the Great Firewall project was handed over to Venustech.

description.zh-cn: 发表社评认为防火墙帮助中国更加强大，必将得到历史的正面评价。
description.en: Published an editorial arguing that the firewall helps make China stronger and will receive a positive evaluation from history.

description.zh-cn: 刊文建议当局继续改进和完善“防火墙”。
description.en: Published an article suggesting authorities continue to improve and perfect the 'firewall'.

description.zh-cn: 作为外交部发言人，回应美国贸易代表办公室的指责，维护了中国的互联网管理模式。
description.en: As a Foreign Ministry spokesperson, responded to accusations from the USTR, defending China's model of internet governance.

description.zh-cn: 封锁了Gmail的网页版及客户端端口。
description.en: Blocked Gmail's web version and client ports.

description.zh-cn: 通过深度包检测和主动探测等方式识别并封锁Tor连接。
description.en: Identifies and blocks Tor connections using methods like deep packet inspection and active probing.

description.zh-cn: 通过主动探测识别并封锁服务器。
description.en: Identifies and blocks servers through active probing.

description.zh-cn: 通过主动探测识别和封锁其依赖的Google App Engine IP。
description.en: Identifies and blocks the Google App Engine IPs it relies on through active probing.

description.zh-cn: 开始对Shadowsocks进行主动探测和封锁。
description.en: Began active probing and blocking of Shadowsocks.

description.zh-cn: 通过IP封锁和DNS污染等方式进行封锁。
description.en: Blocked using methods such as IP blocking and DNS poisoning.

description.zh-cn: 曾对其进行中间人攻击。
description.en: Subjected to a man-in-the-middle attack.

description.zh-cn: 曾对其进行中间人攻击。
description.en: Subjected to a man-in-the-middle attack.

description.zh-cn: 防火长城（北京）使用了曙光4000L机群。
description.en: The Great Firewall (Beijing) used Sugon 4000L clusters.

description.zh-cn: 在回应中称GreatFire.org是境外反华组织创办的反华网站。
description.en: In a response, referred to GreatFire.org as an anti-China website founded by an overseas anti-China organization.

description.zh-cn: 由中国国民党主政的中华民国政府是白色恐怖的执行者，利用公权力迫害异议人士。
description.en: The KMT-led government of the Republic of China was the perpetrator of the White Terror, using state power to persecute dissidents.

description.zh-cn: 作为执政党，中国国民党主导了白色恐怖时期的威权统治。
description.en: As the ruling party, the Kuomintang led the authoritarian rule during the White Terror period.

description.zh-cn: 作为主要情治单位，负责执行戒严与政治肃清。
description.en: As a primary intelligence agency, it was responsible for enforcing martial law and political purges.

description.zh-cn: 作为主要情治单位，参与执行政治肃清。
description.en: As a primary intelligence agency, it participated in carrying out political purges.

description.zh-cn: 该戒严令的实施标志着台湾白色恐怖时期的开始。
description.en: The implementation of this martial law order marked the beginning of Taiwan's White Terror period.

description.zh-cn: 此“特别刑法”成为政府整肃异己、进行政治迫害的法律工具，是白色恐怖的根源。
description.en: This "special criminal law" became a legal tool for the government to purge dissidents and carry out political persecution, and was a root cause of the White Terror.

description.zh-cn: 此条例纵容情治单位介入所有人民的政治活动，其废止被视为白色恐怖时期的结束。
description.en: This statute allowed intelligence agencies to intervene in all political activities of the people, and its abolition is considered the end of the White Terror period.

description.zh-cn: 韩战爆发后，中华民国政府开始对叛乱犯采取更高压的政策，加剧了白色恐怖的程度。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Korean War, the government of the Republic of China began to adopt more repressive policies against rebels, intensifying the White Terror.

description.zh-cn: 以台湾省政府主席兼台湾省警备总司令身份颁布《台湾省戒严令》。
description.en: Issued the Taiwan Province Martial Law Order in his capacity as Governor of Taiwan Province and Commander of the Taiwan Garrison Command.

description.zh-cn: 三读通过《惩治叛乱条例》。
description.en: Passed the Act for the Punishment of Rebellion after three readings.

description.zh-cn: 通过废除《惩治叛乱条例》。
description.en: Passed the abolition of the Act for the Punishment of Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 在泰源事件处理公文中，以红字亲自批示枪决。
description.en: Personally approved the execution in red ink on the official documents for the handling of the Taiyuan Incident.

description.zh-cn: 在泰源事件处理公文中，以红字亲自批示枪决。
description.en: Personally approved the execution in red ink on the official documents for the handling of the Taiyuan Incident.

description.zh-cn: 进入清华大学宿舍拘提历史研究所硕士生廖伟程，引发“独立台湾会事件”。
description.en: Entered Tsing Hua University dormitories to arrest history graduate student Liao Wei-cheng, triggering the "Independent Taiwan Association Incident".

description.zh-cn: 开始陆续公告撤销白色恐怖时期受难者之有罪判决，进行平反。
description.en: Began to announce the revocation of guilty verdicts of victims from the White Terror period, carrying out rehabilitation.

description.zh-cn: 协助中华民国海军护航补给船团，突破解放军的海上封锁。
description.en: Assisted the ROC Navy in escorting supply convoys, breaking the PLA's naval blockade.

description.zh-cn: 国军使用八吋炮对解放军炮兵阵地进行反击，取得火力优势。
description.en: The ROC military used the 8-inch howitzers to counter-attack PLA artillery positions, gaining fire superiority.

description.zh-cn: 向中华民国空军提供了AIM-9响尾蛇飞弹。
description.en: Provided AIM-9 Sidewinder missiles to the ROC Air Force.

description.zh-cn: 该条约是美国介入台海危机、援助中华民国的法律基础。
description.en: This treaty provided the legal basis for U.S. intervention and aid to the Republic of China in the Taiwan Strait Crisis.

description.zh-cn: 彭帅指控康洁在其背后多次进行言语侮辱。
description.en: Peng Shuai accused Kang Jie of verbally insulting her multiple times behind her back.

description.zh-cn: 在彭帅发布指控文章约二十分钟后，新浪微博官方删除了该文章，并禁言了其账号。
description.en: About twenty minutes after Peng Shuai published her accusation post, Sina Weibo officially deleted the post and silenced her account.

description.zh-cn: WTA主席西蒙发表声明，表示对事件深感担忧，并要求进行全面、公平、透明的调查。
description.en: WTA Chairman Steve Simon issued a statement expressing deep concern about the incident and demanding a full, fair, and transparent investigation.

description.zh-cn: 因担忧彭帅的安全和对其事件处理方式，WTA宣布立即暂停所有在中国（包括香港）的WTA巡回赛赛事。
description.en: Due to concerns for Peng Shuai's safety and the handling of her situation, the WTA announced the immediate suspension of all WTA tournaments in China, including Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 与彭帅进行了数次视讯通话，并于2022年2月5日在北京会面。
description.en: Had several video calls with Peng Shuai and met with her in Beijing on February 5, 2022.

description.zh-cn: 联合国人权事务高级专员办事处呼吁中国对彭帅的指控进行全面和透明的调查。
description.en: The UN Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights called on China to conduct a full and transparent investigation into Peng Shuai's allegations.

description.zh-cn: 美国白宫呼吁中国当局提供独立的、可核实的证据，证明彭帅的下落和她的安全。
description.en: The US White House called on Chinese authorities to provide independent, verifiable proof of Peng Shuai's whereabouts and her safety.

description.zh-cn: 巴黎和会决定将德国在山东的权益转让给日本，这一围绕山东问题的主权争议直接点燃了中国民众的怒火，成为五四运动的导火索和核心原因。
description.en: The Paris Peace Conference's decision to transfer German rights in Shandong to Japan, a sovereignty dispute surrounding the Shandong question, directly ignited the anger of the Chinese people, becoming the trigger and core reason for the May Fourth Movement.

description.zh-cn: 新文化运动所倡导的民主、科学思想以及反传统精神，为五四运动提供了思想启蒙和组织上的准备。
description.en: The ideas of democracy and science, as well as the anti-traditional spirit advocated by the New Culture Movement, provided ideological enlightenment and organizational preparation for the May Fourth Movement.

description.zh-cn: 五四运动极大地激发了民众的思想和政治热情，反过来帮助新文化运动进一步推广，但也导致了其内部分化。
description.en: The May Fourth Movement greatly stimulated the ideological and political enthusiasm of the public, which in turn helped to further promote the New Culture Movement, although it also led to its internal division.

description.zh-cn: 在《晨报》发表《外交警报敬告国民》一文，向社会公开了外交失败的消息，直接点燃了学生和民众的爱国情绪，成为运动的催化剂。
description.en: Published 'Diplomatic Warning to Our Countrymen' in the 'Morning Post', publicly disclosing the news of the diplomatic failure, which directly ignited the patriotic sentiment of students and the public, acting as a catalyst for the movement.

description.zh-cn: 作为北京大学校长，蔡元培以其“兼容并包”的学风为运动提供了思想温床，并在运动期间通过私下支持和公开辞职的方式声援学生。
description.en: As the President of Peking University, Cai Yuanpei provided an intellectual breeding ground for the movement with his principle of 'inclusiveness,' and supported the students through private encouragement and public resignation during the movement.

description.zh-cn: 在五四运动中，曹汝霖被学生视为“国贼”，住宅遭焚。作为学生运动主要攻击目标，他在全国压力下于6月9日被迫辞去交通总长职务。
description.en: During the May Fourth Movement, Cao Rulin was denounced by students as a 'national traitor,' and his residence was set on fire. As a primary target of the student movement, he was forced to resign from his position as Minister of Communications on June 9th under national pressure.

description.zh-cn: 五四运动当天，他被学生视为“国贼”，在曹汝霖家被痛打。随后在全国压力下，他被迫辞去驻日公使职务。
description.en: On the day of the May Fourth Movement, he was regarded as a 'national traitor' by students and beaten at Cao Rulin's residence. Subsequently, under national pressure, he was forced to resign from his post as Minister to Japan.

description.zh-cn: 陆宗舆在学生运动中被视为“国贼”，成为主要攻击目标。在全国压力下，他最终被迫辞去货币局总裁职务。
description.en: During the student movement, Lu Zongyu was regarded as a 'national traitor' and became a primary target. Under national pressure, he was eventually forced to resign from his position as President of the Currency Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 由于无法平息全国性的抗议浪潮，钱能训内阁被迫解散。
description.en: Unable to quell the nationwide wave of protests, the Qian Nengxun Cabinet was forced to dissolve.

description.zh-cn: 导致中国代表团拒绝在《凡尔赛条约》上签字。
五四运动促进了马克思主义等激进政治思潮在中国的传播，扩大了共产主义思想的影响力。
description.en: The May Fourth Movement promoted the spread of radical political ideologies such as Marxism in China, expanding the influence of communist thought.

description.zh-cn: 根据毛泽东的理论，五四运动标志着中国无产阶级登上政治舞台，开启了新民主主义革命阶段。
description.en: According to Mao Zedong's theory, the May Fourth Movement marked the ascent of the Chinese proletariat onto the political stage, initiating the stage of the New Democratic Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 蒋介石否定新文化运动，认为其“崇拜外国”、“推翻礼教否定本国历史”，破坏了中国固有道德。
description.en: Chiang Kai-she rejected the New Culture Movement, believing it 'worshipped foreign things' and 'overthrew traditional etiquette and negated national history,' thus destroying China's inherent morality.

description.zh-cn: 认为五四运动将一个文化运动转变为政治运动，干扰了新文化运动的深入发展。
孙中山公开支持五四运动，赞扬青年学生的爱国行为，认为其将来收效必将伟大且久远。
description.en: Sun Yat-sen publicly supported the May Fourth Movement, praising the patriotic actions of the youth and students, believing its future effects would be great and long-lasting.

description.zh-cn: 为北伐准备了舆论、人心、思想和干部。
五四运动在北京政府大规模逮捕学生后，发展为六三运动，运动的中心和参与阶层均得以扩大。
description.en: Following the mass arrest of students by the Beijing government, the May Fourth Movement evolved into the June 3rd Movement, expanding both its center and its participating social classes.

description.zh-cn: 五四运动导致中国拒签《凡尔赛条约》，使得山东问题悬而未决，为该问题在后来的华盛顿会议上重开谈判并最终解决创造了条件。
description.en: The May Fourth Movement led to China's refusal to sign the Treaty of Versailles, leaving the Shandong Problem unresolved and creating the conditions for the issue to be renegotiated and ultimately settled at the later Washington Conference.

description.zh-cn: 派遣代表来到中国，帮助建立了共产主义小组，并发起和主持了中共一大。
带领中国共产党策划并发动了非基督教运动。
虹桥机场事件被视为淞沪会战的导火线之一，直接导致了战事的爆发。
description.en: The Hongqiao Airport Incident is considered one of the catalysts for the Battle of Shanghai, directly leading to the outbreak of the war.

description.zh-cn: 卢沟桥事变后，中日冲突扩大，最终导致淞沪会战的爆发。
作为中方最高统帅，决定在上海开辟战场以分散日军兵力，并指挥了整个战役。
作为日军上海派遣军司令官，指挥日军在上海的进攻。
利用其在上海的地方关系，配合国军作战计划，在闸北秘密修建钢筋水泥掩体。
西安事变导致原驻京沪区的国军精锐部队被调走，顿挫了淞沪作战的准备工作。
率领国军第八十八师一营坚守四行仓库，掩护主力部队撤退。
会战以日军胜利、国军被迫撤退、上海沦陷告终，国军精锐损失惨重。
日军在付出惨重伤亡后取得战役胜利，占领上海，但其“三月亡华”的速胜计划被打破。
在坚守宝山城的战斗中阵亡。
在进攻持志大学时被炮弹击中阵亡。
在掩护主力部队撤退时于白鹤港牺牲。
在事变前策动张学良和杨虎城，并在事变发生后参与谈判，推动其和平解决以促成抗日统一战线。
事变前与中共代表商谈，达成合作抗日协议。
在西安事变前坚决执行“攘外必先安内”的剿共政策。
西安事变后，将张学良长期软禁。
西安事变后，逼迫杨虎城出国，后将其长期监禁并最终杀害。
在南京主张武力讨伐张学良、杨虎城，反对和平解决事变。
主张和平解决事变，并亲自赴西安谈判促成蒋介石获释。
作为中共代表赴西安，参与谈判，确定了和平解决的方针。
指示中国共产党，要求和平解决事变，释放蒋介石以促成抗日统一战线。
在事变中，于西京招待所被第十七军扣押时中枪遇难。
在1935年秋至1936年初奉蒋介石命令在西北剿共，与红军在劳山、榆林桥等地作战并遭受损失。
东北军第六十七军与红军达成互不侵犯、恢复通商的口头协议，此后双方关系转为秘密合作。
根据文本记载，王以哲已秘密加入中国共产党。
公元前306年，越王无彊被楚国杀死。
description.en: In 306 BC, King Wuqiang of Yue was killed by the state of Chu.

description.zh-cn: 秦朝在福建设置闽中郡，是第一个在福建设立行政机构的中原王朝。
description.en: The Qin dynasty established the Minzhong Commandery in Fujian, being the first Central Plains dynasty to set up an administrative body in Fujian.

description.zh-cn: 杀东越王余善以降汉。
description.en: Killed King Yushan of Dongyue and surrendered to Han.

description.zh-cn: 闽国后来为南唐所灭。
description.en: The Min Kingdom was later conquered by the Southern Tang.

description.zh-cn: 在洋务运动中开办福州船政局。
description.en: Established the Fuzhou Arsenal during the Self-Strengthening Movement.

description.zh-cn: 成为近代中国海军的摇篮。
description.en: Became the cradle of the modern Chinese Navy.

description.zh-cn: 发动“闽变”，在福建建立中华共和国。
description.en: Launched the 'Fujian Rebellion' and established the Chinese Republic in Fujian.

description.zh-cn: 对福建省大部分地区进行实质管辖。
description.en: Exercises de facto control over most of Fujian Province.

description.zh-cn: 对福建省部分地区（金门、马祖）进行实质管辖。
description.en: Exercises de facto control over parts of Fujian Province (Kinmen, Matsu).

description.zh-cn: 1974年1月，江青等人发动了“批林批孔运动”。
该案对四人帮成员进行了法律审判和定罪。
种姓制度带来的社会问题引发了沙门新思潮的出现。
佛教是沙门新思潮中包含的宗教改革思潮之一。
从孔雀王朝开始，佛教向南北两个方向广泛传播。
佛教僧团的根本分裂形成了上座部。
大力扶持佛教事业的发展，并颁布《断酒肉文》，开启了汉传佛教素食的传统。
梁武帝受《大般涅槃经》影响，认为僧侣应遵守不食肉的规定。
将禅宗传入中国并被尊为初祖。
上书《谏迎佛骨表》激烈反对佛教。
佛教于东汉时期传入中国，对中国文化产生了深远影响。
于前202年在定陶登基正式称帝，立国号“汉”。
王莽篡汉，改国号为“新”，建立新朝。
篡夺西汉政权，导致西汉灭亡。
曹丕接受汉献帝禅让（代汉），结束了东汉王朝。
在长达四年的楚汉战争中为敌对双方。
刘邦在垓下之战中击败项羽，为建立汉朝奠定了基础。
在垓下之战中，韩信设下十面埋伏大败楚军，项羽被刘邦击败，最终自刎乌江，导致其败亡。
向汉武帝提出“罢黜百家，独尊儒术”的建议并被采纳。
汉惠帝在位时，大权尽为太后吕雉掌握。
与萧何合谋，以陈豨已死为由诱骗韩信至长乐宫钟室并将其处死。
汉惠帝刘盈是吕雉的儿子。
汉文帝的统治开启了文景之治，与汉景帝共同开创了这一盛世。
description.en: The reign of Emperor Wen initiated the Rule of Wen and Jing.

description.zh-cn: 汉文帝与汉景帝共同开创了文景之治。
晁错建议削夺诸藩王的封地，引发了七国之乱。
任用周亚夫出兵平叛，在三个月内弭平了叛乱。
曹操“挟天子以令诸侯”，架空汉室权力，汉献帝成为其控制下的傀儡皇帝。
两次出使西域，开辟了丝绸之路。
1955年，时任国务院总理周恩来批示同意在北京建设电视台的计划。
1953年，当时的中央广播事业局派员赴捷克斯洛伐克学习电视技术，为建立电视台做准备。
批准原北京电视台更名为“中央电视台”。

relationships.source: BAIDU:深化党和国家机构改革方案

description.zh-cn: 根据该方案，合并组建中央广播电视总台。
原中央人民广播电台建制撤销，与中国中央电视台、中国国际广播电台整合组建中央广播电视总台。
中央广播电视总台作为国务院直属事业单位，归口中共中央宣传部领导。
电影频道为中共中央宣传部的挂靠频道。
制作中央电视台国防军事频道的部分节目。

relationships.source: BAIDU:中国农业电影电视中心

description.zh-cn: 制作中央电视台农业农村频道的部分节目。
原中央电视台直属企业单位，央视建制撤销后转由中央广播电视总台领导管理。
“左派”一词起源于法国大革命时期，当时支持革命的人士坐在议会的左边。
居伊·德波是情境主义国际的参与者。
根据路克·马奇的定义，激进左派希望彻底改革资本主义，而极端左派则抨击所有与资本主义的妥协。
毛泽东多次接见红卫兵之后，保皇派和造反派的区分开始出现，此事件激化了派系分化。
description.en: After Mao Zedong received the Red Guards, the distinction between the Royalist and Rebel factions began to emerge, and this event intensified factional differentiation.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东多次接见红卫兵之后，保皇派和造反派的区分开始出现，此事件激化了派系分化。
description.en: After Mao Zedong received the Red Guards, the distinction between the Royalist and Rebel factions began to emerge, and this event intensified factional differentiation.

description.zh-cn: 在各派系斗争中，部分保皇派官员及军区负责人对造反派实行镇压清算，并在其控制的部分地区引发了屠杀事件，如广西文革屠杀。
description.en: During factional struggles, massacres such as the Guangxi Cultural Revolution Massacre occurred in areas controlled by the Royalists.

description.zh-cn: 在广西文革屠杀中，造反派是主要受害群体。
撰文批判后文革时代的“保皇毛派”，认为他们是形左实右的专政右派、纳粹主义的信徒。
一月风暴后，保皇派和造反派之间斗争激化。
一月风暴后，保皇派和造反派之间斗争激化。
作为参与方，与保皇派在重庆发生大规模武斗。
造反派是文化大革命时期的产物，并在运动中发展壮大。
造反派是夺权运动的主要执行者。
造反派与保守派（保皇派）之间时常爆发武斗。
1967-68年间的大规模武斗导致中国大陆进入“全面内战”状态。
1968年夏，毛泽东思想宣传队开始进驻各单位，制止武斗，导致红卫兵组织迅速没落。
1968年底，在毛泽东“大联合”的口号下，全国所有工人造反派组织均被解散。
在“清理阶级队伍”运动中，许多造反派领袖和成员遭到清算整肃。
毛泽东通过写信和散发其大字报的方式，表达了对清华附中红卫兵的支持。
造反派红卫兵的一个特征是批判血统论。
毛泽东八次接见红卫兵使得造反派红卫兵形成气候，并迅速发展。
二月逆流后，造反派红卫兵开始分裂。
为制止大学武斗，毛泽东召见了包括蒯大富在内的首都红卫兵五大领袖。
为制止大学武斗，毛泽东召见了包括聂元梓在内的首都红卫兵五大领袖。
为制止大学武斗，毛泽东召见了包括谭厚兰在内的首都红卫兵五大领袖。
为制止大学武斗，毛泽东召见了包括韩爱晶在内的首都红卫兵五大领袖。
为制止大学武斗，毛泽东召见了包括王大宾在内的首都红卫兵五大领袖。
文革后“清理三种人”运动的主要对象是文革中的造反派成员。
全国范围的民变与群雄割据最终导致了隋朝的灭亡。
description.en: The nationwide rebellions and warlordism ultimately led to the collapse of the Sui dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 李渊在隋末民变后，于长安接受隋恭帝杨侑禅让，建立唐朝。
description.en: Li Yuan accepted the abdication of Emperor Gong Yang You in Chang'an and established the Tang dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 李建成在玄武门之变中被诛杀。
李元吉在玄武门之变中被诛杀。
玄武门之变后，李渊被迫禅让帝位给李世民。
唐高宗时期，唐朝联合新罗灭亡高句丽。
安史之乱中，太子李亨在灵武自行登基，是为唐肃宗。
黄巢之乱严重破坏江南经济，极大动摇了唐朝的统治基础。
朱温为扫除称帝障碍，在胁迫唐昭宗迁都洛阳后，于天祐元年（904年）八月十一日夜间（公历904年9月22日）派部将朱友恭、氏叔琮等人入宫将其弑杀。
description.en: To remove obstacles to his own enthronement, Zhu Wen, after forcing Emperor Zhaozong of Tang to move the capital to Luoyang, dispatched his generals Zhu Yougong, Shi Shucong, and others to assassinate him in the palace on the night of September 22, 904.

description.zh-cn: 朱温逼迫唐哀帝禅位，篡夺了政权。
朱温逼迫唐哀帝禅位，篡夺了唐朝政权，建立了后梁，导致唐朝彻底灭亡。
description.en: Zhu Wen forced Emperor Ai of Tang to abdicate, usurped the Tang dynasty's power, established the Later Liang, leading to the complete demise of the Tang dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 907年，朱温接受唐哀帝“禅位”后，正式称帝，建国号“梁”，史称后梁，中国进入五代十国时期。
description.en: In 907, after Zhu Wen accepted the 'abdication' of Emperor Ai of Tang, he officially ascended the throne and established the state of 'Liang', known in history as the Later Liang, marking China's entry into the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝的灭亡开启了五代十国时期。
1547年，伊凡四世加冕为沙皇，建立俄罗斯沙皇国。
description.en: In 1547, Ivan IV was crowned Tsar, establishing the Tsardom of Russia.

description.zh-cn: 大日本帝国在日俄战争中作为主要交战方击败了俄罗斯帝国。
description.en: The Empire of Japan defeated the Russian Empire in the Russo-Japanese War, acting as the main combatants.

description.zh-cn: 由布尔什维克发起的十月革命推翻了克伦斯基的临时政府。
description.en: The October Revolution, led by the Bolsheviks, overthrew Kerensky's Provisional Government.

description.zh-cn: 十月革命后建立了苏维埃俄国，即俄罗斯苏维埃联邦社会主义共和国。
description.en: After the October Revolution, Soviet Russia was established, officially the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic.

description.zh-cn: 1991年苏联解体。
description.en: The Soviet Union was dissolved in 1991.

description.zh-cn: 因对南千岛群岛（日称北方四岛）的领土争端而关系紧张，至今未签署和平协议。
description.en: Relations are strained due to the territorial dispute over the Southern Kuril Islands (known as the Northern Territories in Japan), and a peace treaty has not been signed.

description.zh-cn: 2008年，俄罗斯军队入侵格鲁吉亚以帮助其境内的分离主义势力。
description.en: In 2008, the Russian military invaded Georgia to aid separatist forces within its territory.

description.zh-cn: 2014年，俄罗斯入侵并吞并了乌克兰的克里米亚半岛，侵犯了乌克兰的领土完整。
description.en: In 2014, Russia invaded and annexed Ukraine's Crimean Peninsula, violating Ukraine's territorial integrity.

description.zh-cn: 2022年俄罗斯对乌克兰发动全面入侵，引发大规模战争。
description.en: In 2022, Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine, triggering a large-scale war.

description.zh-cn: 两国于1997年签订《俄罗斯和白俄罗斯联盟条约》设立俄白联盟，寻求一体化。2022年2月24日，白俄罗斯允许俄罗斯利用其领土集结军队并发动对乌克兰的军事攻势。
description.en: The two countries signed the 'Treaty on the Union between Belarus and Russia' in 1997, establishing the Union State and seeking integration. On February 24, 2022, Belarus allowed Russia to use its territory to assemble troops and launch military offensives against Ukraine.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东在阅读清华附中红卫兵的大字报后决定支持红卫兵。他对刘少奇和邓小平派出工作组的做法进行了批评，导致工作组被撤销。
description.en: After Mao Zedong read the big-character posters from the Red Guards of Tsinghua University High School, he decided to support them. He criticized Liu Shaoqi and Deng Xiaoping for dispatching work groups, leading to their subsequent withdrawal.

description.zh-cn: 将清华附中红卫兵反对工作组的大字报转交给毛泽东，促使毛泽东表态支持红卫兵。
毛泽东在此信中对红卫兵的造反精神表示坚决支持，使红卫兵运动自此蓬勃发展。
继被老红卫兵批斗两年后，习近平又被造反派批斗。

relationships.target: BAIDU:批判资产阶级反动路线

description.zh-cn: “联动”的成立旨在抵制“批判资产阶级反动路线”运动，反对冲击领导干部和老红卫兵。
中央文革下令将“联动”打成“反动组织”，并逮捕其成员。
有说法称邓榕是殴打卞仲耘致死的红卫兵之一。
有说法称刘亭是殴打卞仲耘致死的红卫兵之一。
萨摩藩与长州藩等是讨幕派的核心力量，主导了推翻幕府的战争。
长州藩与萨摩藩等是讨幕派的核心力量，主导了推翻幕府的战争。
日本通过《日韩合并条约》吞并大韩帝国，朝鲜半岛成为日本领土的一部分。
1910年《日韩合并条约》后，日本吞并朝鲜半岛，进行殖民统治。
作为协约国成员向德意志帝国宣战，参与第一次世界大战。
在第一次世界大战中，日本作为协约国成员向德国宣战，并占领了德国在中国的租借地胶州湾。
二二六事件后，军部势力扩张，确立了军国体制。
通过《反共产国际协定》和《三国同盟条约》结成军事政治同盟。
通过《反共产国际协定》和《三国同盟条约》结成军事政治同盟。
日本于1940年9月27日与德国、意大利签署《三国同盟条约》，正式成为轴心国核心成员之一。
description.en: Japan signed the Tripartite Pact with Germany and Italy on September 27, 1940, formally becoming a member of the Axis powers.

description.zh-cn: 日本于1945年8月15日宣布无条件投降，标志着大日本帝国名存实亡。
1947年《日本国宪法》颁布后，日本官方不再使用“大日本帝国”国号，标志着大日本帝国的终结。
韩国刺客安重根在哈尔滨火车站刺杀了伊藤博文，此事件加速了日本吞并朝鲜的进程。
description.en: Assassinated Itō Hirobumi at Harbin Railway Station.

description.zh-cn: 统制派首脑，在太平洋战争期间担任首相。他作为日本首相，主张对英美开战，是日本军国主义的代表人物，也是发动太平洋战争的主要决策者之一。
description.en: Leader of the Control Faction and a representative figure of Japanese militarism. As Prime Minister of Japan during the Pacific War, he advocated for war against the US and UK and was one of the key decision-makers in launching the Pacific War.

description.zh-cn: 担任第一任内阁总理大臣，并在此后多次组阁。
杜月笙是上海青帮的头目之一。
与黄金荣、张啸林合开三鑫公司，并称“上海滩三大亨”。
与黄金荣、张啸林合开三鑫公司，并称“上海滩三大亨”。
抗日战争爆发后，因张啸林与日本合作，杜月笙策划了对张啸林的暗杀。
与黄金荣、张啸林共同开设，垄断上海法租界毒品交易。
与黄金荣、张啸林重组中华共进会，用于协助清党。
诱杀共产党工人领袖汪寿华，协助蒋介石镇压工人武装，推动了清党行动。
在四一二事件中协助国民党清党，杀害共产党员。
在四一二事件中协助蒋介石清党，并长期担任其顾问。
通过募捐、运送物资、组织别动队、协助军统等方式积极抗日。
动员门生组织别动队协助国军作战，并秘密修建防御工事。
应潘汉年的要求，向八路军捐赠物资。
内战末期，杜月笙选择离开上海，前往香港。
在上海实行市值改革期间，以投机倒把罪逮捕了杜月笙的儿子杜维屏。
蒋经国在上海“打老虎”，逮捕了杜月笙的儿子，双方关系紧张。
在吴作栋担任总理期间，李显龙担任副总理。
description.en: Lee Hsien Loong served as Deputy Prime Minister during Goh Chok Tong's premiership.

description.zh-cn: 在李显龙担任总理期间，黄循财担任副总理。
description.en: Lawrence Wong served as Deputy Prime Minister during Lee Hsien Loong's premiership.

description.zh-cn: 李显龙在与马英九会面后，称其为“老朋友”。
description.en: After meeting with Ma Ying-jeou, Lee Hsien Loong referred to him as an "old friend".

description.zh-cn: 因李显龙关于南海仲裁案的言论，时任中国外交部副部长刘振民要求新加坡“少管闲事”。
description.en: Due to Lee Hsien Loong's remarks on the South China Sea arbitration, then Chinese Vice Foreign Minister Liu Zhenmin asked Singapore to "mind its own business".

description.zh-cn: 因李显龙的言论，时任中华民国外交部长陈唐山称新加坡为“鼻屎大的国家”，后正式道歉。
description.en: Angered by Lee Hsien Loong's remarks, then ROC Foreign Minister Chen Tang-shan called Singapore a "booger-sized country", and later formally apologized.

description.zh-cn: 因李光耀故居处置问题发表联合声明，表示对李显龙“失去信心”。
description.en: Issued a joint statement regarding the disposal of Lee Kuan Yew's house, expressing a "loss of confidence" in Lee Hsien Loong.

description.zh-cn: 因李光耀故居处置问题发表联合声明，表示对李显龙“失去信心”。
description.en: Issued a joint statement regarding the disposal of Lee Kuan Yew's house, expressing a "loss of confidence" in Lee Hsien Loong.

description.zh-cn: 李显龙因梁实轩转发关于1MDB丑闻的文章而起诉其诽谤。
description.en: Lee Hsien Loong sued Leong Sze Hian for defamation for sharing an article about the 1MDB scandal.

description.zh-cn: 强烈谴责李显龙就“越南入侵柬埔寨”发表的言论。
description.en: Strongly condemned Lee Hsien Loong's remarks about the "Vietnamese invasion of Cambodia".

description.zh-cn: 朱祁钰是明宣宗的次子。
胡善祥为明宣宗元配皇后，后被废。
朱高煦曾企图在明宣宗即位途中设伏，后于宣德元年（1426年）起兵谋反，是为高煦之乱，最终被明宣宗平定并处死。
description.en: Zhu Gaoxu attempted to ambush the Xuande Emperor on his way to the throne, and later in 1426, he launched a rebellion, known as the Gao Xu's Rebellion, which was eventually suppressed and he was executed by Emperor Xuande.

description.zh-cn: 宣德元年，朱高煦趁北京地震之机，在乐安州谋反，并企图勾结英国公张辅为内应。
description.en: In 1426, Zhu Gaoxu took advantage of an earthquake in Beijing to launch a rebellion in Le'an Prefecture, attempting to collude with Zhang Fu, the Duke of Ying, as an insider.

description.zh-cn: 明宣宗采纳杨荣建议，御驾亲征，迅速抵达乐安，迫使朱高煦出降，平定叛乱。
description.en: Accepting Yang Rong's advice, the Xuande Emperor personally led the campaign, quickly arrived at Le'an, forced Zhu Gaoxu to surrender, and suppressed the rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 宣德元年，明宣宗下令设置内书堂，教导宦官们读书。
黎利在安南反叛明朝统治，并屡次打败明军。
受明宣宗命令执行第七次下西洋任务。
宣德三年，亲率精骑击败入侵边疆的兀良哈军队。
于1940年至1955年担任保守党党魁。
description.en: Served as Leader of the Conservative Party from 1940 to 1955.

description.zh-cn: 两度出任英国首相。
description.en: Served as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom twice.

description.zh-cn: 丘吉尔是希特勒和纳粹主义的坚定反对者，并领导同盟国战胜了轴心国。
description.en: Churchill was a staunch opponent of Hitler and Nazism, and led the Allies to victory over the Axis powers.

description.zh-cn: 作为战时首相，丘吉尔通过其演说和领导，鼓舞了英国人民和军队，赢得了不列颠战役。
description.en: As wartime Prime Minister, Churchill inspired the British people and military through his speeches and leadership to win the Battle of Britain.

description.zh-cn: 两人在二战期间建立了密切的个人友谊和政治同盟，对同盟国的胜利至关重要。
description.en: The two leaders developed a close personal friendship and political alliance during World War II, which was crucial for the Allied victory.

description.zh-cn: 艾德礼在丘吉尔的战时联合政府中担任副首相。
description.en: Attlee served as Deputy Prime Minister in Churchill's wartime coalition government.

description.zh-cn: 领导工党在1945年大选中击败丘吉尔领导的保守党，成为新任首相。
description.en: Led the Labour Party to victory over Churchill's Conservative Party in the 1945 general election, becoming the new Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 丘吉尔在乔治六世国王在位期间担任首相。
description.en: Churchill served as Prime Minister during the reign of King George VI.

description.zh-cn: 丘吉尔在伊丽莎白二世女王在位初期担任首相。
description.en: Churchill served as Prime Minister during the early reign of Queen Elizabeth II.

description.zh-cn: 艾登在丘吉尔的第二届政府中担任副首相，并最终接替他成为首相。
description.en: Eden served as Deputy Prime Minister in Churchill's second government and eventually succeeded him as Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 时任第一海军大臣的丘吉尔批准并推动了达达尼尔海峡的进攻计划。
description.en: As First Lord of the Admiralty, Churchill approved and pushed the plan to attack the Dardanelles.

description.zh-cn: 战役的失败导致丘吉尔的政治声望严重受损，并被迫辞去第一海军大臣的职务。
description.en: The failure of the campaign severely damaged Churchill's political reputation and forced him to resign as First Lord of the Admiralty.

description.zh-cn: 受刘备白帝城托孤，辅佐后主刘禅，总揽蜀汉军政大事。
description.en: Entrusted by Liu Bei at Baidicheng, he assisted Emperor Liu Shan, overseeing all military and political affairs of Shu Han.

description.zh-cn: 由于诸葛亮早期无子，他请求诸葛瑾将诸葛乔过继给他作为养子。
description.en: As Zhuge Liang had no son in his early years, he requested Zhuge Jin to let him adopt Zhuge Qiao.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛乔是诸葛瑾的次子（亲生父子关系），后过继给诸葛亮。
description.en: Zhuge Qiao was the second biological son of Zhuge Jin; later adopted by Zhuge Liang.

description.zh-cn: 二人为至交好友。
description.en: They were close friends.

description.zh-cn: 二人为至交好友。
description.en: They were close friends.

description.zh-cn: 赤壁之战中，孙刘联军大败曹操，不仅挫败了他统一中国的计划，更具体阻止了他统一南方的企图，并奠定了三国鼎立的基础。
description.en: At the Battle of Red Cliffs, the allied forces of Sun and Liu decisively defeated Cao Cao, not only thwarting his ambition to unify China but specifically preventing his attempt to unify southern China, thus laying the foundation for the tripartite division of the Three Kingdoms.

description.zh-cn: 为稳定后方，诸葛亮率军南下平定南中叛乱。
description.en: To stabilize the rear, Zhuge Liang led an army south to pacify the Nanzhong rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 孟获作为南中叛军首领被诸葛亮击败并降服。
description.en: As the leader of the Nanzhong rebels, Meng Huo was defeated and subdued by Zhuge Liang.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮继承刘备遗志，为兴复汉室、克复中原，于228年至234年间五次率军北伐曹魏。
description.en: Inheriting Liu Bei's will, Zhuge Liang led five military expeditions north against Cao Wei between 228 and 234, aiming to restore the Han dynasty and reclaim the Central Plains.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮在第一次北伐前上书刘禅，写下《出师表》。
description.en: Zhuge Liang wrote the 'Chu Shi Biao' as a memorial to Liu Shan before his first Northern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 在后几次北伐中，诸葛亮与司马懿作为蜀魏双方主帅多次对峙。
description.en: In the later Northern Expeditions, Zhuge Liang and Sima Yi confronted each other multiple times as the commanders of the Shu and Wei armies.

description.zh-cn: 马谡因在街亭之战中处置失当，导致蜀军大败，使得第一次北伐失败。
description.en: Ma Su's mishandling of the Battle of Jieting led to a major defeat for the Shu army, causing the failure of the first Northern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 因街亭之败，诸葛亮下令处斩马谡。
description.en: Due to the defeat at Jieting, Zhuge Liang ordered the execution of Ma Su.

description.zh-cn: 在第四次北伐撤退过程中，诸葛亮设伏射杀了追击的魏将张郃。
description.en: During the retreat of the fourth Northern Expedition, Zhuge Liang set an ambush and killed the pursuing Wei general Zhang He.

description.zh-cn: 第四次北伐时，李严负责督运粮草，因运粮不继而谎报军情，导致诸葛亮被迫撤军。
description.en: During the fourth Northern Expedition, Li Yan, responsible for grain transport, failed to supply the army and falsely reported military intelligence, forcing Zhuge Liang to retreat.

description.zh-cn: 事后查明真相，诸葛亮上表弹劾李严，将其废为平民，流放梓潼。
description.en: After discovering the truth, Zhuge Liang impeached Li Yan, had him stripped of his posts and titles, and exiled him to Zitong.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮临终前向后主刘禅推荐蒋琬作为自己的继承人。
description.en: On his deathbed, Zhuge Liang recommended Jiang Wan to Emperor Liu Shan as his successor.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮临终前在蒋琬之后，推荐费祎作为第二继承人。
description.en: On his deathbed, after Jiang Wan, Zhuge Liang recommended Fei Yi as the second successor.

description.zh-cn: 珍珠港事件直接导致美国向日本宣战，正式加入第二次世界大战。

指挥桂系军队在此战役中对解放军进行反击并获胜。
蒋经国派人检查白崇禧的住所，显示其在台受到严密监控。
谷正文回忆曾策划在白崇禧的补药中动手脚，导致其死亡。
在1968年美国总统选举中击败汉弗莱。
description.en: Defeated Humphrey in the 1968 presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 在1972年美国总统选举中以压倒性优势击败麦戈文。
description.en: Defeated McGovern in a landslide in the 1972 presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 作为美国总统对中华人民共和国进行历史性访问。
description.en: As President of the United States, made a historic visit to the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 与苏联等共产主义国家实施缓和政策，签订了SALT I和反弹道导弹条约。
description.en: Implemented the policy of détente with communist nations like the Soviet Union, signing the SALT I and Anti-Ballistic Missile treaties.

description.zh-cn: 访问莫斯科，与苏联领导人勃列日涅夫等人会面，展开激烈谈判。
description.en: Visited Moscow and met with Soviet leader Brezhnev and others for intense negotiations.

description.zh-cn: 水门事件的不断发酵导致尼克松失去政治支持，最终迫使他辞去总统职务。
description.en: The unfolding Watergate scandal caused Nixon to lose political support, ultimately forcing him to resign from the presidency.

description.zh-cn: 在尼克松辞职后，福特总统宣布给予其全面、自由且绝对的赦免。
description.en: After Nixon's resignation, President Ford granted him a full, free, and absolute pardon.

description.zh-cn: 作为众议院非美活动委员会成员，以调查阿尔杰·希斯间谍案而引起全国性关注，并坚信希斯是苏联间谍。
description.en: As a member of the House Un-American Activities Committee, he gained national attention for investigating the Alger Hiss spy case, believing Hiss was a Soviet spy.

position.en: National Security Advisor, Secretary of State

description.zh-cn: 在尼克松政府中担任关键外交职务。
description.en: Held key foreign policy positions in the Nixon administration.

description.zh-cn: 越战是尼克松总统任期内的主要挑战，他推行“越南化”政策以逐步撤军，但战争和国内反战运动给其政府带来巨大压力。
description.en: The Vietnam War was a major challenge of Nixon's presidency; he pursued "Vietnamization" to withdraw troops, but the war and domestic anti-war movements placed immense pressure on his administration.

description.zh-cn: 诱使吕布杀死丁原。
受董卓诱惑而杀害丁原。
董卓与吕布誓为父子，吕布为董卓养子。
与王允合谋刺杀董卓。
董卓死后，李傕与郭汜等董卓旧部联军击败吕布，迫使其逃离长安。
董卓死后，郭汜与李傕等董卓旧部联军击败吕布，迫使其逃离长安。
兵败逃出长安后，吕布曾短暂投靠袁术。
因袁术不满，改投张杨。
离开张杨后，转投袁绍并为其效力。
因吕布恃功自傲，袁绍假意送行，实则派人刺杀，但被吕布识破逃脱。
怂恿吕布部将郝萌起兵造反。
在郝萌反叛时，倒戈对抗郝萌并斩其一臂。
挑拨吕布与袁术的关系，导致吕布与袁术终断盟约。
成功与曹操联络，作为曹操的内应以讨伐吕布。
于下邳之战中击败吕布，并将其缢杀。
在白门楼劝说曹操处死吕布，称其为反复无常之人。
于下邳之战中与宋宪、魏续一同反叛，缚陈宫、高顺投降曹操。
于下邳之战中与侯成、魏续一同反叛，缚陈宫、高顺投降曹操。
于下邳之战中与侯成、宋宪一同反叛，缚陈宫、高顺投降曹操。
吕布麾下名将。
吕布被封为温侯。
吕布在东汉末年担任的官职。

王皇后是唐高宗李治的元配皇后，后被废。
description.en: Empress Wang was the first wife of Emperor Gaozong Li Zhi, and was later deposed.

description.zh-cn: 李治的妃嫔，后被废。
李显是李治的第七子。
唐睿宗李旦是唐高宗李治和武则天的幼子，亦是其第八子。
李弘是李治的第五子。
李贤是李治的第六子。
李忠是李治的长子。
李素节是李治的第四子。
王皇后于永徽六年十月被废，后被武则天处死。
萧淑妃于永徽六年十月被废，后被武则天处死。
王皇后为打击萧淑妃，将武则天纳入后宫。
贺兰氏后被武则天所杀。
武顺是武则天的姐姐。
李治在位初年励精图治，开创了永徽之治。
秦鸣鹤为李治医治头痛。

position.zh-cn: 知尚书及门下二省事、太尉同中书门下三品

description.zh-cn: 在唐高宗朝担任宰相。

position.zh-cn: 中书令、吏部尚书同中书门下三品、尚书右仆射

description.zh-cn: 在唐高宗朝担任宰相。

position.zh-cn: 中书侍郎参知政事、中书令、吏部尚书同中书门下三品、右相

description.zh-cn: 在唐高宗朝担任宰相。
发动昌都战役，向昌都进军。
description.en: Launched the Battle of Chamdo, advancing on Chamdo.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在昌都战役中击败藏军。
description.en: The People's Liberation Army defeated the Tibetan Army in the Battle of Chamdo.

description.zh-cn: 中情局西藏项目向藏人行政中央及相关武装活动提供资金支持，以对抗中国政府。
description.en: The CIA's Tibet program provided financial support to the Central Tibetan Administration and related armed activities to oppose the Chinese government.

description.zh-cn: 六四事件后，挪威诺贝尔委员会授予丹增嘉措诺贝尔和平奖，部分原因是为了对中国政府施加压力。
description.en: After the Tiananmen Square protests, the Norwegian Nobel Committee awarded the Nobel Peace Prize to Tenzin Gyatso, partly to exert pressure on the Chinese government.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀是人民行动党的创始人之一。
description.en: Lee Kuan Yew was one of the founders of the People's Action Party.

description.zh-cn: 吴作栋在李光耀担任总理期间任副总理，后接任总理。
description.en: Goh Chok Tong served as Deputy Prime Minister under Lee Kuan Yew before succeeding him as Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀在吴作栋担任总理期间任国务资政。
description.en: Lee Kuan Yew served as Senior Minister in the cabinet during Goh Chok Tong's premiership.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀带领新加坡政府，配合马来亚及英国殖民政府发起“冷藏行动”，拘捕了大量左翼人士。
description.en: Lee Kuan Yew led the Singapore government, in cooperation with Malayan and British colonial authorities, to launch Operation Coldstore, arresting numerous left-wing figures.

description.zh-cn: 林清祥在冷藏行动中被逮捕关押。
description.en: Lim Chin Siong was arrested and detained during Operation Coldstore.

description.zh-cn: 1961年，行动党内以李光耀为首的“反共分子”与以林清祥为代表的“亲共分子”决裂。
description.en: In 1961, the anti-communist faction led by Lee Kuan Yew split with the pro-communist faction represented by Lim Chin Siong within the PAP.

description.zh-cn: 在新马合并后，李光耀与东姑阿都拉曼在多项政策上产生严重分歧，最终导致新加坡被逐出马来西亚。
description.en: After the merger of Singapore and Malaya, Lee Kuan Yew had serious disagreements with Tunku Abdul Rahman on multiple policies, leading to Singapore's expulsion from Malaysia.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀对邓小平十分尊重，两人在1978年首次会面后建立了良好关系。
description.en: Lee Kuan Yew held Deng Xiaoping in high regard, and the two established a good relationship after their first meeting in 1978.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀于1976年首次访华，会晤了毛泽东。
description.en: Lee Kuan Yew met Mao Zedong during his first visit to China in 1976.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀与时任中华民国总统蒋经国私交甚笃，此深厚友谊是促成新加坡军队移至台湾训练的重要原因之一。
description.en: Lee Kuan Yew had a very good personal relationship with then-President of the Republic of China, Chiang Ching-kuo. This close personal friendship was one of the key reasons for facilitating the training of Singaporean troops in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀与李登辉的交往从密切转向分歧，李光耀后来指责李登辉。
description.en: Lee Kuan Yew's relationship with Lee Teng-hui shifted from close to divergent, with Lee Kuan Yew later criticizing him.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀政府推行以英语为第一语言的教育政策，最终导致以华文教学的南洋大学在1980年关闭。
description.en: The Lee Kuan Yew government's policy of promoting English as the first language led to the closure of the Chinese-medium Nanyang University in 1980.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀政府使用《内部安全法令》将谢太宝未经审判监禁与软禁长达32年。
description.en: The Lee Kuan Yew government used the Internal Security Act to imprison and place Chia Thye Poh under restriction for 32 years without trial.

description.zh-cn: 1996年，李光耀以诽谤罪起诉反对党领袖邓亮洪，迫使其潜逃出国。1997年大选后，李光耀与时任总理吴作栋等共11人再次一同控告邓亮洪诽谤。
description.en: In 1996, Lee Kuan Yew sued opposition leader Tang Liang Hong for defamation, forcing him to flee the country. After the 1997 general election, Lee Kuan Yew, along with then-Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong and 9 others, again sued Tang Liang Hong for defamation.

description.zh-cn: 马哈迪在其文章中提到他经常与李光耀交锋，是政治上的对手。
description.en: In his writings, Mahathir mentioned that he often crossed swords with Lee Kuan Yew, indicating a political rivalry.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀促成了两岸历史性的辜汪会谈在新加坡举行。
description.en: Lee Kuan Yew facilitated the historic Wang-Koo summit between the two sides of the Taiwan Strait to be held in Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 王义川担任民进党政策委员会执行长期间，赖清德为党主席。
王义川担任台中市政府交通局局长期间，林佳龙为台中市市长。
在2019年台中市第五选举区立法委员缺额补选中击败王义川，使其未能当选。
宣布对王义川及其家属实施惩戒。

出道时曾拍拖，后因性格不合分手。
小四至小六就读。
参加业余唱片骑师大赛获亚军后加入。
赏识并邀请周慧敏参与电影演出，后推荐其到唱片公司试音。
鼓励周慧敏参加香港电台主办的业余唱片骑师大赛。
鼓励周慧敏参加香港电台主办的业余唱片骑师大赛。
在香港电台合作主持节目《二人世界》，并多次在音乐上合作。
加盟台湾福茂唱片，开拓国语市场。
为周慧敏的热播代表作《如果你知我苦衷》作曲。
与林隆璇合唱国语歌曲《流言》。
好友关系，古巨基曾担任其演唱会创作总监。
徐志摩在英国剑桥大学期间遇到林徽因，并产生爱慕之情。
徐志摩拜梁启超为师。
劝阻其与陆小曼的恋情，并在他们的婚礼上当众训斥。
徐志摩搭乘的飞机在济南附近坠毁，导致其罹难。
在胡佛总统任期内担任美国陆军参谋长。
description.en: Served as Chief of Staff of the United States Army during President Hoover's term.

description.zh-cn: 在罗斯福总统任期内担任美国陆军参谋长和二战指挥官。
description.en: Served as Chief of Staff of the United States Army and a commander in World War II during President Roosevelt's term.

description.zh-cn: 在韩战战略上与杜鲁门总统存在严重分歧，并公然反对其政策，最终导致被解职。
description.en: Had serious disagreements with President Truman over Korean War strategy, openly opposing his policies, which led to his dismissal.

description.zh-cn: 1903年以第一名的成绩毕业于西点军校。
description.en: Graduated first in his class from West Point in 1903.

description.zh-cn: 担任西点军校校长并推行了一系列改革。
description.en: Served as Superintendent of West Point and implemented a series of reforms.

description.zh-cn: 在胡佛总统命令下，指挥军队暴力驱逐了在华盛顿抗议的退伍军人。
description.en: Under President Hoover's orders, he commanded troops to forcibly disperse protesting veterans in Washington.

description.zh-cn: 不顾高层普遍反对，坚决策划并执行了仁川登陆，扭转了韩战局势。
description.en: Despite widespread opposition from high command, he planned and executed the Incheon Landing, turning the tide of the Korean War.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民志愿军入朝作战，在清川江战役和长津湖战役中击败了麦克阿瑟指挥的联合国军，迫使其大规模撤退。
description.en: The Chinese People's Volunteer Army entered the Korean War and defeated the UN forces under MacArthur's command in the Battle of the Ch'ongch'on River and the Battle of Chosin Reservoir, forcing a major retreat.

description.zh-cn: 杜鲁门总统解除了麦克阿瑟在远东的所有职务，结束了他的军事生涯。
description.en: President Truman relieved MacArthur of all his commands in the Far East, ending his military career.

description.zh-cn: 作为驻日盟军总司令，主导了日本的战后民主化和非军事化改革。
description.en: As Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, he led the post-war democratization and demilitarization reforms of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 曾长期担任麦克阿瑟的副官；1935年，随麦克阿瑟来到菲律宾，担任菲律宾政府军事顾问。
description.en: Served as MacArthur's aide for an extended period; in 1935, he accompanied MacArthur to the Philippines to serve as a military advisor to the Philippine government.

description.zh-cn: 接任第8军团司令，在麦克阿瑟指挥下作战，后接替其联合国军总司令职务。
description.en: Took command of the Eighth Army, fighting under MacArthur's overall command, and later succeeded him as UN Commander.

description.zh-cn: 在一战期间，麦克阿瑟因越级抗议而得罪了远征军司令潘兴，由此结怨。
description.en: During World War I, MacArthur offended AEF Commander Pershing by protesting over his head, creating a lasting enmity.

description.zh-cn: 明宪宗极度宠信比他年长17岁的万贵妃，万贵妃去世后，宪宗因悲伤过度而病逝。
description.en: The Chenghua Emperor was extremely infatuated with Imperial Noble Consort Wan, who was 17 years his senior. After her death, the emperor fell ill from grief and died soon after.

description.zh-cn: 土木堡之变中明英宗被俘，导致朱见深被立为太子。
description.en: After Emperor Yingzong was captured in the Tumu Crisis, Zhu Jianshen was made the crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 景泰三年（1452年），朱祁钰废黜了时为太子的朱见深（后来的明宪宗），将其废为沂王，并改立自己的儿子朱见济为太子。
description.en: In the third year of the Jingtai era (1452), Emperor Zhu Qiyu deposed the then Crown Prince Zhu Jianshen (later the Chenghua Emperor), demoting him to Prince of Yi, and appointed his own son, Zhu Jianji, as the new crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 成化二年，下诏为于谦平反昭雪，恢复其官职并赐祭。
description.en: Upon ascending the throne, he posthumously rehabilitated Yu Qian.

description.zh-cn: 任用李贤为内阁首辅等贤臣。
description.en: Appointed capable ministers like Li Xian, who served as Grand Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 设立西厂以加强特务统治。
description.en: Established the Western Depot to strengthen secret police rule.

description.zh-cn: 将汪直调离京城，并解散西厂。
description.en: Transferred Wang Zhi out of the capital and disbanded the Western Depot.

description.zh-cn: 在房县大石厂立黄旗起义，为郧阳民变的首领之一。
description.en: Raised a yellow banner and started an uprising at Dashi Factory in Fang County, becoming one of the leaders of the Yunyang refugee rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 受明宪宗派遣，讨伐并平定了郧阳民变。
description.en: Dispatched by the Chenghua Emperor, he campaigned against and suppressed the Yunyang refugee rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 成化年间，明朝与朝鲜联手进攻建州女真。
description.en: During the Chenghua era, the Ming and Joseon dynasties jointly attacked the Jianzhou Jurchens.

description.zh-cn: 处处制约同治帝，使其一生未获实权。
辛酉政变后，载淳的年号由“祺祥”改为“同治”，其母慈禧太后与嫡母慈安太后开始垂帘听政。
同治帝在位期间，清朝剿灭了太平天国运动。
引导同治帝微服出宫寻花问柳，被野史及部分史学家认为是导致其早逝的元凶。

据正史记载，同治帝死于天花。

description.zh-cn: 在篡汉前，曹丕是东汉的臣子。
与曹植争夺世子之位，曹丕即位后不仅对其实行政治迫害，甚至屡次欲杀害曹植。
description.en: Became rivals over the succession, Cao Pi repeatedly attempted to kill Cao Zhi after ascending the throne.

description.zh-cn: 因丁仪是曹植派系成员，在称帝后将其全族处刑。
因甄氏失意有怨言，曹丕大怒，于黄初二年（221年）六月遣使赐死甄氏。
孙权拒绝派儿子为人质并拒绝向曹魏称臣后，曹丕发动多次伐吴战争，双方走向敌对。
采纳陈群建议，实行九品中正制作为新的选官制度。
曹丕因年少时向曹洪借钱和借绢被拒而心怀怨恨。称帝后，罗织罪名将曹洪下狱并削爵为民。
description.en: Cao Pi held a grudge against Cao Hong for refusing to lend him money and silk in his youth. After becoming emperor, he fabricated charges to imprison Cao Hong and strip him of his title.

description.zh-cn: 因夏侯尚宠爱妾侍，曹丕下令处死其妾，导致夏侯尚精神衰弱至死。
因鲍勋多次忠谏，曹丕恼怒并找理由将其处死。

description.zh-cn: 戚夫人是刘如意的生母。
雍齿曾占据丰邑反叛刘邦，归降魏国。刘邦承认雍齿是其生平最痛恨的人，因雍齿曾多次羞辱他。
刘邦曾率部投奔项梁，成为其下属。
张良加入刘邦部队，成为其重要谋士，协助其建立汉朝。
刘邦在秦末民变中起兵反秦，为其后来的事业奠定了基础。
刘邦在楚汉战争中最终获胜，得以统一天下，建立汉朝。
刘邦起兵反秦，并率先攻入关中，接受秦王子婴投降，灭亡秦朝。
在鸿门宴上，刘邦成功化解了项羽的杀机，得以保全性命。
白登之围后，刘邦采纳娄敬建议，开启了与匈奴的和亲政策。
白登之围的军事失利直接促使汉朝对匈奴采取和亲政策。
刘邦进入关中后，为了安抚民心，宣布废除秦朝苛法，约法三章。
为巩固刘氏江山，刘邦与群臣杀白马为盟，立下“非刘氏而王者，天下共击之”的誓言。
晚年宠爱戚夫人，多次想废黜太子刘盈，改立其子刘如意为太子。
刘邦死后，吕雉将戚夫人囚禁，后砍断其手脚，挖去眼睛，熏聋耳朵，灌了哑药，扔到厕所之中，称其为“人彘”。
description.en: After Liu Bang's death, Empress Lü imprisoned Consort Qi, later had her limbs cut off, eyes gouged out, ears deafened, forced her to drink a mute potion, and threw her into a latrine, calling her the 'human swine'.

description.zh-cn: 临终前因担心樊哙帮助吕氏作乱，下令陈平、周勃将其斩杀，后因刘邦驾崩而未执行。
叶卡捷琳娜·格拉泽是约瑟夫·斯大林的母亲。
斯大林在列宁去世后与托洛茨基展开权力斗争，最终将托洛茨基驱逐并派人将其暗杀。
description.en: After Lenin's death, Stalin engaged in a power struggle with Trotsky, eventually exiling and assassinating him.

description.zh-cn: 斯大林在与托洛茨基的斗争中曾与加米涅夫结盟，后将其作为“新反对派”清除。
description.en: Stalin allied with Kamenev against Trotsky, but later eliminated him as part of the 'New Opposition'.

description.zh-cn: 斯大林在与托洛茨基的斗争中曾与季诺维也夫结盟，后将其作为“新反对派”清除。
description.en: Stalin allied with Zinoviev against Trotsky, but later eliminated him as part of the 'New Opposition'.

description.zh-cn: 斯大林在清除“左派”后，将支持新经济政策的布哈林作为右倾投降主义集团清除。
description.en: After eliminating the 'Left Opposition', Stalin purged Bukharin, who supported the NEP, as a 'Right Deviation'.

description.zh-cn: 列宁在遗嘱中建议将斯大林从总书记的职位上调开，称其“太粗暴”。
description.en: In his testament, Lenin recommended removing Stalin from the post of General Secretary, calling him 'too rude'.

description.zh-cn: 斯大林强制推行农业集体化政策以解决粮食短缺问题并消灭富农阶级。
description.en: Stalin forced the policy of agricultural collectivization to solve grain shortages and eliminate the kulak class.

description.zh-cn: 强制集体化和过高的粮食征购导致了大规模饥荒。
description.en: Forced collectivization and excessive grain procurement led to a massive famine.

description.zh-cn: 以基洛夫被刺杀为契机，斯大林发动了对党、政、军的大规模清洗。
description.en: Using the assassination of Kirov as a pretext, Stalin launched a large-scale purge of the party, government, and military.

description.zh-cn: 托洛茨基及其支持者是斯大林大清洗的主要目标之一。
description.en: Trotsky and his supporters were one of the main targets of Stalin's Great Purge.

description.zh-cn: 签订《苏德互不侵犯条约》，形成暂时性合作关系。
description.en: Signed the Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact, forming a temporary cooperative relationship.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国入侵苏联后，双方成为战争中的主要对手。
description.en: After Nazi Germany invaded the Soviet Union, the two became major adversaries in the war.

description.zh-cn: 该条约使德国得以入侵波兰而无后顾之忧，从而引发了第二次世界大战。
description.en: The pact allowed Germany to invade Poland without fear of a two-front war, triggering World War II.

description.zh-cn: 二战后，斯大林在东欧扶植社会主义阵营，形成了东方集团。
description.en: After WWII, Stalin fostered a socialist bloc in Eastern Europe, forming the Eastern Bloc.

description.zh-cn: 作为东方集团的领导人，斯大林与西方国家展开对峙，形成冷战格局。
description.en: As the leader of the Eastern Bloc, Stalin engaged in a standoff with Western countries, leading to the Cold War.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立后，斯大林领导的苏联与中国结盟。
description.en: After the founding of the PRC, the Soviet Union under Stalin's leadership allied with China.

description.zh-cn: 该条约正式确立了中苏之间的同盟关系。
description.en: This treaty formally established the alliance between China and the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 该条约正式确立了中苏之间的同盟关系。
description.en: This treaty formally established the alliance between China and the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 赫鲁晓夫在苏共二十大上发表秘密报告，全面批判斯大林，掀起去斯大林化运动。
description.en: Khrushchev delivered a secret speech at the 20th Congress of the CPSU, criticizing Stalin and launching the de-Stalinization campaign.

description.zh-cn: 这份报告是去斯大林化运动的开端。
description.en: This speech marked the beginning of the de-Stalinization campaign.

description.zh-cn: 该运动旨在清除斯大林的个人崇拜和政治影响。
description.en: The campaign aimed to dismantle Stalin's cult of personality and political influence.

description.zh-cn: 被怀疑在斯大林中风后故意延误治疗，甚至下毒谋杀斯大林。
description.en: Suspected of intentionally delaying medical treatment or even poisoning Stalin after his stroke.

description.zh-cn: 以其谋略辅佐朱元璋开创明朝。

position.zh-cn: 高安县丞、江浙儒学副提举

description.zh-cn: 刘基考中元朝进士后曾担任数个官职，后皆弃官。
刘璟为刘基次子。
刘基是南宋抗金将领刘光世的后人。
因刘基不顾李善长求情而处死李彬，二人开始不和。
胡惟庸对与刘基的旧怨怀恨在心，后在刘基病重时派医生医治，刘基服药后病情加重，疑似被其毒害。
据《明史》记载，朱元璋派胡惟庸带医生探视生病的刘基（刘伯温），胡惟庸趁机下毒。刘基服药后病情加重，终至死亡。
description.en: According to the History of Ming, the Hongwu Emperor (Zhu Yuanzhang) sent Hu Weiyong with a doctor to visit the ailing Liu Ji (Liu Bowen). Hu Weiyong took the opportunity to poison him. After taking the medicine, Liu Ji's condition worsened, eventually leading to his death.

description.zh-cn: 刘基主张诛杀作乱的方国珍，方国珍因此畏惧并贿赂京中权贵以求自保。
在归隐青田期间著《郁离子》一书以明志。
在鄱阳湖之战中，刘基向朱元璋献计，最终击败陈友谅。
刘基认为韩林儿出身牧童，不应尊奉，并向朱元璋陈述天命所在。
杨宪平日待刘基很好。
刘基反对朱元璋任命杨宪为丞相，认为其“有相才无相器”。
刘基反对朱元璋任命汪广洋为丞相，认为其气量比杨宪更狭窄。
刘基反对朱元璋任命胡惟庸为丞相，比喻他可能会“偾辕”（弄翻车）。
刘璟当面称明成祖为“殿下”，并直言其“逃不得一‘篡’字”，后被捕入狱并自缢身亡。
刘光世是南宋的抗金将领。
与宋濂并称为“明初诗文三大家”。朱元璋攻下浙东后，同时听闻刘基和宋濂等人的名声并进行招聘。
丰臣秀吉最初以仆人身份侍奉织田信长，后因才干而发迹。
织田信长于本能寺之变中殒命。
明智光秀发动本能寺之变，背叛织田信长。
在本能寺之变后，丰臣秀吉于山崎之战中击败叛臣明智光秀。
为给织田信长报仇，率军与明智军展开决战。
在清洲会议后成为政治对手，并于贱岳之战中击败柴田胜家。
织田信孝与柴田胜家结盟对抗秀吉，失败后被迫自杀。
在小牧长久手之战中与德川家康对立。
德川家康最终臣服于丰臣秀吉。
为实现称霸亚洲的野心，发动了对朝鲜的侵略战争。
命令茶人千利休切腹自尽。
实行刀狩令以加强兵农分离政策。
实行太阁检地以确立税制。
高台院是丰臣秀吉的正室。
淀殿是丰臣秀吉的侧室。
养子关系
description.en: Adopted son

description.zh-cn: 近卫前久认丰臣秀吉为犹子（养子）。
description.en: Adopted son

在民进党党内立法委员初选中击败时任立委何志伟，获得提名并最终当选。
王世坚是张荣宗的外孙。
因《自立晚报》转让问题发生争议，互相指控欺骗。
带领群众抗议连战进行和平之旅，引发冲突。
指控许博允为倒扁运动的“密使”，后被许博允控告诽谤并败诉。
在百万人民倒扁运动期间多次批评施明德，并因指控其收受豪宅而被判诽谤。
抗议马英九特别费案一审无罪判决。
公开表达支持并到场声援占领立法院的学生。
在太阳花学运期间与张安乐率领之群众对峙。
在柯文哲担任台北市长期间，以“柯黑”著称，频繁在市议会质询并批评柯文哲。
批评姚文智“失格、没品兼缺德”，后被姚文智控告并败诉。
在姚文智辞去立委参选市长后，明确表态民进党应自提人选参加补选，拒绝与柯文哲合作。
在政论节目上因武汉包机返台事件发生激烈言语冲突。
在市议会质询时赠送蒋中正肖像等礼物，以表达政治立场和进行监督。
在台北市议会就北农菜价问题与时任总经理的韩国瑜爆发激烈辩论。
多次以打赌方式（如高空弹跳、跳海）表达对蔡英文选举的支持或庆祝其当选。
张玮津承认曾配合王世坚伪造录音以掩盖绯闻，后又翻供，引发争议。
指控陈由豪赠与施明德豪宅。
指控洪智坤收受远雄企业团不当价金，后被洪智坤控告诽谤并败诉。
指控远雄企业团给予洪智坤不当价金。
在立法院就李敖神州文化之旅等议题发生激烈言语冲突。
因其政治立场而怒批张玮珊“为敌国助威”、应该被“斩立决”。
