description.zh-cn: 冯君衡是高力士（本名冯元一）的生父。
高力士被宦官高延福收为养子。
高力士幼年入宫，受到武则天赏识，并被其赐姓高。
唐肃宗即位后，高力士在朝中任职，但不久后因得罪当权宦官李辅国而被贬谪。
追随李隆基发动唐隆政变，杀死韦皇后与安乐公主。
在唐隆政变中被杀死。
李辅国弄权，因高力士当众呵斥其对太上皇玄宗不敬而怀恨在心，将其弹劾流放至巫州。
高力士为维护唐玄宗，当众呵斥弄权的李辅国，因此被其记恨并弹劾流放。
唐玄宗驾崩的消息传到正被赦免回京途中的高力士耳中，他哀痛欲绝，最终吐血而亡。
追念高力士侍奉玄宗有功，追赠其为扬州大都督，并允许其陪葬泰陵。
高力士曾清楚地预见安禄山将要造反的隐患，并提醒唐玄宗，但未被采纳。
安史之乱爆发后，高力士随唐玄宗逃往蜀地。
夏宝龙担任中共中央港澳工作办公室主任。
description.en: Xia Baolong serves as the Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Work Office of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙兼任国务院港澳事务办公室主任。
description.en: Xia Baolong concurrently serves as the Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙担任第十三届全国政协副主席（2018年3月14日至2023年3月10日），并兼任秘书长（2018年3月14日至2020年5月19日）。
description.en: Xia Baolong served as the Vice Chairman of the 13th National Committee of the CPPCC (March 14, 2018 - March 10, 2023), and concurrently as its Secretary-General (March 14, 2018 - May 19, 2020).

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙担任中共浙江省委书记。
description.en: Xia Baolong served as the Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙担任浙江省人大常委会主任。
description.en: Xia Baolong served as the Director of the Standing Committee of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙于2011年8月任浙江省代省长，2012年1月正式当选为省长。
description.en: Xia Baolong became the Acting Governor of Zhejiang in August 2011 and was officially elected Governor in January 2012.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙担任中央港澳工作领导小组常务副组长。
description.en: Xia Baolong serves as the Executive Deputy Head of the Central Leading Group on Hong Kong and Macao Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙于1973年11月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Xia Baolong joined the Communist Party of China in November 1973.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙在北京大学攻读博士学位期间的导师为吴树青。
description.en: Wu Shuqing was Xia Baolong's advisor during his doctoral studies at Peking University.

position.en: Deputy Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Committee of the CPC

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙在担任中共浙江省委副书记期间，是时任省委书记习近平的副手。
description.en: When Xia Baolong served as Deputy Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee, he was the deputy to then-Provincial Party Secretary Xi Jinping.

position.zh-cn: 全国政协副主席、秘书长
position.en: Vice Chairman and Secretary-General of the CPPCC National Committee

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙在担任全国政协副主席和秘书长期间，主席是汪洋。
description.en: While Xia Baolong served as Vice Chairman and Secretary-General of the CPPCC National Committee, the Chairman was Wang Yang.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙担任浙江省省长期间，省委书记是赵洪祝。
description.en: While Xia Baolong was Governor of Zhejiang, the Provincial Party Secretary was Zhao Hongzhu.

position.zh-cn: 国务院港澳事务办公室主任
position.en: Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office of the State Council

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙担任国务院港澳事务办公室主任期间，国务院总理是李克强。
description.en: While Xia Baolong was Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office of the State Council, the Premier was Li Keqiang.

position.zh-cn: 国务院港澳事务办公室主任
position.en: Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office of the State Council

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙担任国务院港澳事务办公室主任期间，国务院总理是李强。
description.en: While Xia Baolong is Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office of the State Council, the Premier is Li Qiang.

position.zh-cn: 中共中央港澳工作办公室副主任
position.en: Deputy Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Work Office of the CPC Central Committee

description.zh-cn: 周霁是中共中央港澳工作办公室主任夏宝龙的副手。
description.en: Zhou Ji is a deputy to Xia Baolong, Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Work Office of the CPC Central Committee.

position.zh-cn: 中共浙江省委副书记、省长
position.en: Deputy Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Committee of the CPC, Governor

description.zh-cn: 在夏宝龙担任浙江省委书记期间，车俊接替李强担任省委副书记、省长。
description.en: While Xia Baolong was Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee, Che Jun succeeded Li Qiang as Deputy Secretary and Governor.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙担任浙江省省长期间，龚正任常务副省长。
description.en: While Xia Baolong was Governor of Zhejiang, Gong Zheng served as Executive Vice Governor.

position.zh-cn: 国务院港澳事务办公室副主任（正部长级）
position.en: Deputy Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office of the State Council (Ministerial Level)

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙接任国务院港澳事务办公室主任后，原主任张晓明改任为副主任。
description.en: After Xia Baolong took over as Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office of the State Council, the former director Zhang Xiaoming was reassigned as Deputy Director.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙在宁波会见了马来西亚前首相马哈迪·莫哈末一行。
description.en: Xia Baolong met with former Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad and his delegation in Ningbo.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙在杭州会见了马来西亚最高元首端姑阿都哈林一行。
description.en: Xia Baolong met with the Supreme Head of State of Malaysia, Tuanku Abdul Halim, and his delegation in Hangzhou.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙在杭州会见了来访的苏丹总统巴希尔一行。
description.en: Xia Baolong met with the visiting Sudanese President Omar al-Bashir and his delegation in Hangzhou.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙在深圳主持座谈会，会见了香港特区行政长官李家超。
description.en: Xia Baolong chaired a symposium in Shenzhen and met with Hong Kong SAR Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙在北京会见香港机场管理局主席林天福一行。
description.en: Xia Baolong met with Fred Lam Tin-fuk, Chairman of the Airport Authority Hong Kong, and his delegation in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙在北京会见香港特区政府律政司司长林定国一行。
description.en: Xia Baolong met with Paul Lam Ting-kwok, Secretary for Justice of the HKSAR Government, and his delegation in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙在北京会见香港特区政府环境及生态局局长谢展寰一行。
description.en: Xia Baolong met with Tse Chin-wan, Secretary for Environment and Ecology of the HKSAR Government, and his delegation in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙在北京会见香港特区政府财政司司长陈茂波一行。
description.en: Xia Baolong met with Paul Chan Mo-po, Financial Secretary of the HKSAR Government, and his delegation in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙在此期间会见了香港特区政府律政司副司长张国钧。
description.en: During this period, Xia Baolong met with Horace Cheung Kwok-kwan, Deputy Secretary for Justice of the HKSAR Government.

description.zh-cn: 在2019年反对逃犯条例修订草案运动后，夏宝龙于2020年2月13日被任命兼任国务院港澳事务办公室主任，以应对香港局势。
description.en: Following the 2019 Anti-Extradition Law Amendment Bill Movement, Xia Baolong was appointed to concurrently serve as Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office of the State Council on February 13, 2020, to handle the situation in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙将“反修例运动”定性为“颜色革命”和“黑暴”，并做出强硬表态准备出手抗击，体现其反对立场。
description.en: Xia Baolong labeled the 'Anti-Extradition Law Movement' as a 'color revolution' and 'black violence,' and made a tough stance to prepare for a counterattack, reflecting his opposition.

description.zh-cn: 因被指“损害香港自治”，夏宝龙被美国财政部依据《香港自治法》制裁。
description.en: Xia Baolong was sanctioned by the U.S. Department of the Treasury under the Hong Kong Autonomy Act for 'undermining Hong Kong's autonomy'.

description.zh-cn: 美国财政部依据《香港自治法》对夏宝龙等官员实施制裁。
description.en: The U.S. Department of the Treasury imposed sanctions on officials including Xia Baolong based on the Hong Kong Autonomy Act.

description.zh-cn: 夏宝龙在讲话中表示，游行不是表达诉求的唯一方式，且容易被骑劫，诱发社会对抗，不鼓励此种行为。
description.en: In a speech, Xia Baolong stated that protest marches are not the only way to express demands and can be easily hijacked, leading to social confrontation, thereby discouraging such activities.

description.zh-cn: 在全民国家安全教育日致辞中，夏宝龙回应并反驳了美国副总统万斯的“乡巴佬”言论。
description.en: In his speech on National Security Education Day, Xia Baolong responded to and refuted the 'hillbilly' remarks made by U.S. Vice President J. D. Vance.

description.zh-cn: 大学士孙承宗巡视辽东后，采纳了袁崇焕在宁远设防的意见，并在此后镇守山海关时更加倚重袁崇焕，视其为防御后金的关键人物。
description.en: After inspecting Liaodong, Grand Secretary Sun Chengzong adopted Yuan Chonghuan's proposal to fortify Ningyuan. He subsequently relied heavily on Yuan while defending Shanhai Pass, viewing him as a key figure in the defense against the Later Jin.

description.zh-cn: 后金大汗努尔哈赤亲率大军进攻宁远，发动了宁远之战。
description.en: The Later Jin khan Nurhaci personally led a large army to attack Ningyuan, initiating the Battle of Ningyuan.

description.zh-cn: 袁崇焕在宁远之战和宁锦之战中，两次成功指挥明军击败后金的进攻。
description.en: Yuan Chonghuan successfully commanded the Ming forces to defeat the Later Jin invasions twice, in the Battle of Ningyuan and the Battle of Ningjin.

description.zh-cn: 崇祯帝即位后，清除魏忠贤党羽，随即任命袁崇焕为兵部尚书兼蓟辽督师，并赐予尚方宝剑，委托其处理辽东事务。
description.en: After ascending the throne and purging the faction of Wei Zhongxian, the Chongzhen Emperor appointed Yuan Chonghuan as Minister of War and Viceroy of Jiliao, granting him an imperial sword and entrusting him with the affairs of Liaodong.

description.zh-cn: 袁崇焕以毛文龙骄横跋扈、虚报兵饷、不受节制等十二条罪状，用尚方宝剑将其在皮岛斩杀。
description.en: Yuan Chonghuan executed Mao Wenlong on Pi Island with an imperial sword, citing twelve crimes including arrogance, insubordination, and fraudulent reporting of military strength and expenses.

description.zh-cn: 皇太极亲自率领后金军队，绕道蒙古地区，突破长城喜峰口，发动了己巳之变，兵临北京城下。
description.en: Hong Taiji personally led the Later Jin army to bypass the Ming defenses via Mongolia, broke through the Great Wall at Xifengkou, and launched the Jisi Incident, bringing his forces to the gates of Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 己巳之变中，袁崇焕虽千里驰援，但京城被围，朝野怨谤纷起，加上后金的反间计，最终导致崇祯帝将其逮捕并处死。
description.en: During the Jisi Incident, although Yuan Chonghuan rushed to defend the capital, the siege of Beijing led to widespread blame and slander at court. This, combined with a Later Jin deception stratagem, resulted in his arrest and execution by the Chongzhen Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 后金在己巳之变期间使用反间计，故意让被俘的明朝宦官听到袁崇焕与后金有密约的假消息并放其逃回，成功使崇祯帝对袁崇焕产生怀疑。
description.en: During the Jisi Incident, the Later Jin employed a deception stratagem by allowing captured Ming eunuchs to 'overhear' false information about a secret pact between Yuan Chonghuan and the Later Jin before releasing them. This successfully sowed suspicion in the mind of the Chongzhen Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 受反间计和朝臣诬陷影响，崇祯帝于1629年12月将袁崇焕下狱，并于次年9月以“通虏谋叛”等罪名将其凌迟处死。
description.en: Influenced by the deception stratagem and slander from court officials, the Chongzhen Emperor imprisoned Yuan Chonghuan in December 1629 and had him executed by lingchi in September of the following year on charges including treasonous collusion with the enemy.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆皇帝下诏为袁崇焕平反，肯定他“尚能忠于所事”，认为其罹难是因“主暗政昏”，深表悯恻。
description.en: The Qianlong Emperor issued an edict posthumously rehabilitating Yuan Chonghuan, affirming that he was 'loyal to his duty' and attributing his tragic fate to a 'dim-witted and muddle-headed ruler,' expressing deep sympathy.

description.zh-cn: 宁锦之战后，魏忠贤党羽以袁崇焕不救锦州为由进行弹劾，导致袁崇焕被迫请求辞官归乡。
description.en: After the Battle of Ningjin, allies of Wei Zhongxian impeached Yuan Chonghuan on the grounds of failing to relieve Jinzhou, forcing Yuan to request retirement from his post.

description.zh-cn: 在位期间，明熹宗采纳朝臣建议，提拔袁崇焕至兵部任职，并在宁远之战后多次予以升迁和嘉奖，支持其在辽东的军事活动。
description.en: During his reign, the Tianqi Emperor adopted the advice of his officials to promote Yuan Chonghuan to a position in the Ministry of War. Following the Battle of Ningyuan, he repeatedly promoted and rewarded Yuan, supporting his military activities in Liaodong.

description.zh-cn: 祖大寿是袁崇焕麾下的重要将领，长期跟随其镇守辽东，是关宁军的核心人物。
description.en: Zu Dashou was a key general under Yuan Chonghuan's command and a core figure of the Guanning Army, having long followed him in defending Liaodong.

position.zh-cn: 普鲁士王国首相, 北德意志邦联首相, 德意志帝国首相
position.en: Minister President of Prussia, Chancellor of the North German Confederation, Chancellor of the German Empire

description.zh-cn: 奥托·冯·俾斯麦长期担任普鲁士及统一后的德国的政府首脑。
description.en: Otto von Bismarck served for a long time as the head of government of Prussia and later the unified Germany.

description.zh-cn: 在威廉一世担任普鲁士国王和德意志皇帝期间，被其任命为首相，两人形成了十分特别的牢固关系。
description.en: During Wilhelm I's reign as King of Prussia and German Emperor, Bismarck was appointed as his Minister President, and the two formed a particularly strong bond.

description.zh-cn: 在腓特烈三世短暂的99天统治期间，俾斯麦继续担任首相。
description.en: During Frederick III's brief 99-day reign, Bismarck continued to serve as Chancellor.

description.zh-cn: 在威廉二世执政初期担任首相，后因分歧被其解职。
description.en: Served as Chancellor during the early years of Wilhelm II's reign, but was later dismissed due to disagreements.

description.zh-cn: 因政策分歧和权力斗争，年少气盛的威廉二世解除了俾斯麦的首相职务，迫使其下野。
description.en: Due to policy disagreements and power struggles, the young and ambitious Wilhelm II dismissed Bismarck from his position as Chancellor, forcing him into retirement.

description.zh-cn: 列奥·冯·卡普里维接替俾斯麦担任德意志帝国首相。
description.en: Leo von Caprivi succeeded Bismarck as Chancellor of the German Empire.

description.zh-cn: 通过三场统一战争（普丹、普奥、普法战争），主导并完成了德意志的统一。
description.en: Orchestrated and completed the unification of Germany through three wars of unification (Second Schleswig, Austro-Prussian, and Franco-Prussian).

description.zh-cn: 就石勒苏益格和荷尔斯泰因问题制造与丹麦的争端，并联合奥地利发动战争。
description.en: Created a dispute with Denmark over Schleswig and Holstein and launched a war in alliance with Austria.

description.zh-cn: 在普丹战争中与奥地利联合击败丹麦，逼使其放弃石勒苏益格和荷尔斯泰因。
description.en: In the Second Schleswig War, allied with Austria to defeat Denmark, forcing it to cede Schleswig and Holstein.

description.zh-cn: 为将奥地利排除出德意志邦联，通过外交手段孤立奥地利后，策划并发动了普奥战争。
description.en: To exclude Austria from the German Confederation, he diplomatically isolated Austria and then planned and initiated the Austro-Prussian War.

description.zh-cn: 在普奥战争中击败奥地利，将其势力逐出德意志邦联，为德国统一铺平了道路。
description.en: Defeated Austria in the Austro-Prussian War, expelling its influence from the German Confederation and paving the way for German unification.

description.zh-cn: 以西班牙王位继承问题制造争端，逼使法国对普鲁士宣战，以团结德意志民族，完成统一大业。
description.en: Used the Spanish succession issue to provoke a dispute, compelling France to declare war on Prussia, thereby uniting the German nation to complete the unification.

description.zh-cn: 在普法战争中击败法国，促成德国统一，并夺取阿尔萨斯和洛林。
description.en: Defeated France in the Franco-Prussian War, leading to German unification and the annexation of Alsace-Lorraine.

description.zh-cn: 在色当会战中战胜法军，导致拿破仑三世投降。
description.en: Defeated the French army at the Battle of Sedan, leading to the surrender of Napoleon III.

description.zh-cn: 普法战争的胜利直接促成了德意志帝国的成立。
description.en: The victory in the Franco-Prussian War directly led to the proclamation of the German Empire.

description.zh-cn: 与意大利签订攻守同盟条约，在普奥战争中共同对奥地利作战。
description.en: Signed an offensive and defensive alliance treaty with Italy to fight together against Austria in the Austro-Prussian War.

description.zh-cn: 为孤立法国，与奥匈帝国、俄罗斯帝国缔结“三帝同盟”。
description.en: To isolate France, he formed the 'League of the Three Emperors' with Austria-Hungary and the Russian Empire.

description.zh-cn: 在俄国退出三帝同盟后，随即与奥匈帝国重订盟约，建立德奥同盟。
description.en: After Russia's withdrawal from the League of the Three Emperors, he promptly renegotiated an alliance with Austria-Hungary, establishing the Dual Alliance.

description.zh-cn: 在俄土战争后主持柏林会议，协调欧洲大国纷争，自称“诚实经纪人”。
description.en: After the Russo-Turkish War, he presided over the Congress of Berlin to mediate disputes among European great powers, calling himself an 'honest broker'.

description.zh-cn: 柏林会议的结果使俄国在巴尔干地区的扩张受阻，成为大输家，导致德俄关系恶化。
description.en: The outcome of the Congress of Berlin thwarted Russia's expansion in the Balkans, making it a major loser and causing a deterioration in German-Russian relations.

description.zh-cn: 弗朗茨·斐迪南是卡尔·路德维希大公的长子。
description.en: Franz Ferdinand was the eldest son of Archduke Karl Ludwig.

description.zh-cn: 弗朗茨·斐迪南是玛丽亚·安农齐亚塔的儿子。
description.en: Franz Ferdinand was the son of Maria Annunciata.

description.zh-cn: 于1900年与霍恩贝格女公爵苏菲结婚。
description.en: Married Sophie, Duchess of Hohenberg in 1900.

description.zh-cn: 马克西米利安是弗朗茨·斐迪南的儿子。
description.en: Maximilian was the son of Franz Ferdinand.

description.zh-cn: 弗朗茨·斐迪南是弗兰茨·约瑟夫一世皇帝的侄子。
description.en: Franz Ferdinand was the nephew of Emperor Franz Joseph I.

description.zh-cn: 自1896年起担任奥匈帝国皇储，直至1914年遇刺身亡。
description.en: Served as the Crown Prince of Austria-Hungary from 1896 until his assassination in 1914.

position.zh-cn: 中尉、上尉、上校、少将、总司令
position.en: Lieutenant, Captain, Colonel, Major General, Inspector General

description.zh-cn: 弗朗茨·斐迪南14岁时加入奥匈陆军，并逐步晋升，最终成为军队总司令。
description.en: Franz Ferdinand joined the Austro-Hungarian Army at age 14, was progressively promoted, and eventually became its Inspector General.

description.zh-cn: 弗朗茨·斐迪南是哈布斯堡-洛林王朝的成员。
description.en: Franz Ferdinand was a member of the House of Habsburg-Lorraine.

description.zh-cn: 鲁道夫皇太子在梅耶林惨案中自杀，使得弗朗茨·斐迪南成为奥匈帝国的皇位继承人。
description.en: The suicide of Crown Prince Rudolf in the Mayerling incident made Franz Ferdinand the heir presumptive to the Austro-Hungarian throne.

description.zh-cn: 普林齐普在萨拉热窝刺杀了弗朗茨·斐迪南。
description.en: Princip assassinated Franz Ferdinand in Sarajevo.

description.zh-cn: 普林齐普在萨拉热窝刺杀了弗朗茨·斐迪南的妻子苏菲。
description.en: Princip assassinated Sophie, the wife of Franz Ferdinand, in Sarajevo.

description.zh-cn: 普林齐普的刺杀行为直接引发了萨拉热窝事件。
description.en: Princip's assassination directly caused the Sarajevo incident.

description.zh-cn: 萨拉热窝事件是第一次世界大战的导火线。
description.en: The Sarajevo incident was the catalyst for World War I.

description.zh-cn: 由于其父母的婚姻属于贵贱通婚，马克西米利安·霍恩贝格没有皇位继承权。
description.en: Due to his parents' morganatic marriage, Maximilian, Duke of Hohenberg had no succession rights to the throne.

description.zh-cn: 大久保利通出身于萨摩藩下级藩士家庭，并以萨摩藩士的身份效命。
description.en: Ōkubo Toshimichi was from a lower-ranking samurai family of the Satsuma Domain and served as a Satsuma samurai.

description.zh-cn: 大久保利通是萨摩藩实际领导人岛津久光的心腹。
description.en: Ōkubo Toshimichi was a trusted confidant of Shimazu Hisamitsu, the de facto leader of the Satsuma Domain.

description.zh-cn: 大久保利通对推动明治维新做出了巨大贡献。
description.en: Ōkubo Toshimichi made significant contributions to advancing the Meiji Restoration.

description.zh-cn: 早期与西乡隆盛同为萨摩藩士，共同致力于推翻幕府和推动明治维新。
description.en: Early in his career, he worked alongside Saigō Takamori as fellow Satsuma samurai, dedicated to overthrowing the shogunate and promoting the Meiji Restoration.

description.zh-cn: 因征韩论问题与西乡隆盛发生政治对立，最终在西南战争中成为敌对双方。
description.en: He became politically opposed to Saigō Takamori over the Seikanron debate, eventually becoming adversaries during the Satsuma Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 木户孝允、大久保利通与西乡隆盛并称“维新三杰”，共同推动明治维新。在明治政府初期，木户孝允与大久保利通共同合作，并在大阪会议上达成和解，共同推进立宪政体。
description.en: Kido Takayoshi, Ōkubo Toshimichi, and Saigō Takamori were known as the 'Three Great Nobles of the Restoration,' jointly advancing the Meiji Restoration. In the early Meiji government, Kido Takayoshi and Ōkubo Toshimichi collaborated, reconciled at the Osaka Conference, and jointly promoted a constitutional system.

description.zh-cn: 1871年，大久保利通与木户孝允等人一同参加岩仓使节团，出使欧洲及美国。
description.en: In 1871, Ōkubo Toshimichi, along with Kido Takayoshi and others, joined the Iwakura Mission to Europe and the United States.

description.zh-cn: 西乡隆盛是留守政府中主张以武力迫使朝鲜开国（即征韩论）的主要倡导者和领导者之一。他的这一主张与明治政府的核心成员产生严重分歧，最终导致其下野。
description.en: Saigō Takamori was one of the key leaders and a leading proponent in the caretaker government who advocated for using military force to open Korea (Seikanron). His stance led to serious disagreements with core members of the Meiji government, ultimately resulting in his resignation.

description.zh-cn: 围绕征韩论的辩论最终演变为“明治六年政变”，导致武断派参议辞职。
description.en: The debate over the Seikanron culminated in the 'Meiji-roku no Seihen,' leading to the resignation of the war-faction councillors.

description.zh-cn: 在政变中，征韩论被否决，西乡隆盛辞去参议等职务下野。
description.en: During the political crisis, the Seikanron was rejected, and Saigō Takamori resigned from his positions, including that of Councillor.

description.zh-cn: 西南战争以政府军胜利告终，西乡隆盛在战斗中身亡。
description.en: The Satsuma Rebellion ended in victory for the government forces, and Saigō Takamori died in battle.

description.zh-cn: 岛田一郎率领六名刺客在纪尾井坂发动了对大久保利通的暗杀。
description.en: Shimada Ichirō led six assassins in carrying out the assassination of Ōkubo Toshimichi at Kioizaka.

description.zh-cn: 大久保利通在纪尾井坂之变中被暗杀身亡。
description.en: Ōkubo Toshimichi was assassinated in the Kioizaka Incident.

description.zh-cn: 大久保利通作为全权大臣前往中国就牡丹社事件进行交涉，最终促成《北京专约》的签订。
description.en: As plenipotentiary minister, Ōkubo Toshimichi went to China to negotiate over the Mudan Incident, ultimately leading to the signing of the Sino-Japanese Treaty of Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 日本将《北京专约》中“保民义举”的措辞解释为清廷承认琉球为日本属地，并随后进行了琉球处分。
description.en: Japan interpreted the phrase 'a just undertaking to protect our people' in the treaty as the Qing court's recognition of Ryukyu as a Japanese territory, and subsequently carried out the Ryukyu Disposition.

description.zh-cn: 就读于联合国译员培训班。
description.en: Studied at the UN Interpreter Training Program.

description.zh-cn: 在外交部翻译室工作期间，曾为邓小平等国家领导人担任翻译。
description.en: While working at the Department of Translation and Interpretation of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, he served as an interpreter for state leaders such as Deng Xiaoping.

description.zh-cn: 张维为提出中国是一个“文明型国家”的概念。
description.en: Zhang Weiwei proposed the concept that China is a 'civilizational state'.

description.zh-cn: 张维为在英国学者马丁·雅克的基础上，提出了中国是一个“文明型国家”的概念。
description.en: Zhang Weiwei proposed the concept of China as a 'civilizational state' based on the work of British scholar Martin Jacques.

description.zh-cn: 张维为与弗朗西斯·福山在上海就“中国模式”进行辩论，反对其提出的“历史终结论”。
description.en: Zhang Weiwei debated with Francis Fukuyama in Shanghai on the 'China model', opposing his 'End of History' thesis.

description.zh-cn: 张维为在与福山的辩论中称“历史终结论”已经终结，并持续批判该理论。
description.en: In his debate with Fukuyama, Zhang Weiwei claimed that the 'End of History thesis' has itself ended, and has continued to criticize the theory.

description.zh-cn: 弗朗西斯·福山是“历史终结论”的提出者。
description.en: Francis Fukuyama is the originator of the 'End of History' thesis.

description.zh-cn: 弗朗西斯·福山预言中国也会出现类似阿拉伯之春的革命。
description.en: Francis Fukuyama predicted that a revolution similar to the Arab Spring would also occur in China.

description.zh-cn: 张维为认为类似阿拉伯之春的革命在中国绝无可能发生。
description.en: Zhang Weiwei argued that a revolution similar to the Arab Spring was absolutely impossible in China.

description.zh-cn: 张小圃于1947年在江苏南通遭国民党还乡团杀害。
description.en: Zhang Xiaopu was killed by the Kuomintang Homecoming Corps in Nantong, Jiangsu in 1947.

description.zh-cn: 冯玮公开质疑张维为的学术资质，称其曾任职的日内瓦外交与国际关系学院是“野鸡大学”。
description.en: Feng Wei publicly questioned Zhang Weiwei's academic credentials, calling the Geneva School of Diplomacy and International Relations where he worked a 'diploma mill'.

description.zh-cn: 相蓝欣撰文批评张维为对“洋教授”头衔的看法，并认为张所鼓吹的中国模式优越论十分荒谬。
description.en: Xiang Lanxin wrote articles criticizing Zhang Weiwei's views on 'foreign professor' titles and considered Zhang's advocacy for the superiority of the China model to be absurd.

description.zh-cn: 胡宗南是蒋介石的心腹之一，深受其器重与信任。
description.en: Hu Zongnan was one of Chiang Kai-shek's confidants and was highly valued and trusted by him.

description.zh-cn: 因胡宗南身高不足，经时任军校党代表廖仲恺特许被录取。
description.en: Due to Hu Zongnan's insufficient height, he was admitted to the military academy with special permission from Liao Zhongkai, the party representative at the time.

description.zh-cn: 参与组织复兴社。
description.en: Participated in the organization of the Fuxing Society.

description.zh-cn: 作为中共间谍，将胡宗南的军事行动计划泄露给中共方面，导致国军多次作战失利。
description.en: As a CCP spy, he leaked Hu Zongnan's military operational plans to the CCP, leading to several operational failures for the Nationalist army.

description.zh-cn: 胡宗南晚年曾感慨称周恩来是其“政治克星”。
description.en: In his later years, Hu Zongnan lamented that Zhou Enlai was his 'political nemesis'.

description.zh-cn: 介绍其学生叶霞翟与胡宗南相识，促成两人婚事。
description.en: Introduced his student Ye Xiazhai to Hu Zongnan, which led to their marriage.

description.zh-cn: 两人曾在西安相处多年，交往甚密。
description.en: The two spent many years together in Xi'an and had a very close relationship.

description.zh-cn: 在宜川战役中阵亡。
description.en: Killed in action during the Yichuan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次国共内战后期，胡宗南指挥的部队屡战失利，最终全军覆没。
description.en: In the later stages of the Second Chinese Civil War, the troops commanded by Hu Zongnan suffered repeated defeats and were eventually annihilated.

description.zh-cn: 胡宗南赴郑州会晤时任参谋总长陈诚，检讨战局并研究作战方案。
description.en: Hu Zongnan went to Zhengzhou to meet with then Chief of the General Staff Chen Cheng to review the war situation and study operational plans.

description.zh-cn: 胡宗南赴郑州会晤时任郑州绥靖公署主任顾祝同，检讨战局并研究作战方案。
description.en: Hu Zongnan went to Zhengzhou to meet with Gu Zhutong, then Director of the Zhengzhou Pacification Headquarters, to review the war situation and study operational plans.

description.zh-cn: 1879年从普林斯顿大学毕业。
description.en: Graduated from Princeton University in 1879.

degree.zh-cn: 历史与政治科学哲学博士
degree.en: Ph.D. in History and Political Science

description.zh-cn: 1886年从约翰·霍普金斯大学获得历史与政治科学的哲学博士学位。
description.en: Received a Ph.D. in History and Political Science from Johns Hopkins University in 1886.

description.zh-cn: 担任普林斯顿大学第13任校长。
description.en: Served as the 13th President of Princeton University.

description.zh-cn: 担任第28任美国总统。
description.en: Served as the 28th President of the United States.

description.zh-cn: 伍德罗·威尔逊是民主党成员，并作为其候选人当选新泽西州州长和美国总统。
description.en: Woodrow Wilson was a member of the Democratic Party and was elected Governor of New Jersey and President of the United States as its candidate.

description.zh-cn: 伍德罗·威尔逊与他的第一任妻子爱伦·艾克森于1885年结婚，直至她1914年去世。
description.en: Woodrow Wilson was married to his first wife, Ellen Axson, from 1885 until her death in 1914.

description.zh-cn: 伍德罗·威尔逊在他的第一任妻子去世后，于1915年与伊迪丝·柏林结婚。
description.en: Woodrow Wilson married Edith Bolling in 1915, following the death of his first wife.

description.zh-cn: 德国发动的无限制潜艇战威胁到美国的商业海运，是促使威尔逊总统要求国会宣战的关键因素之一。
description.en: Germany's campaign of unrestricted submarine warfare, which threatened American commercial shipping, was a key factor that pushed President Wilson to ask Congress for a declaration of war.

description.zh-cn: 德国提议与墨西哥结盟对抗美国的齐默尔曼电报被截获，激起了美国的反德情绪，推动威尔逊政府决定参战。
description.en: The intercepted Zimmermann Telegram, in which Germany proposed an alliance with Mexico against the U.S., fueled anti-German sentiment and pushed the Wilson administration towards war.

description.zh-cn: 威尔逊于1917年4月2日请求国会宣战，将美国带入第一次世界大战。
description.en: Wilson asked Congress for a declaration of war on April 2, 1917, bringing the United States into World War I.

description.zh-cn: 威尔逊在国会演讲中阐述了十四点和平原则，作为结束战争和建立战后世界秩序的蓝图。
description.en: Wilson articulated the Fourteen Points in a speech to Congress, presenting them as a blueprint for ending the war and establishing a postwar world order.

description.zh-cn: 威尔逊在巴黎和会上是建立国际联盟的主要倡导者，并成功将其写入《凡尔赛条约》。
description.en: Wilson was the chief advocate for the creation of the League of Nations at the Paris Peace Conference and succeeded in having its covenant included in the Treaty of Versailles.

description.zh-cn: 参议员亨利·加博·洛吉领导了反对美国加入国际联盟的运动，最终导致《凡尔赛条约》在美国参议院未能获得批准。
description.en: Senator Henry Cabot Lodge led the opposition to U.S. entry into the League of Nations, which ultimately led to the failure of the Senate to ratify the Treaty of Versailles.

description.zh-cn: 由于参议院未能批准《凡尔赛条约》，美国从未加入国际联盟。
description.en: The United States never joined the League of Nations because the Senate failed to ratify the Treaty of Versailles.

description.zh-cn: 在1912年总统选举中，由于共和党选票被西奥多·罗斯福和威廉·塔夫脱分散，伍德罗·威尔逊成功当选总统。
description.en: In the 1912 presidential election, Woodrow Wilson was elected president after the Republican vote was split between Theodore Roosevelt and William Howard Taft.

description.zh-cn: 在1912年总统选举中，西奥多·罗斯福作为进步党候选人参选，分散了本应投给共和党候选人威廉·塔夫脱的选票，导致其败选。
description.en: In the 1912 presidential election, Theodore Roosevelt ran as a Progressive Party candidate, splitting the vote that would have gone to Republican candidate William Howard Taft, causing his defeat.

description.zh-cn: 威尔逊总统于1913年签署了《联邦储备法案》，从而建立了联邦储备系统。
description.en: President Wilson signed the Federal Reserve Act in 1913, establishing the Federal Reserve System.

description.zh-cn: 威尔逊政府在多个联邦政府机构内实施了种族隔离政策，导致大量黑人雇员被解职或隔离。
description.en: The Wilson administration introduced racial segregation in several federal government agencies, leading to the dismissal or segregation of many black employees.

description.zh-cn: 在1912年民主党全国代表大会上，威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩转而支持威尔逊，帮助他获得了总统候选人提名。
description.en: At the 1912 Democratic National Convention, William Jennings Bryan switched his support to Wilson, helping him secure the presidential nomination.

description.zh-cn: 1919年10月的一次严重中风导致威尔逊总统左半身瘫痪，几乎完全丧失工作能力，影响了他余下的总统任期。
description.en: A severe stroke in October 1919 left President Wilson paralyzed on his left side and almost completely incapacitated, affecting the remainder of his presidency.

description.zh-cn: 作为美国总统，威尔逊在1919年巴黎和会上与法国总理乔治·克列孟梭进行谈判。
description.en: As President of the United States, Wilson negotiated with French Prime Minister Georges Clemenceau at the Paris Peace Conference in 1919.

description.zh-cn: 作为美国总统，威尔逊在1919年巴黎和会上与英国首相大卫·劳合·乔治进行谈判。
description.en: As President of the United States, Wilson negotiated with British Prime Minister David Lloyd George at the Paris Peace Conference in 1919.

description.zh-cn: 韩非曾拜儒家大师荀子为师。
description.en: Han Fei studied under the Confucian master Xunzi.

description.zh-cn: 李斯曾拜儒家大师荀子为师。
description.en: Li Si studied under the Confucian master Xunzi.

description.zh-cn: 韩非与李斯一同拜荀子为师，为同学关系。
description.en: Han Fei and Li Si studied under Xunzi together as fellow students.

description.zh-cn: 姚贾与李斯一同诬陷韩非，导致其下狱。
description.en: Yao Jia joined Li Si in slandering Han Fei, leading to his imprisonment.

description.zh-cn: 韩非的思想受商鞅影响。
description.en: Han Fei's thought was influenced by Shang Yang.

description.zh-cn: 韩非的思想受申不害影响。
description.en: Han Fei's thought was influenced by Shen Buhai.

description.zh-cn: 韩非的思想受慎到影响。
description.en: Han Fei's thought was influenced by Shen Dao.

description.zh-cn: 韩非的思想受李悝影响。
description.en: Han Fei's thought was influenced by Li Kui.

description.zh-cn: 韩非的思想受老子影响，并对《道德经》有深入研究。
description.en: Han Fei's thought was influenced by Laozi, and he conducted in-depth research on the Tao Te Ching.

description.zh-cn: 韩非将自己的学说追本溯源于黄老之术。
description.en: Han Fei traced the origins of his doctrines back to the Huang-Lao school of thought.

description.zh-cn: 韩非反对儒家建构在私人情感与社会道德提升上的治国主张。
description.en: Han Fei opposed the Confucian approach to governance, which was based on personal emotional bonds and the elevation of social morality.

description.zh-cn: 韩非是《韩非子》的作者。
description.en: Han Fei is the author of the Han Feizi.

description.zh-cn: 《韩非子》一书传到秦国，其内容促使秦王政以战争为要挟，逼迫韩非出使秦国。
description.en: The book Han Feizi reached the state of Qin, and its contents prompted King Zheng of Qin to use the threat of war to compel Han Fei to be sent as an envoy to Qin.

description.zh-cn: 在秦国以战争威胁的紧急情况下，派遣韩非出使秦国。
description.en: Under the urgent circumstance of a war threat from Qin, King An of Han dispatched Han Fei as an envoy to Qin.

description.zh-cn: 在战国后期，秦国对包括韩国在内的东方六国持续发动兼并战争，两国长期处于敌对状态。例如，秦国曾以战争为要胁，逼迫韩国派韩非出使。
description.en: In the late Warring States period, the State of Qin continuously waged wars of annexation against the six eastern states, including Han, leading to a long-term state of hostility between the two. For instance, the state of Qin used the threat of war to compel the state of Han to send Han Fei as an envoy.

description.zh-cn: 韩非曾与堂谿公谈话。
description.en: Han Fei once had a conversation with Tang Xi Gong.

description.zh-cn: 堂谿公曾与公元前333年去世的韩昭侯谈话。
description.en: Tang Xi Gong had a conversation with Marquis Zhao of Han, who died in 333 BCE.

description.zh-cn: 吴仪于1997年至2002年任中共中央政治局候补委员，2002年至2007年任委员。
description.en: Wu Yi served as an alternate member of the Politburo of the CCP Central Committee from 1997 to 2002, and as a full member from 2002 to 2007.

description.zh-cn: 因SARS疫情，时任卫生部部长张文康被免职。
description.en: Due to the SARS outbreak, then Minister of Health Zhang Wenkang was dismissed from his post.

description.zh-cn: 因SARS疫情，时任北京市市长孟学农被撤职。
description.en: Due to the SARS outbreak, then Mayor of Beijing Meng Xuenong was removed from his post.

position.en: Vice Premier of the State Council

description.zh-cn: 在温家宝担任国务院总理的内阁中，吴仪出任国务院副总理。
description.en: In the cabinet where Wen Jiabao served as Premier of the State Council, Wu Yi was appointed Vice Premier.

description.zh-cn: 在朱镕基担任国务院总理期间，吴仪是国务委员。
description.en: While Zhu Rongji was Premier of the State Council, Wu Yi served as a State Councilor.

description.zh-cn: 在胡锦涛担任中共中央总书记期间，吴仪是中央政治局委员。
description.en: While Hu Jintao was General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee, Wu Yi was a member of the Politburo.

description.zh-cn: 因小泉纯一郎等日本高官在二战历史问题上发出强硬表态，吴仪在访日期间断然决定取消与小泉的会面。
description.en: Due to strong statements from Japanese high officials including Junichiro Koizumi on WWII history issues, Wu Yi decisively canceled her meeting with Koizumi during her visit to Japan.

description.zh-cn: 根据图片描述，吴仪曾与时任美国国务卿克林·鲍威尔会面。
description.en: According to the image caption, Wu Yi met with then U.S. Secretary of State Colin Powell.

description.zh-cn: 2007年初，时任副总理的黄菊病重，吴仪全面接管了中国的经济和金融工作。
description.en: In early 2007, as then Vice Premier Huang Ju was critically ill, Wu Yi took full charge of China's economic and financial affairs.

description.zh-cn: 吴仪曾前往河南，和高耀洁询问基层的艾滋病问题。
description.en: Wu Yi traveled to Henan to inquire with Gao Yaojie about grassroots AIDS issues.

description.zh-cn: 吴仪卸任排名第一的国务院副总理后，由李克强接任。
description.en: After Wu Yi stepped down as the first-ranking Vice Premier of the State Council, she was succeeded by Li Keqiang.

description.zh-cn: 吴仪卸任兼任的卫生部部长后，由高强接任。
description.en: After Wu Yi stepped down from her concurrent post as Minister of Health, she was succeeded by Gao Qiang.

description.zh-cn: 吴仪接替李岚清，出任中华人民共和国对外贸易经济合作部部长。
description.en: Wu Yi succeeded Li Lanqing as the Minister of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 吴仪卸任中华人民共和国对外贸易经济合作部部长后，由石广生接任。
description.en: After Wu Yi stepped down as the Minister of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation, she was succeeded by Shi Guangsheng.

description.zh-cn: 朱元璋认为使用空印文书是官员相互勾结的欺君重罪，对此大为震怒，下令严厉处罚所有相关官员，引发了空印案。
description.en: Zhu Yuanzhang became enraged, viewing the use of pre-sealed blank documents as a serious crime of deceiving the monarch and colluding among officials, and ordered severe punishment for all involved, thus initiating the Empty Seal Case.

description.zh-cn: 空印案中涉及的使用盖有印信的空白书册的做法，是从元朝沿袭而来的习惯，这为案件的发生埋下了伏笔。
description.en: The practice of using pre-sealed blank books, which was at the center of the Empty Seal Case, was a custom inherited from the Yuan Dynasty, setting the stage for the incident.

description.zh-cn: 方克勤在即将服刑期满时，因空印案爆发而受到牵连，最终在狱中去世。
description.en: Just as Fang Keqin was about to complete his prison term, he was implicated in the outbreak of the Empty Seal Case and subsequently died in prison.

description.zh-cn: 郑士利上疏为在空印案中获罪的官员申辩，认为此乃权宜之计，且法不先示而诛不当，试图阻止朱元璋的清洗。
description.en: Zheng Shili submitted a memorial defending the officials convicted in the Empty Seal Case, arguing it was an expedient measure and that punishing without prior prohibition was unjust, attempting to block Zhu Yuanzhang's purge.

description.zh-cn: 朱元璋对郑士利的上疏大怒，不予采纳，并将郑士利及其兄郑士元发往江浦服刑。
description.en: Zhu Yuanzhang was enraged by Zheng Shili's memorial, rejected it, and sentenced both Zheng Shili and his brother Zheng Shiyuan to forced labor in Jiangpu.

description.zh-cn: 郑士元因过去在河南任职期间使用空印文书，在空印案中受到牵连而被捕入狱。
description.en: Zheng Shiyuan was implicated and imprisoned in the Empty Seal Case for his past use of pre-sealed blank documents during his tenure in Henan.

description.zh-cn: 郑士利是郑士元的弟弟。
description.en: Zheng Shili is the younger brother of Zheng Shiyuan.

description.zh-cn: 叶伯巨于洪武九年上疏，批评朱元璋“分封太侈，用刑太繁，求治太速”等政策。
description.en: In the 9th year of Hongwu (1376), Ye Boju submitted a memorial criticizing Zhu Yuanzhang's policies, such as 'excessive enfeoffment, overly harsh punishments, and excessive haste in seeking governance'.

description.zh-cn: 朱元璋因叶伯巨的上疏而大怒，下令将其逮捕下狱，叶伯巨最终死于狱中。
description.en: Enraged by Ye Boju's memorial, Zhu Yuanzhang ordered his arrest and imprisonment, where Ye eventually died.

description.zh-cn: 方克勤是方孝孺的父亲。
description.en: Fang Keqin is the father of Fang Xiaoru.

description.zh-cn: “批邓、反击右倾翻案风”是文化大革命末期的最后一次大规模政治运动，是文革政治路线的延续。
description.en: 'Criticize Deng, Counterattack the Right-Deviationist Verdict-Reversal Wind' was the last large-scale political movement of the late Cultural Revolution, a continuation of its political line.

description.zh-cn: 四人帮是该运动的主要推动者，积极批判邓小平并试图借机夺取更多权力。
description.en: The Gang of Four were the main promoters of this movement, actively criticizing Deng Xiaoping and attempting to seize more power.

description.zh-cn: 四五运动被官方定性为“反革命事件”，并被归罪于邓小平，成为撤销其一切职务的直接借口，使“批邓”运动升级。
description.en: The Tiananmen Incident was officially labeled a 'counter-revolutionary incident' and blamed on Deng Xiaoping, serving as a direct pretext for his dismissal from all posts and escalating the 'Criticize Deng' movement.

description.zh-cn: 在粉碎“四人帮”后，华国锋基于“两个凡是”的需要，继续推进“批邓、反击右倾翻案风”运动，并拒绝为邓小平平反。
description.en: After smashing the Gang of Four, Hua Guofeng, based on the need for the 'Two Whatevers,' continued to advance the 'Criticize Deng, Counterattack the Right-Deviationist Verdict-Reversal Wind' movement and refused to rehabilitate Deng Xiaoping.

description.zh-cn: 会议通过决议，恢复邓小平的全部职务，正式结束了该运动。
description.en: The plenum passed a resolution to restore all of Deng Xiaoping's posts, formally ending the movement.

description.zh-cn: 会议通过《关于恢复邓小平同志职务的决议》，恢复了邓小平的全部职务。
description.en: The plenum passed the 'Resolution on Restoring Comrade Deng Xiaoping's Posts,' restoring all of his positions.

description.zh-cn: 真理标准大讨论旨在从思想理论上批判和否定“两个凡是”，并彻底击溃了其理论基础。
description.en: The great discussion on the criterion of truth aimed to criticize and negate the 'Two Whatevers' from an ideological and theoretical standpoint, and thoroughly defeated its theoretical basis.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平是“真理标准大讨论”的主要策划者和支持者。他公开表示支持《实践是检验真理的唯一标准》一文，并积极推动了关于真理标准问题的讨论。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping was a key planner and supporter of 'the great discussion on the criterion of truth'. He publicly expressed support for the article "Practice is the Sole Criterion for Testing Truth" and actively promoted the discussion on the criterion of truth.

description.zh-cn: 当代印度的种姓制度基于理论上的“瓦尔那”应运而生。
description.en: The contemporary caste system in India arose based on the theoretical concept of 'Varna'.

description.zh-cn: 尼泊尔和印度同属于一个文化圈，故前者种姓制度亦相似于后者。
description.en: Nepal and India belong to the same cultural sphere, thus the former's caste system is similar to the latter's.

description.zh-cn: 出任首相后，尼泊尔正式成为印度教王国，此举巩固并强化了种姓制度。
description.en: After he became Prime Minister, Nepal officially became a Hindu kingdom, which consolidated and strengthened the caste system.

description.zh-cn: 在巴基斯坦，因为受到伊斯兰教的征服和同化，种姓制度的影响力相对印度被弱化。
description.en: In Pakistan, due to the conquest and assimilation by Islam, the influence of the caste system was weakened compared to India.

description.zh-cn: 在柬埔寨、缅甸、泰国等东南亚国家，随着佛教的传入，种姓制度式微并逐渐凋零。
description.en: In Southeast Asian countries such as Cambodia, Myanmar, and Thailand, the caste system declined and gradually disappeared with the introduction of Buddhism.

description.zh-cn: 元朝实行了四等人制，将人民分为四个等级。
description.en: The Yuan dynasty implemented the 'Four-Class System', dividing the population into four classes.

description.zh-cn: 新罗时期实行骨品制，将国人分为八个等级。
description.en: During the Silla period, the Bone-rank system was implemented, dividing the people into eight classes.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜王朝时期实行严密的身份制度，将国人分为五个等级。
description.en: During the Joseon dynasty, a strict status system was implemented, dividing the people into five classes.

description.zh-cn: 中共十八届三中全会明确提出了要深化军队体制编制调整改革，并将军队改革纳入全面深化改革的总体布局。
description.en: The Third Plenary Session of the 18th CPC Central Committee explicitly proposed to deepen the reform of the military's system and structure, and incorporated military reform into the overall layout of comprehensively deepening reforms.

position.zh-cn: 中央军委深化国防和军队改革领导小组副组长
position.en: Deputy Leader of the CMC Leading Group for Deepening National Defense and Military Reform

description.zh-cn: 在中央军委深化国防和军队改革领导小组中，许其亮担任副组长，是组长习近平的下属。
description.en: In the CMC Leading Group for Deepening National Defense and Military Reform, Xu Qiliang served as a deputy leader, subordinate to the leader Xi Jinping.

position.zh-cn: 中央军委深化国防和军队改革领导小组副组长
position.en: Deputy Leader of the CMC Leading Group for Deepening National Defense and Military Reform

description.zh-cn: 在中央军委深化国防和军队改革领导小组中，范长龙担任副组长，是组长习近平的下属。
description.en: In the CMC Leading Group for Deepening National Defense and Military Reform, Fan Changlong served as a deputy leader, subordinate to the leader Xi Jinping.

description.zh-cn: 改革中成立了陆军领导机构，改变了以往陆军由四总部代为管理的情况，标志着大陆军主义的终结。
description.en: The reform established a leading organ for the Ground Force, changing the previous situation where the army was managed by the four general headquarters, and marking the end of 'army-centrism'.

description.zh-cn: 改革撤销了原有的七大军区体制。
description.en: The reform abolished the original system of seven military regions.

description.zh-cn: 根据改革决定，自2018年1月1日起，武警部队由中共中央、中央军委集中统一领导，归中央军委建制。
description.en: According to the reform decision, from January 1, 2018, the People's Armed Police force is under the centralized and unified leadership of the CPC Central Committee and the Central Military Commission, and is placed under the command of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 根据《深化党和国家机构改革方案》，原属武警部队序列的公安边防部队全部退出现役。
description.en: According to the 'Plan for Deepening the Reform of Party and State Institutions', the Public Security Border Troops, formerly part of the People's Armed Police, were all demilitarized.

description.zh-cn: 地震引发的海啸重创了印度东南部沿海地区及安达曼和尼科巴群岛，造成超过1万人罹难。
description.en: The tsunami triggered by the earthquake severely impacted India's southeastern coastal regions and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, causing over 10,000 deaths.

description.zh-cn: 地震引发的海啸对泰国南部的普吉岛等旅游胜地造成了严重破坏，导致超过5000人罹难，其中约一半为外国游客。
description.en: The tsunami triggered by the earthquake caused severe damage to tourist destinations in southern Thailand, such as Phuket, resulting in over 5,000 deaths, about half of whom were foreign tourists.

description.zh-cn: 在2004年印度洋大地震发生时担任印度尼西亚总统，他宣布全国进入国难状态，并领导了该国的救灾工作。
description.en: He was the President of Indonesia at the time of the 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake. He declared a national disaster and led the country's relief efforts.

description.zh-cn: 该地震能量巨大，甚至在遥远的阿拉斯加地区触发了远距地震。
description.en: The energy from this earthquake was so immense that it even triggered remote seismicity in the distant region of Alaska.

description.zh-cn: 对此次地震进行了监测和研究，测定其矩震级为9.1级，并发布了相关的地震数据和科学分析。
description.en: Monitored and studied this earthquake, determining its moment magnitude to be 9.1, and released related seismic data and scientific analysis.

description.zh-cn: 作为政府武装力量的一部分，中国人民武装警察部队被出动以武力镇压骚乱。
description.en: As part of the government's armed forces, the People's Armed Police were deployed to suppress the unrest by force.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军部队被出动以武力平息冲突。
description.en: People's Liberation Army troops were deployed to quell the conflict by force.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛于1988年12月1日起担任中共西藏自治区党委书记，是骚乱期间当地的最高负责人。
description.en: Hu Jintao served as the Party Secretary of the Tibet Autonomous Region Committee of the CPC starting December 1, 1988, making him the highest official in the region during the unrest.

description.zh-cn: 作为中共西藏自治区党委书记，胡锦涛是镇压拉萨骚乱的主要决策者和指挥者之一。
description.en: As the Party Secretary of the Tibet Autonomous Region, Hu Jintao was one of the key decision-makers and commanders in the suppression of the Lhasa unrest.

description.zh-cn: 拉萨骚乱被视为西藏独立运动的一部分，是该运动中的一次重要事件。
description.en: The Lhasa unrest is considered a part of the Tibetan independence movement and a significant event within it.

description.zh-cn: 欧洲议会通过决议，强烈谴责北京在西藏首府的暴力镇压行动，并要求解除戒严。
description.en: The European Parliament passed a resolution strongly condemning Beijing's violent crackdown in the Tibetan capital and demanded the lifting of martial law.

description.zh-cn: 六四事件的爆发促使欧洲议会对中国的人权问题采取更强硬的态度，包括对西藏问题的立场。
description.en: The outbreak of the Tiananmen Square protests prompted the European Parliament to adopt a tougher stance on China's human rights issues, including its position on Tibet.

description.zh-cn: 多吉才让是当时政府方的主要领导人物之一，参与了平息骚乱的行动。
description.en: Doje Cering was one of the main leaders on the government side at the time, involved in quelling the unrest.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛向中共中央政治局常委会汇报了西藏的情况，后者据此形成了指导西藏工作的意见。
description.en: Hu Jintao reported on the situation in Tibet to the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, which then formulated guiding opinions for work in Tibet based on his report.

description.zh-cn: 大同战斗失利后，国民政府于平型关一线组织防御，从而引发了平型关战役。
description.en: After the defeat in the Battle of Datong, the Nationalist Government organized a defense along the Pingxingguan line, which led to the Battle of Pingxingguan.

description.zh-cn: 在平型关战役中，中国第二战区部队与日军华北方面军部队为主要交战双方。
description.en: During the Battle of Pingxingguan, the Chinese 2nd War Area forces and the Japanese North China Area Army were the main adversaries.

description.zh-cn: 在平型关战役中，中国第二战区部队与日军关东军派遣的察哈尔派遣兵团交战。
description.en: During the Battle of Pingxingguan, the Chinese 2nd War Area forces engaged with the Chahar Expeditionary Force dispatched by the Japanese Kwantung Army.

description.zh-cn: 阎锡山作为第二战区司令长官，领导了平型关战役。
description.en: Yan Xishan, as the Commander-in-Chief of the 2nd War Area, led the Battle of Pingxingguan.

description.zh-cn: 在平型关战役期间，国民革命军第十八集团军（八路军）被编入第二战区序列，作为预备军配合作战。
description.en: During the Battle of Pingxingguan, the 18th Group Army (Eighth Route Army) was incorporated into the 2nd War Area as a reserve force for coordinated operations.

description.zh-cn: 林彪时任第115师师长。
description.en: Lin Biao was the commander of the 115th Division at the time.

description.zh-cn: 板垣征四郎在平型关战役期间担任日军第5师团师团长。
description.en: Seishirō Itagaki served as the commander of the Japanese 5th Division during the Battle of Pingxingguan.

description.zh-cn: 东条英机在平型关战役初期担任察哈尔派遣兵团司令官，后由笠原幸雄接任。
description.en: Hideki Tojo served as the commander of the Chahar Expeditionary Force at the beginning of the Battle of Pingxingguan and was later succeeded by Yukio Kasahara.

description.zh-cn: 笠原幸雄于1937年9月20日接替东条英机，担任察哈尔派遣兵团司令官。
description.en: Yukio Kasahara succeeded Hideki Tojo as the commander of the Chahar Expeditionary Force on September 20, 1937.

description.zh-cn: 关东军察哈尔派遣兵团的两个旅团从茹越口、铁角岭突破，截断了平型关前线国军的后路，导致国军全面撤退。
description.en: Two brigades of the Kwantung Army's Chahar Expeditionary Force broke through at Ruyuekou and Tiejiaoling, cutting off the retreat route for the Nationalist forces at the Pingxingguan front, leading to a full retreat.

description.zh-cn: 在平型关伏击战后，蒋中正致电祝贺嘉勉八路军，称其“歼寇如麻，足证官兵用命，深堪嘉慰”，并鼓励其继续努力。
description.en: After the ambush at Pingxingguan, Chiang Kai-shek sent a congratulatory telegram to the Eighth Route Army, praising them for "annihilating bandits like mowing hemp, proving the dedication of officers and soldiers, which is deeply gratifying," and encouraging their continued efforts.

description.zh-cn: 在长沙与周恩来共同审定并最终确定了被称为“长沙决策”的人事安排方案。
description.en: Jointly reviewed and finalized the personnel arrangement plan known as the 'Changsha Decision' with Zhou Enlai in Changsha.

description.zh-cn: 前往长沙向毛泽东汇报四届人大准备情况，并共同确定了“长沙决策”。
description.en: Traveled to Changsha to report to Mao Zedong on the preparations for the 4th National People's Congress and jointly finalized the 'Changsha Decision'.

description.zh-cn: 该事件在中共中央政治局会议上引发了激烈争论。
description.en: This incident caused heated debate at a meeting of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 在王洪文告状后，批评了王洪文。
description.en: Criticized Wang Hongwen after Wang made accusations.

description.zh-cn: 致信江青，告诫其“不要多露面，不要批文件，不要由你组阁（当后台老板）”。
description.en: Sent a letter to Jiang Qing, warning her 'not to make too many public appearances, not to approve documents, and not to form a cabinet (be the boss behind the scenes)'.

description.zh-cn: 1974年12月23日，周恩来向毛泽东汇报四届人大准备情况。12月26日晚，两人单独长谈，最终确定了“长沙决策”。
description.en: On December 23, 1974, Zhou Enlai reported to Mao Zedong on the preparations for the 4th NPC. On the evening of December 26, the two had a long private talk and finalized the 'Changsha Decision'.

description.zh-cn: 1974年10月，王洪文前往长沙向毛泽东告状。12月23日，与周恩来一同向毛泽东汇报工作。
description.en: In October 1974, Wang Hongwen went to Changsha to complain to Mao Zedong. On December 23, he, along with Zhou Enlai, reported to Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 与王洪文一同前往长沙向毛泽东汇报四届人大准备情况。
description.en: Traveled to Changsha together with Wang Hongwen to report to Mao Zedong on the preparations for the 4th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 长沙决策期间毛泽东与周恩来的理论问题谈话，直接导致了1975年的学习无产阶级专政理论运动。
description.en: The conversation on theoretical issues between Mao Zedong and Zhou Enlai during the Changsha Decision period directly led to the 1975 Movement to Study the Theory of the Dictatorship of the Proletariat.

description.zh-cn: 根据其意见，中共中央发出了关于准备召开四届人大的通知，启动了会议的筹备工作。
description.en: Based on his opinion, the CPC Central Committee issued a notice to prepare for the 4th National People's Congress, initiating the preparatory work for the meeting.

description.zh-cn: 开罗会议后发表了会议结果的新闻公报，通称为《开罗宣言》。
description.en: After the Cairo Conference, a press communiqué on the conference's results was issued, which became commonly known as the Cairo Declaration.

description.zh-cn: 作为中华民国国民政府军事委员会委员长，蒋中正代表中国出席开罗会议。
description.en: As the Chairman of the National Military Council of the Nationalist Government of the Republic of China, Chiang Kai-shek represented China at the Cairo Conference.

description.zh-cn: 作为美国总统，富兰克林·德拉诺·罗斯福代表美国出席开罗会议。
description.en: As the President of the United States, Franklin D. Roosevelt represented the United States at the Cairo Conference.

description.zh-cn: 作为英国首相，温斯顿·丘吉尔代表英国出席开罗会议。
description.en: As the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom, Winston Churchill represented the United Kingdom at the Cairo Conference.

description.zh-cn: 富兰克林·德拉诺·罗斯福与温斯顿·丘吉尔在开罗会议期间举行会谈。
description.en: Franklin D. Roosevelt held talks with Winston Churchill during the Cairo Conference.

description.zh-cn: 蒋中正当时担任国民政府军事委员会委员长。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek served as the Chairman of the National Military Council at that time.

description.zh-cn: 《开罗宣言》声明盟国将坚持对日作战直至其无条件投降，并要求日本归还其所窃取的一切领土。
description.en: The Cairo Declaration stated that the Allied powers would persevere in the war against Japan until its unconditional surrender and demanded that Japan return all territories it had stolen.

description.zh-cn: 《开罗宣言》规定，日本自中国所窃取的所有领土，例如满洲、台湾及澎湖群岛，应该归还给中华民国。
description.en: The Cairo Declaration stipulated that all territories Japan had stolen from the Chinese, such as Manchuria, Formosa (Taiwan), and the Pescadores (Penghu), should be restored to the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 《开罗宣言》决定在相当时期内，使朝鲜获得自由与独立。
description.en: The Cairo Declaration decided that in due course Korea shall become free and independent.

description.zh-cn: 作为美国总统特别助理，哈里·霍普金斯在三巨头会谈的基础上起草了《开罗宣言》的草案。
description.en: As a special assistant to the U.S. President, Harry Hopkins drafted the Cairo Declaration based on the talks of the three leaders.

description.zh-cn: 作为中华民国代表，王宠惠在讨论宣言草案时，据理力争保留了“归还中华民国”的段落。
description.en: As a representative of the Republic of China, Wang Ch'ung-hui argued forcefully to retain the clause "be restored to the Republic of China" during discussions on the draft declaration.

description.zh-cn: 作为英国代表，贾德干建议将宣言草案中的“归还中华民国”改为“当然必须由日本放弃”。
description.en: As a British representative, Alexander Cadogan suggested changing the phrase "restored to the Republic of China" in the draft declaration to "must of course be relinquished by Japan."

description.zh-cn: 温斯顿·丘吉尔对宣言草案文字作了进一步修改，将“特别是”改为“例如”，并加上了“澎湖”。
description.en: Winston Churchill made further textual modifications to the draft declaration, changing "in particular" to "for example" and adding "the Pescadores."

description.zh-cn: 在德黑兰会议上，约瑟夫·斯大林表示“完全”赞成《开罗宣言》及其全部内容。
description.en: At the Tehran Conference, Joseph Stalin expressed his "full" approval of the Cairo Declaration and "all its contents."

description.zh-cn: 在开罗会议结束后，罗斯福前往德黑兰与斯大林举行德黑兰会议。
description.en: After the Cairo Conference, Roosevelt traveled to Tehran to hold the Tehran Conference with Stalin.

description.zh-cn: 在开罗会议结束后，丘吉尔前往德黑兰与斯大林举行德黑兰会议。
description.en: After the Cairo Conference, Churchill traveled to Tehran to hold the Tehran Conference with Stalin.

description.zh-cn: 《波茨坦公告》第八条明确规定“《开罗宣言》之条件必将实施”。
description.en: Article 8 of the Potsdam Declaration explicitly states that "The terms of the Cairo Declaration shall be carried out."

description.zh-cn: 日本签署的《降伏文书》中声明接受《波茨坦公告》的条款，从而间接确认了履行《开罗宣言》的义务。
description.en: In the Instrument of Surrender signed by Japan, it declared its acceptance of the terms of the Potsdam Declaration, thereby indirectly confirming the obligation to implement the Cairo Declaration.

description.zh-cn: 由于苏联与日本签有互不侵犯条约，斯大林表示不参加有蒋中正与会的开罗会议。
description.en: Due to the neutrality pact signed between the Soviet Union and Japan, Stalin stated that he would not participate in the Cairo Conference, which was attended by Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: 时任保安局局长李家超于2019年3月29日正式引入《2019年逃犯及刑事事宜相互法律协助法例（修订）条例草案》。
description.en: Then-Secretary for Security John Lee officially introduced the 'Fugitive Offenders and Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters Legislation (Amendment) Bill 2019' on March 29, 2019.

description.zh-cn: 时任香港行政长官林郑月娥推动了《逃犯条例》的修订工作。
description.en: Then-Chief Executive of Hong Kong Carrie Lam promoted the amendment of the Fugitive Offenders Ordinance.

description.zh-cn: 林郑月娥声称修订条例得到中央人民政府的理解、尊重和支持。
description.en: Carrie Lam claimed that the amendment received understanding, respect, and support from the Central People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 示威者包围立法会大楼以阻止条例二读，导致当日会议取消，恢复二读的程序被押后。
description.en: Protesters surrounded the Legislative Council Complex to prevent the second reading of the bill, leading to the cancellation of the meeting that day and the postponement of the second reading process.

description.zh-cn: 2019年10月23日，保安局局长李家超在立法会大会上正式宣布撤回修例。
description.en: On October 23, 2019, Secretary for Security John Lee formally announced the withdrawal of the bill amendment in the Legislative Council meeting.

description.zh-cn: 林郑月娥在宣布撤回条例修订草案前，征得了中共中央总书记习近平的批准。
description.en: Before announcing the withdrawal of the bill amendment, Carrie Lam sought and obtained approval from CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping.

description.zh-cn: 聂伟敬发表评论文章，指出《逃犯条例》修订违反了《中英联合声明》的承诺。
description.en: Malcolm Rifkind published a commentary article pointing out that the amendment to the Fugitive Offenders Ordinance violated the commitments of the Sino-British Joint Declaration.

description.zh-cn: 陈同佳在台北市的旅店内杀害了其女友潘晓颖。
description.en: Chan Tong-kai murdered his girlfriend Poon Hiu-wing in a hotel in Taipei.

description.zh-cn: 在法案委员会首次会议上，郭伟强因批评涂谨申“扮垃圾”而被其逐出会议厅。
description.en: During the first meeting of the bills committee, Kwok Wai-keung was expelled from the chamber by James To after criticizing him for 'acting like rubbish'.

description.zh-cn: 建制派议员联署，要求改由石礼谦主持法案委员会主席选举。
description.en: Pro-establishment lawmakers signed a petition requesting that Abraham Shek preside over the election of the bills committee chairman.

description.zh-cn: 欧盟向香港政府发出外交照会，抗议修订《逃犯条例》。
description.en: The European Union issued a diplomatic démarche to the Hong Kong government to protest the amendment of the Fugitive Offenders Ordinance.

description.zh-cn: 刘銮雄向高等法院申请司法覆核，挑战《逃犯条例》修订草案的合宪性，后于5月29日撤回申请。
description.en: Joseph Lau applied for a judicial review at the High Court to challenge the constitutionality of the extradition bill amendment, but withdrew the application on May 29.

description.zh-cn: 七国集团发表联合声明，重申《中英联合声明》的存在与重要性，并呼吁避免暴力，对修例风波表达了间接立场。
description.en: The G7 issued a joint statement reaffirming the existence and importance of the Sino-British Joint Declaration and calling for the avoidance of violence, indirectly stating its position on the extradition bill controversy.

description.zh-cn: 作为中华人民共和国国务院总理，代表中方在北京人民大会堂签署了《中英联合声明》。
description.en: As the Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, he signed the Sino-British Joint Declaration in the Great Hall of the People in Beijing on behalf of the Chinese side.

description.zh-cn: 作为英国首相，代表英方在北京人民大会堂签署了《中英联合声明》。
description.en: As the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom, she signed the Sino-British Joint Declaration in the Great Hall of the People in Beijing on behalf of the British side.

description.zh-cn: 通过与英国政府谈判并签署《中英联合声明》，声明决定于1997年7月1日对香港恢复行使主权。
description.en: Through negotiations and the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration with the British government, it declared its decision to resume the exercise of sovereignty over Hong Kong on July 1, 1997.

description.zh-cn: 通过与中国政府谈判并签署《中英联合声明》，声明将于1997年7月1日将香港交还给中华人民共和国。
description.en: Through negotiations and the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration with the Chinese government, it declared that it would hand over Hong Kong to the People's Republic of China on July 1, 1997.

description.zh-cn: 《中英联合声明》中列出的中国对香港的基本方针政策，后来都由《香港特别行政区基本法》加以规定。
description.en: The basic policies of China regarding Hong Kong listed in the Sino-British Joint Declaration were later stipulated by the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

description.zh-cn: 在谈判初期，坚持割让香港的三个不平等条约仍然有效，并提出“以主权换治权”的方案，试图让英国在1997年后继续管治香港，阻碍了主权移交的共识达成。
description.en: In the initial stages of negotiations, she insisted on the validity of the three unequal treaties concerning the cession of Hong Kong and proposed a "sovereignty for administration" solution, attempting to allow Britain to continue governing Hong Kong after 1997, which hindered the consensus on the handover of sovereignty.

description.zh-cn: 英国外相蓝韬文发表声明，认为《香港国安法》的制定和实施明显并严重违反了《中英联合声明》中保障香港权利和自由的承诺。
description.en: British Foreign Secretary Dominic Raab issued a statement, asserting that the enactment and implementation of the Hong Kong National Security Law constituted a clear and serious breach of the commitments to protect rights and freedoms in Hong Kong as stipulated in the Sino-British Joint Declaration.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国外交部发言人陆慷称《中英联合声明》是“一个历史文件，不具有任何现实意义”，此番言论引发了关于该声明现今法律效力的广泛争议。
description.en: Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Lu Kang described the Sino-British Joint Declaration as "a historical document that no longer has any practical significance," a statement that sparked widespread controversy over the declaration's current legal validity.

description.zh-cn: 作为中华民国行政院院长，声称中华民国政府一概不承认英国与中共当局有关香港的任何谈判及协议。
description.en: As the Premier of the Executive Yuan of the Republic of China, he stated that the ROC government would not recognize any negotiations or agreements between the United Kingdom and the CCP authorities regarding Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 提出“爱国者治港”要求，推动了2021年对香港选举制度的根本性修改。
description.en: Proposed the requirement of "patriots governing Hong Kong," which drove the fundamental changes to Hong Kong's electoral system in 2021.

description.zh-cn: 作为末任香港总督，在主权移交前推出了一个政改方案，旨在扩大立法会的民主成分。
description.en: As the last Governor of Hong Kong, he introduced a political reform package before the handover of sovereignty aimed at increasing the democratic composition of the Legislative Council.

description.zh-cn: 接见了时任香港行政局议员钟士元等人，并就香港前途问题发表了谈话。
description.en: Met with Chung Sze-yuen, then a member of the Hong Kong Executive Council, and others, and delivered a speech on the future of Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 接见了时任香港行政局议员邓莲如等人，并就香港前途问题发表了谈话。
description.en: Met with Lydia Dunn, then a member of the Hong Kong Executive Council, and others, and delivered a speech on the future of Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 毛主席纪念堂管理局是中共中央办公厅的下属机构。
description.en: The Chairman Mao Memorial Hall Administration Bureau is a subordinate agency of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 为纪念堂瞻仰厅书写了“伟大的领袖和导师毛泽东主席永垂不朽”的金字隶书。
description.en: Inscribed the clerical script text "Eternal Glory to the Great Leader and Teacher Chairman Mao Zedong" in gold in the Hall of Reverence of the memorial hall.

description.zh-cn: 纪念堂北门西侧的群像雕塑中，包含了表现无产阶级文化大革命的内容，反映了官方对这一历史时期的叙事。
description.en: The group sculpture on the west side of the North Gate of the memorial hall includes content depicting the Great Proletarian Cultural Revolution, reflecting the official narrative of this historical period.

description.zh-cn: 在和珅死后，将其府邸（后来的恭王府）赐予庆郡王永璘。
description.en: After Heshen's death, bestowed his mansion (later Prince Gong's Mansion) upon Prince Qing, Yonglin.

description.zh-cn: 将庆王府（后来的恭王府）赐予恭亲王奕䜣。
description.en: Bestowed Prince Qing's Mansion (later Prince Gong's Mansion) upon Prince Gong, Yixin.

description.zh-cn: 作为府邸主人入住，府邸从此得名“恭王府”。
description.en: Moved in as the master of the mansion, and it has since been named "Prince Gong's Mansion."

description.zh-cn: 溥伟是奕䜣的长孙，并承袭了其恭亲王爵位。
description.en: Puwei was Yixin's eldest grandson and inherited his title of Prince Gong.

description.zh-cn: 购买并拥有恭王府作为其校产。
description.en: Purchased and owned Prince Gong's Mansion as its campus property.

description.zh-cn: 文化部是国务院的组成部门，需向国务院报告工作，如恭王府搬迁完成情况。
description.en: The Ministry of Culture is a constituent department of the State Council and is required to report its work, such as the completion of the Prince Gong's Mansion relocation, to the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 蒋介石为加强个人统治，命令戴笠等人建立特务组织，并将其发展为军统局，作为其控制国家和军队的重要工具。
description.en: To strengthen his personal rule, Chiang Kai-shek ordered Dai Li and others to establish a secret service organization, which evolved into the Bureau of Investigation and Statistics (Juntong), serving as a crucial tool for his control over the state and military.

description.zh-cn: 在抗日战争期间，军统局将对日情报工作作为核心任务之一，从事电讯侦破、策反、游击战等多种形式的斗争。
description.en: During the Second Sino-Japanese War, Juntong (BIS) made intelligence work against Japan one of its core missions, engaging in various forms of struggle including signals intelligence, counter-espionage, and guerrilla warfare.

description.zh-cn: 反共是军统自成立之初蒋介石交予的两大任务之一，也是其工作的核心。军统持续对中共组织进行情报搜集、破坏和暗杀活动。
description.en: Anti-communism was one of the two major tasks assigned by Chiang Kai-shek at the inception of Juntong (BIS) and was the core of its work. Juntong continuously conducted intelligence gathering, sabotage, and assassination activities against CCP organizations.

description.zh-cn: 国民党政府迁台后，国防部保密局主导调查了台湾省工作委员会案、孙立人兵变案等，造成了众多冤案，是白色恐怖时期的主要执行机构之一。
description.en: After the KMT government retreated to Taiwan, the Confidential Bureau of the Ministry of National Defense led investigations into cases such as the Taiwan Provincial Work Committee case and the Sun Li-jen incident, resulting in numerous unjust cases and making it one of the main executing agencies of the White Terror period.

description.zh-cn: 孙立人将军因被指控涉嫌兵变而被长期软禁，该案是白色恐怖时期的标志性事件。
description.en: General Sun Li-jen was placed under long-term house arrest for his alleged involvement in a coup plot, a landmark event of the White Terror period.

description.zh-cn: 国防部情报局特训并派遣黑帮成员至美国，杀害了作家刘宜良（江南）。
description.en: The Intelligence Bureau of the Ministry of National Defense trained and dispatched gang members to the United States to assassinate writer Henry Liu (Jiang Nan).

description.zh-cn: 江南案曝光后，时任情报局局长汪希苓因涉案被捕入狱。
description.en: After the Henry Liu case was exposed, the then-Director of the Intelligence Bureau, Wang Hsi-ling, was arrested and imprisoned for his involvement.

description.zh-cn: 江南案对台湾的国际形象造成严重损害，并直接导致国防部情报局进行大规模改组。
description.en: The Henry Liu case severely damaged Taiwan's international image and directly led to a major reorganization of the Intelligence Bureau of the Ministry of National Defense.

description.zh-cn: 在与毛人凤的斗争中，蒋经国开始扶植副主任秘书出身的叶翔之，并最终帮助其在毛人凤死后接掌情报局，从而将该系统纳入自己的势力范围。
description.en: During his struggle with Mao Renfeng, Chiang Ching-kuo began to support Ye Xiangzhi, who had a background as a deputy chief secretary, and eventually helped him take over the Intelligence Bureau after Mao's death, thereby bringing the system into his own sphere of influence.

description.zh-cn: 国民政府军事委员会调查统计局是隶属于国民政府军事委员会办公厅的下属机构。
description.en: The Bureau of Investigation and Statistics was a subordinate organization under the General Office of the Military Affairs Commission of the Nationalist Government.

description.zh-cn: 国防部保密局是隶属于中华民国国防部的下属机构。
description.en: The Confidential Bureau was a subordinate organization under the Ministry of National Defense of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 《港区国安法》的引入导致民主派政党的政治参与空间严重受限，并引发大规模的“解散潮”和“退党潮”。
description.en: The introduction of the National Security Law severely restricted the political participation space for pro-democracy parties and triggered a large-scale wave of dissolutions and party withdrawals.

description.zh-cn: “完善选举制度改革”后，民主派政党的政治参与空间受到严重限制。
description.en: After the 'perfection of the electoral system reform,' the political participation space for pro-democracy parties was severely restricted.

description.zh-cn: 在要求“爱国者治港”的原则下，民主派在香港政坛难以立足。
description.en: Under the principle of 'patriots governing Hong Kong,' it has become difficult for the pro-democracy camp to gain a foothold in Hong Kong politics.

description.zh-cn: 针对民主派初选参与者的大搜捕严重打击了民主派的政治活动。
description.en: The mass arrests targeting participants in the pro-democracy primaries severely cracked down on the political activities of the pro-democracy camp.

description.zh-cn: 民主派对中国人权状况常有所批判，并以“结束一党专政”和“平反六四”作为其核心诉求之一。六四事件后，民主派与中共关系决裂。
description.en: The pro-democracy camp is often critical of the human rights situation in China and holds 'ending one-party rule' and 'vindicating the June 4th incident' as its core demands. After the June 4th incident, the relationship between the pro-democracy camp and the CCP broke down.

description.zh-cn: 因六四事件退出基本法起草委员会。
description.en: Withdrew from the Basic Law Drafting Committee due to the June 4th incident.

description.zh-cn: 因六四事件退出基本法起草委员会。
description.en: Withdrew from the Basic Law Drafting Committee due to the June 4th incident.

description.zh-cn: 1994年，港同盟与汇点合并，形成民主党。
description.en: In 1994, the United Democrats of Hong Kong merged with Meeting Point to form the Democratic Party.

description.zh-cn: 民主党强烈反对并以党内投票否决了参与“五区总辞”运动。
description.en: The Democratic Party strongly opposed and voted internally to reject participation in the 'Five Constituencies Referendum' movement.

description.zh-cn: 公民党表态支持“五区总辞”运动，并派出议员辞职参与。
description.en: The Civic Party expressed support for the 'Five Constituencies Referendum' movement and had its legislators resign to participate.

description.zh-cn: 社民连提出“五区总辞”构想，以作为争取2012年双普选的“变相公投”。
description.en: The League of Social Democrats proposed the idea of the 'Five Constituencies Referendum' as a 'de facto referendum' to fight for dual universal suffrage in 2012.

description.zh-cn: 因民主党在2012年政改方案上与中联办谈判并最终支持改良方案，社民连指摘民主党“出卖港人”、“投共”，导致泛民主派分裂。
description.en: Because the Democratic Party negotiated with the Liaison Office on the 2012 political reform package and ultimately supported a revised proposal, the League of Social Democrats accused the Democratic Party of 'selling out Hong Kong people' and 'surrendering to the Communists,' leading to a split in the pro-democracy camp.

description.zh-cn: 该决定直接导致四名民主派议员被取消资格，进而引发了其余民主派议员的集体总辞。
description.en: This decision directly led to the disqualification of four pro-democracy legislators, which in turn triggered the mass resignation of the remaining pro-democracy camp members.

description.zh-cn: 根据该决定，香港政府宣布取消梁继昌的立法会议员资格。
description.en: According to this decision, the Hong Kong government announced the disqualification of Kenneth Leung as a Legislative Council member.

description.zh-cn: 根据该决定，香港政府宣布取消郭荣铿的立法会议员资格。
description.en: According to this decision, the Hong Kong government announced the disqualification of Dennis Kwok as a Legislative Council member.

description.zh-cn: 根据该决定，香港政府宣布取消郭家麒的立法会议员资格。
description.en: According to this decision, the Hong Kong government announced the disqualification of Kwok Ka-ki as a Legislative Council member.

description.zh-cn: 在公民党解散后，保安局局长邓炳强点名批评公民党末任主席梁家杰态度轻佻，并认为他应为2019年的社会运动向年轻人及其家长道歉。
description.en: After the dissolution of the Civic Party, Secretary for Security Chris Tang publicly criticized its last chairman, Alan Leong, for his flippant attitude and suggested he should apologize to the youth and their parents for the 2019 social movement.

description.zh-cn: 在第十四届全国人大第二次会议主席台上，就最高人民法院工作报告内容进行口头讨论。
在第十四届全国人大第二次会议主席台上，就最高人民法院工作报告内容进行口头讨论，习近平还在报告上作了批注。
在第十四届全国人大第二次会议主席台上，就最高人民法院工作报告内容进行口头讨论。
在2025年“两会”召开前夕，当局针对政治异议人士的监控升级，北京资深媒体人高瑜面临“被旅游”、软禁或警告。
因呼吸道感染请假，缺席全国人大会议闭幕日会议。
因赵乐际请假缺席，代为主持闭幕会。
在缺席人大会议闭幕式次日，赵乐际与李鸿忠一同公开活动，看望参与“两会”报道的新闻工作者。
在缺席人大会议闭幕式次日，赵乐际与李书磊一同公开活动，看望参与“两会”报道的新闻工作者。
在雅各布·祖玛辞职后接任南非总统。
description.en: Succeeded Jacob Zuma as President of South Africa.

description.zh-cn: 《1909年南非法案》的通过促成了南非联邦的成立。
description.en: The passage of the South Africa Act 1909 led to the creation of the Union of South Africa.

description.zh-cn: 国民党在1948年大选中获胜，开始上台执政。
description.en: The National Party won the 1948 general election and came to power.

description.zh-cn: 国民党上台后，开始建立并推行一套系统的种族隔离制度。
description.en: After coming to power, the National Party began to establish and implement a systematic policy of apartheid.

description.zh-cn: 丹尼尔·马兰领导的国民党政府开始制定并实施严格的种族隔离政策。
description.en: The National Party government, led by Daniel Malan, began to formulate and implement strict apartheid policies.

description.zh-cn: 国际社会的撤资运动和经济制裁是导致种族隔离制度结束的重要因素之一。
description.en: The international disinvestment movement and economic sanctions were significant factors leading to the end of apartheid.

description.zh-cn: 德克勒克政府于1990年宣布解除对非洲人国民大会等反种族隔离组织的禁令。
description.en: In 1990, the de Klerk government announced the unbanning of the African National Congress and other anti-apartheid organizations.

description.zh-cn: 与纳尔逊·曼德拉就政策及政府的过渡进行了双边讨论。
description.en: Held bilateral discussions with Nelson Mandela regarding policy and the transition of government.

description.zh-cn: 在首次不分种族的选举中，非洲人国民大会以压倒性多数获胜，成为执政党。
description.en: In the first non-racial election, the African National Congress won by a landslide, becoming the governing party.

description.zh-cn: 最初构思了“彩虹之国”这一名称来形容后种族隔离时期的南非。
description.en: Originally conceived the term 'Rainbow Nation' to describe post-apartheid South Africa.

description.zh-cn: 推广了“彩虹之国”这一名称，以象征南非的文化多样性与和平共处。
description.en: Promoted the term 'Rainbow Nation' to symbolize South Africa's cultural diversity and peaceful coexistence.

description.zh-cn: 荷兰东印度公司于1652年建立了荷属好望角殖民地。
description.en: The Dutch East India Company founded the Dutch Cape Colony in 1652.

description.zh-cn: 代表荷兰东印度公司在好望角登陆，并建立了一个补给中途站，成为欧洲人在南非的首个定居点。
description.en: Landed at the Cape of Good Hope on behalf of the Dutch East India Company and established a supply station, which became the first European settlement in South Africa.

description.zh-cn: 第二次布尔战争以英国胜利告终，德兰士瓦共和国被英国吞并。
description.en: The Second Boer War ended in a British victory, leading to the annexation of the South African Republic.

description.zh-cn: 第二次布尔战争以英国胜利告终，奥兰治自由邦被英国吞并。
description.en: The Second Boer War ended in a British victory, leading to the annexation of the Orange Free State.

description.zh-cn: 南非于1998年1月1日与中华民国断绝外交关系。
description.en: South Africa severed diplomatic relations with the Republic of China on January 1, 1998.

description.zh-cn: 南非于1998年1月1日与中华人民共和国建立外交关系。
description.en: South Africa established diplomatic relations with the People's Republic of China on January 1, 1998.

description.zh-cn: 由于执政党非国大未能获得多数席位，2024年大选后组成了民族团结政府。
description.en: Following the 2024 election where the ruling ANC failed to secure a majority, a government of national unity was formed.

description.zh-cn: 作为主要政党之一，与民主联盟等党派共同组建民族团结政府。
description.en: As one of the main parties, formed a government of national unity with the Democratic Alliance and other parties.

description.zh-cn: 作为主要反对党，与非洲人国民大会等党派共同组建民族团结政府。
description.en: As the main opposition party, formed a government of national unity with the African National Congress and other parties.

description.zh-cn: 加入了由非洲人国民大会和民主联盟领导的民族团结政府。
description.en: Joined the government of national unity led by the ANC and the DA.

description.zh-cn: 国民政府是中国国民党依据孙中山所著《国民政府建国大纲》建立的政府机构。
description.en: The Nationalist Government was a government body established by the Kuomintang based on Sun Yat-sen's 'Fundamentals of National Reconstruction'.

description.zh-cn: 国民政府由中华民国陆海军大元帅大本营改组而成，取代了后者。
description.en: The Nationalist Government was formed by reorganizing the Generalissimo's Headquarters, thus replacing it.

description.zh-cn: 从1925年成立到1928年北伐胜利前，广州国民政府与北京的北洋政府处于对峙状态。
description.en: From its establishment in 1925 until the victory of the Northern Expedition in 1928, the Guangzhou Nationalist Government was in a state of confrontation with the Beiyang Government in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 国民政府发动了国民革命军北伐，以期统一中国。
description.en: The Nationalist Government launched the Northern Expedition with the aim of unifying China.

description.zh-cn: 孙中山撰写了《国民政府建国大纲》，为国民政府的建立提供了蓝图。
description.en: Sun Yat-sen wrote the 'Fundamentals of National Reconstruction', providing a blueprint for the establishment of the Nationalist Government.

description.zh-cn: 国民政府的建立是依据孙中山的《国民政府建国大纲》进行的。
description.en: The establishment of the Nationalist Government was based on Sun Yat-sen's 'Fundamentals of National Reconstruction'.

description.zh-cn: 苏联顾问鲍罗廷在国民政府成立初期排挤胡汉民。
description.en: Soviet advisor Mikhail Borodin marginalized Hu Hanmin during the early period of the Nationalist Government.

description.zh-cn: 张学良宣布东北易帜，名义上接受国民政府领导。
description.en: Zhang Xueliang announced the Northeast Flag Replacement, nominally accepting the leadership of the Nationalist Government.

description.zh-cn: 在中原大战中，阎锡山联合其他军阀反对蒋中正领导的南京国民政府。
description.en: During the Central Plains War, Yan Xishan allied with other warlords against the Nanjing Nationalist Government led by Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: 在中原大战中，冯玉祥联合其他军阀反对蒋中正领导的南京国民政府。
description.en: During the Central Plains War, Feng Yuxiang allied with other warlords against the Nanjing Nationalist Government led by Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: 1931年，蒋中正在南京汤山软禁了胡汉民，引发了国民党内的分裂。
description.en: In 1931, Chiang Kai-shek placed Hu Hanmin under house arrest in Tangshan, Nanjing, which triggered a split within the Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 由中国共产党建立的中华苏维埃共和国与国民政府处于武装对抗状态。
description.en: The Chinese Soviet Republic, established by the Chinese Communist Party, was in a state of armed conflict with the Nationalist Government.

description.zh-cn: 随着日军逼近南京，中国抗日战争的爆发迫使国民政府将首都迁往重庆。
description.en: As the Japanese army advanced on Nanjing, the outbreak of the Second Sino-Japanese War forced the Nationalist Government to move its capital to Chongqing.

description.zh-cn: 大日本帝国在中国抗日战争期间扶植了汪精卫国民政府作为其傀儡政权。
description.en: The Empire of Japan established the Wang Jingwei regime as its puppet state during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 国民政府军事委员会是国民政府下设的最高军事统御机关。
description.en: The Military Affairs Commission was the supreme military command body under the Nationalist Government.

description.zh-cn: 在抗日战争统一战线形成后，中国共产党领导的军队名义上接受国民政府军事委员会的调遣。
description.en: After the formation of the United Front during the Second Sino-Japanese War, the armed forces led by the Chinese Communist Party nominally accepted the command of the Military Affairs Commission of the Nationalist Government.

description.zh-cn: 日本在中国华北地区扶持建立了中华民国临时政府这一傀儡政权。
description.en: Japan supported the establishment of the Provisional Government of the Republic of China, a puppet state, in North China.

description.zh-cn: 在日本扶持的中华民国临时政府统治下，北平被改名为“北京”。
description.en: Under the rule of the Japanese-backed Provisional Government, Peiping was renamed 'Beijing'.

description.zh-cn: 与傅作义达成和平协定，实现了北平的和平解放。
description.en: Reached a peace agreement with Fu Zuoyi, achieving the peaceful liberation of Peiping.

description.zh-cn: 在傅作义投降后和平进入北平城，完成了北平的和平解放。
description.en: Peacefully entered the city of Peiping after Fu Zuoyi's surrender, completing the peaceful liberation of the city.

description.zh-cn: 在此次会议上通过了《关于中华人民共和国国都、纪年、国歌、国旗的决议》。
description.en: The 'Resolution on the Capital, Calendar, National Anthem, and National Flag of the People's Republic of China' was passed during this session.

description.zh-cn: 中国工商银行由中国人民银行的工商信贷和储蓄业务分离而设立。
description.en: ICBC was established by separating the industrial and commercial credit and savings business from the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院于1983年9月决定分拆中国人民银行的相关业务，成立一家新银行，即后来的中国工商银行。
description.en: In September 1983, the State Council of the People's Republic of China decided to spin off relevant businesses from the People's Bank of China to establish a new bank, which became ICBC.

description.zh-cn: 作为主要股东持有中国工商银行34.79%的股份。
description.en: Holds 34.79% of ICBC's shares as a major shareholder.

description.zh-cn: 作为主要股东持有中国工商银行31.14%的股份。
description.en: Holds 31.14% of ICBC's shares as a major shareholder.

description.zh-cn: 恒指服务有限公司于2007年2月9日宣布，将工商银行纳入恒生指数成份股，并于3月12日生效。
description.en: Hang Seng Indexes Company Limited announced on February 9, 2007, that ICBC would be included as a constituent stock of the Hang Seng Index, effective March 12.

description.zh-cn: 斥资56亿美元收购南非标准银行20%的股权，成为其第一大股东。
description.en: Acquired a 20% stake in Standard Bank of South Africa for US$5.6 billion, becoming its largest shareholder.

description.zh-cn: 在天津滨海新区注册成立工银金融租赁有限公司。
description.en: Established ICBC Financial Leasing Co., Ltd. in Tianjin Binhai New Area.

description.zh-cn: 斥资8,025万加元向东亚银行收购前身加拿大东亚银行70%股权。
description.en: Acquired a 70% stake in the former Bank of East Asia (Canada) from the Bank of East Asia for C$80.25 million.

description.zh-cn: 斥资6.7亿元土耳其里拉收购前身Tekstilbank之75.5%股份。
description.en: Acquired a 75.5% stake in the former Tekstilbank for TRY 670 million.

description.zh-cn: 西班牙警方以“涉及洗黑钱及税务欺诈”为名，突击搜查中国工商银行马德里分行，并拘捕5名银行管理层人员。
description.en: Spanish police raided the ICBC Madrid branch on suspicion of money laundering and tax fraud, arresting five members of the bank's management.

description.zh-cn: 作为下属机构，是工商银行集团的成员。
description.en: As a subsidiary, it is a member of the ICBC group.

description.en: As a subsidiary, it is a member of the ICBC group.

description.en: As a subsidiary, it is a member of the ICBC group.

description.zh-cn: 作为下属机构，是工商银行集团的成员。
description.en: As a subsidiary, it is a member of the ICBC group.

description.zh-cn: 德仁于2019年5月1日即位为日本天皇。
description.en: Naruhito ascended to the throne as the Emperor of Japan on May 1, 2019.

description.zh-cn: 根据Wikitext内容，高市早苗担任内阁总理大臣。
description.en: According to the Wikitext, Sanae Takaichi serves as the Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 自卫队是日本的国家防卫力量，由防卫省统辖，最高指挥官为内阁总理大臣。
description.en: The Self-Defense Forces are Japan's national defense force, under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Defense, with the Prime Minister as the commander-in-chief.

description.zh-cn: 大日本帝国作为轴心国的主要成员之一，是第二次世界大战在亚太战场的主要侵略方。
description.en: The Empire of Japan, as one of the main members of the Axis powers, was the primary aggressor in the Asia-Pacific theater of World War II.
