description.zh-cn: 美国在广岛和长崎投下原子弹，最终迫使大日本帝国投降。
description.en: The United States dropped atomic bombs on Hiroshima and Nagasaki, ultimately forcing the Empire of Japan to surrender.

description.zh-cn: 昭和天皇通过广播宣布日本无条件投降，标志着第二次世界大战的结束。
description.en: Emperor Shōwa announced Japan's unconditional surrender via radio broadcast, marking the end of World War II.

description.zh-cn: 战后对日本进行军事占领和全面的民主化改造，并主导制定了《日本国宪法》。
description.en: Conducted the post-war military occupation and comprehensive democratic reforms in Japan, and led the drafting of the Constitution of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 日本于1956年12月18日加入联合国。
description.en: Japan joined the United Nations on December 18, 1956.

description.zh-cn: 东日本大震灾引发的海啸导致了福岛第一核电站的严重事故。
description.en: The tsunami triggered by the Great East Japan Earthquake led to the severe accident at the Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant.

description.zh-cn: 此次事件导致前首相安倍晋三身亡。
description.en: This event resulted in the death of former Prime Minister Shinzo Abe.

description.zh-cn: 德川家康于1603年开创江户幕府。
description.en: Tokugawa Ieyasu founded the Edo shogunate in 1603.

description.zh-cn: 耶稣是基督宗教的创始人，该宗教于公元一世纪由他创立。
description.en: Jesus is the founder of Christianity, which he established in the first century AD.

description.zh-cn: 基督宗教的大部分思想和信仰实践源自犹太教。
description.en: Much of Christianity's thought and faith practices originated from Judaism.

description.zh-cn: 在公元313年《米兰敕令》发布前，罗马帝国曾对基督徒进行迫害。
description.en: Before the Edict of Milan was issued in 313 AD, the Roman Empire persecuted Christians.

description.zh-cn: 罗马皇帝君士坦丁一世发布《米兰敕令》，结束了对基督徒的迫害，为基督教的发展提供了有利条件。
description.en: Roman Emperor Constantine I issued the Edict of Milan, ending the persecution of Christians and creating favorable conditions for the development of Christianity.

description.zh-cn: 该敕令的发布结束了罗马帝国对基督徒的迫害。
description.en: The issuance of this edict ended the Roman Empire's persecution of Christians.

description.zh-cn: 罗马皇帝狄奥多西一世通过《萨洛尼卡敕令》将基督教定为罗马帝国国教。
description.en: Roman Emperor Theodosius I made Christianity the state religion of the Roman Empire through the Edict of Thessalonica.

description.zh-cn: 该敕令将基督教确立为罗马帝国的国教。
description.en: This edict established Christianity as the state religion of the Roman Empire.

description.zh-cn: 东西教会大分裂事件导致了西方教会（后称天主教会）的正式形成。
description.en: The East-West Schism led to the formal establishment of the Western Church (later known as the Catholic Church).

description.zh-cn: 东西教会大分裂事件导致了东方教会（后称东正教会）的正式形成。
description.en: The East-West Schism led to the formal establishment of the Eastern Church (later known as the Eastern Orthodox Church).

description.zh-cn: 16世纪的宗教改革运动直接导致了新教的产生。
description.en: The 16th-century Protestant Reformation directly led to the emergence of Protestantism.

description.zh-cn: 宗教改革运动公开反对罗马教宗的权力，并批判天主教会的教义，削弱了其权威。
description.en: The Protestant Reformation openly opposed the authority of the Roman Pope and criticized the doctrines of the Catholic Church, weakening its authority.

description.zh-cn: 马丁·路德是16世纪欧洲宗教改革的主要代表人物。
description.en: Martin Luther was a leading figure of the 16th-century Protestant Reformation in Europe.

description.zh-cn: 约翰·加尔文是16世纪欧洲宗教改革的主要代表人物。
description.en: John Calvin was a leading figure of the 16th-century Protestant Reformation in Europe.

description.zh-cn: 乌利希·慈运理是16世纪欧洲宗教改革的主要代表人物。
description.en: Huldrych Zwingli was a leading figure of the 16th-century Protestant Reformation in Europe.

description.zh-cn: 在改信基督教前，使徒保罗信奉犹太教并将基督教视为异端进行迫害。
description.en: Before converting to Christianity, the Apostle Paul adhered to Judaism and persecuted Christianity as a heresy.

description.zh-cn: 在改信基督教后，保罗成为向非犹太人族群传播基督信仰的主要推动者。
description.en: After his conversion to Christianity, Paul became a major proponent of spreading the Christian faith to non-Jewish communities.

description.zh-cn: 在追随耶稣前，保罗是犹太公会领袖迦玛列的学生。
description.en: Before following Jesus, Paul was a student of Gamaliel, a leader of the Sanhedrin.

description.zh-cn: 自由派神学否定圣经是神的启示，认为其中包含错误和过时的内容，从而挑战其权威性。
description.en: Liberal theology denies that the Bible is a divine revelation, believing it contains errors and outdated content, thereby challenging its authority.

description.zh-cn: 根据文本记载，伯利恒是耶稣的出生地。
description.en: According to the text, Bethlehem is the birthplace of Jesus.

description.zh-cn: 耶稣于公元33年左右被处决，这一事件终结了其在世的生命。
description.en: Jesus was executed around 33 AD, an event that ended his mortal life.

description.zh-cn: 文本提及，有无神论者批评基督教反对演化论，显示了部分基督教徒对该理论的反对立场。
description.en: The text mentions that some atheists criticize Christianity for opposing the theory of evolution, indicating an oppositional stance from some Christians towards the theory.

description.zh-cn: 亚伯拉罕是犹太教、基督教和伊斯兰教共同的先知，被视为亚伯拉罕诸教的始祖，对犹太教的形成具有奠基性作用。
description.en: Abraham is a prophet common to Judaism, Christianity, and Islam, regarded as the founder of the Abrahamic religions, and played a foundational role in the formation of Judaism.

description.zh-cn: 亚伯拉罕是犹太教、基督教和伊斯兰教共同的先知，被视为亚伯拉罕诸教的始祖，对基督教的形成具有渊源性影响。
description.en: Abraham is a prophet common to Judaism, Christianity, and Islam, regarded as the founder of the Abrahamic religions, and had an original influence on the formation of Christianity.

description.zh-cn: 亚伯拉罕是犹太教、基督教和伊斯兰教共同的先知，被视为亚伯拉罕诸教的始祖，对伊斯兰教的形成具有渊源性影响。
description.en: Abraham is a prophet common to Judaism, Christianity, and Islam, regarded as the founder of the Abrahamic religions, and had an original influence on the formation of Islam.

description.zh-cn: 以中央人民政府人民革命军事委员会主席名义签署命令，将东北边防军改名为“中国人民志愿军”，并决定其入朝作战。
description.en: As Chairman of the People's Revolutionary Military Commission of the Central People's Government, he signed the order to rename the Northeast Border Defense Army to the 'Chinese People's Volunteer Army' and decided on its entry into the Korean War.

description.zh-cn: 志愿军入朝至停战期间，其武装力量领导职能由中央人民政府人民革命军事委员会承担。
description.en: From its entry into Korea until the armistice, the leadership functions for the Volunteer Army were undertaken by the People's Revolutionary Military Commission of the Central People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 于1950年10月19日跨过鸭绿江进入朝鲜参战，迅速击退联合国军，深刻影响了战争的进程和最终结局。
description.en: Crossed the Yalu River to enter the war in Korea on October 19, 1950, quickly pushing back the UN forces and profoundly influencing the course and outcome of the war.

description.zh-cn: 据称，黄炎培认为'支援军'的名称容易引发国际误解，建议改为'志愿军'，以表明中国并非与美国宣战，而是人民志愿支援朝鲜。
description.en: It is said that Huang Yanpei believed the name 'Support Army' could easily cause international misunderstanding and suggested changing it to 'Volunteer Army' to indicate that China was not declaring war on the US, but that its people were voluntarily supporting Korea.

description.zh-cn: 在军委会议上，将“支援军”改为“边防军”，并提出参战部队使用“志愿军”服装和旗帜，影响了部队的最终名称和形象。
description.en: At a Military Commission meeting, changed 'Support Army' to 'Border Defense Army' and proposed that combat troops use 'Volunteer Army' uniforms and flags, influencing the force's final name and image.

description.zh-cn: 同意了周恩来提出的苏联方面提供空军掩护和负责中国主要城市领空安全的要求，为志愿军出兵提供了重要支持。
description.en: Agreed to Zhou Enlai's request for Soviet air cover and responsibility for the air defense of major Chinese cities, providing crucial support for the Volunteer Army's deployment.

description.zh-cn: 向中国人民志愿军防守的上甘岭地区阵地发起进攻，引发了上甘岭战役。
description.en: Launched an attack on the positions held by the Chinese People's Volunteer Army in the Triangle Hill area, triggering the Battle of Triangle Hill.

description.zh-cn: 在上甘岭战役中，黄继光用身体堵住了联合国军的机枪火力点。
description.en: During the Battle of Triangle Hill, Huang Jiguang blocked a UN machine gun emplacement with his body.

description.zh-cn: 针对韩国总统李承晚拒绝承认和平协议的行为，发动了金城战役，打击韩国军队。
description.en: In response to South Korean President Syngman Rhee's refusal to accept the peace agreement, launched the Battle of Kumsong to attack South Korean forces.

description.zh-cn: 拒绝承认和平协议的达成，并以“就地释放”名义将大批朝鲜人民军战俘编入韩国军队，企图破坏停战。时任大韩民国总统李承晚对此表示反对，导致大韩民国最终未在停战协定上签字。
description.en: Refused to accept the peace agreement and forcibly conscripted a large number of KPA prisoners of war into the ROK army under the pretext of 'local release' in an attempt to sabotage the armistice. Then-President of the Republic of Korea, Syngman Rhee, opposed the armistice, leading to South Korea ultimately not signing the agreement.

description.zh-cn: 金城战役打击了拒绝停战的韩国军队，为最终签署停战协定清除了障碍。
description.en: The Battle of Kumsong struck the South Korean forces that were resisting the armistice, clearing the way for the final signing of the agreement.

description.zh-cn: 作为中央军委主席，命令召回驻板门店军事停战委员会的中国人民志愿军代表团，结束了其在朝鲜半岛的官方使命。
description.en: As Chairman of the Central Military Commission, he ordered the recall of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army delegation from the Military Armistice Commission in Panmunjom, ending its official mission on the Korean Peninsula.

description.zh-cn: 为志愿军提供了绝大多数主战装备，如T-34坦克、米格-15战斗机等，并在1951年3月后帮助其逐步换装苏式武器。
description.en: Provided the vast majority of main combat equipment to the Volunteer Army, such as T-34 tanks and MiG-15 fighters, and helped it gradually re-equip with Soviet-made weapons after March 1951.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民志愿军是中华人民共和国派出的赴朝作战部队。
description.en: The Chinese People's Volunteer Army was the expeditionary force dispatched by the People's Republic of China to fight in Korea.

description.zh-cn: 731部队是关东军下属的防疫给水部本部。
description.en: Unit 731 was the headquarters of the Epidemic Prevention and Water Purification Department under the Kwantung Army.

description.zh-cn: 关东军是大日本帝国陆军的一个总军。
description.en: The Kwantung Army was a general army of the Imperial Japanese Army.

description.zh-cn: 731部队使用活体中国人、苏联人、朝鲜人和同盟国战俘进行生物武器与化学武器等惨无人道的实验，至少杀害了3000人。
description.en: Unit 731 conducted inhumane experiments, including biological and chemical weapons tests, on living Chinese, Soviets, Koreans, and Allied prisoners of war, killing at least 3,000 people.

description.zh-cn: 731部队在中国浙江、湖南、山东等地实施了大规模细菌战，造成大量平民死亡。
description.en: Unit 731 carried out large-scale bacteriological warfare in areas such as Zhejiang, Hunan, and Shandong in China, causing numerous civilian deaths.

description.zh-cn: 731部队在浙江宁波、金华等地投放感染了鼠疫杆菌的跳蚤，实施细菌攻击。
description.en: Unit 731 dropped fleas infected with Yersinia pestis in Ningbo, Jinhua and other places in Zhejiang to carry out a bacteriological attack.

description.zh-cn: 九一八事变后，日本陆军省和参谋本部在石井四郎的提议下，准备在中国东北建立细菌研究所，最终促成了731部队的建立。
description.en: After the Mukden Incident, the Japanese Ministry of the Army and the General Staff, at the suggestion of Shirō Ishii, prepared to establish a bacteriological research institute in Northeast China, which ultimately led to the creation of Unit 731.

description.zh-cn: 时任关东军参谋长的板垣征四郎正式提出设立“关东军防疫部”，即731部队的前身。
description.en: Seishirō Itagaki, then Chief of Staff of the Kwantung Army, formally proposed the establishment of the 'Kwantung Army Epidemic Prevention Department,' the predecessor of Unit 731.

description.zh-cn: 苏联对日宣战并进攻满洲，导致731部队计划破产，被迫紧急撤离、销毁设施和证据。
description.en: The Soviet Union's declaration of war on Japan and invasion of Manchuria caused Unit 731's plans to collapse, forcing it to hastily evacuate and destroy its facilities and evidence.

description.zh-cn: 二战后，美国为了获取731部队的研究数据，给予了石井四郎及其他主要成员战争罪豁免权，使其免于被起诉。
description.en: After World War II, the United States granted immunity from war crimes prosecution to Shirō Ishii and other key members in exchange for Unit 731's research data, allowing them to avoid prosecution.

description.zh-cn: 美国政府与731部队成员达成特赦协议，以获取其研究数据，并在此后长期掩盖其战争罪行。
description.en: The U.S. government reached an amnesty agreement with members of Unit 731 to obtain their research data and subsequently covered up their war crimes for a long period.

description.zh-cn: 京都帝国大学向731部队派出了多名医学专家，协助石井四郎进行研究。
description.en: Kyoto Imperial University sent numerous medical experts to Unit 731 to assist Shirō Ishii with his research.

description.zh-cn: 东京帝国大学向731部队派出了至少六名医学专家。
description.en: Tokyo Imperial University sent at least six medical experts to Unit 731.

description.zh-cn: 美国记者鲍威尔于1980年代发表文章，揭露了731部队的内幕以及美国政府对其罪行的掩盖。
description.en: American journalist John W. Powell published articles in the 1980s that exposed the inner workings of Unit 731 and the U.S. government's cover-up of its crimes.

description.zh-cn: 东北野战军（东北人民解放军的野战部队）改称为中国人民解放军第四野战军。
description.en: The Northeast Field Army (the field force of the Northeast People's Liberation Army) was renamed the Fourth Field Army of the Chinese People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 第四野战军直属中央军事委员会领导。
description.en: The Fourth Field Army was directly under the leadership of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 东北人民自治军由进军东北的八路军、新四军及东北抗日联军为骨干组建而成。
description.en: The Northeast People's Self-Governing Army was formed with the Eighth Route Army, New Fourth Army, and Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army that marched into the Northeast as its backbone.

description.zh-cn: 东北人民自治军由进军东北的八路军、新四军及东北抗日联军为骨干组建而成。
description.en: The Northeast People's Self-Governing Army was formed with the Eighth Route Army, New Fourth Army, and Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army that marched into the Northeast as its backbone.

description.zh-cn: 东北人民自治军由进军东北的八路军、新四军及东北抗日联军为骨干组建而成。
description.en: The Northeast People's Self-Governing Army was formed with the Eighth Route Army, New Fourth Army, and Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army that marched into the Northeast as its backbone.

description.zh-cn: 第四野战军是第二次国共内战时期中国人民解放军的主力部队。
description.en: The Fourth Field Army was a main force of the People's Liberation Army during the Second Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次国共内战中，第四野战军及其前身部队与国民政府领导的国军作战。
description.en: During the Second Chinese Civil War, the Fourth Field Army and its predecessor units fought against the National Revolutionary Army led by the Nationalist Government.

description.zh-cn: 东北野战军（东北人民解放军）发动辽沈战役，击败东北全境的大部分国军。
description.en: The Northeast Field Army (Northeast People's Liberation Army) launched the Liaoshen Campaign, defeating most of the Nationalist forces throughout the Northeast.

description.zh-cn: 东北野战军（东北人民解放军）与华北军区部队共同发动平津战役。
description.en: The Northeast Field Army (Northeast People's Liberation Army) jointly launched the Pingjin Campaign with troops from the North China Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 第四野战军以第15兵团为主力实施渡海作战，解放海南岛。
description.en: The Fourth Field Army, with the 15th Army Group as its main force, carried out an amphibious operation to liberate Hainan Island.

description.zh-cn: 第四野战军配合第二、第三野战军发起渡江战役。
description.en: The Fourth Field Army coordinated with the Second and Third Field Armies to launch the Yangtze River Crossing Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 东北民主联军发动新开岭战役，歼灭国军第52军第25师。
description.en: The Northeast Democratic United Army launched the Xinkailing Campaign, annihilating the 25th Division of the KMT's 52nd Army.

description.zh-cn: 东北民主联军在第二次四平战役中失利，放弃四平等重要城市。
description.en: The Northeast Democratic United Army was defeated in the Second Battle of Siping and abandoned important cities such as Siping.

description.zh-cn: 第四野战军在衡阳、宝庆及阳江、阳春地区击败白崇禧部主力。
description.en: The Fourth Field Army defeated the main forces of Bai Chongxi in the Hengyang, Baoqing, and Yangjiang, Yangchun areas.

description.zh-cn: 第四野战军将第164师和第156师的朝鲜族士兵转移编入朝鲜人民军。
description.en: The Fourth Field Army transferred Korean soldiers from the 164th and 156th Divisions to the Korean People's Army.

description.zh-cn: 第四野战军曾收编约3万名日籍军人。
description.en: The Fourth Field Army incorporated approximately 30,000 Japanese soldiers.

description.zh-cn: 黑石集团向燕麦投资2亿美元，获得该公司7％的股份。
description.en: Blackstone invested $200 million in Oatly for a 7% stake in the company.

description.zh-cn: 购买黑石集团价值30亿美元的无投票权有限合伙单位。
description.en: Purchased $3 billion worth of non-voting limited partnership units in The Blackstone Group.

description.zh-cn: 以6亿美元入股购入蓝星20%股权。
description.en: Acquired a 20% stake in Bluestar for $600 million.

description.zh-cn: 三家分晋事件中，赵氏被正式承认为诸侯，建立了赵国。
description.en: During the Partition of Jin, the Zhao clan was officially recognized as a feudal lord, leading to the establishment of the State of Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 前403年，周威烈王正式册封赵烈侯、韩景侯、魏文侯为诸侯，标志着三家分晋的完成。
description.en: In 403 BCE, King Weilie of Zhou formally enfeoffed Marquis Lie of Zhao, Marquis Jing of Han, and Marquis Wen of Wei, marking the completion of the Partition of Jin.

description.zh-cn: 三家分晋最终导致晋国于前376年被瓜分完毕而灭亡。
description.en: The Partition of Jin ultimately led to the complete division and demise of the State of Jin in 376 BCE.

description.zh-cn: 赵烈侯是赵国的始封君主。
description.en: Marquis Lie was the founding monarch of the State of Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 赵国最终为秦国所灭。
description.en: The State of Zhao was ultimately conquered by the State of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 前228年，秦将王翦攻破赵都邯郸，俘虏赵王迁，赵国灭亡。
description.en: In 228 BCE, the Qin general Wang Jian captured Handan, the capital of Zhao, and took King Qian captive, leading to the fall of the State of Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 前307年，赵武灵王在赵国推行“胡服骑射”改革。
description.en: In 307 BCE, King Wuling of Zhao initiated the 'Wearing Hun clothes and shooting from horseback' reform in the State of Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 胡服骑射改革使赵国军力大增，成为战国后期唯一能与秦国抗衡的强国。
description.en: The 'Wearing Hun clothes and shooting from horseback' reform greatly increased Zhao's military strength, making it the only state capable of contending with Qin in the late Warring States period.

description.zh-cn: 赵国在胡服骑射改革后，于前295年灭亡了中山国。
description.en: After the 'Wearing Hun clothes and shooting from horseback' reform, the State of Zhao conquered the State of Zhongshan in 295 BCE.

description.zh-cn: 赵国在胡服骑射改革后，征服了林胡。
description.en: After the 'Wearing Hun clothes and shooting from horseback' reform, the State of Zhao conquered the Linhu people.

description.zh-cn: 赵国在胡服骑射改革后，征服了楼烦。
description.en: After the 'Wearing Hun clothes and shooting from horseback' reform, the State of Zhao conquered the Loufan people.

description.zh-cn: 赵国在长平之战中惨败，元气大伤，从此一蹶不振。
description.en: The State of Zhao suffered a catastrophic defeat in the Battle of Changping, which severely weakened it and from which it never fully recovered.

description.zh-cn: 在长平之战后，秦将白起坑杀赵军降卒，使赵国受到重创。
description.en: After the Battle of Changping, the Qin general Bai Qi executed the surrendered Zhao soldiers, inflicting a devastating blow to the State of Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 赵国灭亡后，代王嘉在代地建立代国，作为赵国的延续。
description.en: After the fall of Zhao, King Jia of Dai established the State of Dai in the Dai region as a successor to Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 前222年，秦将王贲攻灭代国，俘虏代王嘉。
description.en: In 222 BCE, the Qin general Wang Ben conquered the State of Dai and captured King Jia of Dai.

description.zh-cn: 晋国执政大臣知伯瑶被赵、魏、韩三家联合消灭。
description.en: Zhi Bo Yao, a powerful minister of Jin, was eliminated by the allied forces of the Zhao, Wei, and Han clans.

description.zh-cn: 赵襄子联合韩、魏两家，共同消灭了知氏。
description.en: Viscount Xiang of Zhao allied with the Han and Wei clans to jointly eliminate the Zhi clan.

description.zh-cn: 赵武灵王在沙丘之乱中被围困于行宫，最终饿死。
description.en: During the Shaqiu Incident, King Wuling of Zhao was besieged in his palace and eventually starved to death.

description.zh-cn: 赵章发动政变失败，引发了沙丘之乱。
description.en: Zhao Zhang launched a failed coup, which triggered the Shaqiu Incident.

description.zh-cn: 赵国相国肥义在赵章发动的政变中被杀。
description.en: Fei Yi, the chancellor of Zhao, was killed during the coup launched by Zhao Zhang.

description.zh-cn: 赵惠文王是赵武灵王的次子。
description.en: King Huiwen of Zhao was the second son of King Wuling of Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 赵章是赵武灵王的长子。
description.en: Zhao Zhang was the eldest son of King Wuling of Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 赵惠文王与赵章是兄弟关系。
description.en: King Huiwen of Zhao and Zhao Zhang were brothers.

description.zh-cn: 赵王迁（赵幽缪王）听信秦国反间计，杀害了将领李牧。
description.en: King Qian of Zhao (King Youmiu) fell for Qin's stratagem of sowing discord and executed his general Li Mu.

description.zh-cn: 担任第3届直辖市市长，为县市合并后首位女性市长。
description.en: Served as the 3rd mayor of the special municipality, the first female mayor after the county-city merger.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政府接收后首任市长。
description.en: First mayor after the handover to the ROC government.

description.zh-cn: 兼任台中县县长，当时台中市尚属台中县的县辖市。
description.en: Concurrently served as Magistrate of Taichung County, as Taichung City was then a county-administered city.

description.zh-cn: 时任主任秘书，代理市长黄克立职务。
description.en: Served as Acting Mayor in his capacity as Chief Secretary, filling in for Mayor Huang Ke-li.

description.zh-cn: 首位民选市长，当选后加入中国国民党，成为首位该党籍市长。
description.en: The first popularly elected mayor. Joined the KMT after being elected, becoming the first KMT mayor.

description.zh-cn: 连任一届，为首位成功连任的中国国民党籍市长。
description.en: Served two terms, becoming the first KMT mayor to be successfully re-elected.

description.zh-cn: 因案停职。
description.en: Suspended from office due to a legal case.

description.zh-cn: 首位无党籍市长。
description.en: The first independent mayor.

description.zh-cn: 连任失败。
description.en: Failed to win re-election.

description.zh-cn: 陈端堂是邱钦洲的外甥。
description.en: Chen Tuan-tang is Chiu Chin-chou's nephew.

description.zh-cn: 无党籍，连任失败。
description.en: Independent, failed to win re-election.

description.zh-cn: 此事件导致时任市长林柏榕被休职。
description.en: This incident led to the suspension of then-Mayor Lin Po-jung.

description.zh-cn: 任期内调任经济部国营事业委员会副主任委员。
description.en: Transferred to become Deputy Chairman of the State-owned Enterprise Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs, during his term.

description.zh-cn: 以台湾省政府委员身份代理市长职务。
description.en: Served as Acting Mayor in his capacity as a member of the Taiwan Provincial Government Council.

description.zh-cn: 以台湾省政府委员身份代理市长职务。
description.en: Served as Acting Mayor in his capacity as a member of the Taiwan Provincial Government Council.

description.zh-cn: 首位民进党籍市长及首位女性市长，连任失败。
description.en: The first DPP mayor and the first female mayor; failed to win re-election.

description.zh-cn: 后退党成为无党籍。
description.en: Later left the party to become an independent.

description.zh-cn: 张温鹰是陈端堂的媳妇。
description.en: Chang Wen-ying is Chen Tuan-tang's daughter-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 历任省辖市第14、15届市长及改制后第1届直辖市市长，累计任期约13年，连任失败。
description.en: Served as the 14th and 15th mayor of the provincial city and the 1st mayor after its upgrade to a special municipality, with a total tenure of about 13 years; failed to win re-election.

description.zh-cn: 县市合并后首位民进党籍市长，连任失败。
description.en: The first DPP mayor after the county-city merger; failed to win re-election.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党召集各党派代表商议建政事宜，成立了新政治协商会议筹备会。
description.en: The Communist Party of China convened representatives from various parties to discuss state-building matters and established the Preparatory Committee for the New Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议排除了中国国民党及其余跟随国民党迁台的卫星政党。
description.en: The Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference excluded the Kuomintang and other satellite parties that followed it to Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 反右运动使民主党派此后参政议政受到相当程度的限制。
description.en: The Anti-Rightist Campaign significantly restricted the political participation and deliberation of the democratic parties thereafter.

description.zh-cn: 1966年8月30日，全国政协机关因文化大革命停止办公。
description.en: On August 30, 1966, the offices of the CPPCC National Committee ceased operations due to the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 1973年2月28日，经周恩来批准，全国政协举行活动，标志着其开始恢复活动。
description.en: On February 28, 1973, with Zhou Enlai's approval, the CPPCC National Committee held an event, marking the beginning of its resumption of activities.

description.zh-cn: 中国经济社会理事会是政协全国委员会下辖的全国性社会团体组织。
description.en: The China Economic and Social Council is a national social organization under the CPPCC National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国宗教界和平委员会是政协全国委员会下辖的全国性社会团体组织。
description.en: The China Committee on Religion and Peace is a national social organization under the CPPCC National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政协理论研究会是政协全国委员会下辖的全国性社会团体组织。
description.en: The China Society for the Theory of the CPPCC is a national social organization under the CPPCC National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 全国政协常委会是全国政协的常设机构，在全国政协会议闭会期间代行其大部分职权。
description.en: The Standing Committee of the CPPCC National Committee is the permanent body of the National Committee and exercises most of its powers when the plenary session is not in session.

description.zh-cn: 任正非在创立华为前从南油集团辞职。
description.en: Ren Zhengfei resigned from Nanyou Group before founding Huawei.

description.zh-cn: 孟晚舟是任正非的女儿。
description.en: Meng Wanzhou is the daughter of Ren Zhengfei.

description.zh-cn: 深圳市政府的国有企业收购了荣耀终端，以确保其生存。
description.en: A state-owned enterprise of the Shenzhen Municipal Government acquired Honor to ensure its survival.

description.zh-cn: 日本于1945年8月15日宣布无条件投降，并于9月2日正式签署降伏文书，结束了太平洋战争。
description.en: Japan announced its unconditional surrender on August 15, 1945, and formally signed the Instrument of Surrender on September 2, ending the Pacific War.

description.zh-cn: 在珍珠港事件后，美国对日宣战，成为同盟国的主要成员。
description.en: After the attack on Pearl Harbor, the United States declared war on Japan and became a major member of the Allies.

description.zh-cn: 作为《联合国家宣言》的签署国，中国自1937年起便与日本作战，是同盟国的重要成员。
description.en: As a signatory of the Declaration by United Nations, China had been at war with Japan since 1937 and was a key member of the Allies.

description.zh-cn: 英国是同盟国的核心成员之一，参与了太平洋战争。
description.en: The United Kingdom was one of the core members of the Allies and participated in the Pacific War.

description.zh-cn: 中途岛海战是太平洋战争的转折点，日本海军在该战役中损失了四艘主力航空母舰，元气大伤。
description.en: The Battle of Midway was the turning point of the Pacific War, where the Imperial Japanese Navy suffered a devastating blow, losing four of its main aircraft carriers.

description.zh-cn: 莱特湾海战是历史上最大规模的海战，日本海军在此次战役中遭受灾难性失败，其联合舰队基本被摧毁。
description.en: The Battle of Leyte Gulf was the largest naval battle in history. The Imperial Japanese Navy suffered a catastrophic defeat, and its Combined Fleet was effectively destroyed.

description.zh-cn: 通过广播发布《终战诏书》，向日本民众宣布接受《波茨坦公告》，决定投降。
description.en: Broadcast the Jewel Voice Broadcast, announcing to the Japanese people the acceptance of the Potsdam Declaration and the decision to surrender.

description.zh-cn: 《终战诏书》的发布标志着日本决定无条件投降。
description.en: The broadcast of the Imperial Rescript on the Termination of the War signaled Japan's decision to surrender unconditionally.

description.zh-cn: 在珍珠港事件后领导美国对日宣战，是同盟国在太平洋战争期间的主要领导人之一。
description.en: Led the United States to declare war on Japan after the attack on Pearl Harbor and was one of the principal Allied leaders during the Pacific War.

description.zh-cn: 作为美国总统，授权对日本使用原子弹。
description.en: As President of the United States, he authorized the use of atomic bombs against Japan.

description.zh-cn: 实施了“杀光、抢光、烧光”的“三光政策”，对中国平民造成巨大伤害。
description.en: Implemented the "Three Alls Policy" (kill all, loot all, burn all), causing immense harm to Chinese civilians.

description.zh-cn: 在马尼拉战役期间，日本军队对菲律宾平民进行了大规模屠杀。
description.en: During the Battle of Manila, Japanese forces conducted a large-scale massacre of Filipino civilians.

description.zh-cn: 日军在菲律宾强迫美国和菲律宾战俘进行长途跋涉，期间虐待并杀害了数千名战俘。
description.en: Japanese forces forced American and Filipino prisoners of war on a long march in the Philippines, during which thousands were abused and killed.

description.zh-cn: 日本军队建立了“慰安妇”制度，强迫亚洲多国女性为日军提供性服务。
description.en: The Japanese military established the "comfort women" system, forcing women from many Asian countries to provide sexual services to Japanese soldiers.

description.zh-cn: 指挥了对东京的燃烧弹轰炸，即“会议室行动”，造成了大规模的平民伤亡和破坏。
description.en: Commanded the firebombing of Tokyo, known as "Operation Meetinghouse," which caused massive civilian casualties and destruction.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央宣传部指示工人出版社创作一本歌颂刘志丹的小说。
description.en: The Propaganda Department of the CCP Central Committee instructed the Workers' Publishing House to create a novel praising Liu Zhidan.

description.zh-cn: 李建彤是刘景范的妻子。
description.en: Li Jiantong is the wife of Liu Jingfan.

description.zh-cn: 刘景范是刘志丹的弟弟。
description.en: Liu Jingfan is the younger brother of Liu Zhidan.

description.zh-cn: 阎红彦就小说《刘志丹》的问题向康生作了报告，促使康生介入此事。
description.en: Yan Hongyan reported the issue of the novel 'Liu Zhidan' to Kang Sheng, prompting Kang Sheng's intervention.

description.zh-cn: 在中共八届十中全会上，毛泽东念了康生递上的“利用小说进行反党，是一大发明”的纸条并加以评论，为该案的成立提供了最高层的支持。
description.en: At the Tenth Plenary Session of the Eighth CCP Central Committee, Mao Zedong read and commented on a note from Kang Sheng stating 'using novels to carry out anti-Party activities is a great invention', providing top-level support for the case.

description.zh-cn: 贾拓夫因该案被打成反党集团成员，被下放，并在文革期间被迫害致死。
description.en: Jia Tuofu was labeled a member of an anti-Party clique because of this case, was demoted, and was persecuted to death during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 刘景范因该案被打成反党集团成员并受到迫害，直至1974年才获释。
description.en: Liu Jingfan was labeled a member of an anti-Party clique and persecuted because of this case, and was not released until 1974.

description.zh-cn: 作为小说作者，李建彤自1962年起被关押，1970年被开除党籍并下放劳改。
description.en: As the author of the novel, Li Jiantong was imprisoned from 1962, expelled from the Party in 1970, and sent to labor reform.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命的开始使得《刘志丹》案的受害者遭到更严酷的迫害，案件进一步升级为“西北反党集团”。
description.en: The beginning of the Cultural Revolution led to more severe persecution of the victims of the 'Liu Zhidan' case, which was further escalated into the 'Northwest Anti-Party Group'.

description.zh-cn: 1936年，刘志丹在山西中阳县三交镇的战斗中被国民政府军队阻击身亡。
description.en: In 1936, Liu Zhidan was killed by the troops of the Nationalist Government during a battle in Sanjiao Town, Zhongyang County, Shanxi.

description.zh-cn: 在此次会议上，《刘志丹》小说案被正式提出并定性，决定成立专案委员会进行审查，导致事件严重升级。
description.en: At this plenum, the 'Liu Zhidan' novel case was formally raised and characterized, and it was decided to establish a special committee for investigation, leading to a serious escalation of the event.

description.zh-cn: 越南共产党是越南唯一的执政党，对国家实行全面领导。
description.en: The Communist Party of Vietnam is the sole ruling party, exercising comprehensive leadership over the state.

description.zh-cn: 1941年，胡志明等越南革命家创办“越南独立同盟会”（简称越盟）。
description.en: In 1941, Vietnamese revolutionaries including Hồ Chí Minh founded the 'League for the Independence of Vietnam' (Viet Minh).

description.zh-cn: 八月革命后，胡志明于1945年9月2日宣告越南民主共和国成立。
description.en: After the August Revolution, Hồ Chí Minh proclaimed the establishment of the Democratic Republic of Vietnam on September 2, 1945.

description.zh-cn: 1954年的日内瓦会议规定以北纬17度线为临时军事分界线，造成了越南的分裂。
description.en: The 1954 Geneva Conference stipulated the 17th parallel as a provisional military demarcation line, resulting in the partition of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 在越南战争期间，北越（越南民主共和国）与南越（越南共和国）处于敌对状态。
description.en: During the Vietnam War, North Vietnam (Democratic Republic of Vietnam) and South Vietnam (Republic of Vietnam) were in a state of hostility.

description.zh-cn: 在越南战争期间，苏联向北越（越南民主共和国）提供军事和经济援助。
description.en: During the Vietnam War, the Soviet Union provided military and economic aid to North Vietnam (Democratic Republic of Vietnam).

description.zh-cn: 在越南战争期间，中华人民共和国向北越（越南民主共和国）提供支援。
description.en: During the Vietnam War, the People's Republic of China provided support to North Vietnam (Democratic Republic of Vietnam).

description.zh-cn: 在越南战争期间，美国向南越（越南共和国）提供主要支援。
description.en: During the Vietnam War, the United States was the primary supporter of South Vietnam (Republic of Vietnam).

description.zh-cn: 1975年4月30日，北越军队攻陷南越首都西贡，越南共和国灭亡。
description.en: On April 30, 1975, North Vietnamese forces captured Saigon, the capital of South Vietnam, leading to the collapse of the Republic of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 越南于1978年底入侵柬埔寨，推翻了红色高棉政权。
description.en: Vietnam invaded Cambodia in late 1978, overthrowing the Khmer Rouge regime.

description.zh-cn: 1982年入读北京大学，后被保送至该校遥感技术应用研究所。
description.en: Enrolled in Peking University in 1982 and was later admitted to its Institute of Remote Sensing and GIS Application.

description.zh-cn: 流亡法国后进入高等研究应用学院宗教历史系学习，先后获得硕士及博士学位。
description.en: After going into exile in France, he studied at the Department of Religious History at the École pratique des hautes études, where he obtained Master's and PhD degrees.

description.zh-cn: 1997年在莱顿大学研究儒家学说。
description.en: Researched Confucianism at Leiden University in 1997.

description.zh-cn: 作为学生领袖，担任北高联主席等多个领导职务，是运动的主要组织者和领导者之一。
description.en: As a student leader, he served as the chairman of the Beijing Students' Autonomous Federation and held several other leadership positions, making him one of the main organizers and leaders of the movement.

description.zh-cn: 六四事件后，封从德被北京市公安局通缉，在中国大陆逃亡十个月后流亡海外。
description.en: After the Tiananmen Square protests, Feng Congde was put on the wanted list by the Beijing Municipal Public Security Bureau, and he went into exile after being a fugitive in mainland China for ten months.

description.zh-cn: 将封从德列为21名高自联骨干之一，进行全国通缉。
description.en: Listed Feng Congde as one of the 21 core members of the Beijing Students' Autonomous Federation and issued a nationwide arrest warrant for him.

description.zh-cn: 在高等研究应用学院宗教历史系师从施舟人教授。
description.en: Studied under Professor Kristofer Schipper at the Department of Religious History of the École pratique des hautes études.

description.zh-cn: 作为八九民运学生领袖，遭中共当局通缉并流亡海外。其言论主张中共崩溃。
description.en: As a student leader of the 1989 democracy movement, he was wanted by the CCP authorities and went into exile. His statements advocate for the collapse of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 于2001年创建《六四档案》网站。
description.en: Founded the 'June 4th Archive' website in 2001.

description.zh-cn: 主张中国大陆在中共崩溃后回归中华民国。
description.en: Advocates for mainland China to return to the Republic of China after the collapse of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 国防部参谋本部是中华民国国防部的所属部门，是国防部部长的军令幕僚。
国防部参谋本部负责执行指挥中华民国国军。
根据国防法第八条，总统指挥军队时，直接责成国防部部长执行。
根据国防法第八条，国防部部长命令参谋总长指挥执行军队任务。
副参谋总长执行官是参谋总长的下属。
任内逝世
八二三炮战发生在王叔铭担任参谋总长任内。
台湾海峡飞弹危机发生在罗本立担任参谋总长任内。
严德发因阿帕契打卡案自请处分，成为中华民国国军史上首位被记过的参谋总长。
沈一鸣因搭乘UH-60黑鹰直升机失事，任内因公殉职。
国防部海军司令部及其所属部队得编配参谋本部，负责执行军队指挥。
国防部空军司令部及其所属部队得编配参谋本部，负责执行军队指挥。
国防部宪兵指挥部及其所属部队编配参谋本部，执行军队指挥。
国防部资通电军指挥部及其所属部队编配参谋本部，执行军队指挥。
康熙帝将乌拉那拉氏赐婚予皇四子胤禛（后来的雍正帝），成为其嫡福晋。
description.en: The Kangxi Emperor betrothed Lady Ulanara to his fourth son, Yinzhen (the future Yongzheng Emperor), as his primary consort.

description.zh-cn: 为嫡母孝敬宪皇后累加谥号。
description.en: Added posthumous titles for his stepmother, Empress Xiaojingxian.

description.zh-cn: 为孝敬宪皇后累加谥号。
description.en: Added posthumous titles for Empress Xiaojingxian.

description.zh-cn: 杨东明是杨成武之子。
description.en: Yang Dongming is the son of Yang Chengwu.

description.zh-cn: 作为“义勇队”成员参加了黄麻起义。
description.en: Participated in the Huangma Uprising as a member of the 'Volunteer Corps'.

description.zh-cn: 在黄安战役中，秦基伟率部护卫徐向前指挥夺回阵地。
description.en: During the Huang'an Campaign, Qin Jiwei led his troops to protect Xu Xiangqian while he commanded the recapture of the position.

description.zh-cn: 作为西路军成员，在甘肃临泽与马家军骑兵作战。
description.en: As a member of the Western Route Army, he fought against the Ma clique's cavalry in Linze, Gansu.

description.zh-cn: 秦基伟任司令员的第九纵队隶属于陈赓、谢富治指挥的“陈谢集团”。
description.en: The 9th Column, commanded by Qin Jiwei, was subordinate to the 'Chen-Xie Group' led by Chen Geng and Xie Fuzhi.

description.zh-cn: 指挥中国人民志愿军第15军参加上甘岭战役，坚守40余天。
description.en: Commanded the 15th Army of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army in the Battle of Triangle Hill, holding the position for over 40 days.

description.zh-cn: 上甘岭战役的胜利迫使联军停止了对志愿军的大规模进攻计划。
description.en: The victory in the Battle of Triangle Hill forced the UN forces to halt any large-scale offensive plans against the Volunteer Army.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间被批斗，并被下放至农场劳改，后于1973年恢复工作。
description.en: Was persecuted during the Cultural Revolution, sent to a farm for re-education through labor, and reinstated in 1973.

description.zh-cn: 在中华人民共和国成立35周年阅兵式上担任总指挥，陪同邓小平检阅部队。
description.en: Served as the general commander of the military parade for the 35th anniversary of the PRC, accompanying Deng Xiaoping to inspect the troops.

description.zh-cn: 接替张爱萍出任中华人民共和国国防部部长。
description.en: Succeeded Zhang Aiping as the Minister of National Defense of the PRC.

description.zh-cn: 秦基伟卸任国防部长后，由迟浩田接任。
description.en: After Qin Jiwei stepped down as Minister of Defense, Chi Haotian succeeded him.

description.zh-cn: 孟凡利出生于山东临沂。
description.en: Meng Fanli was born in Linyi, Shandong.

description.zh-cn: 孟凡利于1986年3月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Meng Fanli joined the Communist Party of China in March 1986.

description.zh-cn: 在山东经济学院会计系商业会计专业学习。
description.en: Studied commercial accounting in the Department of Accounting at Shandong University of Finance and Economics.

description.zh-cn: 在南开大学会计系西方会计专业在职攻读硕士研究生。
description.en: Pursued a master's degree in Western accounting in the Department of Accounting at Nankai University while working.

description.zh-cn: 在天津财经学院会计学专业在职攻读博士。
description.en: Pursued a doctorate in accounting at Tianjin University of Finance and Economics while working.

position.zh-cn: 会计系教师、财务会计系副主任、财务会计系主任
position.en: Teacher, Deputy Dean, and Dean of the Department of Accounting

description.zh-cn: 孟凡利毕业后留校任教并逐步晋升。
description.en: After graduation, Meng Fanli stayed at the university to teach and was gradually promoted.

description.zh-cn: 孟凡利任广东省省长时，黄坤明任中共广东省委书记，是其直接上级。
description.en: When Meng Fanli was Governor of Guangdong, Huang Kunming was the Party Secretary of Guangdong, his direct superior.

position.zh-cn: 中共深圳市委副书记、市长
position.en: Deputy Secretary of Shenzhen Municipal Party Committee, Mayor

description.zh-cn: 覃伟中任深圳市长时，孟凡利任中共深圳市委书记，是其直接上级。
description.en: When Qin Weizhong was Mayor of Shenzhen, Meng Fanli was the Party Secretary of Shenzhen, his direct superior.

description.zh-cn: 孟凡利接替王伟中担任广东省省长及深圳市委书记职务。
description.en: Meng Fanli succeeded Wang Weizhong as Governor of Guangdong and Party Secretary of Shenzhen.

description.zh-cn: 孟凡利接替张院忠担任中共包头市委书记。
description.en: Meng Fanli succeeded Zhang Yuanzhong as Party Secretary of Baotou.

description.zh-cn: 丁绣峰接替孟凡利担任中共包头市委书记。
description.en: Ding Xiufeng succeeded Meng Fanli as Party Secretary of Baotou.

description.zh-cn: 孟凡利接替张新起担任青岛市市长。
description.en: Meng Fanli succeeded Zhang Xinqi as Mayor of Qingdao.

description.zh-cn: 赵豪志接替孟凡利担任青岛市市长。
description.en: Zhao Haozhi succeeded Meng Fanli as Mayor of Qingdao.

description.zh-cn: 孟凡利接替张江汀担任中共烟台市委书记。此前在烟台任市长时，张江汀是其上级。后在青岛任市长时，张江汀亦是其上级。
description.en: Meng Fanli succeeded Zhang Jiangting as Party Secretary of Yantai. Previously, when Meng was Mayor of Yantai, Zhang was his superior. Later, when Meng was Mayor of Qingdao, Zhang was also his superior.

description.zh-cn: 王浩接替孟凡利担任中共烟台市委书记。
description.en: Wang Hao succeeded Meng Fanli as Party Secretary of Yantai.

description.zh-cn: 孟凡利接替王良担任烟台市市长。
description.en: Meng Fanli succeeded Wang Liang as Mayor of Yantai.

description.zh-cn: 张永霞接替孟凡利担任烟台市市长。
description.en: Zhang Yongxia succeeded Meng Fanli as Mayor of Yantai.

description.zh-cn: 在孟凡利就任深圳市委书记的领导干部会议上，时任广东省委书记李希出席并讲话。
description.en: At the leadership cadre meeting for Meng Fanli's appointment as Shenzhen Party Secretary, Li Xi, then Party Secretary of Guangdong, attended and spoke.

description.zh-cn: 在孟凡利就任深圳市委书记的领导干部会议上，张福海宣读了中央决定。
description.en: At the leadership cadre meeting for Meng Fanli's appointment as Shenzhen Party Secretary, Zhang Fuhai announced the central government's decision.

position.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会总书记
position.en: General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 选举习近平为中央委员会总书记。
description.en: Elected Xi Jinping as General Secretary of the Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 选举产生新一届（第二十届）中央政治局。
description.en: Elected the new (20th) Political Bureau of the Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 选举产生新一届（第二十届）中央政治局常务委员会。
description.en: Elected the new (20th) Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 根据中央政治局常务委员会的提名，通过了中央书记处成员。
description.en: Approved the members of the Central Secretariat based on the nomination of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 决定了中国共产党中央军事委员会组成人员。
description.en: Decided on the composition of the Central Military Commission of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 批准了第二十届中央纪律检查委员会第一次全体会议选举产生的书记、副书记和常务委员会委员人选。
description.en: Approved the elected Secretary, Deputy Secretaries, and members of the Standing Committee of the 20th Central Commission for Discipline Inspection from its first plenary session.

description.zh-cn: 中央政治局在中央委员会全体会议闭会期间，行使中央委员会的职权。
description.en: The Political Bureau exercises the functions and powers of the Central Committee when the latter is not in session.

description.zh-cn: 审议通过了《党和国家机构改革方案》。
description.en: Reviewed and adopted the 'Plan for the Reform of Party and State Institutions'.

description.zh-cn: 在会上作了重要讲话，并就《党和国家机构改革方案（草案）》向全会作了说明。
description.en: Delivered an important speech at the meeting and explained the 'Draft Plan for the Reform of Party and State Institutions' to the plenum.

description.zh-cn: 李先念接替刘少奇（至1968年）担任中华人民共和国主席。
description.en: Li Xiannian succeeded Liu Shaoqi (until 1968) as the President of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 李先念的国家主席职务由杨尚昆接替。
description.en: Li Xiannian was succeeded by Yang Shangkun as the President of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 李先念的全国政协主席职务由李瑞环接替。
description.en: Li Xiannian was succeeded by Li Ruihuan as Chairman of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 李先念被认为是邓小平主政时期的“中共八大元老”之一。
description.en: Li Xiannian is considered one of the 'Eight Elders of the CCP' during Deng Xiaoping's era.

description.zh-cn: 在“六四天安门事件”中，李先念公开表态支持中央决定，支持武力镇压。
description.en: During the 'Tiananmen Square Incident', Li Xiannian publicly expressed support for the central government's decision and supported the use of force.

description.zh-cn: 张国焘拒绝执行中共中央的北上方针，率领红四方面军（包括李先念部）南下。
description.en: Zhang Guotao refused to follow the CPC Central Committee's northward policy, leading the Fourth Front Army (including Li Xiannian's troops) southward.

description.zh-cn: 陈云和滕代远奉命接应兵败的西路军余部，其中包括李先念。
description.en: Chen Yun and Teng Daiyuan were ordered to rescue the remnants of the defeated Western Route Army, including Li Xiannian.

description.zh-cn: 滕代远和陈云奉命接应兵败的西路军余部，其中包括李先念。
description.en: Teng Daiyuan and Chen Yun were ordered to rescue the remnants of the defeated Western Route Army, including Li Xiannian.

description.zh-cn: 1945年1月，李先念率领的新四军第5师与王震的八路军南下支队会师。同年10月，共同组建中原军区。
description.en: In January 1945, the New Fourth Army's 5th Division led by Li Xiannian met with Wang Zhen's southward detachment of the Eighth Route Army. In October of the same year, they jointly established the Central Plains Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 由于国军压迫，中原军区部队于1946年6月26日发起中原突围。
description.en: Under pressure from the Nationalist army, the Central Plains Military Region troops launched the Central Plains Breakout on June 26, 1946.

description.zh-cn: 李先念与邓小平在革命战争时期及建国后长期共事，在文革后期协助邓小平进行全面整顿。
description.en: Li Xiannian and Deng Xiaoping worked together for a long time during the revolutionary wars and after the founding of the PRC. In the later stages of the Cultural Revolution, he assisted Deng Xiaoping in the comprehensive rectification.

description.zh-cn: 1948年，李先念与邓子恢在开封参与领导淮海战役的后勤保障工作。
description.en: In 1948, Li Xiannian and Deng Zihui co-led the logistical support for the Huaihai Campaign in Kaifeng.

description.zh-cn: 1968年，李先念在文化大革命期间被下放到北京市北郊木材厂劳动。
description.en: In 1968, during the Cultural Revolution, Li Xiannian was sent to perform manual labor at a timber factory in the northern suburbs of Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 李先念因被指为“二月逆流”成员而受到批判。
description.en: Li Xiannian was criticized for being identified as a member of the 'February Countercurrent'.

description.zh-cn: 在“二月逆流”后，江青称李先念为“附和错误路线”，使其受到批判。
description.en: After the 'February Countercurrent', Jiang Qing labeled Li Xiannian as 'adhering to an erroneous line', leading to his criticism.

description.zh-cn: 李先念协助邓小平进行1975年的全面整顿工作。
description.en: Li Xiannian assisted Deng Xiaoping in carrying out the comprehensive rectification of 1975.

description.zh-cn: 由于1870年普法战争爆发，拿破仑三世被迫调回驻扎在罗马的军队，从而无法继续保护教宗国。
description.en: Due to the outbreak of the Franco-Prussian War in 1870, Napoleon III was forced to withdraw his troops stationed in Rome, thus ending his protection of the Papal States.

description.zh-cn: 以“教会的保护者”名义出兵保护罗马，阻止意大利王国占领，直到普法战争爆发。
description.en: He sent troops to protect Rome under the title 'protector of the Church', preventing its occupation by the Kingdom of Italy until the Franco-Prussian War.

description.zh-cn: 瑞士近卫队是负责教宗人身安全的志愿禁卫队。
description.en: The Swiss Guard is a volunteer guard unit responsible for the personal safety of the Pope.

description.zh-cn: 罗马教廷宣布梵蒂冈不再自动采纳意大利议会通过的法律，理由是意大利法律过于繁杂且时常与天主教教义相违背。
description.en: The Roman Curia announced that the Vatican would no longer automatically adopt laws passed by the Italian parliament, citing that Italian legislation was too complex and often contrary to Catholic doctrine.

description.zh-cn: “丕平献土”事件为教宗国的成立奠定了基础。
description.en: The 'Donation of Pepin' laid the foundation for the establishment of the Papal States.

description.zh-cn: 菲利普·贝当于1856年4月24日出生于法国北部的科希阿拉图尔。
description.en: Philippe Pétain was born in Cauchy-à-la-Tour in northern France on April 24, 1856.

description.zh-cn: 菲利普·贝当于1876年加入法国陆军，此前曾就读于圣西尔军事学校。
description.en: Philippe Pétain joined the French Army in 1876 after attending the Saint-Cyr military school.

description.zh-cn: 菲利普·贝当自1876年起在法国陆军服役，担任过从低级军官到陆军总司令等一系列职务，直到1945年其军衔被剥夺。
description.en: Philippe Pétain served in the French Army from 1876, holding various positions from junior officer to Commander-in-Chief, until his military ranks were stripped in 1945.

description.zh-cn: 在凡尔登战役中的杰出指挥使菲利普·贝当声名鹊起，被誉为“凡尔登的救星”，成为法国家喻户晓的民族英雄。
description.en: His outstanding command during the Battle of Verdun brought Philippe Pétain to prominence, earning him the title 'Savior of Verdun' and making him a national hero in France.

description.zh-cn: 尼维尔攻势的惨败导致法军士气崩溃并发生兵变，贝当被任命为陆军总司令以稳定局势。
description.en: The disastrous failure of the Nivelle Offensive led to a collapse in French army morale and mutinies, resulting in Pétain's appointment as Commander-in-Chief to restore order.

description.zh-cn: 尼维尔攻势的灾难性失败导致罗贝尔·尼维尔被免去法军总司令职务。
description.en: The catastrophic failure of the Nivelle Offensive led to Robert Nivelle's dismissal as Commander-in-Chief of the French Army.

description.zh-cn: 在1940年法国战役期间，时任总理保罗·雷诺任命贝当为副总理，希望借助其威望稳定局势。
description.en: During the Battle of France in 1940, then-Prime Minister Paul Reynaud appointed Pétain as Vice Premier, hoping his prestige would stabilize the situation.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国在1940年的法国战役中击败法国，导致法兰西第三共和国的垮台。
description.en: Nazi Germany defeated France in the Battle of France in 1940, leading to the collapse of the French Third Republic.

description.zh-cn: 菲利普·贝当因叛国罪被判处死刑后，时任临时政府主席的夏尔·戴高乐签署特赦令，将其减刑为终身监禁。
description.en: After Philippe Pétain was sentenced to death for treason, Charles de Gaulle, then President of the Provisional Government, commuted his sentence to life imprisonment.

description.zh-cn: 夏尔·戴高乐年轻时曾在驻阿拉斯的第33步兵团服役，当时的团长是菲利普·贝当上校。
description.en: As a young officer, Charles de Gaulle served in the 33rd Infantry Regiment in Arras under the command of then-Colonel Philippe Pétain.

description.zh-cn: 由贝当领导的法国政府于1940年6月22日签署了《第二次贡比涅停战协定》，正式向德国投降。
description.en: The French government, led by Pétain, signed the Second Armistice at Compiègne on June 22, 1940, officially surrendering to Germany.

description.zh-cn: 皮埃尔·赖伐尔在维希法国时期担任贝当政府的副元首。
description.en: Pierre Laval served as the Vice-President of the Council in Pétain's government during the Vichy France period.

description.zh-cn: 皮埃尔-艾蒂安·弗朗丹在维希法国时期担任贝当政府的副元首。
description.en: Pierre-Étienne Flandin served as the Vice-President of the Council in Pétain's government during the Vichy France period.

description.zh-cn: 弗朗索瓦·达尔朗在维希法国时期担任贝当政府的副元首。
description.en: François Darlan served as the Vice-President of the Council in Pétain's government during the Vichy France period.

description.zh-cn: 1934年，菲利普·贝当在加斯东·杜梅格担任总理的政府中出任战争部长。
description.en: In 1934, Philippe Pétain served as Minister of War in the government led by Prime Minister Gaston Doumergue.

description.zh-cn: 1940年10月24日，贝当与希特勒在卢瓦河畔蒙图瓦尔会面，商讨两国间的合作事宜。
description.en: On October 24, 1940, Pétain met with Hitler at Montoire-sur-le-Loir to discuss collaboration between their two countries.

description.zh-cn: 在珍珠港事件后，于陆军参谋长马歇尔领导的总参谋部任职，并受其赏识。
description.en: After the attack on Pearl Harbor, he served in the General Staff under Chief of Staff Marshall, who appreciated his abilities.

description.zh-cn: 杜鲁门总统委任艾森豪威尔为美国陆军参谋长。
description.en: President Truman appointed Eisenhower as Chief of Staff of the United States Army.

description.zh-cn: 担任首位北大西洋公约组织最高指挥官。
description.en: Served as the first Supreme Commander of NATO.

description.zh-cn: 艾森豪威尔参加1952年总统选举的主要意图之一是阻止其党内竞争对手塔夫脱当选后推行孤立主义政策。
description.en: One of Eisenhower's primary motivations for running in the 1952 presidential election was to prevent his party rival, Taft, from implementing isolationist policies.

description.zh-cn: 在艾森豪威尔担任总统期间任其副总统。
description.en: Served as Vice President during Eisenhower's presidency.

description.zh-cn: 延续承认中华民国为代表全中国的唯一合法政府，并于1954年与其签订《中美共同防御条约》。
description.en: Continued to recognize the Republic of China as the sole legitimate government of China and signed the Sino-American Mutual Defense Treaty with it in 1954.

description.zh-cn: 该条约旨在保卫台澎金马，稳固美国与中华民国的邦谊。
description.en: The treaty aimed to defend Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen, and Matsu, solidifying the alliance between the US and the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 在国内暗中反对约瑟夫·麦卡锡参议员过于激烈的反共主张，为麦卡锡主义时代的结束做出了一定的贡献。
description.en: Covertly opposed Senator Joseph McCarthy's extreme anti-communist stances, contributing to the end of the McCarthy era.

description.zh-cn: 签署了1956年的相关法案，为州际公路系统的发展确认了法源与基金。
description.en: Signed the relevant 1956 acts, which established the legal and financial foundation for the development of the Interstate Highway System.

description.zh-cn: 在苏联于1957年成功发射人造卫星后，艾森豪威尔随即授权建立美国国家航空航天局。
description.en: After the Soviet Union successfully launched Sputnik in 1957, Eisenhower authorized the establishment of NASA.

description.zh-cn: 于任内访问中华民国台北市，与时任总统蒋中正会面。
description.en: Visited Taipei, Republic of China during his presidency and met with then-President Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: 在古巴导弹危机期间，应时任总统肯尼迪的请求，与其会谈商讨应对方案。
description.en: During the Cuban Missile Crisis, at the request of then-President Kennedy, he met with him to discuss response strategies.

description.zh-cn: 任命厄尔·沃伦为美国最高法院第14任首席大法官。
description.en: Appointed Earl Warren as the 14th Chief Justice of the United States Supreme Court.

description.zh-cn: 沃伦法院频频作出倾向自由派的判决，这与艾森豪威尔的温和保守派立场相悖，他后称提名沃伦是“一生中所犯的最愚蠢的错误”。
description.en: The Warren Court frequently issued liberal rulings, contrary to Eisenhower's moderate conservative stance, leading him to later call Warren's nomination 'the biggest damn-fool mistake I ever made'.

description.zh-cn: 在总统任内推行冷战政策，以遏制苏联共产主义的扩张。
description.en: During his presidency, he implemented Cold War policies to contain the expansion of Soviet communism.

description.zh-cn: 金泳三与孙命顺于1951年结婚，婚姻关系直至金泳三2015年去世。
description.en: Kim Young-sam and Son Myung-soon married in 1951, and their marriage lasted until his death in 2015.

description.zh-cn: 金泳三1952年8月毕业于首尔大学哲学系。
description.en: Kim Young-sam graduated from the Department of Philosophy at Seoul National University in August 1952.

description.zh-cn: 金泳三于1929年1月14日出生于今韩国庆尚南道巨济市。
description.en: Kim Young-sam was born on January 14, 1929, in what is now Geoje, South Gyeongsang Province, South Korea.

description.zh-cn: 在朴正熙执政时期，金泳三作为主要的在野党领袖，长期从事反对其独裁统治的民主化运动。
description.en: During Park Chung-hee's rule, Kim Young-sam, as a major opposition leader, was long engaged in the democratization movement against his dictatorial regime.

description.zh-cn: 金泳三是全斗焕军事独裁时期的主要反对派领袖，曾被软禁并进行绝食抗议。
description.en: Kim Young-sam was a leading opposition figure during Chun Doo-hwan's military dictatorship, during which he was placed under house arrest and conducted a hunger strike in protest.

description.zh-cn: 金泳三是韩国民主运动的领袖人物，长期致力于推动韩国的民主化改革。
description.en: Kim Young-sam was a leading figure in the South Korean democracy movement, long dedicated to promoting democratic reforms in the country.

description.zh-cn: 因金泳三被开除议员资格而引发的釜马民主抗争，加剧了朴正熙政权内部的矛盾，成为其被刺杀的导火索之一。
description.en: The Bu-Ma Democratic Protests, sparked by Kim Young-sam's expulsion from the National Assembly, exacerbated internal conflicts within the Park Chung-hee regime and became one of the triggers for his assassination.

description.zh-cn: 1987年6月的全国性民主运动迫使执政党候选人卢泰愚发表“六二九宣言”，接受总统直选制。
description.en: The nationwide democracy movement in June 1987 forced ruling party candidate Roh Tae-woo to issue the 'June 29 Declaration', accepting a direct presidential election system.

description.zh-cn: 金泳三执政后推行肃军运动，清除了军队内的秘密组织“一心会”，结束了军人干政的局面。
description.en: After taking office, Kim Young-sam launched a military purge, eliminating the secret organization 'Hanahoe' within the army and ending the era of military intervention in politics.

description.zh-cn: 金泳三执政期间，前总统全斗焕因策动军事政变、镇压民主运动及腐败等罪名被逮捕并判刑。
description.en: During Kim Young-sam's presidency, former president Chun Doo-hwan was arrested and sentenced for staging military coups, suppressing democratic movements, and corruption.

description.zh-cn: 1997年亚洲金融危机重创韩国经济，使得金泳三政府未能妥善应对，导致其支持率大幅下跌，在一片谴责声中卸任。
description.en: The 1997 Asian financial crisis severely damaged the South Korean economy. The Kim Young-sam administration's failure to handle it properly led to a sharp drop in his approval ratings, and he left office amidst widespread criticism.

description.zh-cn: 在第一次朝核危机期间，金泳三与美国总统比尔·克林顿协调，成功劝阻了美国对朝鲜宁边核设施的军事打击计划。
description.en: During the First North Korean nuclear crisis, Kim Young-sam coordinated with U.S. President Bill Clinton and successfully dissuaded the U.S. from its plan to conduct a military strike on North Korea's Yongbyon nuclear facilities.

description.zh-cn: 1997年12月，金泳三在征得下届总统金大中同意后，赦免了前总统全斗焕。
description.en: In December 1997, after obtaining the consent of president-elect Kim Dae-jung, Kim Young-sam pardoned former president Chun Doo-hwan.

description.zh-cn: 1997年12月，金泳三在征得下届总统金大中同意后，赦免了前总统卢泰愚。
description.en: In December 1997, after obtaining the consent of president-elect Kim Dae-jung, Kim Young-sam pardoned former president Roh Tae-woo.

description.zh-cn: 北京大兴国际机场的投用导致首都机场客群分流，形成了竞争关系。
description.en: The commissioning of Beijing Daxing International Airport led to a diversion of passengers from Capital Airport, creating a competitive relationship.

description.zh-cn: 受疫情打击，首都机场的旅客吞吐量大幅下滑。
description.en: Affected by the pandemic, the passenger throughput of Capital Airport declined sharply.

description.zh-cn: 于1950年报请中共中央，拟新建一座民航专用机场，即后来的首都机场。
description.en: In 1950, it proposed to the Central Committee of the CCP to build a new civil aviation airport, which later became Capital Airport.

description.zh-cn: 机场建设因朝鲜战争爆发而搁置。
description.en: The construction of the airport was postponed due to the outbreak of the Korean War.

description.zh-cn: 在苏联专家的指导下开始规划设计。
description.en: Planning and design began under the guidance of Soviet experts.

description.zh-cn: 为适应尼克松访华后日益增长的国际交流需求，首都机场提出了第二次扩建计划。
description.en: To meet the growing demand for international exchanges after Nixon's visit, the second expansion plan for Capital Airport was proposed.

description.zh-cn: 为2号航站楼的建设提供了超过300亿日元的长期贷款。
description.en: Provided a long-term loan of over 30 billion yen for the construction of Terminal 2.

description.zh-cn: 北京申奥成功是推动首都机场进行第三次大规模扩建（包括新建3号航站楼）的关键因素。
description.en: Beijing's successful bid for the Olympics was a key factor in promoting the third large-scale expansion of Capital Airport, including the construction of Terminal 3.

description.zh-cn: 先后批准了首都机场2号航站楼扩建工程的可行性研究报告（1992年）和3号航站楼建设方案（2003年）。
description.en: Successively approved the feasibility study report for the Terminal 2 expansion project (1992) and the construction plan for Terminal 3 (2003).

description.zh-cn: 曾长期在首都机场运营，后于2020年10月25日将全部航班转移至北京大兴国际机场，结束了在首都机场29年的运营历史。
description.en: Operated at Capital Airport for a long time, and later transferred all its flights to Beijing Daxing International Airport on October 25, 2020, ending its 29-year operational history at Capital Airport.

description.zh-cn: 北京首都国际机场是2022年北京冬奥会和冬残奥会的唯一官方入境口岸。
description.en: Beijing Capital International Airport was the sole official port of entry for the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics and Paralympics.

description.zh-cn: 温云松是温家宝的儿子。
description.en: Wen Yunsong is the son of Wen Jiabao.

description.zh-cn: 温云松是张培莉的儿子。
description.en: Wen Yunsong is the son of Zhang Peili.

description.zh-cn: 温云松是温如春的哥哥。
description.en: Wen Yunsong is the brother of Wen Ruchun.

description.zh-cn: 张培莉是温家宝的夫人。
description.en: Zhang Peili is the wife of Wen Jiabao.

description.zh-cn: 温家宝曾任中华人民共和国国务院总理。
description.en: Wen Jiabao served as the Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 凯洛管理学院是西北大学的商学院。
description.en: The Kellogg School of Management is the business school of Northwestern University.

description.zh-cn: 因温云松身份敏感为由，拒绝其求职申请。
description.en: Rejected his job application due to his sensitive background.

description.zh-cn: 电讯盈科与中国电信成立合资公司，中盈优创后并入该公司。
description.en: PCCW and China Telecom formed a joint venture, into which Unihub was later incorporated.

description.zh-cn: 温云松于2010年10月转任中国卫星通信集团副董事长，并于2012年2月15日升任董事长。
description.en: Wen Yunsong was appointed Vice Chairman of China Satcom in October 2010, and was promoted to Chairman on February 15, 2012.

description.zh-cn: 中国卫星通信集团是中国航天科技集团下属公司。
description.en: China Satcom is a subsidiary of China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 何晶是新加坡总理李显龙的夫人。
description.en: Ho Ching is the wife of Singapore's Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong.

description.zh-cn: 据博讯新闻称，媒体对温云松的负面报道与当时温家宝和江泽民派系（上海帮）的政治权力斗争有关。
description.en: According to Boxun News, negative media reports about Wen Yunsong were related to the political power struggle between Wen Jiabao and the Jiang Zemin faction (Shanghai clique) at the time.

description.zh-cn: 由于防火长城的审查机制，“温云松”成为网络搜索敏感词，导致其信息在百度、搜狗、新浪微博等平台被封锁或限制。
description.en: Due to the Great Firewall's censorship mechanism, 'Wen Yunsong' became a sensitive search term, leading to the blocking or restriction of his information on platforms like Baidu, Sogou, and Sina Weibo.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉出生于摄津国大坂堂岛。
description.en: Fukuzawa Yukichi was born in Dōjima, Ōsaka, Settsu Province.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉反对并激烈抨击封建社会的身份等级制度和专制压抑。
description.en: Fukuzawa Yukichi opposed and fiercely criticized the status system and authoritarian oppression of the feudal society.

description.zh-cn: 1855年，福泽谕吉前往绪方洪庵的适塾学习兰学，并于1857年成为塾长。
description.en: In 1855, Fukuzawa Yukichi went to Ogata Kōan's Tekijuku to study Rangaku, and became the head of the school in 1857.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉在绪方洪庵的适塾中学习兰学，是其学生。
description.en: Fukuzawa Yukichi studied Rangaku at Ogata Kōan's Tekijuku, being his student.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉于1858年在江户设立的兰学塾是庆应义塾的前身，他被认为是庆应义塾大学的创立者。
description.en: The Rangaku school established by Fukuzawa Yukichi in Edo in 1858 was the predecessor of Keio Gijuku, and he is considered the founder of Keio University.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉曾受雇于江户幕府，从事政府公文的翻译工作，并随幕府使节团出访海外。
description.en: Fukuzawa Yukichi was employed by the Edo Shogunate to translate government documents and accompanied its missions abroad.

description.zh-cn: 在1860年乘坐咸临丸前往美国期间，福泽谕吉与该船的指挥官胜海舟同行。
description.en: During the voyage to the United States aboard the Kanrin Maru in 1860, Fukuzawa Yukichi was accompanied by the ship's commander, Katsu Kaishū.

description.zh-cn: 大隈重信被描述为福泽谕吉的盟友。
description.en: Ōkuma Shigenobu was described as an ally of Fukuzawa Yukichi.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉通过其教育和著述活动，极大地影响和推动了明治维新运动，传播西方思想，倡导“文明开化”。
description.en: Through his educational and literary activities, Fukuzawa Yukichi greatly influenced and promoted the Meiji Restoration by disseminating Western ideas and advocating for 'Civilization and Enlightenment'.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉在其《脱亚论》中对清朝持蔑视态度，视其为“恶友”，主张与其绝交。
description.en: In his 'Datsu-A Ron', Fukuzawa Yukichi held a contemptuous attitude towards the Qing dynasty, regarding it as a 'bad friend' and advocating for breaking ties.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉在其《脱亚论》中对朝鲜王朝持蔑视态度，视其为“恶友”，主张与其绝交。
description.en: In his 'Datsu-A Ron', Fukuzawa Yukichi held a contemptuous attitude towards the Joseon dynasty, regarding it as a 'bad friend' and advocating for breaking ties.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉将中日甲午战争描述为一场“文野之战”，并支持日本对华开战。
description.en: Fukuzawa Yukichi described the First Sino-Japanese War as a 'war between civilization and barbarism' and supported Japan's decision to go to war with China.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉通过出资购买武器来资助朝鲜改革派发动的甲申政变。
description.en: Fukuzawa Yukichi supported the Gapsin Coup, initiated by Korean reformers, by funding the purchase of weapons.

description.zh-cn: 1880年，福泽谕吉担任兴亚会的顾问。
description.en: In 1880, Fukuzawa Yukichi served as an advisor to the Kōakai.

description.zh-cn: 绪方洪庵是兰学私塾“适塾”的创办人。
description.en: Ogata Kōan was the founder of the Rangaku private school, Tekijuku.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉在《劝学篇》中多次提及亚当斯密的自由市场经济论，其经济思想受到其影响。
description.en: Fukuzawa Yukichi repeatedly mentioned Adam Smith's free-market economic theory in 'An Encouragement of Learning', indicating his economic thought was influenced by it.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉1860年访问美国，这次经历让他受到文化震撼，并深刻认识到学习英语和西方制度的必要性。
description.en: Fukuzawa Yukichi's visit to the United States in 1860 caused him culture shock and made him profoundly aware of the necessity of learning English and Western systems.

description.zh-cn: 列夫·托洛茨基是共产国际的创始人之一。
description.en: Leon Trotsky was one of the founders of the Communist International.

description.zh-cn: 格里戈里·季诺维也夫是共产国际的创始人之一。
description.en: Grigory Zinoviev was one of the founders of the Communist International.

description.zh-cn: 卡尔·拉狄克是共产国际的创始人之一。
description.en: Karl Radek was one of the founders of the Communist International.

description.zh-cn: 尼古拉·布哈林是共产国际的创始人之一。
description.en: Nikolai Bukharin was one of the founders of the Communist International.

description.zh-cn: 俄国十月革命的成功，为第三国际的成立提供了政治基础和号召力。
description.en: The success of the October Revolution in Russia provided the political basis and appeal for the establishment of the Third International.

description.zh-cn: 共产国际由第二国际中的革命派分裂出来而成立，以区别于后者的改良主义路线。
description.en: The Communist International was formed by a split of the revolutionary wing from the Second International, distinguishing itself from the latter's reformist line.

description.zh-cn: 共产国际执行委员会主席团于1943年5月15日作出提议解散共产国际的决定，并于6月10日正式宣告解散。
description.en: The Presidium of the Executive Committee of the Communist International made the decision to propose the dissolution of the Comintern on May 15, 1943, and officially announced its dissolution on June 10.

description.zh-cn: 共产国际解散后，其相关人员和组织转入新成立的苏联共产党中央委员会国际部。
description.en: After the dissolution of the Comintern, its personnel and organizations were transferred to the newly established International Department of the Central Committee of the CPSU.

description.zh-cn: 为在反法西斯战争中拉拢英美等国，苏联主导解散了以反对资本主义国家为目的的共产国际。
description.en: In order to win over countries like the United Kingdom and the United States in the anti-fascist war, the Soviet Union led the dissolution of the Comintern, which was originally established to oppose capitalist countries.

description.zh-cn: 共产党和工人党情报局是共产国际的后继组织。
description.en: The Cominform was the successor organization to the Communist International.

description.zh-cn: 格里戈里·季诺维也夫是共产国际执行委员会的第一任主席。
description.en: Grigory Zinoviev was the first Chairman of the Executive Committee of the Communist International.

description.zh-cn: 尼古拉·布哈林于1926年至1929年间担任共产国际执行委员会主席。
description.en: Nikolai Bukharin served as Chairman of the Executive Committee of the Communist International from 1926 to 1929.

description.zh-cn: 格奥尔基·季米特洛夫于1935年至1943年解散前担任共产国际执行委员会主席。
description.en: Georgi Dimitrov served as Chairman of the Executive Committee of the Communist International from 1935 until its dissolution in 1943.

description.zh-cn: 克拉拉·蔡特金在1929年私下批评共产国际已从一个活的政治体变成一个只会复述苏联指令的僵死机构，但公开场合仍表示支持。
description.en: In 1929, Klara Zetkin privately criticized the Comintern as having transformed from a living political body into a dead machine that only repeated Soviet directives, although she continued to support it publicly.

description.zh-cn: 共产国际将纳粹德国等法西斯政权视为主要敌人，并号召建立反法西斯统一战线。
description.en: The Comintern regarded fascist regimes like Nazi Germany as its primary enemy and called for the establishment of an anti-fascist united front.

description.zh-cn: 解散共产国际是苏联为在第二次世界大战中拉拢英国作为盟友而采取的妥协举动。
description.en: The dissolution of the Comintern was a compromise made by the Soviet Union to win over the United Kingdom as an ally in World War II.

description.zh-cn: 共产国际第二次代表大会通过了加入共产国际的条件《二十一条》。
description.en: The Second World Congress of the Communist International adopted the "Twenty-one Conditions" for admission to the Comintern.

description.zh-cn: 共产国际第七次代表大会决定采取人民阵线策略，联合各国力量建立广泛的反法西斯统一战线。
description.en: The 7th World Congress of the Comintern decided to adopt the Popular Front strategy, uniting forces in various countries to build a broad anti-fascist united front.

description.zh-cn: 共产国际执行委员会是共产国际的执行机构。
description.en: The Executive Committee of the Communist International was the executive body of the Comintern.

description.zh-cn: 蔡元培曾两度担任北京大学校长，期间革新北大，开“学术”与“自由”之风，大量引进新人物，使北大成为新文化运动的中心，并于五四运动期间担任校长，发挥了重要作用。
description.en: Cai Yuanpei served as the President of Peking University twice, during which he reformed the university, fostering a spirit of 'academics' and 'freedom'. He brought in many new figures, making Peking University the center of the New Culture Movement, and served as president during the May Fourth Movement, playing a significant role.

description.zh-cn: 1927年，蔡元培在主持教育行政委员会期间，筹设并创办了中央研究院。
description.en: In 1927, while presiding over the Education Administrative Committee, Cai Yuanpei planned and founded the Academia Sinica.

description.zh-cn: 蔡元培担任中央研究院首任院长直至去世。
description.en: Cai Yuanpei served as the first President of Academia Sinica until his death.

description.zh-cn: 蔡元培在南京临时政府担任首任教育总长，奠定了民国教育的基本规模。
description.en: Cai Yuanpei served as the first Minister of Education in the Nanjing Provisional Government, laying the foundation for the educational system of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 蔡元培曾任国民政府监察院首任院长。
description.en: Cai Yuanpei served as the first President of the Control Yuan of the Nationalist Government.

description.zh-cn: 蔡元培倡议成立中华民国大学院作为全国最高学术教育行政机关，并担任首任院长。
description.en: Cai Yuanpei proposed the establishment of the Daxue Yuan as the nation's highest academic and educational administrative body and served as its first Chancellor.

description.zh-cn: 蔡元培与吴稚晖、张静江、李石曾等人提出发动“护党救国”运动，并主持中央监察委员会会议，通过了要求对共产党人进行紧急处置的决议，推动了随后的“清党”行动。
description.en: Cai Yuanpei, along with Wu Zhihui, Zhang Jingjiang, Li Shizeng, and others, proposed the 'Protect the Party, Save the Nation' movement and presided over the Central Supervisory Committee meeting that passed resolutions for emergency measures against Communists, thus promoting the subsequent 'Party purge'.

description.zh-cn: 在1927年，蔡元培积极主张并参与了针对中国共产党的“清党”行动。
description.en: In 1927, Cai Yuanpei actively advocated for and participated in the 'Party purge' targeting the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 蔡元培主持的国民党中央监察委员会会议审定了一份应予看管的共产党人名单，其中包括毛泽东。
description.en: A meeting of the KMT Central Supervisory Committee, presided over by Cai Yuanpei, approved a list of Communists to be placed under surveillance, which included Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 蔡元培主持的国民党中央监察委员会会议审定了一份应予看管的共产党人名单，其中包括周恩来。
description.en: A meeting of the KMT Central Supervisory Committee, presided over by Cai Yuanpei, approved a list of Communists to be placed under surveillance, which included Zhou Enlai.

description.zh-cn: 蔡元培主持的国民党中央监察委员会会议审定了一份应予看管的共产党人名单，其中包括陈独秀。
description.en: A meeting of the KMT Central Supervisory Committee, presided over by Cai Yuanpei, approved a list of Communists to be placed under surveillance, which included Chen Duxiu.

description.zh-cn: 蔡元培在莱比锡大学研究哲学、美学、心理学和民族学。
description.en: Cai Yuanpei studied philosophy, aesthetics, psychology, and ethnology at Leipzig University.

description.zh-cn: 与陶成章等人在上海发起建立光复会，并担任会长。
description.en: Co-founded the Guangfuhui in Shanghai with Tao ChengZhang and others, and served as its president.

description.zh-cn: 1905年加入同盟会，并被孙中山委任为上海分会负责人。
description.en: Joined the Tongmenghui in 1905 and was appointed by Sun Yat-sen as the head of its Shanghai branch.

description.zh-cn: 蔡元培与李石曾等人于1920年成立中法大学，蔡元培任校长。
description.en: Cai Yuanpei, along with Li Shizeng and others, founded the Sino-French University in 1920, with Cai serving as its president.

description.zh-cn: 与宋庆龄、鲁迅、杨杏佛等人共同组织中国民权保障同盟，并被选为副主席。
description.en: Co-founded the China League for Civil Rights with Soong Ching-ling, Lu Xun, and Yang Xingfo, and was elected as its vice-chairman.

description.zh-cn: 蔡元培因不满袁世凯的专制统治，于1912年7月辞去教育总长职务。
description.en: Cai Yuanpei resigned from his post as Minister of Education in July 1912 due to his dissatisfaction with Yuan Shikai's autocratic rule.

description.zh-cn: 在蒋桂战争期间，李济深应蔡元培等人之邀前往南京调停，结果遭到蒋介石扣留。
description.en: During the Chiang-Gui War, Li Jishen went to Nanjing to mediate at the invitation of Cai Yuanpei and others, but was detained by Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: 因蒋介石扣留应其邀请前来调停的李济深，蔡元培对此十分气愤，二人关系出现裂痕。
description.en: Cai Yuanpei was infuriated by Chiang Kai-shek's detention of Li Jishen, who had come to mediate at his invitation, causing a rift in their relationship.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东在蔡元培逝世后发出唁电，称其为“学界泰斗，人世楷模”，高度评价并巩固其历史地位。
description.en: After Cai Yuanpei's death, Mao Zedong sent a condolence telegram praising him as a 'titan of the academic world and a model for all,' highly evaluating and solidifying his historical status.

description.zh-cn: 作为中国共产党最高领导人，毛泽东主导了土地改革运动。他坚决反对“和平土改”，坚持以阶级斗争的激烈方式，通过组织农民与地主阶级进行面对面斗争的方式进行改革。
description.en: As the supreme leader of the Communist Party of China, Mao Zedong led the Land Reform Movement. He firmly opposed 'peaceful land reform,' insisting on carrying it out through intense class struggle by organizing peasants to engage in face-to-face struggle with the landlord class.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党作为执政党，在全国范围内发起并领导了土地改革运动。
description.en: As the ruling party, the Communist Party of China initiated and led the Land Reform Movement nationwide.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国建国后的土地改革运动是第二次国共内战期间中共在“解放区”所实行土地改革的延续，内战期间的经验为全国性运动奠定了基础。
description.en: The post-1949 Land Reform Movement was a continuation of the land reforms implemented by the CCP in 'liberated areas' during the Second Chinese Civil War; experiences from the war period laid the foundation for the nationwide movement.

description.zh-cn: 土地改革运动彻底消灭了中国自秦汉以来存在两千多年作为地方统治阶级的地主阶级，其土地及财产被没收。据各方估计，该过程导致100万至500万地主及相关人员非正常死亡。
description.en: The Land Reform Movement completely eliminated the landlord class, which had existed in China for over two thousand years as the local ruling class since the Qin and Han dynasties. Their land and property were confiscated. According to various estimates, the process resulted in 1 to 5 million unnatural deaths among landlords and related individuals.

description.zh-cn: 土地改革运动使约3亿无地或少地的农民无偿分得了约7亿亩土地及生产资料，暂时成为土地的主人。
description.en: The Land Reform Movement enabled about 300 million landless or land-poor peasants to receive approximately 700 million mu of land and means of production free of charge, temporarily making them landowners.

description.zh-cn: 家庭联产承包责任制的实施使农民重新获得了土地的使用权和经营权。
description.en: The implementation of the household-responsibility system allowed peasants to regain the right to use and manage land.

description.zh-cn: 《中国土地法大纲》于1947年10月10日经中共中央批准正式公布。
description.en: The 'Outline Land Law of China' was officially promulgated with the approval of the CPC Central Committee on October 10, 1947.

description.zh-cn: 1952年2月，毛泽东在中共中央书记处会议上当面批评方方在广东土改中犯了“土改右倾”的错误。
description.en: In February 1952, at a meeting of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee, Mao Zedong personally criticized Fang Fang for making 'right-deviationist' errors in the Guangdong land reform.

position.en: Head of Land Reform Work in Guangdong

description.zh-cn: 因不满广东土改进展缓慢，毛泽东于1951年11月将陶铸调往广东主管土改工作，以加强和加速运动，并推行更激进的政策。
description.en: Dissatisfied with the slow progress of land reform in Guangdong, Mao Zedong transferred Tao Zhu in November 1951 to take charge of the work there, aiming to strengthen and accelerate the movement and implement more radical policies.

position.en: Head of Land Reform Work in Guangdong

description.zh-cn: 因不满广东土改进展缓慢，毛泽东于1951年11月后将赵紫阳与陶铸一同调往广东参与领导土改工作，以推行更激进的政策。
description.en: Dissatisfied with the slow progress of land reform in Guangdong, Mao Zedong transferred Zhao Ziyang along with Tao Zhu after November 1951 to Guangdong to participate in supervising the land reform work and implement more radical policies.

description.zh-cn: 1948年1月，任弼时发表《土地改革中的几个问题》，纠正了当时土改运动中出现的“左”倾偏向。
description.en: In January 1948, Ren Bishi published 'Several Issues in Land Reform', correcting the 'leftist' deviations that had emerged in the land reform movement at the time.

description.zh-cn: 阎慧卿是阎锡山的堂妹。
description.en: Yan Huiqing was Yan Xishan's cousin.

description.zh-cn: 辛亥革命太原起义成功后，阎锡山被推举为山西都督。
description.en: After the success of the Taiyuan Uprising during the Xinhai Revolution, Yan Xishan was elected as the military governor of Shanxi.

description.zh-cn: 与吴禄贞商讨组织燕晋联军，共同反清。
description.en: Conspired with Wu Luzhen to organize the Yan-Jin Allied Army to fight against the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯曾派兵进攻山西，阻挠阎锡山回太原。
description.en: Yuan Shikai once sent troops to attack Shanxi and obstruct Yan Xishan's return to Taiyuan.

description.zh-cn: 孙中山于1912年9月视察山西，与阎锡山密谈，鼓励其保守山西革命基地。
description.en: Sun Yat-sen inspected Shanxi in September 1912, had a secret talk with Yan Xishan, and encouraged him to defend the revolutionary base in Shanxi.

description.zh-cn: 在中原大战中与冯玉祥结盟，共同反对蒋介石。
description.en: Allied with Feng Yuxiang during the Central Plains War to jointly oppose Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: 在中原大战中与李宗仁结盟，共同反对蒋介石。
description.en: Allied with Li Zongren during the Central Plains War to jointly oppose Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: 张学良通电支持蒋介石，并派兵入关，导致阎锡山在中原大战中失败。
description.en: Zhang Xueliang declared his support for Chiang Kai-shek and sent troops into the Shanhai Pass, leading to Yan Xishan's defeat in the Central Plains War.

description.zh-cn: 在中原大战战败后，阎锡山宣布下野并赴大连。随后，他被迫通电下野，其晋系军队也被改编。
description.en: After being defeated in the Central Plains War, Yan Xishan announced his retirement from politics and went to Dalian. Subsequently, he was forced to announce his retirement via telegram, and his Shanxi clique army was reorganized.

description.zh-cn: 阎锡山试图控制的山西新军公开叛变并倒向共产党，使其在与中共的权力斗争中受挫。
description.en: The Shanxi New Army, which Yan Xishan tried to control, openly mutinied and defected to the Communist Party, causing a setback in his power struggle with the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 阎锡山部在战役中被解放军歼灭3.5万人，遭受重创。
description.en: Yan Xishan's forces were annihilated by the PLA in the campaign, with 35,000 casualties, suffering a major blow.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次国共内战期间，阎锡山作为国民党将领与中国人民解放军作战。
description.en: During the second Chinese Civil War, Yan Xishan, as a KMT general, fought against the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军攻占太原，结束了阎锡山在山西长达38年的统治。
description.en: The People's Liberation Army captured Taiyuan, ending Yan Xishan's 38-year rule in Shanxi.

description.zh-cn: 在太原城破后自杀。
description.en: Committed suicide after the fall of Taiyuan.

description.zh-cn: 在太原城破后自杀。
description.en: Committed suicide after the fall of Taiyuan.

description.zh-cn: 阎锡山在重庆提议进行土地改革，遭到陈立夫的愤怒反对。
description.en: Yan Xishan proposed land reform in Chongqing, which was met with angry opposition from Chen Lifu.

description.zh-cn: 阎锡山接替何应钦出任行政院院长及国防部长。
description.en: Yan Xishan succeeded He Yingqin as Premier of the Executive Yuan and Minister of National Defense.

description.zh-cn: 阎锡山辞去行政院院长职务，由陈诚接任。
description.en: Yan Xishan resigned as Premier of the Executive Yuan, and was succeeded by Chen Cheng.

description.zh-cn: 约瑟夫·张伯伦是内维尔·张伯伦的父亲。
description.en: Joseph Chamberlain was Neville Chamberlain's father.

description.zh-cn: 奥斯汀·张伯伦是内维尔·张伯伦的异母长兄。
description.en: Austen Chamberlain was Neville Chamberlain's elder half-brother.

description.zh-cn: 在担任国家服务总监期间与首相劳合·乔治关系不佳并辞职，两人在政治生涯中始终互相排斥。
description.en: Had a poor relationship with Prime Minister Lloyd George while serving as Director of National Service and resigned; the two remained mutually antagonistic throughout their careers.

position.en: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom

description.zh-cn: 内维尔·张伯伦接替斯坦利·鲍德温成为英国首相。
description.en: Neville Chamberlain succeeded Stanley Baldwin as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 温斯顿·丘吉尔接替内维尔·张伯伦出任英国首相。
description.en: Winston Churchill succeeded Neville Chamberlain as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 内维尔·张伯伦接替斯坦利·鲍德温出任英国首相。
description.en: Neville Chamberlain succeeded Stanley Baldwin as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 内维尔·张伯伦以其对纳粹德国的绥靖外交政策而闻名。
description.en: Neville Chamberlain was known for his foreign policy of appeasement towards Nazi Germany.

description.zh-cn: 温斯顿·丘吉尔是绥靖政策的坚定反对者。
description.en: Winston Churchill was a staunch opponent of the policy of appeasement.

description.zh-cn: 内维尔·张伯伦是《慕尼黑协定》的签署者之一，该协定允许德国吞并捷克斯洛伐克的苏台德地区。
description.en: Neville Chamberlain was one of the signatories of the Munich Agreement, which allowed Germany to annex the Sudetenland from Czechoslovakia.

description.zh-cn: 《慕尼黑协定》允许纳粹德国吞并捷克斯洛伐克的苏台德地区。
description.en: The Munich Agreement permitted Nazi Germany to annex the Sudetenland from Czechoslovakia.

description.zh-cn: 德国入侵波兰后，英国于1939年9月3日对德宣战。
description.en: Following the German invasion of Poland, the United Kingdom declared war on Germany on September 3, 1939.

description.zh-cn: 盟军在挪威战役中的失败导致了议会对张伯伦政府的信任危机，并最终使其辞职。
description.en: The failure of the Allied forces in the Norwegian campaign led to a crisis of confidence in Chamberlain's government, ultimately causing his resignation.

description.zh-cn: 工党拒绝加入由内维尔·张伯伦领导的联合政府，这是导致他辞职的直接原因之一。
description.en: The Labour Party refused to join a national government led by Neville Chamberlain, which was one of the direct causes of his resignation.

description.zh-cn: 辞去首相后，内维尔·张伯伦在丘吉尔的战时内阁中担任枢密院议长。
description.en: After resigning as Prime Minister, Neville Chamberlain served as Lord President of the Council in Churchill's war cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 2016年8月前，北京卫戍区隶属于北京军区。
description.en: Before August 2016, the Beijing Garrison was subordinate to the Beijing Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 北京卫戍区接受中央军事委员会直接指挥。
description.en: The Beijing Garrison receives direct command from the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 田明建在北京市区中心地带制造了建国门枪战事件。
description.en: Tian Mingjian caused the Jianguomen shooting incident in the central area of Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 2016年7月，潘良时由北京卫戍区司令员调任陆军副司令员。
