description.en: Under his promotion, Ping An Insurance, the first commercial insurance institution founded by an enterprise in China, was established in Shekou, Shenzhen.

description.zh-cn: 于1900年在三洲田村（现深圳境内）一带发动了惠州起义（又称三洲田起义）。
description.en: In 1900, he launched the Huizhou Uprising (also known as the Sanzhoutian Uprising) in the area of Sanzhoutian Village (now within Shenzhen).

description.zh-cn: 孟凡利现任中共深圳市委书记。
description.en: Meng Fanli currently serves as the Secretary of the Shenzhen Municipal Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 覃伟中现任深圳市市长。
description.en: Qin Weizhong currently serves as the Mayor of Shenzhen.

description.zh-cn: 戴运龙现任深圳市人大常委会主任。
description.en: Dai Yunlong currently serves as the Director of the Standing Committee of the Shenzhen Municipal People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 林洁现任深圳市政协主席。
description.en: Lin Jie currently serves as the Chairwoman of the Shenzhen Municipal Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 朱温于877年加入黄巢军，成为其麾下重要将领，后于882年叛离。
description.en: Zhu Wen joined Huang Chao's army in 877 and became a key general under his command, before defecting in 882.

description.zh-cn: 朱温于882年率部投降唐朝，被授以官职，成为唐末的藩镇节度使。
description.en: In 882, Zhu Wen surrendered to the Tang dynasty with his troops and was appointed as an official, becoming a provincial military governor (jiedushi) in the late Tang period.

description.zh-cn: 自884年上源驿之变后，朱温与李克用成为终身宿敌，双方长期对峙和征战。
description.en: Following the Incident at Shangyuan Station in 884, Zhu Wen and Li Keyong became lifelong arch-rivals, engaging in a long-term standoff and warfare.

description.zh-cn: 为对抗宦官势力，宰相崔胤召朱温率军进入京城。
description.en: To counter the power of the eunuchs, Chancellor Cui Yin summoned Zhu Wen to lead his army into the capital.

description.zh-cn: 朱温在掌控朝政后，杀害了曾召他入京的宰相崔胤。
description.en: After seizing control of the court, Zhu Wen killed Chancellor Cui Yin, who had once summoned him to the capital.

description.zh-cn: 朱温在弑杀唐昭宗后，拥立其第九子李柷为帝，是为唐哀帝，作为傀儡。
description.en: After assassinating Emperor Zhaozong, Zhu Wen installed his ninth son, Li Zhu, as Emperor Ai of Tang, serving as a puppet ruler.

description.zh-cn: 朱友珪因担心父亲朱温另立养子朱友文为储君，发动政变，亲手弑父。
description.en: Fearing that his father Zhu Wen would appoint the adopted son Zhu Youwen as the crown prince instead, Zhu Yougui launched a coup and personally committed patricide.

description.zh-cn: 朱友文是朱温的养子，深受信赖和宠爱。
description.en: Zhu Youwen was the adopted son of Zhu Wen, deeply trusted and favored by him.

description.zh-cn: 朱友珪在弑父后，矫诏将竞争对手朱友文一并杀害。
description.en: After murdering his father, Zhu Yougui forged an edict and had his rival Zhu Youwen killed as well.

description.zh-cn: 1936年，台湾总督府在新竹市成立天然瓦斯研究所，后发展为联合工业研究所。
description.en: In 1936, the Office of the Governor-General of Taiwan established the Natural Gas Research Institute in Hsinchu City, which later evolved into the Union Industrial Research Laboratories.

description.zh-cn: 1998年国华航空一架自新竹起飞的班机坠毁，该事故导致新竹机场于同年9月起停止民航服务。
description.en: In 1998, a Formosa Airlines flight crashed after taking off from Hsinchu, which led to the suspension of civilian flight services at Hsinchu Airport starting from September of the same year.

description.zh-cn: 双方因生活理念出现分歧，于2012年发表离婚声明。
description.en: The couple announced their divorce in 2012 due to differing life philosophies.

description.zh-cn: 黎明在该比赛中获得铜奖，从而正式进入演艺界。
description.en: Leon Lai won the second runner-up in this competition, which formally launched his career in the entertainment industry.

description.zh-cn: 曾三度向黎明授勋（2003年荣誉勋章、2009年铜紫荆星章、2019年银紫荆星章），以表彰其对慈善公益的贡献。
description.en: Awarded honors to Leon Lai three times (Medal of Honour in 2003, Bronze Bauhinia Star in 2009, Silver Bauhinia Star in 2019) in recognition of his contributions to charity and public service.

description.zh-cn: 在第五届新秀歌唱大赛中担任评判，因认为黎明可塑性大而给予高分。
description.en: As a judge in the 5th New Talent Singing Awards, she gave Leon Lai a high score, believing he had great potential.

description.zh-cn: 将黎明介绍给歌唱老师戴思聪。
description.en: Introduced Leon Lai to singing coach Dai Sicong.

description.zh-cn: 向戴思聪学习乐理知识及歌唱发声技巧。
description.en: Learned music theory and vocal techniques from Dai Sicong.

description.zh-cn: 为黎明向宝丽金唱片公司争取到试音机会，并最终促成签约。
description.en: Secured an audition for Leon Lai with PolyGram Records, which ultimately led to a contract.

description.zh-cn: 作为宝丽金监制，认可黎明的潜质并与他签订了歌手合约。
description.en: As a producer for PolyGram, he recognized Leon Lai's potential and signed a singer contract with him.

description.zh-cn: 在黎明因“走音事件”受批评时，公开分析并肯定其为可造之才。
description.en: When Leon Lai was criticized for an 'off-key incident', he publicly analyzed the situation and affirmed Lai's potential.

description.zh-cn: 曾当面赞赏黎明，并在1993年劲歌金曲颁奖典礼上为他颁发“最受欢迎男歌星”奖。
description.en: Publicly praised Leon Lai and presented him with the 'Most Popular Male Singer' award at the 1993 Jade Solid Gold Best Ten Music Awards Presentation.

description.zh-cn: 到北京中国音乐学院跟金铁霖学习乐理和发声技巧。
description.en: Went to the China Conservatory of Music in Beijing to study music theory and vocal techniques with Jin Tielin.

description.zh-cn: 将音乐人雷颂德介绍给黎明的经理人陈善之，促成了黎明与雷颂德的长期音乐合作。
description.en: Introduced musician Mark Lui to Leon Lai's manager Joe Chan, leading to a long-term musical collaboration between Lai and Lui.

description.zh-cn: 长期音乐合作伙伴，共同创作了大量电子音乐舞曲，被视为乐坛中的最佳拍档之一。
description.en: Long-term musical partners who co-created numerous electronic dance tracks and are considered one of the best duos in the music industry.

description.zh-cn: 与林建岳合作成立唱片公司A Music。
description.en: Collaborated with Peter Lam to establish the record label Amusic.

description.zh-cn: 邀请黎明主演电影《甜蜜蜜》，该片成为其演艺生涯的代表作之一。
description.en: Invited Leon Lai to star in the film 'Comrades: Almost a Love Story', which became one of the signature works of his acting career.

description.zh-cn: 黎明在韩国的广泛知名度，使得时任韩国总统卢武铉在2003年于清华大学的演讲中提及他，以此作为文化交流的例子。
description.en: Leon Lai's widespread fame in South Korea led then-President Roh Moo-hyun to mention him in a 2003 speech at Tsinghua University as an example of cultural exchange.

description.zh-cn: 李南央遵从父亲李锐的意愿，将李锐日记捐赠给美国斯坦福大学胡佛研究所。
description.en: Following her father Li Rui's wishes, Li Nanyang donated his diaries to the Hoover Institution at Stanford University in the United States.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会总书记是设立于中央书记处的领导职务，负责处理其运作。
description.en: The General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee was a leading position established within the Central Secretariat, responsible for managing its operations.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央秘书长是1956年设立的中央委员会总书记（作为中央书记处负责人）职务的前身。
description.en: The Secretary-General of the CPC Central Committee was the predecessor to the position of General Secretary of the Central Committee (as head of the Central Secretariat) established in 1956.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命爆发后，总书记职务被撤销。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Cultural Revolution, the position of General Secretary was abolished.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平担任中央书记处总书记，负责处理中央书记处运作。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping served as the General Secretary of the Central Secretariat, responsible for its operations.

description.zh-cn: 胡耀邦在中央书记处重新设立后担任总书记。
description.en: Hu Yaobang served as General Secretary after the Central Secretariat was re-established.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平在担任中央书记处总书记期间，兼任中共中央政治局常委。
description.en: While serving as General Secretary of the Central Secretariat, Deng Xiaoping concurrently held the position of a member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Politburo.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平在担任中央书记处总书记期间，兼任国务院副总理。他先后担任了第一届至第五届国务院副总理，期间曾经历政治起伏，被“打倒”后又复职。
description.en: While serving as General Secretary of the Central Secretariat, Deng Xiaoping concurrently held the position of Vice Premier of the State Council. He served as Vice Premier from the 1st to the 5th State Councils, experiencing political ups and downs, being 'purged' and then reinstated during his tenure.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平在担任中央书记处总书记期间，兼任国防委员会副主席。
description.en: While serving as General Secretary of the Central Secretariat, Deng Xiaoping concurrently held the position of Vice Chairman of the National Defense Commission.

description.zh-cn: 胡耀邦在担任中央书记处总书记期间，兼任中共中央主席。
description.en: While serving as General Secretary of the Central Secretariat, Hu Yaobang concurrently held the position of Chairman of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 胡耀邦在担任中央书记处总书记期间，兼任中共中央政治局常委。
description.en: While serving as General Secretary of the Central Secretariat, Hu Yaobang concurrently held the position of a member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Politburo.

description.zh-cn: 胡耀邦在担任中央书记处总书记期间，兼任中央纪委第三书记。
description.en: While serving as General Secretary of the Central Secretariat, Hu Yaobang concurrently held the position of Third Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection.

description.zh-cn: 胡启恒是胡启立的妹妹。
description.en: Hu Qiheng is Hu Qili's younger sister.

description.zh-cn: 1946年至1951年在北京大学物理系、机械系学习。
description.en: Studied in the Department of Physics and the Department of Mechanics at Peking University from 1946 to 1951.

description.zh-cn: 在六四事件中，胡启立因同情学生运动，支持时任中共中央总书记赵紫阳，而被免去中共中央政治局常委等党内领导职务。
description.en: During the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests, Hu Qili was dismissed from his party leadership positions, including his post on the Politburo Standing Committee, for sympathizing with the student movement and supporting the then-General Secretary Zhao Ziyang.

description.zh-cn: 在六四事件中，同情学生运动并支持赵紫阳。
description.en: During the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests, he sympathized with the student movement and supported Zhao Ziyang.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命开始后，胡启立被下放到“五七干校”劳动，直到1972年才被恢复工作。
description.en: After the Cultural Revolution began, Hu Qili was sent to a 'May Seventh Cadre School' for labor and was not reinstated until 1972.

description.zh-cn: 粉碎四人帮后，胡启立的政治生涯得以恢复和发展，历任清华党委副书记兼副校长，团中央书记处书记等职务。
description.en: After the smashing of the Gang of Four, Hu Qili's political career was restored and developed, and he subsequently served as Deputy Party Secretary and Vice President of Tsinghua University, and Secretary of the Secretariat of the CYL Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 在担任电子工业部部长期间，倡导电信业改革，最终促使邮政和电信分离，相关职能并入1998年成立的信息产业部。
description.en: During his tenure as Minister of Electronics Industry, he advocated for telecommunications reform, which eventually led to the separation of post and telecommunications, with related functions merged into the Ministry of Information Industry established in 1998.

description.zh-cn: 1955年8月，胡启立在当选中华全国学生联合会主席后，受到毛泽东的接见。
description.en: In August 1955, after being elected chairman of the All-China Students' Federation, Hu Qili was received by Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 隋朝的建立取代了北周。
description.en: The establishment of the Sui dynasty replaced the Northern Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 周静帝禅位于杨坚，使其得以建立隋朝。
description.en: Emperor Jing of Northern Zhou abdicated the throne to Yang Jian, enabling him to establish the Sui dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 隋朝发动了灭亡陈朝的统一战争。
description.en: The Sui dynasty launched a war of unification to conquer the Chen dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 隋灭陈之战导致了陈朝的灭亡，隋朝统一中国。
description.en: The war led to the fall of the Chen dynasty and the unification of China by the Sui dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 杨素与杨广合谋，帮助杨广揭露杨勇的过失，使其成功夺得太子之位。
description.en: Yang Su conspired with Yang Guang, helping him expose Yang Yong's faults and successfully secure the position of crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 隋炀帝大规模兴建并连接运河，形成了贯通南北的隋唐大运河。
description.en: Emperor Yang of Sui undertook the large-scale construction and connection of canals, forming the Sui-Tang Grand Canal that ran from north to south.

description.zh-cn: 隋炀帝三次发动对高句丽的大规模征讨。
description.en: Emperor Yang of Sui launched three large-scale military expeditions against Goguryeo.

description.zh-cn: 对高句丽的战争造成了巨大的人力物力消耗，加重了人民负担，是引发隋末民变的主要原因之一。
description.en: The wars against Goguryeo caused immense consumption of human and material resources, increasing the burden on the people, and was one of the main causes of the rebellions at the end of the Sui dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝的建立标志着以长安为中心的隋朝正统的终结。
description.en: The establishment of the Tang dynasty marked the end of the legitimate Sui dynasty centered in Chang'an.

description.zh-cn: 隋恭帝杨侑禅位于李渊，使其合法地建立唐朝。
description.en: Emperor Gong Yang You abdicated the throne to Li Yuan, allowing him to legitimately establish the Tang dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 王世充废黜在洛阳的隋恭帝杨侗，并于不久后将其杀害。
description.en: Wang Shichong deposed Emperor Gong Yang Tong in Luoyang and had him killed shortly thereafter.

description.zh-cn: 隋朝正式确立了三省六部制，成为后世中央行政体系的范本。
description.en: The Sui dynasty formally established the Three Departments and Six Ministries system, which became a model for the central administrative system of later dynasties.

description.zh-cn: 隋朝创立了科举制度，通过考试选拔人才，打破了世族垄断。
description.en: The Sui dynasty created the imperial examination system, selecting talent through tests and breaking the aristocratic monopoly.

description.zh-cn: 李春设计并修建了赵州桥，这是中国建筑史上的重大成就。
description.en: Li Chun designed and built the Zhaozhou Bridge, a major achievement in the history of Chinese architecture.

description.zh-cn: 隋朝灭亡后，东突厥处罗可汗立隋炀帝之孙杨政道为隋王，作为延续隋朝的象征。
description.en: After the fall of the Sui dynasty, Chuluo Khan of the Eastern Turks installed Yang Zhengdao, a grandson of Emperor Yang of Sui, as the King of Sui, as a symbol of the continuation of the dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 大陆委员会是行政院下属的中央二级行政机关。
description.en: The Mainland Affairs Council is a second-level central administrative agency under the Executive Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 2016年民进党再度执政后，两岸关系趋于对峙，双方官方近乎无直接往来。
description.en: After the Democratic Progressive Party came to power again in 2016, cross-strait relations became confrontational, with almost no direct official contact between the two sides.

description.zh-cn: 海峡交流基金会是受大陆委员会委托处理两岸事务的半官方机构。
description.en: The Straits Exchange Foundation is a semi-official organization commissioned by the Mainland Affairs Council to handle cross-strait affairs.

description.zh-cn: 海峡交流基金会与海峡两岸关系协会是两岸分别设立的对口协商机构。
description.en: The Straits Exchange Foundation and the Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits are the counterpart negotiating bodies established by Taiwan and mainland China, respectively.

description.zh-cn: 行政院于1988年8月以任务编组方式成立了行政院大陆工作会报，作为大陆委员会的前身。
description.en: In August 1988, the Executive Yuan established the Mainland Affairs Task Force, the predecessor to the Mainland Affairs Council.

description.zh-cn: 光复大陆设计研究委员会于1991年裁撤后，其业务移交给了大陆委员会等机构。
description.en: After the Commission for the Recovery of Mainland China was dissolved in 1991, its duties were transferred to the Mainland Affairs Council and other agencies.

description.zh-cn: 蒙藏委员会于2017年裁撤后，其情势搜整与研判业务由大陆委员会承接。
description.en: After the Mongolian and Tibetan Affairs Commission was dissolved in 2017, its situation analysis and research duties were taken over by the Mainland Affairs Council.

position.en: Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council

description.zh-cn: 在赖清德担任总统期间，邱垂正被任命为大陆委员会主任委员。
description.en: During Lai Ching-te's presidency, Chiu Chui-cheng was appointed as the Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council.

description.zh-cn: 青蒿素及其衍生物是现今所有药物中起效最快的抗恶性疟原虫疟疾药。
description.en: Artemisinin and its derivatives are the fastest-acting antimalarial drugs against Plasmodium falciparum malaria available today.

description.zh-cn: 523项目是中国为寻找抗疟新药而设立的国家项目，直接促成了青蒿素的发现和研发。
description.en: Project 523 was a Chinese national project established to find new antimalarial drugs, which directly led to the discovery and development of artemisinin.

description.zh-cn: 屠呦呦作为中药研究所的代表参与523项目，并领导一个研究小组进行中草药筛选工作。
description.en: Tu Youyou participated in Project 523 as a representative of the Institute of Chinese Materia Medica and led a research group for screening traditional Chinese herbs.

description.zh-cn: 越南战争期间，北越军队因疟疾严重向中国求援，这成为启动523项目的直接动因。
description.en: During the Vietnam War, North Vietnamese forces suffered heavily from malaria and appealed to China for help, which became the direct impetus for launching Project 523.

description.zh-cn: 越南民主共和国（北越）向中国求援，请求帮助解决军队中的疟疾问题，促使中国启动了523项目。
description.en: The Democratic Republic of Vietnam (North Vietnam) requested aid from China to address the malaria problem among its troops, prompting China to launch Project 523.

description.zh-cn: 时任中国领导人毛泽东亲自下令，要求科学家帮助研发抗疟药物，从而启动了523项目。
description.en: Then Chinese leader Mao Zedong personally ordered scientists to help develop antimalarial drugs, thus initiating Project 523.

description.zh-cn: 屠呦呦从《肘后备急方》中“青蒿一握，以水二升渍，绞取汁，尽服之”的记载受到启发，改用低温提取法，从而成功提取出青蒿素的活性成分。
description.en: Inspired by the description in 'The Handbook of Prescriptions for Emergencies' to 'take a handful of sweet wormwood, soak it in two sheng of water, wring out the juice, and drink it all', Tu Youyou switched to a low-temperature extraction method, which successfully preserved the active components of artemisinin.

description.zh-cn: 葛洪是东晋时期的医学家，他编撰了《肘后备急方》。
description.en: Ge Hong was a medical scholar of the Eastern Jin dynasty who compiled 'The Handbook of Prescriptions for Emergencies'.

description.zh-cn: 2011年，屠呦呦因发现青蒿素而获得拉斯克临床医学研究奖。
description.en: In 2011, Tu Youyou received the Lasker-DeBakey Clinical Medical Research Award for the discovery of artemisinin.

description.zh-cn: 世界卫生组织呼吁停止供应和使用单一青蒿素药物治疗疟疾，以防止疟原虫产生耐药性，并推广青蒿素联合疗法。
description.en: The WHO called for a halt to the provision and use of single-drug artemisinin malaria pills to prevent the development of drug resistance in parasites, promoting artemisinin-based combination therapies instead.

description.zh-cn: 该研究所协助确定了青蒿素的化学结构，为后续研究和合成奠定了基础。
description.en: This institute assisted in determining the chemical structure of artemisinin, laying the foundation for subsequent research and synthesis.

description.zh-cn: 双氢青蒿素是通过还原青蒿素内酯的羰基制得的衍生物，是合成其他衍生物的重要中间体。
description.en: Dihydroartemisinin is a derivative produced by reducing the carbonyl group of the lactone in artemisinin, and it serves as a key intermediate for synthesizing other derivatives.

description.zh-cn: 罗氏公司的研究员G. Schmid和W. Hofheinz于1982年首次完成了青蒿素的全合成。
description.en: Researchers G. Schmid and W. Hofheinz of Roche completed the first total synthesis of artemisinin in 1982.

description.zh-cn: 周维善及其团队在中国科学院上海有机化学研究所完成了青蒿素的全合成。
description.en: Zhou Weishan and his team at the Shanghai Institute of Organic Chemistry completed a total synthesis of artemisinin.

description.zh-cn: 于12月4日凌晨召开会议，190名在场议员全票通过决议，宣布总统颁布之戒严无效。
description.en: Convened a session in the early hours of December 4 and, with a unanimous vote of 190 members present, passed a resolution declaring the president's martial law decree invalid.

description.zh-cn: 宣布戒严事件直接引发了一系列政治危机，包括大规模抗议和总统弹劾。
description.en: The declaration of martial law directly triggered a series of political crises, including mass protests and the impeachment of the president.

description.zh-cn: 戒严事件是韩国国会发起弹劾尹锡悦的直接原因。
description.en: The martial law incident was the direct cause for the National Assembly to initiate the impeachment of Yoon Suk Yeol.

description.zh-cn: 宣布戒严被外界普遍认为是尹锡悦为巩固权力、压制反对派而发动的一场未遂的自我政变。
description.en: The declaration of martial law was widely seen as an attempted self-coup by Yoon Suk Yeol to consolidate power and suppress opposition.

description.zh-cn: 据消息人士透露，国防部长金龙显建议总统尹锡悦实施戒严。
description.en: According to sources, Minister of National Defense Kim Yong-hyun advised President Yoon Suk Yeol to implement martial law.

description.zh-cn: 戒严部队被部署至国会议事堂，阻止国会议员进入，并一度进入大楼试图逮捕议员。
description.en: Martial law troops were deployed to the National Assembly Building, preventing lawmakers from entering and at one point entering the building to attempt arrests.

description.zh-cn: 在戒严令宣布后，约300名士兵被部署到中央选举管理委员会总部等地，并没收了当值人员的手机。
description.en: After the martial law declaration, about 300 soldiers were deployed to the headquarters of the National Election Commission and other locations, confiscating the mobile phones of staff on duty.

description.zh-cn: 因在戒严事件中的核心角色，金龙显被在野党发起弹劾并随后自行辞去国防部长职务。
description.en: Due to his central role in the martial law incident, Kim Yong-hyun was impeached by the opposition and subsequently resigned from his position as Minister of National Defense.

description.zh-cn: 作为执政党党代表，公开表示“总统的戒严宣言是错误的，我们将和人民一起阻止它”。
description.en: As the leader of the ruling party, publicly stated that "The president's declaration of martial law is wrong, and we will stop it together with the people."

description.zh-cn: 作为最大在野党领袖，称戒严令违宪、无效、非法，并呼吁民众前往国会进行抵抗。
description.en: As the leader of the largest opposition party, he called the martial law decree unconstitutional, invalid, and illegal, urging citizens to go to the National Assembly to resist.

description.zh-cn: 作为国会议长，领导国会采取行动，最终通过决议废除了戒严令。
description.en: As the Speaker of the National Assembly, he led the parliament to take action, ultimately passing a resolution to nullify the martial law decree.

description.zh-cn: 在宣布戒严后，指示国军防谍司令部以“反国家势力”为由将其列入逮捕名单。
description.en: After declaring martial law, instructed the Defense Counterintelligence Command to add him to an arrest list under the pretext of being an "anti-state force."

description.zh-cn: 在宣布戒严后，指示国军防谍司令部以“反国家势力”为由将其列入逮捕名单。
description.en: After declaring martial law, instructed the Defense Counterintelligence Command to add him to an arrest list under the pretext of being an "anti-state force."

description.zh-cn: 在宣布戒严后，指示国军防谍司令部以“反国家势力”为由将其列入逮捕名单。
description.en: After declaring martial law, instructed the Defense Counterintelligence Command to add him to an arrest list under the pretext of being an "anti-state force."

description.zh-cn: 在2024年3月底与尹锡悦的晚宴上，明确反对其“于近期颁布戒严令”的计划。
description.en: During a dinner with Yoon Suk Yeol in late March 2024, he explicitly opposed Yoon's plan to "declare martial law in the near future."

description.zh-cn: 在2024年3月明确反对尹锡悦的戒严计划；在戒严当晚，拒绝执行逮捕名单，并搁置了尹锡悦撤换其副手洪壮源的命令。
description.en: Explicitly opposed Yoon Suk Yeol's martial law plan in March 2024; on the night of the martial law, he refused to execute the arrest list and shelved Yoon's order to dismiss his deputy, Hong Jang-won.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次拘捕行动中正式逮捕尹锡悦。
description.en: Officially arrested Yoon Suk Yeol in a second arrest operation.

description.zh-cn: 被指策划了无人机事件以激化南北紧张局势，为宣布戒严制造借口。
description.en: Allegedly orchestrated the drone incident to escalate inter-Korean tensions and create a pretext for declaring martial law.

description.zh-cn: 全斗焕发动的5·17政变是韩国在2024年之前最后一次宣布戒严，成为此次事件的重要历史参照和对比。
description.en: The May 17 coup led by Chun Doo-hwan was the last time martial law was declared in South Korea before 2024, serving as a significant historical precedent and point of comparison for the event.

description.zh-cn: 作为时任国军保安司令官，发动5·17政变，扩大戒严并建立军事独裁统治。
description.en: As the then-commander of the Defense Security Command, he led the May 17 coup, expanded martial law, and established a military dictatorship.

description.zh-cn: 在宣布戒严后，任命时任陆军参谋总长朴安洙为戒严司令官。
description.en: After declaring martial law, appointed the then-Army Chief of Staff Park An-su as the Martial Law Commander.

description.zh-cn: 薄瓜瓜是谷开来的儿子。
description.en: Bo Guagua is the son of Gu Kailai.

description.zh-cn: 谷开来是谷景生的女儿。
description.en: Gu Kailai is the daughter of Gu Jingsheng.

description.zh-cn: 谷开来是范承秀的女儿。
description.en: Gu Kailai is the daughter of Fan Chengxiu.

degree.zh-cn: 法律系学士、国际政治学硕士
degree.en: Bachelor of Laws, Master of International Politics

description.zh-cn: 1978年考取北京大学法律系，后继续攻读该校国际政治学硕士学位。
description.en: She was admitted to the Law Department of Peking University in 1978 and later pursued a master's degree in International Politics at the same university.

description.zh-cn: 一审以故意杀人罪判处谷开来死刑，缓期二年执行。
description.en: In the first instance, sentenced Gu Kailai to death with a two-year reprieve for intentional homicide.

description.zh-cn: 谷开来出生于山西省临猗县。
description.en: Gu Kailai was born in Linyi County, Shanxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 聘请谷开来担任其代理律师，起诉作家赵瑜。
description.en: Hired Gu Kailai as his legal representative to sue author Zhao Yu.

description.zh-cn: 曾受聘担任马俊仁的代理律师，起诉《马家军调查》的作者赵瑜。
description.en: Was hired as the legal representative for Ma Junren and sued Zhao Yu, the author of 'An Investigation into Ma's Army'.

description.zh-cn: 据其丈夫薄熙来称，谷开来以其法律知识在“打黑”行动中给予了很大帮助。
description.en: According to her husband Bo Xilai, Gu Kailai provided significant help to the 'Strike Black' campaign with her legal knowledge.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽民是毛泽东的弟弟。
description.en: Mao Zemin is Mao Zedong's younger brother.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽民是毛泽覃的哥哥。
description.en: Mao Zemin is Mao Zetan's elder brother.

description.zh-cn: 1922年冬，毛泽民加入中国共产党。
description.en: In the winter of 1922, Mao Zemin joined the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 1931年11月，毛泽民被任命为国家银行行长，负责筹建该银行。
description.en: In November 1931, Mao Zemin was appointed as the Governor of the State Bank and was responsible for its establishment.

description.zh-cn: 在长征期间，毛泽民任十五大队队长，负责整个中央红军的筹粮、筹款和后勤供给工作。
description.en: During the Long March, Mao Zemin served as the captain of the 15th Brigade, responsible for fundraising, grain collection, and logistical supplies for the entire Central Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 盛世才扣押了陈潭秋，并最终于1943年9月27日下令将其秘密处决。
description.en: Sheng Shicai detained Chen Tanqiu and ultimately ordered his secret execution on September 27, 1943.

description.zh-cn: 盛世才扣押了林基路，并最终于1943年9月27日下令将其秘密处决。
description.en: Sheng Shicai detained Lin Jilu and ultimately ordered his secret execution on September 27, 1943.

description.zh-cn: 1943年9月，蒋介石批示同意对毛泽民处以极刑。
description.en: In September 1943, Chiang Kai-shek approved the death sentence for Mao Zemin.

description.zh-cn: 1942年，盛世才投靠蒋介石，转而采取反苏反共政策，并扣押、杀害了在新疆工作的中共党员。
description.en: In 1942, Sheng Shicai defected to Chiang Kai-shek, adopted an anti-Soviet and anti-communist policy, and detained and killed CCP members working in Xinjiang.

description.zh-cn: 多次向国民党当局交涉，要求释放被盛世才扣押的毛泽民等人。
description.en: Repeatedly negotiated with the Kuomintang authorities, demanding the release of Mao Zemin and others detained by Sheng Shicai.

description.zh-cn: 1946年，张治中出任新疆省主席后，释放了被盛世才长期关押的129名共产党员及家属。
description.en: In 1946, after becoming the Chairman of Xinjiang Province, Zhang Zhizhong released 129 CCP members and their families who had been imprisoned by Sheng Shicai for a long time.

description.zh-cn: 在新疆被捕后叛变。
description.en: Defected after being arrested in Xinjiang.

description.zh-cn: 其叛变行为导致中统审讯人员知晓了陈潭秋的真实身份，加剧了对陈的迫害。
description.en: His defection led to the Central Bureau of Investigation and Statistics interrogators learning Chen Tanqiu's true identity, intensifying his persecution.

description.zh-cn: 时任中华民国行政院长李焕宣布将在东台湾成立第一座综合型国立大学，即后来的国立东华大学。
description.en: Lee Huan, then Premier of the Republic of China, announced the establishment of the first comprehensive national university in Eastern Taiwan, which later became National Dong Hwa University.

description.zh-cn: 时任中华民国教育部长毛高文负责国立东华大学的设校案。
description.en: Mao Kao-wen, then Minister of Education of the Republic of China, was responsible for the project to establish National Dong Hwa University.

description.zh-cn: 极力延揽时任美国加利福尼亚州立大学洛杉矶分校副校长牟宗灿担任国立东华大学的创校校长。
description.en: Actively recruited Mou Tsung-tsan, then Vice President of California State University, Los Angeles, to serve as the founding president of National Dong Hwa University.

description.zh-cn: 牟宗灿辞去美国教职返国创办国立东华大学，并担任首任校长。
description.en: Mou Tsung-tsan resigned from his teaching position in the United States to return to Taiwan and found National Dong Hwa University, serving as its first president.

description.zh-cn: 杨牧是参与国立东华大学创建过程的北美华裔教授之一。
description.en: Yang Mu was one of the North American Chinese professors who participated in the founding process of National Dong Hwa University.

description.zh-cn: 其设计的蓝图在国立东华大学主校区的国际设计竞图中入选，深刻影响了校园的建筑风格与规划。
description.en: His design blueprint was selected in the international design competition for the main campus of National Dong Hwa University, profoundly influencing the campus's architectural style and planning.

description.zh-cn: 与国立海洋生物博物馆共同创立海洋科学学院。
description.en: Co-founded the College of Marine Sciences with the National Museum of Marine Biology and Aquarium.

description.zh-cn: 将原环境学院与海洋科学学院整合，成立环境暨海洋学院。
description.en: Established the College of Environmental and Ocean Sciences by merging the former College of Environmental Studies and College of Marine Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 原环境学院于2022年被整合进新成立的环境暨海洋学院。
description.en: The former College of Environmental Studies was merged into the newly established College of Environmental and Ocean Sciences in 2022.

description.zh-cn: 时任国立东华大学校长吴茂昆发布公开信，支持学生参与太阳花学运，成为全台湾大学校长中的先例。
description.en: Wu Maw-kuen, then president of National Dong Hwa University, issued an open letter supporting students' participation in the Sunflower Student Movement, setting a precedent among university presidents in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 地震导致国立东华大学理工学院发生火灾，并对图书馆、宿舍等设施造成严重损坏，财物损失近20亿新台币。
description.en: The earthquake caused a fire at the College of Science and Engineering of National Dong Hwa University and severe damage to facilities such as the library and dormitories, with financial losses close to NT$2 billion.

description.zh-cn: 作为东华大学校友及立法委员，在2024年花莲地震后，公开呼吁并希望教育部能全力支持母校的重建经费。
description.en: As an alumna of National Dong Hwa University and a legislator, she publicly urged and hoped that the Ministry of Education would fully support the reconstruction funds for her alma mater after the 2024 Hualien earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 在2024年花莲地震后，义卖19幅艺术作品，并将全部所得捐赠给国立东华大学用于灾后重建。
description.en: After the 2024 Hualien earthquake, he held a charity sale of 19 art pieces and donated all proceeds to National Dong Hwa University for post-disaster reconstruction.

description.zh-cn: 在2024年花莲地震后，捐出半个月薪水以支持国立东华大学的重建工作。
description.en: After the 2024 Hualien earthquake, she donated half a month's salary to support the reconstruction efforts of National Dong Hwa University.

description.zh-cn: 在2024年花莲地震后，与妻子昆凌共同捐款一百万新台币，以帮助国立东华大学重建。
description.en: After the 2024 Hualien earthquake, he and his wife Hannah Quinlivan jointly donated NT$1 million to help with the reconstruction of National Dong Hwa University.

description.zh-cn: 在2024年花莲地震后，与丈夫周杰伦共同捐款一百万新台币，以帮助国立东华大学重建。
description.en: After the 2024 Hualien earthquake, she and her husband Jay Chou jointly donated NT$1 million to help with the reconstruction of National Dong Hwa University.

description.zh-cn: 周杰伦与昆凌是夫妻关系。
description.en: Jay Chou and Hannah Quinlivan are spouses.

description.zh-cn: 曾担任国立东华大学跆拳道队指导教练。
description.en: Formerly served as the coach for the Taekwondo team at National Dong Hwa University.

description.zh-cn: 两校签有学术合作协议，以促进校际交流与学术合作。
description.en: The two universities have signed an academic cooperation agreement to promote inter-university exchange and academic collaboration.

description.zh-cn: 两校签有学术合作协议，以促进校际交流与学术合作。
description.en: The two universities have signed an academic cooperation agreement to promote inter-university exchange and academic collaboration.

description.zh-cn: 两校签署学生交流协议，每学期相互提供交换生名额。
description.en: The two universities have signed a student exchange agreement, providing exchange student quotas for each other every semester.

description.zh-cn: 京都大学是京都学派的发祥地。
description.en: Kyoto University is the birthplace of the Kyoto School.

description.zh-cn: 西田几多郎是京都学派的开创者之一。
description.en: Kitaro Nishida was one of the founders of the Kyoto School.

description.zh-cn: 时任文部大臣的鸠山一郎对京大校长提出罢免泷川幸辰的要求，是引发泷川事件的关键人物。
description.en: As the Minister of Education at the time, Ichirō Hatoyama's demand for the dismissal of Yukitoki Takikawa was a key factor in triggering the Takigawa incident.

description.zh-cn: 泷川事件是日本学术界思想自由和大学自治受到政府压制的一次标志性事件。
description.en: The Takigawa incident was a landmark event where academic freedom of thought and university autonomy in Japan were suppressed by the government.

description.zh-cn: 由于泷川事件，泷川幸辰教授的著作被禁，并最终被迫停职、免职。
description.en: As a result of the Takigawa incident, Professor Yukitoki Takikawa's writings were banned, and he was ultimately suspended and dismissed from his position.

description.zh-cn: 担任《我于青春无悔》的导演。
description.en: Served as the director of 'No Regrets for Our Youth'.

description.zh-cn: 担任京都大学现任校长。
description.en: Serves as the current president of Kyoto University.

description.zh-cn: 将民主、贵族政治及寡头政治都视为共和国的政体，对共和制的概念进行了分类和阐释。
description.en: Classified democracy, aristocracy, and oligarchy as forms of republic, thereby categorizing and interpreting the concept of republicanism.

description.zh-cn: 认为君主制、贵族制与民主制三种制度结合形成的共和制是最优秀的制度。
description.en: Believed that a republic formed by the combination of monarchy, aristocracy, and democracy was the most excellent system.

description.zh-cn: 根据亚里士多德的理论，君主制是构成理想共和制的三个要素之一。
description.en: According to Aristotle's theory, monarchy is one of the three components of an ideal republic.

description.zh-cn: 根据亚里士多德的理论，贵族制是构成理想共和制的三个要素之一。
description.en: According to Aristotle's theory, aristocracy is one of the three components of an ideal republic.

description.zh-cn: 国人暴动推翻了周厉王的统治，迫使其出逃。
description.en: The Compatriots' Rebellion overthrew the rule of King Li of Zhou, forcing him to flee.

description.zh-cn: 国人暴动导致周厉王出逃，直接开启了周召共和时期。
description.en: The Compatriots' Rebellion led to the flight of King Li of Zhou, directly initiating the Gonghe Regency period.

description.zh-cn: 在周召共和时期代行王政14年。
description.en: Acted as regent for 14 years during the Gonghe Regency.

description.zh-cn: 提出“虚君共和”概念，用以和革命党支持的共和制竞争。
description.en: Proposed the concept of 'Republic with a nominal monarch' to compete with the republicanism supported by the revolutionaries.

description.zh-cn: 社会主义共和国体制基于马克思列宁主义国家理论。
description.en: The socialist republic system is based on the state theory of Marxism–Leninism.

description.zh-cn: 通过在朝鲜民主主义人民共和国实行世袭继承制进行统治，与共和制国家元首由选举产生的基本原则相悖。
description.en: Rules North Korea through a system of hereditary succession, which contradicts the fundamental republican principle of an elected head of state.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜劳动党在1980年放弃马克思列宁主义，将其从党和国家的指导思想中删除。
description.en: The Workers' Party of Korea abandoned Marxism–Leninism in 1980, removing it as the guiding ideology of the party and state.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜删除了宪法中的共产主义作为指导思想。
description.en: North Korea removed communism as a guiding ideology from its constitution.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜劳动党在1980年将主体思想确立为唯一指导思想。
description.en: The Workers' Party of Korea established Juche as the sole guiding ideology in 1980.

description.zh-cn: 伊斯兰共和国的所有现行法律都必须与《古兰经》中的伊斯兰教训谕保持一致。
description.en: All current laws in an Islamic republic must be consistent with the Islamic teachings in the Quran.

description.zh-cn: 伊斯兰共和国的所有现行法律都必须与《圣训》中的伊斯兰教训谕保持一致。
description.en: All current laws in an Islamic republic must be consistent with the Islamic teachings in the Hadith.

description.zh-cn: 半总统制国家起源于威玛共和国。
description.en: The semi-presidential system originated in the Weimar Republic.

description.zh-cn: 议会共和制的政府型态属于议会制，行政机构的权力来源于议会。
description.en: The form of government of a parliamentary republic is a parliamentary system, where the executive branch derives its power from the parliament.

description.zh-cn: 俞正声是俞启威（黄敬）的儿子。
description.en: Yu Zhengsheng is the son of Yu Qiwei (Huang Jing).

description.zh-cn: 俞正声是范瑾的儿子。
description.en: Yu Zhengsheng is the son of Fan Jin.

description.zh-cn: 俞正声与张志凯是夫妻关系。
description.en: Yu Zhengsheng and Zhang Zhikai are husband and wife.

description.zh-cn: 张志凯是张震寰的女儿。
description.en: Zhang Zhikai is the daughter of Zhang Zhenhuan.

description.zh-cn: 因母亲范瑾在文革中被打倒，俞正声毕业后被分配到河北张家口的工厂当技术员，影响了其早期职业生涯。
description.en: Because his mother Fan Jin was overthrown during the Cultural Revolution, Yu Zhengsheng was assigned to a factory in Zhangjiakou, Hebei as a technician after graduation, which affected his early career.

description.zh-cn: 1984年，受好友邓朴方力邀，俞正声出任中国残疾人福利基金会负责人。
description.en: In 1984, at the strong invitation of his friend Deng Pufang, Yu Zhengsheng became the head of the China Disabled Persons' Federation.

description.zh-cn: 据中国大陆媒体《财经》杂志暗指，俞正声曾涉入与李薇的不伦关系。
description.en: According to the mainland Chinese media outlet Caijing Magazine, it was implied that Yu Zhengsheng was involved in an illicit affair with Li Wei.

description.zh-cn: 火灾后，民众对上海市政府的救灾活动表达不满，问责直指时任市委书记俞正声的“懒政作风”，损害了其声誉。
description.en: After the fire, the public expressed dissatisfaction with the disaster relief efforts of the Shanghai municipal government, with accountability directed at the "lazy governance style" of then-Party Secretary Yu Zhengsheng, damaging his reputation.

description.zh-cn: 俞正声主政上海期间，成功举办了2010年上海世博会，但也因经济停滞、外来人口激增等问题引发争议和市民不满。
description.en: During his tenure as the head of Shanghai, Yu Zhengsheng successfully hosted the 2010 Shanghai Expo, but also faced controversy and public dissatisfaction due to issues such as economic stagnation and a sharp increase in the migrant population.

position.en: Member of the Politburo Standing Committee

description.zh-cn: 在习近平担任中共中央总书记期间，俞正声任中央政治局常委。
description.en: While Xi Jinping served as General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, Yu Zhengsheng was a member of the Politburo Standing Committee.

description.zh-cn: 汪洋接替俞正声，担任中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会主席职务。
description.en: Wang Yang succeeded Yu Zhengsheng as the Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 俞正声于1963年毕业于北京市第四中学。
description.en: Yu Zhengsheng graduated from Beijing No. 4 High School in 1963.

description.zh-cn: 俞正声曾就读于哈尔滨军事工程学院（现中国人民解放军国防科技大学），并于1968年毕业。
description.en: Yu Zhengsheng studied at the Harbin Military Engineering Institute (now the National University of Defense Technology) and graduated in 1968.

description.zh-cn: 越南战争是冷战在东南亚地区激化的表现，是两大阵营对抗的局部热战。
description.en: The Vietnam War was a manifestation of the intensification of the Cold War in Southeast Asia, a local hot war in the confrontation between the two major blocs.

description.zh-cn: 美国作为南越的主要盟友，与北越直接交战。
description.en: The United States, as the main ally of South Vietnam, was in direct conflict with North Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 肯尼迪政府时期，美国开始向南越派遣特种作战部队，开启了美军战斗部队进入越南的先河。肯尼迪任内，将派往越南的美军顾问从800人增加至16300人，进一步加深了美国对越南战争的介入。
description.en: During the Kennedy administration, the United States began sending special operations forces to South Vietnam, pioneering the entry of U.S. combat troops. Kennedy also increased the number of U.S. military advisors from 800 to 16,300, significantly deepening American involvement in the Vietnam War.

description.zh-cn: 在军事政变中，吴廷琰总统被推翻并被枪杀。
description.en: During the military coup, President Ngô Đình Diệm was overthrown and assassinated.

description.zh-cn: 杨文明是发动1963年军事政变推翻吴廷琰的关键人物。
description.en: Dương Văn Minh was a key figure in launching the 1963 military coup that overthrew Ngô Đình Diệm.

description.zh-cn: 东京湾事件直接导致美国国会通过《东京湾决议案》。
description.en: The Gulf of Tonkin incident directly led to the U.S. Congress passing the Gulf of Tonkin Resolution.

description.zh-cn: 该决议案授权总统林登·约翰逊采取包括使用武力在内的一切必要措施，为美国全面介入战争提供了法律依据。
description.en: The resolution authorized President Lyndon B. Johnson to take all necessary measures, including the use of force, providing a legal basis for full-scale U.S. involvement in the war.

description.zh-cn: 约翰逊总统批准了对北越的“滚雷”轰炸作战计划。
description.en: President Johnson approved the 'Rolling Thunder' bombing campaign against North Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 春节攻势的规模和影响使美国公众对战争失去信心，导致约翰逊总统放弃竞选连任。
description.en: The scale and impact of the Tet Offensive caused the American public to lose faith in the war, leading President Johnson to abandon his bid for re-election.

description.zh-cn: 北越军队与越共游击队共同发动了春节攻势。
description.en: The North Vietnamese Army and Viet Cong guerrillas jointly launched the Tet Offensive.

description.zh-cn: 根据巴黎和平协约，所有美军作战部队需从越南撤出，结束了美国的直接军事介入。
description.en: Under the Paris Peace Accords, all U.S. combat troops were to be withdrawn from Vietnam, ending direct U.S. military involvement.

description.zh-cn: 北越军队攻占西贡，导致南越政权覆灭。
description.en: The North Vietnamese army's capture of Saigon led to the collapse of the South Vietnamese government.

description.zh-cn: 北越在战胜南越后，于1976年将南北统一，成立了越南社会主义共和国。
description.en: After defeating South Vietnam, North Vietnam unified the north and south in 1976, establishing the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.

position.en: Commander, U.S. Military Assistance Command, Vietnam

description.zh-cn: 在约翰逊总统任期内，威斯特摩兰将军作为驻越美军司令，向总统负责。
description.en: During President Johnson's term, General Westmoreland, as the commander of U.S. forces in Vietnam, reported to the President.

position.zh-cn: 越南劳动党主席，越南民主共和国主席
position.en: Chairman of the Workers' Party of Vietnam, President of the Democratic Republic of Vietnam

description.zh-cn: 胡志明是北越的最高领导人，直到他于1969年去世。
description.en: Ho Chi Minh was the supreme leader of North Vietnam until his death in 1969.

description.zh-cn: 武汉会战是抗日战争初期的一场关键性大规模战役。
description.en: The Battle of Wuhan was a key large-scale campaign in the early stages of the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 在武汉会战中，国民革命军与大日本帝国陆军是主要交战双方。
description.en: During the Battle of Wuhan, the National Revolutionary Army and the Imperial Japanese Army were the main combatants.

position.zh-cn: 国民政府军事委员会委员长
position.en: Chairman of the Military Affairs Commission

description.zh-cn: 作为中国军队最高统帅，领导和指挥了武汉会战。
description.en: As the supreme commander of the Chinese forces, he led and directed the Battle of Wuhan.

position.en: Commander of the Central China Area Army

description.zh-cn: 作为华中方面军指挥官，指挥日军发动了武汉会战。
description.en: As the commander of the Central China Area Army, he commanded the Japanese forces in launching the Battle of Wuhan.

description.zh-cn: 日军虽占领武汉，但付出惨重代价（惨胜），未能达到迅速结束战争的战略目的，标志着其速战速决策略的破产。
description.en: Although the Japanese army captured Wuhan, it suffered heavy casualties (a pyrrhic victory) and failed to achieve its strategic goal of ending the war quickly, marking the failure of its strategy of rapid victory.

description.zh-cn: 武汉会战的结束标志着抗日战争由战略防御转入战略相持阶段。
description.en: The end of the Battle of Wuhan marked the transition of the Second Sino-Japanese War from strategic defense to strategic stalemate.

description.zh-cn: 在武汉会战期间，陈诚指挥第九战区负责长江以南的防务。
description.en: During the Battle of Wuhan, Chen Cheng commanded the 9th War Area, responsible for the defense south of the Yangtze River.

description.zh-cn: 黄河花园口决堤造成的洪水，迫使日军中止了沿淮河主攻武汉的计划，阻延了其对武汉的进攻。
description.en: The flood caused by the breaking of the Yellow River dikes at Huayuankou forced the Japanese army to abandon its plan to attack Wuhan along the Huai River, delaying its offensive on the city.

description.zh-cn: 在万家岭战役中，薛岳指挥的中国军队包围并重创了日军第106师团。
description.en: In the Battle of Wanjialing, Chinese forces commanded by Xue Yue surrounded and inflicted heavy casualties on the Japanese 106th Division.

description.zh-cn: 薛岳作为第一兵团司令，指挥中国军队在万家岭地区取得了对日军的重大胜利。
description.en: As commander of the 1st Army Group, Xue Yue led Chinese forces to a major victory against the Japanese army in the Wanjialing area.

description.zh-cn: 在万家岭战役期间，商震指挥第32军成功阻击了试图增援第106师团的日军第27师团。
description.en: During the Battle of Wanjialing, Shang Zhen commanded the 32nd Army and successfully intercepted the Japanese 27th Division, which was attempting to reinforce the 106th Division.

description.zh-cn: 武汉会战结束后，战争进入相持阶段，汪精卫对战局悲观，最终选择发表“艳电”，公开投向日本。
description.en: After the Battle of Wuhan, the war entered a stalemate. Pessimistic about the situation, Wang Jingwei eventually chose to issue the 'Yan Telegram' and publicly defect to Japan.

description.zh-cn: 传达天皇命令，在武汉会战期间批准在375处地点使用化学武器。
description.en: Conveyed the Emperor's order, authorizing the use of chemical weapons at 375 locations during the Battle of Wuhan.

description.zh-cn: 在武汉会战前的御前会议中，裕仁天皇表示要给国民政府最后致命的一击，迫使中国投降。
description.en: In an Imperial Conference before the Battle of Wuhan, Emperor Hirohito stated the need to deal a final, fatal blow to the Nationalist Government to force China's surrender.

description.zh-cn: 时任日本首相近卫文磨于1938年5月5日发布《国家总动员法》，使日本进入战时经济体制以支持战争。
description.en: Then Prime Minister of Japan, Fumimaro Konoe, promulgated the National Mobilization Law on May 5, 1938, transitioning Japan to a wartime economy to support the war.

description.zh-cn: 《中苏互不侵犯条约》的签订是苏联向中国提供包括苏联航空志愿队在内的军事援助的基础。
description.en: The signing of the Sino-Soviet Non-Aggression Pact was the basis for the Soviet Union providing military aid to China, including the Soviet Volunteer Group.

description.zh-cn: 刘志祥是刘志军的弟弟。
description.en: Liu Zhixiang is Liu Zhijun's younger brother.

description.zh-cn: 时任国务院总理温家宝提名刘志军担任中华人民共和国铁道部部长。
description.en: Then-Premier Wen Jiabao nominated Liu Zhijun to be the Minister of Railways of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 时任国家主席胡锦涛根据全国人民代表大会的决定，任命刘志军为铁道部部长。
description.en: Then-President Hu Jintao appointed Liu Zhijun as Minister of Railways in accordance with the decision of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 刘志军在此期间担任铁道部部长及党组书记。
description.en: Liu Zhijun served as the Minister and Party Group Secretary of the Ministry of Railways during this period.

description.zh-cn: 在刘志军担任铁道部部长期间，温家宝是其上级（国务院总理）。
description.en: During Liu Zhijun's tenure as Minister of Railways, Wen Jiabao was his superior (Premier of the State Council).

description.zh-cn: 刘志军接替傅志寰成为铁道部部长。
description.en: Liu Zhijun succeeded Fu Zhihuan as Minister of Railways.

description.zh-cn: 盛光祖在刘志军被免职后接任铁道部部长。
description.en: Sheng Guangzu succeeded Liu Zhijun as Minister of Railways after Liu's dismissal.

description.zh-cn: 在其部长任内，刘志军大力推动了中国高速铁路网的建设，因此被称为“中国高铁之父”。
description.en: During his tenure as minister, Liu Zhijun vigorously promoted the construction of China's high-speed rail network, earning him the nickname "Father of China's High-Speed Rail."

description.zh-cn: 因对该起特大交通事故负有领导责任，刘志军被记过处分。
description.en: Liu Zhijun received a demerit for his leadership responsibility in this major traffic accident.

description.zh-cn: 国家审计署在对京沪高铁的审计中发现了与刘志军有关的线索，直接导致了对其的调查。
description.en: The National Audit Office discovered clues related to Liu Zhijun during its audit of the Beijing-Shanghai High-Speed Railway, which directly led to the investigation against him.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央纪委对刘志军涉嫌严重违纪问题进行立案调查，并最终决定开除其党籍。
description.en: The CCDI of the CPC investigated Liu Zhijun for suspected serious violations of discipline and ultimately decided to expel him from the party.

description.zh-cn: 该法院一审以受贿罪、滥用职权罪判处刘志军死刑，缓期二年执行。
description.en: This court sentenced Liu Zhijun to death with a two-year reprieve for bribery and abuse of power in the first-instance trial.

description.zh-cn: 傅志寰联名多位院士向国务院上书，举报刘志军在高铁技术引进中的不当行为。
description.en: Fu Zhihuan co-signed a letter with multiple academicians to the State Council, reporting Liu Zhijun's misconduct in the process of high-speed rail technology acquisition.

description.zh-cn: “中华之星”总设计师刘友梅联名多位院士向国务院上书，举报刘志军在高铁技术引进中的不当行为。
description.en: Liu Youmei, the chief designer of "China Star," co-signed a letter with multiple academicians to the State Council, reporting Liu Zhijun's misconduct in the process of high-speed rail technology acquisition.

description.zh-cn: 刘志军利用职务便利，为丁书苗在获取铁路货物运输计划、运作工程项目中标等方面提供帮助，使其获得巨额经济利益。
description.en: Liu Zhijun used his official position to help Ding Shumiao obtain railway freight transport plans and win bids for construction projects, enabling her to gain huge economic benefits.

description.zh-cn: 钱列阳在刘志军案中担任其辩护律师。
description.en: Qian Lieyang served as Liu Zhijun's defense lawyer in his case.

description.zh-cn: 赵俪生是秦晖在兰州大学就读时的硕士导师。
description.en: Zhao Lisheng was Qin Hui's master's thesis advisor at Lanzhou University.

description.zh-cn: 于1969年至1978年间加入中国共产党。
description.en: Joined the Communist Party of China between 1969 and 1978.

description.zh-cn: 秦晖于1997年将历史上“农民负担简而复繁”的现象总结为“黄宗羲定律”。
description.en: In 1997, Qin Hui summarized the historical phenomenon of 'the peasant's burden simplifying and then becoming complex again' as 'Huang Zongxi's Law'.

description.zh-cn: 该定律于2003年引起时任总理温家宝的注意。
description.en: The law attracted the attention of then-Premier Wen Jiabao in 2003.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命开始时，秦晖是初中学生，后成为广西“四二二派”的一员，这段经历深刻影响了他的早年生活。
description.en: When the Cultural Revolution began, Qin Hui was a middle school student and later became a member of the 'April 22 Faction' in Guangxi, an experience that profoundly influenced his early life.

description.zh-cn: 在2017年的深化国防和军队改革中，以陆军第三十九集团军为基础，调整组建了陆军第七十九集团军。
description.en: During the 2017 deepening national defense and military reform, the 79th Group Army was formed based on the 39th Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 1946年，原新四军第三师的第八旅、第十旅、独立旅组建为东北民主联军第二纵队。
description.en: In 1946, the 8th, 10th, and Independent Brigades of the former New Fourth Army's 3rd Division were formed into the 2nd Column of the Northeast Democratic United Army.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜战争期间，第三十九军入朝参战，参与了多次重要战役。
description.en: During the Korean War, the 39th Corps entered Korea and participated in several major battles.

description.zh-cn: 东北民主联军第二纵队是第二次国共内战期间东北战场的主力部队之一，参加了辽沈战役、平津战役等。
description.en: The 2nd Column of the Northeast Democratic United Army was one of the main forces in the Northeast China theater during the Chinese Civil War, participating in the Liaoshen and Pingjin Campaigns.

description.zh-cn: 根据天主教会的信仰，教会由耶稣基督建立于公元33年的耶路撒冷。
description.en: According to Catholic belief, the Church was founded by Jesus Christ in Jerusalem in 33 AD.

description.zh-cn: 天主教相信耶稣基督将建立教会的使命托付给了宗徒伯多禄（彼得）。
description.en: Catholicism believes that Jesus Christ entrusted the mission of building the Church to the Apostle Peter.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面信息框，良十四世是天主教会的领袖教宗。
description.en: According to the page's infobox, Leo XIV is the Pope, the leader of the Catholic Church.

description.zh-cn: 拉丁礼教会是天主教会中规模最大的个别教会。
description.en: The Latin Church is the largest particular church within the Catholic Church.

description.zh-cn: 东仪天主教会是与教宗完全共融的23个自治教会。
description.en: The Eastern Catholic Churches are 23 autonomous churches in full communion with the Pope.

description.zh-cn: 11世纪的东西教会大分裂导致了西方教会（天主教会）与东方教会（东正教会）的决裂。
description.en: The East-West Schism in the 11th century caused a break between the Western Church (Catholic Church) and the Eastern Church (Eastern Orthodox Church).

description.zh-cn: 自1054年东西教会大分裂后，天主教会与东正教长期处于分离状态。
description.en: Since the East-West Schism of 1054, the Catholic Church and the Eastern Orthodox Church have been in a state of separation.

description.zh-cn: 利玛窦是耶稣会的会士。
description.en: Matteo Ricci was a member of the Society of Jesus (Jesuits).

description.zh-cn: 利玛窦在明朝中叶成功进入中国传教，使天主教再次在中国传播开来。
description.en: Matteo Ricci successfully entered China to conduct missionary work in the mid-Ming Dynasty, leading to the renewed spread of Catholicism in China.

description.zh-cn: 徐光启与利玛窦讨论并共同确立了将基督教的“God”翻译为中文“天主”。
description.en: Xu Guangqi discussed with and, alongside Matteo Ricci, established the Chinese translation of the Christian 'God' as '天主' (Tīanzhǔ).

description.zh-cn: 首任宗座驻华代表刚恒毅枢机主教创立了主徒会。
description.en: Cardinal Celso Costantini, the first Apostolic Delegate to China, founded the Congregation of the Disciples of the Lord.

description.zh-cn: 雷鸣远神父在安国教区创立了耀汉小兄弟会。
description.en: Father Vincent Lebbe founded the Congregation of the Little Brothers of St. John the Baptist in the Diocese of Anguo.

description.zh-cn: 在431年的厄弗所大公会议中，教会宣布了圣母为“天主之母”的信理。
description.en: At the Council of Ephesus in 431, the Church proclaimed the dogma of Mary as the 'Mother of God' (Theotokos).

description.zh-cn: 中国天主教爱国会强调教会自主，脱离教宗和罗马的直接领导，与圣座的权威相对立。
description.en: The Chinese Patriotic Catholic Association emphasizes church autonomy, breaking away from the direct leadership of the Pope and Rome, which puts it in opposition to the authority of the Holy See.

description.zh-cn: 拒绝在政府登记的中国天主教会（忠贞教会）受到了来自中国官方的坚决打击。
description.en: The unregistered Catholic Church in China (Loyal Church) has been resolutely cracked down on by Chinese officials.

description.zh-cn: 教宗方济各与中国共产党总书记习近平曾互通信件。
description.en: Pope Francis and the General Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party Xi Jinping have exchanged correspondence.

description.zh-cn: 教宗若望保禄二世于2000年10月1日将120位在中国殉教的天主教徒宣布为圣人。
description.en: Pope John Paul II declared 120 Catholics who were martyred in China as saints on October 1, 2000.

description.zh-cn: 班超废黜龟兹扶植的疏勒王，另立疏勒王成的侄子忠为王。
疏勒王忠背叛东汉后，被班超发现并斩杀。
班超长期以疏勒（今喀什）作为其在西域活动的根据地。
自喀喇汗萨图克·博格拉汗皈依伊斯兰教后，喀什噶尔逐渐伊斯兰化。
喀喇汗国分裂后，喀什噶尔成为东喀喇汗国首都。
西辽征服塔里木盆地，东喀喇汗国臣属于西辽。
成吉思汗派遣的将领哲别率军攻入喀什噶尔，消灭了屈出律的统治。
哲别是成吉思汗麾下的将领。
阿古柏以喀什噶尔为根据地，建立了哲德沙尔汗国。
清政府任命左宗棠为钦差大臣，督办新疆军务，负责收复被阿古柏占据的新疆。
在左宗棠率领下，清军消灭了哲德沙尔汗国，收复了新疆。
在1933年喀什战役中，陶菲格·贝伊率领维吾尔与吉尔吉斯联军，企图攻占由回族将领马占仓据守的喀什噶尔新城。
与穆罕默德·伊敏等人在喀什噶尔成立东突厥斯坦伊斯兰共和国。
与沙比提大毛拉等人在喀什噶尔成立东突厥斯坦伊斯兰共和国。
马仲英率领马家军抵达喀什噶尔，要求维吾尔族效忠南京政府，东突厥斯坦第一共和宣告灭亡。
根据彭帅的指控，康洁对张高丽的行为知情，并在一次性侵犯发生时“在外帮守着”，事后还对彭帅进行言语侮辱。
description.en: According to Peng Shuai's accusation, Kang Jie was aware of Zhang Gaoli's actions, 'stood guard outside' during a sexual assault, and subsequently verbally abused Peng.

description.zh-cn: WTA主席西蒙对CGTN发布的邮件的真实性表示严重怀疑，称这封邮件“只让他对彭帅的安全和下落更加担心”。
description.en: WTA Chairman Steve Simon expressed serious doubts about the authenticity of the email released by CGTN, stating that it 'only raises my concerns as to her safety and whereabouts'.

description.zh-cn: 张高丽曾是中国共产党第十八届中央政治局常务委员会委员。
description.en: Zhang Gaoli was a member of the 18th Politburo Standing Committee of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 张高丽曾任中华人民共和国国务院副总理。
description.en: Zhang Gaoli served as a Vice Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 美国众议院以428票对0票通过决议，谴责国际奥委会与中国政府合作，违反其人权承诺，帮助北京掩盖张高丽对彭帅的性侵指控。
description.en: The U.S. House of Representatives passed a resolution 428-0, condemning the IOC for cooperating with the Chinese government, in violation of its own human rights commitments, to help Beijing cover up the sexual assault allegations against Peng Shuai by Zhang Gaoli.

description.zh-cn: 安黎是安子文的女儿。
description.en: An Li is the daughter of An Ziwen.

description.zh-cn: 1962年至1967年在北京大学历史系学习。
description.en: Studied in the Department of History at Peking University from 1962 to 1967.

description.zh-cn: 在中国历史博物馆工作期间，担任国家文物局党委委员。
description.en: While working at the Museum of Chinese History, he served as a member of the Party Committee of the National Cultural Heritage Administration.

description.zh-cn: 担任第十届全国人大常委。
description.en: Served as a member of the Standing Committee of the 10th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 担任第十届全国人大内务司法委员会委员。
description.en: Served as a member of the Internal and Judicial Affairs Committee of the 10th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 2014年4月秘访日本期间，与时任首相安倍晋三会晤。
description.en: During a secret visit to Japan in April 2014, met with then-Prime Minister Shinzo Abe.

description.zh-cn: 2014年4月秘访日本期间，与时任官房长官菅义伟会晤。
description.en: During a secret visit to Japan in April 2014, met with then-Chief Cabinet Secretary Yoshihide Suga.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中国生物多样性保护与绿色发展基金会理事长，现为党委书记。
description.en: Formerly served as the Chairman of the China Biodiversity Conservation and Green Development Foundation, and is currently the Party Committee Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 在1962年9月的中共八届十中全会上，毛泽东提出要进行社会主义教育运动，并于1963年正式发动了该运动。
description.en: At the 10th Plenary Session of the 8th CCP Central Committee in September 1962, Mao Zedong proposed to carry out the Socialist Education Movement, which was formally launched in 1963.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东在这次会议上重提阶级斗争，为社会主义教育运动的发动提供了理论和政治基础。
description.en: Mao Zedong re-emphasized class struggle at this meeting, providing the theoretical and political basis for launching the Socialist Education Movement.

description.zh-cn: 社会主义教育运动常被视为文化大革命的预演，其斗争方式和政治分歧为文革的爆发埋下了伏笔。
description.en: The Socialist Education Movement is often regarded as a prelude to the Cultural Revolution, as its struggle methods and political disagreements set the stage for the outbreak of the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 社会主义教育运动的一个主要意图是“反修防修”，防止资本主义在中国“和平演变”。
description.en: A primary goal of the Socialist Education Movement was to 'combat and prevent revisionism' and to prevent a 'peaceful evolution' towards capitalism in China.

description.zh-cn: 在四清运动期间，由于错误的“左”倾指导思想，造成了大量干部和群众受到不应有的打击，产生了大量冤假错案。
description.en: During the Four Cleanups Movement, due to erroneous 'Leftist' guiding ideology, a large number of cadres and ordinary people were unduly persecuted, resulting in numerous unjust, false, and wrongly decided cases.

description.zh-cn: 刘少奇在全国范围内推广王光美的“桃园经验”，使其成为指导四清运动的重要模式。
description.en: Liu Shaoqi promoted Wang Guangmei's 'Taoyuan Experience' nationwide, making it an important model for guiding the Four Cleanups Movement.

description.zh-cn: “桃园经验”中使用的“燕飞”体罚方式，演变成了后来在文化大革命中流行的“喷气式”批斗方式。
description.en: The 'Yanfei' (swallow flying) corporal punishment method used in the 'Taoyuan Experience' evolved into the 'jetliner' struggle session style that became popular during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 在庐山会议上，彭德怀因对“大跃进”提出异议而被毛泽东打倒。
description.en: At the Lushan Conference, Peng Dehuai was purged by Mao Zedong for criticizing the 'Great Leap Forward'.

description.zh-cn: 在三年困难时期后，刘少奇等人支持“三自一包”作为恢复农村经济的改革措施。
description.en: After the Three Years of Great Famine, Liu Shaoqi and others supported 'Three-Self and One-Bao' as a reform measure to restore the rural economy.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东在1962年的北戴河会议上，批评“三自一包”等政策是走资本主义道路，并坚决阻止其进一步推广。
description.en: At the 1962 Beidaihe Conference, Mao Zedong criticized policies like 'Sanzi Yibao' as taking the capitalist road, and firmly halted their further promotion.

description.zh-cn: 在1965年1月3日，第三届全国人大再度选举刘少奇担任中华人民共和国主席。
description.en: On January 3, 1965, the 3rd National People's Congress re-elected Liu Shaoqi as the President of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 邓子恢支持“三自一包”的经济改革措施。
description.en: Deng Zihui supported the 'Three-Self and One-Bao' economic reform measures.

description.zh-cn: 陈伯达极力主张将王光美的“桃园经验”报告下发各地进行推广。
description.en: Chen Boda strongly advocated for the distribution and promotion of Wang Guangmei's 'Taoyuan Experience' report to all localities.

description.zh-cn: 黄晓明与Angelababy于2015年5月27日结婚，2022年1月28日宣布离婚。
description.en: Huang Xiaoming married Angelababy on May 27, 2015, and they announced their divorce on January 28, 2022.

description.zh-cn: 陈梦是黄晓明的表妹。
description.en: Chen Meng is Huang Xiaoming's cousin.

description.zh-cn: 黄晓明于2000年毕业于北京电影学院表演系本科班。
description.en: Huang Xiaoming graduated from the undergraduate program of the Performing Arts Department at Beijing Film Academy in 2000.

description.zh-cn: 黄晓明于2007年至2010年签约华谊兄弟文化经纪公司。
description.en: Huang Xiaoming was signed with Huayi Brothers Culture and Brokerage Co. from 2007 to 2010.

description.zh-cn: 黄晓明于2007年至2010年签约大国文化集团作为其唱片公司。
description.en: Huang Xiaoming was signed to Music Nation Group as his record company from 2007 to 2010.

description.zh-cn: 黄晓明在大学期间与李钰交往，李钰是其初恋女友。
description.en: Huang Xiaoming dated Li Yu during his university years; she was his first love girlfriend.

description.zh-cn: 2000年至2004年，黄晓明和大学同班同学刘立淇交往并同居。
description.en: From 2000 to 2004, Huang Xiaoming dated and lived with his university classmate Liu Liqi.

description.zh-cn: 黄晓明于2003年与秦岚因拍摄《龙票》相恋，2006年11月28日承认分手。
description.en: Huang Xiaoming fell in love with Qin Lan in 2003 while filming 'Long Piao' and admitted their breakup on November 28, 2006.

description.zh-cn: 黄晓明于2007年因合作《鹿鼎记》与李菲儿交往，2010年分手。
description.en: Huang Xiaoming dated Li Fei'er after collaborating on 'Royal Tramp' in 2007; they broke up in 2010.

description.zh-cn: 李菲儿曾公开指责Angelababy是她与黄晓明之间的第三者。
description.en: Li Fei'er publicly accused Angelababy of being the third party in her relationship with Huang Xiaoming.

description.zh-cn: 2013年，黄晓明以电影《中国合伙人》与张国立并列获得第29届金鸡奖最佳男主角奖。
description.en: In 2013, Huang Xiaoming co-won the Best Actor award at the 29th Golden Rooster Awards with Zhang Guoli for the film 'American Dreams in China'.

description.zh-cn: 2009年8月5日，联合国儿童基金会香港委员会委任黄晓明为爱心大使。
description.en: On August 5, 2009, the Hong Kong Committee for UNICEF appointed Huang Xiaoming as a Goodwill Ambassador.

description.zh-cn: 托洛茨基主义是马克思主义的一个流派，托洛茨基自视为正统马克思主义者。
description.en: Trotskyism is a school of Marxism, and Trotsky considered himself an orthodox Marxist.

description.zh-cn: 托洛茨基自视为布尔什维克列宁主义者，其理论继承了列宁主义。
description.en: Trotsky considered himself a Bolshevik-Leninist, and his theories were a continuation of Leninism.

description.zh-cn: 列夫·托洛茨基是十月革命的实际指挥者。
description.en: Leon Trotsky was the de facto commander of the October Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 列夫·托洛茨基是第四国际的创建者和精神领袖。
description.en: Leon Trotsky was the founder and spiritual leader of the Fourth International.

description.zh-cn: 斯大林将托洛茨基及其领导的左翼反对派强力镇压，并于1929年将其流放出苏联。
description.en: Stalin forcefully suppressed Trotsky and the Left Opposition he led, and exiled him from the Soviet Union in 1929.

description.zh-cn: 布哈林提出“一国社会主义”理论。
description.en: Bukharin proposed the theory of 'Socialism in One Country'.

description.zh-cn: 托洛茨基撰写了《被背叛的革命》一书，批判斯大林主义。
description.en: Trotsky wrote the book 'The Revolution Betrayed', criticizing Stalinism.

description.zh-cn: 托洛茨基主义者称苏联为“堕落的工人国家”，并支持在苏联进行一场政治革命以重建社会主义民主。
description.en: Trotskyists referred to the Soviet Union as a 'degenerated workers' state' and supported a political revolution within it to re-establish socialist democracy.

description.zh-cn: “堕落的工人国家”是托洛茨基主义者用以描述斯大林时期苏联政治性质的理论概念。
description.en: 'Degenerated workers' state' is a theoretical concept used by Trotskyists to describe the political nature of the Soviet Union during the Stalin era.

description.zh-cn: 作为苏联政府的密探，拉蒙·麦卡德在墨西哥城刺杀了托洛茨基。
description.en: As a Soviet government agent, Ramón Mercader assassinated Trotsky in Mexico City.

description.zh-cn: 在西班牙内战中，斯大林主义路线清剿托洛茨基主义者并从西班牙撤军，最终导致了工人阶级的惨败和法西斯的胜利。
description.en: During the Spanish Civil War, the Stalinist line involved purging Trotskyists and withdrawing troops from Spain, which ultimately led to the crushing defeat of the working class and the victory of fascism.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东于1952年12月22日发动“大肃托”，在全国范围内镇压托洛茨基主义者。
description.en: Mao Zedong launched the 'Great Purge of Trotskyists' on December 22, 1952, suppressing Trotskyists nationwide.

description.zh-cn: 在此次运动中，中国大陆的托洛茨基主义者遭到大规模逮捕和关押。
description.en: In this campaign, Trotskyists in mainland China were subjected to mass arrests and imprisonment.

description.zh-cn: 在陈独秀的号召下，中国的四个托洛茨基主义组织于1931年5月统一成立了“中国共产党左派反对派”。
description.en: At the call of Chen Duxiu, four Trotskyist organizations in China united in May 1931 to form the 'Left Opposition of the Communist Party of China'.

description.zh-cn: 无产者社是合并成立中国共产党左派反对派的四个托派组织之一。
description.en: The Proletarian Society was one of the four Trotskyist organizations that merged to form the Left Opposition of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国布尔什维克列宁主义反对派是合并成立中国共产党左派反对派的四个托派组织之一。
description.en: The Chinese Bolshevik-Leninist Opposition was one of the four Trotskyist organizations that merged to form the Left Opposition of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 十月社是合并成立中国共产党左派反对派的四个托派组织之一。
description.en: The October Society was one of the four Trotskyist organizations that merged to form the Left Opposition of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 战斗社是合并成立中国共产党左派反对派的四个托派组织之一。
description.en: The Combat Society was one of the four Trotskyist organizations that merged to form the Left Opposition of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党左派反对派成立不久便遭到中国国民党当局的严重破坏。
description.en: Shortly after its establishment, the Left Opposition of the Communist Party of China was severely undermined by the Kuomintang authorities.

description.zh-cn: 明智光安是明智光秀的叔父及养父，在光秀父亲早逝后照顾他。
description.en: Akechi Mitsuyasu was Akechi Mitsuhide's uncle and adoptive father, who took care of him after his father's early death.

description.zh-cn: 妻木熙子是明智光秀的正室。
description.en: Tsumaki Hiroko was the official wife of Akechi Mitsuhide.

description.zh-cn: 细川玉子是明智光秀的三女。
description.en: Hosokawa Tama was the third daughter of Akechi Mitsuhide.

description.zh-cn: 细川玉子是细川忠兴的正室。
description.en: Hosokawa Tama was the wife of Hosokawa Tadaoki.

description.zh-cn: 明智光秀最初侍奉美浓大名斋藤道三。
description.en: Akechi Mitsuhide initially served Saitō Dōsan, the daimyō of Mino.

description.zh-cn: 在斋藤道三死后，明智光秀曾前往越前仕于朝仓义景。
description.en: After Saitō Dōsan's death, Akechi Mitsuhide went to Echizen to serve Asakura Yoshikage.

description.zh-cn: 明智光秀在投靠织田信长前曾侍奉细川藤孝。
description.en: Akechi Mitsuhide served Hosokawa Fujitaka before pledging allegiance to Oda Nobunaga.

description.zh-cn: 明智光秀曾侍奉室町幕府末代将军足利义昭，并随他一同投靠织田信长。
description.en: Akechi Mitsuhide served the last Ashikaga shōgun, Ashikaga Yoshiaki, and joined Oda Nobunaga's forces along with him.

description.zh-cn: 明智光秀后随足利义昭一同投靠织田信长，并成为其重要家臣，直到在本能寺之变中反叛。
description.en: Akechi Mitsuhide, along with Ashikaga Yoshiaki, joined Oda Nobunaga and became one of his key retainers until his rebellion in the Honnō-ji Incident.

description.zh-cn: 明智光秀在山崎之战中被羽柴秀吉击败，并在败走途中被杀。
description.en: Akechi Mitsuhide was defeated by Hashiba Hideyoshi in the Battle of Yamazaki and was killed while fleeing.

description.zh-cn: 在斋藤道三与斋藤义龙父子内乱期间，明智光秀支持道三，与义龙为敌。
description.en: During the internal conflict between Saitō Dōsan and his son Yoshitatsu, Akechi Mitsuhide supported Dōsan, making him an enemy of Yoshitatsu.

description.zh-cn: 经过长期围攻，明智光秀最终攻陷八上城，成功击败波多野秀治，平定丹波国。
description.en: After a long siege, Akechi Mitsuhide finally captured Yagami Castle, successfully defeating Hatano Hideharu and pacifying Tanba Province.

description.zh-cn: 在本能寺之变后，明智光秀希望拉拢细川藤孝，但遭到拒绝，这阻碍了他巩固权力的计划。
description.en: After the Honnō-ji Incident, Akechi Mitsuhide hoped to win over Hosokawa Fujitaka, but was refused, which hindered his plans to consolidate power.

description.zh-cn: 在本能寺之变后，明智光秀希望拉拢筒井顺庆，但遭到拒绝，这阻碍了他巩固权力的计划。
description.en: After the Honnō-ji Incident, Akechi Mitsuhide hoped to win over Tsutsui Junkei, but was refused, which hindered his plans to consolidate power.

description.zh-cn: 传说在山崎之战中幸存的明智光秀后来化名为南光坊天海，并辅佐德川家康。
description.en: According to legend, Akechi Mitsuhide survived the Battle of Yamazaki and later assumed the identity of Nankōbō Tenkai, serving as an advisor to Tokugawa Ieyasu.

description.zh-cn: 朱立伦是新北市升格为直辖市后的首位市长，并成功连任。
description.en: Eric Chu was the first mayor of New Taipei City after its upgrade to a special municipality, and he was successfully re-elected.

description.zh-cn: 朱立伦是中国国民党籍政治人物。
description.en: Eric Chu is a politician from the Kuomintang (KMT).

description.zh-cn: 侯友宜是中国国民党籍政治人物。
description.en: Hou Yu-ih is a politician from the Kuomintang (KMT).

description.zh-cn: 侯友宜曾任朱立伦市长任内的副市长，并在2015年10月20日至2016年1月18日期间，因朱立伦参选总统而代理市长职务。
description.en: Hou Yu-ih served as Deputy Mayor under Mayor Eric Chu and acted as mayor from October 20, 2015, to January 18, 2016, while Chu ran for president.

description.zh-cn: 朱立伦为参选2016年总统选举，于2015年10月20日至2016年1月18日期间请假新北市市长职务。
description.en: To run in the 2016 presidential election, Eric Chu took a leave of absence from his duties as Mayor of New Taipei City from October 20, 2015, to January 18, 2016.

description.zh-cn: 明朝洪武三十一年（1398年），为防倭寇袭扰，在奇山北麓建奇山守御千户所城，并在“北山”设烽火台。
description.en: In 1398, during the reign of the Hongwu Emperor of the Ming dynasty, the Qishan Guard was established at the northern foot of Mount Qi, and a beacon tower was set up on the 'North Mountain' to defend against raids by Wokou pirates.

description.zh-cn: 为解决马嘉理事件，中英双方在烟台进行谈判并签订了《烟台条约》。
description.en: To resolve the Margary Affair, China and Britain negotiated and signed the Chefoo Convention in Yantai.

description.zh-cn: 北洋大臣李鸿章与英国公使威妥玛在烟台就马嘉理事件进行谈判。
description.en: Beiyang Minister Li Hongzhang negotiated with British Minister Thomas Wade in Yantai regarding the Margary Affair.

description.zh-cn: 俞正声曾于1987年3月至1989年5月期间担任烟台市市长。
description.en: Yu Zhengsheng served as the Mayor of Yantai from March 1987 to May 1989.

description.zh-cn: 《时代》杂志创始人亨利·路思义出生于烟台。
description.en: Henry Luce, founder of Time magazine, was born in Yantai.

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇发起了东巡活动，期间到达了芝罘岛。
description.en: Qin Shi Huang initiated an eastern tour, during which he reached Zhifu Island.

description.zh-cn: 前218年，秦始皇东巡至芝罘岛（位于今烟台市），留下了《芝罘刻石》，并始建东巡宫。
description.en: In 218 BC, Qin Shi Huang's eastern tour reached Zhifu Island (in modern-day Yantai), where he left the 'Zhifu Inscription' and ordered the construction of the Dongxun Palace.

description.zh-cn: 1998年6月9日至15日，第二届APEC国际贸易博览会在烟台市举办。
description.en: From June 9 to 15, 1998, the Second APEC International Trade Fair was held in Yantai.

description.zh-cn: 杨国忠因杨贵妃受到唐玄宗宠信而获得重用，得以任官。
description.en: Yang Guozhong was appointed to high office due to Imperial Consort Yang being favored by Emperor Xuanzong.

description.zh-cn: 唐玄宗赐名杨钊为“国忠”。
description.en: Emperor Xuanzong bestowed the name 'Guozhong' upon Yang Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 杨国忠出于私心，逼迫潼关守将哥舒翰出战，导致其兵败被俘，潼关失陷。
description.en: Driven by personal motives, Yang Guozhong forced Tongguan Pass commander Geshu Han into battle, leading to his defeat, capture, and the fall of the pass.

description.zh-cn: 安史之乱的爆发导致唐玄宗出逃，最终杨国忠在逃亡途中的马嵬驿兵变中被杀。
description.en: The outbreak of the An-Shi Rebellion forced Emperor Xuanzong to flee, and Yang Guozhong was killed during the subsequent Mawei Inn Mutiny on the road.

description.zh-cn: 与宦官李辅国、高力士等人策划并鼓动士兵发动兵变，要求处死杨国忠。
description.en: Conspired with eunuchs like Li Fuguo and Gao Lishi to incite the soldiers to mutiny and demand the death of Yang Guozhong.

description.zh-cn: 在杨国忠被杀后，其妻裴柔在试图逃跑时也被斩杀。
description.en: After Yang Guozhong was killed, his wife Pei Rou was also executed while trying to escape.

description.zh-cn: 2003年，九州艺术工科大学与九州大学并校。
description.en: In 2003, the Kyushu Institute of Design merged with Kyushu University.

description.zh-cn: 九州大学活体解剖事件发生于当时的九州帝国大学医学部。
description.en: The Kyushu University vivisection incident took place at the Faculty of Medicine of what was then Kyushu Imperial University.

description.zh-cn: 淡马锡控股由新加坡政府财政部拥有100%股权，是一家国有企业。
新加坡财政部是新加坡政府下属的部门之一。
张志贤被指定为淡马锡控股的候任董事长。

position.zh-cn: 执行董事, 首席执行长

description.zh-cn: 何晶于2002年5月被任命为淡马锡控股的执行董事，2004年1月出任首席执行长，直至2021年10月退休。
2009年4月，淡马锡控股退出并不再投资捷星亚洲航空。
淡马锡控股于2014年3月21日斥资440亿港元入股屈臣氏集团24.95%的股权。
淡马锡控股于2016年6月9日宣布将其拥有的海皇东方股份转让给法国达飞海运集团。
法国达飞海运集团于2016年6月9日从淡马锡控股手中收购了海皇东方的股份。
孙氏原为贵妃，1428年被册立为皇后，取代了胡善祥。
description.en: Lady Sun was originally a consort and was made Empress in 1428, replacing Hu Shanxiang.

description.zh-cn: 吴贤妃是明宣宗的侧室。
description.en: Consort Wu was a concubine of the Xuande Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 顺德公主嫁给了石璟。
description.en: Princess Shunde was married to Shi Jing.

description.zh-cn: 孝庄睿皇后钱氏是明英宗的皇后。
description.en: Empress Xiaozhuangrui, née Qian, was the empress of Emperor Yingzong.

description.zh-cn: 胡善围是胡善祥的姊姊。
description.en: Hu Shanwei was Hu Shanxiang's older sister.

description.zh-cn: 胡安是胡善祥的兄长。
description.en: Hu An was Hu Shanxiang's older brother.

description.zh-cn: 胡瑄是胡善祥的弟弟。
description.en: Hu Xuan was Hu Shanxiang's younger brother.

description.zh-cn: 以胡皇后“无子多病”为由，命令胡皇后上表辞位。
description.en: Citing Empress Hu's 'childlessness and illness', he ordered her to submit a letter of resignation.

description.zh-cn: 孙贵妃生下宣宗长子明英宗，为宣宗废黜胡善祥提供了借口。
description.en: Consort Sun giving birth to the Xuande Emperor's eldest son, Emperor Yingzong, provided a pretext for the emperor to depose Empress Hu.

description.zh-cn: 在宣宗废后事件中，胡善祥被废黜皇后之位，退居长安宫修道，成为静慈仙师。
description.en: During the event of the emperor's deposition of the empress, Hu Shanxiang was stripped of her title, retired to Chang'an Palace to practice Taoism, and became Jingci Xianshi.

description.zh-cn: 怜悯贤德的胡氏，常召其居住清宁宫，并在内廷朝宴时将其座席安排在孙皇后之上。
description.en: She sympathized with the virtuous Hu, often inviting her to live in Qingning Palace and arranging her seat above Empress Sun during court banquets.

description.zh-cn: 为胡善祥追上尊谥“恭让诚顺康穆静慈章皇后”，并修陵寝，恢复其皇后名分。
description.en: Posthumously honored Hu Shanxiang with the title 'Empress Gongrang Chengshun Kangmu Jingci Zhang', restored her tomb, and reinstated her status as empress.

description.zh-cn: 向明英宗为胡善祥请命，请求恢复其皇后位份。
description.en: She petitioned Emperor Yingzong on behalf of Hu Shanxiang, requesting the restoration of her title as empress.

description.zh-cn: 支持明英宗恢复胡善祥的皇后名位，并建议按制度为其修陵寝、享殿、神主。
description.en: He supported Emperor Yingzong in restoring Hu Shanxiang's title of empress and advised that her mausoleum, memorial hall, and spirit tablet be built according to protocol.

description.zh-cn: 白韵琹自1989年起与谢伟俊同居，并于1997年结婚。她曾公开表示两人关系为有名无实，并曾遭对方殴打。
description.en: Pamela Peck began living with Paul Tse in 1989 and they married in 1997. She has publicly stated that their relationship was in name only and that he had physically assaulted her.

description.zh-cn: 白韵琹是白崇禧的堂妹。
description.en: Pamela Peck is Bai Chongxi's paternal cousin.

description.zh-cn: 在2011年香港区议会选举中，白韵琹击败时任区议员麦国风，使其未能连任。
description.en: In the 2011 Hong Kong District Council election, Pamela Peck defeated incumbent District Councillor Mak Kwok-fung, preventing his re-election.

description.zh-cn: 白韵琹曾与萧若元交往，两人于1983年分手。
description.en: Pamela Peck was in a relationship with Stephen Shiu; they broke up in 1983.

description.zh-cn: 在白韵琹与萧若元于1983年分手后，黄沾在报章上为白韵琹抱不平而辱骂萧若元。
description.en: After Pamela Peck and Stephen Shiu broke up in 1983, James Wong defended Peck by scolding Shiu in the newspapers.

description.zh-cn: 因黄沾在其与白韵琹分手后于报章上辱骂他，萧若元买凶殴打黄沾。
description.en: Because James Wong scolded him in the newspapers after his breakup with Pamela Peck, Stephen Shiu hired thugs to assault Wong.

description.zh-cn: 邓家争产事件爆发后，白韵琹因公开发表支持洪金梅的言论而卷入骂战与诽谤官司。
description.en: After the Tang family property dispute broke out, Pamela Peck became embroiled in public quarrels and a defamation lawsuit for her public statements supporting Hung Kam-mui.

description.zh-cn: 在1997年邓家争产事件中，白韵琹在电台节目中出言支持洪金梅。
description.en: During the Tang family property dispute in 1997, Pamela Peck voiced support for Hung Kam-mui on her radio program.

description.zh-cn: 在1997年邓家争产事件中，白韵琹公开指责新马师曾“浪得虚名”，并批评其子女不孝。
description.en: During the Tang family property dispute in 1997, Pamela Peck publicly accused Sun Ma Sze Tsang of having an undeserved reputation and criticized his children for being unfilial.

description.zh-cn: 因在邓家争产事件上的立场不同，白韵琹与主持人雷宇扬在电台节目中展开骂战。
description.en: Due to differing stances on the Tang family property dispute, Pamela Peck engaged in a public quarrel with host Simon Lui on a radio program.

description.zh-cn: 2004年黄沾离世后，白韵琹与林燕妮爆发骂战。
description.en: After James Wong's death in 2004, Pamela Peck had a public quarrel with Eunice Lam.

description.zh-cn: 黄毓民入禀法院控告白韵琹诽谤。
description.en: Wong Yuk-man filed a lawsuit against Pamela Peck for defamation.

description.zh-cn: 在2010年香港立法会补选中，白韵琹参选以狙击同区候选人黄毓民。
description.en: In the 2010 Hong Kong legislative by-election, Pamela Peck ran to challenge fellow candidate Wong Yuk-man.

description.zh-cn: 在2012年香港立法会选举中，白韵琹参选分薄了同属建制派的刘江华的选票，导致其落选。
description.en: In the 2012 Hong Kong Legislative Council election, Pamela Peck's candidacy split the vote of the pro-establishment camp, leading to the defeat of Lau Kong-wah.

description.zh-cn: 2001年，白韵琹因四项签署虚假利得税报税表的控罪罪名成立，被判入狱3个月及罚款20万元。
description.en: In 2001, Pamela Peck was convicted on four counts of signing false profits tax returns and was sentenced to 3 months in prison and a fine of HK$200,000.

description.zh-cn: 张仪是鬼谷子的徒弟。
description.en: Zhang Yi was a disciple of Guiguzi.

description.zh-cn: 与苏秦同为鬼谷子门下。根据《史记》记载，苏秦曾用计助张仪入秦，但据马王堆出土的《战国纵横家书》，二人活跃时期不同。
description.en: He was a fellow student of Su Qin under Guiguzi. According to the 'Records of the Grand Historian', Su Qin once maneuvered to help Zhang Yi enter the service of Qin, but according to the 'Warring States Vertical and Horizontal Alliances Texts' unearthed at Mawangdui, their active periods did not align.

description.zh-cn: 张仪的连横策略与公孙衍的合纵策略相对立，两人是战国中期的主要政治对手。
description.en: Zhang Yi's 'Lianheng' strategy was in direct opposition to Gongsun Yan's 'Hezong' strategy, making them major political rivals in the mid-Warring States period.

description.zh-cn: 秦武王向来与张仪不和，其即位后，张仪于公元前310年离开秦国。
description.en: King Wu of Qin had long-standing animosity towards Zhang Yi. After King Wu's accession, Zhang Yi left Qin in 310 BC.

description.zh-cn: 公元前322年，张仪担任魏国相国。
description.en: In 322 BC, Zhang Yi served as the chancellor of the State of Wei.

description.zh-cn: 公元前319年，魏国将张仪驱逐回秦国。
description.en: In 319 BC, the State of Wei expelled Zhang Yi, forcing him to return to Qin.

description.zh-cn: 张仪早年曾任楚国相国昭阳的门下客。
description.en: In his early years, Zhang Yi served as a retainer to Zhao Yang, the chancellor of Chu.

description.zh-cn: 因怀疑张仪偷窃和氏璧，昭阳的下人将张仪殴打数百下。
description.en: Suspecting Zhang Yi of stealing the He Shi Bi (a famous jade disc), Zhao Yang's servants had him beaten several hundred times.

description.zh-cn: 公元前313年，张仪担任楚国相国。
description.en: In 313 BC, Zhang Yi served as the chancellor of the State of Chu.

description.zh-cn: 张仪以割让商於六百里土地为诱饵，欺骗楚怀王与齐国断交。
description.en: Zhang Yi deceived King Huai of Chu into breaking his alliance with Qi by falsely promising to cede six hundred li of territory in Shangyu.

description.zh-cn: 张仪是连横策略的主要倡导者和执行者。
description.en: Zhang Yi was the primary advocate and executor of the 'Lianheng' (Horizontal Alliance) strategy.

description.zh-cn: 通过游说各国，多次瓦解公孙衍等人组织的合纵抗秦联盟。
description.en: By persuading various states, he repeatedly dismantled the 'Hezong' (Vertical Alliance) anti-Qin coalitions organized by Gongsun Yan and others.

description.zh-cn: 苏秦是鬼谷子的徒弟。
description.en: Su Qin was a disciple of Guiguzi.

description.zh-cn: 公孙衍是合纵策略的主要倡导者之一，与张仪的连横策略对抗。
description.en: Gongsun Yan was one of the main proponents of the 'Hezong' (Vertical Alliance) strategy, opposing Zhang Yi's 'Lianheng' strategy.

description.zh-cn: 公元前319年，公孙衍由魏将升任魏相邦，并发起函谷关之战，联合五国攻秦。
description.en: In 319 BC, Gongsun Yan was promoted from a general to the chancellor of Wei and initiated the Battle of Hangu Pass, leading a coalition of five states to attack Qin.

description.zh-cn: 于天汉元年（917年）正月，追封张仪为昌化王。
description.en: In the first month of the Tianhan era (917 AD), he posthumously ennobled Zhang Yi as the Prince of Changhua.

description.zh-cn: 景春曾称赞张仪为“一怒而诸侯惧，安居而天下熄”的大丈夫。
description.en: Jing Chun once praised Zhang Yi as a great man of whom it was said, 'When he is angry, all the princes are afraid. When he is quiet, the fire of war is extinguished throughout the empire.'

description.zh-cn: 景春是孟子的弟子。
description.en: Jing Chun was a disciple of Mencius.

description.zh-cn: 马丁·路德·金与拉尔夫·阿伯内西等人共同创建了南方基督教领袖会议。
description.en: Martin Luther King Jr., along with Ralph Abernathy and others, co-founded the Southern Christian Leadership Conference.

description.zh-cn: 拉尔夫·阿伯内西与马丁·路德·金等人共同创建了南方基督教领袖会议。
description.en: Ralph Abernathy, along with Martin Luther King Jr. and others, co-founded the Southern Christian Leadership Conference.

description.zh-cn: 马丁·路德·金领导了持续385天的联合抵制蒙哥马利公车运动。
description.en: Martin Luther King Jr. led the Montgomery bus boycott, which lasted for 385 days.

description.zh-cn: 罗莎·帕克斯因拒绝在公车上让座给白人而被捕，此事件直接引发了蒙哥马利公车抵制运动。
description.en: Rosa Parks's arrest for refusing to give up her bus seat to a white man directly triggered the Montgomery bus boycott.

description.zh-cn: 在局长胡佛的指令下，联邦调查局对金进行监视、窃听，并试图通过揭露其私生活和寄送匿名信等方式来胁迫他，以削弱其作为民权领袖的地位。
