description.en: Under Director Hoover's orders, the FBI conducted surveillance, wiretapped King, and attempted to coerce him by exposing his private life and sending an anonymous letter, aiming to neutralize him as a civil rights leader.

description.zh-cn: 作为司法部长，罗伯特·肯尼迪书面授权联邦调查局对马丁·路德·金的电话进行窃听。
description.en: As Attorney General, Robert F. Kennedy gave written authorization for the FBI to wiretap Martin Luther King Jr.

description.zh-cn: 作为“六大”民权领袖之一，马丁·路德·金是此次游行的主要组织者之一，并在集会上发表了《我有一个梦》的著名演讲。
description.en: As one of the 'Big Six' civil rights leaders, King was a key organizer of the march and delivered his famous 'I Have a Dream' speech at the event.

description.zh-cn: 马丁·路德·金在华盛顿大游行上发表了《我有一个梦》的演讲。
description.en: Martin Luther King Jr. delivered the 'I Have a Dream' speech at the March on Washington.

description.zh-cn: 马丁·路德·金公开发表反越战演说，谴责美国政府是“当今世界最大的暴力供应商”。
description.en: Martin Luther King Jr. publicly delivered an anti-Vietnam War speech, denouncing the U.S. government as 'the greatest purveyor of violence in the world today.'

description.zh-cn: 马丁·路德·金在孟菲斯洛林汽车旅馆的阳台上被子弹击中，不治身亡。
description.en: Martin Luther King Jr. was fatally shot on the balcony of the Lorraine Motel in Memphis.

description.zh-cn: 詹姆斯·厄尔·雷被认定为杀害马丁·路德·金的凶手。
description.en: James Earl Ray was convicted of assassinating Martin Luther King Jr.

description.zh-cn: 甘地的非暴力抵抗哲学深刻影响了马丁·路德·金的民权运动策略。
description.en: Gandhi's philosophy of nonviolent resistance profoundly influenced Martin Luther King Jr.'s strategy for the Civil Rights Movement.

description.zh-cn: 马丁·路德·金和南方基督教领袖会议在伯明翰发起了一场抵制种族隔离和经济不公正的抗议运动。
description.en: Martin Luther King Jr. and the SCLC initiated a campaign in Birmingham against racial segregation and economic injustice.

description.zh-cn: 在伯明翰运动期间被捕入狱时，金撰写了《伯明翰狱中书信》。
description.en: While incarcerated during the Birmingham campaign, King wrote the 'Letter from Birmingham Jail'.

description.zh-cn: 华盛顿大游行，特别是金的演讲，使民权运动成为美国改革家的首要议题，并推动了1964年《民权法案》的通过。
description.en: The March on Washington, and particularly King's speech, made civil rights a top issue for American reformers and facilitated the passage of the Civil Rights Act of 1964.

description.zh-cn: 拉尔夫·阿伯内西是马丁·路德·金的亲密朋友、同事，并在金遇刺后接任南方基督教领袖会议主席。
description.en: Ralph Abernathy was a close friend and colleague of Martin Luther King Jr., succeeding him as president of the SCLC after his assassination.

description.zh-cn: 马丁·路德·金是“非暴力”公民抗命方法的主要倡导者和实践者。
description.en: Martin Luther King Jr. was a leading advocate and practitioner of the method of 'nonviolent' civil disobedience.

description.zh-cn: 刘备与公孙瓒等人一同拜卢植为师学习。
description.en: Liu Bei, along with Gongsun Zan and others, studied under Lu Zhi as his student.

description.zh-cn: 刘备与公孙瓒在卢植门下学习时结为好友，刘备视其为兄长。
description.en: Liu Bei and Gongsun Zan became good friends while studying under Lu Zhi, with Liu Bei treating him as an elder brother.

description.zh-cn: 刘备率领其下属跟随邹靖讨伐黄巾军，并立下战功。
description.en: Liu Bei led his followers to join Zou Jing in suppressing the Yellow Turban rebels, achieving military merit.

description.zh-cn: 因曹操攻打徐州，刘备应陶谦之邀率军救援，后依附于陶谦。
description.en: When Cao Cao attacked Xuzhou, Liu Bei led his troops to reinforce Tao Qian at his request and subsequently served under him.

description.zh-cn: 离开袁绍后，刘备南下荆州投靠刘表，并被委任屯兵新野。
description.en: After leaving Yuan Shao, Liu Bei went south to Jing Province to join Liu Biao, and was assigned to station troops in Xinye.

description.zh-cn: 刘备为寻访人才，三次亲自前往隆中拜访诸葛亮。
description.en: In search of talent, Liu Bei personally visited Zhuge Liang in Longzhong three times.

description.zh-cn: 刘备的诚意打动了诸葛亮，使其同意出山辅佐。
description.en: Liu Bei's sincerity moved Zhuge Liang, who agreed to leave his seclusion to assist him.

description.zh-cn: 刘备应刘璋之邀入蜀，后与刘璋决裂并发动战争，最终夺取益州。
description.en: Liu Bei entered Shu at Liu Zhang's invitation, later broke with him and launched a war, ultimately seizing control of Yi Province.

description.zh-cn: 此战导致刘璋势力覆灭，被迫向刘备投降。
description.en: This war led to the collapse of Liu Zhang's power, forcing him to surrender to Liu Bei.

description.zh-cn: 刘备为夺取战略要地汉中，亲率大军与曹操展开长期战役。
description.en: To capture the strategic region of Hanzhong, Liu Bei personally led a large army in a prolonged campaign against Cao Cao.

description.zh-cn: 夺取汉中后，刘备在群臣的联名上表下自立为汉中王。
description.en: After conquering Hanzhong, Liu Bei declared himself King of Hanzhong following a joint petition from his followers.

description.zh-cn: 在关羽北伐期间，孙权背弃盟约，派吕蒙率军偷袭荆州。此举导致关羽兵败，最终被捕杀。
description.en: During Guan Yu's northern campaign, Sun Quan broke the alliance and dispatched Lü Meng to lead troops in a surprise attack on Jing Province. This led to Guan Yu's defeat and ultimate capture and execution.

description.zh-cn: 为报复孙权偷袭荆州、杀害关羽并夺回荆州，刘备不顾劝阻，执意于222年发兵讨伐东吴，引发著名的夷陵之战。
description.en: To avenge Sun Quan's surprise attack on Jing Province, the killing of Guan Yu, and to retake Jing Province, Liu Bei, against advice, insisted on launching a military campaign against Eastern Wu in 222, which led to the famous Battle of Yiling.

description.zh-cn: 在夷陵之战中，东吴都督陆逊采取以逸待劳的策略，指挥吴军以火烧连营之计大破刘备的蜀军，并迫使其退守白帝城。
description.en: In the Battle of Yiling, Eastern Wu commander Lu Xun adopted a strategy of wearing down the enemy, commanding the Wu forces to decisively defeat Liu Bei's Shu army with the 'fire on interconnected camps' tactic, forcing him to retreat to Baidicheng.

description.zh-cn: 刘备是刘弘的儿子。
description.en: Liu Bei is the son of Liu Hong.

description.zh-cn: 陈云被认为是1980年代保守派的代表人物。
description.en: Chen Yun is considered a representative figure of the conservative faction in the 1980s.

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来被认为是保守派人物。
description.en: Bo Xilai is considered a conservative figure.

description.zh-cn: 保守派主张修复文革破坏前的计划经济体制。
description.en: The conservative faction advocated for restoring the planned economy system that existed before the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 保守派在姓社姓资争论中反对大幅度市场化。
description.en: The conservative faction opposed large-scale marketization during the 'Socialism or Capitalism' debate.

description.zh-cn: 改革派支持市场经济。
description.en: The reformist faction supports a market economy.

description.zh-cn: 改革派支持自由民主与政治体制改革。
description.en: The reformist faction supports liberal democracy and political system reform.

description.zh-cn: 保守派在1980年代早期主张“反对精神污染”。
description.en: The conservative faction advocated for the 'Anti-Spiritual Pollution Campaign' in the early 1980s.

description.zh-cn: 保守派在1980年代中期主张“反对资产阶级自由化”。
description.en: The conservative faction advocated for the 'Campaign against Bourgeois Liberalization' in the mid-1980s.

description.zh-cn: 因对胡耀邦在八六学潮中过于软弱不满，保守派促使其下台。
description.en: Dissatisfied with Hu Yaobang's perceived weakness in handling the 1986 student protests, the conservative faction contributed to his downfall.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平南巡讲话后，重新确立改革开放大趋势，保守派势力大减。
description.en: After Deng Xiaoping's southern tour speeches, the trend of reform and opening-up was re-established, and the influence of the conservative faction was greatly diminished.

description.zh-cn: 中共十四大确立了社会主义市场经济的改革目标。
description.en: The 14th National Congress of the CPC established the reform goal of a socialist market economy.

description.zh-cn: 中共保守派指戈尔巴乔夫是苏联解体、苏共崩溃的罪魁祸首。
description.en: CCP conservatives blamed Mikhail Gorbachev as the main culprit for the dissolution of the Soviet Union and the collapse of the CPSU.

description.zh-cn: 因《炎黄春秋》多次刊登涉及赵紫阳的文章，江泽民要求对其进行严肃处置。
description.en: Because 'Yanhuang Chunqiu' repeatedly published articles concerning Zhao Ziyang, Jiang Zemin demanded that it be dealt with sternly.

description.zh-cn: 在江泽民施压处理《炎黄春秋》时，胡锦涛进行了干预，使其社长得以留任。
description.en: When Jiang Zemin pressured for action against 'Yanhuang Chunqiu', Hu Jintao intervened, allowing its publisher to remain in his position.

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来事件后，支持他的保守派网站乌有之乡被关闭。
description.en: After the Bo Xilai incident, the conservative website 'Utopia', which supported him, was shut down.

description.zh-cn: 这份要求抵制西方思想的内部文件，反映了习近平执政初期的保守政治路线。
description.en: This internal document, calling for resistance against Western ideas, reflected Xi Jinping's conservative political line in his early tenure.

description.zh-cn: 因批评习近平的“独裁统治”，原中共中央党校教授蔡霞被开除党籍。
description.en: For criticizing Xi Jinping's 'dictatorial rule', former Central Party School professor Cai Xia was expelled from the party.

description.zh-cn: 因反对习近平的统治，商人任志强被开除党籍并判刑。
description.en: For opposing Xi Jinping's rule, businessman Ren Zhiqiang was expelled from the party and sentenced to prison.

description.zh-cn: 习近平在中共二十大上获得第三个总书记任期，全面巩固了其领导地位。
description.en: Xi Jinping secured a third term as General Secretary at the 20th National Congress of the CPC, fully consolidating his leadership position.

position.en: President; Chairman of the State Council

description.zh-cn: 李承晚曾先后担任大韩民国临时政府的首任总统和末任国务委员会主席。
description.en: Syngman Rhee served as the first president and the last Chairman of the State Council of the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 李承晚辞职后，由许政代理总统职务。
description.en: After Syngman Rhee's resignation, Heo Jeong served as acting president.

description.zh-cn: 尹潽善是李承晚的正式继任者，成为第四任韩国总统。
description.en: Yun Po-sun was the official successor to Syngman Rhee, becoming the fourth President of South Korea.

description.zh-cn: 李承晚于1951年创立自由党并自任总裁。
description.en: Syngman Rhee founded the Liberal Party in 1951 and served as its president.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜战争在李承晚的总统任期内爆发，深刻影响了他的执政和韩国的命运。
description.en: The Korean War broke out during Syngman Rhee's presidency, profoundly affecting his administration and the fate of South Korea.

description.zh-cn: 李承晚受到徐载弼的影响，加入了其创办的独立协会。
description.en: Influenced by Seo Jae-pil, Syngman Rhee joined the Independence Club that Seo founded.

description.zh-cn: 独立协会被朝鲜高宗下令解散。
description.en: The Independence Club was ordered to be disbanded by Emperor Gojong.

description.zh-cn: 李承晚为游说美国维护韩国独立而与时任美国总统罗斯福会面，但未获支持。
description.en: Syngman Rhee met with then-U.S. President Theodore Roosevelt to lobby for the maintenance of Korean independence, but did not receive support.

description.zh-cn: 在大韩民国临时政府内部，李承晚与李东辉等人在实现韩国独立的手段上存在严重分歧，导致后者脱离临时政府。
description.en: Within the Provisional Government, Syngman Rhee had serious disagreements with Yi Dong-hwi and others over the means to achieve Korean independence, leading to the latter's departure from the government.

description.zh-cn: 在大韩民国临时政府内部，李承晚与安昌浩等人在实现韩国独立的手段上存在严重分歧，导致后者脱离临时政府。
description.en: Within the Provisional Government, Syngman Rhee had serious disagreements with An Changho and others over the means to achieve Korean independence, leading to the latter's departure from the government.

description.zh-cn: 李承晚因在著作《日本内幕记》中成功预告太平洋战争的爆发，在珍珠港事件后成为美国知名人物。
description.en: After successfully predicting the outbreak of the Pacific War in his book 'Japan Inside Out', Syngman Rhee became a well-known figure in the United States after the attack on Pearl Harbor.

description.zh-cn: 韩国民主党在1948年支持李承晚当选韩国首位总统。
description.en: The Korea Democratic Party supported Syngman Rhee's election as the first president of South Korea in 1948.

description.zh-cn: 李承晚当选总统后，为打压韩国民主党，没有提名其党首金性洙为国务总理。1952年，金性洙被迫辞去副总统职务。
description.en: After being elected president, Syngman Rhee, in an effort to suppress the Korea Democratic Party, did not nominate its leader Kim Seong-su as Prime Minister. In 1952, Kim was forced to resign from the vice presidency.

description.zh-cn: 李承晚政府通过了《国家保安法》，该法后成为其镇压左派政敌的工具。
description.en: The Syngman Rhee government passed the National Security Act, which later became a tool for suppressing his left-wing political opponents.

description.zh-cn: 自由党在1960年总统大选中的大规模舞弊行为是引发四·一九运动的直接导火索。
description.en: Widespread fraud by the Liberal Party in the 1960 presidential election was the direct trigger for the April Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 四·一九运动导致李承晚下台，标志着第一共和国的结束。
description.en: The April Revolution led to the resignation of Syngman Rhee, marking the end of the First Republic.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜战争停战后，李承晚政府与美国签署了《韩美共同防御条约》，确立了军事同盟关系。
description.en: After the Korean War armistice, the Syngman Rhee government signed the Mutual Defense Treaty with the United States, establishing a military alliance.

description.zh-cn: 李承晚执政期间对日本采取强硬态度，未建立外交关系，并划定“李承晚线”引发渔业争端。
description.en: During his rule, Syngman Rhee adopted a hardline stance against Japan, did not establish diplomatic relations, and created the 'Syngman Rhee Line,' which sparked fishing disputes.

description.zh-cn: 1953年访日期间，李承晚与时任日本首相吉田茂会面。
description.en: During his visit to Japan in 1953, Syngman Rhee met with then-Prime Minister of Japan, Shigeru Yoshida.

description.zh-cn: 申性模在李承晚政府中担任国防部长官。
description.en: Shin Sung-mo served as the Minister of National Defense in the Syngman Rhee government.

description.zh-cn: 文在寅于1972年考入庆熙大学法学系，并于1980年毕业。
description.en: Moon Jae-in entered the law school of Kyung Hee University in 1972 and graduated in 1980.

description.zh-cn: 文在寅自1982年起与卢武铉合作开设律师事务所，成为其一生的挚友和政治伙伴。
description.en: Starting in 1982, Moon Jae-in partnered with Roh Moo-hyun to open a law firm, becoming his lifelong close friend and political partner.

description.zh-cn: 在卢武铉总统任期内，文在寅担任总统秘书室长。
description.en: Moon Jae-in served as Chief Presidential Secretary during President Roh Moo-hyun's term.

description.zh-cn: 李洛渊在文在寅政府担任国务总理。
description.en: Lee Nak-yon served as Prime Minister under the Moon Jae-in government.

description.zh-cn: 丁世均在文在寅政府担任国务总理。
description.en: Chung Sye-kyun served as Prime Minister under the Moon Jae-in government.

description.zh-cn: 金富谦在文在寅政府担任国务总理。
description.en: Kim Boo-kyum served as Prime Minister under the Moon Jae-in government.

description.zh-cn: 文在寅是朴槿惠的主要政治对手，曾在2012年总统选举中败给朴槿惠，后在2017年朴槿惠被弹劾后当选总统。朴槿惠政府曾将文在寅列入政治黑名单。
description.en: Moon Jae-in was a major political rival to Park Geun-hye. He lost to her in the 2012 presidential election but was elected in 2017 after Park's impeachment. Park's government had placed Moon on a political blacklist.

description.zh-cn: 文在寅卸任后参加了继任者尹锡悦的总统就职典礼。
description.en: After leaving office, Moon Jae-in attended the presidential inauguration of his successor, Yoon Suk-yeol.

description.zh-cn: 尹锡悦就任总统后，韩国检方对文在寅前政府展开了多项调查，被文在寅方面认为是政治报复。
description.en: After Yoon Suk-yeol took office, South Korean prosecutors launched several investigations into the former Moon Jae-in administration, which Moon's side considered political retaliation.

description.zh-cn: 文在寅自2015年起为共同民主党党员，并于2015年至2016年间担任党代表。
description.en: Moon Jae-in has been a member of the Democratic Party since 2015 and served as its leader from 2015 to 2016.

description.zh-cn: 文在寅在韩国陆军特战司令部服役时，全斗焕是其所属的第1空降特战旅的旅长。
description.en: When Moon Jae-in served in the ROK Army Special Warfare Command, Chun Doo-hwan was the commander of his unit, the 1st Special Forces Brigade.

description.zh-cn: 文在寅在韩国陆军特战司令部服役时，张世东是其所属的第3营的营长。
description.en: When Moon Jae-in served in the ROK Army Special Warfare Command, Jang Se-dong was the commander of his unit, the 3rd Battalion.

description.zh-cn: 1975年，文在寅因参与反对时任总统朴正熙的维新宪法抗议活动而被捕入狱。
description.en: In 1975, Moon Jae-in was arrested and imprisoned for participating in protests against the Yushin Constitution of then-President Park Chung-hee.

description.zh-cn: 文在寅访问白宫并与时任美国总统唐纳·川普会面。
description.en: Moon Jae-in visited the White House and met with then-U.S. President Donald Trump.

description.zh-cn: 在2017年总统选举的电视辩论中，作为候选人的洪准杓与文在寅就同性恋等议题进行了激烈交锋。
description.en: In a televised debate during the 2017 presidential election, candidate Hong Joon-pyo clashed with Moon Jae-in on issues such as homosexuality.

description.zh-cn: 文在寅曾代表民主统合党参加2012年总统选举。
description.en: Moon Jae-in represented the Democratic United Party in the 2012 presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯当选为首任中华民国大总统，象征着北洋政府的正式成立。
description.en: Yuan Shikai's election as the first President of the Republic of China symbolized the formal establishment of the Beiyang government.

description.zh-cn: 张学良宣布服从国民政府，标志着北洋政府正式退出历史舞台。
description.en: Zhang Xueliang's announcement of allegiance to the Nationalist Government marked the official exit of the Beiyang government from the stage of history.

description.zh-cn: 日本军队在皇姑屯策划并实施了针对张作霖的爆炸暗杀。
description.en: The Japanese military planned and executed the bombing assassination targeting Zhang Zuolin at Huanggutun.

description.zh-cn: 孙文领导的中华革命党参与了围剿袁世凯帝制的行动。
description.en: The Chinese Revolutionary Party, led by Sun Yat-sen, participated in the campaign against Yuan Shikai's monarchy.

description.zh-cn: 五四运动因抗议巴黎和会对山东问题的处理而爆发，通过全国性的罢课、罢工、罢市，向北洋政府施加了巨大压力。运动迫使北洋政府罢免了三名亲日官员，并最终导致其代表未在《凡尔赛条约》上签字。
description.en: The May Fourth Movement erupted in protest against the handling of the Shandong Problem at the Paris Peace Conference. Through nationwide student strikes, labor strikes, and business shutdowns, it exerted immense pressure on the Beiyang government, forcing it to dismiss three pro-Japanese officials and ultimately leading to its representatives not signing the Treaty of Versailles.

description.zh-cn: 孙中山多次公开批评北洋政府为官僚武人所把持的“假民国”，认为其未能实现革命目的。
description.en: Sun Yat-sen repeatedly and publicly criticized the Beiyang government as a 'fake republic' controlled by bureaucrats and militarists, believing it failed to achieve revolutionary goals.

description.zh-cn: 在府院之争中，总统黎元洪请督军张勋入京调解，直接酿成了张勋复辟事件。
description.en: During the conflict between the Presidential Palace and the State Council, President Li Yuanhong invited warlord Zhang Xun to Beijing to mediate, which directly led to the Zhang Xun Restoration.

description.zh-cn: 在府院之争中，大总统黎元洪解除了段祺瑞的国务总理职务。
description.en: During the conflict between the Presidential Palace and the State Council, President Li Yuanhong dismissed Duan Qirui from his position as Premier.

description.zh-cn: 1943年12月赴延安入中共中央党校学习。
description.en: Went to Yan'an in December 1943 to study at the Party School of the Central Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 1925年12月由中国共产主义青年团团员转为中国共产党党员。
description.en: Transferred from a member of the Communist Youth League of China to a member of the Communist Party of China in December 1925.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争期间，创建牺牲救国同盟会，并参与领导工作。
description.en: During the Second Sino-Japanese War, he founded the Sacrifice for National Salvation League and participated in its leadership.

description.zh-cn: 阎锡山发动晋西事变，意图消灭由薄一波创建的山西新军。
description.en: Yan Xishan launched the Jinxi Incident in an attempt to eliminate the Shanxi New Army founded by Bo Yibo.

description.zh-cn: 1941年1月，薄一波任八路军太岳军区司令员兼政治委员。
description.en: In January 1941, Bo Yibo served as commander and political commissar of the Taiyue Military Region of the Eighth Route Army.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立后，薄一波出任首任中央人民政府财政部部长。
description.en: After the founding of the People's Republic of China, Bo Yibo became the first Minister of Finance of the Central People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 1956年5月，国家经济委员会成立，薄一波任主任。
description.en: In May 1956, the State Economic Commission was established, and Bo Yibo was appointed as its director.

description.zh-cn: 薄一波曾两度担任中华人民共和国国务院副总理。
description.en: Bo Yibo served twice as Vice Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 薄一波担任中顾委常务副主任，主持日常工作。
description.en: Bo Yibo served as the Executive Deputy Director of the Central Advisory Commission, presiding over its daily work.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平与薄一波共同主持起草了旨在调整工业政策的“工业七十条”。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping and Bo Yibo jointly presided over the drafting of the 'Seventy Articles on Industry' aimed at adjusting industrial policy.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，薄一波因“六十一人叛徒集团案”被诬陷打倒，并遭到迫害。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Bo Yibo was falsely accused, overthrown, and persecuted in connection with the 'Case of 61 Renegades'.

description.zh-cn: 薄一波的妻子胡明在被批斗送押期间服安眠药自杀。
description.en: Bo Yibo's wife, Hu Ming, committed suicide by taking sleeping pills while being detained and subjected to struggle sessions.

description.zh-cn: 1978年12月，胡耀邦主持为薄一波彻底平反，恢复了其名誉。
description.en: In December 1978, Hu Yaobang presided over the complete rehabilitation of Bo Yibo, restoring his reputation.

description.zh-cn: 八六学潮被中共元老归咎于胡耀邦的纵容，成为其下台的直接原因。
description.en: The 1986 student protests were blamed by CCP elders on Hu Yaobang's indulgence, becoming the direct cause of his downfall.

description.zh-cn: 与薄一波等中共元老一同商议并推动了胡耀邦的去职。
description.en: Along with Bo Yibo and other CCP elders, discussed and promoted the removal of Hu Yaobang from his post.

description.zh-cn: 在1989年六四天安门事件前夕，薄一波向邓小平提出要采取果断措施，并参加了决定对北京实施戒严的会议。
description.en: On the eve of the 1989 Tiananmen Square incident, Bo Yibo proposed to Deng Xiaoping to take decisive measures and attended the meeting that decided to impose martial law in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 经刘少奇领导的中共中央北方局建议，薄一波于1936年得以出狱。
description.en: Following a proposal from the CCP Central Committee's Northern Bureau led by Liu Shaoqi, Bo Yibo was released from prison in 1936.

description.zh-cn: 于凤至是张学良的原配妻子，两人于1916年结婚，1964年在蒋介石的压力下被迫离婚。
description.en: Yu Fengzhi was Zhang Xueliang's first wife. They married in 1916 and were forced to divorce in 1964 under pressure from Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: 于凤至出生于怀德县大泉眼村。
description.en: Yu Fengzhi was born in Daquanyan Village, Huaide County.

description.zh-cn: 于凤至起初不接纳赵一荻，后因赵的真诚和才智而对其产生好感，两人关系亲如姐妹。
description.en: Yu Fengzhi initially did not accept Zhao Yidi, but later grew fond of her due to her sincerity and intelligence, and their relationship became like that of sisters.

description.zh-cn: 日军策划并实施了皇姑屯事件，旨在暗杀张作霖。
description.en: The Japanese Army planned and executed the Huanggutun Incident to assassinate Zhang Zuolin.

description.zh-cn: 在皇姑屯事件后，于凤至秘不发丧，巧妙周旋，帮助张学良顺利继承了在东北的军政大权。
description.en: After the Huanggutun Incident, Yu Fengzhi concealed the news of Zhang Zuolin's death and skillfully maneuvered, helping Zhang Xueliang smoothly inherit military and political power in the Northeast.

description.zh-cn: 为了稳固军权、争夺大权，张学良于1929年1月10日派高纪毅将奉系旧派代表杨宇霆秘密处决于元帅府“老虎厅”。
description.en: To consolidate his military power and due to a power struggle, Zhang Xueliang ordered Gao Jiyi to secretly execute Yang Yuting, a representative of the old guard of the Fengtian clique, at the 'Tiger Hall' of the Marshal's Mansion on January 10, 1929.

description.zh-cn: 为了稳固军权，张学良于1929年1月10日将奉系旧派代表常荫槐与杨宇霆一同秘密处决。
description.en: To consolidate his military power, Zhang Xueliang secretly executed Chang Yinhuai, a representative of the old guard of the Fengtian clique, along with Yang Yuting on January 10, 1929.

description.zh-cn: 在张学良犹豫是否处置杨宇霆、常荫槐时，于凤至的意见使其下定决心处决二人。
description.en: When Zhang Xueliang hesitated whether to deal with Yang Yuting and Chang Yinhuai, Yu Fengzhi's opinion made him decide to execute them.

description.zh-cn: 于凤至于1930年与宋美龄会面，后结下姐妹情意。
description.en: Yu Fengzhi met Soong Mei-ling in 1930, and they later formed a sisterly bond.

description.zh-cn: 于凤至拜宋美龄之母倪桂珍为干娘。
description.en: Yu Fengzhi acknowledged Ni Guizhen, Soong Mei-ling's mother, as her godmother.

description.zh-cn: 1933年，于凤至随丈夫张学良出访意大利时会见了墨索里尼。
description.en: In 1933, Yu Fengzhi met Mussolini while visiting Italy with her husband Zhang Xueliang.

description.zh-cn: 以张学良皈依基督教需遵守一夫一妻制为由，逼迫其与于凤至离婚。
description.en: Using Zhang Xueliang's conversion to Christianity and the doctrine of monogamy as a pretext, he forced him to divorce Yu Fengzhi.

description.zh-cn: 全面入侵标志着始于2014年的俄乌战争的重大升级。
description.en: The full-scale invasion marked a major escalation of the Russo-Ukrainian War that began in 2014.

description.zh-cn: 在经历时长约一年的军事危机后，俄罗斯对乌克兰发动全面入侵。
description.en: After a military crisis lasting about a year, Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯于2022年2月21日承认顿涅茨克人民共和国为独立国家。
description.en: Russia recognized the Donetsk People's Republic as an independent state on February 21, 2022.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯于2022年2月21日承认卢甘斯克人民共和国为独立国家。
description.en: Russia recognized the Luhansk People's Republic as an independent state on February 21, 2022.

description.zh-cn: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基在俄罗斯入侵后宣布与俄罗斯断绝外交关系。
description.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced the severance of diplomatic relations with Russia after the invasion.

description.zh-cn: 联合国大会通过决议，谴责俄罗斯入侵并要求其全面撤军。
description.en: The UN General Assembly passed a resolution condemning the Russian invasion and demanding a full withdrawal of its forces.

description.zh-cn: 国际法院裁定俄罗斯“必须立即停止军事行动”。
description.en: The International Court of Justice ruled that Russia "must immediately cease military operations."

description.zh-cn: 国际刑事法院以涉嫌非法将乌克兰儿童驱逐至俄罗斯的战争罪行为由，向俄罗斯总统普京发出逮捕令。
description.en: The International Criminal Court issued an arrest warrant for Russian President Vladimir Putin on charges of war crimes related to the unlawful deportation of Ukrainian children to Russia.

description.zh-cn: 2022年9月起，乌克兰发起反攻行动，先后夺回大片土地。
description.en: Starting from September 2022, Ukraine launched a counteroffensive, successively recapturing large areas of land.

description.zh-cn: 2022年9月起，乌克兰发起反攻行动，最终解放赫尔松市。
description.en: Starting from September 2022, Ukraine launched a counteroffensive, eventually liberating the city of Kherson.

description.zh-cn: 由俄罗斯实际控制的顿涅茨克、卢甘斯克、赫尔松和扎波罗热宣布将于9月23日至27日举行加入俄罗斯联邦的公投。
description.en: The Russian-controlled areas of Donetsk, Luhansk, Kherson, and Zaporizhzhia announced referendums on joining the Russian Federation to be held from September 23 to 27.

description.zh-cn: 在有争议的公投后，俄罗斯于9月30日正式将乌东四州并入其领土。
description.en: Following controversial referendums, Russia formally annexed the four eastern Ukrainian oblasts into its territory on September 30.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯的入侵导致了欧洲自二战以来最大的难民危机。
description.en: The Russian invasion caused the largest refugee crisis in Europe since World War II.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯向北约发出最后通牒，要求永久停止在东欧和乌克兰的任何军事活动，并反对乌克兰和格鲁吉亚加入北约。
description.en: Russia issued an ultimatum to NATO, demanding a permanent halt to any military activities in Eastern Europe and Ukraine, and opposing the membership of Ukraine and Georgia in NATO.

description.zh-cn: 在局势升级之际，美国向乌克兰运送了致命武器和军事训练计划，以提高其抵抗能力。
description.en: As tensions escalated, the United States sent lethal weapons and provided military training programs to Ukraine to enhance its defense capabilities.

description.zh-cn: 经过长期战斗，俄罗斯军队于2024年2月17日全面占领了阿夫迪伊夫卡。
description.en: After a prolonged battle, Russian forces fully captured Avdiivka on February 17, 2024.

description.zh-cn: 乌克兰军队于2024年8月对俄罗斯库尔斯克州发起大规模入侵。
description.en: Ukrainian forces launched a large-scale incursion into Russia's Kursk Oblast in August 2024.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜被指控向俄罗斯提供武器及派遣士兵以支持其在乌克兰的战争。
description.en: North Korea is accused of supplying weapons and sending soldiers to Russia to support its war in Ukraine.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗被指控向俄罗斯提供无人机和弹道导弹。
description.en: Iran is accused of supplying drones and ballistic missiles to Russia.

description.zh-cn: 中国被指控向俄罗斯提供经济支持、武器零组件及其他物资。
description.en: China is accused of providing economic support, weapon components, and other materials to Russia.

description.zh-cn: 1952年起，加州大学成为一个独立的行政系统，伯克利分校是其下属的一个校区。
description.en: Since 1952, the University of California has been an independent administrative system, and Berkeley is one of its campuses.

description.zh-cn: 伯克利是美国大学协会的14个创始会员之一。
description.en: Berkeley is one of the 14 founding members of the Association of American Universities.

description.zh-cn: 伯克利的学生发起了“言论自由运动”，在美国社会产生了深远影响。
description.en: Berkeley students initiated the 'Free Speech Movement', which had a profound impact on American society.

description.zh-cn: 作为伯克利教授发明了回旋加速器。
description.en: As a professor at Berkeley, he invented the cyclotron.

description.zh-cn: 在伯克利发明了回旋加速器。
description.en: Invented the cyclotron at Berkeley.

description.zh-cn: 长期担任伯克利教授，并在此期间领导曼哈顿计划。
description.en: Served as a long-term professor at Berkeley and led the Manhattan Project during this time.

description.zh-cn: 被任命领导曼哈顿计划的科学部门。
description.en: Was appointed to lead the scientific division of the Manhattan Project.

description.zh-cn: 在二战期间承包了美国军方的原子弹研发计划（曼哈顿计划）。
description.en: During World War II, it undertook the U.S. military's atomic bomb development program (the Manhattan Project).

description.zh-cn: 曼哈顿计划是在第二次世界大战期间进行的。
description.en: The Manhattan Project was carried out during World War II.

description.zh-cn: 第97号化学元素“锫（Berkelium）”是以伯克利来命名的。
description.en: The 97th chemical element, Berkelium, is named after Berkeley.

description.zh-cn: 应包括陈省身在内的三名伯克利数学家要求，美国国家数学科学研究所在伯克利建立。
description.en: At the request of three Berkeley mathematicians, including Shiing-Shen Chern, the Mathematical Sciences Research Institute was established at Berkeley.

description.zh-cn: 担任研究所首任主任。
description.en: Served as the first director of the institute.

description.zh-cn: 该研究所在加州大学伯克利分校的校园内建立。
description.en: The institute was established on the campus of the University of California, Berkeley.

description.zh-cn: 两校在学术和体育领域，尤其是在每年秋季举行的“大赛（Big Game）”美式足球赛中，是长期的竞争对手。
description.en: The two universities are long-standing rivals in academics and athletics, especially in the annual 'Big Game' football match held in the fall.

description.zh-cn: 四一二事件是导致南京国民政府与武汉国民政府对立（宁汉分裂）的直接原因。
description.en: The April 12th Incident was the direct cause of the confrontation between the Nanjing Nationalist Government and the Wuhan Nationalist Government (Nanjing-Wuhan split).

description.zh-cn: 四一二事件期间，蒋介石下令解散了上海特别市临时政府。
description.en: During the April 12th Incident, Chiang Kai-shek ordered the dissolution of the Shanghai Special Municipality Provisional Government.

description.zh-cn: 四一二事件期间，蒋介石下令解散了上海市总工会。
description.en: During the April 12th Incident, Chiang Kai-shek ordered the dissolution of the Shanghai General Labor Union.

description.zh-cn: 四一二事件是对中国共产党党员及其支持者的大规模搜捕与处决。
description.en: The April 12th Incident was a large-scale roundup and execution of Chinese Communist Party members and their supporters.

description.zh-cn: 以蒋介石为首的国民党右派（清共派）在1927年发动了针对中国共产党的清剿行动。
description.en: The KMT right-wing (pro-purge faction), led by Chiang Kai-shek, launched a campaign to eliminate the Chinese Communist Party in 1927.

description.zh-cn: 在讨论分共问题的会议上，吴稚晖因汪精卫的容共态度而对其激烈批评乃至辱骂。
description.en: During a meeting to discuss the purge of communists, Wu Zhihui fiercely criticized and even insulted Wang Jingwei for his accommodating stance.

description.zh-cn: 上海总工会委员长汪寿华在四一二事件后被杀害。
description.en: Wang Shouhua, chairman of the Shanghai General Labor Union, was killed after the April 12th Incident.

description.zh-cn: 中共早期领导人陈延年在四一二事件后被杀害。
description.en: Chen Yannian, an early leader of the CCP, was killed after the April 12th Incident.

description.zh-cn: 中共早期领导人赵世炎在四一二事件后被杀害。
description.en: Zhao Shiyan, an early leader of the CCP, was killed after the April 12th Incident.

description.zh-cn: 1927年3月6日，国民党党代表倪弼枪杀了赣州总工会委员长陈赞贤。
description.en: On March 6, 1927, KMT representative Ni Bi shot and killed Chen Zanxian, the chairman of the Ganzhou General Labor Union.

description.zh-cn: 1927年4月6日，张作霖的军警搜查了苏联驻北京大使馆，查获了苏联和共产国际企图赤化中国的文件。
description.en: On April 6, 1927, Zhang Zuolin's military police raided the Soviet embassy in Beijing and seized documents detailing Soviet and Comintern plots to communize China.

description.zh-cn: 杨虎是青帮的领袖之一，在清党中扮演了关键的联络和组织角色。
description.en: Yang Hu was a leader of the Green Gang and played a key liaison and organizational role in the party purge.

description.zh-cn: 1927年4月14日，李济深在广州主持会议决定“清共”，直接导致了次日的广州四一五事件。
description.en: On April 14, 1927, Li Jishen presided over a meeting in Guangzhou that decided to "purge the communists," directly leading to the Guangzhou April 15th Incident the following day.

description.zh-cn: 四一二事件后，蒋介石等于4月18日在南京宣布组成南京国民政府。
description.en: Following the April 12th Incident, Chiang Kai-shek and others announced the formation of the Nanjing Nationalist Government in Nanjing on April 18.

description.zh-cn: 南京国民政府成立后，胡汉民出任主席。
description.en: After the establishment of the Nanjing Nationalist Government, Hu Hanmin served as its chairman.

description.zh-cn: 本杰明·富兰克林是宾夕法尼亚大学的创建者。
description.en: Benjamin Franklin was the founder of the University of Pennsylvania.

description.zh-cn: 宾夕法尼亚大学是享誉国际的常春藤盟校之一。
description.en: The University of Pennsylvania is one of the internationally renowned Ivy League schools.

description.zh-cn: 宾夕法尼亚大学是美洲大学协会的12所创始校之一。
description.en: The University of Pennsylvania is one of the 12 founding members of the Association of American Universities.

description.zh-cn: 宾夕法尼亚大学的前身费城学院深受当时苏格兰教育改革的影响。
description.en: The College of Philadelphia, the predecessor to the University of Pennsylvania, was greatly influenced by the Scottish educational reforms of the time.

description.zh-cn: 沃顿商学院是宾夕法尼亚大学下属的大学部学院之一。
description.en: The Wharton School is one of the undergraduate colleges of the University of Pennsylvania.

description.zh-cn: 唐纳德·特朗普是宾夕法尼亚大学的校友。
description.en: Donald Trump is an alumnus of the University of Pennsylvania.

description.zh-cn: 伊隆·马斯克是宾夕法尼亚大学的校友。
description.en: Elon Musk is an alumnus of the University of Pennsylvania.

description.zh-cn: 沃伦·巴菲特是宾夕法尼亚大学的校友。
description.en: Warren Buffett is an alumnus of the University of Pennsylvania.

description.zh-cn: 林徽因是宾夕法尼亚大学的校友。
description.en: Lin Huiyin is an alumna of the University of Pennsylvania.

description.zh-cn: 蒋万安是宾夕法尼亚大学的校友。
description.en: Chiang Wan-an is an alumnus of the University of Pennsylvania.

description.zh-cn: 苏巧慧是宾夕法尼亚大学的校友。
description.en: Su Chiao-hui is an alumna of the University of Pennsylvania.

description.zh-cn: 洪博培是宾夕法尼亚大学的校友。
description.en: Jon Huntsman Jr. is an alumnus of the University of Pennsylvania.

description.zh-cn: 诺姆·乔姆斯基是宾夕法尼亚大学的校友。
description.en: Noam Chomsky is an alumnus of the University of Pennsylvania.

description.zh-cn: 贝聿铭是宾夕法尼亚大学的校友。
description.en: I. M. Pei is an alumnus of the University of Pennsylvania.

description.zh-cn: 郎咸平是宾夕法尼亚大学的校友。
description.en: Larry Lang is an alumnus of the University of Pennsylvania.

description.zh-cn: 林兰英是宾大历史上第一位中国女博士。
description.en: Lin Lanying was the first Chinese female to receive a Ph.D. from the University of Pennsylvania.

description.zh-cn: 担任第二十届中共中央政治局常务委员会委员，排名第二。
description.en: Serves as a member of the 20th Politburo Standing Committee, ranking second.

description.zh-cn: 担任第二十届中共中央政治局常务委员会委员，排名第三；曾任中共十九届中央政治局常委。
description.en: Serves as a member of the 20th Politburo Standing Committee, ranking third; previously served as a member of the Standing Committee of the 19th CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 先后担任中共十九届中央政治局常委，以及第二十届中共中央政治局常务委员会委员，排名第四。
description.en: Successively served as a member of the Standing Committee of the 19th CPC Central Committee, and a member of the 20th Politburo Standing Committee, ranking fourth.

description.zh-cn: 担任第二十届中共中央政治局常务委员会委员，排名第五。
description.en: Serves as a member of the 20th Politburo Standing Committee, ranking fifth.

description.zh-cn: 担任第二十届中共中央政治局常务委员会委员，排名第六。
description.en: Serves as a member of the 20th Politburo Standing Committee, ranking sixth.

description.zh-cn: 担任第二十届中共中央政治局常务委员会委员，排名第七。
description.en: Serves as a member of the 20th Politburo Standing Committee, ranking seventh.

description.zh-cn: 习近平出任总书记后，大幅度提升总书记的地位和权力，改变了原来的集体领导制度，导致政治局常委会的决策权和重要性下降。
description.en: After Xi Jinping became General Secretary, he significantly enhanced the status and power of the General Secretary, changing the original collective leadership system, which led to a decline in the decision-making power and importance of the Politburo Standing Committee.

description.zh-cn: 六四事件直接导致了十三届四中全会的召开，会上对中共高层进行了人事调整。
description.en: The 1989 Tiananmen Square protests directly led to the convening of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 13th Central Committee, where a leadership reshuffle took place.

description.zh-cn: 在十三届四中全会上，江泽民被选举为中央委员会总书记，并增补为中央政治局常委。
description.en: At the Fourth Plenary Session of the 13th Central Committee, Jiang Zemin was elected General Secretary of the Central Committee and added to the Politburo Standing Committee.

description.zh-cn: 2014年12月5日，周永康被开除中国共产党党籍。
description.en: On December 5, 2014, Zhou Yongkang was expelled from the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 撰写并发表了《第五个现代化：民主及其他》。
description.en: Authored and published 'The Fifth Modernization: Democracy and Others'.

description.zh-cn: 在《要民主还是要新的独裁》中批评邓小平是“独裁者”。
description.en: Criticized Deng Xiaoping as a 'dictator' in 'Do We Want Democracy or New Dictatorship?'.

description.zh-cn: 因“反革命罪”和“阴谋颠覆政府罪”两次被判刑，累计服刑超过十八年。
description.en: Was twice sentenced to prison for 'counter-revolutionary crimes' and 'conspiring to subvert the government', serving a total of over 18 years.

description.zh-cn: 在魏京生在囚期间授予其1996年萨哈罗夫奖。
description.en: Awarded the 1996 Sakharov Prize to Wei Jingsheng while he was imprisoned.

description.zh-cn: 授予魏京生1998年民主奖。
description.en: Awarded the 1998 Democracy Award to Wei Jingsheng.

description.zh-cn: 八九民运领袖王丹称呼魏京生为“民主斗士”，两人均为海外知名民运人士。
description.en: 1989 democracy movement leader Wang Dan called Wei Jingsheng a 'democracy fighter'; both are prominent overseas democracy activists.

description.zh-cn: 时任中华民国总统马英九称赞魏京生为“民主先锋”。
description.en: Then-President of the Republic of China Ma Ying-jeou praised Wei Jingsheng as a 'pioneer of democracy'.

description.zh-cn: 魏京生在文化大革命初期参加了红卫兵，这段经历促使他对江青等人产生了怀疑。
description.en: Wei Jingsheng joined the Red Guards in the early days of the Cultural Revolution, an experience that led him to become suspicious of Jiang Qing and others.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，魏京生参加了属于首都中学红卫兵联合行动委员会的红卫兵组织。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Wei Jingsheng joined a Red Guard group that was part of the United Action Committee of Capital Red Guards.

description.zh-cn: 在文革串联期间，魏京生开始对江青等人产生怀疑，形成反对立场。
description.en: During the networking phase of the Cultural Revolution, Wei Jingsheng began to harbor suspicions about Jiang Qing and others, forming an oppositional stance.

description.zh-cn: 在安徽金寨看到大跃进饿死人的废墟后，魏京生认为毛泽东是“刽子手”。
description.en: After seeing the ruins left by the Great Leap Forward famine in Jinzhai, Anhui, Wei Jingsheng came to believe that Mao Zedong was a 'butcher'.

description.zh-cn: 魏京生是西单民主墙运动的重要成员，在此张贴了《第五个现代化》等著名大字报。
description.en: Wei Jingsheng was a key member of the Xidan Democracy Wall movement, where he posted famous big-character posters such as 'The Fifth Modernization'.

description.zh-cn: 在狱中致信邓小平，阐述自己对西藏前途的看法。
description.en: Wrote a letter to Deng Xiaoping from prison, explaining his views on the future of Tibet.

description.zh-cn: 在克林顿总统1998年访华前，作为中美“人质外交”的一部分，中国政府以“保外就医”名义将魏京生释放并流放到美国。
description.en: Prior to President Clinton's 1998 visit to China, as part of US-China 'hostage diplomacy', the Chinese government released Wei Jingsheng on 'medical parole' and exiled him to the United States.

description.zh-cn: 在魏京生流亡美国后，哥伦比亚大学为其提供了办公室、公寓等支持。
description.en: After Wei Jingsheng was exiled to the US, Columbia University provided him with support including an office and an apartment.

description.zh-cn: 于2001年6月中止了对魏京生的财务支出。
description.en: Terminated its financial support for Wei Jingsheng in June 2001.

description.zh-cn: 2001年访问台湾时与时任民主进步党前主席施明德会晤。
description.en: Met with former Democratic Progressive Party chairman Shih Ming-teh during a visit to Taiwan in 2001.

description.zh-cn: 在出席北京奥运会前，布什总统在白宫会见了包括魏京生在内的五位中国自由活动人士。
description.en: Before attending the Beijing Olympics, President Bush met with five Chinese freedom activists, including Wei Jingsheng, at the White House.

description.zh-cn: 与其他萨哈罗夫奖获得者共同呼吁缅甸当局立即释放翁山苏姬。
description.en: Joined other Sakharov Prize laureates in calling for the immediate release of Aung San Suu Kyi by the Myanmar authorities.

description.zh-cn: 在美国众议院议长南希·佩洛西2009年出访中国大陆前与其探讨过该次访问。
description.en: Discussed the upcoming visit with U.S. House Speaker Nancy Pelosi before her 2009 trip to mainland China.

description.zh-cn: 在其2011年《从魏京生到刘晓波》一文中高度评价魏京生。
description.en: Highly praised Wei Jingsheng in his 2011 article 'From Wei Jingsheng to Liu Xiaobo'.

description.zh-cn: 在1979年发表报道，对魏京生进行批判，并引述群众言论支持法院对魏的判决。
description.en: Published a report in 1979 criticizing Wei Jingsheng and citing public opinion in support of the court's verdict against him.

description.zh-cn: 赞同俄罗斯总统普京关于发动战争的观点，认为是“为保护本民族不再遭受种族清洗”。
description.en: Agreed with Russian President Putin's viewpoint on launching the war, considering it an act 'to protect his nation from further ethnic cleansing'.

description.zh-cn: 1819年，任职于英国不列颠东印度公司的斯坦福·莱佛士登陆新加坡，并获准在此建立交易站和殖民地，开启了现代新加坡的历史。
description.en: In 1819, Stamford Raffles, an employee of the British East India Company, landed in Singapore and was permitted to establish a trading post and colony, marking the beginning of modern Singapore's history.

description.zh-cn: 自1824年起，新加坡正式成为英国殖民地，直到1963年加入马来西亚联邦才完全脱离英国统治。
description.en: From 1824, Singapore officially became a British colony, and only fully broke away from British rule when it joined the Federation of Malaysia in 1963.

description.zh-cn: 1963年，新加坡以独立城邦的形式加入马来西亚联邦，成为新加坡州。
description.en: In 1963, Singapore joined the Federation of Malaysia as an independent city-state, becoming the State of Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 在新加坡并入马来西亚期间，李光耀与马来西亚联邦政府在种族权利分配上意见不合，反对“马来人至上”政策，导致政治对立。
description.en: During Singapore's time in Malaysia, Lee Kuan Yew disagreed with the Malaysian federal government on the allocation of racial rights and opposed the 'Malay supremacy' policy, leading to political antagonism.

description.zh-cn: 人民行动党与执政的马来民族统一机构（巫统）之间的政治较量在1964年两次引发新加坡种族骚乱。
description.en: The political struggle between the People's Action Party and the ruling United Malays National Organisation (UMNO) led to two race riots in Singapore in 1964.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚国会通过紧急修宪，将新加坡驱逐出联邦，从而促使新加坡独立建国。
description.en: The Malaysian Parliament passed an emergency constitutional amendment to expel Singapore from the federation, thereby pushing Singapore to become an independent nation.

description.zh-cn: 时任马来西亚首相东姑阿都拉曼下令将新加坡州自马来西亚联邦中除名，是新加坡被迫独立的关键一步。
description.en: Then-Prime Minister of Malaysia Tunku Abdul Rahman ordered the expulsion of the State of Singapore from the Federation of Malaysia, a critical step towards Singapore's forced independence.

description.zh-cn: 担任新加坡共和国总统，为国家元首。
description.en: Serves as the President of the Republic of Singapore, the head of state.

description.zh-cn: 担任新加坡总理，为政府首脑。
description.en: Serves as the Prime Minister of Singapore, the head of government.

description.zh-cn: 担任新加坡国会议长。
description.en: Serves as the Speaker of the Parliament of Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 担任新加坡首席大法官。
description.en: Serves as the Chief Justice of Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡军队与台湾有合作关系，将其被称为“星光部队”的军队移至台湾进行训练。
description.en: The Singapore Armed Forces has a cooperative relationship with Taiwan, sending its troops, known as the 'Starlight Force', to train in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡与以色列的军事关系紧密，其军队的建立曾受到一批以色列军官的亲自指导。
description.en: Singapore and Israel have close military relations; the establishment of the Singaporean army was personally guided by a group of Israeli military officers.

description.zh-cn: 羽毛球选手骆建佑为新加坡获得首枚羽毛球世锦赛金牌，提升了国家在体育领域的声誉。
description.en: Badminton player Loh Kean Yew won Singapore's first-ever Badminton World Championships gold medal, enhancing the nation's reputation in the field of sports.

description.zh-cn: 蜀郡是秦国下辖的一个郡。
description.en: Shu Commandery was a commandery under the jurisdiction of the State of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 二王庙的古建筑群在汶川大地震中全部垮塌。
description.en: The ancient building complex of Erwang Temple completely collapsed during the Wenchuan earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 隆科多是佟国维之子。
description.en: Longkodo was the son of Tung-gowei.

description.zh-cn: 佟国维是佟图赖之子，隆科多是佟图赖之孙。
description.en: Tung-gowei was the son of Tulai, and Longkodo was the grandson of Tulai.

description.zh-cn: 佟国纲是隆科多的二伯父。
description.en: Tung-gogang was Longkodo's second paternal uncle.

description.zh-cn: 隆科多是康熙帝的表弟。
description.en: Longkodo was the Kangxi Emperor's maternal cousin.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝称隆科多为舅舅，因为隆科多的姐姐孝懿仁皇后是雍正帝的嫡母。
description.en: The Yongzheng Emperor addressed Longkodo as 'maternal uncle' because Longkodo's sister, Empress Xiaoyiren, was Yongzheng's adoptive mother.

description.zh-cn: 隆科多是孝懿仁皇后的弟弟。
description.en: Longkodo was the younger brother of Empress Xiaoyiren.

description.zh-cn: 隆科多是悫惠皇贵妃的弟弟。
description.en: Longkodo was the younger brother of Imperial Noble Consort Quehui.

description.zh-cn: 隆科多是满洲镶黄旗人。
description.en: Longkodo was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

description.zh-cn: 隆科多出身于佟佳氏家族。
description.en: Longkodo was from the Tonggiya clan.

description.zh-cn: 隆科多于康熙五十年至雍正三年担任步军统领。
description.en: Longkodo served as the Infantry Commander from 1711 to 1725.

description.zh-cn: 隆科多于康熙六十一年被任命为吏部尚书。
description.en: Longkodo was appointed Minister of Personnel in the 61st year of Kangxi's reign.

description.zh-cn: 因所属人违法，康熙帝责备隆科多不实心任事，罢免其副都统、銮仪使职务。
description.en: Due to illegal activities by his subordinates, the Kangxi Emperor reprimanded Longkodo for dereliction of duty and dismissed him from his posts as Deputy Commander and Master of the Imperial Guard.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝于康熙五十年授予隆科多步军统领之职。
description.en: The Kangxi Emperor appointed Longkodo as the Infantry Commander in the 50th year of his reign (1711).

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝继位后，立即封隆科多为总理事务大臣、吏部尚书，加太保等职务，使其成为两朝重臣。
description.en: Upon his accession, the Yongzheng Emperor immediately appointed Longkodo as Grand Minister Regent and Minister of Personnel, with the additional title of Grand Tutor, making him a powerful figure spanning two reigns.

description.zh-cn: 雍正五年，隆科多被定41款大罪，雍正帝下令从宽，将其在畅春园外禁锢，直至其于次年六月死于禁所。
description.en: In the fifth year of the Yongzheng reign (1727), Longkodo was convicted of 41 major crimes. The emperor showed leniency by commuting his sentence to confinement outside the Changchun Garden, where he died in June of the following year.

description.zh-cn: 雍正时期大兴的文字狱，其打击范围波及到了隆科多。
description.en: The literary inquisitions during the Yongzheng era also implicated Longkodo.

description.zh-cn: 雍正时期大兴的文字狱，其打击范围波及到了年羹尧。
description.en: The literary inquisitions during the Yongzheng era also implicated Nian Gengyao.

description.zh-cn: 夸岱是隆科多的堂兄弟。
description.en: Kuadai was Longkodo's paternal cousin.

description.zh-cn: 拥有中华民国国籍。
description.en: Held Republic of China citizenship.

description.zh-cn: 拥有美国国籍，后于2015年放弃。
description.en: Held United States citizenship, which he renounced in 2015.

description.zh-cn: 2015年起拥有中华人民共和国国籍。
description.en: Has held People's Republic of China citizenship since 2015.

description.zh-cn: 分别于1996年和2000年授予姚期智高德纳奖和图灵奖。
description.en: Awarded Andrew Yao the Knuth Prize in 1996 and the Turing Award in 2000, respectively.

description.zh-cn: 卓荣泰内阁是赖清德政府的首任内阁。
description.en: The Cho Jung-tai cabinet is the first cabinet of the Lai Ching-te administration.

description.zh-cn: 赖清德在2024年中华民国总统选举中获胜，从而得以组建新一届政府。
description.en: Lai Ching-te won the 2024 ROC presidential election, which enabled the formation of a new government administration.

description.zh-cn: 时任候任总统的赖清德于2024年4月10日宣布由卓荣泰出任行政院院长。
description.en: On April 10, 2024, then-President-elect Lai Ching-te announced the appointment of Cho Jung-tai as the Premier of the Executive Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 根据中华民国宪法，行政院为国家最高行政机关，向总统负责。
description.en: According to the Constitution of the Republic of China, the Executive Yuan is the highest administrative organ of the state and is responsible to the President.

description.zh-cn: 作为立法院的反对党，中国国民党对卓荣泰内阁构成政治上的制衡与挑战。
description.en: As an opposition party in the Legislative Yuan, the Kuomintang poses a political check and challenge to the Cho Jung-tai cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 作为立法院的反对党，台湾民众党对卓荣泰内阁构成政治上的制衡与挑战。
description.en: As an opposition party in the Legislative Yuan, the Taiwan People's Party poses a political check and challenge to the Cho Jung-tai cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 杨宇霆深受张作霖信任，历任奉军参谋长、东北陆军训练总监等要职。
description.en: Yang Yuting was deeply trusted by Zhang Zuolin and held key positions such as Chief of Staff of the Fengtian Army and Inspector-General of the Northeast Army Training.

description.zh-cn: 杨宇霆是奉系军阀的重要将领，长期担任奉军总参谋长等职务。
description.en: Yang Yuting was an important general of the Fengtian clique, serving as the Chief of General Staff of the Fengtian Army for a long period.

description.zh-cn: 杨宇霆毕业于日本陆军士官学校第八期砲兵科。
description.en: Yang Yuting graduated from the 8th class of the artillery department of the Imperial Japanese Army Academy.

description.zh-cn: 郭松龄素遭杨宇霆排挤，这是其起兵反奉的原因之一。
description.en: Guo Songling was consistently sidelined by Yang Yuting, which was one of the reasons for his rebellion against the Fengtian clique.

description.zh-cn: 郭松龄于1925年起兵反奉。
description.en: Guo Songling launched a rebellion against the Fengtian clique in 1925.

description.zh-cn: 郭松龄兵败后被奉军处死。
description.en: After his military defeat, Guo Songling was executed by the Fengtian army.

description.zh-cn: 杨宇霆坚决反对东北易帜，认为不应该服从蒋介石。
description.en: Yang Yuting firmly opposed the Northeast Flag Replacement, believing that they should not submit to Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: 1925年，孙传芳联合陈调元在江苏袭击奉军，将其击败。
description.en: In 1925, Sun Chuanfang, along with Chen Tiaoyuan, attacked and defeated the Fengtian army in Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 1925年，陈调元与孙传芳联合在江苏袭击奉军，将其击败。
description.en: In 1925, Chen Tiaoyuan, along with Sun Chuanfang, attacked and defeated the Fengtian army in Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 第二次直奉战争奉军获胜后，杨宇霆被任命为江苏军务督办。
description.en: After the Fengtian clique's victory in the Second Zhili–Fengtian War, Yang Yuting was appointed as the military governor of Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 杨春元是杨宇霆的长子。
description.en: Yang Chunyuan is the eldest son of Yang Yuting.

description.zh-cn: 1928年9月，杨宇霆两次与白崇禧在冀东会晤。
description.en: In September 1928, Yang Yuting met with Bai Chongxi twice in eastern Hebei.

description.zh-cn: 1918年，徐树铮在天津枪杀直系将领陆建章。
description.en: In 1918, Xu Shuzheng shot and killed Zhili clique general Lu Jianzhang in Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 徐树铮枪杀陆建章后，张作霖与徐树铮不和。
description.en: After Xu Shuzheng killed Lu Jianzhang, Zhang Zuolin and Xu were at odds.

description.zh-cn: 声称宗教与神话和哲学相辅相成，相当于人文社科中的一门包罗万象的“生存之道”。
description.en: Claimed that religion, complemented by myth and philosophy, is equivalent to an all-encompassing 'way of life' within the humanities and social sciences.

description.zh-cn: 通过对拉丁语religio的词源学解释，影响了宗教概念的形成，认为其本意包含“重视”和“小心考虑”。
description.en: Influenced the concept of religion through his etymological explanation of the Latin word 'religio', suggesting its original meaning included 'to pay heed' and 'to consider carefully'.

description.zh-cn: 释圣严是法鼓山的创办人。
description.en: Sheng-yen is the founder of Dharma Drum Mountain.

description.zh-cn: 提出了“有所宗而以为教者，即为宗教”的定义。
description.en: Proposed the definition that 'that which has a principle and is taken as a teaching, is religion'.

description.zh-cn: 提出了“万物有灵论”作为解释宗教起源的理论。
description.en: Proposed 'animism' as a theory to explain the origin of religion.

description.zh-cn: 提出巫术论，将巫术视为人类精神发展的第一个阶段。
description.en: Proposed the theory of magic, viewing magic as the first stage of human intellectual development.

description.zh-cn: 根据詹姆斯·弗雷泽的巫术论，当人类发现巫术无法控制自然时，便转向宗教，寻求超自然力量的帮助，因此巫术的发展推动了宗教的产生。
description.en: According to James Frazer's theory of magic, when humans realized magic could not control nature, they turned to religion to seek help from supernatural powers, thus the development from magic pushed the emergence of religion.

description.zh-cn: 根据詹姆斯·弗雷泽的理论，宗教是人类精神发展的第二个阶段，其后发展为科学阶段。
description.en: According to James Frazer's theory, religion is the second stage of human intellectual development, which later evolves into the stage of science.

description.zh-cn: 最先提出功能论，认为宗教等文化现象是为了满足个体的心理和社会需求。
description.en: First proposed functionalism, arguing that cultural phenomena like religion exist to satisfy individual psychological and social needs.

description.zh-cn: 从逻辑和科学角度对宗教，尤其是有神论，提出了批判，例如质疑“第一起因”论证的逻辑性。
description.en: Criticized religion, especially theism, from logical and scientific perspectives, for instance, questioning the logic of the 'first cause' argument.

description.zh-cn: 批评威廉·詹姆士的宗教意志论为“功利、主观”，认为其将信仰问题简化为利益计算。
description.en: Criticized William James's religious voluntarism as 'utilitarian and subjective', arguing that it reduces the matter of faith to a calculation of benefits.

description.zh-cn: 作为理性论护教者，他认为宇宙的高度秩序和规律性为一神论提供了强有力的支持。
description.en: As a proponent of rational theism, he argues that the high degree of order and regularity in the universe provides strong support for monotheism.

description.zh-cn: 提出分离论，主张宗教与科学寻求的真理在不同意域，不应混为一谈，从而在哲学上为宗教划定了独立的领域。
description.en: Proposed the separation theory, arguing that religion and science seek truths in different domains and should not be confused, thereby defining an independent sphere for religion in philosophy.

description.zh-cn: 提出宗教情感论，认为宗教的本质并非理智或道德，而是人对神的“绝对依赖感”。
description.en: Proposed the theory of religious feeling, arguing that the essence of religion is not intellect or morality, but a 'feeling of absolute dependence' on God.

description.zh-cn: 发展了宗教体验理论，认为宗教的核心是对“神圣者”的体验，这种体验是既敬畏又向往的非理性情感交织。
description.en: Developed the theory of religious experience, arguing that the core of religion is the experience of 'the Numinous', a non-rational mixture of awe and fascination.

description.zh-cn: 提出“信仰的赌注”论证，开创了宗教意志论，即在理性无法决断时，根据利害得失来选择信仰是合理的。
description.en: Proposed the 'Pascal's Wager' argument, pioneering religious voluntarism, which posits that it is rational to choose faith based on a cost-benefit analysis when reason is inconclusive.

description.zh-cn: 作为宗教意志论的代表，他主张在面对“真正的抉择”时，信仰的意志和带来的实际好处是做出选择的合法依据。
description.en: As a representative of religious voluntarism, he argued that when faced with a 'genuine option', the will to believe and the practical benefits it brings are legitimate grounds for making a choice.

description.zh-cn: 在清末民初，康有为试图仿效西方基督教国家，将儒家思想改造为“孔教”，并争取将其立为国教。
description.en: In the late Qing and early Republican era, Kang Youwei attempted to transform Confucianism into a 'Confucian Religion' and campaigned to establish it as the state religion, modeling it after Christianity in Western nations.

description.zh-cn: 作为新文化运动的领袖之一，陈独秀等反孔力量强烈反对康有为将孔教立为国教的企图。
description.en: As a leader of the New Culture Movement, Chen Duxiu and other anti-Confucian forces strongly opposed Kang Youwei's attempt to establish Confucianism as the state religion.

description.zh-cn: 在是否将孔教立为国教的问题上，康有为代表的支持方与陈独秀代表的反对方形成了尖锐的政治和思想对立。
description.en: On the issue of establishing Confucianism as the state religion, Kang Youwei, representing the proponents, and Chen Duxiu, representing the opponents, were in sharp political and ideological opposition.

description.zh-cn: 梅葆玖是梅兰芳的第五子。
description.en: Mei Baojiu was the fifth son of Mei Lanfang.

description.zh-cn: 1924年，梅兰芳拜师齐白石学画工虫。
description.en: In 1924, Mei Lanfang became a student of Qi Baishi to learn insect painting.

description.zh-cn: 齐如山是梅兰芳的良师益友。
description.en: Qi Rushan was a good teacher and helpful friend to Mei Lanfang.

description.zh-cn: 1920年，由齐如山介绍，梅兰芳与齐白石相识，后结为师友。
description.en: In 1920, introduced by Qi Rushan, Mei Lanfang met Qi Baishi, and they later became teacher and friend.

description.zh-cn: 梅兰芳得到中共领导人毛泽东的赏识，毛泽东甚至称呼他为“梅老板”。
description.en: Mei Lanfang was admired by the Communist Party leader Mao Zedong, who even addressed him as "Boss Mei".

description.zh-cn: 梅兰芳拒绝为汪精卫政府演出，并蓄须明志，导致在此期间经济来源断绝。
description.en: Mei Lanfang refused to perform for the Wang Jingwei government and grew a beard to show his resolve, which cut off his source of income during this period.

description.zh-cn: 1945年日本投降后，梅兰芳于10月重出舞台。
description.en: After Japan's surrender in 1945, Mei Lanfang returned to the stage in October.

description.zh-cn: 以蒙哥为养子，并由其皇后昂灰抚育长大。
description.en: Adopted Möngke as his son, and had his queen Anghui raise him.

description.zh-cn: 蒙哥是蒙古帝国第四任大汗。
description.en: Möngke was the fourth Great Khan of the Mongol Empire.

description.zh-cn: 以长支宗王的身份召集忽里台，极力称赞并推举蒙哥为大汗。
description.en: As the senior prince, he convened a Kurultai and strongly praised and nominated Möngke to be the Great Khan.

description.zh-cn: 奉其兄拔都之命，率大军随同蒙哥前往斡难河畔召开忽里台，以武力确保蒙哥顺利登基。
description.en: Under his brother Batu's order, he led a large army to accompany Möngke to the Kurultai on the Onon River, ensuring his successful enthronement with military force.

description.zh-cn: 命其子蒙哥应召参与拔都召开的忽里台，并利用其威望笼络多数宗王大臣支持蒙哥登基。
description.en: She ordered her son Möngke to attend the Kurultai convened by Batu and used her prestige to persuade the majority of princes and ministers to support Möngke's enthronement.

description.zh-cn: 钦淑皇后作为窝阔台系的代表反对蒙哥即位，在蒙哥巩固汗位时被其母唆鲁禾帖尼下令处死。
description.en: As a representative of the Ögedeid line, Oghul Qaimish opposed Möngke's accession and was executed by order of Möngke's mother Sorghaghtani while Möngke was consolidating his power.

description.zh-cn: 为了巩固其子蒙哥的汗位，亲自下令处死反对者贵由汗的皇后斡兀立海迷失。
description.en: To consolidate her son Möngke's throne, she personally ordered the execution of the opponent Oghul Qaimish, the empress of Güyük Khan.

description.zh-cn: 蒙哥年轻时参与第二次蒙古西征，征讨钦察、斡罗思等地，屡立战功。
description.en: In his youth, Möngke participated in the second Mongol invasion of the West, campaigning against the Kipchaks and Rus', and repeatedly achieved military merit.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次蒙古西征期间，于里海附近活捉钦察首领八赤蛮。
description.en: During the second Mongol invasion of the West, he captured the Kipchak leader Bachman alive near the Caspian Sea.

description.zh-cn: 任命其弟忽必烈统领漠南汉地军政事务，并命其南征大理国。
description.en: Appointed his younger brother Kublai to oversee military and political affairs in Northern China and ordered him to conquer the Dali Kingdom to the south.

description.zh-cn: 奉蒙哥之命率军南征，攻克大理城，灭亡大理国。
description.en: Under Möngke's order, he led an army south, captured the city of Dali, and destroyed the Dali Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 命令其弟旭烈兀率领大军西征。
description.en: Ordered his younger brother Hulagu to lead a large army to the west.

description.zh-cn: 旭烈兀西征军于1256年攻灭位于波斯西部的木剌夷国（阿萨辛派）。
description.en: Hulagu's expeditionary army destroyed the Nizari Ismaili state (Assassins) in western Persia in 1256.

description.zh-cn: 旭烈兀西征军于1258年攻陷巴格达，灭亡阿拔斯王朝。
description.en: Hulagu's expeditionary army captured Baghdad in 1258, destroying the Abbasid Caliphate.

description.zh-cn: 旭烈兀西征军于1260年攻占叙利亚，灭亡阿尤布王朝。
description.en: Hulagu's expeditionary army captured Syria in 1260, destroying the Ayyubid dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 因蒙哥去世，旭烈兀东返途中留在西亚自成一方，建立了伊儿汗国。
description.en: Due to Möngke's death, Hulagu remained in West Asia during his return journey and established the Ilkhanate.

description.zh-cn: 1258年，蒙哥亲率主力大举进攻南宋四川地区。
description.en: In 1258, Möngke personally led the main army in a major invasion of the Sichuan region of the Southern Song.

description.zh-cn: 蒙哥亲率的蒙古大军在钓鱼城下受阻数月，蒙哥本人最终在此役中身亡。
description.en: The Mongol army personally led by Möngke was bogged down at Diaoyu Fortress for several months, and Möngke himself eventually died during this battle.

description.zh-cn: 蒙哥在钓鱼城之战中去世，直接引发了其弟忽必烈与阿里不哥之间争夺汗位的内战。
description.en: Möngke's death during the Battle of Diaoyu Fortress directly triggered a civil war for the succession to the khanship between his younger brothers Kublai and Ariq Böke.

description.zh-cn: 这场内战标志着蒙古帝国走向分裂，各汗国开始独立发展。
description.en: This civil war marked the beginning of the fragmentation of the Mongol Empire, as the various khanates began to develop independently.

description.zh-cn: 派遣传教士卢布鲁克前往东方觐见蒙古大汗。
description.en: Dispatched the missionary William of Rubruck to the East for an audience with the Great Khan of the Mongols.

description.zh-cn: 法国国王路易九世派遣的传教士卢布鲁克到达蒙哥的营地并觐见了他。
description.en: The missionary William of Rubruck, sent by King Louis IX of France, arrived at Möngke's camp and had an audience with him.

description.zh-cn: 作为蒙古的属国国王，海屯一世前往哈拉和林朝见蒙哥。
description.en: As the king of a Mongol vassal state, Hethum I traveled to Karakorum for an audience with Möngke.

description.zh-cn: 元朝建立后，忽必烈追尊蒙哥庙号为宪宗，谥号为桓肃皇帝。
description.en: After the establishment of the Yuan Dynasty, Kublai Khan posthumously honored Möngke with the temple name Xianzong and the posthumous title Emperor Huansu.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军第七十三集团军隶属于东部战区陆军。
description.en: The PLA 73rd Group Army is subordinate to the Eastern Theater Command Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 丁来富自2022年4月起担任中国人民解放军陆军第七十三集团军军长。
description.en: Ding Laifu has served as the commander of the PLA 73rd Group Army since April 2022.

description.zh-cn: 在深化国防和军队改革中，以原陆军第三十一集团军为基础，调整组建为中国人民解放军陆军第七十三集团军。
description.en: During the deepening of national defense and military reform, the 73rd Group Army was formed based on the former 31st Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军第三十一军由华东野战军第13纵队于1949年2月改编而成。
description.en: The PLA 31st Corps was reorganized from the 13th Column of the East China Field Army in February 1949.

description.zh-cn: 周志坚担任中国人民解放军第三十一军首任军长。
description.en: Zhou Zhijian served as the first commander of the PLA 31st Corps.

description.zh-cn: 陈华堂担任中国人民解放军第三十一军首任政治委员。
description.en: Chen Huatang served as the first political commissar of the PLA 31st Corps.

description.zh-cn: 华东野战军第13纵队（第三十一军前身）参加了济南战役。
description.en: The 13th Column of the East China Field Army (predecessor of the 31st Corps) participated in the Jinan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 华东野战军第13纵队（第三十一军前身）参加了淮海战役。
description.en: The 13th Column of the East China Field Army (predecessor of the 31st Corps) participated in the Huaihai Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军第三十一军参加了渡江战役。
description.en: The PLA 31st Corps participated in the Yangtze River Crossing Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军第三十一军参加了上海战役。
description.en: The PLA 31st Corps participated in the Shanghai Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 胡中强担任中国人民解放军陆军第七十三集团军首任军长。
description.en: Hu Zhongqiang served as the first commander of the PLA 73rd Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 杨诚担任中国人民解放军陆军第七十三集团军首任政治委员。
description.en: Yang Cheng served as the first political commissar of the PLA 73rd Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 丁来富接替胡中强担任中国人民解放军陆军第七十三集团军军长。
description.en: Ding Laifu succeeded Hu Zhongqiang as the commander of the PLA 73rd Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 朱利安·阿桑奇于2006年创建了揭密网站维基解密，并担任其首席编辑与发言人。
description.en: Julian Assange founded the whistle-blowing website WikiLeaks in 2006 and served as its editor-in-chief and spokesperson.

description.zh-cn: 朱利安·阿桑奇是维基解密的核心人物，担任首席编辑与主要发言人。
description.en: Julian Assange is the central figure of WikiLeaks, serving as its editor-in-chief and primary spokesperson.

description.zh-cn: 2010年，时任美国陆军情报分析员的切尔西·曼宁向维基解密提供了一系列机密文件，引发国际关注。
description.en: In 2010, Chelsea Manning, then a U.S. Army intelligence analyst, provided a series of classified documents to WikiLeaks, sparking international attention.

description.zh-cn: 在维基解密公布机密文件后，美国政府对阿桑奇展开了长期的刑事调查，并以违反《间谍法》等多项罪名起诉他，寻求将其引渡至美国。
description.en: After WikiLeaks published classified documents, the U.S. government launched a long-term criminal investigation against Assange, indicting him on multiple charges including violations of the Espionage Act and seeking his extradition.

description.zh-cn: 瑞典检方以涉嫌性犯罪为由对阿桑奇展开调查并寻求引渡，该调查最终于2019年11月中止。
description.en: Swedish prosecutors initiated an investigation and sought the extradition of Assange on allegations of sexual offenses, an investigation that was ultimately dropped in November 2019.

description.zh-cn: 时任厄瓜多尔总统利宁·莫雷诺以阿桑奇违反庇护条款为由，撤销了对他的政治庇护，并允许英国警方进入大使馆将其逮捕。
description.en: Then-President of Ecuador, Lenín Moreno, revoked Assange's political asylum, citing violations of his asylum conditions, and permitted British police to enter the embassy to arrest him.

description.zh-cn: 在厄瓜多尔政府撤销庇护后，伦敦警察厅于2019年4月11日进入厄瓜多尔大使馆逮捕了朱利安·阿桑奇。
description.en: After the Ecuadorian government revoked his asylum, the Metropolitan Police entered the Ecuadorian embassy on April 11, 2019, and arrested Julian Assange.

description.zh-cn: 朱利安·阿桑奇与他的律师史黛拉·亚桑杰于2015年开始交往，并于2022年3月23日在贝尔马什监狱结婚。他们育有两个儿子。
description.en: Julian Assange began a relationship with his lawyer, Stella, in 2015, and they married in Belmarsh Prison on March 23, 2022. They have two sons together.

description.zh-cn: 据雅虎新闻报道，在维基解密发布“七号保险库”文件后，时任中情局局长迈克·蓬佩奥领导下的中情局曾讨论绑架甚至暗杀在厄瓜多尔大使馆的阿桑奇。
description.en: According to Yahoo News, after WikiLeaks published the 'Vault 7' documents, the CIA, under then-Director Mike Pompeo, discussed kidnapping and even assassinating Assange while he was in the Ecuadorian embassy.

description.zh-cn: 美国政府利用《1917年间谍法》对朱利安·阿桑奇提出多项刑事指控。
description.en: The U.S. government used the Espionage Act of 1917 to bring multiple criminal charges against Julian Assange.

description.zh-cn: 2003年至2006年间，朱利安·阿桑奇在墨尔本大学学习物理与数学，但未完成学位。
description.en: From 2003 to 2006, Julian Assange studied physics and mathematics at the University of Melbourne but did not complete his degree.

description.zh-cn: 1949年至1971年间，由于冷战格局，中美处于全面敌对状态。美国承认退守台湾的中华民国政府，并在朝鲜战争中与中国直接交战。
description.en: From 1949 to 1971, due to the Cold War structure, China and the U.S. were in a state of comprehensive hostility. The U.S. recognized the Republic of China government in Taiwan and directly fought against China in the Korean War.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜战争爆发后，中国共产党对美国发表的《中美关系白皮书》反应强烈，毛泽东连续撰文批判，双方关系急速恶化。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Korean War, the Chinese Communist Party reacted strongly to the US 'China White Paper', with Mao Zedong writing successive articles of criticism, leading to a rapid deterioration in relations.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜战争的爆发，使得中美建立外交关系的可能性破灭，美国派遣第七舰队巡逻台湾海峡。
description.en: The outbreak of the Korean War shattered the possibility of establishing diplomatic relations between China and the US, and the US dispatched the Seventh Fleet to patrol the Taiwan Strait.

description.zh-cn: 中国在北越的存在，使得美国林登·约翰逊政府因害怕重演朝鲜战争，排除了对北越进行地面入侵的可能性。
description.en: China's presence in North Vietnam made the administration of US President Lyndon B. Johnson rule out the possibility of a ground invasion of North Vietnam, fearing a repeat of the Korean War.

description.zh-cn: 通过“乒乓外交”事件，中美关系实现历史性突破，为关系正常化铺平了道路。
description.en: Through the 'Ping-pong diplomacy' event, China-US relations achieved a historic breakthrough, paving the way for normalization.

description.zh-cn: 时任美国国家安全顾问的基辛格对北京进行了一次秘密访问，为尼克松访华做准备。
description.en: Then-U.S. National Security Advisor Kissinger made a secret visit to Beijing to prepare for President Nixon's visit.

description.zh-cn: 尼克松访华期间，中美双方签署了《上海公报》，承诺为外交关系完全正常化努力。
description.en: During Nixon's visit to China, the two sides signed the Shanghai Communiqué, committing to work towards the complete normalization of diplomatic relations.

description.zh-cn: 911袭击事件后，美国不再将中国看作是最大的潜在威胁，转而注重中东局势以及恐怖主义威胁，并寻求与中国在反恐方面进行合作。
description.en: After the 9/11 attacks, the U.S. no longer viewed China as its greatest potential threat, shifting its focus to the situation in the Middle East and the threat of terrorism, and sought cooperation with China on counter-terrorism.

description.zh-cn: 911袭击发生当晚，江泽民致电美国总统小布希表示同情。一个月后，小布什总统访华。
description.en: On the evening of the 9/11 attacks, Jiang Zemin called U.S. President George W. Bush to express his condolences. A month later, President Bush visited China.

description.zh-cn: 美国总统奥巴马提出的“亚太再平衡”战略，旨在应对中国经济和军事力量的持续增加。
description.en: The 'Pivot to Asia' strategy proposed by U.S. President Obama was aimed at responding to the continuous increase in China's economic and military power.

description.zh-cn: 特朗普政府正式对中国进口钢铁和铝产品征收关税，并采取措施限制中国投资，引发了中美贸易战。
description.en: The Trump administration officially imposed tariffs on imported steel and aluminum products from China and took measures to restrict Chinese investment, triggering the US-China trade war.

description.zh-cn: 时任美国副总统彭斯发表演说，全面抨击中国的内外政策，宣告美国以往的对华接触政策已经失败。
description.en: Then-US Vice President Pence delivered a speech comprehensively criticizing China's domestic and foreign policies, declaring the failure of the United States' past engagement policy towards China.

description.zh-cn: 作为对美国关闭中国驻休斯敦总领馆的对等反制，中国于2020年7月24日宣布撤销美国驻成都总领事馆的设立和运行许可。
description.en: As a reciprocal countermeasure to the U.S. closure of the Chinese consulate in Houston, China announced on July 24, 2020, the revocation of the establishment and operation license for the U.S. consulate in Chengdu.

description.zh-cn: 时任美国国务卿蓬佩奥发表演说《共产中国与自由世界的未来》，呼吁改变中国威胁自由世界的行为，被认为是开启新冷战的“铁幕演讲”。
description.en: Then-US Secretary of State Pompeo delivered the speech 'Communist China and the Free World's Future,' calling for a change in China's behavior that threatens the free world, which is considered an 'Iron Curtain' speech marking the beginning of a new Cold War.

description.zh-cn: “高空气球事件”导致美国国务卿布林肯取消原定的访华行程，使双边关系进一步紧张。
description.en: The 'high-altitude balloon incident' caused U.S. Secretary of State Blinken to cancel his planned visit to China, further tensing bilateral relations.

description.zh-cn: 美国财政部长耶伦多次访问中国，与中方经济团队会谈，旨在稳定两国经济关系，并沟通美方对中国“产能过剩”等问题的关切。
description.en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Yellen visited China multiple times for talks with the Chinese economic team, aiming to stabilize bilateral economic relations and communicate U.S. concerns about issues such as China's 'overcapacity'.

description.zh-cn: 美国国务卿布林肯在2023年6月和2024年4月两度访华，并与中国国家主席习近平会面，进行“坦诚、实质性和建设性的会谈”。
description.en: U.S. Secretary of State Antony Blinken visited China twice, in June 2023 and April 2024, and met with Chinese President Xi Jinping for 'candid, substantive, and constructive talks'.

position.zh-cn: 警务局长；内务总长；主席；国务委员会主席
position.en: Chief of Police Affairs Bureau; Minister of Home Affairs; President; Chairman of the State Council

description.zh-cn: 金九在不同时期担任大韩民国临时政府的多个要职，并长期是其实际领导人。
description.en: Kim Gu held several key positions in the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea at different times and was its de facto leader for a long period.

description.zh-cn: 金九接替洪震成为大韩民国临时政府主席。
description.en: Kim Gu succeeded Hong Jin as the President of the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 李东宁接替金九成为大韩民国临时政府主席，后金九又接替李东宁成为主席。
description.en: Yi Dong-nyeong succeeded Kim Gu as the President of the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea, and later Kim Gu succeeded Yi Dong-nyeong as Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 李承晚接替金九成为大韩民国临时政府主席。
description.en: Syngman Rhee succeeded Kim Gu as the President of the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 三一运动爆发后，金九流亡中国，参与筹建大韩民国临时政府。
description.en: After the outbreak of the March 1st Movement, Kim Gu went into exile in China and participated in the establishment of the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 在李东宁的劝说下，金九出任大韩民国临时政府国务领。
description.en: At the persuasion of Yi Dong-nyeong, Kim Gu took office as the State Councillor of the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 金九与中国共产党保持着良好的关系。
description.en: Kim Gu maintained a good relationship with the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 美国军政府不承认大韩民国临时政府的合法性，并对金九等临时政府人员回国一事进行了封锁。
description.en: The U.S. Military Government did not recognize the legitimacy of the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea and blocked the return of its members, including Kim Gu.

description.zh-cn: 美军政府在朝鲜半岛南部扶持李承晚建立亲美政权。
description.en: The U.S. Military Government supported Syngman Rhee in establishing a pro-American regime in the southern Korean Peninsula.

description.zh-cn: 金九与金日成在平壤举行的“四月南北联席会议”上会面，商讨南北统一问题。
description.en: Kim Gu and Kim Il-sung met at the 'April Joint Conference of North and South' in Pyongyang to discuss the issue of Korean unification.

description.zh-cn: 时任韩国宪兵司令张兴在其自传中称，安斗熙是受时任国防部长官申性模的指示暗杀金九的。
description.en: According to the autobiography of Jang Heung, then commander of the Korean Military Police, Ahn Doo-hee assassinated Kim Gu under the orders of then Minister of National Defense Shin Sung-mo.

description.zh-cn: 朴正熙政府追授金九大韩民国建国勋章，并追尊其为韩国国父。
description.en: The Park Chung-hee government posthumously awarded Kim Gu the Order of Merit for National Foundation and honored him as the Father of the Nation.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国中央人民委员会追授金九祖国统一奖，以肯定他对南北统一的努力。
description.en: The Central People's Committee of the DPRK posthumously awarded Kim Gu the National Reunification Prize in recognition of his efforts for the unification of North and South Korea.

description.zh-cn: 考虑到金九是为国母报仇，朝鲜高宗在其死刑执行前特赦了他。
description.en: Considering that Kim Gu had acted to avenge the nation's mother, Emperor Gojong granted him a special pardon before his death sentence was carried out.

description.zh-cn: 金九多次被日本当局逮捕入狱，包括因安重根事件和安明根事件。
description.en: Kim Gu was arrested and imprisoned by Japanese authorities multiple times, including in connection with the An Jung-geun incident and the An Myeong-geun incident.

description.zh-cn: 九一八事变后，为开辟新的斗争方式，金九成立了韩人爱国团敢死队。
description.en: After the Mukden Incident, to open up new methods of struggle, Kim Gu established the Korean Patriotic Corps, a commando unit.

description.zh-cn: 李奉昌在东京樱田门向裕仁天皇投掷手榴弹，但未成功。
description.en: Lee Bong-chang threw a hand grenade at Emperor Hirohito at the Sakuradamon Gate in Tokyo, but the attempt failed.

description.zh-cn: 尹奉吉在上海虹口公园用炸弹炸死了日本上海派遣军司令白川义则大将。
description.en: Yun Bong-gil killed General Yoshinori Shirakawa, commander of the Shanghai Expeditionary Army, with a bomb in Shanghai's Hongkou Park.

description.zh-cn: 尹奉吉在上海虹口公园用炸弹炸死了上海日本居留民团团长河端贞次。
description.en: Yun Bong-gil killed Kawabata Sadatsugu, head of the Japanese Residents' Association in Shanghai, with a bomb in Shanghai's Hongkou Park.

description.zh-cn: 虹口公园爆炸事件后，蒋中正政府开始大力支持金九领导的韩国独立运动。
description.en: After the Hongkou Park bombing, the Chiang Kai-shek government began to strongly support the Korean independence movement led by Kim Gu.

description.zh-cn: 蒋中正秘密会见金九，并同意在中央陆军军官学校洛阳分校为韩国独立运动培养军事人才。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek met secretly with Kim Gu and agreed to train military personnel for the Korean independence movement at the Luoyang branch of the Central Military Academy.

description.zh-cn: 韩国光复军是在中国国民党的支持下于重庆成立的。
description.en: The Korean Liberation Army was established in Chongqing with the support of the Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 在金九回国前，周恩来等中共政要为其举行了送别宴会。
description.en: Before Kim Gu returned to Korea, CCP dignitaries including Zhou Enlai held a farewell banquet for him.

description.zh-cn: 施南生曾就读于玛利诺修院学校的小学部和中学部。
description.en: Nansun Shi attended the primary and secondary sections of Maryknoll Convent School.

description.zh-cn: 施南生于70年代在无线电视担任制作及行政职位。
description.en: Nansun Shi worked in production and administration at TVB during the 1970s.

description.zh-cn: 施南生于70年代在香港电台担任制作及行政职位。
description.en: Nansun Shi worked in production and administration at RTHK during the 1970s.

description.zh-cn: 施南生于70年代在佳视担任制作及行政职位。
description.en: Nansun Shi worked in production and administration at Commercial Television during the 1970s.

description.zh-cn: 施南生于70年代在丽的（亚洲电视）担任制作及行政职位。
description.en: Nansun Shi worked in production and administration at Rediffusion Television (ATV) during the 1970s.

description.zh-cn: 施南生于80年代在新艺城工作，并为港产片开创了黄金时代。
description.en: Nansun Shi worked at Cinema City during the 1980s, helping to create the golden age of Hong Kong cinema.

description.zh-cn: 施南生曾协助香港有线电视开创业务。
description.en: Nansun Shi assisted in the establishment of Hong Kong Cable Television.

description.zh-cn: 施南生曾协助传讯开创收费电视业务。
description.en: Nansun Shi assisted in the establishment of the pay television business for Chinese Television Network.

description.zh-cn: 施南生曾协助电讯盈科开创收费电视业务。
description.en: Nansun Shi assisted in the establishment of the pay television business for PCCW.

description.zh-cn: 施南生于1951年8月8日出生于英属香港。
description.en: Nansun Shi was born in British Hong Kong on August 8, 1951.

description.zh-cn: 在第43届香港电影金像奖上，施南生获颁终身成就奖，以表扬其对香港电影的重大贡献。
description.en: At the 43rd Hong Kong Film Awards, Nansun Shi was awarded the Lifetime Achievement Award in recognition of her significant contributions to Hong Kong cinema.

description.zh-cn: 在第67届柏林影展上，施南生获得金摄影奖（Berlinale Camera）。
description.en: At the 67th Berlin International Film Festival, Nansun Shi received the Berlinale Camera award.

description.zh-cn: 2012年，施南生加入凤凰卫视香港台担任政论节目主持人。
description.en: In 2012, Nansun Shi joined Phoenix Hong Kong Channel as a host for a political talk show.

description.zh-cn: 林智坚是民主进步党党员，并曾担任党内多项职务。
description.en: Lin Chih-chien is a member of the Democratic Progressive Party and has held several positions within the party.

description.zh-cn: 在从政初期，林智坚曾担任立法委员柯建铭的助理长达九年，柯建铭亦被其视为政治启蒙导师。
description.en: In his early political career, Lin Chih-chien served as an assistant to Legislator Ker Chien-ming for nine years, and he regards Ker as his political mentor.

description.zh-cn: 在2014年林智坚竞选新竹市市长时，苏贞昌为其提供指导并出借选举团队协助辅选。
description.en: During Lin Chih-chien's 2014 campaign for mayor of Hsinchu, Su Tseng-chang provided guidance and lent his campaign team to assist in the election.

description.zh-cn: 时任民进党主席的蔡英文在2014年新竹市长选举中为林智坚授旗站台，宣示民进党启动世代接班，表示对其支持。
description.en: Then-DPP Chairperson Tsai Ing-wen endorsed Lin Chih-chien during the 2014 Hsinchu mayoral election, symbolizing the party's generational shift and showing her support.

description.zh-cn: 林智坚于2010年至2014年担任新竹市议会第八届议员。
description.en: Lin Chih-chien served as a member of the 8th Hsinchu City Council from 2010 to 2014.

description.zh-cn: 林智坚于2014年至2022年担任两届新竹市市长。
description.en: Lin Chih-chien served two terms as the Mayor of Hsinchu City from 2014 to 2022.

description.zh-cn: 林智坚在2014年和2018年两次新竹市市长选举中，均与寻求（再次）当选的许明财为主要竞争对手。
description.en: In both the 2014 and 2018 Hsinchu mayoral elections, Lin Chih-chien was the main competitor against Hsu Ming-tsai, who was seeking election (and re-election).

description.zh-cn: 在2014年新竹市市长选举中，同属泛绿阵营的蔡仁坚脱党参选，与代表民进党参选的林智坚形成三强鼎立的竞争局面。
description.en: In the 2014 Hsinchu mayoral election, Tsai Jen-chien, also from the Pan-Green Coalition, ran as an independent, creating a three-way competitive race against the DPP's candidate, Lin Chih-chien.

description.zh-cn: 国立台湾大学认定林智坚的国家发展研究所硕士论文构成严重抄袭，宣布撤销其硕士学位。
description.en: National Taiwan University determined that Lin Chih-chien's master's thesis from the Graduate Institute of National Development constituted serious plagiarism and announced the revocation of his master's degree.

description.zh-cn: 中华大学认定林智坚的科技管理研究所硕士论文存在抄袭且情节重大，宣布撤销其硕士学位。
description.en: Chung Hua University determined that Lin Chih-chien's master's thesis from the Graduate Institute of Technology Management involved significant plagiarism and announced the revocation of his master's degree.

description.zh-cn: 因林智坚论文抄袭案，国立台湾大学于2022年8月9日宣布撤销其硕士学位。受此影响，林智坚于2022年8月12日宣布退出桃园市市长选举。
description.en: Due to the plagiarism scandal, National Taiwan University announced the revocation of Lin Chih-chien's master's degree on August 9, 2022. Influenced by this, Lin Chih-chien announced his withdrawal from the Taoyuan mayoral election on August 12, 2022.

description.zh-cn: 林智坚因论文案退选后，民主进步党推举郑运鹏接替其参选桃园市市长。
description.en: After Lin Chih-chien withdrew from the election due to the plagiarism scandal, the Democratic Progressive Party nominated Cheng Yun-peng to run for mayor of Taoyuan in his place.

description.zh-cn: 2024年，三立董事长张荣华延揽林智坚至旗下永兴资本公司担任总经理，助其由政转商。
description.en: In 2024, Sanlih Chairman Chang Jung-hua recruited Lin Chih-chien to serve as general manager of its subsidiary Yong-Xing Capital, facilitating his transition from politics to business.

description.zh-cn: 林智坚在中华大学夜间部完成学业，取得企业管理学系学士学位。
description.en: Lin Chih-chien completed his studies in the evening division of Chung Hua University, earning a bachelor's degree in Business Administration.
