description.en: The political claims within the Sonnō jōi movement about ancient Japan's dominion over the Korean peninsula provided an ideological basis for the Seikanron.

description.zh-cn: 根据部分媒体报道，陈良宇事件是由令计划等人炮制的一起冤案。
description.en: According to some media reports, the Chen Liangyu incident was a wrongful conviction case orchestrated by Ling Jihua and others.

description.zh-cn: 胡温政府需要打击削弱江泽民派系（上海帮）的势力，陈良宇事件被视为这一政治斗争的一部分。
description.en: The Hu-Wen administration needed to weaken the power of the Jiang Zemin faction (Shanghai clique), and the Chen Liangyu incident is seen as part of this political struggle.

description.zh-cn: 陈良宇因反对中央的宏观调控政策，曾反驳顶撞时任总理温家宝。
description.en: Chen Liangyu, opposing the central government's macroeconomic control policies, once confronted and contradicted then-Premier Wen Jiabao.

description.zh-cn: 陈良宇认为宏观经济调控压制上海发展，于是对中央经济方针进行抵制，导致中央经济政策无法通行于全国。
description.en: Chen Liangyu believed that macroeconomic control suppressed Shanghai's development and thus resisted the central economic policies, preventing them from being implemented nationwide.

description.zh-cn: 在黄菊患病离职后，中纪委开始调查上海社保基金案件，派调查组进驻上海，从而引发了整个事件。
description.en: After Huang Ju fell ill and left his post, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection began investigating the Shanghai social security fund case, sending an investigation team to Shanghai, which triggered the entire incident.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央政治局会议决定对陈良宇立案调查，并免去其在上海市一切职务，停止其在中央担任的职务。
description.en: A meeting of the Politburo of the CCP Central Committee decided to open an investigation into Chen Liangyu, remove him from all his posts in Shanghai, and suspend his duties at the central level.

description.zh-cn: 因卷入陈良宇事件，时任上海市宝山区区长的秦裕被双规，并最终被判处无期徒刑。
description.en: Due to his involvement in the Chen Liangyu incident, Qin Yu, then Mayor of Baoshan District in Shanghai, was placed under 'shuanggui' and ultimately sentenced to life imprisonment.

description.zh-cn: 因卷入陈良宇事件，时任上海市社保局长的祝均一被调查，并最终被判处有期徒刑18年。
description.en: Due to his involvement in the Chen Liangyu incident, Zhu Junyi, then Director of the Shanghai Social Security Bureau, was investigated and ultimately sentenced to 18 years in prison.

description.zh-cn: 因卷入陈良宇事件，时任国家统计局局长的邱晓华被捕，并最终被判处有期徒刑一年。
description.en: Due to his involvement in the Chen Liangyu incident, Qiu Xiaohua, then Director of the National Bureau of Statistics, was arrested and ultimately sentenced to one year in prison.

description.zh-cn: 秦裕曾是陈良宇的秘书。
description.en: Qin Yu was formerly Chen Liangyu's secretary.

description.zh-cn: 张荣坤被控行贿已故政治局常委黄菊的秘书王维工九百三十三万元。
description.en: Zhang Rongkun was accused of bribing Wang Weigong, the secretary of the late Politburo Standing Committee member Huang Ju, with 9.33 million yuan.

description.zh-cn: 据媒体称，令计划等人将陈良宇事件炮制成一起冤案。
description.en: According to media reports, Ling Jihua and others fabricated the Chen Liangyu incident into a case of wrongful conviction.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框，“中国民主促进会广西壮族自治区委员会”的上级机构是“中国民主促进会中央委员会”。
description.en: According to the infobox, the superior organization of the 'Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Committee of the China Association for Promoting Democracy' is the 'Central Committee of the China Association for Promoting Democracy'.

description.zh-cn: “中国民主促进会广西壮族自治区委员会”是“中国民主促进会”在广西壮族自治区的地方组织。
description.en: The 'Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Committee of the China Association for Promoting Democracy' is the local organization of the 'China Association for Promoting Democracy' in the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框，“中国民主促进会广西壮族自治区委员会”的机构类型为“民主党派”。
description.en: According to the infobox, the organization type of the 'Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Committee of the China Association for Promoting Democracy' is 'Democratic party'.

description.zh-cn: 中央财经委员会是中国共产党中央委员会领导财经工作的决策议事协调机构。
description.en: The Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission is a decision-making, deliberative, and coordinating body under the leadership of the CCP Central Committee for financial and economic work.

description.zh-cn: 中央财经委员会办公室是中央财经委员会的办事机构。
description.en: The Office of the Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission is the administrative body of the Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission.

description.zh-cn: 担任中央财经委员会主任。
description.en: Serves as the Director of the Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission.

description.zh-cn: 担任第二十届中央委员会时期的中央财经委员会副主任。
description.en: Serves as the Deputy Director of the Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission during the term of the 20th Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 担任第二十届中央委员会时期的中央财经委员会委员。
description.en: Serves as a Member of the Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission during the term of the 20th Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 担任第二十届中央委员会时期的中央财经委员会委员。
description.en: Serves as a Member of the Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission during the term of the 20th Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 担任第二十届中央委员会时期的中央财经委员会办公室主任。
description.en: Serves as the Director of the Office of the Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission during the term of the 20th Central Committee.

relationships.source: BAIDU:深化党和国家机构改革方案

description.zh-cn: 根据该方案，中央财经领导小组改为中央财经委员会。
description.en: According to this plan, the Central Leading Group for Financial and Economic Affairs was transformed into the Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission.

relationships.source: BAIDU:中华人民共和国中央人民政府组织法

description.zh-cn: 根据该法，中央财经委员会更名为政务院财政经济委员会。
description.en: According to this law, the Central Financial and Economic Commission was renamed the Financial and Economic Committee of the Government Administration Council.

description.zh-cn: 担任第十九届（改革后）中央委员会时期的中央财经委员会副主任。
description.en: Served as the Deputy Director of the Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission during the term of the 19th (post-reform) Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 担任第十九届（改革后）中央财经委员会办公室主任。
description.en: Served as the Director of the Office of the Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission during the 19th (post-reform) term.

description.zh-cn: 担任第十九届（改革后）中央财经委员会委员。
description.en: Served as a member of the Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission during the 19th (post-reform) term.

description.zh-cn: 担任第十九届（改革后）中央财经委员会委员。
description.en: Served as a member of the Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission during the 19th (post-reform) term.

description.zh-cn: 担任第十九届（改革后）中央财经委员会办公室副主任。
description.en: Served as the Deputy Director of the Office of the Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission during the 19th (post-reform) term.

description.zh-cn: 出生于安徽省潜山县（现潜山市）。
description.en: Born in Qianshan County (now Qianshan City), Anhui Province.

description.zh-cn: 余桂东是一名中国共产党党员。
description.en: Yu Guidong is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 1997年毕业于安庆师范学院（现安庆师范大学）数学系。
description.en: Graduated from the Department of Mathematics at Anqing Teachers College (now Anqing Normal University) in 1997.

description.zh-cn: 2006年于安徽师范大学获硕士学位。

description.zh-cn: “焚书”政策导致《论语》等儒家经典几乎失传。
description.en: The 'book burning' policy caused Confucian classics like the Analects to be nearly lost.

description.zh-cn: 该政策确立了儒家思想的官方地位，从而极大地提升了《论语》等儒家经典的社会重要性。
description.en: This policy established the official status of Confucianism, thereby greatly enhancing the social importance of Confucian classics like the Analects.

description.zh-cn: 朱熹将《大学》、《论语》、《孟子》、《中庸》合编为“四书”，确立了它们在儒家经典中的核心地位。
description.en: Zhu Xi compiled the Great Learning, the Analects, Mencius, and the Doctrine of the Mean into the 'Four Books', establishing their core status in the Confucian canon.

description.zh-cn: 通过将《论语》纳入“四书”并为其作注，朱熹极大地提升了《论语》在儒家经典体系中的地位。
description.en: By including the Analects in the 'Four Books' and writing commentaries on it, Zhu Xi greatly elevated the status of the Analects within the Confucian classics system.

description.zh-cn: 皇侃在编纂《论语义疏》时受到了佛教思想的影响。
description.en: Huang Kan was influenced by Buddhist thought when compiling the 'Subcommentary on the Analects'.

description.zh-cn: 黑格尔在他的著作中对《论语》提出了尖锐批评，认为其内容平庸，缺乏思辨哲学。
description.en: In his works, Hegel sharply criticized the Analects, arguing that its content was mundane and lacked speculative philosophy.

description.zh-cn: 程颐高度赞扬《论语》，认为随着研读的深入，其意味会愈发深长，他的评价推动了后世对《论语》的重视。
description.en: Cheng Yi highly praised the Analects, believing that its meaning becomes more profound with deeper study. His evaluation promoted the importance attached to the Analects by later generations.

Later, he majored in Western Economics as an on-the-job doctoral student at Huazhong University of Science and Technology and obtained a Ph.D. in Economics.

description.zh-cn: 毕业于西南政法学院刑事侦查专业。

description.en: Liu Yuejin joined the Chinese Communist Party in September 1977 and was expelled on September 11, 2024.

description.zh-cn: 因严重违纪违法，刘跃进被开除中国共产党党籍。
description.en: Liu Yuejin was expelled from the Chinese Communist Party for serious violations of discipline and law.

description.zh-cn: 2015年12月晋升为副总警监警衔。
description.en: Promoted to the rank of Deputy Commissioner-General in December 2015.

description.zh-cn: 在郭声琨担任公安部长期间，刘跃进历任公安部部长助理、国家禁毒委员会副主任、反恐专员、国家反恐怖工作领导小组副组长等职。
description.en: While Guo Shengkun served as Minister of Public Security, Liu Yuejin held positions including Assistant Minister, Deputy Director of the National Narcotics Control Commission, Counter-Terrorism Commissioner, and Deputy Head of the National Counter-Terrorism Leading Group.

description.zh-cn: 在赵克志担任公安部长期间，刘跃进继续担任国家禁毒委员会副主任、反恐专员、国家反恐怖工作领导小组副组长等职。
description.en: While Zhao Kezhi served as Minister of Public Security, Liu Yuejin continued to serve as Deputy Director of the National Narcotics Control Commission, Counter-Terrorism Commissioner, and Deputy Head of the National Counter-Terrorism Leading Group.

description.zh-cn: 先后接替李伟担任国家禁毒委员会副主任、办公室主任及国家反恐怖工作领导小组副组长、办公室主任。
description.en: Successively replaced Li Wei as the Deputy Director and Office Director of the National Narcotics Control Commission, and as the Deputy Head and Office Director of the National Counter-Terrorism Leading Group.

description.zh-cn: 公安部反恐专员职务由岳修虎接任。
description.en: The position of Counter-Terrorism Commissioner of the Ministry of Public Security was succeeded by Yue Xiuhu.

description.zh-cn: 国家禁毒委员会办公室主任职务由徐大彤接任。
description.en: The position of Director of the Office of the National Narcotics Control Commission was succeeded by Xu Datong.

description.zh-cn: 因涉嫌严重违纪违法，刘跃进接受中央纪委国家监委纪律审查和监察调查。
description.en: Liu Yuejin was investigated by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the National Supervisory Commission for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

description.zh-cn: 最高人民检察院依法以涉嫌受贿罪对刘跃进作出逮捕决定。
description.en: The Supreme People's Procuratorate made a decision to arrest Liu Yuejin on suspicion of bribery in accordance with the law.

description.zh-cn: 因成功侦破“湄公河10·5案”，刘跃进被公安部授予全国公安系统二级英雄模范荣誉称号。
description.en: For successfully solving the 'Mekong River 10·5' case, Liu Yuejin was awarded the honorary title of Second-class Hero and Model of the National Public Security System by the Ministry of Public Security.

description.zh-cn: 许飞青早年曾参加过抗日战争。
description.en: Xu Feiqing participated in the Second Sino-Japanese War in his early years.

description.zh-cn: 1979年，许飞青升任甘肃省人民政府副省长，直至1985年转任。
description.en: In 1979, Xu Feiqing was promoted to Vice Governor of the Gansu Provincial People's Government, a position he held until his transfer in 1985.

description.zh-cn: 1985年，许飞青转任甘肃省人大常委会副主任。
description.en: In 1985, Xu Feiqing was transferred to the position of Deputy Director of the Standing Committee of the Gansu Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 许飞青是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Xu Feiqing was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 许飞青是第八届全国人大代表。
description.en: Xu Feiqing was a delegate to the 8th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东在此次斗争中取胜后，确立了对中央红军的领导地位，为其成为中共领袖铺平了道路。
description.en: After winning this struggle, Mao Zedong established his leadership over the Central Red Army, paving the way for him to become the leader of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 代表中共中央军委发出二月来信，要求毛泽东脱离部队前往中央，试图以此调解争端。
description.en: On behalf of the CCP Central Military Commission, sent the 'February Letter' requesting Mao Zedong to leave the army for the central headquarters, in an attempt to mediate the dispute.

description.zh-cn: 会议全盘接受了毛泽东的建军主张，并选举其为前委书记，巩固了其领导地位。
description.en: The conference fully adopted Mao Zedong's principles on army building and elected him as Secretary of the Front Committee, consolidating his leadership position.

description.zh-cn: 林彪在不同历史时期多次支持毛泽东。1929年6月8日，在朱毛之争的白沙会议上，林彪坚定支持毛泽东，为他赢得了长久信任。1962年1月，在七千人大会上，尽管党内高层普遍批评大跃进，林彪仍公开支持毛泽东的路线和“三面红旗”，进一步巩固了毛的地位。
description.en: Lin Biao consistently supported Mao Zedong during different historical periods. On June 8, 1929, amidst the Zhu-Mao controversy, particularly at the Baisha Conference, Lin Biao firmly sided with Mao, earning his long-term trust. Later, in January 1962, at the Seven Thousand Cadres Conference, despite widespread criticism of the Great Leap Forward among high-level party leaders, Lin Biao publicly endorsed Mao Zedong's line and the 'Three Red Banners,' further consolidating Mao's position.

description.zh-cn: 在朱毛之争中，向其老上级朱德、陈毅反戈一击，转而支持毛泽东。
description.en: During the Zhu-Mao controversy, he turned against his old superiors Zhu De and Chen Yi to support Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 在白沙会议上坚决支持毛泽东。
description.en: Resolutely supported Mao Zedong at the Baisha Conference.

description.zh-cn: 在白沙会议上坚决支持毛泽东。
description.en: Resolutely supported Mao Zedong at the Baisha Conference.

description.zh-cn: 在白沙会议上坚决支持毛泽东。
description.en: Resolutely supported Mao Zedong at the Baisha Conference.

description.zh-cn: 文中暗示，毛泽东在朱毛之争中显露的控制欲，导致其后借反AB团之名进行整肃，最终引发富田事变。
description.en: The text implies that the desire for control shown by Mao Zedong during the Zhu-Mao controversy led him to later conduct purges in the name of combating the AB-Tuan, which ultimately triggered the Futian Incident.

description.zh-cn: 在富田事变后，利用其造成的不利影响轻易夺取了毛泽东的军权。
description.en: After the Futian Incident, he took advantage of its negative impact to easily seize military power from Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 在八七会议上首次提出“政权是由枪杆子中取得的”著名论断。
description.en: First proposed the famous thesis 'political power is obtained from the barrel of a gun' at the August 7th Conference.

description.zh-cn: 该论断是在八七会议的背景下提出的，会议为这一思想的产生提供了平台。
description.en: This thesis was proposed in the context of the August 7th Conference, which provided the platform for the emergence of this idea.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央于1927年8月7日在汉口召开紧急会议，即八七会议。
description.en: The Central Committee of the CCP convened an emergency meeting in Hankou on August 7, 1927, known as the August 7th Conference.

description.zh-cn: 八七会议后，瞿秋白欣赏毛泽东，并建议他到上海的中共中央机关工作。
description.en: After the August 7th Conference, Qu Qiubai appreciated Mao Zedong and suggested that he work at the CCP Central Committee's office in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东谢绝了瞿秋白让他去上海中央机关工作的建议，选择上山。
description.en: Mao Zedong declined Qu Qiubai's suggestion to work at the Central Committee's office in Shanghai, choosing to go to the mountains instead.

description.zh-cn: 彭公达因参与组织秋收起义而与毛泽东一同受到处分，表明其为组织者之一。
description.en: Peng Gongda was disciplined along with Mao Zedong for organizing the Autumn Harvest Uprising, indicating he was one of the organizers.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东率领部队到三湾村，开始对部队进行改编。
description.en: Mao Zedong led the troops to Sanwan village and began to reorganize the army.

description.zh-cn: 三湾改编在军队中建立了党的各级组织，确立了党对军队的领导，深刻地塑造了中国工农红军的组织结构。
description.en: The Sanwan Reorganization established Party organizations at all levels within the army, affirmed the Party's leadership over the army, and profoundly shaped the organizational structure of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东在三湾改编中推行的一系列改革深刻影响到后来的新四军的军制改革。
description.en: The series of reforms implemented by Mao Zedong during the Sanwan Reorganization profoundly influenced the later military system reforms of the New Fourth Army.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东在三湾改编中推行的一系列军队改革，当时并没有得到中共中央的支持。
description.en: The series of military reforms implemented by Mao Zedong during the Sanwan Reorganization did not receive support from the CCP Central Committee at the time.

description.en: The CPPCC Fujian Provincial Committee is under the leadership of the CCP Fujian Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，福建省政协的活动被迫停止，直到1977年9月才恢复。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, the activities of the Fujian Provincial CPPCC were forced to stop and did not resume until September 1977.

description.zh-cn: 张肖南是广东揭西人。
description.en: Zhang Xiaonan is from Jiexi, Guangdong.

description.zh-cn: 张肖南拥有中国人民解放军少将军衔。
description.en: Zhang Xiaonan holds the rank of Major General in the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 张肖南曾担任云南省军区司令员。

description.zh-cn: 张肖南是张纪南的兄长。

description.zh-cn: 张纪南是中华人民共和国人力资源和社会保障部原部长。

description.en: In 1991, Jiang Xianjin was promoted to Vice Minister of the Ministry of Public Security of the People's Republic of China.

description.en: Inferred from the page category 'Alumni of Chengdu Institute of Technology', Jiang Xianjin is an alumnus of Chengdu Institute of Technology.

description.en: Inferred from the page category 'Presidents of People's Public Security University of China', Jiang Xianjin served as the president of People's Public Security University of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类“中国武术协会顾问”推断，蒋先进曾担任中国武术协会顾问。
description.en: Inferred from the page category 'Consultants of the Chinese Wushu Association', Jiang Xianjin served as a consultant for the Chinese Wushu Association.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东等中国共产党高层发动了三反五反运动。
description.en: Mao Zedong and other senior leaders of the Communist Party of China launched the Three-anti and Five-anti campaigns.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党发动了三反五反运动，以“反腐败”、“反贪污”为名义。
description.en: The Communist Party of China launched the Three-anti and Five-anti campaigns under the slogans of "anti-corruption" and "anti-embezzlement".

description.zh-cn: 经毛泽东批准，三反五反运动于1952年10月结束。
description.en: With Mao Zedong's approval, the Three-anti and Five-anti campaigns ended in October 1952.

description.zh-cn: 经周恩来批准，三反五反运动于1952年10月结束。
description.en: With Zhou Enlai's approval, the Three-anti and Five-anti campaigns ended in October 1952.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平发现运动中的问题并向中共中央报告，促成了运动的结束。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping discovered problems in the campaign and reported them to the CPC Central Committee, contributing to its conclusion.

description.zh-cn: 三反五反运动为对资本主义工商业和资产阶级进一步的社会主义改造创造了有利条件。
description.en: The Three-anti and Five-anti campaigns created favorable conditions for the further socialist transformation of capitalist industry and commerce and the bourgeoisie.

description.zh-cn: 五反运动的主要目标是国内的资产阶级，导致中国大陆资产阶级走向消亡。
description.en: The main target of the Five-anti campaign was the domestic bourgeoisie, leading to the demise of the bourgeoisie in mainland China.

description.zh-cn: 三反五反运动造成了诸多冤假错案。
description.en: The Three-anti and Five-anti campaigns resulted in numerous unjust, false, and wrongly decided cases.

description.zh-cn: 乐少华在三反运动中被错误批判，于1952年1月15日自杀身亡。
description.en: Le Shaohua was wrongly criticized during the Three-anti campaign and committed suicide on January 15, 1952.

description.zh-cn: 乐少华是邓小平的连襟。
description.en: Le Shaohua was Deng Xiaoping's brother-in-law (husband of his wife's sister).

description.zh-cn: 中国航运大王卢作孚在运动中被迫害，于1952年2月8日自杀。
description.en: Chinese shipping magnate Lu Zuofu was persecuted during the campaign and committed suicide on February 8, 1952.

description.zh-cn: 冠生园创始人冼冠生在运动中被迫害，于1952年4月21日跳楼自杀。
description.en: Guan Sheng Yuan founder Xian Guansheng was persecuted during the campaign and committed suicide by jumping from a building on April 21, 1952.

description.zh-cn: 冼冠生是冠生园的创始人。
description.en: Xian Guansheng was the founder of Guan Sheng Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 刘青山、张子善因严重贪污被处决，该案成为三反运动高潮的标志。
description.en: The execution of Liu Qingshan and Zhang Zishan for serious corruption marked the climax of the Three-anti campaign.

description.zh-cn: 刘青山的死刑由毛泽东最终拍板决定。
description.en: The death sentence for Liu Qingshan was ultimately decided by Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 张子善的死刑由毛泽东最终拍板决定。
description.en: The death sentence for Zhang Zishan was ultimately decided by Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 目睹三反五反运动后，张爱玲于1952年7月决定移居香港。
description.en: After witnessing the Three-anti and Five-anti campaigns, Eileen Chang decided to move to Hong Kong in July 1952.

description.zh-cn: 三反五反运动使银行家陈光甫明确拒绝返回中国大陆的邀请。
description.en: The Three-anti and Five-anti campaigns led banker K. P. Chen to definitively refuse an invitation to return to mainland China.

description.zh-cn: 经济学家顾准在三反运动中受到了撤销党内外一切职务的处分。
description.en: Economist Gu Zhun was punished during the Three-anti campaign by being removed from all his positions both inside and outside the Party.

description.zh-cn: 时任上海副市长潘汉年于1952年2月5日做五反运动动员报告，推动了运动在上海的开展。
description.en: On February 5, 1952, then Deputy Mayor of Shanghai Pan Hannian delivered a mobilization report for the Five-anti campaign, promoting its development in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 罗隆基关于成立平反委员会的主张遭到了中共高层的批判。
description.en: Luo Longji's proposal to establish a rehabilitation committee was criticized by the senior leadership of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 罗隆基被毛泽东划为右派。
description.en: Luo Longji was labeled a rightist by Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 李宝忠是河北易县人。
description.en: Li Baozhong is from Yixian, Hebei.

description.zh-cn: 李宝忠是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Li Baozhong is a member of the Communist Party of China.

position.zh-cn: 全国人大代表（河北地区）
position.en: Deputy to the National People's Congress (Hebei region)

description.zh-cn: 2018年2月24日，李宝忠当选为第十三届全国人民代表大会河北地区代表。
description.en: On February 24, 2018, Li Baozhong was elected as a deputy from the Hebei region to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 谭惠珠是香港励进会的创办人。
description.en: Maria Tam was the founder of the Progressive Hong Kong Society.

description.zh-cn: 郭志权是香港励进会的共同创办人之一。
description.en: Kwok Chi-kuen was one of the co-founders of the Progressive Hong Kong Society.

description.zh-cn: 《中英联合声明》的签署为香港政制改革和香港励进会的成立创造了条件。
description.en: The signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration created the conditions for Hong Kong's political reforms and the establishment of the Progressive Hong Kong Society.

description.zh-cn: 香港励进会的意识形态是保守主义。
description.en: The ideology of the Progressive Hong Kong Society was conservatism.

description.zh-cn: 香港励进会于1990年11月6日解散，并合并入香港自由民主联会。
description.en: The Progressive Hong Kong Society was disbanded on November 6, 1990, and merged into the Hong Kong Liberal Democratic Federation.

description.zh-cn: 谭惠珠于1990年参与创立了香港自由民主联会。
description.en: Maria Tam co-founded the Hong Kong Liberal Democratic Federation in 1990.

description.zh-cn: 香港励进会与泛民主派议员在政治上展开竞争。
description.en: The Progressive Hong Kong Society competed politically with members of the pro-democracy camp.

description.zh-cn: 香港励进会在1988年区议会选举中派出49人参选，其中41人当选，显著提升了其政治影响力。
description.en: In the 1988 District Board elections, the Progressive Hong Kong Society fielded 49 candidates, 41 of whom were elected, significantly boosting its political influence.

description.zh-cn: 香港励进会在1988年立法局选举的间接选举中赢得八个议席，成为立法局中的第一大党。
description.en: In the 1988 Legislative Council election, the Progressive Hong Kong Society won eight seats in the indirect elections, becoming the largest party in the Legislative Council.

description.zh-cn: 在创立励进会时，谭惠珠身兼行政局议员。
description.en: At the time of founding the Progressive Hong Kong Society, Maria Tam was a member of the Executive Council.

description.zh-cn: 在创立励进会时，谭惠珠身兼立法局议员。
description.en: At the time of founding the Progressive Hong Kong Society, Maria Tam was a member of the Legislative Council.

description.zh-cn: 热月政变是法国大革命期间的一个重要转折事件。
description.en: The Thermidorian Reaction was a significant turning point during the French Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 热月党人协调一致地在国民公会攻击罗伯斯庇尔及其支持者，成功发动了政变。
description.en: The Thermidorians launched a coordinated attack on Robespierre and his supporters in the National Convention, successfully carrying out the coup.

description.zh-cn: 让-朗贝尔·塔利安在国民公会中率先抨击罗伯斯庇尔，是政变的主要煽动者之一。
description.en: Jean-Lambert Tallien was one of the main instigators of the coup, being the first to denounce Robespierre in the National Convention.

description.zh-cn: 约瑟夫·富歇在策划消灭罗伯斯庇尔的阴谋中发挥了重要作用，是政变事件的发起者之一。
description.en: Joseph Fouché played a significant role in plotting the elimination of Robespierre and was one of the initiators of the coup.

description.zh-cn: 热月政变导致山岳党失败，其78名代表被处决。
description.en: The Thermidorian Reaction resulted in the defeat of the Mountain, with 78 of its deputies executed.

description.zh-cn: 热月政变之后，随之而来的是针对雅各宾派的第一次白色恐怖。
description.en: Following the Thermidorian Reaction, the First White Terror was unleashed against the Jacobins.

description.zh-cn: 热月政变后的政治重组最终导致了1795年督政府的成立。
description.en: The political restructuring after the Thermidorian Reaction eventually led to the establishment of the Directory in 1795.

description.zh-cn: 奥古斯丁·罗伯斯庇尔是马克西米连·罗伯斯庇尔的弟弟。
description.en: Augustin Robespierre was the younger brother of Maximilien Robespierre.

description.zh-cn: 国民公会投票决定逮捕罗伯斯庇尔及其追随者。
description.en: The National Convention voted to arrest Robespierre and his followers.

description.zh-cn: 巴黎公社派遣部队试图解救被国民公会逮捕的罗伯斯庇尔。
description.en: The Paris Commune sent troops in an attempt to free Robespierre, who had been arrested by the National Convention.

description.zh-cn: 在热月政变期间，保罗·巴拉斯被国民公会任命为指挥其下属部队的指挥官。
description.en: During the Thermidorian Reaction, Paul Barras was appointed by the National Convention as the commander of its forces.

description.zh-cn: 雅各宾派采取了一系列恐怖统治措施，开启了恐怖时期。
description.en: The Jacobins implemented a series of terror measures, initiating the Reign of Terror.

description.zh-cn: 在恐怖统治时期，主张温和共和主义的吉伦特派遭到重创，许多成员被处决或驱逐。
description.en: During the Reign of Terror, the moderate republican Girondins were severely crushed, with many members executed or expelled.

description.zh-cn: 在内忧外患的形势下，雅各宾派领导的法国挫败了第一次反法同盟，并将其赶出法国境内。
description.en: Facing internal and external threats, France, under Jacobin leadership, defeated the First Coalition and drove them out of French territory.

description.zh-cn: 在第一次白色恐怖期间，热月党通过武力镇压了无套裤汉。
description.en: During the First White Terror, the Thermidorians suppressed the sans-culottes by force.

description.zh-cn: 1794年12月24日，热月党人废除了对商品价格和工资进行控制的全面限价法令。
description.en: On December 24, 1794, the Thermidorians abolished the Law of the General Maximum, which controlled prices and wages.

description.zh-cn: 年轻的将军拿破仑·波拿巴镇压了由保皇党人领导的葡月13日反叛。
description.en: The young general Napoleon Bonaparte suppressed the 13 Vendémiaire revolt led by royalists.

description.zh-cn: 1967年1月19日，山西省政协被造反派夺权，活动全部停止。1975年11月5日，成立山西省恢复政协筹备工作领导组，开始恢复工作。

description.zh-cn: 1985年，巩俐考入中央戏剧学院表演系。
description.en: In 1985, Gong Li was admitted to the acting department of the Central Academy of Drama.

description.zh-cn: 1985年，因巩俐高考分数与艺术院校录取标准相差11分，中央戏剧学院招生组呈报文化部艺术教育司，获特批录取巩俐。
description.en: In 1985, as Gong Li's college entrance exam score was 11 points below the admission standard for arts institutions, the admissions team of the Central Academy of Drama reported to the Arts Education Department of the Ministry of Culture and received special approval to admit her.

description.zh-cn: 1987年，张艺谋在其导演处女作《红高粱》中启用巩俐为女主角，使其一举成名，开启了她的演艺生涯。
description.en: In 1987, Zhang Yimou cast Gong Li as the lead actress in his directorial debut 'Red Sorghum', which made her famous overnight and launched her acting career.

description.zh-cn: 巩俐的演艺生涯始于与第五代导演的合作，她主演了该群体导演的多部代表作，被誉为“第五代导演的电影缪斯”。
description.en: Gong Li's acting career began with collaborations with the Fifth Generation directors. She starred in many of their representative works and is hailed as the 'film muse of the Fifth Generation directors'.

description.zh-cn: 巩俐于2019年与法国电子音乐家让-米歇尔·雅尔结婚。
description.en: Gong Li married French electronic musician Jean-Michel Jarre in 2019.

description.zh-cn: 巩俐于2008年11月8日宣誓入籍新加坡，成为新加坡公民。
description.en: Gong Li took an oath to become a Singaporean citizen on November 8, 2008.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命前期，巩俐的父亲调入山东大学教书，导致全家迁往山东济南。
description.en: In the early stages of the Cultural Revolution, Gong Li's father was transferred to teach at Shandong University, leading the entire family to move to Jinan, Shandong.

description.zh-cn: 2010年，法国文化部授予巩俐“艺术与文学勋章”司令勋位。
description.en: In 2010, the French Ministry of Culture awarded Gong Li the rank of Commander of the Ordre des Arts et des Lettres.

description.zh-cn: 2000年5月，巩俐被任命为联合国教科文组织“促进和平艺术家”。
description.en: In May 2000, Gong Li was appointed as a UNESCO Artist for Peace.

description.zh-cn: 2000年10月，巩俐被任命为联合国粮农组织的“民间大使”（粮农大使）。
description.en: In October 2000, Gong Li was appointed as a Goodwill Ambassador for the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations.

description.zh-cn: 2008年，联合国环境保护总部邀请巩俐担任全球环境保护大使。
description.en: In 2008, the United Nations Environment Programme invited Gong Li to serve as a Global Environment Ambassador.

description.zh-cn: 巩俐曾担任第九届、第十届中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会委员。
description.en: Gong Li served as a member of the 9th and 10th National Committees of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 1997年，巩俐担任第50届戛纳国际电影节主竞赛单元评委。
description.en: In 1997, Gong Li served as a member of the main competition jury at the 50th Cannes Film Festival.

description.zh-cn: 2000年，巩俐担任第50届柏林国际电影节评委会主席。
description.en: In 2000, Gong Li served as the President of the Jury for the 50th Berlin International Film Festival.

description.zh-cn: 2002年，巩俐担任第59届威尼斯国际电影节评委会主席。
description.en: In 2002, Gong Li served as the President of the Jury for the 59th Venice International Film Festival.

description.zh-cn: 2003年，巩俐担任第16届东京国际电影节评委会主席。
description.en: In 2003, Gong Li served as the President of the Jury for the 16th Tokyo International Film Festival.

description.zh-cn: 2014年，巩俐担任第17届上海国际电影节评委会主席。
description.en: In 2014, Gong Li served as the President of the Jury for the 17th Shanghai International Film Festival.

description.zh-cn: 2021年，巩俐担任第11届北京国际电影节评委会主席。
description.en: In 2021, Gong Li served as the President of the Jury for the 11th Beijing International Film Festival.

description.zh-cn: 沈阳铁路运输中级法院的上诉法院和业务上级是辽宁省高级人民法院。
description.en: The appellate court and operational superior of the Shenyang Railway Transport Intermediate Court is the Liaoning High People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 沈阳铁路运输中级法院的组织上级是辽宁省人民代表大会常务委员会。
description.en: The organizational superior of the Shenyang Railway Transport Intermediate Court is the Standing Committee of the Liaoning Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国宪法是沈阳铁路运输中级法院的授权法源。
description.en: The Constitution of the People's Republic of China is the authorizing legal source for the Shenyang Railway Transport Intermediate Court.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国人民法院组织法是沈阳铁路运输中级法院的组织法规。
description.en: The Organic Law of the People's Courts of the People's Republic of China is the organizational statute for the Shenyang Railway Transport Intermediate Court.

description.zh-cn: 1979年12月1日，根据中华人民共和国铁道部、司法部的通知，沈阳铁路运输中级法院开始筹建。
description.en: On December 1, 1979, based on a notice from the Ministry of Railways and the Ministry of Justice of the People's Republic of China, preparatory work for the Shenyang Railway Transport Intermediate Court began.

description.zh-cn: “精神文明建设”是在改革开放的背景下提出的新词语和政策。
description.en: "Spiritual Civilization Construction" is a new term and policy proposed in the context of the Reform and Opening-up.

description.zh-cn: 在此次会议上，“精神文明建设”一词被正式发表，标志着该政策的正式提出。
description.en: At this congress, the term "Spiritual Civilization Construction" was formally announced, marking the official proposal of the policy.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央为了加强及控制精神文明，设立了中央精神文明建设指导委员会。
description.en: The CPC Central Committee established the Central Guidance Commission on Building Spiritual Civilization to strengthen and control spiritual civilization.

description.zh-cn: 该委员会的设立旨在加强及控制精神文明建设。
description.en: This commission was established to strengthen and control the construction of spiritual civilization.

description.zh-cn: 精神文明建设是中国共产党提出和领导的一项政治方针和运动。
description.en: Spiritual Civilization Construction is a political policy and movement proposed and led by the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 中央精神文明建设指导委员会办公室是中央精神文明建设指导委员会的办事机构。
description.en: The Office of the Central Guidance Commission on Building Spiritual Civilization is the administrative body of the Commission.

description.zh-cn: 朱邦复于1976年创制了仓颉输入法，其初版名为“形意检字法”。
description.en: Chu Bong-Foo created the Cangjie input method in 1976, which was initially named 'Glyph-meaning Indexing Method'.

description.zh-cn: 1978年，时任三军大学校长的蒋纬国为纪念上古时期仓颉造字的精神，将“形意检字法”改名为“仓颉输入法”。
description.en: In 1978, Chiang Wei-kuo, then president of the Armed Forces University, renamed the 'Glyph-meaning Indexing Method' to 'Cangjie input method' to commemorate the spirit of the ancient figure Cangjie's creation of characters.

description.zh-cn: 蒋纬国为朱邦复发明的输入法命名，其灵感来源于对仓颉造字精神的纪念。
description.en: Chiang Wei-kuo's naming of the input method invented by Chu Bong-Foo was inspired by the commemoration of Cangjie's spirit of character creation.

description.zh-cn: 朱邦复在三军大学担任无给职，负责发展中文通讯系统，并在此期间发明了仓颉输入法。
description.en: Chu Bong-Foo served as an unpaid staff member at the Armed Forces University, responsible for developing a Chinese communication system, during which he invented the Cangjie input method.

description.zh-cn: 在1978年为仓颉输入法命名时，蒋纬国正担任三军大学校长。
description.en: Chiang Wei-kuo was serving as the President of the Armed Forces University when he named the Cangjie input method in 1978.

description.zh-cn: 朱邦复参考《康熙字典》中的四万余字，对第二代仓颉输入法进行改良，并发表了第三代版本。
description.en: Chu Bong-Foo referenced over 40,000 characters from the Kangxi Dictionary to improve the second generation of the Cangjie input method, subsequently releasing the third version.

description.zh-cn: 1982年，朱邦复公开放弃仓颉输入法的专利权，并积极推动电脑的中文化进程。
description.en: In 1982, Chu Bong-Foo publicly relinquished the patent for the Cangjie input method and actively promoted the process of computer sinicization.

description.zh-cn: 朱邦复旨在建立一套“仓颉系统”，用以统一处理汉字的形、音、义、码、序、辨等六大问题。
description.en: Chu Bong-Foo aimed to establish a 'Cangjie System' to uniformly handle six major aspects of Chinese characters: form, sound, meaning, code, order, and distinction.

description.zh-cn: 苍颉检字法被视为由仓颉输入法衍生而来的新输入法，也被称为“第六代”仓颉。
description.en: The Cangjie Glyph-finding Method is considered a new input method derived from the Cangjie input method, and is also known as the 'sixth generation' Cangjie.

description.zh-cn: Microsoft Windows操作系统内置了仓颉输入法，这使其成为主流的形码输入法之一，并产生了目前最常见的版本。
description.en: The Microsoft Windows operating system includes a built-in Cangjie input method, which has made it one of the mainstream glyph-based input methods and produced the most common version in use today.

description.zh-cn: 仓颉输入法是香港最常用的中文输入法之一。
description.en: The Cangjie input method is one of the most commonly used Chinese input methods in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 仓颉输入法是澳门最常用的中文输入法之一，并且是当地中小学的必修课程。
description.en: The Cangjie input method is one of the most commonly used Chinese input methods in Macau and is a compulsory course in local primary and secondary schools.

description.zh-cn: 快速仓颉输入法最初是在倚天中文系统中被开发出来的。
description.en: The Quick Cangjie input method was originally developed within the ETen Chinese System.

description.zh-cn: 快速仓颉输入法是由仓颉输入法改良而成的衍生版本。
description.en: The Quick Cangjie input method is a derivative version improved from the Cangjie input method.

description.zh-cn: 杜星垣在赵紫阳担任国务院总理期间任国务院秘书长。
description.en: Du Xingyuan served as Secretary-General of the State Council while Zhao Ziyang was Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 杜星垣接替姬鹏飞出任中国共产党国务院机关党组书记。
description.en: Du Xingyuan succeeded Ji Pengfei as Secretary of the Party Leadership Group of the State Council of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 杜星垣的中华人民共和国国务院秘书长和中国共产党国务院机关党组书记职务均由田纪云接任。
description.en: Tian Jiyun succeeded Du Xingyuan as both Secretary-General of the State Council of the People's Republic of China and Secretary of the Party Leadership Group of the State Council of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 杜星垣接替金明出任中华人民共和国国务院秘书长。
description.en: Du Xingyuan succeeded Jin Ming as Secretary-General of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 大夏大学是华东师范大学的前身之一。
description.en: Great China University is one of the predecessors of East China Normal University.

description.zh-cn: 徐发淦于1930年12月出生在印度加尔各答。
description.en: Xu Fagan was born in Kolkata, India in December 1930.

description.zh-cn: 徐发淦曾担任中华全国归国华侨联合会副主席。
description.en: Xu Fagan served as the Vice Chairman of the All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese.

description.zh-cn: 徐发淦是第七届和第八届中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会委员。
description.en: Xu Fagan was a member of the 7th and 8th National Committees of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 徐发淦是中华人民共和国的一名政治人物。
description.en: Xu Fagan is a politician in the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，徐发淦是北京师范大学的校友。
description.en: According to Wikipedia categories, Xu Fagan is an alumnus of Beijing Normal University.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，徐发淦是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to Wikipedia categories, Xu Fagan is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 韩桓惠王是韩厘王之子。
description.en: King Huanhui of Han was the son of King Xili of Han.

description.zh-cn: 韩废王（韩安）是韩桓惠王之子。
description.en: King Fei of Han (Han An) was the son of King Huanhui of Han.

description.zh-cn: 韩桓惠王于公元前272年至前239年担任韩国君主。
description.en: King Huanhui of Han reigned as the king of the State of Han from 272 BC to 239 BC.

description.zh-cn: 韩非作为韩国臣子，曾多次向其君主韩桓惠王上书进谏，要求推行法治。
description.en: As a subject of the State of Han, Han Fei repeatedly submitted memorials to his monarch, King Huanhui, advocating for the implementation of the rule of law.

description.zh-cn: 郑国奉韩桓惠王之命，作为使臣前往秦国执行疲秦之计。
description.en: Zheng Guo, acting on the orders of King Huanhui of Han, went to the State of Qin as an envoy to carry out the strategy of exhausting Qin.

description.zh-cn: 公元前262年，秦国大将白起率军进攻韩国，占领了野王，对韩国构成了严重军事威胁。
description.en: In 262 BC, the Qin general Bai Qi led an army to attack the State of Han, capturing the territory of Yewang and posing a serious military threat to Han.

description.zh-cn: 因上党郡太守靳黈拒绝执行割地命令，韩桓惠王将其罢免，以推进对秦的求和政策。
description.en: Because the governor of Shangdang Commandery, Jin Tou, refused to execute the order to cede territory, King Huanhui of Han dismissed him to advance the policy of seeking peace with Qin.

description.zh-cn: 冯亭决定将上党郡献给赵国而非秦国，这一行为直接激化了秦赵矛盾，成为长平之战的导火索。
description.en: Feng Ting's decision to offer Shangdang Commandery to the State of Zhao instead of Qin directly escalated the conflict between Qin and Zhao, becoming the trigger for the Battle of Changping.

description.zh-cn: 为应对白起的军事进攻，韩桓惠王向时任秦国相国的范且（应侯）许诺割让上党郡以求和。
description.en: In response to Bai Qi's military offensive, King Huanhui of Han promised the Prime Minister of Qin, Fan Ju (Marquis of Ying), to cede Shangdang Commandery in exchange for peace.

description.zh-cn: 赵国因接受韩国上党郡而与意图夺取该地的秦国爆发了长平之战，两国成为敌对交战方。
description.en: The State of Zhao's acceptance of Shangdang Commandery from Han led to the Battle of Changping with the State of Qin, which also intended to seize the territory, making the two states adversaries in the war.

description.zh-cn: 为了在南京市实施军事管制，成立了中国人民解放军南京市军事管制委员会作为最高权力机关。
description.en: The Chinese People's Liberation Army Nanjing Municipal Military Control Commission was established as the highest authority to implement military control in Nanjing.

description.zh-cn: 其职能之一是接收清理国民党在南京的中央机关和南京市各机关及官僚资本机构遗留的人员、财产、档案，并肃清其残余势力。
description.en: One of its functions was to take over and liquidate the personnel, property, and archives left by the Kuomintang's central organs, various municipal agencies, and bureaucrat-capital institutions in Nanjing, and to eliminate its remaining forces.

description.zh-cn: 1950年后，南京市军管会的权力逐渐移交给南京市人民政府，导致其第一次使命的结束。
description.en: After 1950, the power of the Nanjing Municipal Military Control Commission was gradually transferred to the Nanjing Municipal People's Government, leading to the end of its first mission.

description.zh-cn: 在军事管制期间作为南京市的最高权力机关，对该市实行全面管治。
description.en: Served as the highest authority in Nanjing during the period of military control, exercising comprehensive governance over the city.

description.zh-cn: 中国科学院软件研究所由中国科学院于1985年3月1日成立。
description.en: The Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences was established by the Chinese Academy of Sciences on March 1, 1985.

description.zh-cn: 中国科学院软件研究所是中国科学院的直属事业单位。
description.en: The Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences is a public institution directly under the Chinese Academy of Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 中国科学院软件研究所的前身是中国科学院计算技术研究所的软件研究室。
description.en: The predecessor of the Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences was the software research department of the Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 中国科学院软件研究所是《软件学报》的主办单位。
description.en: The Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences is the publisher of the 'Journal of Software'.

description.zh-cn: 中国科学院软件研究所是《中文信息学报》的主办单位。
description.en: The Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences is the publisher of the 'Journal of Chinese Information Processing'.

description.zh-cn: 与上海联彤网络通讯技术有限公司联合发布中国操作系统（COS）。
description.en: Jointly released the China Operating System (COS) with Shanghai Liantong Network Communications Technology Co., Ltd.

position.zh-cn: 文艺部主任、海外版总编辑
position.en: Director of the Literature and Art Department, Editor-in-Chief of the Overseas Edition

description.zh-cn: 丁振海曾任《人民日报》文艺部主任、海外版总编辑。
description.en: Ding Zhenhai was the former director of the literature and art department and editor-in-chief of the overseas edition of the People's Daily.

description.zh-cn: 湖南省机关事务管理局是湖南省人民政府的直属机构。
description.en: The Hunan Provincial Government Affairs Administration is a directly affiliated institution of the Hunan Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 出生于俄罗斯帝国库尔斯克省阿列克谢耶夫卡村。
description.en: Born in Alekseyevka village, Kursk Governorate, Russian Empire.

description.zh-cn: 弗拉基米尔·拉祖瓦耶夫接替捷连季·什特科夫担任苏联驻朝鲜特命全权大使。
description.en: Vladimir Razuvaev succeeded Terenty Shtykov as the Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the USSR to North Korea.

description.zh-cn: 参与了第二次世界大战。
description.en: Participated in World War II.

description.zh-cn: 参与了朝鲜战争。
description.en: Participated in the Korean War.

description.zh-cn: 参与了克里米亚战役。
description.en: Participated in the Crimean Offensive.

description.zh-cn: 参与了库尔兰战役。
description.en: Participated in the Courland Pocket.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党三明市委员会的业务上级机构是中国共产党福建省委员会。
description.en: The operational superior of the CPC Sanming Municipal Committee is the CPC Fujian Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中共福建省委批准成立中国共产党三明市委员会。
description.en: The CPC Fujian Provincial Committee approved the establishment of the CPC Sanming Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 邓本元接替黄琪玉任三明市委书记。
description.en: Deng Benyuan succeeded Huang Qiyu as Secretary of the Sanming Municipal Party Committee.

description.zh-cn: 杜源生接替邓本元任三明市委书记。
description.en: Du Yuansheng succeeded Deng Benyuan as Secretary of the Sanming Municipal Party Committee.

description.zh-cn: 离乡参加抗日战争。
description.en: Left his hometown to participate in the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 提供江阴要塞情报并说服司令戴戎光，协助起义。
description.en: Provided intelligence on the Jiangyin Fortress and persuaded Commander Dai Rongguang, assisting in the uprising.

description.zh-cn: 说服戴戎光调整炮台角度以配合起义。
description.en: Persuaded Dai Rongguang to adjust the battery angles to coordinate with the uprising.

description.zh-cn: 追认戴龙为中华人民共和国烈士。
description.en: Posthumously recognized Dai Long as a martyr of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 一同被派遣赴台从事策反及情报工作。
description.en: Were dispatched together to Taiwan to carry out counter-rebellion and intelligence work.

description.zh-cn: 受明成祖之命主编《永乐大典》（初名《文献大成》）。
description.en: Was ordered by the Yongle Emperor to serve as the chief editor of the Yongle Encyclopedia (originally named 'Wenxian Dacheng').

description.zh-cn: 在《文献大成》因不完善而重修时，被明成祖任命为监修。
description.en: When 'Wenxian Dacheng' was being revised due to incompleteness, he was appointed as a supervisor by the Yongle Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 在《文献大成》因不完善而重修时，与姚广孝一同被明成祖任命为监修。
description.en: Was appointed as a supervisor by the Yongle Emperor, along with Yao Guangxiao, during the revision of 'Wenxian Dacheng'.

description.zh-cn: 向明太祖朱元璋提议编写一部类书典籍，但此事后遭搁置。
description.en: Proposed the compilation of a comprehensive leishu to Emperor Hongwu (Zhu Yuanzhang), but the matter was shelved.

description.zh-cn: 非常喜爱《永乐大典》，为避免其因火灾等意外而亡佚，于嘉靖四十一年（1562年）下令重录一部副本。
description.en: Greatly admired the Yongle Encyclopedia and, to prevent its loss from fire or other accidents, ordered the creation of a duplicate manuscript copy in 1562.

description.zh-cn: 被明世宗朱厚熜任命为《永乐大典》重录工作的总校官。
description.en: Was appointed by the Jiajing Emperor (Zhu Houcong) as a general proofreader for the project to create a duplicate copy of the Yongle Encyclopedia.

description.zh-cn: 被明世宗朱厚熜任命为《永乐大典》重录工作的总校官。
description.en: Was appointed by the Jiajing Emperor (Zhu Houcong) as a general proofreader for the project to create a duplicate copy of the Yongle Encyclopedia.

description.zh-cn: 据郭沫若、张升等人推测，《永乐大典》正本可能在明末李自成入京时被其农民军焚毁。
description.en: According to scholars like Guo Moruo and Zhang Sheng, the original manuscript of the Yongle Encyclopedia may have been destroyed by Li Zicheng's peasant army when they entered Beijing at the end of the Ming dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 在焚烧翰林院时，导致一部分《永乐大典》被焚毁、弃置或被外国人盗走。
description.en: When they set fire to the Hanlin Academy, they caused a portion of the Yongle Encyclopedia to be burned, abandoned, or stolen by foreigners.

description.zh-cn: 在光绪十一年至十三年间从翰林院盗走至少百余册《永乐大典》副本，加剧了其散佚。
description.en: Between 1885 and 1887, he stole at least a hundred volumes of the Yongle Encyclopedia's duplicate manuscript from the Hanlin Academy, accelerating its dispersal and loss.

description.zh-cn: 四库馆馆臣从《永乐大典》中辑佚了大量散佚古籍，如《旧五代史》等，这些辑佚成果成为《四库全书》的重要组成部分。
description.en: Scholars of the Siku Quanshu project recovered a large number of lost ancient books, such as the 'Old History of the Five Dynasties', from the Yongle Encyclopedia, and these recovered texts became an important part of the Siku Quanshu.

description.zh-cn: 上《谨陈管见开馆校书折子》，提议从《永乐大典》中辑佚以充实《四库全书》，此建议被采纳。
description.en: Submitted a memorial proposing the recovery of lost texts from the Yongle Encyclopedia to enrich the Siku Quanshu, a suggestion that was adopted.

description.zh-cn: 《永乐大典》以《洪武正韵》作为编排韵目，以韵统字，用字系事。
description.en: The Yongle Encyclopedia used the 'Hongwu Zhengyun' as its organizational framework, arranging entries by rime, with characters under their respective rimes.

description.zh-cn: 将翰林院清点后仅存的64册《永乐大典》运回家中私藏，使其脱离官方保管。
description.en: Moved the last remaining 64 volumes of the Yongle Encyclopedia from the Hanlin Academy to his private residence after an inventory, removing them from official custody.

description.zh-cn: 在教育部任职时，提议将陆润庠私藏的翰林院《大典》残本交由京师图书馆收藏保管，促进了其保护。

description.zh-cn: 1997年毕业于南京大学生物科学与技术系。

description.zh-cn: 2005年进入中科院上海生命科学研究院生物化学与细胞生物学研究所任研究员、博士生导师。
description.en: In 2005, he joined the Institute of Biochemistry and Cell Biology, Shanghai Institutes for Biological Sciences, Chinese Academy of Sciences, as a researcher and PhD supervisor.

description.zh-cn: 2014年任武汉大学生命科学学院院长、教授。

description.zh-cn: 宋保亮现任中国生物物理学会常务理事。

description.zh-cn: 在三权分立的政治制度中，行政机关是与立法、司法机关并列的三个权力分支之一。
description.en: In the political system of separation of powers, the executive branch is one of the three branches of power, alongside the legislative and judicial branches.

description.zh-cn: 行政机关可以是法令的来源。
description.en: The executive branch can be a source of decrees.

description.zh-cn: 行政机关可以是行政命令的来源。
description.en: The executive branch can be a source of executive orders.

description.zh-cn: 在议会制中，行政机构（政府）的存在需要立法机关的信任供给。
description.en: In a parliamentary system, the existence of the executive branch (government) requires the confidence and supply of the legislature.

description.zh-cn: 在儒家文化区域的国家，君主掌握立法权。
description.en: In countries within the Confucian cultural sphere, the monarch held legislative power.

description.zh-cn: 在总统制国家，总统身兼国家元首。
description.en: In presidential systems, the president also serves as the head of state.

description.zh-cn: 在总统制国家，总统身兼政府首脑。
description.en: In presidential systems, the president also serves as the head of government.

description.zh-cn: 在总统制国家，各政府部门的部长由总统任命，并对总统负责。
description.en: In presidential systems, ministers of government departments are appointed by and accountable to the president.

description.zh-cn: 在半总统制国家，总理代替总统对国会负责。
description.en: In semi-presidential systems, the prime minister is accountable to the parliament on behalf of the president.

description.zh-cn: 在议会制国家，内阁由国会多数支持的议员组成，并对国会负责。
description.en: In parliamentary systems, the cabinet is formed by members of parliament who have majority support and is accountable to the parliament.

description.zh-cn: 在议会制国家，获得国会多数支持的议员组成内阁。
description.en: In parliamentary systems, the cabinet is formed by members of parliament who command the support of a majority in parliament.

description.zh-cn: 在社会主义国家，行政机构实际执行的是国内执政党的决策。
description.en: In socialist states, the executive branch actually implements the decisions of the domestic ruling party.

description.zh-cn: 在委员会制国家中，最高行政机构的成员由议会选举产生。
description.en: In directorial systems, members of the supreme executive body are elected by the parliament.

description.zh-cn: 国防部长通常是向政府首脑（如总理）汇报的内阁成员。
description.en: The Minister of Defence is typically a cabinet member who reports to the head of government (such as the Prime Minister).

description.zh-cn: 内政部长通常是向政府首脑（如总理）汇报的内阁成员。
description.en: The Minister of the Interior is typically a cabinet member who reports to the head of government (such as the Prime Minister).

description.zh-cn: 外交部长通常是向政府首脑（如总理）汇报的内阁成员。
description.en: The Minister of Foreign Affairs is typically a cabinet member who reports to the head of government (such as the Prime Minister).

description.zh-cn: 财政部长通常是向政府首脑（如总理）汇报的内阁成员。
description.en: The Minister of Finance is typically a cabinet member who reports to the head of government (such as the Prime Minister).

description.zh-cn: 司法部长通常是向政府首脑（如总理）汇报的内阁成员。
description.en: The Minister of Justice is typically a cabinet member who reports to the head of government (such as the Prime Minister).

description.zh-cn: 内政部长负责监督警察部队。
description.en: The Minister of the Interior supervises the police forces.

description.zh-cn: 分权的主要目的之一是限制和制衡行政部门的权力。
description.en: One of the main purposes of separation of powers is to limit and check the power of the executive branch.

description.zh-cn: 司法机构通过监督方式规制行政机构的权力。
description.en: The judiciary regulates the power of the executive branch through oversight.

description.zh-cn: 行政机关是五权分立制度中的五权之一。
description.en: The executive branch is one of the five branches in the Five-Power Constitution system.

description.zh-cn: 立法机构是五权分立制度中的五权之一。
description.en: The legislative branch is one of the five branches in the Five-Power Constitution system.

description.zh-cn: 司法机构是五权分立制度中的五权之一。
description.en: The judicial branch is one of the five branches in the Five-Power Constitution system.

description.zh-cn: 监察院是五权分立制度中的五权之一，其创设源自于孙中山的五权宪法理论。
description.en: The Control Yuan is one of the five branches in the Five-Power Constitution system, and its establishment originated from Sun Yat-sen's Five-Power Constitution theory.

description.zh-cn: 行政学是研究行政现象的学问。
description.en: Public administration is the academic field that studies the phenomenon of the executive branch.

description.zh-cn: 美国是实行总统制的典型国家。
description.en: The United States is a typical country that implements a presidential system.

description.zh-cn: 法国是实行半总统制的国家。
description.en: France is a country that implements a semi-presidential system.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯是实行半总统制的国家。
description.en: Russia is a country that implements a semi-presidential system.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国是实行半总统制的国家。
description.en: The Republic of China is a country that implements a semi-presidential system.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国是社会主义国家。
description.en: The People's Republic of China is a socialist state.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国是社会主义国家。
description.en: The Democratic People's Republic of Korea is a socialist state.

description.zh-cn: 越南是社会主义国家。

description.en: The Swiss Federal Council is a prime example of a directorial system of government.

description.en: On December 9, 1949, Lu Han, then Chairman of Yunnan Province of the Republic of China, telegraphed the nation to announce the 'Yunnan Uprising'.

description.zh-cn: 通过其下设的金融组，昆明市军事管制委员会成立了中国人民银行云南省分行。

description.en: After its establishment, the People's Bank of China Yunnan Provincial Branch completed the construction of the local RMB market and curbed the long-standing hyperinflation.

description.zh-cn: 大跃进时期，因受左倾浮夸风影响，云南货币投放失去控制。

description.zh-cn: 中国工商银行于2010年对工银亚洲进行私有化，并于同年12月21日完成退市。
description.en: The Industrial and Commercial Bank of China privatized ICBC (Asia) in 2010, and it was delisted on December 21 of the same year.

description.zh-cn: 作为朝鲜人民军最高司令官，金日成是《朝鲜停战协定》的签署人之一。
description.en: As the Supreme Commander of the Korean People's Army, Kim Il-sung was one of the signatories of the Korean Armistice Agreement.

description.zh-cn: 作为中国人民志愿军司令员，彭德怀是《朝鲜停战协定》的签署人之一。
description.en: As the Commander of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army, Peng Dehuai was one of the signatories of the Korean Armistice Agreement.

description.zh-cn: 作为联合国军总司令，马克·克拉克是《朝鲜停战协定》的签署人之一。
description.en: As the Commander-in-Chief of the United Nations Command, Mark W. Clark was one of the signatories of the Korean Armistice Agreement.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜人民军是《朝鲜停战协定》的签署方之一。
description.en: The Korean People's Army was one of the signatory parties to the Korean Armistice Agreement.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民志愿军是《朝鲜停战协定》的签署方之一。
description.en: The Chinese People's Volunteer Army was one of the signatory parties to the Korean Armistice Agreement.

description.zh-cn: 联合国军是《朝鲜停戦协定》的签署方之一。
description.en: The United Nations Command was one of the signatory parties to the Korean Armistice Agreement.

description.zh-cn: 大韩民国因时任总统李承晚的反对而未在《朝鲜停战协定》上签字。1954年日内瓦会议和谈破裂后，时任大韩民国外交部长官卞荣泰称大韩民国“不再认为有义务遵守停战协定”。
description.en: Due to the opposition of then-President Syngman Rhee, the Republic of Korea did not sign the Korean Armistice Agreement. After the breakdown of the Geneva Conference talks in 1954, then-South Korean Foreign Minister Pyon Yong-tae stated that the Republic of Korea 'no longer considers itself obligated to abide by the armistice agreement'.

description.zh-cn: 《朝鲜停战协定》规定设立军事停战委员会，以监督协定的实施。
description.en: The Korean Armistice Agreement stipulated the establishment of the Military Armistice Commission to supervise the implementation of the agreement.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜人民军决定停止参加停战委员会活动，并宣布不再承认停战委员会联合国军司令部部分为对应机构，导致该委员会名存实亡。
description.en: The Korean People's Army decided to cease its participation in the Military Armistice Commission and no longer recognized the UNC component as its counterpart, rendering the commission defunct.

description.zh-cn: 中国政府宣布召回驻板门店停战委员会的中国人民志愿军代表团。
description.en: The Chinese government announced the recall of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army delegation from the Military Armistice Commission in Panmunjom.

description.zh-cn: 为应对韩国加入“防扩散安全倡议”，朝鲜宣布退出停战协定，不再受其约束。2013年3月5日，朝鲜人民军最高司令部再次声明不承认该协定。
description.en: In response to South Korea joining the Proliferation Security Initiative, North Korea announced its withdrawal from the armistice agreement, stating it would no longer be bound by it. On March 5, 2013, the KPA Supreme Command reiterated that it would not recognize the agreement.

description.zh-cn: 金日成在朝鲜战争期间担任朝鲜人民军最高司令官。
description.en: Kim Il-sung served as the Supreme Commander of the Korean People's Army during the Korean War.

description.zh-cn: 马克·克拉克在朝鲜战争后期担任联合国军总司令。
description.en: Mark W. Clark served as the Commander-in-Chief of the United Nations Command during the later stages of the Korean War.

description.zh-cn: 该决议授权美国组建联合国军司令部以介入朝鲜战争。
description.en: This resolution authorized the United States to form the United Nations Command to intervene in the Korean War.

description.zh-cn: 联合国安理会通过了第84号决议。
description.en: The United Nations Security Council passed Resolution 84.

description.zh-cn: 在朝鲜战争中，朝鲜人民军与中国人民志愿军是并肩作战的盟友。
description.en: During the Korean War, the Korean People's Army and the Chinese People's Volunteer Army were allies fighting side by side.

description.zh-cn: 在朝鲜战争中，朝鲜人民军与联合国军是敌对的交战方。
description.en: During the Korean War, the Korean People's Army and the United Nations Command were opposing belligerents.

description.zh-cn: 时任韩国总统文在寅与朝鲜领导人金正恩共同签署了《板门店宣言》。
description.en: Then-South Korean President Moon Jae-in co-signed the Panmunjom Declaration with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜国务委员会委员长金正恩与韩国总统文在寅共同签署了《板门店宣言》。
description.en: Chairman of the State Affairs Commission Kim Jong-un co-signed the Panmunjom Declaration with South Korean President Moon Jae-in.

description.zh-cn: 《板门店宣言》旨在通过达成永久和平协议来正式结束朝鲜战争，从而取代《朝鲜停战协定》。
description.en: The Panmunjom Declaration aimed to formally end the Korean War by reaching a permanent peace agreement, thereby replacing the Korean Armistice Agreement.

description.zh-cn: 丁志刚于1919年5月12日出生于山东滕县。

description.zh-cn: 丁志刚曾担任山东省文学艺术界联合会副主席。
description.en: Ding Zhigang once served as the Vice Chairman of the Shandong Provincial Federation of Literary and Art Circles.

description.zh-cn: 丁志刚曾担任北京图书馆党委副书记、副馆长。

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类“中国共产党党员”，丁志刚是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to the page category 'Communist Party of China members', Ding Zhigang was a member of the Communist Party of China.
