position.en: Party Group Member, Secretary of the Secretariat

description.zh-cn: 根据文本记载，董良翚曾任中国文联党组成员、书记处书记。
description.en: According to the text, Dong Lianghui formerly served as a Party Group Member and a Secretary of the Secretariat of the China Federation of Literary and Art Circles.

description.zh-cn: 董良翚于2008年当选第十一届全国政协委员，代表文化艺术界，分入第二十七组。
description.en: Dong Lianghui was elected as a member of the 11th National Committee of the CPPCC in 2008, representing the culture and arts sector and assigned to the 27th group.

description.zh-cn: 董良翚是董必武的女儿。
description.en: Dong Lianghui is the daughter of Dong Biwu.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类信息，董良翚曾担任第十届全国政协委员。
description.en: According to the page category information, Dong Lianghui served as a member of the 10th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 美国在日本广岛市投下第一颗原子弹。
description.en: The United States dropped the first atomic bomb on the Japanese city of Hiroshima.

description.zh-cn: 美国在日本长崎市投下第二颗原子弹。
description.en: The United States dropped the second atomic bomb on the Japanese city of Nagasaki.

description.zh-cn: 苏联对日宣战，并对满洲国发起大规模进攻。
description.en: The Soviet Union declared war on Japan and launched a large-scale offensive against Manchukuo.

description.zh-cn: 苏联违反《苏日中立条约》，向日本宣战。
description.en: The Soviet Union violated the Soviet–Japanese Neutrality Pact by declaring war on Japan.

description.zh-cn: 广岛原子弹爆炸对日本领导层造成巨大冲击，促使其开始认真讨论接受投降的问题。
description.en: The atomic bombing of Hiroshima profoundly shocked Japan's leadership, prompting them to begin seriously discussing the acceptance of surrender.

description.zh-cn: 苏联的入侵打破了日本寻求其调停的希望，与原子弹轰炸共同构成“双重震撼”，迫使日本政府必须立即结束战争。
description.en: The Soviet invasion shattered Japan's hopes for mediation and, along with the atomic bombings, created a 'double shock' that compelled the Japanese government to end the war immediately.

description.zh-cn: 在御前会议上，裕仁天皇做出了接受《波茨坦宣言》条款、结束战争的“圣断”。
description.en: At the Imperial conference (Gozen Kaigi), Emperor Hirohito made the 'sacred decision' (Seidan) to accept the terms of the Potsdam Declaration and end the war.

description.zh-cn: 日本代表签署《降伏文书》，标志着第二次世界大战的正式结束。
description.en: The signing of the Instrument of Surrender by Japanese representatives marked the formal end of World War II.

description.zh-cn: 代表日本政府在《降伏文书》上签字。
description.en: Signed the Instrument of Surrender on behalf of the Japanese government.

description.zh-cn: 作为盟军最高统帅，代表同盟国接受日本投降并签署《降伏文书》。
description.en: As Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, accepted Japan's surrender and signed the Instrument of Surrender on behalf of the Allied Powers.

description.zh-cn: 策划并领导了旨在阻止日本投降的未遂政变。
description.en: Planned and led the attempted coup d'état aimed at preventing Japan's surrender.

description.zh-cn: 政变参与者试图占领皇居，寻找并销毁天皇宣布投降的录音。
description.en: The coup plotters attempted to seize the Imperial Palace to find and destroy the recording of the Emperor's surrender announcement.

description.zh-cn: 作为东部军司令官，拒绝加入政变，并采取行动平定了叛乱。
description.en: As commander of the Eastern District Army, he refused to join the coup and took action to suppress the rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次世界大战期间，同盟国与大日本帝国处于战争状态。
description.en: During World War II, the Allied Powers were in a state of war with the Empire of Japan.

position.en: Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers

description.zh-cn: 被任命为驻日盟军总司令，负责接受日本投降及后续的占领事宜。
description.en: Appointed as the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, responsible for accepting Japan's surrender and the subsequent occupation.

description.zh-cn: 曼哈顿计划成功研发了原子弹，使其得以在广岛使用。
description.en: The Manhattan Project successfully developed the atomic bomb, enabling its use on Hiroshima.

description.zh-cn: 在雅尔塔会议上，苏联承诺在德国投降后三个月内对日作战。
description.en: At the Yalta Conference, the Soviet Union committed to entering the war against Japan within three months of Germany's surrender.

description.zh-cn: 在最高战争指导会议上，外务大臣东乡茂德主张接受投降，而陆军大臣阿南惟几则坚决反对，两人立场尖锐对立。
description.en: In the Supreme Council for the Direction of the War, Foreign Minister Shigenori Tōgō advocated for accepting surrender, while Army Minister Korechika Anami staunchly opposed it, representing sharply conflicting positions.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军空军航空大学隶属于中国人民解放军空军。
description.en: The PLA Air Force Aviation University is subordinate to the PLA Air Force.

description.zh-cn: 2017年，在深化国防和军队改革中，调整组建新的中国人民解放军空军航空大学。
description.en: In 2017, during the deepening of national defense and military reform, a new PLA Air Force Aviation University was reorganized and established.

description.zh-cn: 1946年3月1日，东北民主联军航空学校在吉林通化成立，隶属东北民主联军。
description.en: On March 1, 1946, the Northeast Democratic United Army Aviation School was established in Tonghua, Jilin, under the Northeast Democratic United Army.

description.zh-cn: 1949年11月18日，奉中央军委命令，改建牡丹江航校，后定名为中国人民解放军第七航空学校。
description.en: On November 18, 1949, under the order of the Central Military Commission, the Mudanjiang Aviation School was rebuilt and later named the PLA Seventh Aviation School.

description.zh-cn: 至正十五年（1355年），常遇春归附朱元璋，自请为前锋，成为其麾下重要将领，直至去世。
description.en: In 1355, Chang Yuchun joined Zhu Yuanzhang, volunteering as a vanguard, and became one of his key generals until his death.

description.zh-cn: 常茂是常遇春的长子。
description.en: Chang Mao is the eldest son of Chang Yuchun.

description.zh-cn: 常升是常遇春的次子。
description.en: Chang Sheng is the second son of Chang Yuchun.

description.zh-cn: 敬懿皇太子妃是常遇春的长女。
description.en: Crown Princess Jingyi is the eldest daughter of Chang Yuchun.

description.zh-cn: 洪武四年四月，常氏被册封为皇太子妃，成为朱标的正妃。
description.en: In April of the fourth year of the Hongwu era (1371), Lady Chang was officially invested as the Crown Princess, becoming the primary consort of Zhu Biao.

description.zh-cn: 蓝玉是常遇春的妻弟。
description.en: Lan Yu was the younger brother of Chang Yuchun's wife.

description.zh-cn: 常遇春多次跟随徐达作战，两人是朱元璋麾下最重要的将领，共同领导北伐等重大军事行动。
description.en: Chang Yuchun frequently fought alongside Xu Da. They were the most important generals under Zhu Yuanzhang and jointly led major military campaigns such as the Northern Expedition.

position.en: Deputy General for the Northern Expedition

description.zh-cn: 至正二十七年十月，徐达被授为征虏大将军，常遇春被授为征虏副将军，随其北伐。
description.en: In October 1367, Xu Da was appointed as the General-in-chief for the Northern Expedition, and Chang Yuchun was appointed as his deputy general.

description.zh-cn: 在鄱阳湖之战中，常遇春协同诸将作战，最终击败并导致陈友谅战死。
description.en: During the Battle of Lake Poyang, Chang Yuchun fought alongside other generals, ultimately defeating and causing the death of Chen Youliang.

description.zh-cn: 常遇春作为副将军，率军攻破平江城，俘虏了张士诚。
description.en: As deputy general, Chang Yuchun led his troops to capture the city of Pingjiang and took Zhang Shicheng prisoner.

description.zh-cn: 在邵荣图谋兵变事败后，朱元璋本想赦免其死罪，但常遇春坚决反对，认为谋反不可原谅，最终导致邵荣被处死。
description.en: After Shao Rong's coup plot was exposed, Zhu Yuanzhang intended to pardon him from death, but Chang Yuchun resolutely opposed it, arguing that rebellion was unforgivable, which ultimately led to Shao Rong's execution.

description.zh-cn: 常遇春早年曾为刘聚麾下，后因察觉刘聚不能成事而离开。
description.en: In his early years, Chang Yuchun served under Liu Ju, but left after realizing Liu was incapable of achieving great things.

description.zh-cn: 常遇春与徐达进攻太原时，趁夜袭击王保保（扩廓帖木儿）的军队，使其仓皇逃走，并俘获其四万士兵。
description.en: When attacking Taiyuan with Xu Da, Chang Yuchun launched a night raid on Wang Baobao's (Köke Temür) army, forcing him to flee in disarray and capturing 40,000 of his soldiers.

description.zh-cn: 常遇春随徐达攻破元大都（1368年），迫使元顺帝北逃；后又率军攻占元上都（1369年），元顺帝再逃奔和林。
description.en: Chang Yuchun, along with Xu Da, conquered the Yuan capital Dadu (1368), forcing Emperor Shun of Yuan to flee north; he later led his army to capture Shangdu (1369), forcing the emperor to flee again to Karakorum.

position.zh-cn: 开国名将、鄂国公、太子少保、中书平章军国重事、征虏副将军
position.en: Founding General, Duke of E, Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince, Grand Marshal, Deputy General for the Northern Expedition

description.zh-cn: 常遇春是明朝的开国功臣。
description.en: Chang Yuchun was a founding father of the Ming Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 常遇春出生于河南江北等处行中书省安丰路濠州怀远县。
description.en: Chang Yuchun was born in Huaiyuan County, Haozhou, Anfeng Circuit, Henan Jiangbei Xingsheng.

description.zh-cn: 常遇春被授为征虏副将军，随徐达北伐，是北伐的主要领导者之一。
description.en: Chang Yuchun was appointed as the Deputy General for the Northern Expedition, accompanying Xu Da, and was one of the main leaders of the campaign.

description.zh-cn: 陈友谅在鄱阳湖之战中被朱元璋军击败，本人中流矢而死。
description.en: Chen Youliang was defeated by Zhu Yuanzhang's forces in the Battle of Lake Poyang and was killed by a stray arrow.

description.zh-cn: 裘新生于浙江省上虞县。
description.en: Qiu Xin was born in Shangyu County, Zhejiang Province.

description.zh-cn: 1988年毕业于复旦大学新闻系，2002年取得新闻学硕士学位。
description.en: Graduated from the Department of Journalism at Fudan University in 1988 and obtained a Master's degree in Journalism in 2002.

description.zh-cn: 2004年取得中欧国际工商学院EMBA学位。
description.en: Obtained an EMBA degree from China Europe International Business School in 2004.

position.zh-cn: 记者、副总编辑、党委书记、总编辑
position.en: Reporter, Deputy Editor-in-Chief, Party Secretary, Editor-in-Chief

description.zh-cn: 1988年进入《解放日报》社成为记者。2000年兼任副总编辑。2005年任党委书记、总编辑。
description.en: Joined Jiefang Daily as a reporter in 1988. Became concurrent Deputy Editor-in-Chief in 2000. Served as Party Secretary and Editor-in-Chief from 2005.

description.zh-cn: 1997年被任命为《申江服务导报》筹建组负责人，次年5月担任该报首任主编。
description.en: Appointed as the head of the preparatory team for 'Shenjiang Service Herald' in 1997, and became its first Editor-in-Chief in May of the following year.

description.zh-cn: 任中国共产党上海市第十一届委员会委员。
description.en: Served as a member of the 11th Shanghai Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

position.zh-cn: 党委常务副书记、党委书记
position.en: Executive Deputy Party Secretary, Party Secretary

description.zh-cn: 2021年11月任复旦大学党委常务副书记，2023年2月升任党委书记。
description.en: Appointed as the Executive Deputy Party Secretary of Fudan University in November 2021, and promoted to Party Secretary in February 2023.

description.zh-cn: 接替黎瑞刚出任上海广播电视台台长。
description.en: Succeeded Li Ruigang as the president of Shanghai Media Group.

description.zh-cn: 裘新在上海广播电视台任职期间，其大致规划仍在其前任黎瑞刚的安排下进行。
description.en: During Qiu Xin's tenure at Shanghai Media Group, the general planning was still carried out under the arrangements of his predecessor, Li Ruigang.

description.zh-cn: 接替焦扬出任复旦大学党委书记。
description.en: Succeeded Jiao Yang as the Party Secretary of Fudan University.

description.zh-cn: 裘新享受中华人民共和国国务院授予的政府专家特殊津贴。
description.en: Qiu Xin enjoys a special government expert allowance granted by the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 小周后在大周后去世三年后成为李煜的第二任皇后（继室）。
description.en: Lesser Empress Zhou became Li Yu's second empress (successor wife) three years after the death of the Great Empress Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 在大周后病重期间，小周后借探病之机与姐夫李煜发生私情。
description.en: During the illness of the Great Empress Zhou, Lesser Empress Zhou had an affair with her brother-in-law Li Yu under the pretext of visiting the sick.

description.zh-cn: 小周后是周宗的次女。
description.en: Lesser Empress Zhou was the second daughter of Zhou Zong.

description.zh-cn: 小周后是周娥皇（大周后）的妹妹。
description.en: Lesser Empress Zhou was the younger sister of Zhou Ehuang (Great Empress Zhou).

description.zh-cn: 周娥皇（大周后）是李煜的第一任皇后（元配）。
description.en: Zhou Ehuang (Great Empress Zhou) was the first empress (original wife) of Li Yu.

description.zh-cn: 小周后与姐夫李煜的私情被大周后发现，使其在双重背叛的刺激下病情迅速恶化，最终去世。
description.en: The affair between Lesser Empress Zhou and her brother-in-law Li Yu was discovered by Great Empress Zhou, causing her condition to rapidly deteriorate under the shock of the dual betrayal, ultimately leading to her death.

description.zh-cn: 南唐灭亡后，李煜被俘至开封，受封为违命侯，处于宋太宗赵光义的控制之下。
description.en: After the fall of the Southern Tang, Li Yu was captured and taken to Kaifeng, where he was enfeoffed as the Marquis of Disobedience and lived under the control of Emperor Taizong, Zhao Guangyi.

description.zh-cn: 蔡正元为中国国民党籍政治人物。
description.en: Tsai Cheng-yuan is a politician affiliated with the Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 在罢免案发生时，蔡正元担任台北市第四选举区第8届立法委员。
description.en: At the time of the recall case, Tsai Cheng-yuan served as the 8th-term legislator for Taipei City's 4th electoral district.

description.zh-cn: 在其罢免案的答辩书中，蔡正元批评林荣三一方面批评ECFA，另一方面又在中国大陆赚钱。
description.en: In his defense statement for the recall case, Tsai Cheng-yuan criticized Lin Rong-san for denouncing the ECFA while simultaneously profiting from business in mainland China.

description.zh-cn: 在《公职人员选举罢免法》于2016年完成修法降低门槛后，称此为全民的胜利。
description.en: After the 'Public Officials Election and Recall Act' was amended in 2016 to lower the thresholds, he hailed it as a victory for all citizens.

description.zh-cn: 在《公职人员选举罢免法》于2016年完成修法降低门槛后，称此为全民的胜利。
description.en: After the 'Public Officials Election and Recall Act' was amended in 2016 to lower the thresholds, he hailed it as a victory for all citizens.

description.zh-cn: 在《公职人员选举罢免法》于2016年完成修法降低门槛后，称此绝对符合民意。
description.en: After the 'Public Officials Election and Recall Act' was amended in 2016 to lower the thresholds, he stated that the change absolutely conformed to public opinion.

description.zh-cn: 柯承发是柯美兰的父亲。
description.en: Ko Cheng-fa is the father of Ko Mei-lan.

description.zh-cn: 柯美兰出生于台湾新竹市北区。
description.en: Ko Mei-lan was born in North District, Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 柯美兰是台湾民众党籍党员，并曾担任第一、二届党员代表。
description.en: Ko Mei-lan is a member of the Taiwan People's Party and served as a party representative for the first and second terms.

description.zh-cn: 于2023年10月12日宣布以不经政党推荐的形式参选2024年新竹市选举区的立法委员，但最终未能当选。
description.en: On October 12, 2023, she announced her candidacy for the legislative seat in the Hsinchu City constituency for the 2024 election as an independent, but was not elected.

description.zh-cn: 在2024年台湾大选前，与胞兄柯文哲和时任新竹市长高虹安一同出席民众党的造势活动。
description.en: Before the 2024 Taiwan general election, attended a Taiwan People's Party rally with her brother Ko Wen-je and then-Hsinchu City Mayor Ann Kao.

description.zh-cn: 在2024年台湾大选前，与胞妹柯美兰和时任新竹市长高虹安一同出席民众党的造势活动。
description.en: Before the 2024 Taiwan general election, attended a Taiwan People's Party rally with his sister Ko Mei-lan and then-Hsinchu City Mayor Ann Kao.

description.zh-cn: 国立台湾大学医学院是国立台湾大学下属的学院之一。
description.en: The College of Medicine is one of the colleges under National Taiwan University.

description.zh-cn: 国立台湾大学医学院附设医院新竹分院是国立台湾大学医学院附设医院的分院，隶属于国立台湾大学系统。
description.en: The Hsinchu Branch of National Taiwan University Hospital is a branch of the National Taiwan University Hospital, affiliated with the National Taiwan University system.

description.zh-cn: 张著是刘备势力的将领，参与了建安二十四年（219年）的汉中之战。
description.en: Zhang Zhu was a general in Liu Bei's forces and participated in the Hanzhong Campaign in the year 219.

description.zh-cn: 刘备在汉中之战期间担任左将军。
description.en: Liu Bei held the title of General of the Left during the Hanzhong Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 刘备在汉中之战期间担任益州牧，管辖益州地区。
description.en: Liu Bei served as the Governor of Yi Province during the Hanzhong Campaign, governing the Yi Province region.

description.zh-cn: 黄忠是刘备麾下将领，时任征西将军。
description.en: Huang Zhong was a general under Liu Bei, holding the title of General Who Conquers the West.

description.zh-cn: 赵云是刘备麾下的重要将领。
description.en: Zhao Yun was an important general serving under Liu Bei.

description.zh-cn: 在汉中之战中，赵云率部与曹操大军正面交锋，并使用空城计将其击退。
description.en: During the Battle of Hanzhong, Zhao Yun led his troops to confront Cao Cao's main army and repelled them using the empty fort strategy.

description.zh-cn: 在汉中之战中，当赵云被曹军追击至营寨时，时任沔阳长的张翼正在赵云营内。
description.en: During the Battle of Hanzhong, when Zhao Yun was pursued by Cao's army to his camp, Zhang Yi, then Magistrate of Mianyang, was inside Zhao Yun's camp.

description.zh-cn: 根据小说《三国演义》的描述，在汉水之战中，张著担任黄忠的副将。
description.en: According to the novel 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Zhang Zhu served as Huang Zhong's vice general during the Battle of the Han River.

description.zh-cn: 根据小说《三国演义》的描述，黄忠在定军山之战中斩杀了夏侯渊。
description.en: According to the novel 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Huang Zhong killed Xiahou Yuan in the Battle of Mount Dingjun.

description.zh-cn: 根据小说《三国演义》的描述，在汉水之战中，黄忠与张郃的部队发生混战。
description.en: According to the novel 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Huang Zhong's troops clashed with Zhang He's in a chaotic battle at the Han River.

description.zh-cn: 根据小说《三国演义》的描述，在汉水之战中，张著突围时被文聘拦住去路。
description.en: According to the novel 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', during the Battle of the Han River, Zhang Zhu's path was blocked by Wen Pin while trying to break out.

description.zh-cn: 1918年到北京大学旁听，1919年转为正式生，1921年毕业。
description.en: Started as an auditor at Peking University in 1918, became a regular student in 1919, and graduated in 1921.

description.zh-cn: 与茅盾、郑振铎等人共同发起成立。
description.en: Co-founded with Mao Dun, Zheng Zhenduo, and others.

description.zh-cn: 安排孙伏园任职北大图书馆书记。
description.en: Arranged for Sun Fuyuan to work as a secretary at the Peking University Library.

description.zh-cn: 孙伏园辞去北大图书馆书记职务后，由毛泽东接任。
description.en: After Sun Fuyuan resigned from his post as secretary at the Peking University Library, Mao Zedong took over the position.

description.zh-cn: 在主持《晨报》副刊时发表了鲁迅的《阿Q正传》。
description.en: Published Lu Xun's 'The True Story of Ah Q' while editing the supplement of 'Chen Bao'.

description.zh-cn: 在主持《晨报》副刊时发表了冰心的《寄小读者》。
description.en: Published Bing Xin's 'To Young Readers' while editing the supplement of 'Chen Bao'.

description.zh-cn: 在主持《晨报》副刊时发表了周作人的《自己的园地》。
description.en: Published Zhou Zuoren's 'My Own Garden' while editing the supplement of 'Chen Bao'.

description.zh-cn: 邀请孙伏园主编《京报副刊》。
description.en: Invited Sun Fuyuan to be the chief editor of the 'Jing Bao' supplement.

description.zh-cn: 作为厦门大学文学院院长，邀请孙伏园赴该校任职。
description.en: As the Dean of the College of Arts at Xiamen University, he invited Sun Fuyuan to join the faculty.

description.zh-cn: 在厦门大学任职期间，与同在该校任教的鲁迅保持密切联系。
description.en: While working at Xiamen University, maintained close contact with Lu Xun, who was also teaching there.

description.zh-cn: 在汉口《中央日报》副刊上发表了毛泽东的《湖南农民运动考察报告》。
description.en: Published Mao Zedong's 'Report on an Investigation of the Peasant Movement in Hunan' in the Hankou 'Central Daily News' supplement.

description.zh-cn: 邀请孙伏园出任中华平民教育促进会文学部主任。
description.en: Invited Sun Fuyuan to serve as the Director of the Literature Department of the China Association for the Advancement of Mass Education.

description.zh-cn: 作为重庆《中央日报》社社长，约请孙伏园主编《中央副刊》。
description.en: As the president of the Chongqing 'Central Daily News', invited Sun Fuyuan to be the chief editor of the 'Central Supplement'.

description.zh-cn: 在《中央副刊》上刊发了郭沫若的历史剧《屈原》。
description.en: Published Guo Moruo's historical play 'Qu Yuan' in the 'Central Supplement'.

description.zh-cn: 孙伏园因刊发历史剧《屈原》而被解聘。
description.en: Sun Fuyuan was dismissed for publishing the historical play 'Qu Yuan'.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党云南省纪律检查委员会是中国共产党中央纪律检查委员会的下级机构。
description.en: The CCP Yunnan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection is a subordinate body of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党云南省纪律检查委员会与云南省监察委员会合署办公，是“一套人马、两块牌子”的机构。
description.en: The CCP Yunnan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and the Yunnan Provincial Supervisory Commission work jointly in the same office, operating under the model of 'one team, two signs'.

description.zh-cn: 1950年4月，中共云南省委决定成立中共云南省委纪律检查委员会。
description.en: In April 1950, the CCP Yunnan Provincial Committee decided to establish the CCP Yunnan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection.

description.zh-cn: 李洪波是海南儋州人。
description.en: Li Hongbo is a native of Danzhou, Hainan.

description.zh-cn: 李洪波是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Li Hongbo is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 赵津芳曾担任北京市妇女联合会党组书记、主席。
description.en: Zhao Jinfang served as the Party Group Secretary and Chairwoman of the Beijing Women's Federation.

description.zh-cn: 赵津芳曾担任中华全国妇女联合会常务委员。
description.en: Zhao Jinfang served as a member of the Standing Committee of the All-China Women's Federation.

description.zh-cn: 赵津芳是中共十八大代表。
description.en: Zhao Jinfang was a delegate to the 18th National Congress of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 中学毕业后，在内蒙古扎赉特旗巴达尔胡农场担任中学教员。
description.en: After graduating from middle school, he worked as a middle school teacher at Badarhu Farm in Jalaid Banner, Inner Mongolia.

degree.zh-cn: 学士学位、硕士学位、博士学位
degree.en: Bachelor's degree, Master's degree, Doctoral degree

description.zh-cn: 1978年考入北京大学化学系，并先后获得学士、硕士和博士学位。
description.en: Admitted to the Department of Chemistry at Peking University in 1978, and subsequently obtained bachelor's, master's, and doctoral degrees.

description.zh-cn: 1986年博士毕业后留校任教。2004年12月起，任北京大学党委常委、常务副校长。2015年2月15日至2018年10月23日，担任北京大学校长。
description.en: After graduating with a Ph.D. in 1986, he stayed at Peking University to teach. Since December 2004, he has served as a member of the Standing Committee of the Party Committee and Executive Vice President of Peking University. From February 15, 2015, to October 23, 2018, he served as the President of Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 1988年至1993年，在美国艾奥瓦州立大学化学系从事博士后研究。
description.en: From 1988 to 1993, he conducted postdoctoral research at the Department of Chemistry, Iowa State University, USA.

description.zh-cn: 1998年6月至2001年4月，任北京大学化学与分子工程学院院长。
description.en: From June 1998 to April 2001, he served as the Dean of the College of Chemistry and Molecular Engineering at Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 2010年12月至2013年6月，担任重庆大学校长。
description.en: From December 2010 to June 2013, he served as the President of Chongqing University.

description.zh-cn: 2013年6月至2015年2月，担任浙江大学校长。
description.en: From June 2013 to February 2015, he served as the President of Zhejiang University.

description.zh-cn: 正式宣布任命林建华为浙江大学校长。
description.en: Officially announced the appointment of Lin Jianhua as the President of Zhejiang University.

description.zh-cn: 决定任免林建华，使其不再担任重庆大学校长，为后续任命铺平道路。
description.en: Decided on the appointment and removal of Lin Jianhua, ending his tenure as President of Chongqing University and paving the way for his subsequent appointment.

description.zh-cn: 周绪红接替林建华担任重庆大学校长。
description.en: Zhou Xuhong succeeded Lin Jianhua as the President of Chongqing University.

description.zh-cn: 有传闻称褚健曾是抵制林建华出任浙江大学校长任命的“幕后推手”。
description.en: It was rumored that Chu Jian was the 'mastermind' behind the resistance to Lin Jianhua's appointment as President of Zhejiang University.

description.zh-cn: 以涉嫌贪污罪对褚健立案侦查并将其逮捕。
description.en: Placed Chu Jian under investigation for suspected embezzlement and arrested him.

description.zh-cn: 林建华在为自己念错别字道歉时，将原因归咎于文化大革命，暗示其教育受到了影响。
description.en: When apologizing for mispronouncing a word, Lin Jianhua attributed the mistake to the Cultural Revolution, implying his education was affected.

description.zh-cn: 郝平接替林建华担任北京大学校长。
description.en: Hao Ping succeeded Lin Jianhua as the President of Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 林建华接替王恩哥担任北京大学校长。
description.en: Lin Jianhua succeeded Wang Enge as the President of Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 林建华接替杨卫担任浙江大学校长。
description.en: Lin Jianhua succeeded Yang Wei as the President of Zhejiang University.

description.zh-cn: 吴朝晖接替林建华担任浙江大学校长。
description.en: Wu Zhaohui succeeded Lin Jianhua as the President of Zhejiang University.

description.zh-cn: 林建华接替李晓红担任重庆大学校长。
description.en: Lin Jianhua succeeded Li Xiaohong as the President of Chongqing University.

description.zh-cn: 孙中山提出了五权宪法理论。
description.en: Sun Yat-sen proposed the Five-Power Constitution theory.

description.zh-cn: 1928年北伐完成后，国民政府实行五权分治，于1931年2月成立监察院。
description.en: After the completion of the Northern Expedition in 1928, the Nationalist Government implemented the five-power system of governance and established the Control Yuan in February 1931.

description.zh-cn: 时任总统蔡英文提名陈菊担任监察院院长。
description.en: Then-President Tsai Ing-wen nominated Chen Chu to serve as the President of the Control Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 陈菊自2020年8月1日起担任第六届监察院院长。
description.en: Chen Chu has served as the President of the sixth Control Yuan since August 1, 2020.

description.zh-cn: 总统蔡英文提名李鸿钧为监察院副院长。
description.en: President Tsai Ing-wen nominated Lee Hong-chun as the Vice President of the Control Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 李鸿钧于2022年5月30日就任监察院副院长。
description.en: Lee Hong-chun took office as the Vice President of the Control Yuan on May 30, 2022.

description.zh-cn: 审计院于1931年2月降为部并改隶监察院。
description.en: The Audit Yuan was downgraded to a ministry and placed under the jurisdiction of the Control Yuan in February 1931.

description.zh-cn: 国家人权委员会隶属于监察院。
description.en: The National Human Rights Commission is subordinate to the Control Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 监察委员陶百川等五人自行发动调查孙立人案，其报告认为孙立人一案乃莫须有之罪。
description.en: Control Yuan member Tao Pai-chuan and four others independently initiated an investigation into the Sun Li-jen case, and their report concluded that the charges against him were unfounded.

description.zh-cn: 时任副总统陈诚组成“九人小组”调查孙立人案，其上报导致孙立人被软禁长达33年。
description.en: Then-Vice President Chen Cheng formed a 'nine-person group' to investigate the Sun Li-jen case, and their report led to Sun's house arrest for 33 years.

description.zh-cn: 监察院因时任行政院院长俞鸿钧拒绝约询而通过弹劾，俞鸿钧随后辞职。
description.en: The Control Yuan impeached then-Premier Yu Hung-chun for refusing a summons, and Yu subsequently resigned.

description.zh-cn: 总统蒋中正对于监察院弹劾俞鸿钧颇为不满，曾威胁开除弹劾提案的国民党籍监委。
description.en: President Chiang Kai-shek was quite dissatisfied with the Control Yuan's impeachment of Yu Hung-chun and threatened to expel the KMT-affiliated Control Yuan members who proposed the impeachment.

description.zh-cn: 监察院弹劾时任桃园县县长许信良。
description.en: The Control Yuan impeached then-Taoyuan County Magistrate Hsu Hsin-liang.

description.zh-cn: 监察院弹劾时任台南市市长赖清德。
description.en: The Control Yuan impeached then-Tainan Mayor Lai Ching-te.

description.zh-cn: 以中国国民党为首的泛蓝阵营在立法院杯葛总统陈水扁提名的监察委员人选，导致监察院长期空转。
description.en: The Pan-Blue coalition, led by the Kuomintang, boycotted President Chen Shui-bian's nominations for Control Yuan members in the Legislative Yuan, causing the Control Yuan to be inactive for a long period.

description.zh-cn: 马英九接任总统后，重新提名第四届监察委员并获立法院通过，使监察院恢复运作。
description.en: After Ma Ying-jeou took office as President, he re-nominated the fourth term of Control Yuan members, who were approved by the Legislative Yuan, allowing the Control Yuan to resume operations.

description.zh-cn: 张博雅担任第五届监察院院长。
description.en: Chang Po-ya served as the President of the fifth Control Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 民主进步党主张修改宪法以废除监察院。
description.en: The Democratic Progressive Party advocates for amending the constitution to abolish the Control Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 时任台湾民众党立法院党团总召黄国昌表示，已连署达标，将向院会提出修宪废除监察院案。
description.en: Huang Kuo-chang, then caucus whip of the Taiwan People's Party in the Legislative Yuan, announced that enough signatures had been collected to formally propose a constitutional amendment to abolish the Control Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 在114年度中央政府总预算案中，中国国民党籍立委大幅删减监察院的预算，使其无法正常运作。
description.en: In the 114th fiscal year central government budget, Kuomintang legislators drastically cut the Control Yuan's budget, preventing it from functioning normally.

description.zh-cn: 在114年度中央政府总预算案中，台湾民众党籍立委大幅删减监察院的预算，使其无法正常运作。
description.en: In the 114th fiscal year central government budget, Taiwan People's Party legislators drastically cut the Control Yuan's budget, preventing it from functioning normally.

description.zh-cn: 杨金永曾任中共中央直属机关工作委员会副书记。
description.en: Yang Jinyong served as Deputy Secretary of the Work Committee for the Organs Directly Under the Central Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 杨金永为第十二届全国政协委员。
description.en: Yang Jinyong was a member of the 12th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 根据其担任的党内职务，杨金永是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Based on his party positions, Yang Jinyong is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 杨金永为中共十八大代表。
description.en: Yang Jinyong was a delegate to the 18th National Congress of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，保皇派与造反派、极左派对立。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, the Royalist faction was opposed to the Rebel and Ultra-Left factions.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，保皇派与造反派、极左派对立。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, the Royalist faction was opposed to the Rebel and Ultra-Left factions.

description.zh-cn: 部分保皇派政府官员及地方军区负责人曾对造反派实行镇压与清算。
description.en: Some Royalist government officials and local military leaders suppressed and purged the Rebel faction.

description.zh-cn: 一月风暴后，保皇派和造反派之间的斗争激化。
description.en: After the January Storm, the struggle between the Royalist and Rebel factions intensified.

description.zh-cn: 一月风暴后，保皇派和造反派之间的斗争激化。
description.en: After the January Storm, the struggle between the Royalist and Rebel factions intensified.

description.zh-cn: 七二零事件是保皇派与造反派之间斗争的案例之一。
description.en: The Wuhan Incident was one of the cases of struggle between the Royalist and Rebel factions.

description.zh-cn: 七二零事件是保皇派与造反派之间斗争的案例之一。
description.en: The Wuhan Incident was one of the cases of struggle between the Royalist and Rebel factions.

description.zh-cn: 重庆大武斗是保皇派与造反派之间斗争的案例之一。
description.en: The Chongqing massive armed struggles were one of the cases of struggle between the Royalist and Rebel factions.

description.zh-cn: 重庆大武斗是保皇派与造反派之间斗争的案例之一。
description.en: The Chongqing massive armed struggles were one of the cases of struggle between the Royalist and Rebel factions.

description.zh-cn: 陈子明将张宏良归类为“保皇派毛派”，并批判其为“形左实右的专政右派的别动队”、“纳粹主义的忠实信徒”。
description.en: Chen Ziming classified Zhang Hongliang as a 'Royalist Maoist' and criticized him as a 'commando of the right-wing dictatorship that is left in form but right in essence' and a 'faithful believer of Nazism'.

description.zh-cn: 被学者陈子明认为是后文革时代的“保皇毛派”。
description.en: Considered a 'Royalist Maoist' of the post-Cultural Revolution era by scholar Chen Ziming.

description.zh-cn: 被学者陈子明认为是后文革时代的“保皇派毛派”。
description.en: Considered a 'Royalist Maoist' of the post-Cultural Revolution era by scholar Chen Ziming.

description.zh-cn: 习近平被官方认定为习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想的主要创立者，该思想是在他2012年11月当选中共中央总书记后逐步形成的。
description.en: Xi Jinping is officially recognized as the main founder of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, which was gradually formed after he was elected General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee in November 2012.

position.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会总书记
position.en: General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 会议选举习近平为中国共产党中央委员会总书记。
description.en: The meeting elected Xi Jinping as the General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 评价认为，习近平思想的14条方略没有任何理论创新，将其写入党章的本意在于树立绝对政治权威，便于排除异己，为其长期执政做铺垫。
description.en: Commented that the 14 strategies of Xi Jinping Thought have no theoretical innovation, and that writing it into the party constitution is intended to establish absolute political authority, facilitate the elimination of dissidents, and pave the way for his long-term rule.

description.zh-cn: 批准在中国社会科学院成立10家习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想研究中心之一。
description.en: Approved the establishment of one of the 10 research centers for Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 陈中是安徽宁国人。
description.en: Chen Zhong is a native of Ningguo, Anhui.

description.zh-cn: 1978年毕业于安徽师范大学英语专业。
description.en: Graduated from the English major at Anhui Normal University in 1978.

description.zh-cn: 陈中是一名中国共产党党员。
description.en: Chen Zhong is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 陈中曾任贵州无线电工业学校（贵州电子信息职业技术学院前身）校长，后任贵州电子信息职业技术学院院长。
description.en: Chen Zhong served as the principal of Guizhou Radio Industry School (the predecessor of Guizhou Electronic Information Vocational College) and later as the president of Guizhou Electronic Information Vocational College.

position.zh-cn: 第二中学校长, 董事局董事, 党委副书记, 副总裁, 董事长, 党委书记
position.en: Principal of the No. 2 Middle School, Board Director, Deputy Party Secretary, Vice President, Chairman, Party Secretary

description.zh-cn: 陈中历任中国振华电子集团公司第二中学校长，及中国振华电子集团有限公司的董事局董事、党委副书记、副总裁、董事长、党委书记等多个职务。
description.en: Chen Zhong successively served as the Principal of the No. 2 Middle School of China Zhenhua Electronics Group Corporation, and held various positions at China Zhenhua Electronics Group Co., Ltd., including Board Director, Deputy Party Secretary, Vice President, Chairman, and Party Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 2008年2月，陈中当选为第十一届全国人大代表。
description.en: In February 2008, Chen Zhong was elected as a deputy to the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 2013年2月，陈中当选为第十二届全国人大代表。
description.en: In February 2013, Chen Zhong was elected as a deputy to the 12th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 清朝通过一片石之战的胜利得以顺利入关，为后续统一中国奠定了决定性基础。
description.en: The victory in the Battle of Shanhai Pass enabled the Qing dynasty to smoothly enter the pass, laying a decisive foundation for the subsequent unification of China.

description.zh-cn: 大顺军在一片石之战中惨败，由盛转衰，被迫撤出北京。
description.en: The Dashun army suffered a crushing defeat in the Battle of Shanhai Pass, marking a turning point from prosperity to decline and forcing them to withdraw from Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 接受了吴三桂的投降请求，并与之结盟共同对抗大顺军。
description.en: Accepted Wu Sangui's surrender and formed an alliance with him to fight against the Dashun army.

description.zh-cn: 于1644年四月二十二日（公历5月27日）率部跪降于多尔衮，接受清朝的领导。
description.en: On April 22, 1644 (May 27 in the Gregorian calendar), he led his troops to surrender to Dorgon, accepting the leadership of the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 在投降清朝前，吴三桂是明朝驻守辽东的总兵。
description.en: Before surrendering to the Qing dynasty, Wu Sangui was the Ming dynasty's commanding general stationed in Liaodong.

description.zh-cn: 投降后，多尔衮封吴三桂为平西王。
description.en: After his surrender, Dorgon enfeoffed Wu Sangui as the Prince of Pacifying the West.

description.zh-cn: 在宁远战役中，明朝将领袁崇焕成功击败了努尔哈赤的进攻，并可能使其负伤。
description.en: During the Battle of Ningyuan, Ming general Yuan Chonghuan successfully defeated Nurhaci's attack and possibly wounded him.

description.zh-cn: 一片石之战是明末民变这一系列大规模冲突的一部分。
description.en: The Battle of Shanhai Pass was part of the series of large-scale conflicts known as the Late Ming peasant rebellions.

description.zh-cn: 一片石之战是明清战争中的一场决定性战役。
description.en: The Battle of Shanhai Pass was a decisive battle in the Ming-Qing transition.

description.zh-cn: 于1644年6月6日进入北京，并定都于此。
description.en: Entered Beijing on June 6, 1644, and established it as the capital.

description.zh-cn: 改革开放后，为满足中国发展对外贸易对专业人才的迫切需求，对外贸易部决定筹建天津对外贸易学院。
description.en: After the Reform and Opening-up, to meet the urgent need for professionals in China's foreign trade development, the Ministry of Foreign Trade decided to establish the Tianjin Institute of Foreign Trade.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国对外贸易经济合作部投资兴建并管理天津对外贸易学院。
description.en: The Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Co-operation of the People's Republic of China invested in, built, and managed the Tianjin Institute of Foreign Trade.

description.zh-cn: 天津对外贸易学院是对外贸易经济合作部直属的四所高校之一。
description.en: The Tianjin Institute of Foreign Trade was one of the four higher education institutions directly under the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Co-operation.

description.zh-cn: 南开大学在原天津对外贸易学院的基础上组建了南开大学国际商学院。
description.en: Nankai University established the Nankai University International Business School on the basis of the former Tianjin Institute of Foreign Trade.

description.zh-cn: 天津对外贸易学院的师资在并入南开大学后，参与组建了南开大学国际商学院。
description.en: After the merger into Nankai University, the faculty of Tianjin Institute of Foreign Trade participated in the establishment of Nankai University International Business School.

description.zh-cn: 北京对外贸易学院（后更名为对外经济贸易大学）为外经贸部直属高校之一。
description.en: Beijing Institute of Foreign Trade (later renamed University of International Business and Economics) was one of the institutions directly under the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Co-operation.

description.zh-cn: 上海对外贸易学院（后更名为上海对外经贸大学）为外经贸部直属高校之一。
description.en: Shanghai Institute of Foreign Trade (later renamed Shanghai University of International Business and Economics) was one of the institutions directly under the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Co-operation.

description.zh-cn: 广州对外贸易学院为外经贸部直属高校之一。
description.en: Guangzhou Institute of Foreign Trade was one of the institutions directly under the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Co-operation.

description.zh-cn: 金平一是金日成的儿子。
description.en: Kim Pyong-il is the son of Kim Il-sung.

description.zh-cn: 金平一是金圣爱的儿子。
description.en: Kim Pyong-il is the son of Kim Song-ae.

description.zh-cn: 金平一是金正日的同父异母弟。
description.en: Kim Pyong-il is the half-brother of Kim Jong-il.

description.zh-cn: 金平一是金万一的同父异母弟。
description.en: Kim Pyong-il is the half-brother of Kim Man-il.

description.zh-cn: 金平一是金庆喜的同父异母弟。
description.en: Kim Pyong-il is the half-brother of Kim Kyong-hui.

description.zh-cn: 金平一是金英一的同母兄弟。
description.en: Kim Pyong-il is the brother of Kim Yong-il.

description.zh-cn: 1977年于金日成综合大学经济系毕业。
description.en: Graduated from the Department of Economics at Kim Il-sung University in 1977.

description.zh-cn: 曾在护卫总局担任装甲车队长。
description.en: Served as an armored vehicle captain in the Guard Command.

position.en: Deputy Director of the Operations Bureau

description.zh-cn: 曾担任朝鲜人民军总参谋部作战局副局长。
description.en: Served as the Deputy Director of the Operations Bureau of the General Staff Department of the Korean People's Army.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类，金平一是朝鲜劳动党党员。
description.en: According to categorization, Kim Pyong-il is a member of the Workers' Party of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 金正日在1974年被确立为接班人后，曾作为继承人候选之一的金平一遭到排挤，并被外派至欧洲各国。
description.en: After Kim Jong-il was established as the successor in 1974, Kim Pyong-il, who had been a candidate for succession, was marginalized and sent to serve in various European countries.

description.zh-cn: 金平一于2019年11月返回朝鲜后，据信受到严密监视，以防止外国势力扶植他来取代金正恩。
description.en: After returning to North Korea in November 2019, Kim Pyong-il is believed to be under close surveillance to prevent foreign powers from propping him up to replace Kim Jong-un.

description.zh-cn: 据自由亚洲电台2020年4月报导，金正恩曾将军权暂时交给金平日掌管。
description.en: According to a Radio Free Asia report in April 2020, Kim Jong-un temporarily handed over military power to Kim Pyong-il.

description.zh-cn: 古月出生于中华民国时期的湖北省汉口市。
description.en: Gu Yue was born in Hankou, Hubei, during the Republic of China era.

description.zh-cn: 1949年，中国人民解放军解放桂林时，胡诗学参军并开始军旅文艺工作者生涯。
description.en: In 1949, when the People's Liberation Army liberated Guilin, Hu Shixue joined the army and began his career as a military literary and art worker.

position.en: Cultural Officer, Head of Culture Section

description.zh-cn: 古月曾在中国人民解放军昆明军区担任文化干事，后升任文化科科长（正团职）。
description.en: Gu Yue served as a cultural officer in the Kunming Military Region of the PLA and was later promoted to Head of the Culture Section (regimental level).

description.zh-cn: 古月在文化大革命期间被发现其相貌与油画《毛主席去安源》中的毛泽东极为相似，这成为他日后被选为特型演员的契机。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Gu Yue was discovered to bear a strong resemblance to Mao Zedong in the oil painting 'Chairman Mao Goes to Anyuan', which became the catalyst for his selection as a look-alike actor.

description.zh-cn: 1978年，中华人民共和国文化部和中国人民解放军总政治部联合开展特型演员的选拔工作，最终选中了古月扮演毛泽东。
description.en: In 1978, the Ministry of Culture and the PLA's General Political Department jointly launched a selection process for look-alike actors, ultimately choosing Gu Yue to portray Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 1978年，中国人民解放军总政治部和中华人民共和国文化部联合开展特型演员的选拔工作，最终选中了古月扮演毛泽东。
description.en: In 1978, the PLA's General Political Department and the Ministry of Culture jointly launched a selection process for look-alike actors, ultimately choosing Gu Yue to portray Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 时任解放军艺术学院院长胡可发现了外貌酷似毛泽东的古月，并坚持考察，促成了其成为特型演员。
description.en: Hu Ke, then president of the PLA Academy of Art, discovered Gu Yue's resemblance to Mao Zedong and insisted on evaluating him, which led to him becoming a look-alike actor.

description.zh-cn: 在对比十余名候选人的定妆照后，叶剑英元帅亲自将古月圈定为饰演毛泽东的特型演员。
description.en: After comparing the makeup photos of more than ten candidates, Marshal Ye Jianying personally selected Gu Yue as the look-alike actor to portray Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 被选为特型演员后，古月随即被调到八一电影制片厂。
description.en: After being selected as a look-alike actor, Gu Yue was immediately transferred to the August First Film Studio.

description.zh-cn: 1983年，时任中央军委副主席的杨尚昆嘱咐古月在生活中“也要像毛泽东”。
description.en: In 1983, Yang Shangkun, then Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission, advised Gu Yue to 'be like Mao Zedong' in his daily life as well.

description.zh-cn: 古月因外貌酷似毛泽东而被选为特型演员，其整个演艺生涯都围绕着扮演毛泽东展开。
description.en: Gu Yue was chosen as a look-alike actor due to his resemblance to Mao Zedong, and his entire acting career was centered around portraying him.

description.zh-cn: 2019年10月12日，经中央批准，牟玉昌任中国人民警察大学党委书记，明确为副部长级。
description.en: On October 12, 2019, with the approval of the Central Committee, Mou Yuchang was appointed as the Party Secretary of the China People's Police University, with his rank clarified as vice-ministerial level.

description.zh-cn: 长期在公安边防部队任职。
description.en: Served for a long term in the Public Security Border Troops.

description.zh-cn: 2003年，担任山西省政协秘书长。
description.en: In 2003, he served as Secretary-General of the Shanxi Provincial CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 2008年，担任全国人大代表。
description.en: In 2008, he served as a deputy to the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 2013年3月田喜荣兼任山西省总工会党组书记。
description.en: In March 2013, Tian Xirong concurrently served as Party Group Secretary of the Shanxi Provincial Federation of Trade Unions.

description.zh-cn: 田喜荣接替张建欣出任朔州市人民政府市长。
description.en: Tian Xirong succeeded Zhang Jianxin as Mayor of the Shuozhou Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 田喜荣卸任朔州市人民政府市长，由冯改朵接任。
description.en: Tian Xirong stepped down as Mayor of the Shuozhou Municipal People's Government, and was succeeded by Feng Gaiduo.

description.zh-cn: 田喜荣接替王雅安出任中国共产党朔州市委员会书记。
description.en: Tian Xirong succeeded Wang Ya'an as Secretary of the CPC Shuozhou Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 田喜荣卸任中国共产党朔州市委员会书记，由王茂设接任。
description.en: Tian Xirong stepped down as Secretary of the CPC Shuozhou Municipal Committee, and was succeeded by Wang Maoshe.

description.zh-cn: 田喜荣接替杜善学出任中国共产党长治市委员会书记。
description.en: Tian Xirong succeeded Du Shanxue as Secretary of the CPC Changzhi Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 徐懋德于1920年12月31日出生于江苏省苏州市吴县。
description.en: Xu Maode was born in Wu County, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province on December 31, 1920.

description.zh-cn: 徐懋德于1938年至1942年就读于交通大学土木系。
description.en: Xu Maode studied in the Civil Engineering Department of Jiaotong University from 1938 to 1942.

description.zh-cn: 在海门中学就读期间，徐懋德受师长邱汉生影响思想左倾，并由其介绍加入中国共产党相关组织。
description.en: During his studies at Haimen Middle School, Xu Maode was influenced by his teacher Qiu Hansheng, became left-leaning, and was introduced by him to join organizations related to the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 1942年，徐懋德受师长影响加入中国共产党。
description.en: In 1942, influenced by his teacher, Xu Maode joined the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 徐懋德赴台后，协助时任台湾省工委书记蔡孝干建立学生工作委员会。
description.en: After arriving in Taiwan, Xu Maode assisted the then-secretary of the Taiwan Provincial Working Committee, Cai Xiaogan, in establishing the Student Work Committee.

description.zh-cn: 徐懋德派遣陈炳基成立外围组织“新民主同志会”。
description.en: Xu Maode dispatched Chen Bingji to establish the peripheral organization 'New Democratic Comrades Association'.

description.zh-cn: 陈炳基受徐懋德派遣成立了“新民主同志会”。
description.en: Chen Bingji founded the 'New Democratic Comrades Association' under the dispatch of Xu Maode.

description.zh-cn: 李登辉被吸收加入新民主同志会。
description.en: Lee Teng-hui was recruited into the New Democratic Comrades Association.

description.zh-cn: 林如堉被吸收加入新民主同志会。
description.en: Lin Ruyu was recruited into the New Democratic Comrades Association.

description.zh-cn: 李苍降被吸收加入新民主同志会。
description.en: Li Cangjiang was recruited into the New Democratic Comrades Association.

description.zh-cn: 徐懋德曾为李登辉监誓，使其加入中国共产党。
description.en: Xu Maode administered the oath for Lee Teng-hui to join the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 蔡孝干在落网脱逃后，刊登启事试图诱捕徐懋德，此事让徐懋德察觉到危险，并最终决定潜返大陆。
description.en: After being arrested and escaping, Cai Xiaogan published a notice in an attempt to entrap Xu Maode. This incident made Xu Maode aware of the danger and ultimately led to his decision to flee back to the mainland.

description.zh-cn: 1950年潜返大陆后，徐懋德进入天津大学建筑系任教，直至退休。
description.en: After fleeing back to the mainland in 1950, Xu Maode joined the Department of Architecture at Tianjin University as a professor and taught there until his retirement.

description.zh-cn: 关东军扶植前清宣统帝，建立了满洲国。
description.en: The Kwantung Army supported the former Qing emperor Puyi to establish Manchukuo.

description.zh-cn: 关东军在诺门罕战役中被朱可夫指挥的苏联红军击败，导致其“北进”计划严重受挫。
description.en: The Kwantung Army was defeated by the Soviet Red Army under the command of Georgy Zhukov in the Battles of Nomonhan, severely thwarting its 'Northward Advance' plan.

description.zh-cn: 在诺门罕战役中，朱可夫指挥苏联远东军击败了关东军。
description.en: In the Battles of Nomonhan, Zhukov commanded the Soviet Far East Army and defeated the Kwantung Army.

description.zh-cn: 诺门罕战役失败后，时任关东军司令官植田谦吉被撤职。
description.en: After the defeat in the Battles of Nomonhan, the then-commander of the Kwantung Army, Ueda Kenkichi, was dismissed.

description.zh-cn: 在苏联发动的“八月风暴”攻势下，关东军被击败并最终投降。
description.en: Under the 'August Storm' offensive launched by the Soviet Union, the Kwantung Army was defeated and ultimately surrendered.

description.zh-cn: 关东军最后一任总司令山田乙三向苏联红军代表交出军刀，宣布投降。
description.en: The last commander of the Kwantung Army, Otozō Yamada, surrendered his sword to a representative of the Soviet Red Army, announcing his capitulation.

description.zh-cn: 东北民主联军击败并发起了通化事件的暴动者，镇压了该事件。
description.en: The Northeast Democratic United Army defeated the rebels who initiated the Tonghua Incident and suppressed the event.

description.zh-cn: 新建陆军是北洋军的直接前身和核心基础。
description.en: The Newly Created Army was the direct predecessor and core foundation of the Beiyang Army.

description.zh-cn: 在1912年清帝退位前，北洋军是清朝的国防军。
description.en: Before the abdication of the Qing emperor in 1912, the Beiyang Army was the national defense force of the Qing Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国成立后，北洋军成为北京政府主要的国防武力。
description.en: After the establishment of the Republic of China, the Beiyang Army became the main national defense force of the Beijing Government.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯在世时以其威望和能力统御着整个北洋军，他的去世导致无人能控制局面，北洋军分裂，中国进入军阀割据时代。
description.en: While Yuan Shikai was alive, he commanded the entire Beiyang Army with his prestige and ability. His death led to a power vacuum, causing the Beiyang Army to fracture and China to enter the Warlord Era.

description.zh-cn: 冯国璋是直系军阀的创始人。
description.en: Feng Guozhang was the founder of the Zhili clique.

description.zh-cn: 国民革命军发动的北伐战争旨在消灭北洋军阀，最终导致北洋军的瓦解和改编。
description.en: The Northern Expedition launched by the National Revolutionary Army aimed to eliminate the Beiyang warlords, ultimately leading to the disintegration and reorganization of the Beiyang Army.

description.zh-cn: 张学良宣布服从国民政府，标志着北洋军作为一个政治军事集团的正式终结。
description.en: Zhang Xueliang's declaration of allegiance to the Nationalist Government marked the official end of the Beiyang Army as a political and military bloc.

description.zh-cn: 苏联支持冯玉祥及其领导的西北军。
description.en: The Soviet Union supported Feng Yuxiang and his Northwest Army.

description.zh-cn: 在辛亥革命初期，清廷派遣荫昌、冯国璋等人率领北洋军南下镇压武昌起义，并收复了汉口、汉阳。
description.en: In the early stages of the Xinhai Revolution, the Qing court dispatched Yinchang, Feng Guozhang, and others to lead the Beiyang Army south to suppress the Wuchang Uprising, successfully recapturing Hankou and Hanyang.

description.zh-cn: 姜治莹接替杨振斌担任中国共产党吉林大学委员会书记。
description.en: Jiang Zhiying succeeded Yang Zhenbin as the Secretary of the Jilin University Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 田辉接替姜治莹担任中国共产党吉林大学委员会书记。
description.en: Tian Hui succeeded Jiang Zhiying as the Secretary of the Jilin University Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 姜治莹接替庄严担任中国共产党延边朝鲜族自治州委员会书记。
description.en: Jiang Zhiying succeeded Zhuang Yan as the Secretary of the Yanbian Korean Autonomous Prefecture Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 田锦尘接替姜治莹担任中国共产党延边朝鲜族自治州委员会书记。
description.en: Tian Jinchen succeeded Jiang Zhiying as the Secretary of the Yanbian Korean Autonomous Prefecture Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 姜治莹接替金振吉担任中国共产党吉林省委员会政法委员会书记。
description.en: Jiang Zhiying succeeded Jin Zhenji as the Secretary of the Political and Legal Affairs Commission of the Jilin Provincial Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 胡家福接替姜治莹担任中国共产党吉林省委员会政法委员会书记。
description.en: Hu Jiafu succeeded Jiang Zhiying as the Secretary of the Political and Legal Affairs Commission of the Jilin Provincial Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 李晋修接替姜治莹担任中国共产党白城市委员会书记。
description.en: Li Jinxiu succeeded Jiang Zhiying as the Secretary of the Baicheng Municipal Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 姜治莹接替崔杰担任长春市人民政府市长。
description.en: Jiang Zhiying succeeded Cui Jie as the Mayor of Changchun Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 刘长龙接替姜治莹出任长春市人民政府市长。
description.en: Liu Changlong succeeded Jiang Zhiying as the Mayor of Changchun Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 王胜今是吉林磐石人。
description.en: Wang Shengjin is from Panshi, Jilin.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类“吉林大学校友”可知。
description.en: Indicated by the category 'Jilin University alumni'.

position.zh-cn: 教授、博士生导师、副校长

description.zh-cn: 王胜今现任吉林大学教授、博士生导师，且根据相关分类，他亦是该校副校长。
description.en: Wang Shengjin is currently a professor and doctoral supervisor at Jilin University. According to relevant categories, he is also a Vice President of the university.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类“中国共产党党员”可知。
description.en: Indicated by the category 'Communist Party of China members'.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类及模板可知，王胜今是国务院学位委员会第五届及第六届学科评议组成员。
description.en: Indicated by categories and templates, Wang Shengjin was a member of the 5th and 6th Disciplinary Review Groups of the Academic Degrees Committee of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类“中国人口学会副会长”及相关模板可知。
description.en: Indicated by the category 'Vice presidents of the China Population Association' and related templates.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类“中国高等教育学会常务理事”及相关模板可知。
description.en: Indicated by the category 'Executive council members of the China Association of Higher Education' and related templates.

description.zh-cn: 张开勋是甘肃古浪人。
description.en: Zhang Kaixun is from Gulang, Gansu.

description.zh-cn: 张开勋曾任中共嘉峪关市委书记。
description.en: Zhang Kaixun once served as Secretary of the CPC Jiayuguan Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 张开勋曾任甘肃省人大常委会秘书长、副主任。
description.en: Zhang Kaixun once served as Secretary-General and Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Gansu Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 张开勋是第十届全国人大代表。
description.en: Zhang Kaixun was a deputy to the 10th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 张开勋是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Zhang Kaixun is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 张开勋是中共中央党校校友。
description.en: Zhang Kaixun is an alumnus of the Central Party School of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命后，义务教育的口号在拨乱反正时期被提出。
description.en: After the Cultural Revolution, the slogan of compulsory education was proposed during the Boluan Fanzheng period.

description.zh-cn: 在邓小平的推动下，义务教育被写入《中华人民共和国宪法（八二宪法）》。
description.en: Under the promotion of Deng Xiaoping, compulsory education was written into the Constitution of the People's Republic of China (1982).

description.zh-cn: 1982年通过的《中华人民共和国宪法》规定实行义务教育。
description.en: The Constitution of the People's Republic of China, passed in 1982, stipulates the implementation of compulsory education.

description.zh-cn: 第六届全国人民代表大会第四次会议通过了《中华人民共和国义务教育法》。
description.en: The fourth session of the 6th National People's Congress passed the Compulsory Education Law of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 《中华人民共和国义务教育法》于1986年颁布施行，标志着九年义务教育正式实行。
description.en: The Compulsory Education Law of the People's Republic of China was promulgated and implemented in 1986, marking the official implementation of nine-year compulsory education.

description.zh-cn: 第十届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第二十二次会议对《中华人民共和国义务教育法》进行了修订。
description.en: The 22nd meeting of the Standing Committee of the 10th National People's Congress revised the Compulsory Education Law of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 2006年修订的《中华人民共和国义务教育法》明确了义务教育的本质应为素质教育。
description.en: The revised Compulsory Education Law of the People's Republic of China in 2006 clarified that the essence of compulsory education should be quality-oriented education.

description.zh-cn: 《中华人民共和国未成年人保护法》包含保障适龄儿童接受并完成义务教育权利的法条。
description.en: The Law on the Protection of Minors of the People's Republic of China contains legal articles that guarantee the right of school-age children to receive and complete compulsory education.

description.zh-cn: 《中华人民共和国劳动法》禁止用人单位招用未满十六周岁的未成年人，从而保障其接受义务教育的权利。
description.en: The Labour Law of the People's Republic of China prohibits employers from hiring minors under the age of sixteen, thereby protecting their right to receive compulsory education.

description.zh-cn: “两免一补”政策通过对经济困难者提供补助，帮助他们完成义务教育。
description.en: The 'Two Exemptions and One Subsidy' policy helps financially disadvantaged individuals complete compulsory education by providing subsidies.

description.zh-cn: 义务教育与中华人民共和国的扫盲运动关系紧密。
description.en: Compulsory education is closely related to the literacy campaign in the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 在义务教育体系内，绝大多数小学生被要求“入学即入队”，加入中国少年先锋队。
description.en: Within the compulsory education system, the vast majority of primary school students are required to join the Young Pioneers of China upon enrollment.

description.zh-cn: 在初级中学（义务教育的一部分）阶段，学生被鼓励分批加入中国共产主义青年团。
description.en: During the junior high school stage (part of compulsory education), students are encouraged to join the Communist Youth League of China in batches.

description.zh-cn: 应试教育成为了困扰义务教育工作者和学生的重要问题，并且严重地阻碍了均衡教育（素质教育的一部分）的实现步伐。
description.en: Exam-oriented education has become a major problem for compulsory education workers and students, and has severely hindered the implementation of balanced education (a part of quality-oriented education).

description.zh-cn: 户籍制度导致了城市和农村义务教育的实行程度有较大区别，尤其体现在“农民工”子女接受义务教育的问题上。
description.en: The Hukou system has led to significant differences in the implementation of compulsory education between urban and rural areas, particularly affecting the education of migrant workers' children.

description.zh-cn: 河南省洛阳市中级人民法院的上诉法院和业务上级是河南省高级人民法院。
description.en: The appellate court and operational superior of the Luoyang Intermediate People's Court is the Henan High People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 在2003年5月的“河南种子案”中，李慧娟担任河南省洛阳市中级人民法院的审判长。
description.en: In the 'Henan Seed Case' of May 2003, Li Huijuan served as the presiding judge of the Luoyang Intermediate People's Court of Henan Province.

description.zh-cn: 在“河南种子案”后，李慧娟的判决遭到了河南省人民代表大会的强烈指责。
description.en: After the 'Henan Seed Case', Li Huijuan's verdict was strongly criticized by the Henan Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 2019年8月19日，河南省洛阳市中级人民法院对“殴打20年前班主任”案作出二审判决，维持原判。
description.en: On August 19, 2019, the Luoyang Intermediate People's Court of Henan Province issued a second-instance judgment in the 'Case of Beating a Teacher from 20 Years Ago', upholding the original verdict.

description.zh-cn: 1999年毕业于北京外国语大学英语专业。
description.en: Graduated from the English Department of Beijing Foreign Studies University in 1999.

description.zh-cn: 林剑是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Lin Jian is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 1999年进入外交部工作。
description.en: Began working at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in 1999.

description.zh-cn: 林剑与毛宁同为中华人民共和国外交部发言人。
description.en: Lin Jian and Mao Ning are colleagues as spokespersons for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 林剑与郭嘉昆同为中华人民共和国外交部发言人。
description.en: Lin Jian and Guo Jiakun are colleagues as spokespersons for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 外交部发言人由新闻司司长和副司长兼任。
description.en: The spokespersons for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs are concurrently held by the Director-General and Deputy Directors-General of the Information Department.

description.zh-cn: 蔡霞于1952年10月出生于江苏省常州市。
description.en: Cai Xia was born in Changzhou, Jiangsu Province in October 1952.

description.zh-cn: 蔡霞于1969年加入中国共产党，后于2020年8月17日被开除党籍。
description.en: Cai Xia joined the Chinese Communist Party in 1969 and was expelled on August 17, 2020.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央党校于2020年8月17日宣布开除蔡霞的中国共产党党籍，并取消其相关退休待遇。
description.en: On August 17, 2020, the Central Party School of the CCP announced the expulsion of Cai Xia from the Chinese Communist Party and the cancellation of her related retirement benefits.

description.zh-cn: 蔡霞于1969年参军入伍，1978年退伍。
description.en: Cai Xia joined the army in 1969 and was discharged in 1978.

description.zh-cn: 蔡霞在文化大革命期间曾是红卫兵。
description.en: Cai Xia was a Red Guard during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 蔡霞于1992年考入中共中央党校，先后攻读硕士和博士学位，2000年获法学博士学位。
description.en: Cai Xia was admitted to the Central Party School of the CCP in 1992, where she pursued master's and doctoral degrees, obtaining her Doctor of Law degree in 2000.

position.en: Professor at the Party Building Teaching and Research Department

description.zh-cn: 蔡霞在中共中央党校任教，直至2012年退休。
description.en: Cai Xia taught at the Central Party School of the CCP until her retirement in 2012.

description.zh-cn: 蔡霞反对2018年取消国家主席任期制的修宪，认为其从党内程序上不合法。
description.en: Cai Xia opposed the 2018 constitutional amendment that removed presidential term limits, believing it was procedurally illegitimate within the party.

description.zh-cn: 蔡霞公开抨击习近平提出的“四个自信”等政治口号。
description.en: Cai Xia publicly criticized political slogans proposed by Xi Jinping, including the 'Four Confidences'.

description.zh-cn: 蔡霞公开抨击习近平提出的“四个意识”等政治口号。
description.en: Cai Xia publicly criticized political slogans proposed by Xi Jinping, including the 'Four Consciousnesses'.

description.zh-cn: 蔡霞公开抨击习近平提出的“两个维护”等政治口号。
description.en: Cai Xia publicly criticized political slogans proposed by Xi Jinping, including the 'Two Upholds'.

description.zh-cn: 蔡霞撰写文章反对《港区国安法》，认为它会毁掉香港的法治和自由秩序。
description.en: Cai Xia wrote articles opposing the Hong Kong National Security Law, arguing that it would destroy Hong Kong's rule of law and free order.

description.zh-cn: 2016年，蔡霞发表文章引用党章党规，支持党员任志强拥有发表批评意见的权利。
description.en: In 2016, Cai Xia published an article citing the party constitution and regulations to support party member Ren Zhiqiang's right to express critical opinions.

description.zh-cn: 1989年的六四事件使蔡霞对解放军向学生开火的行为感到十分震惊，影响了她的政治观点。
description.en: The 1989 Tiananmen Square incident deeply shocked Cai Xia due to the PLA's use of force against students, influencing her political views.

description.zh-cn: 由于不满中共对雷洋事件的处理，蔡霞对中共彻底失去信心。
description.en: Due to dissatisfaction with the CCP's handling of the Lei Yang incident, Cai Xia completely lost faith in the party.

description.zh-cn: 2017年左右，刘亚洲因写信建议习近平调整新疆政策而被警告不要再妄议习近平的政策。
description.en: Around 2017, Liu Yazhou was warned not to question Xi Jinping's policies again after writing a letter suggesting adjustments to the Xinjiang policy.

description.zh-cn: 2020年1月上旬，习近平拒绝了总理李克强就新冠疫情启动应急响应机制的提议。
description.en: In early January 2020, Xi Jinping rejected Premier Li Keqiang's proposal to activate an emergency response mechanism for the COVID-19 outbreak.

description.zh-cn: 2003年，蔡霞参与了《“三个代表”重要思想学习纲要》的编写工作。
description.en: In 2003, Cai Xia participated in the compilation of the 'Study Outline for the Important Thought of Three Represents'.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛在2007年中共十七大报告中首次提出了“尊重党员主体地位”的论断，推动了党内民主的讨论。
description.en: In his report to the 17th Party Congress in 2007, Hu Jintao first introduced the assertion of 'respecting the principal status of party members,' promoting discussions on intra-party democracy.

description.zh-cn: 赵紫阳受十二届中央委员会委托，向中国共产党第十三次全国代表大会作报告。
description.en: Entrusted by the 12th Central Committee, Zhao Ziyang delivered a report to the 13th National Congress of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 大会提出并系统阐述了社会主义初级阶段理论。
description.en: The congress proposed and systematically elaborated the theory of the primary stage of socialism.

description.zh-cn: 大会审议并通过了《中国共产党章程部分条文修正案》。
description.en: The congress deliberated on and adopted the 'Resolution on the Partial Revision of the Constitution of the Communist Party of China'.

description.zh-cn: 大会首次采用差额选举方式选举中央委员会等机构。
description.en: The congress used the competitive election method for the first time to elect bodies like the Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 大会选举产生了由175名委员和110名候补委员组成的第十三届中央委员会。
description.en: The congress elected the 13th Central Committee, composed of 175 members and 110 alternate members.

description.zh-cn: 大会选举产生了由200人组成的新一届中央顾问委员会。
description.en: The congress elected a new Central Advisory Commission composed of 200 members.

description.zh-cn: 大会选举产生了由69人组成的新一届中央纪律检查委员会。
description.en: The congress elected a new Central Commission for Discipline Inspection composed of 69 members.

description.zh-cn: 作为中央总书记主持了中国共产党第十九届中央委员会第一次全体会议。
description.en: As the General Secretary of the Central Committee, presided over the First Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 会议选举习近平为中国共产党中央委员会总书记。此外，通过不设立明确的接班人，为习近平在中共二十大后继续执政铺平了道路。
description.en: The session elected Xi Jinping as the General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee. Furthermore, by not appointing a clear successor, it paved the way for Xi Jinping to continue in power after the 20th Party Congress.

description.zh-cn: 胡春华未能在中共十九届一中全会上进入中央政治局常委会，使其失去了第六代接班人的资格。
description.en: Hu Chunhua failed to enter the Politburo Standing Committee at the First Plenary Session of the 19th CPC Central Committee, losing his qualification as a sixth-generation successor.

description.zh-cn: 陈敏尔未能在中共十九届一中全会上进入中央政治局常委会，使其失去了第六代接班人的资格。
description.en: Chen Min'er failed to enter the Politburo Standing Committee at the First Plenary Session of the 19th CPC Central Committee, losing his qualification as a sixth-generation successor.

description.zh-cn: 由于会议未选出明显的接班人，外界认为这打破了改革开放以来形成的领导人任期制，使得原有的接班体系失效。
description.en: As the session did not elect a clear successor, it was seen as breaking the leadership term-limit system established since the Reform and Opening Up, causing the original succession system to become ineffective.

description.zh-cn: 改革开放以来，中国形成了领导人任期制。
description.en: Since the Reform and Opening Up, China has formed a system of leadership term limits.

description.zh-cn: 文本提及习近平复辟毛泽东时代的个人崇拜。
description.en: The text mentions that Xi Jinping revived the Mao Zedong-era personality cult.

description.zh-cn: 祝贺习近平当选中国共产党第十九届中央委员会总书记。
description.en: Congratulated Xi Jinping on his election as General Secretary of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 祝贺习近平当选中国共产党第十九届中央委员会总书记。
description.en: Congratulated Xi Jinping on his election as General Secretary of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 刘强东于1998年6月18日创立了京东集团。
description.en: Liu Qiangdong founded JD.com on June 18, 1998.

description.zh-cn: 腾讯于2014年3月10日以2.14亿美元入股京东，成为其重要股东。
description.en: Tencent invested $214 million in JD.com on March 10, 2014, becoming a major shareholder.

description.zh-cn: 腾讯与京东建立了战略合作伙伴关系。
description.en: Tencent and JD.com established a strategic partnership.

description.zh-cn: 作为腾讯入股京东协议的一部分，腾讯总裁刘炽平加入京东董事会。
description.en: As part of Tencent's investment deal, Tencent President Martin Lau joined JD.com's board of directors.

description.zh-cn: 沃尔玛将其在线零售平台“1号店”出售给京东，以换取京东约5%的股权，并后续增持。
description.en: Walmart sold its online retail platform 'Yihaodian' to JD.com in exchange for an approximately 5% stake in JD.com, and later increased its holding.

description.zh-cn: 京东从沃尔玛处收购了在线零售平台“1号店”的业务。
description.en: JD.com acquired the business of the online retail platform 'Yihaodian' from Walmart.

description.zh-cn: Google向京东投资5.5亿美元。
description.en: Google invested $550 million in JD.com.

description.zh-cn: 刘强东与章泽天是夫妻关系。
description.en: Liu Qiangdong and Zhang Zetian are husband and wife.

description.zh-cn: 京东被指推行“996工作制”，引发了关于员工工作时长和劳动权益的争议。
description.en: JD.com has been criticized for implementing the '996 working hour system', sparking controversy over employee working hours and labor rights.

description.zh-cn: 诺亚控股旗下的歌斐资产因“承兴案”相关合同纠纷向京东提起诉讼。
description.en: Noah Holdings' subsidiary, Gopher Asset Management, filed a lawsuit against JD.com over contract disputes related to the 'Camsing case'.

description.zh-cn: 1647年，约翰·洛克被送至伦敦的西敏公学就读。
description.en: In 1647, John Locke was sent to study at Westminster School in London.

description.zh-cn: 洛克在牛津大学基督堂学院就读，并分别于1656年、1658年和1664年获得学士、硕士和医学学士学位。
description.en: Locke studied at Christ Church, Oxford, and obtained a B.A. in 1656, an M.A. in 1658, and a B.Med. in 1664.

description.zh-cn: 约翰·洛克是皇家学会的院士。
description.en: John Locke was a Fellow of the Royal Society.

description.zh-cn: 光荣革命结束后，洛克于1688年得以跟随奥兰治亲王的妻子返回英格兰，结束了其流亡生涯。
description.en: After the Glorious Revolution, Locke was able to return to England in 1688 with the wife of the Prince of Orange, ending his exile.

description.zh-cn: 在他晚年于艾塞克斯郡定居期间，洛克经常与艾萨克·牛顿等人讨论各种议题。
description.en: During his later years in Essex, Locke frequently discussed various topics with Isaac Newton and others.

description.zh-cn: 《政府论》的第一篇有效地驳斥了罗伯特·菲尔默的君权神授主张。
description.en: The First Treatise of 'Two Treatises of Government' effectively refutes Robert Filmer's claims of the divine right of kings.

description.zh-cn: 《政府论》中，洛克批评了托马斯·霍布斯等人的独裁主义政治哲学。
description.en: In 'Two Treatises of Government', Locke criticized the authoritarian political philosophy of Thomas Hobbes and others.

description.zh-cn: 洛克被广泛视为自由主义的奠基者，其思想对自由主义的发展产生了巨大影响。
description.en: Locke is widely regarded as the founder of liberalism, and his ideas had a profound impact on its development.

description.zh-cn: 洛克被广泛视为启蒙时代最具影响力的思想家之一。
description.en: Locke is widely regarded as one of the most influential thinkers of the Enlightenment.

description.zh-cn: 洛克的著作对伏尔泰产生了巨大影响。
description.en: Locke's writings greatly influenced Voltaire.

description.zh-cn: 洛克的著作对让·雅各·卢梭产生了影响。
description.en: Locke's writings influenced Jean-Jacques Rousseau.

description.zh-cn: 洛克的自由和社会契约理论影响了许多美国开国元勋。
description.en: Locke's theories on liberty and the social contract influenced many of the American Founding Fathers.

description.zh-cn: 《美国独立宣言》受到了洛克的古典共和主义和自由主义观念的影响。
description.en: The Declaration of Independence was influenced by Locke's concepts of classical republicanism and liberalism.

description.zh-cn: 洛克发现笛卡尔等哲学家的著作比大学教材更有趣，尽管他批评笛卡尔的理论，但其著作仍对洛克产生了思想上的影响。
description.en: Locke found the works of philosophers like Descartes more interesting than university textbooks. Although he criticized Descartes' theories, his writings still had an intellectual influence on Locke.

description.zh-cn: 洛克发展出了一套与托马斯·霍布斯的自然状态不同的理论，显示霍布斯的思想是其理论建构的重要参照点。
description.en: Locke developed a theory of the state of nature that differed from that of Thomas Hobbes, indicating Hobbes's ideas were a significant reference point for Locke's theoretical constructions.

description.zh-cn: 洛克的政治理论激励了后来的美国革命。
description.en: Locke's political theories inspired the later American Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 洛克的政治理论激励了后来的法国大革命。
description.en: Locke's political theories inspired the later French Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 根据《深化党和国家机构改革方案》，原公安消防部队成建制划归应急管理部。
description.en: According to the 'Plan for Deepening the Reform of Party and State Institutions', the former public security fire fighting forces were transferred to the Ministry of Emergency Management as complete units.

description.zh-cn: 吴佳和是福建云霄人。
description.en: Wu Jiahe is from Yunxiao, Fujian.

description.zh-cn: 吴佳和曾任新疆维吾尔自治区政协副主席。
description.en: Wu Jiahe once served as the Vice Chairman of the CPPCC of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 吴佳和是第七届全国人大代表。
description.en: Wu Jiahe was a deputy to the 7th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 吴佳和是第八届全国政协委员。
description.en: Wu Jiahe was a member of the 8th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 吴佳和是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Wu Jiahe is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 吴佳和是新疆八一农学院（现新疆农业大学）的校友。
description.en: Wu Jiahe is an alumnus of Xinjiang Bayi Agricultural College (now Xinjiang Agricultural University).

description.zh-cn: 黎笋是印度支那共产党成立时的首批党员之一。
description.en: Lê Duẩn was one of the first members when the Indochinese Communist Party was founded.

description.zh-cn: 黎笋是印度支那共产党的早期创始人之一。
description.en: Lê Duẩn was one of the early founders of the Indochinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 1931年被法国殖民当局逮捕，1936年获释。1940年再次被捕。
description.en: Arrested by French colonial authorities in 1931 and released in 1936. Arrested again in 1940.

description.zh-cn: 在胡志明担任越南劳动党中央委员会主席期间，黎笋作为第一书记，是党内的二号领导人。
description.en: While Ho Chi Minh was Chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Vietnam, Lê Duẩn, as First Secretary, was the party's second-in-command.

description.zh-cn: 黎笋接替胡志明出任越南劳动党中央委员会第一书记。
description.en: Lê Duẩn succeeded Ho Chi Minh as the First Secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 长征接替黎笋出任越南共产党中央委员会总书记。
description.en: Trường Chinh succeeded Lê Duẩn as the General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 黎笋下令入侵柬埔寨。
description.en: Lê Duẩn ordered the invasion of Cambodia.

description.zh-cn: 黎笋在位期间，由于其亲苏立场、否认中国对南海诸岛的主权以及发动排华运动，与中国的关系十分紧张。
description.en: During Lê Duẩn's time in power, relations with China were very tense due to his pro-Soviet stance, his denial of China's sovereignty over the South China Sea islands, and the launch of an anti-Chinese movement.

description.zh-cn: 黎笋是越南民主共和国的主要缔造者和领导人之一。
description.en: Lê Duẩn was one of the main founders and leaders of the Democratic Republic of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 黎笋是越南社会主义共和国的主要缔造者和领导人之一。
description.en: Lê Duẩn was one of the main founders and leaders of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 张子善出生于直隶省深县尚村。
description.en: Zhang Zishan was born in Shangcun, Shen County, Zhili Province.

description.zh-cn: 1934年，河北民军总指挥张荫梧的部队应县长王凤翔要求逮捕了张子善。
description.en: In 1934, the troops of Hebei Civilian Army Commander Zhang Yinwu arrested Zhang Zishan at the request of county magistrate Wang Fengxiang.

description.zh-cn: 七七事变后，天津监狱发生混乱，张子善趁机逃出。
description.en: After the Marco Polo Bridge Incident, chaos erupted in Tianjin Prison, and Zhang Zishan took the opportunity to escape.

description.zh-cn: 张子善因在刘青山张子善案中犯有贪污罪，被判处死刑。
description.en: Zhang Zishan was sentenced to death for corruption in the Liu Qingshan and Zhang Zishan case.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政府因贪污罪判处张子善死刑并执行枪决。
description.en: The government of the People's Republic of China sentenced Zhang Zishan to death and executed him by firing squad for corruption.

description.zh-cn: 就读于初中和高中部。
description.en: Attended junior and senior high school.

description.zh-cn: 就读于水利工程系。
description.en: Studied in the Department of Hydraulic Engineering.

description.zh-cn: 先后就读于经济系、财政系。
description.en: Studied in the Department of Economics and then the Department of Finance.

description.zh-cn: 被免试录为财政系研究生。
description.en: Admitted to the postgraduate program in the Department of Finance without examination.

description.zh-cn: 1953年毕业后留校任教。
description.en: After graduating in 1953, he stayed at the university to teach.

description.zh-cn: 梁尚敏在1957年的反右运动中被打为右派。
description.en: Liang Shangmin was labeled a 'rightist' during the Anti-Rightist Movement in 1957.

position.zh-cn: 教授、财政金融系财政教研室主任、财政金融系主任、财税研究所所长
position.en: Professor, Director of the Finance Teaching and Research Office of the Department of Finance and Banking, Head of the Department of Finance and Banking, Director of the Institute of Finance and Taxation

description.zh-cn: 1978年调入该校前身湖北财经学院任职，1995年于该校退休。
description.en: He was transferred to the Hubei Institute of Finance and Economics, the predecessor of the university, in 1978 and retired from the university in 1995.

description.zh-cn: 授予梁尚敏首届“中国财政理论研究终身成就奖”。
description.en: Awarded Liang Shangmin the inaugural 'Lifetime Achievement Award for Chinese Fiscal Theory Research'.

description.zh-cn: 海关总署驻上海特派员办事处是中华人民共和国海关总署设立的派出机构，直属海关总署领导。
description.en: The Shanghai Special Commissioner's Office is a dispatched agency established by the General Administration of Customs of the People's Republic of China and is directly under its leadership.

description.zh-cn: 海关总署驻上海特派员办事处负责对合肥海关进行执法督查、干部考察、廉政督察等工作。
description.en: The Shanghai Special Commissioner's Office of the General Administration of Customs is responsible for law enforcement supervision, cadre assessment, and integrity inspection of Hefei Customs.

description.zh-cn: 海关总署驻上海特派员办事处负责对厦门海关进行执法督查、干部考察、廉政督察等工作。
description.en: The Shanghai Special Commissioner's Office of the General Administration of Customs is responsible for law enforcement supervision, cadre assessment, and integrity inspection of Xiamen Customs.

description.zh-cn: 海关总署驻上海特派员办事处负责对青岛海关进行执法督查、干部考察、廉政督察等工作。
description.en: The Shanghai Special Commissioner's Office of the General Administration of Customs is responsible for law enforcement supervision, cadre assessment, and integrity inspection of Qingdao Customs.

description.zh-cn: 海关总署驻上海特派员办事处负责对上海海关高等专科学校进行执法督查、干部考察、廉政督察等工作。
description.en: The Shanghai Special Commissioner's Office of the General Administration of Customs is responsible for law enforcement supervision, cadre assessment, and integrity inspection of Shanghai Customs College.

description.zh-cn: 刘家义在温家宝担任国务院总理期间任审计署审计长。
description.en: Liu Jiayi served as Auditor General while Wen Jiabao was the Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 刘家义在李克强担任国务院总理期间任审计署审计长。
description.en: Liu Jiayi served as Auditor General while Li Keqiang was the Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 刘家义接替李金华出任中华人民共和国审计署审计长。
description.en: Liu Jiayi succeeded Li Jinhua as the Auditor General of the National Audit Office of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 胡泽君接替刘家义出任中华人民共和国审计署审计长。
description.en: Hu Zejun succeeded Liu Jiayi as the Auditor General of the National Audit Office of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 刘家义接替姜异康出任中共山东省委书记。
description.en: Liu Jiayi succeeded Jiang Yikang as the Secretary of the Shandong Provincial Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 李干杰接替刘家义出任中共山东省委书记。
description.en: Li Ganjie succeeded Liu Jiayi as the Secretary of the Shandong Provincial Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 习近平签署第68号主席令，决定免去刘家义的中华人民共和国审计署审计长职务。
description.en: Xi Jinping signed the 68th Presidential Order, deciding to remove Liu Jiayi from the post of Auditor General of the National Audit Office of the People's Republic of China.

position.zh-cn: 全国人民代表大会财政经济委员会副主任委员
position.en: Vice Chairman of the Financial and Economic Affairs Committee of the National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 刘家义担任全国人民代表大会财政经济委员会副主任委员时，徐绍史是主任委员。
description.en: When Liu Jiayi served as Vice Chairman of the Financial and Economic Affairs Committee of the National People's Congress, Xu Shaoshi was the Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 向刘家义颁发一等独立勋章。
description.en: Awarded the First Class Order of Independence to Liu Jiayi.

description.zh-cn: 陆军参谋长受陆军部长直接领导，负责陆军事务并辅助部长的对外职责。
description.en: The Chief of Staff of the Army is under the direct leadership of the Secretary of the Army, responsible for Army matters and assisting the Secretary's external duties.

description.zh-cn: 美国陆军参谋长是参谋长联席会议的成员。
description.en: The Chief of Staff of the Army is a member of the Joint Chiefs of Staff.

description.zh-cn: 美国陆军参谋长是美国陆军部内的一个职位。
description.en: The Chief of Staff of the Army is a position within the Department of the Army.

description.zh-cn: 美国陆军总指挥官是美国陆军参谋长的前身职务。
description.en: The Commanding General of the United States Army was the precursor to the Chief of Staff of the United States Army.

description.zh-cn: 陆军参谋长向国会提交陆军预算与计划。
description.en: The Chief of Staff of the Army submits the Army's budget and plans to Congress.

description.zh-cn: 陆军参谋长负责一体化作战司令部的人事和资源调配。
description.en: The Chief of Staff of the Army is responsible for the assignment of personnel and resources to the Unified Combatant Commands.

description.zh-cn: 美国陆军参谋长由总统提名。

description.zh-cn: 美国法典第10编第3033节规定了美国陆军参谋长的职责。

description.zh-cn: 美国陆军参谋长是美国陆军中军阶最高的军官职位之一。
description.en: The Chief of Staff of the Army is one of the highest-ranking officer positions in the United States Army.

description.zh-cn: 根据资料，联邦储备系统的过度投资是导致1929年华尔街股灾的原因之一。
description.en: According to the information, over-investment by the Federal Reserve System was one of the causes of the Wall Street Crash of 1929.

description.zh-cn: 1929年的股灾将“咆哮的二十年代”的经济繁荣时期划上句号。
description.en: The stock market crash of 1929 brought the prosperous era of the Roaring Twenties to an end.

description.zh-cn: 经济学家裘德·万尼斯基认为，股灾前市场的剧烈波动与美国国会当时正辩论《斯姆特-霍利关税法案》有关。
description.en: Economist Jude Wanniski suggested that the market volatility before the crash was related to the ongoing congressional debate over the Smoot-Hawley Tariff Act.

description.zh-cn: 股灾导致道琼斯工业平均指数暴跌，至1932年7月8日跌至20世纪的最低点，由最高点计蒸发掉89%。
description.en: The crash caused the Dow Jones Industrial Average to plummet, reaching its 20th-century low on July 8, 1932, an 89% loss from its peak.

description.zh-cn: 与其他商界巨富高调大手入市，企图稳住公众对市场的信心，但未能成功。
description.en: Along with other business magnates, made large, high-profile stock purchases in an unsuccessful attempt to stabilize public confidence in the market.

description.zh-cn: 王皓在1999年至2014年期间为八一大商乒乓球俱乐部的成员。
description.en: Wang Hao was a member of the Bayi Dashang Table Tennis Club from 1999 to 2014.

description.zh-cn: 王皓是中华人民共和国公民。
description.en: Wang Hao is a citizen of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 王皓出生于吉林省长春市。
description.en: Wang Hao was born in Changchun, Jilin Province.

description.zh-cn: 王皓自2022年12月29日起担任中国国家乒乓球队男队主教练。此前他长期作为该队运动员。
description.en: Wang Hao has been the head coach of the Chinese national men's table tennis team since December 29, 2022. He was previously a long-time player for the team.

description.zh-cn: 作为同时代的顶尖球员，王皓与马琳在多项赛事中既是队友也是对手。例如，王皓在2006年多哈亚运会男单决赛中击败马琳，但在2008年北京奥运会男单决赛中负于马琳。
description.en: As top players of the same era, Wang Hao and Ma Lin were both teammates and rivals in many competitions. For example, Wang Hao defeated Ma Lin in the men's singles final of the 2006 Doha Asian Games, but lost to Ma Lin in the men's singles final of the 2008 Beijing Olympics.

description.zh-cn: 作为同时代的顶尖球员，王皓与王励勤在多项赛事中既是队友也是对手。例如，王皓在2005年全运会男单决赛中负于王励勤，但在2009年横滨世乒赛男单决赛中战胜王励勤夺冠。
