description.en: As top players of the same era, Wang Hao and Wang Liqin were both teammates and rivals in many competitions. For example, Wang Hao lost to Wang Liqin in the men's singles final of the 2005 National Games, but defeated him in the men's singles final of the 2009 Yokohama World Championships to win the title.

description.zh-cn: 在2008年北京奥运会男子乒乓球单打半决赛上，王皓以4比1击败瑞典选手约尔根·佩尔森。
description.en: In the men's table tennis singles semi-final at the 2008 Beijing Olympics, Wang Hao defeated Swedish player Jörgen Persson 4-1.

description.zh-cn: 王皓与柳承敏在重大比赛决赛中多次交手，包括在2004年雅典奥运会男单决赛中负于对手，以及在2007年男单世界杯决赛中战胜对手。
description.en: Wang Hao and Ryu Seung-min faced each other in several major finals, including losing to him in the men's singles final of the 2004 Athens Olympics and defeating him in the men's singles final of the 2007 World Cup.

description.zh-cn: 王皓取代孔令辉获得2004年雅典奥运会参赛资格。两人在2005年世界乒乓球锦标赛中搭档获得男子双打冠军。
description.en: Wang Hao replaced Kong Linghui to qualify for the 2004 Athens Olympics. The two partnered to win the men's doubles title at the 2005 World Table Tennis Championships.

description.zh-cn: 王皓与德国选手蒂莫·波尔在职业生涯中多次交锋，例如在2005年男子乒乓球世界杯赛中负于对手，但在2007年和2008年的世界杯中均战胜对手夺冠。
description.en: Wang Hao competed against German player Timo Boll multiple times in his career, for example, losing to him in the 2005 Men's Table Tennis World Cup, but defeating him to win the title in the 2007 and 2008 World Cups.

description.zh-cn: 王皓与队友马龙多次交手，例如在2009年全运会决赛中击败马龙，以及在2010年亚运会决赛中负于马龙。两人也作为队友共同获得2012年伦敦奥运会男团冠军。
description.en: Wang Hao played against his teammate Ma Long multiple times, such as defeating him in the 2009 National Games final and losing to him in the 2010 Asian Games final. They also won the men's team gold together at the 2012 London Olympics.

description.zh-cn: 王皓在2011年世乒赛、2012年伦敦奥运会和2013年世乒赛的男单决赛中均负于队友张继科。两人也作为队友共同获得2012年伦敦奥运会男团冠军。
description.en: Wang Hao lost to his teammate Zhang Jike in the men's singles finals of the 2011 World Championships, the 2012 London Olympics, and the 2013 World Championships. They also won the men's team gold together at the 2012 London Olympics.

description.zh-cn: 王皓在队友郝帅为儿子举办的宴会上宣布退出国家队。
description.en: Wang Hao announced his retirement from the national team at a banquet held by his teammate Hao Shuai for his son.

description.zh-cn: 王皓于2013年与舞蹈演员闫博雅结婚。
description.en: Wang Hao married dancer Yan Boya in 2013.

description.zh-cn: 王皓是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Wang Hao is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 台湾省政府指派时任省政府委员的柯丁选代理花莲县县长。
description.en: The Taiwan Provincial Government appointed Ko Ting-hsuan, then a member of the provincial government council, to act as the Magistrate of Hualien County.

description.zh-cn: 台湾省政府指派时任省政府委员的陈正雄代理花莲县县长。
description.en: The Taiwan Provincial Government appointed Chen Cheng-hsiung, then a member of the provincial government council, to act as the Magistrate of Hualien County.

description.zh-cn: 2014年傅崐萁申请回复中国国民党党籍失败。
description.en: In 2014, Fu Kun-chi's application to restore his Kuomintang membership failed.

description.zh-cn: 李峰是山东淄博人。
description.en: Li Feng is from Zibo, Shandong.

description.zh-cn: 李峰是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Li Feng is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 2018年，李峰被选为山东省出席第十三届全国人民代表大会代表。
description.en: In 2018, Li Feng was elected as a deputy representing Shandong Province to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 朱芳春1911年腊月生于直隶省藁城县黄庄村。
description.en: Zhu Fangchun was born in Huangzhuang Village, Gaocheng County, Zhili Province in December 1911.

description.zh-cn: 1933年考入国立北平师范大学，获教育系心理学专业兼国文系双学士学位。
description.en: Admitted to National Beiping Normal University in 1933, and obtained a double bachelor's degree in psychology from the Department of Education and the Department of Chinese Language.

description.zh-cn: 大学期间加入共产党。
description.en: Joined the Communist Party during his university years.

description.zh-cn: 1948年中共中央社会部部长李克农派遣朱芳春赴台发展组织。
description.en: In 1948, Li Kenong, the head of the Central Social Affairs Department of the CCP, dispatched Zhu Fangchun to Taiwan to develop organizations.

description.zh-cn: 朱芳春吸收萧明华加入共产党，并在台湾的谍报小组中领导她，萧明华负责情报搜集、保管、密写工作。
description.en: Zhu Fangchun recruited Xiao Minghua into the Communist Party and led her in the espionage group in Taiwan, where Xiao was responsible for intelligence collection, safekeeping, and secret writing.

description.zh-cn: 1947年7月，朱芳春策反北平驻军被傅作义发觉并遭到通缉。
description.en: In July 1947, Zhu Fangchun's efforts to subvert the Beiping garrison were discovered by Fu Zuoyi, who then issued a warrant for his arrest.

description.zh-cn: 1948年由中共中央社会部派遣来台从事谍报活动。
description.en: In 1948, he was dispatched by the Central Social Affairs Department of the CCP to Taiwan to engage in espionage activities.

description.zh-cn: 来台后，朱芳春利用讲习成立读书会，并在此基础上成立了“新民主主义青年团”。
description.en: After arriving in Taiwan, Zhu Fangchun used lectures to form study groups, which became the basis for establishing the 'New Democratic Youth League'.

description.zh-cn: 文革时，朱芳春下放河北省正定中学担任教师，遭到无情的批斗。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Zhu Fangchun was sent down to teach at Zhengding Middle School in Hebei Province and was subjected to relentless struggle sessions.

description.zh-cn: 1979年获得平反，任教于北京国际关系学院，1993年退休。
description.en: He was rehabilitated in 1979 and taught at the University of International Relations in Beijing until his retirement in 1993.

description.zh-cn: 1950年，朱芳春透过田子彬办理谍报证顺利通关，潜逃香港。
description.en: In 1950, with the help of Tian Zibin, Zhu Fangchun obtained an espionage certificate to pass through customs and escape to Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 1950年，朱芳春透过白静寅办理谍报证顺利通关，潜逃香港。
description.en: In 1950, with the help of Bai Jingyin, Zhu Fangchun obtained an espionage certificate to pass through customs and escape to Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 1950年朱芳春逃返大陆后，协助土地改革运动。
description.en: After fleeing back to mainland China in 1950, Zhu Fangchun assisted in the Land Reform Movement.

description.zh-cn: 在明末清初的一波西学东渐中，以天主教耶稣会为主的传教士扮演著相当重要的角色，他们系统地将西方科技学术思想引入中国。
description.en: In the first wave of West-to-East knowledge transfer during the late Ming and early Qing, Jesuit missionaries played a very important role by systematically introducing Western science, technology, and academic thought to China.

description.zh-cn: 利玛窦与徐光启合作翻译了《几何原本》等西方科学著作，是中西文化交流史上的重要合作。
description.en: Matteo Ricci collaborated with Xu Guangqi to translate Western scientific works such as 'Elements' of Euclid, marking an important collaboration in the history of Sino-Western cultural exchange.

description.zh-cn: 与徐光启合译了欧几里得《几何原本》前六卷。
description.en: Co-translated the first six books of Euclid's 'Elements' with Xu Guangqi.

description.zh-cn: 与利玛窦合译了欧几里得《几何原本》前六卷。
description.en: Co-translated the first six books of Euclid's 'Elements' with Matteo Ricci.

description.zh-cn: 罗马教廷对来华传教政策的改变（废除利玛窦规矩，禁止祭祖），引起雍正朝廷反感，导致禁教，中断了第一阶段的西学东渐。
description.en: The Holy See's change in missionary policy towards China (abolishing the 'Ricci rules' and banning ancestor worship) caused resentment from the Yongzheng court, leading to the prohibition of Christianity and the interruption of the first phase of West-to-East knowledge transfer.

description.zh-cn: 因罗马教廷改变政策，雍正帝实行禁教，中断了明末清初的西学东渐进程。
description.en: Due to the change in policy by the Holy See, Emperor Yongzheng implemented a ban on Christianity, interrupting the process of West-to-East knowledge transfer of the late Ming and early Qing period.

description.zh-cn: 鸦片战争的失败刺激了清朝部分有识之士，促使他们开始关注和学习西方的科学技术，开启了第二阶段的西学东渐。
description.en: The defeat in the Opium Wars stimulated some enlightened individuals in the Qing dynasty, prompting them to pay attention to and learn from Western science and technology, thus initiating the second phase of West-to-East knowledge transfer.

description.zh-cn: 甲午战争的失败使许多中国知识分子认识到仅学习西方技术不足以救国，必须更积极全面地学习西方的学术思想与政治制度，从而极大地推动了西学东渐的广度和深度。
description.en: The defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War made many Chinese intellectuals realize that learning Western technology alone was insufficient to save the nation. They had to more actively and comprehensively study Western academic thought and political systems, which greatly promoted the breadth and depth of the West-to-East knowledge transfer.

description.zh-cn: 魏源著《海国图志》，开启了国人系统了解世界的眼界。
description.en: Wei Yuan authored the 'Illustrated Treatise on the Maritime Kingdoms', opening the eyes of his countrymen to systematically understand the world.

description.zh-cn: 严复翻译的《天演论》引入了达尔文的演化论，其“物竞天择，适者生存”的观念对当时中国思想界产生了重大影响，是西学东渐中的标志性事件。
description.en: Yan Fu's translation, 'Tian Yan Lun', introduced Darwin's theory of evolution. Its concept of 'natural selection and survival of the fittest' had a profound impact on the Chinese intellectual world and was a landmark event in the West-to-East knowledge transfer.

description.zh-cn: 1843年，英国传教士麦都思在上海创建墨海书馆。
description.en: In 1843, the English missionary Walter Henry Medhurst founded the Mohai Shu Guan (London Missionary Society Press) in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 墨海书馆出版了大量关于西方政治、科学、宗教的书籍，是道光、咸丰年间译介西学最重要的出版组织。
description.en: The Mohai Shu Guan published a large number of books on Western politics, science, and religion, and was the most important publishing organization for translating Western knowledge during the Daoguang and Xianfeng eras.

description.zh-cn: 广学会翻译出版的书刊是康有为、梁启超等人了解西学的重要资料来源。
description.en: The books and periodicals translated and published by the Society for the Diffusion of Christian and General Knowledge were an important source of information about the West for reformers like Kang Youwei and Liang Qichao.

description.zh-cn: 在容闳的争取提议下，清政府于1872年选派了第一批留美幼童。
description.en: Through the efforts and proposal of Yung Wing, the Qing government sent the first group of students of the Chinese Educational Mission to the United States in 1872.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞提出的“中学为体，西学为用”，成为晚清新式知识分子最典型的西学观点。
description.en: Zhang Zhidong's proposal of 'Chinese learning as substance, Western learning for application' became the most typical view on Western learning among the new-style intellectuals of the late Qing.

description.zh-cn: 五四运动时期，对政治的不满导致知识分子们提出“全盘西化”的主张，将西学东渐推向了更深层次的思想文化领域。
description.en: During the May Fourth Movement, dissatisfaction with politics led intellectuals to propose 'total Westernization', pushing the West-to-East knowledge transfer into the deeper realms of thought and culture.

description.zh-cn: 陈彬于1919年9月26日出生于四川通江。
description.en: Chen Bin was born in Tongjiang, Sichuan on September 26, 1919.

description.zh-cn: 陈彬于十六岁（约1935年）时参加中国工农红军。
description.en: Chen Bin joined the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army at the age of sixteen (around 1935).

description.zh-cn: 陈彬在长征后被编入西路军。
description.en: Chen Bin was incorporated into the West Route Army after the Long March.

description.zh-cn: 陈彬曾是中国共产主义青年团团员，后于1938年转为中国共产党党员。
description.en: Chen Bin was a member of the Communist Youth League of China before becoming a member of the Communist Party of China in 1938.

description.zh-cn: 陈彬于1938年由中国共产主义青年团团员转为中国共产党党员。
description.en: In 1938, Chen Bin transferred his membership from the Communist Youth League of China to the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 陈彬曾被调往北京在军委总参军务部任职。
description.en: Chen Bin was transferred to Beijing to serve in the Military Affairs Department of the General Staff of the Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 陈彬于1961年晋升少将军衔。
description.en: Chen Bin was promoted to the rank of Major General in 1961.

description.zh-cn: 陈彬于1969年出任国家计划委员会副主任。
description.en: Chen Bin was appointed Deputy Director of the State Planning Commission in 1969.

description.zh-cn: 陈彬曾出任国防科学技术委员会副主任。
description.en: Chen Bin once served as the Deputy Director of the National Defense Science and Technology Commission.

description.zh-cn: 陈彬于1982年至1985年担任新建立的国防科学技术工业委员会首任主任。
description.en: From 1982 to 1985, Chen Bin served as the first Director of the newly established Commission for Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense.

description.zh-cn: 陈彬在1982年的中共十二大上被选为中共中央委员会委员。
description.en: Chen Bin was elected as a member of the Central Committee of the CCP at the 12th National Congress of the CCP in 1982.

description.zh-cn: 陈彬于1982年至1985年担任中共第十二届中央委员会委员。
description.en: Chen Bin served as a member of the 12th Central Committee of the CCP from 1982 to 1985.

description.zh-cn: 陈彬在1987年的中共十三大上被选为中央顾问委员会委员。
description.en: Chen Bin was elected as a member of the Central Advisory Commission at the 13th National Congress of the CCP in 1987.

description.zh-cn: 陈彬于1987年当选为中央顾问委员会委员。
description.en: Chen Bin was elected as a member of the Central Advisory Commission in 1987.

description.zh-cn: 1985年，丁衡高接替陈彬担任中华人民共和国国防科学技术工业委员会主任。
description.en: In 1985, Ding Henggao succeeded Chen Bin as the Director of the Commission for Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 公元前473年，越国灭亡吴国，势力范围一度雄踞东南。
description.en: In 473 BC, the State of Yue conquered the State of Wu, and its sphere of influence once dominated the southeast.

description.zh-cn: 公元前306年，楚国乘越国内乱，占领其江东之地，导致越国分崩离析。
description.en: In 306 BC, the State of Chu took advantage of internal turmoil in Yue to occupy its territory east of the Yangtze River, leading to the disintegration of Yue.

description.zh-cn: 公元前257年，蜀泮灭亡文郎国。
description.en: In 257 BC, Thục Phán conquered the state of Văn Lang.

description.zh-cn: 蜀泮在灭亡文郎国后建立了瓯貉国。
description.en: After conquering Văn Lang, Thục Phán established the state of Âu Lạc.

description.zh-cn: 南越王赵佗灭亡瓯貉国。
description.en: Zhao Tuo, king of Nanyue, conquered the state of Âu Lạc.

description.zh-cn: 秦朝于前219年开始发动旨在征服岭南地区百越部落的战争。
description.en: The Qin dynasty launched a war in 219 BC aimed at conquering the Baiyue tribes in the Lingnan region.

description.zh-cn: 秦攻百越之战期间，秦军进攻了西瓯部落。
description.en: During Qin's campaign against the Baiyue, the Qin army attacked the Xi'ou tribes.

description.zh-cn: 秦攻百越之战期间，秦军进攻了骆越部落。
description.en: During Qin's campaign against the Baiyue, the Qin army attacked the Luoyue tribes.

description.zh-cn: 前138年，闽越发兵围攻东瓯，导致东瓯国举国迁往汉朝江淮地区而灭亡。
description.en: In 138 BC, Minyue dispatched troops to besiege Dong'ou, which led to the entire Dong'ou kingdom relocating to the Jiang-Huai region of the Han dynasty and its subsequent demise.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝派兵攻灭自立为帝的闽越国。
description.en: Emperor Wu of Han sent troops to conquer the Minyue kingdom, which had declared its own emperor.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝于前112年派兵十万分五路进攻南越国，并于次年将其平定。
description.en: In 112 BC, Emperor Wu of Han dispatched 100,000 troops in five columns to attack the Nanyue kingdom, pacifying it the following year.

description.zh-cn: 元封二年（前109年），滇国归降汉朝，汉朝在其地设置益州郡。
description.en: In the second year of Yuanfeng (109 BC), the Dian Kingdom surrendered to the Han dynasty, which then established Yizhou Commandery in its territory.

description.zh-cn: 夜郎王兴于前27年举兵反汉，被汉朝派兵诛灭。
description.en: In 27 BC, King Xing of Yelang raised troops in rebellion against the Han, but was defeated and killed by Han forces.

description.zh-cn: 元鼎六年（前111年），句町王毋波率部归附汉朝。
description.en: In the sixth year of Yuanding (111 BC), King Wubo of Gouding led his people to submit to the Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 始元五年（前82年），句町首领亡波奉汉昭帝调遣，参与平息益州地区的反叛。
description.en: In the fifth year of Shiyuan (82 BC), Wang Bo, leader of Gouding, was dispatched by Emperor Zhao of Han to participate in suppressing a rebellion in the Yizhou region.

description.zh-cn: 因平叛有功，汉昭帝于始元六年（前81年）封亡波为句町王。
description.en: For his merit in suppressing the rebellion, Emperor Zhao of Han enfeoffed Wang Bo as King of Gouding in the sixth year of Shiyuan (81 BC).

description.zh-cn: 考古学表明，马家浜文化与河姆渡文化有明显的继承关系。
description.en: Archaeology indicates a clear line of succession from the Hemudu culture to the Majiabang culture.

description.zh-cn: 崧泽文化是马家浜文化的直接继承者。
description.en: The Songze culture is the direct successor to the Majiabang culture.

description.zh-cn: 良渚文化继承了崧泽文化。
description.en: The Liangzhu culture inherited from the Songze culture.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命结束后，叶少兰与杜近芳展开合作。
description.en: After the Cultural Revolution ended, Ye Shaolan began to collaborate with Du Jinfang.

description.zh-cn: 2008年，当选第十一届全国政协委员。
description.en: In 2008, he was elected as a member of the 11th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 担任中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会教科文卫体委员会专委。
description.en: Served as a special committee member of the Education, Science, Culture, Health and Sports Committee of the CPPCC National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 叶少兰是叶盛兰的小儿子。
description.en: Ye Shaolan is the youngest son of Ye Shenglan.

description.zh-cn: 叶少兰是叶蓬的弟弟。
description.en: Ye Shaolan is the younger brother of Ye Peng.

description.zh-cn: 叶少兰是中国一级演员。
description.en: Ye Shaolan is a Chinese first-class actor.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党黑龙江省纪律检查委员会是中央纪律检查委员会的下级机构。
description.en: The CPC Heilongjiang Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection is a subordinate body of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党黑龙江省纪律检查委员会是中国共产党的组成部分。
description.en: The CPC Heilongjiang Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection is a component of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党黑龙江省纪律检查委员会是中国共产党的省级纪律检查机关。
description.en: The CPC Heilongjiang Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection is a provincial-level discipline inspection agency of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 1625年，布木布泰嫁给皇太极为福晋。
description.en: In 1625, Bumbutai married Hong Taiji as his fujin (consort).

description.zh-cn: 福临（顺治帝）是孝庄太皇太后与皇太极所生之子。
description.en: Fulin (the Shunzhi Emperor) was the son of Empress Dowager Xiaozhuang and Hong Taiji.

description.zh-cn: 福临（顺治帝）是皇太极的第九子。
description.en: Fulin (the Shunzhi Emperor) was the ninth son of Hong Taiji.

description.zh-cn: 孝庄太皇太后是科尔沁贝勒寨桑之女。
description.en: Empress Dowager Xiaozhuang was the daughter of the Khorchin beile Zaisang.

description.zh-cn: 孝庄太皇太后是寨桑之妻科尔沁次妃博礼所生。
description.en: Empress Dowager Xiaozhuang was born to Boli, the secondary consort of Zaisang.

description.zh-cn: 玄烨（康熙帝）是福临（顺治帝）的第三子，孝庄太皇太后的孙子。
description.en: Xuanye (the Kangxi Emperor) was the third son of Fulin (the Shunzhi Emperor) and the grandson of Empress Dowager Xiaozhuang.

description.zh-cn: 在皇太极驾崩后，与多尔衮联手拥立其子福临为帝，并共同辅政，稳定清初政权。
description.en: After Hong Taiji's death, she allied with Dorgon to enthrone her son Fulin and they jointly governed as regents, stabilizing the early Qing regime.

description.zh-cn: 在皇太极死后的皇位争夺中，运用政治手段确保其子福临成功即位。
description.en: In the struggle for the throne after Hong Taiji's death, she used political maneuvering to ensure her son Fulin's successful accession.

description.zh-cn: 在皇位争夺中与孝庄太皇太后联手，拥立福临为帝，并担任摄政王。
description.en: In the struggle for the throne, he allied with Empress Dowager Xiaozhuang to enthrone Fulin and served as Prince Regent.

description.zh-cn: 在康熙帝亲政初期，协助康熙帝拉拢索尼家族，最终扳倒了鳌拜的政治势力。
description.en: In the early years of the Kangxi Emperor's personal rule, she assisted him in winning over the Soni family to eventually topple Oboi's political faction.

description.zh-cn: 孝庄太皇太后是孝端文皇后的侄女。
description.en: Empress Dowager Xiaozhuang was the niece of Empress Xiaoduanwen.

description.zh-cn: 敏惠恭和元妃（海兰珠）是孝庄太皇太后的姐姐。
description.en: Consort Minhui Gonghe Yuan (Harjol) was the older sister of Empress Dowager Xiaozhuang.

description.zh-cn: 乌克善是孝庄太皇太后的兄长。
description.en: Ukšan was the older brother of Empress Dowager Xiaozhuang.

description.zh-cn: 满珠习礼是孝庄太皇太后的兄长。
description.en: Manjusri was the older brother of Empress Dowager Xiaozhuang.

description.zh-cn: 皇太极是努尔哈赤的第八子。
description.en: Hong Taiji was the eighth son of Nurhaci.

description.zh-cn: 孝端文皇后（哲哲）是皇太极的正室皇后。
description.en: Empress Xiaoduanwen (Jerjer) was the primary empress consort of Hong Taiji.

description.zh-cn: 敏惠恭和元妃（海兰珠）是皇太极的宸妃。
description.en: Consort Minhui Gonghe Yuan (Harjol) was a consort of Hong Taiji.

description.zh-cn: 孝庄太皇太后出生于蒙古科尔沁部。
description.en: Empress Dowager Xiaozhuang was born in the Mongol Khorchin tribe.

description.zh-cn: 侯漫路是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Hou Manlu is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 2018年2月24日，侯漫路当选为第十三届全国人民代表大会辽宁地区代表。
description.en: On February 24, 2018, Hou Manlu was elected as a delegate from the Liaoning region to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 侯漫路是山东平阴人。
description.en: Hou Manlu is from Pingyin, Shandong.

description.zh-cn: 河源市人民政府是广东省人民政府的业务下级单位。
description.en: The Heyuan Municipal People's Government is a business subordinate of the Guangdong Provincial People's Government.

relationships.target: BAIDU:中国共产党河源市委员会

description.zh-cn: 河源市人民政府接受中国共产党河源市委员会的领导。
description.en: The Heyuan Municipal People's Government operates under the leadership of the Heyuan Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 陈国以陈县为其首都。
description.en: The State of Chen used Chen County as its capital.

description.zh-cn: 张楚国以陈县为其首都。
description.en: The Zhangchu regime used Chen County as its capital.

description.zh-cn: 与吴广共同号召并领导了大泽乡起义。
description.en: Co-initiated and led the Dazexiang Uprising with Wu Guang.

description.zh-cn: 与陈胜共同号召并领导了大泽乡起义。
description.en: Co-initiated and led the Dazexiang Uprising with Chen Sheng.

description.zh-cn: 共同领导大泽乡起义的伙伴。
description.en: Partners who jointly led the Dazexiang Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 陈胜以吴广率重兵进攻荥阳。
description.en: Chen Sheng ordered Wu Guang to lead a large force to attack Xingyang.

description.zh-cn: 受秦二世急令，率军迎击周文军。
description.en: Under urgent orders from Qin Er Shi, he led an army to counter Zhou Wen's forces.

description.zh-cn: 率领秦军击败了周文的军队，导致周文兵败自杀。
description.en: Led the Qin army to defeat Zhou Wen's forces, leading to Zhou Wen's defeat and suicide.

description.zh-cn: 作为吴广的部将，将其杀害。
description.en: As Wu Guang's subordinate general, he killed him.

description.zh-cn: 率军攻来，田臧兵败被杀。
description.en: Led his army to attack, resulting in Tian Zang's defeat and death.

description.zh-cn: 率军进攻陈县，击败陈胜。
description.en: Led his army to attack Chen County and defeated Chen Sheng.

description.zh-cn: 拥立景驹为王，重新建立张楚政权。
description.en: Enthroned Jing Ju as king to re-establish the Zhangchu regime.

description.zh-cn: 拥立楚怀王之孙熊心为王。
description.en: Enthroned Xiong Xin, the grandson of King Huai of Chu, as the new king.

description.zh-cn: 在项梁拥立熊心为王后，吕臣立即投奔。
description.en: After Xiang Liang installed Xiong Xin as king, Lü Chen immediately joined his forces.

description.zh-cn: 吕臣投奔项梁后，张楚政权并入西楚。
description.en: After Lü Chen joined Xiang Liang, the Zhangchu regime was merged into Western Chu.

description.zh-cn: 率领汉军在陈县追击项羽，并大破楚军。
description.en: Led the Han army to pursue Xiang Yu to Chen County and defeated the Chu army.

description.zh-cn: 在陈县与汉高祖刘邦会合，共同包围项羽。
description.en: Joined forces with Emperor Gaozu of Han (Liu Bang) at Chen County to encircle Xiang Yu.

description.zh-cn: 淮阳国属兖州刺史部管辖。
description.en: The Huaiyang Kingdom was under the jurisdiction of the Yan Province Inspectorate.

description.zh-cn: 新朝时期，陈县改称为陈陵县。
description.en: During the Xin Dynasty, Chen County was renamed Chenling County.

description.zh-cn: 张克俭的籍贯为山西潞安府长治县。
description.en: Zhang Kejian's ancestral home was Changzhi County, Lu'an Prefecture, Shanxi.

position.zh-cn: 河南辉县知县；湖广佥事；都察院右佥都御史、巡抚河南
position.en: Magistrate of Huixian County, Henan; Surveillance Commissioner of Huguang; Right Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate and Governor of Henan

description.zh-cn: 崇祯四年（1631年）中进士后，张克俭被授予河南辉县知县一职。此后，于崇祯十二年（1639年）考选后，擢升为湖广佥事，先后负责岳州和襄阳的兵备。崇祯十四年（1641年）二月，他被擢升为巡抚河南都察院右佥都御史，但未及上任即殉国。
description.en: After passing the imperial examination in 1631, Zhang Kejian was appointed as the Magistrate of Huixian County, Henan. Subsequently, after being selected in the 1639 evaluation, he was promoted to Surveillance Commissioner of Huguang, responsible for military preparations in Yuezhou and later Xiangyang. In February 1641, he was further promoted to Governor of Henan and Right Vice Censor-in-Chief, but tragically died before assuming the post.

description.zh-cn: 杨嗣昌任督师并将襄阳设为军府时，张克俭作为其下属深得倚仗，负责监军等事务。
description.en: When Yang Sichang served as the Supreme Commander and established his military headquarters in Xiangyang, Zhang Kejian, as his subordinate, was deeply trusted and responsible for military supervision.

description.zh-cn: 张献忠率军攻破襄阳城，张克俭被执后不屈被杀。
description.en: Zhang Xianzhong's forces captured Xiangyang, and Zhang Kejian was executed after being captured and refusing to surrender.

description.zh-cn: 在张献忠攻破襄阳时殉职。
description.en: Died in the line of duty when Xiangyang fell to Zhang Xianzhong.

description.zh-cn: 崇祯六年（1633年），时任辉县知县的张克俭成功率众抵御了农民军的进攻。
description.en: In 1633, Zhang Kejian, then Magistrate of Huixian, successfully led the defense of the county against an attack by peasant rebels.

description.zh-cn: 程梦醒的籍贯是湖北应城。
description.en: Cheng Mengxing's ancestral home is Yingcheng, Hubei.

description.zh-cn: 程梦醒是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Cheng Mengxing is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 2018年，程梦醒被选为湖北省出席第十三届全国人民代表大会代表。
description.en: In 2018, Cheng Mengxing was elected as a delegate from Hubei Province to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 程梦醒担任第十三届全国人民代表大会代表。
description.en: Cheng Mengxing serves as a delegate to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 江西省人民政府是中华人民共和国国务院领导下的地方国家行政机关。
description.en: The Jiangxi Provincial People's Government is a local state administrative organ under the leadership of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 江西省人民政府由江西省人民代表大会产生，对它负责，受它监督。
description.en: The Jiangxi Provincial People's Government is produced by, responsible to, and supervised by the Jiangxi Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 江西省人民代表大会闭会期间，江西省人民政府对江西省人民代表大会常务委员会负责并报告工作。
description.en: When the Jiangxi Provincial People's Congress is not in session, the Jiangxi Provincial People's Government is responsible to and reports its work to the Standing Committee of the Jiangxi Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 1955年2月，江西省人民政府改组为江西省人民委员会。
description.en: In February 1955, the Jiangxi Provincial People's Government was reorganized into the Jiangxi Provincial People's Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1968年1月，江西省人民委员会改组为江西省革命委员会。
description.en: In January 1968, the Jiangxi Provincial People's Committee was reorganized into the Jiangxi Provincial Revolutionary Committee.

description.zh-cn: 江西省教育厅是江西省人民政府的组成部门。
description.en: The Jiangxi Provincial Department of Education is a component department of the Jiangxi Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 江西省人民政府国有资产监督管理委员会是江西省人民政府的直属特设机构。
description.en: The State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of Jiangxi Provincial People's Government is a special commission directly under the Jiangxi Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 专区行政公署是省人民政府的派出机构。
description.en: The Special Administrative Office was a dispatched agency of the provincial people's government.

description.zh-cn: 1949年中华人民共和国成立后，将中华民国大陆时期的“行政督察专员公署”改设为“专区行政公署”。
description.en: After the founding of the People's Republic of China in 1949, the 'Administrative Inspectorate Commissioner's Office' from the ROC mainland period was reorganized into the 'Special Administrative Office'.

description.zh-cn: 在20世纪60年代末期开始的文化大革命期间，专区行政公署被地区革命委员会取代。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, which began in the late 1960s, the Special Administrative Offices were replaced by Prefectural Revolutionary Committees.

description.zh-cn: 在20世纪60年代末期开始的文化大革命期间，地区革命委员会取代了专区行政公署，成为地方行政机构。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, which began in the late 1960s, Prefectural Revolutionary Committees replaced the Special Administrative Offices as the local administrative bodies.

description.zh-cn: 王显政于阜新矿业学院采煤专业学习。
description.en: Wang Xianzheng studied in the coal mining program at Fuxin Mining Institute.

description.zh-cn: 王显政于1982年加入中国共产党。
description.en: Wang Xianzheng joined the Communist Party of China in 1982.

description.zh-cn: 在中共十六大上，王显政被选为中共中央纪律检查委员会委员。
description.en: At the 16th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, Wang Xianzheng was elected as a member of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection.

description.zh-cn: 2005年，王显政被免去国家安全生产监督管理总局局长职务，由李毅中接任。
description.en: In 2005, Wang Xianzheng was removed from the post of Director of the State Administration of Work Safety and was succeeded by Li Yizhong.

description.zh-cn: 凌屹是江苏南通人。
description.en: Ling Yi is a native of Nantong, Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 于2018年2月24日当选为第十三届全国人民代表大会代表。
description.en: Elected as a deputy to the 13th National People's Congress on February 24, 2018.

description.zh-cn: 陈平曾在魏咎手下任太仆，但其进言不被采纳。
description.en: Chen Ping served as Grand Servant under Wei Jiu, but his advice was not heeded.

description.zh-cn: 陈平在离开魏咎后，投奔项羽，被任命为都尉。
description.en: After leaving Wei Jiu, Chen Ping joined Xiang Yu and was appointed Commandant.

description.zh-cn: 项羽因殷地再次被刘邦攻下而大怒，准备处死包括陈平在内的将领，导致陈平逃亡。
description.en: Xiang Yu was enraged after the Yin region was recaptured by Liu Bang and prepared to execute the commanders involved, including Chen Ping, prompting Chen Ping to flee.

position.en: Commandant, Protector of the Army, Chancellor

description.zh-cn: 陈平逃离项羽后归附刘邦，成为其重要谋臣，后官至丞相。
description.en: After fleeing from Xiang Yu, Chen Ping joined Liu Bang and became a key advisor, eventually rising to the position of Chancellor.

description.zh-cn: 周勃与灌婴等人一同向刘邦诋毁陈平，称其品行不端，反复无常。
description.en: Zhou Bo, along with Guan Ying and others, slandered Chen Ping to Liu Bang, accusing him of misconduct and being unreliable.

description.zh-cn: 灌婴与周勃等人一同向刘邦诋毁陈平，称其品行不端，反复无常。
description.en: Guan Ying, along with Zhou Bo and others, slandered Chen Ping to Liu Bang, accusing him of misconduct and being unreliable.

description.zh-cn: 陈平献反间计，在楚军中散布谣言，使项羽猜忌范增，最终导致范增愤而离去，病死途中。
description.en: Chen Ping proposed a strategy to sow discord, spreading rumors in the Chu army that made Xiang Yu suspicious of Fan Zeng, ultimately leading Fan Zeng to leave in anger and die of illness on his way home.

description.zh-cn: 陈平使用反间计，声称钟离昧等将领欲与汉联合，导致项羽对其产生怀疑。
description.en: Chen Ping used a strategy to sow discord, claiming that generals like Zhongli Mo intended to ally with Han, which caused Xiang Yu to become suspicious of them.

description.zh-cn: 刘邦晚年命陈平斩杀樊哙，陈平与周勃商议后，决定将樊哙囚禁押送回京，而非立即处决，从而保住了他的性命。
description.en: In his later years, Liu Bang ordered Chen Ping to execute Fan Kuai. After consulting with Zhou Bo, Chen Ping decided to imprison Fan Kuai and escort him back to the capital instead of executing him on the spot, thereby saving his life.

description.zh-cn: 吕后死后，陈平与太尉周勃合谋，成功铲除了吕氏外戚势力，稳定了刘氏政权。
description.en: After the death of Empress Lü, Chen Ping conspired with Grand Marshal Zhou Bo to successfully eliminate the power of the Lü clan, stabilizing the Liu family's regime.

description.zh-cn: 吕后死后，周勃与丞相陈平合谋，成功铲除了吕氏外戚势力，稳定了刘氏政权。
description.en: After the death of Empress Lü, Zhou Bo conspired with Chancellor Chen Ping to successfully eliminate the power of the Lü clan, stabilizing the Liu family's regime.

description.zh-cn: 在诛灭诸吕后，与周勃等大臣共同拥立代王刘恒为帝，即汉文帝。
description.en: After eliminating the Lü clan, he, along with Zhou Bo and other ministers, supported Liu Heng, the Prince of Dai, to become emperor, who is known as Emperor Wen of Han.

description.zh-cn: 汉文帝询问政事时，周勃无法回答，而陈平对答如流，阐明了丞相的职责。周勃自知能力远不如陈平，不久后便称病辞去右丞相之职。
description.en: When Emperor Wen inquired about state affairs, Zhou Bo could not answer, while Chen Ping responded fluently, clarifying the duties of a chancellor. Realizing his abilities were far inferior to Chen Ping's, Zhou Bo soon resigned from his position as Chancellor of the Right, citing illness.

description.zh-cn: 樊哙是吕后之妹吕媭的丈夫。
description.en: Fan Kuai was the husband of Lü Xu, the younger sister of Empress Lü.

description.zh-cn: 吕后欲立吕氏族人为王，王陵引用高帝“白马之盟”明确表示反对。
description.en: When Empress Lü wanted to make members of the Lü clan kings, Wang Ling explicitly objected, citing Emperor Gaozu's 'Covenant of the White Horse'.

description.zh-cn: 新疆维吾尔自治区地震局是在中国地震局和新疆维吾尔自治区人民政府双重领导下，以中国地震局领导为主的事业单位。
description.en: The Xinjiang Earthquake Administration is a public institution under the dual leadership of the China Earthquake Administration and the People's Government of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, with the China Earthquake Administration taking the primary leadership role.

description.zh-cn: 新疆维吾尔自治区地震局是在中国地震局和新疆维吾尔自治区人民政府双重领导下的事业单位，并根据新疆维吾尔自治区人民政府授权，依法履行防震减灾主管机构的各项职责。
description.en: The Xinjiang Earthquake Administration is a public institution under the dual leadership of the China Earthquake Administration and the People's Government of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, and it performs the duties of the competent authority for earthquake prevention and disaster reduction in accordance with the law as authorized by the People's Government of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: “武装保卫苏联”运动是在中东路事件爆发后发起的。
description.en: The 'Armed Defense of the Soviet Union' movement was launched after the outbreak of the Sino-Soviet conflict of 1929.

description.zh-cn: 共产国际远东局明确要求中共中央提出“武装保卫苏联”的口号。
description.en: The Far Eastern Bureau of the Comintern explicitly demanded that the CCP Central Committee put forward the slogan 'Armed Defense of the Soviet Union'.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党响应共产国际的号召，发起了“武装保卫苏联”运动。
description.en: The Chinese Communist Party responded to the Comintern's call and initiated the 'Armed Defense of the Soviet Union' movement.

description.zh-cn: 共产国际派遣伍修权担任苏联红军翻译以参与中东路事件。
description.en: The Comintern dispatched Wu Xiuquan to serve as a translator for the Soviet Red Army to participate in the Sino-Soviet conflict.

description.zh-cn: 刘少奇于中东路事件期间担任中共满洲省委书记。
description.en: Liu Shaoqi served as the Secretary of the CCP Manchuria Provincial Committee during the Sino-Soviet conflict.

description.zh-cn: 中共满洲省委是中国共产党在东北地区的下级组织。
description.en: The CCP Manchuria Provincial Committee was a subordinate organization of the Chinese Communist Party in Northeast China.

description.zh-cn: 时任中共满洲省委书记的刘少奇发动了支持苏联的运动。
description.en: As Secretary of the CCP Manchuria Provincial Committee, Liu Shaoqi launched a movement in support of the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 刘少奇因在奉天煽动罢工嫌疑被捕，该事件中断了他在当地的活动。
description.en: Liu Shaoqi was arrested in Fengtian on suspicion of inciting a strike, which interrupted his activities in the area.

description.zh-cn: 陈独秀致信中共中央，批评“武装保卫苏联”的口号，认为对中共不利。
description.en: Chen Duxiu wrote to the CCP Central Committee, criticizing the slogan 'Armed Defense of the Soviet Union' as detrimental to the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 根据文本，柯建华是浙江玉环人，这通常表示其籍贯或出生地。
description.en: According to the text, Ke Jianhua is from Yuhuan, Zhejiang, which usually indicates her place of origin or birth.

description.zh-cn: 柯建华是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Ke Jianhua is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 柯建华的国籍为中华人民共和国。
description.en: Ke Jianhua's nationality is the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 2018年2月24日，柯建华当选为第十三届全国人民代表大会浙江地区代表。
description.en: On February 24, 2018, Ke Jianhua was elected as a delegate representing the Zhejiang region to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 薛志国是内蒙古敖汉旗人。
description.en: Xue Zhiguo is from Aohan Banner, Inner Mongolia.

description.zh-cn: 薛志国加入了中国共产党。
description.en: Xue Zhiguo joined the Communist Party of China.

position.zh-cn: 怀柔分公司望京经营部经理
position.en: Manager of Wangjing Business Department, Huairou Branch

description.zh-cn: 薛志国曾在北京市保安服务总公司工作，担任怀柔分公司望京经营部经理。
description.en: Xue Zhiguo worked at the Beijing Security Service General Company, serving as the manager of the Wangjing Business Department of the Huairou Branch.

description.zh-cn: 2013年，薛志国被选为第十二届全国人民代表大会内蒙古地区代表。
description.en: In 2013, Xue Zhiguo was elected as a delegate from the Inner Mongolia region to the 12th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 2018年2月24日，薛志国当选为第十三届全国人大代表。
description.en: On February 24, 2018, Xue Zhiguo was elected as a delegate to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国地震局发展研究中心是中国地震局的直属事业单位。
description.en: The Development Research Center of the China Earthquake Administration is a public institution directly under the China Earthquake Administration.

description.zh-cn: 该中心的办公地址位于北京市。
description.en: The office of this center is located in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 自1952年国家体委（国家体育总局前身）成立后，北京体育大学长期由其直接领导。
description.en: Since the establishment of the State Sports Commission (predecessor of the General Administration of Sport) in 1952, Beijing Sport University has been under its direct leadership for a long period.

description.zh-cn: 1952年，中华人民共和国教育部决定创办中央体育学院（北京体育大学前身）。
description.en: In 1952, the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China decided to establish the Central Institute of Physical Culture (predecessor of Beijing Sport University).

description.zh-cn: 1953年，中央体育学院（北京体育大学前身）以北京师范大学体育系为基础成立。
description.en: In 1953, the Central Institute of Physical Culture (predecessor of Beijing Sport University) was established based on the Department of Physical Education of Beijing Normal University.

description.zh-cn: 1979年起，北京体育大学隶属教育部和国家体委双重领导，以国家体委为主。
description.en: Since 1979, Beijing Sport University has been under the dual leadership of the Ministry of Education and the State Sports Commission, with the latter being the primary authority.

description.zh-cn: 1972年至1979年间，北京体育学院归国家体委和北京市双重领导。
description.en: Between 1972 and 1979, Beijing Institute of Physical Education was under the dual leadership of the State Sports Commission and the Beijing Municipality.

description.zh-cn: 北京体育大学的党的关系隶属中共北京市委。
description.en: The party organization of Beijing Sport University is affiliated with the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东《体育之研究》中的“文明其精神，野蛮其体魄”一句被用作北京体育大学的校训精神。
description.en: The phrase 'Civilize the mind, and make savage the body' from Mao Zedong's 'A Study of Physical Education' is used as the spirit of Beijing Sport University's motto.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东撰写《体育之研究》并发表于《新青年》杂志。
description.en: Mao Zedong wrote 'A Study of Physical Education' and had it published in the 'New Youth' magazine.

description.zh-cn: 习近平给北京体育大学2016级研究生冠军班全体学生回信，对他们提出勉励和期望。
description.en: Xi Jinping sent a reply letter to all students of the 2016 graduate champion class at Beijing Sport University, offering them encouragement and expectations.

description.zh-cn: 北京体育大学与德国科隆体育大学建立了友好校际关系。
description.en: Beijing Sport University has established a friendly inter-university relationship with German Sport University Cologne.

description.zh-cn: 北京体育大学与英国拉夫堡大学是友好院校。
description.en: Beijing Sport University and Loughborough University in the UK are friendly institutions.

description.zh-cn: 袁汝稳是广东东莞人。
description.en: Yuan Ruwen was from Dongguan, Guangdong.

description.zh-cn: 1969年9月毕业于华南农学院农学系农学专业。
description.en: Graduated from the Department of Agronomy, Agronomy Major, at South China Agricultural College in September 1969.

description.zh-cn: 1995年5月，担任深圳市人民政府副市长。
description.en: In May 1995, he served as the Deputy Mayor of the Shenzhen Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 1999年4月，改任福建省厦门市人民政府副市长。
description.en: In April 1999, he was reassigned as the Deputy Mayor of the Xiamen Municipal People's Government, Fujian Province.

description.zh-cn: 2000年6月，任深圳市人大常委会副主任。
description.en: In June 2000, he served as the Deputy Director of the Standing Committee of the Shenzhen Municipal People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，袁汝稳是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to Wikipedia categories, Yuan Ruwen was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 范石生在云南优级师范学堂学习期间加入了中国同盟会。
description.en: Fan Shisheng joined the Tongmenghui while studying at the Yunnan Superior Normal School.

description.zh-cn: 李鸿祥为范石生的世交。
description.en: Li Hongxiang was a family friend of Fan Shisheng.

description.zh-cn: 范石生于1909年考入云南陆军讲武堂丙班，1911年毕业。
description.en: Fan Shisheng was admitted to Class C of the Yunnan Military Academy in 1909 and graduated in 1911.

description.zh-cn: 在云南陆军讲武堂期间结拜为兄弟。
description.en: Became sworn brothers during their time at the Yunnan Military Academy.

description.zh-cn: 参与策划并执行了1911年10月30日的昆明重九起义，护送总司令蔡锷前往起义指挥部。
description.en: Participated in the planning and execution of the Kunming Double Ninth Uprising on October 30, 1911, and escorted Commander-in-Chief Cai E to the uprising headquarters.

description.zh-cn: 被推举为起义军总司令，领导了昆明重九起义。
description.en: Was elected as the Commander-in-Chief of the uprising army and led the Kunming Double Ninth Uprising.

position.zh-cn: 上尉连长、营长、师参谋长
position.en: Captain Company Commander, Battalion Commander, Division Chief of Staff

description.zh-cn: 范石生曾在顾品珍部任职，后因作战方案异议被免职。
description.en: Fan Shisheng served in Gu Pinzhen's unit and was later dismissed due to disagreements over operational plans.

description.zh-cn: 因对作战方案提出异议，顾品珍免去了范石生的职务并将其驱逐出滇军。
description.en: Due to Fan Shisheng's disagreement over operational plans, Gu Pinzhen dismissed him and expelled him from the Yunnan Army.

description.zh-cn: 范石生后与杨蓁等人密谋倒唐，并参与了“援桂讨唐”军事行动。
description.en: Fan Shisheng later conspired with Yang Zhen and others to overthrow Tang Jiyao and participated in the 'Aid Guangxi, Punish Tang' military campaign.

description.zh-cn: 唐继尧率部返回云南，内外夹击将顾品珍打死于天生关鹅毛寨，重新控制云南。
description.en: Tang Jiyao led his troops back to Yunnan, launched a pincer attack, and killed Gu Pinzhen at Goose Feather Village, Tianshengguan, regaining control of Yunnan.

description.zh-cn: 在孙中山号召下，范石生主张并参与了讨伐陈炯明的军事行动，并于1923年底在前线击退陈炯明部。
description.en: Under Sun Yat-sen's call, Fan Shisheng advocated for and participated in the military campaign against Chen Jiongming, and defeated Chen's forces on the front line at the end of 1923.

description.zh-cn: 因范石生在击退陈炯明部时立下战功，孙中山为其题字“功在国家”，赠与军刀，并授予上将军衔。
description.en: In recognition of Fan Shisheng's military achievements in repelling Chen Jiongming's forces, Sun Yat-sen wrote the inscription 'Merit in Service to the Nation' for him, presented him with a military sword, and conferred upon him the rank of General.

description.zh-cn: 1926年北伐前夕，范石生的部队被改编为国民革命军第十六军，范石生任军长。
description.en: On the eve of the Northern Expedition in 1926, Fan Shisheng's troops were reorganized into the 16th Army of the National Revolutionary Army, with Fan as its commander.

description.zh-cn: 应范石生要求，周恩来派遣多名共产党员进入第十六军，成立了中国共产党的组织并组建了政治部。
description.en: At Fan Shisheng's request, Zhou Enlai sent several Communist Party members to the 16th Army to establish a CPC organization and form a political department.

description.zh-cn: 范石生抵制国民党的清党运动，使其军队中的中国共产党组织得以保全。
description.en: Fan Shisheng resisted the Kuomintang's party purge, allowing the Communist Party organization within his army to remain intact.

description.zh-cn: 蒋中正发现朱德化名藏身于范石生军中，下令范石生将其逮捕并处决。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek discovered that Zhu De was hiding in Fan Shisheng's army under an alias and ordered Fan to arrest and execute him.

description.zh-cn: 范石生违抗蒋中正的命令，秘密通知朱德离开，并赠送了数万元经费、军需装备以及一个营的兵力。
description.en: Fan Shisheng defied Chiang Kai-shek's order, secretly informed Zhu De to leave, and provided him with tens of thousands of yuan in funds, military supplies, and a battalion of troops.

description.zh-cn: 通过庇护并资助朱德及其部队，范石生为朱毛井冈山会师保存了关键的革命力量。
description.en: By protecting and financing Zhu De and his troops, Fan Shisheng preserved a key revolutionary force for the historic meeting of Zhu De and Mao Zedong in the Jinggang Mountains.

description.zh-cn: 奉蒋中正之命围剿贺龙、周逸群的中国工农红军时，仅派队尾随，不与接触，消极应付命令。
description.en: When ordered by Chiang Kai-shek to suppress the Chinese Red Army led by He Long and Zhou Yiqun, he only sent troops to follow without engaging, passively carrying out the order.

description.zh-cn: 陈明通于2002年加入民主进步党。
description.en: Chen Ming-tong joined the Democratic Progressive Party in 2002.

degree.zh-cn: 政治学系学士、政治学研究所硕士、政治学研究所博士
degree.en: Bachelor of Arts in Political Science, Master of Arts in Political Science, Doctor of Philosophy in Political Science

description.zh-cn: 陈明通于1979年获得国立台湾大学政治学学士学位，1981年获得硕士学位，1990年获得博士学位。
description.en: Chen Ming-tong received his bachelor's degree in political science from National Taiwan University in 1979, his master's degree in 1981, and his doctorate in 1990.
Chen Ming-tong served as Deputy Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council (2000-2004) and twice as Minister (2007-2008, 2018-2021).

description.zh-cn: 陈明通于2021年2月23日至2023年1月30日担任国家安全局局长。
description.en: Chen Ming-tong served as Director-General of the National Security Bureau from February 23, 2021, to January 30, 2023.

description.zh-cn: 陈明通曾担任任务型国民大会代表。
description.en: Chen Ming-tong served as a delegate to the ad hoc National Assembly.

description.zh-cn: 陈明通在担任陆委会副主委期间，蔡英文是其主委。在他担任陆委会主委及国安局局长期间，蔡英文是总统。
description.en: When Chen Ming-tong was Deputy Minister of the MAC, Tsai Ing-wen was the Minister. When he served as Minister of the MAC and Director-General of the NSB, Tsai Ing-wen was the President.

description.zh-cn: 在陈明通首次担任陆委会主委期间，陈水扁是时任总统。
description.en: During Chen Ming-tong's first term as Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council, Chen Shui-bian was the serving President.

description.zh-cn: 陈明通发表“人如果只求温饱，和猪狗禽兽有什么差别？”的言论，被认为是在影射和暗讽时任高雄市长韩国瑜注重经济的政策，引发争议并最终道歉。
description.en: Chen Ming-tong made a controversial remark, "If a person only seeks to be fed and clothed, what is the difference between them and pigs, dogs, or beasts?" which was seen as an allusion to then-Kaohsiung Mayor Han Kuo-yu's focus on economic policies, leading to a public apology.

description.zh-cn: 林智坚是陈明通在国立台湾大学国家发展研究所指导的硕士生。
description.en: Lin Chih-chien was a master's student supervised by Chen Ming-tong at the Graduate Institute of Development Studies, National Taiwan University.

description.zh-cn: 郑文灿是陈明通在国立台湾大学国家发展研究所指导的硕士生。
description.en: Cheng Wen-tsan was a master's student supervised by Chen Ming-tong at the Graduate Institute of Development Studies, National Taiwan University.

description.zh-cn: 林智坚论文抄袭案的爆发，使作为指导教授的陈明通被指控违反学术伦理，并遭到调查，其学术声誉受损，并于次年不再于台大兼课。
description.en: The outbreak of the Lin Chih-chien plagiarism scandal led to accusations that Chen Ming-tong, as the supervising professor, violated academic ethics. This resulted in an investigation, damaged his academic reputation, and he subsequently stopped teaching part-time at National Taiwan University.

description.zh-cn: 王鸿薇向教育部检举陈明通涉嫌学术诈欺。
description.en: Wang Hung-wei reported Chen Ming-tong to the Ministry of Education for alleged academic fraud.

description.zh-cn: 于1927年加入中国共产党。
description.en: Joined the Communist Party of China in 1927.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间受到迫害。
description.en: Was persecuted during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框，九三学社黑龙江省委员会的上级机构是九三学社中央委员会。
description.en: According to the infobox, the superior organization of the Jiusan Society Heilongjiang Provincial Committee is the Jiusan Society Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 九三学社黑龙江省委员会作为九三学社的地方组织，属于中国的民主党派。
description.en: As a local organization of the Jiusan Society, the Jiusan Society Heilongjiang Provincial Committee belongs to China's democratic parties.

description.zh-cn: 九三学社黑龙江省委员会是九三学社在黑龙江省设立的地方组织，其活动范围主要在黑龙江省。
description.en: The Jiusan Society Heilongjiang Provincial Committee is the local organization of the Jiusan Society established in Heilongjiang Province, and its activities are primarily within Heilongjiang Province.

description.zh-cn: 伯笃鲁丁在元朝担任政治人物，官至礼部侍郎、达鲁花赤等。
description.en: Bo Dulu Ding served as a political figure in the Yuan dynasty, holding positions such as Vice Minister of Rites and Darughachi.

description.zh-cn: 其姓氏“答失蛮氏”是元代对伊斯兰教士的称呼，表明其伊斯兰教背景。
description.en: His family name 'Dashiman' was the Yuan dynasty's term for Islamic clerics, indicating his Islamic background.

description.zh-cn: 伯笃鲁丁在元英宗至治元年（1321年）考中进士，开启其仕途。
description.en: Bo Dulu Ding passed the imperial examination in the first year of the Zhizhi era of Emperor Yingzong of Yuan (1321), which started his official career.

description.zh-cn: 在元惠宗时期担任礼部侍郎、秘书太监等职务。
description.en: He served in positions such as Vice Minister of Rites and Secretary-Eunuch during the reign of Emperor Huizong of Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 元惠宗至元元年（1335年）由礼部侍郎迁秘书太监。
description.en: In the first year of the Zhiyuan era of Emperor Huizong of Yuan (1335), he was transferred from Vice Minister of Rites to Secretary-Eunuch.

position.zh-cn: 赣州路达鲁花赤、建德路达鲁花赤
position.en: Darughachi of Ganzhou Circuit, Darughachi of Jiande Circuit

description.zh-cn: 历任赣州路达鲁花赤、建德路达鲁花赤。
description.en: He successively served as Darughachi of Ganzhou Circuit and Jiande Circuit.

description.zh-cn: 教育家陶行知于1939年3月在重庆创办了育才学校。
description.en: Educator Tao Xingzhi founded Yucai School in Chongqing in March 1939.

description.zh-cn: 陶行知亲自担任育才学校首任校长。
description.en: Tao Xingzhi personally served as the first principal of Yucai School.

description.zh-cn: 陶行知创办育才学校的计划得到了吴玉章的支持。
description.en: Tao Xingzhi's plan to found Yucai School received support from Wu Yuzhang.

description.zh-cn: 学校的创办得到了中共中央南方局的重视和支持。
description.en: The founding of the school received attention and support from the Southern Bureau of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 周恩来曾亲自到育才学校看望全校师生，并题词支持。
description.en: Zhou Enlai personally visited Yucai School to see the teachers and students and wrote an inscription in support.

description.zh-cn: 于1943年参观育才学校，并给予了正面评价。
description.en: Visited Yucai School in 1943 and gave a positive evaluation.

description.zh-cn: 于1943年参观育才学校，并给予了正面评价。
description.en: Visited Yucai School in 1943 and gave a positive evaluation.

description.zh-cn: 在育才学校执教，担任音乐组组长。
description.en: Taught at Yucai School as the head of the Music Group.

description.zh-cn: 在育才学校执教，担任文学组组长。
description.en: Taught at Yucai School as the head of the Literature Group.

description.zh-cn: 在育才学校执教，担任绘画组组长。
description.en: Taught at Yucai School as the head of the Painting Group.

description.zh-cn: 在育才学校执教，担任舞蹈组组长。
description.en: Taught at Yucai School as the head of the Dance Group.

description.zh-cn: 曾在育才学校讲学。
description.en: Lectured at Yucai School.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，学校校舍遭到严重破坏。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, the school's buildings were severely damaged.

description.zh-cn: 在文革武斗期间，学校校舍遭到严重破坏，众多学生参加武斗并导致伤亡。
description.en: During the violent struggles of the Cultural Revolution, the school's buildings were severely damaged, and many students participated in the fighting, resulting in casualties.

description.zh-cn: 重庆育才中学是重庆市教委直属重点中学。
description.en: Chongqing Yucai Secondary School is a key secondary school directly under the Chongqing Municipal Education Commission.

description.zh-cn: 李鹏是育才学校的知名校友。
description.en: Li Peng is a notable alumnus of Yucai School.

position.zh-cn: 分部主任（主持学校工作）
position.en: Branch Director (in charge of school affairs)

description.zh-cn: 以分部主任身份主持重庆育才学校工作。
description.en: Presided over the work of Chongqing Yucai School as Branch Director.

description.zh-cn: 自2022年8月起担任重庆市育才中学校校长。
description.en: Has been serving as the principal of Chongqing Yucai Secondary School since August 2022.

description.zh-cn: 在陶行知的构思下，设计出育才学校第一代校徽。
description.en: Under the conception of Tao Xingzhi, designed the first emblem of Yucai School.

description.zh-cn: 张正德是安徽寿县人。
description.en: Zhang Zhengde was a native of Shou County, Anhui.

description.zh-cn: 张正德曾入学延安中央党校。
description.en: Zhang Zhengde studied at the Central Party School in Yan'an.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次国共内战期间，张正德担任了热河省乌丹县县长、热河省民政厅厅长等职务。
description.en: During the Second Chinese Civil War, Zhang Zhengde served as the county mayor of Wudan County and director of the Civil Affairs Department in Rehe Province.

description.zh-cn: 张正德曾任辽宁省人民委员会副省长。
description.en: Zhang Zhengde served as Vice Governor of the Liaoning Provincial People's Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1979年，张正德升任中共辽宁省委书记。
description.en: In 1979, Zhang Zhengde was promoted to Secretary of the CPC Liaoning Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1983年，张正德当选辽宁省人大常委会主任。
description.en: In 1983, Zhang Zhengde was elected Director of the Standing Committee of the Liaoning Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 张正德是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Zhang Zhengde was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 张正德是第五届、第六届全国人大代表。
description.en: Zhang Zhengde was a deputy to the 5th and 6th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 张正德曾担任中华诗词学会第一届理事会成员及顾问。
description.en: Zhang Zhengde served as a member of the first council and a consultant for the Chinese Poetry Society.

description.zh-cn: 方岱宁出生于江西南昌。
description.en: Fang Daining was born in Nanchang, Jiangxi.

description.zh-cn: 方岱宁于1982年和1986年分别获得南京工业大学的学士和硕士学位。
description.en: Fang Daining obtained his bachelor's and master's degrees from Nanjing Tech University in 1982 and 1986, respectively.

description.zh-cn: 方岱宁于1989至1993年在以色列理工学院航空航天系学习，并获得博士学位。
description.en: Fang Daining studied at the Department of Aerospace Engineering at the Technion – Israel Institute of Technology from 1989 to 1993 and obtained his PhD.

description.zh-cn: 方岱宁于1993至1994年在以色列特拉维夫大学力学与材料结构系从事博士后研究。
description.en: Fang Daining was a postdoctoral fellow at the Department of Mechanics, Materials, and Structures at Tel Aviv University from 1993 to 1994.

description.zh-cn: 方岱宁于1994至1995年在美国马里兰大学机械工程系担任研究助理。
description.en: Fang Daining worked as a research assistant at the Department of Mechanical Engineering at the University of Maryland from 1994 to 1995.

description.zh-cn: 方岱宁于1995至2009年在清华大学工程力学系任职，先后担任副教授、教授。
description.en: Fang Daining worked at the Department of Engineering Mechanics at Tsinghua University from 1995 to 2009, serving as an associate professor and then professor.

position.zh-cn: 讲席教授、工学院副院长
position.en: Chair Professor, Vice Dean of the College of Engineering

description.zh-cn: 方岱宁于2009至2015年在北京大学任职，担任讲席教授和工学院副院长。
description.en: Fang Daining worked at Peking University from 2009 to 2015, serving as a Chair Professor and Vice Dean of the College of Engineering.

description.zh-cn: 因“亲吻门”事件，中国科学院于2022年12月7日决定暂停方岱宁参加院士会议等学部组织的学术活动、推荐和选举院士以及外籍院士、选举和被选举成为学部常设领导机构成员的权利。
description.en: Due to the 'Kissing Gate' incident, the Chinese Academy of Sciences decided on December 7, 2022, to suspend Fang Daining's rights to participate in academic activities organized by the academy such as academician conferences, to recommend and elect academicians and foreign academicians, and to elect and be elected as a member of the standing leadership of the academic divisions.

description.zh-cn: 1914年以第一名的成绩毕业。
description.en: Graduated first in his class in 1914.

description.zh-cn: 1914年以第一名的成绩被录取，1921年以第一名毕业。
description.en: Admitted as the top student in 1914 and graduated first in his class in 1921.

description.zh-cn: 授予张孝骞医学博士学位。
description.en: Awarded Zhang Xiaoqian a Doctor of Medicine degree.

position.zh-cn: 曾任内科医师，后任院长

description.zh-cn: 毕业后留校专攻内科；后回长沙接任湘雅医学院院长职务，并领导学院在战争期间迁校。
description.en: After graduation, he stayed at the school to specialize in internal medicine; later, he returned to Changsha to assume the presidency of Xiangya Medical College and led the college's relocation during the war.

description.zh-cn: 到北京协和医学院深造1年。
description.en: Went to Peking Union Medical College for one year of advanced study.

position.zh-cn: 住院医师、总住院医师、副教授、内科消化专业组主管；内科学教授、内科主任、副校长
position.en: Resident, Chief Resident, Associate Professor, Head of the Gastroenterology Division of Internal Medicine; Professor of Internal Medicine, Head of Internal Medicine, Vice President

description.zh-cn: 在协和医学院陆续担任多个职务。
description.en: Held various positions successively at Peking Union Medical College.

description.zh-cn: 被选送到约翰斯·霍普金斯大学进行研究。
description.en: Was selected to go to Johns Hopkins University for research.

description.zh-cn: 邀请张孝骞赴美国考察医学教育和讲学。
description.en: Invited Zhang Xiaoqian to the United States for a tour to inspect medical education and give lectures.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，张孝骞被打成“反动学术权威”、“特务”，备受侮辱和折磨。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Zhang Xiaoqian was labeled a 'reactionary academic authority' and 'spy', and was subjected to humiliation and torture.

description.zh-cn: 亲自过问张孝骞在文革中的处境，并为其安排住所。
description.en: Personally intervened regarding Zhang Xiaoqian's situation during the Cultural Revolution and arranged housing for him.

description.zh-cn: 梁振英在该次选举中获得689票，成功当选为第四任香港特别行政区行政长官。
description.en: Leung Chun-ying won the election with 689 votes, successfully becoming the fourth Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

description.zh-cn: 唐英年在该次选举中获得285票，未能当选。
description.en: Henry Tang received 285 votes in the election and was not elected.

description.zh-cn: 何俊仁在该次选举中获得76票，未能当选。
description.en: Albert Ho received 76 votes in the election and was not elected.

description.zh-cn: 两人在2012年香港行政长官选举中是主要竞争对手，选战过程激烈。
description.en: The two were major rivals in the 2012 Hong Kong Chief Executive election, which was a fierce contest.

position.zh-cn: 香港特别行政区第四任行政长官
position.en: The fourth-term Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

description.zh-cn: 国务院召开全体会议，任命梁振英为香港特别行政区第四任行政长官。
description.en: The State Council held a plenary session and appointed Leung Chun-ying as the fourth-term Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

description.zh-cn: 时任中共中央总书记、国家主席胡锦涛为梁振英及香港第四届政府主要官员监誓。
description.en: Then-General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee and President of the PRC, Hu Jintao, administered the oath of office for Leung Chun-ying and the principal officials of the fourth-term Hong Kong government.

description.zh-cn: 梁振英竞选团队成员与江湖人物的饭局被曝光，引发了对其“黑金政治”的负面批评。
description.en: A dinner meeting between members of Leung Chun-ying's campaign team and a triad figure was exposed, leading to negative criticism of him regarding "black-gold politics".

description.zh-cn: 唐英年被揭发其住宅存在大型僭建，引发诚信危机，严重打击其选情。
description.en: It was revealed that Henry Tang's residence had a large illegal structure, triggering a crisis of integrity that severely damaged his election campaign.

description.zh-cn: 唐英年的僭建丑闻使其民望大跌，客观上为竞争对手梁振英创造了更有利的选举形势。
description.en: Henry Tang's illegal structure scandal caused his popularity to plummet, objectively creating a more favorable election situation for his rival, Leung Chun-ying.

description.zh-cn: 叶刘淑仪曾公开狠批唐英年从政多年“毫无建树”。
description.en: Regina Ip once publicly and harshly criticized Henry Tang for having "achieved nothing" after many years in politics.

description.zh-cn: 叶刘淑仪曾不点名批评梁振英无管治经验，由他治港风险极高。
description.en: Regina Ip once implicitly criticized Leung Chun-ying for lacking governance experience, stating that it would be extremely risky for him to govern Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 盛传唐英年早获前中共中央总书记江泽民钦点为2012年的新一届特首。
description.en: It was widely rumored that Henry Tang had been handpicked by former CCP General Secretary Jiang Zemin to be the new Chief Executive in 2012.

description.zh-cn: 作为选举委员会委员，李嘉诚提名唐英年参选行政长官。
description.en: As a member of the Election Committee, Li Ka-shing nominated Henry Tang for the Chief Executive election.

description.zh-cn: 自由党宣布党内29名选委一致支持唐英年参选特首。
description.en: The Liberal Party announced that its 29 members on the Election Committee would unanimously support Henry Tang's candidacy for Chief Executive.

description.zh-cn: 泛民主派提出的“2012年双普选”建议最终没有被中央政府接纳。
description.en: The "dual universal suffrage in 2012" proposal put forward by the pan-democrats was ultimately not accepted by the Central Government.

description.zh-cn: 在梁振英就职当日，民间人权阵线主办的七一大游行，主要诉求之一为要求梁振英下台。
description.en: On the day of Leung Chun-ying's inauguration, one of the main demands of the July 1st protest organized by the Civil Human Rights Front was for his resignation.

description.zh-cn: 时任国家副主席习近平在会见港澳政协委员时，先与梁振英阵营的委员刘梦熊握手，此举被外界解读为中央政府对梁振英的支持。
description.en: Then-Vice President Xi Jinping's handshake with Lew Mon-hung, a member of Leung Chun-ying's camp, during a meeting with Hong Kong and Macau CPPCC members was interpreted by outsiders as a sign of the central government's support for Leung.

description.zh-cn: 选举委员会是负责选出香港特别行政区行政长官的机构，其成员投票决定了选举结果。
description.en: The Election Committee is the body responsible for electing the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong SAR, and its members' votes determined the outcome of the election.

description.zh-cn: 2007年的选举是2012年选举的前一届，为后者提供了政治背景和连续性。
description.en: The 2007 election was the immediate predecessor to the 2012 election, providing political context and continuity.

description.zh-cn: 2012年的选举结果和过程影响了香港的政治生态，并为2017年的选举提供了背景。
description.en: The outcome and process of the 2012 election influenced Hong Kong's political landscape and provided the context for the 2017 election.

description.zh-cn: 梁振英在2012年选举中获胜，成为第四任香港特别行政区行政长官。
description.en: Leung Chun-ying won the 2012 election to become the fourth Chief Executive of the Hong Kong SAR.

description.zh-cn: 汤川秀树于1907年出生于东京市麻布区市兵卫町。
description.en: Hideki Yukawa was born in Ichibeicho, Azabu-ku, Tokyo City in 1907.

description.zh-cn: 汤川秀树与朝永振一郎是京都一中、三高、京都帝国大学的同期生。
description.en: Hideki Yukawa and Sin-Itiro Tomonaga were contemporaries at Kyoto First Middle School, the Third High School, and Kyoto Imperial University.

description.zh-cn: 1929年，汤川秀树从京都帝国大学理学部物理学科毕业。
description.en: In 1929, Hideki Yukawa graduated from the Department of Physics, Faculty of Science, Kyoto Imperial University.

description.zh-cn: 汤川秀树于1929年任京都帝国大学助手，1932年任讲师，1939年任教授。
description.en: Hideki Yukawa became an assistant at Kyoto Imperial University in 1929, a lecturer in 1932, and a professor in 1939.

description.zh-cn: 在八木秀次的帮助下，汤川秀树于1933年开始兼任大阪帝国大学讲师。
description.en: With the help of Hidetsugu Yagi, Hideki Yukawa began serving as a lecturer at Osaka Imperial University in 1933.

description.zh-cn: 汤川秀树于1933年兼任大阪帝国大学讲师，1936年升任助理教授。
description.en: Hideki Yukawa served as a lecturer at Osaka Imperial University starting in 1933 and was promoted to assistant professor in 1936.

description.zh-cn: 1938年，汤川秀树因其对基本粒子相互作用的研究获得大阪帝国大学理学博士学位。
description.en: In 1938, Hideki Yukawa was awarded a Doctor of Science degree from Osaka Imperial University for his research on the interaction of elementary particles.

description.zh-cn: 汤川秀树于1949年担任哥伦比亚大学客席教授。
description.en: Hideki Yukawa served as a visiting professor at Columbia University in 1949.

description.zh-cn: 汤川秀树于1953年担任京都大学基础物理学研究所首任所长。
description.en: In 1953, Hideki Yukawa became the first director of the Yukawa Institute for Theoretical Physics at Kyoto University.

description.zh-cn: 1955年，汤川秀树签署了《罗素—爱因斯坦宣言》。
description.en: In 1955, Hideki Yukawa signed the Russell–Einstein Manifesto.

description.zh-cn: 汤川秀树于1963年当选为伦敦皇家学会外籍会士。
description.en: Hideki Yukawa was elected a Foreign Member of the Royal Society of London in 1963.

description.zh-cn: 仁科芳雄是汤川秀树的博士导师。
description.en: Yoshio Nishina was Hideki Yukawa's doctoral advisor.

description.zh-cn: 林忠四郎是汤川秀树的博士生。
description.en: Chushiro Hayashi was a doctoral student of Hideki Yukawa.

description.zh-cn: 坂田昌一是汤川秀树的博士生。
description.en: Shoichi Sakata was a doctoral student of Hideki Yukawa.

description.zh-cn: 小川环树是汤川秀树的弟弟。
description.en: Tamaki Ogawa was Hideki Yukawa's younger brother.

description.zh-cn: 高莉出生于安徽濉溪。
description.en: Gao Li was born in Suixi, Anhui.

description.zh-cn: 高莉毕业于安徽师范大学中文专业。
description.en: Gao Li graduated from Anhui Normal University with a major in Chinese Language.

description.zh-cn: 高莉是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Gao Li is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 高莉于2013年当选第十二届全国人大代表，于2018年1月当选第十三届全国人大代表。
description.en: Gao Li was elected as a delegate to the 12th National People's Congress in 2013, and as a delegate to the 13th National People's Congress in January 2018.

description.zh-cn: 郑海荣是安徽长丰人。
description.en: Zheng Hairong is a native of Changfeng, Anhui.

position.en: Member of the Standing Committee of the Party Committee, Vice President

description.zh-cn: 郑海荣担任南京大学党委常委、副校长。
description.en: Zheng Hairong serves as a member of the Standing Committee of the Party Committee and Vice President of Nanjing University.

description.zh-cn: 郑海荣是中国科学院院士。
description.en: Zheng Hairong is an academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，郑海荣是哈尔滨工业大学的校友。
description.en: According to Wikipedia categories, Zheng Hairong is an alumnus of Harbin Institute of Technology.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，郑海荣是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to Wikipedia categories, Zheng Hairong is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，郑海荣是中国电子学会会士。
description.en: According to Wikipedia categories, Zheng Hairong is a fellow of the Chinese Institute of Electronics.

description.zh-cn: 河南省妇女联合会是中华全国妇女联合会的地方组织。
description.en: The Henan Women's Federation is a local organization of the All-China Women's Federation.

description.zh-cn: 河南省妇女联合会接受中国共产党河南省委员会的领导。
description.en: The Henan Women's Federation is under the leadership of the Henan Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 河南省妇女联合会是中华人民共和国河南省妇女儿童工作者组成的人民团体。
description.en: The Henan Women's Federation is a people's organization composed of women and children workers in Henan Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 赵守钰是刘仲容的前岳父。
description.en: Zhao Shouyu was Liu Zhongrong's former father-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 1933年经赵守钰介绍，刘仲容与刘仲华相识并开始参加革命工作。
description.en: In 1933, through Zhao Shouyu's introduction, Liu Zhongrong met Liu Zhonghua and began to participate in revolutionary work.

description.zh-cn: 青海马家军俘虏了红军西路军。
description.en: The Ma clique in Qinghai captured the Red Army's West Route Army.

description.zh-cn: 刘秉琳随晋冀鲁豫野战军（刘邓大军）参与了千里跃进大别山行动。
description.en: Liu Binglin participated in the Thousand-li leap to the Dabie Mountains with the Shanxi-Hebei-Shandong-Henan Field Army (Liu-Deng Army).

description.zh-cn: 李小新自2022年4月起担任中央机构编制委员会办公室主任。
description.en: Li Xiaoxin has been serving as the Director of the Office of the Central Institutional Organization Commission since April 2022.

description.zh-cn: 李小新兼任中国共产党中央委员会组织部副部长。
description.en: Li Xiaoxin concurrently serves as a Deputy Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中央机构编制委员会办公室是中央机构编制委员会的常设办事机构。
description.en: The Office of the Central Institutional Organization Commission is the permanent working body of the Central Institutional Organization Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中央机构编制委员会办公室列入中共中央直属机构序列，是中共中央办事机构。
description.en: The Office of the Central Institutional Organization Commission is listed in the sequence of institutions directly under the CPC Central Committee and is a working body of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中央机构编制委员会办公室同时也是国务院的机构，是国务院机构编制管理机关。
description.en: The Office of the Central Institutional Organization Commission is also an institution of the State Council, serving as its institutional organization management organ.

description.zh-cn: 2018年的《深化党和国家机构改革方案》决定将中央机构编制委员会办公室归口中共中央组织部管理。
description.en: The 2018 'Plan for Deepening the Reform of Party and State Institutions' stipulated that the Office of the Central Institutional Organization Commission would be managed by the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1988年组建国家机构编制委员会办公室，由人事部下属的中央机构编制司、地方机构编制司承担其工作。
description.en: In 1988, the Office of the National Commission for Institutional Organization was established, with its work undertaken by the Central Institutional Organization Department and the Local Institutional Organization Department of the Ministry of Personnel.

description.zh-cn: 根据Wikitext记载，李淦是山东济宁人。
description.en: According to the Wikitext, Li Gan was from Jining, Shandong.

description.zh-cn: 李淦曾任中华全国音乐工作者协会候补委员。
description.en: Li Gan served as an alternate member of the All-China Music Workers Association.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类，李淦是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to the page category, Li Gan was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 导航模板的上下文表明，中华全国音乐工作者协会是中国音乐家协会的前身。
description.en: The context of the navigation template indicates that the All-China Music Workers Association is the predecessor of the Chinese Musicians' Association.

description.zh-cn: 1928年，国民政府将绥远特别区改制为绥远省。
description.en: In 1928, the Nationalist Government reorganized the Suiyuan Special Administrative Region into Suiyuan Province.

description.zh-cn: 项昌乐是安徽霍山人。
description.en: Xiang Changle is a native of Huoshan, Anhui.

description.zh-cn: 项昌乐于1983年12月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Xiang Changle joined the Communist Party of China in December 1983.

description.zh-cn: 项昌乐于1984年获得北京理工大学工学学士学位，后于2001年获得该校工学博士学位。
description.en: Xiang Changle received his Bachelor of Engineering degree from Beijing Institute of Technology in 1984, and subsequently his Doctor of Engineering degree from the same university in 2001.

description.zh-cn: 项昌乐接替王寒松担任中国共产党大连理工大学委员会书记职务。
description.en: Xiang Changle succeeded Wang Hansong as the Secretary of the Dalian University of Technology Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 赵祥娃是陕西扶风人。
description.en: Zhao Xiangwa is a native of Fufeng, Shaanxi.

description.zh-cn: 赵祥娃曾任新疆维吾尔自治区高级人民法院党组书记、副院长。
description.en: Zhao Xiangwa served as the Party Secretary and Vice President of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region High People's Court.

position.en: Grand Justice of the second rank

description.zh-cn: 赵祥娃是中华人民共和国的二级大法官。
description.en: Zhao Xiangwa is a Grand Justice of the second rank of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类信息，赵祥娃是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to category information, Zhao Xiangwa is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类信息，赵祥娃曾任新疆维吾尔自治区司法厅副厅长。
description.en: According to category information, Zhao Xiangwa served as the Vice Director of the Department of Justice of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 安徽人民广播电台于1952年6月1日开播后，淮南人民广播电台于1953年6月19日奉命停播。
description.en: After Anhui People's Radio Station began broadcasting on June 1, 1952, Huainan People's Radio Station was ordered to cease broadcasting on June 19, 1953.

description.zh-cn: 决定于1964年7月28日关闭淮南人民广播电台。
description.en: Decided to close Huainan People's Radio Station on July 28, 1964.

description.zh-cn: 与丁取忠等人合著多部数学著作。
description.en: Co-authored several mathematical works with Ding Quzhong and others.

description.zh-cn: 与左潜等人合著多部数学著作。
description.en: Co-authored several mathematical works with Zuo Qian and others.

description.zh-cn: 与吴嘉善等人合著多部数学著作。
description.en: Co-authored several mathematical works with Wu Jiashan and others.

description.zh-cn: 与李善兰等人合著多部数学著作。
description.en: Co-authored several mathematical works with Li Shanlan and others.

description.zh-cn: 郭沛霖与曾国藩是同年进士。
description.en: Guo Peilin and Zeng Guofan passed the imperial examination in the same year.

description.zh-cn: 郭沛霖被太平军杀害。
description.en: Guo Peilin was killed by the Taiping army.

description.zh-cn: 曾广钧是曾纪鸿的长子。
description.en: Zeng Guangjun was the eldest son of Zeng Jihong.

description.zh-cn: 曾纪鸿是曾纪泽的弟弟。
description.en: Zeng Jihong was the younger brother of Zeng Jize.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛乔是诸葛恪的弟弟。
description.en: Zhuge Qiao was the younger brother of Zhuge Ke.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛乔是诸葛融的哥哥。
description.en: Zhuge Qiao was the elder brother of Zhuge Rong.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛瑾是诸葛亮的哥哥。
description.en: Zhuge Jin was the elder brother of Zhuge Liang.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛瑾在同意将儿子诸葛乔过继给诸葛亮前，先禀告了东吴君主孙权。
description.en: Before agreeing to let his son Zhuge Qiao be adopted by Zhuge Liang, Zhuge Jin reported the matter to his lord, Sun Quan of Eastern Wu.

position.en: Fuma Duwei (Commander of the Imperial Son-in-law's Cavalry)

description.zh-cn: 诸葛乔来到蜀汉后，被任命为驸马都尉。
description.en: After arriving in Shu Han, Zhuge Qiao was appointed as Fuma Duwei.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛乔与霍弋一同在汉中参赞军务。
description.en: Zhuge Qiao participated in military affairs in Hanzhong together with Huo Yi.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛攀是诸葛乔的儿子。
description.en: Zhuge Pan was the son of Zhuge Qiao.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛瞻是诸葛亮的亲生儿子。
description.en: Zhuge Zhan was the biological son of Zhuge Liang.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛乔的籍贯是琅邪郡阳都县。
description.en: Zhuge Qiao's ancestral home was Yangdu County, Langya Commandery.

description.zh-cn: 王荣顺出生于江苏金坛。
description.en: Wang Rongshun was born in Jintan, Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 1949年考取金坛县中学（现江苏省华罗庚中学）。
description.en: In 1949, he was admitted to Jintan County Middle School (now Jiangsu Hua Luogeng High School).

description.zh-cn: 1953年至1957年在东北师范大学化学系学习。
description.en: Studied at the Department of Chemistry, Northeast Normal University from 1953 to 1957.

description.zh-cn: 在吉林大学化学系进修量子化学。
description.en: Pursued advanced studies in quantum chemistry at the Department of Chemistry, Jilin University.

description.zh-cn: 在吉林大学进修期间，师从唐敖庆教授从事量子化学研究。
description.en: During his advanced studies at Jilin University, he studied quantum chemistry under the guidance of Professor Tang Aoqing.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，王荣顺被迫中断科研，改行教“自然辩证法”。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Wang Rongshun was forced to interrupt his scientific research and switch to teaching 'Dialectics of Nature'.

description.zh-cn: 改革开放后，王荣顺重新投入了研究工作。
description.en: After the Reform and Opening-up, Wang Rongshun resumed his research work.

description.zh-cn: 王荣顺曾三次在美国南伊利诺伊大学化学系做高级访问学者。
description.en: Wang Rongshun served as a senior visiting scholar at the Department of Chemistry, Southern Illinois University, on three occasions.

description.zh-cn: 王荣顺曾三次在美国纽约州立大学水牛城分校做高级访问学者。
description.en: Wang Rongshun served as a senior visiting scholar at the State University of New York at Buffalo on three occasions.

description.zh-cn: 史宁中是王荣顺的继任东北师范大学校长。
description.en: Shi Ningzhong was the successor to Wang Rongshun as the president of Northeast Normal University.

description.zh-cn: 王荣顺和其研究团队将经过特殊处理的聚并苯作为锂离子电池的负极材料，使电池循环寿命、工作电压和比容量等技术指标均高于同类产品。
description.en: Wang Rongshun and his research team used specially treated polyacene as the anode material for lithium-ion batteries, resulting in technical indicators such as cycle life, working voltage, and specific capacity that were superior to similar products.

description.zh-cn: 从1982年开始，王荣顺运用量子化学方法提出“有机导体掺杂导电的双向机制”理论模型，并应用于材料学研究。
description.en: Starting in 1982, Wang Rongshun applied quantum chemistry methods to propose the theoretical model of 'dual-mechanism of doping conductivity in organic conductors' and used it in materials science research.

description.zh-cn: 神圣罗马帝国解体事件标志着神圣罗马帝国的终结。
description.en: The dissolution event marked the end of the Holy Roman Empire.

description.zh-cn: 拿破仑促使德意志邦国组成法国的卫星国莱茵邦联。
description.en: Napoleon pushed the German states to form the Confederation of the Rhine as a satellite state of France.

description.zh-cn: 莱茵邦联是法国（拿破仑）的卫星国。
description.en: The Confederation of the Rhine was a satellite state of France (Napoleon).

description.zh-cn: 神圣罗马帝国卷入拿破仑战争后，开始了真正的衰落并最终解体。
description.en: After getting involved in the Napoleonic Wars, the Holy Roman Empire began its true decline and eventual dissolution.

description.zh-cn: 神圣罗马帝国卷入法国大革命战争后，开始了真正的衰落。
description.en: After getting involved in the French Revolutionary Wars, the Holy Roman Empire began its true decline.

description.zh-cn: 奥斯特里茨战役的失败导致第三次反法同盟瓦解。
description.en: The defeat at the Battle of Austerlitz led to the collapse of the Third Coalition.

description.zh-cn: 弗朗茨二世统治下的奥地利在奥斯特里茨战役中战败，这是导致他最终解散帝国的关键事件。
description.en: Austria under Francis II was defeated at the Battle of Austerlitz, a key event that led him to eventually dissolve the empire.

description.zh-cn: 拿破仑在1804年称帝，与神圣罗马皇帝弗朗茨二世对立，并在战争中击败后者，最终迫使其解散帝国。
description.en: Napoleon crowned himself emperor in 1804, opposing Holy Roman Emperor Francis II, defeated him in war, and ultimately forced him to dissolve the empire.

description.zh-cn: 他是最后一位神圣罗马皇帝。
description.en: He was the last Holy Roman Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 作为对拿破仑称帝的回应，弗朗茨二世宣布自己为奥地利皇帝弗朗茨一世。
description.en: In response to Napoleon's coronation, Francis II declared himself Francis I, Emperor of Austria.

description.zh-cn: 神圣罗马帝国解体后，在其原地区于1815年建立了德意志邦联作为后继者之一。
description.en: After the dissolution of the Holy Roman Empire, the German Confederation was established in 1815 in its former territory as one of its successors.

description.zh-cn: 神圣罗马帝国的解体产生了“德国问题”，即关于德意志统一可能性的探讨。
description.en: The dissolution of the Holy Roman Empire gave rise to the 'German Question', a debate about the possibilities of German unification.

description.zh-cn: 对“德国问题”的探讨推动了德意志统一运动。
description.en: The debate on the 'German Question' spurred the movement for German unification.

description.zh-cn: 德意志统一运动最终导致了德意志帝国的宣告成立。
description.en: The movement for German unification ultimately led to the proclamation of the German Empire.

description.zh-cn: 第七届全国人大常委会是第七届全国人大的常设机关。
description.en: The Standing Committee of the 7th NPC is the permanent body of the 7th NPC.

description.zh-cn: 第八届全国人大接替第七届全国人大成为最高国家权力机关。
description.en: The 8th NPC succeeded the 7th NPC as the highest organ of state power.

description.zh-cn: 在第七届全国人大第一次会议上当选为委员长。
description.en: Elected as Chairman at the First Session of the 7th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 在第三次会议上选举江泽民接替邓小平担任中华人民共和国中央军事委员会主席。
description.en: Elected Jiang Zemin to succeed Deng Xiaoping as Chairman of the Central Military Commission of the PRC during its third session.

description.zh-cn: 在第三次会议上通过了邓小平辞去中华人民共和国中央军事委员会主席职务的请求。
description.en: Approved Deng Xiaoping's resignation from the Chairmanship of the Central Military Commission of the PRC during its third session.

description.zh-cn: 在其第一次会议上通过了《中华人民共和国宪法》修正案。
description.en: Passed the amendment to the Constitution of the People's Republic of China during its first session.

description.zh-cn: 在其第一次会议上决定成立澳门特别行政区基本法草委会。
description.en: Decided to establish the Drafting Committee for the Basic Law of the Macao Special Administrative Region during its first session.

description.zh-cn: 在其第二次会议上通过了《中华人民共和国行政诉讼法》。
description.en: Passed the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China during its second session.

relationships.target: BAIDU:中华人民共和国全国人民代表大会议事规则

description.zh-cn: 在其第二次会议上通过了《中华人民共和国全国人民代表大会议事规则》。
description.en: Passed the Rules of Procedure for the National People's Congress of the PRC during its second session.

description.zh-cn: 在其第三次会议上通过了《中华人民共和国香港特别行政区基本法》。
description.en: Passed the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the PRC during its third session.

description.zh-cn: 在其第四次会议上批准了《国民经济和社会发展十年规划和第八个五年计划纲要》。
description.en: Approved the 'Ten-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development and the Outline of the Eighth Five-Year Plan' during its fourth session.

description.zh-cn: 在第七届全国人大第五次会议上提交了《关于提请审议兴建长江三峡工程议案的说明》。
description.en: Submitted the 'Explanation on the Proposal for the Construction of the Three Gorges Project' at the Fifth Session of the 7th NPC.

position.en: Acting Chairman, President of the Executive Yuan

description.zh-cn: 汪精卫是汪精卫国民政府的首任及核心领导人。
description.en: Wang Jingwei was the first and core leader of the Wang Jingwei regime.

position.zh-cn: 行政院院长、代理国民政府主席
position.en: President of the Executive Yuan, Acting Chairman of the Nationalist Government

description.zh-cn: 汪精卫去世后，陈公博接任政府首脑。
description.en: After Wang Jingwei's death, Chen Gongbo took over as the head of the government.

description.zh-cn: 1945年8月15日日本宣布投降，次日汪精卫国民政府宣布解散，政权终结。
