description.en: On August 15, 1945, Japan announced its surrender. The following day, the Wang Jingwei regime announced its dissolution, bringing the regime to an end.

description.zh-cn: 汪精卫前往云南试图获取滇系军阀龙云的支持以合组政府，但龙云并未明确表态。
description.en: Wang Jingwei traveled to Yunnan to seek the support of warlord Long Yun for forming a new government, but Long Yun did not give a clear commitment.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国承认汪精卫国民政府为代表中国的唯一合法政府并与其建交。
description.en: Nazi Germany recognized the Wang Jingwei regime as the sole legitimate government of China and established diplomatic relations with it.

description.zh-cn: 意大利承认汪精卫国民政府为代表中国的唯一合法政府并与其建交。
description.en: The Kingdom of Italy recognized the Wang Jingwei regime as the sole legitimate government of China and established diplomatic relations with it.

description.zh-cn: 汪精卫国民政府于1943年1月9日对美国宣战。
description.en: The Wang Jingwei regime declared war on the United States on January 9, 1943.

description.zh-cn: 日本投降后，陈公博被国民政府逮捕并于1946年以汉奸罪判处死刑、执行枪决。
description.en: After Japan's surrender, Chen Gongbo was arrested by the Nationalist Government, convicted of treason, sentenced to death, and executed in 1946.

description.zh-cn: 日本投降后，周佛海被国民政府逮捕，1946年被判处死刑，后被蒋介石减为无期徒刑，1948年因病死于狱中。
description.en: After Japan's surrender, Zhou Fohai was arrested by the Nationalist Government, sentenced to death in 1946, but his sentence was commuted to life imprisonment by Chiang Kai-shek. He died of illness in prison in 1948.

description.zh-cn: 日本投降后，褚民谊被国民政府逮捕并于1946年以汉奸罪判处死刑、执行枪决。
description.en: After Japan's surrender, Chu Minyi was arrested by the Nationalist Government, convicted of treason, sentenced to death, and executed in 1946.

description.zh-cn: 1946年，时任中国陆军总司令的何应钦下令炸毁了位于南京的汪精卫墓，并将其遗骸火化扬灰。
description.en: In 1946, He Yingqin, then Commander-in-Chief of the Chinese Army, ordered the destruction of Wang Jingwei's tomb in Nanjing, and had his remains cremated and scattered.

description.zh-cn: 汪精卫国民政府名义上统辖蒙疆联合自治政府，但后者实际上保持了一定的独立性。
description.en: The Wang Jingwei regime nominally had jurisdiction over the Mengjiang United Autonomous Government, but the latter maintained a degree of independence in practice.

position.zh-cn: 山东方面军总司令/第三方面军总司令
position.en: Commander of the Shandong Front Army / Commander of the Third Front Army

description.zh-cn: 1943年1月18日，原国民党将领吴化文率所部约4万人投靠汪精卫国民政府。
description.en: On January 18, 1943, former KMT general Wu Huawen defected with his troops of about 40,000 men to the Wang Jingwei regime.

position.en: Commander of the Sixth Front Army

description.zh-cn: 1943年4月，原国民党将领孙殿英被俘后投靠汪精卫国民政府。
description.en: In April 1943, former KMT general Sun Dianying defected to the Wang Jingwei regime after being captured.

description.zh-cn: 1943年，汪精卫在东京会见时任日本内阁总理大臣东条英机。
description.en: In 1943, Wang Jingwei met with the then Prime Minister of Japan, Hideki Tojo, in Tokyo.

description.zh-cn: 1943年，汪精卫在东京会见自由印度临时政府领导人苏巴斯·钱德拉·鲍斯。
description.en: In 1943, Wang Jingwei met with Subhas Chandra Bose, the leader of the Provisional Government of Free India, in Tokyo.

position.en: Head of the CCDI-NSC Discipline Inspection and Supervision Group stationed at the People's Bank of China, Member of the Party Committee of the People's Bank of China

description.en: Since September 2022, has served as the Head of the CCDI-NSC Discipline Inspection and Supervision Group stationed at the People's Bank of China and a member of the Party Committee of the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 当选为中国共产党第二十届中央纪律检查委员会委员。
description.en: Elected as a member of the 20th Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 曲吉山接替徐加爱，担任中央纪委国家监委驻中国人民银行纪检监察组组长职务。

description.zh-cn: 孟玉珍是鄂伦春族。
description.en: Meng Yuzhen belongs to the Oroqen ethnic group.

description.zh-cn: 2008年起担任第十一届全国人民代表大会内蒙古地区代表。
description.en: Starting from 2008, she served as a deputy from the Inner Mongolia region to the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 毕业于中国青年政治学院思想政治教育专业。

description.zh-cn: 孟玉珍是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Meng Yuzhen is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 孟玉珍担任鄂伦春自治旗古里乡乡长。
description.en: Meng Yuzhen served as the head of Guli Township in the Oroqen Autonomous Banner.

description.zh-cn: 洪磊出生于浙江省杭州市富阳区。
description.en: Hong Lei was born in Fuyang District, Hangzhou City, Zhejiang Province.

description.zh-cn: 1991年毕业于北京语言大学。
description.en: Graduated from Beijing Language and Culture University in 1991.

description.zh-cn: 洪磊是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Hong Lei is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 1992年至1996年，任驻荷兰大使馆随员、三秘。
description.en: From 1992 to 1996, served as an Attaché and Third Secretary at the Embassy in the Netherlands.

description.zh-cn: 2000年至2004年，任驻旧金山总领事馆二秘、一秘。
description.en: From 2000 to 2004, served as a Second Secretary and First Secretary at the Consulate-General in San Francisco.

description.zh-cn: 2010年11月至2016年7月21日，担任外交部发言人。
description.en: From November 2010 to July 21, 2016, served as a spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 2018年9月调任外交部礼宾司副司长，任职至2019年2月。同年2月起，升任外交部礼宾司司长。
description.en: From September 2018, served as Deputy Director-General of the Protocol Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs until February 2019. In February of the same year, promoted to Director-General of the department.

description.zh-cn: 洪磊接替秦刚担任中华人民共和国外交部礼宾司司长职务。
description.en: Hong Lei succeeded Qin Gang as the Director-General of the Protocol Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 洪磊接替赵卫平担任中华人民共和国驻芝加哥总领事职务。
description.en: Hong Lei succeeded Zhao Weiping as the Consul General of the People's Republic of China in Chicago.

description.zh-cn: 赵建接替洪磊担任中华人民共和国驻芝加哥总领事职务。
description.en: Zhao Jian succeeded Hong Lei as the Consul General of the People's Republic of China in Chicago.

description.zh-cn: 耿爽接替洪磊担任中华人民共和国外交部发言人职务。
description.en: Geng Shuang succeeded Hong Lei as the spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 新闻司是中华人民共和国外交部的内设机构。

description.zh-cn: 在2021年2月25日举行的全国脱贫攻坚总结表彰大会上，德吉被授予“全国脱贫攻坚先进个人”荣誉称号。
description.en: At the National Poverty Alleviation Summary and Commendation Conference held on February 25, 2021, Deji was awarded the honorary title of 'National Advanced Individual in Poverty Alleviation'.

description.zh-cn: 德吉因在脱贫攻坚战中作出突出贡献，被授予“全国脱贫攻坚先进个人”荣誉称号。
description.en: Deji was awarded the honorary title of 'National Advanced Individual in Poverty Alleviation' for her outstanding contributions in the Poverty Alleviation Battle.

description.zh-cn: 于2021年2月25日被授予“全国脱贫攻坚先进个人”荣誉称号。
description.en: Was awarded the honorary title of 'National Advanced Individual in Poverty Alleviation' on February 25, 2021.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类信息，德吉是西北农林科技大学的校友。
description.en: According to the page category information, Deji is an alumna of Northwest A&F University.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类信息，德吉是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to the page category information, Deji is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 国家体育指导委员会是朝鲜民主主义人民共和国国务委员会的直属机关。
description.en: The State Physical Culture and Sports Guidance Commission is an organ directly under the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 张成泽于2012年12月至2013年担任国家体育指导委员会委员长。
description.en: Jang Song-thaek served as the Chairman of the State Physical Culture and Sports Guidance Commission from December 2012 to 2013.

description.zh-cn: 崔龙海于2013年至2017年担任国家体育指导委员会委员长。
description.en: Choe Ryong-hae served as the Chairman of the State Physical Culture and Sports Guidance Commission from 2013 to 2017.

description.zh-cn: 崔辉于2017年至2023年2月担任国家体育指导委员会委员长。
description.en: Choe Hwi served as the Chairman of the State Physical Culture and Sports Guidance Commission from 2017 to February 2023.

description.zh-cn: 金德训自2023年2月起担任国家体育指导委员会委员长。
description.en: Kim Tok-hun has been serving as the Chairman of the State Physical Culture and Sports Guidance Commission since February 2023.

description.zh-cn: 金德训兼任朝鲜民主主义人民共和国内阁总理。
description.en: Kim Tok-hun concurrently serves as the Premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 温枢刚是河北临漳人。
description.en: Wen Shugang is from Linzhang, Hebei.

description.zh-cn: 温枢刚的民族为汉族。
description.en: Wen Shugang's ethnicity is Han Chinese.

description.zh-cn: 温枢刚是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Wen Shugang is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 2018年，温枢刚被选为广西壮族自治区出席第十三届全国人民代表大会的代表。
description.en: In 2018, Wen Shugang was elected as a deputy to the 13th National People's Congress, representing the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region.

position.zh-cn: 赞军校尉、汉昌太守、偏将军、横江将军
position.en: Colonel of Military Aid, Grand Administrator of Hanchang, General of the Standard, General Who Crosses the River

description.zh-cn: 在周瑜推荐下，鲁肃开始为孙权效力，成为其重要的战略顾问和军事将领，直至去世。
description.en: Recommended by Zhou Yu, Lu Su began serving Sun Quan, becoming his key strategic advisor and military general until his death.

description.zh-cn: 周瑜向孙策和孙权多次引荐鲁肃，认为其才堪当大任，是成就功业不可或缺的人才。
description.en: Zhou Yu repeatedly recommended Lu Su to Sun Ce and Sun Quan, believing his talents were crucial for their great cause and that he was an indispensable figure.

description.zh-cn: 周瑜病逝后，鲁肃根据其遗言推荐，接替了他的兵权和职务。
description.en: After Zhou Yu's death from illness, Lu Su took over his military command and duties as per Zhou Yu's dying recommendation.

description.zh-cn: 鲁肃去世后，吕蒙接替了他的职务。
description.en: After Lu Su's death, Lü Meng succeeded him in his position.

description.zh-cn: 鲁肃在与孙权首次密谈时，便提出了“榻上策”这一长远战略构想。
description.en: During his first private meeting with Sun Quan, Lu Su proposed the long-term strategic vision known as 'Tashang Ce'.

description.zh-cn: 榻上策为孙权规划了鼎足江东、称帝图取天下的战略蓝图，对其后续决策产生了深远影响。
description.en: The 'Tashang Ce' provided Sun Quan with a strategic blueprint to secure Jiangdong and eventually vie for the empire, profoundly influencing his subsequent decisions.

description.zh-cn: 张昭曾向孙权非议鲁肃，认为他年少粗疏，不可任用，但孙权并未采纳其意见。
description.en: Zhang Zhao spoke ill of Lu Su to Sun Quan, claiming he was young and crude and should not be appointed. However, Sun Quan did not accept this advice.

description.zh-cn: 鲁肃在与刘备会面时结识了诸葛亮，二人因共同促成孙刘联盟的目标而结为好友。
description.en: Lu Su met Zhuge Liang during his meeting with Liu Bei, and the two became good friends due to their shared goal of forging the Sun-Liu alliance.

description.zh-cn: 在鲁肃的劝说下，孙权将南郡等地借给刘备，为刘备提供了发展的基地。
description.en: Persuaded by Lu Su, Sun Quan lent Nan Commandery and other territories to Liu Bei, providing him with a base for development.

description.zh-cn: 鲁淑是鲁肃的儿子。
description.en: Lu Shu was the son of Lu Su.

description.zh-cn: 中国地震局机关服务中心是中国地震局的直属事业单位。
description.en: The Service Center of the China Earthquake Administration is a directly affiliated public institution of the China Earthquake Administration.

description.zh-cn: 张敏担任中国地震局机关服务中心主任。
description.en: Zhang Min serves as the Director of the Service Center of the China Earthquake Administration.

description.zh-cn: 1971年8月2日，中华人民共和国国务院经审议决定，调整中国科学院机构设置，新设立国家地震局。
description.en: On August 2, 1971, the State Council of the People's Republic of China decided to adjust the organizational structure of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and establish the new State Seismological Bureau.

position.en: Public institution directly under the State Council

description.zh-cn: 国家地震局作为副部级国务院直属事业单位，领导全国地震工作。
description.en: As a vice-ministerial level public institution directly under the State Council, the State Seismological Bureau led national earthquake-related work.

description.zh-cn: 1999年，国家地震局被改组为中国地震局。
description.en: In 1999, the State Seismological Bureau was reorganized into the China Earthquake Administration.

description.zh-cn: 1999年，国务院办公厅在其印发的三定方案中，决定将国家地震局改组为中国地震局。
description.en: In 1999, the General Office of the State Council, in its issued 'Three-Determinations' plan, decided to reorganize the State Seismological Bureau into the China Earthquake Administration.

position.en: Vice Dean of the Law School

description.zh-cn: 何兵是中国政法大学法学院副院长。
description.en: He Bing is the Vice Dean of the Law School at China University of Political Science and Law.

description.zh-cn: 作为全国人大代表，朱列玉认为中国地震局缺乏存在的必要性，应当裁撤，并建议参考日本气象厅和美国地质调查局的机构设置。
description.en: As a deputy to the National People's Congress, Zhu Lieyu argued that the China Earthquake Administration lacked the necessity for its existence and should be abolished, suggesting referencing the organizational structures of the Japan Meteorological Agency and the United States Geological Survey.

description.zh-cn: 授予方守恩意大利之星指挥官勋章。
description.en: Awarded Fang Shou'en the Order of the Star of Italy (Commander).

description.zh-cn: 接替杨贤金出任中国共产党同济大学委员会书记。
description.en: Succeeded Yang Xianjin as the Secretary of the Tongji University Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 接替方守恩出任中国共产党同济大学委员会书记。
description.en: Succeeded Fang Shou'en as the Secretary of the Tongji University Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 江鹏坚于1984年创立了台湾人权促进会。
description.en: Chiang Peng-chien founded the Taiwan Association for Human Rights in 1984.

description.zh-cn: 江鹏坚在美丽岛事件中担任被告林义雄的辩护律师，此举加深了他对党外运动的参与。
description.en: Chiang Peng-chien served as the defense lawyer for defendant Lin I-hsiung in the Kaohsiung Incident, which deepened his involvement in the Tangwai movement.

description.zh-cn: 在军事法庭审判中，江鹏坚为美丽岛事件被告之一的林义雄辩护。
description.en: In the military court trial, Chiang Peng-chien defended Lin I-hsiung, one of the defendants of the Kaohsiung Incident.

description.zh-cn: 美丽岛事件发生后，蒋经国政府逮捕了许多参与者。
description.en: After the Kaohsiung Incident, the Chiang Ching-kuo government arrested many participants.

description.zh-cn: 江鹏坚是民主进步党创党十人小组之一，并协同其他党外人士筹组该党。
description.en: Chiang Peng-chien was one of the ten-member group that founded the Democratic Progressive Party and organized the party with other Tangwai activists.

description.zh-cn: 江鹏坚于1986年至1987年担任民进党首任党主席，并于1992年至1993年担任秘书长。
description.en: Chiang Peng-chien served as the first chairman of the DPP from 1986 to 1987, and as Secretary-General from 1992 to 1993.

description.zh-cn: 于江鹏坚担任民进党主席期间，担任秘书长。
description.en: Served as Secretary-General while Chiang Peng-chien was the DPP Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 于许信良担任民进党主席期间，担任秘书长。
description.en: Served as Secretary-General while Hsu Hsin-liang was the DPP Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 江鹏坚担任监察委员期间，王作荣为监察院院长。
description.en: While Chiang Peng-chien was a member of the Control Yuan, Wang Tso-jung was its President.

description.zh-cn: 江鹏坚担任监察委员期间，钱复为监察院院长。
description.en: While Chiang Peng-chien was a member of the Control Yuan, Fredrick Chien was its President.

description.zh-cn: 1994年共同角逐民进党台北市长候选人提名。
description.en: Competed for the DPP's Taipei mayoral nomination in 1994.

description.zh-cn: 1994年共同角逐民进党台北市长候选人提名。
description.en: Competed for the DPP's Taipei mayoral nomination in 1994.

description.zh-cn: 以时任中华民国总统身份，于江鹏坚逝世后颁赠褒扬令。
description.en: As the incumbent President of the Republic of China, issued a posthumous citation after Chiang Peng-chien's death.

description.zh-cn: 宣称看过江鹏坚持有的情搜文件，支持施明德的指控。
description.en: Claimed to have seen intelligence documents held by Chiang Peng-chien, supporting Shih Ming-teh's accusation.

description.zh-cn: 根据施明德的指控，江鹏坚曾负责监视施明正。
description.en: According to Shih Ming-teh's accusation, Chiang Peng-chien was responsible for monitoring Shih Ming-cheng.

description.zh-cn: 在施明德指控江鹏坚为调查局卧底后，谢长廷发文为江鹏坚辩护。
description.en: After Shih Ming-teh accused Chiang Peng-chien of being an undercover agent for the Investigation Bureau, Frank Hsieh posted to defend Chiang.

description.zh-cn: 温熙森出生于江苏常熟。
description.en: Wen Xisen was born in Changshu, Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 2000年，温熙森被授予中国人民解放军中将军衔。
description.en: In 2000, Wen Xisen was awarded the rank of Lieutenant General in the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 温熙森曾担任国防科技大学校长。
description.en: Wen Xisen served as the President of the National University of Defense Technology.

description.zh-cn: 2008年，温熙森当选第十一届全国政协常务委员。
description.en: In 2008, Wen Xisen was elected as a Standing Committee member of the 11th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类信息，温熙森是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to category information, Wen Xisen is a member of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类信息，温熙森是中国共产党第十六届中央委员会候补委员。
description.en: According to category information, Wen Xisen was an alternate member of the 16th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类信息，温熙森是中国宇航学会常务理事。
description.en: According to category information, Wen Xisen was a standing council member of the Chinese Society of Astronautics.

description.zh-cn: 鲁元公主是刘邦的长女。
description.en: Princess Yuan of Lu is the eldest daughter of Liu Bang.

description.zh-cn: 鲁元公主是吕雉的长女。
description.en: Princess Yuan of Lu is the eldest daughter of Lü Zhi.

description.zh-cn: 鲁元公主嫁给赵王张敖为妻。
description.en: Princess Yuan of Lu married Zhang Ao, the King of Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 张偃是鲁元公主的儿子。
description.en: Zhang Yan is the son of Princess Yuan of Lu.

description.zh-cn: 前192年，吕太后为巩固家族势力，将外孙女（鲁元公主之女）张氏嫁与舅舅汉惠帝刘盈为皇后。
description.en: In 192 BC, Empress Dowager Lü, to strengthen family ties and power, arranged the marriage of her granddaughter, Lady Zhang (daughter of Princess Lu Yuan), to her maternal uncle, Emperor Hui of Han (Liu Ying), as empress.

description.zh-cn: 鲁元公主是汉惠帝的姐姐。
description.en: Princess Yuan of Lu is the elder sister of Emperor Hui of Han.

description.zh-cn: 在刘邦将子女推下车后，夏侯婴将鲁元公主救回车上。
description.en: After Liu Bang pushed his children off the chariot, Xiahou Ying rescued Princess Yuan of Lu and brought her back onto it.

description.zh-cn: 刘敬向刘邦建议将鲁元公主嫁给匈奴冒顿单于以实行和亲政策。
description.en: Liu Jing suggested to Liu Bang that he should marry Princess Yuan of Lu to Modu Chanyu of the Xiongnu to implement the Heqin policy.

description.zh-cn: 吕雉因日夜哭泣反对，阻止了刘邦将鲁元公主嫁给冒顿单于的和亲计划。
description.en: Lü Zhi's constant weeping and opposition prevented Liu Bang's plan to marry Princess Yuan of Lu to Modu Chanyu as part of the Heqin alliance.

description.zh-cn: 为求自保，齐王刘肥将齐国的城阳郡作为公主的汤沐邑献上，并尊其为齐国王太后。
description.en: To protect himself, Liu Fei, King of Qi, presented the Chengyang Commandery of Qi to Princess Yuan of Lu as her fief and honored her as the Queen Dowager of Qi.

description.zh-cn: 张敖是张耳的儿子。
description.en: Zhang Ao is the son of Zhang Er.

description.zh-cn: 鲁元公主是刘肥的异母妹妹。
description.en: Princess Yuan of Lu is the half-sister of Liu Fei.

description.zh-cn: 鲁元公主是刘如意的异母姐姐。
description.en: Princess Yuan of Lu is the half-sister of Liu Ruyi.

description.zh-cn: 鲁元公主是刘恒的异母姐姐。
description.en: Princess Yuan of Lu is the half-sister of Liu Heng.

description.zh-cn: 鲁元公主是刘友的异母姐姐。
description.en: Princess Yuan of Lu is the half-sister of Liu You.

description.zh-cn: 鲁元公主是刘长的异母姐姐。
description.en: Princess Yuan of Lu is the half-sister of Liu Zhang.

description.zh-cn: 鲁元公主是刘建的异母姐姐。
description.en: Princess Yuan of Lu is the half-sister of Liu Jian.

description.zh-cn: 王莽时期改淮浦县为淮敬县。
description.en: During the reign of Wang Mang, Huaipu County was renamed Huaijing.

description.zh-cn: 明洪武二年（1369年）涟水境改称安东县。
description.en: In 1369 AD (the second year of the Hongwu era of the Ming Dynasty), the territory of Lianshui was renamed Andong County.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国三年（1914年），因与奉天省安东县同名，复名涟水县。
description.en: In 1914 (the third year of the Republic of China), its name was reverted to Lianshui County because it shared the same name as Andong County in Fengtian Province.

description.zh-cn: 根据第七次全国人口普查数据，截至2020年11月1日零时，涟水县常住人口为829699人。
description.en: According to the data from the Seventh National Population Census, as of 00:00 on November 1, 2020, the resident population of Lianshui County was 829,699.

description.zh-cn: 连镇铁路在涟水县设涟水站。
description.en: The Lianyungang-Zhenjiang High-Speed Railway has a station, Lianshui Station, in Lianshui County.

description.zh-cn: 今世缘公司位于高沟镇。
description.en: The Jinshiyuan company is located in Gaogou Town.

description.zh-cn: 炎黄职业技术学院是位于涟水县的院校。
description.en: Yanhuang Vocational and Technical College is an institution located in Lianshui County.

description.zh-cn: 能仁寺是位于涟水县的寺庙。
description.en: Nengren Temple is a temple located in Lianshui County.

description.zh-cn: 南汉在北宋开国战争中被宋军攻灭。
description.en: The Southern Han was conquered by the Song army during the wars of the founding of the Northern Song.

description.zh-cn: 刘隐接受后梁的册封，先后被封为彭郡王、南平王、南海王，名义上是后梁的臣属。
description.en: Liu Yin accepted titles from the Later Liang, being successively created Prince of Peng Commandery, Prince of Nanping, and Prince of Nanhai, nominally a vassal of the Later Liang.

description.zh-cn: 吴权击败南汉军队，占有交州，使该地区脱离南汉控制。
description.en: Ngô Quyền defeated the Southern Han army and occupied Jiaozhou, removing the region from Southern Han's control.

description.zh-cn: 吴权在交州打败了刘䶮之子刘弘操率领的南汉军队，刘弘操在此战中阵亡。
description.en: In Jiaozhou, Ngô Quyền defeated the Southern Han army led by Liu Hongcao, son of Liu Yan; Liu Hongcao was killed in this battle.

description.zh-cn: 吴权在击败南汉军队后占有交州，建立了吴朝。
description.en: After defeating the Southern Han army, Ngô Quyền occupied Jiaozhou and founded the Ngô dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 矫公羡在交州兵变后，向南汉君主刘䶮求救，促使刘䶮派兵干预。
description.en: After a mutiny in Jiaozhou, Kiều Công Tiễn requested aid from the Southern Han ruler Liu Yan, prompting Liu Yan to send troops to intervene.

description.zh-cn: 南汉与南唐曾经是友好邻邦，两国关系被形容为“情若弟兄，义同交契”。
description.en: Southern Han and Southern Tang were once friendly neighboring states, with their relationship described as being 'like brothers in affection, and united by a common bond'.

description.zh-cn: 邵廷琄成功抵御宋军后，反遭诬陷谋反，被后主刘𬬮赐死。
description.en: After successfully repelling the Song army, Shao Tingyuan was falsely accused of treason and put to death by the Last Ruler Liu Chang.

description.zh-cn: 宋太祖赵匡胤授意南唐国主李煜，劝说南汉后主刘𬬮主动归降宋朝。
description.en: Emperor Taizu of Song, Zhao Kuangyin, instructed Li Yu, the ruler of Southern Tang, to persuade Liu Chang, the Last Ruler of Southern Han, to voluntarily submit to the Song.

description.zh-cn: 李煜受宋太祖之命，派使者游说刘𬬮向宋称臣。
description.en: Under the instruction of Emperor Taizu of Song, Li Yu sent an envoy to persuade Liu Chang to become a vassal of the Song.

description.zh-cn: 刘𬬮拒绝了李煜的劝降，扣押了南唐使者并回书斥责李煜。
description.en: Liu Chang rejected Li Yu's persuasion to surrender, detained the Southern Tang envoy, and sent back a letter rebuking Li Yu.

description.zh-cn: 南汉将领潘崇彻见南汉覆灭在即，向宋军投降，加速了南汉的灭亡。
description.en: The Southern Han general Pan Chongche, seeing the imminent collapse of the state, surrendered to the Song army, hastening Southern Han's demise.

position.zh-cn: 贺州道行营兵马都总管
position.en: Commander-in-Chief of the Hezhou Circuit Field Army

description.zh-cn: 赵匡胤任命潘美为都总管，发兵攻打南汉。
description.en: Zhao Kuangyin appointed Pan Mei as Commander-in-Chief and dispatched him to attack Southern Han.

description.zh-cn: 彭城之战后，刘邦为逃命多次将刘盈和鲁元公主踢下车，夏侯婴每次都下车将他们救回车上。
description.en: After the Battle of Pengcheng, while fleeing for his life, Liu Bang kicked Liu Ying and Princess Yuan of Lu off his chariot multiple times, but Xiahou Ying got off each time to bring them back aboard.

description.zh-cn: 刘盈在位期间，朝政深受母亲吕后干预，吕后成为实际统治者。吕后将戚夫人制成“人彘”给刘盈观看，导致其大受打击，从此不理朝政。
description.en: During Liu Ying's reign, state affairs were heavily influenced by his mother, Empress Lü, who became the de facto ruler. Empress Lü had Consort Qi mutilated into a 'human swine' and showed her to Liu Ying, which traumatized him to the point of neglecting his governmental duties.

description.zh-cn: 刘邦认为刘盈为人仁弱，不像自己，常想废掉他，改立戚夫人的儿子刘如意为太子。
description.en: Liu Bang considered Liu Ying to be too benevolent and weak, unlike himself, and often wanted to depose him and install Liu Ruyi, the son of Consort Qi, as the crown prince instead.

description.zh-cn: 在刘邦意图废黜太子刘盈时，张良为吕后献策，请来商山四皓辅佐太子，最终使刘邦放弃了废黜太子的想法。
description.en: When Liu Bang intended to depose Crown Prince Liu Ying, Zhang Liang advised Empress Lü to invite the Four Whiteheads of Mount Shang to assist the prince, which ultimately led Liu Bang to abandon the idea of deposing him.

description.zh-cn: 刘盈知道母亲吕雉欲加害刘如意，亲自到霸上迎接，并与之同吃同住，设法保护他。
description.en: Knowing that his mother Empress Lü intended to harm Liu Ruyi, Liu Ying personally went to Bashang to welcome him, and then lived and ate with him in an effort to protect him.

description.zh-cn: 在吕后意图用毒酒谋害齐王刘肥时，刘盈起身欲与兄长共饮，迫使吕后打消了计划，救了刘肥。
description.en: When Empress Lü attempted to poison Liu Fei, the King of Qi, with wine, Liu Ying stood up to drink with his brother, forcing the empress to abandon her plan and thus saving Liu Fei.

description.zh-cn: 曹参继任相国后，做事情没有任何变更，一概遵循萧何制定的法度，世称“萧规曹随”。
description.en: After succeeding Xiao He as chancellor, Cao Shen made no changes and strictly followed the laws and regulations established by Xiao He, a practice known as 'Cao following Xiao's rules'.

description.zh-cn: 吕后首先废黜并杀害了前少帝。
description.en: Empress Lü first deposed and killed the Former Emperor Shao.

description.zh-cn: 功臣集团与刘氏皇族在诛灭诸吕后，以血缘不明为由，将刘盈尚在人世的四子（包括后少帝刘弘）全部杀害，导致刘盈绝后。
description.en: After exterminating the Lü clan, the group of ministers and the Liu imperial clan, citing uncertain parentage, killed all four of Liu Ying's surviving sons (including the Later Emperor Shao, Liu Hong), leaving Liu Ying with no descendants.

description.zh-cn: 陈平作为功臣集团的核心人物，与周勃等元老列侯在吕后死后，共同策划并执行了铲除吕氏外戚势力的行动。
description.en: As a key figure among the meritorious ministers and senior statesmen, Chen Ping, along with Zhou Bo and others, planned and executed the purge of the Lü consort clan after the death of Empress Lü.

description.zh-cn: 冒顿单于曾致信吕后，言辞轻慢，提议两人通婚，激怒了吕后和汉朝大臣。
description.en: Modu Chanyu once sent a letter to Empress Lü with disrespectful language, proposing a marriage between them, which angered the empress and the Han court officials.

description.zh-cn: 在朝堂上，季布激烈反对樊哙率十万大军攻打匈奴的提议，并称“樊哙可斩”。
description.en: In the imperial court, Ji Bu vehemently opposed Fan Kuai's proposal to lead 100,000 troops to attack the Xiongnu, stating that 'Fan Kuai deserves to be executed'.

description.zh-cn: 汉惠帝刘盈于前195年至前188年间担任汉朝皇帝，在位7年。
description.en: Emperor Hui of Han, Liu Ying, reigned as the emperor of the Han Dynasty from 195 BC to 188 BC, for a period of 7 years.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国重工业部是国务院的组成部门之一。
description.en: The Ministry of Heavy Industry of the People's Republic of China was a constituent department of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国重工业部属于国务院组成部门。
description.en: The Ministry of Heavy Industry of the People's Republic of China was classified as a constituent department of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 1954年，中央人民政府重工业部改称为中华人民共和国重工业部。
description.en: In 1954, the Ministry of Heavy Industry of the Central People's Government was renamed to the Ministry of Heavy Industry of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 在第四十次会议上批准国务院撤销重工业部。
description.en: Approved the State Council's decision to abolish the Ministry of Heavy Industry at its 40th meeting.

description.zh-cn: 重工业部撤销后，其钢铁工业管理局和有色金属管理局被合并组建为冶金工业部。
description.en: After the abolition of the Ministry of Heavy Industry, its Steel Industry Administration and Non-ferrous Metals Administration were merged to form the Ministry of Metallurgical Industry.

description.zh-cn: 重工业部撤销后，其建筑材料工业管理局被改组为建筑材料工业部。
description.en: After the abolition of the Ministry of Heavy Industry, its Building Materials Industry Administration was reorganized into the Ministry of Building Materials Industry.

description.zh-cn: 中央人民政府重工业部的人员主要来自华北人民政府公营企业部。
description.en: The personnel of the Ministry of Heavy Industry of the Central People's Government primarily came from the Public Enterprise Department of the North China People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 兼任中央人民政府重工业部部长。
description.en: Concurrently served as the Minister of Heavy Industry of the Central People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中央人民政府委员会第十七次会议决定从重工业部分出成立第一机械工业部。
description.en: The 17th meeting of the Central People's Government Council decided to establish the First Ministry of Machine-Building Industry by splitting it from the Ministry of Heavy Industry.

description.zh-cn: 中央人民政府委员会第十七次会议决定从重工业部分出成立第二机械工业部。
description.en: The 17th meeting of the Central People's Government Council decided to establish the Second Ministry of Machine-Building Industry by splitting it from the Ministry of Heavy Industry.

description.zh-cn: 会议通过了相关法律，正式成立中华人民共和国国务院。
description.en: The session passed relevant laws, formally establishing the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 156项重点工程是第一个五年计划的核心部分。
description.en: The 156 Key Projects were a core part of the First Five-Year Plan.

description.zh-cn: 鞍山钢铁公司是列入中国第一个五年计划苏联援建的156项重点工程的建设项目之一。
description.en: Anshan Iron and Steel Company was one of the construction projects listed in the 156 Key Projects aided by the Soviet Union during China's First Five-Year Plan.

description.zh-cn: 武汉钢铁公司是列入中国第一个五年计划苏联援建的156项重点工程的建设项目之一。
description.en: Wuhan Iron and Steel Company was one of the construction projects listed in the 156 Key Projects aided by the Soviet Union during China's First Five-Year Plan.

description.zh-cn: 包头钢铁公司是列入中国第一个五年计划苏联援建的156项重点工程的建设项目之一。
description.en: Baotou Iron and Steel Company was one of the construction projects listed in the 156 Key Projects aided by the Soviet Union during China's First Five-Year Plan.

description.zh-cn: 无锡市公安局是无锡市人民政府的组成部门，在组织上受其领导。
description.en: The Wuxi Public Security Bureau is a constituent department of the Wuxi Municipal People's Government and is organizationally subordinate to it.

description.zh-cn: 无锡市公安局在业务上接受江苏省公安厅的领导，构成双重领导关系的一部分。
description.en: The Wuxi Public Security Bureau is operationally subordinate to the Jiangsu Provincial Public Security Department, forming part of a dual leadership relationship.

description.zh-cn: 在党组织关系上，无锡市公安局接受中国共产党无锡市委员会的领导。
description.en: In terms of Party organization, the Wuxi Public Security Bureau is under the leadership of the Wuxi Municipal Committee of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军于1949年4月23日攻占无锡，为无锡市人民政府的成立和正式运作创造了条件。
description.en: The People's Liberation Army captured Wuxi on April 23, 1949, creating the conditions for the establishment and official operation of the Wuxi Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 1949年5月20日，在无锡市人民政府的运作下，无锡市公安局正式建立。
description.en: On May 20, 1949, under the operation of the Wuxi Municipal People's Government, the Wuxi Public Security Bureau was formally established.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，无锡市公安局被实行军事管制，组织陷入混乱与瘫痪，其职能由新成立的无锡市公检法军事管制委员会接管，直至1973年3月恢复。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, the Wuxi Public Security Bureau was placed under military control, its organization fell into chaos and paralysis, and its functions were taken over by the newly established Wuxi Municipal Public Security, Procuratorate, and Court Military Control Committee until it was restored in March 1973.

description.zh-cn: 中国石油天然气集团是国家石油天然气管网集团的创始股东之一，持股比例为30%。
description.en: China National Petroleum Corporation is one of the founding shareholders of PipeChina, holding a 30% stake.

description.zh-cn: 孙桂泉是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Sun Guiquan is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 2018年2月24日，孙桂泉当选为第十三届全国人民代表大会江苏地区代表。
description.en: On February 24, 2018, Sun Guiquan was elected as a delegate from the Jiangsu area to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 孙桂泉的职务是全国人大代表。
description.en: Sun Guiquan holds the position of Deputy to the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 孙桂泉出生于江苏省如东县。
description.en: Sun Guiquan was born in Rudong County, Jiangsu Province.

description.zh-cn: 孙桂泉是汉族。
description.en: Sun Guiquan is of Han ethnicity.

description.zh-cn: 阎锡山于1911年年底辛亥革命之际响应起义，创立了晋系。此后，他于1932年2月设立太原绥靖公署并就任主任。
description.en: In late 1911, during the Xinhai Revolution, Yan Xishan responded to the uprising and founded the Jin clique. Subsequently, in February 1932, he established the Taiyuan Pacification Headquarters and assumed the position of Director.

description.zh-cn: 阎锡山是晋系军阀的创始人和最高领导人。
description.en: Yan Xishan was the founder and supreme leader of the Jin warlord clique.

description.zh-cn: 晋系以山西为根据地，并统治山西长达38年之久。
description.en: The Jin clique was based in Shanxi and ruled it for 38 years.

description.zh-cn: 1927年6月，阎锡山宣布山西易帜，晋系效忠国民政府。
description.en: In June 1927, Yan Xishan announced that Shanxi would switch its allegiance, and the Jin clique pledged loyalty to the Nationalist government.

description.zh-cn: 阎锡山曾拥戴袁世凯洪宪称帝。
description.en: Yan Xishan once supported Yuan Shikai's attempt to become emperor.

description.zh-cn: 1949年，傅作义投向中国共产党。
description.en: In 1949, Fu Zuoyi defected to the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 傅作义投向共产党导致晋系消亡。
description.en: Fu Zuoyi's defection to the Communists led to the demise of the Jin clique.

description.zh-cn: 辛亥革命后，山西革命军遭到大清陆军第三镇攻击，战力大为受创。
description.en: After the Xinhai Revolution, the Shanxi revolutionary army was attacked by the 3rd Town of the Qing Army and suffered heavy losses.

description.zh-cn: 1916年护国战争后，阎锡山收编了商震的陕西旅。
description.en: After the National Protection War in 1916, Yan Xishan incorporated Shang Zhen's Shaanxi brigade.

description.zh-cn: 1927年9月，晋系与奉系之间爆发奉晋战争。
description.en: In September 1927, the Fengtian-Jin War broke out between the Jin clique and the Fengtian clique.

description.zh-cn: 中原大战后，张学良将晋绥军（晋系军队）的14个军40余师压缩为4个军8个师，削弱了其力量。
description.en: After the Central Plains War, Zhang Xueliang downsized the Jin-Sui Army (Jin clique army) from 14 armies and over 40 divisions to 4 armies and 8 divisions, weakening its strength.

description.zh-cn: 九一八事变爆发后，南京国民政府无暇顾及阎锡山，为他重返山西创造了条件。
description.en: After the Mukden Incident, the Nanjing Nationalist Government was too preoccupied to deal with Yan Xishan, creating conditions for his return to Shanxi.

description.zh-cn: 赵广是赵云的次子。
description.en: Zhao Guang is the second son of Zhao Yun.

description.zh-cn: 赵广是赵统的弟弟。
description.en: Zhao Guang is the younger brother of Zhao Tong.

description.zh-cn: 赵统是赵云的长子。
description.en: Zhao Tong is the eldest son of Zhao Yun.

description.zh-cn: 赵广在蜀汉担任牙门将。
description.en: Zhao Guang served as a Gate General in the state of Shu Han.

position.en: Commandant of the Tiger Guards, acting Commander

description.zh-cn: 赵统在父亲赵云去世后，在蜀汉官至虎贲中郎督，行领军。
description.en: After his father Zhao Yun's death, Zhao Tong served in Shu Han, reaching the position of Commandant of the Tiger Guards and acting Commander.

description.zh-cn: 赵广作为牙门将，曾随同姜维参与北伐。
description.en: As a Gate General, Zhao Guang followed Jiang Wei to participate in the northern expeditions.

description.zh-cn: 赵广在跟随姜维于沓中进行北伐作战时，不幸临阵战死。
description.en: Zhao Guang was killed in action at Tazhong while fighting in a battle during Jiang Wei's northern expeditions.

description.zh-cn: 继诸葛亮之后，蜀汉大将姜维于247年至262年间发动了十一次北伐，是后期北伐战争的主要领导者和推动者。
description.en: Following Zhuge Liang, Shu Han General Jiang Wei launched eleven northern expeditions between 247 and 262, serving as the main leader and promoter of these northern campaigns during the late Shu Han period.

description.zh-cn: 在漫画《火凤燎原》中，赵广以“燎原广”的虚构身份登场，并被设定为主角燎原火（赵云）的义子。
description.en: In the manhua 'The Ravages of Time', Zhao Guang appears under the fictional identity 'Liaoyuan Guang' and is portrayed as the adopted son of the protagonist Liaoyuan Huo (Zhao Yun).

description.zh-cn: 陈某是漫画《火凤燎原》的创作者。
description.en: Chen Mou is the creator of the manhua 'The Ravages of Time'.

description.zh-cn: 在历史小说《三国演义》中，赵广与其兄赵统向诸葛亮报告了父亲的死讯，并被后主刘禅任命为牙门将守卫父亲的坟墓，这部分情节与史实有所不同。
description.en: In the historical novel 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Zhao Guang and his brother Zhao Tong reported their father's death to Zhuge Liang and were appointed by the Later Lord Liu Shan as Gate Generals to guard their father's tomb, a plot point that differs from historical records.

description.zh-cn: 叶楠与白桦是孪生兄弟。
description.en: Ye Nan and Bai Hua are twin brothers.

description.zh-cn: 叶楠出生于河南信阳。
description.en: Ye Nan was born in Xinyang, Henan.

description.zh-cn: 叶楠曾任中国电影家协会理事，包括第四届及第五届理事会。
description.en: Ye Nan served as a council member of the China Film Association, including for the 4th and 5th councils.

description.zh-cn: 叶楠是中国作家协会会员，曾任第四届理事会理事和第六届全国委员会名誉委员。
description.en: Ye Nan was a member of the China Writers Association, serving as a council member of the 4th Council and an honorary committee member of the 6th National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类信息，叶楠是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to the page's category information, Ye Nan was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 邵逸夫是邵玉轩的第六子。
description.en: Run Run Shaw is the sixth son of Shao Yuxuan.

description.zh-cn: 邵醉翁是邵玉轩的长子。
description.en: Runje Shaw is the eldest son of Shao Yuxuan.

description.zh-cn: 邵邨人是邵玉轩的二子。
description.en: Runde Shaw is the second son of Shao Yuxuan.

description.zh-cn: 邵玉轩与虞洽卿是至交。
description.en: Shao Yuxuan and Yu Qiaqing were close friends.

description.zh-cn: 邵玉轩与朱葆三是至交。
description.en: Shao Yuxuan and Zhu Baosan were close friends.

description.zh-cn: 邵玉轩与严信厚是至交。
description.en: Shao Yuxuan and Yan Xinhou were close friends.

description.zh-cn: 邵玉轩支持孙中山的反清运动。
description.en: Shao Yuxuan supported Sun Yat-sen's anti-Qing movement.

description.zh-cn: 邵玉轩支持陈其美的反清运动。
description.en: Shao Yuxuan supported Chen Qimei's anti-Qing movement.

description.zh-cn: 邵玉轩与同盟会秘密交往，并且是其会员。
description.en: Shao Yuxuan had secret dealings with the Tongmenghui and was a member.

description.zh-cn: 邵玉轩与光复会秘密交往。
description.en: Shao Yuxuan had secret dealings with the Guangfuhui.

description.zh-cn: 邵玉轩曾斥巨资资助辛亥革命。
description.en: Shao Yuxuan heavily funded the Xinhai Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 邵玉轩曾斥巨资资助上海光复。
description.en: Shao Yuxuan heavily funded the Shanghai Restoration.

description.zh-cn: 邵玉轩出生于浙江省宁波府镇海县。
description.en: Shao Yuxuan was born in Zhenhai County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang Province.

description.zh-cn: 邵玉轩与周宗良是上海颜料业的同行，二人齐名。
description.en: Shao Yuxuan and Zhou Zongliang were contemporaries in the Shanghai pigment industry and were equally famous.

description.zh-cn: 卢永祥在1920年邵玉轩逝世后为其赠挽致哀。
description.en: Lu Yongxiang sent condolences upon Shao Yuxuan's death in 1920.

description.zh-cn: 1910年，与宋炜臣一道出资修建家乡道路。
description.en: In 1910, he co-funded the construction of roads in his hometown with Song Weichen.

description.zh-cn: 1910年，与阮雯衷一道出资修建家乡道路。
description.en: In 1910, he co-funded the construction of roads in his hometown with Ruan Wenzhong.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框，河南省许昌市中级人民法院的上诉法院和业务上级均为河南省高级人民法院。
description.en: According to the infobox, the appellate court and operational superior of the Xuchang Intermediate People's Court are both the Henan Higher People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框，河南省许昌市中级人民法院的机构类型是中级人民法院。
description.en: According to the infobox, the institutional type of the Xuchang Intermediate People's Court of Henan Province is an Intermediate People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框，《中华人民共和国人民法院组织法》是河南省许昌市中级人民法院的组织法规。
description.en: According to the infobox, the Organic Law of the People's Courts of the People's Republic of China is the organizational regulation for the Xuchang Intermediate People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 河南省许昌市中级人民法院位于河南省许昌市魏都区。
description.en: The Xuchang Intermediate People's Court of Henan Province is located in Weidu District, Xuchang City, Henan Province.

description.zh-cn: 撰写了《帝国主义与革命》一书。
description.en: Authored the book 'Imperialism and the Revolution'.

description.zh-cn: 于1978年12月公开发行了《帝国主义与革命》的第二版。
description.en: Publicly released the second edition of 'Imperialism and the Revolution' in December 1978.

description.zh-cn: 该书的诞生标志着霍查主义的最终形成。
description.en: The publication of this book marked the final formation of Hoxhaism.

description.zh-cn: 书中抨击“三个世界”理论是一种反革命沙文主义理论。
description.en: The book criticized the 'Three Worlds Theory' as a counter-revolutionary chauvinist theory.

description.zh-cn: 书中批评了“美帝国主义”。
description.en: The book criticized 'US imperialism'.

description.zh-cn: 书中批评了“中国社会帝国主义”。
description.en: The book criticized 'Chinese social-imperialism'.

description.zh-cn: 书中批评了“日本军国主义”。
description.en: The book criticized 'Japanese militarism'.

description.zh-cn: 书中批评了“南斯拉夫修正主义”。
description.en: The book criticized 'Yugoslav revisionism'.

description.zh-cn: 书中批评了“野蛮竞争的共同市场”。
description.en: The book criticized the 'Common Market of savage competition'.

description.zh-cn: 书中批评了“欧洲修正主义党”。
description.en: The book criticized 'European revisionist parties'.

description.zh-cn: 书中批评了“意大利颓废派”。
description.en: The book criticized the 'Italian decadent school'.

description.zh-cn: 书中批评了“西班牙君主王朝的走狗”。
description.en: The book criticized the 'lackeys of the Spanish monarchy'.

description.zh-cn: 书中评价“无产阶级文化大革命”既不是一场革命，也不伟大，更无关文化，最关键的是，它绝不是“无产阶级的”。
description.en: The book evaluated that the 'Great Proletarian Cultural Revolution' was neither a revolution, nor great, nor cultural, and most importantly, it was by no means 'proletarian'.

description.zh-cn: 印度共产主义起义党评价该书反对赫鲁晓夫修正主义。
description.en: The Communist Ghadar Party of India praised the book for opposing Khrushchevite revisionism.

description.zh-cn: 根据《帝国主义与革命》的观点，毛泽东思想是来自无政府主义等意识形态的融合。
description.en: According to 'Imperialism and the Revolution', Mao Zedong Thought is a fusion of ideologies including anarchism.

description.zh-cn: 根据《帝国主义与革命》的观点，毛泽东思想是来自托洛茨基主义等意识形态的融合。
description.en: According to 'Imperialism and the Revolution', Mao Zedong Thought is a fusion of ideologies including Trotskyism.

description.zh-cn: 根据《帝国主义与革命》的观点，毛泽东思想是来自现代修正主义等意识形态的融合。
description.en: According to 'Imperialism and the Revolution', Mao Zedong Thought is a fusion of ideologies including modern revisionism.

description.zh-cn: 根据《帝国主义与革命》的观点，毛泽东思想是来自铁托主义等意识形态的融合。
description.en: According to 'Imperialism and the Revolution', Mao Zedong Thought is a fusion of ideologies including Titoism.

description.zh-cn: 根据《帝国主义与革命》的观点，毛泽东思想是来自赫鲁晓夫主义等意识形态的融合。
description.en: According to 'Imperialism and the Revolution', Mao Zedong Thought is a fusion of ideologies including Khrushchevism.

description.zh-cn: 根据《帝国主义与革命》的观点，毛泽东思想是来自“欧洲共产主义”等意识形态的融合。
description.en: According to 'Imperialism and the Revolution', Mao Zedong Thought is a fusion of ideologies including 'Eurocommunism'.

description.zh-cn: 根据《帝国主义与革命》的观点，孔子等中国哲学家的旧思想直接影响了毛泽东思想的形成。
description.en: According to 'Imperialism and the Revolution', old ideas from Chinese philosophers like Confucius directly influenced the formation of Mao Zedong Thought.

description.zh-cn: 根据《帝国主义与革命》的观点，孟子等中国哲学家的旧思想直接影响了毛泽东思想的形成。
description.en: According to 'Imperialism and the Revolution', old ideas from Chinese philosophers like Mencius directly influenced the formation of Mao Zedong Thought.

description.zh-cn: 根据《帝国主义与革命》的观点，毛泽东思想带有佛教色彩的印记。
description.en: According to 'Imperialism and the Revolution', Mao Zedong Thought bears the imprint of Buddhist colors.

description.zh-cn: 高度评价《帝国主义与革命》，认为其捍卫了马克思列宁主义。
description.en: Highly praised 'Imperialism and the Revolution', considering it a defense of Marxism-Leninism.

description.zh-cn: 该书被印度共产主义起义党评价为捍卫马克思列宁主义的著作。
description.en: The book was evaluated by the Communist Ghadar Party of India as a work that defends Marxism-Leninism.

description.zh-cn: 该书的一个章节论证了列宁主义关于帝国主义的理论仍保持完整有效性。
description.en: A chapter of the book argues that the Leninist theory of imperialism remains fully valid.

description.zh-cn: 恩维尔·霍查是阿尔巴尼亚社会主义人民共和国的最高领导人。
description.en: Enver Hoxha was the supreme leader of the Socialist People's Republic of Albania.

description.zh-cn: 恩维尔·霍查曾任阿尔巴尼亚劳动党第一书记。
description.en: Enver Hoxha served as the First Secretary of the Party of Labour of Albania.

description.zh-cn: 盛宣怀作为天津海关道，上奏并获准设立北洋大学堂，并担任首任督办。
description.en: As the Daotai of Tianjin Customs, Sheng Xuanhuai proposed and received approval to establish Peiyang University, and he served as its first supervisor.

description.zh-cn: 王文韶作为直隶总督，通过他向光绪帝禀奏，并参与了北洋大学堂的创办过程。
description.en: As the Viceroy of Zhili, Wang Wenshao submitted the proposal to the Guangxu Emperor and participated in the founding process of Peiyang University.

description.zh-cn: 光绪帝御笔钦准成立北洋大学堂。
description.en: The Guangxu Emperor gave imperial approval to establish Peiyang University.

description.zh-cn: 1912年1月，北洋大学堂改名“北洋大学校”，直属当时的国民政府教育部。
description.en: In January 1912, Peiyang University was renamed 'Peiyang University School' and placed under the direct administration of the then Ministry of Education of the Nationalist Government.

description.zh-cn: 1917年，国民政府教育部对北洋大学进行科系调整，将其改为专办工科。
description.en: In 1917, the Ministry of Education of the Nationalist Government restructured the departments of Peiyang University, transforming it into a specialized engineering institution.

description.zh-cn: 1917年，国民政府教育部进行科系调整，将北洋大学的法科并入北京大学。
description.en: In 1917, the Ministry of Education of the Nationalist Government restructured departments, merging the law department of Peiyang University into Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 北洋大学堂成立时，使用了呑纳学院的校址。
description.en: Peiyang University used the campus of Tunnar College at its founding.

description.zh-cn: 国立北洋工学院是中国天津大学的前身。
description.en: The National Peiyang Technical Institute is the predecessor of Tianjin University.

description.zh-cn: 杜吉洲是辽宁大连市人。
description.en: Du Jizhou is from Dalian, Liaoning.

description.zh-cn: 杜吉洲是中国共产党的党员。
description.en: Du Jizhou is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 2013年，杜吉洲被选为第十二届全国人民代表大会内蒙古地区代表。
description.en: In 2013, Du Jizhou was elected as a delegate from the Inner Mongolia region to the 12th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 佘孟孝是江苏苏州人。
description.en: She Mengxiao was a native of Suzhou, Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 曾任新华社香港分社副社长。
description.en: Served as the deputy director of the Hong Kong Branch of Xinhua News Agency.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中华人民共和国司法部副部长。
description.en: Served as the Vice Minister of Justice of the People's Republic of China.

position.en: Executive Vice President, Party Group Secretary

description.zh-cn: 曾任中国法学会常务副会长、党组书记。
description.en: Served as the executive vice president and party group secretary of the China Law Society.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，佘孟孝是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to the Wikipedia category, She Mengxiao was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，佘孟孝是江苏省苏州中学校友。
description.en: According to the Wikipedia category, She Mengxiao was an alumnus of Suzhou High School of Jiangsu Province.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，佘孟孝曾任中共中央政法委员会副秘书长。
description.en: According to the Wikipedia category, She Mengxiao served as the Deputy Secretary-General of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 江西省农产品质量安全中心是隶属于江西省农业厅的单位。
description.en: The Jiangxi Provincial Agro-product Quality and Safety Center is an organization subordinate to the Jiangxi Provincial Department of Agriculture.

description.zh-cn: 邱水平担任江西省农产品质量安全中心的主任。
description.en: Qiu Shuiping serves as the Director of the Jiangxi Provincial Agro-product Quality and Safety Center.

description.zh-cn: 江西省农产品质量安全中心的行政级别被定为正县处级。
description.en: The administrative rank of the Jiangxi Provincial Agro-product Quality and Safety Center is designated as County-level Director Grade.

description.zh-cn: 江西省农产品质量安全中心的官方印章由江西省人民政府制发。
description.en: The official seal of the Jiangxi Provincial Agro-product Quality and Safety Center is made and issued by the Jiangxi Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 席强担任中央民族乐团团长、党委副书记。
description.en: Xi Qiang served as the Director and Deputy Party Secretary of the China National Traditional Orchestra.

description.zh-cn: 2008年当选第十一届全国政协委员，代表文化艺术界，分入第二十八组。
description.en: Elected as a member of the 11th National Committee of the CPPCC in 2008, representing the culture and arts sector and assigned to Group 28.

description.zh-cn: 席强是第十二届全国政协委员，此信息来源于页面分类。
description.en: Xi Qiang was a member of the 12th National Committee of the CPPCC, as indicated by the page category.

description.zh-cn: 2018年1月当选第十三届全国政协委员。
description.en: Elected as a member of the 13th National Committee of the CPPCC in January 2018.

description.zh-cn: 席强是中国音乐家协会会员，并曾担任其第七届和第八届理事会理事。
description.en: Xi Qiang is a member of the Chinese Musicians' Association and served as a council member for its 7th and 8th councils.

description.zh-cn: 席强是中国共产党党员，此信息来源于页面分类。
description.en: Xi Qiang is a member of the Communist Party of China, as indicated by the page category.

description.zh-cn: HIV病毒污染了用于治疗的血液制品，是引发药害爱滋事件的根本原因。
description.en: The HIV virus contaminated blood products used for treatment, which was the root cause of the HIV-tainted blood scandal.

description.zh-cn: 未经热处理的受污染血液制品被广泛使用，直接导致了HIV病毒的大规模传播和事件的发生。
description.en: The widespread use of untreated, contaminated blood products directly led to the mass transmission of HIV and the occurrence of the scandal.

description.zh-cn: 1983年，百特国际向日本厚生劳动省申请销售其经过热处理、可杀死HIV病毒的新血液制品。
description.en: In 1983, Baxter International applied to the Japanese Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare to sell its new heat-treated blood product that could kill the HIV virus.

description.zh-cn: 作为记者，樱井良子公开批判厚生省在药害爱滋事件中的不作为。
description.en: As a journalist, Yoshiko Sakurai publicly criticized the Ministry of Health for its inaction in the HIV-tainted blood scandal.

description.zh-cn: 厚生劳动省是日本的中央政府部门之一。
description.en: The Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare is one of the central government ministries of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 2019年12月，晋升中将军衔。
description.en: Promoted to the rank of Lieutenant General in December 2019.

description.zh-cn: 在2013年12月之前曾任中国人民解放军海军装备部办公室主任。
description.en: Served as the Office Director of the PLA Navy Armament Department before December 2013.

description.zh-cn: 接替堵远放，担任中国人民解放军空军政治工作部主任。
description.en: Succeeded Du Yuanfang as Director of the Political Work Department of the People's Liberation Army Air Force.

description.zh-cn: 接替康春元，担任中国人民解放军战略支援部队航天系统部政治委员。
description.en: Succeeded Kang Chunyuan as Political Commissar of the Aerospace Systems Department of the People's Liberation Army Strategic Support Force.

description.zh-cn: 接替姜平，担任中国人民解放军战略支援部队航天系统部政治委员。
description.en: Succeeded Jiang Ping as Political Commissar of the Aerospace Systems Department of the People's Liberation Army Strategic Support Force.

position.en: Deputy Secretary-General of the State Council

description.zh-cn: 舒晓琴担任国务院副秘书长期间，杨晶为国务院秘书长。
description.en: When Shu Xiaoqin served as Deputy Secretary-General of the State Council, Yang Jing was the Secretary-General of the State Council.

position.en: Deputy Secretary-General of the State Council

description.zh-cn: 舒晓琴担任国务院副秘书长期间，肖捷为国务院秘书长。
description.en: When Shu Xiaoqin served as Deputy Secretary-General of the State Council, Xiao Jie was the Secretary-General of the State Council.

position.zh-cn: 国务院副秘书长、国家信访局局长
position.en: Deputy Secretary-General of the State Council, Director of the National Public Complaints and Proposals Administration

description.zh-cn: 舒晓琴在李克强担任国务院总理期间在国务院任职。
description.en: Shu Xiaoqin served in the State Council during Li Keqiang's tenure as Premier.

description.zh-cn: 毕业于江西师范大学政法系思想政治教育专业。
description.en: Graduated from the Department of Politics and Law with a major in Ideological and Political Education at Jiangxi Normal University.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中国共产党第十六届、十七届、十八届中央委员会候补委员。
description.en: Served as an alternate member of the 16th, 17th, and 18th Central Committees of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党第十八届中央委员会委员（于十八届七中全会递补）。
description.en: Member of the 18th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party (promoted at the 7th Plenary Session of the 18th Central Committee).

description.zh-cn: 舒晓琴接替王学军担任国家信访局局长。
description.en: Shu Xiaoqin succeeded Wang Xuejun as the Director of the National Public Complaints and Proposals Administration.

description.zh-cn: 李文章接替舒晓琴担任国家信访局局长。
description.en: Li Wenzhang succeeded Shu Xiaoqin as the Director of the National Public Complaints and Proposals Administration.

description.zh-cn: 舒晓琴接替曾页九担任江西省公安厅厅长。
description.en: Shu Xiaoqin succeeded Zeng Yejiu as Director of the Jiangxi Provincial Public Security Department.

description.zh-cn: 郑为文接替舒晓琴担任江西省公安厅厅长。
description.en: Zheng Weiwen succeeded Shu Xiaoqin as Director of the Jiangxi Provincial Public Security Department.

description.zh-cn: 舒晓琴于1995年3月接替殷国光担任景德镇市人民政府市长，并于1998年9月再次接替其担任中共景德镇市委书记。
description.en: Shu Xiaoqin succeeded Yin Guoguango as Mayor of Jingdezhen in March 1995, and then as Secretary of the Jingdezhen Municipal Committee of the CCP in September 1998.

description.zh-cn: 刘爱才接替舒晓琴担任景德镇市人民政府市长。
description.en: Liu Aicai succeeded Shu Xiaoqin as Mayor of Jingdezhen.

description.zh-cn: 舒晓琴接替彭宏松担任中共江西省委政法委书记。
description.en: Shu Xiaoqin succeeded Peng Hongsong as Secretary of the Political and Legal Affairs Commission of the Jiangxi Provincial Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 周萌接替舒晓琴担任中共江西省委政法委书记。
description.en: Zhou Meng succeeded Shu Xiaoqin as Secretary of the Political and Legal Affairs Commission of the Jiangxi Provincial Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 姚亚平接替舒晓琴担任中共景德镇市委书记。
description.en: Yao Yaping succeeded Shu Xiaoqin as Secretary of the Jingdezhen Municipal Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 汉成帝因无子，于绥和元年（前8年）立侄子刘欣为太子。
description.en: Lacking an heir, Emperor Cheng appointed his nephew Liu Xin as crown prince in the first year of the Suihe era (8 BCE).

description.zh-cn: 作为西汉皇帝在位。
description.en: Reigned as an emperor of the Western Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 汉哀帝极度宠爱董贤，与他形影不离，甚至产生了“断袖”的典故，并表示想效法尧舜禅让于董贤。
description.en: Emperor Ai deeply doted on Dong Xian, being inseparable from him, which led to the 'cut sleeve' anecdote. He even expressed a desire to emulate Yao and Shun by abdicating the throne to Dong Xian.

description.zh-cn: 汉哀帝为不惊醒董贤而割断衣袖的行为，促成了“断袖”这一典故的产生。
description.en: Emperor Ai's act of cutting his sleeve to avoid waking Dong Xian led to the creation of the 'cut sleeve' anecdote.

description.zh-cn: 汉哀帝在位期间，董贤一月之内三次升迁，最终于元寿元年（前2年）被提升为百官之首的大司马。
description.en: During Emperor Ai's reign, Dong Xian was promoted three times within a month, eventually being elevated to Grand Marshal, the head of all officials, in the first year of the Yuanshou era (2 BCE).

description.zh-cn: 汉哀帝为重振皇权，屡次打击以王莽为首的王氏外戚集团。
description.en: To restore imperial authority, Emperor Ai repeatedly targeted the Wang consort clan led by Wang Mang.

description.zh-cn: 汉哀帝死后，太皇太后王政君一派重新得势，傅昭仪（傅太皇太后）一派遭诛杀。
description.en: After Emperor Ai's death, the faction of Grand Empress Dowager Wang Zhengjun regained power, and the faction of Consort Fu (Grand Empress Dowager Fu) was purged.

description.zh-cn: 汉哀帝死后，王莽扶植年幼的汉平帝继位，从而掌控朝政。
description.en: After Emperor Ai's death, Wang Mang installed the young Emperor Ping on the throne, thereby seizing control of the government.

description.zh-cn: 汉哀帝将曲阳侯王根免去职务，并将其赶到封国。
description.en: Emperor Ai dismissed Wang Gen, the Marquis of Quyang, from his post and sent him to his fiefdom.

description.zh-cn: 汉哀帝将成都侯王况废为庶人。
description.en: Emperor Ai demoted Wang Kuang, the Marquis of Chengdu, to the status of a commoner.

description.zh-cn: 因王闳劝谏不该戏言禅让，汉哀帝不悦并将其赶出宴席。
description.en: Because Wang Hong advised against joking about abdication, Emperor Ai was displeased and had him expelled from the banquet.

description.zh-cn: 汉哀帝即位后，以“郑声淫而乱乐”为由废除了采集民歌的乐府官。
description.en: After ascending the throne, Emperor Ai abolished the Yuefu (Music Bureau) officials who collected folk songs, citing the reason that 'the sounds of Zheng are lewd and disrupt proper music'.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党广州市委员会是中国共产党广东省委员会的下级机构，并向其报告工作。
description.en: The CCP Guangzhou Municipal Committee is a subordinate body of the CCP Guangdong Provincial Committee and reports its work to it.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党广州市委员会执行中国共产党中央委员会的指示。
description.en: The CCP Guangzhou Municipal Committee carries out the instructions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 郭永航自2023年6月起担任中共广州市委书记。
description.en: Guo Yonghang has served as the Party Secretary of Guangzhou since June 2023.

description.zh-cn: 郭永航兼任中共广东省委常委。
description.en: Guo Yonghang concurrently serves as a member of the Standing Committee of the CCP Guangdong Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 孙志洋是中共广州市第十二届委员会委员，担任副书记。
description.en: Sun Zhiyang is a member of the 12th CCP Guangzhou Municipal Committee, serving as Deputy Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 孙志洋担任广州市市长。
description.en: Sun Zhiyang serves as the Mayor of Guangzhou.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军攻占广州后，中共广州市委得以重建。
description.en: After the People's Liberation Army captured Guangzhou, the CCP Guangzhou Municipal Committee was re-established.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军发动了广州战斗并攻占该市。
description.en: The People's Liberation Army launched the Guangzhou Campaign and captured the city.

description.zh-cn: 广州日报报业集团是中共广州市委的直属事业单位。
description.en: Guangzhou Daily Press Group is a public institution directly affiliated with the CCP Guangzhou Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 曾志是陶铸的夫人。
description.en: Zeng Zhi was the wife of Tao Zhu.

description.zh-cn: 曾志曾任中共广州市委书记。
description.en: Zeng Zhi served as the Party Secretary of Guangzhou.

description.zh-cn: 叶剑英于1949年10月至1952年12月间担任中共广州市委第一书记。
description.en: Ye Jianying served as the First Party Secretary of Guangzhou from October 1949 to December 1952.

description.zh-cn: 杨尚昆于1979年3月至1980年11月间担任中共广州市委书记。
description.en: Yang Shangkun served as the Party Secretary of Guangzhou from March 1979 to November 1980.

description.zh-cn: 谢非于1986年11月至1988年5月间担任中共广州市委书记。
description.en: Xie Fei served as the Party Secretary of Guangzhou from November 1986 to May 1988.

description.zh-cn: 万庆良于2011年12月至2014年6月间担任中共广州市委书记。
description.en: Wan Qingliang served as the Party Secretary of Guangzhou from December 2011 to June 2014.

description.zh-cn: 广州市监察委员会是广东省监察委员会的业务下级，并向其负责。
description.en: The Guangzhou Municipal Supervisory Commission is professionally subordinate to the Guangdong Provincial Supervisory Commission and is accountable to it.

description.zh-cn: 广州市监察委员会是广州市人民代表大会的组织下级，由其选举产生并向其负责。
description.en: The Guangzhou Municipal Supervisory Commission is organizationally subordinate to the Guangzhou Municipal People's Congress, by which it is elected and to which it is accountable.

description.zh-cn: 根据中国共产党的组织原则，广州市纪委是广东省纪委的下级单位。
description.en: According to the organizational principles of the Communist Party of China, the Guangzhou Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection is a subordinate unit of the Guangdong Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection.

description.zh-cn: 广州市监察委员会与中国共产党广州市纪律检查委员会合署办公，实行一套工作机构、两个机关名称的体制。
description.en: The Guangzhou Municipal Supervisory Commission and the Guangzhou Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection of the CPC work jointly, operating as one working body under two names.

description.zh-cn: 广州市监察委员会是中华人民共和国的国家监察机关之一。
description.en: The Guangzhou Municipal Supervisory Commission is one of the state supervisory organs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 元代改宁西军置广安府。
description.en: The Yuan dynasty reorganized Ningxi Jun to establish Guang'an Fu.

description.zh-cn: 元代广安府隶属于顺庆路。
description.en: During the Yuan dynasty, Guang'an Fu was subordinate to Shunqing Lu.

description.zh-cn: 明洪武十年（1377年）五月，将渠江县省入广安州，取消了渠江县的独立建制。
description.en: In May 1377 (the tenth year of the Hongwu reign), the Ming dynasty merged Qujiang County into Guang'an Zhou, abolishing its independent status.

description.zh-cn: 杰佛瑞·萨克斯是哈佛大学的经济学教授。
description.en: Jeffrey Sachs is a professor of economics at Harvard University.

description.zh-cn: 芝加哥男孩在智利拟定并推行了带来“智利奇迹”的经济政策。
description.en: The Chicago Boys formulated and implemented the economic policies in Chile that led to the 'Miracle of Chile'.

description.zh-cn: “芝加哥男孩”是一群有留学芝加哥大学背景的财经官员。
description.en: The 'Chicago Boys' were a group of finance officials with a background of studying at the University of Chicago.

description.zh-cn: 董彩云是甘肃积石山人。
description.en: Dong Caiyun is from Jishishan, Gansu.

description.zh-cn: 董彩云是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Dong Caiyun is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 2018年，董彩云被选为甘肃省出席第十三届全国人民代表大会代表。
description.en: In 2018, Dong Caiyun was elected as a delegate representing Gansu Province to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 1980年至1984年在莱阳农学院（现青岛农业大学）农学系学习。
description.en: Studied in the Department of Agronomy at Laiyang Agricultural College (now Qingdao Agricultural University) from 1980 to 1984.

position.en: Secretary-General, Member of the Standing Committee

description.zh-cn: 2002年11月至2006年12月，孙政才担任中共北京市委秘书长、市委常委。
description.en: From November 2002 to December 2006, Sun Zhengcai served as Secretary-General and a member of the Standing Committee of the Beijing Municipal Party Committee.

description.zh-cn: 2006年12月29日至2009年12月26日，孙政才担任中华人民共和国农业部部长。
description.en: From December 29, 2006, to December 26, 2009, Sun Zhengcai served as the Minister of Agriculture of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 2009年11月30日至2012年11月20日，孙政才担任中共吉林省委书记。
description.en: From November 30, 2009, to November 20, 2012, Sun Zhengcai served as the Secretary of the Jilin Provincial Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 2012年11月15日当选中共中央政治局委员，至2017年9月29日被处分。
description.en: Elected as a member of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee on November 15, 2012, until he was disciplined on September 29, 2017.

description.zh-cn: 2012年11月20日至2017年7月14日，孙政才担任中共重庆市委书记。
description.en: From November 20, 2012, to July 14, 2017, Sun Zhengcai served as the Secretary of the Chongqing Municipal Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 据称，孙政才将北京顺义区价值几十亿的地皮以极低价格输送给时任总理温家宝的夫人张蓓莉，以获得政治支持。
description.en: It is alleged that Sun Zhengcai transferred land in Beijing's Shunyi District worth billions to Zhang Beili, the wife of then-Premier Wen Jiabao, at an extremely low price to gain political support.

description.zh-cn: 评论认为，习近平主导了对孙政才的查处，以清除政治障碍并巩固权力。
description.en: Commentators believe that Xi Jinping led the investigation and removal of Sun Zhengcai to eliminate political obstacles and consolidate power.

description.zh-cn: 1902年，熊希龄创建了常德市第一中学的前身西路师范讲习所。
description.en: In 1902, Xiong Xiling founded the West Route Normal School, the predecessor of Changde No. 1 Middle School.

description.zh-cn: 1939年，时任民国政府教育部长陈立夫批示常德市第一中学前身为“全国最善之公立高中”，以肯定其办学水平。
description.en: In 1939, Chen Lifu, then Minister of Education of the Republic of China, designated the predecessor of Changde No. 1 Middle School as the 'best public high school in the nation', affirming its educational excellence.

description.zh-cn: 亚当·斯密于14岁进入格拉斯哥大学学习道德哲学。
description.en: Adam Smith entered the University of Glasgow at the age of 14 to study moral philosophy.

description.zh-cn: 亚当·斯密获得斯内尔奖学金进入牛津大学贝利奥尔学院学习。
description.en: Adam Smith studied at Balliol College, Oxford, with the Snell Exhibition scholarship.

position.zh-cn: 逻辑学教授；道德哲学教授
position.en: Professor of Logic; Professor of Moral Philosophy

description.zh-cn: 亚当·斯密于1751年被任命为格拉斯哥大学的逻辑学教授，次年改任道德哲学教授，直至1764年辞职。
description.en: Adam Smith was appointed Professor of Logic at the University of Glasgow in 1751, and became Professor of Moral Philosophy the following year, a position he held until his resignation in 1764.

description.zh-cn: 亚当·斯密与大卫·休谟在爱丁堡讲座期间相识，并成为终身挚友。
description.en: Adam Smith and David Hume met during Smith's lectures in Edinburgh and became lifelong close friends.

description.zh-cn: 亚当·斯密撰写并出版了《道德情操论》，该书具体化了他在格拉斯哥的授课内容。
description.en: Adam Smith wrote and published 'The Theory of Moral Sentiments', which elaborated on the content of his lectures in Glasgow.

description.zh-cn: 亚当·斯密撰写并出版了《国富论》，奠定了古典自由市场经济理论的基础。
description.en: Adam Smith wrote and published 'The Wealth of Nations', which laid the foundation for classical free-market economic theory.

description.zh-cn: 《国富论》成为针对重商主义最经典的反驳，推动了自由贸易思想的传播。
description.en: 'The Wealth of Nations' became the most classic refutation of mercantilism, promoting the spread of free trade ideas.

description.zh-cn: 《国富论》否定了重农主义学派对于土地是财富唯一来源的观点，强调劳动的重要性。
description.en: 'The Wealth of Nations' refuted the physiocratic school's view that land is the sole source of wealth, emphasizing the importance of labor instead.

description.zh-cn: 《国富论》的出版被认为是古典经济学的开端，为该学派提供了理论基础。
description.en: The publication of 'The Wealth of Nations' is considered the beginning of classical economics, providing the theoretical foundation for this school of thought.

description.zh-cn: 亚当·斯密接受查理·汤森的聘请，担任其继子亨利·斯科特的私人家教，并陪同其游历欧洲。
description.en: Adam Smith accepted an offer from Charles Townshend to become the private tutor for his stepson, Henry Scott, accompanying him on a tour of Europe.

description.zh-cn: 亨利·斯科特是亚当·斯密在欧陆游历期间的学生。
description.en: Henry Scott was Adam Smith's pupil during his tour of the European continent.

description.zh-cn: 亚当·斯密在欧陆游历期间，于日内瓦见到了他所仰慕的伏尔泰。
description.en: During his tour of Europe, Adam Smith met the much-admired Voltaire in Geneva.

description.zh-cn: 亚当·斯密在巴黎结识了重农主义学派的领导人弗朗索瓦·魁奈，并极为尊重其理论。
description.en: In Paris, Adam Smith met François Quesnay, the leader of the Physiocratic school, and held his theories in high regard.

description.zh-cn: 亚当·斯密出生于苏格兰法夫郡的柯科迪。
description.en: Adam Smith was born in Kirkcaldy, Fife, Scotland.

description.zh-cn: 亚当·斯密在格拉斯哥担任教职期间与约瑟夫·布雷克成为同事并建立了一生的友谊。布雷克是斯密的遗嘱执行人之一。
description.en: Adam Smith became a colleague and lifelong friend of Joseph Black while teaching in Glasgow. Black was one of the executors of Smith's will.

description.zh-cn: 亚当·斯密与詹姆斯·赫顿是好友，共同创立了牡蛎俱乐部，赫顿也是斯密的遗嘱执行人之一。
description.en: Adam Smith and James Hutton were friends who co-founded the Oyster Club. Hutton was also one of the executors of Smith's will.

description.zh-cn: 西南军政长官公署直隶于行政院。
description.en: The Southwest Military and Political Administrator's Office was directly subordinate to the Executive Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 西南军政长官公署在西昌战役中失败而溃散，并于1950年3月27日被撤销。
description.en: The Southwest Military and Political Administrator's Office was defeated and disintegrated during the Xichang Campaign, and was abolished on March 27, 1950.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军西南军区发起了西昌战役。
description.en: The Southwest Military Region of the People's Liberation Army launched the Xichang Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 蒋介石于1949年12月7日改派顾祝同为西南军政长官。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek re-appointed Gu Zhutong as the Southwest Military and Political Administrator on December 7, 1949.

description.zh-cn: 蒋介石于1949年12月7日任命胡宗南为西南军政长官公署副长官兼参谋长。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek appointed Hu Zongnan as the Deputy Administrator and Chief of Staff of the Southwest Military and Political Administrator's Office on December 7, 1949.

description.zh-cn: 随着解放军在西昌战役中逼近，代理长官胡宗南于3月26日晚乘飞机离开西昌。
description.en: As the PLA closed in during the Xichang Campaign, Acting Administrator Hu Zongnan fled Xichang by plane on the night of March 26.

description.zh-cn: 随着解放军在西昌战役中逼近，副长官贺国光于3月26日晚乘飞机离开西昌。
description.en: As the PLA closed in during the Xichang Campaign, Deputy Administrator He Guoguang fled Xichang by plane on the night of March 26.

description.zh-cn: 国家发改委曝光太原五中在2004年、2005年招生中，以每生3万元的标准，多招收113名“三限生”，共多收费用339万元。
description.en: The National Development and Reform Commission exposed Taiyuan No. 5 Middle School for illicitly collecting 3.39 million yuan by enrolling an extra 113 students at a standard of 30,000 yuan per student in 2004 and 2005.

description.zh-cn: 因乱收费问题，山西省教育厅责成太原五中作出深刻检查。
description.en: Due to the issue of illegal fees, the Shanxi Provincial Department of Education ordered Taiyuan No. 5 Middle School to conduct a thorough self-criticism.

description.zh-cn: 王一瑛是太原市第五中学校的历届校长之一。
description.en: Wang Yiying was one of the former principals of Taiyuan No. 5 Middle School.

description.zh-cn: 高君宇是太原市第五中学校的杰出校友。
description.en: Gao Junyu is a distinguished alumnus of Taiyuan No. 5 Middle School.

description.zh-cn: 贺昌是太原市第五中学校的杰出校友。
description.en: He Chang is a distinguished alumnus of Taiyuan No. 5 Middle School.

description.zh-cn: 彭真是太原市第五中学校的杰出校友。
description.en: Peng Zhen is a distinguished alumnus of Taiyuan No. 5 Middle School.

description.zh-cn: 根据文本信息，宁建华是河南孟津人。
description.en: According to the text, Ning Jianhua is from Mengjin, Henan.

description.zh-cn: 根据文本信息，宁建华是汉族。
description.en: According to the text, Ning Jianhua is of Han ethnicity.

description.zh-cn: 根据文本信息，宁建华是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to the text, Ning Jianhua is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据文本信息，宁建华是中华人民共和国政治人物。
description.en: According to the text, Ning Jianhua is a political figure of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 2018年，宁建华被选为河南省出席第十三届全国人民代表大会代表。
description.en: In 2018, Ning Jianhua was elected as a deputy from Henan Province to the 13th National People's Congress.

position.en: Deputy to the National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 宁建华的职务为全国人大代表。
description.en: Ning Jianhua's title is Deputy to the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 王悦华是黑龙江望奎人。
description.en: Wang Yuehua is from Wangkui, Heilongjiang.

description.zh-cn: 1983年任共青团黑龙江省委副书记，1985年升任书记。
description.en: In 1983, he became the Deputy Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Committee of the Communist Youth League, and was promoted to Secretary in 1985.

description.zh-cn: 1987年至1992年，任鸡西市人民政府副市长。
description.en: From 1987 to 1992, he served as the Deputy Mayor of the Jixi Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 1996年至1998年，任中华人民共和国建设部市长培训中心主任。
description.en: From 1996 to 1998, he served as the Director of the Mayor Training Center of the Ministry of Construction of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1998年至2003年，任黑龙江省人民政府省长助理。
description.en: From 1998 to 2003, he served as the Assistant to the Governor of the Heilongjiang Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 自2003年起，任黑龙江省总工会主席。
description.en: Since 2003, he has served as the Chairman of the Heilongjiang Provincial Federation of Trade Unions.

description.zh-cn: 胡彦林出生于滨江省哈尔滨市。
description.en: Hu Yanlin was born in Harbin, Binjiang Province.

description.zh-cn: 胡彦林于1959年7月入伍参加中国人民解放军，2008年12月退役。
description.en: Hu Yanlin joined the People's Liberation Army in July 1959 and retired in December 2008.

description.zh-cn: 胡彦林于1959年7月入伍，此后在空军第一航空预备学校学习一年，并于1960年进入空军第七航空学校学习飞行。
description.en: Hu Yanlin enlisted in July 1959, subsequently studying for one year at the PLAAF No. 1 Preparatory Aviation School, and then entering the PLAAF No. 7 Aviation School in 1960 to learn to fly.

description.zh-cn: 胡彦林于1960年10月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Hu Yanlin joined the Communist Party of China in October 1960.

description.zh-cn: 胡彦林于1986年9月至1988年7月在国防大学基本系学习。
description.en: From September 1986 to July 1988, Hu Yanlin studied at the Basic Department of the PLA National Defence University.

description.zh-cn: 胡彦林于2003年6月至2008年12月担任中国人民解放军海军政治委员。
description.en: Hu Yanlin served as the Political Commissar of the People's Liberation Army Navy from June 2003 to December 2008.

description.zh-cn: 胡彦林接替因海军361潜艇失事而被免职的杨怀庆，担任海军政治委员。
description.en: Hu Yanlin succeeded Yang Huaiqing, who was dismissed due to the PLAN Submarine 361 accident, as the Political Commissar of the Navy.

description.zh-cn: 刘晓江在胡彦林退役后，接替其担任海军政治委员。
description.en: After Hu Yanlin's retirement, Liu Xiaojiang succeeded him as the Political Commissar of the Navy.

description.zh-cn: 2010年4月29日，胡彦林被任命为第十一届全国人民代表大会法律委员会副主任委员。
description.en: On April 29, 2010, Hu Yanlin was appointed as the Vice Chairman of the Law Committee of the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 全国人民代表大会法律委员会是第十一届全国人民代表大会的专门委员会之一。
description.en: The Law Committee is one of the specialized committees of the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 毕业于生物系。
description.en: Graduated from the Department of Biology.

position.en: Head of the Department of Soil Science, College of Agriculture

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争结束后任教于北京大学农学院。
description.en: Taught at the College of Agriculture, Peking University after the end of the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 张作霖在其兄张作孚阵亡后，将侄子张学成抚养成人，并提拔他担任团长、旅长等职务。
description.en: After his brother Zhang Zuofu was killed in action, Zhang Zuolin raised his nephew Zhang Xuecheng and promoted him to positions such as regiment commander and brigade commander.

description.zh-cn: 1919年，张学成就读于奉天讲武堂第一期。
description.en: In 1919, Zhang Xuecheng was enrolled in the first class of the Fengtian Military Academy.

description.zh-cn: 张学成毕业于奉天讲武堂后，被张作霖送到日本陆军大学留学深造。
description.en: After graduating from the Fengtian Military Academy, Zhang Xuecheng was sent by Zhang Zuolin to study at the Imperial Japanese Army Academy.

description.zh-cn: 1928年，日军在皇姑屯事件中刺杀了张作霖。
description.en: In 1928, the Japanese army assassinated Zhang Zuolin in the Huanggutun Incident.

description.zh-cn: 1928年张作霖被刺杀后，张学成投靠石友三。
description.en: After Zhang Zuolin was assassinated in 1928, Zhang Xuecheng joined Shi Yousan.

description.zh-cn: 石友三的部队在中原大战中失败。
description.en: Shi Yousan's forces were defeated in the Central Plains War.

description.zh-cn: 九一八事变发生后，张学成从天津回到奉天并投靠日军。
description.en: After the Mukden Incident occurred, Zhang Xuecheng returned from Tianjin to Fengtian and defected to the Japanese army.

description.zh-cn: 1931年9月奉天事变后，张学成投靠日军。
description.en: After the Mukden Incident in September 1931, Zhang Xuecheng defected to the Japanese army.

description.zh-cn: 因张学成投靠日本，张学良恨其不顾国仇家恨，下令将其剿杀。
description.en: Because Zhang Xuecheng defected to Japan, Zhang Xueliang, hating him for disregarding national enmity, ordered his assassination.

description.zh-cn: 胡厚钧是中华人民共和国的政治人物。
description.en: Hu Houjun is a political figure of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 胡厚钧曾任吉林省文学艺术界联合会主席。
description.en: Hu Houjun formerly served as the Chairman of the Jilin Federation of Literary and Art Circles.

description.zh-cn: 胡厚钧曾任吉林省政协副主席。
description.en: Hu Houjun formerly served as the Vice Chairman of the Jilin Provincial CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，胡厚钧是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to the Wikipedia category, Hu Houjun is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 因“高饶事件”，时任中央人民政府副主席高岗在北京服安眠药自杀身亡。
description.en: Due to the 'Gao-Rao Affair', Gao Gang, then Vice Chairman of the Central People's Government, committed suicide by taking sleeping pills in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 该决议由中共中央通过，认定毛泽东在文化大革命中“犯了严重错误”。
description.en: This resolution, passed by the CPC Central Committee, concluded that Mao Zedong had 'made serious mistakes' during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 作为“林彪、江青反革命集团案”主犯，被最高人民法院特别审判庭判处死刑，缓期两年执行。
description.en: As a main culprit in the 'Case of the Lin Biao and Jiang Qing Counter-revolutionary Cliques', she was sentenced to death with a two-year reprieve by the Special Court of the Supreme People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 作为“林彪、江青反革命集团案”主犯，被最高人民法院特别审判庭判处死刑，缓期两年执行。
description.en: As a main culprit in the 'Case of the Lin Biao and Jiang Qing Counter-revolutionary Cliques', he was sentenced to death with a two-year reprieve by the Special Court of the Supreme People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 作为“林彪、江青反革命集团案”主犯，被最高人民法院特别审判庭判处无期徒刑。
description.en: As a main culprit in the 'Case of the Lin Biao and Jiang Qing Counter-revolutionary Cliques', he was sentenced to life imprisonment by the Special Court of the Supreme People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 作为“林彪、江青反革命集团案”主犯，被最高人民法院特别审判庭判处有期徒刑。
description.en: As a main culprit in the 'Case of the Lin Biao and Jiang Qing Counter-revolutionary Cliques', he was sentenced to a term of imprisonment by the Special Court of the Supreme People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 作为“林彪、江青反革命集团案”主犯，被最高人民法院特别审判庭判处有期徒刑。
description.en: As a main culprit in the 'Case of the Lin Biao and Jiang Qing Counter-revolutionary Cliques', he was sentenced to a term of imprisonment by the Special Court of the Supreme People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 中央八项规定限制只有中共中央总书记和国务院总理出访时可以乘坐专机，从而对党和国家领导人的公务出行方式进行了限制。
description.en: The Eight-point Regulation restricts the use of private jets for official overseas visits to only the General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee and the Premier of the State Council, thus limiting the mode of official travel for party and state leaders.

description.zh-cn: 法肯豪森于1930年受邀到中国担任军事顾问，并于1935年3月接替汉斯·冯·塞克特成为顾问团的最后一任领导人。
description.en: Falkenhausen was invited to China in 1930 as a military advisor and succeeded Hans von Seeckt in March 1935 as the last head of the advisory group.

description.zh-cn: 法肯豪森受邀担任蒋中正的军事顾问。
description.en: Falkenhausen was invited to serve as Chiang Kai-shek's military advisor.

description.zh-cn: 法肯豪森曾跟随东亚远征军参加了镇压义和团的军事行动。
description.en: Falkenhausen participated in the military operations to suppress the Boxer Rebellion as part of the East Asian Expeditionary Force.

description.zh-cn: 法肯豪森于1904年至1907年在战争学院进修。
description.en: Falkenhausen studied at the War College from 1904 to 1907.

description.zh-cn: 为向日本表示善意，德国政府强迫法肯豪森辞去中华民国军事顾问职务并召其回国。
description.en: As a gesture of goodwill towards Japan, the German government forced Falkenhausen to resign from his position as a military advisor to the Republic of China and recalled him to Germany.

description.zh-cn: 法肯豪森担任二战时德国占领下的比利时和法国北部的军政府司令官。
description.en: Falkenhausen served as the commander of the military government in German-occupied Belgium and northern France during World War II.

description.zh-cn: 在担任比利时占领区军政府司令官期间，法肯豪森与党卫军暗中抗衡。
description.en: During his tenure as military governor of occupied Belgium, Falkenhausen secretly contended with the SS.

description.zh-cn: 在担任比利时占领区军政府司令官期间，法肯豪森与盖世太保暗中抗衡。
description.en: During his tenure as military governor of occupied Belgium, Falkenhausen secretly contended with the Gestapo.

description.zh-cn: 法肯豪森签署了17道反犹太人的命令，这些命令是1942年从比利时驱逐犹太人的前奏。
description.en: Falkenhausen signed 17 anti-Jewish orders, which were a prelude to the deportation of Jews from Belgium in 1942.

description.zh-cn: 钱秀玲曾两次向法肯豪森求情，使其特赦了约100名被判死刑的比利时反抗组织成员。战后，她也出面为法肯豪森辩护作证。
description.en: Qian Xiuling twice pleaded with Falkenhausen, leading him to pardon about 100 condemned members of the Belgian resistance. After the war, she also testified in his defense.

description.zh-cn: 法肯豪森是卡尔·格德勒的亲密朋友。
description.en: Falkenhausen was a close friend of Carl Goerdeler.

description.zh-cn: 法肯豪森是埃尔温·冯·维茨莱本的亲密朋友。
description.en: Falkenhausen was a close friend of Erwin von Witzleben.

description.zh-cn: 法肯豪森逐渐开始憎恶希特勒与纳粹政权。
description.en: Falkenhausen grew to despise Hitler and the Nazi regime.

description.zh-cn: 法肯豪森支持其朋友维茨莱本的一个军事政变计划，并因此卷入7月20日密谋案。
description.en: Falkenhausen supported a military coup plan by his friend Witzleben and thus became involved in the 20 July plot.

description.zh-cn: 在7月20日密谋案失败后，法肯豪森被解除职务和逮捕，并辗转于多个集中营。
description.en: After the failure of the 20 July plot, Falkenhausen was dismissed from his post, arrested, and transferred between several concentration camps.

description.zh-cn: 法肯豪森在被比利时法庭判处12年监禁的三周后，被西德总理特赦。
description.en: Three weeks after being sentenced to 12 years in prison by a Belgian court, Falkenhausen was pardoned by the West German Chancellor.

description.zh-cn: 1950年法肯豪森72岁生日时，收到蒋中正的12,000元美金作为贺礼，并称他为“中国的友人”。
description.en: On Falkenhausen's 72nd birthday in 1950, he received $12,000 from Chiang Kai-shek as a gift, who called him a 'friend of China'.

description.zh-cn: 1958年11月28日，中华民国政府授予法肯豪森勋章。
