description.en: On November 28, 1958, the government of the Republic of China awarded a medal to Falkenhausen.

description.zh-cn: 1925年参加中国共产党。
description.en: Joined the Communist Party of China in 1925.

description.zh-cn: 郭洪涛是陕西米脂人。
description.en: Guo Hongtao was born in Mizhi, Shaanxi.

description.zh-cn: 朱理治到达西北工委所在地后向郭洪涛了解西北情况。
description.en: After arriving at the location of the Northwest Working Committee, Zhu Lizhi met with Guo Hongtao to understand the situation in the Northwest.

description.zh-cn: 作为山东代表团成员出席会议。
description.en: Attended the meeting as a member of the Shandong delegation.

description.zh-cn: 在中共中央西北局高干会议上，高岗指责郭洪涛在陕北肃反和山东分局工作期间犯有错误。
description.en: At a high-level cadre meeting of the Northwest Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Gao Gang accused Guo Hongtao of making mistakes during the suppression of counter-revolutionaries in northern Shaanxi and in his work at the Shandong Sub-bureau.

description.zh-cn: 高岗饶漱石事件被揭露后，中央同意重新审查郭洪涛的问题，最终促成了其平反。
description.en: After the Gao Gang-Rao Shushi affair was exposed, the Central Committee agreed to re-examine Guo Hongtao's case, which ultimately led to his rehabilitation.

description.zh-cn: 同意中央重新审查郭洪涛问题，并于1960年批准为其平反。
description.en: Agreed to the Central Committee's re-examination of Guo Hongtao's case and approved his rehabilitation in 1960.

description.zh-cn: 同意中央重新审查郭洪涛问题，并于1960年批准为其平反。
description.en: Agreed to the Central Committee's re-examination of Guo Hongtao's case and approved his rehabilitation in 1960.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间遭受迫害。
description.en: Was persecuted during the Cultural Revolution.

relationships.source: BAIDU:中华人民共和国中央人民政府组织法

description.zh-cn: 根据《中华人民共和国中央人民政府组织法》第十八条的规定，设置了中央人民政府重工业部。
description.en: According to Article 18 of the Organic Law of the Central People's Government of the People's Republic of China, the Central People's Government Ministry of Heavy Industry was established.

description.zh-cn: 中央人民政府重工业部是中央人民政府政务院的组成部门。
description.en: The Central People's Government Ministry of Heavy Industry was a component department of the Government Administration Council of the Central People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中央人民政府重工业部在中央人民政府政务院财政经济委员会的指导下展开工作。
description.en: The Central People's Government Ministry of Heavy Industry carried out its work under the guidance of the Finance and Economics Committee of the Government Administration Council of the Central People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 晏婴是晏弱的儿子。
description.en: Yan Ying is the son of Yan Ruo.

description.zh-cn: 晏圉是晏婴的儿子。
description.en: Yan Yu is the son of Yan Ying.

description.zh-cn: 晏弱是宋穆公的曾孙。
description.en: Yan Ruo is the great-grandson of Duke Mu of Song.

description.zh-cn: 晏婴在其父晏弱于齐灵公二十六年（公元前558年）病逝后，继任为齐国上大夫，直至公元前500年去世。
description.en: After his father Yan Ruo passed away in the 26th year of Duke Ling of Qi (558 BC), Yan Ying succeeded him as the Shang Dafu (Senior Official) of the State of Qi until his death in 500 BC.

description.zh-cn: 晏弱因宋国内乱逃至齐国，担任齐国上大夫。
description.en: Yan Ruo fled to the State of Qi due to civil unrest in the State of Song and served as a Shang Dafu (Senior Official).

description.zh-cn: 晏婴是齐灵公的臣子。
description.en: Yan Ying was a minister to Duke Ling of Qi.

description.zh-cn: 晏婴是齐后庄公的臣子。
description.en: Yan Ying was a minister to Duke Zhuang II of Qi.

description.zh-cn: 晏婴是齐景公的臣子，长期辅佐并劝谏他。
description.en: Yan Ying was a minister to Duke Jing of Qi, serving and advising him for a long period.

description.zh-cn: 公元前548年，崔杼因齐后庄公与其妻子通奸而设局谋杀了他。
description.en: In 548 BC, Cui Zhu plotted and assassinated Duke Zhuang II for having an affair with his wife.

description.zh-cn: 作为齐国使臣出使楚国时会见楚灵王，并以智慧维护了国家尊严。
description.en: As an envoy of Qi, Yan Ying met with King Ling of Chu and defended the dignity of his state with his wisdom.

description.zh-cn: 多次劝谏齐景公，阻止其奢侈无度、大造宫室、加重刑罚等行为。
description.en: Repeatedly advised Duke Jing of Qi, dissuading him from extravagance, excessive construction of palaces, and harsh punishments.

description.zh-cn: 孔子称赞晏婴能体恤民情（“景公能行其所善也”），善于与人交往（“善与人交，久而敬之”），并称其为君子。
description.en: Confucius praised Yan Ying for being able to understand the people's suffering, for being skilled in interacting with others ('Good at associating with people, and respecting them over time'), and called him a true gentleman (junzi).

description.zh-cn: 晏婴在路上遇到被囚禁的贤人越石父，将他赎出并待为贵宾。
description.en: Yan Ying encountered the worthy man Yue Shifu in chains on the road, ransomed him, and treated him as an honored guest.

description.zh-cn: 孟子称赞晏婴使其君主显名。
description.en: Mencius praised Yan Ying for making his ruler illustrious.

description.zh-cn: 司马迁在《史记》中高度评价晏婴，称其“进思尽忠，退思补过”，并表达了对他的仰慕。
description.en: Sima Qian highly praised Yan Ying in the 'Records of the Grand Historian', describing him as 'When advancing, he thought of utmost loyalty; when retreating, he thought of making up for faults,' and expressed his admiration.

description.zh-cn: 郭庆所属的中共地下组织由张志忠等人领导。
description.en: The CCP underground organization Guo Qing belonged to was led by Zhang Zhizhong and others.

description.zh-cn: 经钟心宽介绍，郭庆参加了中国共产党的地下组织。
description.en: Through Zhong Xinkuan's introduction, Guo Qing joined the underground organization of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政府以“意图颠覆政府”为由将郭庆逮捕并处决。
description.en: The government of the Republic of China arrested and executed Guo Qing on charges of "intending to subvert the government".

description.zh-cn: 郭庆是台湾白色恐怖时期的政治受难者之一，在此期间被政府处决。
description.en: Guo Qing was one of the political victims of the White Terror period in Taiwan and was executed by the government during this time.

description.zh-cn: 于2018年12月7日正式公告撤销郭庆的有罪判决，为其平反。
description.en: On December 7, 2018, it officially announced the revocation of Guo Qing's guilty verdict, posthumously rehabilitating him.

description.zh-cn: 郭庆被枪决后，被埋葬于台北六张犁，其墓碑后于此地被发现。
description.en: After his execution, Guo Qing was buried at Liuzhangli in Taipei, where his tombstone was later discovered.

description.zh-cn: 郭庆利用国民党政府的三七五减租政策，推动业佃谈判，以发展共产党组织。
description.en: Guo Qing used the Kuomintang government's 375 Rent Reduction policy to promote negotiations between landlords and tenants in order to expand the Communist Party organization.

description.zh-cn: 根据资料，李明是四川成都人。
description.en: According to the information, Li Ming is from Chengdu, Sichuan.

description.zh-cn: 李明是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Li Ming is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 李明是中华人民共和国公民。
description.en: Li Ming is a citizen of the People's Republic of China.

position.zh-cn: 解放军和武警部队代表
position.en: Delegate of the People's Liberation Army and People's Armed Police Force

description.zh-cn: 2018年，李明被选为解放军和武警部队出席第十三届全国人民代表大会代表。
description.en: In 2018, Li Ming was elected as a delegate of the People's Liberation Army and Armed Police Force to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 刘晓连是中华人民共和国的飞行员。
description.en: Liu Xiaolian is a pilot of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 刘晓连担任中国人民解放军空军指挥学院副院长。
description.en: Liu Xiaolian served as the Deputy Dean of the PLA Air Force Command College.

description.zh-cn: 刘晓连曾担任中华全国妇女联合会副主席。
description.en: Liu Xiaolian previously served as the Vice Chairperson of the All-China Women's Federation.

description.zh-cn: 刘晓连是第六届和第七届全国人民代表大会代表。
description.en: Liu Xiaolian was a deputy to the 6th and 7th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 文心一言被媒体视为ChatGPT在中国市场的竞争对手。
description.en: ERNIE Bot is considered by the media as a competitor to ChatGPT in the Chinese market.

description.zh-cn: 百度公司声称，其最新版本的文心一言模型在多个中文功能方面表现优于GPT-4。
description.en: Baidu claimed that the latest version of its ERNIE Bot model outperformed GPT-4 in several Chinese language capabilities.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政府批准百度公司向公众开放其生成式人工智能产品文心一言，使其成为首批获批的同类产品之一。
description.en: The government of the People's Republic of China approved Baidu to open its generative AI product ERNIE Bot to the public, making it one of the first such products to receive approval.

description.zh-cn: 在路透社的测试中，文心一言通过答非所问或建议更换主题的方式，回避了关于中国政治的敏感问题。
description.en: In tests conducted by Reuters, ERNIE Bot evaded sensitive questions about Chinese politics by giving non-sequitur answers or suggesting changing the topic.

description.zh-cn: 因内置的审查机制，文心一言会回避或过滤关于习近平的敏感提问。
description.en: Due to its built-in censorship mechanism, ERNIE Bot evades or filters sensitive questions about Xi Jinping.

description.zh-cn: 因内置的审查机制，文心一言会回避或过滤关于六四事件的敏感提问。
description.en: Due to its built-in censorship mechanism, ERNIE Bot evades or filters sensitive questions about the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests and massacre.

description.zh-cn: 国家互联网信息办公室规定生成式人工智能服务应“体现社会主义核心价值观”，此规定影响了文心一言的内容生成策略。
description.en: The Cyberspace Administration of China stipulates that generative AI services should 'embody core socialist values', a regulation that influences ERNIE Bot's content generation strategy.

description.zh-cn: 针对外界关于文心一言AI作画功能调用Stable Diffusion的质疑，百度公司予以否认，并声明其技术完全自研。
description.en: In response to external speculation that ERNIE Bot's AI image generation feature uses Stable Diffusion, Baidu denied the claim and stated its technology is entirely self-developed.

description.zh-cn: 百度公司将文心一言app在苹果公司的App Store上架。
description.en: Baidu launched the ERNIE Bot app on Apple's App Store.

description.zh-cn: App Store是苹果公司为其操作系统创建和维护的移动应用程序数字发行平台。
description.en: The App Store is a mobile application digital distribution platform created and maintained by Apple Inc. for its operating systems.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命导致普通高等学校招生全国统一考试（高考）长期中断。
description.en: The Cultural Revolution caused a long-term suspension of the National College Entrance Examination (Gaokao).

description.zh-cn: 1977年8月，邓小平主持召开科学和教育工作座谈会，决定恢复高考。
description.en: In August 1977, Deng Xiaoping presided over a symposium on science and education, where the decision was made to restore the Gaokao.

description.zh-cn: 1977年10月22日，《人民日报》发表文章，正式向全国宣布恢复高考。
description.en: On October 22, 1977, the People's Daily published an article, formally announcing the restoration of the Gaokao to the nation.

description.zh-cn: 1977年恢复高考，直接招收并形成了77-78级大学生群体。
description.en: The restoration of the Gaokao in 1977 directly led to the enrollment and formation of the Class of 77-78 university students.

description.zh-cn: 恢复高考的消息使得许多上山下乡的知青们感到鼓舞和兴奋，为他们提供了改变命运的机会。
description.en: The news of the Gaokao's restoration encouraged and excited many sent-down youths, providing them with an opportunity to change their fate.

description.zh-cn: 77-78级毕业生在急需人才的改革开放中发挥了重要作用。
description.en: Graduates of the Class of 77-78 played a significant role during the Reform and Opening-up era, which had an urgent need for talented individuals.

description.zh-cn: 上山下乡运动是文化大革命期间的一项重要政治运动。
description.en: The Up to the Mountains and Down to the Countryside Movement was a major political campaign during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 上山下乡运动将大量城市知识青年送往农村，形成了“知青”这一群体。
description.en: The Up to the Mountains and Down to the Countryside Movement sent large numbers of urban intellectual youth to the countryside, forming the 'Zhiqing' group.

description.zh-cn: 在“上山下乡”运动中，知青被要求接受贫下中农的再教育。
description.en: During the 'Up to the Mountains and Down to the Countryside Movement', the sent-down youth were required to undergo re-education from the poor and lower-middle peasants.

description.zh-cn: 77-78级大学生在“读书无用论”盛行的时代依然坚持读书，该理论是他们求学路上的思想障碍。
description.en: The Class of 77-78 persisted in studying during an era when the 'theory that studying is useless' was prevalent, making this theory an ideological obstacle to their education.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，大学招生采用推荐制，产生了工农兵学员这一群体。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, universities used a recommendation-based enrollment system, which produced the group of Worker-Peasant-Soldier students.

description.en: According to its Wikipedia category, the Koo Foundation is part of the Koos Group.

description.en: Ren Fengxia served as the Vice Chairman of the Jilin Provincial Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类“长春人”，任凤霞出生于长春市。
description.en: According to the Wikipedia category 'People from Changchun', Ren Fengxia was born in Changchun.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类“东北师范大学校友”，任凤霞是东北师范大学的校友。
description.en: According to the Wikipedia category 'Northeast Normal University alumni', Ren Fengxia is an alumna of Northeast Normal University.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类“中国共产党党员”，任凤霞是中国共产党的党员。
description.en: According to the Wikipedia category 'Communist Party of China members', Ren Fengxia is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类和导航模板，任凤霞是中国电视艺术家协会的会员，并曾担任其第三届和第四届理事会的理事。

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来曾任中共重庆市委书记，于2012年3月15日被免职。
description.en: Bo Xilai served as the Secretary of the CPC Chongqing Municipal Committee and was dismissed on March 15, 2012.

description.zh-cn: 2008年金融海啸后中国经济发展遭遇瓶颈，在此背景下，重庆的经济发展表现使其“重庆模式”受到关注。
description.en: After the 2008 financial crisis caused a bottleneck in China's economic development, Chongqing's economic performance brought attention to its 'Chongqing Model'.

description.zh-cn: 重庆模式吸引了中国左派人士的关注和支持，并由他们将其归结为一种发展模式。
description.en: The Chongqing Model attracted the attention and support of Chinese leftists, who summarized it as a development model.

description.zh-cn: 随着王立军事件的爆发及薄熙来的去职，重庆模式随之终结。
description.en: Following the outbreak of the Wang Lijun incident and the removal of Bo Xilai, the Chongqing Model came to an end.

description.zh-cn: 2008年6月，王立军调任重庆市公安局局长。
description.en: In June 2008, Wang Lijun was transferred to the position of Director of the Chongqing Municipal Public Security Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 李庄案是重庆打黑运动中引发巨大争议的标志性案件。
description.en: The Li Zhuang case was a landmark controversial case that arose from the Chongqing 'strike black' campaign.

description.zh-cn: “唱红歌、读经典、讲故事、传箴言”活动是重庆模式在意识形态领域的重要组成部分。
description.en: The 'Singing red songs, reading classics, telling stories, and spreading maxims' campaign was an important ideological component of the Chongqing Model.

description.zh-cn: 美国前国务卿基辛格对薄熙来时期重庆的发展持正面评价。
description.en: Former U.S. Secretary of State Henry Kissinger held a positive evaluation of Chongqing's development during Bo Xilai's era.

description.zh-cn: 反对者认为，重庆模式是回到毛泽东时代的极左模式，体现了毛泽东时代的部分特征。
description.en: Opponents believed that the Chongqing Model was a return to the ultra-leftist model of the Mao Zedong era, reflecting some of its characteristics.

description.zh-cn: 法学家何兵批评重庆模式中的“打黑”是“黑打”，破坏了法制。
description.en: Legal scholar He Bing criticized the 'strike black' campaign within the Chongqing Model as an illegal crackdown that undermined the rule of law.

description.zh-cn: 法学家张千帆批评重庆模式中的“打黑”是“黑打”，破坏了法制。
description.en: Legal scholar Zhang Qianfan criticized the 'strike black' campaign within the Chongqing Model as an illegal crackdown that undermined the rule of law.

description.zh-cn: 经济学家夏业良批评重庆的户籍新政策是一种剥夺。
description.en: Economist Xia Yeliang criticized Chongqing's new household registration policy as a form of deprivation.

description.zh-cn: 在一次中共中央政治局会议上，习近平评价重庆模式是服务于薄熙来个人政治野心的“为自己造势的行动”。
description.en: At a Politburo meeting, Xi Jinping evaluated the Chongqing Model as 'an action to build momentum for himself' that served Bo Xilai's personal political ambitions.

description.zh-cn: 在中共十八大期间，接任重庆市委书记的张德江公开声称“根本就不存在重庆模式”，从官方层面否定了该模式。
description.en: During the 18th CPC National Congress, Zhang Dejiang, the new Party Secretary of Chongqing, publicly stated that 'the Chongqing Model fundamentally does not exist,' officially negating the model.

description.zh-cn: 作为左派网站，乌有之乡曾开设专题区赞扬重庆模式，是其重要的舆论支持者。
description.en: As a left-wing website, Utopia created a special section to praise the Chongqing Model, acting as one of its important public opinion supporters.

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来担任中共重庆市委书记期间，黄奇帆担任重庆市市长，两人是“重庆模式”时期的主要党政领导。
description.en: While Bo Xilai was the CPC Secretary of Chongqing, Huang Qifan was the Mayor. They were the main party and government leaders during the 'Chongqing Model' era.

description.zh-cn: 审议并最终通过了《中华人民共和国治安管理处罚法》的修订案。

description.zh-cn: 作为司法部部长，在第十四届全国人大常委会上就《中华人民共和国治安管理处罚法（修订草案）》作说明，推动了修订进程。

description.zh-cn: 劳东燕是清华大学法学院的教授。
description.en: Lao Dongyan is a professor at Tsinghua University School of Law.

description.zh-cn: 批评2023年修订草案中“伤害中华民族感情”的条款，认为需要对相关情况进行细化以避免误解。
description.en: Criticized the 'hurting the feelings of the Chinese nation' clause in the 2023 draft amendment, arguing that it needed to be more specific to avoid misunderstanding.

description.zh-cn: 对《治安管理处罚法》2023年修订草案提出了批评意见。
description.en: Raised critical opinions on the 2023 draft amendment to the 'Public Security Administration Punishments Law'.

description.zh-cn: 对《治安管理处罚法》2023年修订草案提出了批评意见。
description.en: Raised critical opinions on the 2023 draft amendment to the 'Public Security Administration Punishments Law'.

description.zh-cn: 对2023年修订草案中将“侮辱”、“谩骂”视为阻碍执行职务的行为表示担忧，认为其违背了“少拘慎罚”的法治观念。
description.en: Expressed concern that classifying 'insult' and 'verbal abuse' as obstruction of duty in the 2023 draft amendment violates the legal principle of 'less and cautious detention and punishment'.

description.zh-cn: 在2019冠状病毒病疫情期间，地方政府在未依法宣布进入紧急状态的情况下，引用该法第五十条关于“紧急状态”的规定对违反防疫规定的行为进行处罚，引发了对该条款适用范围的争议。
description.en: During the COVID-19 pandemic, local governments cited Article 50 of the law regarding 'state of emergency' to punish violations of pandemic control measures without legally declaring a state of emergency, sparking controversy over the scope of the clause's application.

description.zh-cn: 《中华人民共和国宪法》规定县为直属省级政府管辖的“第二级地方行政单位”，奠定了县级行政区划的法律地位。
description.en: The Constitution of the People's Republic of China stipulates that counties are 'second-level local administrative units' directly under the jurisdiction of provincial governments, establishing the legal status of county-level divisions.

description.zh-cn: 提议在中国人民大学外交系的基础上建立外交学院，并亲自为学院题写校牌，其提出的十六字方针也成为校训。
description.en: Proposed the establishment of China Foreign Affairs University based on the Department of Diplomacy of Renmin University of China, personally wrote the school name, and his sixteen-character principle became the school motto.

description.zh-cn: 批准在中国人民大学外交系基础上筹建外交学院。
description.en: Approved the establishment of China Foreign Affairs University based on the Department of Diplomacy of Renmin University of China.

description.zh-cn: 外交学院是中华人民共和国外交部直属高校。
description.en: China Foreign Affairs University is an institution directly under the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 外交学院在中国人民大学外交系的基础上建立，其教师队伍大部、全部学生和部分行政管理干部转入外交学院。
description.en: China Foreign Affairs University was established on the basis of the Department of Diplomacy of Renmin University of China, with the majority of its faculty, all of its students, and some administrative staff being transferred to the new university.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命开始后，外交学院教学工作被迫停止，并最终于1970年1月3日废校。
description.en: After the start of the Cultural Revolution, teaching at China Foreign Affairs University was forced to stop, and the university was eventually closed on January 3, 1970.

description.zh-cn: 在外交部造反派的压力下，被迫同意停办外交学院。
description.en: Under pressure from the rebel faction of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, he was forced to agree to the closure of China Foreign Affairs University.

description.zh-cn: 收到外交学院老职工请求恢复学院的联名信后，批示李先念考虑此事，推动了学院的恢复。
description.en: After receiving a joint letter from former staff of China Foreign Affairs University requesting its re-establishment, he instructed Li Xiannian to consider the matter, which promoted the university's restoration.

description.zh-cn: 在收到请求恢复外交学院的联名信后，批示“请先念同志考虑”。
description.en: After receiving a joint letter requesting the re-establishment of China Foreign Affairs University, he instructed: 'Please have Comrade Xiannian consider it.'

description.zh-cn: 1980年5月7日，外交部签发通知，同意外交学院在原址恢复。2014年1月3日，外交部决定与外交学院共建，并在政策、经费、学科建设等方面加大支持力度。
description.en: On May 7, 1980, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs issued a notice approving the re-establishment of China Foreign Affairs University at its original site. On January 3, 2014, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs decided to jointly build the university, increasing support for it in terms of policy, funding, and discipline construction.

description.zh-cn: 与教育部决定共建外交学院，在政策、经费、学科建设等方面加大对学院的支持力度。
description.en: Decided to jointly build China Foreign Affairs University with the Ministry of Education, increasing support for the university in terms of policy, funding, and discipline construction.

description.zh-cn: 1965年，外交学院原外事干部学校部分分出，建立了国际关系学院。
description.en: In 1965, the part of the former Foreign Affairs Cadre School of China Foreign Affairs University was split off to establish the University of International Relations.

description.zh-cn: 为外交学院沙河校区赠送了“中国外交官的摇篮”的亲笔题词，并出席了周恩来和陈毅铜像的揭幕仪式。
description.en: Presented a personally inscribed piece of calligraphy reading 'The Cradle of Chinese Diplomats' to the Shahe Campus of China Foreign Affairs University and attended the unveiling ceremony of the bronze statues of Zhou Enlai and Chen Yi.

description.zh-cn: 两校学生对“外交官摇篮”称号的归属问题十分敏感，因此多次在网上爆发争执矛盾。
description.en: Students from both universities are very sensitive about the ownership of the title 'cradle of diplomats,' leading to frequent disputes and conflicts online.

description.zh-cn: 外交学院建校初期，曾在原北京外国语学院校舍开课。
description.en: In its early days, China Foreign Affairs University held classes on the campus of the former Beijing Foreign Languages Institute.

description.zh-cn: 举行了第一届模拟联合国大会，是中国大陆第一所举办模拟联合国活动的高校。
description.en: Held its first Model United Nations conference, becoming the first university in mainland China to host a Model UN event.

description.zh-cn: 在外交学院演讲时，称外交学院是“积极、互动地讨论与中国有关的各项议题的权威论坛”。
description.en: During a speech at China Foreign Affairs University, he called it 'an authoritative forum for active and interactive discussions on various issues related to China'.

description.zh-cn: 在外交学院演讲时，称外交学院是为“中国外交培养最优秀的人才”的高等学校。
description.en: During a speech at China Foreign Affairs University, he referred to it as an institution of higher learning that 'cultivates the most outstanding talents for Chinese diplomacy'.

description.zh-cn: 在外交学院演讲时，称外交学院为“培育外交人才的摇篮”。
description.en: During a speech at China Foreign Affairs University, he called it 'the cradle for cultivating diplomatic talent'.

description.zh-cn: 1991年5月至1992年4月任代理党委书记。
description.en: Served as Acting Party Secretary from May 1991 to April 1992.

description.zh-cn: 宋关昶籍贯为浙江绍兴，是绍兴人。
description.en: Song Guanchang's ancestral home is Shaoxing, Zhejiang, and he is a native of Shaoxing.

description.zh-cn: 宋关昶是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Song Guanchang is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 宋关昶是中华人民共和国的政治人物。
description.en: Song Guanchang is a political figure in the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 2018年，宋关昶被选为甘肃省出席第十三届全国人民代表大会的代表。
description.en: In 2018, Song Guanchang was elected as a deputy from Gansu Province to the 13th National People's Congress.

position.en: Deputy to the National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 宋关昶的职务为全国人大代表。
description.en: Song Guanchang's title is Deputy to the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 杨德广曾任上海大学校长。
description.en: Yang Deguang formerly served as the President of Shanghai University.

description.zh-cn: 杨德广曾任上海师范大学校长。
description.en: Yang Deguang formerly served as the President of Shanghai Normal University.

description.zh-cn: 杨德广曾任中国高等教育学会副会长。他还曾担任该学会常务理事，涉及第三届、第四届、第五届理事会。
description.en: Yang Deguang formerly served as the Vice President of the China Association of Higher Education. He also served as a Standing Council Member of the association, involved in the 3rd, 4th, and 5th councils.

description.zh-cn: 汪明荃是四朵金花的成员，负责编舞。
description.en: Liza Wang was a member of the Four Golden Flowers, responsible for choreography.

description.zh-cn: 王爱明是四朵金花的成员，负责服装及造型设计。
description.en: Wong Oi-ming was a member of the Four Golden Flowers, responsible for costume and styling design.

description.zh-cn: 张德兰是四朵金花的成员，负责和音。
description.en: Teresa Cheung was a member of the Four Golden Flowers, responsible for harmony vocals.

description.zh-cn: 四朵金花是无线电视旗下的女子音乐组合，由其担任经纪公司。
description.en: The Four Golden Flowers was a female music group under Television Broadcasts Limited (TVB), which served as their management agency.

description.zh-cn: 四朵金花是在综艺节目《欢乐今宵》中组成并进行歌舞演出的组合。
description.en: The Four Golden Flowers was a group formed and performing song and dance numbers on the variety show 'Enjoy Yourself Tonight'.

description.zh-cn: 时任《欢乐今宵》司仪的谭炳文将该组合命名为“四朵金花”。
description.en: Tam Ping-man, then host of 'Enjoy Yourself Tonight', named the group 'Four Golden Flowers'.

description.zh-cn: 苏翁为四朵金花创作了同名代表歌曲《四朵金花》。
description.en: So Yung composed the signature song of the same name for the Four Golden Flowers.

description.zh-cn: 就读于轻工系发酵工程专业。
description.en: Studied in the Department of Light Industry, majoring in Fermentation Engineering.

description.zh-cn: 在担任习酒董事长期间，通过推出窖藏1988、君品习酒等产品，成功将习酒打造成高端品牌。
description.en: During his tenure as Chairman of Xijiu, he successfully developed Xijiu into a high-end brand by launching products such as Jiaocang 1988 and Junpin Xijiu.

description.zh-cn: 张德芹接替丁雄军出任贵州茅台集团董事长。
description.en: Zhang Deqin succeeded Ding Xiongjun as Chairman of Kweichow Moutai Group.

description.zh-cn: 信息来源于维基百科分类“北京大学校友”。
description.en: Information sourced from the Wikipedia category 'Peking University alumni'.

description.zh-cn: 信息来源于维基百科分类“西北大学校友”。
description.en: Information sourced from the Wikipedia category 'Northwest University (China) alumni'.

description.zh-cn: 信息来源于维基百科分类“中欧国际工商学院校友”。
description.en: Information sourced from the Wikipedia category 'China Europe International Business School alumni'.

description.zh-cn: 作为签署方之一，与美国政府共同发表了《中美建交公报》。
description.en: As one of the signatories, jointly issued the Joint Communiqué on the Establishment of Diplomatic Relations with the U.S. government.

description.zh-cn: 作为签署方之一，与中华人民共和国政府共同发表了《中美建交公报》。
description.en: As one of the signatories, jointly issued the Joint Communiqué on the Establishment of Diplomatic Relations with the government of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 代表美国政府签署了《上海公报》。
description.en: Signed the Shanghai Communiqué on behalf of the United States government.

position.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院总理
position.en: Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 代表中华人民共和国政府签署了《上海公报》。
description.en: Signed the Shanghai Communiqué on behalf of the government of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 《上海公报》中，美方承诺将逐步减少驻台美军设施和武装力量，此后驻台美军人数开始下降。
description.en: In the Shanghai Communiqué, the U.S. side pledged to progressively reduce its military installations and armed forces in Taiwan, after which the number of U.S. troops in Taiwan began to decline.

description.zh-cn: 在该公报中，美国政府承认中华人民共和国政府是中国的唯一合法政府，加强了其在国际上的合法性。
description.en: In this communiqué, the U.S. government recognized the government of the People's Republic of China as the sole legal government of China, enhancing its international legitimacy.

description.zh-cn: 美国在该公报中承认中华人民共和国政府为中国唯一合法政府，是对坚持拥有全中国主权的中华民国政府的又一次外交打击。
description.en: The U.S. recognition of the PRC government as the sole legal government of China in this communiqué was another diplomatic blow to the Republic of China government, which still claimed sovereignty over all of China.

description.zh-cn: 该决议导致中华民国政府失去在联合国的中国代表权，是其在国际外交上的重大挫折。
description.en: This resolution caused the Government of the Republic of China to lose its representation of China in the United Nations, a major setback in its international diplomacy.

description.zh-cn: 《中美建交公报》在邓小平访美前夕公布，为此次访问铺平了道路。
description.en: The Joint Communiqué on the Establishment of Diplomatic Relations was announced on the eve of Deng Xiaoping's visit to the U.S., paving the way for the visit.

description.zh-cn: 该公报旨在彻底停止美国对台武器出售问题，美方在公报中承诺准备逐步减少对台军售。
description.en: This communiqué was intended to bring about a final resolution to the issue of U.S. arms sales to Taiwan, with the U.S. side promising in the communiqué that it was prepared to gradually reduce its arms sales to Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 其总统任内，美国政府在发布八一七公报的同时，向台湾提出六项保证作为单方面说明。
description.en: During his presidency, the U.S. government, concurrent with the issuance of the August 17th Communiqué, presented the Six Assurances to Taiwan as a unilateral explanation.

description.zh-cn: 《六项保证》是美国政府作为对《八一七公报》的单方面内容说明而提出的，影响了美方对该公报的解释和执行。
description.en: The Six Assurances were presented by the U.S. government as a unilateral explanation of the August 17th Communiqué, influencing the U.S. interpretation and implementation of the communiqué.

description.zh-cn: 在签署《八一七公报》当天，里根发布内部备忘录，将美国减少对台军售的意愿与中国推行和平解决方案的前提联系起来，为持续对台军售提供了依据。
description.en: On the same day the August 17th Communiqué was signed, Reagan issued an internal memorandum linking the U.S. willingness to reduce arms sales to Taiwan to the premise of China's continued pursuit of a peaceful solution, providing a basis for continued arms sales to Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 乔治·舒尔茨在罗纳德·里根总统任内担任国务卿。
description.en: George Shultz served as Secretary of State under President Ronald Reagan.

description.zh-cn: 卡斯帕·温伯格在罗纳德·里根总统任内担任国防部长。
description.en: Caspar Weinberger served as Secretary of Defense under President Ronald Reagan.

description.zh-cn: 尼克松访华后，亲自向时任中华民国驻美大使沈剑虹说明情况并提出保证。
description.en: After his visit to China, Nixon personally met with James Shen, then the Republic of China's ambassador to the U.S., to explain the situation and offer assurances.

description.zh-cn: 在《上海公报》中，中方坚决反对任何旨在制造“一中一台”的活动。
description.en: In the Shanghai Communiqué, the Chinese side firmly opposed any activities aimed at creating 'One China, One Taiwan'.

description.zh-cn: 在《上海公报》中，中方坚决反对任何旨在制造“一个中国、两个政府”的活动。
description.en: In the Shanghai Communiqué, the Chinese side firmly opposed any activities aimed at creating 'One China, two governments'.

description.zh-cn: 在《上海公报》中，中方坚决反对任何旨在制造“两个中国”的活动。
description.en: In the Shanghai Communiqué, the Chinese side firmly opposed any activities aimed at creating 'Two Chinas'.

description.zh-cn: 在《上海公报》中，中方坚决反对任何旨在制造“台湾独立”的活动。
description.en: In the Shanghai Communiqué, the Chinese side firmly opposed any activities aimed at creating 'Taiwan independence'.

description.zh-cn: 在《上海公报》中，中方坚决反对任何鼓吹“台湾地位未定论”的活动。
description.en: In the Shanghai Communiqué, the Chinese side firmly opposed any activities that advocated the 'Theory of the Undetermined Status of Taiwan'.

description.zh-cn: 美国在台协会于2020年公布了关于六项保证内容的解密电报。
description.en: In 2020, the American Institute in Taiwan published declassified telegrams regarding the content of the Six Assurances.

description.zh-cn: 黄连珍出生于浙江省临安县。
description.en: Huang Lianzhen was born in Lin'an County, Zhejiang Province.

description.zh-cn: 黄连珍是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Huang Lianzhen is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 2018年，黄连珍被选为第十三届全国人民代表大会代表。
description.en: In 2018, Huang Lianzhen was elected as a deputy to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 黄连珍作为解放军和武警部队代表团成员出席第十三届全国人民代表大会。
description.en: Huang Lianzhen attended the 13th National People's Congress as a member of the People's Liberation Army and People's Armed Police Force delegation.

description.zh-cn: 《维护国家安全条例》是香港特别行政区为履行《基本法》第二十三条规定的宪制责任而进行的本地立法。
description.en: The Safeguarding National Security Ordinance is local legislation enacted by the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to fulfill its constitutional responsibility as stipulated in Article 23 of the Basic Law.

description.zh-cn: 2014年4月15日，习近平在中央国家安全委员会第一次会议上提出“总体国家安全观”。
description.en: On April 15, 2014, Xi Jinping proposed the 'Overall National Security Concept' at the first meeting of the Central National Security Commission.

description.zh-cn: 《维护国家安全条例》以“总体国家安全观”为指导原则。
description.en: The Safeguarding National Security Ordinance is guided by the 'Overall National Security Concept'.

description.zh-cn: 邓炳强作为保安局局长，于2024年3月8日向立法会提交《维护国家安全条例草案》。
description.en: As the Secretary for Security, Chris Tang introduced the Safeguarding National Security Bill to the Legislative Council on March 8, 2024.

description.zh-cn: 50万名香港市民参与七一游行反对为《基本法》第二十三条立法，最终导致政府撤回《国家安全（立法条文）条例草案》。
description.en: 500,000 Hong Kong citizens participated in the July 1st march to oppose the legislation of Article 23 of the Basic Law, which ultimately led to the government's withdrawal of the National Security (Legislative Provisions) Bill.

description.zh-cn: 在巨大争议和大规模抗议后，香港政府于2003年9月5日最终撤回《国家安全（立法条文）条例草案》。
description.en: After significant controversy and large-scale protests, the Hong Kong government ultimately withdrew the National Security (Legislative Provisions) Bill on September 5, 2003.

description.zh-cn: 2019年爆发的“反送中”运动，促使中央政府制定并在香港实施《香港国安法》以“止暴制乱”。
description.en: The Anti-Extradition Law Amendment Bill Movement that broke out in 2019 prompted the Central Government to enact and implement the Hong Kong National Security Law to 'stop violence and curb disorder'.

description.zh-cn: 第十三届全国人大常委会于2020年6月30日表决通过《中华人民共和国香港特别行政区维护国家安全法》。
description.en: The Standing Committee of the 13th National People's Congress voted to pass the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region on June 30, 2020.

description.zh-cn: 《香港国安法》未涵盖《基本法》第二十三条规定的所有罪行，因此特区政府认为仍有必要进行本地立法以完成宪制责任。
description.en: The Hong Kong National Security Law did not cover all the offenses stipulated in Article 23 of the Basic Law, thus the HKSAR government deemed it necessary to proceed with local legislation to fulfill its constitutional duty.

description.zh-cn: 丁薛祥在会见港澳人大代表团时表示，香港基本法第23条要尽早完成立法。
description.en: During a meeting with NPC deputies from Hong Kong and Macau, Ding Xuexiang stated that the legislation of Article 23 of the Hong Kong Basic Law should be completed as soon as possible.

description.zh-cn: 香港警方国安处首次引用《维护国家安全条例》，拘捕了包括邹幸彤在内的多人，指控其涉嫌违反“煽动意图的相关罪行”。
description.en: The National Security Department of the Hong Kong Police Force invoked the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance for the first time to arrest multiple individuals, including Chow Hang-tung, on suspicion of 'offences in connection with seditious intention'.

description.zh-cn: 香港政府引用《维护国家安全条例》，对罗冠聪等六名潜逃英国人士采取限制措施，包括撤销其特区护照。
description.en: The Hong Kong government invoked the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance to impose restrictive measures on six fugitives in the UK, including Nathan Law, such as the cancellation of his HKSAR passport.

description.zh-cn: 香港政府引用《维护国家安全条例》，对刘祖廸等六名潜逃英国人士采取限制措施。
description.en: The Hong Kong government invoked the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance to impose restrictive measures on six fugitives in the UK, including Finn Lau.

description.zh-cn: 香港政府引用《维护国家安全条例》，对郑文杰等六名潜逃英国人士采取限制措施。
description.en: The Hong Kong government invoked the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance to impose restrictive measures on six fugitives in the UK, including Simon Cheng.

description.zh-cn: 香港政府引用《维护国家安全条例》，对蔡明达等六名潜逃英国人士采取限制措施。
description.en: The Hong Kong government invoked the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance to impose restrictive measures on six fugitives in the UK, including Choi Ming-da.

description.zh-cn: 香港政府引用《维护国家安全条例》，将许智峰列为“潜逃者”并实施限制措施。
description.en: The Hong Kong government invoked the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance to declare Ted Hui a 'fugitive' and impose restrictive measures.

description.zh-cn: 香港政府引用《维护国家安全条例》，将郭荣铿列为“潜逃者”并实施限制措施。
description.en: The Hong Kong government invoked the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance to declare Dennis Kwok a 'fugitive' and impose restrictive measures.

description.zh-cn: 美国国务院就《维护国家安全条例》的通过表示担忧，认为其定义不明确，可能加速香港社会的封闭。
description.en: The U.S. Department of State expressed concern over the passage of the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance, stating that its vague definitions could accelerate the closing of Hong Kong's society.

description.zh-cn: 美国国务卿布林肯表示该条例可能对在港美国公民和企业产生广泛影响，并宣布对香港官员实施签证限制。
description.en: U.S. Secretary of State Antony Blinken stated the ordinance could have a broad impact on American citizens and businesses in Hong Kong and announced visa restrictions on Hong Kong officials.

description.zh-cn: 英国外交大臣卡梅伦表示该条例将进一步损害香港的权利和自由。
description.en: UK Foreign Secretary David Cameron stated the ordinance would 'further damage the rights and freedoms' in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 欧盟发表声明称，《维护国家安全条例》可能会加剧对香港基本自由和政治多元化的侵蚀。
description.en: The EU issued a statement saying the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance could exacerbate the 'erosion of fundamental freedoms and political pluralism' in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 社会民主连线成员在政府总部门外抗议二十三条立法。
description.en: Members of the League of Social Democrats protested against the Article 23 legislation outside the Central Government Offices.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央港澳办就《维护国家安全条例》全票通过发布声明祝贺，形容此举开启“由治及兴”的新篇章。
description.en: The Hong Kong and Macao Work Office of the CCP Central Committee issued a statement congratulating the unanimous passage of the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance, describing it as opening a new chapter of 'moving from governance to prosperity'.

description.zh-cn: 明朝后期，宗人府归于礼部管理，其所管辖的事都移交给礼部。
description.en: In the later period of the Ming Dynasty, the Zongrenfu was placed under the administration of the Ministry of Rites, and all its affairs were transferred to the Ministry of Rites.

description.zh-cn: 明朝初期，秦王朱樉担任宗人府的宗人令。
description.en: In the early Ming Dynasty, Zhu Shuang, Prince of Qin, served as the Zongren Ling of the Zongrenfu.

position.en: Left Zongzheng (Grand marshal of the Left)

description.zh-cn: 明朝初期，晋王朱㭎担任宗人府的左宗正。
description.en: In the early Ming Dynasty, Zhu Gang, Prince of Jin, served as the Left Zongzheng of the Zongrenfu.

position.en: Right Zongzheng (Grand marshal of the Right)

description.zh-cn: 明朝初期，燕王朱棣担任宗人府的右宗正。
description.en: In the early Ming Dynasty, Zhu Di, Prince of Yan, served as the Right Zongzheng of the Zongrenfu.

description.zh-cn: 明朝初期，周王朱橚担任宗人府的左宗人。
description.en: In the early Ming Dynasty, Zhu Su, Prince of Zhou, served as the Left Zongren of the Zongrenfu.

description.zh-cn: 明朝初期，楚王朱桢担任宗人府的右宗人。
description.en: In the early Ming Dynasty, Zhu Zhen, Prince of Chu, served as the Right Zongren of the Zongrenfu.

description.zh-cn: 清朝沿设明制，于顺治九年（1652年）设立宗人府。
description.en: The Qing dynasty followed the Ming system and established the Zongrenfu in 1652 (the ninth year of the Shunzhi reign).

description.zh-cn: 雍正二年（1724年），宗人府的郎中改称为理事官。
description.en: In 1724 (the second year of the Yongzheng reign), the title of Langzhong in the Zongrenfu was changed to Lisiguan (Director).

description.zh-cn: 雍正二年（1724年），宗人府的员外郎改称为副理事官。
description.en: In 1724 (the second year of the Yongzheng reign), the title of Yuanwailang in the Zongrenfu was changed to Fulisiguan (Deputy Director).

description.zh-cn: 后黎朝时期，大宗正府改名为宗人府。
description.en: During the Later Lê dynasty, the Dazongzhengfu was renamed Zongrenfu (越南).

description.zh-cn: 赵继东是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Zhao Jidong is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 赵继东拥有中国人民武装警察部队少将警衔。
description.en: Zhao Jidong holds the rank of Major General in the People's Armed Police Force.

description.zh-cn: 赵继东曾任广东省政协常委。
description.en: Zhao Jidong served as a Standing Committee Member of the Guangdong Provincial Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 赵继东曾任中国人民武装警察部队广东省总队司令员。
description.en: Zhao Jidong served as the Commander of the Guangdong Provincial Corps of the People's Armed Police Force.

description.zh-cn: 赵继东曾任武警8630部队师长。
description.en: Zhao Jidong served as the Division Commander of the PAPF 8630 Unit.

description.zh-cn: 赵继东效忠于中华人民共和国。
description.en: Zhao Jidong is in allegiance with the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民武装警察部队广东省总队是中国人民武装警察部队的下属单位。
description.en: The Guangdong Provincial Corps of the People's Armed Police Force is a subordinate unit of the People's Armed Police Force.

description.zh-cn: 武警8630部队是中国人民武装警察部队的下属单位。
description.en: PAPF Unit 8630 is a subordinate unit of the People's Armed Police Force.

description.zh-cn: 丁国成是黑龙江肇东人。
description.en: Ding Guocheng is from Zhaodong, Heilongjiang.

description.zh-cn: 丁国成担任中华诗词学会副会长，并曾任第一届、第二届、第三届、第四届理事会成员。他也被列为该学会的顾问。
description.en: Ding Guocheng serves as the Vice President of the Chinese Poetry Society and was a member of its first, second, third, and fourth councils. He is also listed as a consultant for the society.

description.zh-cn: 丁国成是中国作家协会会员，曾任第六届、第七届、第八届、第九届全国委员会委员，后成为名誉委员。
description.en: Ding Guocheng is a member of the China Writers Association. He served as a member of the 6th, 7th, 8th, and 9th National Committees, and later became an Honorary Member.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类信息，丁国成是吉林大学的校友。
description.en: According to category information, Ding Guocheng is an alumnus of Jilin University.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类信息，丁国成是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to category information, Ding Guocheng is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 东南互保事件是地方实力派首次公然反抗中央政府，导致清廷威信扫地，中央权威下降。
description.en: The Mutual Protection of Southeast China was the first time regional strongmen openly defied the central government, causing the Qing court to lose its prestige and central authority to decline.

description.zh-cn: 劝告两江总督刘坤一和湖广总督张之洞参与东南互保，倡议抗命。
description.en: Advised Viceroy of Liangjiang Liu Kunyi and Viceroy of Huguang Zhang Zhidong to participate in the Mutual Protection of Southeast China, advocating for defiance of the imperial order.

description.zh-cn: 劝告两江总督刘坤一和湖广总督张之洞参与东南互保，倡议抗命。
description.en: Advised Viceroy of Liangjiang Liu Kunyi and Viceroy of Huguang Zhang Zhidong to participate in the Mutual Protection of Southeast China, advocating for defiance of the imperial order.

description.zh-cn: 与张之洞一同邀约各国驻上海领事商订《东南保护约款》。
description.en: Along with Zhang Zhidong, invited foreign consuls in Shanghai to negotiate and conclude the 'Articles for Mutual Protection of the Southeast'.

description.zh-cn: 与刘坤一一同邀约各国驻上海领事商订《东南保护约款》。
description.en: Along with Liu Kunyi, invited foreign consuls in Shanghai to negotiate and conclude the 'Articles for Mutual Protection of the Southeast'.

description.zh-cn: 东南互保事件中地方势力的崛起和中央权威的衰落，为辛亥革命时各省宣布独立铺垫了基础。
description.en: The rise of regional power and the decline of central authority during the Mutual Protection of Southeast China laid the groundwork for the provinces to declare independence during the Xinhai Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 李鸿章是淮军的创始人和统帅。
description.en: Li Hongzhang was the founder and commander of the Huai Army.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯系的北洋军阀由淮军发展而来。
description.en: The Beiyang warlords under Yuan Shikai developed from the Huai Army.

description.zh-cn: 铁良前往武昌等地，改编或解散了张之洞创办的勇营武装，以加强中央对地方军事的控制。
description.en: Tieliang traveled to Wuchang and other places to reorganize or disband the 'Yong Ying' forces established by Zhang Zhidong, aiming to strengthen central control over regional military.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党中央委员会文化传播委员会是中国国民党中央委员会的下属部门。
description.en: The Kuomintang Central Committee's Cultural and Communications Committee is a subordinate department of the Kuomintang Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 担任中国国民党中央委员会文化传播委员会现任主任委员。
description.en: Serves as the current Director-General of the Kuomintang Central Committee's Cultural and Communications Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政府迁台后，中国国民党进行了改造。
description.en: After the government of the Republic of China relocated to Taiwan, the Kuomintang underwent reforms.

description.zh-cn: 作为国民党改造的一部分，设立了中央委员会第四组以取代原宣传部。
description.en: As part of the Kuomintang's reform, the Central Committee's 4th Group was established to replace the original Propaganda Department.

description.zh-cn: 2000年政党轮替后，国民党进行组织改造，成立了文化传播委员会。
description.en: After the party rotation in 2000, the Kuomintang underwent organizational reform and established the Cultural and Communications Committee.

description.zh-cn: 党史馆是文传会下设的组织之一。
description.en: The Party History Museum is one of the organizations under the Cultural and Communications Committee.

description.zh-cn: 根据“世无卢梭，即无法国大革命”的说法，卢梭的思想是法国大革命的重要思想源泉。
description.en: According to the saying 'Without Rousseau, there would be no French Revolution,' Rousseau's ideas were a significant intellectual source for the French Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 根据文本记述，在1957年9月的中共八大上，知识分子被认定为“资产阶级和小资产阶级”。
description.en: According to the text, at the 8th National Congress of the CCP in September 1957, intellectuals were identified as 'bourgeoisie and petty bourgeoisie'.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东自1957年起多次对知识分子持负面看法，认为他们世界观属资产阶级，并提出“卑贱者最聪明，高贵者最愚蠢”等观点，在反右运动及文化大革命中对知识分子进行打压。
description.en: Starting from 1957, Mao Zedong repeatedly expressed negative views on intellectuals, believing their worldview was bourgeois and putting forward ideas like 'the lowly are the most intelligent; the elite are the most ignorant,' suppressing intellectuals during the Anti-Rightist Campaign and the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，对知识分子的歧视和迫害达到了顶峰，他们被当作“反动学术权威”和“臭老九”进行批斗。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, discrimination and persecution of intellectuals reached its peak; they were criticized as 'reactionary academic authorities' and the 'stinking ninth category'.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东提出了“知识越多越反动”或“书读得越多越蠢”的观点。
description.en: Mao Zedong put forward the idea that 'the more knowledge one has, the more reactionary one becomes' or 'the more books one reads, the dumber one gets'.

description.zh-cn: 自1977年起，邓小平多次提出要“尊重知识，尊重人才”，并在1978年全国科学大会上正式为知识分子平反，称其绝大多数“已经是工人阶级自己的一部分”。
description.en: Starting from May 1977, Deng Xiaoping repeatedly proposed to 'respect knowledge and respect talent,' and officially rehabilitated intellectuals at the 1978 National Science Conference, stating that the vast majority of them were 'already a part of the working class itself'.

description.zh-cn: 该决议明确肯定知识分子同工人、农民一样是社会主义事业的依靠力量，并要求扫除轻视知识分子的错误观念。
description.en: This resolution explicitly affirmed that intellectuals, like workers and peasants, are a force to rely on for the socialist cause, and called for the elimination of the erroneous concept of despising intellectuals.

description.zh-cn: 1982年通过的《中华人民共和国宪法》规定：“社会主义的建设事业必须依靠工人、农民和知识分子”。
description.en: The Constitution of the People's Republic of China, passed in 1982, stipulates: 'The cause of socialist construction must rely on the workers, peasants, and intellectuals'.

description.zh-cn: 米尔顿·弗里德曼认为，大多数知识分子相信社会主义，因此与商人一样都是资本主义的敌人。
description.en: Milton Friedman argued that most intellectuals believe in socialism and are therefore, like businessmen, enemies of capitalism.

description.zh-cn: 杜渊泉是吉林桦甸人。
description.en: Du Yuanquan is from Huadian, Jilin.

description.zh-cn: 杜渊泉曾任国有重点大型企业监事会主席。
description.en: Du Yuanquan formerly served as the Chairman of the Supervisory Board for Key Large State-owned Enterprises.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，杜渊泉是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to Wikipedia categories, Du Yuanquan is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 马氏是明太祖朱元璋的结发妻子和皇后。
description.en: Lady Ma was the primary wife and empress consort of the Hongwu Emperor, Zhu Yuanzhang.

description.zh-cn: 洪武元年正月初四，朱元璋登基当日册封马氏为皇后。
description.en: On January 23, 1368, the day he ascended the throne, the Hongwu Emperor created Lady Ma as Empress.

description.zh-cn: 正史记载，朱标为马皇后长子。
description.en: According to official histories, Zhu Biao was the eldest son of Empress Ma.

description.zh-cn: 正史记载，朱樉为马皇后次子。
description.en: According to official histories, Zhu Shuang was the second son of Empress Ma.

description.zh-cn: 正史记载，朱㭎为马皇后三子。
description.en: According to official histories, Zhu Gang was the third son of Empress Ma.

description.zh-cn: 正史记载，朱橚为马皇后五子。
description.en: According to official histories, Zhu Su was the fifth son of Empress Ma.

description.zh-cn: 宁国公主为马皇后所生之女。
description.en: Princess Ningguo was the daughter of Empress Ma.

description.zh-cn: 安庆公主为马皇后所生之女。
description.en: Princess Anqing was the daughter of Empress Ma.

description.zh-cn: 宋濂因孙子犯罪被论死，马皇后为他求情，最终使朱元璋赦免了他。
description.en: When Song Lian was sentenced to death due to his grandson's crime, Empress Ma interceded on his behalf, ultimately persuading the Hongwu Emperor to pardon him.

description.zh-cn: 马皇后认为对郭景祥之子的指控可能不实，劝谏朱元璋查证，最终证实其子被冤枉，使其免于处罚。
description.en: Believing the accusation against Guo Jingxiang's son might be false, Empress Ma advised the Hongwu Emperor to investigate, which ultimately proved the son's innocence and saved him from punishment.

description.zh-cn: 马皇后认为不应轻信对李文忠的诬告且轻易换将不妥，劝说朱元璋打消了召还李文忠的念头。
description.en: Empress Ma advised the Hongwu Emperor against rashly replacing Li Wenzhong based on unsubstantiated accusations, persuading the emperor to cancel his recall.

description.zh-cn: 洪武三十一年六月，建文帝朱允炆追尊祖母马皇后，为其上谥号“孝慈昭宪至仁文德承天顺圣高皇后”。
description.en: In June 1398, the Jianwen Emperor honored his grandmother, Empress Ma, with the posthumous title 'Xiaoci Zhaoxian Zhiren Wende Chengtian Shunsheng Gao Empress'.

description.zh-cn: 永乐十九年正月，明成祖朱棣重尊其为“孝慈昭宪至仁文德承天顺圣高皇后”。
description.en: In January 1421, the Yongle Emperor re-honored her with the title 'Xiaoci Zhaoxian Zhiren Wende Chengtian Shunsheng Gao Empress'.

description.zh-cn: 嘉靖十七年，明世宗朱厚熜再次追尊马皇后，为其加上尊谥“孝慈贞化哲顺仁徽成天育圣至德高皇后”。
description.en: In 1538, the Jiajing Emperor further extended Empress Ma's posthumous title to 'Xiaoci Zhenhua Zheshun Renhui Chengtian Yusheng Zhide Gao Empress'.

description.zh-cn: 湘军是湘军南京屠城的执行者。
description.en: The Xiang Army was the perpetrator of the Nanjing Massacre by the Xiang Army.

description.zh-cn: 湘军在屠城中杀害了大量太平军官兵、其眷属及城内平民。
description.en: During the massacre, the Xiang Army killed a large number of Taiping Army officers and soldiers, their families, and civilians in the city.

description.zh-cn: 屠城事件导致南京城遭到严重破坏，人口锐减，经济和城市面貌在十余年后仍未恢复。
description.en: The massacre caused severe destruction to the city of Nanjing, a sharp decline in population, and its economy and urban landscape did not recover even after more than a decade.

description.zh-cn: 曾国荃是湘军攻克天京时的前线总指挥。
description.en: Zeng Guoquan was the frontline commander of the Xiang Army during the capture of Tianjing.

description.zh-cn: 李秀成是太平天国后期的重要将领。
description.en: Li Xiucheng was an important general in the late period of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 天京城破时，李秀成带领幼主洪天贵福突围。
description.en: When Tianjing fell, Li Xiucheng led the young monarch Hong Tianguifu in an attempt to break out of the siege.

description.zh-cn: 赵烈文是曾国荃的幕僚，随军行动并记录见闻。
description.en: Zhao Liewen was Zeng Guoquan's staff advisor, accompanying the army and documenting events.

description.zh-cn: 李臣典是曾国荃的部下，与他一同在现场指挥攻城。
description.en: Li Chendian was a subordinate of Zeng Guoquan and commanded the assault on the city on-site with him.

description.zh-cn: 屠城三十余年后，谭嗣同到访南京，仍能感受到当地人对湘军暴行的深刻愤恨，并记录下相关见闻。
description.en: More than thirty years after the massacre, Tan Sitong visited Nanjing and could still sense the deep resentment of the locals towards the atrocities of the Xiang Army, and he documented his observations.

description.zh-cn: 天京城破时，李秀成下令纵火焚烧天王府。
description.en: When Tianjing fell, Li Xiucheng ordered the burning of the Heavenly King's Mansion.

description.zh-cn: 城破后，赵烈文劝说曾国荃采取措施制止杀戮并办理善后事宜。
description.en: After the city fell, Zhao Liewen advised Zeng Guoquan to take measures to stop the killing and handle the aftermath.

description.zh-cn: 湘军南京屠城对南京造成了长期破坏，以至于十余年后的1875年光绪帝登基时，该城依然萧条。
description.en: The Nanjing Massacre by the Xiang Army caused long-term devastation to Nanjing, such that the city remained desolate when the Guangxu Emperor ascended the throne in 1875, more than a decade later.

description.zh-cn: 作为曾国荃麾下统领，其部队在天京城破后不奉禁令，大肆掠夺。
description.en: As a commander under Zeng Guoquan, his troops disobeyed orders and engaged in widespread looting after the fall of Tianjing.

description.zh-cn: 作为曾国荃麾下统领，其部队在天京城破后不奉禁令，大肆掠夺。
description.en: As a commander under Zeng Guoquan, his troops disobeyed orders and engaged in widespread looting after the fall of Tianjing.

description.zh-cn: 1961年考入哈尔滨工业大学，在工程力学系学习，1966年毕业。
description.en: Admitted to Harbin Institute of Technology in 1961, studied in the Department of Engineering Mechanics, and graduated in 1966.

description.zh-cn: 于1965年加入中国共产党。
description.en: Joined the Communist Party of China in 1965.

description.zh-cn: 由于文化大革命爆发，李继耐于1966年至1967年在校待分配，推迟了其职业生涯的开始。
description.en: Due to the outbreak of the Cultural Revolution, Li Jinai was waiting for assignment at his university from 1966 to 1967, which delayed the start of his career.

description.zh-cn: 1967年12月通过冬季征兵入伍，加入中国人民解放军，直至2013年退役。
description.en: Joined the People's Liberation Army through winter conscription in December 1967 and served until his retirement in 2013.

description.zh-cn: 自1969年4月起在第二炮兵部队（火箭军前身）任职，曾任副排长、干事、副政治委员、基地副政委等职务。
description.en: Served in the Second Artillery Corps (predecessor of the Rocket Force) from April 1969, holding positions such as deputy platoon leader, officer, deputy political commissar, and deputy political commissar of a base.

position.zh-cn: 干部管理部部长、副主任、主任
position.en: Director of the Cadre Management Department, Deputy Director, Director

description.zh-cn: 李继耐曾两度在总政治部任职，早期任干部管理部部长、副主任，后期担任总政治部主任。
description.en: Li Jinai served in the General Political Department twice, early in his career as Director of the Cadre Management Department and Deputy Director, and later as Director of the General Political Department.

description.zh-cn: 1992年11月调任国防科工委副政治委员，1995年7月升任政治委员。
description.en: Transferred to COSTIND as Deputy Political Commissar in November 1992, and was promoted to Political Commissar in July 1995.

position.zh-cn: 中央候补委员、中央委员
position.en: Alternate Member of the Central Committee, Member of the Central Committee

description.zh-cn: 于中共十四大当选为中央候补委员，十五、十六、十七大当选为中央委员。
description.en: Elected as an alternate member of the Central Committee at the 14th Party Congress, and as a full member at the 15th, 16th, and 17th Party Congresses.

description.zh-cn: 1998年总装备部成立时任首任政委，2002年转任部长。
description.en: Served as the first Political Commissar of the General Armaments Department upon its establishment in 1998, and became its Director in 2002.

description.zh-cn: 1998年总装备部成立后，李继耐与部长曹刚川搭档，分别担任政治委员和部长。
description.en: After the establishment of the General Armaments Department in 1998, Li Jinai worked alongside Director Cao Gangchuan, serving as Political Commissar and Director respectively.

description.zh-cn: 在中共十六大和十七大后被任命为中共中央军事委员会委员，并在第十届和第十一届全国人民代表大会第一次会议上被任命为中华人民共和国中央军事委员会委员。
description.en: He was appointed as a member of the CPC Central Military Commission after the 16th and 17th National Congresses of the CPC, and subsequently appointed as a member of the Central Military Commission of the PRC at the first sessions of the 10th and 11th National People's Congresses.

description.zh-cn: 李继耐接替徐才厚担任总政治部主任，因徐才厚被增补为中央军委副主席。
description.en: Li Jinai succeeded Xu Caihou as Director of the General Political Department after Xu was promoted to Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 2012年10月，张阳接替李继耐升任总政治部主任。
description.en: In October 2012, Zhang Yang succeeded Li Jinai as Director of the General Political Department.

description.zh-cn: 2004年9月，陈炳德接替李继耐担任中国人民解放军总装备部部长。
description.en: In September 2004, Chen Bingde succeeded Li Jinai as Director of the PLA General Armaments Department.

description.zh-cn: 2002年11月，迟万春接替李继耐担任中国人民解放军总装备部政治委员。
description.en: In November 2002, Chi Wanchun succeeded Li Jinai as Political Commissar of the PLA General Armaments Department.

description.zh-cn: 李继耐曾公开表示要坚决抵制“军队非党化、非政治化”和“军队国家化”等错误政治观点。
description.en: Li Jinai publicly stated the need to resolutely resist erroneous political viewpoints such as 'departy-ization and depoliticization of the military' and 'nationalization of the military'.

description.zh-cn: 李磊是李继耐的儿子。
description.en: Li Lei is the son of Li Jinai.

description.zh-cn: 2000年6月晋升上将军衔。
description.en: Promoted to the rank of General in June 2000.

description.zh-cn: 李继耐出生于山东省滕县。
description.en: Li Jinai was born in Teng County, Shandong Province.

description.zh-cn: 陈辐宽担任天津市监察委员会主任。
description.en: Chen Fukuan serves as the Director of the Tianjin Municipal Supervisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国家监察委员会是天津市监察委员会的业务上级机构。
description.en: The National Supervisory Commission of the People's Republic of China is the operational superior of the Tianjin Municipal Supervisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 天津市人民代表大会是天津市监察委员会的组织上级机构。
description.en: The Tianjin Municipal People's Congress is the organizational superior of the Tianjin Municipal Supervisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 天津市人民代表大会常务委员会是天津市监察委员会的组织上级机构。
description.en: The Standing Committee of the Tianjin Municipal People's Congress is the organizational superior of the Tianjin Municipal Supervisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 天津市监察委员会依据《中华人民共和国监察法》组建。
description.en: The Tianjin Municipal Supervisory Commission was established in accordance with the Supervision Law of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 郭宁宁任中共福州市委书记。
description.en: Guo Ningning serves as the Secretary of the Fuzhou Municipal Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 吴贤德任福州市人民政府市长。
description.en: Wu Xiande serves as the Mayor of the Fuzhou Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 汉朝于公元前110年灭亡闽越国。
description.en: The Han dynasty conquered the Minyue Kingdom in 110 BC.

description.zh-cn: 王审知于909年建立闽国，定都福州。
description.en: Wang Shenzhi founded the Min Kingdom in 909, establishing its capital in Fuzhou.

description.zh-cn: 1044年，时任福州知州的蔡襄倡导在福州种植榕树。
description.en: In 1044, Cai Xiang, then prefect of Fuzhou, advocated for the planting of banyan trees in the city.

description.zh-cn: 蒙古军队于1276年11月攻占福州，宋端宗从海路南逃。
description.en: The Mongol army captured Fuzhou in November 1276, forcing Emperor Duanzong to flee south by sea.

description.zh-cn: 1624年底，艾儒略将天主教传入福州。
description.en: At the end of 1624, Giulio Aleni introduced Catholicism to Fuzhou.

description.zh-cn: 1646年，清军击溃隆武政权后攻占福州。
description.en: In 1646, the Qing army defeated the Longwu regime and captured Fuzhou.

description.zh-cn: 1866年，在洋务运动期间，清政府在马尾设立福州船政局。
description.en: In 1866, during the Self-Strengthening Movement, the Qing government established the Fuzhou Arsenal in Mawei.

description.zh-cn: 1884年的马江海战导致福建水师几乎全军覆没。
description.en: The Battle of Fuzhou in 1884 resulted in the near-total annihilation of the Fujian Fleet.

description.zh-cn: 1933年11月20日，十九路军在福州发动福建事变。
description.en: On November 20, 1933, the 19th Route Army launched the Fujian Rebellion in Fuzhou.

description.zh-cn: 福建事变后，于1933年11月22日成立中华共和国，定都福州。
description.en: After the Fujian Rebellion, the Chinese Republic was established on November 22, 1933, with its capital in Fuzhou.

description.zh-cn: 蒋中正调遣军队进攻福建，于1934年1月16日占领福州，中华共和国随之瓦解。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek dispatched troops to attack Fujian, capturing Fuzhou on January 16, 1934, which led to the collapse of the Chinese Republic.

description.zh-cn: 时任福州市委书记习近平谋划了“福州3820工程”战略，目标是让福州成为国际化大都市。
description.en: When he was the Party Secretary of Fuzhou, Xi Jinping masterminded the 'Fuzhou 3820 Project' strategy, aiming to transform Fuzhou into an international metropolis.

description.zh-cn: 围棋大师吴清源出生于福州。
description.en: Go master Go Seigen was born in Fuzhou.

description.zh-cn: 谢坚是广东湛江人。
description.en: Xie Jian is from Zhanjiang, Guangdong.

description.zh-cn: 谢坚是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Xie Jian is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 2018年2月24日，谢坚当选为第十三届全国人民代表大会广东地区代表。
description.en: On February 24, 2018, Xie Jian was elected as a delegate representing the Guangdong region to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 亨丽埃特·普莱斯堡是卡尔·马克思的母亲。
description.en: Henriette Pressburg was Karl Marx's mother.

description.zh-cn: 卡尔·马克思与燕妮·冯·威斯特华伦于1843年结婚，直至1881年燕妮去世。
description.en: Karl Marx married Jenny von Westphalen in 1843, and they were married until her death in 1881.

description.zh-cn: 卡尔·马克思于1818年5月5日出生于普鲁士王国的特里尔市。
description.en: Karl Marx was born in the city of Trier, Kingdom of Prussia, on May 5, 1818.

description.zh-cn: 马克思于1835年至1836年在波恩大学学习法学。
description.en: Marx studied law at the University of Bonn from 1835 to 1836.

description.zh-cn: 马克思于1836年至1841年在柏林大学学习法学和哲学，并加入了青年黑格尔派的“博士俱乐部”。
description.en: Marx studied law and philosophy at the University of Berlin from 1836 to 1841, and joined the Young Hegelians' 'Doctor's Club'.

description.zh-cn: 马克思向耶拿大学提交了博士论文，并于1841年4月获得哲学博士学位。
description.en: Marx submitted his doctoral dissertation to the University of Jena and was awarded a Doctor of Philosophy degree in April 1841.

description.zh-cn: 在柏林大学期间，马克思加入了由激进思想家组成的青年黑格尔派，并与其中成员深入交往。
description.en: During his time at the University of Berlin, Marx joined the Young Hegelians, a group of radical thinkers, and became deeply involved with its members.

description.zh-cn: 马克思是共产主义者同盟的核心成员，并与恩格斯共同为其起草了纲领《共产党宣言》。
description.en: Marx was a key member of the Communist League and co-authored its program, The Communist Manifesto, with Engels.

description.zh-cn: 马克思于1864年参与创立了国际工人协会（第一国际），并成为其核心领导人。
description.en: Marx participated in the founding of the International Workingmen's Association (the First International) in 1864 and became its central leader.

description.zh-cn: 卡尔·马克思创立了历史唯物主义，将其作为自己哲学和历史观的基础。
description.en: Karl Marx founded historical materialism, making it the basis of his philosophy and view of history.

description.zh-cn: 马克思积极支持1848年欧洲革命，并返回德国科隆创办《新莱茵报》以传播革命思想。
description.en: Marx actively supported the 1848 European revolutions and returned to Cologne, Germany, to found the Neue Rheinische Zeitung to spread revolutionary ideas.

description.zh-cn: 马克思在其著作《哲学的贫困》中，对法国无政府社会主义者皮埃尔-约瑟夫·蒲鲁东的“小资产阶级哲学”进行了系统性批判。
description.en: In his work 'The Poverty of Philosophy', Marx systematically criticized the 'petty-bourgeois philosophy' of the French anarcho-socialist Pierre-Joseph Proudhon.

description.zh-cn: 马克思在其著作《法兰西内战》中为1871年的巴黎公社运动进行了辩护和正名。
description.en: In his work 'The Civil War in France', Marx defended and justified the Paris Commune of 1871.

description.zh-cn: 在流亡伦敦期间，马克思从1852年到1862年担任《纽约每日论坛报》的欧洲通讯员以获取收入。
description.en: During his exile in London, Marx served as a European correspondent for the New York Daily Tribune from 1852 to 1862 to earn an income.

description.zh-cn: 马克思列宁毛主义被认为是毛主义的更高发展阶段。
description.en: Marxism-Leninism-Maoism is considered a higher stage of development of Maoism.

description.zh-cn: 毛主义被其拥护者认为是马克思列宁主义的第三个和更高的阶段。
description.en: Maoism is considered by its proponents to be the third and higher stage of Marxism-Leninism.

description.zh-cn: 1993年12月26日，革命国际主义运动发表文章《马克思列宁毛主义万岁！》，正式采纳并推广“马克思列宁毛主义”这一术语。
description.en: On December 26, 1993, the Revolutionary Internationalist Movement published the document 'Long Live Marxism-Leninism-Maoism!', formally adopting and promoting the term.

description.zh-cn: 1960年代的中苏论战促使中国共产党在国内强调和推广“马克思列宁主义、毛泽东思想”。
description.en: The Sino-Soviet split in the 1960s prompted the Communist Party of China to emphasize and promote 'Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought' domestically.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命初期，中国官方媒体将毛泽东思想宣传为“当代最高水平的马克思列宁主义”。
description.en: In the early stages of the Cultural Revolution, Chinese state media promoted Mao Zedong Thought as 'the highest level of contemporary Marxism-Leninism'.

description.zh-cn: 无产阶级专政下继续革命的理论是文化大革命的核心理论基础和指导思想。
description.en: The theory of continuing revolution under the dictatorship of the proletariat was the core theoretical basis and guiding ideology of the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 群众路线理论以列宁的先锋队理论为基础发展而来。
description.en: The Mass Line theory is based on Lenin's theory of the vanguard party.

description.zh-cn: 列宁是先锋队理论的提出者和主要阐述者。
description.en: Lenin was the originator and main exponent of the theory of the vanguard party.

description.zh-cn: 尼泊尔共产党（毛主义中心）宣称其指导思想“普拉昌达道路”是对马列毛主义的发展。
description.en: The Communist Party of Nepal (Maoist Centre) claims its guiding ideology, 'Prachanda Path', is a development of Marxism-Leninism-Maoism.

description.zh-cn: 尼泊尔共产党（毛主义中心）将其意识形态总结为“普拉昌达道路”。
description.en: The Communist Party of Nepal (Maoist Centre) summarized its ideology as 'Prachanda Path'.

description.zh-cn: 秘鲁共产党（光辉道路）将自己的意识形态称为“马克思列宁毛主义、贡萨罗思想”。
description.en: The Shining Path calls its own ideology 'Marxism-Leninism-Maoism, Gonzalo Thought'.

description.zh-cn: 马克思列宁毛主义包含卡尔·马克思的思想。
description.en: Marxism-Leninism-Maoism incorporates the thought of Karl Marx.

description.zh-cn: 马克思列宁毛主义包含恩格斯的思想。
description.en: Marxism-Leninism-Maoism incorporates the thought of Friedrich Engels.

description.zh-cn: 马克思列宁毛主义包含列宁的思想。
description.en: Marxism-Leninism-Maoism incorporates the thought of Vladimir Lenin.

description.zh-cn: 马克思列宁毛主义包含斯大林的思想。
description.en: Marxism-Leninism-Maoism incorporates the thought of Joseph Stalin.

description.zh-cn: 马克思列宁毛主义包含毛泽东的思想。
description.en: Marxism-Leninism-Maoism incorporates the thought of Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 土耳其共产党/马列是支持马列毛主义的政党之一。
description.en: The Communist Party of Turkey/Marxist–Leninist is one of the political parties that supports Marxism-Leninism-Maoism.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗共产党（马列毛）是支持马列毛主义的政党之一。
description.en: The Communist Party of Iran (Marxist-Leninist-Maoist) is one of the political parties that supports Marxism-Leninism-Maoism.

description.zh-cn: 印度共产党（毛主义）是支持马列毛主义的政党之一。
description.en: The Communist Party of India (Maoist) is one of the political parties that supports Marxism-Leninism-Maoism.

description.zh-cn: 东孟加拉无产阶级党是支持马列毛主义的政党之一。
description.en: The Proletarian Party of East Bengal is one of the political parties that supports Marxism-Leninism-Maoism.

description.zh-cn: 尼泊尔共产党（毛主义中心）是支持马列毛主义的政党之一。
description.en: The Communist Party of Nepal (Maoist Centre) is one of the political parties that supports Marxism-Leninism-Maoism.

description.zh-cn: 菲律宾共产党是支持马列毛主义的政党之一。
description.en: The Communist Party of the Philippines is one of the political parties that supports Marxism-Leninism-Maoism.

description.zh-cn: 美国革命共产党是支持马列毛主义的政党之一。
description.en: The Revolutionary Communist Party, USA is one of the political parties that supports Marxism-Leninism-Maoism.

description.zh-cn: 厄瓜多尔共产党—红太阳是支持马列毛主义的政党之一。
description.en: The Communist Party of Ecuador – Red Sun is one of the political parties that supports Marxism-Leninism-Maoism.

description.zh-cn: 1990年4月18日，中华人民共和国政府作出浦东开发开放的决策。
邓小平在1991年视察上海时发表讲话，为浦东开发开放表示了关键支持。
时任国务院总理李鹏于1990年4月18日正式宣布中央同意加快浦东地区的开发。
中共中央于1990年4月同意上海市加快浦东地区的开发。
国务院于1990年4月同意上海市加快浦东地区的开发，并于1992年10月11日正式批复设立浦东新区。
2009年，国务院批复同意将原南汇区行政区域整体并入浦东新区，扩大了浦东新区的管辖范围。
在浦东新区设立过程中，原川沙县被撤销，其行政区域成为浦东新区的主体部分。
约翰·F·肯尼迪与杰奎琳·布维尔于1953年结婚，婚姻关系直至肯尼迪去世。
description.en: John F. Kennedy married Jacqueline Bouvier in 1953, and they remained married until his death.

position.en: Attorney General of the United States

description.zh-cn: 肯尼迪总统任命其弟罗伯特·肯尼迪为司法部长。
description.en: President Kennedy appointed his brother, Robert Kennedy, as Attorney General.

description.zh-cn: 肯尼迪于1940年6月以优异成绩从哈佛大学毕业。
description.en: Kennedy graduated from Harvard University with honors in June 1940.

description.zh-cn: 在1960年美国总统选举中，肯尼迪作为民主党候选人与共和党候选人尼克松竞争并获胜。
description.en: In the 1960 United States presidential election, Kennedy, as the Democratic candidate, competed against and defeated the Republican candidate, Nixon.

description.zh-cn: 肯尼迪总统下令执行了入侵古巴的“猪湾事件”计划。
description.en: President Kennedy ordered the execution of the 'Bay of Pigs Invasion' plan to invade Cuba.

description.zh-cn: 猪湾事件的失败使肯尼迪政府备受批评，并迫使其为释放被俘人员进行谈判。
description.en: The failure of the Bay of Pigs Invasion brought criticism upon the Kennedy administration and forced it to negotiate for the release of captured personnel.

description.zh-cn: 在古巴导弹危机期间，肯尼迪总统通过谈判和海上封锁，成功迫使苏联撤出在古巴的导弹，化解了核战争危机。
description.en: During the Cuban Missile Crisis, President Kennedy, through negotiation and a naval quarantine, successfully forced the Soviet Union to withdraw its missiles from Cuba, resolving the threat of nuclear war.

description.zh-cn: 作为冷战时期美苏两国的领导人，肯尼迪与赫鲁晓夫在古巴导弹危机等事件中处于直接对抗状态。
description.en: As leaders of the US and USSR during the Cold War, Kennedy and Khrushchev were in direct confrontation during events such as the Cuban Missile Crisis.

description.zh-cn: 肯尼迪请求国会建立了和平队。
description.en: Kennedy requested that Congress establish the Peace Corps.

description.zh-cn: 肯尼迪在国会发表演说，宣布了在十年内将宇航员送上月球并安全返回的目标，从而正式启动并大力推动了阿波罗计划。
description.en: In a speech to Congress, Kennedy announced the goal of landing an astronaut on the Moon and returning him safely to the Earth within a decade, thereby officially launching and strongly promoting the Apollo program.

description.zh-cn: 肯尼迪政府默许了推翻南越总统吴廷琰的军事政变，导致吴廷琰被杀。
description.en: The Kennedy administration tacitly approved the military coup that overthrew South Vietnamese President Ngô Đình Diệm, leading to his assassination.

description.zh-cn: 肯尼迪政府介入了多起民权事件，包括派遣法警确保詹姆斯·梅雷迪思进入密西西比大学，以及干预亚拉巴马州州长乔治·华莱士的“挡校门事件”。
description.en: The Kennedy administration intervened in several civil rights events, including sending federal marshals to ensure James Meredith's enrollment at the University of Mississippi and intervening in Governor George Wallace's 'Stand in the Schoolhouse Door'.

description.zh-cn: 当乔治·华莱士试图阻止黑人学生入学时，肯尼迪派遣联邦部队进行干预，迫使其让步。
description.en: When George Wallace attempted to block black students from enrolling, Kennedy intervened by dispatching federal troops, forcing him to stand aside.

description.zh-cn: 肯尼迪推动了《部分禁止核试验条约》的签订，该条约于1963年由美国、英国和苏联签署。
description.en: Kennedy pushed for the 'Partial Nuclear Test Ban Treaty', which was signed by the United States, the United Kingdom, and the Soviet Union in 1963.

description.zh-cn: 该事件导致约翰·F·肯尼迪的死亡。
description.en: This event resulted in the death of John F. Kennedy.

description.zh-cn: 李·哈维·奥斯瓦尔德被认定为刺杀约翰·F·肯尼迪的嫌犯。
description.en: Lee Harvey Oswald was identified as the suspect who assassinated John F. Kennedy.

description.zh-cn: 据报道，约翰·肯尼迪与玛丽莲·梦露有婚外情关系。
description.en: John Kennedy reportedly had an extramarital affair with Marilyn Monroe.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东在其文章《论人民民主专政》中明确提出了“一边倒”的外交政策，主张倒向以苏联为首的社会主义阵营。
description.en: In his article "On the People's Democratic Dictatorship," Mao Zedong explicitly proposed the "Lean to One Side" foreign policy, advocating for siding with the socialist camp led by the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: “一边倒”的外交政策是中华人民共和国决定与苏联结盟并签署《中苏友好同盟互助条约》的指导方针。
description.en: The "Lean to One Side" foreign policy was the guiding principle for the People's Republic of China to ally with the Soviet Union and sign the Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship, Alliance and Mutual Assistance.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东亲自前往莫斯科，与斯大林进行了数周的谈判，最终促成了新条约的签署，以取代旧的1945年条约。
description.en: Mao Zedong personally traveled to Moscow and negotiated with Stalin for several weeks, ultimately leading to the signing of a new treaty to replace the old 1945 treaty.

description.zh-cn: 斯大林出于扩大苏联在东亚影响力的战略考虑，最终同意了毛泽东缔结新条约的要求，并参与了谈判。
description.en: For strategic considerations of expanding Soviet influence in East Asia, Stalin eventually agreed to Mao Zedong's request for a new treaty and participated in the negotiations.

position.zh-cn: 政务院总理兼外交部长
position.en: Premier of the Government Administration Council and Minister of Foreign Affairs

description.zh-cn: 周恩来作为中华人民共和国的全权代表，在莫斯科正式签署了《中苏友好同盟互助条约》。
description.en: As the plenipotentiary representative of the People's Republic of China, Zhou Enlai formally signed the Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship, Alliance and Mutual Assistance in Moscow.

description.zh-cn: 安德烈·维辛斯基作为苏联的全权代表，在莫斯科正式签署了《中苏友好同盟互助条约》。
description.en: As the plenipotentiary representative of the Soviet Union, Andrey Vyshinsky formally signed the Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship, Alliance and Mutual Assistance in Moscow.

description.zh-cn: 条约的签订为新成立的中华人民共和国提供了安全保障和关键的经济与技术援助，为其经济恢复、工业化和政权巩固做出了贡献。
description.en: The signing of the treaty provided security guarantees and crucial economic and technical assistance to the newly founded People's Republic of China, contributing to its economic recovery, industrialization, and regime consolidation.

description.zh-cn: 1950年的新条约明确取代了由中华民国政府在1945年签署的《中苏友好同盟条约》。
description.en: The new treaty of 1950 explicitly replaced the Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship and Alliance signed in 1945 by the Government of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 在蒋介石的领导下，中华民国政府与苏联签署了《中苏友好同盟条约》。
description.en: Under the leadership of Chiang Kai-shek, the Government of the Republic of China signed the Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship and Alliance with the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 雅尔塔会议上达成的协议确保了苏联在远东的利益，这迫使中华民国政府同意与苏联签署《中苏友好同盟条约》。
description.en: The agreements reached at the Yalta Conference secured Soviet interests in the Far East, which compelled the Government of the Republic of China to agree to sign the Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship and Alliance with the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 中苏关系的急剧恶化导致了《中苏友好同盟互助条约》在1980年期满后失效，双方未再续约。
description.en: The sharp deterioration of Sino-Soviet relations led to the expiration of the Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship, Alliance and Mutual Assistance in 1980 without renewal.

description.zh-cn: 在条约即将到期时，邓小平希望中国不要与苏联谈判，除非苏联同意中国的要求，例如从阿富汗、蒙古和中苏边境撤军，以及停止支持越南入侵柬埔寨。
description.en: As the treaty was nearing expiration, Deng Xiaoping wished for China not to negotiate with the Soviet Union unless it agreed to China's demands, such as withdrawing troops from Afghanistan, Mongolia, and the Sino-Soviet border, and stopping support for Vietnam's invasion of Cambodia.

description.zh-cn: 在谈判初期，斯大林拒绝了毛泽东希望苏联为进攻台湾计划提供空中支持的请求，理由是这会给美国干预的借口。
description.en: In the early stages of negotiations, Stalin rejected Mao Zedong's request for Soviet air support for the planned invasion of Taiwan, citing it would give the United States a pretext for intervention.

description.zh-cn: 条约的一个核心条款是双方承诺共同防止日本帝国主义的复兴及其侵略行为。
description.en: A core provision of the treaty was the mutual commitment to prevent the resurgence of Japanese imperialism and its aggressive actions.

description.zh-cn: 根据毛泽东的说法，中国在朝鲜战争中的表现赢得了苏联的信任，促使苏联后续提供了更多的援助与合作，包括156个重点工业项目。
description.en: According to Mao Zedong, China's performance in the Korean War won the trust of the Soviet Union, prompting it to provide more aid and cooperation subsequently, including 156 key industrial projects.

description.zh-cn: 1947年加入中国共产党。
description.en: Joined the Communist Party of China in 1947.

description.zh-cn: 1949年加入台湾民主自治同盟。此后，于1952年至1987年期间，担任该同盟总部第一至三届秘书长。
description.en: Joined the Taiwan Democratic Self-Government League in 1949. Subsequently, from 1952 to 1987, served as the Secretary-General of the headquarters for the first three congresses of the League.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立后，徐萌山开始担任上海市侨联副秘书长、全国青联执行委员等职务。
description.en: After the founding of the People's Republic of China, Xu Mengshan began to serve as Deputy Secretary-General of the Shanghai Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese and an executive committee member of the All-China Youth Federation.

description.zh-cn: 担任第三、四、五、六、七、八届全国政协委员。
description.en: Served as a member of the 3rd, 4th, 5th, 6th, 7th, and 8th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 查尔斯三世是现任加拿大君主，为国家元首。
description.en: Charles III is the current Monarch of Canada, serving as the head of state.

description.zh-cn: 根据资料文本，马克·卡尼是加拿大总理，向代表君主的总督负责。
description.en: According to the source text, Mark Carney is the Prime Minister of Canada, accountable to the Governor General who represents the monarch.

description.zh-cn: 加拿大上议院是加拿大国会的组成部分之一，是其上议院。
description.en: The Senate of Canada is a component of the Parliament of Canada, serving as its upper house.

description.zh-cn: 加拿大下议院是加拿大国会的组成部分之一，是其下议院。
description.en: The House of Commons of Canada is a component of the Parliament of Canada, serving as its lower house.

description.zh-cn: 《1867年宪法法令》的通过正式促成了加拿大联邦的建立。
description.en: The passage of the Constitution Act, 1867 formally brought about the establishment of the Canadian Confederation.

description.zh-cn: 加拿大联邦化事件标志着现代加拿大的诞生。
description.en: The event of Canadian Confederation marked the birth of modern Canada.

description.zh-cn: 《1931年西敏法规》肯定了加拿大的独立性，使其成为独立国家。
description.en: The Statute of Westminster 1931 affirmed Canada's independence, establishing it as an independent nation.

description.zh-cn: 在1982年宪法本国化之前，加拿大在立法上受英国国会管辖，英国君主为国家元首。
description.en: Before the patriation of the constitution in 1982, Canada was subject to the legislative authority of the British Parliament, with the British monarch as head of state.

description.zh-cn: 时任加拿大女王伊丽莎白二世御准了《1982年加拿大法令》，将加拿大宪法修宪权移交加拿大国会。
description.en: The then Queen of Canada, Elizabeth II, gave Royal Assent to the Canada Act 1982, transferring the power to amend the Canadian Constitution to the Parliament of Canada.

description.zh-cn: 七年战争结束后，法国将其在北美洲的殖民地新法兰西让予英国，结束了法国的统治。
description.en: After the Seven Years' War, France ceded its North American colony of New France to Great Britain, ending French rule.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次世界大战期间，加拿大对纳粹德国宣战，并作为同盟国一方参与了战争。
description.en: During World War II, Canada declared war on Nazi Germany and participated in the war as one of the Allied powers.

description.zh-cn: 加拿大拒绝了美国提出的出兵伊拉克战争的邀请，未参与该次军事行动。
description.en: Canada declined the United States' invitation to send troops to the Iraq War and did not participate in the military operation.

description.zh-cn: 加拿大与美国有着世界上最长的不设防边境，在军事和经济上有着广泛的合作，并且互为对方最大的贸易伙伴。
description.en: Canada and the United States share the world's longest undefended border, have extensive military and economic cooperation, and are each other's largest trading partners.

description.zh-cn: 加拿大是北大西洋公约组织的创始成员国之一。
description.en: Canada is one of the founding members of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO).

description.zh-cn: 加拿大是联合国的创始成员国之一。
description.en: Canada is one of the founding members of the United Nations.

description.zh-cn: 作为前英国殖民地，加拿大是英联邦的成员国。
description.en: As a former British colony, Canada is a member of the Commonwealth of Nations.

description.zh-cn: 由于其双语传统，加拿大是法语国家及地区国际组织的成员国。
description.en: Due to its bilingual heritage, Canada is a member of the Organisation internationale de la Francophonie.

description.zh-cn: 《北美自由贸易协议》旨在消除加拿大、美国和墨西哥之间的关税，促进了加拿大的对外贸易。
description.en: The North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA) aimed to eliminate tariffs between Canada, the United States, and Mexico, thereby promoting Canada's foreign trade.

description.zh-cn: 《北美自由贸易协议》旨在消除加拿大、美国和墨西哥之间的关税，促进了美国的对外贸易。
description.en: The North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA) aimed to eliminate tariffs between Canada, the United States, and Mexico, thereby promoting US foreign trade.

description.zh-cn: 《北美自由贸易协议》旨在消除加拿大、美国和墨西哥之间的关税，促进了墨西哥的对外贸易。
description.en: The North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA) aimed to eliminate tariffs between Canada, the United States, and Mexico, thereby promoting Mexico's foreign trade.

description.zh-cn: 余承业是浙江温州人。
description.en: Yu Chengye was a native of Wenzhou, Zhejiang.

position.zh-cn: 副院长、院长、教授、博士生导师
position.en: Vice President, President, Professor, Doctoral Supervisor

description.zh-cn: 余承业曾担任南京航空学院的副院长、院长、教授及博士生导师。
description.en: Yu Chengye served as Vice President, President, Professor, and Doctoral Supervisor at Nanjing Aeronautical Institute.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类“中国共产党党员”，余承业是中国共产党的成员。
description.en: According to the page category 'Communist Party of China members', Yu Chengye was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 担任世界知识产权组织第五任总干事。
