description.en: Serves as the fifth Director General of the World Intellectual Property Organization.

description.zh-cn: 曾任新加坡政府的贸易律师和公务员。
description.en: Formerly a trade lawyer and civil servant for the Singapore Government.

description.zh-cn: 曾玉康是四川隆昌人。
description.en: Zeng Yukang is from Longchang, Sichuan.

description.zh-cn: 曾玉康曾任黑龙江省政协副主席。
description.en: Zeng Yukang served as Vice Chairman of the Heilongjiang Provincial Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 曾玉康是第十届全国人大代表。
description.en: Zeng Yukang was a deputy to the 10th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类，曾玉康是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to the category, Zeng Yukang is a member of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 史思明作为安禄山的主要部将，共同发动了安史之乱。
description.en: As one of An Lushan's key generals, Shi Siming co-initiated the An Lushan Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 宰相李林甫为杜绝边将入相，建议唐玄宗任用胡人为节度使，使得安禄山得以掌握重兵，为其叛乱创造了条件。
description.en: To prevent border generals from becoming chancellors, Li Linfu advised Emperor Xuanzong to appoint non-Han individuals as military governors, which allowed An Lushan to command a large army and created the conditions for his rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 安史之乱的爆发终结了唐玄宗前期开创的开元盛世。
description.en: The outbreak of the An Lushan Rebellion brought an end to the Kaiyuan Era of prosperity established during the early reign of Emperor Xuanzong.

description.zh-cn: 战后，唐朝为招降叛将而分封节度使，导致了地方势力拥兵自重、不受中央控制的藩镇割据局面。
description.en: After the rebellion, the Tang court enfeoffed surrendered rebel generals as military governors to bring a swift end to the war, which led to the Fanzhen system where regional powers became militarily autonomous and beyond central control.

description.zh-cn: 安史之乱导致唐朝边防空虚，吐蕃帝国乘机出兵占领了原属唐朝的西域和河西走廊。
description.en: The An Lushan Rebellion left the Tang Dynasty's borders vulnerable, allowing the Tibetan Empire to seize the opportunity to invade and occupy the Western Regions and Hexi Corridor, which were previously under Tang control.

description.zh-cn: 趁安史之乱，吐蕃占领了西域地区。
description.en: Taking advantage of the An Lushan Rebellion, the Tibetan Empire occupied the Western Regions.

description.zh-cn: 趁安史之乱，吐蕃占领了河西走廊。
description.en: Taking advantage of the An Lushan Rebellion, the Tibetan Empire occupied the Hexi Corridor.

description.zh-cn: 作为唐朝的盟友，回鹘汗国曾出兵协助唐军平定安史之乱，收复两京。
description.en: As an ally of the Tang Dynasty, the Uyghur Khaganate dispatched troops to assist the Tang army in quelling the An Lushan Rebellion and recapturing the two capitals.

description.zh-cn: 757年正月，安庆绪杀害其父安禄山，自立为帝。
description.en: In the first lunar month of 757, An Qingxu assassinated his father An Lushan and declared himself emperor.

description.zh-cn: 史思明于759年杀死安庆绪，并接收了其部队。
description.en: Shi Siming killed An Qingxu in 759 and took control of his forces.

description.zh-cn: 761年三月，史朝义发动兵变，杀死了其父史思明。
description.en: In the third lunar month of 761, Shi Chaoyi launched a coup and killed his father, Shi Siming.

description.zh-cn: 在邺城之战后，宦官鱼朝恩向皇帝谗毁郭子仪，导致郭子仪被召回长安并解除兵权。
description.en: After the Battle of Yecheng, the eunuch Yu Chao'en slandered Guo Ziyi to the emperor, which led to Guo Ziyi being recalled to Chang'an and stripped of his military command.

description.zh-cn: 令狐路线是山西平陆人。
description.en: Linghu Luxian is from Pinglu, Shanxi.

description.zh-cn: 1976年，令狐路线被推荐进入山西医科大学，成为工农兵大学生。
description.en: In 1976, Linghu Luxian was recommended to enter Shanxi Medical University as a Worker-Peasant-Soldier student.

description.zh-cn: 令狐路线是令狐野的女儿。
description.en: Linghu Luxian is the daughter of Linghu Ye.

description.zh-cn: 令方针是令狐路线的兄长。
description.en: Ling Fangzhen is the elder brother of Linghu Luxian.

description.zh-cn: 令政策是令狐路线的兄长。
description.en: Ling Zhengce is the elder brother of Linghu Luxian.

description.zh-cn: 令完成是令狐路线的弟弟。
description.en: Ling Wancheng is the younger brother of Linghu Luxian.

description.zh-cn: 王健康是令狐路线的丈夫。
description.en: Wang Jiankang is the husband of Linghu Luxian.

description.zh-cn: 王玲是令狐路线的女儿。
description.en: Wang Ling is the daughter of Linghu Luxian.

description.zh-cn: 2010年3月，令完成从汇金立方退出，其合伙股份转给王玲。
description.en: In March 2010, Ling Wancheng withdrew from Huijin Lifang, and his partnership shares were transferred to Wang Ling.

description.zh-cn: 该运动等经历给徐景贤很大的影响。
description.en: This movement and other experiences had a great influence on Xu Jingxian.

description.zh-cn: 国民政府压制了五二〇运动中的游行。
description.en: The Nationalist Government suppressed the demonstrations during the May Twentieth Movement.

description.zh-cn: 介绍徐景贤加入中国共产党。
description.en: Introduced Xu Jingxian to join the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 徐景贤在丁景唐担任处长的文艺处任干事。
description.en: Xu Jingxian worked as an officer in the literary and art department where Ding Jingtang was the director.

description.zh-cn: 1953年4月26日成为预备党员，1956年6月转正，1980年5月被开除党籍。
description.en: Became a probationary member on April 26, 1953, became a full member in June 1956, and was expelled from the party in May 1980.

description.zh-cn: 徐景贤在调回市委文艺工作部后认识了时任部长张春桥。
description.en: Xu Jingxian met Zhang Chunqiao, then the department minister, after being transferred back to the Municipal Party Committee's Literature and Art Work Department.

description.zh-cn: 徐景贤在市委宣传部时，在谷牧手下工作。
description.en: When Xu Jingxian was in the Municipal Party Committee's Propaganda Department, he worked under Gu Mu.

description.zh-cn: 徐景贤在市委宣传部时，在石西民手下工作。
description.en: When Xu Jingxian was in the Municipal Party Committee's Propaganda Department, he worked under Shi Ximin.

description.zh-cn: 在反右运动中遭到批判。
description.en: Was criticized during the Anti-Rightist Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 撰写回忆录《十年一梦》，于2003年出版。
description.en: Authored the memoir 'Ten Years a Dream', published in 2003.

description.zh-cn: 张海阳是张震的儿子。
description.en: Zhang Haiyang is the son of Zhang Zhen.

description.zh-cn: 张海阳是孙克骥的女婿。
description.en: Zhang Haiyang is the son-in-law of Sun Keji.

description.zh-cn: 张海阳的父亲张震为纪念上海解放而为其取名“海阳”。
description.en: Zhang Haiyang's father, Zhang Zhen, named him 'Haiyang' to commemorate the liberation of Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 于1969年参军。
description.en: Joined the army in 1969.

description.zh-cn: 张海阳接替彭小枫担任中国人民解放军第二炮兵部队政治委员。
description.en: Zhang Haiyang succeeded Peng Xiaofeng as the Political Commissar of the PLA Second Artillery Force.

description.zh-cn: 王家胜接替张海阳担任中国人民解放军第二炮兵部队政治委员。
description.en: Wang Jiasheng succeeded Zhang Haiyang as the Political Commissar of the PLA Second Artillery Force.

description.zh-cn: 张海阳接替刘书田担任中国人民解放军成都军区政治委员。
description.en: Zhang Haiyang succeeded Liu Shutian as the Political Commissar of the Chengdu Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 田修思接替张海阳担任中国人民解放军成都军区政治委员。
description.en: Tian Xiusi succeeded Zhang Haiyang as the Political Commissar of the Chengdu Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 六十一人叛徒集团案是在文化大革命期间制造的一起大案。
description.en: The Case of the 61 Renegades was a major case fabricated during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 该案是为打击国家主席刘少奇一派的中共领导人而制造的。
description.en: This case was fabricated to attack the faction of CPC leaders headed by State Chairman Liu Shaoqi.

description.zh-cn: 1936年，刘少奇担任中共中央北方局书记。
description.en: In 1936, Liu Shaoqi served as the Secretary of the Northern Bureau of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 时任中共中央总书记的张闻天代表党中央批准了刘少奇关于保释61名干部的决定。
description.en: Zhang Wentian, then General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, approved Liu Shaoqi's decision to bail out the 61 cadres on behalf of the Party Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 廖鲁言因六十一人案受到迫害，被折磨至死。
description.en: Liao Luyan was persecuted due to the Case of the 61 and was tortured to death.

description.zh-cn: 徐子荣因六十一人案受到迫害，被折磨至死。
description.en: Xu Zirong was persecuted due to the Case of the 61 and was tortured to death.

description.zh-cn: 汪东兴阻挠胡耀邦为六十一人叛徒集团案平反，认为该案由毛泽东定性，不能翻案。
description.en: Wang Dongxing obstructed Hu Yaobang's efforts to rehabilitate the Case of the 61 Renegades, arguing that the case was decided by Mao Zedong and could not be overturned.

description.zh-cn: 纪登奎阻挠胡耀邦为六十一人叛徒集团案平反。
description.en: Ji Dengkui obstructed Hu Yaobang's efforts to rehabilitate the Case of the 61 Renegades.

description.zh-cn: 吴德阻挠胡耀邦为六十一人叛徒集团案平反。
description.en: Wu De obstructed Hu Yaobang's efforts to rehabilitate the Case of the 61 Renegades.

description.zh-cn: 胡耀邦指示中组部坚持对六十一人案进行调查以促成平反。
description.en: Hu Yaobang instructed the Central Organization Department to persist in investigating the Case of the 61 to facilitate its rehabilitation.

description.zh-cn: 潘汉年是董慧的配偶。
description.en: Pan Hannian is the spouse of Dong Hui.

description.zh-cn: 潘梓年是潘汉年的大哥。
description.en: Pan Zinian is Pan Hannian's elder brother.

description.zh-cn: 潘汉年于1925年11月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Pan Hannian joined the Communist Party of China in November 1925.

position.en: Secretary of the CPC Party Group

description.zh-cn: 潘汉年担任中国左翼作家联盟（左联）的中共党组书记。
description.en: Pan Hannian served as the Secretary of the CPC Party Group of the League of Left-Wing Writers.

description.zh-cn: 秦邦宪（博古）邀请潘汉年参与孙中山追悼会的筹备工作，并将其介绍给恽代英，为潘汉年开启了革命生涯。
description.en: Qin Bangxian (Bo Gu) invited Pan Hannian to participate in the preparation of Sun Yat-sen's memorial service and introduced him to Yun Daiying, which started Pan's revolutionary career.

description.zh-cn: 建议潘汉年去上海工作，促使其进入更广阔的革命活动舞台。
description.en: Suggested that Pan Hannian go to Shanghai to work, prompting him to enter a broader stage of revolutionary activities.

description.zh-cn: 邀请潘汉年赴南昌编辑《革命军日报》，使其在国民革命军总政治部担任职务。
description.en: Invited Pan Hannian to Nanchang to edit the 'Revolutionary Army Daily', leading to his position in the General Political Department of the National Revolutionary Army.

description.zh-cn: 介绍袁殊加入中国共产党，袁殊后成为其重要的情报人员。
description.en: Introduced Yuan Shu to join the Communist Party of China; Yuan later became his key intelligence operative.

description.zh-cn: 同意潘汉年与汪精卫政权特务头子李士群进行接触。
description.en: Approved Pan Hannian's contact with Li Shiqun, the head of the secret service of the Wang Jingwei regime.

description.zh-cn: 与汪精卫政权特务头子李士群建立联系并展开情报合作，曾住进其私人寓所。
description.en: Established contact with Li Shiqun, head of the Wang Jingwei regime's secret service, for intelligence cooperation, and once lived in his private residence.

description.zh-cn: 在李士群的安排下与汪精卫会面。潘汉年此事对中共中央隐瞒长达十二年，成为其后来被判内奸罪的重要依据。
description.en: Met with Wang Jingwei, arranged by Li Shiqun. Pan Hannian concealed this meeting from the CPC Central Committee for twelve years, which became a key piece of evidence in his later conviction as a traitor.

description.zh-cn: 安排了潘汉年与汪精卫的会面。
description.en: Arranged the meeting between Pan Hannian and Wang Jingwei.

description.zh-cn: 在潘汉年向其坦白曾会见汪精卫后，将此事转呈给毛泽东，直接导致了潘汉年的被捕。
description.en: After Pan Hannian confessed to him about meeting Wang Jingwei, he reported the matter to Mao Zedong, which directly led to Pan's arrest.

description.zh-cn: 在收到陈毅转呈的潘汉年报告后，批示“此人从此不可信用”，并手谕“立即逮捕审查潘汉年”，将其定性为内奸并导致其被长期监禁。
description.en: After receiving Pan Hannian's report forwarded by Chen Yi, Mao Zedong wrote the directive 'This person is henceforth not to be trusted' and ordered 'Immediately arrest and investigate Pan Hannian,' labeling him a traitor and leading to his long-term imprisonment.

description.zh-cn: 时任公安部部长，根据毛泽东的指示，在北京饭店亲自秘密逮捕了潘汉年。
description.en: As the Minister of Public Security at the time, he personally and secretly arrested Pan Hannian at the Beijing Hotel under Mao Zedong's instructions.

description.zh-cn: 在潘汉年被捕后，向中共中央政治局和书记处报告，从情报工作的角度反驳了潘汉年的内奸嫌疑。
description.en: After Pan Hannian's arrest, he reported to the Politburo and Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee, refuting the suspicion of Pan being a traitor from an intelligence work perspective.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，指控潘汉年等人为反革命集团，导致潘汉年被重新收监并被判处无期徒刑。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, she accused Pan Hannian and others of being a counter-revolutionary clique, leading to Pan's re-imprisonment and a life sentence.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命开始后，潘汉年被重新收监，并最终被判处无期徒刑，永久开除党籍。
description.en: After the start of the Cultural Revolution, Pan Hannian was re-imprisoned, and eventually sentenced to life imprisonment and permanently expelled from the party.

description.zh-cn: 公开表示应当为潘汉年平反，并向陈云写信阐明观点，对案件的复查起到了推动作用。
description.en: Publicly stated that Pan Hannian should be rehabilitated and wrote to Chen Yun to clarify his views, which helped promote the review of the case.

description.zh-cn: 在收到陈云转交的信件后，同意并支持了对潘汉年案的复查工作。
description.en: After receiving the letter forwarded by Chen Yun, he agreed to and supported the review of Pan Hannian's case.

description.zh-cn: 正式发出《关于为潘汉年同志平反昭雪恢复名誉的通知》，为其公开恢复名誉，推翻了所有不实之词。
description.en: Officially issued the 'Notice on the Rehabilitation and Restoration of Comrade Pan Hannian's Reputation,' publicly clearing his name and overturning all false accusations.

description.zh-cn: 蔡锷曾是梁启超在长沙时务学堂的学生，后在护国运动中成为其重要的政治盟友。
description.en: Cai E was a student of Liang Qichao at the Academy of Current Affairs in Changsha and later became his important political ally during the National Protection War.

description.zh-cn: 在熊希龄内阁中担任司法总长。
description.en: Served as Minister of Justice in Xiong Xiling's cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 在段祺瑞内阁中担任财政总长。
description.en: Served as Minister of Finance in Duan Qirui's cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 康有为未能及时将筹集到的军饷送达，是导致自立军起义仓促发动并最终失败的重要原因之一。
description.en: Kang Youwei's failure to deliver the raised military funds in time was a major reason for the hasty launch and eventual failure of the Self-Strengthening Army Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 戊戌变法失败后，梁启超流亡日本，期间与孙中山会面，商讨合作反清事宜，但因政治理念分歧未能成功。
description.en: After the failure of the Hundred Days' Reform, Liang Qichao went into exile in Japan, where he met with Sun Yat-sen to discuss cooperation against the Qing government, but they failed to reach an agreement due to different political ideologies.

description.zh-cn: 根据Wikitext中的“西盟人”，推断其出生或籍贯地为西盟。
description.en: Based on the text "西盟人" (person from Ximeng), his place of birth or origin is inferred to be Ximeng.

description.zh-cn: 魏金龙是佤族人。
description.en: Wei Jinlong is of the Wa ethnicity.

description.zh-cn: 魏金龙是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Wei Jinlong is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 2018年，魏金龙被选为云南省出席第十三届全国人民代表大会代表。
description.en: In 2018, Wei Jinlong was elected as a deputy from Yunnan Province to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 聂曦自1941年起长期担任吴石的副官。
description.en: Nie Xi served as Wu Shi's long-term aide-de-camp starting from 1941.

description.zh-cn: 聂曦是中国共产党的秘密地下党员。
description.en: Nie Xi was a secret underground member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 聂曦在中华民国陆军的军衔为上校。
description.en: Nie Xi held the rank of Colonel in the Republic of China Army.

position.en: Head of the General Affairs Section

description.zh-cn: 聂曦曾担任国防部史政局总务组组长。
description.en: Nie Xi once served as the Head of the General Affairs Section of the Historical and Political Compilation Bureau of the Ministry of National Defense.

position.en: Chief of the Public Relations Section, General Affairs Department

description.zh-cn: 聂曦赴台后担任东南军政长官公署总务处交际科上校科长。
description.en: After going to Taiwan, Nie Xi served as the Chief of the Public Relations Section in the General Affairs Department of the Southeast Military and Political Administrator's Office, with the rank of Colonel.

description.zh-cn: 因卷入“吴石案”，聂曦被判处死刑，并于1950年6月10日在台北马场町被枪决。
description.en: Due to his involvement in the 'Wu Shi case', Nie Xi was sentenced to death and executed by firing squad at Machangding, Taipei on June 10, 1950.

description.zh-cn: 聂曦在福州与邻居王正均交好，两人同为中共地下党员。
description.en: Nie Xi was on good terms with his neighbor Wang Zhengjun in Fuzhou; both were underground members of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 聂曦介绍王正均接替其职位，担任国防部参谋次长办公室少校副官。
description.en: Nie Xi introduced Wang Zhengjun to take over his position as a Major aide-de-camp in the office of the Deputy Chief of Staff of the Ministry of National Defense.

description.zh-cn: 在1949年福州战役前夕，吴石安排聂曦等人将机密资料移交给解放军第十兵团司令部。
description.en: On the eve of the Fuzhou Campaign in 1949, Wu Shi arranged for Nie Xi and others to transfer confidential materials to the headquarters of the 10th Corps of the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 1949年11月，中共华东局派遣交通员朱枫赴台，负责与吴石接触以传递情报。
description.en: In November 1949, the East China Bureau of the CCP dispatched courier Zhu Feng to Taiwan to make contact with Wu Shi for intelligence transmission.

description.zh-cn: 蔡孝干被捕是吴石案的导火索。情治单位通过其随身物品中的线索（朱枫的照片）进行追查，最终导致吴石等人的间谍网络被破获。
description.en: The arrest of Cai Xiaogan triggered the Wu Shi case. Intelligence units followed leads from items found on his person (a photo of Zhu Feng), which ultimately led to the uncovering of the espionage network involving Wu Shi and others.

description.zh-cn: 作为主犯，吴石被判处死刑，并于1950年6月10日在台北马场町被枪决。
description.en: As the main culprit, Wu Shi was sentenced to death and executed by firing squad at Machangding, Taipei on June 10, 1950.

description.zh-cn: 因卷入“吴石案”，朱枫被判处死刑，并于1950年6月10日在台北马场町被枪决。
description.en: Due to her involvement in the 'Wu Shi case', Zhu Feng was sentenced to death and executed by firing squad at Machangding, Taipei on June 10, 1950.

description.zh-cn: 因卷入“吴石案”，陈宝仓被判处死刑，并于1950年6月10日在台北马场町被枪决。
description.en: Due to his involvement in the 'Wu Shi case', Chen Baocang was sentenced to death and executed by firing squad at Machangding, Taipei on June 10, 1950.

description.zh-cn: 蒋中正驳回了蒋鼎文等人为吴石求情的请求，坚持判处其死刑。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek rejected the plea for clemency for Wu Shi made by Jiang Dingwen and others, insisting on the death penalty.

description.zh-cn: 因蒋鼎文为吴石等人说情，蒋中正感到震怒，并将其革除原职。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek was furious that Jiang Dingwen pleaded for Wu Shi and others, and subsequently removed him from his original post.

description.zh-cn: 因韩德勤为吴石等人说情，蒋中正感到震怒，并将其革除原职。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek was furious that Han Deqin pleaded for Wu Shi and others, and subsequently removed him from his original post.

description.zh-cn: 因刘咏尧为吴石等人说情，蒋中正感到震怒，并将其革除原职。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek was furious that Liu Yongyao pleaded for Wu Shi and others, and subsequently removed him from his original post.

description.zh-cn: 作为审理吴石案的负责人之一，联名向蒋中正求情，希望对吴石等人宽大处理。
description.en: As one of the officials in charge of the Wu Shi case trial, he jointly pleaded with Chiang Kai-shek for leniency towards Wu Shi and the others.

description.zh-cn: 1965年，中华人民共和国追认吴石为革命烈士。
description.en: In 1965, the People's Republic of China posthumously recognized Wu Shi as a revolutionary martyr.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯宣布洪宪帝制，直接引发了蔡锷、唐继尧等人在云南起兵，发动护国战争。
description.en: Yuan Shikai's proclamation of the Hongxian Monarchy directly led to Cai E, Tang Jiyao, and others launching an uprising in Yunnan, starting the National Protection War.

description.zh-cn: 该文是梁启超所著，旨在反对君主立宪国体，对洪宪帝制形成舆论阻力。
description.en: This article, written by Liang Qichao, aimed to oppose the constitutional monarchical system, creating public opinion resistance to the Hongxian Monarchy.

description.zh-cn: 护国战争导致袁世凯病逝，黎元洪依法继任大总统职务。
description.en: The National Protection War led to the death of Yuan Shikai, and Li Yuanhong succeeded him as President according to the law.

description.zh-cn: 护国战争结束后，新任大总统黎元洪宣布恢复《中华民国临时约法》和国会。
description.en: After the end of the National Protection War, the new President Li Yuanhong announced the restoration of the Provisional Constitution of the Republic of China and the National Assembly.

description.zh-cn: 唐继尧联同蔡锷、李烈钧等人在云南宣布独立，起兵讨袁，是护国战争的发起者之一。
description.en: Tang Jiyao, along with Cai E, Li Liejun, and others, declared independence in Yunnan and launched an uprising against Yuan, being one of the initiators of the National Protection War.

description.zh-cn: 李烈钧联同蔡锷、唐继尧等人在云南宣布独立，起兵讨袁，是护国战争的发起者之一。
description.en: Li Liejun, along with Cai E, Tang Jiyao, and others, declared independence in Yunnan and launched an uprising against Yuan, being one of the initiators of the National Protection War.

description.zh-cn: 为在上海发动反袁革命，陈其美组织并成功刺杀了时任上海镇守使郑汝成。
description.en: To launch an anti-Yuan revolution in Shanghai, Chen Qimei organized and successfully assassinated Zheng Rucheng, the then Military Governor of Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯买凶将积极从事反袁活动的中华革命党人陈其美刺杀。
description.en: Yuan Shikai hired assassins to kill Chen Qimei, a member of the Chinese Revolutionary Party who was actively involved in anti-Yuan activities.

description.zh-cn: 作为护国运动的主要领导人之一，唐继尧参与在肇庆成立军务院以统一指挥反袁力量。
description.en: As one of the main leaders of the National Protection Movement, Tang Jiyao participated in the establishment of the Military Affairs Council in Zhaoqing to unify the command of anti-Yuan forces.

description.zh-cn: 梁启超是护国运动的重要策划者，并参与在肇庆成立军务院，担任抚军兼政务委员长。
description.en: Liang Qichao was an important planner of the National Protection Movement and participated in the establishment of the Military Affairs Council in Zhaoqing, serving as Military Governor and Chairman of Political Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 时任江苏都督的冯国璋于1916年4月两次通电，劝说袁世凯退位，对他形成巨大的政治压力。
description.en: Feng Guozhang, then Governor of Jiangsu, sent two telegrams in April 1916 urging Yuan Shikai to abdicate, creating immense political pressure on him.

description.zh-cn: 日本大隈重信内阁认为袁世凯政权是其在华利益的障碍，决定采取促使其下台的政策。
description.en: The Ōkuma Shigenobu Cabinet of Japan considered the Yuan Shikai regime an obstacle to its interests in China and decided to adopt a policy to force him to step down.

description.zh-cn: 作为时任日本首相，大隈重信的内阁会议决定采取让袁世凯退出中国权力圈的方针。
description.en: As the then Prime Minister of Japan, Ōkuma Shigenobu's cabinet meeting decided on a policy to have Yuan Shikai withdraw from the circle of power in China.

description.zh-cn: 在武冈衡阳战斗中，旧桂系军队决定性地歼灭了当地的北洋军队。
description.en: In the Battle of Wugang-Hengyang, the Old Guangxi clique's army decisively annihilated the local Beiyang army forces.

description.zh-cn: 刘进是刘仰峤之女。
description.en: Liu Jin is the daughter of Liu Yangqiao.

description.zh-cn: 王晶垚是卞仲耘的丈夫。
description.en: Wang Jingyao is the husband of Bian Zhongyun.

description.zh-cn: 在卞仲耘被打死当晚，宋彬彬等人向时任中共北京市委第二书记吴德报告了其死因。
description.en: On the night Bian Zhongyun was beaten to death, Song Binbin and others reported the cause of her death to Wu De, who was then the Second Secretary of the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东在得知宋彬彬的名字后说“要武嘛”，此后“宋要武”的名字闻名全国，深刻影响了宋彬彬的公众形象。
description.en: After learning Song Binbin's name, Mao Zedong said, "Be martial (要武嘛)." Subsequently, the name "Song Yaowu" became known nationwide, profoundly influencing Song Binbin's public image.

description.zh-cn: 卞仲耘的丈夫王晶垚认为宋彬彬是杀害其妻的红卫兵主要负责人，多次抗议学校将其评为荣誉校友，并于2014年拒绝接受宋彬彬的道歉，称其虚伪。
description.en: Wang Jingyao, the husband of Bian Zhongyun, considered Song Binbin a main person in charge of the Red Guards who killed his wife. He repeatedly protested the school's decision to honor her as an outstanding alumna and, in 2014, refused to accept her apology, calling it hypocritical.

description.zh-cn: 杨丽霞是云南大理人。
description.en: Yang Lixia is from Dali, Yunnan.

description.zh-cn: 杨丽霞是白族人。
description.en: Yang Lixia is of the Bai ethnicity.

description.zh-cn: 杨丽霞是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Yang Lixia is a member of the Communist Party of China.

position.zh-cn: 解放军和武警部队代表
position.en: Deputy of the People's Liberation Army and Armed Police Force delegation

description.zh-cn: 杨丽霞是第十三届全国人民代表大会解放军和武警部队代表。
description.en: Yang Lixia was a deputy of the People's Liberation Army and Armed Police Force delegation to the 13th National People's Congress.

position.en: Director of the Department of Cardiovascular Medicine

description.zh-cn: 杨丽霞曾担任成都军区昆明总医院（现第九二〇医院）心血管内科主任。
description.en: Yang Lixia previously served as the Director of the Department of Cardiovascular Medicine at Kunming General Hospital of the Chengdu Military Region (now the 920th Hospital).

description.zh-cn: 杨丽霞是第三军医大学（现陆军军医大学）的博士生导师。
description.en: Yang Lixia is a doctoral supervisor at the Third Military Medical University (now the Army Medical University).

description.zh-cn: 杨丽霞是昆明医科大学的博士生导师。
description.en: Yang Lixia is a doctoral supervisor at Kunming Medical University.

description.zh-cn: 昆明总医院（现第九二〇医院）曾隶属于成都军区，直到2016年成都军区被撤销。
description.en: Kunming General Hospital (now the 920th Hospital) was subordinate to the Chengdu Military Region until the region was disbanded in 2016.

description.zh-cn: 2024年5月30日，马朝旭在华盛顿会见美国副国务卿库尔特·坎贝尔。
description.en: On May 30, 2024, Ma Zhaoxu met with U.S. Deputy Secretary of State Kurt Campbell in Washington.

description.zh-cn: 马朝旭接替乐玉成出任中华人民共和国外交部常务副部长。
description.en: Ma Zhaoxu succeeded Le Yucheng as the Executive Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 马朝旭接替刘结一担任中国常驻联合国代表。
description.en: Ma Zhaoxu succeeded Liu Jieyi as the Permanent Representative of China to the United Nations.

description.zh-cn: 张军接替马朝旭担任中国常驻联合国代表。
description.en: Zhang Jun succeeded Ma Zhaoxu as the Permanent Representative of China to the United Nations.

description.zh-cn: 马朝旭接替陈育明任中华人民共和国驻澳大利亚大使。
description.en: Ma Zhaoxu succeeded Chen Yuming as the Ambassador of the People's Republic of China to Australia.

description.zh-cn: 成竞业接替马朝旭任中华人民共和国驻澳大利亚大使。
description.en: Cheng Jingye succeeded Ma Zhaoxu as the Ambassador of the People's Republic of China to Australia.

description.zh-cn: 马朝旭接替吴海龙，任常驻联合国日内瓦办事处和瑞士其他国际组织代表。
description.en: Ma Zhaoxu succeeded Wu Hailong as the Permanent Representative to the United Nations Office at Geneva and other International Organizations in Switzerland.

description.zh-cn: 俞建华接替马朝旭，任常驻联合国日内瓦办事处和瑞士其他国际组织代表。
description.en: Yu Jianhua succeeded Ma Zhaoxu as the Permanent Representative to the United Nations Office at Geneva and other International Organizations in Switzerland.

description.zh-cn: 马朝旭接替刘建超担任中华人民共和国外交部新闻司司长。
description.en: Ma Zhaoxu succeeded Liu Jianchao as the Director-General of the Information Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 秦刚接替马朝旭出任外交部新闻司司长。
description.en: Qin Gang succeeded Ma Zhaoxu as Director-General of the Information Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 在担任中华人民共和国外交部副部长及常务副部长期间，于王毅任外交部长时为其下属。
description.en: During his tenure as Vice Minister and Executive Vice Minister of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, he was a subordinate of Wang Yi when Wang was the Foreign Minister.

description.zh-cn: 在担任中华人民共和国外交部副部长及常务副部长期间，于秦刚任外交部长时为其下属。
description.en: During his tenure as Vice Minister and Executive Vice Minister of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, he was a subordinate of Qin Gang when Qin was the Foreign Minister.

description.zh-cn: 根据文本，毕春景是一名中共党员。
description.en: According to the text, Bi Chunjing is a member of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框，毕春景在中国人民武装警察部队服役。
description.en: According to the infobox, Bi Chunjing serves in the Chinese People's Armed Police Force.

description.zh-cn: 自2019年4月起，毕春景出任武警黑龙江省总队政委。
description.en: Since April 2019, Bi Chunjing has served as the Political Commissar of the PAP Heilongjiang Provincial Corps.

description.zh-cn: 毕春景是北京市第十五届人民代表大会代表。
description.en: Bi Chunjing was a delegate to the 15th Beijing Municipal People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 武警黑龙江省总队是中国人民武装警察部队的下属单位。
description.en: The PAP Heilongjiang Provincial Corps is a subordinate unit of the Chinese People's Armed Police Force.

description.zh-cn: 武警北京市总队是中国人民武装警察部队的下属单位。
description.en: The PAP Beijing Municipal Corps is a subordinate unit of the Chinese People's Armed Police Force.

description.zh-cn: 董学书是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Dong Xueshu is a member of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 邓楠是邓小平的女儿。
description.en: Deng Nan is the daughter of Deng Xiaoping.

description.zh-cn: 邓楠于1945年10月15日出生于河北省涉县。
description.en: Deng Nan was born on October 15, 1945, in She County, Hebei Province.

description.zh-cn: 邓楠于1964年毕业于北京师范大学附属实验中学（原师大女附中）。
description.en: Deng Nan graduated from The High School Affiliated to Beijing Normal University (formerly the Girls' High School Affiliated to Beijing Normal University) in 1964.

description.zh-cn: 邓楠于1970年毕业于北京大学物理系。
description.en: Deng Nan graduated from the Department of Physics at Peking University in 1970.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，邓楠在陕西汉中地区劳动，中断了正常的学术或职业发展。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Deng Nan labored in the Hanzhong area of Shaanxi, which interrupted her normal academic or professional development.

description.zh-cn: 邓楠曾在中国科学院自动化研究所任研究实习员。
description.en: Deng Nan once served as a research intern at the Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 邓楠曾在中国科学院半导体研究所任研究实习员。
description.en: Deng Nan once served as a research intern at the Institute of Semiconductors, Chinese Academy of Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 邓楠曾任原国家科委政策局副局长、社会发展司司长，1991年11月任国家科委副主任，1998年4月出任改组后的科学技术部副部长，直至2004年10月调任中国科协。
description.en: Deng Nan served as Deputy Director of the Policy Bureau and Director of the Department of Social Development of the former State Science and Technology Commission (SSTC), became Vice Chairman of the SSTC in November 1991, and was appointed Vice Minister of the reorganized Ministry of Science and Technology in April 1998, a position she held until she was transferred to the China Association for Science and Technology in October 2004.

position.zh-cn: 党组书记、书记处第一书记、常务副主席
position.en: Party Group Secretary, First Secretary of the Secretariat, Executive Vice Chairman

description.zh-cn: 邓楠于2004年10月至2011年4月在中国科学技术协会担任党组书记、书记处第一书记、常务副主席等职务。
description.en: From October 2004 to April 2011, Deng Nan served in various roles at the China Association for Science and Technology, including Party Group Secretary, First Secretary of the Secretariat, and Executive Vice Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 邓楠于2007年10月当选为中国共产党第十七届中央委员会委员。
description.en: Deng Nan was elected as a member of the 17th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party in October 2007.

position.zh-cn: 委员、常务委员、教科文卫体委员会副主任
position.en: Member, Standing Committee Member, Vice Director of the Committee for Education, Science, Culture, Health and Sports

description.zh-cn: 邓楠于2003年当选第十届全国政协委员，2011年增补为第十一届全国政协委员、教科文卫体委员会副主任，2013年当选第十二届全国政协常委及科教文卫体委员会副主任。
description.en: Deng Nan was elected as a member of the 10th National Committee of the CPPCC in 2003, was added as a member of the 11th National Committee and Vice Director of its Committee for Education, Science, Culture, Health and Sports in 2011, and was elected as a Standing Committee member of the 12th National Committee and Vice Director of its Committee for Education, Science, Culture, Health and Sports in 2013.

description.zh-cn: 张宏是邓楠的丈夫。
description.en: Zhang Hong is the husband of Deng Nan.

description.zh-cn: 张宏毕业于北京大学。
description.en: Zhang Hong graduated from Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 张宏出生于江苏省泰州。
description.en: Zhang Hong was born in Taizhou, Jiangsu province.

description.zh-cn: 邓楠是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Deng Nan is a member of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 蔡正元于2018年10月18日至2019年6月3日担任国会政党联盟总顾问。
description.en: Tsai Cheng-yuan served as the Chief Advisor of the Congress Party Alliance from October 18, 2018, to June 3, 2019.

description.zh-cn: 蔡正元曾任第五、六、七、八届立法委员。
description.en: Tsai Cheng-yuan served as a legislator for the 5th, 6th, 7th, and 8th terms.

description.zh-cn: 吕德康曾担任中国青年艺术剧院的党委书记。
description.en: Lü Dekang once served as the Party Secretary of the China Youth Art Theatre.

description.zh-cn: 在周恩来担任总理期间任国防部长。
description.en: Served as Minister of National Defense during Zhou Enlai's premiership.

description.zh-cn: 在华国锋担任总理期间任国防部长。
description.en: Served as Minister of National Defense during Hua Guofeng's premiership.

description.zh-cn: 在赵紫阳担任总理期间任国防部长。
description.en: Served as Minister of National Defense during Zhao Ziyang's premiership.

description.zh-cn: 担任国防部长期间，中越战争爆发。
description.en: The Sino-Vietnamese War broke out during his tenure as Minister of National Defense.

description.zh-cn: 在赵紫阳担任总理期间任国防部长。
description.en: Served as Minister of National Defense during Zhao Ziyang's premiership.

description.zh-cn: 在邓小平担任军委主席期间任国防部长。
description.en: Served as Minister of National Defense while Deng Xiaoping was Chairman of the Central Military Commission.

description.en: Xi Jinping once served as Geng Biao's secretary.

description.en: Served as Minister of National Defense during Li Keqiang's premiership.

description.en: Served as Minister of National Defense while Xi Jinping was Chairman of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 担任国防部长期间，深化国防和军队改革开始。
description.en: During his tenure as Minister of National Defense, the deepening of national defense and military reform began.

description.zh-cn: 被开除党籍。
description.en: Expelled from the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 全国人大常委会通过免去李尚福的国务委员、国防部长职务。
description.en: The Standing Committee of the National People's Congress approved the removal of Li Shangfu from his posts as State Councilor and Minister of National Defense.

description.zh-cn: 在李强担任总理期间任国防部长。
description.en: Serves as Minister of National Defense during Li Qiang's premiership.

description.zh-cn: 在习近平担任军委主席期间任国防部长。
description.en: Serves as Minister of National Defense while Xi Jinping is Chairman of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 国防部部长人选由全国人民代表大会投票表决通过。
description.en: The candidate for Minister of National Defense is approved by a vote of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 2023年3月10日，在第十四届全国人民代表大会上，铁凝当选为全国人大常委会副委员长。
description.en: On March 10, 2023, at the 14th National People's Congress, Tie Ning was elected as a Vice Chairperson of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 自2016年12月起，铁凝担任中国文学艺术界联合会主席。
description.en: Since December 2016, Tie Ning has served as the Chairperson of the China Federation of Literary and Art Circles.

description.zh-cn: 自1985年起担任中国作家协会理事，1996年底当选为副主席，2006年11月12日起担任主席，预计于2025年3月卸任。
description.en: She has been a council member of the China Writers Association since 1985, was elected Vice Chairperson at the end of 1996, and has served as Chairperson since November 12, 2006, with her term expected to end in March 2025.

description.zh-cn: 铁凝于1957年9月出生于北京。
description.en: Tie Ning was born in Beijing in September 1957.

description.zh-cn: 铁凝于1975年11月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Tie Ning joined the Communist Party of China in November 1975.

description.zh-cn: 习近平任命铁凝为国家主席特使，出席墨西哥总统权力交接仪式。
description.en: Xi Jinping appointed Tie Ning as his special presidential envoy to attend the Mexican presidential inauguration.

description.zh-cn: 铁凝于2002年凭借中篇小说《永远有多远》获得老舍文学奖。
description.en: Tie Ning won the Lao She Literary Award in 2002 for her novella 'How Long is Forever'.

description.zh-cn: 铁凝是中共第十八届、十九届、二十届中央委员。
description.en: Tie Ning is a member of the 18th, 19th, and 20th Central Committees of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央根据毛泽东的建议，决定调各中央局书记到中央工作，发起了“五马进京”事件。
description.en: Based on Mao Zedong's suggestion, the CCP Central Committee decided to transfer secretaries of various central bureaus to work in the central government, initiating the 'Five Horses Enter Beijing' incident.

description.zh-cn: “五马进京”事件旨在削弱大行政区的地方权力，加强中央集权。
description.en: The 'Five Horses Enter Beijing' incident aimed to weaken the local power of the great administrative areas and strengthen central authority.

description.zh-cn: 作为“五马进京”加强中央集权的一部分，中央人民政府于1952年11月成立了国家计划委员会。
description.en: As part of the centralization of power in the 'Five Horses Enter Beijing' incident, the Central People's Government established the State Planning Commission in November 1952.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜战争进入停战谈判阶段，经济恢复时期基本结束，为中国进行大规模经济建设和加强中央集权（如“五马进京”）创造了条件。
description.en: As the Korean War entered the armistice negotiation stage and the period of economic recovery basically ended, conditions were created for China to carry out large-scale economic construction and strengthen central authority (such as the 'Five Horses Enter Beijing' incident).

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东不满新民主主义经济政策，希望通过“五马进京”及成立国家计委来转向社会主义计划经济。
description.en: Mao Zedong was dissatisfied with the New Democratic economic policy and hoped to shift towards a socialist planned economy through the 'Five Horses Enter Beijing' incident and the establishment of the State Planning Commission.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东希望通过“五马进京”及成立国家计委来推动社会主义计划经济的实施。
description.en: Mao Zedong hoped to promote the implementation of a socialist planned economy through the 'Five Horses Enter Beijing' incident and the establishment of the State Planning Commission.

description.zh-cn: 国家计划委员会成立后，与政务院平级，并接管了政务院管辖的经济大权，改变了政务院总理周恩来实际上掌管国家事务的局面。
description.en: After its establishment, the State Planning Commission was on the same level as the Government Administration Council and took over the economic powers under its jurisdiction, changing the situation where Premier Zhou Enlai effectively managed state affairs.

description.zh-cn: 土地改革运动中，乡绅阶层随地主阶级一同消亡，改变了中国农村的社会结构。
description.en: During the Land Reform Movement, the gentry class disappeared along with the landlord class, changing the social structure of rural China.

description.zh-cn: 土地改革运动大大削弱了富农的经济实力，并在政治上孤立了富农。
description.en: The Land Reform Movement significantly weakened the economic power of rich peasants and politically isolated them.

description.zh-cn: 该大纲是国共内战时期中共进行土地改革的纲领性文件，为建国后的土地改革运动奠定了基础。
description.en: This outline was the programmatic document for the CCP's land reform during the Civil War, laying the foundation for the Land Reform Movement after the founding of the PRC.

description.zh-cn: 在1947年的全国土地会议上，中国共产党制定并通过了《中国土地法大纲》。
description.en: At the National Land Conference in 1947, the Communist Party of China formulated and passed the 'Outline Land Law of China'.

description.zh-cn: 《中国土地法大纲》于1947年10月10日经中共中央批准正式公布。
description.en: The 'Outline Land Law of China' was officially promulgated with the approval of the CPC Central Committee on October 10, 1947.

description.zh-cn: 农业合作化运动通过将土地等生产资料转为集体所有，收回了在土地改革中分给农民的土地所有权。
description.en: The Agricultural Collectivization Movement reclaimed the land ownership granted to peasants during the Land Reform by transferring land and other means of production to collective ownership.

description.zh-cn: 人民公社化运动进一步将土地所有权收归集体，剥夺了农民对土地的所有权、使用权和经营权。
description.en: The People's Commune Movement further consolidated land ownership under the collective, stripping peasants of their rights of ownership, use, and management of the land.

description.zh-cn: 林立果是林彪的儿子。
description.en: Lin Liguo is the son of Lin Biao.

description.zh-cn: 周宇驰是《“571工程”纪要》的共同密谋者之一。
description.en: Zhou Yuchi was one of the co-conspirators of the "Project 571 Outline".

description.zh-cn: 于新野执笔起草了《“571工程”纪要》。
description.en: Yu Xinye drafted the "Project 571 Outline".

description.zh-cn: 李伟信是《“571工程”纪要》的共同密谋者之一。
description.en: Li Weixin was one of the co-conspirators of the "Project 571 Outline".

description.zh-cn: 九一三事件的发生导致《“571工程”纪要》政变计划败露并最终失败。
description.en: The occurrence of the September 13th Incident led to the exposure and ultimate failure of the coup plan outlined in the "Project 571 Outline".

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东不顾周恩来等人劝阻，执意批准将《“571工程”纪要》全文下发全国进行传达和批判。
description.en: Disregarding the advice of Zhou Enlai and others, Mao Zedong insisted on approving the nationwide distribution of the full text of the "Project 571 Outline" for circulation and criticism.

description.zh-cn: 经毛泽东首肯后，中共中央以文件的形式将《“571工程”纪要》向全国人民传达。
description.en: After Mao Zedong's approval, the CCP Central Committee circulated the "Project 571 Outline" to the entire nation in the form of an official document.

description.zh-cn: 周恩来等人曾劝阻毛泽东，反对将《“571工程”纪要》全文下发。
description.en: Zhou Enlai and others advised Mao Zedong against distributing the full text of the "Project 571 Outline".

description.zh-cn: 《“571工程”纪要》中的思想和语句对1976年天安门广场“四五运动”中的诗篇和言论产生了明显影响。
description.en: The ideas and phrases from the "Project 571 Outline" significantly influenced the poems and speeches during the 1976 "Four-Five Movement" in Tiananmen Square.

description.zh-cn: 该纪要对毛泽东的直接批判以及其在全国的传达，客观上揭示了文化大革命的内部矛盾和弊病，起到了启蒙作用，动摇了文革的群众基础。
description.en: The document's direct criticism of Mao Zedong and its nationwide circulation objectively revealed the internal contradictions and problems of the Cultural Revolution, serving an enlightening role and shaking the movement's mass support.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东的逝世是导致文化大革命结束的关键事件之一。
description.en: Mao Zedong's death was one of the key events that led to the end of the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 根据魏京生的评论，邓小平后来的改革，除了不反毛泽东之外，其余内容均是按照《“571工程”纪要》来的。
description.en: According to commentary by Wei Jingsheng, Deng Xiaoping's later reforms, apart from not opposing Mao Zedong, followed the contents of the "Project 571 Outline".

description.zh-cn: 大清帝国在鸦片战争中战败，是导致香港岛被割让的直接原因。
description.en: The Qing Empire was defeated in the Opium War, which was the direct cause of the cession of Hong Kong Island.

description.zh-cn: 英国在鸦片战争中获胜，为其占领香港岛创造了条件。
description.en: The United Kingdom's victory in the Opium War created the conditions for its occupation of Hong Kong Island.

description.zh-cn: 《南京条约》的签订正式确定了将香港岛割让给英国。
description.en: The signing of the Treaty of Nanking formally confirmed the cession of Hong Kong Island to the United Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 通过香港割让，大清帝国丧失了对香港岛的主权。
description.en: Through the cession of Hong Kong, the Qing Empire lost its sovereignty over Hong Kong Island.

description.zh-cn: 通过香港割让，英国获得了对香港岛的主权。
description.en: Through the cession of Hong Kong, the United Kingdom gained sovereignty over Hong Kong Island.

description.zh-cn: 查理·义律率领英军最先占领香港岛，并举行升旗仪式，标志着香港开埠的开始。
description.en: Charles Elliot led British forces to first occupy Hong Kong Island and held a flag-raising ceremony, marking the beginning of the founding of Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 香港开埠后，香港岛成为最早被发展的地区，并逐渐成为行政和商业中心。
description.en: After the founding of Hong Kong, Hong Kong Island became the earliest developed area and gradually became the administrative and commercial center.

description.zh-cn: 在香港保卫战中，驻港英军最终向日军投降，结束了英国在香港的统治。
description.en: During the Battle of Hong Kong, the British garrison surrendered to the Japanese army, ending British rule in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 日本通过香港保卫战的胜利，成功占领香港，开始了日占时期。
description.en: Through its victory in the Battle of Hong Kong, Japan successfully occupied Hong Kong, beginning the period of Japanese occupation.

description.zh-cn: 日军在香港保卫战胜利后，开始了对香港为期三年零八个月的占领。
description.en: After their victory in the Battle of Hong Kong, the Japanese army began a three-year and eight-month occupation of Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战结束后，香港岛人口剧增，岛上不少地方开始发展。
description.en: After the end of World War II, the population of Hong Kong Island surged, and many areas on the island began to develop.

description.zh-cn: 香港主权移交结束了英国对香港岛长达150多年的殖民统治。
description.en: The handover of Hong Kong ended more than 150 years of British colonial rule over Hong Kong Island.

description.zh-cn: 通过香港主权移交，中华人民共和国恢复对香港岛行使主权。
description.en: Through the handover of Hong Kong, the People's Republic of China resumed the exercise of sovereignty over Hong Kong Island.

description.zh-cn: 清朝初年的迁界令导致香港岛上的原居民被全数迫迁，严重影响了岛上的人口和社会结构。
description.en: The Great Clearance policy of the early Qing dynasty led to the forced relocation of all original inhabitants from Hong Kong Island, severely impacting the island's population and social structure.

description.zh-cn: 南丫岛发电厂为整个香港岛供应电力。
description.en: The Lamma Power Station supplies electricity to the entirety of Hong Kong Island.

description.zh-cn: 蜀汉以承继汉室为名，与篡汉的曹魏分庭抗礼，多次进行北伐。
description.en: Shu Han, claiming to be the legitimate successor to the Han dynasty, rivaled the usurping state of Cao Wei and launched multiple northern expeditions against it.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮主政后，立即与东吴修复关系，恢复了联吴抗曹的政策。
description.en: After Zhuge Liang took charge, he immediately repaired relations with Eastern Wu, resuming the policy of allying with Wu to resist Cao Wei.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮的第一次北伐在街亭之战中因马谡的失误而失败。
description.en: Zhuge Liang's first northern expedition failed due to Ma Su's mistakes at the Battle of Jieting.

description.zh-cn: 姜维的多次大规模北伐严重消耗了蜀汉国力，导致人民困苦不堪。
description.en: Jiang Wei's numerous large-scale northern expeditions severely drained Shu Han's national strength, causing great hardship for the people.

description.zh-cn: 公元263年，曹魏发动伐蜀之战，导致蜀汉灭亡。
description.en: In 263 AD, Cao Wei launched a campaign to conquer Shu, which led to the demise of Shu Han.

description.zh-cn: 曹魏的实际掌权者司马昭在得知蜀汉内部状况后，决定发动伐蜀之战。
description.en: Sima Zhao, the de facto ruler of Cao Wei, decided to launch the campaign to conquer Shu after learning about its internal conditions.

description.zh-cn: 面对邓艾军队的进攻，刘禅接受投降建议，带领成都文武百官出降，蜀汉正式灭亡。
description.en: Facing the advance of Deng Ai's army, Liu Shan accepted advice to surrender and led the officials of Chengdu to capitulate, formally ending Shu Han.

description.zh-cn: 邓艾在进攻成都途中，击败并斩杀了负责防守的卫将军诸葛瞻。
description.en: On his way to attack Chengdu, Deng Ai defeated and killed General-in-Chief of the Guards Zhuge Zhan, who was in charge of the defense.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛瞻与董厥等大臣因姜维多次北伐无功、耗费国力而感到反感，曾上书要求剥夺其兵权。
description.en: Zhuge Zhan, along with other ministers like Dong Jue, disapproved of Jiang Wei's repeated fruitless northern expeditions that drained national resources, and they once petitioned to have his military command revoked.

description.zh-cn: 董厥与诸葛瞻等大臣因姜维多次北伐无功、耗费国力而感到反感，曾上书要求剥夺其兵权。
description.en: Dong Jue, along with other ministers like Zhuge Zhan, disapproved of Jiang Wei's repeated fruitless northern expeditions that drained national resources, and they once petitioned to have his military command revoked.

description.zh-cn: 刘禅接受了大臣谯周的意见，决定投降。
description.en: Liu Shan accepted the advice of his minister Qiao Zhou and decided to surrender.

description.zh-cn: 刘备通过汉中之战成功从曹操手中夺取了汉中地区，并于同年自封为汉中王。
description.en: Through the Hanzhong Campaign, Liu Bei successfully seized the Hanzhong region from Cao Cao and declared himself King of Hanzhong in the same year.

description.zh-cn: 刘备在汉中之战中击败了曹操，成功夺取了汉中。
description.en: Liu Bei defeated Cao Cao in the Hanzhong Campaign and successfully captured Hanzhong.

description.zh-cn: 齐云是齐心的姐姐。
description.en: Qi Yun is Qi Xin's elder sister.

description.zh-cn: 七七事变前夕，齐心考入北平市立第一女子中学（现北京一六一中学）。
description.en: On the eve of the Marco Polo Bridge Incident, Qi Xin was admitted to the Beiping Municipal First Girls' High School (now Beijing 161 Middle School).

description.zh-cn: 1943年冬天，时任抗大校长何长工写信向习仲勋介绍齐心，促成了他们的相识与婚姻。
description.en: In the winter of 1943, He Changgong, then president of the Counter-Japanese Military and Political University, wrote a letter to Xi Zhongxun introducing Qi Xin, which led to their acquaintance and marriage.

description.zh-cn: 与丈夫习仲勋一同接待了来华访问的蒙古领导人泽登巴尔夫妇。
description.en: Together with her husband Xi Zhongxun, she received the visiting Mongolian leader Yumjaagiin Tsedenbal and his wife.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，康生将齐心列入500人黑名单，导致她受到审查。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Kang Sheng placed Qi Xin on a blacklist of 500 people, which led to her being investigated.

description.zh-cn: 因丈夫习仲勋的问题，齐心在文化大革命期间受到审查，并在五七干校劳动了7年。
description.en: Due to her husband Xi Zhongxun's problems, Qi Xin was investigated during the Cultural Revolution and spent 7 years in labor at a May Seventh Cadre School.

description.zh-cn: 在齐心写信求助后，周恩来作出批复，安排齐心母子见到了被关押的习仲勋，并帮助解决了其生活困难。
description.en: After Qi Xin wrote a letter asking for help, Zhou Enlai gave instructions to arrange for her and her children to meet the imprisoned Xi Zhongxun and helped solve their living difficulties.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命结束后，为帮助丈夫习仲勋复出而四处奔走“上访”。
description.en: After the end of the Cultural Revolution, she traveled extensively to petition for her husband Xi Zhongxun's political rehabilitation.

description.zh-cn: 受齐心所托，向邓小平为习仲勋说情，促成了其政治复出。
description.en: At the request of Qi Xin, he interceded with Deng Xiaoping on behalf of Xi Zhongxun, which led to his political rehabilitation.

description.zh-cn: 胡耀邦在担任中共中央总书记期间提拔了大量有共青团背景的官员，形成了第一代团派，因此被认为是团派的创始人。
description.en: During his tenure as General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, Hu Yaobang promoted a large number of officials with backgrounds in the Communist Youth League, forming the first generation of the Tuanpai (Youth League Faction), and is thus considered its founder.

description.zh-cn: 在习近平主导的反腐运动中，多位团派高级官员被查处、撤职或调职，导致团派势力受到严重削弱。
description.en: In the anti-corruption campaign led by Xi Jinping, several high-ranking officials of the Tuanpai (Youth League Faction) were investigated, dismissed, or transferred, severely weakening the faction's power.

description.zh-cn: 令计划因严重违纪问题被中共中央纪委调查，并于2015年7月被开除党籍和公职。
description.en: Ling Jihua was investigated by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection for serious violations of discipline and was expelled from the party and public office in July 2015.

description.zh-cn: 六四事件后，与赵紫阳关系密切的第一代团派成员大多被清洗，团派作为一个党内派系一度不复存在。
description.en: After the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests, most members of the first-generation Tuanpai (Youth League Faction) who were close to Zhao Ziyang were purged, and the faction temporarily ceased to exist as an intra-party group.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平等元老对胡锦涛的赏识是其最终能成为最高领导人的重要因素。
description.en: The appreciation from party elders like Deng Xiaoping was a significant factor in Hu Jintao's ultimate rise to the paramount leadership position.

description.zh-cn: 习近平上任后，逐渐提拔自己的亲信（被称为“习派”或“之江新军”）出任党政重要职位。
description.en: After taking office, Xi Jinping gradually promoted his own confidants (known as the 'Xi Faction' or 'Zhijiang New Army') to important party and government positions.

description.zh-cn: 在中共十九大上，原本被视为接班人选的胡春华未能进入中共中央政治局常务委员会。
description.en: At the 19th CPC National Congress, Hu Chunhua, who was once considered a potential successor, failed to be elected to the Politburo Standing Committee.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛在胡耀邦担任总书记期间获得提拔。
description.en: Hu Jintao was promoted during Hu Yaobang's tenure as General Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 1983年，时任共青团书记的胡锦涛看中李克强，将其引荐至共青团中央委员会并视其为门徒。李克强由此成为胡锦涛政治上的重要盟友和潜在继任者之一。
description.en: In 1983, Hu Jintao, then secretary of the Communist Youth League, recognized Li Keqiang's potential, brought him into the CYL Central Committee, and regarded him as a protégé. Li Keqiang subsequently became one of Hu Jintao's key political allies and potential successors.

description.zh-cn: 胡春华由胡锦涛举荐，曾被视为隔代指定的接班人。
description.en: Hu Chunhua was recommended by Hu Jintao and was once seen as the designated successor for the next generation.

description.zh-cn: 布茹玛汗·毛勒朵是新疆乌恰人。
description.en: Burmakan Molde is from Wuqia, Xinjiang.

description.zh-cn: 布茹玛汗·毛勒朵是柯尔克孜族人。
description.en: Burmakan Molde is of the Kirgiz ethnicity.

description.zh-cn: 担任中华人民共和国的守边员，长期在中国和吉尔吉斯斯坦的边境线上巡边。
description.en: Served as a border guard for the People's Republic of China, patrolling the border line between China and Kyrgyzstan for a long time.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类，布茹玛汗·毛勒朵是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to the page category, Burmakan Molde is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科页面信息，廖仁旺是湖南蓝山人。
description.en: According to the Wikipedia page, Liao Renwang is from Lanshan, Hunan.

description.zh-cn: 廖仁旺是汉族。
description.en: Liao Renwang is of Han ethnicity.

description.zh-cn: 廖仁旺是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Liao Renwang is a member of the Communist Party of China.

position.zh-cn: 全国人大代表（湖南地区）
position.en: Deputy to the National People's Congress (Hunan region)

description.zh-cn: 2018年2月24日，廖仁旺当选为第十三届全国人民代表大会湖南地区代表。
description.en: On February 24, 2018, Liao Renwang was elected as a deputy from the Hunan region to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 林向荣为中国清朝武官官员。
description.en: Lin Xiangrong was a military official of the Qing Dynasty in China.

description.zh-cn: 林向荣本籍福建厦门。
description.en: Lin Xiangrong's native place was Xiamen, Fujian.

description.zh-cn: 1857年奉旨接任台湾镇总兵，直至1862年殉职。
description.en: In 1857, he was appointed as the Taiwan Town General by imperial decree and held the position until his death in 1862.

description.zh-cn: 在台湾清治时期，台湾镇总兵受台湾道制约。
description.en: During the period of Qing rule in Taiwan, the Taiwan Town General was supervised by the Taiwan Circuit.

description.zh-cn: 1862年，林向荣于戴潮春事件中的斗六门战役殉职。
description.en: In 1862, Lin Xiangrong was killed in the Battle of Douliumen during the Dai Chaochun Incident.

description.zh-cn: 1857年，林向荣奉旨接替邵连科担任台湾镇总兵。
description.en: In 1857, Lin Xiangrong was appointed by imperial decree to succeed Shao Lianke as the Taiwan Town General.

description.zh-cn: 1862年林向荣殉职后，由曾元福接任台湾镇总兵。
description.en: After Lin Xiangrong's death in 1862, Zeng Yuanfu succeeded him as the Taiwan Town General.

description.zh-cn: 以“枉法诬贤”、“蠹害政治”等罪名，将时任宰相胡惟庸凌迟处死。
description.en: Executed Chancellor Hu Weiyong by lingchi (death by a thousand cuts) on charges such as 'perverting the law and framing the virtuous' and 'harming politics'.

description.zh-cn: 开国功臣李善长在胡惟庸案中被指“知逆谋不举”，受株连被杀。
description.en: The founding father Li Shanchang was implicated in the Hu Weiyong case, accused of 'knowing of the rebellion plot but failing to report it', and was subsequently executed.

description.zh-cn: 在诛杀胡惟庸后，朱元璋宣布废除丞相制度，以加强皇权。
description.en: After executing Hu Weiyong, Zhu Yuanzhang announced the abolition of the chancellery system to strengthen imperial power.

description.zh-cn: 在废除丞相后，朱元璋设立内阁作为皇帝的顾问机构。
description.en: After abolishing the chancellery, Zhu Yuanzhang established the Grand Secretariat (Neige) as an advisory body to the emperor.

description.zh-cn: 胡惟庸案的延续，其中靖宁侯叶升因“交通胡惟庸”被杀，此事揭开了蓝玉案的序幕。
description.en: As a continuation of the Hu Weiyong case, the execution of Marquis Ye Sheng for 'communicating with Hu Weiyong' served as the prelude to the Lan Yu case.

description.zh-cn: 胡惟庸案是明初四大案之一，与蓝玉案合称为胡蓝党狱。
description.en: The Hu Weiyong case is one of the Four Major Cases of the early Ming dynasty, and together with the Lan Yu case, it is collectively known as the Hu-Lan Case.

description.zh-cn: 胡惟庸案与蓝玉案合称为胡蓝党狱。
description.en: The Hu Weiyong case and the Lan Yu case are collectively known as the Hu-Lan Case.

description.zh-cn: 朱元璋在胡惟庸案爆发前夕赐死右丞相汪广洋。
description.en: The Hongwu Emperor ordered Right Chancellor Wang Guangyang to commit suicide on the eve of the Hu Weiyong case.

description.zh-cn: 大将军徐达极其厌恶胡惟庸，并向朱元璋密报其奸行。
description.en: Grand General Xu Da deeply detested Hu Weiyong and secretly reported his villainous activities to the Hongwu Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 胡惟庸试图收买徐达的守门人福寿以谋害徐达，但被福寿揭发。
description.en: Hu Weiyong attempted to bribe Xu Da's gatekeeper, Fushou, to assassinate Xu Da, but Fushou exposed the plot.

description.zh-cn: 御史中丞商暠也告发了胡惟庸的阴谋。
description.en: Censor-in-chief Shang Gao also exposed Hu Weiyong's conspiracy.

description.zh-cn: 因其孙宋慎卷入胡惟庸案，宋濂受到株连，被贬死于四川夔州。
description.en: Due to his grandson Song Shen's involvement in the Hu Weiyong case, Song Lian was implicated and died in exile in Kuizhou, Sichuan.

description.zh-cn: 宋濂的孙子宋慎因胡惟庸案受牵连被杀。
description.en: Song Shen, the grandson of Song Lian, was implicated and executed in the Hu Weiyong case.

description.zh-cn: 胡惟庸案一直延续到洪武二十五年，靖宁侯叶升因“交通胡惟庸”被杀。
description.en: The Hu Weiyong case continued until the 25th year of the Hongwu reign, when Marquis Ye Sheng of Jingning was executed for 'communicating with Hu Weiyong'.

description.zh-cn: 叶升是蓝玉的姻亲。
description.en: Ye Sheng was a relative of Lan Yu by marriage.

description.zh-cn: 胡惟庸于洪武六年任右丞相，后升任左丞相，独相数年。
description.en: Hu Weiyong was appointed Right Chancellor in the 6th year of the Hongwu reign, later promoted to Left Chancellor, and served as the sole chancellor for several years.

description.zh-cn: 朱元璋废除丞相后，六部尚书直接对皇帝负责，分理天下事务。
description.en: After Zhu Yuanzhang abolished the chancellery, the ministers of the Six Ministries became directly responsible to the emperor, managing the affairs of the state.

description.zh-cn: 根据野史记载，太监云奇拼死拦住朱元璋座驾，揭发了胡惟庸的谋反计划。
description.en: According to unofficial histories, the eunuch Yun Qi desperately stopped the Hongwu Emperor's carriage, exposing Hu Weiyong's rebellion plot.

description.zh-cn: 李治廷于1987年2月26日出生于香港。
description.en: Aarif Rahman was born in Hong Kong on February 26, 1987.

description.zh-cn: 2008年于伦敦帝国学院物理系毕业。
description.en: Graduated from the Department of Physics at Imperial College London in 2008.

description.zh-cn: 2009年至2016年期间，李治廷签约东亚唱片(A Music)及其经纪公司百仕活。
description.en: From 2009 to 2016, Aarif Rahman was signed to the record label A Music and its management company.

description.zh-cn: 李治廷凭借其在电影《岁月神偷》中的演出，获得了第29届香港电影金像奖“最佳新演员奖”。
description.en: For his performance in the film 'Echoes of the Rainbow', Aarif Rahman won the Best New Performer award at the 29th Hong Kong Film Awards.

description.zh-cn: 凭借在电视剧《武媚娘传奇》中饰演唐高宗李治一角，李治廷在中国大陆人气急升，并获得第17届华鼎奖中国古代题材电视剧最佳男演员。
description.en: His role as Emperor Gaozong of Tang (Li Zhi) in the TV series 'The Empress of China' led to a surge in his popularity in mainland China and earned him the Best Actor in a Chinese historical drama at the 17th Huading Awards.

description.zh-cn: 凭借电影《一夜惊喜》，李治廷获得第1届伦敦国际华语电影节最佳新锐演员奖。
description.en: With the film 'One Night Surprise', Aarif Rahman won the Best Newcomer award at the 1st London International Chinese Film Festival.

description.zh-cn: 李治廷为卫兰的英文专辑《Morning》全碟包办歌词，并与她多次合唱歌曲，如《为你钟情》。
description.en: Aarif Rahman wrote all the lyrics for Janice Vidal's English album 'Morning' and has collaborated with her on several songs, such as 'For You'.

description.zh-cn: 李治廷为卫兰的英文专辑《Morning》全碟包办歌词。
description.en: Aarif Rahman wrote all the lyrics for Janice Vidal's English album 'Morning'.

description.zh-cn: 李治廷与谭焌钊是同学。
description.en: Aarif Rahman and Tam Chun-chiu were classmates.

description.zh-cn: 李治廷与成龙合作出演动作喜剧电影《功夫瑜伽》。
description.en: Aarif Rahman co-starred with Jackie Chan in the action-comedy film 'Kung Fu Yoga'.

description.zh-cn: 在电影《功夫瑜伽》合作后，导演唐季礼盛赞李治廷“像25年前的成龙”。
description.en: After their collaboration on the film 'Kung Fu Yoga', director Stanley Tong praised Aarif Rahman, saying he was 'like Jackie Chan 25 years ago'.

description.zh-cn: 李治廷与范冰冰合作主演电影《一夜惊喜》并合唱同名主题曲。
description.en: Aarif Rahman co-starred with Fan Bingbing in the film 'One Night Surprise' and they sang the theme song of the same name together.

description.zh-cn: 元稹与白居易一同倡导新乐府运动。
description.en: Yuan Zhen, along with Bai Juyi, advocated for the New Yuefu Movement.

description.zh-cn: 白居易十分仰慕陶渊明的为人，并曾写作《效陶潜体诗十六首》模仿其风格。
description.en: Bai Juyi greatly admired Tao Yuanming's character and once wrote 'Sixteen Poems in Imitation of Tao Qian's Style'.

description.zh-cn: 白居易于唐代宗大历七年出生于河南新郑。
description.en: Bai Juyi was born in Xinzheng, Henan, in the year 772 during the reign of Emperor Daizong of Tang.

description.zh-cn: 任杭州刺史期间，白居易见西湖淤塞、农田干旱，于是修筑堤防以蓄水灌溉。
description.en: During his tenure as Prefect of Hangzhou, Bai Juyi observed that the West Lake was silted up and farmland was arid, so he had an embankment constructed to store water for irrigation.

description.zh-cn: 白居易创作了阐述其文学观点的长信《与元九书》。
description.en: Bai Juyi authored the long letter 'Letter to Yuan Jiu', which explains his literary views.

description.zh-cn: 白居易的作品在生前就已流传至日本，对日本平安时代的文学（如《源氏物语》）产生了巨大影响。
description.en: Bai Juyi's works spread to Japan during his lifetime and had a huge influence on the literature of the Heian period, such as 'The Tale of Genji'.

description.zh-cn: 唐昭宗是唐懿宗的第七子。
description.en: Emperor Zhaozong was the seventh son of Emperor Yizong.

description.zh-cn: 唐昭宗的生母是王氏，后被追尊为恭宪皇后。
description.en: Emperor Zhaozong's birth mother was Lady Wang, posthumously honored as Empress Gongxian.

description.zh-cn: 唐昭宗是唐僖宗的弟弟。
description.en: Emperor Zhaozong was the younger brother of Emperor Xizong.

description.zh-cn: 何氏是唐昭宗的皇后。
description.en: Lady He was the empress consort of Emperor Zhaozong.

description.zh-cn: 李𥙿是唐昭宗的长子。
description.en: Li Yu was the eldest son of Emperor Zhaozong.

description.zh-cn: 李𥙿是何皇后所生。
description.en: Li Yu was born to Empress He.

description.zh-cn: 唐哀帝李柷是唐昭宗的第九子。
description.en: Emperor Ai, Li Zhu, was the ninth son of Emperor Zhaozong.

description.zh-cn: 唐僖宗死后，宦官杨复恭拥立唐昭宗（时为寿王李晔）为帝。
description.en: After Emperor Xizong's death, the eunuch Yang Fudong enthroned Emperor Zhaozong (then Prince of Shou, Li Ye).

description.zh-cn: 大顺二年（891年），唐昭宗下令逮捕杨复恭，杨复恭抵抗失败后出奔。
description.en: In 891, Emperor Zhaozong ordered the arrest of Yang Fudong, who fled after his resistance failed.

description.zh-cn: 唐昭宗曾下令讨伐河东节度使李克用，但反被李克用击败。
description.en: Emperor Zhaozong ordered a campaign against Li Keyong, the jiedushi of Hedong, but was defeated by him.

description.zh-cn: 凤翔节度使李茂贞因对朝廷人事任命不满，与盟友王行瑜兵临京城长安，迫使昭宗赐死宰相杜让能。
description.en: Dissatisfied with a court appointment, Li Maozhen, the jiedushi of Fengxiang, marched on the capital Chang'an with his ally Wang Xingyu, forcing Emperor Zhaozong to order the death of Chancellor Du Rangneng.

description.zh-cn: 唐昭宗为躲避李茂贞而逃至华州，但被镇国节度使韩建所控制，期间韩建还杀害了十一王。
description.en: Emperor Zhaozong fled to Huazhou to escape Li Maozhen but was held under the control of jiedushi Han Jian, who also killed eleven imperial princes during this time.

description.zh-cn: 光化三年（900年）十一月，宦官刘季述发动政变，逼迫唐昭宗禅位给太子李𥙿，并将昭宗与何皇后软禁。
description.en: In November 900, the eunuch Liu Jishu launched a coup, forcing Emperor Zhaozong to abdicate in favor of Crown Prince Li Yu and placing Zhaozong and Empress He under house arrest.

description.zh-cn: 在政变中，刘季述迎立皇太子李𥙿为皇帝。
description.en: During the coup, Liu Jishu installed Crown Prince Li Yu as the new emperor.

description.zh-cn: 天复元年（901年）正月，神策军军官孙德昭发动反政变，杀死了刘季述。
description.en: In January 901, Shence Army officer Sun Dezhao launched a counter-coup, killing Liu Jishu.

description.zh-cn: 孙德昭杀死刘季述后，迎请唐昭宗复位。
description.en: After killing Liu Jishu, Sun Dezhao restored Emperor Zhaozong to the throne.

description.zh-cn: 朱友恭奉朱温之命，率兵闯入宫中执行了弑杀唐昭宗的行动。
description.en: Under Zhu Wen's orders, Zhu Yougong led soldiers into the palace and carried out the assassination of Emperor Zhaozong.

description.zh-cn: 氏叔琮奉朱温之命，参与了弑杀唐昭宗的行动。
description.en: Under Zhu Wen's orders, Shi Shucong participated in the assassination of Emperor Zhaozong.

description.zh-cn: 在弑君行动中，龙武衙官史太追上并直接杀害了正在逃跑的唐昭宗。
description.en: During the assassination, Longwu Guard officer Shi Tai pursued and directly killed the fleeing Emperor Zhaozong.

description.zh-cn: 昭仪李渐荣试图以身体保护唐昭宗，被史太一同杀害。
description.en: Zhaoyi Li Jianrong attempted to shield Emperor Zhaozong with her body and was killed by Shi Tai along with him.

description.zh-cn: 因厌恶曾被拥立为帝的德王李𥙿，朱温在天祐二年（905年）二月将其杀害。
description.en: Due to his dislike for the Prince of De, Li Yu, who had once been made emperor, Zhu Wen had him killed in February 905.

description.zh-cn: 朱温强迫唐昭宗及长安居民迁都洛阳，并拆毁长安城宫室建筑。
description.en: Zhu Wen forced Emperor Zhaozong and the residents of Chang'an to move to Luoyang, and demolished the palaces and buildings in Chang'an.

description.zh-cn: 子路出生于鲁国卞邑，即今天的山东省泗水县一带。
description.en: Zi Lu was born in Bianyi of Lu State, which is around today's Sishui County, Shandong Province.

description.zh-cn: 子路是孔子的著名弟子，也是侍奉孔子最久的学生。
description.en: Zi Lu was a prominent disciple of Confucius and the student who served him the longest.

description.zh-cn: 孔子十分信赖子路，曾说若自己理想无法实现，会跟随自己的只有子路。当听闻子路殉职并被处以醢刑后，孔子极为伤心，并誓言此后不再食用肉酱。
description.en: Confucius trusted Zi Lu deeply, once saying that if his ideals failed, only Zi Lu would follow him. Upon hearing of Zi Lu's death and mutilation, Confucius was extremely grieved and vowed never to eat meat paste again.

description.zh-cn: 子路名列孔门十哲，是政事科的杰出人才。
description.en: Zi Lu was listed among the Ten Philosophers of the Confucian school, excelling in political affairs.

description.zh-cn: 子路是卫国大夫孔悝的家臣，并为救他而死。
description.en: Zi Lu was a retainer of Kong Kui, a grand master of the State of Wei, and died trying to save him.

description.zh-cn: 石乞与盂黡一同围攻并杀死了子路。
description.en: Shi Qi, along with Yu Yan, besieged and killed Zi Lu.

description.zh-cn: 唐玄宗追尊子路为“卫侯”。
description.en: Emperor Xuanzong of Tang posthumously honored Zi Lu as 'Marquis of Wei'.

description.zh-cn: 宋真宗加封子路为“河内公”。
description.en: Emperor Zhenzong of Song granted Zi Lu the title 'Duke of Henei'.

description.zh-cn: 宋度宗又追尊子路为“卫公”。
description.en: Emperor Duzong of Song also posthumously honored Zi Lu as 'Duke of Wei'.

description.zh-cn: 明世宗改称子路为“先贤仲子”。
description.en: The Jiajing Emperor of Ming changed Zi Lu's title to 'Former Worthy, Master Zhong'.

description.zh-cn: 子路随孔子周游列国，是十四年间始终追随孔子服侍左右的弟子。
description.en: Zi Lu accompanied Confucius on his travels through the states and was the disciple who followed and served him throughout the fourteen years.

description.zh-cn: 子路委派同为孔子弟子的子羔担任费邑的邑宰。
description.en: Zi Lu appointed Zi Gao, also a disciple of Confucius, as the governor of Fei.

description.zh-cn: 卫出公是蒯聩的儿子。
description.en: Duke Chu of Wei was the son of Kuai Kui.

description.zh-cn: 蒯聩意图废黜自己的儿子卫出公，以重夺君位。
description.en: Kuai Kui intended to depose his own son, Duke Chu of Wei, to reclaim the throne.

description.zh-cn: 蒯聩是卫灵公的太子。
description.en: Kuai Kui was the crown prince of Duke Ling of Wei.

description.zh-cn: 蒯聩因谋害嫡母南子事败而获罪出逃。
description.en: Kuai Kui was incriminated and fled after his plot to harm his formal mother Nanzi failed.

description.zh-cn: 蒯聩获罪后，出逃并投奔晋国的赵简子。
description.en: After being incriminated, Kuai Kui fled and sought refuge with Zhao Jianzi of the State of Jin.

description.zh-cn: 伯姬是蒯聩的妹妹。
description.en: Bo Ji was the younger sister of Kuai Kui.

description.zh-cn: 孔悝是伯姬的儿子。
description.en: Kong Kui was the son of Bo Ji.

description.zh-cn: 浑良夫是伯姬的情夫，并与她一同协助蒯聩劫持孔悝。
description.en: Hun Liangfu was the lover of Bo Ji and, together with her, assisted Kuai Kui in abducting Kong Kui.

description.zh-cn: 伯姬与情夫浑良夫、兄长蒯聩联手，劫持了自己的儿子孔悝，以逼迫他协助蒯聩夺权。
description.en: Bo Ji, along with her lover Hun Liangfu and her brother Kuai Kui, abducted her own son Kong Kui to force him to assist Kuai Kui in seizing power.

description.zh-cn: 栾宁是孔悝的家臣。
description.en: Luan Ning was a retainer of Kong Kui.

description.zh-cn: 在蒯聩兵变期间，栾宁将卫出公送往鲁国避难。
description.en: During Kuai Kui's coup, Luan Ning escorted Duke Chu of Wei to the State of Lu for safety.

description.zh-cn: 在蒯聩兵变时，守将公孙敢关闭城门，试图阻止子路进入城中救助孔悝。
description.en: During Kuai Kui's coup, the defending general Gongsun Gan closed the city gates, attempting to prevent Zi Lu from entering to rescue Kong Kui.

description.zh-cn: 石乞是蒯聩手下的勇士，奉命阻挡并杀害子路。
description.en: Shi Qi was a warrior under Kuai Kui, ordered to stop and kill Zi Lu.

description.zh-cn: 子羔是孔子的弟子。
description.en: Zi Gao was a disciple of Confucius.

description.zh-cn: 后金自努尔哈赤发布“七大恨”起，便与明朝进入长期的战争状态。
description.en: Starting from Nurhaci's issuance of the 'Seven Grievances', the Later Jin entered a state of prolonged warfare with the Ming dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 后金是清朝的前身，1636年皇太极改国号为大清。
description.en: The Later Jin was the predecessor of the Qing dynasty; Hong Taiji renamed the state to Great Qing in 1636.

description.zh-cn: 皇太极继努尔哈赤之后成为后金的第二位，也是最后一位汗。
description.en: Hong Taiji succeeded Nurhaci as the second and last khan of the Later Jin.

description.zh-cn: 努尔哈赤是后金的开国君主。
description.en: Nurhaci was the founding monarch of the Later Jin.

description.zh-cn: 努尔哈赤公布“七大恨”，以此为由起兵反明，标志着后金与明朝的战争正式开始。
description.en: Nurhaci announced the 'Seven Grievances' as the reason for rebelling against the Ming, marking the official start of the war between the Later Jin and the Ming dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 在后金的军事征讨下，林丹汗被迫西逃，最终病逝于甘肃。
description.en: Under the military campaign of the Later Jin, Ligdan Khan was forced to flee west and eventually died of illness in Gansu.

description.zh-cn: 皇太极通过一系列军事和政治手段，最终征服了漠南蒙古各部。
description.en: Through a series of military and political maneuvers, Hong Taiji eventually conquered the tribes of Southern Mongolia.

description.zh-cn: 丁卯战争后，朝鲜王朝被迫与后金缔结不平等的“兄弟之盟”，成为其半臣属国。
description.en: After the Dingmao War, the Joseon dynasty was forced to conclude the unequal 'Brotherly Alliance' with the Later Jin, becoming its semi-vassal state.

description.zh-cn: 皇太极下令废除“女真”旧称，定族名为“满洲”。
description.en: Hong Taiji ordered the abolition of the old name 'Jurchen' and designated the ethnic name as 'Manchu'.

description.zh-cn: 努尔哈赤是塔克世的长子。
description.en: Nurhaci was the eldest son of Taksi.

description.zh-cn: 努尔哈赤的父亲塔克世在涉及明军的混战中被杀害，这是努尔哈赤反明的原因之一。
description.en: Nurhaci's father, Taksi, was killed in a melee involving Ming forces, which became one of Nurhaci's reasons for rebelling against the Ming.

description.zh-cn: 额哲是林丹汗的儿子。
description.en: Ejei was the son of Ligdan Khan.

description.zh-cn: 林丹汗之子额哲率部向皇太极投降。
description.en: Ejei, son of Ligdan Khan, surrendered with his followers to Hong Taiji.

description.zh-cn: 额尔德尼奉努尔哈赤之命创制满文。
description.en: Erdeni created the Manchu script under Nurhaci's order.

description.zh-cn: 噶盖奉努尔哈赤之命创制满文。
description.en: Gagai created the Manchu script under Nurhaci's order.

description.zh-cn: 原明朝将领孔有德于1633年率部投降皇太极。
description.en: The former Ming general Kong Youde defected with his troops to Hong Taiji in 1633.

description.zh-cn: 1990年4月，中共中央和国务院作出开发开放上海浦东的决定，推动了上海经济的快速发展。
description.en: In April 1990, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council decided to develop and open up Pudong, Shanghai, which promoted the rapid economic development of the city.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军于1949年5月发动上海战役，并于5月27日控制上海全境。
description.en: The People's Liberation Army launched the Shanghai Campaign in May 1949 and took full control of the city on May 27.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国空军于1950年2月6日对上海市进行了大规模轰炸。
description.en: The Republic of China Air Force conducted a large-scale bombing of Shanghai on February 6, 1950.

description.zh-cn: 上海因疫情执行的严格清零政策引发了民众抗议，成为白纸运动的一部分。
description.en: The strict zero-COVID policy implemented in Shanghai due to the outbreak triggered public protests, becoming part of the White Paper protests.

description.zh-cn: 海派文化根植于江南地区传统的吴越文化。
description.en: The Shanghai School culture is rooted in the traditional Wuyue culture of the Jiangnan region.

description.zh-cn: 上海美术电影制片厂创作并出品了动画长片《大闹天宫》。
description.en: The Shanghai Animation Film Studio created and produced the animated feature film 'Havoc in Heaven'.

description.zh-cn: 陈吉宁是中共中央政治局委员。
description.en: Chen Jining is a member of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 根据Wikitext中的“政党”信息框和分类，顾明亮是中国共产党的党员。
description.en: According to the 'political party' infobox and categories in the Wikitext, Gu Mingliang was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 顾明亮的籍贯是江苏无锡。
description.en: Gu Mingliang's ancestral home is Wuxi, Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 1985年6月毕业于徐州师范大学（江苏师范大学前身）物理系，获理学学士学位。
description.en: In June 1985, he graduated from the Department of Physics of Xuzhou Normal University (the predecessor of Jiangsu Normal University) with a Bachelor of Science degree.

description.zh-cn: 1998年6月毕业于东南大学通信与信息处理专业，获工学博士学位。
description.en: In June 1998, he graduated from Southeast University with a major in Communication and Information Processing, receiving a Doctor of Engineering degree.

position.zh-cn: 物理系主任、物理与电子工程学院院长、研究生处处长、研究生院院长、学科办主任、研究生工作部部长、敬文书院院长
position.en: Director of the Physics Department, Dean of the School of Physics and Electronic Engineering, Director of the Graduate Office, Dean of the Graduate School, Director of the Discipline Construction Office, Head of the Graduate Student Affairs Department, Dean of Jingwen College

description.zh-cn: 历任徐州师范大学（江苏师范大学前身）物理系主任，以及江苏师范大学物理与电子工程学院院长等多个行政与学术职务。
description.en: He successively served as the Director of the Physics Department at Xuzhou Normal University (predecessor of Jiangsu Normal University), and held multiple administrative and academic positions at Jiangsu Normal University, including Dean of the School of Physics and Electronic Engineering.

description.zh-cn: 2008年8月升任教授。
description.en: He was promoted to professor in August 2008.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命的结束以及毛泽东的逝世，为华国锋提出和奉行“两个凡是”创造了政治背景。
description.en: The end of the Cultural Revolution and the death of Mao Zedong created the political context for Hua Guofeng to propose and implement the 'Two Whatevers'.

description.zh-cn: 与黄沾、蔡澜共同主持该节目。
description.en: Co-hosted the program with Wong Jim and Chua Lam.

description.zh-cn: 1963年，金庸鼓励倪匡在《明报》副刊连载小说，促成了《卫斯理系列》的诞生。
description.en: In 1963, Jin Yong encouraged Ni Kuang to serialize a novel in the Ming Pao supplement, which led to the creation of the 'Wisely Series'.

description.zh-cn: 倪匡创作了《卫斯理系列》科幻小说。
description.en: Ni Kuang created the 'Wisely Series' of science fiction novels.

description.zh-cn: 倪匡创作了虚构角色陈真。
description.en: Ni Kuang created the fictional character Chen Zhen.

description.zh-cn: 倪匡曾帮助朋友金庸代笔《天龙八部》的部分章节。
description.en: Ni Kuang once helped his friend Jin Yong by ghostwriting parts of 'Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils'.

description.zh-cn: 倪匡表示影响他最深的小说作家为“还珠楼主”李寿民。
description.en: Ni Kuang stated that the novelist who influenced him the most was Li Shoumin, pen name Huanzhu Louzhu.

description.zh-cn: 第31届香港电影金像奖授予倪匡终身成就奖。
description.en: The 31st Hong Kong Film Awards presented the Lifetime Achievement Award to Ni Kuang.

description.zh-cn: 由于害怕中共收回香港，倪匡于1992年移居美国。
description.en: Fearing the CCP's takeover of Hong Kong, Ni Kuang emigrated to the United States in 1992.

description.zh-cn: 倪匡创作了科幻小说《追龙》作为对香港未来的寓言。
description.en: Ni Kuang wrote the science fiction novel 'Chasing the Dragon' as an allegory for the future of Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 纪登奎于1938年4月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Ji Dengkui joined the Communist Party of China in April 1938.

description.zh-cn: 纪登奎出生于山西省武乡县。
description.en: Ji Dengkui was born in Wuxiang County, Shanxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 王纯是纪登奎的妻子。
description.en: Wang Chun was the spouse of Ji Dengkui.

description.zh-cn: 纪坡民是纪登奎的儿子。
description.en: Ji Pomin is the son of Ji Dengkui.

description.zh-cn: 纪登奎于1975年1月17日至1980年4月16日担任中华人民共和国国务院副总理，历任第四届、第五届国务院副总理。
description.en: Ji Dengkui served as Vice Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China from January 17, 1975 to April 16, 1980, serving in the 4th and 5th State Councils.

description.zh-cn: 纪登奎于1969年6月至1973年8月任中共中央政治局候补委员，1973年8月至1980年2月任委员。
description.en: Ji Dengkui served as an Alternate Member of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee from June 1969 to August 1973, and as a full Member from August 1973 to February 1980.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东晚年赏识和培养纪登奎，称其为“老朋友”，并将其从地方提拔至中央核心领导层。
description.en: In his later years, Mao Zedong appreciated and cultivated Ji Dengkui, calling him an 'old friend' and promoting him from local government to the central core leadership.

description.zh-cn: 纪登奎在文化大革命期间获得毛泽东提拔，进入中央核心，成为活跃的政治人物。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Ji Dengkui was promoted by Mao Zedong, entered the central leadership core, and became an active political figure.

description.zh-cn: 在“一月风暴”的背景下，纪登奎受到冲击，被关押了起来。
description.en: In the context of the 'January Storm', Ji Dengkui was impacted and detained.

description.zh-cn: 庐山会议后，毛泽东任命无军队任职经验的纪登奎进入军委办事组，意在“掺沙子”以牵制林彪，两人形成政治对立关系。
description.en: After the Lushan Conference, Mao Zedong appointed Ji Dengkui, who had no military experience, to the Military Commission's administrative group, intending to 'mix in sand' to counterbalance Lin Biao, thus creating a political rivalry between them.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平在中共十一届三中全会后掌握实权，纪登奎作为被视为“凡是派”的代表人物之一，在政治上受到指责、被边缘化，并最终辞去所有职务。
description.en: After Deng Xiaoping gained power following the Third Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee, Ji Dengkui, as a representative of the 'Whatever Faction', was politically criticized, marginalized, and ultimately resigned from all his posts.

description.zh-cn: 在讨论隔离审查“四人帮”的文件时，纪登奎提出应在文件中指出“文革”的错误，表明其对“四人帮”路线的否定态度。
description.en: When discussing the document for the quarantine and investigation of the 'Gang of Four', Ji Dengkui proposed that the errors of the 'Cultural Revolution' should be pointed out in the document, indicating his negative stance on the 'Gang of Four's' line.

description.zh-cn: 在此次会议上，纪登奎等人因其“凡是派”立场受到批评，此后在政治上被边缘化。
description.en: At this meeting, Ji Dengkui and others were criticized for their 'Whatever Faction' stance and were subsequently marginalized politically.

description.zh-cn: 刘长是汉高祖刘邦的第七个儿子。
description.en: Liu Chang was the seventh son of Emperor Gaozu of Han, Liu Bang.

description.zh-cn: 刘长由赵姬所生。
description.en: Liu Chang was born to Consort Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 赵王张敖将姬妾赵姬献给刘邦侍寝，赵姬因此怀孕生下刘长。
description.en: Zhang Ao, King of Zhao, presented his concubine Consort Zhao to Liu Bang, who then became pregnant with Liu Chang.

description.zh-cn: 刘安是刘长的长子。
description.en: Liu An was the eldest son of Liu Chang.

description.zh-cn: 刘安是《淮南子》的作者（主编）。
description.en: Liu An was the author (patron and chief editor) of the Huainanzi.

description.zh-cn: 赵国国相贯高曾图谋暗杀刘邦，但未成功。
description.en: Guan Gao, the Chancellor of Zhao, attempted to assassinate Liu Bang but failed.

description.zh-cn: 吕后因嫉妒，对身陷囹圄的赵姬不予理会，导致赵姬在生下刘长后愤而自杀。
description.en: Out of jealousy, Empress Lü ignored the plight of the imprisoned Consort Zhao, leading to Zhao's suicide after giving birth to Liu Chang.

description.zh-cn: 刘长之母赵姬自杀后，刘长由吕后抚养长大。
description.en: After his mother Consort Zhao committed suicide, Liu Chang was raised by Empress Lü.

description.zh-cn: 为报其母赵姬之仇，刘长亲自刺杀了审食其。
description.en: To avenge his mother, Consort Zhao, Liu Chang personally assassinated Shen Yiji.

description.zh-cn: 在“夷灭诸吕”后，刘长与刘襄等人都是皇位的潜在竞争者。
description.en: After the Lü Clan Disturbance, Liu Chang and Liu Xiang were potential competitors for the imperial throne.

description.zh-cn: 刘长与汉文帝刘恒是同父异母的兄弟。
description.en: Liu Chang and Emperor Wen (Liu Heng) were half-brothers, sharing the same father.

description.zh-cn: 在刘长谋反事败后，丞相张苍领群臣要求汉文帝将其处死。
description.en: After Liu Chang's rebellion plot was exposed, Chancellor Zhang Cang led the ministers in demanding his execution by Emperor Wen.

description.zh-cn: 刘勃是刘长的儿子。
description.en: Liu Bo was a son of Liu Chang.

description.zh-cn: 刘赐是刘长的儿子。
description.en: Liu Ci was a son of Liu Chang.

description.zh-cn: 经杜国庠介绍，许涤新加入中国共产党。
description.en: Through Du Guoxiang's introduction, Xu Dixin joined the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 由于叛徒告密被国民党逮捕入狱。
description.en: Was arrested and imprisoned by the Kuomintang due to being betrayed.

description.zh-cn: 卢沟桥事变后，国共合作的背景促成了许涤新等政治犯的释放。
description.en: After the Marco Polo Bridge Incident, the context of KMT-CPC cooperation facilitated the release of political prisoners like Xu Dixin.

description.zh-cn: 经八路军南京办事处交涉，许涤新得以释放。
description.en: Xu Dixin was released after negotiations by the Nanjing Office of the Eighth Route Army.

description.zh-cn: 1940年冬调至南方局宣传部，协助董必武工作。
description.en: In the winter of 1940, he was transferred to the Propaganda Department of the Southern Bureau to assist Dong Biwu.

description.zh-cn: 王昭悠是江西吉安人。
description.en: Wang Zhaoyou is from Ji'an, Jiangxi.

description.zh-cn: 王昭悠是第九届全国人大代表。
description.en: Wang Zhaoyou was a deputy to the 9th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 王昭悠是第十届全国人大代表。
description.en: Wang Zhaoyou was a deputy to the 10th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，王昭悠是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to Wikipedia categories, Wang Zhaoyou is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 张宪省接替温孚江担任山东农业大学校长。
description.en: Zhang Xiansheng succeeded Wen Fujiang as President of Shandong Agricultural University.

description.zh-cn: 张宪省是享受国务院政府特殊津贴专家。
