description.en: Zhang Xiansheng is an expert who enjoys the special government allowances of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 井上馨是长州藩的武士。
description.en: Inoue Kaoru was a samurai of the Chōshū Domain.

description.zh-cn: 留学期间目睹西方国家的国力，使井上馨的思想从攘夷转向开国，并在战争期间紧急回国进行和平协商。
description.en: Witnessing the national power of Western countries while studying abroad shifted Inoue Kaoru's ideology from anti-foreigner to pro-opening, and he urgently returned to Japan during the war to conduct peace negotiations.

description.zh-cn: 时任司法卿的江藤新平以尾去泽铜山贪污事件为由追究井上馨，最终迫使其辞去大藏大辅之职。
description.en: As the Lord of Justice, Etō Shinpei investigated Inoue Kaoru for the Osarizawa Copper Mine scandal, ultimately forcing him to resign from his post as Senior Vice Minister of Finance.

description.zh-cn: 离开政界后，井上馨与益田孝等人成立了贸易公司“冈田组”，后分离矿山事业，公司发展成为三井物产。
description.en: After leaving politics, Inoue Kaoru, together with Masuda Takashi and others, founded the trading company 'Okada Gumi'. After separating the mining business, the company evolved into Mitsui & Co.

description.zh-cn: 井上馨与三井财阀关系密切，在财界有强大的发言权，并最终成为其最高顾问，被讥为“三井的掌柜”。
description.en: Inoue Kaoru had close ties with the Mitsui zaibatsu, held significant influence in the financial world, and eventually became its supreme advisor, earning the nickname 'Mitsui's head clerk'.

description.zh-cn: 在明治十四年政变中与伊藤博文合作，将政见不合的大隈重信驱逐出政府。
description.en: Collaborated with Itō Hirobumi in the Political Crisis of 1881 to oust Ōkuma Shigenobu, with whom he had political disagreements, from the government.

description.zh-cn: 担任驻朝鲜公使期间，推动了朝鲜的现代化运动。
description.en: During his tenure as Minister to Korea, he promoted the modernization movement in Korea.

description.zh-cn: 井上馨深受高杉晋作的影响，使其政见与吉田松阴的思想相近。
description.en: Inoue Kaoru was deeply influenced by Takasugi Shinsaku, which aligned his political views with the ideas of Yoshida Shōin.

description.zh-cn: 尽管井上馨并非松下村塾的学生，但通过高杉晋作等人的影响，其政见与吉田松阴相近。
description.en: Although Inoue Kaoru was not a student of the Shōka Sonjuku, his political views were similar to those of Yoshida Shōin due to the influence of figures like Takasugi Shinsaku.

position.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会副主席
position.en: Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference

description.zh-cn: 茅以升担任全国政协副主席期间，邓颖超是全国政协主席。
description.en: When Mao Yisheng served as Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee, Deng Yingchao was the Chairwoman.

description.zh-cn: 茅以升于1916年毕业于唐山工业专门学校。
description.en: Mao Yisheng graduated from Tangshan Industrial College in 1916.

description.zh-cn: 茅以升于1917年获得美国康乃尔大学硕士学位（桥梁专业）。
description.en: Mao Yisheng received a Master's degree in Bridge Engineering from Cornell University in the United States in 1917.

description.zh-cn: 茅以升于1921年获美国卡耐基理工学院博士学位，是该校的第一位博士。
description.en: Mao Yisheng obtained his PhD from the Carnegie Institute of Technology in the United States in 1921, becoming the school's first doctoral graduate.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，茅以升多次受到批斗，被戴上“反动学术权威”的牌子并被游街围攻。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Mao Yisheng was subjected to multiple struggle sessions, labeled as a 'reactionary academic authority', and publicly paraded and attacked.

description.zh-cn: 在人民大会堂的建设中，周恩来总理指定茅以升为设计方案审定人。
description.en: During the construction of the Great Hall of the People, Premier Zhou Enlai appointed Mao Yisheng as the final approver of the design plan.

description.zh-cn: 在1957年储安平“党天下”事件时，茅以升站出来批判储的言论。
description.en: During the 1957 'Party-state' incident involving Chu Anping, Mao Yisheng stood up to criticize Chu's remarks.

description.zh-cn: 2006年，茅以升的母校卡内基美隆大学为其铜像举行落成典礼，铜像文字出自时任中国国务院总理温家宝的手笔，提升了茅以升的国际声誉。
description.en: In 2006, Mao Yisheng's alma mater, Carnegie Mellon University, held an unveiling ceremony for his bronze statue. The inscription on the statue was written by then-Chinese Premier Wen Jiabao, enhancing Mao Yisheng's international reputation.

description.zh-cn: 茅以升于1980年当选为中国科学技术协会第二届全国委员会副主席，于1986年被推举为第三届全国委员会名誉主席。
description.en: Mao Yisheng was elected as Vice Chairman of the Second National Committee of the China Association for Science and Technology in 1980, and was appointed Honorary Chairman of the Third National Committee in 1986.

description.zh-cn: 林彪提议让罗瑞卿当总参谋长，后又因罗瑞卿与其意见不合，派其妻叶群向毛泽东诬告罗瑞卿，是罗瑞卿事件的主要发起者之一。
description.en: Lin Biao proposed Luo Ruiqing for Chief of the General Staff, but later, due to disagreements, sent his wife Ye Qun to falsely accuse Luo to Mao Zedong, making him a key instigator of the Luo Ruiqing incident.

description.zh-cn: 叶群带着林彪的信和十一份材料，向毛泽东作了数小时的汇报，诬告罗瑞卿，直接促成了批判罗瑞卿的上海会议。
description.en: Ye Qun, carrying a letter from Lin Biao and eleven documents, reported to Mao Zedong for several hours, falsely accusing Luo Ruiqing, which directly led to the Shanghai Conference to criticize Luo.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东听取了对罗瑞卿的汇报后，决定并主持召开了中共中央政治局扩大会议（上海会议），对罗瑞卿进行批判，是事件的最高决策者。
description.en: After hearing reports about Luo Ruiqing, Mao Zedong decided to convene and preside over the Enlarged Politburo Meeting (Shanghai Conference) to criticize Luo, acting as the ultimate decision-maker in the incident.

description.zh-cn: 叶剑英向林彪传达了毛泽东关于罗瑞卿问题的指示，并向毛泽东汇报过罗的问题。他在后续的批判会议中作了重要发言。
description.en: Ye Jianying conveyed Mao Zedong's instructions on the Luo Ruiqing issue to Lin Biao and had reported Luo's problems to Mao. He delivered an important speech at the subsequent criticism meeting.

description.zh-cn: 在1959年庐山会议后，时任中国人民解放军总参谋长黄克诚被打倒。
description.en: After the 1959 Lushan Conference, then Chief of the General Staff of the PLA Huang Kecheng was purged.

description.zh-cn: 在黄克诚被打倒后，时任国防部长林彪提议让罗瑞卿担任总参谋长。
description.en: After Huang Kecheng was purged, then Minister of National Defense Lin Biao proposed Luo Ruiqing for the position of Chief of the General Staff.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命结束后，邓小平上台主政，罗瑞卿得以平反。
description.en: After the Cultural Revolution ended, Deng Xiaoping came to power, and Luo Ruiqing was rehabilitated.

description.zh-cn: 在毛泽东就罗瑞卿事件表态后，江青等人继续寻找借口，拖延对罗瑞卿的平反。
description.en: After Mao Zedong expressed his view on the Luo Ruiqing incident, Jiang Qing and others continued to find excuses to delay Luo's rehabilitation.

description.zh-cn: 罗瑞卿事件是“文化大革命”开始前的一次重要政治事件，被认为是文革的前奏。
description.en: The Luo Ruiqing Incident was a major political event before the start of the "Cultural Revolution" and is considered a prelude to it.

description.zh-cn: 谢尔盖·绍伊古被认为是俄罗斯总统普京的亲密盟友，属于普京西罗维基核心圈子的成员。
description.en: Sergey Shoigu is considered a close ally of Russian President Vladimir Putin and a member of Putin's siloviki inner circle.

position.zh-cn: 俄罗斯联邦安全会议秘书长
position.en: Secretary of the Security Council of the Russian Federation

description.zh-cn: 在弗拉基米尔·普京总统任内担任俄罗斯联邦安全会议秘书长。
description.en: Serves as the Secretary of the Security Council of the Russian Federation under President Vladimir Putin.

description.zh-cn: 谢尔盖·绍伊古接替尼古拉·帕特鲁舍夫，出任俄罗斯联邦安全会议秘书长。
description.en: Sergey Shoigu succeeded Nikolai Patrushev as Secretary of the Security Council of the Russian Federation.

description.zh-cn: 安德烈·别洛乌索夫接替谢尔盖·绍伊古，出任俄罗斯联邦国防部部长。
description.en: Andrey Belousov succeeded Sergey Shoigu as Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation.

description.zh-cn: 在阿纳托利·谢尔久科夫因腐败丑闻被解除职务后，谢尔盖·绍伊古被任命为国防部长。
description.en: After Anatoliy Serdyukov was dismissed due to a corruption scandal, Sergey Shoigu was appointed as Minister of Defence.

description.zh-cn: 谢尔盖·绍伊古接替鲍里斯·格罗莫夫，出任莫斯科州州长。
description.en: Sergey Shoigu succeeded Boris Gromov as Governor of Moscow Oblast.

description.zh-cn: 安德烈·尤里耶维奇·沃罗比约夫接替谢尔盖·绍伊古，出任莫斯科州州长。
description.en: Andrey Vorobyov succeeded Sergey Shoigu as Governor of Moscow Oblast.

description.zh-cn: 作为俄罗斯国防部长，谢尔盖·绍伊古是入侵乌克兰行动的关键指挥官之一。
description.en: As the Russian Minister of Defence, Sergey Shoigu was one of the key commanders of the invasion of Ukraine.

description.zh-cn: 乌克兰对谢尔盖·绍伊古提起刑事检控，指控他协助乌克兰东部的非法军事团体。
description.en: Ukraine initiated criminal proceedings against Sergey Shoigu, accusing him of assisting 'illegal military groups' in eastern Ukraine.

description.zh-cn: 因俄罗斯入侵乌克兰，加拿大对谢尔盖·绍伊古实施制裁。
description.en: Canada imposed sanctions on Sergey Shoigu due to the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

description.zh-cn: 在俄罗斯入侵乌克兰前夕，时任俄罗斯国防部长绍伊古会见了时任英国国防大臣本·华莱士，并否认了俄罗斯的入侵计划。
description.en: On the eve of the Russian invasion of Ukraine, then-Russian Defence Minister Shoigu met with then-British Defence Secretary Ben Wallace and denied Russia's invasion plans.

description.zh-cn: 瓦格纳集团领导人叶夫根尼·普里戈任与俄罗斯国防部长谢尔盖·绍伊古之间存在公开冲突，普里戈任指责绍伊古意图摧毁瓦格纳军团，并最终发动了瓦格纳集团叛乱。
description.en: Wagner Group leader Yevgeny Prigozhin had a public conflict with Russian Minister of Defence Sergey Shoigu. Prigozhin accused Shoigu of intending to destroy the Wagner legion, which ultimately led to the Wagner Group rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 叶夫根尼·普里戈任是与绍伊古冲突的主要当事人之一。
description.en: Yevgeny Prigozhin was one of the main parties in the conflict with Shoigu.

description.zh-cn: 叶夫根尼·普里戈任以惩罚国防部长绍伊古为由，发动了瓦格纳集团叛乱。
description.en: Yevgeny Prigozhin launched the Wagner Group rebellion to punish Minister of Defence Shoigu.

description.zh-cn: 瓦格纳集团叛乱是针对俄罗斯国防部长谢尔盖·绍伊古和总参谋长瓦列里·格拉西莫夫的武装行动。
description.en: The Wagner Group rebellion was an armed action targeting Russian Minister of Defence Sergey Shoigu and Chief of the General Staff Valery Gerasimov.

description.zh-cn: 国际刑事法院以涉嫌危害人类罪、战争罪等国际罪行，对谢尔盖·绍伊古发出拘捕令。
description.en: The International Criminal Court issued an arrest warrant for Sergey Shoigu for suspected international crimes, including crimes against humanity and war crimes.

description.zh-cn: 谢尔盖·绍伊古曾与普京、摩纳哥亲王阿尔贝二世一同在图瓦钓鱼。
description.en: Sergey Shoigu once went fishing in Tuva with Putin and Albert II, Prince of Monaco.

description.zh-cn: 谢尔盖·绍伊古上任国防部长后，向普京推荐瓦列里·格拉西莫夫出任国防部第一副部长兼俄军总参谋长。
description.en: After becoming Minister of Defence, Sergey Shoigu recommended Valery Gerasimov to Putin for the position of First Deputy Minister of Defence and Chief of the General Staff.

description.zh-cn: 谢尔盖·绍伊古下令指挥官每天早上在军营播放俄罗斯国歌。
description.en: Sergey Shoigu ordered commanders to play the Russian national anthem in barracks every morning.

description.zh-cn: 韩林儿是韩山童的儿子。
description.en: Han Lin'er is the son of Han Shantong.

description.zh-cn: 韩林儿是杨氏的儿子。
description.en: Han Lin'er is the son of Lady Yang.

description.zh-cn: 韩山童与杨氏是夫妻关系。
description.en: Han Shantong and Lady Yang were husband and wife.

description.zh-cn: 韩山童与刘福通等人在颍州召集河工发动起义。
description.en: Han Shantong, Liu Futong, and others gathered river workers in Yingzhou to launch an uprising.

description.zh-cn: 在韩山童死后，刘福通再次发动起义，并拥立韩林儿为帝。
description.en: After Han Shantong's death, Liu Futong launched another uprising and installed Han Lin'er as emperor.

description.zh-cn: 刘福通拥立韩林儿为帝，建立国号为“宋”的政权。
description.en: Liu Futong installed Han Lin'er as emperor, establishing a regime with the state name 'Song'.

description.zh-cn: 韩林儿被拥立为宋政权的皇帝，称号“小明王”，年号“龙凤”。
description.en: Han Lin'er was installed as the emperor of the Song regime, with the title 'Lesser King of Light' and the era name 'Longfeng'.

description.zh-cn: 刘福通拥立韩林儿为帝后，作为其麾下最重要的军事领袖。
description.en: After installing Han Lin'er as emperor, Liu Futong served as his most important military leader.

description.zh-cn: 作为元朝将领，察罕帖木儿率军反攻韩林儿的红巾军。
description.en: As a Yuan dynasty general, Chaghan Temur led forces to counter-attack Han Lin'er's Red Turban Army.

description.zh-cn: 察罕帖木儿攻破宋政权的首都汴梁，迫使韩林儿逃往安丰。
description.en: Chaghan Temur captured Bianliang, the capital of the Song regime, forcing Han Lin'er to flee to Anfeng.

description.zh-cn: 吕珍是张士诚的部将，奉命围攻安丰。
description.en: Lü Zhen was a general under Zhang Shicheng, ordered to besiege Anfeng.

description.zh-cn: 吕珍在围攻安丰时，杀死了前来救援的刘福通。
description.en: During the siege of Anfeng, Lü Zhen killed Liu Futong who was leading a relief force.

description.zh-cn: 张士诚派部将吕珍围攻韩林儿所在的安丰，导致刘福通战死。
description.en: Zhang Shicheng sent his general Lü Zhen to besiege Anfeng where Han Lin'er was located, leading to the death of Liu Futong.

description.zh-cn: 朱元璋从张士诚部将吕珍的围攻中救出韩林儿。
description.en: Zhu Yuanzhang rescued Han Lin'er from the siege by Lü Zhen, a general under Zhang Shicheng.

description.zh-cn: 廖永忠是朱元璋麾下的将领。
description.en: Liao Yongzhong was a general under Zhu Yuanzhang's command.

description.zh-cn: 廖永忠奉命迎接韩林儿，途中韩林儿在瓜步渡江时船覆溺亡，廖永忠被认为是直接责任人。
description.en: Liao Yongzhong was ordered to escort Han Lin'er. During the journey at Guabu, Han Lin'er's boat capsized and he drowned. Liao Yongzhong is considered to be directly responsible for his death.

description.zh-cn: 韩林儿在渡过长江时因船难而溺亡。
description.en: Han Lin'er drowned in a shipwreck while crossing the Yangtze River.

description.zh-cn: 韩林儿是河北栾城人。
description.en: Han Lin'er was from Luancheng, Hebei.

description.zh-cn: 林美珠出生于中华民国台北市。
description.en: Lin Mei-chu was born in Taipei, Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 林美珠与吴明鸿为夫妻关系。
description.en: Lin Mei-chu and Wu Ming-hung are spouses.

description.zh-cn: 林美珠于1972至1976年就读于国立政治大学法律学系，获得学士学位。
description.en: Lin Mei-chu studied at the Department of Law, National Chengchi University from 1972 to 1976, earning a bachelor's degree.

description.zh-cn: 林美珠于2017年2月8日至2018年2月26日期间担任第四任劳动部部长。
description.en: Lin Mei-chu served as the fourth Minister of Labor from February 8, 2017, to February 26, 2018.

description.zh-cn: 林美珠于2016年5月20日至2017年2月7日期间担任第30任蒙藏委员会委员长。
description.en: Lin Mei-chu served as the 30th Chairperson of the Mongolian and Tibetan Affairs Commission from May 20, 2016, to February 7, 2017.

description.zh-cn: 林美珠于2016年5月20日至2017年2月7日期间担任行政院政务委员，负责督导内政部与法务部。
description.en: Lin Mei-chu served as a Minister without Portfolio of the Executive Yuan from May 20, 2016, to February 7, 2017, responsible for supervising the Ministry of the Interior and the Ministry of Justice.

description.zh-cn: 林美珠于2010年5月17日至2014年12月期间担任嘉义县副县长。
description.en: Lin Mei-chu served as the Deputy Magistrate of Chiayi County from May 17, 2010, to December 2014.

description.zh-cn: 林美珠于2006年8月至2008年5月19日期间担任内政部政务次长。
description.en: Lin Mei-chu served as the Political Deputy Minister of the Interior from August 2006 to May 19, 2008.

description.zh-cn: 林美珠于2004年11月至2006年8月期间担任中央选举委员会秘书长。
description.en: Lin Mei-chu served as the Secretary-General of the Central Election Commission from November 2004 to August 2006.

description.zh-cn: 林美珠于2002年9月至2004年3月期间担任内政部民政司司长。
description.en: Lin Mei-chu served as the Director-General of the Department of Civil Affairs, Ministry of the Interior from September 2002 to March 2004.

description.zh-cn: 林美珠曾短暂担任台湾金联资产管理公司董事长，因舆论争议于就职一日后辞职。
description.en: Lin Mei-chu briefly served as the Chairperson of Taiwan Financial Asset Service Corporation, resigning one day after taking office due to public controversy.

position.zh-cn: 蒙藏委员会委员长、政务委员、劳动部部长
position.en: Chairperson of the Mongolian and Tibetan Affairs Commission, Minister without Portfolio, Minister of Labor

description.zh-cn: 林美珠在林全担任行政院院长期间，先后担任蒙藏委员会委员长、政务委员及劳动部部长。
description.en: During Lin Chuan's tenure as Premier, Lin Mei-chu served successively as Chairperson of the Mongolian and Tibetan Affairs Commission, Minister without Portfolio, and Minister of Labor.

description.zh-cn: 林美珠在赖清德担任行政院院长期间，担任劳动部部长。
description.en: During Lai Ching-te's tenure as Premier, Lin Mei-chu served as the Minister of Labor.

description.zh-cn: 林美珠在张花冠担任嘉义县县长期间，担任副县长。
description.en: While Chang Hwa-kuan was the Magistrate of Chiayi County, Lin Mei-chu served as the Deputy Magistrate.

description.zh-cn: 林美珠在李逸洋担任内政部部长期间，担任政务次长。
description.en: While Lee Yi-yang was the Minister of the Interior, Lin Mei-chu served as the Political Deputy Minister.

description.zh-cn: 林美珠在张政雄担任中央选举委员会主任委员期间，担任秘书长。
description.en: While Chang Cheng-hsiung was the Chairperson of the Central Election Commission, Lin Mei-chu served as the Secretary-General.

description.zh-cn: 林美珠在余政宪担任内政部部长期间，担任内政部民政司司长。
description.en: While Yu Cheng-hsien was the Minister of the Interior, Lin Mei-chu served as the Director-General of the Department of Civil Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 林美珠在苏贞昌担任行政院院长期间，曾担任内政部政务次长。
description.en: During Su Tseng-chang's tenure as Premier, Lin Mei-chu served as the Political Deputy Minister of the Interior.

description.zh-cn: 时任中国国民党立委王育敏在立法院质询时任劳动部长林美珠，质疑其对游览车驾驶工时的见解。
description.en: Then-KMT legislator Wang Yu-min questioned then-Minister of Labor Lin Mei-chu in the Legislative Yuan about her views on the working hours of tour bus drivers.

description.zh-cn: 时任中国国民党立委许淑华在立法院质询时，批评时任劳动部长林美珠为“神隐部长”。
description.en: Then-KMT legislator Hsu Shu-hua criticized then-Minister of Labor Lin Mei-chu during an interpellation in the Legislative Yuan, calling her the 'invisible minister'.

description.zh-cn: 民政司是内政部的内部单位。
description.en: The Department of Civil Affairs is an internal unit of the Ministry of the Interior.

description.zh-cn: 林美珠为林全内阁的成员。
description.en: Lin Mei-chu was a member of the Lin Chuan cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 林美珠为赖清德内阁的成员。
description.en: Lin Mei-chu was a member of the Lai Ching-te cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 大卫·佛利民是米尔顿·佛利民的儿子。
description.en: David Friedman is the son of Milton Friedman.

description.zh-cn: 1932年，米尔顿·佛利民从罗格斯大学获得文学士学位。
description.en: In 1932, Milton Friedman received his Bachelor of Arts degree from Rutgers University.

description.zh-cn: 1933年，米尔顿·佛利民从芝加哥大学获得硕士学位。
description.en: In 1933, Milton Friedman received his Master of Arts degree from the University of Chicago.

description.zh-cn: 1946年，米尔顿·佛利民从哥伦比亚大学获得博士学位。
description.en: In 1946, Milton Friedman received his Ph.D. from Columbia University.

description.zh-cn: 米尔顿·佛利民在芝加哥大学担任经济学教授长达30年，期间将该校经济系形塑成著名的芝加哥经济学派。
description.en: Milton Friedman served as a professor of economics at the University of Chicago for 30 years, during which he shaped its economics department into the renowned Chicago School of economics.

description.zh-cn: 从1977年开始，米尔顿·佛利民加入了斯坦福大学的胡佛研究所。
description.en: Beginning in 1977, Milton Friedman joined the Hoover Institution at Stanford University.

description.zh-cn: 西蒙·史密斯·库兹涅茨是米尔顿·佛利民在哥伦比亚大学的博士生导师。
description.en: Simon Smith Kuznets was Milton Friedman's doctoral advisor at Columbia University.

description.zh-cn: 加里·贝克是米尔顿·佛利民的博士生。
description.en: Gary Becker was a doctoral student of Milton Friedman.

description.zh-cn: 弗里德里希·海耶克是影响米尔顿·佛利民思想的重要人物之一，两人共同促使了20世纪古典自由主义的复苏。
description.en: Friedrich Hayek was one of the key figures who influenced Milton Friedman's thinking, and together they were major figures in the revival of classical liberalism in the 20th century.

description.zh-cn: 米尔顿·佛利民是凯恩斯主义经济学的著名批评者，他的货币主义理论直接挑战了凯恩斯学派的观点。
description.en: Milton Friedman was a prominent critic of Keynesian economics, and his monetarist theories directly challenged the views of the Keynesian school.

description.zh-cn: 米尔顿·佛利民的经济理论对英国首相柴契尔夫人的经济政策产生了极大影响。
description.en: Milton Friedman's economic theories had a significant influence on the economic policies of British Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher.

description.zh-cn: 1981年，米尔顿·佛利民担任罗纳德·里根总统的经济政策顾问。
description.en: In 1981, Milton Friedman served as an economic policy advisor to President Ronald Reagan.

description.zh-cn: 米尔顿·佛利民的经济思想，通过被称为“芝加哥男孩”的学生们，深刻影响了奥古斯图·皮诺契特治下智利的经济改革。
description.en: Milton Friedman's economic ideas, through his students known as the 'Chicago Boys', profoundly influenced the economic reforms in Chile under Augusto Pinochet.

description.zh-cn: 根据米尔顿·佛利民的观点，联邦储备银行的政策和管理失误，特别是错误的紧缩货币供给，是导致经济大萧条的主要原因。
description.en: According to Milton Friedman, the policy and management failures of the Federal Reserve, especially the misguided contraction of the money supply, were the main cause of the Great Depression.

description.zh-cn: 1988年9月19日，米尔顿·佛利民在北京中南海获时任中共中央总书记赵紫阳接见，双方就中国经济改革等问题进行了两个小时的会谈。
description.en: On September 19, 1988, Milton Friedman was received by then-General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee Zhao Ziyang at Zhongnanhai in Beijing, where they had a two-hour discussion on China's economic reforms.

description.zh-cn: 1941年至1943年，佛利民出任美国财政部顾问，研究战时税务政策。
description.en: From 1941 to 1943, Friedman served as an advisor to the U.S. Department of the Treasury, researching wartime tax policy.

description.zh-cn: 根据规定，陇川县人民政府的印章由云南省人民政府制发，此为政府行使职权的凭证。
description.en: According to regulations, the official seal of the Longchuan County People's Government is manufactured and issued by the Yunnan Provincial People's Government, which serves as the credential for the government to exercise its powers.

description.zh-cn: 该法律规定了包括陇川县人民政府在内的县级地方政府所行使的职权。
description.en: This law stipulates the powers and functions exercised by county-level local governments, including the Longchuan County People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 宣德五年，明宣宗以外番多不来朝贡为由，命令郑和率队进行第七次，也是最后一次下西洋。
description.en: In the fifth year of the Xuande reign (1430), the Xuande Emperor, citing the decline in tribute missions from foreign states, ordered Zheng He to lead the seventh and final voyage.

description.zh-cn: 明朝自洪武年间起便实行海禁政策，以防范倭寇和沿海反叛势力，严格限制民间海外贸易。
description.en: The Ming Dynasty implemented the sea ban policy from the Hongwu era onwards to guard against Wokou pirates and coastal rebel forces, severely restricting private overseas trade.

description.zh-cn: 在第一次下西洋期间，郑和船队在旧港（今巨港）击败了海盗陈祖义的势力，将其生擒并押送至京师问斩，扫除了当地的海上威胁。
description.en: During the first voyage, Zheng He's fleet defeated the forces of the pirate Chen Zuyi at Old Port (modern Palembang), capturing him alive and escorting him to the capital for execution, thereby eliminating a major maritime threat in the region.

description.zh-cn: 第三次下西洋期间，锡兰山国王亚烈苦奈儿图谋攻击船队。郑和察觉后，率兵突袭其王城，生擒亚烈苦奈儿及其家属。
description.en: During the third voyage, King Alakesvara of Ceylon plotted to attack the fleet. After discovering the plot, Zheng He led a surprise attack on the king's capital, capturing him and his family.

description.zh-cn: 郑和船队奉明成祖之命，册封拜里迷苏剌为满剌加国（马六甲）国王，赐予印信袍服，帮助其摆脱暹罗的控制，建立了一个重要的贸易据点。
description.en: Under the Yongle Emperor's orders, Zheng He's fleet officially recognized Parameswara as the king of Malacca, bestowing upon him a seal and royal robes. This helped him break free from Siamese control and establish a vital trading hub.

description.zh-cn: 明成祖（朱棣）通过发动靖难之变，成功从其侄子建文帝手中夺取了皇位。
description.en: The Yongle Emperor (Zhu Di) successfully seized the throne from his nephew, the Jianwen Emperor, by launching the Jingnan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 在靖难之变中，明成祖击败并推翻了建文帝的统治。建文帝从此下落不明，寻找其踪迹成为郑和下西洋的动机之一。
description.en: During the Jingnan Campaign, the Yongle Emperor defeated and overthrew the rule of the Jianwen Emperor. The Jianwen Emperor's subsequent disappearance became one of the motivations for Zheng He's voyages.

description.zh-cn: 民主进步党中央执行委员会于2023年4月12日正式公告提名时任党主席赖清德代表该党参与2024年总统选举。
description.en: On April 12, 2023, the Central Executive Committee of the Democratic Progressive Party officially announced the nomination of its incumbent chairman, Lai Ching-te, to represent the party in the 2024 presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 赖清德于2023年11月20日宣布，由时任驻美代表萧美琴担任其副总统候选人搭档，组成“赖萧配”。
description.en: On November 20, 2023, Lai Ching-te announced that then-Representative to the U.S. Hsiao Bi-khim would be his running mate for vice president, forming the 'Lai-Hsiao ticket'.

description.zh-cn: 柯文哲于2023年11月24日宣布，由党籍不分区立委吴欣盈担任其副总统候选人搭档，组成“柯吴配”。
description.en: On November 24, 2023, Ko Wen-je announced that TPP legislator-at-large Cynthia Wu would be his running mate for vice president, forming the 'Ko-Wu ticket'.

description.zh-cn: 赖清德与萧美琴在选举中获得5,586,019票（得票率40.05%），成功当选中华民国第16任总统。
description.en: Lai Ching-te and Hsiao Bi-khim won the election with 5,586,019 votes (40.05%) and were successfully elected as the 16th President of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 柯文哲与吴欣盈在选举中获得3,690,466票（得票率26.46%），未能当选。
description.en: Ko Wen-je and Wu Hsin-ying received 3,690,466 votes (26.46%) in the election and were not elected.

description.zh-cn: 郭台铭及其搭档赖佩霞虽通过公民连署门槛获得参选资格，但在2023年11月24日候选人登记截止日当天共同发表声明，宣布不登记参选，退出本次选举。
description.en: Although Terry Gou and his running mate Lai Pei-hsia qualified for the election by meeting the citizen petition threshold, they jointly issued a statement on the registration deadline, November 24, 2023, announcing their decision not to register and to withdraw from the election.

description.zh-cn: 蔡英文在完成八年总统任期后，成功将政权交棒给同属民主进步党的赖清德，打破了台湾总统直选以来难以由同一政党连续执政超过八年的“魔咒”。
description.en: After completing her eight-year presidential term, Tsai Ing-wen successfully handed over power to Lai Ching-te of the same Democratic Progressive Party, breaking the 'curse' where no single party had managed to hold the presidency for more than eight consecutive years since direct elections began in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 在台北君悦酒店举行的公开协商是“蓝白合作”的最后尝试，会谈因多方分歧而不欢而散，直接导致了在野整合的彻底破局。
description.en: The public negotiation at the Grand Hyatt Taipei was the final attempt at 'Blue-White Cooperation.' The meeting ended acrimoniously due to multiple disagreements, directly leading to the complete collapse of the opposition coalition effort.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国被指控通过多种方式介入2024年台湾总统选举，包括经济施压（如终止部分ECFA商品关税优惠）、散播假新闻和假民调、资助特定人士赴中国大陆旅游并为其支持的候选人拉票等，企图影响选举结果。
description.en: The People's Republic of China was accused of interfering in the 2024 Taiwan presidential election through various means, including economic pressure (such as terminating tariff concessions for some ECFA products), spreading fake news and polls, and funding travel to mainland China for certain individuals to canvass for its favored candidates, in an attempt to influence the election outcome.

description.zh-cn: 在郭台铭宣布参选后，中国大陆当局于2023年10月对其创办的鸿海集团（富士康）展开税务及用地调查，此举被广泛解读为北京方面对其参选施加政治压力的警告。
description.en: After Terry Gou announced his candidacy, mainland Chinese authorities launched tax and land use investigations into his company, Hon Hai Precision Industry (Foxconn), in October 2023. This move was widely interpreted as a warning from Beijing to exert political pressure on his campaign.

description.zh-cn: 习近平在2024年新年贺词中表示，中国大陆与台湾的统一是“历史必然”，其对台措辞被认为比往年更为严厉，为此次选举增添了紧张的外部因素。
description.en: In his 2024 New Year's address, Xi Jinping stated that the reunification of mainland China and Taiwan is a 'historical inevitability.' His rhetoric towards Taiwan was considered more severe than in previous years, adding a tense external factor to this election.

description.zh-cn: 在台湾选举结果出炉后，美国总统乔·拜登被问及此事时回应称“我们不支持（台湾）独立”，此番表态重申了美国的长期政策，并引起国际关注。
description.en: After the Taiwan election results were announced, U.S. President Joe Biden, when asked about the matter, responded, 'We do not support independence,' a statement that reiterated long-standing U.S. policy and drew international attention.

description.zh-cn: 李显龙宣布卸任总理职务，并交棒给黄循财。
description.en: Lee Hsien Loong announced his resignation as Prime Minister and handed over the position to Lawrence Wong.

description.zh-cn: 在黄循财担任总理期间，尚达曼为新加坡总统。
description.en: During Lawrence Wong's term as Prime Minister, Tharman Shanmugaratnam served as the President of Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 在黄循财的总理任期内，颜金勇担任其副总理。
description.en: During Lawrence Wong's premiership, Gan Kim Yong serves as his Deputy Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 在黄循财的总理任期内，王瑞杰担任其副总理。
description.en: During Lawrence Wong's premiership, Heng Swee Keat serves as his Deputy Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 黄循财与王乙康、颜金勇共同主持了应对2019冠状病毒病新加坡疫情的多部委工作组。
description.en: Lawrence Wong co-chaired the multi-ministerial task force for the COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore, along with Ong Ye Kung and Gan Kim Yong.

description.zh-cn: 在2011年新加坡大选中，黄循财所在的人民行动党团队以66.66%的得票率击败了革新党。
description.en: In the 2011 Singaporean general election, the People's Action Party team, which included Lawrence Wong, defeated the Reform Party with 66.66% of the votes.

description.zh-cn: 黄循财与时任美国副国务卿维多利亚·纽兰会面。
description.en: Lawrence Wong met with then U.S. Deputy Secretary of State Victoria Nuland.

description.zh-cn: 黄循财与菲律宾总统小费迪南德·马科斯在马尼拉举行联合新闻发布会。
description.en: Lawrence Wong held a joint press conference with Philippine President Bongbong Marcos in Manila.

description.zh-cn: 黄循财在秘鲁利马举行的第31届亚太经合组织经济领袖会议期间与中国国家主席习近平会面。
description.en: Lawrence Wong met with Chinese President Xi Jinping during the 31st APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting in Lima, Peru.

description.zh-cn: 在接受《经济学人》专访时，黄循财强调新加坡反对台湾独立，并表示不允许新加坡被台独势力利用。
description.en: In an interview with The Economist, Lawrence Wong emphasized Singapore's opposition to Taiwan independence and stated that Singapore would not allow itself to be used by pro-independence forces.

description.zh-cn: 作为新加坡领导人，黄循财重申并坚持“一个中国”政策。
description.en: As the leader of Singapore, Lawrence Wong reaffirms and adheres to the 'One-China' policy.

description.zh-cn: 陈独秀、胡适、蔡元培是新文化运动的主要发起人。
description.en: Chen Duxiu, Hu Shih, and Cai Yuanpei were the main initiators of the New Culture Movement.

description.zh-cn: 陈独秀、胡适、蔡元培是新文化运动的主要发起人。
description.en: Chen Duxiu, Hu Shih, and Cai Yuanpei were the main initiators of the New Culture Movement.

position.en: Dean of the School of Letters at Peking University

description.zh-cn: 1917年1月，时任北京大学校长的蔡元培聘请陈独秀出任文科学长，使《新青年》总部随之迁往北京。
description.en: In January 1917, Cai Yuanpei, then president of Peking University, appointed Chen Duxiu as the Dean of the School of Letters, which led to the relocation of the 'New Youth' headquarters to Beijing.

position.en: Dean of the School of Letters

description.zh-cn: 1917年1月11日，陈独秀受蔡元培聘请，出任北京大学文科学长。
description.en: On January 11, 1917, at the invitation of Cai Yuanpei, Chen Duxiu became the Dean of the School of Letters at Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 1917年1月，胡适在《新青年》发表《文学改良刍议》，引起巨大反响，被广泛认为是文学革命的开端。
description.en: In January 1917, Hu Shih published 'A Preliminary Discussion of Literary Reform' in 'New Youth', which caused a great sensation and is widely regarded as the beginning of the Literary Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 新文化运动以“打倒孔家店”为口号，对以孔教为代表的传统儒家思想和封建礼教进行了猛烈的批判。
description.en: With the slogan 'Down with the Confucian establishment,' the New Culture Movement launched a fierce critique against traditional Confucian thought and feudal ethics represented by Confucianism.

description.zh-cn: 吴虞在《新青年》上连续发表多篇反孔文章，对儒家进行了严厉批判，被称为“只手打孔家店的老英雄”。
description.en: Wu Yu published a series of anti-Confucian articles in 'New Youth', severely criticizing Confucianism, and was known as 'the old hero who single-handedly smashed the Confucian establishment'.

description.zh-cn: 鲁迅在其小说《狂人日记》中，将写满“仁义道德”的封建历史解读为“吃人”，深刻地批判了以孔教为核心的封建礼教。
description.en: In his novel 'A Madman's Diary', Lu Xun interpreted feudal history, filled with 'benevolence, righteousness, and morality', as 'man-eating', profoundly criticizing the feudal ethical code centered on Confucianism.

description.zh-cn: 康有为开办孔教会，积极推动尊孔运动，与新文化运动的反孔思潮形成尖锐对立。
description.en: Kang Youwei established the Confucian Society and actively promoted the movement to venerate Confucius, creating a sharp opposition to the anti-Confucian trend of the New Culture Movement.

description.zh-cn: 古文家林纾致信蔡元培并公开发表文章，激烈反对废除文言文、推行白话文的文学革命。
description.en: Lin Shu, a classical Chinese scholar, wrote to Cai Yuanpei and published articles to vehemently oppose the Literary Revolution's aim of abolishing classical Chinese in favor of vernacular Chinese.

description.zh-cn: 学衡派创办《学衡》杂志，系统地批评新文化运动为“务为诡激，专图破坏”，反对其对传统文化的全盘否定。
description.en: The Xueheng School founded the 'Xueheng' (Critical Review) magazine to systematically criticize the New Culture Movement as 'deliberately radical and solely aimed at destruction,' opposing its wholesale rejection of traditional culture.

description.zh-cn: 作为学衡派代表人物，吴宓发表《论新文化运动》等文章，批判新文化运动崇尚西方糟粕而破坏中国国粹。
description.en: As a representative figure of the Xueheng School, Wu Mi published articles such as 'On the New Culture Movement,' criticizing the movement for venerating the dregs of Western culture while destroying the quintessence of China.

description.zh-cn: 孙中山认为新文化运动是外来文化的压迫，破坏了中国固有的忠孝仁义等优良道德。
description.en: Sun Yat-sen believed that the New Culture Movement was a form of foreign cultural oppression that destroyed China's inherent virtues such as loyalty, filial piety, benevolence, and righteousness.

description.zh-cn: 五四运动后，胡适与李大钊因“问题与主义”之争展开辩论，思想路径开始分化。胡适主张渐进改良的自由主义，李大钊则倾向于以马克思主义为指导进行社会革命，两人成为不同思想阵营的代表。
description.en: After the May Fourth Movement, Hu Shih and Li Dazhao engaged in the 'Problems and Isms' debate, marking the divergence of their ideological paths. Hu advocated for gradualist liberalism, while Li leaned towards social revolution guided by Marxism, making them representatives of opposing intellectual camps.

description.zh-cn: 维经斯基先后与李大钊和陈独秀会面，推动了中国各地共产主义小组的建立和中国共产党的成立。
description.en: Grigori Voitinsky met with Li Dazhao and Chen Duxiu, promoting the establishment of communist groups across China and the founding of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 杜威在中国长达两年的巡回讲学，传播实用主义哲学、教育和民主思想，对新文化运动产生了广泛而深刻的影响。
description.en: Dewey's two-year lecture tour in China spread pragmatist philosophy, educational, and democratic ideas, exerting a broad and profound influence on the New Culture Movement.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东在《新民主主义论》中对新文化运动作出定性，认为它是资产阶级领导的、反对封建文化的革命，是进步的但不彻底，并将其划分为五四前后的旧民主主义和新民主主义两个阶段。这一评价在中国大陆长期成为官方论述。
description.en: In 'On New Democracy', Mao Zedong defined the New Culture Movement as a progressive but incomplete anti-feudal revolution led by the bourgeoisie, dividing it into the pre- and post-May Fourth stages of old and new democracy. This assessment became the long-standing official narrative in mainland China.

description.zh-cn: 1929年，胡适提出“全盘的西化”口号，主张中国应一心一意地走上世界化的道路。此观点引发巨大争议，后被他修正为“充分世界化”。
description.en: In 1929, Hu Shih proposed the slogan of 'Wholesale Westernization,' arguing that China should single-mindedly embark on the path of world-ification. This view sparked immense controversy and was later revised by him to 'full-scale world-ification'.

description.zh-cn: 在新文化运动对传统礼教的批判和对个人解放的倡导下，中国的妇女运动得到进一步发展，女性开始争取在教育、职业、婚姻等方面的平等权利。
description.en: Under the New Culture Movement's critique of traditional ethics and advocacy for individual liberation, the women's movement in China developed further, with women beginning to fight for equal rights in education, career, and marriage.

description.zh-cn: 新文化运动猛烈抨击作为封建礼教一部分的包办婚姻制度，提倡自由恋爱和婚姻自主，深刻地改变了中国的社会婚恋观。
description.en: The New Culture Movement fiercely attacked the system of arranged marriage as part of the feudal ethical code, advocating for free love and marital autonomy, which profoundly changed social views on love and marriage in China.

description.zh-cn: 梁漱溟作为新儒家代表，对新文化运动的反传统倾向提出批评，同时又吸收其精神，试图在批判地继承中国传统文化的基础上，融合西方文化的优点，为中国文化寻求新的出路。他的思想构成了对新文化运动的一种重要回应和修正。
description.en: As a representative of New Confucianism, Liang Shuming criticized the anti-traditional tendencies of the New Culture Movement while also absorbing its spirit. He attempted to find a new path for Chinese culture by critically inheriting its traditions and integrating the merits of Western culture. His thought constituted an important response to and revision of the New Culture Movement.

description.zh-cn: 国立台湾大学的前身为台北帝国大学，于1945年由中华民国政府接收后改制而成。
description.en: National Taiwan University's predecessor was Taihoku Imperial University, which was reorganized after being taken over by the Republic of China government in 1945.

description.zh-cn: 1945年11月，国民政府教育部接收台北帝国大学后，将其易名为“国立台北大学”。
description.en: In November 1945, after the Ministry of Education of the Nationalist Government took over Taihoku Imperial University, it renamed it 'National Taipei University'.

description.zh-cn: 1945年12月15日，经行政院院会决议，国立台北大学正式定名为“国立台湾大学”。
description.en: On December 15, 1945, following a resolution by the Executive Yuan Council, National Taipei University was officially renamed 'National Taiwan University'.

description.zh-cn: 国立台湾大学的主管机关为中华民国教育部。
description.en: The competent authority of National Taiwan University is the Ministry of Education of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 该事件发生在台湾大学校园内，后于事发地设立“陈文成事件纪念广场”以兹纪念。
description.en: The incident occurred on the NTU campus, and the 'Chen Wen-chen Incident Memorial Square' was later established at the site to commemorate it.

description.zh-cn: 刘半农是刘天华的兄长。
description.en: Liu Bannong was the elder brother of Liu Tianhua.

description.zh-cn: 刘半农出生于江苏江阴。
description.en: Liu Bannong was born in Jiangyin, Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 刘半农于1907年入读常州中学，1911年毕业。
description.en: Liu Bannong enrolled in Changzhou High School in 1907 and graduated in 1911.

description.zh-cn: 刘半农与吴研因等人共同编辑《江阴杂志》。
description.en: Liu Bannong co-edited the 'Jiangyin Magazine' with Wu Yanyin and others.

description.zh-cn: 自1913年起，刘半农在中华书局任编译员。
description.en: Starting in 1913, Liu Bannong worked as a compiler and translator at the Zhonghua Book Company.

description.zh-cn: 1917年夏，蔡元培邀请刘半农至北京大学预科任教。
description.en: In the summer of 1917, Cai Yuanpei invited Liu Bannong to teach at the preparatory school of Peking University.

position.zh-cn: 预科教员、国文系教授、研究所国学门导师
position.en: Preparatory School Teacher, Professor of the Department of Chinese Literature, Mentor at the Institute of Sinology

description.zh-cn: 刘半农于1917年任北京大学预科教员，1925年回国后任国文系教授兼研究所国学门导师。
description.en: Liu Bannong became a teacher at the preparatory school of Peking University in 1917, and after returning to China in 1925, he became a professor in the Department of Chinese Literature and a mentor at the Institute of Sinology.

description.zh-cn: 在五四运动期间，刘半农曾声援被捕的学生。
description.en: During the May Fourth Movement, Liu Bannong supported the arrested students.

description.zh-cn: 1920年，刘半农赴欧洲留学，初于伦敦大学学习。
description.en: In 1920, Liu Bannong went to Europe to study, initially at the University of London.

description.zh-cn: 刘半农于1921年夏赴巴黎大学留学，1925年获得国家文学博士学位。
description.en: Liu Bannong went to study at the University of Paris in the summer of 1921 and obtained a state doctorate in literature in 1925.

description.zh-cn: 1929年7月，沈兼士邀请刘半农兼任辅仁大学教务长。
description.en: In July 1929, Shen Jianshi invited Liu Bannong to serve concurrently as the Dean of Studies at Fu Jen Catholic University.

position.zh-cn: 教务长、附中高中部主任
position.en: Dean of Studies, Director of the Affiliated High School Department

description.zh-cn: 刘半农于1929年7月兼任辅仁大学教务长，1930年12月兼任附中高中部主任。
description.en: Liu Bannong concurrently served as Dean of Studies at Fu Jen Catholic University from July 1929, and as director of the affiliated high school department from December 1930.

description.zh-cn: 九一八事变后，刘半农的政治立场转为积极主张抗日救国。
description.en: After the Mukden Incident, Liu Bannong's political stance shifted to actively advocating for resisting Japan and saving the nation.

description.zh-cn: 刘半农与李家瑞合著了《宋元以来俗字谱》。
description.en: Liu Bannong co-authored 'A谱 of Popular Characters since the Song and Yuan Dynasties' with Li Jiarui.

description.zh-cn: 李家瑞与刘半农合著了《宋元以来俗字谱》。
description.en: Li Jiarui co-authored 'A谱 of Popular Characters since the Song and Yuan Dynasties' with Liu Bannong.

description.zh-cn: 王洪文是“四人帮”成员之一。
description.en: Wang Hongwen was a member of the 'Gang of Four'.

description.zh-cn: 张春桥是“四人帮”成员之一。
description.en: Zhang Chunqiao was a member of the 'Gang of Four'.

description.zh-cn: 姚文元是“四人帮”成员之一。
description.en: Yao Wenyuan was a member of the 'Gang of Four'.

description.zh-cn: 在毛泽东支持下，江青与张春桥指使姚文元编写《评新编历史剧〈海瑞罢官〉》。
description.en: With Mao Zedong's support, Jiang Qing and Zhang Chunqiao instructed Yao Wenyuan to write 'On the New Historical Drama "Hai Rui Dismissed from Office"'.

description.zh-cn: 在林彪九一三事件后，王洪文从上海上调中央，并与张、江、姚结成联盟。
description.en: After the Lin Biao September 13 Incident, Wang Hongwen was transferred from Shanghai to the central government and formed an alliance with Zhang, Jiang, and Yao.

description.zh-cn: 中共十届三中全会决定开除王洪文、张春桥、江青、姚文元四人的党籍并撤销其党内外一切职务。
description.en: The Third Plenary Session of the 10th CPC Central Committee decided to expel Wang Hongwen, Zhang Chunqiao, Jiang Qing, and Yao Wenyuan from the party and remove them from all their posts inside and outside the party.

description.zh-cn: 陈峰云是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Chen Fengyun is a member of the Communist Party of China.

position.en: Director of Baishi Office, Town Mayor

description.zh-cn: 陈峰云历任田村镇白石办事处主任、田村镇镇长。
description.en: Chen Fengyun successively served as the Director of Baishi Office and the Mayor of Tiancun Town.

description.zh-cn: 陈峰云曾任茅店镇党委书记。
description.en: Chen Fengyun served as the Party Secretary of Maodian Town.

description.zh-cn: 陈峰云在长洛乡任期内在脱贫攻坚战中作出突出贡献。
description.en: During his tenure in Changluo Township, Chen Fengyun made outstanding contributions to the poverty alleviation campaign.

description.zh-cn: 在2021年2月25日举行的全国脱贫攻坚总结表彰大会上，陈峰云被授予“全国脱贫攻坚先进个人”荣誉称号。
description.en: At the National Poverty Alleviation Summary and Commendation Conference held on February 25, 2021, Chen Fengyun was awarded the honorary title of 'National Advanced Individual in Poverty Alleviation'.

description.zh-cn: 刘贤是吴王刘濞的儿子和太子。
description.en: Liu Xian was the son and crown prince of Liu Pi, the King of Wu.

description.zh-cn: 在汉文帝时期，刘启担任皇太子，后继位为汉景帝。
description.en: During the reign of Emperor Wen, Liu Qi served as the Crown Prince before succeeding to the throne as Emperor Jing.

description.zh-cn: 在与刘贤下六博棋时，因争执用棋盘砸死了刘贤。
description.en: Killed Liu Xian with a chessboard during a dispute while playing Liubo.

description.zh-cn: 汤玛斯·坎贝尔与亨利·布鲁厄姆共同创办了伦敦大学学院。
description.en: Thomas Campbell co-founded University College London with Henry Brougham.

description.zh-cn: 亨利·布鲁厄姆与汤玛斯·坎贝尔共同创办了伦敦大学学院。
description.en: Henry Brougham co-founded University College London with Thomas Campbell.

description.zh-cn: 杰里米·边沁关于普及教育的思想深刻影响了伦敦大学学院的创办者，成为学校的办学理念，因此他被誉为“伦大教父”。
description.en: Jeremy Bentham's ideas on universal education deeply influenced the founders of University College London, becoming the institution's guiding philosophy, which earned him the title of its 'spiritual father'.

description.zh-cn: 创办人之一汤玛斯·坎贝尔在到访波恩大学后，受其宗教自由的办学理念启发，决定在伦敦建立类似的学府，即伦敦大学学院。
description.en: After visiting the University of Bonn, co-founder Thomas Campbell was inspired by its principle of religious freedom and decided to establish a similar institution in London, which became University College London.

description.zh-cn: 1836年，伦敦大学学院与伦敦国王学院成为新成立的伦敦大学的两位始创成员学院。
description.en: In 1836, University College London and King's College London became the two founding constituent colleges of the newly established University of London.

description.zh-cn: 1836年，伦敦国王学院与伦敦大学学院成为新成立的伦敦大学的两位始创成员学院。
description.en: In 1836, King's College London and University College London became the two founding constituent colleges of the newly established University of London.

description.zh-cn: 两校之间存在历史悠久的体育竞争关系。
description.en: The two colleges have a long-standing rivalry in sports.

description.zh-cn: 在伦敦大学学院筹建期间，奥地利外交官克莱门斯·梅特涅曾要求他的驻英大使转述他对此计划“可能有损英格兰发展”的反对看法。
description.en: During the planning stages of University College London, Austrian diplomat Klemens von Metternich instructed his ambassador to the UK to convey his opposition, viewing the project as potentially 'detrimental to England's development'.

description.zh-cn: 由辉格党领导的英国政府在1831年成功为伦敦大学学院争取到皇家宪章，赋予其颁授学位的权力。
description.en: In 1831, the Whig-led British government successfully secured a Royal Charter for University College London, granting it the power to award degrees.

description.zh-cn: 1985年，女王伊利沙伯二世主持了伦敦大学学院本部大楼的启用仪式，标志其最终完工。
description.en: In 1985, Queen Elizabeth II presided over the opening ceremony of the main building of University College London, marking its final completion.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战期间，伦敦大学学院的本部大楼被炸毁，多数院系被迫搬离伦敦。
description.en: During World War II, the main building of University College London was bombed, and most of its departments were forced to evacuate London.

description.zh-cn: 伦敦大学学院在澳大利亚阿德雷德设立了能源学院卫星校园。
description.en: University College London established a satellite campus for its School of Energy and Resources in Adelaide, Australia.

description.zh-cn: 伦敦大学学院在卡塔尔多哈设立了考古与博物馆学院卫星校园。
description.en: University College London established a satellite campus for archaeology and museum studies in Doha, Qatar.

description.zh-cn: 第一次全联盟苏维埃代表大会通过了《苏联成立宣言》。
description.en: The First All-Union Congress of Soviets approved the Declaration of the Creation of the USSR.

description.zh-cn: 苏维埃俄国是苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟的创始成员国。
description.en: Soviet Russia was a founding member of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics.

description.zh-cn: 李景隆是李文忠的儿子。
description.en: Li Jinglong was the son of Li Wenzhong.

description.zh-cn: 李增枝是李景隆的弟弟。
description.en: Li Zengzhi was Li Jinglong's younger brother.

description.zh-cn: 李景隆是朱元璋外甥李文忠的儿子，即朱元璋的外甥孙。
description.en: Li Jinglong was the son of Zhu Yuanzhang's nephew, Li Wenzhong, making him Zhu Yuanzhang's grandnephew.

position.en: Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince

description.zh-cn: 李景隆曾掌管左军都督府事，并加太子太傅衔。
description.en: Li Jinglong was in charge of the Left Military Command and was also appointed Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince.

description.zh-cn: 在靖难之役期间，李景隆被建文帝任命为大将军，率领朝廷军队对抗燕王朱棣。
description.en: During the Jingnan Campaign, Li Jinglong was appointed Grand General by the Jianwen Emperor to lead the imperial army against Zhu Di, the Prince of Yan.

description.zh-cn: 在郑村坝之战中，李景隆被朱棣率领的燕军击败，大败而逃，丧师十余万。
description.en: In the Battle of Zhengcunba, Li Jinglong was defeated by the Yan army led by Zhu Di and fled, losing over a hundred thousand troops.

description.zh-cn: 白沟河惨败后，建文帝下诏将李景隆召回，并以盛庸替代其大将军之职。
description.en: After the disastrous defeat at Baigou River, the Jianwen Emperor recalled Li Jinglong and replaced him as Grand General with Sheng Yong.

description.zh-cn: 李景隆兵败还京后，黄子澄在朝廷上抓住他，请求将其处死以谢天下。
description.en: After Li Jinglong returned to the capital in defeat, Huang Zicheng seized him at court and requested his execution to atone for his failures.

description.zh-cn: 燕军渡江后，方孝孺请求建文帝诛杀李景隆。
description.en: After the Yan army crossed the Yangtze River, Fang Xiaoru requested that the Jianwen Emperor execute Li Jinglong.

description.zh-cn: 金川门的打开使得朱棣的军队得以顺利进入南京，为其最终夺取皇位铺平了道路。
description.en: The opening of the Jinchuan Gate allowed Zhu Di's army to enter Nanjing smoothly, paving the way for him to ultimately seize the throne.

description.zh-cn: 金川门的打开标志着南京的陷落和建文帝政权的覆灭。
description.en: The opening of the Jinchuan Gate marked the fall of Nanjing and the collapse of the Jianwen Emperor's regime.

description.zh-cn: 2022年12月起，袁家军担任中共重庆市委书记。
description.en: Since December 2022, Yuan Jiajun has served as the Secretary of the CPC Chongqing Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 2021年12月起，胡衡华担任重庆市市长。
description.en: Since December 2021, Hu Henghua has served as the Mayor of Chongqing.

description.zh-cn: 因其即位是“双重喜庆”，遂将自己曾藩封的恭州升为重庆府，重庆由此得名。
description.en: Because his enthronement was a 'double celebration', he elevated his former fief of Gongzhou to Chongqing Fu, from which the city gets its name.

description.zh-cn: 赵惇是宋孝宗的第三子。
description.en: Zhao Dun was the third son of Emperor Xiaozong of Song.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争时期，国民政府颁布《国民政府移驻重庆宣言》，定重庆为战时首都和永久陪都。
description.en: During the Second Sino-Japanese War, the Nationalist Government issued the 'Declaration of the National Government's Relocation to Chongqing', designating Chongqing as the wartime capital and permanent auxiliary capital.

description.zh-cn: 从1938年到1944年，日本对重庆进行了长达6年半的战略轰炸。
description.en: From 1938 to 1944, Japan conducted strategic bombing of Chongqing for six and a half years.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命初期，重庆发生了全国闻名的使用重型装备的大规模武斗。
description.en: In the early stages of the Cultural Revolution, Chongqing experienced large-scale armed conflicts, famous throughout the country for the use of heavy equipment.

description.zh-cn: 贺龙于1951年主持修建大田湾体育场，该体育场于1956年竣工。
description.en: He Long presided over the construction of Datianwan Stadium starting in 1951, and the stadium was completed in May 1956.

description.zh-cn: 根据Wikitext，邬宝恒是内蒙古杭锦后旗人。
description.en: According to the Wikitext, Wu Baoheng is from Hangjin Rear Banner, Inner Mongolia.

description.zh-cn: 邬宝恒曾担任内蒙古自治区政协副主席。
description.en: Wu Baoheng served as Vice Chairman of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类“Category:中国共产党党员”推断，邬宝恒是中国共产党的党员。
description.en: Inferred from the page category 'Category:Communist Party of China members', Wu Baoheng is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 指导巡逻队因“违反着装规范”逮捕了玛莎·阿米尼，阿米尼在被拘留期间死亡。
description.en: The Guidance Patrol arrested Mahsa Amini for 'improper hijab', and Amini died while in custody.

description.zh-cn: 阿米尼示威的目标之一是推翻伊朗伊斯兰共和国政府。
description.en: One of the goals of the Mahsa Amini protests is to overthrow the Government of the Islamic Republic of Iran.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗政府通过武力镇压、网络封锁等手段来压制阿米尼示威。
description.en: The Iranian government suppressed the Mahsa Amini protests through means such as violent crackdowns and internet blackouts.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗最高领袖阿里·哈梅内伊将示威定性为“暴乱”，并支持对其进行镇压。
description.en: Iran's Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei labeled the protests as 'riots' and supported the crackdown against them.

description.zh-cn: 阿里·哈梅内伊宣称阿米尼示威是由美国策划的。
description.en: Ali Khamenei claimed that the Mahsa Amini protests were orchestrated by the United States.

description.zh-cn: 阿里·哈梅内伊宣称阿米尼示威是由以色列策划的。
description.en: Ali Khamenei claimed that the Mahsa Amini protests were orchestrated by Israel.

description.zh-cn: 易卜拉欣·莱希于2021年当选为伊朗总统。
description.en: Ebrahim Raisi was elected President of Iran in 2021.

description.zh-cn: “革命街女孩”运动是反对强制头巾的早期抗议形式，为后来的阿米尼示威奠定了基础，阿米尼示威也被视为该运动的一部分。
description.en: The 'Girls of Enghelab Street' movement was an earlier form of protest against the compulsory hijab, laying the groundwork for the later Mahsa Amini protests, which are also considered part of this movement.

description.zh-cn: “女性、生命、自由”是阿米尼示威中最核心和流传最广的口号。
description.en: 'Woman, Life, Freedom' is the central and most widely circulated slogan of the Mahsa Amini protests.

description.zh-cn: 德国多特蒙德足球俱乐部的球迷在比赛中展示横幅，声援阿米尼示威并悼念遇难者萨丽娜·伊斯梅尔扎德。
description.en: Fans of the German football club Borussia Dortmund displayed a banner during a match to show solidarity with the Mahsa Amini protests and mourn the victim Sarina Esmailzadeh.

description.zh-cn: 在2022年世界杯对阵英格兰的比赛前，伊朗国家队球员集体拒唱国歌，以示对国内示威的支持。
description.en: Before their 2022 World Cup match against England, players of the Iran national team collectively refused to sing the national anthem as a sign of support for the domestic protests.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗前国脚沃里亚·加富里因在社交媒体声援示威而被捕。
description.en: Former Iran national team player Voria Ghafouri was arrested for supporting the protests on social media.

description.zh-cn: 为支持伊朗示威者，美国足协在社交媒体上发布了不含伊朗国徽的伊朗国旗图片。
description.en: To support protesters in Iran, the U.S. Soccer Federation posted an image of the Iranian flag on social media without its national emblem.

description.zh-cn: 联合国经济及社会理事会投票决定将伊朗从联合国妇女地位委员会中除名，以回应伊朗政府对示威的镇压。
description.en: The UN Economic and Social Council voted to remove Iran from the Commission on the Status of Women in response to the government's crackdown on protests.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗情报部逮捕了报道玛莎·阿米尼之死的记者尼罗法·哈米迪，并指控其为外国间谍。
description.en: The Iranian Ministry of Intelligence arrested journalist Niloofar Hamedi, who reported on the death of Mahsa Amini, and accused her of being a foreign agent.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗情报部逮捕了报道玛莎·阿米尼之死的记者埃拉赫·穆罕默迪，并指控其为外国间谍。
description.en: The Iranian Ministry of Intelligence arrested journalist Elaheh Mohammadi, who reported on the death of Mahsa Amini, and accused her of being a foreign agent.

description.zh-cn: 侯赛因·萨拉米是伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队总司令。
description.en: Hossein Salami is the Commander-in-Chief of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.

description.zh-cn: 伊斯兰革命卫队总司令侯赛因·萨拉米警告沙特阿拉伯，指责其支持阿米尼示威。
description.en: Hossein Salami, Commander-in-Chief of the IRGC, warned Saudi Arabia, accusing it of supporting the Mahsa Amini protests.

description.zh-cn: 联合国人权理事会通过决议，成立调查团调查伊朗当局对示威的镇压行为。
description.en: The UN Human Rights Council passed a resolution to establish a fact-finding mission to investigate the Iranian authorities' crackdown on the protests.

description.zh-cn: 欧洲议会负责授予萨哈罗夫奖。
description.en: The European Parliament is responsible for awarding the Sakharov Prize.

description.zh-cn: 2023年萨哈罗夫奖被追授给玛莎·阿米尼，以表彰她为自由和平等进行的抗争。
description.en: The 2023 Sakharov Prize was posthumously awarded to Mahsa Amini in recognition of her fight for freedom and equality.

description.zh-cn: 2023年萨哈罗夫奖被授予“女性、生命、自由”运动，以表彰其为自由和平等进行的抗争。
description.en: The 2023 Sakharov Prize was awarded to the 'Woman, Life, Freedom' movement in recognition of its fight for freedom and equality.

description.zh-cn: 因其为伊朗受压迫女性的斗争，纳尔吉斯·穆罕默迪被授予2023年诺贝尔和平奖。
description.en: Narges Mohammadi was awarded the 2023 Nobel Peace Prize for her fight against the oppression of women in Iran.

description.zh-cn: 加拿大政府宣布对伊朗道德警察及多名官员实施制裁，以回应其对示威的镇压。
description.en: The Canadian government announced sanctions against Iran's morality police and several officials in response to their crackdown on protests.

description.zh-cn: 德国政府谴责伊朗政权镇压示威，并呼吁欧盟对相关责任人实施制裁。
description.en: The German government condemned the Iranian regime's suppression of protests and called for EU sanctions against those responsible.

description.zh-cn: 强硬保守派候选人易卜拉欣·莱希在2021年伊朗总统选举中获胜，成为伊朗总统。
description.en: Hardline conservative candidate Ebrahim Raisi won the 2021 Iranian presidential election, becoming the President of Iran.

description.zh-cn: 1979年的伊朗伊斯兰革命建立了现行的政教合一制度，深刻地影响了伊朗的社会和政治结构，包括妇女权利和着装规范。
description.en: The 1979 Iranian Islamic Revolution established the current theocratic system, profoundly influencing Iran's social and political structure, including women's rights and dress codes.

description.zh-cn: 艾菲尔曾表示，1853年纽约世界博览会上的莱廷观览塔是其设计的灵感来源之一。
description.en: Eiffel stated that the Latting Observatory from the 1853 New York World's Fair was one of the inspirations for his design.

description.zh-cn: 在1938年中共六届六中全会期间，担任中央书记处书记。
description.en: Served as a secretary of the Central Secretariat during the 6th Plenary Session of the 6th CPC Central Committee in 1938.

description.zh-cn: 在1938年中共六届六中全会期间，担任中央书记处书记。
description.en: Served as a secretary of the Central Secretariat during the 6th Plenary Session of the 6th CPC Central Committee in 1938.

description.zh-cn: 在1938年中共六届六中全会期间，担任中央书记处书记。
description.en: Served as a secretary of the Central Secretariat during the 6th Plenary Session of the 6th CPC Central Committee in 1938.

description.zh-cn: 在1938年中共六届六中全会期间，担任中央书记处书记。
description.en: Served as a secretary of the Central Secretariat during the 6th Plenary Session of the 6th CPC Central Committee in 1938.

description.zh-cn: 在1938年中共六届六中全会期间，担任中央书记处书记。
description.en: Served as a secretary of the Central Secretariat during the 6th Plenary Session of the 6th CPC Central Committee in 1938.

description.zh-cn: 1945年中共七届一中全会上当选为中央书记处书记，成为“五大书记”之首。
description.en: Elected as a secretary of the Central Secretariat at the first plenary session of the 7th CPC Central Committee in 1945, becoming the head of the 'Five Great Secretaries'.

description.zh-cn: 1945年中共七届一中全会上当选为中央书记处书记，是“五大书记”之一。
description.en: Elected as a secretary of the Central Secretariat at the first plenary session of the 7th CPC Central Committee in 1945, becoming one of the 'Five Great Secretaries'.

description.zh-cn: 1945年中共七届一中全会上当选为中央书记处书记，是“五大书记”之一。
description.en: Elected as a secretary of the Central Secretariat at the first plenary session of the 7th CPC Central Committee in 1945, becoming one of the 'Five Great Secretaries'.

description.zh-cn: 1945年中共七届一中全会上当选为中央书记处书记，是“五大书记”之一。
description.en: Elected as a secretary of the Central Secretariat at the first plenary session of the 7th CPC Central Committee in 1945, becoming one of the 'Five Great Secretaries'.

description.zh-cn: 1945年中共七届一中全会上当选为中央书记处书记，是“五大书记”之一，于1950年去世。
description.en: Elected as a secretary of the Central Secretariat at the first plenary session of the 7th CPC Central Committee in 1945, becoming one of the 'Five Great Secretaries'; passed away in 1950.

description.zh-cn: 1956年9月中共八届一中全会上，当选为中央委员会主席。
description.en: In September 1956, at the first plenary session of the 8th CPC Central Committee, he was elected Chairman of the Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1956年9月中共八届一中全会上，当选为中央委员会副主席。
description.en: In September 1956, at the first plenary session of the 8th CPC Central Committee, he was elected Vice Chairman of the Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1956年9月中共八届一中全会上，当选为中央委员会副主席。
description.en: In September 1956, at the first plenary session of the 8th CPC Central Committee, he was elected Vice Chairman of the Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1956年9月中共八届一中全会上，当选为中央委员会副主席。
description.en: In September 1956, at the first plenary session of the 8th CPC Central Committee, he was elected Vice Chairman of the Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1956年9月中共八届一中全会上，当选为中央委员会副主席。
description.en: In September 1956, at the first plenary session of the 8th CPC Central Committee, he was elected Vice Chairman of the Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1956年9月中共八届一中全会上，当选为中央委员会总书记。
description.en: In September 1956, at the first plenary session of the 8th CPC Central Committee, he was elected General Secretary of the Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1956年9月起，兼任国务院副总理。
description.en: Starting from September 1956, he also served as Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 1956年9月起，兼任国防委员会副主席。
description.en: Starting from September 1956, he also served as Vice Chairman of the National Defense Commission.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命的开始标志着“毛刘周朱陈林邓”这一领导集体格局的终结。
description.en: The beginning of the Cultural Revolution marked the end of the 'Mao-Liu-Zhou-Zhu-Chen-Lin-Deng' collective leadership structure.

description.zh-cn: 1966年文革开始后，林彪一度成为仅次于毛泽东的接班人。
description.en: After the Cultural Revolution began in 1966, Lin Biao became the designated successor to Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 林彪事件后，林彪被定为林彪反党集团的主谋。
description.en: After the Lin Biao incident, Lin Biao was identified as the mastermind of the Lin Biao Anti-Party Clique.

description.zh-cn: 1989年5月，陈云提出“以邓小平为头子（核心）的党中央”，巩固了邓小平的领导核心地位。
description.en: In May 1989, Chen Yun proposed 'the Party Central Committee with Deng Xiaoping as its head (core)', consolidating Deng's core leadership position.

description.zh-cn: 《零八宪章》是受捷克斯洛伐克反体制运动的象征性文件《七七宪章》启发而作。
description.en: Charter 08 was inspired by Charter 77, a symbolic document of the anti-regime movement in Czechoslovakia.

description.zh-cn: 负责起草《零八宪章》。
description.en: Was responsible for drafting Charter 08.

description.zh-cn: 作为首批签署人之一签署了《零八宪章》。
description.en: Signed Charter 08 as one of the first signatories.

description.zh-cn: 作为首批签署人之一签署了《零八宪章》。
description.en: Signed Charter 08 as one of the first signatories.

description.zh-cn: 《零八宪章》提出建立中华联邦共和国来解决两岸问题及各民族问题。
description.en: Charter 08 proposed the establishment of a Federal Republic of China to resolve cross-strait and ethnic issues.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政府禁止了与《零八宪章》相关的活动，并逮捕多名发起人。
description.en: The government of the People's Republic of China banned activities related to Charter 08 and arrested several of its initiators.

description.zh-cn: 在《零八宪章》发布前夕拘留刘晓波，并随后以“煽动颠覆国家政权罪”将其逮捕判刑，直至其在监禁中去世。
description.en: Detained Liu Xiaobo on the eve of Charter 08's release, and later arrested and sentenced him for 'inciting subversion of state power', until his death in custody.

description.zh-cn: 刘晓波被以“涉嫌煽动颠覆国家政权”的罪名逮捕并最终判刑。
description.en: Liu Xiaobo was arrested and eventually sentenced on charges of 'suspicion of inciting subversion of state power'.

description.zh-cn: 因“为中国基本人权所进行的长期、非暴力的斗争”而授予刘晓波诺贝尔和平奖。
description.en: Awarded the Nobel Peace Prize to Liu Xiaobo for his 'long and non-violent struggle for fundamental human rights in China'.

description.zh-cn: 刘晓波获奖使得《零八宪章》在国际上广为人知。
description.en: Liu Xiaobo's award brought widespread international attention to Charter 08.

description.zh-cn: 亲自将“人与人”（Homo Homini）人权奖授予《零八宪章》签署群体。
description.en: Personally presented the Homo Homini Award to the Charter 08 signatory group.

description.zh-cn: 在报道中称制定《零八宪章》属于“公然的违宪行为”。
description.en: Claimed in a report that the creation of Charter 08 was an 'overtly unconstitutional act'.

description.zh-cn: 对《零八宪章》表示了支持和赞赏。
description.en: Expressed support and admiration for Charter 08.

description.zh-cn: 作为海外知名人士支持并签署了《零八宪章》。
description.en: As a prominent overseas figure, supported and signed Charter 08.

description.zh-cn: 一些评论员认为《零八宪章》的起草人士可能受到三十年前台湾民主运动（以《美丽岛》为代表）的启发。
description.en: Some commentators believe the drafters of Charter 08 may have been inspired by Taiwan's democracy movement from thirty years prior, represented by the Formosa Magazine.

description.zh-cn: 陈元是陈云的长子。
description.en: Chen Yuan is the eldest son of Chen Yun.

description.zh-cn: 陈元于1945年1月出生于江苏省青浦县。
description.en: Chen Yuan was born in Qingpu County, Jiangsu Province in January 1945.

description.zh-cn: 陈元于1964年毕业于北京四中。
description.en: Chen Yuan graduated from Beijing No. 4 High School in 1964.

description.zh-cn: 陈元于1964年至1970年在清华大学自动控制系学习。
description.en: Chen Yuan studied in the Department of Automatic Control at Tsinghua University from 1964 to 1970.

description.zh-cn: 陈元于1978年至1980年在上海机械学院（今上海理工大学）系统工程研究生班学习。
description.en: From 1978 to 1980, Chen Yuan studied in the Systems Engineering postgraduate class at Shanghai Institute of Mechanical Engineering (now University of Shanghai for Science and Technology).

description.zh-cn: 陈元于1981年毕业于中国社会科学院研究生院经济系企业管理专业，获硕士学位。
description.en: Chen Yuan graduated in 1981 from the Graduate School of the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences with a Master's degree in Enterprise Management from the Department of Economics.

description.zh-cn: 陈元曾师从经济学家马洪。
description.en: Chen Yuan was a student of economist Ma Hong.

description.zh-cn: 陈元曾师从经济学家于光远。
description.en: Chen Yuan was a student of economist Yu Guangyuan.

description.zh-cn: 陈元在中国人民银行任职期间，曾在行长李贵鲜领导下工作。
description.en: During his tenure at the People's Bank of China, Chen Yuan worked under Governor Li Guixian.

description.zh-cn: 陈元在中国人民银行任职期间，曾在行长朱镕基领导下工作。
description.en: During his tenure at the People's Bank of China, Chen Yuan worked under Governor Zhu Rongji.

description.zh-cn: 陈元在中国人民银行任职期间，曾在行长戴相龙领导下工作。
description.en: During his tenure at the People's Bank of China, Chen Yuan worked under Governor Dai Xianglong.

description.zh-cn: 陈元在俞正声担任全国政协主席期间任副主席。
description.en: Chen Yuan served as Vice Chairman while Yu Zhengsheng was the Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 2013年3月，陈元当选全国政协副主席，成为党和国家领导人。
description.en: In March 2013, Chen Yuan was elected Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee, becoming a Party and state leader.

description.zh-cn: 2013年清明节期间，陈元为薄一波敬献花篮，以示纪念。
description.en: During the Qingming Festival in 2013, Chen Yuan presented a flower basket in memory of Bo Yibo.

description.zh-cn: 2013年4月11日，陈元在《人民日报》发表文章，称赞江泽民的反腐功绩。
description.en: On April 11, 2013, Chen Yuan published an article in the People's Daily praising Jiang Zemin's anti-corruption achievements.

description.zh-cn: 陈云曾任国务院副总理。
description.en: Chen Yun once served as Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 有评论称，江泽民为陈元安排了全国政协副主席的职务。
description.en: According to some commentators, Jiang Zemin arranged the position of Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee for Chen Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 陈晓丹2007年毕业于杜克大学经济系。
description.en: Chen Xiaodan graduated from the Department of Economics at Duke University in 2007.

description.zh-cn: 台湾总督府于1919年创办了“台湾总督府农林专门学校”，即国立中兴大学的前身。
description.en: The Governor-General of Taiwan founded the 'Agricultural and Forestry Vocational School of the Governor-General of Taiwan' in 1919, which is the predecessor of National Chung Hsing University.

description.zh-cn: 自1971年起由台湾省立改隶教育部，正式成为“国立中兴大学”。
description.en: Since 1971, it was transferred from Taiwan Provincial to the Ministry of Education, officially becoming 'National Chung Hsing University'.

description.zh-cn: 国立中兴大学法商学院于2000年改制为国立台北大学。
description.en: The College of Law and Business of National Chung Hsing University was restructured into National Taipei University in 2000.

description.zh-cn: 林致平担任台湾省立中兴大学首任校长。
description.en: Lin Chih-Ping served as the first president of Taiwan Provincial Chung Hsing University.

description.zh-cn: 汤惠荪担任台湾省立中兴大学第二任校长。
description.en: Tang Hui-Sun served as the second president of Taiwan Provincial Chung Hsing University.

description.zh-cn: 原国立大里高级中学于2014年2月1日合并入国立中兴大学，并改制为其附属高级中学。
description.en: The former National Dali Senior High School was merged into National Chung Hsing University on February 1, 2014, and was restructured as its affiliated senior high school.

description.zh-cn: 国立台中高级农业职业学校于2014年2月1日合并入国立中兴大学，并改制为其附属农业学校。
description.en: National Taichung Agricultural Senior High School was merged into National Chung Hsing University on February 1, 2014, and was restructured as its affiliated agricultural school.

description.zh-cn: 国立中兴大学于2021年11月8日加入“台湾国立大学系统”（NUST）。
description.en: National Chung Hsing University joined the National University System of Taiwan (NUST) on November 8, 2021.

description.zh-cn: 国立中兴大学是台湾综合大学系统的成员之一。
description.en: National Chung Hsing University is a member of the Taiwan Comprehensive University System.

description.zh-cn: 国立中兴大学于2005年入选教育部“发展国际一流大学及顶尖研究中心计划”（五年五百亿），获得经费补助以提升国际竞争力。
description.en: In 2005, National Chung Hsing University was selected for the Ministry of Education's 'Development Plan for World-Class Universities and Top-Tier Research Centers' (Five-Year 50 Billion Project), receiving funding to enhance its international competitiveness.

description.zh-cn: 自2009年起，国立中兴大学加入由国立成功大学和国立中山大学发起的“城湾杯”校际竞赛，该竞赛后更名为“兴城湾杯”，并发展为“正兴城湾杯”。
description.en: Since 2009, National Chung Hsing University has joined the 'Cheng-Wan Cup' intercollegiate competition initiated by National Cheng Kung University and National Sun Yat-sen University, which was later renamed the 'Hsing-Cheng-Wan Cup' and evolved into the 'Jheng-Sing-Cheng-Wan Cup'.

description.zh-cn: 自2011年起，国立中兴大学与国立中正大学等校共同参与“正兴城湾杯”校际竞赛。
description.en: Since 2011, National Chung Hsing University, along with National Chung Cheng University and other institutions, has participated in the 'Jheng-Sing-Cheng-Wan Cup' intercollegiate competition.

description.zh-cn: 罗豪才担任中国人民政治协商会议第九届、十届全国委员会副主席。
description.en: Luo Haocai served as the Vice Chairman of the 9th and 10th National Committees of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 罗豪才担任第九届全国政协副主席期间，李瑞环是时任全国政协主席。
description.en: During Luo Haocai's term as Vice Chairman of the 9th CPPCC, Li Ruihuan was the serving Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 罗豪才担任第十届全国政协副主席期间，贾庆林是时任全国政协主席。
description.en: During Luo Haocai's term as Vice Chairman of the 10th CPPCC, Jia Qinglin was the serving Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 罗豪才担任中国致公党第十一届、十二届中央委员会主席。
description.en: Luo Haocai served as the Chairman of the 11th and 12th Central Committees of the China Zhi Gong Party.

description.zh-cn: 万钢接替罗豪才，当选为中国致公党中央委员会主席。
description.en: Wan Gang succeeded Luo Haocai as the elected Chairman of the Central Committee of the China Zhi Gong Party.

description.zh-cn: 罗豪才是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Luo Haocai was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 罗豪才是中国致公党党员，并曾担任其最高领导人。
description.en: Luo Haocai was a member of the China Zhi Gong Party and served as its top leader.

description.zh-cn: 罗豪才被认为是中国现代行政法学的开拓者与奠基人。
description.en: Luo Haocai is considered a pioneer and founder of modern administrative law in China.

description.zh-cn: 罗豪才幼年时，因日本侵略新加坡，其不少亲友被杀害，使他自幼便痛恨日本帝国主义。
description.en: During Luo Haocai's childhood, many of his relatives and friends were killed due to the Japanese invasion of Singapore, causing him to hate Japanese imperialism from a young age.

description.zh-cn: 因参加反对英国殖民统治的斗争，罗豪才被新加坡的英国殖民当局逮捕、监禁，并最终被驱逐出境。
description.en: For participating in the struggle against British colonial rule, Luo Haocai was arrested, imprisoned, and ultimately deported by the British colonial authorities in Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 1952年至1956年期间，罗豪才先后在广州市知用中学和无锡市第一中学学习。
description.en: Between 1952 and 1956, Luo Haocai studied at Guangzhou Zhiyong Middle School and subsequently at Wuxi No. 1 High School.

description.zh-cn: 1952年至1956年期间，罗豪才先后在广州市知用中学和无锡市第一中学学习。
description.en: Between 1952 and 1956, Luo Haocai studied at Guangzhou Zhiyong Middle School and subsequently at Wuxi No. 1 High School.

description.zh-cn: 1956年至1960年在北京大学法律系学习。
description.en: Studied at the Department of Law, Peking University from 1956 to 1960.

position.zh-cn: 助教、讲师、系副主任、副校长、教授
position.en: Teaching Assistant, Lecturer, Deputy Head of Department, Vice President, Professor

description.zh-cn: 1960年毕业后留校任教，至1995年，历任北京大学法律系助教、讲师、系副主任、副校长、教授等职。
description.en: After graduating in 1960, he stayed at Peking University to teach until 1995, holding positions such as Teaching Assistant, Lecturer, Deputy Head of the Law Department, Vice President, and Professor.

description.zh-cn: 1990年代初，罗豪才与袁曙宏等人率先提出“现代行政法的平衡理论”。
description.en: In the early 1990s, Luo Haocai, along with Yuan Shuhong and others, pioneered the 'balance theory of modern administrative law'.

description.zh-cn: 作为中国现代行政法学的开拓者，罗豪才的学术活动和理论研究为《中华人民共和国行政诉讼法》的建立与施行起到了推动作用。
description.en: As a pioneer of modern administrative law in China, Luo Haocai's academic activities and theoretical research played a promotional role in the establishment and implementation of the Administrative Procedure Law of the PRC.

description.zh-cn: 罗豪才在1990年代曾担任中国侨联副主席。
description.en: Luo Haocai served as the Vice Chairman of the All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese in the 1990s.

description.zh-cn: 罗豪才在1990年代曾担任中国法学会副会长。
description.en: Luo Haocai served as the Vice President of the China Law Society in the 1990s.

position.zh-cn: 副院长、审判委员会委员
position.en: Vice President, Member of the Judicial Committee

description.zh-cn: 1995年至1998年，罗豪才担任最高人民法院副院长、审判委员会委员。
description.en: From 1995 to 1998, Luo Haocai served as Vice President and a member of the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 2000年，罗豪才当选为中国和平统一促进会会长。
description.en: In 2000, Luo Haocai was elected President of the China Council for the Promotion of Peaceful National Reunification.

description.zh-cn: 2007年5月至2016年12月，罗豪才担任中国人权研究会会长。
description.en: From May 2007 to December 2016, Luo Haocai served as President of the China Society for Human Rights Studies.

description.zh-cn: 1998年3月，罗豪才当选第九届全国政协副主席，成为副国级领导人，直至2008年3月卸任。
description.en: In March 1998, Luo Haocai was elected Vice Chairman of the 9th CPPCC National Committee, becoming a deputy national leader, a rank he held until he stepped down in March 2008.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国空军在第二次世界大战期间对伦敦进行了一系列轰炸，史称“伦敦大轰炸”。
description.en: The Luftwaffe conducted a series of bombings against London during World War II, known as 'The Blitz'.

description.zh-cn: 1952年的大雾霾事件最终促使英国议会通过了《1956年空气清净法案》。
description.en: The Great Smog of 1952 ultimately led to the passage of the Clean Air Act 1956 by the UK Parliament.

description.zh-cn: 萨迪克·汗是现任伦敦市长。
description.en: Sadiq Khan is the current Mayor of London.

description.zh-cn: 伦敦议会负责监督伦敦市长的决策，并有权批准或否决其年度预算提案。
description.en: The London Assembly scrutinises the decisions of the Mayor of London and has the power to approve or reject the mayor's annual budget proposals.

description.zh-cn: 伦敦警察厅由伦敦市长通过市长警务和犯罪问题办公室进行监督。
description.en: The Metropolitan Police Service is overseen by the Mayor of London through the Mayor's Office for Policing and Crime.

description.zh-cn: 在被迫同意离婚后，溥仪为挽回体面，登报发布“上谕”，宣布撤去文绣的原封位号，废为庶人。
description.en: After being forced to agree to the divorce, Puyi, in order to save face, published an 'imperial edict' in the newspapers, announcing the revocation of Wenxiu's title and demoting her to the status of a commoner.

description.zh-cn: 文绣的家族是蒙古八旗中的鄂尔德特氏，隶属于上三旗的镶黄旗。
description.en: Wenxiu's family, the Erdet clan of the Mongol Eight Banners, belonged to the Bordered Yellow Banner of the Upper Three Banners.

description.zh-cn: 文绣是清朝末代皇帝溥仪的淑妃。
description.en: Wenxiu was the Consort Shu of Puyi, the last emperor of the Qing Dynasty.

position.en: Teacher of Chinese Literature and Painting

description.zh-cn: 离婚后，文绣化名傅玉芳在私立四存中小学（现北京市第八中学）担任教师，后因身份暴露而辞职。
description.en: After her divorce, Wenxiu worked as a teacher at the Si Cun Private Middle School (now Beijing No. 8 Middle School) under the alias Fu Yufang, but resigned after her identity was revealed.

description.zh-cn: 1947年，文绣经人介绍在《华北日报》担任校对员。
description.en: In 1947, through an acquaintance, Wenxiu began working as a proofreader at the Huabei Daily.

description.zh-cn: 为准备称帝，将太和殿、中和殿、保和殿等主要建筑改名。
description.en: In preparation for his enthronement, he renamed major buildings such as the Hall of Supreme Harmony, Hall of Central Harmony, and Hall of Preserving Harmony.

description.zh-cn: 此次政变结束了紫禁城作为皇室居所的历史，为次年成立故宫博物院创造了条件。
description.en: This coup ended the history of the Forbidden City as an imperial residence, creating the conditions for the establishment of the Palace Museum the following year.

description.zh-cn: 埃德加斯·林克维奇斯是拉脱维亚的现任总统。
description.en: Edgars Rinkēvičs is the current President of Latvia.

description.zh-cn: 埃维卡·西利尼亚是拉脱维亚的现任总理。
description.en: Evika Siliņa is the current Prime Minister of Latvia.

description.zh-cn: 拉脱维亚于1918年11月18日宣布从俄罗斯帝国独立。
description.en: Latvia declared independence from the Russian Empire on November 18, 1918.

description.zh-cn: 1991年的独立公投推动了拉脱维亚在同年8月21日正式恢复独立。
description.en: The 1991 independence referendum pushed Latvia to formally restore its independence on August 21 of the same year.

description.zh-cn: 拉脱维亚于1991年8月21日恢复独立，脱离苏联。
description.en: Latvia restored its independence on August 21, 1991, seceding from the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 拉脱维亚于2004年加入欧洲联盟。
description.en: Latvia joined the European Union in 2004.

description.zh-cn: 拉脱维亚于2004年加入北大西洋公约组织。
description.en: Latvia joined NATO in 2004.

description.zh-cn: 在13世纪早期，条顿骑士团通过武力征服了现今拉脱维亚的大部分地区。
description.en: In the early 13th century, the Teutonic Order conquered most of the territory of present-day Latvia by force.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次世界大战期间，苏联吞并拉脱维亚，直至其1991年恢复独立。
description.en: During World War II, the Soviet Union annexed Latvia, a control that lasted until its restoration of independence in 1991.

description.zh-cn: 苏联吞并拉脱维亚后，建立了拉脱维亚苏维埃社会主义共和国作为其加盟共和国。
description.en: After annexing Latvia, the Soviet Union established the Latvian Soviet Socialist Republic as its constituent republic.

description.zh-cn: 拉脱维亚苏维埃社会主义共和国是苏联的一个加盟共和国。
description.en: The Latvian Soviet Socialist Republic was a constituent republic of the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 1941年6月苏德战争爆发后，纳粹德国占领了原属苏联控制的拉脱维亚，直到1944年苏联反攻。
description.en: After the outbreak of the German-Soviet War in June 1941, Nazi Germany occupied Latvia, which was previously under Soviet control, until the Soviet counter-offensive in 1944.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国占领波罗的海国家后，建立了奥斯兰总督辖区进行管治。
description.en: After occupying the Baltic states, Nazi Germany established the Reichskommissariat Ostland to administer the territory.

description.zh-cn: 歌唱革命作为波罗的海独立运动的一部分，促进了拉脱维亚的最终独立。
description.en: The Singing Revolution, as part of the Baltic independence movement, contributed to the eventual independence of Latvia.

description.zh-cn: 拉脱维亚议会于2007年5月31日选举瓦尔季斯·扎特莱尔斯为总统。
description.en: The Saeima elected Valdis Zatlers as President on May 31, 2007.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国与拉脱维亚在1936-1940年间有公使级外交关系，在1992-1994年间有总领事关系。
description.en: The Republic of China had minister-level diplomatic relations with Latvia from 1936-1940 and consular-general relations from 1992-1994.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国与拉脱维亚自1991年起建立外交关系。
description.en: The People's Republic of China and Latvia have maintained diplomatic relations since 1991.

description.zh-cn: 因苏联历史问题，拉脱维亚对俄罗斯抱持反感态度，并配合欧盟对其实施经济制裁。
description.en: Due to historical issues with the Soviet Union, Latvia holds negative sentiment towards Russia and cooperates with the EU in imposing economic sanctions against it.

description.zh-cn: 时任总统莱伊蒙茨·维尤尼斯签署法令，规定自2020年1月1日起，在拉脱维亚出生的非公民子女自动获得公民身份，从而停止了新生儿被赋予非公民身份的做法。
description.en: Then-President Raimonds Vējonis signed a law stipulating that from January 1, 2020, children of non-citizens born in Latvia would automatically receive citizenship, thus ending the practice of granting non-citizen status to newborns.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框内容，德宏州政协的上级机构是中国人民政治协商会议云南省委员会。
description.en: According to the infobox, the superior body of the CPPCC Dehong Committee is the CPPCC Yunnan Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框内容，德宏州政协的中共上级是中国共产党德宏傣族景颇族自治州委员会，接受其政治领导。
description.en: According to the infobox, the superior CCP organization of the CPPCC Dehong Committee is the CCP Dehong Prefectural Committee, accepting its political leadership.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命爆发后，德宏州政协受到冲击停止工作，直至1983年4月才恢复工作。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Cultural Revolution, the CPPCC Dehong Committee was impacted and ceased its work until it was restored in April 1983.

description.zh-cn: 吴克华出生于江西省弋阳县曹溪区芳墩村。
description.en: Wu Kehua was born in Fangdun Village, Caoxi District, Yiyang County, Jiangxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 吴克华于1938年10月与张铭结婚。
description.en: Wu Kehua married Zhang Ming in October 1938.

description.zh-cn: 吴克华于1937年8月抗日红军大学毕业后与张爱萍一同前往上海。
description.en: After graduating from the Counter-Japanese Red Army University in August 1937, Wu Kehua went to Shanghai with Zhang Aiping.

description.zh-cn: 吴克华于1929年加入中国共产党。
description.en: Wu Kehua joined the Communist Party of China in 1929.

description.zh-cn: 吴克华于1929年秋参加中国工农红军。
description.en: Wu Kehua joined the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army in the autumn of 1929.

description.zh-cn: 1954年7月至1957年，吴克华在南京军事学院学习。
description.en: From July 1954 to 1957, Wu Kehua studied at the Nanjing Military Academy.

description.zh-cn: 在“文化大革命”期间，吴克华于1967年7月开始遭受迫害，9月被隔离审查，其后被长期关押，直至1972年7月被解除监禁。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Wu Kehua was persecuted starting in July 1967, placed under isolated investigation in September, and subsequently imprisoned for a long period until his release in July 1972.

description.zh-cn: 吴克华担任乌鲁木齐军区司令员。
description.en: Wu Kehua served as commander of the Ürümqi Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 在辽沈战役期间，吴克华指挥第四纵队执行了塔山阻击战。
description.en: During the Liaoshen Campaign, Wu Kehua commanded the 4th Column in the Battle of Tashan.

description.zh-cn: 吴克华参与指挥了新开岭战役。
description.en: Wu Kehua participated in commanding the Xinkailing Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 破四旧是文化大革命初期的一场社会运动。
description.en: The Destroy the Four Olds movement was a social movement in the early stages of the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 林彪在讲话中鼓动“破四旧、立四新”。
description.en: In his speeches, Lin Biao incited the 'destruction of the Four Olds and establishment of the Four News'.

description.zh-cn: 该《人民日报》社论提出了“彻底破除……旧思想、旧文化、旧风俗、旧习惯”的口号，引发了破四旧运动。
description.en: This People's Daily editorial proposed the slogan of 'thoroughly destroying... old ideas, old culture, old customs, and old habits,' triggering the Destroy the Four Olds movement.

description.zh-cn: 《人民日报》于1966年6月1日发表了社论《横扫一切牛鬼蛇神》。
description.en: The People's Daily published the editorial 'Sweep Away All Ghosts and Monsters' on June 1, 1966.

description.zh-cn: 该文件（《十六条》）明确规定“破四旧”、“立四新”是文革的重要目标。
description.en: This document (the Sixteen Points) explicitly stipulated that 'Destroying the Four Olds' and 'Establishing the Four News' were important goals of the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 在北京的“红八月”期间，“破四旧”运动逐渐升级。
description.en: During the 'Red August' in Beijing, the 'Destroy the Four Olds' movement gradually escalated.

position.zh-cn: 北京红卫兵“五大领袖”之一
position.en: One of the 'Five Great Leaders' of the Beijing Red Guards

description.zh-cn: 谭厚兰是北京红卫兵的五大领袖之一。
