description.en: Tan Houlan was one of the five great leaders of the Beijing Red Guards.

description.zh-cn: 在“破四旧”运动中，孔子的思想被视为封建主义的代表而受到批判，其相关文物古迹也遭到破坏。
description.en: During the 'Destroy the Four Olds' movement, Confucius's ideas were criticized as representative of feudalism, and related cultural relics and historical sites were destroyed.

description.zh-cn: 1966年8月，周作人被红卫兵鞭打批斗，家也被多次查封和洗劫。
description.en: In August 1966, Zhou Zuoren was beaten and denounced by Red Guards, and his house was raided and sealed multiple times.

description.zh-cn: 林彪在1966年8月31日的讲话中提出“要用文斗，不用武斗”，意图抑制运动中的暴力行为。
description.en: In his speech on August 31, 1966, Lin Biao proposed to 'use struggle by reasoning, not by coercion or force,' in an attempt to curb the violence in the movement.

description.zh-cn: 该文件要求各地保护文物，是官方制止“破四旧”中破坏文物行为的措施之一。
description.en: This document required all localities to protect cultural relics, and was one of the official measures to stop the destruction of cultural heritage during the 'Destroy the Four Olds' movement.

description.zh-cn: 该文件由中共中央下发。
description.en: This document was issued by the Central Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 上山下乡运动的开始，使得红卫兵运动逐渐停止。
description.en: The beginning of the Down to the Countryside Movement led to the gradual cessation of the Red Guard movement.

description.zh-cn: 中华文化复兴运动是中华民国方面为了反制在中国大陆发生的“破四旧”而发起的。
description.en: The Chinese Cultural Renaissance movement was initiated by the Republic of China to counter the 'Destroy the Four Olds' movement happening in mainland China.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国在台湾地区发起了中华文化复兴运动。
description.en: The Republic of China launched the Chinese Cultural Renaissance movement in the Taiwan area.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛与刘永清是清华大学水利系1959年级同班同学。
description.en: Hu Jintao and Liu Yongqing were classmates in the Class of 1959 in the Department of Hydraulic Engineering at Tsinghua University.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，刘永清被下放到宁夏青铜峡的五七干校。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Liu Yongqing was sent down to the May Seventh Cadre School in Qingtongxia, Ningxia.

description.zh-cn: 常芝青被描述为邓小平的地下红人，受其信任。
description.en: Chang Zhiqing was described as an underground contact of Deng Xiaoping, trusted by him.

description.zh-cn: 在刘永清担任北京市城乡规划委员会副主任的时期，贾庆林是时任中共北京市委书记，为刘永清的上级领导。
description.en: During Liu Yongqing's tenure as Deputy Director of the Beijing Municipal Commission of Urban Planning, Jia Qinglin was the then-serving Party Secretary of the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee, making him Liu's superior.

description.zh-cn: 江充因与太子刘据有隙，担心其继位后对自己不利，便诬陷太子以巫蛊诅咒汉武帝，直接引发了巫蛊之祸。
description.en: Due to a feud with Crown Prince Liu Ju and fearing for his future, Jiang Chong falsely accused the prince of using witchcraft to curse Emperor Wu, directly triggering the Witchcraft Delusion.

description.zh-cn: 苏文与江充合谋，阻止太子面见汉武帝自辩，并在江充被杀后向武帝谎报太子谋反。
description.en: Su Wen conspired with Jiang Chong, prevented the Crown Prince from seeing Emperor Wu to defend himself, and after Jiang Chong's death, falsely reported to the emperor that the prince was rebelling.

description.zh-cn: 朱安世被公孙贺抓捕后，在狱中上书报复，诬告公孙贺父子以巫蛊诅咒汉武帝，导致公孙家族被灭，拉开了巫蛊之祸的序幕。
description.en: After being arrested by Gongsun He, Zhu Anshi retaliated from prison by falsely accusing Gongsun He and his son of using witchcraft to curse Emperor Wu, leading to the extermination of the Gongsun family and marking the prelude to the Witchcraft Delusion.

description.zh-cn: 在被江充逼得走投无路后，太子刘据以监国身份起兵，以谋反罪名将江充斩首。
description.en: Forced into a corner by Jiang Chong, Crown Prince Liu Ju raised troops in his capacity as regent and had Jiang Chong beheaded on charges of treason.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝误信太子谋反的谎言，派遣丞相刘屈牦发兵镇压，最终导致太子兵败自杀。
description.en: Emperor Wu mistakenly believed the lie that the Crown Prince was rebelling and dispatched Chancellor Liu Qumao with troops to suppress him, ultimately leading to the prince's defeat and suicide.

description.zh-cn: 在巫蛊之祸水落石出后，汉武帝深感后悔，下令将进谗言的宦官苏文在横桥上烧死。
description.en: After the truth of the Witchcraft Delusion came to light, Emperor Wu was filled with regret and ordered the eunuch Su Wen, who had slandered the prince, to be burned to death on the Heng Bridge.

description.zh-cn: 太子刘据派人持节杖命令任安出兵协助，但任安选择闭门不出，拒绝了太子的命令。
description.en: Crown Prince Liu Ju sent an envoy with his credentials to order Ren An to dispatch troops for assistance, but Ren An refused by closing the gates and ignoring the command.

description.zh-cn: 在太子刘据兵败逃亡时，时任司直的田仁故意放其从自己驻守的城门逃走。
description.en: When Crown Prince Liu Ju was fleeing after his defeat, Tian Ren, the Director of Justice at the time, intentionally allowed him to escape through the city gate he was guarding.

description.zh-cn: 巫蛊之祸导致汉武帝失去了培养多年的继承人刘据，使得年幼的刘弗陵最终得以被立为太子并继承皇位。
description.en: The Witchcraft Delusion caused Emperor Wu to lose his long-cultivated heir, Liu Ju, which ultimately allowed the young Liu Fuling to be appointed Crown Prince and inherit the throne.

description.zh-cn: 巫蛊之祸带来的巨大灾难和丧子之痛，促使汉武帝反思其执政生涯，最终颁布轮台诏，转变国策为休养生息。
description.en: The great disaster and the pain of losing his son from the Witchcraft Delusion prompted Emperor Wu to reflect on his reign, ultimately leading to the issuance of the Edict of Luntai, which shifted national policy towards recuperation.

description.zh-cn: 在巫蛊之祸中，时任狱吏的邴吉暗中保护并抚养了尚在襁褓中的皇曾孙刘病已，使其得以幸存。
description.en: During the Witchcraft Delusion, Bing Ji, then a prison official, secretly protected and raised the infant imperial great-grandson Liu Bingyi, ensuring his survival.

description.zh-cn: 在汉昭帝无子驾崩、刘贺被废后，霍光在邴吉的建议下，拥立刘据唯一幸存的孙子刘病已为帝。
description.en: After Emperor Zhao died without an heir and Liu He was deposed, Huo Guang, on the advice of Bing Ji, enthroned Liu Bingyi, the only surviving grandson of Liu Ju.

description.zh-cn: 刘据是汉武帝的长子。
description.en: Liu Ju was the eldest son of Emperor Wu of Han.

description.zh-cn: 刘据是皇后卫子夫所生之子。
description.en: Liu Ju was the son of Empress Wei Zifu.

description.zh-cn: 卫子夫是汉武帝的皇后。
description.en: Wei Zifu was the empress of Emperor Wu of Han.

description.zh-cn: 刘进是皇太子刘据的长子。
description.en: Liu Jin was the eldest son of Crown Prince Liu Ju.

description.zh-cn: 刘病已是王翁须之子。
description.en: Liu Bingyi was the son of Wang Wengxu.

description.zh-cn: 王翁须是刘进之妻。
description.en: Wang Wengxu was the wife of Liu Jin.

description.zh-cn: 史良娣是皇太子妃，刘进是她的儿子。
description.en: Lady Shi was the Crown Princess, and Liu Jin was her son.

description.zh-cn: 史良娣是太子刘据的妾室。
description.en: Lady Shi was a consort of Crown Prince Liu Ju.

description.zh-cn: 公孙敬声是公孙贺之子。
description.en: Gongsun Jingsheng was the son of Gongsun He.

description.zh-cn: 卫青是皇后卫子夫的弟弟。
description.en: Wei Qing was the younger brother of Empress Wei Zifu.

description.zh-cn: 卫伉是卫青的长子。
description.en: Wei Kang was the eldest son of Wei Qing.

description.zh-cn: 刘弗陵是汉武帝的幼子。
description.en: Liu Fuling was the youngest son of Emperor Wu of Han.

description.zh-cn: 刘弗陵是钩弋夫人所生。
description.en: Liu Fuling was the son of Lady Gouyi.

description.zh-cn: 李克强担任两届中华人民共和国国务院总理。
description.en: Li Keqiang served two terms as the Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 李克强自中共十七届一中全会起，连续担任三届中央政治局常委，其中涵盖中共十九届中央政治局常委任期。
description.en: Li Keqiang served as a member of the Politburo Standing Committee for three consecutive terms, starting from the 1st Plenary Session of the 17th CCP Central Committee, which included his tenure on the 19th CCP Central Committee Politburo Standing Committee.

description.zh-cn: 在温家宝总理任期内，李克强担任排名第一的国务院副总理。
description.en: During Premier Wen Jiabao's term, Li Keqiang served as the first-ranking Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 外界普遍认为李克强与习近平在经济政策和治理理念上存在分歧，流传有“习李不和”的说法。李克强倡导的“地摊经济”等务实政策与习近平的政治议程时有冲突，导致其被边缘化。
description.en: It is widely believed that Li Keqiang and Xi Jinping had disagreements on economic policies and governance philosophies, leading to rumors of discord. Li's pragmatic policies, such as the 'stall economy,' often conflicted with Xi's political agenda, resulting in his marginalization.

description.zh-cn: 李强接替李克强成为中华人民共和国国务院总理。
description.en: Li Qiang succeeded Li Keqiang as the Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 李克强在北京大学法律系学习期间，师从龚祥瑞教授。
description.en: During his studies at the Peking University Law Department, Li Keqiang was a student of Professor Gong Xiangrui.

description.zh-cn: 李克强在北京大学攻读经济学博士学位期间，师从厉以宁教授。
description.en: While pursuing his doctoral degree in economics at Peking University, Li Keqiang was supervised by Professor Li Yining.

description.zh-cn: 在李克强提倡“地摊经济”后不久，《北京日报》等官方媒体发表评论称其“不卫生、不文明”，导致该政策的热度迅速降温。
description.en: Shortly after Li Keqiang promoted the 'stall economy,' official media outlets like Beijing Daily published commentaries calling it 'unhygienic and uncivilized,' which quickly cooled enthusiasm for the policy.

description.zh-cn: 李克强在深圳向邓小平铜像献花，并重申改革开放的决心，此举被解读为他试图传承邓小平的政治遗产，以表达其政治立场。
description.en: Li Keqiang's gesture of presenting a flower basket to Deng Xiaoping's statue in Shenzhen and reaffirming his commitment to 'Reform and Opening Up' was interpreted as an attempt to carry on Deng's political legacy and express his own political stance.

description.zh-cn: 李克强在主政河南期间，面临处理“血祸”遗留问题的挑战。他一方面因被指控早期掩盖事件而受批评，另一方面也组织了首次省级艾滋病情普查并建立了对患者的救助机制。
description.en: During his tenure in Henan, Li Keqiang faced the challenge of dealing with the aftermath of the 'AIDS scandal.' He was criticized for an alleged early cover-up but also organized the first provincial AIDS survey and established a support mechanism for patients.

description.zh-cn: 在2019冠状病毒病疫情爆发后，李克强担任中央应对疫情工作领导小组组长。
description.en: After the outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemic, Li Keqiang served as the head of the Central Leading Group for Novel Coronavirus Prevention and Control.

description.zh-cn: 周鸿祎与齐向东于2005年9月共同创立了三六零安全科技股份有限公司（原奇虎360）。
description.en: Zhou Hongyi co-founded Qihoo 360 with Qi Xiangdong in September 2005.

description.zh-cn: 齐向东与周鸿祎于2005年9月共同创立了三六零安全科技股份有限公司（原奇虎360）。
description.en: Qi Xiangdong co-founded Qihoo 360 with Zhou Hongyi in September 2005.

description.zh-cn: 周鸿祎是三六零安全科技股份有限公司的董事长和实际控制人。
description.en: Zhou Hongyi is the Chairman and actual controller of Qihoo 360.

description.zh-cn: 齐向东曾担任三六零安全科技股份有限公司的总裁。
description.en: Qi Xiangdong formerly served as the President of Qihoo 360.

description.zh-cn: 周鸿祎在创立奇虎360之前曾就职于方正集团。
description.en: Zhou Hongyi worked at Founder Group before founding Qihoo 360.

description.zh-cn: 美国商务部将奇虎360列入《出口管制条例》下的实体清单，对其进行制裁。
description.en: The U.S. Department of Commerce placed Qihoo 360 on the Entity List under the Export Administration Regulations, imposing sanctions on the company.

description.zh-cn: 自2010年起，百度与奇虎360之间发生了多起法律诉讼，涉及不正当竞争、侵犯商标权以及违反Robots协议等问题，双方互有胜负。
description.en: Starting from 2010, Baidu and Qihoo 360 were involved in multiple lawsuits concerning unfair competition, trademark infringement, and violation of the Robots Exclusion Standard, with rulings in favor of both sides at different times.

description.zh-cn: 2010年5月，因周鸿祎在微博等平台发表攻击金山公司的言论，金山公司起诉其名誉侵权并胜诉。
description.en: In May 2010, Kingsoft sued Zhou Hongyi for defamation over his attacks on the company on platforms like Weibo and won the case.

description.zh-cn: 2010年，双方因“360隐私保护器”和“扣扣保镖”软件爆发了著名的“3Q大战”，随后多年间就商业诋毁、不正当竞争及垄断等问题多次对簿公堂。
description.en: In 2010, the two companies engaged in the famous '3Q War' over the '360 Privacy Protector' and 'KouKou Bodyguard' software, leading to years of litigation over issues like commercial defamation, unfair competition, and monopoly.

description.zh-cn: 2010年2月，瑞星发文称360安全卫士存在后门，奇虎360随后以捏造事实、不正当竞争为由起诉瑞星并胜诉。
description.en: In February 2010, Rising published an article claiming 360 Safeguard had a backdoor. Qihoo 360 subsequently sued Rising for fabricating facts and unfair competition, and won the case.

description.zh-cn: 在2011年至2012年间，金山与奇虎360就强行卸载对方软件、商业诋毁等行为多次互相起诉，双方互有胜负。
description.en: Between 2011 and 2012, Kingsoft and Qihoo 360 sued each other multiple times for actions such as forcibly uninstalling each other's software and commercial defamation, with mixed legal outcomes.

description.zh-cn: 2011年9月，因傅盛在社交平台发布抨击性言论，奇虎360起诉其诋毁商业信誉并在一审中胜诉。
description.en: In September 2011, Qihoo 360 sued Fu Sheng for defamation of business reputation due to his critical comments on social media platforms and won the first-instance trial.

description.zh-cn: 在2014年至2015年间，搜狗与奇虎360因强制提示用户卸载对方软件、商业诋毁等不正当竞争行为相互起诉，双方互有胜负。
description.en: Between 2014 and 2015, Sogou and Qihoo 360 sued each other for unfair competition practices, such as forcibly prompting users to uninstall the other's software and commercial defamation, with mixed legal outcomes.

description.zh-cn: 1167年，丘处机拜全真道创始人王重阳为师。
description.en: In 1167, Qiu Chuji became a disciple of Wang Chongyang, the founder of the Quanzhen School.

description.zh-cn: 1203年，丘处机接替刘处玄成为全真道第五任掌教，直至1227年去世。
description.en: In 1203, Qiu Chuji succeeded Liu Chuxuan to become the fifth leader of the Quanzhen School, a position he held until his death in 1227.

description.zh-cn: 尹志平是丘处机的弟子，并随其西行会见成吉思汗。
description.en: Yin Zhiping was a disciple of Qiu Chuji and accompanied him on his journey west to meet Genghis Khan.

description.zh-cn: 李志常是丘处机的弟子，并随其西行会见成吉思汗。
description.en: Li Zhichang was a disciple of Qiu Chuji and accompanied him on his journey west to meet Genghis Khan.

description.zh-cn: 丘处机被奉为全真教龙门派的祖师。
description.en: Qiu Chuji is revered as the founder of the Dragon Gate sect of the Quanzhen School.

description.zh-cn: 丘处机是王重阳的七位主要弟子之一，合称“北七真”。
description.en: Qiu Chuji was one of Wang Chongyang's seven main disciples, collectively known as the 'Seven True Disciples of the North'.

description.zh-cn: 1222年，丘处机向成吉思汗阐述“敬天爱民”、减少屠杀、清心寡欲等治国养生之道，对其产生影响。
description.en: In 1222, Qiu Chuji expounded on the principles of 'revering Heaven and loving the people,' reducing slaughter, and practicing asceticism to Genghis Khan, influencing his approach to governance and personal cultivation.

description.zh-cn: 成吉思汗对丘处机极为敬重，下诏豁免全真道的赋役，并于1227年赐金虎牌，命其掌管天下道教事务。
description.en: Genghis Khan held Qiu Chuji in high esteem, issuing an edict to exempt the Quanzhen School from taxes and corvée labor, and in 1227, granted him a golden tiger tablet, appointing him to oversee all Taoist affairs in the empire.

description.zh-cn: 1188年春，丘处机应金世宗诏书邀请，前往燕京会面并主持万春节醮事。
description.en: In the spring of 1188, at the invitation of Emperor Shizong of Jin, Qiu Chuji traveled to Yanjing for an audience and to preside over the Wanchun Festival ceremonies.

description.zh-cn: 1207年，金章宗赐匾额及《玄都宝藏》予丘处机所在的栖霞太虚观，以示支持。
description.en: In 1207, Emperor Zhangzong of Jin showed his support by bestowing a plaque and the 'Xuan Du Bao Zang' scriptures upon the Taixu Temple in Qixia, where Qiu Chuji resided.

description.zh-cn: 1211年，丘处机奉金卫绍王诏书前往中都。
description.en: In 1211, Qiu Chuji traveled to the capital, Zhongdu, upon receiving an edict from the Prince of Wei Shao of Jin.

description.zh-cn: 1214年，因丘处机协助招抚山东起义民众，金宣宗朝廷赐其封号“自然应化弘教大师”。
description.en: In 1214, because Qiu Chuji assisted in pacifying rebels in Shandong, the court of Emperor Xuanzong of Jin bestowed upon him the title 'Master of Natural Response, Transformation, and Propagation of the Teachings'.

description.zh-cn: 1219年12月，作为成吉思汗的使者，刘仲禄到达山东莱州邀请丘处机，并随后陪同其西行。
description.en: In December 1219, as an envoy of Genghis Khan, Liu Zhonglu arrived in Laizhou, Shandong to invite Qiu Chuji, and subsequently accompanied him on his journey west.

description.zh-cn: 在西行途中，丘处机劝阻了刘仲禄为成吉思汗挑选处女的行为。
description.en: During the journey west, Qiu Chuji dissuaded Liu Zhonglu from the act of selecting virgins for Genghis Khan.

description.zh-cn: 李志常根据跟随丘处机西行的见闻，撰写了《长春真人西游记》一书。
description.en: Based on his experiences accompanying Qiu Chuji on his journey west, Li Zhichang wrote the book 'The Travels of the Perfect Man Changchun to the West'.

description.zh-cn: 1269年，元世祖忽必烈下诏追赠丘处机为“长春演道主教真人”的封号。
description.en: In 1269, Emperor Shizu of Yuan, Kublai Khan, issued an edict posthumously granting Qiu Chuji the title 'Perfect Man Changchun, Who Expounds the Tao and Leads the Religion'.

description.zh-cn: 元武宗加封丘处机为“长春全德神化明应真君”。
description.en: Emperor Wuzong of Yuan granted Qiu Chuji the additional title 'Perfect Lord Changchun of Complete Virtue, Divine Transformation, and Luminous Response'.

description.zh-cn: 1214年，金朝将领仆散安贞请求丘处机协助招抚山东地区的起义农民。
description.en: In 1214, the Jin dynasty general Pusan Anzhen requested Qiu Chuji's help in pacifying the peasant rebels in the Shandong region.

description.zh-cn: 1227年，成吉思汗下圣旨，将天长观改名为长春宫（今白云观），并赐予丘处机。
description.en: In 1227, Genghis Khan issued an edict renaming the Tianchang Temple to Changchun Palace (present-day White Cloud Temple) and bestowing it upon Qiu Chuji.

description.zh-cn: 钟伟民批评《雪狼湖》的宣传品上没有提及他的名字，认为制作方不尊重原作者。
description.en: Chung Wai Man criticized 'Snow.Wolf.Lake' for not mentioning his name in promotional materials, believing the producers disrespected the original author.

description.zh-cn: 陈淑芬担任《雪狼湖》的出品人。
description.en: Florence Chan served as the producer for 'Snow.Wolf.Lake'.

description.zh-cn: 《不老的传说》专辑在音乐剧公演前推出，收录了剧中主要歌曲，起到了宣传作用。
description.en: The album 'The Undying Legend' was released before the musical's premiere, featuring its main songs and serving a promotional role.

description.zh-cn: 宝丽金唱片公司发行了专辑《不老的传说》。
description.en: PolyGram released the album 'The Undying Legend'.

description.zh-cn: 花旗银行是《雪狼湖》音乐剧的主要赞助商。
description.en: Citibank was the main sponsor of the musical 'Snow.Wolf.Lake'.

description.zh-cn: 1996年《爱与交响曲》音乐会的成功，促使张学友开始转向更具艺术性质的表演，从而催生了音乐剧《雪狼湖》的创作想法。
description.en: The success of the 'Love & Symphony' concert in 1996 prompted Jacky Cheung to shift towards more artistic performances, leading to the creative idea for the musical 'Snow.Wolf.Lake'.

description.zh-cn: 张学友与香港管弦乐团合作演出了《爱与交响曲》音乐会。
description.en: Jacky Cheung performed in the 'Love & Symphony' concert in collaboration with the Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra.

description.zh-cn: 香港管弦乐团与张学友合作演出了《爱与交响曲》音乐会。
description.en: The Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra collaborated with Jacky Cheung for the 'Love & Symphony' concert.

description.zh-cn: 文本中提及张国荣是张学友的好友。
description.en: The text mentions that Leslie Cheung was a good friend of Jacky Cheung.

description.zh-cn: 张国荣曾在2001年向张学友提出共同制作一部音乐剧，但该计划因张国荣逝世而中止。
description.en: In 2001, Leslie Cheung proposed to Jacky Cheung that they co-create a musical, but the project was terminated due to Leslie Cheung's death.

description.zh-cn: 王义全是王思聪的祖父。
description.en: Wang Yiquan is Wang Sicong's paternal grandfather.

description.zh-cn: 王思聪出生于辽宁省大连市西岗区。
description.en: Wang Sicong was born in Xigang District, Dalian City, Liaoning Province.

description.zh-cn: 就读于哲学系。
description.en: Studied in the Department of Philosophy.

description.zh-cn: 王思聪曾担任万达集团董事，但不负责任何事务，后于2022年8月30日卸任。
description.en: Wang Sicong served as a director of the Wanda Group, but was not responsible for any specific affairs, and he stepped down on August 30, 2022.

description.zh-cn: 提供约5亿元人民币作为启动资金，鼓励王思聪成立北京普思投资有限公司进行创业实践。
description.en: Provided about 500 million RMB as start-up capital to encourage Wang Sicong to establish Beijing Pusi Investment Co., Ltd. for entrepreneurial practice.

description.zh-cn: 王健林拿出5亿元人民币让王思聪成立北京普思投资有限公司。
description.en: Wang Jianlin provided 500 million RMB for Wang Sicong to establish Beijing Pusi Investment Co., Ltd.

description.zh-cn: 通过收购CCM电竞俱乐部，成立了iG电竞俱乐部。
description.en: Founded iG e-Sports Club by acquiring CCM e-Sports Club.

description.zh-cn: 香蕉计划签约韩国女团T-ara。
description.en: Banana Plan signed the South Korean girl group T-ara.

description.zh-cn: 与林更新合资成立“上海水晶荔枝娱乐文化有限公司”。
description.en: Co-founded 'Shanghai Crystal Lychee Entertainment Culture Co., Ltd.' with Lin Gengxin.

description.zh-cn: 因大S与汪小菲的婚礼赞助问题，王思聪公开斥责张兰炒作，引发争论。
description.en: Due to sponsorship issues of the wedding of Da S and Wang Xiaofei, Wang Sicong publicly accused Zhang Lan of creating hype, sparking a dispute.

description.zh-cn: 王思聪在微博上评论朱圣祎的负面信息，引发网络骂战，并被朱圣祎以名誉侵权起诉。
description.en: Wang Sicong commented on negative information about Zhu Shengyi on Weibo, leading to an online spat and a lawsuit for defamation filed by Zhu Shengyi.

description.zh-cn: 王思聪在微博转发视频，要求证监会严查以岭药业，导致该公司股价次日跌停。
description.en: Wang Sicong reposted a video on Weibo, demanding the China Securities Regulatory Commission to strictly investigate Yiling Pharmaceutical, causing the company's stock to hit the limit down the next day.

description.zh-cn: 因发表关于连花清瘟和核酸检测的争议性言论，王思聪的新浪微博账号被注销。
description.en: Wang Sicong's Sina Weibo account was deleted due to his controversial remarks about Lianhua Qingwen and nucleic acid testing.

description.zh-cn: 就王思聪与孙一宁的纠纷发表评论文章，批评王思聪的行为逾越了正常界限。
description.en: Published a commentary on the dispute between Wang Sicong and Sun Yining, criticizing Wang's actions for crossing normal boundaries.

description.zh-cn: 黄一鸣在社交平台称自己与王思聪有一私生女。
description.en: Huang Yiming claimed on social media that she has an illegitimate daughter with Wang Sicong.

description.zh-cn: 因财务官司败诉，王思聪被北京市第二中级人民法院限制消费并查封其名下的房产、车辆、银行存款等财产。
description.en: Due to losing a financial lawsuit, Wang Sicong was subjected to consumption restrictions and had his properties, vehicles, and bank deposits seized by the Beijing No. 2 Intermediate People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 于民国36年（1947年）6月5日公布了东北九省行政区划划分方案。
description.en: Announced the administrative division plan of the Nine Northeastern Provinces on June 5, 1947.

description.zh-cn: 由于国共内战，东北九省的行政区划方案从未完全施行。
description.en: Due to the Chinese Civil War, the administrative division plan of the Nine Northeastern Provinces was never fully implemented.

description.zh-cn: 在日本的扶植之下建立满洲国。
description.en: Manchukuo was established under the support of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 中国抗日战争胜利后，满洲国随之瓦解。
description.en: After the victory of the Second Sino-Japanese War, Manchukuo collapsed.

description.zh-cn: 抗战胜利后，苏联支援大批的中国共产党行政人员与中国人民解放军进入东北进行接收。
description.en: After the victory of the war, the Soviet Union supported a large number of CCP administrators and PLA forces to enter Northeast China for takeover.

description.zh-cn: 苏联红军在东北的驻军及对中共的支持，阻碍了国民政府对东北的接收。
description.en: The presence of the Soviet Red Army in Northeast China and its support for the CCP hindered the Nationalist Government's takeover of the region.

description.zh-cn: 梁肃戎曾任立法院院长，其选举区域为辽北省。
description.en: Liang Su-yung served as the President of the Legislative Yuan, with his constituency being Liaobei Province.

description.zh-cn: 费希平为辽宁省选出的立法委员。
description.en: Fei Hsi-ping was a legislator elected from Liaoning Province.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政府作为官方机构，在全国范围内推行新生活运动。
description.en: The Government of the Republic of China, as the official body, promoted the New Life Movement nationwide.

description.zh-cn: 作为执政党，中国国民党通过其领袖蒋中正发起并主导新生活运动，并以其核心思想《三民主义》为运动提供理论权威。
description.en: As the ruling party, the Kuomintang initiated and led the New Life Movement through its leader Chiang Kai-shek, and provided theoretical authority for the movement with its core ideology, the Three Principles of the People.

description.zh-cn: 新生活运动在思想层面上融合了基督教的价值观元素，与儒家思想共同构成其思想基础。
description.en: The New Life Movement ideologically incorporated elements of Christian values, which, along with Confucianism, formed its intellectual foundation.

description.zh-cn: 被中国国民党奉为圭臬的《三民主义》是新生活运动的合法性来源与理论权威。
description.en: The Three Principles of the People, revered by the Kuomintang, served as the source of legitimacy and theoretical authority for the New Life Movement.

description.zh-cn: 蒋中正强调新生活运动与孙中山的思想一脉相承，特别是孙中山关于恢复民族固有道德的主张。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek emphasized that the New Life Movement was in line with Sun Yat-sen's thought, especially his advocacy for restoring the nation's inherent morality.

description.zh-cn: 由于国民政府在第二次国共内战中失利，无力兼顾，新生活运动于1949年被暂停办理。
description.en: Due to the Nationalist government's defeat in the Second Chinese Civil War, it could no longer sustain the effort, and the New Life Movement was suspended in 1949.

description.zh-cn: 1949年，蒋中正亲自下令“暂停办理”新生活运动的一切活动。
description.en: In 1949, Chiang Kai-shek personally ordered to 'suspend' all activities of the New Life Movement.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争爆发后，新生活运动的工作重点转为服务抗战，其组织网络和动员能力为战时服务提供了便利，对抗战起到了积极作用。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Second Sino-Japanese War, the focus of the New Life Movement shifted to serving the war effort. Its organizational network and mobilization capabilities facilitated wartime services, playing a positive role in the resistance.

description.zh-cn: 中华文化复兴运动被认为是新生活运动的延续。
description.en: The Chinese Cultural Renaissance is considered a continuation of the New Life Movement.

description.zh-cn: 宋美龄是蒋中正的夫人，两人共同出席了新生活运动市民大会。
description.en: Soong Mei-ling was the wife of Chiang Kai-shek; they attended the New Life Movement citizens' rally together.

description.zh-cn: 时任日本首相阿部信行在战前曾表示新生活运动是中国不可轻视的大事，这影响了他对当时中国实力的判断。
description.en: Then Prime Minister of Japan, Nobuyuki Abe, stated before the war that the New Life Movement was a major affair in China that should not be underestimated, which influenced his judgment of China's strength at the time.

description.zh-cn: 新生活运动提倡军事化生活的目标之一是为了准备对付来自日本的军事威胁。
description.en: One of the goals of the New Life Movement's promotion of a militarized lifestyle was to prepare to counter the military threat from Japan.

description.zh-cn: 新生活运动提倡军事化生活的目标之一是“安内”，即与中国共产党进行抗衡。
description.en: One of the goals of the New Life Movement's promotion of a militarized lifestyle was 'internal pacification,' which meant confronting the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 天安门是1949年10月1日中华人民共和国开国大典的举办地。
description.en: Tiananmen was the venue for the founding ceremony of the People's Republic of China on October 1, 1949.

description.zh-cn: 1961年，中华人民共和国国务院将天安门列入第一批全国重点文物保护单位。
description.en: In 1961, the State Council of the People's Republic of China listed Tiananmen as one of the first Major Historical and Cultural Sites Protected at the National Level.

description.zh-cn: 1928年，国民革命军北伐统一后，天安门首次挂上孙中山的肖像。
description.en: In 1928, after the unification of the Northern Expedition by the National Revolutionary Army, a portrait of Sun Yat-sen was hung on Tiananmen for the first time.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争胜利后至1949年，天安门城楼上悬挂着时任国民政府主席蒋中正的肖像。
description.en: From the end of the Second Sino-Japanese War until 1949, a portrait of then Chairman of the Nationalist Government, Chiang Kai-shek, was hung on the Tiananmen gate.

description.zh-cn: 自1949年中华人民共和国成立以来，毛泽东的巨幅肖像一直悬挂于天安门城楼。
description.en: Since the founding of the People's Republic of China in 1949, a large portrait of Mao Zedong has been hung on the Tiananmen gate.

description.zh-cn: 1953年3月9日，为追悼苏联领导人史达林，天安门城楼上的毛泽东肖像被更换为史达林肖像一天。
description.en: On March 9, 1953, to mourn the Soviet leader Joseph Stalin, the portrait of Mao Zedong on the Tiananmen gate was replaced with a portrait of Stalin for one day.

description.zh-cn: 1989年5月23日，喻东岳与另外两人向悬挂在天安门的毛泽东肖像泼洒颜料。
description.en: On May 23, 1989, Yu Dongyue and two others threw paint at the portrait of Mao Zedong hanging on Tiananmen.

description.zh-cn: 1989年5月23日，鲁德成与另外两人向悬挂在天安门的毛泽东肖像泼洒颜料。
description.en: On May 23, 1989, Lu Decheng and two others threw paint at the portrait of Mao Zedong hanging on Tiananmen.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东在天安门城楼上宣布中华人民共和国中央人民政府成立。
description.en: Mao Zedong announced the establishment of the Central People's Government of the People's Republic of China from the Tiananmen gate.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，天安门成为毛泽东接见红卫兵和举行大型群众集会的场所，进一步强化了其政治符号意义。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Tiananmen became a venue for Mao Zedong to receive Red Guards and hold large-scale mass rallies, further strengthening its political symbolism.

description.zh-cn: 1919年的“五四运动”在天安门广场爆发，使其成为中国现代史上学生爱国运动的标志性地点。
description.en: The 'May Fourth Movement' of 1919 broke out in Tiananmen Square, making it a landmark location for student patriotic movements in modern Chinese history.

description.zh-cn: 1976年的“四五运动”在天安门广场发生，是悼念周恩来、反对“四人帮”的群众性运动。
description.en: The '1976 Tiananmen Incident' took place in Tiananmen Square as a mass movement to mourn Zhou Enlai and oppose the 'Gang of Four'.

description.zh-cn: 1989年的“六四天安门事件”主要发生在天安门广场及其周边地区。
description.en: The '1989 Tiananmen Square protests' mainly occurred in and around Tiananmen Square.

description.zh-cn: 文敏生早年参加中国工农红军。
description.en: Wen Minsheng joined the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army in his early years.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间被批斗迫害。
description.en: Was struggled against and persecuted during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 担任中华人民共和国邮电部部长期间，对中国邮政进行改革。
description.en: During his tenure as Minister of Posts and Telecommunications of the People's Republic of China, he carried out reforms on China Post.

description.zh-cn: 文敏生在中国共产党河南省委员会代理书记一职上接替刘建勋，后又由刘建勋接任河南省最高行政长官。
description.en: Wen Minsheng succeeded Liu Jianxun as the acting Secretary of the Henan Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China, and was later succeeded by Liu Jianxun as the top administrator of Henan.

description.zh-cn: 文敏生接替吴芝圃担任河南省人民委员会省长。
description.en: Wen Minsheng succeeded Wu Zhipu as the Governor of the Henan Provincial People's Committee.

description.zh-cn: 文敏生接替李剑白担任中国共产党哈尔滨市委员会第一书记及哈尔滨市革命委员会主任。
description.en: Wen Minsheng succeeded Li Jianbai as the First Secretary of the Harbin Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China and Director of the Harbin Municipal Revolutionary Committee.

description.zh-cn: 李力安接替文敏生担任中国共产党哈尔滨市委员会第一书记。
description.en: Li Li'an succeeded Wen Minsheng as the First Secretary of the Harbin Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 王化成接替文敏生担任哈尔滨市革命委员会主任。
description.en: Wang Huacheng succeeded Wen Minsheng as the Director of the Harbin Municipal Revolutionary Committee.

description.zh-cn: 文敏生接替王子纲担任中华人民共和国邮电部部长。
description.en: Wen Minsheng succeeded Wang Zigang as the Minister of Posts and Telecommunications of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 杨泰芳接替文敏生担任中华人民共和国邮电部部长。
description.en: Yang Taifang succeeded Wen Minsheng as the Minister of Posts and Telecommunications of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 汉室后人刘秀通过武力统一天下，光复汉朝，定都洛阳，史称东汉。
description.en: Liu Xiu, a descendant of the Han imperial family, reunified the realm by force, restored the Han dynasty, and established the capital at Luoyang, known historically as the Eastern Han.

description.zh-cn: 刘秀在绿林军的协助下推翻了王莽的新朝。
description.en: With the assistance of the Lülin Army, Liu Xiu overthrew Wang Mang's Xin dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 刘秀通过进行多项政治改革让汉朝再次进入平稳发展的局面，史称“光武中兴”。
description.en: Through various political reforms, Liu Xiu brought the Han dynasty back to a state of stable development, a period known as the 'Guangwu Restoration'.

description.zh-cn: 汉章帝开启了东汉大力任用外戚的先河，导致外戚势力开始坐大。
description.en: Emperor Zhang initiated the precedent of heavily employing consort clans in the Eastern Han, which led to the rise of their power.

description.zh-cn: 汉和帝联合宦官力量消灭了以窦宪为首的窦氏外戚势力。
description.en: Emperor He allied with eunuch forces to eliminate the Dou consort clan, led by Dou Xian.

description.zh-cn: 汉和帝为制衡外戚势力而重用宦官，使得宦官成为朝廷中一只强大的政治力量。
description.en: Emperor He heavily used eunuchs to counterbalance the power of the consort clans, which allowed the eunuchs to become a powerful political force in the court.

description.zh-cn: 何进被杀后，袁绍率军攻入皇宫，对宦官进行屠杀，十常侍也被杀死。
description.en: After He Jin was killed, Yuan Shao led troops to storm the imperial palace and massacre the eunuchs, including the Ten Attendants.

description.zh-cn: 董卓废黜少帝后，杀害了其母何太后。
description.en: After deposing Emperor Shao, Dong Zhuo killed his mother, Empress Dowager He.

description.zh-cn: 地方官员不满董卓的专权，推举袁绍为盟主，组成关东联军讨伐董卓。
description.en: Dissatisfied with Dong Zhuo's tyranny, regional officials elected Yuan Shao as their leader and formed the Guandong Coalition to campaign against Dong Zhuo.

description.zh-cn: 大臣王允唆使董卓的部将吕布，合作谋杀了董卓。
description.en: The minister Wang Yun instigated Dong Zhuo's general Lü Bu to cooperate in assassinating Dong Zhuo.

description.zh-cn: 曹操将汉献帝迎至许都，此后长期控制汉献帝，掌握朝廷权力。
description.en: Cao Cao moved Emperor Xian to Xudu and subsequently controlled him for a long period, holding the power of the imperial court.

description.zh-cn: 汉质帝因表露出对梁冀的不满，而被梁冀毒死。
description.en: Because Emperor Zhi expressed dissatisfaction with Liang Ji, he was poisoned to death by him.

description.zh-cn: 汉桓帝联合宦官一起诛灭了梁氏外戚势力。
description.en: Emperor Huan, in alliance with the eunuchs, exterminated the Liang consort clan.

description.zh-cn: 东汉在公元91年灭亡北匈奴，消除了长期的北方外患。
description.en: In 91 AD, the Eastern Han dynasty destroyed the Northern Xiongnu, eliminating a long-standing northern threat.

description.zh-cn: 东汉永平十年，汉明帝派人去西域求法，迎来高僧，并修建白马寺以供其翻译佛经，推动了佛教在中国的传播。
description.en: In the 10th year of the Yongping era of the Eastern Han (67 AD), Emperor Ming dispatched envoys to the Western Regions to seek Buddhist teachings, welcomed eminent monks, and built the White Horse Temple for them to translate scriptures, thereby promoting the spread of Buddhism in China.

description.zh-cn: 建安十二年，曹操北征乌桓，在白狼山之战中大败乌桓，从此乌桓彻底衰落。
description.en: In the 12th year of the Jian'an era (207 AD), Cao Cao launched a northern expedition against the Wuhuan, decisively defeating them at the Battle of White Wolf Mountain, which led to the complete decline of the Wuhuan.

description.zh-cn: 在北征乌桓的白狼山之战中，曹操俘获并斩杀了乌桓首领蹋顿。
description.en: During the Battle of White Wolf Mountain in his northern campaign against the Wuhuan, Cao Cao captured and executed the Wuhuan chieftain, Tadun.

description.zh-cn: 东汉宦官蔡伦对造纸工艺进行了重大改良，降低了原料和成本要求，为纸的普及创造了条件。
description.en: The Eastern Han eunuch Cai Lun significantly improved the papermaking process, reducing raw material and cost requirements, which paved the way for the widespread use of paper.

description.zh-cn: 高嘉瑜是民主进步党籍的政治人物。
description.en: Kao Chia-yu is a politician and a member of the Democratic Progressive Party.

degree.zh-cn: 法律学系学士、国家发展研究所硕士
degree.en: Bachelor of Laws, Master from the Graduate Institute of National Development

description.zh-cn: 高嘉瑜毕业于国立台湾大学法律学系，并进修获得国家发展研究所硕士学位。
description.en: Kao Chia-yu graduated from the Department of Law at National Taiwan University and obtained a master's degree from its Graduate Institute of National Development.

description.zh-cn: 高嘉瑜出生于基隆市七堵区。
description.en: Kao Chia-yu was born in Qidu District, Keelung City.

description.zh-cn: 高嘉瑜担任第10届中华民国立法委员。
description.en: Kao Chia-yu served as a legislator in the 10th Legislative Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 高嘉瑜曾连任三届台北市议员（第11至13届）。
description.en: Kao Chia-yu served three consecutive terms (11th to 13th) as a Taipei City Councilor.

description.zh-cn: 高嘉瑜于2005年当选为任务型国民大会代表。
description.en: Kao Chia-yu was elected as a delegate to the ad-hoc National Assembly in 2005.

description.zh-cn: 高嘉瑜初入政坛时曾担任罗文嘉的特别助理。
description.en: Early in her political career, Kao Chia-yu served as a special assistant to Luo Wen-chia.

description.zh-cn: 时任民进党主席的陈水扁撤换了高嘉瑜在2008年立法委员选举中的候选人资格。
description.en: Then-DPP Chairman Chen Shui-bian revoked Kao Chia-yu's candidacy for the 2008 Legislative Yuan election.

description.zh-cn: 在2024年立法委员选举中，李彦秀击败高嘉瑜，导致其连任失利。
description.en: In the 2024 Legislative Yuan election, Lee Yen-hsiu defeated Kao Chia-yu, causing her to lose her re-election bid.

description.zh-cn: 在2020年立法委员选举中，高嘉瑜击败时任立委李彦秀，成功当选。
description.en: In the 2020 Legislative Yuan election, Kao Chia-yu defeated incumbent legislator Lee Yen-hsiu to win the seat.

description.zh-cn: 吴欣岱在2024年立法委员选举中参选，严重瓜分泛绿选票，是导致高嘉瑜连任失败的因素之一。
description.en: Wu Hsin-tai's candidacy in the 2024 Legislative Yuan election severely split the pan-Green vote, which was a contributing factor to Kao Chia-yu's failure to be re-elected.

description.zh-cn: 在2018年台北市长选举的造势晚会上，姚文智暗指高嘉瑜在其发言时离开，引发支持者对高的不满。
description.en: During a rally for the 2018 Taipei mayoral election, Pasuya Yao implied that Kao Chia-yu left while he was speaking, inciting discontent among his supporters towards her.

description.zh-cn: 高嘉瑜担任台北市长候选人陈时中竞选办公室的副主委及分区总督导，为其助选。
description.en: Kao Chia-yu served as the deputy director and regional supervisor for Taipei mayoral candidate Chen Shih-chung's campaign office, supporting his election bid.

description.zh-cn: 高嘉瑜批评时任高雄市长韩国瑜阻挡罢免案的行为，并将其形容为“高雄金正恩”。
description.en: Kao Chia-yu criticized then-Kaohsiung Mayor Han Kuo-yu for obstructing a recall vote and described him as the 'Kim Jong-un of Kaohsiung'.

description.zh-cn: 徐麟出生于上海市南汇县。
description.en: Xu Lin was born in Nanhui County, Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 徐麟于1982年9月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Xu Lin joined the Communist Party of China in September 1982.

description.zh-cn: 1982年10月毕业于上海师范学院（现上海师范大学）政教系共青团工作专业。
description.en: Graduated in October 1982 from the Department of Political Education, specializing in Communist Youth League work, at Shanghai Normal College (now Shanghai Normal University).

description.zh-cn: 2001年毕业于中国人民解放军南京政治学院上海分院经济管理专业。
description.en: Graduated in 2001 from the Shanghai branch of PLA Nanjing Political College with a major in Economic Management.

description.zh-cn: 2006年毕业于中欧国际工商学院高层管理人员工商管理专业。
description.en: Graduated in 2006 from the Executive MBA program at China Europe International Business School (CEIBS).

description.zh-cn: 2007年5月，时任上海市委书记习近平在介绍新当选市委常委的徐麟时，称其为“领导班子里面最年轻的一位”。
description.en: In May 2007, Xi Jinping, then Party Secretary of Shanghai, introduced the newly elected member of the Standing Committee, Xu Lin, highlighting him as 'the youngest member of the leadership team'.

description.zh-cn: 徐麟作为中共贵州省委书记，向中共中央总书记习近平负责。
description.en: As the CCP Committee Secretary of Guizhou, Xu Lin is subordinate to the General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee, Xi Jinping.

position.zh-cn: 国家互联网信息办公室主任、国务院新闻办公室主任、国家广播电视总局局长
position.en: Director of the Cyberspace Administration of China, Director of the State Council Information Office, Director of the National Radio and Television Administration

description.zh-cn: 徐麟在担任国家互联网信息办公室、国务院新闻办公室、国家广播电视总局的负责人期间，这些机构均隶属于时任总理李克强领导的国务院。
description.en: While Xu Lin served as the head of the Cyberspace Administration of China, the State Council Information Office, and the National Radio and Television Administration, these agencies were under the State Council led by then-Premier Li Keqiang.

position.zh-cn: 中共贵州省委副书记、贵州省省长
position.en: Deputy Secretary of the CCP Guizhou Provincial Committee, Governor of Guizhou

description.zh-cn: 李炳军担任中共贵州省委副书记，是省委书记徐麟的副手。
description.en: Li Bingjun serves as the Deputy Secretary of the CCP Guizhou Provincial Committee, acting as the deputy to Provincial Party Secretary Xu Lin.

description.zh-cn: 徐麟接替谌贻琴出任中共贵州省委书记。
description.en: Xu Lin succeeded Shen Yiqin as the CCP Committee Secretary of Guizhou.

description.zh-cn: 徐麟接替聂辰席出任国家广播电视总局局长。
description.en: Xu Lin succeeded Nie Chenxi as the Director of the National Radio and Television Administration.

description.zh-cn: 曹淑敏接替徐麟出任国家广播电视总局局长。
description.en: Cao Shumin succeeded Xu Lin as the Director of the National Radio and Television Administration.

description.zh-cn: 徐麟接替蒋建国出任国务院新闻办公室主任。
description.en: Xu Lin succeeded Jiang Jianguo as the Director of the State Council Information Office.

description.zh-cn: 孙业礼接替徐麟出任国务院新闻办公室主任。
description.en: Sun Yeli succeeded Xu Lin as the Director of the State Council Information Office.

description.zh-cn: 徐麟接替鲁炜出任国家互联网信息办公室主任和中央网络安全和信息化委员会办公室主任。
description.en: Xu Lin succeeded Lu Wei as Director of the Cyberspace Administration of China and Director of the Office of the Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission.

description.zh-cn: 庄荣文接替徐麟出任国家互联网信息办公室主任和中央网络安全和信息化委员会办公室主任。
description.en: Zhuang Rongwen succeeded Xu Lin as Director of the Cyberspace Administration of China and Director of the Office of the Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission.

description.zh-cn: 在莫斯科中山大学学习，并于1929年回国。
description.en: Studied at Moscow Sun Yat-sen University and returned to China in 1929.

description.zh-cn: 参加了长征。
description.en: Participated in the Long March.

description.zh-cn: 在抗日军政大学工作。
description.en: Worked at the Counter-Japanese Military and Political University.

description.zh-cn: 在延安大学工作。
description.en: Worked at Yan'an University.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命中遭受迫害。
description.en: Was persecuted during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类“第一届全国人大代表”提取。
description.en: Extracted from the page category 'Delegate to the 1st National People's Congress'.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类“中国人民政治协商会议第一届全体会议代表”提取。
description.en: Extracted from the page category 'Delegate to the 1st Plenary Session of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference'.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类“毛泽东秘书”提取。
description.en: Extracted from the page category 'Mao Zedong's secretary'.

description.zh-cn: 根据史料记载，崔州平是崔烈的儿子。
description.en: According to historical records, Cui Zhouping was the son of Cui Lie.

description.zh-cn: 根据史料记载，崔钧是崔烈的儿子。
description.en: According to historical records, Cui Jun was the son of Cui Lie.

description.zh-cn: 根据史料记载，崔州平是崔钧的弟弟。
description.en: According to historical records, Cui Zhouping was the younger brother of Cui Jun.

description.zh-cn: 崔州平出身于博陵崔氏士族。
description.en: Cui Zhouping came from the aristocratic Cui clan of Boling.

description.zh-cn: 崔州平的籍贯为博陵郡安平县。
description.en: Cui Zhouping's ancestral home was Anping County, Boling Commandery.

description.zh-cn: 崔烈在东汉官至太尉。
description.en: Cui Lie served as the Grand Commandant in the Eastern Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 崔钧在东汉担任西河郡太守。
description.en: Cui Jun served as the Grand Administrator of Xihe Commandery in the Eastern Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 崔州平与徐庶、诸葛亮是好友。
description.en: Cui Zhouping was a good friend of Xu Shu and Zhuge Liang.

description.zh-cn: 根据小说《三国演义》的描述，刘备在“三顾茅庐”期间第一次拜访诸葛亮时遇见了崔州平。
description.en: According to the novel 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Liu Bei met Cui Zhouping during his first visit to Zhuge Liang's cottage.

description.zh-cn: 丁纯是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Ding Chun is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 2018年2月24日，丁纯当选为第十三届全国人民代表大会江苏省代表。
description.en: On February 24, 2018, Ding Chun was elected as a delegate from Jiangsu Province to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 丁纯是江苏江阴人。
description.en: Ding Chun is a native of Jiangyin, Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 丁纯接替费高云担任常州市人民政府市长。
description.en: Ding Chun succeeded Fei Gaoyun as Mayor of the Changzhou Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 陈金虎接替丁纯担任常州市人民政府市长。
description.en: Chen Jinhu succeeded Ding Chun as Mayor of the Changzhou Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 李傕是董卓的部将，在董卓死后成为其势力的继承者之一。
description.en: Li Jue was a general under Dong Zhuo and became one of the successors to his power after Dong Zhuo's death.

description.zh-cn: 董卓死后，贾诩劝说李傕等人不要解散部队，而是率军攻打长安为董卓报仇，并献上“奉国家以正天下”之策，李傕采纳了其建议。
description.en: After Dong Zhuo's death, Jia Xu persuaded Li Jue and others not to disband their troops but to attack Chang'an to avenge Dong Zhuo, proposing the strategy of 'upholding the state to rectify the world,' which Li Jue adopted.

description.zh-cn: 李傕率军攻入长安后，与吕布发生巷战，最终击败吕布，迫使其逃离长安。
description.en: After leading his army into Chang'an, Li Jue engaged in street fighting with Lu Bu, ultimately defeating him and forcing him to flee the city.

description.zh-cn: 李傕与郭汜等人攻占长安后，挟持汉献帝，掌控了东汉朝廷并专政。
description.en: After capturing Chang'an, Li Jue, along with Guo Si and others, held Emperor Xian hostage, seizing control of the Eastern Han court and establishing a dictatorship.

description.zh-cn: 李傕是李郭之乱的主要发动者和领导者之一。
description.en: Li Jue was one of the main instigators and leaders of the Rebellion of Li Jue and Guo Si.

description.zh-cn: 李傕曾被董卓的女婿牛辅派遣至中牟与朱俊交战。
description.en: Li Jue was once dispatched by Dong Zhuo's son-in-law, Niu Fu, to engage Zhu Jun in Zhongmou.

description.zh-cn: 李傕在中牟与朱俊交战，并成功击破对方。
description.en: Li Jue engaged and defeated Zhu Jun in battle at Zhongmou.

description.zh-cn: 兴平二年（195年），李傕因猜忌樊稠勇而得人心，且不满其曾私放韩遂，于是命其外甥胡封在会议上刺杀了樊稠。
description.en: In 195, Li Jue, suspicious of Fan Chou's bravery and popularity, and resentful of him for previously releasing Han Sui, ordered his nephew Hu Feng to assassinate him during a meeting.

description.zh-cn: 兴平二年（195年），李傕在会议上将李蒙与樊稠一同刺死。
description.en: In 195, Li Jue had Li Meng assassinated along with Fan Chou during a meeting.

description.zh-cn: 兴平元年（194年），马腾联合韩遂攻打李傕，被李傕派兵击败。
description.en: In 194, Ma Teng allied with Han Sui to attack Li Jue, but was defeated by forces dispatched by Li Jue.

description.zh-cn: 兴平元年（194年），韩遂联合马腾攻打李傕，被李傕派兵击败。
description.en: In 194, Han Sui allied with Ma Teng to attack Li Jue, but was defeated by forces dispatched by Li Jue.

description.zh-cn: 建安二年（197年），曹操派谒者仆射裴茂率领关中诸将讨伐李傕，并于次年将其势力消灭。
description.en: In 197, Cao Cao dispatched the Ye Zhe Pu She Pei Mao to lead the generals of Guanzhong on a punitive expedition against Li Jue, eliminating his forces the following year.

description.zh-cn: 裴茂奉曹操之命，率领段煨、梁兴、张横等关中诸将讨伐并消灭了李傕。
description.en: Under Cao Cao's orders, Pei Mao led Guanzhong generals such as Duan Wei, Liang Xing, and Zhang Heng to attack and eliminate Li Jue.

description.zh-cn: 建安三年（198年），梁兴与张横等人合力击败并斩杀了李傕。
description.en: In 198, Liang Xing, along with Zhang Heng and others, joined forces to defeat and execute Li Jue.

description.zh-cn: 建安二年（197年），郭汜被其部将伍习所杀。
description.en: In 197, Guo Si was killed by his subordinate general, Wu Xi.

description.zh-cn: 李式是李傕的儿子。
description.en: Li Shi was the son of Li Jue.

description.zh-cn: 李利是李傕兄长之子。
description.en: Li Li was the son of Li Jue's older brother.

description.zh-cn: 李暹是李傕兄长之子。
description.en: Li Xian was the son of Li Jue's older brother.

description.zh-cn: 根据传说，施耐庵是罗贯中的老师。
description.en: According to legend, Shi Nai'an was Luo Guanzhong's teacher.

description.zh-cn: 《三国演义》是根据正史《三国志》等史书进行改编和演义的历史小说。
description.en: 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' is a historical novel adapted and dramatized based on official histories such as 'Records of the Three Kingdoms'.

description.zh-cn: 元代话本《三国志平话》是《三国演义》的重要创作来源之一。
description.en: The Yuan dynasty storybook 'Sanguozhi Pinghua' was one of the important sources for the creation of 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms'.

description.zh-cn: 与父亲毛纶一同评改《三国演义》，增删文字，形成了今日流传最广的120回“毛本”。
description.en: Together with his father Mao Lun, he edited and revised 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', adding and removing text, to form the most widely circulated 120-chapter 'Mao edition' today.

description.zh-cn: 与儿子毛宗岗一同评改《三国演义》，形成了今日流传最广的“毛本”。
description.en: Together with his son Mao Zonggang, he edited and revised 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', forming the widely circulated 'Mao edition' today.

description.zh-cn: 吕蒙以“白衣渡江”之计奇袭荆州，最终俘虏并斩杀了关羽。
description.en: Lü Meng used the tactic of 'crossing the river in civilian clothes' to launch a surprise attack on Jing Province, ultimately capturing and executing Guan Yu.

description.zh-cn: 魏将邓艾偷渡阴平，兵临成都，后主刘禅投降，蜀汉灭亡。其后司马氏篡魏建晋。
description.en: The Wei general Deng Ai crossed Yinping by a treacherous route and appeared before Chengdu. The Shu emperor Liu Shan surrendered, and Shu Han fell. The Sima clan later usurped Wei and established Jin.

description.zh-cn: 西晋发兵攻打东吴，吴主孙皓投降，东吴灭亡，三国时代结束。
description.en: The Western Jin launched a campaign against Eastern Wu. The Wu emperor Sun Hao surrendered, marking the end of Eastern Wu and the Three Kingdoms period.

description.zh-cn: 褚锦锋是陕西富平人。
description.en: Chu Jinfeng is from Fuping, Shaanxi.

description.zh-cn: 褚锦锋是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Chu Jinfeng is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 2018年，褚锦锋被选为陕西省出席第十三届全国人民代表大会代表。
description.en: In 2018, Chu Jinfeng was elected as a deputy from Shaanxi Province to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 在浮夸风之下，国家基于虚报的粮食产量进行高额征购，导致农民的口粮、种子和饲料被收走，是造成饥荒的一个重要制度性原因。
description.en: Under the influence of the 'wind of exaggeration,' the state imposed high procurement quotas based on inflated grain production figures, leading to the confiscation of peasants' food rations, seeds, and feed, which was a significant institutional cause of the famine.

description.zh-cn: 1958年开始实施的严格户籍制度限制了人口流动，阻止了饥民外出逃荒，加剧了饥荒的严重程度和死亡人数。
description.en: The strict household registration system implemented in 1958 restricted population movement, preventing famine victims from fleeing to find food, which exacerbated the severity of the famine and the death toll.

description.zh-cn: 三年困难时期的严重后果导致中共中央开始调整经济政策，并于1961年批准“八字方针”，实际上停止了大跃进运动。
description.en: The severe consequences of the Three Years of Difficult Period led the CPC Central Committee to adjust its economic policies, approving the 'Eight-Character Policy' in 1961, which effectively ended the Great Leap Forward movement.

description.zh-cn: 在七千人大会上，毛泽东作了自我批评，并随后退居二线，由刘少奇、邓小平等主持中央具体事务。
description.en: At the Seven Thousand Cadres Conference, Mao Zedong made a self-criticism and subsequently retreated to a secondary role, with Liu Shaoqi, Deng Xiaoping, and others taking charge of the central administration's daily affairs.

description.zh-cn: 大饥荒后，邓小平支持并推动“三自一包”等经济调整政策，并提出了著名的“猫论”。
description.en: After the Great Famine, Deng Xiaoping supported and promoted economic adjustment policies like 'Sanzi Yibao' and proposed his famous 'cat theory'.

description.zh-cn: 因支持“包产到户”，邓子恢在1962年北戴河会议及八届十中全会上遭到毛泽东的严厉批判，并被降职。
description.en: For supporting 'fixing output quotas on a household basis,' Deng Zihui was severely criticized by Mao Zedong at the 1962 Beidaihe Conference and the 8th Plenary Session of the 10th Central Committee, and was subsequently demoted.

description.zh-cn: 黄立众于1956年考入北京大学哲学系，后被开除。
description.en: Huang Lizhong was admitted to the Department of Philosophy at Peking University in 1956 and was later expelled.

description.zh-cn: 时任北京大学校长陆平因黄立众谈及农村饿死人情况而将其开除。
description.en: Lu Ping, then President of Peking University, expelled Huang Lizhong for discussing the starvation deaths in rural areas.

description.zh-cn: 在自身发生严重饥荒的情况下，中国政府于1960年4月决定无偿赠送几内亚大米1万吨。
description.en: Despite facing a severe famine domestically, the Chinese government decided in April 1960 to donate 10,000 tons of rice to Guinea free of charge.

description.zh-cn: 在自身发生严重饥荒的情况下，中国于1960年援助阿尔巴尼亚15000吨小麦，并于1961年赠予其五亿卢布及额外的小麦。
description.en: Despite its own severe famine, China provided Albania with 15,000 tons of wheat in 1960, and in 1961, granted it 500 million rubles and additional wheat.

description.zh-cn: 1960年11月切·格瓦拉访华期间，周恩来代表中国向古巴提供了6000万美元贷款，并表示可以不还。
description.en: During Che Guevara's visit to China in November 1960, Zhou Enlai, on behalf of China, provided Cuba with a 60 million USD loan and stated that it could be considered non-repayable.

description.zh-cn: 周恩来代表中国政府，拒绝了赫鲁晓夫主动提出的对华援助以缓解饥荒的建议。
description.en: On behalf of the Chinese government, Zhou Enlai rejected Khrushchev's unsolicited offer of aid to alleviate the famine.

description.zh-cn: 刘长龙是吉林公主岭人。
description.en: Liu Changlong is from Gongzhuling, Jilin.

description.zh-cn: 刘长龙是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Liu Changlong is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 刘长龙是东北师范大学的校友。
description.en: Liu Changlong is an alumnus of Northeast Normal University.

description.zh-cn: 刘长龙自2016年9月起任长春市代市长，同年10月正式当选市长，直至2018年8月辞职。
description.en: Liu Changlong served as acting mayor of Changchun from September 2016, was formally elected mayor in October of the same year, and held the post until his resignation in August 2018.

description.zh-cn: 2018年2月24日，刘长龙当选为第十三届全国人民代表大会代表。
description.en: On February 24, 2018, Liu Changlong was elected as a delegate to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央政治局常务委员会于2018年8月16日召开会议，要求对长春长生疫苗事件负有责任的刘长龙引咎辞职。
description.en: The Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee held a meeting on August 16, 2018, and required Liu Changlong, who was held responsible for the Changsheng vaccine incident, to resign.

description.zh-cn: 刘忻接替因疫苗案件引咎辞职的刘长龙出任长春市人民政府市长。
description.en: Liu Xin succeeded Liu Changlong, who resigned due to the vaccine scandal, as the Mayor of Changchun Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会机关委员会的组织上级机构和业务上级机构是中共中央直属机关工作委员会。
description.en: The organizational and operational superior of the CPC Committee of the Organs of the National Committee of the CPPCC is the Work Committee for Organs Directly under the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会机关委员会的业务上级机构是中国共产党中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会机关党组。
description.en: The operational superior of the CPC Committee of the Organs of the National Committee of the CPPCC is the Party Leadership Group of the Organs of the National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 自1983年起，中国共产党中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会机关委员会成为中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会办公厅下设的机构之一。
description.en: Since 1983, the CPC Committee of the Organs of the National Committee of the CPPCC has been one of the bodies established under the General Office of the National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 自2017年起，舒启明担任中国共产党中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会机关委员会书记。
description.en: Since 2017, Shu Qiming has served as the Secretary of the CPC Committee of the Organs of the National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 截至2017年11月，舒启明是全国政协机关党组成员。
description.en: As of November 2017, Shu Qiming was a member of the Party Leadership Group of the Organs of the CPPCC National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 截至2017年11月，舒启明担任全国政协办公厅研究室主任。
description.en: As of November 2017, Shu Qiming served as the Director of the Research Office of the General Office of the CPPCC National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 2013年3月至2017年6月，张秋俭担任中国共产党中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会机关委员会书记。
description.en: From March 2013 to June 2017, Zhang Qiujian served as the Secretary of the CPC Committee of the Organs of the National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 截至2015年2月13日，孙怀山担任全国政协机关党组书记。
description.en: As of February 13, 2015, Sun Huaishan served as the Secretary of the Party Leadership Group of the Organs of the CPPCC National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 截至2017年11月，李勇担任中共中央直属机关工作委员会副书记。
description.en: As of November 2017, Li Yong served as the Deputy Secretary of the Work Committee for Organs Directly under the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 上海战役的结束使得华东军区得以接管位于上海的联勤第二总医院。
description.en: The end of the Shanghai Campaign enabled the East China Military Region to take over the Second General Hospital of the Combined Services located in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 上海市立博物馆是大上海计划的一部分。
description.en: The Shanghai Municipal Museum was part of the Greater Shanghai Plan.

description.zh-cn: 中国航空协会大楼是大上海计划的一部分。
description.en: The China Aviation Association Building was part of the Greater Shanghai Plan.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗人质危机是伊朗伊斯兰革命的直接后果和延续。
description.en: The Iran hostage crisis was a direct consequence and continuation of the Iranian Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 由于人质危机事件，时任伊朗总理迈赫迪·巴扎尔甘及其内阁成员集体辞职。
description.en: Due to the hostage crisis, then-Prime Minister of Iran Mehdi Bazargan and his cabinet resigned en masse.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗人质危机导致由迈赫迪·巴扎尔甘领导的伊朗临时政府集体辞职。
description.en: The Iran hostage crisis led to the mass resignation of the Interim Government of Iran, led by Mehdi Bazargan.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗人质危机被普遍认为是导致吉米·卡特在1980年总统选举中竞选连任失败的主要原因。
description.en: The Iran hostage crisis is widely considered to be the primary reason for Jimmy Carter's failure to win re-election in the 1980 presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 在被推翻前的数十年间，美国一直是伊朗国王穆罕默德·礼萨·巴列维的主要支持者，为其提供了大量军事和经济援助。
description.en: For decades before he was overthrown, the United States was the main supporter of Shah Mohammad Reza Pahlavi of Iran, providing him with extensive military and economic aid.

description.zh-cn: 美国中央情报局帮助巴列维国王发动了旨在推翻莫沙德哈的阿贾克斯行动。
description.en: The U.S. Central Intelligence Agency assisted Shah Pahlavi in launching Operation Ajax to overthrow Mosaddegh.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗伊斯兰革命推翻了穆罕默德·礼萨·巴列维的统治，迫使其流亡国外。
description.en: The Iranian Revolution overthrew the rule of Mohammad Reza Pahlavi, forcing him into exile.

description.zh-cn: 时任美国总统吉米·卡特批准了旨在营救人质的“鹰爪行动”。
description.en: Then-U.S. President Jimmy Carter approved Operation Eagle Claw, which aimed to rescue the hostages.

description.zh-cn: 鹰爪行动因飞机相撞坠毁而失败，并导致8名美国军人阵亡。
description.en: Operation Eagle Claw failed due to a helicopter and transport plane collision, resulting in the deaths of eight U.S. servicemen.

description.zh-cn: 加拿大政府及其驻伊朗大使肯·泰勒为六名逃脱的美国外交官提供了庇护和虚假护照，帮助他们安全离开伊朗。
description.en: The Canadian government and its ambassador to Iran, Ken Taylor, provided shelter and false passports for six escaped American diplomats, helping them to leave Iran safely.

description.zh-cn: 2012年的电影《逃离德黑兰》改编自伊朗人质危机期间六名美国人质在加拿大的帮助下成功逃脱的事件。
description.en: The 2012 film 'Argo' is based on the event during the Iran hostage crisis where six American hostages successfully escaped with Canadian help.

description.zh-cn: 罗纳德·雷根在1980年美国总统选举中击败了寻求连任的吉米·卡特。
description.en: Ronald Reagan defeated the incumbent Jimmy Carter in the 1980 United States presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 两伊战争的爆发使得伊朗方面变得更希望能够解决人质危机。
description.en: The outbreak of the Iran-Iraq War made Iran more eager to resolve the hostage crisis.

description.zh-cn: 阿尔及利亚作为中间人，帮助美国与伊朗就人质危机进行谈判。
description.en: Algeria acted as an intermediary, helping the United States and Iran negotiate over the hostage crisis.

description.zh-cn: 根据部分前人质的指认，马哈茂德·艾哈迈迪内贾德曾参与人质劫持行动，但伊朗政府对此予以否认。
description.en: According to some former hostages, Mahmoud Ahmadinejad participated in the hostage-taking, but the Iranian government denies this.

description.zh-cn: 根据传说，伏羲创造了八卦。
description.en: According to legend, Fu Xi created the Eight Trigrams.

description.zh-cn: 根据传说，夏禹将八卦扩充为六十四卦。
description.en: According to legend, Yu the Great expanded the eight trigrams into the sixty-four hexagrams.

description.zh-cn: 根据传统说法，周文王在被囚禁于羑里时推演了《周易》，并为每一卦写下了“卦辞”。
description.en: According to tradition, King Wen of Zhou developed the I Ching while imprisoned in Youli and wrote the 'hexagram judgments' for each hexagram.

description.zh-cn: 根据传统说法，周公旦为《周易》的每一爻撰写了解释，即“爻辞”。
description.en: According to tradition, the Duke of Zhou wrote the explanations for each line of the I Ching, known as the 'line statements' (yaoci).

description.zh-cn: 根据《史记》等传统文献，孔子晚年喜爱《易经》，并参与编辑了《十翼》（即《易传》）以解释其经文。
description.en: According to traditional texts like the 'Records of the Grand Historian', Confucius developed a fondness for the I Ching in his later years and participated in editing the 'Ten Wings' (Yizhuan) to explain its text.

description.zh-cn: 《易传》是早期儒家学者对《周易》所作出的系统性解释。
description.en: The Yizhuan is a systematic interpretation of the I Ching made by early Confucian scholars.

description.zh-cn: 《易传》作为对《周易》的解释和阐发，极大地丰富和推广了《易经》的哲学思想和道德内涵，使其成为儒家经典。
description.en: As a work of interpretation and elaboration on the I Ching, the Yizhuan greatly enriched and promoted the philosophical ideas and moral connotations of the I Ching, establishing it as a Confucian classic.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝采纳“罢黜百家，独尊儒术”的政策，将《周易》与《诗》、《书》、《礼》、《春秋》并列为《五经》，确立了其官方经典的地位。
description.en: Emperor Wu of Han adopted the policy of 'dismissing the hundred schools and revering only Confucianism,' elevating the I Ching along with the 'Poetry', 'Documents', 'Rites', and 'Spring and Autumn Annals' to the status of the 'Five Classics', thereby establishing its official canonical status.

description.zh-cn: 自汉代开始，《易经》被官方尊奉为“五经”之一。
description.en: Since the Han Dynasty, the I Ching has been officially revered as one of the 'Five Classics'.

description.zh-cn: 在秦始皇“焚书坑儒”期间，时任丞相李斯将《周易》归类为医术占卜之书，从而使其免于被焚毁。
description.en: During Qin Shi Huang's 'burning of books and burying of scholars', Chancellor Li Si classified the I Ching as a book of medicine and divination, thus sparing it from being burned.

description.zh-cn: 自17世纪起，耶稣会的传教士开始将《易经》翻译并介绍到西方世界。
description.en: Starting in the 17th century, Jesuit missionaries began to translate and introduce the I Ching to the Western world.

description.zh-cn: 法国传教士白晋向德国哲学家莱布尼茨介绍了邵雍的伏羲先天六十四卦图，引发了莱布尼茨对《易经》与二进制关系的思考。
description.en: The French missionary Joachim Bouvet introduced Shao Yong's Fuxi's 'Former Heaven Sixty-Four Hexagrams Chart' to the German philosopher Leibniz, sparking Leibniz's thoughts on the relationship between the I Ching and the binary system.

description.zh-cn: 莱布尼茨认为《易经》的六十四卦图形与他发明的二进制相符合，并对此赞扬备至，促进了《易经》在西方的传播和研究。
description.en: Leibniz believed that the sixty-four hexagram figures of the I Ching corresponded to his invention of the binary system, and he praised it highly, promoting the spread and study of the I Ching in the West.

description.zh-cn: 莱布尼茨是现代二进制记数法的发明者。
description.en: Leibniz was the inventor of the modern binary numeral system.

description.zh-cn: 著名心理学家卡尔·荣格认为，《易经》作为一种“预测未来和解析过去”的方法是极其有效的，他的认可提升了《易经》在现代心理学领域的地位。
description.en: The famous psychologist Carl Jung believed that the I Ching is an extremely effective method for 'predicting the future and analyzing the past,' and his endorsement elevated the status of the I Ching in the field of modern psychology.

description.zh-cn: 在中国哲学体系中，太极产生了两仪（阴和阳）。
description.en: In the Chinese philosophical system, Taiji generates the Liangyi (yin and yang).

description.zh-cn: 两仪（阴阳）的变化和组合产生了四象。
description.en: The changes and combinations of Liangyi (yin and yang) generate the Sixiang (four images).

description.zh-cn: 四象进一步组合演化，产生了八卦。
description.en: The further combination and evolution of the Sixiang generate the Bagua (eight trigrams).

description.zh-cn: 两个八卦相叠（重卦）构成了六十四卦。
description.en: Two Bagua (trigrams) are stacked to form the sixty-four hexagrams.

description.zh-cn: 王抗平是湖南益阳人。
description.en: Wang Kangping is a native of Yiyang, Hunan.

description.zh-cn: 王抗平曾任成都军区空军副参谋长。
description.en: Wang Kangping once served as the Deputy Chief of Staff of the Chengdu Military Region Air Force.

description.zh-cn: 王抗平于2021年6月至2024年10月期间担任东部战区副司令员。
description.en: Wang Kangping served as the Deputy Commander of the Eastern Theater Command from June 2021 to October 2024.

description.zh-cn: 王抗平于2024年10月调任联勤保障部队司令员。
description.en: In October 2024, Wang Kangping was transferred to the position of Commander of the Joint Logistics Support Force.

description.zh-cn: 王抗平于2021年6月晋升空军中将军衔。
description.en: Wang Kangping was promoted to the rank of Air Force Lieutenant General in June 2021.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类信息，王抗平是中国人民解放军国防大学的校友。
description.en: According to category information, Wang Kangping is an alumnus of the PLA National Defence University.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类信息，王抗平是中国共产党第二十届中央委员会候补委员。
description.en: According to category information, Wang Kangping is an alternate member of the 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类信息，王抗平是中华人民共和国建立后加入中国共产党的党员。
description.en: According to category information, Wang Kangping joined the Communist Party of China after the founding of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 作为中方代表签署了《中华人民共和国政府和日本国政府联合声明》。
description.en: Signed the Joint Communiqué of the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of Japan as a representative of the Chinese side.

description.zh-cn: 作为日方代表签署了《中华人民共和国政府和日本国政府联合声明》。
description.en: Signed the Joint Communiqué of the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of Japan as a representative of the Japanese side.

description.zh-cn: 中苏关系恶化及苏联带来的安全威胁，是促使中国寻求与日本及西方国家改善关系的战略背景之一。
description.en: The deterioration of Sino-Soviet relations and the security threat posed by the Soviet Union were part of the strategic background that prompted China to seek improved relations with Japan and Western countries.

description.zh-cn: 美国对华战略的转变，以尼克松访华为标志，为日本调整其对华政策并与中国建交创造了国际环境。
description.en: The shift in U.S. strategy towards China, marked by Nixon's visit, created the international environment for Japan to adjust its China policy and establish diplomatic relations.

description.zh-cn: 《中日联合声明》签署后，日本外相大平正芳宣布，日本与中华民国之间订立的《中日和约》失去存在的意义而宣告终结。
description.en: After the signing of the Sino-Japanese Joint Communiqué, Japanese Foreign Minister Masayoshi Ōhira announced that the Treaty of Peace between Japan and the Republic of China had lost its significance and was terminated.

description.zh-cn: 通过签署《中日联合声明》，日本国政府承认中华人民共和国政府是中国的唯一合法政府，从而与中华民国政府断绝了外交关系。
description.en: By signing the Sino-Japanese Joint Communiqué, the Government of Japan recognized the Government of the People's Republic of China as the sole legal government of China, thereby severing diplomatic relations with the Government of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 在1972年日本自由民主党总裁选举中，田中角荣击败了其最大的竞争对手、属于亲中华民国派的福田赳夫。
description.en: In the 1972 Liberal Democratic Party presidential election, Kakuei Tanaka defeated his biggest competitor, Takeo Fukuda, who belonged to the pro-Republic of China faction.

description.zh-cn: 在《中日联合声明》中，日本政府声明其将坚持遵循《波茨坦公告》第八条的立场，该条款涉及日本领土范围。
description.en: In the Sino-Japanese Joint Communiqué, the Japanese government stated its adherence to the position of Article 8 of the Potsdam Declaration, which relates to the extent of Japanese territory.

description.zh-cn: 针对日方说法，中国外交部回应称，《中日联合声明》的原则已由《中日和平友好条约》从法律上确认，当然具有法律约束力。
description.en: In response to the Japanese side's statement, the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs responded that the principles of the Sino-Japanese Joint Communiqué were legally confirmed by the Treaty of Peace and Friendship between Japan and China and are therefore legally binding.

description.zh-cn: 1978年签订的《中日和平友好条约》在法律上确认了《中日联合声明》是两国和平友好关系的基础，且声明所表明的各项原则应予严格遵守。
description.en: The 1978 Treaty of Peace and Friendship between Japan and China legally confirmed that the Sino-Japanese Joint Communiqué is the foundation of the peaceful and friendly relations between the two countries, and that the principles outlined in the communiqué should be strictly observed.

description.zh-cn: 在中原大战中，南京国民政府与北平国民政府是敌对的交战双方。
description.en: During the Central Plains War, the Nanjing Nationalist Government and the Beiping Nationalist Government were opposing belligerents.

position.zh-cn: 中华民国陆海空军总司令
position.en: Commander-in-chief of the Army, Navy, and Air Force of the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 阎锡山被反蒋各派推举为“中华民国陆海空军总司令”，是北平国民政府名义上的最高军事领导人。
description.en: Yan Xishan was acclaimed by the anti-Chiang factions as the Commander-in-chief of the armed forces, making him the nominal supreme military leader of the Beiping Nationalist Government.

description.zh-cn: 冯玉祥担任反蒋联军的副总司令，是北平国民政府的核心人物之一。
description.en: Feng Yuxiang served as the Deputy Commander-in-chief of the anti-Chiang coalition forces and was a key figure in the Beiping Nationalist Government.

description.zh-cn: 李宗仁担任反蒋联军的副总司令，是北平国民政府的核心人物之一。
description.en: Li Zongren served as the Deputy Commander-in-chief of the anti-Chiang coalition forces and was a key figure in the Beiping Nationalist Government.

description.zh-cn: 汪精卫联合各地方实力派挑战南京国民政府，并支持阎锡山等人另立中央，促成了北平国民政府的建立。
description.en: Wang Jingwei united with various regional warlords to challenge the Nanjing Nationalist Government and supported Yan Xishan and others in establishing an alternative central government, contributing to the formation of the Beiping Nationalist Government.

description.zh-cn: 张学良于1930年9月18日通电拥蒋，并率领东北军入关，其行动成为蒋中正一方取得中原大战胜利的关键因素。
description.en: On September 18, 1930, Zhang Xueliang declared his support for Chiang Kai-shek and led the Northeast Army into Central China, an action that became a decisive factor for Chiang's victory in the Central Plains War.

description.zh-cn: 张学良率领东北军入山海关，攻进北平，导致反蒋同盟瓦解。
description.en: Zhang Xueliang led the Northeast Army through the Shanhai Pass and into Beiping, leading to the collapse of the anti-Chiang coalition.

description.zh-cn: 中原大战的胜利巩固了蒋中正在南京国民政府的最高领导权。
description.en: The victory in the Central Plains War consolidated Chiang Kai-shek's supreme leadership in the Nanjing Nationalist Government.

description.zh-cn: 中原大战战败后，冯玉祥被迫通电下野，其西北军大部被改编。
description.en: After being defeated in the Central Plains War, Feng Yuxiang was forced to announce his retirement from politics, and most of his Northwest Army was reorganized.

description.zh-cn: 在中原大战中，李宗仁指挥的桂军北伐湖南，但最终受挫撤回广西，以战败告终。
description.en: During the Central Plains War, the Guangxi army commanded by Li Zongren marched north to Hunan but was eventually thwarted and retreated to Guangxi, ending in defeat.

description.zh-cn: 中原大战调动了大量原计划用于剿共的国民革命军，为中国共产党提供了喘息和发展的机会。
description.en: The Central Plains War diverted a large number of National Revolutionary Army troops originally intended for anti-communist campaigns, providing the Communist Party of China with an opportunity to recuperate and expand.

description.zh-cn: 张学良率东北军主力入关参与中原大战，导致中国东北防务空虚，为日本关东军发动九一八事变创造了机会。
description.en: Zhang Xueliang led the main force of the Northeastern Army into the Shanhai Pass to participate in the Central Plains War, leaving Northeast China's defenses vulnerable and creating an opportunity for the Japanese Kwantung Army to launch the Mukden Incident.

description.zh-cn: 1930年6月4日，南京国民政府的飞机队在许昌前线发动空袭，重创反蒋联军将领樊钟秀，其于次日不治身亡。
description.en: On June 4, 1930, aircraft of the Nanjing Nationalist Government launched an air raid on the Xuchang front, severely wounding anti-Chiang coalition general Fan Zhongxiu, who died the next day.

description.zh-cn: 1930年5月31日，西北军将领郑大章率骑兵奇袭归德机场，并险些在朱集车站俘获当时在此地的蒋中正。
description.en: On May 31, 1930, Northwest Army general Zheng Dazhang led a cavalry raid on Guider airfield and nearly captured Chiang Kai-shek, who was at the nearby Zhuji station at the time.

description.zh-cn: 梁启超从巴黎致电林长民，通报了中国在巴黎和会上的外交失败，促使林长民向国民发出警报。
description.en: Liang Qichao sent a telegram from Paris to Lin Changmin, informing him of China's diplomatic failure at the Peace Conference, which prompted Lin to issue a warning to the nation.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东在其著作《新民主主义论》中，将五四运动定义为中国新民主主义革命的开端，这一论断深刻影响了中国共产党的官方史观。
description.en: In his work 'On New Democracy,' Mao Zedong defined the May Fourth Movement as the beginning of China's New Democratic Revolution, a thesis that profoundly shaped the official historiography of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 蒋介石肯定五四运动的爱国主义层面，称其为国民“强烈革命要求最鲜明的表现”。
description.en: Chiang Kai-she affirmed the patriotic aspect of the May Fourth Movement, calling it 'the most vivid expression of the people's strong revolutionary demands.'

description.zh-cn: 作为五四当天游行示威的一部分，学生们前往曹汝霖住宅抗议，最终演变为放火烧楼的激烈行动。
description.en: As part of the demonstration on May 4, students went to Cao Rulin's residence to protest, an action which ultimately escalated into the burning of the building.

description.zh-cn: 法律专业毕业。
description.en: Graduated with a major in Law.

description.zh-cn: 管理科学与工程专业在职研究生。
description.en: In-service postgraduate student in Management Science and Engineering.

description.zh-cn: 接替刘建洋出任中国共产党江苏省委员会政法委员会书记。
description.en: Succeeded Liu Jianyang as Secretary of the Political and Legal Affairs Commission of the CPC Jiangsu Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 接替刘旸出任江苏省公安厅厅长。
description.en: Succeeded Liu Yang as Director of the Jiangsu Provincial Department of Public Security.

description.zh-cn: 接替李耀光出任江苏省公安厅厅长。
description.en: Succeeded Li Yaoguang as Director of the Jiangsu Provincial Department of Public Security.

description.zh-cn: 洪武十五年（1382年），明太祖在原亲军都尉府及所属的仪鸾司的基础上改制而成锦衣卫。
description.en: In 1382, the Hongwu Emperor reorganized the former Imperial Guard's Commander's Office and the Imperial Standard Guard to establish the Jinyiwei.

description.zh-cn: 锦衣卫是明朝的特务机构，直接向皇帝负责。
description.en: The Jinyiwei was a secret service agency of the Ming Dynasty and was directly responsible to the emperor.

description.zh-cn: 锦衣卫是在原亲军都尉府的基础上改制而成的。
description.en: The Jinyiwei was reorganized from the former Imperial Guard's Commander's Office.

description.zh-cn: 咒水之难中，南明锦衣卫指挥使马吉翔与掌卫事任子信被杀，标志着锦衣卫历史的正式结束。
description.en: In the Cursed Water Incident, the Southern Ming Jinyiwei commander Ma Jixiang and commander in charge Ren Zixin were killed, marking the official end of the Jinyiwei's history.

description.zh-cn: 在咒水之难中被杀。
description.en: Was killed in the Cursed Water Incident.

description.zh-cn: 胡惟庸案结束后，明太祖扩大了锦衣卫的编制。
description.en: After the case of Hu Weiyong, the Hongwu Emperor expanded the establishment of the Jinyiwei.

description.zh-cn: 空印案结束后，明太祖扩大了锦衣卫的编制。
description.en: After the Case of the Blank Seals, the Hongwu Emperor expanded the establishment of the Jinyiwei.

description.zh-cn: 洪武二十年，因锦衣卫多有非法凌虐之举，明太祖下令削减其权力，诏令内外狱咸归三法司。
description.en: In 1387, due to numerous illegal abuses by the Jinyiwei, the Hongwu Emperor ordered the reduction of its power and decreed that all judicial cases be handled by the Three Judicial Offices.

description.zh-cn: 永乐十三年（1415年），时任锦衣卫掌卫事的纪纲将《永乐大典》总裁官解缙置于雪地冻死。
description.en: In 1415, Ji Gang, then commander in charge of the Jinyiwei, had Xie Jin, the chief editor of the Yongle Encyclopedia, frozen to death in the snow.

description.zh-cn: 将锦衣卫改名为龙衣卫。
description.en: Renamed the Jinyiwei to Longyiwei (Dragon-Clad Guard).

description.zh-cn: 顺治二年，清朝将锦衣卫改名为銮仪卫，并变更其职能，使其专责皇室仪仗。
description.en: In 1645, the Qing dynasty renamed the Jinyiwei to Luan Yi Wei (Imperial Guard of Honor) and changed its function to be solely responsible for imperial ceremonies.

description.zh-cn: 锦衣卫侦办了蓝玉谋反案，并将其报告给皇帝。此案为著名的诏狱案件之一。
description.en: The Jinyiwei investigated the treason case of Lan Yu and reported it to the emperor. This case is one of the famous imperial prison cases.

description.zh-cn: 锦衣卫侦办了周延儒案，并将其报告给皇帝。此案为著名的诏狱案件之一。
description.en: The Jinyiwei investigated the case of Zhou Yanru and reported it to the emperor. This case is one of the famous imperial prison cases.

description.zh-cn: 首任锦衣卫指挥使。
description.en: The first commander of the Jinyiwei.

description.zh-cn: 在1997年国会大选中作为新加坡工人党候选人出战静山集选区。
description.en: Ran as a candidate for the Workers' Party in the Jalan Besar Group Representation Constituency during the 1997 general election.

description.zh-cn: 在1997年大选后，与时任内阁资政李光耀等共11人一同控告邓亮洪诽谤。
description.en: After the 1997 general election, along with then-Senior Minister Lee Kuan Yew and 9 others, sued Tang Liang Hong for defamation.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀控告邓亮洪诽谤，邓亮洪则在其回忆录《与李光耀较量》中记录了两人的政治对抗。
description.en: Lee Kuan Yew sued Tang Liang Hong for defamation, and Tang documented their political confrontation in his memoir, 'Contesting with Lee Kuan Yew'.

description.zh-cn: 1997年大选前后，邓亮洪向警方报告死亡恐吓未被受理，并被税局指控逃税，其妻子的护照也曾遭没收，这些事件导致他最终流亡海外。
description.en: Around the 1997 general election, Tang Liang Hong's report to the police about death threats was not accepted, he was accused of tax evasion by the tax authorities, and his wife's passport was confiscated, which ultimately led to his exile.

description.zh-cn: 根据邓亮洪的回忆录，人民行动党通过操纵选举规则、限制公共经费、重新划分选区等手段来压制包括新加坡工人党在内的反对党。
description.en: According to Tang Liang Hong's memoir, the People's Action Party suppressed opposition parties, including the Workers' Party, by manipulating election rules, limiting public funds, and redrawing constituencies.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡工人党是新加坡的主要反对党，与执政的人民行动党构成政治竞争关系。
description.en: The Workers' Party is a main opposition party in Singapore, in political competition with the ruling People's Action Party.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科页面分类，邓亮洪是南洋大学的校友。
description.en: According to Wikipedia page categories, Tang Liang Hong is an alumnus of Nanyang University.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科页面分类，邓亮洪是新加坡国立大学的校友。
description.en: According to Wikipedia page categories, Tang Liang Hong is an alumnus of the National University of Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 鲁道夫与玛丽亚·费瑟拉是情妇关系，两人于1888年11月5日在霍夫堡皇宫开始发展恋情。
description.en: Rudolf and Mary Vetsera were lovers; their affair began on November 5, 1888, at the Hofburg Palace.

description.zh-cn: 鲁道夫皇太子在梅耶林惨案中自杀身亡。
description.en: Crown Prince Rudolf died by suicide in the Mayerling incident.

description.zh-cn: 鲁道夫是弗朗茨·约瑟夫一世的独子。
description.en: Rudolf was the only son of Franz Joseph I.

description.zh-cn: 鲁道夫是伊丽莎白皇后的独子。
description.en: Rudolf was the only son of Empress Elisabeth.

description.zh-cn: 鲁道夫于1881年5月10日与比利时的斯蒂芬妮结婚。
description.en: Rudolf married Princess Stéphanie of Belgium on May 10, 1881.

description.zh-cn: 比利时的斯蒂芬妮是利奥波德二世国王的女儿。
description.en: Princess Stéphanie was the daughter of King Leopold II.

description.zh-cn: 弗朗茨·约瑟夫一世召见鲁道夫，以继承权为要挟，命令他与玛丽亚·费瑟拉断绝关系。
description.en: Franz Joseph I summoned Rudolf and, threatening his right of succession, ordered him to end his relationship with Mary Vetsera.

description.zh-cn: 鲁道夫曾写信给教宗良十三世，请求解除他与斯蒂芬妮公主的婚姻关系。
description.en: Rudolf wrote to Pope Leo XIII requesting an annulment of his marriage to Princess Stéphanie.

description.zh-cn: 教宗良十三世将鲁道夫请求解除婚姻关系一事告知了弗朗茨·约瑟夫一世皇帝。
description.en: Pope Leo XIII informed Emperor Franz Joseph I of Rudolf's request for a marriage annulment.

description.zh-cn: 鲁道夫皇太子死后，其叔父卡尔·路德维希大公成为奥匈帝国皇位的推定继承人。
description.en: After the death of Crown Prince Rudolf, his uncle Archduke Karl Ludwig became the heir presumptive to the Austro-Hungarian throne.

description.zh-cn: 卡尔·路德维希大公是弗朗茨·约瑟夫一世皇帝的弟弟。
description.en: Archduke Karl Ludwig was the younger brother of Emperor Franz Joseph I.

description.zh-cn: 在成为推定继承人几天后，卡尔·路德维希大公放弃继承权，将其转给长子弗朗茨·斐迪南大公。
description.en: A few days after becoming the heir presumptive, Archduke Karl Ludwig renounced his succession rights in favor of his eldest son, Archduke Franz Ferdinand.

description.zh-cn: 弗朗茨·斐迪南大公是卡尔·路德维希大公的长子。
description.en: Archduke Franz Ferdinand was the eldest son of Archduke Karl Ludwig.

description.zh-cn: 加夫里洛·普林齐普刺杀弗朗茨·斐迪南大公，导致卡尔一世成为皇位推定继承人。
description.en: Gavrilo Princip's assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand led to Charles I becoming the heir presumptive to the throne.

description.zh-cn: 卡尔一世是卡尔·路德维希大公的孙子。
description.en: Charles I was the grandson of Archduke Karl Ludwig.

description.zh-cn: 该决定授权全国人民代表大会常务委员会制定《香港国安法》。
description.en: This decision authorized the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress to enact the Hong Kong National Security Law.

description.zh-cn: 警方国安处依据《香港国安法》，以“颠覆国家政权罪”为由对参与民主派初选的人士进行大规模拘捕。
description.en: Citing the Hong Kong National Security Law, the National Security Department of the police conducted large-scale arrests of participants in the pro-democracy primaries on charges of 'subversion'.

description.zh-cn: 警方国安处依据《香港国安法》对《苹果日报》高层进行拘捕并冻结其资产，最终导致该报于2021年6月24日停刊。
description.en: The National Security Department of the police arrested senior executives of Apple Daily and froze its assets under the Hong Kong National Security Law, ultimately leading to the newspaper's closure on June 24, 2021.

description.zh-cn: 警方国安处以“串谋发布煽动刊物罪”拘捕《立场新闻》多名高层，导致该媒体于同日停止运作。
description.en: The National Security Department of the police arrested several senior executives of Stand News for 'conspiracy to publish seditious materials', causing the media outlet to cease operations on the same day.

description.zh-cn: 在《港区国安法》实施后的政治环境下，曾为香港民主派第二大政党的公民党于2023年5月27日宣布解散。
description.en: In the political climate following the implementation of the National Security Law, the Civic Party, once the second-largest pro-democracy party in Hong Kong, announced its dissolution on May 27, 2023.

description.zh-cn: 因《港区国安法》的实施，认为继续任职会被视作为背弃政治自由的政权背书，故宣布辞职。
description.en: Resigned due to the implementation of the National Security Law, believing that continued service would be seen as an endorsement of a regime that has departed from political freedom.

description.zh-cn: 因《港区国安法》的实施，与英国最高法院院长韦彦德一同宣布辞去香港终审法院非常任法官职务。
description.en: Resigned as a non-permanent judge of the Hong Kong Court of Final Appeal along with Lord Reed, President of the UK Supreme Court, due to the implementation of the National Security Law.

description.zh-cn: 于2024年6月辞任香港终审法院非常任法官，并公开撰文称香港法治因《国安法》而岌岌可危。
