description.en: Resigned as a non-permanent judge of the Hong Kong Court of Final Appeal in June 2024 and publicly wrote that the rule of law in Hong Kong is in grave danger due to the National Security Law.

description.zh-cn: 在辞任终审法院非常任法官后，于英国《金融时报》撰文批评《港区国安法》严重限制法官的决策自由，并指香港正步入极权社会。
description.en: After resigning as a Non-Permanent Judge of the Court of Final Appeal, he wrote an article in the Financial Times criticizing the National Security Law for severely restricting judges' freedom of decision and stating that Hong Kong is becoming a totalitarian state.

description.zh-cn: 向香港高等法院申请禁制令，要求禁止以任何方式广播、传播或发布歌曲《愿荣光归香港》。
description.en: Applied to the Hong Kong High Court for an injunction to prohibit the broadcast, dissemination, or publication of the song 'Glory to Hong Kong' in any manner.

description.zh-cn: 作为时任行政长官，担任香港特别行政区维护国家安全委员会的首任主席。
description.en: As the then Chief Executive, served as the inaugural Chairperson of the Committee for Safeguarding National Security of the HKSAR.

description.zh-cn: 作为行政长官，担任香港特别行政区维护国家安全委员会主席。
description.en: As Chief Executive, serves as the Chairperson of the Committee for Safeguarding National Security of the HKSAR.

description.zh-cn: 姚依林在中共十三届一中全会上当选为中央政治局常委。他同时兼任第七届国务院副总理。
description.en: Yao Yilin was elected as a member of the Politburo Standing Committee at the First Plenary Session of the 13th Central Committee of the CCP. Concurrently, he served as Vice Premier of the 7th State Council.

description.zh-cn: 姚依林曾两度担任国家计划委员会主任。
description.en: Yao Yilin served twice as the Director of the State Planning Commission.

description.zh-cn: 姚依林长期担任国务院副总理，分管经济工作。
description.en: Yao Yilin served as Vice Premier of the State Council for a long time, in charge of economic work.

description.zh-cn: 周彬是姚依林的第一任妻子。
description.en: Zhou Bin was the first wife of Yao Yilin.

description.zh-cn: 1934年考入清华大学化学系。
description.en: Admitted to the Department of Chemistry at Tsinghua University in 1934.

description.zh-cn: 1937年左右考入南开大学经济系学习。
description.en: Enrolled in the Department of Economics at Nankai University around 1937.

description.zh-cn: 服役期间参与了中国抗日战争和第二次国共内战。
description.en: During his service, he participated in the Second Sino-Japanese War and the Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 周小舟介绍姚依林加入中国共产党。
description.en: Zhou Xiaozhou introduced Yao Yilin to join the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 姚依林在文化大革命期间受到严重迫害，直到1973年才复出工作。
description.en: Yao Yilin was severely persecuted during the Cultural Revolution and did not return to work until 1973.

description.zh-cn: 姚依林反对华国锋提出的“两个凡是”方针。
description.en: Yao Yilin opposed the "Two Whatevers" policy proposed by Hua Guofeng.

description.zh-cn: 姚依林坚决支持对学生运动采取军事镇压，是唯一一位没有与学生对话的政治局常委。
description.en: Yao Yilin firmly supported the military suppression of the student movement and was the only Politburo Standing Committee member who did not engage in dialogue with the students.

description.zh-cn: 姚依林担任中央政治局常委期间，江泽民是中共中央总书记。
description.en: While Yao Yilin was a member of the Politburo Standing Committee, Jiang Zemin was the General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 姚依林在担任国家计划委员会主任和国务院副总理期间，李鹏是国务院总理。
description.en: While Yao Yilin served as Director of the State Planning Commission and Vice Premier, Li Peng was the Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 姚依林在担任中央办公厅主任、商业部长和国务院副总理期间，华国锋是党主席或国务院总理。
description.en: While Yao Yilin served as Director of the General Office of the Central Committee, Minister of Commerce, and Vice Premier, Hua Guofeng was the Party Chairman or Premier.

description.zh-cn: 姚依林担任中央办公厅主任期间，胡耀邦是中共中央主席。
description.en: While Yao Yilin was Director of the General Office of the Central Committee, Hu Yaobang was the Chairman of the CCP Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 段宜康是民主进步党的党员，并曾代表该党担任多项公职。
description.en: Duan Yi-kang is a member of the Democratic Progressive Party and has held several public offices on behalf of the party.

description.zh-cn: 段宜康曾担任新潮流系的总召，后于2005年12月辞去该职务。
description.en: Duan Yi-kang previously served as the convener of the New Tide faction, a position he resigned from in December 2005.

description.zh-cn: 1988年，段宜康担任时任《民进报》总编辑林浊水的助理。
description.en: In 1988, Duan Yi-kang worked as an assistant to Lin Cho-shui, who was the editor-in-chief of the DPP News.

position.zh-cn: 联合助理、台南服务处主任
position.en: Joint Assistant, Tainan Service Office Director

description.zh-cn: 1991年，段宜康担任立法委员洪奇昌、卢修一、叶菊兰的联合助理，同年亦担任洪奇昌台南服务处主任。
description.en: In 1991, Duan Yi-kang served as a joint assistant to legislators Hung Chi-chang, Lu Hsiu-yi, and Yeh Chu-lan. In the same year, he also served as the director of Hung Chi-chang's Tainan service office.

description.zh-cn: 1993年，段宜康在高植澎当选澎湖县长后，担任其特别助理。
description.en: In 1993, after Kao Chih-peng was elected Magistrate of Penghu County, Duan Yi-kang served as his special assistant.

description.zh-cn: 段宜康在2014年11月指控时任国民党立委的林沧敏涉及中华民国曲棍球协会弊案，并引发了“吞曲棍球”的赌注争议。林沧敏后对此提起诉讼。
description.en: In November 2014, Duan Yi-kang accused then-KMT legislator Lin Tsang-min of being involved in a corruption case concerning the Chinese Taipei Hockey Association, leading to a controversial bet involving 'swallowing hockey pucks'. Lin later filed a lawsuit in response.

description.zh-cn: 段宜康指控2014年彰化县长候选人黄文玲与国民党候选人林沧敏共用金主萧景田。黄文玲因此对段宜康提起诉讼，最终法院改判段宜康无罪。
description.en: Duan Yi-kang accused Huang Wen-ling, a 2014 candidate for Changhua County Magistrate, of sharing the same financial backer, Hsiao Ching-tien, with KMT candidate Lin Tsang-min. Huang sued Duan for these remarks, and the court ultimately acquitted Duan.

description.zh-cn: 根据段宜康的指控，萧景田在2014年彰化县长选举中资助了候选人黄文玲。
description.en: According to allegations by Duan Yi-kang, Hsiao Ching-tien financially backed candidate Huang Wen-ling in the 2014 Changhua County magistrate election.

description.zh-cn: 根据段宜康的指控，萧景田在2014年彰化县长选举中资助了候选人林沧敏。
description.en: According to allegations by Duan Yi-kang, Hsiao Ching-tien financially backed candidate Lin Tsang-min in the 2014 Changhua County magistrate election.

description.zh-cn: 2016年10月，因台湾菜价高涨，段宜康指控时任台北农产运销公司总经理的韩国瑜为“菜虫”（意指市场中牟取暴利者），引发激烈争论。
description.en: In October 2016, amid soaring vegetable prices in Taiwan, Duan Yi-kang accused Han Kuo-yu, then the general manager of the Taipei Agricultural Products Marketing Corporation, of being a 'vegetable worm' (a term for a market profiteer), which triggered a heated dispute.

description.zh-cn: 2018年5月，因陈之汉批评政府对外捐款，段宜康在社交媒体上发文回击，双方爆发激烈网络论战。
description.en: In May 2018, after Holger Chen criticized the government's foreign aid donations, Duan Yi-kang responded on social media, leading to a fierce online feud between the two.

description.zh-cn: 2012年5月，段宜康在立法院质询时，批评时任文化部长龙应台为“厚脸皮”、“花瓶”，导致龙应台一度离席抗议，双方关系紧张。
description.en: In May 2012, during a legislative interpellation, Duan Yi-kang criticized then-Minister of Culture Lung Ying-tai as 'thick-skinned' and a 'vase', causing Lung to walk out in protest and creating tension between them.

description.zh-cn: 孝定景皇后是光绪帝的嫡妻皇后。
description.en: Empress Xiaodingjing was the primary empress consort of the Guangxu Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 因慈禧太后强行指定婚事，光绪帝厌恶孝定景皇后，夫妻关系不睦。
description.en: Due to the marriage being arranged against his will by Empress Dowager Cixi, the Guangxu Emperor disliked Empress Xiaodingjing, leading to a strained marital relationship.

description.zh-cn: 孝定景皇后是慈禧太后之弟桂祥的女儿，即慈禧太后的侄女。
description.en: Empress Xiaodingjing was the daughter of Guixiang, the younger brother of Empress Dowager Cixi, making her Cixi's niece.

description.zh-cn: 慈禧太后选定自己的侄女叶赫那拉氏为光绪帝的皇后，以便监视光绪帝。
description.en: Empress Dowager Cixi selected her niece, the future Empress Xiaodingjing, to be the Guangxu Emperor's empress in order to monitor his actions.

description.zh-cn: 孝定景皇后是桂祥的长女。
description.en: Empress Xiaodingjing was the eldest daughter of Guixiang.

description.zh-cn: 桂祥是慈禧太后的弟弟。
description.en: Guixiang was the younger brother of Empress Dowager Cixi.

description.zh-cn: 光绪帝驾崩后，孝定景皇后成为宣统帝溥仪的养母，并负责抚养他。
description.en: After the death of the Guangxu Emperor, Empress Xiaodingjing became the adoptive mother of the Xuantong Emperor Puyi and was responsible for raising him.

description.zh-cn: 在宣统帝年幼时，作为皇太后垂帘听政，代行国家最高统治权。
description.en: During the Xuantong Emperor's childhood, she ruled as Empress Dowager regent, exercising supreme state power on his behalf.

description.zh-cn: 该诏书的颁布标志着清朝统治的正式结束。
description.en: The promulgation of this edict marked the official end of the Qing dynasty's rule.

description.zh-cn: 该诏书的颁布结束了中国两千多年的君主专制政体。
description.en: The promulgation of this edict ended more than two millennia of absolute monarchy in China.

description.zh-cn: 退位诏书将统治权移交给中华民国，为其全国统治提供了法理依据。
description.en: The abdication edict transferred sovereignty to the Republic of China, providing it with a legal basis for national rule.

description.zh-cn: 隆裕太后逝世后，北洋政府为其举行了高规格的国葬，并通告全国下半旗致哀三日。
description.en: After Empress Dowager Longyu's death, the Beiyang Government held a high-profile state funeral for her and ordered national flags to be flown at half-mast for three days in mourning.

description.zh-cn: 在隆裕太后逝世后，时任副总统黎元洪致唁电称赞其“德至功高，女中尧舜”。
description.en: After the death of Empress Dowager Longyu, then Vice President Li Yuanhong sent a condolence telegram praising her as having 'the virtue of Yao and Shun among women'.

description.zh-cn: 珍妃是光绪帝宠爱的妃子。
description.en: Consort Zhen was a favored consort of the Guangxu Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 光绪帝厌恶皇后而独宠珍妃，导致皇后与珍妃关系不睦。
description.en: The Guangxu Emperor's dislike for the empress and exclusive favor towards Consort Zhen led to an antagonistic relationship between the two women.

description.zh-cn: 八国联军攻入北京后，孝定景皇后与瑾妃一同随慈禧太后、光绪帝逃往西安。
description.en: After the Eight-Nation Alliance entered Beijing, Empress Xiaodingjing, along with Consort Jin, fled to Xi'an with Empress Dowager Cixi and the Guangxu Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 在东北爆发鼠疫期间，隆裕太后任命伍连德为全权总医官，负责防疫救治。
description.en: During the Manchurian plague outbreak, Empress Dowager Longyu appointed Wu Lien-teh as the chief medical officer with full authority to lead epidemic prevention and treatment efforts.

description.zh-cn: 作为清政府的最高统治者，隆裕太后领导了对东北鼠疫的防疫工作，并最终宣布疫情被肃清。
description.en: As the supreme ruler of the Qing government, Empress Dowager Longyu led the efforts to combat the Manchurian plague and eventually declared the epidemic eradicated.

description.zh-cn: 齐威王封邹忌为下邳的成侯。
description.en: King Wei of Qi enfeoffed Zou Ji as Marquis Cheng of Xiapī.

description.zh-cn: 被封为下邳的成侯。
description.en: Was enfeoffed as Marquis Cheng of Xiapī.

description.zh-cn: 因邹忌被封于此，该地开始称为“下邳”。
description.en: Because Zou Ji was enfeoffed here, the place began to be called 'Xiapī'.

description.zh-cn: 韩信成为楚王后，将楚国国都定在下邳。
description.en: After becoming the King of Chu, Han Xin established the capital of his kingdom at Xiapī.

description.zh-cn: 公元72年，汉明帝成立了下邳国。
description.en: In 72 AD, Emperor Ming of Han established the Kingdom of Xiapī.

description.zh-cn: 汉明帝封他的儿子刘衍为下邳王。
description.en: Emperor Ming of Han enfeoffed his son Liu Yan as the King of Xiapī.

description.zh-cn: 刘衍是下邳国的第一任国王。
description.en: Liu Yan was the first king of the Kingdom of Xiapī.

description.zh-cn: 在东汉与西晋时期，下邳是下邳国的治所。
description.en: During the Eastern Han and Western Jin dynasties, Xiapī was the administrative center of the Kingdom of Xiapī.

description.zh-cn: 隋朝时期，下邳郡的治所是宿豫。
description.en: During the Sui dynasty, the administrative center of Xiapī Commandery was Suyu.

description.zh-cn: 清朝年间的郯城大地震导致下邳都城由古邳镇迁往今天的邳州市。
description.en: The Tancheng earthquake during the Qing dynasty caused the capital of Xiapī to be moved from Gupi Town to modern-day Pizhou.

description.zh-cn: 曹长青出生于黑龙江省北安市。
description.en: Cao Changqing was born in Bei'an, Heilongjiang Province.

description.zh-cn: 曹长青在1996年前为中华人民共和国公民。
description.en: Cao Changqing was a citizen of the People's Republic of China before 1996.

description.zh-cn: 曹长青于1996年归化成为美国公民。
description.en: Cao Changqing became a naturalized US citizen in 1996.

description.zh-cn: 1982年毕业于黑龙江大学中文系。
description.en: Graduated from the Department of Chinese at Heilongjiang University in 1982.

description.zh-cn: 曹长青因反对中共政权而移民美国，并持续发表文章批判中国共产党。
description.en: Cao Changqing immigrated to the United States due to his opposition to the CCP regime and continues to publish articles criticizing the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 曹长青的政治立场偏向极右派，拥护保守主义。
description.en: Cao Changqing's political stance is far-right, and he supports conservatism.

description.zh-cn: 曹长青支持美国共和党。
description.en: Cao Changqing supports the US Republican Party.

description.zh-cn: 曹长青支持台湾独立运动。
description.en: Cao Changqing supports the Taiwan independence movement.

description.zh-cn: 曹长青曾专访过华罗庚。
description.en: Cao Changqing once interviewed Hua Luogeng.

description.zh-cn: 曹长青曾专访过刘绍棠。
description.en: Cao Changqing once interviewed Liu Shaotang.

description.zh-cn: 曹长青于1988年赴美后遭中国取消护照。
description.en: After Cao Changqing went to the US in 1988, his Chinese passport was cancelled.

description.zh-cn: 曹长青在洛杉矶创办《新闻自由导报》，并于1990年离开。
description.en: Cao Changqing founded the 'Press Freedom Herald' in Los Angeles and left in 1990.

description.zh-cn: 曹长青支持郭文贵的政治庇护申请，并力挺其爆料行为。
description.en: Cao Changqing supported Guo Wengui's political asylum application and strongly endorsed his whistleblowing activities.

description.zh-cn: 曹长青称，蔡英文曾打电话向《自由时报》高层要求撤下其专栏，导致其后续文章受限，最终停止为该报撰稿。
description.en: Cao Changqing claimed that Tsai Ing-wen called senior executives at the Liberty Times to demand the removal of his column, which led to restrictions on his subsequent articles and his eventual cessation of writing for the paper.

description.zh-cn: 在2016年美国总统大选前，曹长青多次撰文批评共和党候选人川普，将他与墨索里尼和希特勒相提并论。
description.en: Before the 2016 US presidential election, Cao Changqing wrote multiple articles criticizing Republican candidate Donald Trump, comparing him to Mussolini and Hitler.

description.zh-cn: 在川普赢得2016年大选后，曹长青改变立场，成为其狂热支持者。
description.en: After Trump won the 2016 election, Cao Changqing changed his stance and became his ardent supporter.

description.zh-cn: 美籍华人作家哈金在其小说《折腾到底》的扉页上，明确表示要将该小说献给曹长青。
description.en: Chinese-American writer Ha Jin dedicated his novel 'The Boat Rocker' to Cao Changqing on its title page.

description.zh-cn: 流亡美国的中国富商郭文贵称赞曹长青是“中华民族的真男人”。
description.en: Exiled Chinese businessman Guo Wengui praised Cao Changqing as a 'true man of the Chinese nation'.

description.zh-cn: 佐治亚理工学院是乔治亚大学系统的成员之一。
description.en: Georgia Institute of Technology is a member of the University System of Georgia.

description.zh-cn: 佐治亚理工学院是大西洋沿岸联盟的成员学校之一。
description.en: Georgia Institute of Technology is a member school of the Atlantic Coast Conference.

description.zh-cn: 2010年4月20日，佐治亚理工学院应邀加入美国大学协会。
description.en: On April 20, 2010, Georgia Institute of Technology was invited to join the Association of American Universities.

description.zh-cn: 佐治亚理工学院为1996年亚特兰大夏季奥运会建造了奥运村等设施，对赛事的顺利召开起到了重要作用。
description.en: Georgia Institute of Technology contributed significantly to the 1996 Atlanta Summer Olympics by constructing facilities such as the Olympic Village, playing an important role in the successful hosting of the event.

description.zh-cn: 吉米·卡特是佐治亚理工学院1946届校友。
description.en: Jimmy Carter is an alumnus of Georgia Institute of Technology, class of 1946.

description.zh-cn: 凯利·穆利斯是佐治亚理工学院1964届校友。
description.en: Kary Mullis is an alumnus of Georgia Institute of Technology, class of 1964.

description.zh-cn: 凯利·穆利斯发明了聚合酶链式反应（PCR），并因此获得诺贝尔化学奖。
description.en: Kary Mullis invented the polymerase chain reaction (PCR), for which he was awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry.

description.zh-cn: 胡安·卡洛斯·瓦雷拉是佐治亚理工学院1985届校友。
description.en: Juan Carlos Varela is an alumnus of Georgia Institute of Technology, class of 1985.

degree.en: Master in Electrical and Computer Engineering

description.zh-cn: 刘伟毕业于佐治亚理工学院，获得电子计算机工程硕士学位。
description.en: Liu Wei graduated from Georgia Institute of Technology with a master's degree in Electrical and Computer Engineering.

description.zh-cn: 刘伟是米哈游公司的联合创始人之一。
description.en: Liu Wei is one of the co-founders of miHoYo.

description.zh-cn: 佐治亚理工学院与天津大学合作在深圳设立了天津大学佐治亚理工深圳学院。
description.en: Georgia Institute of Technology co-founded the Georgia Tech Shenzhen Institute, Tianjin University in Shenzhen in cooperation with Tianjin University.

description.zh-cn: 1979年毕业于解放军外国语学院。
description.en: Graduated from the PLA Foreign Language Institute in 1979.

description.zh-cn: 1988年获北京外国语学院俄语系硕士学位。
description.en: Received a Master's degree in Russian from Beijing Foreign Studies University in 1988.

position.zh-cn: 教员、第一系主任、教务长、副院长、院长
position.en: Instructor, Head of the First Department, Dean of Academic Affairs, Vice President, President

description.zh-cn: 毕业后留校任教，并历任多个领导职务。
description.en: After graduation, he stayed on to teach and held various leadership positions.

description.zh-cn: 自2010年起担任第二炮兵部队副司令员，并在2015年部队改制为火箭军后继续担任副司令员，直至2020年退役。
description.en: Served as Deputy Commander of the Second Artillery Force since 2010, and continued in the role after its restructuring into the Rocket Force in 2015, until his retirement in 2020.

description.zh-cn: 吴国华的逝世时间与火箭军腐败案曝光时间相近，其死因（传闻为自杀）被外界认为可能与该案有关。
description.en: The timing of Wu Guohua's death coincided with the exposure of the Rocket Force corruption case, and his cause of death (rumored to be suicide) is considered by outsiders to be potentially related to the case.

description.zh-cn: 作为内阁首辅，杨士奇是仁宣之治核心政策的主要制定者和推动者。
description.en: As the head of the Grand Secretariat, Yang Shiqi was a primary architect and promoter of the core policies of the Reign of Ren and Xuan.

description.zh-cn: 作为内阁大学士，杨荣是仁宣之治的重要辅臣。
description.en: As a Grand Secretary, Yang Rong was an important supporting minister of the Reign of Ren and Xuan.

description.zh-cn: 作为内阁大学士，杨溥是仁宣之治的重要辅臣。
description.en: As a Grand Secretary, Yang Pu was an important supporting minister of the Reign of Ren and Xuan.

description.zh-cn: 作为户部尚书，夏原吉在仁宣时期的财政和民生政策中发挥了关键作用。
description.en: As Minister of Revenue, Xia Yuanji played a key role in the fiscal and livelihood policies of the Ren-Xuan period.

description.zh-cn: 作为吏部尚书，蹇义在仁宣时期的官员任免和吏治整顿中发挥了重要作用。
description.en: As Minister of Personnel, Jian Yi played an important role in the appointment, dismissal, and rectification of officials during the Ren-Xuan period.

description.zh-cn: 明仁宗即位后，将尚在狱中的夏原吉释放并恢复其户部尚书原职。
description.en: After ascending the throne, the Hongxi Emperor released Xia Yuanji from prison and restored him to his original post as Minister of Revenue.

description.zh-cn: 明宣宗以皇后无子多病为由，废黜了胡善祥的皇后之位。
description.en: The Xuande Emperor deposed Empress Hu Shanxiang on the grounds of her being childless and frequently ill.

description.zh-cn: 在张太皇太后去世、三杨年老后，王振开始独揽大权，干预朝政。
description.en: After the death of Grand Empress Dowager Zhang and as the Three Yangs aged, Wang Zhen began to monopolize power and interfere in court politics.

description.zh-cn: 王振的擅政导致明朝政治腐败，仁宣之治所创造的基业也随之衰退。
description.en: Wang Zhen's usurpation of power led to political corruption in the Ming dynasty, causing the decline of the achievements established during the Reign of Ren and Xuan.

description.zh-cn: 当张太皇太后欲处死王振时，年幼的明英宗跪下求情，使其得以幸免。
description.en: When Grand Empress Dowager Zhang intended to execute Wang Zhen, the young Emperor Yingzong knelt and pleaded for him, allowing him to be spared.

description.zh-cn: 全国人大常委会委员长位列国家级正职。
description.en: The Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress holds a national-level positive rank.

description.zh-cn: 全国人大常委会委员长是党和国家领导人之一。
description.en: The Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress is one of the leaders of the Party and the State.

description.zh-cn: 全国人大常委会委员长由全国人民代表大会选举产生，并向其负责。
description.en: The Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress is elected by and responsible to the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 全国人民代表大会会议主席团负责提名全国人大常委会委员长的人选。
description.en: The Presidium of the National People's Congress is responsible for nominating candidates for the Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 全国人大常委会委员长的人选根据中共中央的建议进行提名。
description.en: The candidate for the Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress is nominated based on the recommendation of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 全国人大常委会委员长由全国人民代表大会选举产生。
description.en: The Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress is elected by the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 在国家主席废除时期（1975-1982），全国人大常委会委员长曾行使部分国家元首职权，提升了该职位的实际地位和权力。
description.en: During the period when the state presidency was abolished (1975-1982), the Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress exercised some of the powers of the head of state, which enhanced the actual status and power of the position.

description.zh-cn: 1954年宪法正式设立了全国人民代表大会常务委员会委员长一职。
description.en: The 1954 Constitution formally established the position of Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 1975年宪法规定由全国人民代表大会常务委员会集体行使国家元首职权。
description.en: The 1975 Constitution stipulated that the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress would collectively exercise the powers of the head of state.

description.zh-cn: 1982年宪法重新设立了中华人民共和国主席职位。
description.en: The 1982 Constitution re-established the office of the President of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1978年宪法明确将“接受外国使节”等国家元首职权规定为委员长的职权。
description.en: The 1978 Constitution explicitly stipulated powers of the head of state, such as "receiving foreign envoys," as the powers of the Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 自1993年乔石当选委员长起，该职务一直由中共中央政治局常委担任。
description.en: Since Qiao Shi was elected Chairman in 1993, this position has been held by a member of the Standing Committee of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 自1993年起，全国人大常委会委员长职务一直由中共中央政治局常委担任。
description.en: Since 1993, the position of Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress has been held by a member of the Standing Committee of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 自1993年起，全国人大常委会委员长职务一直由中共中央政治局常委担任。
description.en: Since 1993, the position of Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress has been held by a member of the Standing Committee of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 自1993年起，全国人大常委会委员长职务一直由中共中央政治局常委担任。
description.en: Since 1993, the position of Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress has been held by a member of the Standing Committee of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 该人物曾担任中共十九届中央政治局常委。根据惯例，全国人大常委会委员长职务自1993年起由中共中央政治局常委担任，该人物亦在此期间担任此职。
description.en: This individual served as a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the 19th CPC Central Committee. According to convention, the position of Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress has been held by a member of the Standing Committee of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee since 1993, and this individual also held this position during this period.

description.zh-cn: 胡正出生于山西灵石。
description.en: Hu Zheng was born in Lingshi, Shanxi.

description.zh-cn: 胡正是山药蛋派的成员。
description.en: Hu Zheng was a member of the Shanyaodan School.

description.zh-cn: 胡正曾担任山西省文学艺术界联合会副主席。
description.en: Hu Zheng formerly served as the Vice Chairman of the Shanxi Federation of Literary and Art Circles.

description.zh-cn: 胡正曾担任山西省作家协会副主席。
description.en: Hu Zheng formerly served as the Vice Chairman of the Shanxi Writers Association.

description.zh-cn: 胡正是中国作家协会名誉委员。
description.en: Hu Zheng was an honorary member of the China Writers Association.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，胡正是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to Wikipedia categories, Hu Zheng was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 戴笠是忠义救国军的著名指挥官，并兼任首任总指挥。
description.en: Dai Li was a famous commander of the Loyal and Righteous Army and also served as its first Commander-in-Chief.

description.zh-cn: 忠义救国军效忠于中国国民党。
description.en: The Loyal and Righteous Army was loyal to the Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 忠义救国军是国民政府军事委员会下辖的部队。
description.en: The Loyal and Righteous Army was a unit under the Military Affairs Commission of the Nationalist Government.

description.zh-cn: 1938年5月，苏浙行动委员会别働队改名为国民政府军事委员会忠义救国军。
description.en: In May 1938, the Commando Unit of the Suzhe Action Committee was renamed the Loyal and Righteous Army of the Military Affairs Commission of the Nationalist Government.

description.zh-cn: 淞沪战役爆发后，蒋中正下令成立了苏浙行动委员会以组织敌后武装。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Battle of Shanghai, Chiang Kai-shek ordered the establishment of the Suzhe Action Committee to organize armed forces behind enemy lines.

description.zh-cn: 1937年9月4日，蒋中正电令在上海成立苏浙行动委员会。
description.en: On September 4, 1937, Chiang Kai-shek ordered the establishment of the Suzhe Action Committee in Shanghai via telegram.

description.zh-cn: 忠义救国军作为敌后游击部队参与了中国抗日战争。
description.en: The Loyal and Righteous Army participated in the Second Sino-Japanese War as a guerrilla force behind enemy lines.

description.zh-cn: 忠义救国军参与了第二次国共内战。
description.en: The Loyal and Righteous Army participated in the Second Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 1943年起，中美合作所为忠义救国军提供训练和美式装备，提升其战斗力。
description.en: Starting in 1943, the Sino-American Cooperative Organization provided training and American equipment to the Loyal and Righteous Army, enhancing its combat capabilities.

description.zh-cn: 1941年，忠义救国军与新四军第六师发生摩擦。
description.en: In 1941, the Loyal and Righteous Army had frictions with the New Fourth Army's 6th Division.

description.zh-cn: 1947年3月8日，时任保密局局长郑介民派遣刘戈青前往台湾处理二二八事件相关事宜。
description.en: On March 8, 1947, Zheng Jiemin, then director of the Secrecy Bureau, dispatched Liu Geqing to Taiwan to handle matters related to the February 28 Incident.

description.zh-cn: 刘戈青抵达台湾后，召集人员组织了忠义救国军别动队以执行清乡任务。
description.en: After arriving in Taiwan, Liu Geqing gathered personnel to organize commando units of the Loyal and Righteous Army to carry out rural pacification tasks.

description.zh-cn: 刘戈青是保密局（军统）的人员。
description.en: Liu Geqing was an agent of the Secrecy Bureau (Juntong).

description.zh-cn: 郑介民是国民政府军事委员会调查统计局后续机构保密局的局长。
description.en: Zheng Jiemin was the director of the Secrecy Bureau, the successor organization to the Bureau of Investigation and Statistics of the Military Affairs Commission.

description.zh-cn: 忠义救国军（及其前身）的早期成员有许多来自杜月笙领导的青帮势力。
description.en: Many early members of the Loyal and Righteous Army (and its predecessor) came from the Green Gang forces led by Du Yuesheng.

description.zh-cn: 湖北省汉江中级人民法院的上诉法院和业务上级是湖北省高级人民法院，并直接隶属于其管理。
description.en: The appellate court and professional superior of the Hubei Provincial Hanjiang Intermediate People's Court is the Hubei Provincial High People's Court, to which it is directly subordinate.

description.zh-cn: 湖北省汉江中级人民法院的组织上级是湖北省人民代表大会，并受其监督。
description.en: The organizational superior of the Hubei Provincial Hanjiang Intermediate People's Court is the Hubei Provincial People's Congress, and it is supervised by it.

description.zh-cn: 湖北省汉江中级人民法院的中共上级是中国共产党湖北省委员会。
description.en: The superior CCP organization of the Hubei Provincial Hanjiang Intermediate People's Court is the Hubei Provincial Committee of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 《中华人民共和国宪法》是湖北省汉江中级人民法院的授权法源。
description.en: The Constitution of the People's Republic of China is the authorizing legal source for the Hubei Provincial Hanjiang Intermediate People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 《中华人民共和国人民法院组织法》是湖北省汉江中级人民法院的组织法规。
description.en: The Organic Law of the People's Courts of the People's Republic of China is the organizational statute for the Hubei Provincial Hanjiang Intermediate People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 湖北省汉江中级人民法院的设立得到了最高人民法院的同意。
description.en: The establishment of the Hubei Provincial Hanjiang Intermediate People's Court was approved by the Supreme People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 中央机构编制委员会于1999年10月18日批准设立湖北省汉江中级人民法院。
description.en: The Central Organization Establishment Committee approved the establishment of the Hubei Provincial Hanjiang Intermediate People's Court on October 18, 1999.

description.zh-cn: 湖北省汉江中级人民法院审理了原国务院国有资产监督管理委员会主任蒋洁敏受贿、巨额财产来源不明案。
description.en: The Hubei Provincial Hanjiang Intermediate People's Court tried the case of Jiang Jiemin, former Director of the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission, for bribery and having a huge amount of property with unidentified sources.

description.zh-cn: 蒋洁敏曾担任国务院国有资产监督管理委员会主任。
description.en: Jiang Jiemin served as the Director of the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 刘强担任中国共产党济南市委员会书记。
description.en: Liu Qiang serves as the Secretary of the Jinan Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 于海田担任济南市人民政府市长。
description.en: Yu Haitian serves as the Mayor of the Jinan Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 韩金峰担任济南市人民代表大会常务委员会主任。
description.en: Han Jinfeng serves as the Director of the Standing Committee of the Jinan Municipal People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 雷杰担任中国人民政治协商会议济南市委员会主席。
description.en: Lei Jie serves as the Chairwoman of the Jinan Municipal Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 日本借口北伐军“抢劫”日本侨民，出兵济南，蓄意屠杀中国军民，引发五三惨案。
description.en: Japan used the pretext of the Northern Expeditionary Army 'looting' Japanese civilians to dispatch troops to Jinan, deliberately massacring Chinese soldiers and civilians, which triggered the Jinan Incident.

description.zh-cn: 在五三惨案中，国民政府外交部特派山东交涉员蔡公时及署内职员17人被日军虐杀。
description.en: During the Jinan Incident, Cai Gongshi, a special commissioner of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Nationalist Government, and 17 staff members were brutally killed by the Japanese army.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军发动济南战役并占领济南。
description.en: The People's Liberation Army launched the Jinan Campaign and occupied Jinan.

description.zh-cn: 济南市是龙山文化的发现地，该文化于1928年在今济南市章丘区龙山街道的城子崖遗址首次被发现。
description.en: Jinan is the discovery site of the Longshan culture, which was first discovered in 1928 at the Chengziya site in today's Longshan Subdistrict, Zhangqiu District, Jinan.

description.zh-cn: 根据1892年的“专属协定”，停战诸酋长国成为英国的保护国，英国负责其防务和外交事务，直至1971年条约终止。
description.en: Under the 'Exclusive Agreements' of 1892, the Trucial States became a British protectorate, with Britain handling their defense and foreign affairs until the treaty's termination in 1971.

description.zh-cn: 其领导的英国政府宣布决定终止与停战诸酋长国的条约关系，从而结束了英国的保护国地位。
description.en: His government announced the decision to terminate the treaty relationship with the Trucial States, thereby ending its status as a British protectorate.

description.zh-cn: 阿布扎比酋长国是1971年12月2日组成阿拉伯联合酋长国的六个创始酋长国之一。
description.en: The Emirate of Abu Dhabi was one of the six founding emirates that formed the United Arab Emirates on December 2, 1971.

description.zh-cn: 迪拜酋长国是1971年12月2日组成阿拉伯联合酋长国的六个创始酋长国之一。
description.en: The Emirate of Dubai was one of the six founding emirates that formed the United Arab Emirates on December 2, 1971.

description.zh-cn: 沙迦酋长国是1971年12月2日组成阿拉伯联合酋长国的六个创始酋长国之一。
description.en: The Emirate of Sharjah was one of the six founding emirates that formed the United Arab Emirates on December 2, 1971.

description.zh-cn: 阿治曼酋长国是1971年12月2日组成阿拉伯联合酋长国的六个创始酋长国之一。
description.en: The Emirate of Ajman was one of the six founding emirates that formed the United Arab Emirates on December 2, 1971.

description.zh-cn: 富查伊拉酋长国是1971年12月2日组成阿拉伯联合酋长国的六个创始酋长国之一。
description.en: The Emirate of Fujairah was one of the six founding emirates that formed the United Arab Emirates on December 2, 1971.

description.zh-cn: 乌姆盖万酋长国是1971年12月2日组成阿拉伯联合酋长国的六个创始酋长国之一。
description.en: The Emirate of Umm Al Quwain was one of the six founding emirates that formed the United Arab Emirates on December 2, 1971.

description.zh-cn: 哈伊马角酋长国于1972年1月10日正式加入阿拉伯联合酋长国联邦。
description.en: The Emirate of Ras Al Khaimah officially joined the federation of the United Arab Emirates on January 10, 1972.

description.zh-cn: 穆罕默德·本·扎耶德·阿勒纳哈扬于2022年就任阿拉伯联合酋长国总统。
description.en: Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan assumed the presidency of the United Arab Emirates in 2022.

description.zh-cn: 穆罕默德·本·扎耶德·阿勒纳哈扬是阿布扎比酋长国的酋长。
description.en: Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan is the Ruler of the Emirate of Abu Dhabi.

description.zh-cn: 穆罕默德·本·拉希德·阿勒马克图姆于2006年就任阿拉伯联合酋长国副总统兼总理。
description.en: Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum became the Vice President and Prime Minister of the United Arab Emirates in 2006.

description.zh-cn: 穆罕默德·本·拉希德·阿勒马克图姆是迪拜酋长国的酋长。
description.en: Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum is the Ruler of the Emirate of Dubai.

description.zh-cn: 沙迦酋长哈立德与伊朗达成协议，将阿布穆萨岛租予伊朗。
description.en: Sheikh Khalid of Sharjah reached an agreement with Iran to lease Abu Musa island to Iran.

description.zh-cn: 沙特阿拉伯曾声称对阿布扎比大片领土拥有主权，两国存在领土争端，直至1974年签署边界协议。
description.en: Saudi Arabia claimed sovereignty over large parts of Abu Dhabi's territory, leading to a territorial dispute that lasted until a border agreement was signed in 1974.

description.zh-cn: 阿拉伯联合酋长国是1981年5月成立的海湾合作委员会的创始成员国之一。
description.en: The United Arab Emirates was one of the founding members of the Gulf Cooperation Council, established in May 1981.

description.zh-cn: 阿拉伯联合酋长国于1972年12月6日加入阿拉伯联盟。
description.en: The United Arab Emirates joined the Arab League on December 6, 1972.

description.zh-cn: 阿拉伯联合酋长国于1972年12月9日成为联合国会员国。
description.en: The United Arab Emirates became a member of the United Nations on December 9, 1972.

description.zh-cn: 随着石油收入的增长，阿布扎比酋长扎耶德·阿勒纳哈扬开始推进大规模建设项目，兴建学校、住宅、医院与道路。
description.en: With growing oil revenues, Sheikh Zayed of Abu Dhabi began to advance large-scale construction projects, building schools, housing, hospitals, and roads.

description.zh-cn: 在1969年迪拜开始出口石油后，酋长拉希德利用石油收入推动经济多元化，将迪拜建设成现代化城市。
description.en: After Dubai began exporting oil in 1969, Sheikh Rashid used the revenue to drive economic diversification, building Dubai into a modern city.

description.zh-cn: 栗战书在中国社会科学院研究生院获得在职研究生学历。
description.en: Li Zhanshu obtained an in-service postgraduate qualification from the Graduate School of the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 栗战书在哈尔滨工业大学获得高级工商管理硕士学位。
description.en: Li Zhanshu obtained an Executive Master of Business Administration (EMBA) degree from Harbin Institute of Technology.

description.zh-cn: 1983年，时任无极县委书记的栗战书与邻近的正定县县委书记习近平相识并建立良好关系，后被视为习近平最信任的心腹之一。
description.en: In 1983, Li Zhanshu, then Party Secretary of Wuji County, became acquainted with Xi Jinping, Party Secretary of the neighboring Zhengding County, and established a good relationship. He was later regarded as one of Xi Jinping's most trusted confidants.

description.zh-cn: 栗战书与时任河北省委书记程维高的秘书李真产生矛盾，导致其在1997年12月被调任边缘职务。
description.en: Li Zhanshu had a conflict with Li Zhen, secretary to then-Hebei Party Secretary Cheng Weigao, which led to Li being transferred to a marginal post in December 1997.

description.zh-cn: 1982年，时任中共中央主席的胡耀邦批转了栗战书建议高唱《社会主义好》的信件，该信件随后在《人民日报》发表，使栗战书名声大增。
description.en: In 1982, then-CPC Chairman Hu Yaobang approved Li Zhanshu's letter suggesting the promotion of the song 'Socialism is Good'. The letter was subsequently published in the People's Daily, greatly increasing Li's fame.

description.zh-cn: 栗战书接替令计划，担任中共中央办公厅主任。
description.en: Li Zhanshu succeeded Ling Jihua as Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 由栗战书担任委员长的第十三届全国人大常委会于2019年12月28日通过决定，废止了收容教育制度。
description.en: On December 28, 2019, the 13th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, chaired by Li Zhanshu, passed a decision to abolish the re-education system.

description.zh-cn: 2022年9月访问俄罗斯时，栗战书表示中方理解俄方为维护国家核心利益所采取的行动，并从不同方面给予“策应”。
description.en: During a visit to Russia in September 2022, Li Zhanshu stated that China understands the actions taken by Russia to safeguard its core national interests and provides 'coordination' from various aspects.

description.zh-cn: 栗战书于1950年出生于河北省平山县。
description.en: Li Zhanshu was born in Pingshan County, Hebei province, in 1950.

description.zh-cn: 大跃进造成的严重后果促使中共中央召开七千人大会，以总结经验教训并纠正错误。
description.en: The severe consequences of the Great Leap Forward prompted the CPC Central Committee to convene the Seven Thousand Cadres Conference to summarize lessons learned and correct mistakes.

description.zh-cn: 在七千人大会上，大跃进的错误受到批评，毛泽东本人也作了自我批评，并在此后一度退居权力二线。
description.en: At the Seven Thousand Cadres Conference, the errors of the Great Leap Forward were criticized, Mao Zedong himself made a self-criticism, and subsequently retreated to the second line of power for a period.

description.zh-cn: 反右倾运动造成党内无人敢于讲真话，使得大跃进的错误政策未能及时刹车，并进一步助长了“跃进”风潮，加剧了灾难。
description.en: The Anti-Rightist campaign created a climate where no one in the party dared to speak the truth, preventing the timely correction of the Great Leap Forward's erroneous policies and further fueling the 'leap forward' trend, thus exacerbating the disaster.

description.zh-cn: 面对大跃进造成的严重后果，中共八届九中全会正式决定实行“调整、巩固、充实、提高”的八字方针。
description.en: Facing the severe consequences of the Great Leap Forward, the 9th Plenary Session of the 8th CPC Central Committee officially decided to implement the 'Eight-Character Policy' of 'Readjustment, Consolidation, Filling-out, and Raising standards'.

description.zh-cn: “鼓足干劲、力争上游、多快好省地建设社会主义”的总路线是“三面红旗”之一，为大跃进运动提供了核心的指导思想和政治动员口号。
description.en: The General Line of 'going all out, aiming high and achieving greater, faster, better and more economical results in building socialism' was one of the 'Three Red Banners', providing the core guiding ideology and political mobilization slogan for the Great Leap Forward.

description.zh-cn: 人民公社化运动是大跃进的重要组成部分和“三面红旗”之一，旨在农村地区建立集工农兵学商为一体的组织。
description.en: The People's Commune Movement was an important component of the Great Leap Forward and one of the 'Three Red Banners', aiming to establish organizations integrating industry, agriculture, military, education, and commerce in rural areas.

description.zh-cn: 在“大跃进”急于求成的氛围下，全国各行各业普遍出现了虚报产量、夸大成绩的“浮夸风”。
description.en: In the atmosphere of haste for success during the 'Great Leap Forward', a 'wind of exaggeration' characterized by false reporting of output and exaggeration of achievements became widespread across all sectors nationwide.

description.zh-cn: 唐·瓦伦丁于1972年在加利福尼亚州门洛帕克创立了红杉资本。
description.en: Don Valentine founded Sequoia Capital in 1972 in Menlo Park, California.

description.zh-cn: 在1990年代中期，唐·瓦伦丁将红杉资本的控制权交给了道格·莱昂内和迈克尔·莫里茨。
description.en: In the mid-1990s, Don Valentine handed over control of Sequoia Capital to Doug Leone and Michael Moritz.

description.zh-cn: 在1990年代中期，唐·瓦伦丁将红杉资本的控制权交给了道格·莱昂内和迈克尔·莫里茨。
description.en: In the mid-1990s, Don Valentine handed over control of Sequoia Capital to Doug Leone and Michael Moritz.

description.zh-cn: 道格·莱昂内是红杉资本的关键人物，并在1990年代中期接管了公司。
description.en: Doug Leone is a key person at Sequoia Capital and took over the firm in the mid-1990s.

description.zh-cn: 迈克尔·莫里茨是红杉资本的关键人物，并在1990年代中期接管了公司。
description.en: Michael Moritz is a key person at Sequoia Capital and took over the firm in the mid-1990s.

description.zh-cn: 2005年9月，张帆与沈南鹏和红杉资本共同创立了红杉资本中国基金。
description.en: In September 2005, Zhang Fan co-founded Sequoia Capital China Fund with Neil Shen and Sequoia Capital.

description.zh-cn: 2005年9月，沈南鹏与张帆和红杉资本共同创立了红杉资本中国基金。
description.en: In September 2005, Neil Shen co-founded Sequoia Capital China Fund with Zhang Fan and Sequoia Capital.

description.zh-cn: 2005年9月，红杉资本与张帆和沈南鹏共同创立了红杉资本中国基金。
description.en: In September 2005, Sequoia Capital co-founded Sequoia Capital China Fund with Zhang Fan and Neil Shen.

description.zh-cn: 红杉中国作为红杉资本的附属公司成立，直到2023年6月分拆为止。
description.en: Sequoia China was established as an affiliate of Sequoia Capital and remained so until the spin-off in June 2023.

description.zh-cn: 在创立红杉中国之前，张帆是德丰杰全球基金的董事。
description.en: Before co-founding Sequoia China, Zhang Fan was a director of Draper Fisher Jurvetson's global fund.

description.zh-cn: 在创立红杉中国之前，沈南鹏是携程网的总裁兼CFO。
description.en: Before co-founding Sequoia China, Neil Shen was the President and CFO of Ctrip.

description.zh-cn: 沈南鹏是红杉中国的领导者。
description.en: Neil Shen leads Sequoia China.

description.zh-cn: 2023年6月，红杉资本宣布将其中国业务分拆，使红杉中国成为一个完全独立的实体。
description.en: In June 2023, Sequoia Capital announced the spin-off of its China business, making Sequoia China a completely independent entity.

description.zh-cn: 在从红杉资本分拆后，红杉中国将其英文名改为“HongShan”。
description.en: After spinning off from Sequoia Capital, Sequoia China changed its English name to 'HongShan'.

description.zh-cn: 红杉资本投资了苹果公司。
description.en: Sequoia Capital invested in Apple Inc.

description.zh-cn: 红杉资本投资了YouTube。
description.en: Sequoia Capital invested in YouTube.

description.zh-cn: 红杉资本投资了PayPal。
description.en: Sequoia Capital invested in PayPal.

description.zh-cn: 红杉资本投资了思科系统。
description.en: Sequoia Capital invested in Cisco Systems.

description.zh-cn: 红杉资本投资了甲骨文公司。
description.en: Sequoia Capital invested in Oracle Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 红杉资本投资了SHEIN。
description.en: Sequoia Capital invested in SHEIN.

description.zh-cn: 红杉资本投资了Electronic Arts。
description.en: Sequoia Capital invested in Electronic Arts.

description.zh-cn: 红杉资本投资了Atari。
description.en: Sequoia Capital invested in Atari.

description.zh-cn: 红杉资本投资了WhatsApp。
description.en: Sequoia Capital invested in WhatsApp.

description.zh-cn: 红杉资本投资了领英。
description.en: Sequoia Capital invested in LinkedIn.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争的爆发导致华北高校南迁，最终在昆明组建了国立西南联合大学。
description.en: The outbreak of the Second Sino-Japanese War led to the southward relocation of universities from North China, eventually resulting in the formation of the National Southwestern Associated University in Kunming.

description.zh-cn: 国立清华大学是组成国立西南联合大学的三所大学之一。
description.en: National Tsinghua University was one of the three universities that formed the National Southwestern Associated University.

description.zh-cn: 南开大学是组成国立西南联合大学的三所大学之一。
description.en: Nankai University was one of the three universities that formed the National Southwestern Associated University.

description.zh-cn: 国立长沙临时大学因战局紧张迁往昆明，并更名为国立西南联合大学。
description.en: Due to the escalating war situation, the National Temporary University of Changsha relocated to Kunming and was renamed the National Southwestern Associated University.

description.zh-cn: 梅贻琦长期担任常务委员会主席，主导校务。
description.en: Mei Yiqi served as the long-term Chairman of the Standing Committee, directing the university's affairs.

description.zh-cn: 国立西南联合大学解散后，其师范学院留在昆明，独立设院为国立昆明师范学院。
description.en: After the dissolution of the National Southwestern Associated University, its Normal College remained in Kunming and was independently established as the National Kunming Teachers College.

description.zh-cn: 1937年7月29日，南开大学校园遭到日军轰炸，校舍被付之一炬。
description.en: On July 29, 1937, the Nankai University campus was bombed by the Japanese army and its buildings were destroyed.

description.zh-cn: 作为国立大学，西南联大需听从教育部的指令，如奉命迁校。
description.en: As a national university, the National Southwestern Associated University was under the direction of the Ministry of Education, such as receiving orders to relocate.

position.en: Leader of the student trekking group

description.zh-cn: 在国立长沙临时大学迁往昆明期间，担任步行学生旅行团的团长。
description.en: During the relocation of the National Temporary University of Changsha to Kunming, he served as the leader of the student trekking group.

description.zh-cn: 两校在昆明为邻，许多学者在两校兼职，师生也共同参加活动。
description.en: The two universities were neighbors in Kunming, with many scholars holding concurrent positions and students and faculty participating in joint activities.

description.en: Authored the lyrics for the school anthem.

description.zh-cn: 为校歌作曲。
description.en: Composed the music for the school anthem.

description.zh-cn: 黄铭出生于江苏宜兴。
description.en: Huang Ming was born in Yixing, Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 黄铭是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Huang Ming is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 黄铭于2023年1月晋升上将军衔。
description.en: Huang Ming was promoted to the rank of general in January 2023.

description.zh-cn: 在改编前担任中国人民解放军陆军第十六集团军参谋长。
description.en: Served as the Chief of Staff of the PLA 16th Group Army before its reorganization.

description.zh-cn: 作为将军领队之一，率领“平型关大战突击连”英模部队方阵参加阅兵式。
description.en: As one of the general leaders, he led the 'Pingxingguan Battle Assault Company' model unit formation in the military parade.

description.zh-cn: 黄铭接替王强出任中国人民解放军北部战区司令员。
description.en: Huang Ming succeeded Wang Qiang as the commander of the PLA Northern Theater Command.

description.zh-cn: 黄铭接替吴亚男出任中国人民解放军中部战区司令员。
description.en: Huang Ming succeeded Wu Yanan as the commander of the PLA Central Theater Command.

description.zh-cn: 黄铭接替刘振立出任中国人民解放军陆军参谋长。
description.en: Huang Ming succeeded Liu Zhenli as the Chief of Staff of the PLA Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 李中林接替黄铭出任中国人民解放军陆军参谋长。
description.en: Li Zhonglin succeeded Huang Ming as the Chief of Staff of the PLA Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 黄铭接替李桥铭出任中国人民解放军陆军第四十一集团军军长。
description.en: Huang Ming succeeded Li Qiaoming as the commander of the PLA 41st Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 黄铭接替张学锋出任中国人民解放军陆军第十六集团军参谋长。
description.en: Huang Ming succeeded Zhang Xuefeng as the Chief of Staff of the PLA 16th Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 丁来富接替黄铭出任中国人民解放军陆军第十六集团军参谋长。
description.en: Ding Laifu succeeded Huang Ming as the Chief of Staff of the PLA 16th Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党在此次选举中席次大幅减少，从15席锐减至6席，遭遇重大挫败。
description.en: The Kuomintang suffered a major defeat in this election, with its number of seats drastically reduced from 15 to 6.

description.zh-cn: 民主进步党在此次选举中取得重大胜利，席次从6席大幅增加至13席。
description.en: The Democratic Progressive Party achieved a major victory in this election, increasing its number of seats from 6 to 13.

description.zh-cn: 柯文哲以无党籍身份参选并当选2014年台北市长。
description.en: Ko Wen-je ran and was elected as Mayor of Taipei in 2014 as an independent.

description.zh-cn: 柯文哲在2014年选举中当选台北市市长。
description.en: Ko Wen-je was elected Mayor of Taipei in the 2014 election.

description.zh-cn: 连胜文为中国国民党党员，并代表该党参选2014年台北市长。
description.en: Lien Sheng-wen is a member of the Kuomintang and represented the party in the 2014 Taipei mayoral election.

description.zh-cn: 连胜文在2014年台北市长选举中落败。
description.en: Lien Sheng-wen was defeated in the 2014 Taipei mayoral election.

description.zh-cn: 朱立伦在2014年选举中成功连任新北市市长。
description.en: Eric Chu was successfully re-elected as Mayor of New Taipei City in the 2014 election.

description.zh-cn: 游锡堃在2014年新北市长选举中落败。
description.en: You Si-kun was defeated in the 2014 New Taipei City mayoral election.

description.zh-cn: 郑文灿在2014年选举中当选桃园市市长。
description.en: Cheng Wen-tsan was elected Mayor of Taoyuan in the 2014 election.

description.zh-cn: 时任桃园县长的吴志扬在2014年首届桃园市长选举中落败。
description.en: Then-Magistrate of Taoyuan County, Wu Chih-yang, was defeated in the inaugural 2014 Taoyuan City mayoral election.

description.zh-cn: 八德合宜住宅弊案在其副手叶世文涉案后爆发，对吴志扬的选情造成了一定的影响。
description.en: The Bade affordable housing scandal broke after his deputy Yeh Shih-wen was implicated, which had a certain impact on Wu Chih-yang's election campaign.

description.zh-cn: 叶世文因卷入八德合宜住宅弊案而被解职。
description.en: Yeh Shih-wen was dismissed from his post due to his involvement in the Bade affordable housing scandal.

description.zh-cn: 叶世文曾任吴志扬的副手，担任桃园县副县长。
description.en: Yeh Shih-wen served as Wu Chih-yang's deputy, as the Deputy Magistrate of Taoyuan County.

description.zh-cn: 林佳龙在2014年选举中当选台中市市长。
description.en: Lin Chia-lung was elected Mayor of Taichung in the 2014 election.

description.zh-cn: 时任台中市长的胡志强在2014年竞选连任失败。
description.en: Then-Mayor of Taichung, Jason Hu, was defeated in his re-election campaign in 2014.

description.zh-cn: 赖清德在2014年选举中成功连任台南市市长。
description.en: Lai Ching-te was successfully re-elected as Mayor of Tainan in the 2014 election.

description.zh-cn: 黄秀霜在2014年台南市长选举中落败。
description.en: Huang Hsiu-shuang was defeated in the 2014 Tainan mayoral election.

description.zh-cn: 陈菊在2014年选举中成功连任高雄市市长。
description.en: Chen Chu was successfully re-elected as Mayor of Kaohsiung in the 2014 election.

description.zh-cn: 杨秋兴在2014年高雄市长选举中落败。
description.en: Yang Chiu-hsing was defeated in the 2014 Kaohsiung mayoral election.

description.zh-cn: 林右昌在2014年选举中当选基隆市市长。
description.en: Lin Yu-chang was elected Mayor of Keelung in the 2014 election.

description.zh-cn: 由于黄景泰涉入关说建案，中国国民党于2014年7月9日撤销其基隆市长候选人提名。
description.en: Due to his involvement in a lobbying case, the Kuomintang revoked Huang Ching-tai's nomination for Keelung Mayor on July 9, 2014.

description.zh-cn: 在撤销黄景泰的提名后，中国国民党征召谢立功参选基隆市长。
description.en: After revoking Huang Ching-tai's nomination, the Kuomintang recruited Hsieh Li-kung to run for Mayor of Keelung.

description.zh-cn: 谢立功在2014年基隆市长选举中落败。
description.en: Hsieh Li-kung was defeated in the 2014 Keelung mayoral election.

description.zh-cn: 民主进步党支持以无党籍身份参选2014年新竹县县长的郑永金。
description.en: The Democratic Progressive Party supported Cheng Yung-chin, who ran as an independent, in the 2014 Hsinchu County magistrate election.

description.zh-cn: 邱镜淳在2014年选举中成功连任新竹县县长。
description.en: Chiu Ching-chun was successfully re-elected as Magistrate of Hsinchu County in the 2014 election.

description.zh-cn: 林智坚在2014年选举中当选新竹市市长。
description.en: Lin Chih-chien was elected Mayor of Hsinchu City in the 2014 election.

description.zh-cn: 前市长蔡仁坚以无党籍身份参选，吸收了部分国民党支持者的票源，间接导致了许明财的落败。
description.en: Former mayor Tsai Jen-chien's independent candidacy attracted some votes from KMT supporters, indirectly contributing to Hsu Ming-tsai's defeat.

description.zh-cn: 徐耀昌在2014年选举中当选苗栗县县长。
description.en: Hsu Yao-chang was elected Magistrate of Miaoli County in the 2014 election.

description.zh-cn: 林明溱在2014年选举中当选南投县县长。
description.en: Lin Ming-chen was elected Magistrate of Nantou County in the 2014 election.

description.zh-cn: 魏明谷在2014年选举中当选彰化县县长。
description.en: Wei Ming-ku was elected Magistrate of Changhua County in the 2014 election.

description.zh-cn: 李进勇在2014年选举中当选云林县县长。
description.en: Lee Chin-yung was elected Magistrate of Yunlin County in the 2014 election.

description.zh-cn: 张花冠在2014年选举中成功连任嘉义县县长。
description.en: Chang Hwa-kuan was successfully re-elected as Magistrate of Chiayi County in the 2014 election.

description.zh-cn: 涂醒哲在2014年选举中当选嘉义市市长。
description.en: Twu Shiing-jer was elected Mayor of Chiayi City in the 2014 election.

description.zh-cn: 潘孟安在2014年选举中当选屏东县县长。
description.en: Pan Men-an was elected Magistrate of Pingtung County in the 2014 election.

description.zh-cn: 林聪贤在2014年选举中成功连任宜兰县县长。
description.en: Lin Tsung-hsien was successfully re-elected as Magistrate of Yilan County in the 2014 election.

description.zh-cn: 傅崐萁在2014年选举中成功连任花莲县县长。
description.en: Fu Kun-chi was successfully re-elected as Magistrate of Hualien County in the 2014 election.

description.zh-cn: 傅崐萁在2014年花莲县长选举中获得亲民党背书。
description.en: Fu Kun-chi was endorsed by the People First Party in the 2014 Hualien County magistrate election.

description.zh-cn: 黄健庭在2014年选举中成功连任台东县县长。
description.en: Justin Huang was successfully re-elected as Magistrate of Taitung County in the 2014 election.

description.zh-cn: 陈光复在2014年选举中当选澎湖县县长。
description.en: Chen Kuang-fu was elected Magistrate of Penghu County in the 2014 election.

description.zh-cn: 陈福海在2014年选举中当选金门县县长。
description.en: Chen Fu-hai was elected Magistrate of Kinmen County in the 2014 election.

description.zh-cn: 陈福海在2014年金门县长选举中获得亲民党背书。
description.en: Chen Fu-hai was endorsed by the People First Party in the 2014 Kinmen County magistrate election.

description.zh-cn: 时任金门县长的李沃士在2014年竞选连任失败。
description.en: Then-Magistrate of Kinmen County, Li Wo-shi, was defeated in his re-election campaign in 2014.

description.zh-cn: 刘增应在2014年选举中当选连江县县长。
description.en: Liu Tseng-ying was elected Magistrate of Lienchiang County in the 2014 election.

description.zh-cn: 时任连江县长的杨绥生在2014年竞选连任失败。
description.en: Then-Magistrate of Lienchiang County, Yang Sui-sheng, was defeated in his re-election campaign in 2014.

description.zh-cn: 同属中国国民党的刘增应与杨绥生在2014年连江县长选举中互为竞争对手。
description.en: Liu Tseng-ying and Yang Sui-sheng, both members of the KMT, were opponents in the 2014 Lienchiang County magistrate election.

description.zh-cn: 根据文本，中国共产主义青年团河北省委员会接受中国共产主义青年团中央委员会的领导。
description.en: According to the text, the Hebei Provincial Committee of the Communist Youth League of China is under the leadership of the Central Committee of the Communist Youth League of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据文本，中国共产主义青年团河北省委员会接受中国共产党河北省委员会的领导。
description.en: According to the text, the Hebei Provincial Committee of the Communist Youth League of China is under the leadership of the Hebei Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 文本提及，2020年的暴雨导致太湖水位上涨。
description.en: The text mentions that the 2020 rainstorms caused the water level of Lake Tai to rise.

description.zh-cn: 西沙海战发生于越南战争末期，美军从越南撤军的背景下，南越海军实力得到增强，是冲突的背景之一。
description.en: The Battle of the Paracel Islands occurred in the final stages of the Vietnam War, against the backdrop of the U.S. withdrawal, which strengthened the South Vietnamese Navy and was one of the contexts for the conflict.

description.zh-cn: 西沙海战是中越海上边界冲突的一部分。
description.en: The Battle of the Paracel Islands was part of the Sino-Vietnamese maritime border conflicts.

description.zh-cn: 两国因西沙群岛主权争议爆发西沙海战。
description.en: The two countries fought the Battle of the Paracel Islands over a sovereignty dispute concerning the islands.

position.zh-cn: 海军榆林基地副司令员、西沙巡逻海上编队指挥组指挥员
position.en: Deputy Commander of the Yulin Naval Base, Commander of the Xisha Patrol Maritime Formation Command Group

description.zh-cn: 魏鸣森作为中方海上指挥官，指挥了西沙海战。
description.en: As the Chinese maritime commander, Wei Mingsen commanded the Battle of the Paracel Islands.

description.zh-cn: 许世友作为广州军区司令员，统一指挥所有参与西沙海战的中国部队。
description.en: As the Commander of the Guangzhou Military Region, Xu Shiyou had unified command over all Chinese forces participating in the Battle of the Paracel Islands.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央军委决定，所有参与西沙海战的部队行动统一由广州军区指挥。
description.en: The CPC Central Military Commission decided that all troop movements in the Battle of the Paracel Islands would be under the unified command of the Guangzhou Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 周恩来电话指示叶剑英召集领导小组，到总参谋部指挥作战。
description.en: Zhou Enlai instructed Ye Jianying via telephone to convene a leading group to command the battle from the General Staff Department.

description.zh-cn: 叶剑英负责组织领导小组，直接指挥了西沙海战。
description.en: Ye Jianying was responsible for organizing a leading group that directly commanded the Battle of the Paracel Islands.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平是叶剑英组织的指挥西沙海战的领导小组成员之一。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping was a member of the leading group organized by Ye Jianying to command the Battle of the Paracel Islands.

description.zh-cn: 阮文绍授权其海军在冲突中可以开火还击，推动了战斗的爆发。
description.en: Nguyễn Văn Thiệu authorized his navy to return fire in the conflict, which pushed towards the outbreak of the battle.

description.zh-cn: 西沙海战以中方胜利告终，使得中华人民共和国取得了对整个西沙群岛及其周边海域的实际控制权。
description.en: The Battle of the Paracel Islands ended in a Chinese victory, allowing the People's Republic of China to gain de facto control over the entire Paracel Islands and its surrounding waters.

description.zh-cn: 越南共和国在西沙海战中战败，丧失了对西沙部分岛屿的控制权，并遭受了人员和舰艇损失。
description.en: The Republic of Vietnam was defeated in the Battle of the Paracel Islands, losing control over parts of the islands and suffering casualties and naval losses.

description.zh-cn: 越南共和国海军10号舰舰长魏文他在战斗中阵亡。
description.en: Ngụy Văn Thà, Captain of Republic of Vietnam Navy vessel HQ-10, was killed in action during the battle.

description.zh-cn: 南越方面曾呼吁在附近活动的美国海军第七舰队干预，但请求被拒绝。
description.en: South Vietnam appealed for intervention from the nearby U.S. Navy's Seventh Fleet, but the request was denied.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军东海舰队派舰艇编队通过台湾海峡南下增援时，中华民国海军对其进行了全程监控，但未采取军事行动进行阻拦。
description.en: When the PLA's East Sea Fleet dispatched a formation through the Taiwan Strait to reinforce the south, the Republic of China Navy monitored its entire passage but took no military action to obstruct it.

description.zh-cn: 巴金与萧珊于1944年5月1日结婚，直至1972年萧珊去世。
description.en: Ba Jin and Xiao Shan married on May 1, 1944, and were together until her death in 1972.

description.zh-cn: 李济生是巴金的弟弟。
description.en: Li Jisheng is Ba Jin's younger brother.

description.zh-cn: 巴金在文化大革命期间受到上海作家协会“造反派”批判，被关进“牛棚”，并被《人民日报》点名批评。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Ba Jin was criticized by the 'rebel faction' of the Shanghai Writers Association, confined to a 'cowshed', and singled out for criticism in a People's Daily article.

description.zh-cn: 巴金的妻子萧珊在文化大革命期间被迫害致死。
description.en: Ba Jin's wife, Xiao Shan, was persecuted to death during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 1919年，巴金通过《新青年》接触到克鲁泡特金所著的《告少年》，此后一直信仰无政府主义。
description.en: In 1919, Ba Jin came into contact with Kropotkin's 'An Appeal to the Young' through 'New Youth' magazine, and became a lifelong believer in anarchism.

description.zh-cn: 巴金晚年提议建立中国现代文学馆。
description.en: In his later years, Ba Jin proposed the establishment of the Museum of Modern Chinese Literature.

description.zh-cn: 茅盾是中国作家协会主席，巴金于1984年接任其职务。
description.en: Mao Dun was the chairman of the China Writers Association, and Ba Jin succeeded him in 1984.

description.zh-cn: 巴金曾三度到泉州，与无政府主义者叶非英等人来往。
description.en: Ba Jin visited Quanzhou three times to associate with anarchist Ye Feiying and others.

description.zh-cn: 在巴金的遗体告别仪式上为其送别。
description.en: Attended Ba Jin's farewell ceremony.

description.zh-cn: 在巴金的遗体告别仪式上为其送别。
description.en: Attended Ba Jin's farewell ceremony.

description.zh-cn: 在巴金的遗体告别仪式上为其送别。
description.en: Attended Ba Jin's farewell ceremony.

description.zh-cn: 在巴金的遗体告别仪式上为其送别。
description.en: Attended Ba Jin's farewell ceremony.

description.zh-cn: 在国立东南大学附中学习并毕业。
description.en: Studied at and graduated from the affiliated middle school of National Southeastern University.

description.zh-cn: 埃米尔·左拉是对巴金产生影响的作家之一。
description.en: Émile Zola was one of the writers who influenced Ba Jin.

description.zh-cn: 伊万·谢尔盖耶维奇·屠格涅夫是对巴金产生影响的作家之一。
description.en: Ivan Turgenev was one of the writers who influenced Ba Jin.

description.zh-cn: 亚历山大·赫尔岑是对巴金产生影响的作家之一。
description.en: Alexander Herzen was one of the writers who influenced Ba Jin.

description.zh-cn: 安东·帕夫洛维奇·契诃夫是对巴金产生影响的作家之一。
description.en: Anton Chekhov was one of the writers who influenced Ba Jin.

description.zh-cn: 中国科协是由中共中央书记处直接领导的团体。
description.en: CAST is an organization directly led by the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 担任中国科学技术协会第九、十届主席。
description.en: Serves as the chairman of the 9th and 10th National Committees of the China Association for Science and Technology.

description.zh-cn: 中国科协主席万钢是致公党党员。
description.en: Wan Gang, the Chairman of CAST, is a member of the China Zhi Gong Party.

description.zh-cn: 担任中国科学技术协会第一届主席。
description.en: Served as the chairman of the 1st National Committee of the China Association for Science and Technology.

description.zh-cn: 担任中国科学技术协会第二届主席。
description.en: Served as the chairman of the 2nd National Committee of the China Association for Science and Technology.

description.zh-cn: 担任中国科学技术协会第三届主席。
description.en: Served as the chairman of the 3rd National Committee of the China Association for Science and Technology.

description.zh-cn: 担任中国科学技术协会第四届主席。
description.en: Served as the chairman of the 4th National Committee of the China Association for Science and Technology.

description.zh-cn: 担任中国科学技术协会第五、六届主席。
description.en: Served as the chairman of the 5th and 6th National Committees of the China Association for Science and Technology.

description.zh-cn: 担任中国科学技术协会第七、八届主席。
description.en: Served as the chairman of the 7th and 8th National Committees of the China Association for Science and Technology.

description.zh-cn: 于第二十八次会议通过了《中华人民共和国科学技术普及法》。
description.en: Passed the Law of the People's Republic of China on Popularization of Science and Technology at its 28th session.

description.zh-cn: 该法规定中国科学技术协会是执行科学技术普及工作的主力。
description.en: This law stipulates that the China Association for Science and Technology is the main force for implementing science and technology popularization work.

description.zh-cn: 中国科协主管的全国性学会。
description.en: A national society supervised by the China Association for Science and Technology.

description.zh-cn: 中国科协的直属事业单位。
description.en: A public institution directly under the China Association for Science and Technology.

description.zh-cn: 中国科协的直属事业单位。
description.en: A public institution directly under the China Association for Science and Technology.

description.zh-cn: 中国科协主管的地方科协。
description.en: A local association for science and technology supervised by the China Association for Science and Technology.

description.zh-cn: 胡絜青是老舍的妻子。2005年8月23日，夫妇二人在去世后合葬于北京八宝山革命公墓。
description.en: Hu Jieqing was Lao She's wife. On August 23, 2005, the couple was jointly buried at the Babaoshan Revolutionary Cemetery in Beijing after their deaths.

description.zh-cn: 舒乙是胡絜青的儿子。
description.en: Shu Yi is the son of Hu Jieqing.

description.zh-cn: 舒乙是老舍的儿子。2005年，他将父亲在文革受难时所穿血衣的残片放入其骨灰盒中。
description.en: Shu Yi is the son of Lao She. In 2005, he placed a fragment of the blood-stained clothing his father wore during his persecution in the Cultural Revolution into his cinerary casket.

degree.en: Department of Chinese Language and Literature

description.zh-cn: 胡絜青于1931年自北京师范大学国文系毕业。
description.en: Hu Jieqing graduated from the Department of Chinese Language and Literature at Beijing Normal University in 1931.

description.zh-cn: 胡絜青曾受画家汪采白的影响。
description.en: Hu Jieqing was influenced by the painter Wang Caibai.

description.zh-cn: 胡絜青曾受画家孙诵昭的影响。
description.en: Hu Jieqing was influenced by the painter Sun Songzhao.

description.zh-cn: 胡絜青曾受画家杨仲子的影响。
description.en: Hu Jieqing was influenced by the painter Yang Zhongzi.

description.zh-cn: 1958年，胡絜青受聘于北京中国画院（今北京画院），任一级美术师。
description.en: In 1958, Hu Jieqing was employed by the Beijing Chinese Painting Academy (now Beijing Painting Academy) as a First-class Artist.

description.zh-cn: 胡絜青曾任第五、六、七届全国政协委员。
description.en: Hu Jieqing served as a member of the 5th, 6th, and 7th National Committees of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 舒乙设计了其父母老舍与胡絜青的合葬陵墓，并亲自将他们合葬。
description.en: Shu Yi designed the joint tomb for his parents, Lao She and Hu Jieqing, and personally buried them together.

description.zh-cn: 胡絜青是满洲正红旗人。
description.en: Hu Jieqing was of the Manchu Plain Red Banner.

description.zh-cn: 安定公主是唐高宗的长女。
description.en: Princess Anding was the eldest daughter of Emperor Gaozong.

description.zh-cn: 安定公主是武则天的长女。
description.en: Princess Anding was the eldest daughter of Wu Zetian.

description.zh-cn: 安定公主是唐中宗的同胞姐姐。
description.en: Princess Anding was the full sister of Emperor Zhongzong.

description.zh-cn: 安定公主是唐睿宗的同胞姐姐。
description.en: Princess Anding was the full sister of Emperor Ruizong.

description.zh-cn: 安定公主是太平公主的姐姐。
description.en: Princess Anding was the elder sister of Princess Taiping.

description.zh-cn: 唐高宗是武则天的丈夫。
description.en: Emperor Gaozong was the husband of Wu Zetian.

description.zh-cn: 因认为王皇后杀害了安定公主，唐高宗对其恨之入骨，并最终促成了废后事件。
description.en: Believing Empress Wang had killed Princess Anding, Emperor Gaozong developed a deep hatred for her, which ultimately led to her deposition.

description.zh-cn: 根据《新唐书》和《资治通鉴》的记载，武则天为嫁祸王皇后，亲手将刚出生的女儿（即后来的安定公主）闷死。
description.en: According to the 'New Book of Tang' and 'Zizhi Tongjian', Wu Zetian personally smothered her newborn daughter (later known as Princess Anding) to frame Empress Wang.

description.zh-cn: 于664年下诏追封其长女为安定公主，谥号思，并以亲王之礼迁葬。
description.en: In 664, he issued an edict to posthumously honor his eldest daughter as Princess Anding with the posthumous name 'Si', and had her reburied with the honors of a prince.

description.zh-cn: 翼皇后是塔克世的母亲。
description.en: Empress Yi was the mother of Taksi.

description.zh-cn: 嘉靖末年，塔克世作为建州右卫都指挥使王杲的部下。
description.en: In the late Jiajing era, Taksi was a subordinate of Wang Gao, the commander of the Jianzhou Right Guard.

description.zh-cn: 塔克世背弃王杲归顺明朝，并帮助李成梁击灭王杲。
description.en: Taksi betrayed Wang Gao, submitted to the Ming Dynasty, and helped Li Chengliang defeat Wang Gao.

description.zh-cn: 塔克世归顺明朝，后升任建州左卫指挥使。
description.en: Taksi submitted to the Ming Dynasty and was later promoted to Commander of the Jianzhou Left Guard.

description.zh-cn: 万历二年（1574年），塔克世帮助李成梁击灭王杲，升任建州左卫指挥使。
description.en: In 1574 (the second year of the Wanli era), Taksi helped Li Chengliang defeat Wang Gao and was promoted to Commander of the Jianzhou Left Guard.

description.zh-cn: 万历二年（1574年），在塔克世的帮助下，李成梁击灭了王杲。
description.en: In 1574, with the help of Taksi, Li Chengliang defeated Wang Gao.

description.zh-cn: 尼堪外兰在古埒城纵兵屠城，导致塔克世死难。
description.en: Nikan Wailan's troops massacred the inhabitants of Gure city, leading to the death of Taksi.

description.zh-cn: 尼堪外兰在古埒城纵兵屠城，导致觉昌安死难。
description.en: Nikan Wailan's troops massacred the inhabitants of Gure city, leading to the death of Giocangga.

description.zh-cn: 皇太极追尊塔克世为福王。
description.en: Hong Taiji posthumously honored Taksi as Prince Fu.

description.zh-cn: 顺治帝追谥塔克世为宣皇帝，庙号显祖。
description.en: The Shunzhi Emperor posthumously honored Taksi as Emperor Xuan with the temple name Xianzhu.

description.zh-cn: 宣皇后是塔克世的嫡夫人。
description.en: Empress Xuan was Taksi's primary consort.

description.zh-cn: 清显祖继妃是塔克世的次夫人。
description.en: The secondary consort of Qing Xianzhu was Taksi's secondary consort.

description.zh-cn: 李佳氏是塔克世的庶妃。
description.en: Lady Ligiya was Taksi's concubine.

description.zh-cn: 努尔哈赤的生母为宣皇后。
description.en: Nurhaci's birth mother was Empress Xuan.

description.zh-cn: 穆尔哈齐是塔克世的次子。
description.en: Murhaci was the second son of Taksi.

description.zh-cn: 穆尔哈齐的生母为李佳氏。
description.en: Murhaci's birth mother was Lady Ligiya.

description.zh-cn: 舒尔哈齐是塔克世的第三子。
description.en: Šurhaci was the third son of Taksi.

description.zh-cn: 舒尔哈齐是努尔哈赤的同母弟，其生母为宣皇后。
description.en: Šurhaci was a full brother of Nurhaci; his birth mother was Empress Xuan.

description.zh-cn: 雅尔哈齐是塔克世的第四子。
description.en: Yarhaci was the fourth son of Taksi.

description.zh-cn: 雅尔哈齐是努尔哈赤的同母弟，其生母为宣皇后。
description.en: Yarhaci was a full brother of Nurhaci; his birth mother was Empress Xuan.

description.zh-cn: 雅尔哈齐是努尔哈赤的同母弟。
description.en: Yarhaci was a full brother of Nurhaci.

description.zh-cn: 巴雅喇是塔克世的第五子。
description.en: Bayara was the fifth son of Taksi.

description.zh-cn: 巴雅喇的生母为恳哲（清显祖继妃）。
description.en: Bayara's birth mother was Kenzhe (Secondary consort of Qing Xianzhu).

description.zh-cn: 塔克世之女。
description.en: Daughter of Taksi.

description.zh-cn: 常柱妻是努尔哈赤的异母姐。
description.en: The wife of Cangju was a half-sister of Nurhaci.

description.zh-cn: 塔克世之女。
description.en: Daughter of Taksi.

description.zh-cn: 沾河姑是努尔哈赤的同母妹，其生母为宣皇后。
description.en: Zhanhegu was a full sister of Nurhaci; her birth mother was Empress Xuan.

description.zh-cn: 沾河姑是努尔哈赤的同母妹。
description.en: Zhanhegu was a full sister of Nurhaci.

description.zh-cn: 阿台是塔克世的姪女婿。
description.en: Atai was Taksi's nephew-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 阿台曾叛明。
description.en: Atai rebelled against the Ming dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 皮埃尔·赖伐尔在1942年至1944年期间担任维希法国的总理。
description.en: Pierre Laval served as the Prime Minister of Vichy France from 1942 to 1944.

description.zh-cn: 法国在法国战役中的军事溃败直接导致了法兰西第三共和国的垮台和寻求停战，为菲利普·贝当上台建立维希政权创造了条件。
description.en: The military defeat of France in the Battle of France directly led to the collapse of the Third Republic and the pursuit of an armistice, creating the conditions for Philippe Pétain to come to power and establish the Vichy regime.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国于1940年5月10日入侵法国，发动了法国战役。
description.en: Nazi Germany invaded France on May 10, 1940, launching the Battle of France.

description.zh-cn: 该停战协定是维希法国得以成立的直接法律和政治前提，确立了其与德国的从属关系和法国领土的分割。
description.en: This armistice was the direct legal and political prerequisite for the establishment of Vichy France, defining its subordinate relationship with Germany and the division of French territory.

description.zh-cn: 自1942年11月“安东行动”后，德国占领法国全境，维希政府被德国完全控制，失去了军队和实际自主权。
description.en: After Operation Anton in November 1942, Germany occupied all of France, and the Vichy government was completely controlled by Germany, losing its army and effective autonomy.

description.zh-cn: 由夏尔·戴高乐领导的自由法国在整个维希政权存在期间，始终在政治和军事上对其进行反对，并视其为非法的傀儡政府。
description.en: Led by Charles de Gaulle, Free France consistently opposed the Vichy regime politically and militarily throughout its existence, viewing it as an illegitimate puppet government.

description.zh-cn: 盟军在北非的“火炬行动”登陆，直接导致德国与意大利执行“安东行动”以占领维希法国全境，以防其倒向盟军。
description.en: The Allied landings in North Africa during Operation Torch directly led Germany and Italy to execute Operation Anton to occupy all of Vichy France, preventing it from siding with the Allies.

description.zh-cn: 在“安东行动”中，德意军队占领了法国南部，彻底摧毁了维希政府的实际管治权、自主性及其武装力量“停战军”。
description.en: During Operation Anton, German and Italian forces occupied southern France, completely destroying the Vichy government's effective administrative power, autonomy, and its armed force, the 'Armistice Army'.

description.zh-cn: 盟军通过诺曼底登陆攻入法国，开启了解放法国的进程，直接导致了维希政权在法国本土的崩溃。
description.en: The Allies' invasion of France through the Normandy landings initiated the process of liberating France, directly leading to the collapse of the Vichy regime on French soil.

description.zh-cn: 战后，菲利普·贝当被法兰西共和国临时政府以叛国罪审判，并被判处死刑。
description.en: After the war, Philippe Pétain was tried for treason by the Provisional Government of the French Republic and sentenced to death.

description.zh-cn: 战后，皮埃尔·赖伐尔被法兰西共和国临时政府以叛国罪判处死刑，并于1945年10月15日被处决。
description.en: After the war, Pierre Laval was sentenced to death for treason by the Provisional Government of the French Republic and was executed on October 15, 1945.

description.zh-cn: 维希政府协助纳粹德国抓捕犹太人，其警察部队被命令围捕犹太人及其他政治难民，导致至少72,500名犹太人被杀害。
description.en: The Vichy government assisted Nazi Germany in arresting Jewish people; its police forces were ordered to round up Jews and other political refugees, resulting in the murder of at least 72,500 Jews.

description.zh-cn: 维希政府协助抓捕罗姆人（吉普赛人）等被其视为“不良分子”的群体。
description.en: The Vichy government assisted in the arrest of Romani people (Gypsies) and other groups it deemed 'undesirables'.

description.zh-cn: 1940年6月，时任法国总理保罗·雷诺因寻求继续抵抗的方案不受支持而辞职，由菲利普·贝当接任其总理职务。
description.en: In June 1940, then-Prime Minister of France Paul Reynaud resigned after his proposal to continue resistance failed to gain support, and was succeeded as prime minister by Philippe Pétain.

description.zh-cn: 法国解放后，维希政府的核心成员迁至德国西格马林根，组成了流亡政府，即西格马林根飞地。
description.en: After the liberation of France, core members of the Vichy government moved to Sigmaringen, Germany, and formed a government-in-exile, the Sigmaringen enclave.

description.zh-cn: 1945年4月22日，法国第一军团攻下西格马林根，俘虏了维希流亡政府的最后一批成员，标志着其彻底终结。
description.en: On April 22, 1945, the First French Army captured Sigmaringen and took the last members of the Vichy government-in-exile prisoner, marking its complete end.

description.zh-cn: 克拉夫丘克于1934年1月10日出生于乌克兰罗夫诺州。
description.en: Kravchuk was born on January 10, 1934, in Rivne Oblast, Ukraine.

description.zh-cn: 1958年毕业于基辅大学。
description.en: Graduated from Kyiv University in 1958.

description.zh-cn: 列昂尼德·克拉夫丘克接替弗拉基米尔·伊瓦什科担任乌克兰最高苏维埃主席。
description.en: Leonid Kravchuk succeeded Vladimir Ivashko as Chairman of the Supreme Soviet of Ukraine.

description.zh-cn: 列昂尼德·克拉夫丘克在1991年12月1日的总统选举中当选为首任乌克兰总统。
description.en: Leonid Kravchuk was elected as the first President of Ukraine in the presidential election on December 1, 1991.

description.zh-cn: 列昂尼德·库奇马接替列昂尼德·克拉夫丘克担任乌克兰总统。
description.en: Leonid Kuchma succeeded Leonid Kravchuk as President of Ukraine.

description.zh-cn: 齐桥桥于1949年3月1日出生在延安桥儿沟中央医院。
description.en: Qi Qiaoqiao was born on March 1, 1949, at Yan'an Central Hospital in Qiao'ergou.

description.zh-cn: 齐桥桥在北京市八一学校就读小学。
description.en: Qi Qiaoqiao attended primary school at Beijing Bayi School.

description.zh-cn: 齐桥桥担任北京中民信房地产开发有限公司董事长。
description.en: Qi Qiaoqiao serves as the Chairman of Beijing Zhongminxin Real Estate Development Co., Ltd.

description.zh-cn: 齐桥桥是银川大学的客座教授。
description.en: Qi Qiaoqiao is a visiting professor at Yinchuan University.

description.zh-cn: 邓家贵于1990年与齐桥桥相识。
description.en: Deng Jiagui met Qi Qiaoqiao in 1990.

description.zh-cn: 习仲勋让女儿习桥桥随母姓，改名齐桥桥。
description.en: Xi Zhongxun had his daughter Xi Qiaoqiao take her mother's surname, changing her name to Qi Qiaoqiao.

description.zh-cn: 娜杰日达·阿利卢耶娃是斯大林的第二任妻子。
description.en: Nadezhda Alliluyeva was the second wife of Stalin.

description.zh-cn: 根据娜杰日达的密友波林娜·热姆丘任娜的说法，两人的婚姻并不愉快，斯大林和娜杰日达之间经常发生争吵。
description.en: According to Nadezhda's close friend Polina Zhemchuzhina, their marriage was unhappy, and Stalin and Nadezhda frequently quarreled.

description.zh-cn: 十月革命之后，娜杰日达成为列宁办公室的机要秘书。
description.en: After the October Revolution, Nadezhda became a confidential secretary in Lenin's office.

description.zh-cn: 根据文本，波林娜·热姆丘任娜是娜杰日达·阿利卢耶娃的密友。
description.en: According to the text, Polina Zhemchuzhina was a close friend of Nadezhda Alliluyeva.

description.zh-cn: 因拒绝在娜杰日达·阿利卢耶娃的验尸报告上签字，列夫·列文在第二次莫斯科审判中被处决。
description.en: For refusing to sign Nadezhda Alliluyeva's autopsy report, Lev Levin was executed during the Second Moscow Trial.

description.zh-cn: 先后三次向香港律政司提出司法互助请求，希望港府遣送陈同佳到台湾受审。
description.en: Made three judicial assistance requests to the Hong Kong Department of Justice, hoping the Hong Kong government would extradite Chan Tong-kai to Taiwan for trial.

description.zh-cn: 以港台两地之间并无移交疑犯的机制为由，未理会台湾士林地方检察署的三度司法互助请求。
description.en: Citing the lack of an extradition mechanism between Hong Kong and Taiwan, the government ignored three requests for judicial assistance from the Taiwan Shilin District Prosecutors Office.

description.zh-cn: 正式对陈同佳发出时效长达37年6个月的通缉令。
description.en: Officially issued a warrant for the arrest of Chan Tong-kai with a statute of limitations of 37 years and 6 months.

description.zh-cn: 在香港立法会中反对该修订草案。
description.en: Opposed the amendment bill in the Hong Kong Legislative Council.

description.zh-cn: 曾就读于圣公会圣马利亚堂莫庆尧中学。
description.en: Formerly studied at SKH St. Mary's Church Mok Hing Yiu College.

description.zh-cn: 曾修读商科副学士课程，后退学。
description.en: Studied for an associate degree in business, but later dropped out.

description.zh-cn: 劝说陈同佳同意赴台自首，并在其出狱后提供协助。
description.en: Persuaded Chan Tong-kai to agree to surrender in Taiwan and provided assistance after his release from prison.

description.zh-cn: 担任香港特别行政区第五届政府的行政长官。
description.en: Served as the Chief Executive of the Fifth Administration of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

description.zh-cn: 萧建华于2017年在香港被带走，此事成为中纪委要求港府修例以建立合法引渡渠道的触发点。
description.en: Xiao Jianhua was taken from Hong Kong in 2017, an incident that became the trigger for the CCDI to demand that the Hong Kong government amend its laws to establish a legal extradition channel.

description.zh-cn: 赵秉钧是袁世凯的亲信，在其提拔下掌握警政实权，并在袁世凯内阁中任职。
description.en: Zhao Bingjun was a confidant of Yuan Shikai. Under Yuan's promotion, he gained control of police administration and served in Yuan's cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯多次推荐和提拔赵秉钧，使其先后担任知府、巡警部右侍郎等职，并掌握警政实权。1915年12月袁世凯称帝后，追赠赵秉钧为一等忠襄公。
description.en: Yuan Shikai repeatedly recommended and promoted Zhao Bingjun, enabling him to hold positions such as Prefect and Right Vice Minister of the Ministry of Police, and to control police administration. After Yuan Shikai declared himself emperor in December 1915, he posthumously honored Zhao Bingjun with the title of First-Class Duke Zhongxiang.

description.zh-cn: 赵秉钧与驻中国的日本警官合力创制了中国近代警察制度，被誉为创始人。
description.en: Zhao Bingjun, in collaboration with Japanese police officers in China, created China's modern police system and is regarded as its founder.

description.zh-cn: 赵秉钧辞去国务总理后，由段祺瑞代理其职务。
description.en: After Zhao Bingjun resigned as Premier, Duan Qirui took over as acting Premier.

description.zh-cn: 赵秉钧在1900年参与镇压义和团。
description.en: Zhao Bingjun participated in the suppression of the Boxer Rebellion in 1900.

description.zh-cn: 赵秉钧曾在直隷总督李鸿章手下补用为知州。
description.en: Zhao Bingjun served as a prefect under the Governor-General of Zhili, Li Hongzhang.

description.zh-cn: 辛亥革命的爆发导致清政府重新启用袁世凯，并组建了袁世凯内阁。
description.en: The outbreak of the Xinhai Revolution led the Qing government to reappoint Yuan Shikai and form the Yuan Shikai Cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 赵秉钧奉袁世凯之命开展反唐运动，导致唐绍仪被迫辞去总理职务。
description.en: Under Yuan Shikai's orders, Zhao Bingjun launched an anti-Tang movement, which forced Tang Shaoyi to resign as Premier.

description.zh-cn: 陆征祥因遭到中华民国临时参议院的弹劾而被迫辞职。
description.en: Lu Zhengxiang was forced to resign after being impeached by the Provisional Senate of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 曹洪是曹操麾下的重要将领，为其效力。
description.en: Cao Hong was an important general under Cao Cao.

description.zh-cn: 曹丕称帝后，曹洪在其麾下任职。
description.en: After Cao Pi became emperor, Cao Hong served under him.

description.zh-cn: 曹叡即位后，曹洪在其麾下任职。
description.en: After Cao Rui ascended the throne, Cao Hong served under him.

description.zh-cn: 曹洪是曹操的堂弟。
description.en: Cao Hong was Cao Cao's younger paternal cousin.

description.zh-cn: 曹纯是曹洪的弟弟。
description.en: Cao Chun was Cao Hong's younger brother.

description.zh-cn: 曹馥是曹洪的儿子。
description.en: Cao Fu was the son of Cao Hong.

description.zh-cn: 曹震是曹洪的儿子。
description.en: Cao Zhen was the son of Cao Hong.

description.zh-cn: 曹洪是曹魏的开国功臣和重要将领。
description.en: Cao Hong was a founding contributor and important general of Cao Wei.

description.zh-cn: 曹洪的籍贯是沛国谯县。
description.en: Cao Hong's ancestral home was Qiao County, Pei Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 在荥阳之战中，曹操兵败失去坐骑，曹洪将自己的马让给曹操，并说出“天下可无洪，不可无公”的话，救了曹操一命。
description.en: In the Battle of Xingyang, after Cao Cao was defeated and lost his horse, Cao Hong gave his own horse to Cao Cao, saying 'The world can do without Hong, but not without you, my lord,' saving his life.

description.zh-cn: 曹洪与扬州刺史陈温有深厚的交情。
description.en: Cao Hong had a deep friendship with Chen Wen, the Inspector of Yang Province.

description.zh-cn: 官渡之战中，张郃前来投降时，曹洪心存疑虑，荀攸劝说曹洪接纳了张郃。
description.en: During the Battle of Guandu, when Zhang He came to surrender, Cao Hong was suspicious. Xun You persuaded Cao Hong to accept Zhang He.

description.zh-cn: 官渡之战中，曹洪听从荀攸的建议，接纳了前来投降的张郃。
description.en: During the Battle of Guandu, Cao Hong followed Xun You's advice and accepted the surrender of Zhang He.

description.zh-cn: 在下辨之战中，曹洪率军击败了刘备的将领吴兰。
description.en: In the Battle of Xiabian, Cao Hong led forces to defeat Liu Bei's general Wu Lan.

description.zh-cn: 曹丕称帝后，借口曹洪的食客犯法，将其收监并准备处死，后虽免死但仍被削爵贬为庶民。
description.en: After becoming emperor, Cao Pi used the excuse of Cao Hong's retainer breaking the law to imprison him and prepare for his execution. Although spared death, he was stripped of his titles and reduced to a commoner.

description.zh-cn: 在曹洪将被曹丕处死时，卞太后出面干预，胁迫郭皇后向曹丕求情，最终使曹洪免于一死。
description.en: When Cao Hong was about to be executed by Cao Pi, Empress Dowager Bian intervened, forcing Empress Guo to plead with Cao Pi, ultimately saving Cao Hong's life.

description.zh-cn: 在卞太后的胁迫下，郭皇后尽力为曹洪周旋求情，使其免死。
description.en: Under pressure from Empress Dowager Bian, Empress Guo interceded on Cao Hong's behalf, saving him from execution.

description.zh-cn: 曹叡即位后，恢复了曹洪的名誉和爵位。
