description.en: After ascending the throne, Cao Rui restored Cao Hong's reputation and titles.

description.zh-cn: 在汉中之战后的庆功宴上，杨阜因曹洪令女倡跳脱衣舞而厉声谴责他。
description.en: At a celebratory banquet after the Hanzhong Campaign, Yang Fu harshly condemned Cao Hong for making female entertainers perform a striptease.

description.zh-cn: 许令满宠不听曹洪求情，依法处置了其犯法的宾客。
description.en: Man Chong, the Prefect of Xu, ignored Cao Hong's pleas and dealt with his law-breaking retainers according to the law.

description.zh-cn: 阮瑀拒绝了曹洪强迫其担任书记的要求。
description.en: Ruan Yu refused Cao Hong's forceful demand to serve as his secretary.

description.zh-cn: 司马懿耻于和曹洪来往，以生病为由拒绝了曹洪的邀请。
description.en: Sima Yi was ashamed to associate with Cao Hong and declined his invitation on the grounds of illness.

description.zh-cn: 因司马懿拒绝与自己来往，曹洪心生怨恨并向曹操告状。
description.en: Because Sima Yi refused to associate with him, Cao Hong became resentful and reported him to Cao Cao.

description.zh-cn: 因马尼拉人质事件一同前往礼顿山社区礼堂追悼遇难者。
description.en: Attended a memorial service for the victims of the Manila hostage crisis at Leighton Hill Community Hall together.

description.zh-cn: 因马尼拉人质事件一同前往礼顿山社区礼堂追悼遇难者。
description.en: Attended a memorial service for the victims of the Manila hostage crisis at Leighton Hill Community Hall together.

description.zh-cn: 因马尼拉人质事件一同前往礼顿山社区礼堂追悼遇难者。
description.en: Attended a memorial service for the victims of the Manila hostage crisis at Leighton Hill Community Hall together.

description.zh-cn: 陈伯达在中共九大上当选为政治局常委，但在九届二中全会后失势。
description.en: Chen Boda was elected as a member of the Politburo Standing Committee at the 9th CPC National Congress, but fell from power after the Second Plenary Session of the 9th Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 陈伯达在文化大革命初期担任中央文革小组组长，是运动的主要领导者之一。
description.en: Chen Boda served as the leader of the Central Cultural Revolution Group in the early stages of the Cultural Revolution, and was one of the main leaders of the movement.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，陈伯达作为中央文革小组组长，参与了对时任国家主席刘少奇的批判和迫害。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, as the head of the Central Cultural Revolution Group, Chen Boda participated in the criticism and persecution of then-State Chairman Liu Shaoqi.

position.zh-cn: 中共中央北方局宣传部部长
position.en: Minister of the Propaganda Department of the Northern Bureau of the CPC Central Committee

description.zh-cn: 1936年春，时任中共中央北方局书记的刘少奇提名陈伯达担任宣传部部长。
description.en: In the spring of 1936, Liu Shaoqi, then Secretary of the Northern Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, nominated Chen Boda to be the Minister of the Propaganda Department.

description.zh-cn: 周恩来在华北会议上作总结讲话，系统地揭露了陈伯达的罪行。
description.en: Zhou Enlai delivered a concluding speech at the North China Conference, systematically exposing Chen Boda's crimes.

description.zh-cn: 经毛泽东批准，陈伯达率领工作组到人民日报社夺权。
description.en: With Mao Zedong's approval, Chen Boda led a work team to seize power at the People's Daily office.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平在给毛泽东的信中，将陈伯达与林彪并列为反革命集团，并对其个人品质作出负面评价。
description.en: In a letter to Mao Zedong, Deng Xiaoping equated Chen Boda with Lin Biao as a counter-revolutionary clique and made negative comments on his personal character.

description.zh-cn: 在该案的审判中，陈伯达被判处有期徒刑18年。
description.en: In the trial of this case, Chen Boda was sentenced to 18 years in prison.

description.zh-cn: 在中共六大后，向忠发当选为中央政治局主席兼中央政治局常委会主席，党内习惯称之为“总书记”。
description.en: After the 6th National Congress of the CCP, Xiang Zhongfa was elected Chairman of the Central Politburo and its Standing Committee, a position customarily referred to within the party as 'General Secretary'.

description.zh-cn: 在向忠发担任湖北省总工会委员长期间，刘少奇是其副委员长。
description.en: While Xiang Zhongfa was Chairman of the Hubei Provincial General Labor Union, Liu Shaoqi was his Vice Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 在向忠发担任湖北省总工会委员长期间，李立三是其副委员长。
description.en: While Xiang Zhongfa was Chairman of the Hubei Provincial General Labor Union, Li Lisan was his Vice Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 在向忠发担任湖北省总工会委员长期间，项英是其副委员长。
description.en: While Xiang Zhongfa was Chairman of the Hubei Provincial General Labor Union, Xiang Ying was his Vice Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 向忠发在中共五大上当选为中央委员，进入中共中央领导层。
description.en: Xiang Zhongfa was elected to the Central Committee at the 5th National Congress of the CCP, entering the party's central leadership.

description.zh-cn: 在共产国际的支持下，向忠发在中共六大后当选为中央政治局主席兼常委会主席，成为名义上的党内最高领导人。
description.en: With the support of the Comintern, Xiang Zhongfa was elected Chairman of the Central Politburo and its Standing Committee after the 6th National Congress of the CCP, becoming the nominal top leader of the party.

description.zh-cn: 在周恩来前往苏联期间，向忠发听信李立三的建议，推行了“立三路线”的冒险主义政策。
description.en: While Zhou Enlai was in the Soviet Union, Xiang Zhongfa heeded Li Lisan's advice and implemented the adventurist policies of the 'Lisan Line'.

description.zh-cn: 共产国际派遣周恩来和瞿秋白回国，在中共六届三中全会上纠正了李立三的错误路线。
description.en: The Comintern dispatched Zhou Enlai and Qu Qiubai back to China, where they corrected Li Lisan's erroneous line at the Third Plenum of the 6th CCP Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 共产国际派遣周恩来和瞿秋白回国，在中共六届三中全会上纠正了李立三的错误路线。
description.en: The Comintern dispatched Zhou Enlai and Qu Qiubai back to China, where they corrected Li Lisan's erroneous line at the Third Plenum of the 6th CCP Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 向忠发被捕后，时任国民政府领导人蒋介石下达了“就地枪决”的命令。
description.en: After Xiang Zhongfa's arrest, Chiang Kai-shek, then leader of the Nationalist Government, issued the order to 'execute on the spot'.

description.zh-cn: 向忠发在中共六大后接替陈独秀（及其后的瞿秋白），成为中共最高领导人。
description.en: After the 6th National Congress of the CCP, Xiang Zhongfa succeeded Chen Duxiu (and his successor Qu Qiubai) to become the top leader of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 设立中央顾问委员会是为解决干部领导职务终身制问题、实现新老交替而采取的一种过渡性措施。
description.en: The establishment of the Central Advisory Commission was a transitional measure taken to address the issue of lifelong tenure for leading cadres and to achieve the transition from the old to the new generation of leaders.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平是设立中央顾问委员会的主要倡导者和推动者，多次提出并最终促成了该机构的建立。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping was the main advocate and promoter for the establishment of the Central Advisory Commission, proposing it multiple times and ultimately facilitating its creation.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东在1973年曾考虑设立一个以老干部为主的“中央顾问委员会”，提出了该机构的初步设想，尽管当时未能实现。
description.en: In 1973, Mao Zedong considered establishing a 'Central Advisory Committee' mainly composed of veteran cadres, putting forward the initial concept for the body, although it was not realized at the time.

description.zh-cn: 1982年通过的《中国共产党章程》为中央顾问委员会的设立提供了法规依据，明确了其性质、任务和权限。
description.en: The Constitution of the Communist Party of China, adopted in 1982, provided the legal basis for the establishment of the Central Advisory Commission, defining its nature, tasks, and powers.

description.zh-cn: 根据党章规定，中央顾问委员会是中央委员会的政治上的助手、参谋，在中央委员会的领导下工作。
description.en: According to the party constitution, the Central Advisory Commission was a political assistant and advisor to the Central Committee and worked under its leadership.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平担任中央顾问委员会第一届主任。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping served as the Director of the first Central Advisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 陈云担任中央顾问委员会第二届主任。
description.en: Chen Yun served as the Director of the second Central Advisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 宋任穷于1985年增选为中顾委副主任，并在第二届中连任。
description.en: Song Renqiong was elected as a Vice Director of the Central Advisory Commission in 1985 and was re-elected for the second term.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平在1989年9月明确提出从中共十四大起不再设立中顾委的设想，并在此后坚持中顾委必须撤销。
description.en: In September 1989, Deng Xiaoping clearly proposed the idea of not establishing the Central Advisory Commission from the 14th National Congress of the CPC onwards, and subsequently insisted that it must be abolished.

description.zh-cn: 1991年上半年，时任中顾委主任陈云表示自己将在中共十四大后退下，并建议研究不再设立中顾委。
description.en: In the first half of 1991, Chen Yun, then Director of the Central Advisory Commission, stated that he would step down after the 14th National Congress of the CPC and suggested that the abolition of the commission be considered.

description.zh-cn: 中共十四大通过了关于中央顾问委员会工作报告的决议，同意了其报告中提出的“不再设立中央顾问委员会”的建议，正式结束了该机构的历史使命。
description.en: The 14th National Congress of the CPC passed a resolution on the work report of the Central Advisory Commission, agreeing to the suggestion in the report to 'no longer establish the Central Advisory Commission', officially ending the historical mission of the institution.

description.zh-cn: 1991年上半年，陈丕显在上海看望了时任中顾委主任陈云。
description.en: In the first half of 1991, Chen Pixian visited Chen Yun, then Director of the Central Advisory Commission, in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 在中央党校函授学院经济管理专业学习。
description.en: Studied economic management through the correspondence college of the Central Party School.

description.zh-cn: 2008年中国奶制品污染事件后，车俊被任命为中共石家庄市委书记，处理该事件的后续事宜。
description.en: After the 2008 Chinese milk scandal, Che Jun was appointed as the Party Secretary of Shijiazhuang to handle the aftermath of the incident.

description.zh-cn: 任命车俊为全国人大监察和司法委员会副主任委员。
description.en: Appointed Che Jun as Deputy Director of the Supervision and Judicial Affairs Committee of the National People's Congress.

position.en: Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Committee of the CCP

description.zh-cn: 车俊担任浙江省委书记期间，习近平为中共中央总书记。
description.en: During Che Jun's tenure as Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee, Xi Jinping was the General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 车俊接替夏宝龙出任中共浙江省委书记。
description.en: Che Jun succeeded Xia Baolong as Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 车俊任浙江省委书记期间，袁家军任副书记、省长，后接任车俊的书记职务。
description.en: During Che Jun's tenure as Zhejiang Provincial Party Secretary, Yuan Jiajun served as Deputy Secretary and Governor, and later succeeded Che Jun as Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 车俊接替李强出任浙江省人民政府代省长。
description.en: Che Jun succeeded Li Qiang as Acting Governor of Zhejiang Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 韩勇接替车俊出任新疆生产建设兵团政治委员。
description.en: Han Yong succeeded Che Jun as Political Commissar of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps.

description.zh-cn: 车俊接替吴显国出任中共石家庄市委书记。
description.en: Che Jun succeeded Wu Xianguo as Secretary of the Shijiazhuang Municipal Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 梁兴初于1913年8月23日出生于江西省吉安县。
description.en: Liang Xingchu was born in Jian County, Jiangxi Province on August 23, 1913.

description.zh-cn: 1930年4月，梁兴初参加中国工农红军。
description.en: In April 1930, Liang Xingchu joined the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 1930年11月，梁兴初加入中国共产党。
description.en: In November 1930, Liang Xingchu joined the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 1936年，梁兴初进入抗日军政大学学习。
description.en: In 1936, Liang Xingchu enrolled in the Counter-Japanese Military and Political University.

description.zh-cn: 1960年，梁兴初毕业于中国人民解放军高等军事学院。
description.en: In 1960, Liang Xingchu graduated from the PLA Higher Military Academy.

description.zh-cn: 长征途经哈达铺时，梁兴初奉命搜集报纸，促使毛泽东决策红军进军陕北。
description.en: During the Long March, while passing through Hadapu, Liang Xingchu was ordered to collect newspapers, which prompted Mao Zedong to decide to march the Red Army to northern Shaanxi.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争期间，梁兴初被王凤鸣指控为托派，险遭杀害。
description.en: During the Second Sino-Japanese War, Liang Xingchu was accused by Wang Fengming of being a Trotskyist and was nearly killed.

description.zh-cn: 在梁兴初被王凤鸣指控为托派时，经罗荣桓干预而幸免于难。
description.en: When Liang Xingchu was accused by Wang Fengming of being a Trotskyist, he was saved through the intervention of Luo Ronghuan.

description.zh-cn: 1942年，刘少奇视察115师与山东军区时，与梁兴初等人合影。
description.en: In 1942, when Liu Shaoqi inspected the 115th Division and the Shandong Military Region, he was photographed with Liang Xingchu and others.

description.zh-cn: 1942年，刘少奇视察115师与山东军区时，与梁兴初、罗荣桓等人合影。
description.en: In 1942, when Liu Shaoqi inspected the 115th Division and the Shandong Military Region, he was photographed with Liang Xingchu, Luo Ronghuan and others.

position.zh-cn: 第一纵队副司令员、第六纵队副司令员、第十纵队司令员
position.en: Deputy Commander of the 1st Column, Deputy Commander of the 6th Column, Commander of the 10th Column

description.zh-cn: 梁兴初在东北民主联军时期先后担任第一、第六纵队副司令员和第十纵队司令员。
description.en: During his time in the Northeast Democratic United Army, Liang Xingchu served successively as Deputy Commander of the 1st and 6th Columns, and Commander of the 10th Column.

description.zh-cn: 在辽沈战役期间，梁兴初奉东北人民解放军司令员林彪之命，率部参加黑山阻击战。
description.en: During the Liaoshen Campaign, under the orders of Lin Biao, commander of the Northeast People's Liberation Army, Liang Xingchu led his troops in the Battle of Heishan.

description.zh-cn: 梁兴初率领第10纵队发起了黑山阻击战，成功阻击了廖耀湘兵团。
description.en: Liang Xingchu led the 10th Column to launch the Battle of Heishan, successfully blocking the Liao Yaoxiang Army Group.

description.zh-cn: 在黑山阻击战中，梁兴初率部阻击了国民党军廖耀湘兵团。
description.en: In the Battle of Heishan, Liang Xingchu led his troops to block the KMT's Liao Yaoxiang Army Group.

description.zh-cn: 1949年5月，梁兴初调任第38军军长，并率该部参加朝鲜战争。
description.en: In May 1949, Liang Xingchu was transferred to be the commander of the 38th Army and led this unit in the Korean War.

description.zh-cn: 在朝鲜战争中，梁兴初率领中国人民志愿军第38军与联合国军作战。
description.en: In the Korean War, Liang Xingchu led the 38th Army of the Chinese People's Volunteers to fight against the UN forces.

description.zh-cn: 1967年3月，梁兴初任成都军区司令员。
description.en: In March 1967, Liang Xingchu became the commander of the Chengdu Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 1969年，在中共九大上当选中央委员。
description.en: In 1969, he was elected as a member of the Central Committee at the 9th National Congress of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 1971年林彪事件后，梁兴初受到牵连，于1972年被免职并接受审查。
description.en: After the Lin Biao incident in 1971, Liang Xingchu was implicated, dismissed from his post in 1972, and placed under investigation.

description.zh-cn: 1981年10月，中共中央决定为梁兴初平反，免于党内外一切处分，恢复其大军区正职待遇。
description.en: In October 1981, the CPC Central Committee decided to rehabilitate Liang Xingchu, exempting him from all punishments inside and outside the party and restoring his treatment as a military region commander.

description.zh-cn: 梁兴初与陈仁麒、谢家祥一同因林彪事件受到牵连并被审查。
description.en: Liang Xingchu, along with Chen Renqi and Xie Jiaxiang, was implicated and investigated in connection with the Lin Biao incident.

description.zh-cn: 梁兴初与陈仁麒、谢家祥一同因林彪事件受到牵连并被审查。
description.en: Liang Xingchu, along with Chen Renqi and Xie Jiaxiang, was implicated and investigated in connection with the Lin Biao incident.

description.zh-cn: 1947年9月东北民主联军第十纵队组建时，梁兴初任司令员，周赤萍任政治委员。
description.en: When the 10th Column of the Northeast Democratic United Army was formed in September 1947, Liang Xingchu was the commander and Zhou Chiping was the political commissar.

description.zh-cn: 杨尚昆与李伯钊于1929年在苏联莫斯科结婚。
description.en: Yang Shangkun married Li Bozhao in Moscow, Soviet Union in 1929.

description.zh-cn: 杨李是杨尚昆的女儿。
description.en: Yang Li is the daughter of Yang Shangkun.

description.zh-cn: 1926年11月，杨尚昆受中共委派赴苏联，入莫斯科中山大学学习。
description.en: In November 1926, Yang Shangkun was sent by the CPC to the Soviet Union to study at Moscow Sun Yat-sen University.

description.zh-cn: 1926年，杨尚昆入上海大学学习。
description.en: In 1926, Yang Shangkun enrolled in Shanghai University to study.

description.zh-cn: 杨尚昆接替李先念担任中华人民共和国第四任主席。
description.en: Yang Shangkun succeeded Li Xiannian as the fourth President of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 杨尚昆在任期内担任中国共产党中央军事委员会和中华人民共和国中央军事委员会的副主席。
description.en: During his tenure, Yang Shangkun served as Vice Chairman of both the Central Military Commission of the Communist Party of China and the Central Military Commission of the People's Republic of China.

position.zh-cn: 中共中央军委副主席、秘书长
position.en: Vice Chairman and Secretary-General of the CPC Central Military Commission

description.zh-cn: 在邓小平担任中央军委主席期间，杨尚昆担任副主席及秘书长。
description.en: While Deng Xiaoping was Chairman of the Central Military Commission, Yang Shangkun served as Vice Chairman and Secretary-General.

position.en: Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Military Commission

description.zh-cn: 在江泽民接任中央军委主席后，杨尚昆继续担任副主席。
description.en: After Jiang Zemin took over as Chairman of the Central Military Commission, Yang Shangkun continued to serve as Vice Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 杨尚昆长期担任中共中央办公厅主任。
description.en: Yang Shangkun served as the Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee for a long period.

description.zh-cn: 长征期间，杨尚昆和彭德怀率领红三军团，杨尚昆任政治委员。
description.en: During the Long March, Yang Shangkun and Peng Dehuai led the Third Red Army Corps, with Yang serving as its Political Commissar.

description.zh-cn: 长征期间，杨尚昆与彭德怀共同率领红三军团。
description.en: During the Long March, Yang Shangkun and Peng Dehuai jointly led the Third Red Army Corps.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命开始后，杨尚昆被列为“彭、罗、陆、杨反党集团”成员，被撤销一切职务并受到监护审查。
description.en: After the start of the Cultural Revolution, Yang Shangkun was labeled a member of the 'Peng, Luo, Lu, Yang Anti-Party Clique', stripped of all positions, and placed under surveillance and investigation.

description.zh-cn: 刘少奇在一次座谈会上发表讲话，将彭、罗、陆、杨定性为反对毛主席、企图实现修正主义政策的反党集团。
description.en: In a speech at a symposium, Liu Shaoqi characterized Peng, Luo, Lu, and Yang as an anti-Party clique opposing Chairman Mao and attempting to implement revisionist policies.

description.zh-cn: 在六四天安门事件期间，杨尚昆最终表明坚决支持李鹏、邓小平的决定，支持对事件的武力镇压。
description.en: During the 1989 Tiananmen Square incident, Yang Shangkun ultimately expressed firm support for the decisions of Li Peng and Deng Xiaoping, endorsing the military crackdown.

description.zh-cn: 1992年春，杨尚昆陪同邓小平进行南方巡视，并和其弟杨白冰公开表态军方坚定支持改革开放。
description.en: In the spring of 1992, Yang Shangkun accompanied Deng Xiaoping on his Southern Tour, and together with his brother Yang Baibing, publicly declared the military's firm support for the reform and opening-up policy.

description.zh-cn: 科大讯飞由中国科学技术大学背景的“讯飞信息科技有限公司”整体变更设立，体现了其与该大学的紧密渊源。
description.en: iFlytek was established through the overall transformation of 'Xunfei Information Technology Co., Ltd.', a company with ties to the University of Science and Technology of China, reflecting its close origins with the university.

description.zh-cn: 科大讯飞在深圳证券交易所中小板挂牌上市，成为其上市公司成员。
description.en: iFlytek was listed on the SME Board of the Shenzhen Stock Exchange, becoming one of its listed company members.

description.zh-cn: 刘庆峰现任科大讯飞董事长。他曾兼任总裁一职，并于2021年2月7日卸任该职务。
description.en: Liu Qingfeng serves as the Chairman of iFlytek. He also held the position of President until he stepped down on February 7, 2021.

description.zh-cn: 《纽约时报》于2017年12月5日发文，评价科大讯飞的人工智能技术背后存在反乌托邦可能性，对其公众形象和声誉造成了负面影响。
description.en: On December 5, 2017, The New York Times published an article evaluating the dystopian possibilities behind iFlytek's artificial intelligence technology, negatively impacting its public image and reputation.

description.zh-cn: 以新疆穆斯林人权问题为由，美国商务部于2019年10月8日将科大讯飞列入《出口管制条例》的实体清单，从而限制其获取美国技术和产品。
description.en: Citing the Xinjiang Muslim human rights issue, the U.S. Department of Commerce added iFlytek to the Entity List of the Export Administration Regulations on October 8, 2019, thereby restricting its access to U.S. technology and products.

description.zh-cn: 刘季幸是江苏靖江人。
description.en: Liu Jixing is a native of Jingjiang, Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 1979年至1983年，刘季幸就读于西南政法学院。
description.en: From 1979 to 1983, Liu Jixing studied at the Southwest College of Political Science and Law.

description.zh-cn: 刘季幸曾任中央军委纪委专职委员。
description.en: Liu Jixing previously served as a full-time member of the Discipline Inspection Commission of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 刘季幸于2009年7月任中国人民解放军军事法院副院长，2011年8月升任院长，直至2018年6月卸任。
description.en: Liu Jixing was appointed Vice President of the PLA Military Court in July 2009, promoted to President in August 2011, and served until June 2018.

position.en: Grand Justice of the first rank

description.zh-cn: 2012年12月，刘季幸获晋一级大法官。
description.en: In December 2012, Liu Jixing was promoted to the rank of Grand Justice of the first rank.

description.zh-cn: 2014年12月，刘季幸与时任中国人民解放军军事检察院检察长李晓峰一同晋升为副大军区级。
description.en: In December 2014, Liu Jixing and Li Xiaofeng, then Procurator-General of the PLA Military Procuratorate, were promoted together to the deputy theater command level.

description.zh-cn: 2018年2月24日，刘季幸当选为第十三届全国人大代表。
description.en: On February 24, 2018, Liu Jixing was elected as a deputy to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 2016年8月，刘季幸晋升中将军衔。
description.en: In August 2016, Liu Jixing was promoted to the rank of lieutenant general.

description.zh-cn: 2018年3月，刘季幸开始担任第十三届全国人民代表大会常务委员会委员。
description.en: In March 2018, Liu Jixing began to serve as a member of the Standing Committee of the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 2018年3月，刘季幸开始担任第十三届全国人民代表大会宪法和法律委员会副主任委员。
description.en: In March 2018, Liu Jixing began to serve as a Vice Chairman of the Constitution and Law Committee of the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 刘季幸接替苏勇担任中国人民解放军军事法院院长职务。
description.en: Liu Jixing succeeded Su Yong as the President of the PLA Military Court.

description.zh-cn: 刘立根接替刘季幸担任中国人民解放军军事法院院长职务。
description.en: Liu Ligen succeeded Liu Jixing as the President of the PLA Military Court.

description.zh-cn: 刘季幸是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Liu Jixing is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 武正国是山西交城人。
description.en: Wu Zhengguo is from Jiaocheng, Shanxi.

position.zh-cn: 办公厅主任; 秘书长; 省委常委
position.en: Director of the General Office; Secretary-General; Member of the Standing Committee of the Provincial Committee

description.zh-cn: 武正国于1982年担任中共山西省委办公厅主任，1995年改任中共山西省委秘书长，并于1996年出任山西省省委常委。
description.en: Wu Zhengguo served as the Director of the General Office of the CPC Shanxi Provincial Committee in 1982, was appointed Secretary-General in 1995, and became a member of the Standing Committee of the Shanxi Provincial Party Committee in 1996.

description.zh-cn: 2000年，武正国改任山西省人大常委会副主任。
description.en: In 2000, Wu Zhengguo was reassigned to the position of Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Shanxi Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 武正国是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Wu Zhengguo is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 武正国是中国作家协会会员。
description.en: Wu Zhengguo is a member of the China Writers Association.

description.zh-cn: 武正国曾担任中华诗词学会副会长。
description.en: Wu Zhengguo served as the Vice President of the China National Association of Poetry.

description.zh-cn: 武正国曾担任中国政治学会副会长。
description.en: Wu Zhengguo served as the Vice President of the Chinese Association of Political Science.

description.zh-cn: 邦联军队炮击萨姆特堡，迫使其投降，此事件是美国内战的导火索。
description.en: The bombardment of Fort Sumter by Confederate forces, forcing its surrender, served as the trigger for the American Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 在邦联总统杰佛逊·戴维斯的命令下，皮埃尔·博雷加德指挥部队炮击萨姆特堡。
description.en: Under orders from Confederate President Jefferson Davis, P.G.T. Beauregard commanded the forces that bombarded Fort Sumter.

description.zh-cn: 联邦在美国内战中最终战胜邦联，维护了国家统一。
description.en: The Union ultimately defeated the Confederacy in the American Civil War, preserving the nation's unity.

description.zh-cn: 亚伯拉罕·林肯在美国内战期间担任美国总统，领导联邦。
description.en: Abraham Lincoln served as the President of the United States and led the Union during the Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 杰佛逊·戴维斯是美利坚联盟国的唯一一任总统。
description.en: Jefferson Davis was the only president of the Confederate States of America.

description.zh-cn: 在安提耶坦之役中，麦克莱伦指挥的联邦军阻止了李将军率领的邦联军的北侵。
description.en: At the Battle of Antietam, Union forces under McClellan halted the northern invasion by Confederate forces led by General Lee.

description.zh-cn: 在盖茨堡之役中，米德指挥的联邦军击败了李将军的军队，结束了其第二次北侵。
description.en: At the Battle of Gettysburg, Union forces commanded by Meade defeated General Lee's army, ending his second invasion of the North.

description.zh-cn: 盖茨堡之役的失败对邦联造成了重大打击，被广泛认为是战争的转折点。
description.en: The defeat at the Battle of Gettysburg was a major blow to the Confederacy and is widely considered the turning point of the war.

description.zh-cn: 美国内战的结束开启了美国重建时期，以解决南方各州重返联邦及非裔美国人权利等问题。
description.en: The end of the American Civil War initiated the Reconstruction era to address the reintegration of the southern states into the Union and the rights of African Americans.

description.zh-cn: 林肯总统在内战结束后不久遇刺身亡。
description.en: President Lincoln was assassinated shortly after the end of the Civil War, leading to his death.

description.zh-cn: 温菲尔德·史考特将军制定了旨在通过经济手段扼杀邦联的“蟒蛇计划”。
description.en: General Winfield Scott devised the 'Anaconda Plan' aimed at strangling the Confederacy through economic means.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党太原市委员会是中国共产党在太原市的地方领导机关。
description.en: The Taiyuan Municipal Committee of the CPC is the local leading body of the Communist Party of China in Taiyuan.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党太原市委员会的业务上级机构是中国共产党山西省委员会。
description.en: The immediate superior body of the Taiyuan Municipal Committee of the CPC is the Shanxi Provincial Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党章程是中国共产党太原市委员会的授权法源。
description.en: The Constitution of the Communist Party of China is the legal source of authority for the Taiyuan Municipal Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 1981年考入清华大学自动化系工业自动化专业学习，1986年本科毕业后在职攻读研究生，获系统工程专业硕士学位。
description.en: Admitted to the Department of Automation for Industrial Automation in 1981, and after graduating with a bachelor's degree in 1986, he pursued postgraduate studies part-time, obtaining a master's degree in Systems Engineering.

description.zh-cn: 2012年4月，杨振斌在升任厦门大学党委书记时，晋升为副部级干部。
description.en: In April 2012, when Yang Zhenbin was promoted to Party Secretary of Xiamen University, he was promoted to the vice-ministerial level.

description.zh-cn: 2012年4月，杨振斌接替朱之文担任中国共产党厦门大学委员会书记。
description.en: In April 2012, Yang Zhenbin succeeded Zhu Zhiwen as the Secretary of the CPC Xiamen University Committee.

description.zh-cn: 2014年11月，张彦接替杨振斌担任中国共产党厦门大学委员会书记。
description.en: In November 2014, Zhang Yan succeeded Yang Zhenbin as the Secretary of the CPC Xiamen University Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会办公厅是直接隶属于中国共产党中央委员会的工作机关。
description.en: The General Office of the CPC Central Committee is a working organ directly subordinate to the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会宣传部是直接隶属于中国共产党中央委员会的工作机关。
description.en: The Propaganda Department of the CPC Central Committee is a working organ directly subordinate to the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会统一战线工作部是直接隶属于中国共产党中央委员会的工作机关。
description.en: The United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee is a working organ directly subordinate to the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会对外联络部是直接隶属于中国共产党中央委员会的工作机关。
description.en: The International Liaison Department of the CPC Central Committee is a working organ directly subordinate to the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会政策研究室是直接隶属于中国共产党中央委员会的工作机关。
description.en: The Policy Research Office of the CPC Central Committee is a working organ directly subordinate to the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央党校是直接隶属于中国共产党中央委员会的事业单位。
description.en: The Party School of the CPC Central Committee is a public institution directly subordinate to the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中央金融委员会办公室与中央金融工作委员会合署办公。
description.en: The Office of the Central Financial Commission and the Central Financial Work Commission work together in the same premises.

description.zh-cn: 经济日报社由中央宣传部代管。
description.en: The Economic Daily is managed by the Central Propaganda Department.

description.zh-cn: 中央密码工作领导小组办公室与国家密码管理局，一个机构两块牌子。
description.en: The Office of the Central Leading Group for Cryptography Work and the State Cryptography Administration are one institution with two signs.

description.zh-cn: 1978年，14岁的李书磊考入北京大学图书馆学系学习。
description.en: In 1978, at the age of 14, Li Shulei was admitted to the Department of Library Science at Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 1985年获中国现代文学专业硕士学位，1989年获博士学位。
description.en: Received a Master's degree in modern Chinese literature in 1985 and a PhD in 1989.

description.zh-cn: 自1989年起长期在中央党校工作，曾任副校长（2008-2014），后返回担任常务副校长（2020-2022）。
description.en: Worked at the Central Party School for a long term since 1989, served as Vice President (2008-2014), and later returned as Executive Vice President (2020-2022).

position.en: Vice President of the Central Party School

description.zh-cn: 习近平任中共中央党校校长期间，李书磊任副校长，受到习的赏识，并经常参与起草习近平等高层的重要讲话稿。
description.en: While Xi Jinping was President of the Central Party School, Li Shulei served as Vice President, was appreciated by Xi, and often participated in drafting important speeches for Xi and other senior leaders.

description.zh-cn: 2022年4月任常务副部长，同年10月升任部长。
description.en: Appointed as Executive Deputy Head in April 2022, and promoted to Head in October of the same year.

description.zh-cn: 李书磊最敬佩的人是唐代诗人白居易。
description.en: The person Li Shulei admires most is the Tang dynasty poet Bai Juyi.

description.zh-cn: 蔡京是蔡卞的兄长。
description.en: Cai Jing is the elder brother of Cai Bian.

description.zh-cn: 蔡攸是蔡京的长子。
description.en: Cai You is the eldest son of Cai Jing.

description.zh-cn: 蔡绦是蔡京的第四子。
description.en: Cai Tao is the fourth son of Cai Jing.

description.zh-cn: 蔡翛是蔡京的第三子。
description.en: Cai Xiao is the third son of Cai Jing.

description.zh-cn: 蔡鞗是蔡京的第五子。
description.en: Cai Tiao is the fifth son of Cai Jing.

description.zh-cn: 蔡鞗迎娶宋徽宗之女茂德帝姬为妻。
description.en: Cai Tiao married Princess Maode, the daughter of Emperor Huizong.

description.zh-cn: 茂德帝姬是宋徽宗的女儿。
description.en: Princess Maode is the daughter of Emperor Huizong.

description.zh-cn: 蔡京于熙宁三年进士及第，在北宋朝廷中任官，先后四次担任宰相，最高至太师。
description.en: Cai Jing passed the imperial examination in 1070 and served in the Northern Song court, serving as prime minister four times and reaching the highest position of Grand Preceptor.

description.zh-cn: 蔡京早年支持王安石变法，并在绍圣元年（1094年）与章惇一同恢复免役法等新法政策。
description.en: Cai Jing supported Wang Anshi's reforms in his early years and, together with Zhang Dun, reinstated the New Policies such as the Hired Service Law in 1094.

description.zh-cn: 在元祐更化期间，蔡京遵从司马光的指令，在五日内将开封府的募役法改回差役法，受到司马光称赞。
description.en: During the Yuanyou Reforms, Cai Jing followed Sima Guang's orders and reverted the Hired Service Law back to the Corvée Labor Law in Kaifeng Prefecture within five days, earning praise from Sima Guang.

description.zh-cn: 蔡京在失势后结交宦官童贯，得以重新获得宋徽宗的任用。二人同为“六贼”，共同主导了宣和攻辽等重大决策。
description.en: After falling from power, Cai Jing allied with the eunuch Tong Guan to regain favor with Emperor Huizong. Both were members of the 'Six Traitors' and jointly led major decisions such as the war against the Liao during the Xuanhe era.

description.zh-cn: 崇宁元年（1102年），蔡京排挤掉时任宰相韩忠彦，自己得以复用并最终拜相。
description.en: In 1102, Cai Jing ousted the incumbent prime minister Han Zhongyan, enabling his own return to power and eventual appointment as prime minister.

description.zh-cn: 钦宗即位后，太学生陈东上书，将蔡京列为“六贼”之首，请求将其诛杀。
description.en: After Emperor Qinzong ascended the throne, the imperial university student Chen Dong submitted a memorial listing Cai Jing as the head of the 'Six Traitors' and called for his execution.

description.zh-cn: 靖康元年（1126年），宋钦宗即位后，将蔡京连续贬谪，最终移送至儋州，蔡京在途中病死。
description.en: In 1126, after Emperor Qinzong of Song ascended the throne, he successively demoted and exiled Cai Jing, ultimately ordering his transfer to Danzhou. Cai Jing died of illness en route.

description.zh-cn: 蔡京长子蔡攸后来与父蔡京各立门户，关系恶化至仇敌。蔡攸曾借口蔡京有病试图使其罢官，并最终联合他人逼其辞职。
description.en: Cai Jing's eldest son, Cai You, later established his own faction and his relationship with his father deteriorated to the point of enmity. Cai You once used his father's alleged illness as a pretext to have him dismissed and eventually forced his resignation in collaboration with others.

description.zh-cn: 蔡攸嫉妒其弟蔡绦擅权用事，联合白时中、李邦彦告发蔡绦，并请求宋徽宗将其处死。
description.en: Jealous of his younger brother Cai Tao's abuse of power, Cai You conspired with Bai Shizhong and Li Bangyan to denounce him and requested Emperor Huizong to execute him.

description.zh-cn: 蔡京被民间舆论和后世史家视为北宋末年“六贼”之首，对北宋的败亡负有重要责任。
description.en: Cai Jing was regarded by public opinion and later historians as the head of the 'Six Traitors' of the late Northern Song, bearing significant responsibility for the dynasty's fall.

description.zh-cn: 童贯与蔡京等人一同被列为祸国殃民的“六贼”。
description.en: Tong Guan, along with Cai Jing and others, was listed as one of the 'Six Traitors' who brought disaster to the country and its people.

description.zh-cn: 蔡京参与制定了北宋与金国的“海上之盟”，该盟约旨在联合金国攻打辽国。
description.en: Cai Jing participated in the formulation of the 'Alliance on the Sea' between the Northern Song and the Jin state, which aimed to jointly attack the Liao dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 宋孝宗即位后，下诏为已故的蔡京平反昭雪，恢复其官职并追赠鲁国公，此举被视为对其政治遗产的某种程度的重新评价。
description.en: After ascending the throne, Emperor Xiaozong of Song issued an edict to posthumously rehabilitate the deceased Cai Jing, restoring his official titles and conferring upon him the title of Duke of Lu. This act is seen as a re-evaluation of his political legacy to some extent.

description.zh-cn: 蔡京出生于福建路兴化军仙游县。
description.en: Cai Jing was born in Xianyou County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian Circuit.

description.zh-cn: 民族和宗教委员会是在常务委员会和主席会议领导下的工作机构。
description.en: The Committee for Ethnic and Religious Affairs is a working body under the leadership of the Standing Committee and the Chairperson's Council.

description.zh-cn: 民族和宗教委员会是在常务委员会和主席会议领导下的工作机构。
description.en: The Committee for Ethnic and Religious Affairs is a working body under the leadership of the Standing Committee and the Chairperson's Council.

description.zh-cn: 作为全国政协的下属机构，民族和宗教委员会接受全国政协党组的领导。
description.en: As a subordinate body of the CPPCC National Committee, the Committee for Ethnic and Religious Affairs accepts the leadership of the CPPCC National Committee's Party Group.

description.zh-cn: 办公室是民族和宗教委员会的办事机构。
description.en: The Office is the administrative body of the Committee for Ethnic and Religious Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 担任第十四届全国政协民族和宗教委员会主任。
description.en: Serves as the Chairman of the Committee for Ethnic and Religious Affairs of the 14th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 1949年6月30日，北朝鲜劳动党和南朝鲜劳动党合并为统一的朝鲜劳动党。
description.en: On June 30, 1949, the Workers' Party of North Korea and the Workers' Party of South Korea merged to form the unified Workers' Party of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 1949年6月30日，北朝鲜劳动党和南朝鲜劳动党合并为统一的朝鲜劳动党。
description.en: On June 30, 1949, the Workers' Party of North Korea and the Workers' Party of South Korea merged to form the unified Workers' Party of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 根据朝鲜劳动党党章，金日成是朝鲜劳动党的创建者。
description.en: According to the charter of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Il-sung is the founder of the party.

description.zh-cn: 金镕范是朝鲜劳动党的创建者之一。
description.en: Kim Yong-bom was one of the founders of the Workers' Party of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 朴宪永是朝鲜劳动党的创建者之一。
description.en: Pak Hon-yong was one of the founders of the Workers' Party of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜劳动党将朝鲜共产党北朝鲜分局的成立日（1945年10月10日）定为建党纪念日，视其为直接前身。
description.en: The Workers' Party of Korea designated the founding date of the North Korea Bureau of the Communist Party of Korea (October 10, 1945) as its founding anniversary, considering it a direct predecessor.

description.zh-cn: 金日成在1955年12月28日的演讲中首次提出“主体”概念，创立了主体思想。
description.en: Kim Il-sung first introduced the concept of 'Juche' in a speech on December 28, 1955, thereby creating the Juche Idea.

description.zh-cn: 金日成从苏联回国后，首先清除了原朝鲜共产党的代表人物玄俊赫。
description.en: After returning from the Soviet Union, Kim Il-sung first eliminated Hyon Chun-hyok, a representative figure of the original Communist Party of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 1951年，金日成以“平壤失守”和“作战不力”为由解除了延安派核心人物武亭的权力。
description.en: In 1951, Kim Il-sung used the 'fall of Pyongyang' and 'ineffective combat' as reasons to remove Mu Chong, a key figure of the Yan'an faction, from power.

description.zh-cn: 在八月宗派事件中，党内延安派和苏联派成员试图联合推翻金日成的领导地位。
description.en: During the August Faction Incident, members of the Yan'an and Soviet factions attempted to jointly overthrow Kim Il-sung's leadership.

description.zh-cn: 金日成组织力量反击，挫败了八月宗派事件中的挑战，并清洗了相关人员。
description.en: Kim Il-sung organized his forces to counterattack, thwarting the challenge during the August Faction Incident and purging the involved personnel.

description.zh-cn: 在八月宗派事件后，金日成对延安派进行了清洗，至1958年清洗完毕。
description.en: After the August Faction Incident, Kim Il-sung purged the Yan'an faction, completing the process by 1958.

description.zh-cn: 在八月宗派事件后，金日成对苏联派进行了清洗，至1961年清洗完毕。
description.en: After the August Faction Incident, Kim Il-sung purged the Soviet faction, completing the process by 1961.

description.zh-cn: 1967年5月，金日成以反对资产阶级、修正主义为名，批判并清除了甲山派。
description.en: In May 1967, Kim Il-sung criticized and purged the Kapsan faction under the pretext of opposing bourgeois and revisionist ideas.

description.zh-cn: 1968年“青瓦台事件”失败后，金日成追究军方领导责任，批判并处理了军内反对派。
description.en: After the failure of the 1968 'Blue House Raid,' Kim Il-sung held military leaders accountable, criticizing and dealing with the military opposition faction.

description.zh-cn: 金日成通过一系列党内清洗巩固权力后，于1974年确立了金正日的接班人地位。
description.en: After consolidating power through a series of internal purges, Kim Il-sung established Kim Jong-il's status as his successor in 1974.

description.zh-cn: 金正恩是现任朝鲜劳动党总书记，为该党的最高领导人。
description.en: Kim Jong-un is the current General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, serving as its supreme leader.

description.zh-cn: 根据朝鲜劳动党党章，朝鲜人民军是该党的革命武装力量。
description.en: According to the charter of the Workers' Party of Korea, the Korean People's Army is the party's revolutionary armed force.

description.zh-cn: 崔龙海是朝鲜劳动党中央委员会政治局常务委员会委员。
description.en: Choe Ryong-hae is a member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 李炳哲是朝鲜劳动党中央委员会政治局常务委员会委员。
description.en: Ri Pyong-chol is a member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 金德训是朝鲜劳动党中央委员会政治局常务委员会委员。
description.en: Kim Tok-hun is a member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 赵甬元是朝鲜劳动党中央委员会政治局常务委员会委员。
description.en: Jo Yong-won is a member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 朴正天是朝鲜劳动党中央委员会政治局常务委员会委员。
description.en: Pak Jong-chon is a member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 根据大韩民国的《国家保安法》，朝鲜劳动党被禁止在该国活动。
description.en: According to the National Security Act of the Republic of Korea, the Workers' Party of Korea is banned from operating in the country.

description.zh-cn: 1928年，因朝鲜共产党内部宗派斗争，共产国际下令解散朝鲜共产党。
description.en: In 1928, due to internal factional struggles within the Communist Party of Korea, the Comintern ordered its dissolution.

description.zh-cn: 李承晚政府对南朝鲜劳动党进行了镇压，导致其大多数领导人转移到朝鲜半岛北部。
description.en: The Syngman Rhee government suppressed the Workers' Party of South Korea, causing most of its leaders to move to the northern part of the Korean peninsula.

description.zh-cn: 在1956年的苏共二十大上，赫鲁晓夫发表秘密报告反对斯大林个人崇拜，开启了去斯大林化运动。
description.en: At the 20th Congress of the CPSU in 1956, Khrushchev delivered a secret speech denouncing Stalin's personality cult, which initiated the de-Stalinization movement.

description.zh-cn: 赵本山与高秀敏、范伟是长期合作的搭档，被誉为“铁三角”。
description.en: Zhao Benshan, Gao Xiumin, and Fan Wei were long-term partners, known as the 'Iron Triangle'.

description.zh-cn: 赵本山与宋丹丹在央视春晚舞台上多次合作表演小品。
description.en: Zhao Benshan and Song Dandan collaborated on several skits for the CCTV Spring Festival Gala.

description.zh-cn: 2005年，赵本山入主辽宁足球队担任董事长，但在当赛季结束后即宣布退出。
description.en: In 2005, Zhao Benshan became the chairman of the Liaoning Football Club, but announced his withdrawal after the season.

description.zh-cn: 赵本山因曾为蚁力神产品代言，在2007年蚁力神事件爆发后受到舆论批评。
description.en: Zhao Benshan was criticized by public opinion after the Yilishen scandal broke out in 2007 because he had endorsed the product.

description.zh-cn: 2014年9月，广电总局以“题材丑化农民群众”为由，在开播前临时停播了赵本山主演的电视剧《爹妈满院》。
description.en: In September 2014, the NRTA halted the broadcast of the Zhao Benshan-starring TV series 'Die Ma Man Yuan' just before its premiere, citing that its theme 'uglified the peasant masses'.

description.zh-cn: 在赵本山陷入政治风波后，一直与其密切合作的辽宁卫视终止了合作关系。
description.en: After Zhao Benshan became embroiled in political controversy, Liaoning TV, which had long collaborated closely with him, terminated their partnership.

description.zh-cn: 在2014年赵本山陷入政治风波时，崔永元公开出面力挺赵本山。
description.en: In 2014, when Zhao Benshan was caught in a political storm, Cui Yongyuan publicly supported him.

description.zh-cn: 张戎于1991年与乔·哈利戴结婚。
description.en: Jung Chang married Jon Halliday in 1991.

description.zh-cn: 张戎出生于四川省宜宾市。
description.en: Jung Chang was born in Yibin, Sichuan Province.

description.zh-cn: 薛之珩是张戎的外祖父。
description.en: Xue Zhiheng is Jung Chang's maternal grandfather.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，张戎曾担任红卫兵、农民、赤脚医生、翻砂工和电工。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Jung Chang served as a Red Guard, peasant, barefoot doctor, sand caster, and electrician.

description.zh-cn: 张戎在文革期间曾是红卫兵。
description.en: Jung Chang was a Red Guard during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 1973年，张戎进入四川大学外语系成为工农兵大学生。
description.en: In 1973, Jung Chang entered the Department of Foreign Languages at Sichuan University as a Worker-Peasant-Soldier student.

description.zh-cn: 张戎从四川大学毕业后留校任教。
description.en: After graduating from Sichuan University, Jung Chang stayed on to teach.

description.zh-cn: 张戎于1973年成为一名工农兵大学生。
description.en: Jung Chang became a Worker-Peasant-Soldier student in 1973.

description.zh-cn: 张戎在英国约克大学取得博士学位。
description.en: Jung Chang obtained her PhD from the University of York in the UK.

description.zh-cn: 创作了自传《鸿：三代中国女人的故事》。
description.en: Authored the autobiography 'Wild Swans: Three Daughters of China'.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类信息，张戎是西伦敦大学的校友。
description.en: According to category information, Jung Chang is an alumna of the University of West London.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类信息，张戎曾是伦敦大学亚非学院的教师。
description.en: According to category information, Jung Chang was a teacher at SOAS University of London.

relationships.target: BAIDU:宋氏三姊妹与她们的丈夫

description.zh-cn: 于2019年出版了传记《宋氏三姊妹与她们的丈夫》。
description.en: Published the biography 'Big Sister, Little Sister, Red Sister' in 2019.

description.zh-cn: 周新民 (1969年)担任中国航空工业集团有限公司的董事长、党组书记。
description.en: Zhou Xinmin (born 1969) serves as the Chairman and Party Group Secretary of Aviation Industry Corporation of China, Ltd.

description.zh-cn: 中国航空工业第一集团公司与中国航空工业第二集团公司于2008年11月合并组建为中国航空工业集团有限公司。
description.en: China Aviation Industry Corporation I and China Aviation Industry Corporation II merged in November 2008 to form Aviation Industry Corporation of China, Ltd.

description.zh-cn: 中国航空工业第二集团公司与中国航空工业第一集团公司于2008年11月合并组建为中国航空工业集团有限公司。
description.en: China Aviation Industry Corporation II and China Aviation Industry Corporation I merged in November 2008 to form Aviation Industry Corporation of China, Ltd.

description.zh-cn: 1999年7月，中国航空工业总公司被拆分为中国航空工业第一集团公司和中国航空工业第二集团公司。
description.en: In July 1999, China Aviation Industry Corporation was split into China Aviation Industry Corporation I and China Aviation Industry Corporation II.

description.zh-cn: 1999年7月，中国航空工业总公司被拆分为中国航空工业第一集团公司和中国航空工业第二集团公司。
description.en: In July 1999, China Aviation Industry Corporation was split into China Aviation Industry Corporation I and China Aviation Industry Corporation II.

description.zh-cn: 1993年6月，航空航天工业部的航空工业相关资产被划拨组建中国航空工业总公司。
description.en: In June 1993, the aviation-related assets of the Ministry of Aerospace Industry were allocated to establish the China Aviation Industry Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 1988年4月，航空工业部与航天工业部合并组建中华人民共和国航空航天工业部。
description.en: In April 1988, the Ministry of Aviation Industry and the Ministry of Aerospace Industry merged to form the Ministry of Aerospace Industry of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 2009年，中国航空工业集团的民用喷射机业务被分拆成为中国商用飞机公司。
description.en: In 2009, the civil jet business of AVIC was spun off to become the Commercial Aircraft Corporation of China.

description.zh-cn: 2016年，中国航空工业集团的发动机业务被分拆成为中国航空发动机集团。
description.en: In 2016, the engine business of AVIC was spun off to become the Aero Engine Corporation of China.

description.zh-cn: 2017年12月27日，中国航空工业集团公司由全民所有制企业整体改制为国有独资企业。
description.en: On December 27, 2017, Aviation Industry Corporation of China was restructured from an enterprise under ownership by the whole people into a wholly state-owned enterprise.

description.zh-cn: 经国务院国资委批复同意，中国航空工业集团完成了公司制改制。
description.en: With the approval of the SASAC, Aviation Industry Corporation of China completed its corporate restructuring.

description.zh-cn: 哈尔滨飞机工业集团有限责任公司是中国航空工业集团有限公司的全资子公司。
description.en: Harbin Aircraft Industry Group Co., Ltd. is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Aviation Industry Corporation of China, Ltd.

description.zh-cn: 哈尔滨飞机工业公司与安博威合营成立哈尔滨安博威飞机工业有限公司。
description.en: Harbin Aircraft Industry Company and Embraer jointly established Harbin Embraer Aircraft Industry Co., Ltd.

description.zh-cn: 哈尔滨飞机工业公司与空中客车合营成立哈尔滨哈飞空客复合材料制造中心有限公司。
description.en: Harbin Aircraft Industry Company and Airbus jointly established Hafei Airbus Composite Manufacturing Centre Company Limited.

description.zh-cn: 全国人大主席团有权提名中华人民共和国主席的候选人。
description.en: The Presidium of the National People's Congress has the authority to nominate candidates for the President of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1954年宪法首次设立了中华人民共和国主席职务。
description.en: The 1954 Constitution first established the post of President of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 刘少奇被罢免后，国家主席职位开始长期缺位。
description.en: After Liu Shaoqi was dismissed, the post of President became vacant for a long period.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央向全国人大提出了关于修改宪法部分内容的建议，包括取消国家主席的任期限制。
description.en: The CCP Central Committee proposed to the NPC suggestions for amending parts of the Constitution, including the removal of term limits for the President.

description.zh-cn: 该修正案取消了国家主席和副主席“连续任职不得超过两届”的限制。
description.en: This amendment removed the restriction that the President and Vice President shall serve no more than two consecutive terms.

description.zh-cn: 第十四届全国人大一次会议选举习近平为中华人民共和国主席，使其开启第三个任期。
description.en: The first session of the 14th National People's Congress elected Xi Jinping as President of the PRC, beginning his third term.

description.zh-cn: 随着大不列颠王国的成立，英格兰王国作为独立政治实体不复存在。
description.en: With the establishment of the Kingdom of Great Britain, the Kingdom of England ceased to exist as an independent political entity.

description.zh-cn: 随着大不列颠及爱尔兰联合王国的成立，大不列颠王国作为独立政治实体不复存在。
description.en: With the establishment of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland, the Kingdom of Great Britain ceased to exist as an independent political entity.

description.zh-cn: 作为18世纪的主要殖民竞争对手，两国在西班牙王位继承战争和七年战争中敌对。战争结果导致法国向英国割让了包括新法兰西在内的大片北美殖民地，英国确立了海上霸权。
description.en: As the main colonial rivals of the 18th century, the two kingdoms were adversaries in the War of the Spanish Succession and the Seven Years' War. The wars resulted in France ceding vast North American colonies, including New France, to Britain, establishing British maritime supremacy.

description.zh-cn: 在西班牙王位继承战争中，大不列颠王国与法国和西班牙作战。战后，西班牙向英国割让了直布罗陀和梅诺卡岛。
description.en: During the War of the Spanish Succession, Great Britain fought against France and Spain. After the war, Spain ceded Gibraltar and Menorca to Great Britain.

description.zh-cn: 该和约的签订结束了西班牙王位继承战争。
description.en: The signing of this treaty ended the War of the Spanish Succession.

description.zh-cn: 该和约的签订结束了七年战争。
description.en: The signing of this treaty ended the Seven Years' War.

description.zh-cn: 在普拉西战役后，罗伯特·克莱芙会见了米尔·贾法尔。
description.en: After the Battle of Plassey, Robert Clive met with Mir Jafar.

description.zh-cn: 根据文本，肖万世是河北邢台人。
description.en: According to the text, Xiao Wanshi was from Xingtai, Hebei.

description.zh-cn: 根据文本，肖万世是中共党员。
description.en: According to the text, Xiao Wanshi was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 肖万世曾在中国抗日战争时期担任八路军排长。
description.en: Xiao Wanshi served as a platoon leader in the Eighth Route Army during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 元朝于至元十四年（1277年）将安庆府升为安庆路。
description.en: The Yuan Dynasty promoted Anqing Fu to Anqing Lu in 1277.

description.zh-cn: 元朝时期，安庆府被升格并改制为安庆路。
description.en: During the Yuan Dynasty, Anqing Fu was promoted and reorganized into Anqing Lu.

description.zh-cn: 安庆府是安徽巡抚的驻地。
description.en: Anqing Fu was the official residence of the Governor of Anhui.

description.zh-cn: 安庆府是清朝安徽省的省治（省会）。
description.en: Anqing Fu was the provincial capital of Anhui Province during the Qing Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 常陸宮正仁親王是上皇明仁的弟弟。
description.en: Masahito, Prince Hitachi is the younger brother of Akihito.

description.zh-cn: 常陸宮正仁親王是东久迩成子的弟弟。
description.en: Masahito, Prince Hitachi is the younger brother of Shigeko Higashikuni.

description.zh-cn: 常陸宮正仁親王是久宫祐子内亲王的弟弟。
description.en: Masahito, Prince Hitachi is the younger brother of Princess Hisa.

description.zh-cn: 常陸宮正仁親王是鹰司和子的弟弟。
description.en: Masahito, Prince Hitachi is the younger brother of Kazuko Takatsukasa.

description.zh-cn: 常陸宮正仁親王是池田厚子的弟弟。
description.en: Masahito, Prince Hitachi is the younger brother of Atsuko Ikeda.

description.zh-cn: 常陸宮正仁親王是岛津贵子的哥哥。
description.en: Masahito, Prince Hitachi is the elder brother of Takako Shimazu.

position.zh-cn: 大学院理学研究科研究生

description.zh-cn: 于东京大学大学院理学研究科成为研究生，专攻动物学。
description.en: Became a postgraduate researcher in the Graduate School of Science at the University of Tokyo, specializing in zoology.

description.zh-cn: 作为皇子，是日本皇室成员。
description.en: As a prince, he is a member of the Imperial House of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 与津轻华子结婚，创设常陆宫。
description.en: Established the Hitachi-no-miya upon his marriage to Hanako Tsugaru.

description.zh-cn: 授予常陸宮正仁親王名誉博士学位，以表彰其对癌症研究的贡献。
description.en: Awarded an honorary doctorate to Prince Masahito of Hitachi in recognition of his contributions to cancer research.

description.zh-cn: 授予常陸宮正仁親王名誉博士学位。
description.en: Awarded an honorary doctorate to Prince Masahito of Hitachi.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党第一次全国代表大会决议开办军官学校，创立党军，陆军官校最初为中国国民党的党校。
description.en: The First National Congress of the Kuomintang resolved to establish a military academy and create a party army; the academy was initially the party school of the KMT.

description.zh-cn: 在第一次国共合作期间，中国共产党支持陆军官校成立，并有许多党员在该校任职或学习。
description.en: During the First United Front, the Chinese Communist Party supported the establishment of the military academy, and many of its members served as instructors or cadets there.

description.zh-cn: 由孙中山任命为陆军官校首任校长，后于1947年卸任改任名誉校长。
description.en: Appointed by Sun Yat-sen as the first Commandant of the academy, he later resigned in 1947 to become Honorary Commandant.

description.zh-cn: 在陆军官校创校初期担任总教官。
description.en: Served as the Chief Instructor during the early days of the academy.

description.zh-cn: 陆军官校目前隶属于中华民国国防部。
description.en: The R.O.C. Military Academy is currently subordinate to the Ministry of National Defense.

description.zh-cn: 1927年，陆军官校迁往南京市，改为隶属国民政府。
description.en: In 1927, the military academy relocated to Nanjing and became subordinate to the Nationalist Government.

description.zh-cn: 因中国抗日战争爆发，陆军官校为躲避战火由南京西迁至成都市。
description.en: Due to the outbreak of the Second Sino-Japanese War, the military academy relocated from Nanjing to Chengdu to evade the conflict.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政府于1949年迁往台湾后，推动陆军官校于1950年8月在高雄凤山复校。
description.en: After the Government of the Republic of China relocated to Taiwan in 1949, it pushed for the re-establishment of the military academy in Fengshan, Kaohsiung, in August 1950.

description.zh-cn: 1947年孙立人奉命在台湾高雄凤山开设陆军军官学校第四军官训练班。
description.en: In 1947, Sun Li-jen was ordered to establish the Fourth Officer Training Corps of the R.O.C. Military Academy in Fengshan, Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 第四军官训练班的所有学员、教师及设施都被编进陆军官校的学员总队，其班址成为陆官在台复校的校址。
description.en: All cadets, instructors, and facilities of the Fourth Officer Training Corps were incorporated into the cadet corps of the R.O.C. Military Academy, and its site became the location for the academy's re-establishment in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 接替蒋中正成为陆军官校校长。
description.en: Succeeded Chiang Kai-shek as the Commandant of the R.O.C. Military Academy.

description.zh-cn: 担任陆军官校在台复校后的首任校长。
description.en: Served as the first Commandant after the R.O.C. Military Academy was re-established in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 陆官第44期第二名毕业。
description.en: Graduated second in the 44th class of the R.O.C. Military Academy.

description.zh-cn: 陆官专科班第1期毕业。
description.en: Graduated from the 1st class of the junior college program at the R.O.C. Military Academy.

description.zh-cn: 对《开罗宣言》的公报草案文字作了修改，加入了“澎湖”。
description.en: He personally revised the draft of the communiqué for the Cairo Declaration, adding the 'Pescadores'.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次世界大战期间，作为同盟国与日本作战。
description.en: As one of the Allied powers, fought against Japan during World War II.

description.zh-cn: 宣言规定，日本自中国人所窃取的所有领土，比如满洲、台湾及澎湖群岛，应该归还给中华民国。
description.en: The declaration stipulated that all the territories Japan has stolen from the Chinese, such as Manchuria, Formosa, and The Pescadores, shall be restored to the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 日本签署的《降伏文书》中，明白宣示接受《波茨坦公告》。
description.en: In the Japanese Instrument of Surrender, Japan clearly proclaimed its acceptance of the Potsdam Declaration.

description.zh-cn: 根据《旧金山和约》第二条，日本放弃对台湾、澎湖等岛屿的一切权利、权利名义与要求。
description.en: According to Article 2 of the Treaty of San Francisco, Japan renounced all right, title and claim to Formosa and the Pescadores.

description.zh-cn: 主张《开罗宣言》具有法律约束力，是构成中华民国光复台湾的法律基础。
description.en: Argued that the Cairo Declaration is legally binding and constitutes the legal basis for the retrocession of Taiwan to the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 认为俗称为“开罗宣言”的文件只是一项新闻公报，并非正式宣言，对其存在性或法律效力提出质疑。
description.en: Argued that the document commonly known as the 'Cairo Declaration' is only a press communiqué, not a formal declaration, questioning its existence or legal validity.

description.zh-cn: 胡枫曾于1973年至1977年及1988年至今两度为无线电视艺员。
description.en: Bowie Woo has been an artist for TVB during two periods: from 1973 to 1977, and from 1988 to the present.

description.zh-cn: 在1970年代中至1987年间，胡枫曾于丽的电视（亚洲电视前身）工作。
description.en: From the mid-1970s until 1987, Bowie Woo worked at Rediffusion Television (predecessor to ATV).

description.zh-cn: 胡枫于1952年毕业于香港培英中学。
description.en: Bowie Woo graduated from Pui Ying Secondary School in 1952.

description.zh-cn: 胡枫于1932年1月18日出生于广州市的广州医学院第三附属医院。
description.en: Bowie Woo was born on January 18, 1932, at The Third Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou Medical University in Guangzhou.

description.zh-cn: 自2019年起，胡枫和罗兰常在影视剧中扮演夫妻，在现实生活中是情同兄妹的挚友。
description.en: Since 2019, Bowie Woo and Helena Law have often played couples in film and television, and are close friends in real life, like brother and sister.

description.zh-cn: 胡枫与谢贤是多年好友，并曾共同主持旅游节目《4个小生去旅行》。尽管2015年发生过谢贤掌掴曾江并误中胡枫的宣传事件，但他们依然是好友。
description.en: Bowie Woo and Patrick Tse are long-time friends and co-hosted the travel show '4 Amigos Bon Voyage'. Despite a 2015 publicity stunt where Tse slapped Kenneth Tsang and accidentally hit Woo, they remain good friends.

description.zh-cn: 胡枫与曾江是好友，并曾共同主持旅游节目《4个小生去旅行》。
description.en: Bowie Woo and Kenneth Tsang are friends and co-hosted the travel show '4 Amigos Bon Voyage'.

description.zh-cn: 谢贤与曾江是多年好友。2015年在《4个小生去旅行》记者会上发生的掌掴事件后被证实为节目宣传技俩。
description.en: Patrick Tse and Kenneth Tsang are long-time friends. The slapping incident at the '4 Amigos Bon Voyage' press conference in 2015 was later confirmed to be a publicity stunt for the show.

description.zh-cn: 胡枫与Joe Junior曾共同主持旅游节目。
description.en: Bowie Woo and Joe Junior have co-hosted travel shows together.

description.zh-cn: 胡枫的出道作《男人心》是与当红女星芳艳芬搭档。
description.en: Bowie Woo's debut film, 'A Man's Heart', co-starred the famous actress Fong Yim Fun.

description.zh-cn: 胡枫曾是李小龙的演技导师。
description.en: Bowie Woo was an acting coach for Bruce Lee.

description.zh-cn: 胡枫曾是成龙的演技导师。
description.en: Bowie Woo was an acting coach for Jackie Chan.

description.zh-cn: 黎明是胡枫的谊子，在1989年拍摄电影《四千金》时上契。
description.en: Leon Lai is the godson of Bowie Woo. The godfather-godson relationship was formally acknowledged in 1989 during the filming of 'Four Loves'.

description.zh-cn: 林忆莲是胡枫的谊女，在拍摄电影《猛鬼学堂》时上契。
description.en: Sandy Lam is the goddaughter of Bowie Woo. The goddaughter-godfather relationship was formally acknowledged during the filming of 'The Haunted Cop Shop'.

description.zh-cn: 方国珊是胡枫的契女。
description.en: Christine Fong is the goddaughter of Bowie Woo.

description.zh-cn: 在第41届香港电影金像奖颁奖典礼上，胡枫获颁终身成就奖。
description.en: At the 41st Hong Kong Film Awards, Bowie Woo was presented with the Lifetime Achievement Award.

description.zh-cn: 曹魏于222年在今西宁市修筑了西平郡城。
description.en: In 222, Cao Wei constructed the Xiping Commandery city in present-day Xining.

description.zh-cn: 十六国时期的南凉政权曾一度建都于西宁（时称西平）。
description.en: The Southern Liang regime during the Sixteen Kingdoms period once established its capital in Xining (then called Xiping).

description.zh-cn: 北魏于526年将此地改置为鄯州。
description.en: In 526, the Northern Wei dynasty re-established this area as Shanzhou.

description.zh-cn: 隋炀帝于大业三年（607年）将鄯州改为西平郡，西宁为其辖地。
description.en: In the third year of the Daye era (607), Emperor Yang of Sui changed Shanzhou to Xiping Commandery, with Xining under its jurisdiction.

description.zh-cn: 安史之乱后，吐蕃从唐军手中夺取了对西宁的控制权。
description.en: After the An Lushan Rebellion, the Tibetan Empire seized control of Xining from the Tang army.

description.zh-cn: 吐蕃占领西宁后，将其改称为青唐城。
description.en: After occupying Xining, the Tibetan Empire renamed it Qingtangcheng.

description.zh-cn: 将吐蕃赞普的后代唃厮啰劫持并尊为名义上的赞普，自己则自立为相进行控制。
description.en: He abducted Gusiluo, a descendant of the Tibetan emperor, and installed him as a nominal Tsenpo, while making himself regent to control him.

description.zh-cn: 北宋于1104年将鄯州改为西宁州，“西宁”这一名称自此开始并沿用至今。
description.en: In 1104, the Northern Song dynasty changed Shanzhou to Xiningzhou, and the name "Xining" has been used ever since.

description.zh-cn: 金朝于1129年占领了原属北宋的西宁州。
description.en: In 1129, the Jin dynasty occupied Xiningzhou, which had previously belonged to the Northern Song.

description.zh-cn: 西夏于1136年占领了原属金朝的西宁州。
description.en: In 1136, the Western Xia occupied Xiningzhou, which had previously belonged to the Jin dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 成吉思汗于1227年率蒙古军队攻占西宁州，结束了西夏对此地的统治。
description.en: In 1227, Genghis Khan led the Mongol army to capture Xiningzhou, ending the rule of the Western Xia over the area.

description.zh-cn: 明朝时期，西宁卫属陕西行都司管辖。
description.en: During the Ming dynasty, the Xining Guard was under the jurisdiction of the Shaanxi Regional Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 清朝于雍正三年（1725年）平定了罗卜藏丹津的反清叛乱。
description.en: In the third year of the Yongzheng era (1725), the Qing dynasty suppressed the anti-Qing rebellion of Lobsang Danjin.

description.zh-cn: 平定罗卜藏丹津叛乱后，清朝改西宁卫为西宁府。
description.en: After suppressing the Lobsang Danjin rebellion, the Qing dynasty changed the Xining Guard to Xining Prefecture.

description.zh-cn: 国民政府于1929年设立青海省。
description.en: The Nationalist Government established Qinghai Province in 1929.

description.zh-cn: 钟登华于2019年2月15日至2023年1月19日期间担任中华人民共和国教育部副部长。
description.en: Zhong Denghua served as Vice Minister of the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China from February 15, 2019, to January 19, 2023.

description.zh-cn: 钟登华担任教育部副部长期间，陈宝生是时任部长。
description.en: While Zhong Denghua was Vice Minister of Education, Chen Baosheng was the incumbent Minister.

description.zh-cn: 钟登华担任教育部副部长期间，怀进鹏是时任部长。
description.en: While Zhong Denghua was Vice Minister of Education, Huai Jinpeng was the incumbent Minister.

description.zh-cn: 钟登华在天津大学获得水资源与港湾工程系硕士学位和工学博士学位。
description.en: Zhong Denghua received his master's degree in Water Resources and Harbor Engineering and his PhD in Engineering from Tianjin University.

description.zh-cn: 钟登华于2016年9月至2019年2月担任天津大学校长。此前他还曾担任该校副校长、常务副校长等职务。
description.en: Zhong Denghua served as President of Tianjin University from September 2016 to February 2019. He had also previously held positions such as Vice President and Executive Vice President at the university.

description.zh-cn: 钟登华接替李家俊出任天津大学校长。
description.en: Zhong Denghua succeeded Li Jiajun as the President of Tianjin University.

description.zh-cn: 金东寒接替钟登华出任天津大学校长。
description.en: Jin Donghan succeeded Zhong Denghua as the President of Tianjin University.

description.zh-cn: 钟登华于1963年11月20日出生于江西省赣县梅林镇桃源村。
description.en: Zhong Denghua was born on November 20, 1963, in Taoyuan Village, Meilin Town, Gan County, Jiangxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 钟登华于1985年7月在江西工业大学（现南昌大学）土木建筑系获得学士学位。
description.en: Zhong Denghua received his bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering from Jiangxi Industrial University (now Nanchang University) in July 1985.

description.zh-cn: 钟登华自2022年12月起担任中国农业大学党委书记。
description.en: Zhong Denghua has served as the Party Secretary of China Agricultural University since December 2022.

description.zh-cn: 钟登华接替姜沛民出任中国农业大学党委书记。
description.en: Zhong Denghua succeeded Jiang Peimin as the Party Secretary of China Agricultural University.

description.zh-cn: 2017年10月，钟登华在中国共产党第十九次全国代表大会上当选为中央委员会候补委员。
description.en: In October 2017, Zhong Denghua was elected as an alternate member of the Central Committee at the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 2023年3月，钟登华当选为第十四届全国政协委员。
description.en: In March 2023, Zhong Denghua was elected as a member of the 14th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 钟登华当选第十四届全国政协委员后，同时担任农业和农村委员会委员。
description.en: After being elected as a member of the 14th National Committee of the CPPCC, Zhong Denghua also serves as a member of the Committee for Agriculture and Rural Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 钟登华于2009年当选为中国工程院院士。
description.en: Zhong Denghua was elected as an academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering in 2009.

description.zh-cn: 国务院副总理是国务院的副职负责人。
description.en: The Vice Premier is the deputy head of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 国务院副总理在总理负责制下协助总理工作。
description.en: The Vice Premier assists the Premier under the Premier's responsibility system.

description.zh-cn: 作为国务院组成人员，国务院副总理是国务院全体会议的成员。
description.en: As a member of the State Council, the Vice Premier is a member of the Plenary Meeting of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 国务院副总理是国务院常务会议的重要组成人员。
description.en: The Vice Premier is an important member of the Executive Meeting of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 国务院副总理的职务为国家级副职。
description.en: The post of Vice Premier is at the national deputy level.

description.zh-cn: 国务院副总理位列党和国家领导人。
description.en: The Vice Premier is ranked among the Party and state leaders.

description.zh-cn: 国务院副总理的人选由国务院总理提名。
description.en: Candidates for Vice Premier are nominated by the Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 国务院副总理的人选需经全国人民代表大会表决通过。
description.en: Candidates for Vice Premier must be approved by a vote of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 国家主席根据全国人民代表大会的决定任命国务院副总理。
description.en: The President of the PRC appoints the Vice Premier based on the decision of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中央人民政府政务院是中华人民共和国国务院的前身。
description.en: The Government Administration Council of the Central People's Government was the predecessor of the State Council of the PRC.

description.en: Served as Vice Premier in the 13th State Council.

description.zh-cn: 任第十三届国务院副总理。
description.en: Served as Vice Premier in the 13th State Council.

description.zh-cn: 在担任第八届国务院副总理期间，为中共中央政治局常委。
description.en: Was a member of the Politburo Standing Committee while serving as Vice Premier in the 8th State Council.

description.zh-cn: 在担任第九届国务院副总理期间，为中共中央政治局常委。
description.en: Was a member of the Politburo Standing Committee while serving as Vice Premier in the 9th State Council.

description.zh-cn: 在担任第十届国务院副总理期间，为中共中央政治局常委。
description.en: Was a member of the Politburo Standing Committee while serving as Vice Premier in the 10th State Council.

description.en: Inferred from the page category 'People who joined the Communist Party of China in 1971' that Li Shenxue joined the CPC in 1971.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类“副总警监”推断，李申学拥有副总警监警衔。
description.en: Inferred from the page category 'Deputy Commissioner Generals' that Li Shenxue holds the rank of Deputy Commissioner General.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类“吉林省人民政府副秘书长”推断。
description.en: Inferred from the page category 'Deputy Secretary-Generals of Jilin Provincial People's Government'.

description.en: Inferred from the page category 'Secretary-Generals of the CCP Jilin Provincial Committee'.

description.en: Inferred from the page category 'Members of the 12th National Committee of the CPPCC'.

description.zh-cn: 贾有权是奉天（今辽宁）昌图人。
description.en: Jia Youquan was from Changtu, Fengtian (modern-day Liaoning).

description.zh-cn: 贾有权曾任天津大学教授、博士生导师。
description.en: Jia Youquan served as a professor and doctoral supervisor at Tianjin University.

description.zh-cn: 贾有权曾任中国力学学会理事。
description.en: Jia Youquan served as a council member of the Chinese Society of Theoretical and Applied Mechanics.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类信息，贾有权是西北工学院的校友。
description.en: According to category information, Jia Youquan is an alumnus of Northwestern Engineering College.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类信息，贾有权是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to category information, Jia Youquan was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 2018年6月7日，拜耳完成对孟山都的收购，孟山都成为拜耳旗下的一个品牌。
description.en: On June 7, 2018, Bayer completed the acquisition of Monsanto, making Monsanto a brand under Bayer.

description.zh-cn: 孟山都的研发部承担了曼哈顿计划的一些研究工作，被称为代顿计划。
description.en: Monsanto's R&D department undertook some research work for the Manhattan Project, known as the Dayton Project.

description.zh-cn: 在1947年的德克萨斯城灾难中，孟山都公司的一家分厂被完全摧毁。
description.en: In the 1947 Texas City disaster, a Monsanto branch factory was completely destroyed.

description.zh-cn: 孟山都公司从1944年开始生产DDT，直到1972年美国立法禁用后停止生产。
description.en: Monsanto began producing DDT in 1944 and ceased production after it was banned by US law in 1972.

description.zh-cn: 从1960年代起，孟山都公司开始为美国军方生产在越南战争中使用的落叶剂橙剂。
description.en: Starting in the 1960s, Monsanto produced the defoliant Agent Orange for the U.S. military for use in the Vietnam War.

description.zh-cn: 美国军方在越南战争中大量使用橙剂作为落叶剂。
description.en: The U.S. military used Agent Orange extensively as a defoliant during the Vietnam War.

description.zh-cn: 1985年，孟山都公司以2.7亿美元收购了G.D.希尔勒公司。
description.en: In 1985, Monsanto acquired G. D. Searle & Company for $270 million.

description.zh-cn: 2000年10月，Pharmacia公司将其农业子公司分拆，合并成一个名为“新孟山都”的新公司。
description.en: In October 2000, Pharmacia spun off its agricultural subsidiary, which was merged into a new company called the 'new Monsanto'.

description.zh-cn: 辉瑞制药于2002年声明收购Pharmacia，并于次年完成。
description.en: Pfizer announced the acquisition of Pharmacia in 2002, completing it the following year.

description.zh-cn: 孟山都公司于1994年发明了重组牛生长激素，并以商品名Posilac进行销售。
description.en: In 1994, Monsanto developed recombinant bovine growth hormone and marketed it under the trade name Posilac.

description.zh-cn: 2008年10月，礼来公司从孟山都公司收购了重组牛生长激素（Posilac）业务。
description.en: In October 2008, Eli Lilly and Company acquired the recombinant bovine growth hormone (Posilac) business from Monsanto.

description.zh-cn: 绿色和平组织反驳孟山都公司就猪只育种技术提交的专利申请，认为其企图将普通育种技术据为己有。
description.en: Greenpeace opposed Monsanto's patent application for pig breeding technology, arguing that the company was attempting to claim ownership of common breeding techniques.

description.zh-cn: 中国经济学者郎咸平批评孟山都控制了中国的大豆市场，并指控其贿赂农业部官员。
description.en: Chinese economist Larry Lang criticized Monsanto for controlling China's soybean market and accused it of bribing officials from the Ministry of Agriculture.

description.zh-cn: 香港浸会大学前校长陈新滋曾于孟山都公司工作多年，担任高级化学研究师。
description.en: Albert Sun-Chi Chan, former president of Hong Kong Baptist University, worked at Monsanto for many years as a Senior Research Chemist.

description.zh-cn: 《全国新闻联播》是由中央人民广播电台制作和播出的新闻节目。
description.en: "National News Hookup" is a news program produced and broadcast by China National Radio.

description.zh-cn: 《新闻联播》是由中国中央电视台制作和播出的新闻节目。
description.en: "Xinwen Lianbo" is a news program produced and broadcast by China Central Television.

description.zh-cn: 美国第七舰队隶属于美国太平洋舰队。
description.en: The U.S. Seventh Fleet is subordinate to the U.S. Pacific Fleet.

description.zh-cn: 美国太平洋舰队隶属于美国印太司令部。
description.en: The U.S. Pacific Fleet is subordinate to the U.S. Indo-Pacific Command.

description.zh-cn: 美国第七舰队是美国海军旗下的舰队之一。
description.en: The U.S. Seventh Fleet is one of the fleets under the United States Navy.

description.zh-cn: 太平洋战争爆发后，美国于1943年3月将西南太平洋的舰队改编为第七舰队。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Pacific War, the United States reorganized its fleet in the Southwest Pacific into the Seventh Fleet in March 1943.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜战争的爆发促使美国总统杜鲁门宣告台湾海峡中立化。
description.en: The outbreak of the Korean War prompted U.S. President Truman to declare the neutralization of the Taiwan Strait.

description.zh-cn: 第七舰队奉命进入台湾海峡，以吓阻中国人民解放军对台湾的任何潜在行动。
description.en: The Seventh Fleet was ordered into the Taiwan Strait to deter any potential actions by the People's Liberation Army against Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 1955年，美国第七舰队协助中华民国国军进行大陈岛军民的撤退行动。
description.en: In 1955, the U.S. Seventh Fleet assisted the Republic of China Armed Forces in the evacuation of military personnel and civilians from the Dachen Islands.

description.zh-cn: 1955年，中华民国国军与美国第七舰队合作，执行了大陈岛军民的撤退行动。
description.en: In 1955, the Republic of China Armed Forces, in cooperation with the U.S. Seventh Fleet, carried out the evacuation of military personnel and civilians from the Dachen Islands.

description.zh-cn: 蒲赖德在担任美军协防台湾司令部首任司令时，同时也是第七舰队的司令。
description.en: While serving as the first commander of the U.S. Taiwan Defense Command, Alfred M. Pride was also the commander of the Seventh Fleet.

description.zh-cn: 为应对1996年台海导弹危机，美国总统比尔·克林顿下令第七舰队航母战斗群开进台湾周边海域。
description.en: In response to the 1996 Taiwan Strait missile crisis, U.S. President Bill Clinton ordered Seventh Fleet carrier strike groups into the waters surrounding Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 小鹰号航空母舰于2008年除役，其在日本前沿部署的任务空缺由核动力的乔治·华盛顿号航空母舰接替。
description.en: The USS Kitty Hawk was decommissioned in 2008, and its forward-deployment role in Japan was taken over by the nuclear-powered USS George Washington.

description.zh-cn: 贾庆林于1959年12月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Jia Qinglin joined the Chinese Communist Party in December 1959.

description.zh-cn: 1962年从河北工学院（现河北工业大学）电力系毕业。
description.en: Graduated from the Department of Electrical Engineering at Hebei Institute of Technology (now Hebei University of Technology) in 1962.

description.zh-cn: 大学毕业后被分配到第一机械工业部工作。
description.en: After graduating from university, he was assigned to work at the First Ministry of Machine Building.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，贾庆林被下放到“一机部”在江西奉新的五七干校劳动。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Jia Qinglin was sent to the May Seventh Cadre School of the First Ministry of Machine Building in Fengxin, Jiangxi for labor.

position.en: Member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the CCP Central Committee

description.zh-cn: 在贾庆林担任中共中央政治局常委期间，胡锦涛为中共中央总书记。
description.en: During Jia Qinglin's tenure as a member of the Politburo Standing Committee, Hu Jintao was the General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee.

position.zh-cn: 中共福建省委书记、中共北京市委书记
position.en: Secretary of Fujian Provincial CPC Committee, Secretary of Beijing Municipal CPC Committee

description.zh-cn: 在贾庆林担任福建省委书记和北京市委书记期间，江泽民为中共中央总书记。
description.en: During Jia Qinglin's tenures as Secretary of the Fujian Provincial Committee and Beijing Municipal Committee, Jiang Zemin was the General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 在远华案争议期间，时任中共中央总书记江泽民曾公开表达对贾庆林的支持，并认为贾庆林能进入政治局完全是江泽民游说的结果。
description.en: During the Yuanhua case controversy, then-General Secretary Jiang Zemin publicly expressed support for Jia Qinglin. Analysts also believed Jia's elevation to the Politburo was entirely due to Jiang's lobbying.

description.zh-cn: 江泽民安排贾庆林的妻子林幼芳接受凤凰卫视专访，以澄清其与远华案的关系。
description.en: Jiang Zemin arranged for Jia Qinglin's wife, Lin Youfang, to be interviewed by Phoenix Television to clarify her connection to the Yuanhua case.

description.zh-cn: 据媒体报道，贾庆林家族持有万达集团的股份，暗示双方存在财务联系。
description.en: According to media reports, Jia Qinglin's family holds shares in Wanda Group, suggesting a financial connection between them.

description.zh-cn: 四川的保路运动是由立宪派发动和领导的，他们力图将运动控制在和平抗议的范围内。
description.en: The Railway Protection Movement in Sichuan was initiated and led by the Constitutionalists, who sought to keep the movement within the bounds of peaceful protest.

description.zh-cn: 同盟会执行“借保路之名，行革命之实”的策略，暗中推动保路运动向武装起义方向发展。
description.en: The Tongmenghui implemented a strategy of 'using the cause of railway protection to advance the reality of revolution,' secretly pushing the movement towards armed uprising.

description.zh-cn: 保路运动使清廷调派湖北新军前往四川镇压，导致武昌防务空虚，为武昌起义的成功创造了决定性的有利条件。
description.en: The Railway Protection Movement prompted the Qing court to dispatch the Hubei New Army to Sichuan for suppression, leaving Wuchang's defenses vulnerable, which created decisively favorable conditions for the success of the Wuchang Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 四川总督赵尔丰诱捕了包括蒲殿俊在内的保路同志会和股东会首要人物。
description.en: Viceroy of Sichuan Zhao Erfeng arrested key leaders of the Railway Protection League and the shareholders' meeting, including Pu Dianjun.

description.zh-cn: 四川总督赵尔丰诱捕了包括罗纶在内的保路同志会和股东会首要人物。
description.en: Viceroy of Sichuan Zhao Erfeng arrested key leaders of the Railway Protection League and the shareholders' meeting, including Luo Lun.

description.zh-cn: 因处理保路运动不力，清廷于1911年9月10日将赵尔丰免职。
description.en: Due to his mismanagement of the Railway Protection Movement, the Qing court dismissed Zhao Erfeng from his post on September 10, 1911.

description.zh-cn: 清廷任命端方署理四川总督，并率领湖北新军入川镇压保路运动。
description.en: The Qing court appointed Duanfang as acting Viceroy of Sichuan and ordered him to lead the Hubei New Army into Sichuan to suppress the Railway Protection Movement.

description.zh-cn: 大汉四川军政府的成立，标志着清朝在四川的统治彻底覆灭。
description.en: The establishment of the Dahan Sichuan Military Government marked the complete collapse of Qing rule in Sichuan.

description.zh-cn: 成都独立后，蒲殿俊被推举为大汉四川军政府的首任都督。
description.en: After Chengdu's independence, Pu Dianjun was elected as the first Governor-General of the Dahan Sichuan Military Government.

description.zh-cn: 1911年8月2日，赵尔丰接任四川总督，直至9月10日被免职。
description.en: On August 2, 1911, Zhao Erfeng took over as Viceroy of Sichuan, until he was dismissed on September 10.

description.zh-cn: 1911年9月10日，清廷命端方署理四川总督，直至其被杀。
description.en: On September 10, 1911, the Qing court ordered Duanfang to act as Viceroy of Sichuan, a position he held until his death.

description.zh-cn: 在推行铁路国有政策时，盛宣怀担任邮传大臣。
description.en: Sheng Xuanhuai served as the Minister of Posts and Communications while implementing the railway nationalization policy.

description.zh-cn: 吴玉章是同盟会会员，参与领导了荣县独立。
description.en: Wu Yuzhang was a member of the Tongmenghui and participated in leading the independence of Rong County.

description.zh-cn: 王天杰是同盟会会员，参与领导了荣县独立。
description.en: Wang Tianjie was a member of the Tongmenghui and participated in leading the independence of Rong County.

description.zh-cn: 根据文本，李瑞是李洪志的妻子，两人于1980年代结婚。
description.en: According to the text, Li Rui is the wife of Li Hongzhi; they married in the 1980s.

description.zh-cn: 李洪志于1951年5月13日出生于吉林省公主岭市（原怀德县）。
description.en: Li Hongzhi was born on May 13, 1951, in Gongzhuling City (formerly Huide County), Jilin Province.

description.zh-cn: 自1998年起，李洪志以永久居民身份定居美国。
description.en: Since 1998, Li Hongzhi has lived in the United States as a permanent resident.

description.zh-cn: 李洪志担任神韵艺术团的艺术总监。
description.en: Li Hongzhi serves as the Artistic Director of Shen Yun Performing Arts.

description.zh-cn: 李洪志撰写并出版了法轮功的核心著作《转法轮》。
description.en: Li Hongzhi wrote and published 'Zhuan Falun', the core text of Falun Gong.

description.zh-cn: 自1999年7月起，中国政府将法轮功取缔，并展开了全面的镇压运动。
description.en: Starting from July 1999, the Chinese government banned Falun Gong and launched a comprehensive suppression campaign.

description.zh-cn: 自1999年镇压开始，中国政府将李洪志视为主要目标，对其进行媒体攻击并发布通缉令。
description.en: Since the suppression began in 1999, the Chinese government has targeted Li Hongzhi as a primary figure, launching media attacks against him and issuing a wanted notice.

description.zh-cn: 中国的“气功热”为法轮功在1990年代的迅速传播提供了有利的社会环境。
description.en: The 'Qigong fever' in China provided a favorable social environment for the rapid spread of Falun Gong in the 1990s.

description.zh-cn: 1995年，中国驻法国大使馆邀请李洪志赴巴黎举办讲法班，开启了其海外传法活动。
description.en: In 1995, the Chinese Embassy in France invited Li Hongzhi to hold a lecture seminar in Paris, which initiated his overseas teaching activities.

description.zh-cn: 李洪志对疫情发表评论，称其为“中共病毒”，旨在淘汰中共及其追随者，并声称中国有数亿人因此死亡。
description.en: Li Hongzhi commented on the pandemic, calling it the 'CCP virus' aimed at eliminating the CCP and its followers, and claimed hundreds of millions had died from it in China.

description.zh-cn: 新唐人电视台曾于2004年采访李洪志，并在2023年报导了他关于中国疫情死亡人数的说法，扩大了他的言论传播。
description.en: New Tang Dynasty Television interviewed Li Hongzhi in 2004 and reported his claims about the COVID-19 death toll in China in 2023, amplifying the dissemination of his statements.

description.zh-cn: 关东军炸毁南满铁路柳条湖段，制造了柳条湖事件作为发动九一八事变的借口。
description.en: The Kwantung Army bombed the Liutiaohu section of the South Manchuria Railway, creating the Liutiaohu Incident as a pretext to launch the Mukden Incident.

description.zh-cn: 柳条湖事件是九一八事变的直接导火索，关东军以此为借口向中国军队发动全面进攻。
description.en: The Liutiaohu Incident was the direct trigger for the Mukden Incident, with the Kwantung Army using it as a pretext to launch a full-scale attack on Chinese forces.

description.zh-cn: 在九一八事变中，关东军作为侵略方与作为防御方的东北军发生了直接军事冲突。
description.en: During the Mukden Incident, the Kwantung Army, as the aggressor, engaged in direct military conflict with the Northeastern Army, the defending force.

description.zh-cn: 张学良在九一八事变爆发当晚下令东北军“不抵抗”，避免与日军发生正面冲突，导致东北军未能有效组织抵抗。
description.en: On the night of the Mukden Incident, Zhang Xueliang ordered the Northeastern Army 'not to resist' and to avoid direct conflict with the Japanese forces, which prevented the Northeastern Army from organizing an effective defense.

description.zh-cn: 国际联盟决定组织李顿调查团前往中国东北调查九一八事变真相，并最终发表了李顿报告。
description.en: The League of Nations decided to organize the Lytton Commission to investigate the truth of the Mukden Incident in Northeast China, which ultimately resulted in the publication of the Lytton Report.

description.zh-cn: 李顿报告强烈谴责日本发动九一八事变是侵略行为，否定了满洲国的合法性。
description.en: The Lytton Report strongly condemned Japan's launching of the Mukden Incident as an act of aggression and denied the legitimacy of Manchukuo.

description.zh-cn: 本庄繁在九一八事变期间担任关东军司令官。
