description.en: Shigeru Honjō served as the commander of the Kwantung Army during the Mukden Incident.

description.zh-cn: 马占山率领其部队在嫩江桥地区抵抗日军，领导了江桥抗战。
description.en: Ma Zhanshan led his troops to resist the Japanese forces in the Nen River Bridge area, leading the Jiangqiao Resistance.

description.zh-cn: 日本首相犬养毅在五一五事件中被海军少壮派军官暗杀。
description.en: Japanese Prime Minister Inukai Tsuyoshi was assassinated by young naval officers during the May 15 Incident.

description.zh-cn: 九一八事变中关东军的成功行动，使得日本军部主战派地位上升，国家走上军国主义道路。
description.en: The successful operation of the Kwantung Army in the Mukden Incident led to the rise of the pro-war faction in the Japanese military, putting the nation on the path to militarism.

description.zh-cn: 咸丰帝在英法联军进逼北京时北逃，命令奕䜣留京主持议和，这成为奕䜣进入权力中心、处理外交事务并积累政治资本的契机。
description.en: When Anglo-French forces advanced on Beijing, the Xianfeng Emperor fled north and ordered Yixin to remain and negotiate peace. This became Yixin's opportunity to enter the center of power, handle foreign affairs, and accumulate political capital.

description.zh-cn: 作为辛酉政变的核心策划者之一，将顾命八大臣之首的肃顺等人捉拿并定罪。
description.en: As one of the key planners of the Xinyou Coup, he had Sushun, the leader of the Eight Regent Ministers, arrested and convicted.

description.zh-cn: 在辛酉政变期间及之后初期，奕䜣与慈禧太后结为政治盟友，共同执掌政权。
description.en: During and in the immediate aftermath of the Xinyou Coup, Yixin and Empress Dowager Cixi formed a political alliance and jointly held power.

description.zh-cn: 因翁同龢反对洋务运动，奕䜣在病逝前向光绪帝表达了对其的反对意见，希望光绪帝不要被其迷惑。
description.en: Because Weng Tonghe opposed the Self-Strengthening Movement, Yixin, before his death, expressed his opposition to him to the Guangxu Emperor, hoping the emperor would not be misled by him.

description.zh-cn: 艾跃进因胃癌逝世。
description.en: Ai Yuejin died of stomach cancer.

description.zh-cn: 艾跃进从南开大学获得学士学位后便留校工作，后组建军事教研室。
description.en: After obtaining his bachelor's degree from Nankai University, Ai Yuejin stayed on to work and later established the military teaching and research section.

description.zh-cn: 钦本立1918年出生于浙江长兴。
description.en: Qin Benli was born in Changxing, Zhejiang in 1918.

description.zh-cn: 1936年入读杭州高中，1939年因在校期间推动学潮而被开除。
description.en: Entered Hangzhou High School in 1936 and was expelled in 1939 for promoting student activism at the school.

description.zh-cn: 抗战时期考入朝阳大学攻读法律，后在大学三年级时因组织学生运动被学校开除学籍。
description.en: During the Second Sino-Japanese War, he enrolled in Chaoyang University to study law but was expelled in his third year for organizing student movements.

description.zh-cn: 因参加并组织学生运动，钦本立在大学三年级时被朝阳大学开除了学籍。
description.en: Due to his participation in and organization of student movements, Qin Benli was expelled from Chaoyang University in his third year.

position.zh-cn: 记者、编辑；党组书记、副总编辑
position.en: Reporter, Editor; Party Group Secretary, Deputy Editor-in-Chief

description.zh-cn: 钦本立曾两度在《文汇报》任职。抗战胜利后任记者、编辑；1956年9月返回上海任《文汇报》党组书记、副总编辑，直至1957年因反右运动被调离。
description.en: Qin Benli worked at 'Wen Wei Po' on two separate occasions. After the war, he was a reporter and editor; in September 1956, he returned to Shanghai to serve as the paper's Party Group Secretary and Deputy Editor-in-Chief until he was removed in 1957 during the Anti-Rightist Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 1949年加入中国共产党。
description.en: Joined the Communist Party of China in 1949.

position.en: Head of the Finance and Economics Group

description.zh-cn: 1949年5月上海战役后，任《解放日报》财经组组长。
description.en: After the Shanghai Campaign in May 1949, he served as the Head of the Finance and Economics Group at 'Jiefang Daily'.

position.zh-cn: 财经部、国际部工作人员
position.en: Staff of the Finance & Economics Department and International Department

description.zh-cn: 1951年赴北京《人民日报》财经部、国际部工作，直至1956年9月返回上海。
description.en: In 1951, he went to work in the Finance & Economics Department and International Department of the 'People's Daily' in Beijing, until he returned to Shanghai in September 1956.

description.zh-cn: 1957年，毛泽东点名批评响应大鸣大放号召的《文汇报》，并将其定性为右派报纸。
description.en: In 1957, Mao Zedong publicly criticized 'Wen Wei Po' for its response to the Hundred Flowers Campaign and labeled it a rightist newspaper.

description.zh-cn: 因《文汇报》事件，钦本立被调离该报，并受到留党察看两年、行政降三级的处分。
description.en: As a result of the 'Wen Wei Po' incident, Qin Benli was removed from the newspaper and punished with two years of party probation and a three-level administrative demotion.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命开始后，钦本立被关“牛棚”七个月，后又被下放到“五七”农场进行劳动改造。
description.en: After the Cultural Revolution began, Qin Benli was imprisoned in a 'cowshed' for seven months and later sent to a 'May Seventh' farm for labor reform.

position.zh-cn: 院党委委员、世界经济研究所党委书记、副所长、《社会科学》杂志主编
position.en: Member of the Academy's Party Committee, Party Secretary and Deputy Director of the World Economy Institute, Editor-in-Chief of 'Social Sciences' journal

description.zh-cn: 1978年12月文革结束后获得平反，调入上海社会科学院，先后担任多个职务。
description.en: After being politically rehabilitated at the end of the Cultural Revolution in December 1978, he was transferred to the Shanghai Academy of Social Sciences, where he held several positions.

description.zh-cn: 在钱俊瑞的倡导下，《世界经济导报》得以创办。
description.en: The 'World Economic Herald' was founded under the advocacy of Qian Junrui.

description.zh-cn: 1980年6月，钦本立主持创办了《世界经济导报》。
description.en: In June 1980, Qin Benli led the founding of the 'World Economic Herald'.

description.zh-cn: 自1980年创办起担任《世界经济导报》总编辑，直至1989年被免职。
description.en: He served as the Editor-in-Chief of the 'World Economic Herald' from its founding in 1980 until his dismissal in 1989.

description.zh-cn: 《世界经济导报》因计划刊载纪念胡耀邦的文章，此举意在维护和传播其改革派政治遗产，但最终导致报社被停刊。
description.en: The 'World Economic Herald' planned to publish an article commemorating Hu Yaobang, an act intended to uphold and disseminate his reformist political legacy, but which ultimately led to the newspaper's shutdown.

description.zh-cn: 因计划刊登纪念胡耀邦的文章，《世界经济导报》于1989年4月26日被中共上海市委勒令停刊。
description.en: Due to its plan to publish an article commemorating Hu Yaobang, the 'World Economic Herald' was ordered to cease publication by the CPC Shanghai Municipal Committee on April 26, 1989.

description.zh-cn: 因《世界经济导报》事件，钦本立于1989年4月26日被中共官方免去总编辑职务并置于软禁之下。临终前的1991年3月29日，又在病床前被上海市社科院党委宣布处以留党察看两年。
description.en: As a result of the 'World Economic Herald' incident, Qin Benli was dismissed from his post as editor-in-chief by CPC officials on April 26, 1989, and placed under house arrest. Shortly before his death, on March 29, 1991, the Party committee of the Shanghai Academy of Social Sciences announced at his bedside that he was being placed on two years of party probation.

description.zh-cn: 保安局是政务司司长辖下的决策局之一。
description.en: The Security Bureau is one of the policy bureaus under the Chief Secretary for Administration.

description.zh-cn: 为应付第二次世界大战爆发后日益紧张的东亚局势，港英政府于1941年4月增设防卫科。
description.en: To cope with the increasingly tense situation in East Asia after the outbreak of World War II, the British Hong Kong Government established the Defence Branch in April 1941.

description.zh-cn: 防卫科于1973年5月改称为保安科。
description.en: The Defence Branch was renamed the Security Branch in May 1973.

description.zh-cn: 香港主权移交导致政府架构重组，保安科改组为保安局。
description.en: The handover of Hong Kong led to a government restructuring, in which the Security Branch was reorganized into the Security Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 对《香港特别行政区基本法》第二十三条立法的反对是2003年七一大游行的主要原因之一。
description.en: Opposition to the legislation of Article 23 of the Hong Kong Basic Law was one of the main reasons for the July 1st march in 2003.

description.zh-cn: 因基本法23条立法引发的七一大游行后，时任保安局局长叶刘淑仪申请辞职。
description.en: Following the July 1st march triggered by the legislation of Basic Law Article 23, then-Secretary for Security Regina Ip applied to resign.

description.zh-cn: 傅瑞宪因被发现协助盟军收集情报，于1943年10月遭日军处决。
description.en: After being discovered assisting Allied forces in intelligence gathering, John Alexander Fraser was executed by the Japanese military in October 1943.

description.zh-cn: 为响应香港主权移交前的本地化政策，首位华人保安司黎庆宁在1995年2月上任。
description.en: In response to the localisation policy before the handover of Hong Kong, the first ethnic Chinese Secretary for Security, Peter Lai, took office in February 1995.

description.zh-cn: 2002年7月1日开始实行主要官员问责制，保安局局长由公务员改为政治任命。
description.en: With the implementation of the Principal Officials Accountability System on July 1, 2002, the position of Secretary for Security was changed from a civil service post to a political appointment.

description.zh-cn: 香港警务处是保安局下辖的纪律部队之一。
description.en: The Hong Kong Police Force is one of the disciplinary services under the Security Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 入境事务处是保安局下辖的纪律部队之一。
description.en: The Immigration Department is one of the disciplinary services under the Security Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 香港海关是保安局下辖的纪律部队之一。
description.en: The Customs and Excise Department is one of the disciplinary services under the Security Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 香港惩教署是保安局下辖的纪律部队之一。
description.en: The Hong Kong Correctional Services is one of the disciplinary services under the Security Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 香港消防处是保安局下辖的纪律部队之一。
description.en: The Hong Kong Fire Services Department is one of the disciplinary services under the Security Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 政府飞行服务队是保安局下辖的纪律部队之一。
description.en: The Government Flying Service is one of the disciplinary services under the Security Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 禁毒处是保安局下辖的部门。
description.en: The Narcotics Division is a department under the Security Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 医疗辅助队是保安局下辖的部门。
description.en: The Auxiliary Medical Service is a department under the Security Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 独立监察警方处理投诉委员会是保安局下辖的公营机构。
description.en: The Independent Police Complaints Council is a public body under the Security Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 周本顺于1971年9月加入中国共产党，2015年10月16日因严重违纪违法被开除党籍。
description.en: Zhou Benshun joined the Communist Party of China in September 1971 and was expelled on October 16, 2015, for serious violations of discipline and law.

description.zh-cn: 周本顺长期担任时任中共中央政治局常委、中央政法委书记周永康的秘书，是其直接下属。
description.en: Zhou Benshun served for a long time as the secretary to Zhou Yongkang, who was then a member of the Politburo Standing Committee and Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, making him his direct subordinate.

description.zh-cn: 周本顺在担任中央政法委秘书长期间，向时任书记孟建柱汇报工作。
description.en: During his tenure as Secretary-General of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, Zhou Benshun reported to the then-Secretary Meng Jianzhu.

description.zh-cn: 2015年7月24日，中共中央纪委宣布对周本顺涉嫌严重违纪违法问题进行组织调查。
description.en: On July 24, 2015, the CPC Central Commission for Discipline Inspection announced an investigation into Zhou Benshun for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

description.zh-cn: 2017年2月15日，厦门市中级人民法院以受贿罪一审判处周本顺有期徒刑十五年。
description.en: On February 15, 2017, the Xiamen Intermediate People's Court sentenced Zhou Benshun to fifteen years in prison for bribery in the first instance.

description.zh-cn: 据中纪委办案人员透露，周本顺在调任河北后多次在公开场合对“中央八项规定”表达不满，认为规定抓得太细太严。
description.en: According to CCDI investigators, after his transfer to Hebei, Zhou Benshun publicly expressed dissatisfaction with the 'Eight-point Regulation' on multiple occasions, believing the rules were too detailed and strict.

description.zh-cn: 在该政治活动期间，中共中央总书记习近平到河北参加专题民主生活会，推动了周本顺及河北省委常委班子进行批评与自我批评。
description.en: During this political campaign, CPC General Secretary Xi Jinping attended a special democratic life meeting in Hebei, which prompted Zhou Benshun and the Hebei Provincial Party Standing Committee to engage in criticism and self-criticism.

description.zh-cn: 2013年9月23日，习近平抵达河北，与时任省委书记周本顺谈话，并参加了河北省委常委班子专题民主生活会。
description.en: On September 23, 2013, Xi Jinping arrived in Hebei, spoke with then-Provincial Party Secretary Zhou Benshun, and attended the special democratic life meeting of the Hebei Provincial Party Standing Committee.

description.zh-cn: 在周本顺担任中共河北省委书记期间，张庆伟任省委副书记、省长，是其主要副手。
description.en: While Zhou Benshun was the Party Secretary of Hebei, Zhang Qingwei served as Deputy Party Secretary and Governor, acting as his main deputy.

description.zh-cn: 中国地震局离退休干部办公室是中国地震局直属的内设职能机构。
description.en: The Retired Cadres Office is an internal functional agency directly under the China Earthquake Administration.

description.zh-cn: 1971年8月2日，中华人民共和国国务院决定调整原中国科学院下属的各地震研究部门，组建国家地震局（中国地震局前身）。
description.en: On August 2, 1971, the State Council of the People's Republic of China decided to reorganize the earthquake research departments formerly under the Chinese Academy of Sciences to form the National Earthquake Administration (predecessor of the China Earthquake Administration).

description.zh-cn: 李昌在文化大革命期间遭到残酷批斗。
description.en: Li Chang was brutally persecuted during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 在中国科学院任职期间，协助时任副院长胡耀邦主持工作。
description.en: While serving at the Chinese Academy of Sciences, he assisted Hu Yaobang, then Vice President, in presiding over the work.

description.zh-cn: 李昌担任中纪委书记时，陈云为第一书记，是其直接上级。
description.en: When Li Chang served as Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, Chen Yun was the First Secretary, making him his direct superior.

description.zh-cn: 在中央顾问委员会任职期间，力排众议，反对邓力群当选为中顾委常委。
description.en: During his tenure on the Central Advisory Commission, he went against the majority opinion and opposed Deng Liqun's election to the Standing Committee of the Central Advisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 在中央顾问委员会任职期间，力排众议，反对王鹤寿当选为中顾委常委。
description.en: During his tenure on the Central Advisory Commission, he went against the majority opinion and opposed Wang Heshou's election to the Standing Committee of the Central Advisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 在赵紫阳去世后，不顾禁令前往赵家吊唁。
description.en: After Zhao Ziyang's death, he defied a ban to go to Zhao's home to offer condolences.

description.zh-cn: 万润南是李昌的女婿。
description.en: Wan Runnan is Li Chang's son-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国对外文化联络委员会后来与其他政府机关合并，成为中华人民共和国文化部的一部分。
description.en: The Commission for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries of the People's Republic of China was later merged with other government agencies to become part of the Ministry of Culture of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 受文化大革命影响，江苏省公安学校教学中断，直至1978年8月才恢复。
description.en: Affected by the Cultural Revolution, teaching at the Jiangsu Provincial Public Security School was interrupted and did not resume until August 1978.

description.zh-cn: 艾山·买合苏木与阿不都卡德尔·亚甫泉于1997年再次发起组织，重建了该组织。
description.en: Hasan Mahsum, along with Abudukadir Yapuquan, re-established the organization in 1997.

description.zh-cn: 阿不都卡德尔·亚甫泉与艾山·买合苏木于1997年再次发起组织，重建了该组织。
description.en: Abudukadir Yapuquan, along with Hasan Mahsum, re-established the organization in 1997.

description.zh-cn: 突厥斯坦伊斯兰党策划了1997年乌鲁木齐公共汽车爆炸案。
description.en: The Turkistan Islamic Party planned the 1997 Ürümqi bus bombings.

description.zh-cn: 盖达组织向突厥斯坦伊斯兰党（东伊运）提供了资金和训练支持。
description.en: Al-Qaeda provided funding and training support to the Turkistan Islamic Party (ETIM).

description.zh-cn: 突厥斯坦伊斯兰党得到了塔利班的支持，并在塔利班统治阿富汗时期在其境内活动。
description.en: The Turkistan Islamic Party was supported by the Taliban and operated in its territory during the Taliban's rule in Afghanistan.

description.zh-cn: 联合国安理会将东突厥斯坦伊斯兰运动列为恐怖组织。
description.en: The United Nations Security Council listed the East Turkestan Islamic Movement as a terrorist organization.

description.zh-cn: 美国财政部于2002年将“东伊运”列为恐怖组织，并对其进行制裁。
description.en: The U.S. Department of the Treasury designated ETIM as a terrorist organization in 2002 and imposed sanctions on it.

description.zh-cn: 美国政府正式将“东伊运”从恐怖组织名单上除名，理由是无可信证据表明其继续存在。
description.en: The U.S. government formally removed ETIM from its list of terrorist organizations, citing a lack of credible evidence that the group continued to exist.

description.zh-cn: 突厥斯坦伊斯兰党领导人艾山·买合苏木被巴基斯坦军队击毙。
description.en: Turkistan Islamic Party leader Hasan Mahsum was killed by the Pakistani military.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国公安部将东突厥斯坦伊斯兰运动列入首批“东突”恐怖组织名单。
description.en: The Ministry of Public Security of the PRC included the East Turkestan Islamic Movement in its first list of 'East Turkestan' terrorist organizations.

description.zh-cn: 突厥斯坦伊斯兰党领导人买买提明·买买提据称在巴基斯坦遭美军导弹击中受重伤。
description.en: Turkistan Islamic Party leader Abdul Haq al-Turkistani was reportedly seriously injured in a US missile strike in Pakistan.

description.zh-cn: 突厥斯坦伊斯兰党的分支机构在2011年叙利亚内战爆发后设在叙利亚，并派人参加叙利亚反政府武装。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Syrian Civil War in 2011, a branch of the Turkistan Islamic Party was established in Syria, and it sent members to join the Syrian anti-government forces.

description.zh-cn: 阿拉伯联合酋长国将“东伊运”列入恐怖主义组织名单。
description.en: The United Arab Emirates listed ETIM as a terrorist organization.

description.zh-cn: 英国内政部将突厥斯坦伊斯兰党列入《被禁恐怖组织名单》。
description.en: The UK Home Office added the Turkistan Islamic Party to the Proscribed Terrorist Organisations list.

description.zh-cn: 土耳其政府将“东伊运”列入恐怖主义名单。
description.en: The Turkish government listed ETIM as a terrorist organization.

description.zh-cn: 世界维吾尔代表大会主席热比娅于2007年否认新疆存在东突厥斯坦伊斯兰运动之组织。
description.en: In 2007, Rebiya Kadeer, then president of the World Uyghur Congress, denied the existence of the ETIM organization in Xinjiang.

description.zh-cn: 作为世俗派东突势力，世界维吾尔代表大会与伊斯兰化的“东伊运”在东突独立运动的话语权上存在竞争关系。
description.en: As a secular East Turkestan force, the World Uyghur Congress competes with the Islamist ETIM for narrative control within the East Turkestan independence movement.

description.zh-cn: 突厥斯坦伊斯兰党曾是叙利亚内战期间的反政府武装联盟“征服军”的成员，直至2017年该联盟解散。
description.en: The Turkistan Islamic Party was a member of the Army of Conquest, an anti-government militant alliance during the Syrian Civil War, until the alliance dissolved in 2017.

description.zh-cn: 突厥斯坦伊斯兰党旨在在中国新疆地区建立独立国家，并策划实施了多起针对中国的恐怖袭击。
description.en: The Turkistan Islamic Party aims to establish an independent state in China's Xinjiang region and has planned and carried out multiple terrorist attacks against China.

description.zh-cn: 穆罕默德·伊本·阿卜杜勒·瓦哈卜是瓦哈比派的首倡者及领导人。
description.en: Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab was the initiator and leader of the Wahhabi movement.

description.zh-cn: 穆罕默德·伊本·阿卜杜勒·瓦哈卜的思想吸取自伊本·泰米叶的复古主义思想。
description.en: Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab's ideas were drawn from the revivalist thought of Ibn Taymiyyah.

description.zh-cn: 穆罕默德·伊本·阿卜杜勒·瓦哈卜的思想吸取自逊尼宗的罕百里学派的教法学说。
description.en: Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab's ideas were drawn from the legal doctrines of the Hanbali school of Sunni Islam.

description.zh-cn: 瓦哈比派与绍德家族的合作促成了沙特阿拉伯的成立。
description.en: The cooperation between the Wahhabi movement and the House of Saud led to the establishment of Saudi Arabia.

description.zh-cn: 沙特阿拉伯将瓦哈比派定为国教，王室成员必须信奉，并且政府在世界各地推广瓦哈比派信仰，包括每年耗资20至30亿美元资助相关清真寺和伊斯兰学校。
description.en: Saudi Arabia has made Wahhabism the state religion, which royal family members must adhere to. The government also promotes the Wahhabi faith worldwide, including spending $2-3 billion annually to fund related mosques and Islamic schools.

description.zh-cn: 瓦哈比派反对什叶派等其认定的异端行为。
description.en: Wahhabism opposes what it considers heretical practices, such as Shia Islam.

description.zh-cn: 瓦哈比派反对苏菲派等其认定的异端行为。
description.en: Wahhabism opposes what it considers heretical practices, such as Sufism.

description.zh-cn: 瓦哈比派反对世俗化等其认定的异端行为。
description.en: Wahhabism opposes what it considers heretical practices, such as secularization.

description.zh-cn: 瓦哈比派主张对所谓的异端和异教徒进行圣战。
description.en: Wahhabism advocates for jihad against so-called heretics and infidels.

description.zh-cn: 苏联解体后，瓦哈比派分子得以进入俄罗斯的伊奇克里亚车臣共和国扩张势力。
description.en: After the dissolution of the Soviet Union, Wahhabi elements were able to enter the Chechen Republic of Ichkeria in Russia to expand their influence.

description.zh-cn: 车臣分离主义政府为了争取外部援助，与瓦哈比派分子合作，并在其推动下实施伊斯兰教法。
description.en: The Chechen separatist government cooperated with Wahhabi elements to secure external aid and implemented Sharia law under their influence.

description.zh-cn: 恐怖分子本·拉登被认为是瓦哈比派的信徒。
description.en: The terrorist Osama bin Laden is considered a follower of Wahhabism.

description.zh-cn: 东突厥斯坦伊斯兰党头目阿不力克木·买合苏木是瓦哈比派信徒。
description.en: Ablikim Mahsum, the leader of the Turkistan Islamic Party, is a follower of Wahhabism.

description.zh-cn: 2015年11月巴黎袭击事件发生后，时任德国副总理西格玛尔·加布里尔公开要求沙特政府停止资助宣扬极端宗教思想的清真寺。
description.en: Following the November 2015 Paris attacks, then-German Vice Chancellor Sigmar Gabriel publicly demanded that the Saudi government stop funding mosques that promote extremist religious ideology.

description.zh-cn: 瓦哈比派是逊尼派伊斯兰教内部的一个运动。
description.en: Wahhabism is a movement within Sunni Islam.

description.zh-cn: 王志东是新浪的三位创始人之一。
description.en: Wang Zhidong is one of the three co-founders of Sina.

description.zh-cn: 汪延是新浪的三位创始人之一。
description.en: Wang Yan is one of the three co-founders of Sina.

description.zh-cn: 姜丰年是新浪的三位创始人之一。
description.en: Jiang Fengnian is one of the three co-founders of Sina.

description.zh-cn: 四通集团公司与王志东、严援朝共同创办了四通利方。
description.en: Stone Group co-founded SRSNet with Wang Zhidong and Yan Yuanchao.

description.zh-cn: 严援朝与四通集团公司、王志东共同创办了四通利方。
description.en: Yan Yuanchao co-founded SRSNet with Stone Group and Wang Zhidong.

description.zh-cn: 王志东自新浪成立起担任总裁，后兼任CEO，直至2001年被董事会免职。
description.en: Wang Zhidong served as President since Sina's inception, later also as CEO, until he was dismissed by the board in 2001.

description.zh-cn: 新浪董事会投票免去了王志东的CEO及董事职务。
description.en: Sina's board of directors voted to remove Wang Zhidong from his positions as CEO and director.

description.zh-cn: 曹国伟自2006年5月起担任新浪CEO，并于2012年8月起兼任董事长。
description.en: Charles Chao has been the CEO of Sina since May 2006, and also took on the role of Chairman in August 2012.

description.zh-cn: 在茅道林离职后，汪延被任命为新浪CEO。
description.en: After Mao Daolin's departure, Wang Yan was appointed CEO of Sina.

description.zh-cn: 新浪于2000年4月13日在纳斯达克上市，成为第一家在美国上市的中国门户网站，后于2021年3月23日完成私有化并退市。
description.en: Sina was listed on NASDAQ on April 13, 2000, becoming the first Chinese portal website to be listed in the United States. It completed its privatization and delisted on March 23, 2021.

description.zh-cn: 作为中国四大门户网站之一，新浪与腾讯在门户业务等领域存在竞争关系。
description.en: As one of China's four major portal websites, Sina competes with Tencent in the portal business and other areas.

description.zh-cn: 作为中国四大门户网站之一，新浪与搜狐在门户业务等领域存在竞争关系。
description.en: As one of China's four major portal websites, Sina competes with Sohu in the portal business and other areas.

description.zh-cn: 作为中国四大门户网站之一，新浪与网易在门户业务等领域存在竞争关系。
description.en: As one of China's four major portal websites, Sina competes with NetEase in the portal business and other areas.

description.zh-cn: 2005年，盛大网络对新浪发起恶意收购，意图控股新浪，但最终失败。
description.en: In 2005, Shanda Interactive launched a hostile takeover bid for Sina, attempting to gain a controlling stake, but ultimately failed.

description.zh-cn: 新浪启动“毒丸计划”以反击盛大网络的恶意收购。
description.en: Sina initiated a 'poison pill' defense to counter the hostile takeover attempt by Shanda Interactive.

description.zh-cn: 新浪向土豆网投资6,640万美元，成为其第五大股东。
description.en: Sina invested US$66.4 million in Tudou, becoming its fifth-largest shareholder.

description.zh-cn: 阿里巴巴集团入股新浪微博18%股份。
description.en: Alibaba Group acquired an 18% stake in Sina Weibo.

description.zh-cn: 新浪于2009年8月推出微博服务“新浪微博”。
description.en: Sina launched its microblogging service, Sina Weibo, in August 2009.

description.zh-cn: 新浪于2005年上线网络日志频道“新浪博客”。
description.en: Sina launched its online blog channel, Sina Blog, in 2005.

description.zh-cn: 新浪博客服务于2022年4月关闭。
description.en: The Sina Blog service was shut down in April 2022.

description.zh-cn: 新浪与京东签署“京浪计划”战略合作。
description.en: Sina and JD.com signed the 'Jing-Lang Plan' for strategic cooperation.

description.zh-cn: 以CEO曹国伟为首的新浪管理团队通过管理层收购（MBO）成为新浪第一大股东，获得了公司的实际控制权。
description.en: A management team led by CEO Charles Chao became Sina's largest shareholder through a management buyout (MBO), gaining effective control of the company.

description.zh-cn: 因涉嫌传播淫秽色情信息，全国扫黄打非办通报处罚新浪，拟吊销其《互联网出版许可证》和《信息网络传播视听节目许可证》。
description.en: Due to suspicion of spreading obscene and pornographic information, the National Office Against Pornographic and Illegal Publications announced penalties against Sina, intending to revoke its 'Internet Publishing License' and 'License for Online Transmission of Audio-Visual Programs'.

description.zh-cn: 国家网信办指导北京市网信办因新浪网传播违法有害信息等问题约谈新浪负责人，并责令其全面深入整改。
description.en: The Cyberspace Administration of China directed its Beijing office to summon Sina's负责人 over the dissemination of illegal and harmful information, ordering comprehensive rectification.

description.zh-cn: 温斯顿·丘吉尔是伦道夫·邱吉尔勋爵的儿子。
description.en: Winston Churchill was the son of Lord Randolph Churchill.

description.zh-cn: 温斯顿·丘吉尔于1908年9月12日与克莱门汀·霍齐尔结婚。
description.en: Winston Churchill married Clementine Hozier on September 12, 1908.

description.zh-cn: 温斯顿·丘吉尔于1888年入读哈罗公学。
description.en: Winston Churchill attended Harrow School from 1888.

description.zh-cn: 丘吉尔于1904年从保守党转投自由党，并于1924年重返保守党。
description.en: Churchill crossed the floor from the Conservatives to the Liberal Party in 1904, and returned to the Conservatives in 1924.

description.zh-cn: 在加里波利之战失败后，时任首相阿斯奎斯免去了丘吉尔的第一海军大臣职务。
description.en: After the failure of the Gallipoli campaign, Prime Minister Asquith removed Churchill from his position as First Lord of the Admiralty.

description.zh-cn: 1917年，时任首相劳合·乔治任命丘吉尔为军需部长，使其重返政府核心。
description.en: In 1917, Prime Minister Lloyd George appointed Churchill as Minister of Munitions, bringing him back into the heart of government.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战的爆发使丘吉尔重返内阁，并最终于1940年成为英国首相。
description.en: The outbreak of World War II led to Churchill's return to the cabinet and ultimately his appointment as Prime Minister in 1940.

description.zh-cn: 温斯顿·丘吉尔曾两度担任英国首相。
description.en: Winston Churchill served two terms as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 作为英国战时首相，丘吉尔领导同盟国对抗轴心国。
description.en: As Britain's wartime Prime Minister, Churchill led the Allied effort against the Axis powers.

description.zh-cn: 尽管丘吉尔是坚定的反共主义者，但在二战期间，他与苏联领导人斯大林结成同盟以对抗纳粹德国。
description.en: Despite being a staunch anti-communist, Churchill formed an alliance with Soviet leader Stalin during World War II to combat Nazi Germany.

description.zh-cn: 在1945年的大选中，克莱门特·艾德礼领导的工党击败了丘吉尔的保守党，两人成为政治上的主要对手。
description.en: In the 1945 general election, Clement Attlee's Labour Party defeated Churchill's Conservatives, making them primary political rivals.

description.zh-cn: 丘吉尔于1946年发表的“铁幕演说”被广泛认为是冷战开始的标志性事件。
description.en: Churchill's 'Iron Curtain' speech in 1946 is widely regarded as a symbolic starting point of the Cold War.

description.zh-cn: 丘吉尔发表铁幕演说时，时任美国总统杜鲁门是台下听众之一。
description.en: When Churchill delivered his Iron Curtain speech, then-U.S. President Truman was in the audience.

description.zh-cn: 二战后，丘吉尔明确将苏联视为西方民主世界的主要威胁。
description.en: After World War II, Churchill clearly identified the Soviet Union as the main threat to the Western democratic world.

description.zh-cn: 年羹尧是年遐龄的儿子。
description.en: Nian Gengyao was the son of Nian Xialing.

description.zh-cn: 敦肃皇贵妃是年羹尧的妹妹。
description.en: Imperial Noble Consort Dunsu was Nian Gengyao's younger sister.

description.zh-cn: 年希尧是年羹尧的兄长。
description.en: Nian Xiyao was Nian Gengyao's elder brother.

description.zh-cn: 年富是年羹尧的儿子。
description.en: Nian Fu was the son of Nian Gengyao.

description.zh-cn: 年羹尧的籍贯是辽东广宁。
description.en: Nian Gengyao's ancestral home was Guangning in Liaodong.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝因年羹尧在平定西藏时的出色表现而赏识他，并任命他为四川总督等要职。
description.en: The Kangxi Emperor appreciated Nian Gengyao for his outstanding performance in pacifying Tibet and appointed him to key positions such as the Viceroy of Sichuan.

position.zh-cn: 四川巡抚、四川总督、川陕总督、定西将军
position.en: Governor of Sichuan, Viceroy of Sichuan, Viceroy of Sichuan and Shaanxi, General Who Pacifies the West

description.zh-cn: 在康熙朝后期，年羹尧历任多个重要职务，直接向康熙帝负责。
description.en: In the late Kangxi period, Nian Gengyao held several important posts, reporting directly to the Kangxi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 在康熙末年的皇位继承斗争中，年羹尧与隆科多合作，为雍正帝的顺利即位发挥了关键作用。
description.en: During the succession struggle in the final years of Kangxi's reign, Nian Gengyao collaborated with Longkodo, playing a crucial role in the smooth accession of the Yongzheng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 年羹尧早年即成为时为雍亲王的胤禛的亲信，两人关系密切，直至雍正三年关系破裂。
description.en: Early in his career, Nian Gengyao became a confidant of Yinzhen, then Prince Yong, and they maintained a close relationship until it fractured in the third year of the Yongzheng reign (1725).

description.zh-cn: 自雍正三年（1725年）起，雍正帝以年羹尧恃功自傲、结党营私等九十二条大罪，逐步削夺其官爵，并最终于雍正三年十二月（1726年1月）赐其自尽。
description.en: Starting from 1725, the Yongzheng Emperor, citing 92 major crimes including arrogance, factionalism, and abuse of power, progressively stripped Nian Gengyao of his titles and positions, ultimately ordering him to commit suicide in January 1726.

description.zh-cn: 在拥立雍正帝即位时，两人里应外合，被时人并称为“内有隆科多，外有年羹尧”。
description.en: During the enthronement of Emperor Yongzheng, the two collaborated closely, leading to the contemporary saying, 'Longkodo on the inside, Nian Gengyao on the outside'.

description.zh-cn: 在平定青海罗卜藏丹津叛乱期间，岳钟琪作为将领在抚远大将军年羹尧麾下作战。
description.en: During the suppression of the Lobsang Tendzin rebellion in Qinghai, Yue Zhongqi served as a general under the command of Fuyuan Great General Nian Gengyao.

description.zh-cn: 雍正元年，年羹尧被任命为抚远大将军，率军征讨并平定了罗卜藏丹津在青海发动的叛乱。
description.en: In 1723, Nian Gengyao was appointed Fuyuan Great General and led the army to suppress the rebellion launched by Lobsang Tendzin in Qinghai.

description.zh-cn: 年羹尧权势鼎盛时，入京时曾令巡抚范时捷跪在路旁迎接，对其进行羞辱。
description.en: At the height of his power, Nian Gengyao humiliated Governor Fan Shijie by forcing him to kneel on the roadside to greet him upon his arrival in the capital.

description.zh-cn: 汪景祺是年羹尧的幕僚和亲信，因与年羹尧关系密切而受牵连，在年案后被处死。
description.en: Wang Jingqi was Nian Gengyao's advisor and confidant. He was implicated due to his close relationship with Nian and was executed after Nian's case.

description.zh-cn: 钱名世因作诗谄媚颂扬年羹尧，被视为年党成员，在年羹尧倒台后遭到严惩。
description.en: Qian Mingshi was considered a member of Nian's faction for writing flattering poems in praise of Nian Gengyao, and was severely punished after Nian's downfall.

description.zh-cn: 年羹尧于康熙三十九年（1700年）中进士后，入翰林院任职，后累迁至侍讲学士。
description.en: After passing the imperial examination in 1700, Nian Gengyao joined the Hanlin Academy and was later promoted to Expositor-in-waiting.

description.zh-cn: 年羹尧及其家族最初隶属于汉军镶白旗。
description.en: Nian Gengyao and his family were originally affiliated with the Bordered White Banner Han Martial.

description.zh-cn: 雍正元年（1723年），为表彰其功绩，雍正帝将年羹尧抬入汉军镶黄旗。
description.en: In 1723, to recognize his merits, the Yongzheng Emperor transferred Nian Gengyao to the Bordered Yellow Banner Han Martial.

description.zh-cn: 莱希曾接受时任伊朗总统阿里·哈梅内伊的培训。后来，作为最高领袖的哈梅内伊任命莱希为司法总监。在莱希担任总统期间，哈梅内伊是伊朗的最高领袖，为莱希的直接上级。
description.en: Raisi was trained by then-President Ali Khamenei. Later, as Supreme Leader, Khamenei appointed Raisi as Chief Justice. During Raisi's presidency, Khamenei was the Supreme Leader of Iran, making him Raisi's direct superior.

description.zh-cn: 阿里·哈梅内伊任命易卜拉欣·莱希担任伊朗司法总监。
description.en: Ali Khamenei appointed Ebrahim Raisi to the position of Chief Justice of Iran.

description.zh-cn: 易卜拉欣·莱希在2017年伊朗总统选举中作为哈桑·鲁哈尼的主要竞争对手，但最终落败。
description.en: Ebrahim Raisi was the main competitor to Hassan Rouhani in the 2017 Iranian presidential election, but was ultimately defeated.

description.zh-cn: 易卜拉欣·莱希在此次直升机坠毁事故中身亡。
description.en: Ebrahim Raisi was killed in this helicopter crash.

description.zh-cn: 侯赛因·阿米尔-阿卜杜拉希扬与总统莱希同乘一架直升机，在此次事故中身亡。
description.en: Hossein Amir-Abdollahian was on the same helicopter as President Raisi and was killed in this crash.

description.zh-cn: 莱希15岁时前往库姆进入什叶派神学院学习。
description.en: At the age of 15, Raisi went to Qom to study at the Shia seminary.

description.zh-cn: 在易卜拉欣·莱希担任总统期间，穆罕默德·穆赫贝尔是其第一副总统。
description.en: During Ebrahim Raisi's presidency, Mohammad Mokhber was his First Vice President.

description.zh-cn: 侯赛因·阿米尔-阿卜杜拉希扬在易卜拉欣·莱希的内阁中担任外交部长。
description.en: Hossein Amir-Abdollahian served as the Minister of Foreign Affairs in Ebrahim Raisi's cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 莱希被认为是“死亡委员会”的成员之一，该委员会在1988年对数千名政治犯判处死刑。
description.en: Raisi is believed to have been a member of the 'death committee' that sentenced thousands of political prisoners to death in 1988.

description.zh-cn: 侯赛因-阿里·蒙塔泽里公开谴责了1988年的处决事件，称其为“伊斯兰共和国历史上最大的罪行”。
description.en: Hussein-Ali Montazeri publicly condemned the 1988 executions, calling them 'the greatest crime in the history of the Islamic Republic'.

description.zh-cn: 美国政府根据13876号行政命令，因易卜拉欣·莱希涉及“侵犯人权”而对其进行制裁。
description.en: The U.S. government sanctioned Ebrahim Raisi under Executive Order 13876 for his involvement in 'human rights abuses'.

description.zh-cn: 作为时任总统，莱希政府对因玛莎·阿米尼之死引发的抗议活动采取了镇压措施，包括逮捕和判处死刑。
description.en: As the president at the time, Raisi's government cracked down on the protests sparked by the death of Mahsa Amini, including arrests and death sentences.

description.zh-cn: 作为伊朗总统，莱希于2022年7月在德黑兰会见普京，并于2023年12月回访莫斯科。
description.en: As President of Iran, Raisi met with Putin in Tehran in July 2022 and made a return visit to Moscow in December 2023.

description.zh-cn: 在易卜拉欣·莱希担任总统期间，伊朗与沙特阿拉伯在断交七年后，于2023年3月同意恢复外交关系。
description.en: During the presidency of Ebrahim Raisi, Iran and Saudi Arabia agreed to restore diplomatic relations in March 2023, after a seven-year break.

description.zh-cn: 易卜拉欣·莱希全力支持1979年的伊朗伊斯兰革命，并在革命后建立的新政权下开启了他的司法和政治生涯。
description.en: Ebrahim Raisi fully supported the 1979 Iranian Islamic Revolution, which launched his judicial and political career under the newly established regime.

description.zh-cn: 珍妃于1889年入宫成为光绪帝的嫔，后晋封为妃，是光绪帝最宠爱的妃子。
description.en: Consort Zhen entered the palace in 1889 as a concubine of the Guangxu Emperor, later promoted to Consort, and was his most favored consort.

description.zh-cn: 据史料记载，太监崔玉贵奉慈禧太后之命，将珍妃推入井中杀害。
description.en: According to historical records, the eunuch Cui Yugui, under orders from Empress Dowager Cixi, pushed Consort Zhen into a well, causing her death.

description.zh-cn: 戊戌政变失败后，珍妃因被视为光绪帝的支持者而受到牵连，被慈禧太后下令软禁。
description.en: After the failure of the Wuxu Coup, Consort Zhen was implicated as a supporter of the Guangxu Emperor and was placed under house arrest by order of Empress Dowager Cixi.

description.zh-cn: 珍妃是瑾妃的同胞妹妹。
description.en: Consort Zhen was the biological younger sister of Consort Jin.

description.zh-cn: 志锐是珍妃的同胞兄长。
description.en: Zhirui was the biological elder brother of Consort Zhen.

description.zh-cn: 瑾妃性情忠厚，与失宠的皇后走得很近，关系较好。
description.en: Consort Jin, being loyal and kind, was close to the out-of-favor Empress and had a good relationship with her.

description.zh-cn: 文廷式曾是珍妃的老师，教其读书，使其颇通文史。
description.en: Wen Tingshi was Consort Zhen's tutor, teaching her literature and history, which made her well-versed in these subjects.

description.zh-cn: 珍妃多次向光绪帝称赞文廷式，促使光绪帝在甲午大考翰詹中将其拔置第一，并擢升其官职。
description.en: Consort Zhen repeatedly praised Wen Tingshi to the Guangxu Emperor, which led the emperor to rank him first in the Hanlin Academy examination and promote him.

description.zh-cn: 甲午战争期间，主战的文廷式与持妥协态度的李鸿章极度不和。
description.en: During the First Sino-Japanese War, the pro-war Wen Tingshi was in extreme disagreement with the compromising Li Hongzhang.

description.zh-cn: 杨崇伊受李鸿章授意，向慈禧参奏，诬陷珍妃干预朝政与觊觎后位，这是导致珍妃第一次获罪降级的重要原因。
description.en: Instigated by Li Hongzhang, Yang Chongyi submitted a memorial to Cixi, falsely accusing Consort Zhen of interfering in politics and coveting the empress's position, which was a major reason for her first punishment and demotion.

description.zh-cn: 因杨崇伊对珍妃的参奏，其兄志锐也受到牵连，被贬为乌里雅苏台参赞大臣。
description.en: Due to Yang Chongyi's accusations against Consort Zhen, her brother Zhirui was also implicated and demoted to Counselor of Uliastai.

description.zh-cn: 因杨崇伊的参奏，文廷式被革职。
description.en: As a result of Yang Chongyi's accusations, Wen Tingshi was dismissed from his post.

description.zh-cn: 珍妃出身于满洲镶红旗他他拉氏。
description.en: Consort Zhen was from the Tatara clan of the Manchu Bordered Red Banner.

description.zh-cn: 蔡雪瑾与尼格买提·热合曼为中国传媒大学播音与主持艺术专业的同班同学。
description.en: Cai Xuejin and Nigmat Rahman were classmates in the Broadcasting and Hosting Arts program at the Communication University of China.

description.zh-cn: 主持民生政策节目《直通990》。
description.en: Hosts the public policy program 'Direct to 990'.

description.zh-cn: 参与“神舟六号”相关新闻事件的报道，扩大了事件的传播。
description.en: Participated in reporting on the 'Shenzhou 6' news event, amplifying its dissemination.

description.zh-cn: 参与“汶川大地震”相关新闻事件的报道，扩大了事件的传播。
description.en: Participated in reporting on the 'Wenchuan Earthquake' news event, amplifying its dissemination.

description.zh-cn: 参与“上海世博会”相关新闻事件的报道，扩大了事件的传播。
description.en: Participated in reporting on the 'Expo 2010 Shanghai' news event, amplifying its dissemination.

description.zh-cn: 参与“伦敦奥运会”相关新闻事件的报道，扩大了事件的传播。
description.en: Participated in reporting on the 'London Olympics' news event, amplifying its dissemination.

description.zh-cn: 东方网于2020年开发的上海话拟音SaaS服务使用了蔡雪瑾作为女声音源。
description.en: An AI-powered Shanghainese text-to-speech SaaS developed by Eastday.com in 2020 used Cai Xuejin as the female voice source.

description.zh-cn: 文革期间的造反派运动可分为早期的红卫兵造反运动以及后期的工人造反运动，红卫兵运动是造反派运动的开端和重要组成部分。
description.en: The rebel movement during the Cultural Revolution can be divided into the early Red Guard rebel movement and the later worker rebel movement; the Red Guard movement was the beginning and an important component of the rebel movement.

description.zh-cn: 造反派与保守派之间，或造反派内部，时常发生武斗。
description.en: Violent struggles frequently occurred between the Rebel Faction and the Conservative Faction, or within the Rebel Faction itself.

description.zh-cn: 1968年夏，由工农兵组成的毛泽东思想宣传队开始进驻各单位，制止了大规模武斗。
description.en: In the summer of 1968, Mao Zedong Thought Propaganda Teams composed of workers, peasants, and soldiers began to enter various units, stopping the large-scale violent struggles.

description.zh-cn: 在文革“清查五一六”运动中，许多造反派领袖和成员遭到清算整肃。
description.en: During the 'Cleansing of the May 16th Elements' campaign of the Cultural Revolution, many rebel leaders and members were purged and persecuted.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东通过引用“造反有理”、写信支持清华附中红卫兵、八次接见红卫兵等方式，明确支持了造反派运动。
description.en: Mao Zedong explicitly supported the rebel movement by quoting 'rebellion is justified', writing a letter in support of the Tsinghua University High School Red Guards, and receiving Red Guards eight times.

description.zh-cn: 在刘备部队溃散、极度困窘时，将妹妹嫁给刘备为夫人，并献上僮仆二千及金银货币以助军资，帮助刘备重新振作。
description.en: When Liu Bei's forces were scattered and in dire straits, Mi Zhu married his younger sister to Liu Bei and presented two thousand servants and financial resources to aid his army, helping Liu Bei to recover.

description.zh-cn: 偷袭下邳，俘虏了刘备的妻子。
description.en: Launched a surprise attack on Xiapi and captured Liu Bei's wife.

description.zh-cn: 偷袭下邳时俘虏了时为刘备妻子的麋夫人。
description.en: Captured Lady Mi, then Liu Bei's wife, during his surprise attack on Xiapi.

description.zh-cn: 率军东征，击败刘备，占领徐州。
description.en: Led an eastern campaign, defeated Liu Bei, and seized Xuzhou.

description.zh-cn: 在进攻徐州时俘虏了麋夫人，并将其带回许都。
description.en: Captured Lady Mi during the attack on Xuzhou and took her back to Xudu.

description.zh-cn: 根据小说《三国演义》的描述，麋夫人在长阪坡之战中受伤，为保全刘禅，将阿斗托付给赵云后投井自尽。
description.en: According to the novel 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Lady Mi was injured during the Battle of Changban. To ensure the safety of Liu Shan (Adou), she entrusted him to Zhao Yun before committing suicide by jumping into a well.

description.zh-cn: 小说《三国演义》详细描绘了麋夫人的形象，特别是她在长阪坡之战中托孤投井的情节，使其忠烈形象深入人心。
description.en: The novel 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' shaped the popular image of Lady Mi, particularly through the episode at the Battle of Changban where she entrusts her son to a general and commits suicide, establishing her as a loyal and heroic figure.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议是在中国共产党领导下的统一战线组织和多党合作的重要机构。
description.en: The Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference is a united front organization and a key institution for multi-party cooperation under the leadership of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 重庆谈判的《双十协定》中正式确定了召开政治协商会议。
description.en: The 'Double Tenth Agreement' from the Chongqing Negotiations formally decided to convene the Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 新政协筹备会负责了第一届全体会议的一切筹备事宜。
description.en: The preparatory committee for the new PCC was responsible for all preparations for the First Plenary Session.

description.zh-cn: 第一届全国人大一次会议召开后，政协不再代行立法机关职权，其角色转变为统一战线组织。
description.en: After the first session of the 1st NPC was held, the CPPCC no longer exercised legislative powers, and its role shifted to that of a united front organization.

description.zh-cn: 在改革开放新时期，邓小平明确了人民政协在国家大政方针、政治生活和现代化建设中的协商、讨论和监督作用。
description.en: In the new era of reform and opening-up, Deng Xiaoping clarified the CPPCC's role in consultation, discussion, and supervision regarding major state policies, political life, and modernization.

description.zh-cn: 1982年宪法在序言中首次明确规定了中国人民政治协商会议的性质、地位和作用，为其发展提供了法律依据。
description.en: The 1982 Constitution, for the first time in its preamble, explicitly defined the nature, status, and role of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, providing a legal basis for its development.

description.zh-cn: 现任中国人民政治协商会议第十四届全国委员会主席。
description.en: Currently serves as the Chairman of the 14th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 现任中国人民政治协商会议第十四届全国委员会副主席、秘书长。
description.en: Currently serves as a Vice Chairman and the Secretary-General of the 14th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 任四川省委第一书记期间，全力执行粮食征购任务，保障了中央及大城市的粮食供给，但导致四川省因缺粮而出现大量民众饿死的情况。
description.en: As the First Secretary of the Sichuan Provincial Committee, he fully implemented the grain procurement tasks, ensuring the grain supply for the central government and major cities, but this led to a large number of deaths from starvation in Sichuan Province due to food shortages.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东看中李井泉，并将其留在红一方面军工作。
description.en: Mao Zedong took a liking to Li Jingquan and kept him to work in the First Front Army of the Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 在庐山会议上紧跟毛泽东批判彭德怀。
description.en: Followed Mao Zedong closely in criticizing Peng Dehuai at the Lushan Conference.

description.zh-cn: 在七千人大会上保护李井泉，使其免于被追究在大饥荒中的责任。
description.en: Protected Li Jingquan at the Seven Thousand Cadres Conference, saving him from being held responsible for his role in the Great Famine.

description.zh-cn: 在从武汉到九江的船上，田家英与李井泉谈及饿死人的问题。
description.en: On a boat from Wuhan to Jiujiang, Tian Jiaying spoke with Li Jingquan about people starving to death.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命中被打倒，定性为“反党、反社会主义、反毛泽东思想的独立王国”。
description.en: Was overthrown during the Cultural Revolution and labeled as an "independent kingdom opposing the Party, socialism, and Mao Zedong Thought."

description.zh-cn: 在七千人大会上，周恩来对李井泉上调粮食救急表示赞赏，使其未被追究责任。
description.en: At the Seven Thousand Cadres Conference, Zhou Enlai praised Li Jingquan for transferring grain for emergency relief, which helped him avoid being held accountable.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命中被迫害致死。
description.en: Persecuted to death during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 联名书写大字报，为刘少奇等老干部鸣冤，狠批中央文革。
description.en: Co-authored a big-character poster to protest the injustice against Liu Shaoqi and other veteran cadres, sharply criticizing the Central Cultural Revolution Group.

description.zh-cn: 由于国共内战，吴宇森的家人于1951年从广州逃难至香港。
description.en: Due to the Chinese Civil War, John Woo's family fled from Guangzhou to Hong Kong in 1951.

description.zh-cn: 1953年的石硖尾大火烧毁了吴宇森全家的身份证件，导致他们被迫滞留香港，未能按原计划迁往台湾。
description.en: The Shek Kip Mei fire in 1953 destroyed the identification documents of John Woo's family, forcing them to remain in Hong Kong and preventing their planned move to Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 2004年，香港浸会大学授予吴宇森荣誉社会科学博士学位，以表彰其在电影专业的卓越成就。
description.en: In 2004, Hong Kong Baptist University conferred an Honorary Doctor of Social Sciences degree upon John Woo in recognition of his outstanding achievements in the film profession.

description.zh-cn: 在邵氏影业拔擢吴宇森成为其助理导演。
description.en: Promoted John Woo to be his assistant director at Shaw Brothers Studio.

description.zh-cn: 在吴宇森职业生涯低谷期，徐克力邀他加入新艺城，并支持他执导了其职业生涯的转折点作品《英雄本色》。
description.en: During a low point in John Woo's career, Tsui Hark invited him to join Cinema City and supported him in directing 'A Better Tomorrow', a turning point in his career.

description.zh-cn: 担任《英雄本色》的导演和编剧。
description.en: Served as the director and screenwriter for 'A Better Tomorrow'.

description.zh-cn: 电影《英雄本色》的成功，极大地提升了主演周润发的知名度。
description.en: The success of the film 'A Better Tomorrow' significantly boosted the stardom of its lead actor, Chow Yun-fat.

description.zh-cn: 吴宇森与周润发是长期合作伙伴，共同创作了《英雄本色》、《喋血双雄》、《纵横四海》等多部经典电影。
description.en: John Woo and Chow Yun-fat are long-term collaborators, having worked together on several classic films including 'A Better Tomorrow', 'The Killer', and 'Once a Thief'.

description.zh-cn: 担任《喋血双雄》的导演。
description.en: Served as the director for 'The Killer'.

description.zh-cn: 电影《夺面双雄》的巨大成功帮助当时声名下坠的约翰·特拉沃尔塔重振了演艺事业。
description.en: The huge success of the film 'Face/Off' helped to revive the career of John Travolta, whose fame was declining at the time.

description.zh-cn: 担任电影《赛德克·巴莱》的监制，为导演魏德圣提供战争和动作场面的技术指导。
description.en: Served as the producer for the film 'Seediq Bale', providing technical guidance on war and action scenes to director Wei Te-sheng.

description.zh-cn: 国防参议会是国防最高会议下设的咨询机关。
description.en: The National Defense Council was an advisory body established under the Supreme National Defense Council.

description.zh-cn: 国民大会召开后，国民参政会于1948年3月正式结束。
description.en: After the convening of the National Assembly, the People's Political Council was formally dissolved in March 1948.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在1938年3月向国民党临时全国代表大会提议“健全民意机关”，促成了国民参政会的建立。
description.en: In March 1938, the Communist Party of China proposed to 'strengthen the organs of public opinion' at the Kuomintang's Provisional National Congress, which led to the establishment of the People's Political Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党在临时全国代表大会上决定接受中共提议，并通过《抗战建国纲领》，决定组织国民参政机关。
description.en: The Kuomintang decided to accept the CCP's proposal at its Provisional National Congress and passed the 'Program of Armed Resistance and National Reconstruction,' deciding to organize a national political participation body.

description.zh-cn: 该纲领规定“组织国民参政机关”，为国民参政会的成立提供了法律依据。
description.en: This program stipulated the 'organization of a national political participation body,' providing the legal basis for the establishment of the People's Political Council.

description.zh-cn: 1938年6月，国民政府任命汪兆铭（汪精卫）为国民参政会议长。
description.en: In June 1938, the Nationalist Government appointed Wang Zhaoming (Wang Jingwei) as the speaker of the People's Political Council.

description.zh-cn: 1938年6月，国民政府任命张伯苓为国民参政会代理副议长。
description.en: In June 1938, the Nationalist Government appointed Zhang Boling as the acting deputy speaker of the People's Political Council.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东被任命为国民参政会参政员，后于1947年7月31日被国民政府除名。
description.en: Mao Zedong was appointed as a councilor of the People's Political Council and was later removed from the list by the Nationalist Government on July 31, 1947.

description.zh-cn: 董必武是国民参政会中共参政员，并担任第一、二、三、四届驻会委员，后于1947年7月31日被国民政府除名。
description.en: Dong Biwu was a CCP councilor of the People's Political Council, served as a resident committee member for the first four sessions, and was later removed from the list by the Nationalist Government on July 31, 1947.

description.zh-cn: 邓颖超被任命为国民参政会参政员，后于1947年7月31日被国民政府除名。
description.en: Deng Yingchao was appointed as a councilor of the People's Political Council and was later removed from the list by the Nationalist Government on July 31, 1947.

description.zh-cn: 皖南事变后，中国共产党参政员为抗议国民党的反共政策，曾有几次拒绝出席参政会会议，影响了参政会的正常运作。
description.en: After the New Fourth Army Incident, the CCP councilors, in protest of the Kuomintang's anti-communist policies, refused to attend the council's meetings on several occasions, affecting its normal operation.

description.zh-cn: 国民政府于1947年7月31日发布公报，将中共毛泽东等七人从国民参政会参政员中除名。
description.en: On July 31, 1947, the Nationalist Government issued a gazette removing seven CCP members, including Mao Zedong, from their positions as councilors of the People's Political Council.

description.zh-cn: 宪政期成会通过了宪法草案，即《期成宪草》。
description.en: The Constitutionalism Promotion Committee passed the draft constitution known as the 'Qicheng Xiancao'.

description.zh-cn: 在访问延安期间，黄炎培在杨家岭的窑洞里与毛泽东会面，并进行了关于“历史周期率”的著名对话，即“窑洞对”。
description.en: During his visit to Yan'an, Huang Yanpei met with Mao Zedong in a cave dwelling in Yangjialing and had the famous conversation about the 'historical cycle', known as the 'cave-dwelling dialogue'.

description.zh-cn: 长征是由中国共产党领导的军事战略转移。
description.en: The Long March was a military strategic retreat led by the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 遵义会议取消了李德的最高军事指挥权。
description.en: The Zunyi Conference stripped Li De of his supreme military command.

description.zh-cn: 张国焘在另立中央后，宣布开除周恩来等人的党籍。
description.en: After establishing his separate central committee, Zhang Guotao announced the expulsion of Zhou Enlai and others from the party.

description.zh-cn: 时任中共中央总负责人博古支持李德的错误军事指挥，被认为对第五次反围剿战争的失败负有主要责任。
description.en: As the de facto head of the CCP Central Committee, Bo Gu supported Li De's erroneous military command and was considered primarily responsible for the failure of the Fifth Anti-Encirclement Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 共产国际军事顾问李德采取“短促突击”战术，与国民革命军打阵地战和消耗战，导致第五次反围剿战争失败。
description.en: Comintern military advisor Li De adopted 'short, swift thrusts' tactics, engaging in positional and attritional warfare with the National Revolutionary Army, which led to the failure of the Fifth Anti-Encirclement Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 红军三大主力在会宁地区会师，标志着长征的结束。
description.en: The rendezvous of the three main forces of the Red Army in the Huining area marked the end of the Long March.

description.zh-cn: 中央红军在湘江战役中损失惨重，兵力从出发时的八万余人锐减至三万余人。
description.en: The Central Red Army suffered heavy losses in the Battle of the Xiang River, with its forces reduced from over 80,000 at the start to just over 30,000.

description.zh-cn: 在毛泽东的指挥下，中央红军通过四渡赤水的机动作战，摆脱了国民革命军的围追堵截。
description.en: Under Mao Zedong's command, the Central Red Army, through the mobile warfare of crossing the Chishui River four times, broke free from the encirclement and pursuit of the National Revolutionary Army.

description.zh-cn: 蒋介石部署并指挥国民革命军对长征中的红军进行围追堵截。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek deployed and commanded the National Revolutionary Army to encircle, pursue, and intercept the Red Army during the Long March.

description.zh-cn: 长征结束后，由红四方面军主力组成的西路军奉命西渡黄河，执行宁夏战役计划。
description.en: After the Long March concluded, the Western Route Army, composed of the main force of the Fourth Front Army, was ordered to cross the Yellow River to execute the Ningxia Campaign Plan.

description.zh-cn: 天津市人民代表大会是中华人民共和国天津市的地方国家权力机关。
description.en: The Tianjin Municipal People's Congress is the local state power organ of Tianjin, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 天津市人民代表大会是地方各级人民代表大会之一，是天津市的地方国家权力机关。
description.en: The Tianjin Municipal People's Congress is one of the local people's congresses at various levels and is the local state power organ of Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 天津市人民代表大会常务委员会是天津市人民代表大会的常设机构。
description.en: The Standing Committee of the Tianjin Municipal People's Congress is the standing body of the Tianjin Municipal People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 《中华人民共和国宪法》是天津市人民代表大会的授权法源。
description.en: The Constitution of the People's Republic of China is the legal source of authorization for the Tianjin Municipal People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 《中华人民共和国地方各级人民代表大会和地方各级人民政府组织法》是天津市人民代表大会的组织法规。
description.en: The 'Organic Law of the Local People's Congresses and Local People's Governments of the People's Republic of China' is the organizational statute for the Tianjin Municipal People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 天津市人民代表大会是天津市的地方国家权力机关。
description.en: The Tianjin Municipal People's Congress is the local state power organ of Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 毛宁于2022年9月5日作为第33任新闻发言人首次亮相。
description.en: Mao Ning debuted as the 33rd spokesperson on September 5, 2022.

description.zh-cn: 毛宁是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Mao Ning is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 在毛宁担任外交部新闻司司长期间，郭嘉昆为其副手。
description.en: While Mao Ning serves as Director of the Information Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Guo Jiakun is her deputy.

description.zh-cn: 亚洲司是外交部内设的司局级机构。
description.en: The Department of Asian Affairs is a department-level agency within the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 2018年机构改革后，国家林业和草原局加挂“国家公园管理局”牌子。
description.en: After the 2018 institutional reform, the National Forestry and Grassland Administration added the 'National Park Administration' nameplate.

description.zh-cn: 交通运输部海事局是中华人民共和国交通运输部的直属机构。
description.en: The Maritime Safety Administration of the Ministry of Transport is a directly affiliated institution of the Ministry of Transport of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 该法规定国家通用语言文字工作由国务院语言文字工作部门（即国家语言文字工作委员会）负责。
description.en: This law stipulates that the work on the standard national language is the responsibility of the State Council's language and characters work department (i.e., the State Language Commission).

description.zh-cn: 江西省妇幼保健院被调整为南昌医学院的直属附属医院。
description.en: Jiangxi Provincial Maternal and Child Health Hospital was adjusted to be a directly affiliated hospital of Nanchang Medical College.

description.zh-cn: 丁兴农出生于江苏建湖。
description.en: Ding Xingnong was born in Jianhu, Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 丁兴农是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Ding Xingnong is a member of the Communist Party of China.

position.en: Deputy Director of the Cadre Department of the Political Department

description.zh-cn: 丁兴农曾任总装备部政治部干部部副部长。
description.en: Ding Xingnong served as Deputy Director of the Cadre Department of the Political Department of the General Armament Department.

description.zh-cn: 2008年，丁兴农任中国卫星海上测控部党委书记、政治委员。
description.en: In 2008, Ding Xingnong was appointed Party Secretary and Political Commissar of the China Satellite Maritime Tracking and Control Department.

description.zh-cn: 2010年7月，丁兴农晋升为少将军衔。
description.en: In July 2010, Ding Xingnong was promoted to the rank of Major General.

description.zh-cn: 2012年3月，丁兴农任总装备部政治部（后为中央军委装备发展部政治工作局）主任。
description.en: In March 2012, Ding Xingnong was appointed Director of the Political Department of the General Armament Department (later the Political Work Bureau of the Equipment Development Department of the Central Military Commission).

description.zh-cn: 2019年，丁兴农晋升为中将军衔。
description.en: In 2019, Ding Xingnong was promoted to the rank of Lieutenant General.

position.en: Director of the Political Work Department

description.zh-cn: 2021年12月，丁兴农任战略支援部队政治工作部主任。
description.en: In December 2021, Ding Xingnong was appointed Director of the Political Work Department of the Strategic Support Force.

description.zh-cn: 2024年4月，丁兴农调任火箭军副政委。
description.en: In April 2024, Ding Xingnong was transferred to the position of Deputy Political Commissar of the Rocket Force.

description.zh-cn: 丁兴农是中国共产党第二十届中央委员会候补委员。
description.en: Ding Xingnong is an alternate member of the 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 批准成立中国人民解放军国防大学。
description.en: Approved the establishment of the PLA National Defense University.

description.zh-cn: 1969年，解放军后勤学院与高等军事学院、军事学院、政治学院四校合并，组建中国人民解放军军事政治大学。1986年1月15日，后勤学院又与军事学院、政治学院合并，成立中国人民解放军国防大学。
description.en: In 1969, the PLA Logistics Academy merged with the Higher Military Academy, Military Academy, and Political Academy to form the PLA Military and Political University. On January 15, 1986, the Logistics Academy further merged with the Military Academy and the Political Academy to establish the PLA National Defense University.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军国防大学是中央军委副战区级直属单位。
description.en: The PLA National Defense University is a deputy theater-grade unit directly under the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 向林彪提出“团结紧张严肃活泼”八个字，后被抗大作为校风。
description.en: Proposed the eight-character motto 'Unity, Intensity, Seriousness, Liveliness' to Lin Biao, which was later adopted as the university's style.

description.zh-cn: 国防大学将毛泽东提出的“团结紧张严肃活泼”立为校训。
description.en: The National Defense University adopted 'Unity, Intensity, Seriousness, Liveliness', proposed by Mao Zedong, as its motto.

description.zh-cn: 在新调整组建的国防大学成立大会上向其授军旗、致训词。
description.en: Presented the military flag and delivered a speech at the founding ceremony of the newly restructured National Defense University.

description.zh-cn: 2017年7月，后勤学院等院校并入国防大学，参与调整组建新的国防大学。
description.en: In July 2017, the Logistics Academy and other institutions were merged into the National Defense University to participate in its restructuring.

description.zh-cn: 2017年7月，装备学院部分专业培训任务和相关机构并入国防大学，参与调整组建新的国防大学。
description.en: In July 2017, some professional training tasks and related institutions of the Equipment Academy were merged into the National Defense University to participate in its restructuring.

description.zh-cn: 以国民革命军第二军副党代表兼政治部主任身份参与北伐战争。
description.en: Participated in the Northern Expedition as the Deputy Party Representative and Director of the Political Department of the National Revolutionary Army's Second Army.

description.zh-cn: 参与长征。
description.en: Participated in the Long March.

description.zh-cn: 参与遵义会议。
description.en: Participated in the Zunyi Conference.

description.zh-cn: 在长征期间，反对张国焘的南下路线。
description.en: During the Long March, he opposed Zhang Guotao's southern route.

description.zh-cn: 在李富春的追悼会上致悼词。
description.en: Delivered the eulogy at Li Fuchun's memorial service.

description.zh-cn: 余秋里接替李富春担任中华人民共和国国家计划委员会主任。
description.en: Yu Qiuli succeeded Li Fuchun as Director of the State Planning Commission of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 杨彬是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Yang Bin is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 杨彬作为辽宁地区代表，于2018年2月24日当选为第十三届全国人民代表大会代表。
description.en: Representing the Liaoning region, Yang Bin was elected as a deputy to the 13th National People's Congress on February 24, 2018.

description.zh-cn: 卢沟桥事变后，上海附近的事态日益紧张，中国军队加强了淞沪地区的武装力量，为虹桥机场事件的爆发创造了条件。
description.en: After the Marco Polo Bridge Incident, the situation in Shanghai became increasingly tense, and the Chinese army strengthened its forces in the Shanghai-Wusong area, creating the conditions for the outbreak of the Hongqiao Airport Incident.

description.zh-cn: 1932年的一·二八事变后，中日双方签订了《淞沪停战协定》。
description.en: After the January 28 Incident in 1932, China and Japan signed the Shanghai Ceasefire Agreement.

description.zh-cn: 总团长吉章简在接到下级报告后，再向京沪警备司令张治中报告。
description.en: After receiving a report from his subordinate, Commander-in-Chief Ji Zhangjian then reported to Zhang Zhizhong, commander of the Jinghu Garrison.

description.zh-cn: 俞鸿钧时任上海市长。
description.en: Yu Hung-chun was the mayor of Shanghai at the time.

description.zh-cn: 在真理标准大讨论期间，以邓小平为首的“求是派”与以华国锋为首的“凡是派”展开了激烈的政治和思想交锋。
description.en: During the Truth Criterion Discussion, the "Pragmatist Faction" led by Deng Xiaoping engaged in intense political and ideological confrontation with the "Whatever Faction" led by Hua Guofeng.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平是“求是派”的领导者。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping was the leader of the "Pragmatist Faction".

description.zh-cn: 胡耀邦是“求是派”的代表人物之一。
description.en: Hu Yaobang was one of the representative figures of the "Pragmatist Faction".

description.zh-cn: 真理标准大讨论造就了一场全社会的思想解放运动，成为“新启蒙运动”的起点。
description.en: The Truth Criterion Discussion led to a society-wide ideological emancipation movement, becoming the starting point of the "New Enlightenment Movement".

description.zh-cn: 真理标准大讨论是“拨乱反正”运动的重要组成部分，并极大地推动了其进程。
description.en: The Truth Criterion Discussion was a crucial component of the "Boluan Fanzheng" movement and greatly advanced its progress.

description.zh-cn: 胡福明是《实践是检验真理的唯一标准》一文的撰写者。
description.en: Hu Fuming was the author of the article "Practice is the Sole Criterion for Testing Truth".

description.zh-cn: 中共元老叶剑英支持关于真理标准问题的讨论。
description.en: CCP elder Ye Jianying supported the discussion on the criterion of truth.

description.zh-cn: 中共元老李先念支持关于真理标准问题的讨论。
description.en: CCP elder Li Xiannian supported the discussion on the criterion of truth.

description.zh-cn: 中共元老陈云支持关于真理标准问题的讨论。
description.en: CCP elder Chen Yun supported the discussion on the criterion of truth.

description.zh-cn: 北京民间的“西单民主墙”运动支持“求是派”。
description.en: The civic "Xidan Democracy Wall" movement in Beijing supported the "Pragmatist Faction".

description.zh-cn: 在中共十一届三中全会上，“求是派”压倒“凡是派”，确立了其主导地位。
description.en: At the Third Plenary Session of the 11th CCP Central Committee, the "Pragmatist Faction" prevailed over the "Whatever Faction", establishing its dominant position.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平在理论务虚会上提出了“四项基本原则”。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping proposed the "Four Cardinal Principles" at the conference on theoretical work.

description.zh-cn: “四项基本原则”的提出，为当时的思想解放运动（新启蒙运动）和言论自由划定了不可逾越的界限（红线）。
description.en: The introduction of the "Four Cardinal Principles" set an insurmountable boundary (a red line) for the ideological emancipation movement (New Enlightenment Movement) and freedom of speech at the time.

description.zh-cn: 新启蒙运动为改革开放奠定了思想基础。
description.en: The New Enlightenment Movement laid the ideological foundation for the Reform and Opening-up.

description.zh-cn: 胡耀邦在中共十一届六中全会上接替华国锋，担任中共中央主席。
description.en: Hu Yaobang succeeded Hua Guofeng as Chairman of the CCP Central Committee at the Sixth Plenary Session of the 11th CCP Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平在中共十一届六中全会上接替华国锋，担任中共中央军委主席。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping succeeded Hua Guofeng as Chairman of the CCP Central Military Commission at the Sixth Plenary Session of the 11th CCP Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 赵紫阳于1980年9月接替华国锋担任国务院总理。
description.en: Zhao Ziyang succeeded Hua Guofeng as Premier of the State Council in September 1980.

description.zh-cn: 威廉·巴顿·罗杰斯创立了麻省理工学院，旨在建立一所专注于应用科学与工程的学府，以应对美国日益增长的工业化需求。
description.en: William Barton Rogers founded MIT with the vision of establishing an institution focused on applied science and engineering to address the increasing industrialization of the United States.

description.zh-cn: 美国内战的爆发使得麻省理工学院的教学工作延误，直到1865年才正式开班。
description.en: The outbreak of the American Civil War delayed MIT's academic activities, with classes not beginning until 1865.

description.zh-cn: 时任哈佛大学校长的查尔斯·艾略特曾六次提议将麻省理工学院并入哈佛大学，但均遭到麻省理工师生及校友的强烈反对，最终该提议被法院否决。
description.en: As president of Harvard University, Charles Eliot proposed merging MIT into Harvard six times, but faced strong opposition from MIT's faculty, students, and alumni. The proposal was ultimately blocked by the courts.

description.zh-cn: 伊士曼柯达公司创始人乔治·伊士曼以匿名方式向麻省理工学院捐赠了价值两千万美元的现金和股票，极大地支持了学校的发展和剑桥新校区的建设。
description.en: George Eastman, founder of Eastman Kodak, anonymously donated $20 million in cash and stock to MIT, significantly supporting the institute's growth and the construction of its new Cambridge campus.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战期间，麻省理工学院的军事科研活动大幅增加，成立了放射实验室等机构，致力于开发雷达和惯性导航系统等关键技术，这极大地促进了学校的发展。
description.en: During World War II, MIT's military research activities increased significantly. It established institutions like the Radiation Laboratory to develop key technologies such as radar and inertial navigation systems, which greatly spurred the university's growth.

description.zh-cn: 由于美国国内反战者抗议美方参与越战及麻省理工学院继续进行军事研究，学校最终将部分军事研究项目转移并退出了相关实验室的管理。
description.en: Due to protests by anti-war activists in the U.S. against American involvement in the Vietnam War and MIT's ongoing military research, the university eventually transferred some military research projects and divested from related laboratories.

description.zh-cn: 1994年，万维网发明者蒂姆·伯纳斯-李在麻省理工学院创立了万维网联盟（W3C），以制定网络标准。
description.en: In 1994, Tim Berners-Lee, the inventor of the World Wide Web, founded the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) at MIT to develop web standards.

description.zh-cn: 前联合国秘书长科菲·安南是麻省理工学院斯隆管理学院的校友。
description.en: Former UN Secretary-General Kofi Annan is an alumnus of the MIT Sloan School of Management.

description.zh-cn: 阿波罗11号登月舱驾驶员巴兹·奥尔德林拥有麻省理工学院的航空航天学博士学位。
description.en: Apollo 11 Lunar Module Pilot Buzz Aldrin holds a Sc.D. in astronautics from MIT.

description.zh-cn: 麻省理工学院校友罗伯特·诺伊斯联合创办了英特尔公司。
description.en: MIT alumnus Robert Noyce co-founded Intel Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 神经科学家苏珊·霍克菲尔德是麻省理工学院的第一位女校长。
description.en: Neuroscientist Susan Hockfield was the first female president of MIT.

description.zh-cn: 1985年12月，中华人民共和国广播电影电视部批准建立潮州电视台。
description.en: In December 1985, the Ministry of Radio, Film and Television of the People's Republic of China approved the establishment of Chaozhou Television Station.

description.zh-cn: 潮州广播电视台是南方广播影视传媒集团的下属单位。
description.en: Chaozhou Broadcast Television Station is a subordinate unit of Southern Radio, Film and Television Media Group.

description.zh-cn: 潮州广播电视台是潮州市人民政府的市级广播电视媒体。
description.en: Chaozhou Broadcast Television Station is a municipal-level radio and television media outlet of the Chaozhou Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 2011年6月21日，潮州广播电视台新闻综合频道和公共频道上线中国网络电视台，为其提供了网络播出平台，扩大了其影响力。
description.en: On June 21, 2011, Chaozhou Broadcast Television Station's news and public channels were launched on China Network Television, which provided an online broadcasting platform and expanded their influence.

description.zh-cn: 2013年起，潮州、汕头、揭阳三市实施电视互相落地措施，汕头有线电视用户可以接收潮州广播电视台的电视频道。
description.en: Since 2013, Chaozhou, Shantou, and Jieyang have implemented mutual television broadcasting access, allowing cable TV users in Shantou to receive channels from Chaozhou Broadcast Television Station.

description.zh-cn: 2013年起，潮州、汕头、揭阳三市实施电视互相落地措施，揭阳有线电视用户可以接收潮州广播电视台的电视频道。
description.en: Since 2013, Chaozhou, Shantou, and Jieyang have implemented mutual television broadcasting access, allowing cable TV users in Jieyang to receive channels from Chaozhou Broadcast Television Station.

description.zh-cn: 潮州广播电视台的广播频率转播中央人民广播电台的《全国新闻联播》节目。
description.en: The radio frequencies of Chaozhou Broadcast Television Station rebroadcast the "National News Hookup" program from China National Radio.

description.zh-cn: 2005年起，潮州广播电视台通过建设中继站、发射塔及转播设施，成功解决了饶平县部分地区难以收听到其节目的问题。
description.en: Starting in 2005, Chaozhou Broadcast Television Station successfully resolved signal reception issues in parts of Raoping County by building relay stations, transmission towers, and rebroadcasting facilities.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党第十九次全国代表大会选举产生了中国共产党第十九届中央委员会。
description.en: The 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China elected the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 担任中共十九届中央政治局常委。
description.en: Served as a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the 19th CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 担任中共十九届中央政治局常委。
description.en: Served as a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the 19th CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 担任中共十九届中央书记处书记。
description.en: Served as a secretary of the Secretariat of the 19th CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 担任中共十九届中央书记处书记。
description.en: Served as a secretary of the Secretariat of the 19th CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 担任中共十九届中央书记处书记。
description.en: Served as a secretary of the Secretariat of the 19th CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 担任中共十九届中央书记处书记。
description.en: Served as a secretary of the Secretariat of the 19th CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 担任中共十九届中央书记处书记。
description.en: Served as a secretary of the Secretariat of the 19th CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 担任中共十九届中央书记处书记。
description.en: Served as a secretary of the Secretariat of the 19th CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 担任中共十九届中央书记处书记。
description.en: Served as a secretary of the Secretariat of the 19th CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 选举产生了中国共产党第十九届中央政治局委员及常务委员会委员。
description.en: Elected the members and Standing Committee members of the Political Bureau of the 19th CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 审议通过了《中共中央关于修改宪法部分内容的建议》，提议将习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想和国家监察委员会写入宪法。
description.en: Reviewed and adopted the 'Proposals of the CPC Central Committee on Amending Parts of the Constitution', proposing to write Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era and the National Supervisory Commission into the Constitution.

description.zh-cn: 在中共十九届二中全会上就《中共中央关于修改宪法部分内容的建议（草案）》向全会作了说明。
description.en: Explained the 'Draft Proposals of the CPC Central Committee on Amending Parts of the Constitution' to the plenum at the Second Plenary Session of the 19th CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 审议通过了《中共中央关于深化党和国家机构改革的决定》和《深化党和国家机构改革方案》，全面启动了该项改革。
description.en: Reviewed and adopted the 'Decision of the CPC Central Committee on Deepening the Reform of Party and State Institutions' and the 'Plan for Deepening the Reform of Party and State Institutions', officially launching the reform.

description.zh-cn: 决定递补中央候补委员马正武为中央委员。
description.en: Decided to elevate Ma Zhengwu, an alternate member of the Central Committee, to a full member.

description.zh-cn: 决定递补中央候补委员马伟明为中央委员。
description.en: Decided to elevate Ma Weiming, an alternate member of the Central Committee, to a full member.

description.zh-cn: 追认中央政治局作出的给予刘士余留党察看二年的决定。
description.en: Confirmed the decision made by the Political Bureau to place Liu Shiyu on probation within the Party for two years.

description.zh-cn: 审议通过了《中共中央关于党的百年奋斗重大成就和历史经验的决议》。
description.en: Reviewed and adopted the 'Resolution of the CPC Central Committee on the Major Achievements and Historical Experience of the Party over the Past Century'.

description.zh-cn: 决定中国共产党第二十次全国代表大会于2022年10月16日在北京召开。
description.en: Decided that the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China would be convened in Beijing on October 16, 2022.

description.zh-cn: 作为中共中央的工作机关，隶属于中国共产党第十九届中央委员会。
description.en: As a working body of the CPC Central Committee, it was subordinate to the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 作为中共中央的职能部门，隶属于中国共产党第十九届中央委员会。
description.en: As a functional department of the CPC Central Committee, it was subordinate to the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 作为中共中央的职能部门，隶属于中国共产党第十九届中央委员会。
description.en: As a functional department of the CPC Central Committee, it was subordinate to the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 在中共十九届期间担任中央组织部部长。
description.en: Served as Head of the Organization Department of the Central Committee during the 19th CPC term.

description.zh-cn: 在中共十九届期间担任中央党校校长。
description.en: Served as President of the Central Party School during the 19th CPC term.

description.zh-cn: 在中共十九届期间担任中央政法委书记。
description.en: Served as Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission during the 19th CPC term.

description.zh-cn: 在中共十九届期间担任中央宣传部部长。
description.en: Served as Head of the Propaganda Department of the Central Committee during the 19th CPC term.

description.zh-cn: 在中共十九届期间担任中央统战部部长。
description.en: Served as Head of the United Front Work Department of the Central Committee during the 19th CPC term.

description.zh-cn: 张文勋是云南洱源人。
description.en: Zhang Wenxun is from Eryuan, Yunnan.

position.en: Student of the Department of Literature and History

description.zh-cn: 1948年考入云南大学文史系，1953年毕业于云南大学中文系。
description.en: Enrolled in the Department of Literature and History at Yunnan University in 1948 and graduated from the Department of Chinese in 1953.

description.zh-cn: 1954年，张文勋被送到北京大学中文系文艺理论进修斑学习两年，此段非学历性质的学习经历对其学术生涯产生了影响。
description.en: In 1954, Zhang Wenxun was sent to a two-year advanced study class on literary theory at the Department of Chinese, Peking University. This non-degree study experience influenced his academic career.

description.zh-cn: 1956年从北京大学进修结业后，回云南大学任教。
description.en: After completing his advanced studies at Peking University in 1956, he returned to Yunnan University to teach.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类信息，张文勋是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to page category information, Zhang Wenxun is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类信息，张文勋是中国作家协会会员。
description.en: According to page category information, Zhang Wenxun is a member of the Chinese Writers Association.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类信息，张文勋是中华诗词学会顾问。
description.en: According to page category information, Zhang Wenxun is a consultant for the China Poetry Society.

description.zh-cn: 管仲的改革被一些学者视为法家的起源。
description.en: The reforms of Guan Zhong are considered by some scholars to be the origin of Legalism.

description.zh-cn: 商鞅是法家学派的代表人物，大力发展了法家思想。
description.en: Shang Yang was a representative figure of the Legalist school and significantly developed Legalist thought.

description.zh-cn: 韩非汇集各家学说，成为法家思想的集大成者。
description.en: Han Fei synthesized various doctrines, becoming the great synthesizer of Legalist thought.

description.zh-cn: 商鞅在秦国执政期间推行了全面的变法改革。
description.en: Shang Yang implemented comprehensive reforms during his administration in the State of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 商鞅变法使秦国崛起，成为战国时期的大国，为其统一六国奠定了基础。
description.en: Shang Yang's reforms led to the rise of Qin, making it a major power during the Warring States period and laying the foundation for its unification of the six states.

description.zh-cn: 管仲辅佐齐桓公进行改革，帮助齐国称霸。
description.en: Guan Zhong assisted Duke Huan of Qi with reforms, helping the state of Qi achieve hegemony.

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇读了《韩非子》后极为赞赏，一心想要见韩非，促使其入秦。
description.en: After reading the 'Han Feizi', Qin Shi Huang greatly admired it and was eager to meet Han Fei, which led to Han Fei's journey to Qin.

description.zh-cn: 根据钱穆的观点，法家是从儒家发展而来的，许多早期法家人物由儒家培养。
description.en: According to Qian Mu, Legalism developed from Confucianism, as many early Legalist figures were educated by Confucians.

description.zh-cn: 钱穆认为，就儒家的本旨而言，法家毋宁算是儒家的正宗。
description.en: Qian Mu argued that in terms of the original purpose of Confucianism, Legalism should be considered its orthodox successor.

description.zh-cn: 子夏是孔子的弟子，位列孔门十哲。
description.en: Zixia was a disciple of Confucius, ranked among the Ten Wise Ones of the Confucian School.

description.zh-cn: 法家代表人物李悝是子夏的学生。
description.en: The Legalist representative Li Kui was a student of Zixia.

description.zh-cn: 法家代表人物吴起曾师从子夏。
description.en: The Legalist representative Wu Qi once studied under Zixia.

description.zh-cn: 受五四运动的影响，柯仲平在昆明与同学组织了“爱国联合会”和研究社会主义的“共同社”团体。
description.en: Influenced by the May Fourth Movement, Ke Zhongping organized the 'Patriotic Federation' and the 'Common Society' for studying socialism with his classmates in Kunming.

description.zh-cn: 1925年至1926年初，柯仲平常常拿着自己的诗作拜访鲁迅。
description.en: From 1925 to early 1926, Ke Zhongping often visited Lu Xun with his poems.

description.zh-cn: 经郁达夫介绍，柯仲平于1926年春到达上海，在创造社出版部工作。
description.en: Recommended by Yu Dafu, Ke Zhongping arrived in Shanghai in the spring of 1926 and worked in the publishing department of the Creation Society.

description.zh-cn: 与陈为人一同介绍柯仲平加入中国共产党。
description.en: Introduced Ke Zhongping to join the Communist Party of China along with Chen Weiren.

description.zh-cn: 与潘汉年一同介绍柯仲平加入中国共产党。
description.en: Introduced Ke Zhongping to join the Communist Party of China along with Pan Hannian.

description.zh-cn: 七七事变后，柯仲平在董必武的安排下辗转到了延安。
description.en: After the Marco Polo Bridge Incident, Ke Zhongping traveled to Yan'an under the arrangement of Dong Biwu.

description.zh-cn: 安排柯仲平前往延安。
description.en: Arranged for Ke Zhongping to go to Yan'an.

description.zh-cn: 第一届、第二届全国人大代表。
description.en: Delegate to the First and Second National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 为柯仲平举行悼念会并予以平反。
description.en: Held a memorial service for Ke Zhongping and posthumously rehabilitated him.

description.zh-cn: 曾泽生出生于清朝时期的云南省永善县。
description.en: Zeng Zesheng was born in Yongshan County, Yunnan Province, during the Qing Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 曾泽生因在建国军军士队受训期间成绩优秀，被送入云南陆军讲武堂学习。
description.en: Due to his excellent performance during training at the National Construction Army's NCO team, Zeng Zesheng was sent to study at the Yunnan Military Academy.

description.zh-cn: 1925年任黄埔军校区队长。
description.en: In 1925, he served as a district commander at the Whampoa Military Academy.

description.zh-cn: 1926年入黄埔军校高级班学习。
description.en: In 1926, he entered the senior class of the Whampoa Military Academy for study.

position.en: Battalion Commander of the 6th Regiment, 3rd Brigade

description.zh-cn: 1931年2月，曾泽生在滇军第三旅第六团担任营长。
description.en: In February 1931, Zeng Zesheng served as a battalion commander in the 6th Regiment, 3rd Brigade of the Yunnan Army.

description.zh-cn: 曾泽生因在台儿庄战役中战功卓著，升任师长。
description.en: Due to his outstanding military achievements in the Battle of Taierzhuang, Zeng Zesheng was promoted to division commander.

description.zh-cn: 曾泽生于1945年升任国民革命军第六十军军长。1949年1月2日，国民革命军第六十军被改编为中国人民解放军第五十军，曾泽生继续担任军长一职，直至1969年因病离职。
description.en: In 1945, Zeng Zesheng was promoted to commander of the 60th Corps of the National Revolutionary Army. On January 2, 1949, the 60th Corps was reorganized into the PLA 50th Corps, and Zeng Zesheng continued to serve as its commander until he stepped down due to illness in 1969.

description.zh-cn: 在1948年长春围困战中，曾泽生率领国民革命军第六十军起义。
description.en: During the Siege of Changchun in 1948, Zeng Zesheng led the 60th Corps of the National Revolutionary Army to defect.

description.zh-cn: 徐文烈于1949年1月2日被任命为中国人民解放军第五十军的政治部主任。
description.en: Xu Wenlie was appointed Director of the Political Department of the PLA 50th Corps on January 2, 1949.

description.zh-cn: 曾泽生率领中国人民解放军第五十军参加了抗美援朝战争的第一至第四次战役。
description.en: Zeng Zesheng led the 50th Corps of the People's Liberation Army to participate in the First through Fourth Phase Offensives of the Korean War.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立后，曾泽生担任中南军政委员会委员。
description.en: After the founding of the People's Republic of China, Zeng Zesheng served as a member of the Central and Southern Military and Administrative Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立后，曾泽生担任政治协商会议全国委员会委员。
description.en: After the founding of the People's Republic of China, Zeng Zesheng served as a member of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 1954年，曾泽生当选为中华人民共和国国防委员会委员。
description.en: In 1954, Zeng Zesheng was elected as a member of the National Defence Commission of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1954年，曾泽生当选为第一届全国人民代表大会代表。
description.en: In 1954, Zeng Zesheng was elected as a delegate to the 1st National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 1955年，中国人民解放军授予曾泽生中将军衔及一级解放勋章。
description.en: In 1955, the People's Liberation Army awarded Zeng Zesheng the rank of Lieutenant General and the First Class Order of Liberation.

description.zh-cn: 1953年，朝鲜民主主义人民共和国授予曾泽生一级国旗勋章。
description.en: In 1953, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea awarded Zeng Zesheng the First Class Order of the National Flag.

description.zh-cn: 曾泽生曾是中国国民党党员。
description.en: Zeng Zesheng was a member of the Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 曾泽生在1948年率部起义前，效忠于中华民国。
description.en: Before leading his troops to defect in 1948, Zeng Zesheng was loyal to the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 自1949年起，曾泽生为中华人民共和国效力，直至1973年去世。
description.en: From 1949, Zeng Zesheng served the People's Republic of China until his death in 1973.
